pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO y taotao, ni ti mamomocat gui pinagat y manaelaye, ni y ti sumasaga gui chalan manisao, ni y ti matatachong gui siyan ayo sija y manmanmofefea.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand in the way of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guiya lay Jeova, ayo y minagofña, ya y layña jajaso, jaane yan puenge.
pairs.english: but his delight is in Yahweh's law. On his law he meditates day and night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüijeja y trongcon jayo ni y matanme gui oriyan sadog, ya guaja tinegchaña gui tiempoña, ya y jagonña ti umalayo; ya todo y finatinasña mumemegae.
pairs.english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ti taegüine y manaelaye; lao parejo yan y paja ni y güinaefe ni y manglo.
pairs.english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa enao na ti mangajujulo y manaelaye gui sentensia; ni y manisao gui y inetnon manunas.
pairs.english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jatungo y chalan manunas: lao y chalan manaelaye ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SA jafa na manlalalo y nasion sija, ya y taotao sija manmanjaso y banida?
pairs.english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manotojgue y ray sija gui tano, ya y prinsipe sija manafaesen entalo sija contra si Jeova, yan contra y pinalaeña, ilegñija:
pairs.english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nita yulang y guinideña, ya nasuja guiya jita y godeña.
pairs.english: "Let's break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sumasaga gui langet uchumachaleg: ya y Señot jamofefea sija.
pairs.english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cumuentos yan sija yan y linalaloña: ya y binibuña ninafañatsaga sija.
pairs.english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo japolo y rayjo gui jilo Sion, gui santos na egsojo.
pairs.english: "Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jusangan y tinagojo: si Jeova ilegña nu guajo: Lajijo jao; ya guajo julilis jao pago na jaane.
pairs.english: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, "You are my son. Today I have become your father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gagaoyo ya guajo junaejao ni y nasion sija pot y erensiamo ya y uttimon patte y tano, uiyomo.
pairs.english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unyulang sija ni y baran lulog; taegüije y bason y yero unyogyog sija.
pairs.english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, tingo, O ray sija: resibe finanagüe, jamyo man jues gui tano.
pairs.english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Setbe si Jeova ni y minaañao, yan fanmagof ni minayengyong.
pairs.english: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chico y laje, no sea ulalálalo, ya unfanmalingo jamyo gui chalan, sa gusisija y linalaloña sinenggue. Mandichoso todos y umangoco sija guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Give sincere homage to the Son , lest he be angry, and you perish in the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jafa muna manlajyan y enimigujo! Megae mangajulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. > > Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae umaalog ni y antijo: Taya inayuda para güiya, gui as Yuus. Sila.
pairs.english: Many there are who say of my soul, "There is no help for him in God ." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, jago y patang gui oriyajo; y minalagjo yan ayo ni y janacajulo y ilujo.
pairs.english: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagangjo juagang si Jeova, ya güiyaja umopeyo gui santos na ogsoña. Sila.
pairs.english: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juason ya maegoyo; ya magmatayo; sa si Jeova gumuguutyo.
pairs.english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti maañaoyo nu y dies mit na taotao, ni y mapolo sija gui oriyajo contra guajo.
pairs.english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova; nalibre yo, O Yuusso: sa jago manalamen todo y enimigujo ni y guijadas; y nifen y manaelaye unyamag.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Jeova nae gaegue y satbasion: ya y taotaomo nae gaegue y bendisonmo. Sila.
pairs.english: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. Your blessing be on your people. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE juagangjao, opeyo, O Yuus y tininasso: anae chatsagayo jago munadangculoyo: maase nu guajo ya jungog y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. > > Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo, famaguon taotao, asta ñgaean nae innanalo y onraco gui minamajlao? Asta ñgaean yanmiyo y banida ya inaliligao y dinague? Sila.
pairs.english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tingoja, na si Jeova japolo apatte y deboto para güiya namaesa: si Jeova jajungog yo, anae juagang güe.
pairs.english: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fangalamten ya chatmiyo faniisao: fanmanjaso nu y corasonmiyo gui jilo camanmiyo, ya famacaca. Sila.
pairs.english: Stand in awe, and don't sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae y tunas na inefresen ya angoco si Jeova.
pairs.english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae umaalog: Jaye ufanuejit jafa minauleg? Jatsa gui jilonmame, O Jeova, y minalag y matamo.
pairs.english: Many say, "Who will show us any good?" Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago numae minagof y corasonjo, megaeña qui uguaja sija anae umemegae y maeisñija yan y binoñija.
pairs.english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pas nae umason yo ya taegüijeja maegoyo: sa jagoja Jeova, unnasagayo seguro.
pairs.english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG, O Jeova, y sinanganjo, ecungog y jinasoco.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. > > Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ecungog y vos y inagangjo, Ray jo, yan Yuusso: sa jago jutaetaetaye.
pairs.english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to you do I pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, y egaan unjungog y vosso; y egaan juguaguato y tinaetaejo guiya jago, ya jubébela.
pairs.english: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jago na Yuus ni y gumaeya y tinaelaye: y taelaye ti usaga guiya jago.
pairs.english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can't live with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti manasaga y mangaduco gui menan matamo: ya ti yamo todo y fumatitinas y taelaye.
pairs.english: The arrogant shall not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumulang y manguecuentos mandague: ya y taotao cajâgâ yan y dinague, si Jeova jaguefchatlie.
pairs.english: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajoja, yan y megagae y minaasemo, bae jalom gui guimamo: ya juadora anae juatan y santo templomo ni y ninamaañaomo.
pairs.english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, esgaejonyo gui tininasmo, pot causa ya enimigujo; natunas gui menajo y chalanmo.
pairs.english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya finitme gui pachotñija; ya sanjalomñija senmanaelaye: naftan mababa y agagañija; yan y jilañija finande:
pairs.english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Condena sija, O Yuus, polo y ufamodong pot y pinagatñija: gui minegae y isaoñija nasuja sija sa managuaguat contra jago.
pairs.english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmagof todos y umangngocojao, polo para taejinecog ya ufanagang pot y minagofñija sa undefiende sija, polo ya ufanmagof ni jago, y gumaeya y naanmo.
pairs.english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice, Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago bumendise y manunas; O Jeova, parejoja yan un patang unpolo gui oriyaña y finaborese.
pairs.english: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA chamoyo lumalalatde ni y binibumo: chamoyo cumastitiga nu y dangculo na linalalomo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh, don't rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova, sa estagüe yo namasogsog: amte yo, O Jeova, sa y tolangjo esta mananatchatsaga.
pairs.english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y antijo esta senchatsaga: Ya jago, O Jeova, asta ngaean?
pairs.english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh--how long?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nanalo, O Jeova, nalibre y antijo: satbayo pot causa y minaasemo.
pairs.english: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finatae nae taya jinaso guiya jago: ya y naftan nae jaye numannae jao grasias?
pairs.english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol , who shall give you thanks?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yayasyo nu y todo y siningonjo: todo y puenge junamamaya y camajo ni lagojo: junafotgon y catreco nu y lagojo.
pairs.english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo esta magasta nu y pinite: ninafanbijo pot todo ayo y munachachatsaga yo.
pairs.english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjanao guiya guajo todo ayo y fumatitinas y taelaye: sa si Jeova jajungog y vos y casaojo.
pairs.english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jajungog y guinagaojo: si Jeova uresibe y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmamajlao ya ninafañatsaga megae, todo y enimigujo: sija manalo, sija manmamajlao gusise.
pairs.english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, yya jago nae gaegue y inangococo: Satbayo todo gui pumetsisigue yo, ya nalibre yo.
pairs.english: < < A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. > > Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para chaña pumedasitos y antijo taegüije y leon, ni jayulang, anae taya jaye uninalibre.
pairs.english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, yaguin jufatinas este: yaguin guaja gui canaejo taelaye;
pairs.english: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan juapase taelaye y sumaga guiya guajo yan pas, (magajet na junalibre y pumetsisigue yo pot taya causa:)
pairs.english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japetsisigue y enimigujo y antijo, ya jachule; magajet, na jagacha gui tano y jaanijo: ya y onraco japolo gui eda. Sila.
pairs.english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, yan y linalalomo; jatsa namaesa contra y binibon y munachachatsagayo: ya magmata pot guajo untago y sentensia.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inetnon taotao unineriyaye jao: ya gui san jiloñija natalo jao guato gui san jilo.
pairs.english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jajusga y taotao: jusgayo, O Jeova, taemanoja y tininasso: taemanoja y minaulegmo ni y gaegue guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ujocog y taelayen manaelaye, lao nafitme y manunas: sa si Yuus, ni tinas, jachachague y corason yan y jinaso gui sanjalom.
pairs.english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y patangjo gaegue gui as Yuus, güiya munalibre y manunas gui corason.
pairs.english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus y tinas na jues: magajet na si Yuus lalalalo todo na jaane.
pairs.english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y taotao ti jabira güe, güiya janamalagtos y espadaña: janaregla y atcosña ya janalisto.
pairs.english: If a man doesn't relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas para güiya y atmas y finatae: janafañila y flechaña.
pairs.english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na uguaja piniten mañago tinaelaye: magajet na mapotgue y inacacha ya mañago dinague.
pairs.english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaguadog y tipo, ya janatadong: ya esta podong gui joyo na y finatinasñaja.
pairs.english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inacachaña ubira güi jilo y iluña: ya y binibuña upodong gui jilo cácagongña.
pairs.english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junae si Jeova gracias taemanoja y tininasña: ya jucantaye ni y tinina y naan Jeova Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Señotmame, jafa muna mauleg y naanmo gui todo y tano: ni y unpolo y minalagmo gui jilo y langet.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth, who has set your glory above the heavens!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin pachot y mandiquique yan y mañususo nae unpolo y minetgot? Pot y enimigumo sija: sa para unnasuja y enimigo yan y umeemog.
pairs.english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae julie y langetmo, ni y checho y calolotmo, y pilan yan y pution, ni jago pumolo;
pairs.english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y taotao, para uguaja guiya güiya jinaso? yan lajin taotao para ubinesita güe.
pairs.english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unfatinas didide diquiqueña qui y angjeles, ya uncorona güe ni y minalag yan inenra.
pairs.english: For you have made him a little lower than God, and crowned him with glory and honor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmagas todo ni checho y canaemo: todo unpolo gui papa y adengña.
pairs.english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y quinilo yan y nobiyo todo ayo: taegüenaoja y gâgâ ni gaegue gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pajaro gui langet, yan y güijan gui tase: ya jafaja ni manmalolofan gui chalan y tase.
pairs.english: The birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Señotmame: jafa muna mauleg y naanmo gui todo y tano.
pairs.english: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE junae grasias si Jeova contodo y corasonjo: bae jufanue todo ni ninamanman na chechomo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. Set to "The Death of the Son." A Psalm by David. > > I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jumagof, ya unnasenmagofyo guiya jago: jucantaye ni y tinina y naanmo O jago Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y enimiguja unnabira sija tate: manbasnag, ya manmalingo gui menamo.
pairs.english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago fumatinas y jinasoco yan y causaco: unfatachong gui trono, ya unjusga y tinas.
pairs.english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unlalatde y nasion sija, guinin unyulang y manaelaye, guinin unfunas y naanñija para siempre taejinecog.
pairs.english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta malachae y enimigo; esta mayulang para siempre: yan y siuda ni y inyilang, y jinasoñija manachamalingo yan sija.
pairs.english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova sumaga calang ray para siempre, ya janalisto y tronuña para usentensia.
pairs.english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jumusga y tano ni tininas, ujajusga y taotao sija yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova locue y taquilo na tore para y manmachiguit, y taquilo na tore gui tiempon chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaangoco sija guiya jago y tumungo y naanmo; sa jago, Jeova, ti unyute ayo y umaliligao jao.
pairs.english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova ni y tinina ni sumasaga gui Sion: namatungo gui entalo taotao sija y checoña.
pairs.english: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa anae jacocobla y jâgâ jajaso sija: ya ti malefa ni inagang y mamoble.
pairs.english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn't forget the cry of the afflicted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova; atan y pinitejo ni jususungonja y chumatlie yo, jago y munacajulo yo gui pettan finatae:
pairs.english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jufamanue todo ni y tininamo gui trangcan y jagan Sion: ya umagof yo gui satbasionmo.
pairs.english: that I may show forth all your praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmafondo y nasion gui joyo ni y finatinasñija: ya y casiyas nae ni janaaatog, y patasñija esta mangodon.
pairs.english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova janamatungo güe ni y sentensia ni jafatinas; ya jalaso y taelaye ni y checho y canaena: Jinaso. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmanalo guato y manaelaye gui sasalaguan: yan todo y taotao ni manmalefa as Yuus.
pairs.english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol , even all the nations that forget God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti para siempre umamalefanñaejon y nesesitao: ni y ninanggan y mamoble ufanmalingo para siempre.
pairs.english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova: chamo munamametgot y taotao: ya ufanmajusga y nasion gui menamo.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh! Don't let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo, O Jeova, y minaañao guiya sija: polo ya utungo y nasion na sija taotaoja.
pairs.english: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAFA na tumojgue jao na chago, O Jeova? jafa na umatogjao gui tiempon chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot sobetbia y taelaye na japetsisigue y pebble; ufanmachule gui finababa y manmajajaso.
pairs.english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa enao mina jatunanmaesagüe y taelaye, ni y minalago y antiña: ya y manlagga jarechasa; junggan, jadespresia si Jeova.
pairs.english: For the wicked boasts of his heart's cravings. He blesses the greedy, and condemns Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jasangan: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanña chatsaga todo y tiempo; y juisiomo goschago gui linieña: ya todo y enimiguña, güiya jaguaefe sija.
pairs.english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is haughty, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña gui corasonña: Ti jucalamten: gui todo y generasion sija, ti jufalag y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: He says in his heart, "I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y matdision bula y pachotña yan dinague yan chiniguit: y papa y jilaña inacacha yan tinaelaye.
pairs.english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaegue matatachong y lugat ti matungo gui sengsong: ya y umatog na lugat japupuno y taeisao: y atadogña manaatanja contra y pebble.
pairs.english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jananangga gui lugat ti matungo, taegüije y leon gui liyangña: jananangga para ucone y pebble: jacone y pebble anae jayotte ni y lasoña.
pairs.english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he draws him in his net.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jacojajatgüe, janatunog, megae na manaeninasiña mamodong gui gaesisiña na iyoña.
pairs.english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña gui corasonña: Si Yuus esta malefa: janaatog y mataña; taya nae jalie.
pairs.english: He says in his heart, "God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova; O Yuus, jatsa y canaemo: chamo malelefa ni y mamoble.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don't forget the helpless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa jadespresia y taelaye si Yuus; ya ilegña gui corasonño: Jago ti ugagao.
pairs.english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, "God won't call me into account?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago lumie: sa jago umatan y inacacha yan y minattrata, para uchule gui canaemo: yya jago nae mandaña y mamoble: y manaesaena, jago umayuyuda.
pairs.english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yulang y canae y manaelaye: ya ayo y taelaye, aliligao jao y tinailayeña asta qui ti unsoda.
pairs.english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova Ray na para taejinecog yan taejinecog: ya y nasion esta manmalachae gui tanoña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minalago y manumitde jago jumungog, O Jeova: jago dumespopone y corasonñija, ungueguesecungog ni y talangamo:
pairs.english: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unjusga y manaesaena yan y mamoble: para chamo tumatalo munamaañao y taotao gui tano.
pairs.english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AS Jeova nae juangocoyo: jafa na ilegmo ni antijo: Gupo gui egsomo calang pajaro?
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By David. > > In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, y manaelaye na jaaregla y atcos: jafamauleg y flecha gui taliña para uflecha gui jinemjom y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y plinanta sija esta mayulang: jafa siña y manunas ujafatinas.
pairs.english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova gaegue gui santos na temploña; si Jeova, y tronuña gaegue gui langet; y atadogña manlilie yan y babaliña jachachague y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jachachague y manunas: lao y manaelaye, ya y gumaeya mandague, y antiña chumatlie.
pairs.english: Yahweh examines the righteous, but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uuchan y casiyas gui jilo y manaelaye: guafe yan asufre ya y manglo na mañila y patteña gui basuña.
pairs.english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinas Jeova; yaña y tinas: ya jaatan y manunas y mataña.
pairs.english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYUDA, O Jeova, sa jocog mandeboto: sa jocog y manmauleg gui entalo y famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. > > Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masasangang taebale cada uno gui tiguangña: yan labios na jaande, yan doble na corason jasasangan.
pairs.english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uutut todo y labios na jaande, yan y jila ni cumuecuentos mandangculo:
pairs.english: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na ujaalog: Pot y jilata na utagana; y labiosta iyota: jaye siña señot gui jilota?
pairs.english: who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y chiniguit y mamoble y an y inigong y mannesesitao: pago bae cajulo, ilegña si Jeova: guajo jupolo güi na seguro, ni y jaguaefeye.
pairs.english: "Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says Yahweh; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finijo Jeova, gasgas na finijo: calang salape na managasgas gui jotno gui jilo y tano: managasgas siete biaje.
pairs.english: The words of Yahweh are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Jeova, ni umadadaje sija, jago umantiene para taejinecog, guine este na generasion.
pairs.english: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jijot gui oriya manjajanao y manaelaye: anae esta nacajulo y tinaelaye gui entalo y famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ASTA ngaean, O Jeova, nae, umalefa jao guajo para taejinecog? asta ngaean nae unnaatog y matamo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean nae jujaso y pinagat gui antijo, anae guaja pinite gui corasonjo todo y jaane? Asta ngaean nae ufangajulo y enimigujo guiya guajo?
pairs.english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso ya jungogyo, O Jeova, Yuusso: ina y atadogjo sija para mungayo maego gui maego finatae.
pairs.english: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa chaña umaalog y enimigujo: Jugana güe: sa chaña y enimigujo fanmamagof yaguin calamtenyo.
pairs.english: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him"; Lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, y minaasemo nae juangocoyo: ya umagof y corasonjo gui satbasionmo.
pairs.english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae cantaye si Jeova: sa jafatinas y mauleg guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YLEGÑA y taetiningo gui corasonña: Taya Yuus: sija manpotlilo, jafatinas y chatliion na chocho: taya ni uno ni y fumatitinas y mauleg.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By David. > > The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt. They have done abominable works. There is none who does good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaaatan desde y langet y jilo y famaguon taotao, para ulie cao guaja uno malate, yan jaaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todos manlache; manjuyong potlilo todo; taya jaye fumatitinas y mauleg, taya ni uno.
pairs.english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is none who does good, no, not one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti jatungo todo y fumatitinas y taelaye? ni y jacacano y taotaojo, taegüije y chumochocho pan? ya si Jeova ti jaaagang.
pairs.english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don't call on Yahweh?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manlaolao ni minaañao: sa si Yuus gaegue gui rasan y manunas.
pairs.english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pinagat y pebble innamamajlao, sa si Jeova guinegüeña.
pairs.english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malago, y satbasion Israel mato guinin Sion! Anae jatalo si Jeova quinautiba y taotaoña, ayo nae magof si Jacob yan magof Israel.
pairs.english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jaye usaga gue tabernaculumo? jaye usaga gui santos na ogsomo.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumanao gui minauleg, ya y fumatitinas y tininas, yan y cumuecuentos magajet gui jalom corasonña.
pairs.english: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti fafajiyunge ni jilaña, ni ti jafatitinas taelaye gui amiguña, ni usigue sumangan y minamajlao contra y tiguangña.
pairs.english: He who doesn't slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui atadogña ninadespresiao ni y taotao áplacha, lao y maañao as Jeova jaonra: y manjula para dañoña namaesa ya ti jatolaeca.
pairs.english: In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn't change;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y salapeña ti mannanae para ufangana, ni uchule y apas contra y taeisao: ya y fumatinas estesija ti siña cumalamten.
pairs.english: he who doesn't lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ADAJE yo, O Yuus: sa iya jago nae gaegue y inangococo.
pairs.english: < < A Poem by David. > > Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegmo, O antijo, as Jeova: jago Señotto: taya minaulegco yaguin taegüe guiya jago.
pairs.english: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, "You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañantos ni mangaegue gui tano, sija manmagas ya todo y minalagojo gaegue guiya sija.
pairs.english: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mumegae y piniteñija ni tumolaeca si Jeova pot otro Yuus: ti juofrese ni y inefreseñija na jâgâ, ni juchule y naanñija gui labiosso.
pairs.english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y patten ni y ineredajo, yan y basujo: jago mumantietiene y fottunajo.
pairs.english: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, y fottunajo upodong gui lugat na magof: magajet na bonito na ineredajo.
pairs.english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jubendise si Jeova, ni y japagat yo: ya an puenge nae jafananagüe yo y jinasoco gui san jalomjo.
pairs.english: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jupolo gui menajo para siempre: sa yaguin gaegue güe gui agapajo, ti siña yo manacalamten.
pairs.english: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina magof y corasonjo ya magof y inenrajo: locue y catneco sumaga seguro.
pairs.english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti undingo y antijo gui naftan: ni unnae y santosmo para ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol , neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnatungoyo ni y chalan y linâlâ: binilan minagof y gaegue gui menamo: ya y agapa na canaemo guaja minagof para siempre.
pairs.english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG, O Jeova, y taotao tunas: atituye y casaojo; guefecungog y tinaetaejo, na ti jumajanao gui labios dinagüe.
pairs.english: < < A Prayer by David. > > Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn't go out of deceitful lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y menamo nae ya ujuyong y sentensiajo: lie ni y atadogmo y tininas.
pairs.english: Let my sentence come forth from your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago guinin chumague y corasonjo; guinin unbisitayo gui puenge; guinin unchagueyo ya taya sinedamo: y jinasoco na ti manisagüe y pachotto.
pairs.english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para y finatinas y taotao, pot y finijo ni guinin y labiosmo, jumantiene yo gui san juyong y chalan ni y manyuyulang.
pairs.english: As for the works of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinecatto guiniut gui chalanmo, ya y adengjo ti susulong.
pairs.english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja juagang jao, sa jago unope yo, O Yuus: naegueng guiya guajo y talangamo, ya jungog y sinanganjo.
pairs.english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanue ni y minaasemo ni namanman, jago na unnalibre y umangoco sija guiya jago, guinin y ayosija ni mangajulo contra y agapa na canaemo.
pairs.english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje yo, taegüije y atilong y niñon mata, naatog yo gui papa y anineng papamo,
pairs.english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y menan y manaelaye ni y jumojoño yo: y gostaelaye y enimigujo ni majijujute yo.
pairs.english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmaafuyot ni y linedoñija: ya y pachotñija cumuecuentos sobetbio.
pairs.english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinecatmame nae maoriyayejam pago: japolo y atadogñija para ujayutejam gui tano.
pairs.english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y león ni y gosmalago ni y naña: ya y león diquique ni y gaegue gui saga na umaalog.
pairs.english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, polo jao gui menaña, yute papa: libre y antijo gui manaelaye nu y espadamo.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui taotao sija nu y canaemo, O Jeova, gui taotao ni y iyon tano, ayo na güinajaña gaegue gui estisija na jaane: ayo y tiyanña unabula nu y tesorumo: sija manjaspog y famaguon, ya polo y sebla y güinaja gui mandiquique na patgonñija.
pairs.english: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo, yan y tininas julie y matamo: najong yo anae magmata yo gui pinarejumo.
pairs.english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUGUAEYAJAO, O Jeova, y minetgotto.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, > > I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y achojo, y castiyujo, yan y nanalibrijo: Yuusso, metgot y achojo, juangoco yo guiya güiya; patangjo yan y cánggilon y satbasionjo, y leca na torijo.
pairs.english: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juagang si Jeova, ni combiene na mannae todo ni y alabansa: taegüije bae julibre gui enimigujo.
pairs.english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato guiya guajo y piniten finatae, ya y minilalag y tinaelaye janamaañaoyo.
pairs.english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y piniten naftan gaegue gui oriyajo, y lason finatae mato guiya guajo.
pairs.english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chinatsagaco nae juagang si Jeova, ya juagang y Yuusso: güiya jajungog gui temploña y vosso, ya y inagangjo gui menaña, jumalom y talangaña.
pairs.english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y tano calamten ya mayengyong, ya y simiento sija y egso manmanyengyong yan mangalamten, sa güiya lalalo.
pairs.english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo aso gui güiingña, ya guinin pachotña guafe manonggue y pinigan mañila pot este.
pairs.english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y janamangag y langet ya tumunog: ya teog na jinemjom gaegue gui sampapa y adengña.
pairs.english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maudae güe gui jilo un querubin, ya gumupo güe; magajet na gumupo güe gui jilo y papan y manglo.
pairs.english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo jinemjom para fanatuganña; para y tabernaculuña gui oriyaña; jinemjom y janom, teog na mapagajes guinin y langet.
pairs.english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y minalag gui menaña y teog na mapagajesña malofan: graniso yan pinigan guafe.
pairs.english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jajulo locue si Jeova gui langet, ya y Gueftaquilo jasangan ni y inagangña: graniso yan pinigan guafe.
pairs.english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y flechaña ya manchinalapon: ya magajet, megae na lamlam ya manyinilang.
pairs.english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae esta malie y tinadong y janom, ya janamababa y simiento y tano sija pot y linalatdemo, O Jeova, pot y güinaefen y jinagong gui güiingmo.
pairs.english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago desde sanjilo, jachuleyo; ya jaatoyo guinin y megae na janom.
pairs.english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalibrego gui manmetgot na enimigujo, yan y chumatliéyo, sa sija mas manmetgot qui guajo.
pairs.english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmato guiya guajo gui un jaanen y chinatsagaco: lao si Jeova, güiya y fanapojo.
pairs.english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachuleyo locue gui anae ancho na lugat: janalibreyo sa ninamagof ni guajo.
pairs.english: He brought me forth also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaapaseyo taemanoja y y tininasso: taemanoja y guinasgas y canaejo unaeyo.
pairs.english: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa juadaje y chalan Jeova: ya ti taelaye yo na juapattayo gui as Yuusso.
pairs.english: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y jinasoña mangaegue gui menajo: ya ti junajanao guiya guajo y tinagoña.
pairs.english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn't put away his statutes from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo cabales guiya güiya: ya juadaje yo guinin y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jaapaseyo si Jeova taemanoja y tininasso: taemanoja y guinasgas y canaejo gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaemaase unfanue na gaemaasejao: ya y taotao ni y cabales, unfanue na cabales jao.
pairs.english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gasgas unfanue na gasgasjao: ya y camten unfanue na camtenjao.
pairs.english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago munalibre y mangaepinite na taotao; ya y sobetbio na atadog jago munatunog.
pairs.english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago munamalag y candetto: si Jeova, Yuusso, namanana y jemjom guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot jago na jufalagüe y inetnon sendalo: ya pot y Yuusso jugope y quelat.
pairs.english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus, cabales y chalanña: y fino Jeova esta machague: patang güe para todo y numanangga güe.
pairs.english: As for God, his way is perfect. The word of Yahweh is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye si Yuus yaguin ti si Jeova güe? ya jaye y acho, jaguin ti si Yuusta?
pairs.english: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus jagogode yo ni y minetgot: ya jafatitinas cabales y chalanjo?
pairs.english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatitinas y adengjo taegüije y adeng y benado: ya janasagayo gui taquilo na sagajo sija.
pairs.english: He makes my feet like deer's feet, and sets me on my high places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafanagüe y canaejo para y guera: ya enaomina y canaejo judobla y atcas bronse.
pairs.english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unnaeyo locue ni y patang gui satbasionmo: ya y agapa na canaemo mumantietieneyo; ya y minansomo munamegaeyo.
pairs.english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnadangculo y pinecatto gui papajo; ya y adengjo ti usulong.
pairs.english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Judulalag y enimigujo sija, ya jugâchâ: ya ti jubirago talo asta que jocog.
pairs.english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. Neither will I turn again until they are consumed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junafanmañetnot, ya ti siña mangajulo: mamodong sija gui papa adengjo.
pairs.english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin ungode yo ni y minetgot para y guera: unnafanecon y enimigujo gui papajo.
