pairs.english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unfatinas ni y enimigujo na unaeyo ni y tataloñija, para juyulang y chumatliiyo.
pairs.english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: manaagange sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They cried, but there was none to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn't answer them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae juguleg sija taegüije y petbos gui menan y manglo; taegüije y fache gui chalan ni y manmachalapon.
pairs.english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unnalibre yo gui y inaguaguat y taotao: guinin unadaje yo para jumagas gui nasion sija: y taotao sija ni ti jutungo ujasesetbeyo.
pairs.english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog guiya guajo ujaosgueyo: ya y taotao juyong ujaosgueyo ni y dinague.
pairs.english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taotao juyong manlinachae ya manmamamaela ya manlalaolao guinin manmapongle.
pairs.english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their close places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lâlâ si Jeova; ya ubendito y achojo: ya umanataquilo na Yuus y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Yahweh lives; and blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ni y numae yo y inemog, ya jasujeta y taotao gui papajo.
pairs.english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalibre yo gui enimigujo: magajet na unnasanjiloyo gui ayo sija y mangajulo contra guajo: ya janalibre yo gui taotao ni y matatnga.
pairs.english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este junae jao grasias gui entalo y nasion sija, O Jeova; ya jucanta y alabansa para y naanmo.
pairs.english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo na linibre janae y rayña; ya jafanue minaase ni y pinalaeña; as David ya y semiyaña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his seed, forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet munaclaro y minalag Yuus; ya y fineda mamanue y checho canaeña.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y un jaane yan y otro jaane masangang y finijo, ya y un puenge ya y otro puenge mamanue tiningo.
pairs.english: Day after day they pour forth speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya sinangan, ni finijo; ti siña umajungog y vosñija.
pairs.english: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gui todo y tano jumanao y rayaña, ya asta uttimon y tano y finoña: ya japolo tabernaculo para atdao guiya sija.
pairs.english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya taegüije y nobio ni jumujuyong guinin y cuattoña, ya jamagof taegüije y matatnga na taotao, para ufalago gui finalago.
pairs.english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinanaoña guinin un punta gui langet, ya y linilicoña asta y uttimoña: ya taya jaye uatog ni y minaepeña.
pairs.english: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends; There is nothing hidden from its heat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay Jeova cabales, jafamauleg y ante; y testimonion Jeova seguro, janafanmalalate y manaeisao.
pairs.english: Yahweh's law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh's testimony is sure, making wise the simple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finañagüe Jeova tunas, janafanmamagof y corason: y tinago Jeova claro, janafanmalag y atadogsija.
pairs.english: Yahweh's precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh's commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaañao as Jeova gasgas, sumaga para taejinecog; y sentensian Jeova magajet, ya todo tunas.
pairs.english: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh's ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na malago mas que y oro, magajet mas que y megae na oro ni y manfino: mames mas que y miet, que y titijo gui sagan miet.
pairs.english: More to be desired are they than gold, yes, than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tentagomo locue mapagat yan sija: ya yaguin jaadaje sija y uguaja dangculo na apas.
pairs.english: Moreover by them is your servant warned. In keeping them there is great reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linachiña jaye utiningo? ya y linache na ti jutungo, nalibreyo.
pairs.english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unmantiene locue y tentagomo guinin y sobetbio na isao: ya munga mangae ninasiñañija guiya guajo: ayo nae cabalesyo ya gasgas yo guinin y dangculo na quinebrantan y tinago.
pairs.english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y sinangang y pachotto ya y jinason y corasonjo umauleg gui menamo, O Jeova, minetgotto yan y munalilibreyo.
pairs.english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova uninepejao y jaanen chinatsaga: y naan y Yuus Jacob ninacajulojao.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utago y para uinayudajao guinin y santuario, ya guinin y Sion unninametgotjao.
pairs.english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujaso todo y ninaemo, ya uchajlao y inefresimo sinenggue.
pairs.english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae jao taemanoja y minalago y corasonmo, ya cumple todo y pinagatmo.
pairs.english: May He grant you your heart's desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utafangana gui satbasionmo, ya y naan y Yuusmame injatsa julo y banderanmame: ucumple si Jeova todo y guinagaomo.
pairs.english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jutungo na si Jeova jaadadaje y pinalaeña: güiya uinepe gue guinin santos y langetña yan y minetgot y satbasion gui agapaña.
pairs.english: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija gui caretasija, ya ayosija gui cabayosija nae jaangocosija: lao jita y naan Jeova, ni y Yuusta, utajajasoja.
pairs.english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija mandimo ya mamodong: lao jita tafangajulo ya tafanogue tunas.
pairs.english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, nalibre: polo y Ray ya uopejam anae inagang.
pairs.english: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, gui minetgotmo ninamagof y ray; ya gui satbasionmo ninamagof megae!
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minalago y corasonña, jago numae: ya ti unpune ni y guinagao y labiosña.
pairs.english: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa untagam güe nu y bendision y minauleg: y coronan oro nu y fino, unpolo gui jilo y iluña.
pairs.english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linâlâ na guinagaoña unnae: y anaco na jaane, para siempre taejinecog.
pairs.english: He asked life of you, you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo y minalagña gui satbasionmo: onra yan minagas unpolo gui jiloña.
pairs.english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago bumendise para taejinecog: unnamagof güe yan minagof gui menamo.
pairs.english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y ray jaangongoco si Jeova: ya pot y minaase y Gueftaquilo ti calamten.
pairs.english: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo usoda todo y enimigumo: y agapa na canaemo usoda todo y chumatlie jao.
pairs.english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo sija taegüije y jetnon guafe gui tiempon binibumo: si Jeova yumulang sija anae lalalo, ya y guafe ufanlinachae.
pairs.english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tinegchaña unyulang gui jilo y tano, ya y semiyaña gui entalo y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja majasuye y taelaye contra jago: jagasja majaso y dinague ni y ti siña mafatinas.
pairs.english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago fumatinas na jabira y tataloñija ya unnalisto y jalon y atcosmo contra y matañija.
pairs.english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taquilo jao, O Jeova, yan y minetgotmo: incantaye yan inalabaye y ninasiñamo.
pairs.english: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YUUSSO, Yuusso, sa jafa na undingo yo? sa jafa chago jao gui inayudajo yan y finijo gui inigongjo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician; set to "The Doe of the Morning." A Psalm by David. > > My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, juagang gui jaane ya ti unope: ya gui puenge lao jusoda y descanso.
pairs.english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don't answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y santos jao, O jago ni y sumasaga gui alabansan Israel.
pairs.english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya jago nae manangoco y tatanmame: manangoco ya unnafanlibre sija.
pairs.english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maaagang jao ya ninafanlibre: manmanangoco nu jago ya ti manmamajlao.
pairs.english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo y gâgâ ilo ya ti taotao: namamajlao gui lalaje ya madespresia gui taotao.
pairs.english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y lumiiyo manatchatgue pot guajo mamuyuyueyo ya jayeyengyong y ilonñija.
pairs.english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angoco jao as Jeova; polo ya ulibre gue: polo ya ulibre güe sa güinaeya güe.
pairs.english: "He trusts in Yahweh; let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y chumule yo gui tiyan: ya unnafanangoco anae gaegue yo gui jaof nanajo.
pairs.english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust at my mother's breasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui jilomo mayute yo guinin y tiyan: desde y tiyan nanajo jago Yuusso.
pairs.english: I was thrown on you from my mother's womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo chachago guiya guajo; sa y chinatsagaco esta jijot, sa taya jaye yo uayuda.
pairs.english: Don't be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is none to help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na toro jaoriyayeyo: manmetgot na toron Básan jumijujuteyo.
pairs.english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabababa y pachotñija guiya guajo taegüije y león ni tegcho yan cumate.
pairs.english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janamachuda yo taegüije y janom, todo y telangjo manápula: y corasonjo taegüije y danges; esta madirite gui talo gui sanjalomjo.
pairs.english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anglo y minetgotto taegüije y pedason an mafag: ya y jilajo cheton gui paladatto: ya gui petbos finatae nae unpoloyo.
pairs.english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa maoriyayayeyo y galago sija: majijujuteyo y inetnon y manaelaye; ya manadochon gui canaejo yan y adengjo.
pairs.english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mojon jusangan todo ni y telangjo: sija jaatanyo ya jaconsidedera.
pairs.english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maipe gui entaloñija todo y bestidujo: ya y magagujo marifa.
pairs.english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, chamo chachago: O jago, minetgotto, chadig yan unayudayo.
pairs.english: But don't be far off, Yahweh. You are my help: hurry to help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre gui espada y antijo: y beyan corasonjo, guinin y ninasiñan y galago.
pairs.english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui pachot y león; magajet, guinin y canggilon y nubiyo ni titogcha, unope yo.
pairs.english: Save me from the lion's mouth! Yes, from the horns of the wild oxen, you have answered me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusaasgane y mañelujo y naanmo: ya gui entalo gui inetnon taotao bae jualalabajao.
pairs.english: I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the assembly, I will praise you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmaañao as Jeova, fanmanalaba nu güiya: todo y semiyan Jacob fanmanonra nu güiya: ya fanmaañao nu güiya todo y semiyan Israel.
pairs.english: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti guinin jadespresia ni jachatlie y pinadesen y pebble; ni unaatog y mataña guiya güiya: ya anae jaagang guiya güiya, jajungog.
pairs.english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya jago nae mamaela y alabansajo gui dangculon inetnon: ya y promesajo juapase gui menan y manmaañao güe.
pairs.english: Of you comes my praise in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufañocho y manmanso ya ufanjaspog: ufanmanalaba as Jeova y umaliligao güe: polo ya ufanmanlâlâ y corasonmiyo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujajaso ya ufanalo guato as Jeova todo y uttimon y tano: ya ufamnanadora gui menamo todo y familian y nasion sija.
pairs.english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa as Jeova y raeno: ya güiya umagas gui todo nasion.
pairs.english: For the kingdom is Yahweh's. He is the ruler over the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufañocho ya ufanmanadora todo y yinemog y tano: gui menanña ufandimo, todo y manunog gui eda: güiyaja ni y tisiña unalala y antiña.
pairs.english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can't keep his soul alive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un semiya usinetbe güe: ya umasangan si Jeova asta y uttimo generasion.
pairs.english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmato ya ufanmasangan y tininasña ni y taotao na umafañago, na güiya fumatinas este.
pairs.english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova güiya y pastotjo: tayayo unafatta.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manbetde na chaguan nae janaason yo: ya y quieto na janom nae jaosgaejon yo.
pairs.english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jananalo y antijo: jaosgaejon yo gui chalan tininas pot y naanña.
pairs.english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jufamocat gui chalan y anineng y finatae, ti maañao yo ni jafa na taelaye, sa jago gaegue guiya guajo: y baramo yan y bastonmo unnae yo minagof.
pairs.english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unfamauleg y lamasa gui menajo yan y menan y enimigujo sija: naye laña y ilujo, ya y copajo esta machúchuda.
pairs.english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sen magajet y minauleg yan y minaase madalalagyo todo nu sija gui jaanen linâlâjo: ya y guima Jeova jusaga para taejinecog na jaane.
pairs.english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh's house forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano iyon Jeova yan y binilaña: y tano yan y manasaga gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > The earth is Yahweh's, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya fumatinas gui jilo y tase: ya gui jilo y janom nae japolo fitme.
pairs.english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye ucajulo gui egso Jeova? ya jaye ugaegue gui sagan y sinantosña.
pairs.english: Who may ascend to Yahweh's hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y gasgas canaeña yan y gasgas corasonña: ni ti pumopolo gui taebale y antiña ni ufanjula ni y dinague.
pairs.english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uresibe y bendision Jeova: yan y tininas guine as Yuus satbasionña.
pairs.english: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na generasion y umaliligao güe: y umaliligao y matamo, O Yuus Jacob. Sila.
pairs.english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face--even Jacob. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y ilonmiyo, O jamyo trangco sija ya umajatsa julo y taejinecog na potta sija, ya y Ray langet ujalom.
pairs.english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye este na Ray langet? Si Jeova, metgot yan matatnga: si Jeova matatnga gui guera.
pairs.english: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y ilonmiyo, O jamyo trangca sija ya umajatsa julo y taejinecog na potta sija ya y Ray langet ujalom.
pairs.english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye este na Bay langet? Si Jeova gui inetnon sendalo, güiya ayo y Ray langet. Sila.
pairs.english: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae jujatsa y antijo.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, iyajago nae juangocoyo: chamo yo munamamamajlao; chamo pumopolo y enimigujo na ugana gui jilojo.
pairs.english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don't let me be shamed. Don't let my enemies triumph over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, na todo y mumananggajao ti ufanmamajlao: sija ufanmamajlao ni y chumogüe dinague sin jafa.
pairs.english: Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo, O Jeova, fanueyo; fanagüe yo, ni y chalanmo.
pairs.english: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Osgaejonyo gui minagajetmo ya unfanagüeyo; sa jago y Yuus ni y satbasionjo: iyajago nae jufannangga todotdia.
pairs.english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso, O Jeova, y mauleg na minaasemo; yan y mauleg na güinaeyamo, sa sija guinin apmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo jumajaso y isao y pinatgonjo, ni y quinebrantaco ni y tinago: segun y güinaeyamo jasoyo, pot y minauleg y naanmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Don't remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness' sake, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mauleg yan tunas si Jeova: pot enao na jafanagüe y maniisao ni y chalan.
pairs.english: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanso ufanfinanagüe gui juisio: yan y manmanso ufanguinia gui chalan.
pairs.english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chalan Jeova güinaeya yan minagajet ni y ayo y umadadaje y tratuña yan y testimoniuña.
pairs.english: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y naanmo, O Jeova, asie y isaojo sa gosdangculo.
pairs.english: For your name's sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye ayo na taotao y maañao as Jeova? güiya ufinanagüe ni y chalan mano y inayegña.
pairs.english: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antiña usaga gui mauleg: ya y semiyaña uereda y tano.
pairs.english: His soul shall dwell at ease. His seed shall inherit the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y secreton Jeova gaegue guiya sija y mumaañaogüe güe; ya güiya ufanagüe sija ni y tratuña.
pairs.english: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo siempre juatan si Jeova; sa güiya ujala y adengjo juyong gui laso.
pairs.english: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanyo, ya gaease ni guajo: sa guajo taeconsueloyo yan piniteyo.
pairs.english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chinatsagan y corasonjo lumalamegae: najuyongyo gui pinitijo.
pairs.english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y trinesteco yan y pinitijo; ya unasie todo y isaojo.
pairs.english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y enimigujo, sa sija manmegae, ya sija chumatliiyo ni y fejman na chinatlie.
pairs.english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y antijo ya nalibreyo: ya chajo mamamajlao, sa iyajago nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minauleg yan y tininas juadádajeyo: sa jago junanangga.
pairs.english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre, O Yuus, y iya Israel gui todo y chinatsagaña.
pairs.english: Redeem Israel, God, out all of his troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUSGAYO, O Jeova, sa guajo jumajanao yo gui tininasso: juangocoyo locue gui as Jeova: pot enao na ti jusulong.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ecsamina yo, O Jeova, ya chagueyo: chague y jinasojo gui jinalomjo yan y corasonjo.
pairs.english: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y güinaeyamo gaegue gui menan atadogjo; ya gui minagajetmo nae jumajanaoyo.
pairs.english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jagasja matachongyo yan y ti manmagajet na taotao; ni jujalom yan y lumilipa.
pairs.english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie y inetnon y chumogüe taelaye: ya ti jufatachong yan y manaelaye.
pairs.english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jufagase y canaejo ni y tinaeisao: taegüije juoriya gui attatmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para junajungog y inagang y grasias yan para jusangan todo y ninamanmanmo.
pairs.english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all your wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, yajo y sagan y guimamo: yan y lugat nae sumasaga minalagmo.
pairs.english: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo na fandadaña yan y maniisao y antijo, ni y jaanijo yan y taotao cájaga.
pairs.english: Don't gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayosija na canaeñija mangaegue y nacacha: ya y agapa y canaeñija bula ni y catnada.
pairs.english: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo jumajanao yo yan y tininasso: nalibreyo, ya gaease ni guajo.
pairs.english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y adengjo gaegue gui lugat ni yano: ya gui inetnon taotao nae jubendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova y candetto yan y satbasionjo? ya jaye jumaañagüeyo? si Jeova y minetgot y linâlâjo, ya jaye yo nae jumaañao?
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manmato guiya guajo y chumogüe taelaye para u jacano y catneco, y contrariojo yan y enimigujo, sija manmatompo ya manmatomba.
pairs.english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja ujapolo un inetnon sendalo contra guajo ti maañao y corasonjo: achogja ucajulo y guera contra guajo, este nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unoja na güinaja jugagao gui as Jeova, este jualiligao; na jugaegue gui guima Jeova todo y jaanen linâlâjo, para julie y guinatbon Jeova ya para jualigao gui temploña.
pairs.english: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after, that I may dwell in the house of Yahweh all the days of my life, to see Yahweh's beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munaatogyo gui tabernacoluña gui jaanen pinite: ya janaatogyo gui fanatog y tabernacoluña: ya japoloyo julo gui jilo y acho.
pairs.english: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the covert of his tabernacle he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago janataquiloyo y ilujo gui jilo y enimigujo gui oriyajo: ya junae gui tabernacoluña inefresen minagof; bae jucantae, magajet, jucantaye alabansa sija si Jeova.
pairs.english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Jeova, anae juagang ni inagangjo, gaease locue ni guajo ya unopeyo.
pairs.english: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ilegmo: Aligao jamyo y matajo; y corasonjo ilegña nu jago: O Jeova, y matamo jualiligao.
pairs.english: When you said, "Seek my face," my heart said to you, "I will seek your face, Yahweh."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo munaaatog y matamo guiya guajo; chamo munasusuja yan y binibumo y tentagomo: jago guinin ayudajo; chamoyo yumuyute ya chamoyo dumidingo, O Yuus gui satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Don't hide your face from me. Don't put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don't abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si tatajo yan nanajo yumuteyo: si Jeova jumocayo.
pairs.english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüeyo, O Jeova, ni y chalanmo: ya osgaejonyo, gui chalan yano, pot rason y enimigujo.
pairs.english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo pumopolo gui minalago y contrariojo: sa mangajujulo contra guajo mandacon na testigo, ya jaye usinangang y taease.
pairs.english: Don't deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin lalangoyo yaguin ti jujonggue na guaja nae julie y minauleg Jeova gui tano ni y manlâlâlâ.
pairs.english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nangga si Jeova: nametgotjao ya polo ya unamatatnga y corasonmo: magajet, na nangga jao si Jeova.
pairs.english: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, juaagang; achojo, chamo fatilúluye yo: yaguin infatiluye yo, guajo uparejo yan y manútunog gui tadong y joyo.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don't be deaf to me; lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y inagang y guinagaojo anae juagang jao: anae jujatsa y canaejo gui sinantos templomo.
pairs.english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo cumocone guato gui manaelaye yan y chumogüe y taelaye: ya jasasangan y pas gui tiguangña ya y inacacha gaegue gui corasonñija.
pairs.english: Don't draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae sija taemanoja y chechoñija: ya taemanoja y taelayen chechoña. Nae sija taemanoja y finatinas y canaeñija: apase ni y para ujamarese.
pairs.english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa timanmalago jalie y checho Jeova, ni y finatinas y canaeña, ufanyinilang sija ya ti uninafangajulo.
pairs.english: Because they don't respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova, sa jajungong y inagang y guinagaojo.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y minetgotto yan y patangjo; y iyagüiya nae manangoco y corasonjo, ya guajo uayuda: Enao mina senmagof y corasonjo; ya y quinantaco nae jualabagüe.
pairs.english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y minetgotñija: ya güiya y minetgot y satbasion para y pinalaeña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre y taotaomo ya bendise y erensiamo: ya nafañocho sija ya unmantiene sija para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAE si Jeova, O famaguon manmetgot, nae si Jeova ni inenra yan y minetgot.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova y inenra ni mauleg para y naanña: adora si Jeova ni guinatbon y sinantosña.
pairs.english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova gaegue gui jilo y janomsija: ya y Yuus langet janajujulo: junggan, si Jeova, gui jilo y megae na janom.
pairs.english: Yahweh's voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova y ninasiña: y inagang Jeova bula y minagas.
pairs.english: Yahweh's voice is powerful. Yahweh's voice is full of majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova yumuyulang y trongcon y sedrosija: magajet na jayulang si Jeova y trongcon sedrosija y Líbano.
pairs.english: The voice of Yahweh breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanayog sija locue taegüije y tatnero: y Líbano yan y Sirion taegüije y patgon y dadao na nubiyo.
pairs.english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova umuutut y mañila y guafe.
pairs.english: Yahweh's voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova munamayengyong y jalomtano: janameyeyengyong si Jeova y jalomtano guiya Cades.
pairs.english: Yahweh's voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova munafanmañañago y binado sija ya janafanquesnuda y jalomtano: ya y temploña nae todo y güinaja ilegña: Minalag.
pairs.english: Yahweh's voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, "Glory!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova anae guaja delubio matachong calang un ray; magajet na matatachong si Jeova calang ray na taejinecog.
pairs.english: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova unae minetgot y taotaoña: si Jeova jabendise y taotaoña ni y pas.
pairs.english: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNATAQUILO jao, O Jeova; sa jago unnajatsa yo julo: ya ti unnafanmagof y enimigujo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. > > I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, juagangjao ya unnajomloyo.
pairs.english: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, jago munacajulo y antijo gui naftan: unadajeyo na lâlâyo para mungayo tumunog gui naftan.
pairs.english: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol . You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova, O jamyo mañantosña: ya innae grasias y santos na naaña.
pairs.english: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot didideja guaja linalaloña; gui finaboreseña nae guaja linâlâ: yaguin y pupuenge majon sumaga y tinanges; y egaan mato y minagof.
pairs.english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo jagas ileco anae lumálaguaja yo: ti jucalamten talo taejinecog.
pairs.english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be moved."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, pot y finaboresemo jagasja unnafitme y egsojo: lao unnana y matamo, ya guajo chumatsaga.
pairs.english: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya jago, O Jeova, juaagangjao: ya si Jeova jutayuyut.
pairs.english: I cried to you, Yahweh. To Yahweh I made supplication:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafayo probechoco gui jâgâjo, anae tumunog yo gui naftan? Ada uinalabajao ni y petbos? Ada usangan y minagajetmo?
pairs.english: "What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Jeova, ya gaease ni guajo: Jeova, jago para inayudajo.
pairs.english: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumira y inigongjo gui baela: ya unpula y lutojo ya unnaquinereasyo ni y minagof;
pairs.english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jucantaye jao inenra ya ti jufamatquilo: O Jeova, Yuusso, junaejao grasias para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae juangoco: chamoyo munamamamajlao para taejinecog: nalibreyo gui tininasmo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Egueng papa guiya guajo y talangamo, nalibreyo guse: jago y para guajo acho ni y fitme, pot y guima lumijing nae para unnalibreyo.
pairs.english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y achojo yan y castiyujo; enao mina pot y naanmo esgaejonyo ya chachalalaneyo.
pairs.english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name's sake lead me and guide me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chuleyo gui lagua ni y munanaaatogyo gui ti umatungo: sa jago y seguro na sagajo.
pairs.english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo nae, junae ni y espiritujo: unnalibreyo, O Jeova, jago Yuus minagajet.
pairs.english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie ayo sija y numanangga y taebale na dinague: lao guajo si Jeova juangongoco.
pairs.english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumagof ya jusenmagof gui minaasemo: sa jagas unlie y pinitijo: ya jagas untungo y antijo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago ti jumujuchomyo gui canae y enimigujo: jagas unpolo y adengjo gui dangculo na sagayan.
pairs.english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease ni guajo, O Jeova, sa estagüe yo gui chinatsaga: sa y atadogjo linachae ni y pinite, junggan, y antijo yan y tataotaojo.
pairs.english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanijo linachae ni y trinestico, ya y sacanjo ni y suspiros: linalachae y minetgotto pot y tinaelayeco: ya y telangjo mananglo.
pairs.english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot todo y enimigujo, jumuyongyo mamajlao, magajet na sentaegüijeja a para y tiguangjo yan y minaañao ni y manatungoyo: ya y lumiliiyo gui sanjiyong mañuja guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta malefayo taegüije y matae ni ti manjaso: taegüijeyo y an mafag baso.
pairs.english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jujungog y dinisonran y lajyayan: minaañao sija gui todo oriya: anae manafaesen entresija contra guajo, ya majasusuye para umacone y antijo.
pairs.english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, iya jago nae juangocoyo, O Jeova: ileco: Jago y Yuusso.
pairs.english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, "You are my God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo nae gaegue y tiempoco: nalibre yo gui canae y enimigujo yan y pumetsisigueyo.
pairs.english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanina y matamo gui jilo y tentagomo: nalibreyo ni y güinaeyamo.
pairs.english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, chamo yo munamámamajlao; sa jagasja juaagangjao: polo y manaelaye ya ufanmamajlao: polo sija ya ufanmamatquilo gui naftan.
pairs.english: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmamatquilo y labios ni y manmandadague; sa manguecuentos saguat contra y manunas, yan sobetbia yan despresio.
pairs.english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna dangculo y minaulegmo ni unadadaje para y mumaañaogüe jao, na unfatinas para y umangocojao gui menan y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago nae ufanatog sija na ti umatungo gui menamo guinin y taelaye na contraton taotao; jago unadaje sija gui guima lumijing guinin y inaguaguat y jila sija.
pairs.english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova: sa jafanueyo ninamanman gui minaaseña gui siudan manmetgot.
pairs.english: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ileco y nalulajo: Juutut yo gui menan atadogmo; lao magajet na jago jumungog y vos y guinagaojo anae juagangjao.
pairs.english: As for me, I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before your eyes." Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaeya si Jeova todo jamyo mañantos; ya y manmauleg adaje si Jeova, ya apase megagae y fumatitinas ni y sobetbia.
pairs.english: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmetgot jamyo, ya inafanmatatnga y corasonmiyo, todo y numanangga si Jeova.
pairs.english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO y maasie ni y taelayen finatinasña, ya y isaoña matampe.
pairs.english: < < By David. A contemplative psalm. > > Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y ti jacatgaye si Jeova ni tinaelaye, ni uguaja gui espirituña dinague.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn't impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae mamatquiloyo, y telangjo ninafanbijo, ni y inigongjo todotdia.
pairs.english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaane yan y puenge y canaemo macat guiya guajo; ya y finetgonjo mabira para y inanglo gui tiempon maepe. Sila.
pairs.english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y isaojo junatungo jao ya y tinaelayeco ti junaatog; ya ileco: Guajo bae juconfesatñaejon y tinaelayen finatinasso as Jeova; ya jago unasie y taelayen y isaojo. Sila.
pairs.english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn't hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este nae umatayuyut jao y mandeboto todos gui tiempo anae mojon siña ujasoda: senmagajet anae machuchuda inetnon y janom, ti ufato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y fanatugco; ya gui chinatsaga jago unadajeyo: ya nu y cantan linibre, jago unoriyayeyo.
pairs.english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junatungo jao ya jufanagüe jao ni y chalan anae jumajanao: jupagat jao nu y atadogco.
pairs.english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumarérejo yan y cabayo, pat y mula ni taya tiningoñija: na nesesita y modasa yan y freno para umantiene; yaguin taya estesija ti malago guaguato guiya jago.
pairs.english: Don't be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na triniste para y manaelaye: lao y numaangongoco si Jeova, minaase umoriyayayegüe.
pairs.english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof as Jeova, ya infansenmagof, O jamyo manunas; ya fanagang ni y minagof, todo y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMAGOF gui as Jeova jamyo manunas: sa y manunas bonito na alabansa.
pairs.english: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmannae grasias indandane si Jeova ni atpa: cantaye güe ni alabansa nu y guitala ni y gaecuetdas dies.
pairs.english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye güe ni y nuebo na canta: dandan mauleg ni y agang.
pairs.english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y fino Jeova tunas: ya todo y chechoña esta mafatinas ni y minagajet.
pairs.english: For the word of Yahweh is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya yaña y tininas yan y juisio; ya cariño na güinaeya gui as Jeova, bula y tano.
pairs.english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y fino Jeova esta mafatinas y langetsija: ya pot y jajaja ni y pachotña, todo y inetnonñija.
pairs.english: By Yahweh's word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munadaña gui un monton y janom gui tase: güiya pumolo gui atmasén y tinadongsija.
pairs.english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmaañao as Jeova todo y tano: manmaañao nu güiya todo mañasaga gui tano.
pairs.english: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya umalog ya jumuyong: güiya manago ya sumaga fitme.
pairs.english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova munataesetbe y pinagat y nasion; ya güiya munataebale y jinaso y taotao.
pairs.english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinagat Jeova sumaga para taejinecog: y jinason y corasonña para todo y generasion.
