pairs.english: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y nasion ni si Jeova Yuusña: yan y taotao ni y jaayeg pot erensia para güiya.
pairs.english: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y langet jaatan si Jeova: jalilie todos y famaguon Adam.
pairs.english: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y sagaña na lugat jaatan; jaatitutuye todo y mañasaga gui jilo y tano.
pairs.english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya fumatinas y corasonñija todos: yan jaatitutuye todo y chechoñija.
pairs.english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray ti umalibre pot y dangculon inetnon sendaloña: y matatnga na taotao ti umasatba pot y dangculon minetgotña.
pairs.english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cabayo taebale para useguro: sa güiya ti unalibre ni uno nu y dangculon jinilatña.
pairs.english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, y atadog Jeova gui jilo y manmaañagüe güe: gui jiloñija y numanangga y minaaseña.
pairs.english: Behold, Yahweh's eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unalibre gui finatae y antiñija: ya para unae linâlâ gui ñinalang.
pairs.english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antita jagas jananangga si Jeova: y ayudata yan y patangta güiya.
pairs.english: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot güiya manmagof y corasonta, sa y sinantos naanña nae jagas taangocojit.
pairs.english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y minaasemo, O Jeova, ugaegue guiya jame, según ninangganmamame guiya jago.
pairs.english: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUBENDISE si Jeova gui todo y tiempo: y alabansaña siésiempreja sumaga gui pachotto.
pairs.english: < < By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.Psalm 34 is an acrostic poem, with each verse starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav). > > I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova umalaba y antijo: man manjungog y manmanso ya ninafanmagof.
pairs.english: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junadangculo si Jeova guiya guajo: ya nita tanataquilo y naanña gui un vos.
pairs.english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualigao si Jeova ya güiya jajungogyo: ya todo y minaañaojo janalibreyo.
pairs.english: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija inatangüe ya infaninina: ya y matañija ti ufanmamajlao.
pairs.english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y namase na taotao umagang, ya si Jeova jumungog, ya ninalibre todo gui chinatsagaña.
pairs.english: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y angjet Jeova jaoriyaye sija y manmaañao nu güiya ya janalibre sija.
pairs.english: The angel of Yahweh encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chague ya unlie na mauleg si Jeova: dichoso y taotao ni umangocogüe guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmaañao as Jeova, jamyo mañantosña: sa taya ufatta para y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mandiquique na león mannamase ya manñalang; ya y umaliligao si Jeova ti ufatta ni jafa na minauleg.
pairs.english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela jamyo famaguon, ecungog yo: ya jufanagüe jamyo ni y minaañao as Jeova.
pairs.english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye enao na taotao y tumátana y linâlâ, ya yaña megae na jaane para ulie y minauleg?
pairs.english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y jilamo gui taelaye, yan y labiosmo na ucuentos mandague.
pairs.english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Suja gui taelaye ya fatinas y mauleg; aligao y pas ya dalalag.
pairs.english: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadog Jeova gaegue gui jilo y manunas: ya y talangaña esta mababa pot y inagangñija.
pairs.english: Yahweh's eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y matan Jeova contra y fumatitinas y taelaye para uutut gui tano y jinasoñija.
pairs.english: Yahweh's face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Managang y manunas ya si Jeova jumungog: ya todo y chinatsagañija ninafanlibre.
pairs.english: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jijot esta si Jeova gui manmaque branta na corason: yan y manmañetnot na espiritu janalibre.
pairs.english: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae y pinitiñiñija y manunas: lao todo ayo si Jeova munafanlibre.
pairs.english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaadaje todo y telangñija: ya ni uno guiya sija umayamag.
pairs.english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: taotao sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalilibre si Jeova y linâlâ y tentagoña: ya taya ni uno ni umangoco güe usinentensia.
pairs.english: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AGUAGUATE, O Jeova, ayo y umaguaguaguateyo; mumo yan ayo y amumumujo.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mantiene y patang yan guinegüe, ya tojgue para unayudayo.
pairs.english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chule y lansa ya patang y chalan contra ayo y pumetsisigueyo: alog ni antijo: Guajo y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, "I am your salvation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao, ya ufanquinenfunde y umaliligao y antijo: polo ya ufanalo tate ya ufanmamajlao y jumajaso y taelayejo.
pairs.english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya calang y paja gui menan y manglo: ya y angjet Jeova ufanchineneg sija.
pairs.english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh's angel driving them on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y chalanñija ya jomjom yan palagse: ya y angjet Jeova ufanpinetsigue sija.
pairs.english: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh's angel pursuing them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sin causa manatog para guajo y lagua gui joyo: ya sin causa manmanguadog joyo para y antijo.
pairs.english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufato guiya güiya ya yinilang ni ti jatungo: polo ya y lagua ni janaaatog, ucone maesagüe: yan y jalom yinilang nae upodong güe.
pairs.english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umagof y antijo gui as Jeova: ya umagof gui satbasionña.
pairs.english: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y telangjo y ilegñija: Jeova, jaye parejumo? ni unalibre y mamoble gui mas manmetgot qui güiya: magajet na y mamoble yan y mannesesitao, guinin y jachulelejguan?
pairs.english: All my bones shall say, "Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo testigon mandague: ya jafaesenyo ni y ti jutungo.
pairs.english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don't know about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaeyo ni taelaye pot y mauleg, ya manataelaye y antijo.
pairs.english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo anae manmalango sija, magagojo y luto: junatriste y antijo yan umayunat: y tinaetaejo tumalo jalom gui pechoco.
pairs.english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamomocat yo ya ileleco: Güiya buente y gachongjo, pat y chelujo: ya tumecon yo triste calang uno ni y umuugung pot si nanaña.
pairs.english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae desgrasiaoyo, sija manmagof ya mandaña: ya y gosnamaase mandaña contra guajo ya guajo ti jutungo: sija matitegyo ya ti manbasta.
pairs.english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn't know it. They tore at me, and didn't cease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y áplacha na minefea gui fandango, janachéchegcheg y nifenñija guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, asta ngaean nae unatan? nalibre y antijo gui yinilangña, yan y beya y corasonjo gui león.
pairs.english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junae jao grasias gui dangculon y inetnon taotao: ya jualaba jao gui entalo linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo na ufanmamagof guiya guajo y enimigujo sin jafa? ni ayo y chumatlieyo sin causa jaachetgue yo nu y atadog.
pairs.english: Don't let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti manguecuentos pas: ya contra y manmanso gui tano jajajaso y finijo dinague.
pairs.english: For they don't speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jabababa y pachotñija contra guajo; ilegñija: Ja, ja y atadogmameja lumie.
pairs.english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, "Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unlie este, O Jeova; chamo famatquiquilo: O Jeova, chamo chachago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don't keep silent. Lord, don't be far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso ya fagmata para y juisioco; junggan, para y causaco Yuusso yan y Señotto.
pairs.english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusgayo taemanoja y tininasmo, O Jeova, Yuusso, ya chamo pumopolo na ufanmamagof guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don't let them gloat over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo na ujaalog gui corasonñija: Ja, taegüije manmalagojit; chamo pumopolo na ujaalog: Jita jagas tacalamot güe.
pairs.english: Don't let them say in their heart, "Aha! That's the way we want it!" Don't let them say, "We have swallowed him up!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao ya ufañatsaga ayo sija y manmagof pot y manadañujo: polo ya ufanminagago ni y minamajlao yan y disonra y munadangculo sija contra guajo.
pairs.english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanagang ni minagof ya ufanmagof y gumaeya y tinas na causaco: junggan, polo ya ujaalog siempre: innadangculo si Jeova, ni y yaña na memegae y tentagoña.
pairs.english: Let them shout for joy and be glad, who favor my righteous cause. Yes, let them say continually, "Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jilajo usangan ni y tininasmo, yan todotdia ni y alabansamo.
pairs.english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YINEMBESTE y taelaye, ilegña gui corasonjo, taya minaañao as Yuus gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. > > An oracle is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: "There is no fear of God before his eyes."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot enao jafaande maesa güe gui atadogña, ya ti usoda y taelayeña ya umachatlie gue.
pairs.english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finijo gui pachotña manaelaye yan finababa: basta güe ni utungo yan ufatinas y mauleg.
pairs.english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinaelaye jajajaso gui jilo camaña: japolo maesa güe gui un chalan ni y ti mauleg: ti jachatlie y inacacha.
pairs.english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn't abhor evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, asta y langet y güinaeyamo; y minagajetmo inataca asta y mapagajes.
pairs.english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininasmo taegüije y egso Yuus; y juisiomo sija dangculoña tinadong: y taotao yan y gâgâ, jago umadadaje, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosdangculo y balotña y güinaeyamo, O Yuus! ya y famaguon taotao ufanmagogue gui papa y anineng y papamo.
pairs.english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufansennajong ni y minegae y guimamo: ya jago unnafanguimen ni y sadog y minagofmo.
pairs.english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyajago nae gaegue y bebô y linâlâ: ya y ininamo nae infanmalie inina.
pairs.english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sisigueja y güinaeyamo para y tumungo jao; ya y tininasmo para manunas na corason.
pairs.english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo ya ufato contra guajo y patas y sobetbio: ni y canae y manaelaye unasuja yo.
pairs.english: Don't let the foot of pride come against me. Don't let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mamodong y manmamatitinas ni y taelaye: sija manmachoneg ya ti siña ufangajulo.
pairs.english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO umestotban mamaesa jao ni y chumogüe daño, ni unguaja embidia, ni y fumatitinas y taelaye.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Don't fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufanmautut guse taegüijeja y chaguan, ya ufanmalayo taegüije y chaguan betde.
pairs.english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angocojao as Jeova, ya fatinas y mauleg: saga gui tano ya unchogüe minauleg.
pairs.english: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magofjao as Jeova: ya güiya unninae ni guinagao y corasonmo.
pairs.english: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bira y chalanmo para as Jeova: ya angocogüe locue, ya güiya unajuyong este.
pairs.english: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janajanao y tininasmo taegüije y manana: ya y juisiomo taegüije y taloane.
pairs.english: he will make your righteousness go forth as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Quieto jao as Jeova, ya nanggagüe nu y siningon: chamo umestotban mamaesa jao ni y mumegae, gui chalanña ni y taotao ni fumatitinas y dinague.
pairs.english: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don't fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Basta y binibo, ya polo y linalalo; chamo umestotban mamaesa jao para unfatinas y dano.
pairs.english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don't fret, it leads only to evildoing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y chumogüe dano ufanmautut: lao y numanangga si Jeova, sija ujaereda y tano.
pairs.english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde este didide ti utaegüe y taelaye: magajet na jaguefjajaso y sagaña ya utaegüe güe.
pairs.english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn't there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manmanso ujaereda y tano: ya ufanmagof maesa sija ni megae na pas.
pairs.english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye man jajaso dinague contra y manunas ya janachechegcheg y nifenñija guiya güiya.
pairs.english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova chumachaleg pot güiya: sa jalilie na ufato gui jaaniña.
pairs.english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye jalagnos y espada, yan janadilog y atcosñija para uyute papa y mamoble yan y mannesesitao: para ujapuno sija y manunas gui chalan.
pairs.english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright in the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y espadañija jumalom gui corasonñijaja ya y atcosñija umayamag.
pairs.english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maulegñaja y didide gui manunas, qui y minegae gui megae na manaelaye.
pairs.english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y canae y manaelaye ufanmayamag: lao si Jeova jamantietene y manunas.
pairs.english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatungo si Jeova y jaanen y manunas: ya y erensiañija usaga para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija, ti ufanmamajlao gui taelaye na tiempo: ya y jaanen ñinalang ufanjaspog.
pairs.english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manaelaye ufanmalingo: yan y enimigon Jeova ufanparejo y sebon cotdero sija: sija ufanlinachae, calang aso ufanguelinachae.
pairs.english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish-- vanish like smoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye mañuñule inayao ya ti jaapapasetalo: ya y manunas guaja minaaseñija ya mannae.
pairs.english: The wicked borrow, and don't pay back, but the righteous give generously.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayosija y manbendise pot güiya ujaereda y tano: ya ayosija y manmatdise pot güiya ufanmautut.
pairs.english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinanao y mauleg na taotao si Jeova mumantietene; ya güiya yaña y chalanña.
pairs.english: A man's goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin matomba, ti uguefpodong: sa si Jeova mumantietene nu y canaeña.
pairs.english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guine patgon yo ya estayo bijo; lao tatnae julie y mauleg madingo, ni y semiyaña manegagao nengcanoñija.
pairs.english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todotdia guaja minaase yan ninaayao: ya y simiyaña para bendision.
pairs.english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His seed is blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Suja gui taelaye, ya fatinas y mauleg; ya sumasasaga jao para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova yaña y juisio, ya ti jadingo y mañantosña: sija ufanmaadaje para siempre: ya y semiyan y manaelaye ufanmautut.
pairs.english: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn't forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ujaereda y tano ya usaga para taejinecog gui jiloña.
pairs.english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachot y manunas manguecuentos minalate, ya y jilaña cumuecuentos juisio.
pairs.english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay y Yuusña gaegue gui corasonña, pot enao na y adengña ti usulong.
pairs.english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye jaespipia y tinas ya jaegaga para upuno.
pairs.english: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ti upinelo gue gui canaeña: ni usinentensia güe yan manjusga.
pairs.english: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nangga si Jeova ya adaje y chalanña, ya güiya unninataquilo para unereda y tano: anae y manaelaye ufanmautut, jago siempre unlie.
pairs.english: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jagas julie y taelaye na dangculo ninasiñaña, ya janamayao güe, calang y atbot ni betde gui edaña.
pairs.english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalofan ya estagüe, na taegüe: magajet na jualigao ya tisiña masoda.
pairs.english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y cabales, ya atan y tinas na taotao: sa y uttimoña ayo na taotao y pas.
pairs.english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manaelaye todo manmayulang: ya y uttimon y manaelaye ufanmautut.
pairs.english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y satbasion y manunas gui as Jeova: güiya y minetgotñija gui tiempon y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova ufaninayuda ya uninafanlibre gui manaelay: ya uninafansatba sa sija numananggagüe.
pairs.english: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, chamoyo lumalálatde nu y lalalomo, ni uncastigayo nu y binibumo.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David, for a memorial. > > Yahweh, don't rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y flechamo cheton guiya guajo: ya y canaemo macat gui jilojo.
pairs.english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya jinemlo gui catneco pot y binibumo: ya taya pas gui telangjo pot causa y isaojo.
pairs.english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinaelayeco malofan gui jilo ilujo: sija sen macat guiya guajo taegüije y catga macat.
pairs.english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chetnotto manmutung yan manpotlilo, pot causa y binabajo.
pairs.english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pinite yo yan gostumecon yo: todotdia jumajanaoyo yan umuugong yo.
pairs.english: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atayojo bula sinenggue: ya taya jinemlo gui catneco.
pairs.english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manyafaeyo yan gosmamuteyo: cumate yo pot y atboroto gui corasonjo.
pairs.english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, y menamo nae gaegue todo y tinangajo: ya y inigongjo tiunaatog guiya jago.
pairs.english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo bobongbong, y minetgotto malingo: ya y minalag y atadogjo fatta esta.
pairs.english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya yo yan y mangachongjo manotojgue chago gui chetnotto; ya parientesso manotojgue gui chago.
pairs.english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija ni y umaliligao y antijo manmaplanta laso para guajo; ya y umaliligao y dañujo manguecuentos tinaelaye: ya todotdia manmanajaso ni y finababa.
pairs.english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, calang tanga, ti jujungog: ya guajo calang udo ni ti ubaba y pachotña.
pairs.english: But I, as a deaf man, don't hear. I am as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na guajo calang un taotao ni ti manjujungog: ya taya linalatde gui pachotña.
pairs.english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn't hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iya jago, O Jeova, junanangga: jago unfanope, O Jeova, Yuusso.
pairs.english: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ileco: Chañija fanmamagof guiya guajo: anae sulong y adengjo manladangculon sija guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For I said, "Don't let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo cana na ugadon: ya y pinitijo gaegue siesiempre gui menajo.
pairs.english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jusangan y tinaelayeco; bae jutriste pot y isaojo.
pairs.english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigujo manlâlâ ya manmetgot: ya mumemegaeja y chumatlieyo sin jafa.
pairs.english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija locue ni y jaapapase y mauleg pot y taelaye, sija contrarionjo, sa judadalalag y mauleg.
pairs.english: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo dumidingoyo, O Jeova: O Yuusso, chamo chachago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Don't forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don't be far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Laguse ya unayudayo, O Jeova y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJO ileco bae juadaje y chalanjo, para chajo umiisao pot y jilajo: bae juadaje y pachotto ni freno, anae y manaelaye mangaegue gui menajo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. > > I said, "I will watch my ways, so that I don't sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jugueffamatquilo ya juquieto gui minauleg: ya y pinitijo manatbororota.
pairs.english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo maepe gui sanjalomjo: anae jujajaso, y guafe mañoñonggue: ayo nae cumuentos yo yan y jilajo.
pairs.english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned: I spoke with my tongue:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natungo yo, Jeova, ni uttimoco, yan y medidan y jaanijo cuanto guaja; natungoyo jafa na checayo.
pairs.english: "Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na un atafja unnae y jaanijo; ya y sacanjo calangja taya gui menamo: sen magajet na todo y taotao taebale anae guaja mas balotña.
pairs.english: Behold, you have made my days handbreadths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Senmagajet na calang anineng jumajanao todo y taotao: senmagajet na taesetbe y atborotoñija: Sa manrecocoje y güinaja ya ti jatungo jaye y chinile.
pairs.english: "Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn't know who shall gather.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, Jeova, jafa junangga? y ninanggaco gaegue guiya jago.
pairs.english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre yo gui todo y tinaelayeco, chamoyo pumopolo na jumanamamajlao gui taetiningo.
pairs.english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don't make me the reproach of the foolish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo mamatquilo, ti jubaba y pachotto: sa jago fumatinas.
pairs.english: I was mute. I didn't open my mouth, because you did it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najanao guiya guajo y sinaulagmo: sa pot y tinetpen y canaemo lumachaeyo.
pairs.english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae unnatunas y taotao nu y linalatde, pot y tinaelaye, ninalachae y bonituña taegüije y puliya: senmagajet na todo y taotao taebale.
pairs.english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, You consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y tinaetaejo, O Jeova, ecungog y inagangjo: chamo famatquilo gui menan y lagojo: sa taotao tumano yo guiya jago: pago finatoyo taegüeje y mañaenajo todos.
pairs.english: "Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don't be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Poloyo ya jufañule minetgot, antes de jujanao ya ti jutalo.
pairs.english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNANGGA nu y siningon as Jeova; ya janaegueng maesa güe guiya guajo, ya jajungog y inagangjo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya chumule yo guinin un joyo chatliion, guinin fache na tadong: ya japolo y adengjo gui jilo acho, ya janafitme y jinanaojo.
pairs.english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo gui pachotto canta na mannuebo, junggan, y alabansa gui Yuusta. Megae lumie ya manmaañao, ya ufanangoco as Jeova.
pairs.english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni jaangoco gui as Jeova: ya ti jaaatan y mansobetbio ni y manabag manmalag y mandague.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn't respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae O Jeova, y ninamanmanmo ni unfatinas: yan y jinasomo para jame; ti siña maaregla sija gui menamo: yaguin guajo judeclara ya jusangang sija, tisiña matufong sa gosmegae.
pairs.english: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can't be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inefresen ninae ti yamo: y talangajo jagasja unbaba: inefresen sinenggue ya y ninae pot y isao, ti jagasja ungagao.
pairs.english: Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ileco: Estagüe na matoyo: gui finalulon y leblo nae esta matugue pot guajo.
pairs.english: Then I said, "Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yajo para jufatinas y minalagomo, O Yuusso: magajet na y laymo gaegue gui jalom corasonjo.
pairs.english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jagas jusangan y tininas gui jalom y dangculo na inetnon taotao: estagüe, na ti junaquiequeto y labiosso, O Jeova, jago tumungo.
pairs.english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti junaatog y tininasmo gui jalom corasonjo; y minagajetmo yan satbasionmo jagas jusangan: ti jupune y minaasemo yan y minaulegmo gui dangculon inetnon taotao.
pairs.english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Jeova, chamo dumitietietene y minaasemo para guajo: sa y minaasemo yan y minagajetmo juadadaje yo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Don't withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegue gui oriyajo y tinaelaye asta ti tufungon: jajiguef yo y tinaelayeco sija, ya ti siña juatan julo; megaeña mas que y gapotulo gui ilujo, ya y corasonjo yafae esta.
pairs.english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malagojao, O Jeova, unnalibreyo: O Jeova, laguse para unayudayo.
pairs.english: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao ya ufaninestotba ayo y umaliligao y antijo para uyulang: polo ya ufanalo tate ya ufanmamajlao, ni y yañija y munataelaye yo.
pairs.english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanlapoble sija, pot y minamajlaoñija, ni y umaalog ni guajo: Ja, ja.
pairs.english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, "Aha! Aha!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmagof ya ufansemagof ni jago, todo y umaliligao jao: ya polo ya siesiempreja ujaalog, y gumaeya y satbasionmo: Ladangculo Jeova.
pairs.english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, "Let Yahweh be exalted!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo pobleyo ya nesesitaoyo; lao si Jeova jajajasoyo. Jago y umayuyudayo yan y munalibre yo: O Yuusso, chamo atrasasao.
pairs.english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don't delay, my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO ayo y maase ni y mamoble; sa y jaanen y tinaelaye nae, si Jeova ulinibre.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uinadajegüe, yan umantiene güe lâlâ; ya güiya udichoso gui tano; ya tiuenentrega güe gui minalago y enemiguña.
pairs.english: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uinayuda güe jilo camaña ni y pinitiña; unfatinas todo y camaña anae malango.
pairs.english: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ilegco: Jeova gaease nu guajo: najomlo y antijo; sa umisaoyo contra jago.
pairs.english: I said, "Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: y enemigujo jasangan y taelaye contra guajo ilegñija: Ngaean umatae, ya ufalingo y naanña?
pairs.english: My enemies speak evil against me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae mato para uliiyo, jasangan y taebale; y corasonña nae mandaña y tinaelaye pot güiyaja; anae jumanao juyong jasangan ayo.
pairs.english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chumatliiyo manañangon entre sija contra guajo; contra guajo nae majaso y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti mauleg na chetnot, ilegñija, sumaga guiya güiya; sa anae umason gui cama ti siña ninacajulo talo.
pairs.english: "An evil disease," they say, "has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y güinaeyaco nae juangocoyo, güiya y cumano y najo pan, jajatsa y dedegoña contra guajo.
pairs.english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago Jeova, gaease nu guajo, ya unacajuloyo, para juapase sija.
pairs.english: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jutungo, na unmagof guiya guajo, sa y enemigujo ti ujagana yo.
pairs.english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn't triumph over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo, gui quinabalesso unmantieneyo; ya unpoloyo gui menamo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendesido si Jeova ni y Yuus Israel, ni y taejinecog, yan taejinecog. Amen, Amen.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TAEGÜIJE y benabo ni y guija, ni y malago ni y minilalag y janom: taegüijeja locue y antijo sumospípiros pot jago, O Yuus.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. > > As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo majo pot si Yuus, pot y lalâlâ na Yuus; ngaean nae jufato, ya juanog gui menan Yuus?
pairs.english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lagojo guinin nengcanojo, jaane yan puenge, ya todo y jaane ilegñiñijaja nu guajo: Manggue y Yuusmo?
pairs.english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jujaso estesija, machuda juyong y antijo guiya guajo, anae manmalofan y linajyan taotao, maposyo, ya jucone sija asta y guimayuus; yan y minagof, yan y tinina; un linajyan na umadadaje y guipot na jaane.
pairs.english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God's house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilogjao, O antijo? yan jafa na estotbajao gui jinalomjo? Nangga jao si Yuus, sa guajo bae jutuna güe pot y ayudo gui menaña.
pairs.english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yuusso, y antijo esta dumilog gui jinalomjo; pot enao na jujajasojao desde y tano guiya Jordan, yan Hermonitas, desde y egso Misar.
pairs.english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tinadong, jaagang y otro tinadong, pot palangpang y janommo sija: todo y napomo, yan y langatmo, manmalofan gui jilojo.
pairs.english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago si Jeova y minaaseña gui jaane, ya y puenge y cantaña guiya guajo, ya y tinaetae para y Yuus a linâlâjo.
pairs.english: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualog as Yuus, y achojo: Jafa na malefajao nu guajo? Jafa mina na tristeyo pot y chiniguit y enemigo?
pairs.english: I will ask God, my rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoja yan y espada gui telangjo, y enemigujo mamofeayo, anae ilegñija cada jaane nu guajo: Mano nae gaegue y Yuusmo?
pairs.english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilog jao, O antijo? yan jafa na, estotbajao gui jinalomjo? Nangga si Yuus, sa bae jutuna güe, ni y ayuda nu y matajo, yan y Yuusso.
pairs.english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUSGAYO, O Yuus, ya unsangan y mumujo contra y nasion ni y ti manjonggue: O coneyo gui manmandadague, yan y manaelaye na taotao.
pairs.english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago Yuus y ninasiñajo; jafa na unrechasa? ya fafa mina tristeyo pot y chiniguit y enemigo?
pairs.english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O tago y mananamo, yan y minagajetmo; ya uesgaejonyo: ya uchuleyo asta y santos na egsomo, yan y tabetnaculumo.
pairs.english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jujalom gui attat Yuus, y as Yuus nae gaegue y dangculon minagofjo; Ja jutuna jao yan y atpa, O Yuus, Yuusso.
pairs.english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilog jao, O antijo? yan jafa na estotba jao gui jinalomjo? Nangga si Yuus; sa bae jutuna güe, ni y inayuda nu y matajo, yan y Yuusso.
pairs.english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAME injingog ni y talanganmame, O Yuus, na jasanganejam y tantanmane, ni y finatinasmo gui tiemponñija, gui antiguo na tiempo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. > > We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nu y canaemoja unyute y nasion, ya unpolo sija; unnafantriste y taotao sija, ya unnafanjanao.
pairs.english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti inchile y tano pot espadanñija para iyonñija, ni ti unnafanlibre pot y canaeñija; lao y agapa na canaemo yan y canaemo, yan y minalag y matamo, sa unguaeya sija.
pairs.english: For they didn't get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y Rayjo, O Yuus: fanago linibre para si Jacob.
pairs.english: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jago na inyite papa y enemigonmame: pot y naanmo, na ingacha y mangajulo contra jame.
pairs.english: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti juangocoyo ni y flechaco, ni y espadajo ti ulibreyo.
pairs.english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago umadadajejam gui enemigonmame; ya y chumatliijam unnafanmamajlao.
pairs.english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gui as Yuus tatunanmaesa jit todot dia; ya para taejinecog, intina y naanmo.
pairs.english: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago unyute jam, ya unnafanmamajlaojam; ya ti jumanaojao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don't go out with our armies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbirajam tate guinin y enemigonmame; ya ayo sija y chumatliijam, manmañaque para sija namaesa.
pairs.english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take spoil for themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unpolojam taegüije y quinilo ni y para umacano; ya janafanmachalaponjam gui entalo y nasion.
pairs.english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbende y taotaomo pot taya; ya ti mumegae y güinajamo pot y balenñija.
pairs.english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmamajlaojam ni y tiguangmame; pot y manmanmofefea, yan manmanbotlelea ni y mangaegue gui oriyanmame.
pairs.english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmafa y sinanganjam gui entalo y nasion, pot y yinengyong y ilonñija gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y desenrajo gaegueja gui menajo todot dia; ya y minamajlao y matajo jatampe yo.
pairs.english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y inagang ayo y numanamamajlao, yan y chumatfino contra si Yuus; pot y enemigo yan y taotao ni y maneemog.
pairs.english: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo este manmato guiya jame; lao ti manmalelefajam nu jago, ni ti manmatinasjam mandague ni y tratumo.
pairs.english: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonmame ti inbira tate; ni y pinecatmame ti sumuja gui chalanmo.
pairs.english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja unyamagjam gui sagan y jacal sija, ya untampejam ni y aninen y finatae.
pairs.english: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin manmalefajam ni y naan Yuusmame, ya inestira y canaemame pot y otro Yuus;
pairs.english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti ualigaojam si Yuus? Sa jatungoja y secreton y corason.
pairs.english: won't God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junggan, pot y jago manmapunojam todo y inanaco y jaane; manmatufongjam taegüije y quinilo ni y para umapuno.
pairs.english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fagmata, jafajao na mamaego, Señot? Cajulo, chamojam yumuyute para siempre.
pairs.english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don't reject us forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa nae unnaatog y matamo, ya malefajao ni y pinitenmame yan y chiniguitmame.
pairs.english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antenmame esta dumilog gui petbos; ya y tiyanmame cheton papa gui tano.
pairs.english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
