pairs.chamorro: Cajulo ya unayudajam, ya unnafanlibrejam gui minaasemo.
pairs.english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo machúchuda nu y mauleg na güinaja; jusangan ayo sija y para y ray; y jilajo, calang y pluman y chadeg mangue.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. > > My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefpaguñajao qui y famaguon y taotao sija: y grasia machúchuda jalom gui labiosmo; enaomina binendisejao as Yuus, para taejinecog.
pairs.english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gode y espadamo gui cháchagamo, O gosbalente jao, yan y langetmo yan y minagasmo.
pairs.english: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y minagasmo sigue di mumegae, sa pot y minagajet, yan y minanso, yan tininas: ya y agapa na canaemo unfinanagüe ni y mannamaañao na güinaja.
pairs.english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y flechamo manacadedog; mamodong y taotao gui papamo; sija gaegue gui corason y enemigon y ray.
pairs.english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king's enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronumo taejinecog, yan taejinecog, O Yuus: y bariyan y raenomo, tunas na bariya.
pairs.english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeya y tininas, ya unchatlie y tinaelaye; enaomina si Yuus ni y Yuusmo, pinalaejao ni y lañan minagof, mas qui y mangachongmo.
pairs.english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: manjuyong sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaga sija y ray, mangaegue gui entalo y manonrada na famalaoanmo; ya y rayna matátachong gui agapamo yan y magaguña y oron Ofir.
pairs.english: Kings' daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog O jaga, jaso ya tecon y talangamo; ya unmalefa ni y mañataotaomo, yan y guima tatamo.
pairs.english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father's house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ugosmalago y ray ni y bonitamo; sa güiya y Señotmo yanguin unadora güe.
pairs.english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jagan Tiro yan y ninae ugaegue güije; asta y manrico gui entalo y taotao unmagaogao ni y fabotmo.
pairs.english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jagan y ray, gui palasyo gosbonita güe: y magaguña maadotna ni y oro.
pairs.english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Macone guato gui as ray, yan y magaguña ni y mabotda: y bitgen sija mangachongña ni y tumattitiye, sija unquinenie guato.
pairs.english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija machulilie guato yan minagof yan alegria: ufanjalom gui palasyon y ray.
pairs.english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king's palace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui lugat si tatamo, y ugaegae y famaguonmo; unnafanprinsipe gui todo y tano.
pairs.english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo junamajaso y naanmo gui todo y generasion sija: enaomina y taotao sija mannaejao grasias para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus, güiya y guinegüeta yan y minetgotta, enseguidas manayuda gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth.Alamoth is a musical term. > > God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mungajit manmaañao, achogaja ucalamten y tano, yan y egso umachule asta y talo gui tase sija;
pairs.english: Therefore we won't be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogaja manapangpang y janom ya chatsaga; achogaja umayeyengyong y egso sija, pot causa y minatatgaña. Sila.
pairs.english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayogüeja y sadog yan y minilalagña sija janamamagof y siuda Yuus; y santos na sagan y tabetnaculo guiya Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus gaegue gui entaloña; ti ucalamten; si Yuus uinayuda y ininan y egaan.
pairs.english: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manlalalo y nasion sija, ya mangalamten y raeno sija; umagang, ya maderite y tano.
pairs.english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjijita yan y Señot y inetnon sendalo. Y Yuus Jacob, güiya y guinegüeta. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya inlie y checho Jeova; Jafa na yinilang jafatinas gui jilo tano?
pairs.english: Come, see Yahweh's works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munabasta y guera, asta y uttimon y tano; jayulang y atcos, ya jautut y lansa; güiya sumonggue y caretan guera gui guafe.
pairs.english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Quieto, ya untungo na guajo si Yuus: jutaquilo gui entalo y nasion sija, jutaquilo gui tano.
pairs.english: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjijita yan y Señot y inetnon sendalo. Y Yuus Jacob, güiya y guinegüeta. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAFAMAGPAG y canaemiyo todo jamya na taotao; agang si Yuus ni y inagang guinana.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. > > Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova sentaquilo yan namaañao; Güiya mas dangculo na ray gui jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ugana todo y taotao ya upolo gui papata; yan y nasion sija gui papa adengta.
pairs.english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya umayig y erensiata ni y para jita: y minagas gui as Jacob ni y güinaeyaña. Sila.
pairs.english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus mapos julo yan y inagang, si Jeova yan y sonidon y trompeta.
pairs.english: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanganta tinina sija para si Yuus; fanganta tinina sija; fanganta tinina sija para y rayta, fanganta tinina sija.
pairs.english: Sing praise to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus güiya ray todo y tano: fanganta y tinina sija, yan y tiningo.
pairs.english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus mangobiebietna gui jilo y nasion sija; si Yuus matatachong gui tronon y sinantosña.
pairs.english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y prinsipen y taotao sija mandaña ufantaotao y Yuus Abraham; sa y patang y tano, iyon Yuus: Güiya y sentaquilo.
pairs.english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DANGCULO si Yuus, ya para umagueftuna, gui siuda y Yuusta, gui egso y sinantosña.
pairs.english: < < A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. > > Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bonito na sagayan, y minagof todo gui tano, y egso Sion gui sumanlago na banda, siuda y dangculo na ray.
pairs.english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus esta matungo gui jalom y palasyoña, na para y guinegüe.
pairs.english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa estagüe y ray sija na mandaña, manmalofan ya mandadañaja.
pairs.english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalie, ya luego ninafanmanman; ninafañatsaga, ya maninalulula manjanao.
pairs.english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mayengyong gumote sija güije; yan y pinite taegüije y palaoan yan para ufañago.
pairs.english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumamag y batcon Tarsis, ni y manglo sancatan.
pairs.english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y jiningogmame, taegüijeja liniimame gui siuda y Señot y inetnon sendalo; gui siuda y Yuusmame: si Yuus plumanta para taejinecog. Sila.
pairs.english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injaso y güinaeyamo, O Yuus, gui talo gui templomo.
pairs.english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y naanmo, O Yuus, taegüijeja y tininamo asta y uttimon y tano: y agapa na canaemo, bula ni y tininas.
pairs.english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namagof y egso Sion, yan sija jagan Juda ufanmagof; pot y jinisgamo sija.
pairs.english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Famocat gui Sion, ya unjanagüe y oriyaña; ya untufong y tore güije.
pairs.english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matca y colatña ni y munaseguguro, ya injaso y palasyoña; para usiña jamyo insangane y generasion ni y mamamaela.
pairs.english: Mark well her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este na Yuus, y Yuusta para taejinecog, yan taejinecog: güiya uesgaejonjit, asta y finataeta.
pairs.english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JINGOG este todo jamyo ni y taotao; ecungog jamyo todos ni y mañasaga. gui tano:
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. > > Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo todo mandaña, y managpapa, y managquilo, y manrico, yan y mamoble.
pairs.english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usangan y minalate; ya y jinason y corasonjo y tiningo.
pairs.english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juecungog y parabola; ya jubaba y jemjom sinanganjo gui atpa.
pairs.english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa na maañaoyo gui jaanen y tinaelaye, anae y tinaelayen y dedegoco jaoriyayayeyo?
pairs.english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y umangongoco sija ni y güinajañija, yan jatunanmaesaja ni y minegae y riniconñija;
pairs.english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya guiya sija siña umapasiye y cheluña, ni unae si Yuus ni y rumescata güe;
pairs.english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa y ninálibre y antinñija, dangculo presiuña, ya para upolu para siempre.)
pairs.english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ulâlâ asta y taejinecog, ya ti ulie minitong.
pairs.english: That he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jalie na y manmalate na taotao sija manmamataeja, y manaejinaso yan y manbababa, manmalingo, ya japolo y güinajañija para y palo.
pairs.english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinason y sumanjalomñija, na y guimañija usaga para taejinecog, ya y anae mañasaga na lugat para y todo generasion sija; ya jafanaan y tanoñija, ni y naanñijaja.
pairs.english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao ti sumaga gui onraña, parejoja yan y gâgâ na matae.
pairs.english: But man, despite his riches, doesn't endure. He is like the animals that perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y jinanaoñiñija, y binabanñiñijaja; ya anae esta manmapos, manmagof y taotao nu y sinanganñija. Sila.
pairs.english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanquinano gui naftan parejoja yan y manadan quinilo y finatae upinasto sija; ya y manunas mangaeninasiña gui jiloñija gui egaan; ya y boninituñija, para ulachae gui jalom naftan, sa taya sagaña.
pairs.english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol . Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol , far from their mansion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus unalibre y antijo gui ninasiñan y naftan; sa uresibeyo. Sila.
pairs.english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol , for he will receive me. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo maaañao, yanguin guaja taotao urico; yanguin y güinaja, y guimaña mumémegae;
pairs.english: Don't be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yanguin matae, taya uchule; y güinajaña, ti udinalalaggüe.
pairs.english: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away. His glory shall not descend after him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogaja anae lalâlâ, dichoso y antiña; sa matutunajao ni y taotao sija, yanguin unfamauleg mamaesajao.
pairs.english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul-- and men praise you when you do well for yourself--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujanao para y generasion tataña; ti ufanmanlie manana.
pairs.english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao ni y maoonra, ya ti matungo; parejoja yan y gâgâ ni y umatae.
pairs.english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus, junggan, si Yuus, si Jeova sumangan, ya jaagang y tano desde y quinajulo y atdao asta y tumunogña papa güije.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by Asaph. > > The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sumanjiyong Sion, gosbonito, sí Yuus umiina.
pairs.english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuusta ufato, ya ti ufamatquilo: y guafe ufanlinachae gui menaña, ya uguaja dangculon pinagyo gui oriyaña.
pairs.english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: uagang gui taquilo na langet yan y tano, para ujusga y taotaoña.
pairs.english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafandaña y mañantos guiya guajo; ayo sija y fumatinas y tratujo pot y inefrese.
pairs.english: "Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet udineclara y tininasña: sa si Yuus güiyaja y jues. Sila.
pairs.english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jingog, O taotaojo, ya jusangan; O Israel, ya bae jusangan testimonio contra jago: guajo si Yuus, ni si Yuusmo.
pairs.english: "Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti julalatde jao pot y inefresimo, ya y inefresimo sinenggue, para todo y jaane gui menajo.
pairs.english: I don't rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jufangone nubiyo gui guimamo, ni laje na chiba gui quelatmo.
pairs.english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y gâgâ gui jalom tano, gâjo, yan y gâgâ sija gui jilo y mit na sabana.
pairs.english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungo todo y pajaro gui jalom tano; y manmachaleg na gâgâ sija gui jalomtano; todo gâjo.
pairs.english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ñalangyo, ti jusanganejao; sa iyoco y tano, yan y sinajguanña.
pairs.english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchoco catnen nubiyo, pat jugui. men jâgâ chiba?
pairs.english: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Yuus inefresen grasia; ya unapase y promesamo gui Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unagangyo gui jaanen y chinatsaga: junalibrejao, ya siempre unonrayo.
pairs.english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña si Yuus ni y manaelaye; Jafa unfatinas para undeclara y tina. gojo, pat jagas unchule y tratujo gui pachotmo?
pairs.english: But to the wicked God says, "What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago unchatlie y finanagüe, ya unyute y sinanganjo gui tatemo.
pairs.english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae unlie y saque, undalalag güe; yan jagas gaepattejao yan y manábale.
pairs.english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unnasetbe y pachotmo gui tae laye, ya y jilamo fumatitinas ocodon dinague.
pairs.english: "You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matátachongjao, ya cumuecuentosjao contra y chelumo; undesonra y lajin nanamo.
pairs.english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother's son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija finatinasmo, lao mamatquiquilojayo: jinasomo na parejojitja: lao bae julalatdejao, ya jupolo tinaelayemo sija gui menan matamo.
pairs.english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jaso este, jamyo ni y manmalefa as Yuus; na noseaja jusisi jamyo ya jufapidasos, ya taya unalibre.
pairs.english: "Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be none to deliver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y numaeyo inefresen tinina, jaonrayo; ya ayo y munatutunas y sinanganña, jufanue ni y satbasion Yuus.
pairs.english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God's salvation to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus, jaftaemanoja y minauleg güinaeyamo, jaftaemanoja y minegae y minaasemo; fuñas y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. > > Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosfagaseyo todo ni y tinaelayeco, ya unnagasgasyo ni y isaojo.
pairs.english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungoja y tinaelayeco: ya y isaojo gaegueja siempre gui menajo.
pairs.english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa contra jago, jagoja, juisagüe, ya jufatinas y daño gui menan matamo: para utunas yanguin cumuentosjao, ya utaefatta yanguin manjusgajao.
pairs.english: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, na mafatinasyo gui tinaelaye, yan y isao nae si nanajo mumapotguenaejonyo.
pairs.english: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, na unguaeya y magajet guiya jalolom; ya y umatog na lugat nae unnatungoyo ni y tiningo.
pairs.english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nagasgasyo ni hisopo, ya jumuyong gasgas: fagaseyo ya jumuyong apacaña, qui y niebe.
pairs.english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjungogyo minagof yan y alegria para ufanmagof y telangjo ni y unyamag.
pairs.english: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naatog y matamo gui isaojo; ya unfunas todo y inechongjo.
pairs.english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas gui sumanjalomjo y gasgas na corason, O Yuus; ya unnanuebo y tinas na espiritu gui sumanjalomjo.
pairs.english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo yumuyuteyo gui menamo; yan chamo chumuchule y santos na Espiritumo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Don't throw me from your presence, and don't take your holy Spirit from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natalo mague guiya guajo y minagof y satbasionmo: ya unmantieneyo ni y libre na Espiritumo.
pairs.english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jufanagüe y manaelaye ni y chalanmo: ya y maniisao ufanmañotsot guiya jago.
pairs.english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui isao gui jâgâ, O Yuus, jago Yuus y satbasinojo; ya y jilajo ucanta agang ni y tininasmo.
pairs.english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, baba y labiosso: ya y pachotto ufamanue ni y matunamo.
pairs.english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti yamo inefrese para junaejao; ti magofjao ni y inefresen sinenggue.
pairs.english: For you don't delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inefrese para si Yuus, manmayamag na espiritu: y mayamag yan y pinite na corason, O Yuus, jago siempre ti undespresia.
pairs.english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas mauleg, ni y minauleg minagofmo, guiya Sion; fatinas y quelat Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae unmagof ni y inefresen tininas, y inefresen sinenggue yan y cabales na inefresen sinenggue: Ayo nae unmaofrese nubiyo gui attatmo.
pairs.english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAFA na tunanmaesajao gui inacacha, O matatnga na taotao? y minaasen Yuus sumasagaja cada jaane siempre.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, "David has come to Abimelech's house." > > Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God's loving kindness endures continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jilamo fumatitinas ocodon y taelaye: parejo yan y malagtos na inabajan batbas, machochoeho dinague.
pairs.english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeyaña y daño mas qui y mauleg; yan y mandague, mas qui cumuentos ni y tininas. Sila.
pairs.english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeya todo y mannanataelaye na sinangan: O, dacon na jula.
pairs.english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus unyinilang locue para taejinecog; unquinene, ya unjinala juyong gui guimamo magago; ya unjinale juyong gui tano y lalâlâ. Sila.
pairs.english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ilegñija:
pairs.english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, yuje na taotao y ti japolo si Yuus para minetgotña: lao jaangoco güe ni y manadan güinajaña, ya janametgot güe ni y tinaelayeña.
pairs.english: "Behold, this is the man who didn't make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, parejoyo yan y betde na troncon oliba gui jalom guimayuus; juangongocoyo ni y minaase Yuus para taejinecog, yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God's house. I trust in God's loving kindness forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junaejao grasias, para taejinecog, sa unfatinas este; ya junangga y naanmo, sa este mauleg; gui menan y mañantosmo.
pairs.english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ILEGÑA y taetiningo gui corasonña: Taya Yuus. Manpotlilo sija, mafatinas y chatliion na tinaelaye; taya ni uno ni fumatitinas mauleg.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Mahalath." A contemplation by David. > > The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus gui langet tumalag pápapa y famaguon taotao sija; para ulie cao guaja gaetiningo, ni y umaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todos sija manalo tate; ya manjuyong potlilo sija; taya ni uno ni fumatitinas y mauleg, aje, taya ni uno.
pairs.english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya tiningoñija ni chumogüe inechong? ni y macano y taotaojo sija, taegüije yan mañochocho pan: ya ti maagang si Yuus.
pairs.english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don't call on God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangosmanmaañao sija gui anae taya minaañao: sa si Yuus janafanmachapon adisapatta y telang ayo y tumotojgue contra jago; jago jagas unnafanmamajlao, sa si Yuus manrenechasa sija.
pairs.english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, na y satbasion Israel mojon ujuyong guiya Sion! anae si Yuus janatalo y quinautiba y taotaoña; ayo nae umagof si Jacob, yan ufanmagof y Israel.
pairs.english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SATBAYO, O Yuus, pot y naanmo, ya unjusgayo pot y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Isn't David hiding himself among us?" > > Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y tinaetaejo, O Yuus; ecungog y sinangan y pachotto.
pairs.english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao juyong sija mangajulo contra guajo, yan y taotao ni y fijon y minatatgañija maaliligao y antijo; sija jagasja ti japopolo si Yuus gui menanñija. Sila.
pairs.english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven't set God before them. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na si Yuus umayuyudayo; si Jeova mañisija yan ayo y mumantietene y antijo.
pairs.english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uapase taelaye y enemigujo sija; yulang sija gui minagajetmo.
pairs.english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa inefresijo ni y minalagojo bae junaejao; bae jualaba y naanmo, O Jeova, sa mauleg.
pairs.english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munalibreyo todo gui chinatsaga: sa y atadogjo jagasja jalie y minalagojo contra y enemigujo.
pairs.english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y tinaetaejo, O Yuus: ya chamo umaatog maesa jao gui guinagaojo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. > > Listen to my prayer, God. Don't hide yourself from my supplication.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atituyeyo, ya opeyo: sa inestotbayo gui trinistieco, ya umugongyo;
pairs.english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y inagang y enemigo: sa pot y chiniguit y manaelaye; sa mayute y tinaelaye gui jilojo, ya pot y biniboñija, na machatliiyo, japetsigueyo.
pairs.english: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo gospute gui sumanjalomjo: yan y minaañao y finatae podong gui jilojo.
pairs.english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Minaañao yan linaolao, manmato guiya guajo; y linijan ñumoñoyo.
pairs.english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegco: O mojon yanguin gaepapayo, taegüije y paluma! ayo nae jugupo chago, ya judescansa.
pairs.english: I said, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, ayo nae jujanao chago, ya jusaga gui jalomtano. Sila.
pairs.english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mojon bae jualula malag y guinegüe, guinin y duron manglo yan y pinagyo.
pairs.english: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yulang, O Jeova, ya ipe y jilañija; sa jagasja julie y fijom na manaelaye, ya y manmanpotfifia gui siuda.
pairs.english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaane yan puenge manjajanao gui sumanjilo y quelatña: inechong yan inacacha mangaegue gui entaloña.
pairs.english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaelaye mangaegue gui entaloña; chiniguit yan dinague ti usuja gui chalanña.
pairs.english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don't depart from her streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti y enemigo lumalatdeyo; ayo nae siña jusungon; ni ti ayo y chumatliiyo ni y munadangculo güe contra guajo: ayo nae junaatog maesayo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jagoja, un taotao, ni y parejujo, yan y gachongjo, yan y senjuguflie na amigujo.
pairs.english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamis na inangoco manasangane jam y jinasonmame; ya tafanmamocat yan linajyan taotao gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God's house with company.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya derepente ufanchinile ni y finatae: polosija ya ufansinetta papa manlalâlâ guiya sasalaguan; sa guaja y manaelaye gui sagañija yan y sanjalomñija.
pairs.english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol . For wickedness is in their dwelling, in their midst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, bae juagang si Yuus; ya si Jeova usatbayo.
pairs.english: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pupuenge, ogaan, yan taloane, jufanjaso ya juagang duro, ya güiya ujungog y inaganjo.
pairs.english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jagasja munalibre y antijo qui pas, guinin y guera ni y comontrayo: sa megae pumotfifia yo.
pairs.english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ufaninjingog, ya ufaninepe sija; asta ayo y mañasaga desde y apmam na tiempo. Sila. Ti taotao sija ni siempre jatulaeca, ya ti manmaañao as Yuus.
pairs.english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don't fear God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaestira mona y canaeña contra ayo sija ni y manpas guiya güiya: jayulang y tratuña.
pairs.english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sinangan y pachotña palagseña qui y mantica, lao guera gui jalom corasonña; y sinanganña mananana qui y laña; lao puro ayo sija espada in malagnos.
pairs.english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y catgamo gui as Jeova, ya güiya uminantiene; sa taya nae jasotta y manunas ya umanacalamten.
pairs.english: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Yuus, ufansinetta sija papa gui joyon finatae; sa y manmejgá, yan manfáfababa na taotao sija, ti ufanlâlâ ni lamita gui jaaniñija; lao guajo juangocoyo nu jago.
pairs.english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus; sa y taotao malago na ujapañotyo; mumumo todot dia, ya jachichiguityo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. > > Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todot dia y enemigujo manmalago na ujapañotyo; sa megae mamumujo ya mansobetbio.
pairs.english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja na tiempo nae maañaoyo, juangocojayo guiya jago.
pairs.english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus jualaba y finoña; gui as Yuus nae jagasja jupolo y inangococo, ti maañaoyo; jafa ufatinas y catne guiya guajo?
pairs.english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todot dia mabira y sinanganjo; sa todo y jinasoñija contra guajo para tinaelaye.
pairs.english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandaña ya manatog maesasija; ya magueguesatituye y pinecatjo, anae jagas mananangga sija y antijo.
pairs.english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanescapa nu y tinaelaye? gui binibo nae unyute papa y taotao sija, O Yuus.
pairs.english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago sumangan y jinanaojo; polo gui jalom boteyamo y lagojo: manaegüe sija gui leblomo?
pairs.english: You number my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren't they in your book?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae, ujabira sija tate y enemigujo y jaane nae juagangjao; este jutungo, na si Yuus para guajo.
pairs.english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus jualaba y finoña: gui as Jeova jualaba y finona.
pairs.english: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus nae jagasja jupolo y inangococo; ya siempre ti jumaañao; jafa y taotao ufatinas guiya guajo?
pairs.english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y promesamo gaegue guiya guajo, O Yuus: ya juapasejao siempre ni y inefresen grasias.
pairs.english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja unnalibre y antijo gui finatae; ti siempre unnalibre y adengjo an podong? para jufamocat gui menan Yuus gui candet y manlálâlâ.
pairs.english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus, gaease nu guajo; sa y antijo guinegüe güe guiya jago: magajet, y anineng y papamo ugogüeyo asta qui manmalofan y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. > > Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juagang si Yuus Gueftaquilo; si Yuus ni y jafatinas todo y güinaja para guajo.
pairs.english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanago guinin y langet ya unalibreyo; anae jalalatde ayo y malago pumañotyo. Sila. Si Yuus utago y minaaseña yan y minagajetña.
pairs.english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo gaegue gui entalo y león sija: ya umaasonyo gui entalo ayo sija y minañila guafe, junggan, yan y lalajin taotao sija ni y nifenñija y lansa sija, yan flecha sija, ya y jilañija malagtos na espada.
pairs.english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao gui jilo y langet, O Yuus; polo y inenramo todo gui sanjilo tano.
pairs.english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagas mamatinas laso, para y pinecatto; y antijo tumecon papa; jagas manmaguadog joyo gui menajo; ya sija mamodong maesaja gui taloloja. Sila.
pairs.english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into its midst themselves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo, esta meton, O Yuus, y corasonjo esta meton; bae jucanta, magajetja, jucanta alabansa sija.
pairs.english: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fagmata, inenrajo; fagmata, guitala yan atpa; guajoja na maesa magmatayo taftaf.
pairs.english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, psaltery and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junaetjao grasias, O Jeova, gui entalo y taotao sija; jucantayejao alabansa sija gui entalo y nasion sija.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa asta y langet, dangculo y minaasemo, yan asta y mapagajes y minagajetmo.
pairs.english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao gui jilo y langet, O Yuus; polo y minalagmo todo gui sanjilo y tano.
pairs.english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: anae debe de sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David. > > Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, na y jalom corason nae manmachochocho jamyo tinaelaye; intajlang gui canaenmiyo y tinaelaye gui tano.
pairs.english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye, manaotao juyong desde y jalom tuyan: enseguidas qui manmafañago, manabag manguecuentos ni y mandague.
pairs.english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y binenoñija, parejo yan y binenon y culebbla: sija parejo yan y tangan y serpiente, ni y jajuchum talangaña;
pairs.english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jaecungog y inagang y encantador, ni y gosfaye manencanta.
pairs.english: which doesn't listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yamag y nifenñija gui jalom pachotñija, O Yuus: yamag juyong y dangculo na nifen y patgon leon, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmadirite taegüije y janom ni y malalagoja gui iyoña: anae jaachechetgüe y flechaña, polo ya calang manutut.
pairs.english: Let them vanish as water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya utaegüije y acaleja ni y madirite ya umalofan: taegüije y taetiempo na mañagon palaoan, ni y ti guinin lumilie y atdao.
pairs.english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: guafen y sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ufanmagof yanguin jalilie y inemog; ufagase y adengña gui jâgâ y taelaye.
pairs.english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ualog y taotao: Magajet na guaja apasñija y manunas: magajet guaja si Yuus ni y manjujusga gui tano.
pairs.english: so that men shall say, "Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NALIBREYO gui enemigujo sija, O Yuusso; polo yo gui jilo guinin ayosija ni y mangajujulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. > > Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui chumogüe y tinaelaye, ya satbayo gui manmejga na taotao sija.
pairs.english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, na mananangga y antijo: y manmetgot mandaña contra guajo; ti pot y tinaelayeco, ni ti pot y isaojo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalago ya japrepara sija, sin y linachijo; fagmata, ya unayudayo, ya unlie.
pairs.english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, si Yuus Israel; fagmata ya unbisita todo y nasion sija; chamo gagaease ni y manaelaye. Sila.
pairs.english: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manalo guato yan pupuenge: ya manboruruca taegüije y galago, ya malilicucue y siuda.
pairs.english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Liija, sa mannutugap juyong guinin y pachotñija: espada sija guaja gui jalom labiosñija; jaye, ilegñiñija, cao jajungog?
pairs.english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, "For," they say, "who hears us?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, siempre unchatgue sija; siempre unmofea todo y nasion.
pairs.english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O minetgotto, junanangga jao; sa si Yuus y guimajo lumijing.
pairs.english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuusso nu y minaaseña, ugaegue gui menajo: si Yuus unaliiyo y minalagojo, gui jilo y enemigujo sija.
pairs.english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumupuno sija, sa trabia ti manmalelefa y taotaojo; chalapon sija pot y ninasiñamo; ya unchule sija papa, O Jeova, patangmame.
pairs.english: Don't kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y isao y pachotñija, yan pot y sinangan y labiosñija, polo ya ufanmacone, pot y sobetbioñija: yan pot y matdision, yan manmandadague ni y sinanganñija.
pairs.english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lachae sija ni y binibumo, lachae sija, para sija ti ufangaegue talo: ya ujatungo na si Yuus mangobiebietna gui as Jacob, asta y uttimon y tano. Sila.
pairs.english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya an pupuenge, polo ya ufanalo guato, ya unfanboruca taegüije y galago ya umalilicue y siuda.
pairs.english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjajanao julo yan papa, ya ufanmanaliligao nañija; ya usaga todo puenge yanguin ti manjaspog.
pairs.english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren't satisfied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, jucanta ni y ninasiñamo; magajet, na jucanta agang ni y minaasemo yan ogaan; sa guinin jago y guimajo lumijing, yan y guinegüeco gui jaanen chinatsagaco.
pairs.english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O minetgotjo, jucantaye y alabansa sija; sa si Yuus y guimajo lumijing, yan y Yuus y minaasejo.
pairs.english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago yumutejam, jago gumapotjam papa; guinin lalalojao; O, natalojam guato.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lily of the Covenant." A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. > > God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jagasja munamayengyong y tano; jago yumulang; nafanjomlo y yinilangña sija, sa manmayeyengyong.
pairs.english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unfanue y taotaomo sija ni y manmajetog na güinaja; unnafanguimenjam ni y binon na matulalaejon.
pairs.english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnae ayo sija ni y manmaañao nu jago, un bandera para ujatsa pot y minagajet. Sila.
pairs.english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa para ufanlibre y güinaeyamo; satba ni y agapa na canaemo, yan opejam.
pairs.english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
