pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus sumangan y sinantosña; siempre jumagof; ya siempre judibide iya Siquem, ya jumide y bayen Sucot.
pairs.english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Iyoco Galaad, ya iyoco Manases: Efraim y guinegüe y ilujo; Juda y baston minagasso.
pairs.english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Moab, y palanggana para jufagagaseyo; y jilo Edom nae juyute y sapatosso: Filistia, agangjao pot guajo.
pairs.english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye uchinileyo guato gui fitme na siuda? jaye uesgaejonyo guato Edom?
pairs.english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mungajao, O Yuus, ni y guinin yumutejam? yan jago, O Yuus, ti jumanao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: Haven't you, God, rejected us? You don't go out with our armies, God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam inayuda contra y contrario gui chinatsaga; sa taebale y inayudan taotao.
pairs.english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin as Yuus nae infatinas y minatatnga; sa güiyaja ni ugacha papa y contrarionmame.
pairs.english: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y inaganjo, O Yuus; atituye y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. > > Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y uttimon y tano juagang jao, anae taeninasiña y corasonjo: chalaneyo asta y acho ni y mas taquilo qui guajo.
pairs.english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago guinin y guinegüeco, yan y guiman lumijing guinin y enemigo.
pairs.english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusaga gui jalom y tabetnaculumo para taejinecog: ya jugogüeyo gui tinampen y papamo. Sila.
pairs.english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago O Yuus guinin jumungog y promesajo; jago guinin numaeyo ni y erensian ayo sija y manmaañao ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munaanaco y jaanin y ray; y sacanña taegüije y megae na generasion sija.
pairs.english: You will prolong the king's life; his years shall be for generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Usaga gui menan Yuus para taejinecog: O, nalisto y güinaeya yan y minagajet, para ufanadaje güe.
pairs.english: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jucantaye y naanmo para taejinecog, para jufatinas y prinimetijo cada jaane.
pairs.english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo janananggaja si Yuus; sa guinin güiya nae mamaela y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthan. A Psalm by David. > > My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiyaja y achojo yan y satbasionjo, güiya y torejo taquilo: ya ti megae jumanacalamten.
pairs.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress-- I will never be greatly shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaen nae intigong contra unoja taotao? todos jamyo infanmapuno; taegüije y padet ni y cumba, yan taegüije y matomba na colat.
pairs.english: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manafaesenja gui entaloñija na umayute papa gui ninasiñaña: manmagof ni y dinague sija: manmanbendidise ni y pachotñija, lao manmanmatdidise qui sumanjalomñija.
pairs.english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus nanggajao, O antijo; sa guinin güiya y ninanggaco.
pairs.english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiyaja y achojo yan y satbasionjo; güiya y torejo taquilo, ya ti jumanacalamten.
pairs.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus nae gaegue y satbasionjo yan y minalagjo; y acho y minetgotjo yan y guinegüeco mangaegue gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angoco gue todo y tiempo, jamyo ni y taotao sija; chuda y corasonmiyo gui menaña: si Yuus y guinegüe para jita. Sila.
pairs.english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Seguro todo y taotao sija ni y umitde condisioñija manjinaja; ya y managquilo condisioñija, un dinague; yanguin manmapolo gui balansa, todos manñajlalangña qui y jinaja.
pairs.english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo umangongoco jao gui inamot, yan chamo na gagaebale y sinaque: yanguin y güinaja manlalamegae; chamo pumópolo y corasonmo guiya sija.
pairs.english: Don't trust in oppression. Don't become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don't set your heart on them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin jasangan si Yuus un biaje; ya dos biaje jagasja jujungog este; na y ninasiña iyon Yuus.
pairs.english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyomoja locue Jeova y minaase: sa unapapaseja cada taotao jaftaemano y chechonâ.
pairs.english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago y Yuusso; taftaf jualigao jao; y antijo majo pot jago, y catneco majalang nu jago, gui anglo an majo na tano, anae taya janom;
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. > > God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije juatan jao gui templo para julie y ninasiñamo yan y minlagmo.
pairs.english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mauleg güinaeyamo maulegña qui y linâlâ; y labiosso ualabajao.
pairs.english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine jubendise jao gui linâlâjo; ya jujatsa julo y canaejo ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo ujaspog taegüije y ujaspog ni y titanos an montica; ya y pachotjo ualabajao yan y minagof y labiosso.
pairs.english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jujaso jao gui jilo camajo; ya y jinasoco nu jago gui ora nae bumebelayo an puenge.
pairs.english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago guinin umayudayo; enaomina y anineng y papamo nae jumagof.
pairs.english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo dangculo na tinatitiye jao: y agapa na canaemo mumantieteneyo.
pairs.english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija y umaliligao y antijo, para umayulang, sija ufanjanao para y mas tadong na joyo gui tano.
pairs.english: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmaentrega gui jinilat y espada; sija ugüinaja para y sora sija.
pairs.english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y ray umagof gui as Yuus; ya todo y manmanjula pot güiya unfanmagof: sa y pachot ayo sija y manmandadague ufanmajuchom.
pairs.english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y inagangjo, O Yuus, gui quejaco: adaje y linâlâjo ni y minaañaoña ni y enemigo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naatogyo gui secreto na pinagat y manaelaye; yan y inatborota ni y chumogüe y taelaye.
pairs.english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y janafanmalagtos y jilañija taegüije y espada, yan janafanapunta y flechañija, ni manmalaet na sinangan.
pairs.english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujaflecha gui secreto y cabales; ya derepente manflecha güe, ya ti maañao.
pairs.english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanfitmeja sija gui na jinasuye taelaye: manmanafaesen para ujananaplinanta y laso; ya ilegñija: Jaye ufanlinie?
pairs.english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanaliligao ni y tinaelaye; ilegñija na tacumple guse y inaligaota: cada uno guiya sija manacjalom jinasonñija yan corasonñija manadong.
pairs.english: They plot injustice, saying, "We have made a perfect plan!" Surely man's mind and heart are cunning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus flumecha sija, ya enseguidas ninafanlamen nu y flecha.
pairs.english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije ninafanmatompo; y jilañija contra sija; ya todo y lumie sija ujayengyong y ilonñija.
pairs.english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija ufanmaañao; ya ujasangan y checho Yuus: sa ujaguesjaso y finatinasña.
pairs.english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ufanmagof sija gui as Jeova, ya ujaangoco nu güiya; yan todo y manunas na corason, ufanmalag.
pairs.english: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinina unanangga jao guiya Sion, O Yuus; iya jago nae umapase y promesa.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. > > Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jago ni y jumungog y utinaetae, todo y catne ufanmato guiya jago.
pairs.english: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaganayo y tinaelaye sija; lao y isaomame, jago umasie.
pairs.english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y unayeg, ya unnaguaguato guiya jago, para usaga gui sagamo: manjaspogjam ni y minauleg y guimamo, asta y santos na lugat gui templomo.
pairs.english: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y namaañao na güinaja nae unopejam gui tininas; O Yuus y satbasionmame; jago y ninangga gui uttimon puntan tano todo, yan asta todo ayo sija y manlachago, ni y mangaegue gui jilo y tase.
pairs.english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y pot ninasiñaña japlanta seguro y egso, madudog ni y ninasiñaña;
pairs.english: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: janafanbasta sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija ni y mañasaga gui uttimon tano, manmaañao ni señatmo: unnamagof y jumuyong y egaan yan y pupuenge.
pairs.english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning's dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumisita y tano yan unriega; unnagosrico; y sadog Yuus bula janom: unnafanmauleg y maies para sija yanguin esta unnalisto y tano taegüije.
pairs.english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafangosbula janom y sutcoñija: unnafitme a pujañija güije; ya unnamañaña ni y ichan; ya unbendise y sinisoñija.
pairs.english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uncorona y sacan sija ni y minaulegmo; ya y finaposmo manutujo y mantica.
pairs.english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manutujo gui jilo y pastaje sija gui desierto: ya y mandiquique na sabana madudog ni y minagof.
pairs.english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pastaje sija manminagago ni y manadan gâgâ; y baye sija locue mantinampe ni y maies; manesalao ni y minagofñija, ya mangacanta locue.
pairs.english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FATINAS y minagof na inagang gui as Yuus todo y tano.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. > > Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Canta y minagof gui naanña: namalag y tininaña.
pairs.english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alog as Yuus: jafa na manámaañao y chechomo: pot y dinangculon y ninasiñamo uninaseja y contrarionmo papa.
pairs.english: Tell God, "How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y tano umadodorajao yan macantatayejao: yan macantataye y naanmo. Sila.
pairs.english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya inlie y checho Yuus: na ninámaañao y chechoña gui jilo y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Come, and see God's deeds-- awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatolaeca y tase y anglo na tano: ya japocacate y sadog: ya ayo nae manmagofjam nu güiya.
pairs.english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jagobiebietna ni y minetgotña para taejinecog: y atadogña pumupulan y nasion sija: ya munga y managuaguat na ujajatsa sija. Sila.
pairs.english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don't let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanbendise ni y Yuusta jamyo ni y taotao ya namajungog y inagang y tininaña:
pairs.english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y mumantiene y antita gui linâlâ: ya ti japolo y adengta na usulong.
pairs.english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn't allow our feet to be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago chumaguejam, O Yuus; jagasja unchague jam taegüije y salape an machague.
pairs.english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumulejam gui jalom y laso: unpolo chinatsaga na catga gui sinturanmame.
pairs.english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago namaudae y taotao guijilomame: jame infaposgüe y guafe an y janom: lao unchulejam asta y jalom y rico na sagayan.
pairs.english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujalom gui jalom guimamo yan y sinenggue na inefrese sija: ya bae juapase jao ni y promesajo,
pairs.english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y labiosso sumangan, yan y pachotto jagas cumuentos anae estabayo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junaejao sinenggue na inefrese ni y yemog yan paopao na tatneron quinilo: bae junaejao nobiyo yan chiba sija. Sila.
pairs.english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya injingong, todo ayo y manmañao as Yuus, ya bae jusangane jamyo jafa finatinasña ni y antijo.
pairs.english: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo juagang güe ni y pachotto: ya güiya umaalaba ni y jilajo.
pairs.english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jumantiene y tinaelaye gui corasonjo, si Jeova ti ujungogyo.
pairs.english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn't have listened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao magajet na si Yuus jajungog: güiya umadaje y inagang y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Yuus, sa ti jabira y tinaetaejo ni y minaaseña guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, gaease ni jame ya unbendisejam: yan janafanmalag y mataña gui jilomame. Sila.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. > > May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña matungo y chalanmo gui jilo y tano yan y satbasionmo gui nasion todos:
pairs.english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taotao ya umatuna jao, O Yuus: polo y taotao todo ya umatuna.
pairs.english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, polo y nasion sija ya ufanmagof yan ufanganta ni y minagof: sa jago siempre jumusga y taotao gui tininas yan ungobietna y nasion sija gui jilo y tano. Sila.
pairs.english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taotao ya umatuna jao, O Yuus: polo y taotao todo ya umatuna.
pairs.english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tano jagasja unajuyong megae tinegchaña: ya si Yuus ni y Yuusta ubendisejit.
pairs.english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ubendisejit: yan todo y uttimon y tano umaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: POLO si Yuus ya ucajulo, polo y enimiguña ya ufanmachalapon: polo ayo sija y chumatlie güe ya ufanmalago gui menaña.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. > > Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y manajanao y aso, taegüijeja yute sija: taegüije y maderite y danges gui menan guafe, taegüijeja manmalingoñija y manaelaye gui menan Yuus.
pairs.english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manunas ufansénmagof: ufansenalegre gui menan Yuus: magajet ya usendangculo y minagofñija.
pairs.english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Yuus, cantaye alabansa sija y naanña: nacajulo y chalan para ayo na maudae y inanaco y desierto sija; y naanña, si Yah ya fansenmagof gui menaña.
pairs.english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tatan y manaetata ya y jues para y manbiuda, si Yuus gui sinantos na sagaña.
pairs.english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus munafañaga y taeparientes gui familia sija: güiya chumule juyong preso para umegae: lao y managuaguat mañagaja gui anglo na tano.
pairs.english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, mientras unjanao gui menan y taotao; mientras na unfamocat gui inanaco desierto. Sila.
pairs.english: God, when you went forth before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano mayeyengyong, y langet locue manutujo gui menan Yuus: ayo iya Sinae mayengyong gui menan Yuus, ni si Yuus guiya Israel.
pairs.english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai-- at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Yuus, tumago megae na uchan, yan jago munafitme y erensiamo na taotao anae yayas.
pairs.english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inetnon taotaomo mañaga güije: jago, O Yuus, fumamauleg y minaulegmo para y mamoble.
pairs.english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jananae ni finijo: yan mandangculo ayo na inetnon famalaoan ni y munamatungo:
pairs.english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ray sija y inetnon sendalo falago chadig: ya güiya palaoan ni y sumasaga iya sija mafacae y inamot na güinaja.
pairs.english: "Kings of armies flee! They flee!" She who waits at home divides the spoil,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmalago jamyo dumescansa gui quelat quinilo; calang y papan y paluma nii platiao, yan y piluña nii amariyo calang oro.
pairs.english: while you sleep among the campfires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ayo todo janasiña manafanmachalapon y ray sija guiya güiya: taegüije anae mamodong nieve guiya Salmón.
pairs.english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egso Yuus y egso Basán: y gostaquilo na ogso y egso Basán.
pairs.english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa na manaatansegüet, jamyo nii manaquilo na osgo guato gui egso güinaeyan Yuus para sagaña: magajet na si Jeova sumaga güije para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y caretan Yuus y viente mil, junggan, miyares yan miyares ya si Jeova gui entaloñija taegüije iya Sinae, iya santos na sagaña.
pairs.english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jao cajulo iya jululo, jagas uncone y mamacautiba na megae: jagas unresibe ninae sija entre taotao sija: magajet entre y managuaguat locue, para si Jeova Yuus usiña sumaga gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si, Jeova nii todo y jaane jaencatga y catgata, junggan, ayo y Yuus y satbasionta. Sila.
pairs.english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus güiya si Yuus satbasion para jita: ya y jinanao guinin y finatae iyon Jeova, Señot.
pairs.english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus janafanlamen y ilon y enimiguña yan y cácagong y manmipe ayo y sisigueja gui isaoña.
pairs.english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova ilegña: Bae chule talo guinin Basán, bae chule sija talo, guinin y tádodong na tase.
pairs.english: The Lord said, "I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y adengmo siña umanaatunog gui jâgâ ya y jila y gamo galago siña patten y enimigumo.
pairs.english: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija jalie y jinanaomo, O Yuus; magajet y jinanao y Yuusso, Rayjo gui sinantos na sagaña.
pairs.english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mangacanta manjajanao gui menan, y mandadangdang yan y dandanñija jatatituye; y entaloñija y donseya sija ni y mandadangdang nii pandireta.
pairs.english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanbendise si Yuus gui jalom y inetnon taotao; junggan, jamyo y tutujonña guiya Israel.
pairs.english: "Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae estaba y diquique as Benjamin y magasñija, y prinsipen Juda yan y compañia apapagat, y prinsipen Sabulon yan y prinsipen Neftali.
pairs.english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuusmo tumago y minetgotmo; O Yuus, nametgot y chechomo para jame.
pairs.english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot causa y templomo guiya Jerusalem, y ray sija manmañuñule ninae sija para jago.
pairs.english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lalatde y dadao na gâgâ gui piao, y manadan nobiyo yan y tatneron gataotao, nii guinocha papa adengñija y pedason salape sija: jochalapon ayosija taotao nii manmalago manguera.
pairs.english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmato y prinsipe sija guinin Egipto: Etiopia guse ujaestira y canaeña gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Yuus jamyo nii raenon tano; O canta tinina para y Señot. Sila.
pairs.english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ayo y maudae gui jilo y langet y langet sija, nii guinin ampman na tiempo; estagüe na güiya masangan nii inagang; nii gaeninasiña na inagang.
pairs.english: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan y minetgot Yuus: y minagasña gaegue gui jilo Israel, yan y minetgotña gaegue gui jalom y mapagages.
pairs.english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, ninamaañaojao gui santos na sagamo sija: y Yuus Israel, güiya numae minetgot yan ninasiña y taotaoña: Bendito si Yuus.
pairs.english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NALIBREYO, O Yuus; sa y janom manjalom asta y antijo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Lilies." By David. > > Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magñoyo gui tadong na luño; anae ti siñayo tumojgue: guajo mato y jalom tadong na janom anae y milag malofan gui jilojo.
pairs.english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yayasyo ni y inagangjo: y agagajo ninaanglo: y atadogco linálachae mientras junanangga si Yuusso.
pairs.english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija y chumatliiyo pot taya, megaeña qui y gapotulo gui ilujo: ayosija y manmalago umututyo nii enemigujo sin jafa na linache, mangaeninasiña: ayo nae guajo junatalo guato ayo y taya nae juchuleguan.
pairs.english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn't take away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago tumungo y taetiningojo: yan y isaojo sija ti junaatog guiya jago.
pairs.english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo ayo sija y numananggajao munafanmamamajlao pot guajo, O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo: chamo ayo sija y umaliligaojao umadesonra pot guajo, O Yuus Israel.
pairs.english: Don't let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don't let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot jago jupadese y linalatde: minamajlao tumampe y matajo.
pairs.english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin manataotao juyong yo nii mañelujo; yan taotao juyongyo gui famaguon nanajo.
pairs.english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother's children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y inigo y guimamo cumanoyo: ya y linalatdeñija y ayo sija nii lumalatde jao manbasnag guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae tumangesyo ya junamajalang y antijo pot ti chumocho, este y para malalatdeco.
pairs.english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jufatinas y luto para magagujo, jumuyongyo un cuentos nu sija.
pairs.english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y manmatatachong gui petta, manadingan contra guajo: ya guajo y cantasionñija anae mangacanta y manbulacho.
pairs.english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajoja, y tinaetaejo guiya jago, O Jeova, gui tiempon y finaboresemo: O Yuus, pot y minegae y minaasemo opeyo gui minagajet y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui liño ya chajo mamagño: polo ya ulibreyo güije sija nii chumatliiyo, yan gui y tinadong y janom sija.
pairs.english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don't let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo y minilalag na janom na ufalofan gui jilojo, ni unpolo y tinadong na upañotyo; chamo pumopolo y joyo na ujuchom y pachotña gui jilojo.
pairs.english: Don't let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don't let the pit shut its mouth on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Opeyo, O Jeova; sa y minaasemo gosmauleg: taemanoja y minegae y minaasemo, birajao guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo na aatog y matamo gui tentagomo; sa gaegue yo gui chinatsaga: opeyo guse.
pairs.english: Don't hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najijot jao gui antijo ya unnalibre: rescatayo sa juguaja y enimigujo sija.
pairs.english: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago tumungo y malalatdeco, yan y minamajlaojo yan y madesonraco: y contrariojo mangaegue todo gui menamo.
pairs.english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linalatde yumulang y corasonjo: yan bulayo y pinite: ya manaliligaoyo jaye upinite, lao taya ni uno: yan y numamagofyo lao ti jusoda ni uno.
pairs.english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija numaeyo locue lalaet para nengcanojo: yan anae majoyo, sija numaeyo binagle para juguimen.
pairs.english: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya lamasañija mamalaso gui menanñija: polo ya yaguin gaegue sija gui pas, este para ocodo.
pairs.english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ujomjom y atadogñija para chañija fanmalilie; yan janayeyengyong nii sinturanñija para todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can't see. Let their backs be continually bent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Basija gui jiloñija y binibumo, ya polo y dangculon linalalomo ya ufanjeniguif sija.
pairs.english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y sagañija ya umayulang: yan taya ni uno siña sumaga gui tiendañija.
pairs.english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija pumetsigue ayo sija y sinaolagmo: ya sija sumangan y pinitinja ni y ninafanlamenmo.
pairs.english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naye mas taelaye y tinaelayeñija, ya chamo munafanjajalom gui tininasmo.
pairs.english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don't let them come into your righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo ya umafunas sija gui leblon linâlâ: ya munga manmatugue sija yan y manunas.
pairs.english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo pobleyo yan tristeyo: polo y satbasionmo, O Yuus, ya upoloyo guiya jululo.
pairs.english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jualaba y naan Yuus nu y cantasion, ya junadangculo güe nu y inefresen grasias.
pairs.english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este munaguefmagof si Jeova mas qui y nobiyo, pat y toro nii mangaecángjilon yan papaquis.
pairs.english: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanso, jalie este ya ninafanmagof: ya y corasonmiyo ufanlâlâ y unaaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jajungog y mannesesitao ya ti jachatlie y prenesuña sija.
pairs.english: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn't despise his captive people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y langet yan tano ya umaalaba güe, yan y tase sija yan todo y güinaja nii mangalalamten gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus ujasatba y Sion yan ujafatinas y siuda sija guiya Juda: para usiña sija mañaga güije yan uguaja para y iyonñija.
pairs.english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiya locue gui tentagoña uereda ni ayo: ya ayo sija y gumaeya y naanña unafañaga güije.
pairs.english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NACHADIG, O Yuus, para unalibreyo: nachadig umayudayo, O Yuus.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. > > Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufaninistotba ni y umaliligao y antijo: polo sija ya ufanalo tate yan ufanmamajlao ni y manmagof nii desonraco.
pairs.english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanalo tate para apas y minamajlaoñija ja ni y ilegñija: Aha, Aha.
pairs.english: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, "Aha! Aha!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ayo todo y umaliligaojao ya unfanmagof yan ufansenmagof ni jago: ya polo ya ayo y gumaeya y satbasionmo ya ilelegñija siésiempreja: Umanasendangculo si Yuus.
pairs.english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, "Let God be exalted!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo pobleyo yan nesesitaoyo: nachadig jao guiya guajo, O Yuus: sa jago umayuyudayo, yan y munalibreyo; O Jeova, chamo umatrasasao.
pairs.english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don't delay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae jupolo y inangococo: ya chajo mamámajlao para taejinecog.
pairs.english: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo, nii tininasmo ya rescatayo: naapo y talangamo guiya guajo ya unsatbayo.
pairs.english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y acho y saga para guajo, anae mafatoyo todo y tiempo: jago mannae tinago na jumasatbayo: sa jago y finitmeco yan y castiyujo.
pairs.english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescatayo, O Yuusso, juyong gui canae y manaelaye yan y canae y ti manunas yan y manrecto na taotao.
pairs.english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y ninanggaco, O Jeova Yuus: jago y inangococo desde y pinatgonjo.
pairs.english: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago mumantieneyo desde y jalom tuyan, jago chumuleyo juyong guinin y tiyan nana: ya y tininajo todo y tiempo guiya jago.
pairs.english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo taegüije y ninamanman gui linajyan; lao jago y megot na guinegüeco.
pairs.english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto ubula nii tininamo, an y inenramo todot dia.
pairs.english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo yumuyute gui tiempo y inamcojo: yaguin minetgotto esta jocog chamoyo dumidingo.
pairs.english: Don't reject me in my old age. Don't forsake me when my strength fails.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigujo manadingan contra guajo; yan ayo sija y numanangga y antijo, manafaesen entre sija.
pairs.english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: Diningogüe as Yuus: petsigue ya enchilegüe; sa taya para ulinibregüe.
pairs.english: saying, "God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, chamo chachago guiya guajo; Yuusso, nachadig yan para unayudayo.
pairs.english: God, don't be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufanlinachae, ayo y contrarion y antijo; polo sija ya ufantinampe nii minamajlao yan y sinala, y umaliligao y dañujo.
pairs.english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo juananangga todo y tiempo, yan junalala megae y tininajo guiya jago.
pairs.english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usinangan y tininasmo, yan y satbasionmo todot dia: sa ti jutungo y minegaeña.
pairs.english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don't know its full measure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jufalag y minetgot gui as Yuus, Jeova; ya jusangan y tininasmo, magajet, iyomoja namaesa.
pairs.english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago jagasja fumanagüe yo desde y pinatgonjo; yan asta pago jusangan claro nii ninamanman y chechomo.
pairs.english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago locue anae estayo bijo ya chungeyo, O Yuus chamoyo dumidingo: asta que jusangan claro nii minetgotmo y manmámamaela na generasion, yan y ninasiñamo cada uno ni ayo y ufanmato.
pairs.english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don't forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y tinasmo locue, O Yuus, sumentaquilo; jagasja unfatinas y mandangculo na güinaja sija: O Yuus, jaye uparejumo?
pairs.english: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y fumanuejam mandangculo na pinite yan chinatsaga, siempre unnalâlâjam talo, yan unchulejam talo julo guinin y tinadong y tano.
pairs.english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aumenta y dinangculoco; yan birajao ya unamamagofyo.
pairs.english: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo locue bae jualaba jao yan y guitala: magajet, y minagajetmo, O Yuusso: yyajago nae jucantaye yan y atpa, O jagoja na Santos guiya Israel.
pairs.english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y labiosso sendangculo minagofña anae jucantayejao tinina; yan y antijo ni jago munalilibre.
pairs.english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jilajo locue jasasangan y tininasmo todot dia: sa innafanmamajlao yan innafaninestotba ayo y umaliligao y dañujo.
pairs.english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAE y ray ni juisiomo, O Yuus, yan y tininasmo gui lajin y ray.
pairs.english: < < By Solomon. > > God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ufanjusga y taotaomo gui tininas, yan y mamoblemo gui juisio.
pairs.english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y beca sija chumule y pas gui taotao yan y mandiquique na ogso sija pot y tininas.
pairs.english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufanjusga y mamoble na taotao, güiya ufañatba y famaguon y mannesesitao, yan ufanyinamag y manmachaleg.
pairs.english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanmaañao ni jago mientras gagaegue y atdao, yan y pilan gui todo y generasion yan y generasion.
pairs.english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya tumunog papa taegüije y ichan gui jilo y manmautot na chaguan: taegüije minatmon janom ni y nafotgon y tano.
pairs.english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaaniña sija, mumamta y tininas; ya y pas sumenmegae asta qui jocog y pilan.
pairs.english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uguaja minagasña locue guinin y tase asta y tase, yan guinin y sadog asta y uttimon y tano.
pairs.english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y mañasaga gui desierto, manecon gui menaña; ya y enimiguña sija mamanjojoflag gui eda.
pairs.english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray sija guiya Tarsis yan isla sija ufanmañuñule ninae: yan y ray sija guiya Sabá yan iya Seba ufanmannae ninae.
pairs.english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, y ray todos ujatomba sija gui menaña: yan y nasion todos usinetbe güe.
pairs.english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya unalibre y nesesitao an jumagang; yan ayo locue y peble an ni y taya uinayuda.
pairs.english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanmañotbla y mamoble yan y mannesesitao yan ujasatba y anten y mannesesitao.
pairs.english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanlibre y antiñija guinin y chiniguit yan y finijom: yan ugagaebale y jâgâñija gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya lumala, ya para güiya umanae ni y oron Sabá; ya y tinayuyut locue mafatitinas pot güiya todo y tiempo; sa sija ufanbendise güe todot dia.
pairs.english: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa uguaja megae na maies gui jalom y eda gui sanjilo y puntan y beca sija; ya y tinegchaña ufanmayengyong taegüije y Libano.; ya sija gui siuda ninafangatbo taegüije y chaguan gui eda.
pairs.english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y naanña gagaegue para taejinecog: y naanña sisigueja taegüije y siniguen y atdao: yan todo y taotao ufandichoso guiya güiya; yan todo y nasion umafanaan güe dichoso.
pairs.english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova Yuus, ni si Yuus Israel, sa güiyaja na maesa fumatinas y mannamanman na güinaja.
pairs.english: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan bendito y minalag y naanmo para taejinecog: ya polo todo y tano ya ufanbula ni y minalagmo. Amen yan Amen.
pairs.english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magpo y tinayuyut David ni y lajin Isai.
pairs.english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SENMAGAJET si Yuus na mauleg para Israel, ni ayo sija y mangasgas na corason.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by Asaph. > > Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo cánaja sumuja y adengjo; didideja tentenjan sulon y pinecatta.
pairs.english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jumalatgue y mangaduco, anae julie y minauleg y manaelaye.
pairs.english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya pinite gui finataeñija: lao y minetgotñija fitme.
pairs.english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya chinatsagañija taegüije y otro taotao sija; ni ufanmasapet taegüije y palo na taotao sija.
pairs.english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina na sobetbia y cadena nii lisayon y cueyoñija; y finijom tumampe sija taegüije y magago.
pairs.english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogñija mamachom ni y yinemog; guajañija mas qui y corason siña umalatgue.
pairs.english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmanbotlelea, yan jasasangan chiniguit gui tinaelaye: jasasangan y mansentaquilo.
pairs.english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo y pachotñija gui langet, yan y jilañija janafanmamocat gui inanaco y tano.
pairs.english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
