pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y taotaoña manalo mague: yan y binilan y janom gui posuelo umafugo nu sija.
pairs.english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Jaftaemano tungoña si Yuus? Ada guaja tiningo gui Gueftaquilo?
pairs.english: They say, "How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa estagüe ya sija y manaelaye; ya sija manmegae gui tano, sa taya chinatsagañija todo y jaane.
pairs.english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Senmagajet na taebale y junagasgas y corasonjo: yan jufagase y canaejo gui guinasgas.
pairs.english: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y inanaco y jaane chatsagayo, yan y castigojo cada ogaan.
pairs.english: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jagasja jualog, bae jusangan este; este na jagasja judague y generasion: y famaguonmo.
pairs.english: If I had said, "I will speak thus"; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jujaso jaftaemano na jutungo este, sumenmacat para guajo;
pairs.english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta que jujalom gui sinantos na sagayan gui as Yuus; ya jujaso y uttimoñija.
pairs.english: Until I entered God's sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jago pumolo sija gui palagse na sagayan; jago yumute sija papa gui jalom y yinilang.
pairs.english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaftaemano na ufanyinilang, gui un rato! sija chadig malimachae ni y minaañao sija.
pairs.english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije güinife an magmata; taegüenaoja, O Señot, yaguin magmatajao, unchatlie y jechurañija.
pairs.english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonjo estaba triste, ya matogchayo gui sumanjalom.
pairs.english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na taegüije taejinasoyo, yan taetiningoyo: taegüijeyo y gâgâ gui menamo.
pairs.english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja gagaegueyo siempre guiya jago; jago mumantiene y agapa na canaejo.
pairs.english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umesgaejonyo ni y consejumo, ya despues unresibeyo gui langet.
pairs.english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeyo guajayo gui langet sino jagoja? ya taya gui jilo y tano güinaeyaco, na jagoja.
pairs.english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y catneco yan y corasonjo malachae: lao si Yuus y minetgot y corasonjo, yan y güinajajo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe ya ayo sija y mañago guiya jago, na ufanmalingo: jago yumulang todo ayo sija y manjanao guiya jago para inábale.
pairs.english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mauleg para guajo y juguaguato jijot gui as Yuus: sa jupolo y inangococo gui Señot Jeova, para usiña jusangan todo y chechomo.
pairs.english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, sajafa na unyutejam para taejinecog? sajafa na y linalomo umasgon contra y quinilo sija gui pastajimo?
pairs.english: < < A contemplation by Asaph. > > God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y inetnonmo ni y unfajan gui ampmam na tiempo; y tribon y erensiamo, ni y jago sumatba; yan y egso Sion, anae sumasagajao.
pairs.english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa y adengmo para taejinecog na yinilang: sa y enimigo jafatinas y tinaelaye todo gui jalom y sinantos na sagamo.
pairs.english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y contrariumo sija manaagang gui entalo y inetnonmo; ya japolo julo y banderañija para señat sija.
pairs.english: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y taotao y jajatsa julo y gachae sija gui jilo y chemchom na trongco jayo sija.
pairs.english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago sija yumute papa y binetda na chocho un biajeja, ni y gachae yan y mattiyo sija.
pairs.english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija sumanggüe y sinantos na sagamo, yan munainale y sagan y naanmo, sanpapa gui tano.
pairs.english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija gui corasonñija: Nije tayulang sija ni mandaño: ya sija sumonggue todo y sinagogan Yuus gui tano.
pairs.english: They said in their heart, "We will crush them completely." They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti talie y señatta sija: ya taya ni uno profeta mas: ni uguaja sija ni utiningo asta ngaean.
pairs.english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean, O Yuus, nae y contrario ulalatde? ya y enimigo ufañatfino contra y naanmo para taejinecog?
pairs.english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa na unjedo y canaemo, junggan y agapa na canaemo? jala juyong gui pechomo ya unyulang.
pairs.english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus y Rayjo gui ampmam na tiempo, jafatitinas y satbasion gui entalo y tano.
pairs.english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago dumibide y tase ni y ninasiñamo: jago yumamag y ilon y alo sija gui tase.
pairs.english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ni y dadao na güijan, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumaba y matan janom yan y minilalag: jago munafananglo y manmetgot na sadog sija.
pairs.english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane iyomo, y puenge locue iyomo: jago fumamauleg y inina yan y atdao.
pairs.english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo todo y oriyan y tano: jago fumatinas y tiempon maepe yan y tiempom manengjeng.
pairs.english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso este, na y enimigo manmalalatde, O Jeova, ya ayo y mangaduco na taotao jachatfino y naanmo.
pairs.english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, chamo umintrerega y anten y gamo paluma gui dadao na gâgâ: chamo malelefa ni y dinaña y mamoblemo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Don't deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don't forget the life of your poor forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Respeta y trato: sa y jemjom na sagayan sija gui tano manbula y sagan y manmalamaña.
pairs.english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, Chamo munafanatalo manmamajlao y manmachichiguit: polo y mamoble yan y mannesesitao ya umalalaba y naanmo.
pairs.english: Don't let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Yuus, gogüe y causamo: jaso jaftaemano y manaejinaso na taotao ni y lumalatdejao cada jaane.
pairs.english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo malelefa ni y inangang y contrariumo sija; y borucan ayo sija y mangajulo contra jago, lumala cajuloja siesiempre.
pairs.english: Don't forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Yuus, innae grasia; iyajago innae grasia sa y naanmo esta jijot: sa y ninamanman na chechomo masasangan.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm by Asaph. A song. > > We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ngaean nae jusoda y tiempo na mamatca, bae jujusga ni y tinas.
pairs.english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano yan todo y mañasaga mamalachae: guajo chumuchule julo y jaliguiña. Sila.
pairs.english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ileco ni y mansobetbio: Chamiyo fumatitinas y sinebetbio: yan ni y manaelaye, chamiyo jumajatsa julo y canggelon.
pairs.english: I said to the arrogant, "Don't boast!" I said to the wicked, "Don't lift up the horn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumajatsa y canggelonmiyo gui taquilo; chamiyo fanguecuentos ni y tiso na tongjo.
pairs.english: Don't lift up your horn on high. Don't speak with a stiff neck."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinatsa ni y ufato ni y guinin y sancatan, ni y guinin y sanlichan, ni y guinin y sajaya.
pairs.english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus y jues: güiya pumolo papa uno, yan jajatsa julo otro.
pairs.english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegue gui canae Jeova y copa, yan y bino ni lalálalo; bula dinaña, ya jachuda juyong taeguijeja; lao y asiento gui fondoña, todo y manaelaye gui tano jafufugo ya jaguiguimen sija.
pairs.english: For in the hand of Yahweh there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo bae jusangan claro para taejinecog; ya bae jucantaye si Yuus Jacob, y alabansa sija.
pairs.english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y canggelon y manaelaye locue bae juutot: lao y canggelon y manunas umanafangajulo.
pairs.english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MATUNGO si Yuus esta guiya Juda: y naanña manadangculo guiya Israel.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. > > In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya Salem nae gaegue y tabetnacoluña, ya y sagaña gaegue guiya Sion.
pairs.english: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jayamag sija y flechan y atcos; yan y patang yan y espada, yan y guera. Sila.
pairs.english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malagjao yan magas jao mas qui y tadong na jalomtano.
pairs.english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmajetog na corason manmayulang manafanaelaye; esta jamaego y minaegoñija; ya taya ni un taotao ni y gaeninasiña jasoda y canaeñija.
pairs.english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y chinemamo, O Yuus Jacob, todo careta yan y cabayo manmayute gui minaego y finatae.
pairs.english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, junggan jago, para unamaañao: ya jaye siña tumogue gui menamo yan lalalojao?
pairs.english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munamajungog y sentensia guinin y langet; ya y tano manmaañao, ya manmamatquilo.
pairs.english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Yuus jacajulo gui juisio, para usatba todo y manmanso gui tano. Sila.
pairs.english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na y binibon y taotao uinalabajao: yan y seblan y binibo, jago sumoma.
pairs.english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Promete ya inapase si Jeova ni y Yuusmiyo: todo ayo y mangaegue gui oriyaña manmañuñule ninae para güiya ni y namaañao.
pairs.english: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munamautut y espiriton y prinsipe sija: sa güiya y namaañao para y ray sija gui tano.
pairs.english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE juagang si Yuus ni y inagangjo; magajet na si Yuus ni y inagangjo; ya güiya jumungogyo.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. > > My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane y chinatsagaco jualigao y Señot: y canaejo maestira gui puenge ya pumapara: y antijo ti malago manamagof.
pairs.english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn't get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso, si Yuus ya janaestotbayo: umuugongyo, sa y espiritujo lalalango. Sila.
pairs.english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago unadaje y atadogjo ni taemaego: sa taegüije chatsagayo na ti siñayo cumuentos.
pairs.english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can't speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo jujajaso y jaane ni y ampmam manmalofan, yan y sacan ni y ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso y cantaco gui puenge: jujajaso ni y corasonjo; ya y espiritujo guine guefaligao?
pairs.english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada uyute y Señot para taejinecog? ya ti utalo y finaboresiña?
pairs.english: "Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cao y minaaseña usenjanaoja para taejinecog? ya y promesaña ufanlingo para taejinecog?
pairs.english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malefa si Yuus na uyóase? ya pot y linalaloña na jajuchom y güinaeyaña? Sila.
pairs.english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?" Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ileco: Este y dinafejo: lao bae jujaso y sacan sija gui agapa na canae y Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: Then I thought, "I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusangan y checho Jeova: sa bae jujaso y ninamanmanmo gui ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I will remember Yah's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jujaso locue todo y chechomo, yan jusangan sumanjalomjo y finatinasmo.
pairs.english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo, O Yuus, gague gui sinantos na sagayan: jaye dangculo na yuus calang y Yuusta?
pairs.english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y Yuus ni y fumatinas y mannamanman: jago munamatungo y minetgotmo gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yan y canaemo munafanlibre y taotaomo; ni y famaguon Jacob yan José. Sila.
pairs.english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y janom malie jao, O Yuus, y janom malie jao, ya sija ninafanmaañao: ya y tinadong locue ninafanmayengyong.
pairs.english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mapagajes sija manmañuñuda janom: ya y langet mannae y inagang: ya y flechamo locue manjanao juyong.
pairs.english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palampan y jilumo estaba gui remolino; ya y lamlam maniiina gui tano: ya y tano manmayengyong yan manlalaolao.
pairs.english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo gui tase, ya y finaposmo gui mandangculo na janom, ya y guinachamo ti matungo.
pairs.english: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umesgaejon y taotaomo taegüije y manadang quinilo pot y canae Moises yan Aaron.
pairs.english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ECUNGOG, O taotaojo, y tinagojo: na inecungog ni y talanganmo y sinangan y pachotto.
pairs.english: < < A contemplation by Asaph. > > Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jubaba y pachotto gui acomparasion: bae jusangan sinangan na gui jemjom gui ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija ni y injingog yan y intingo, yan y tatanmame ni jasanganejam.
pairs.english: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti innafanatog sija guinin y famaguonñija, masangangane y generasion ni y manmamamaela ni y tinina sija gui Señot, yan y minetgotña yan y mannamanman na chechoña ni y jachogüe.
pairs.english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munacajulo y testimonio gui as Jacob, yan japolo tinago guiya Israel, ni y janatungo sija y famaguonñija.
pairs.english: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujatungo y generasion ni y manmamamaela, y famaguonja ni y finañagonñija; ni y ufangajulo ya ujasangane y famaguonñija.
pairs.english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña japolo y ninanggañija gui as Yuus, ya ti ufanmalefa ni y checho Yuus, lao jaadaje y tinagoña sija.
pairs.english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chañija fanaegüigüije y tatañija; un generasion ni managuaguat yan ti manmalago manmanosgue: y generasion ni y ti japolo y corasonñija gui tinas, yan ayo na espirituñija y ti manfitme gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn't make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguon Efraim, guaja atmas yan manmañule y atcos sija, manalo tate gui jaanen y guera.
pairs.english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jaadaje y traton Yuus, ya ti manmalago na ufanmamocat gui tinagoña.
pairs.english: They didn't keep God's covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalefa ni y chechoña, yan y ninamanmanña ni y manfinanue sija.
pairs.english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namanman na güinaja finatinasña gui menan y tatañija, gui tano Egipto, gui fangualuan Soan.
pairs.english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadebide y tase ya janafanmalofan gui inanaco sija todo; yan janafañaga y janom taegüije y monton.
pairs.english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaane janafanenesgaegaejonja ni y mapagajes; yan todo puenge y finañila y guafe.
pairs.english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japanag y acho gue desierto, ya janae sija na ufanguinem taegüije na jumuyong guinin y dangculon tinadong.
pairs.english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañule minilalag locue guinin y acho, yan janafalalago y janom taegüije y sadog.
pairs.english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao trabia sisigueja mas isagüegüe, ya manmanembeste contra Gueftaquilo gui desierto.
pairs.english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jatienta si Yuus gui corasonñija, yan mangagagao catne pot y güinaeyañija.
pairs.english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na sija manguentos contra si Yuus; ilegñija: Ada siña si Yuus jafamaulequejit lamasa gui desierto?
pairs.english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, na anae japanag y acho, manjuyong y janom, ya y minilalag manmachuchuda. Ada siña güe manae pan locue? umafamauleg catne para y taotaoña?
pairs.english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae jajungog este, y Señot ninabubo: ya umasonggue y guafe contra as Jacob, yan y linalalo locue cajulo contra Israel;
pairs.english: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jajonggue si Yuus, yan ti jaangoco sija gui satbasionña.
pairs.english: because they didn't believe in God, and didn't trust in his salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya tumago y mapagajes guinin y sanjilo; yan jababa y pettan langet.
pairs.english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janauchan papa y mana gui jiloñija para ujacano, yan janae sija ni y maies y langet.
pairs.english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao cumano y na y manmetgot: güiya numae sija catne para ufanjaspog.
pairs.english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago y manglo sancatan na ufanguaefe gui jalom y langet: yan pot y ninasiñaña jachachalane y manglo sanjaya.
pairs.english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janauchan catne locue gui jiloñija taegüije y petbos; yan y pajaro ni gaepapa taegüije inae gui tase;
pairs.english: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo ayo sija na ufanbasnag gui entalo y campoñija, ya gui oriyan y sagañija.
pairs.english: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jacano, ya mangosjaspog sija; sa güiya numae sija ni y tinangañiñija.
pairs.english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ti janajanao guiya sija y tinangañija; lao estabaja trabia y catneñija gui jalom y pachotñija,
pairs.english: They didn't turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y binibon Yuus mato gui jiloñija, ya japuno y mas manyomog guiya sija, yan jayute papa y patgon na taotao sija guiya Israel.
pairs.english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao contodo este, sigueja di maaiisao trabia: yan ti majonggue y mamnamanman na chochoña.
pairs.english: For all this they still sinned, and didn't believe in his wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na y jaaneñija janafanlinachae ni y banidá; yan y sacanñija gui minaañao.
pairs.english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae japuno sija, ayo nae manafaesen pot güiya yan jabira sija ya maaligao guse si Yuus.
pairs.english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jajaso na si Yuus y achoñija, yan y Gueftaquilo na Yuus y Satbadotñija.
pairs.english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja ujafaande güe ni y pachotñija yan ujadague ni y jilañija.
pairs.english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonñija ti tunas guiya güiya: ni ufanfitme gui tratuña.
pairs.english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jajatsa sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn't destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn't stir up all his wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajaso na sija catneja; y manglo na malofan ya mapos ya ti mamaela talo.
pairs.english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn't come again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cuanto biaje manmanembeste contra güiya gui jalomtano yan manatriste güe gui desierto!
pairs.english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manalo tate ya matienta si Yuus; ya macase y Santosgüe guiya Israel.
pairs.english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jajaso y canaeña; ni jaane anae ninafanlibre gui contrario.
pairs.english: They didn't remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pineloña na señatña guiya Egipto: yan y ninamanmanña gui fangualuan Soan:
pairs.english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jatulaeca y Sadog janajâgâ; yan y minilalag para chañija fanguiguimen.
pairs.english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae megae na lalo para ufanquinano; yan rana sija para ufanyinilang.
pairs.english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae y ilo oruga ni y aumentan tano; ya y finachochoñija y apacha.
pairs.english: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayulang y fangualuanñija ubas ni y ichan grano; yan y trongco igos sija ni y hielo.
pairs.english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo y gañija gâgâ locue gui papa y ichan grano, ya y manadan gañija gui minaepen lamlam.
pairs.english: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute gui jiloñija y fijom na binibuña; binibo, linalalo, yan chinatsaga; y manadan manaelaye na angjet sija.
pairs.english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamatinas chalan para y linalaloña; ya ti jachoma y antiñija guinin y finatae, lao japolo y linâlâñija gui peste.
pairs.english: He made a path for his anger. He didn't spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno todo y finenena na finañagon guiya Egipto, y mas magas naminetgotñija gui jalom y tiendan Cam!
pairs.english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao chalane juyong y taotaoña taegüije y quinilo sija, yan jaesgagaejon sija gui desierto taegüije y manadan, gâgâ.
pairs.english: But he led forth his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule sija gui seguro, ya sija ti manmaañao: lao y tase tumampe y enimigoñija.
pairs.english: He led them safely, so that they weren't afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija asta y oriyan y sinantos na sagaña, güineja na ogso ni y guinanan y agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute juyong y nasion locue gui menañija, yan jafacae guiya sija y erensiañija ya jaraya, ya janafañaga y tribon Israel gui jalom y tiendañija.
pairs.english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija trabia jatietentaja, yan manmanembebesteja contra y Gueftaquilo na Yuus, yan ti jaadaje y tinagoña.
pairs.english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn't keep his testimonies;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manalo tate, yan manmafatinas dinague taegüije y tatañija: ya manmabira sija gui un banda taegüije y dacon na atco.
pairs.english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa macase güe ya mannalalalo pot y sagañija ni taquilo ya masuog güe ya manafanugo ni y imageñija ni tinaga.
pairs.english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog este si Yuus, ninabubo, yan jagoschatlie iya Israel.
pairs.english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot ayo na jadingo y tabetnaculo guiya Silo, yan y tienda ni y japolo gui entalo taotao sija.
pairs.english: So that he forsook the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janae ni y minetgotña y cautibo, ya y minalagña gui canae y contrario.
pairs.english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary's hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae y espada ni y taotaoña: yan ninabubo ni y erensiaña.
pairs.english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linachae ni y guafe y manpatgon na lalaje; ya y manpatgon na famalaoan taya cantan umasagua.
pairs.english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mamaleñija manmodong gui espada; ya y manbiuda sija ti ninafantriste.
pairs.english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn't weep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot magmata taegüije y uno ni y guinin mamaego, yan taegüije y matatñga na taotao ni y ninaaagang pot rason di y bino.
pairs.english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno y enimiguña sija ni y mañasaga gui santate: yan japolo sija güi taejinecog na minamajlao.
pairs.english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ademas jarechasa y tabetnaculo gui as José, ya ti jaayeg y tribon Efraim.
pairs.english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn't choose the tribe of Ephraim,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaayeg tribon Juda, ayo ogso Sion ni y güinaeyaña.
pairs.english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas y sinantos na sagaña taegüije y manaquilo na sagayan sija, taegüije y tano na japlanta para taejinecog.
pairs.english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaayeg si David locue na tentagoña, yan jacone güe guinin y quelat y quinilo,
pairs.english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jacone sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije janafañocho sija segun y tininas y corasonña; yan jaesgaejon sija pot y tiningon y canaeña.
pairs.english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: mayulang sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by Asaph. > > God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tataotao y manmatae na tentagomo manmanae nañija y pajaro gui langet: ya y catnen y mañantosmo y gâgâ gui tano.
pairs.english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jâgâñija manmachuda taegüije y janom, gui oriyan Jerusalem; sa taya jaye ufanjinafog.
pairs.english: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manafanmamamajlaojam ni y tiguangmame: manmamofeajam yan manmabotleajam ni y mañasaga gui oriyanmame.
pairs.english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean, O Señot, unlalalo para taejinecog? ya y inigomo sinenggue taegüije y guafe?
pairs.english: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chuda juyong y binibumo gui jilo y nasion ni y ti tumungojao, yan y jilo y raeno sija ni y ti umaagan y naanmo.
pairs.english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don't know you; on the kingdoms that don't call on your name;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija lumachae si Jacob, yan jayulang y sagañija.
pairs.english: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo jumajaso contra jame y tinaelayen y tatamname: Polo y minauleg minaasemo ya uchadig insedajam; sa manafangostagpapjamam.
pairs.english: Don't hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayudajam, O Yuus, gui satbasionmame pot y minalag y naanmo; yan nafanlibrejam, yan fagase y isaomame pot y naanmo.
pairs.english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa ilegñija y nasion ni ti manmanjonggue: Mangue y Yuusñija? Polo y inemog y jâgâ y tentagomo sija ni y manmachuda ya umatungo ni y nasion ni ti manmanjonggue, gui menan y matanmame.
pairs.english: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants' blood is being poured out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inigon y manmapreso mato gui menamo; segun y dinangculo y ninasiñamo adaje ayo sija y esta manmatancho para ufanmatae.
pairs.english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya apase gui tiguangmame siete mas gui jalom y pechoñija, y linalatdeñija, sa sija lumalatdejao, O Señot.
pairs.english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jame y taotaomo yan y quinilo gui pastajimo, bae inalaba jao para taejinecog; ya infanmamanue ni y alabansamo para todo y generasion.
pairs.english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ECUNGOG, O Pastot guiya Israel, jago ni y umesgagaejon si José taegüije y manadan quinilo; jago ni y sumasaga gui entalo y querubin sija manina mona.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Lilies of the Covenant." A Psalm by Asaph. > > Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y menan Efraim, yan Benjamin, yan Manases, nacajulo y minatatngamo, ya maelajao para usatbajam.
pairs.english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Yuus; ya nafanina y matamo ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, asta ngaean unlálalaloja contra y tinayuyut y taotaomo?
pairs.english: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unafañochocho sija ni y pan lago; yan unnae sija ni y lago para ujaguinem gui dangculo na medida.
pairs.english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmumojam yan y tiguangmame: yan y enimigonmame manmachachatgue jam gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Yuus y inetnon sendalo, ya nafanina y matamo; ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumule juyong y trongcon ubas guiya Egipto: ya jagasja unyute juyong y nasion, ya untanme güe.
pairs.english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago fumamauleg y saga gui menaña, ya güiya y natadodong y jaleña, yan nabula y tano.
pairs.english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sabana sija mantinampe ni y aninengña, yan y ramasña taegüije y sedro Yuus na trongcon jayo.
pairs.english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God's cedars.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago juyong y ramasña gui tase; yan y manlodo na siniso gui sadog.
pairs.english: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa unjulog papa y quelatña: ya todo y manmalolofan gui chalan matitife güe?
pairs.english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y balaco guinin y jalomtano machuchule ya mayúyulang, yan y manmachaleg na gâgâ gui fangualuan cumacano.
pairs.english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajao talo, O Yuus inentnon sendalo, ingagagao jao: ya talag papa guinin y langet ya unlie yan unbisita este na trongcon ubas,
pairs.english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fangualuan ni y tinanom y agapa na canaemo, yan y ramas ni jago munafitme para jagoja namaesa,
pairs.english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masinenggue ni y guafe, ya mautut papa esta; ya manmalingo pot y chinema gui menamo.
pairs.english: It's burned with fire. It's cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y canaemo gui jilo y taotao gui agapa na canaemo, gui jilo y lajin y taotao ni unnametgot para jago.
pairs.english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ti infanalo tate guinin jago: nafanlâlâjam ya bae inagang y naanmo.
pairs.english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, ya nafanina y matamo; ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANGANTA agang gui as Yuus ni y minetgotta: fatinas y magof na boruca gui as Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. > > Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entona y salmo, yan chule mague y pandireta; yan y magof na atpa yan y guitala.
pairs.english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaefe y trompeta gui tiempo y nuebo na pulan, gui tiempon gualafon na pulan, gui jaanen y guipot magas.
pairs.english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este lay guiya Israel: yan y tinago Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas este as José para untestimonio anae jumanao juyong gui inanaco y tano Egipto: anae jujungog y finijo na ti siña jutungo.
pairs.english: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn't know.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y apagaña guinin y catga: yan y canaeña manalibre guinin y lauya.
pairs.english: "I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umaagan gui chinatsaga, ya guajo munalibrejao: guajo umopejao gui umatog na sagayan julo: ya juchaguejao gui oriyan janom guiya Meriba. Sila.
pairs.english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O taotaojo, ya guajo junae jao testimonio, O Israel, yaguin malagojao unecungogyo!
pairs.english: "Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Munga otro yuus, guiya jago; ni unadora otro yuus.
pairs.english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo y Jeova Yuusmo, ni y chumule jao juyong gui tano Egipto: baba y pachotmo, ya bae nabula.
pairs.english: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotaojo ti jajungog y inagangjo; ya iya Israel ti malago ni guajo.
pairs.english: But my people didn't listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jupolo sija ya jumanao ni y minajetog y corasonñija: para ufanmamomocat ni y pinagatñija.
pairs.english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O yaguin y taotaojo majungog yo, ya iya Israel manmamocat gui chalanjo!
pairs.english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña guse juchoma y enimigoñija, ya jubira y canaejo contra y contrarioñija.
pairs.english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y umanmachatlie ni y Jeova, mojon mansujeto sija guiya güiya: y tiempoñija usaga para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafañocho sija locue ni y mas mauleg na trigo: yan y miet ni jumujuyong gui acho anae junajaspog jao.
pairs.english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus tumotojgue gui inetnon Yuus; ya jajusga gui entalo yuus sija.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by Asaph. > > God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean nae unjusga ti tunas, yan unresibe y taotao sija ni y manaelaye? Sila.
pairs.english: "How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?" Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusga y mamoble yan y manaesaena: ya nafanunas y manpinite yan y mannesesitao.
pairs.english: "Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescata mamoble yan y mannesesitao: nafanlibre sija gui canae y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jatungo ni ujaquetungo: manmamomocatja gui jalom jomjom: ya todo y plinantan tano manalamten.
pairs.english: They don't know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ileco: Jamyo yuus; yan todo jamyo y famaguon y Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I said, "You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao infanmataeja taegüije y taotao sija, yan infanbasnag taegüije y uno gui prinsipe sija.
pairs.english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Yuus, jusga y tano: sa jago umerensia todo y nasion.
pairs.english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO famatquiquilo, O Yuus: ya chamo tiumaagan yan chamo quequeto, O Yuus.
pairs.english: < < A song. A Psalm by Asaph. > > God, don't keep silent. Don't keep silent, and don't be still, God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, enimigumo na manpalalangpang: yan ayo sija y chumatlie jao jajatsa y iloñija.
pairs.english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manpinagat ni y dinague consejo contra y taotaomo, yan manafaesen entre sija contra y ninafanatogmo.
pairs.english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin ilegñija: Maela, ya nije tautut sija ni y guinin y nasion; para y naan Israel munga majaso mas.
pairs.english: "Come," they say, "and let's destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija manafaesen entre sija ni y unoja corason; ya managogüe contra jago.
pairs.english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tiendan Edom yan Ismaelita sija: Moab yan Agareno sija.
pairs.english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gebal yan Ammon yan Amaleg; Filistia yan y mañasaga guiya Tiro.
pairs.english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asur locue mandaña yan sija: sa maninayuda ni y famaguon Lot. Sila.
pairs.english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas guiya sija taegüije unfatinas iya Madian yan taegüije iya Sisara taegüije iya Jabin jijot gui sadog Sison:
pairs.english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmalingo guiya Endor: manjuyong manaegüije y estiecot para y tano.
pairs.english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas y magasñija ya parejo yan Oreb yan Seeb; magajet na todo y prinsipeñija parejo yan Sebah yan Salmuna:
pairs.english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y ilegñija: Nije jitaja tachule y sagayan para iyotaja.
pairs.english: who said, "Let us take possession of God's pasturelands."
