pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, fatinas sija ya ufanparejo yan y petbos ni y remolílino; parejo yan y ngasan trigo gui menan y manglo;
pairs.english: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y guafe anae jasonggue y jalomtano, yan taegüije y mañila anae finaliñagüe y sabana.
pairs.english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijija petsigue sija ni y pagyomo, yan nafanmaañao sija ni y dangculon pinagyomo.
pairs.english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nabula y matañija ni y dinesonra: para sija ujaaligao y naanmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufanmaañao para taejinecog: magajet na sija ufandesonrao, ya ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujatungo na jagoja y naanmo si Jeova, na jagoja y Gueftaquilo gui jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAGÜINAEYAYON y sagamo, O Señot y inetnon sendalo!
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. > > How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo tumatanga, magajet na asta ninamalango pot y sagan y Jeova: y corasonjo yan y catneco agagange y lâlâlâ na Yuus.
pairs.english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet y gorrión mañoda gumaña, yan y golondrina chenchonña para güiya, anae siña mapolo y famaguonña, esta y jalom y attatmo, O Señot y inetnon sendalo, Rayjo yan Yuusso.
pairs.english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija y mañasaga gui jalom y guimamo; sa sigueja di malabajao:
pairs.english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y minetgotña gaegue guiya jago: yan y chalan para jago gaegue gui corasonña.
pairs.english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae janafanmalofan gui inanaco bayen tinangis jafatinase tupo sija; ya y taftaf na ichan locue tinampe ni y bendision.
pairs.english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: otro sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, jungog y tinayuyutto: ecungog, O Yuus Jacob. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lie, O Yuus, patangmame: ya atan y matan y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y un jaane gui sagamo mas mauleg qui un mit. Gañacoja na jupottero gui guima y Yuusso, qui jusaga gui jalom y sagan y manaelaye.
pairs.english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Jeova Yuus, güiya y atdao yan y patang: si Jeova unfannae grasia yan minalag: ti jachoma y manmauleg na güinaja ni y mammamomocat gui tininas.
pairs.english: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Señot y inetnon sendalo, dichoso y taotao ni y umangoco güe guiya jago.
pairs.english: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jago guinin ninamagof jao ni y tanomo: sa unnafanalo mague y manmacautiba sija gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. > > Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago guinin umasie y tinaelayen y taotaomo: yan untampe todo y isaoñija. Sila.
pairs.english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unnajanao todo y binibumo: ya unbirajao talo guinin y finijom y binibumo.
pairs.english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam, O Yuus, gui satbasionmame, yan nabasta y binibumo guiya jame.
pairs.english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada unlalalaloja nu jame para taejinecog? Ada unnajujuyong y linâlâlomo para todo y generasion?
pairs.english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti unnalâlâjam talo: para y taotaomo ufanmagof ni jago?
pairs.english: Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanuejam ni y minaasemo, O Jeova, ya unnaejam ni y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jujungog jafa usangan si Yuus Jeova: sa güiya usangan y pas gui taotaoña, yan y mañantos sija: lao chañija natalo guato gui binaba.
pairs.english: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na y satbasionña esta jijot güije sija ni manmaañao nu güiya: para y minalag usaga gui tanomame.
pairs.english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Minaase yan minagajet manásoda ya mandaña: y tininas yan y pas manachico.
pairs.english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minagajet lacho julo gui tano; yan y tininas jaatan papa guinin y langet.
pairs.english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na si Jeova numae ni y minauleg: ya y tanota manae minegaeña.
pairs.english: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tininas jumajanao gui menaña; yan japolo y pinecatña y chalan para ufamocat.
pairs.english: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAEGUENG papa y talangamo, O Jeova, ya unopeyo: sa pobleyo yan nesesitaoyo.
pairs.english: < < A Prayer by David. > > Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y antijo; sa debotoyo: O jago ni y Yuusso, nalibre y tentagomo sa jaangoco gue guiya jago.
pairs.english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova: sa juaagang jao todot dia.
pairs.english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namagof y anten y tentagomo; sa iya jago, O Jeova, nae jujatsa julo y antijo.
pairs.english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, y mauleg yan y chadig manasie; yan dangculo y minaasemo güije todo gui umaagangjao.
pairs.english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Señot y tinayuyutto: yan ecungog y inagang y guinagagaojo.
pairs.english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanen y chinatsagaco juagangjao: ya jago y unopeyo.
pairs.english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y entalo y yuus sija, taya taegüenao iya jago, O Jeova; ni jafa na chocho parejo yan y chechomo.
pairs.english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y nasion sija ni y finatinasmo, manmato y manmanadora gui menamo, O Jeova; yan ufanalaba y naanmo.
pairs.english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago dangculojao yan unfatitinas y manmaman na güinaja: jagoja na maesa Yuus.
pairs.english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jinason sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jualaba jao, O Jeova, Yuusso, contodo y corasonjo: yan junamalag y naanmo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sendangculo y minaasemo para guajo; sa guinin unnalibre y antijo guinin iya papapa guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, y mansobetbio mangajulo contra guajo, yan y inetnon y managuaguat na taotao jagasja maaliligao y antijo: yan ti mapolo jao gui menañija.
pairs.english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don't hold regard for you before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, si Yuus jao ni y bila minaase yan cariñoso, ñateng para binibo yan dangculo na minaase yan minagajet.
pairs.english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O birajao, guiya guajo ya gaease nu guajo: nae ni y minetgotmo y tentagomo, yan nalibre y lajin y tentagomo palaoan.
pairs.english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your handmaid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanueyo ni y señat para y mauleg: para ujalie ayo sija y chumatliiyo ya ufanmamajlao: sa jago, Jeova, y umayudayo yan cumonsuelayo.
pairs.english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YPLINANTAÑA gaegue gui santos na ogso.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. > > His foundation is in the holy mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaguaeyaña si Jeova y trangca Sion mas que todo y saga sija gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalag na güinaja y manmasasangan guiya jago, O siuda Yuus. Sila.
pairs.english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jusangan ni y Rahab yan Babilonia gui entalo ayo sija ni y tumunogyo: Sa, estagüe, Palestina yan Tiro yan Etiopia: este na taotao mafañagon güije.
pairs.english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: "This one was born there."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan iya Sion ualog: Este yan ayo na taotao mafañagon iya güiya: yan y Gueftaquilo namaesa unafitmegüe.
pairs.english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her"; the Most High himself will establish her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeovaja tumufong anae jatugue sija y taotao, na esta na taotao mafañagon güije. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ufangaegue güije: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, "All my springs are in you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus satbasionjo, güajo guinin umaagan jaane yan puenge gui menamo:
pairs.english: < < A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of "The Suffering of Affliction." A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. > > Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tinayuyutto ya ufato gui menamo: naegueng y talangamo gui inagangjo.
pairs.english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y antijo bula chinatsaga sija: ya y linâlâjo esta jijot gui para y naftan.
pairs.english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estayo matufong yan ayo sija y manjajanao papa gui joyo: sa taegüije yo y taotao ni y taya ayudaña.
pairs.english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mayute esta gui entalo y manmatae, taegüije y manmapuno ni y manaason jalom y naftan; ni y ti unjajaso mas: ni y manmautut guinin y canaemo.
pairs.english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumoloyo guiya papapa na joyo, gui jalom jomjom na lugat gui jalom y tinadong.
pairs.english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y binibumo sumasaga macat guiya güajo, ya unachatsagayo nu y todo napomo. Sila.
pairs.english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munafanjanao lachago y manatungojo guiya guajo; unpoloyo na jumachatlie nu sija: mapongleyo ya ti siñayo manajanao.
pairs.english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can't escape.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo ninalachae pot y pinitijo: ya juagangjajao, O Jeova, cada jaane, jujuto juyong y canaejo guiya jago.
pairs.english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada unnamalie y ninamanman gui manmatae? Siña y manmatae mangajulo ya unmaalaba? Sila.
pairs.english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the dead rise up and praise you? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña y minauleg güinaeyamo masangan gui jalom y naftan? pat y minagajetmo gui yinilang?
pairs.english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña y ninamanmanmo matungo gui jalom jomjom? yan y tininasmo gui jalom tano ni y manmalefa?
pairs.english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo iya jago, O Jeova, umaagangyo: yan ogaan tinayuyutto ufato gui menamo.
pairs.english: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa, O Jeova, na unyute y antijo? Sajafa na unnaatog y matamo guinin iya guajo?
pairs.english: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gofchatsaga tristeyo yan cana yo matae, desde y pinatgonjo: mientras jususungon y minamaañaomo, ya janagosestotbayo.
pairs.english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fijom na binibumo malofan guiya guajo: ya y minamaañaomo umututyo.
pairs.english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manmato gui oriyajo todot dia taegüije y janom: mandaña gui oriyajo.
pairs.english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y güinaeyaco yan y amigujo unnafañago guiya guajo, yan y manatungojo gui jalom jomjom.
pairs.english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE jucanta y minaase Jeova para taejinecog: ya y pachotto nae junamatungo y minagajetmo gui todo y generasion.
pairs.english: < < A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. > > I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ileco: Y minaase umanacajulo para taejinecog: ya y minagajetmo unnafitme todo gui langet.
pairs.english: I indeed declare, "Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jufatinas y trato gui inayegco, yan manjulayo gui as David ni y tentagojo.
pairs.english: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyamo junafitme para taejinecog: ya jufatinas julo y tronumo gui todo y generasion. Sila.
pairs.english: 'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y langet sija ufanmanalaba ni y ninamanmanmo, O Jeova: y minagajetmo locue gui inetnon y mañantos.
pairs.english: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaye gui langet sija siña parejuña si Jeova? Jaye gui lajin y gaeninasiña uparejuña si Jeova?
pairs.english: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, gosnamaañao gui pinagat y mañantos, yan umamaanaogüe güe mas qui todo ni ayo sija y mangaegue gui oriyaña.
pairs.english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, jaye matatnga parejo yan jago, O YAH? ya y minagajetmo ni y gaegue gui oriyamo?
pairs.english: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umaregla y sobetbian tase: anae y napo mangajulo, jago pumoca sija.
pairs.english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumamag iya Rahab ya unfapidaso taegüije y uno ni y mapuno; jago chumalapon y enimigumo ni y canae y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet sija iyomo, yan yo tano locue iyomo: y tano yan y binilan sinajguanña ni y plinantamo sija.
pairs.english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sanlago yan y sanjaya, jago fumatinas sija: Tabor yan Hermon manmagof ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaegue guiya jago y canae ni y matatnga: sa y canaemo metgot, ya taquilo y agapa na canaemo.
pairs.english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininas yan y juisio y plinantan tronumo: minaase yan minagajet manjajanao gui menan metamo.
pairs.english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo na taotao y tumungo y magof na inagang: sa manmamocat gui mananan y matamo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y naanmo nae manmamagof todot dia: yan y tininasmo nae munafangajulo.
pairs.english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y minalag y minetgotñija: yan pot y finaboresimo na injatsajulo y canggelonmame.
pairs.english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyon Jeova y patangta: yan y rayta iyon Ayo na Santos guiya Israel.
pairs.english: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae unsangan gui guinigüife gui mañantosmo, ya ilegmo: guajo jupolo y inayuda gui jilo y uno ni y matatnga: yan junacajulo y uno na y maayeg gui taotao.
pairs.english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, "I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusoda si David na tentagojo; ya jupalae güe nu y santos na lañajo.
pairs.english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya y canaejo munafitme: yan y canaejoja locue munametgot güe:
pairs.english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y enimigo taeinamot guiya güiya: ni y lajin y manaelaye ti umanalamen güe.
pairs.english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae juyute papa y contrarioña gui menaña yan jucastiga ayo sija y chumatlie güe.
pairs.english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minagajetto yan y minaasejo usaga guiya güiya: yan pot y naanjo na umanacajulo y canggelonña.
pairs.english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya bae jupolo y canaeña locue gui jalom tase, yan y agapa na canaeña gui jalom sadog.
pairs.english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya umalog ni guajo: Jago y tatajo, Yuusso, yan y acho gui satbasionjo.
pairs.english: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jupolo güe locue pot finenana na finañagujo, mas taquiloña qui y ray sija gui tano.
pairs.english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaasejo bae juadaje pot güiya para taejinecog, yan y tratujo ufitme guiya güiya.
pairs.english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y semiyaña locue junasaga para ugaegue taejinecog, yan y tronuña taegüije y jaanen y langet.
pairs.english: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin famaguonña dumingo y tinagojo, yan ti manmamomocat gui juisioco,
pairs.english: If his children forsake my law, and don't walk in my ordinances;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin maquebranta y layjo yan ti maadaje y tinagojo;
pairs.english: if they break my statutes, and don't keep my commandments;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jufatoegüe gui inaguaguatñija yan y bara, ya jusaulag gui tinaelayeñija.
pairs.english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minaasejo ti junajanao todo guiya güiya: ya ti jupolo na ufatta y minagajetto.
pairs.english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tratujo ti juquebranta ni jutolaeca y sinanganjo ni jumuyong gui labiosso.
pairs.english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un biajeja jufanjula pot y sinantosso ya ti judague si David.
pairs.english: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y semiyaña gagaegue para taejinecog, yan y tronuña taegüijeja y atdao gui menajo.
pairs.english: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maplanta para taejinecog taegüije y pilan, ya taegüije y gosmagajet na testigo gui langet. Sila.
pairs.english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago jagasja unyute yan unrechasa, jago jagasja lalalojao ni y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unchatlie y traton y tentagomo; ya unnaale y coronaña asta papa gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unyamag papa todo y quelatña; yan unyulang y minetgot na castiyaña.
pairs.english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y manmalolofan gui ayo na chalan mayuteñaeñaejon: güiya manamamamajlao ni y tiguangña.
pairs.english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jumatsa julo y agapa na canae y contrariuña sija; yan jago munafanmagof todo y enimiguña.
pairs.english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jago locue bumira y filon y espadaña, ya ti unnafitme güe gui guera.
pairs.english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven't supported him in battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jagasja munabasta y minalagña, yan unyute y tronuña papa gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaanen y pinatgonña jago jagasja munacadada: jago jagasja tumampe güe ni y minamajlao. Sila.
pairs.english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, jaso na quinadada y tiempoco esta: pot jafa na taesetbe jagas unfatinas todo y famaguan taotao?
pairs.english: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye na taotao enao y lalâlâ ya ti ulie finatae, ni y ujanalibre y antiña gui ninasiñan y naftan? Sila.
pairs.english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol ? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, mangue y minaasemo sija ni y ampmam, ni y jinilamo as David gui minagajetmo?
pairs.english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso, Jeova, y minamajlao y tentagomo sija: ni y jucatgaja gui jalom pechoco, y minamamajlao y taotao todo ni y matatnga:
pairs.english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y enimigumo mannanamamajlao, O Jeova: ni y enimigumo munamamajlao y pinecat y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova para taejinecog: Amen yan Amen.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh forevermore. Amen, and Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA jago guinin saganmamame yan todo y generasion.
pairs.english: < < A Prayer by Moses, the man of GodThe Hebrew word rendered "God" is "Elohim.". > > Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Antes de najuyong y egso sija ya unfatinas y tano todo yan y mañasaga: sa desde y tutujonña yan asta y taejinecog, jagoja si Yuus.
pairs.english: Before the mountains were brought forth, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumira y taotao para y yinilang; ya ilelegmo: Fanalo guato, jamyo famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: You turn man to destruction, saying, "Return, you children of men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mit años gui menamo taegüijeja y nigapja anae malofan esta, yan taegüijeja y ora gui bumebela gui puenge.
pairs.english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumule sija taegüije y minilag y janom; manaegüije y minaego: ya y egaan manaeguije y chaguan ni y manlacho julo.
pairs.english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y egaan, mumegae ya manlacho julo; lao y pupuenge manmautut yan ufanmalayo.
pairs.english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y linalalomo nae lumachaejam, yan y binibumo nae munafañatsagajam.
pairs.english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unpolo y tinaelayenmame gui menamo, yan y ti matungo na isaomame gui minananan y matamo.
pairs.english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sat odo y jaaninmame manmalofan gui binibumo: inlachae y sacanmame ni y taegüijeja cuentos ni y masangan esta.
pairs.english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaanen y sacanmame setenta años, ya y pot y minetgot siña gagaegue asta ochenta años; lao y sobetbiañija y checho yan y trineste; sa munaguse manmapos: yan jame mangupo.
pairs.english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye tumungo y ninasiñan y linalalomo, ya y binibumo segun y ninamaañao guiya jago.
pairs.english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya fanagüejam tumufong y jaaninmame, para mojon usiña guajajam un corason ni y malate.
pairs.english: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Talo mague, O Jeova: asta ngaean? ya polo ya unfañotsot pot y tentagomo.
pairs.english: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nafannajong jam taftaf ni y minaasemo: ya insiña manmagof yan infansenmagof todo gui jaaninmame.
pairs.english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmagof jam, segun na jaane anae unnafanpinite jam, yan y sacan anae inlie y taelaye:
pairs.english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y chechomo umalie gui tentagomo sija, yan y minalagmo gui famaguonña.
pairs.english: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y guinatbon Jeova ni y Yuusta ugaegue guiya jame; ya unnafitme guiya jame y checho y canaeta: magajet, y checho y canaemame unnafitme.
pairs.english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA y sumasaga gui umatog na sagayan y Gueftaquilo, güiya usaga gui papa y anineng y Todojajanasiña.
pairs.english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusangan as Jeova, güiya y umamparayo yan y castiyujo: Yuusso, iya güiya nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: I will say of Yahweh, "He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya unninalibre guinin y lason y tiradot, yan guinin y yinilang peste.
pairs.english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya untinampe ni y piluña, yan y papa y papaña nae unangoco jao: y minagajetña uguinogüemo yan upatangmo.
pairs.english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ti unmaañao ni y minamaañao y puenge; ni y flecha ni mangugupo gui jaane;
pairs.english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y peste ni manmamomocat gui jalom jomjom; ni pot y yinilang ni y lumachae y taloane.
pairs.english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mit ufanbasnag gui oriyamo, yan y dies mit gui agapa na canaemo: lao ti siña mato jijot guiya jago.
pairs.english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atadogmoja umatan, yan lumie y apas y manaelaye.
pairs.english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagoja, O Jeova, y umamparayo! Sa jagasja unfatinas y Gueftaquilo na sagamo.
pairs.english: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya taelaye ufato guiya jago, ni jafa na chetnot ujijot gui sagamo.
pairs.english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaencatga y angjetña sija nu jago, para uninadaje todo gui jinanaomo.
pairs.english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unmajatsa julo ni y canaeñija, ya ti umanafannotpe acho y adengmo.
pairs.english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won't dash your foot against a stone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unfamgacha gui jilo y leon yan y culebla: y patgon leon yan y serpiente ungagacha gui papa adeng sija.
pairs.english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa japolo y güinaeyaña guiya guajo, enao mina junalibre güe: guajo pumolo güe gui taquilo, sa güiya guinin tumungo y naanjo.
pairs.english: "Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya umagangyo ya guajo umopegüe: sa jumajame gui chinatsaga; junalibre güe yan juonra güe.
pairs.english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inanaco y linâlâña junanajong güe, yan jufanue güe ni y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MAULEG para umannae grasias si Jeova ya umacanta y alabansa sija gui naanmo, O Jago, Gueftaquilo:
pairs.english: < < A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. > > It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para infamamanue ni y minauleg güinaeyamo gui egaan yan y minagajetmo cada puenge.
pairs.english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui dandan ni y dies cuetdasña; yan gui guitala; yan gui atpa yan y mames na inagang.
pairs.english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, unnamagofyo nu y chechomo: ya bae junagana pot y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, namandinangculo sija y chechomo! yan jinasomo mansentadong:
pairs.english: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao ni y aguaguat ti jatungo: ni y caduco ti jatutungo este.
pairs.english: A senseless man doesn't know, neither does a fool understand this:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y manaelaye lachog taegüije y chaguan, yan anae todo y chumogüe y tinaelaye manlajyan: ayo mina ufanmayulang para taejinecog:
pairs.english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, para taejinecog gagaegue y tinaquilo.
pairs.english: But you, Yahweh, are on high forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, y enimigumo, O Jeova, sa, estagüe, y enimigumo na ufanmalingo; yan todo y chumochogüe y tinaelaye ufanmachalapon.
pairs.english: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y canggelonjo, jago munacajulo taegüije y canggelon y titogcha na nubiyo: ya mapalaeyo ni y lañan nuebo.
pairs.english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atadogcoja lumie y güinaeyaco gui enimigujo sija yan y talangajoja jumungog y güinaeyaco ni chumogüe y taelaye ni y mangajulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinas lâlâ taegüije y trongcon palma: lumadangculo güe taegüije y trongcon sedro gui Libano.
pairs.english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmatanme gui guima Jeova, manlâlâ gui jalom y sagan y Yuusta.
pairs.english: They are planted in Yahweh's house. They will flourish in our God's courts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sigueja di manmanogcha asta que manbijo: manmesgo yan manbetde.
pairs.english: They will still bring forth fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ufanmamanue na si Jeova goftunas: güiya y achojo ya taya tinaelaye guiya güiya.
pairs.english: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna mabeste güe ni y ninasifia; si Jeova numabeste güe, ni y minetgot dinidog güe: y tano locue ninafitme ya ti siña manacalamten.
pairs.english: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can't be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronumo mafatinas desde di ampmam na tiempo: jago guinin y taejinecog.
pairs.english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo y minalag sija, O Jeova, ya y minalag sija mangajulo y inangangñija; y minalag sija mangajulo y napoñija.
pairs.english: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mastaquilo y inagang sija y minegae y janom sija, yan y fijom na napo gui tase, si Jeova gui sanjilo gaesisiña.
pairs.english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y testimoniomo sija mansenmagajet: sinantosja conbiene gui jalom guimamo, O Jeova, para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus Jao, ni y inemog iyomo; O Yuus Jao, ni y inemog iyomo, famanuen maesajao ni y minalag.
pairs.english: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa jao julo, jago y jues y tano: nae ni y apasñija y mansobetbio.
pairs.english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, asta ngaean y manaelaye, asta ngaean y manaelaye nae ufanmagana?
pairs.english: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmefno, sija sumangan sinaguat yan todo y chumochogüe y tinaelaye manbanidoso.
pairs.english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija yumamag ya japedasitos y taotaomo, O Jeova, yan janafanpinite y erensiamo.
pairs.english: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija pumuno y biuda yan taotao juyong, yan japuno y manaetata.
pairs.english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegñija: Si Jeova ti ujalie, ni si Yuus Jacob ti ufanatituye.
pairs.english: They say, "Yah will not see, neither will Jacob's God consider."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanatituye, jamyo managuaguat gui taotao: yan jamyo mangaduco, ngaean nae infanmalate?
pairs.english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y plumanta y talanga, ada ti ujungog? ya ayo y fumatinas y atadog, ada ti ulie?
pairs.english: He who implanted the ear, won't he hear? He who formed the eye, won't he see?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y cumastiga y taotao sija ada ti ujanafanunas? ayoja y fumanagüe y taotao ni y tiningo?
pairs.english: He who disciplines the nations, won't he punish? He who teaches man knows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jatungo y jinason y taotao, na sija puro jinaja.
pairs.english: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y unnaregla güe, O Jeova, yan ufanagüe güe ni y tinagomo;
pairs.english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago siña numae gui descanso guinin y jaanin y chinatsaga, asta qui y joyo maguadog para y manaelaye.
pairs.english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova ti janasuja y taotaoña, ni ti udingo y erensiaña.
pairs.english: For Yahweh won't reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jinisga utalo guato gui tininas: yan todo y manunas na corason ujadalalag.
pairs.english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye malago cajulo para guajo contra y chumochogüe y daño? Jaye malago tumojgue julo para guajo contra y chumochogüe y taelaye?
pairs.english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Jeova guinin ti umayudayo, y antijo gusija guinin sumaga gui finatquilo.
pairs.english: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ileco: Sulong y adengjo: y minaasemo, O Jeova, mumantieneyo.
pairs.english: When I said, "My foot is slipping!" Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae juguaja y manadan jinasoco gui sanjalomjo, y quinensuelamo sija ninasenmagof y antijo.
pairs.english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronon tinaelaye uguaja comunion yan jago, ni y fumatinas daño pot y tinago?
pairs.english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija mandaña contra y anten y manunas, yan ja sentensia y jâgâ y taeisao.
pairs.english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jeova guinin y leca na torijo: yan Yuusso y achon y guinegüeco.
pairs.english: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya chumule gui jiloñija y isaoñija, yan ujautut sija gui dañoñijaja; ya si Jeova, ni y Yuusta, umutut sija.
pairs.english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O maela, ya tacantaye si Jeova: nije tafatinas y minagof na inagang para y acho y satbasionta.
pairs.english: Oh come, let's sing to Yahweh. Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nije taufanmato gui menaña yan y grasias, ya tafatinas y minagof na inagang nu y salmos.
pairs.english: Let's come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let's extol him with songs!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova y dangculo na Yuus, yan y dangculo na Ray gui jilo todo yuus.
pairs.english: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jalom y canaeña nae mangaegue y manadong na sagayan gui tano: y minetgot y beca sija iyoña locue.
pairs.english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tase iyoña yan güiya fumatinas: yan y canaeñaja fumatinas y anglo na tano.
pairs.english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O maela nije taadora ya tafanecon papa, nije tafandimo gui menan Jeova ni y fumatinasjit.
pairs.english: Oh come, let's worship and bow down. Let's kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya y Yuusta; yan jita y taotao gui pastajiña, yan y quinilo gui canaeña. Pago na jaane yaguin injingog y inagangña,
pairs.english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo munafanmajejetog y corasonmiyo, taegüije guiya Meriba, taegüije y jaanin y tentasion gui desierto.
pairs.english: Don't harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y tatanmiyo tumientayo, machagueyo, yan malie y chechojo.
pairs.english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cuarenta años inapmamña nae tristeyo pot este na generasion, ya ileco: Sija na taotao ni y manlache gui corasonñija, yan jagasja ti jatungo y chalanjo.
pairs.english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, "It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot ayo na manjulayo gui binibujo, ya sija ti siña majalom gui descansoco.
pairs.english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They won't enter into my rest."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O cantaye si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta: cantaye si Jeova todo y tano.
pairs.english: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova, bendise y naanña; fanmamanue ni y satbasionña guinin y jaane yan y jaane.
pairs.english: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan claro y minalagña gui nasion sija ya y ninámanmanña gui entalo todo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova dangculo, yan sendangculo para umaalaba: güiya umamaañaogüe mas qui todo yuus.
pairs.english: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y yuus y nasion sija manidolo: lao si Jeova fumatinas y langet sija.
pairs.english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Onra yan minagas mangaegue gui menaña: minetgot yan guinatbo mangaegue gui jalom y santos na sagaña.
pairs.english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova, O familian gui taotao sija, nae si Jeova minalag yan minetgot.
pairs.english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova ni y minalag sa uiyon y naanña: chule y ninae ya maela sanjalom gui sagaña.
pairs.english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O adora si Jeova gui guinatbon y sinantosña: fanlaolao gui menaña todo y tano.
pairs.english: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan gui nasion sija na si Jeova jagobiebietna: y tano maplanta locue ni y ti siña manacalamten: guiya jumusga y taotao gui tininas.
pairs.english: Say among the nations, "Yahweh reigns." The world is also established. It can't be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmagof y langet sija, yan senmagof y tano; ya y tase palalangpang, yan y binilaña.
pairs.english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fangualuan senmagof yan todo y mangaegue gui sanjalomña: ayonae todo y trongco sija gui jalomtano mangantapot y minagof.
pairs.english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui menan Jeova, sa güiya umamamaela; sa guiya umamamaela para ujusga y tano: ujusga y tano gui tininas, yan y taotao sija gui minagajetña.
pairs.english: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna, polo ya y tano umagof; polo ya y minegae y isla ufansenmagof.
pairs.english: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
