pairs.chamorro: Y mapagajes yan y jemjom sija mangaegue gui oriyaña: tininas yan juisio y plinantan y tronuña.
pairs.english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guafe manjanao gui menaña, yan mausinesenggue y enimiguña gui oriya.
pairs.english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lamlamña maninina y tano: ya y tano malie ya ninalaolao.
pairs.english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egso sija manmadirite taegüije y danges gui menan Jeova, gui menan y Señot y tano todo.
pairs.english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet sumangan claro y tininasña, yan todo y taotao guinin malie y minalagña.
pairs.english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmamajlao todo ayo sija y sumesetbe y imagen sija ni tinaga, ni y tunanmaesaja sija y ídolo sija: Adora güe todo jamyo ni y yuus.
pairs.english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya Sion jajungog ya ninamagof, yan y jagan Juda sija ninafansenmagof; sa pot y juisiomo sija, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago Jeova, mas taquilo gui jilo todo y tano: ya jago umanacajulo chago gui jilo todo y yuus.
pairs.english: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jamyo y gumaeya si Jeova, jachatlie y daño: güiya umadaje y anten y mañantosña: güiya munafanlibre sija juyong gui canae y manaelaye.
pairs.english: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manana matanme para y manunas, yan minagof para y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof as Jeova jamyo ni y manunas; nae grasias y santos na naaña.
pairs.english: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CANTAYE si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta; sa güiya fumatinas y mannamanman na güinaja: sa y agapa na canaeña, yan y santos na canaeña fumatinas y satbasion para güiya.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm. > > Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova janamatungo y satbasionña: y tininasña jafanue gui menan y nasion sija.
pairs.english: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jajaso y minaaseña yan y minagajetña para y guima Israel: ya todo sija y uttimon y tano, guinin malie y satbasion y Yuusta.
pairs.english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas y minagof na inagang as Jeova, todo y tano: agang yan fanganta, nu y minagof, junggan, fanganta alabansa sija.
pairs.english: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantayo si Jeova y alabansa sija, nu y atpa; y atpa yan y inagang y guinatbon musica.
pairs.english: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y trompeta sija yan y sonidon y cotneta; fatinas y minagof na inagang gui menan y Ray Jeova.
pairs.english: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y tase upalalangpang yan y binilaña; y tano yan y mañasaga gui sanjalomña;
pairs.english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y manadan janom ujanafamapagpag canaeñija: polo ya y egso sija manganta pot y minagof.
pairs.english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui menan Jeova: sa güiya umamamaela para ujusga y tano: ujusga y tano, gui tininas yan y taotao sija gui minagajet.
pairs.english: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna; polo ya y taotao sija ufanlaolao; matatachong güe guijilo y querubin: polo ya y tano ufangalamten.
pairs.english: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova dangculo guiya Sion: yan güiya mas taquilo gui jilo todo y taotao.
pairs.english: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija ufanalaba y dinagculon yan y namaañao na naanmo; sa santos güe.
pairs.english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ninasiñan y ray locue jaguaeya y juisio: jago pumolo y tininas; jago fumatinas y juisio yan y tininas gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: The King's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nacajulo si Jeova ni y Yuusta, yan adora gui fañajangan y adengña; sa santos güe.
pairs.english: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Moises yan Aaron gui entalo mamale, yan si Samuel manisija yan ayo y umaagang y naanña; sija umaagang si Jeova, ya güiya umope sija.
pairs.english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya cumuentutuse sija gui jalom y jaliguen y mapagajes: sija umadaje y tinagoña, yan y otden ni y mannae sija.
pairs.english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umope sija, O Jeova Yuusmame: jago si Yuus ni y umasie sija, achogja jago chumule y inemog gui chechoñija.
pairs.english: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nacajulo si Jeova ni y Yuusta, yan adora güe gui santos na ogsoña: sa si Jeova, ni y Yuusta, santos güe.
pairs.english: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FATINAS y minagof na inagang as Jeova: jamyo tano todos.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm of thanksgiving. > > Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Setbe si Jeova ni y minagof: maela gui menaña ya fanganta.
pairs.english: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tingo na si Jeova, güiya si Yuus: güiyaja y fumatinas jit, yan jita iyoña; jita y taotaoña yan y quinilo sija gui pastajiña.
pairs.english: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanjalom gui trangcaña yan y inefresen grasias, ya y jalom y sagaña yan y alabansa: nae güe grasias, yan bendise y naanña.
pairs.english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova mauleg; y minaaseña ugagaegue para taejinecog; yan y minagajet para todo y generasion sija.
pairs.english: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE jucanta y minaase yan y juisio: iyajago nae O Jeova, bae jucanta.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juadajeyo ni y malate gui cabales na jinanao. O ngaean nae unfato jao guiya guajo? bae jufamocat gui jalom guimajo yan y cabales na corason.
pairs.english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mungayo pumolo y taelaye na güinaja gui menan atadogjo: juchatlie y chechoñija ayo y manabag sija: tiucheton guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chatpayon na corason junafanjanao guiya guajo; ti yajo tumungo y manaelaye na güinaja.
pairs.english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y secreto na finajiyunge y tiguangña, güiya bae juyulang: ya ayo y taquilo y inatanña yan y sobetbio na corason ti siña jusungon.
pairs.english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won't tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo bae janameton y manmanjonggue gui tano, para ufañaga sija guiya guajo: ya ayo y mamomocat gui cabales na jinanao, güiya siempre sumesetbeyo.
pairs.english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y chumochogüe y dinague ti siña sumaga gui jalom guimajo: ya ayo y sumasagan y mandague ti siña numafitme gui menan y atadogjo.
pairs.english: He who practices deceit won't dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won't be established before my eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egaan yan y egaan bae juyulang todo y manaelaye gui tano; para uutot todo y chumochogüe ni y taelaye gui siuda Jeova.
pairs.english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh's city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y tinayuyutto, O Jeova, polo y inagangjo ya ufato guiya Jago.
pairs.english: < < A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. > > Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo munaatog y matamo guiya guajo gui jaanen anae chatsagayo: naegueng y talangamo guiya guajo; y jaane anae juagangjao, opeyo guse.
pairs.english: Don't hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanijo linachae taegüije y aso, ya y telangjo janon taegüije y falot.
pairs.english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo manetnot, yan anglo taegüije chaguan; sa malefayo jucano y najo pan.
pairs.english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y inagang y inigongjo y telangjo mafachet yan y catneco.
pairs.english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoyo yan y pelicano na pájaro gui desierto: yan taegüijeyo y memo gui lugat na mayulang.
pairs.english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jupulan, yan jumuyong yo taegüije y gorrion na pajaro güigüiyaja gui jilo y atof y guima.
pairs.english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y enimigujo lumalatdeyo todot dia; yan ayo sija y manlalalo contra guajo manmanjula pot guajo.
pairs.english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja jucano y apo taegüije y pan, yan manadaña y guimenjo yan y tanges.
pairs.english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y linalalomo yan y binibumo: sa jago jumatsayo yan yumuteyo.
pairs.english: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaanijo taegüije y anineng ni y umaso; yan angloyo taegüije y chaguan.
pairs.english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, gagaegue jao para taejinecog: yan y memoriasmo asta todo y generasion.
pairs.english: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ucajulo, yan umaase ni iya Sion: sa y tiempo para unmaase nu güiya, magajet na mato y tiempo ni y matancho.
pairs.english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tentagomo ninafanmagof ni y achoña: yan ninafanmaase ni y petbosña.
pairs.english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y nasion sija ufanmaañao ni y naan Jeova, yan todo y ray sija gui tano ni y minalagmo.
pairs.english: So the nations will fear the name of Yahweh; all the kings of the earth your glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jafatinas y Sion, umanog güe gui jalom y minalagña.
pairs.english: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagoflamen y tinayuyut y mannesesitao; yan ti jachatlie y tinayuyutñija.
pairs.english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utugue este para y generasion ni y manmámamaela: yan y taotao ni y ufanmafatinas ujaalaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya jagasja jaatan papa gui y tinaquilo y santos na sagaña; guinin y langet nae si Jeova jaatan y tano.
pairs.english: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujungog y inigong y manmaprereso: yan para upula ayo sija y manmatancho para ufanmapuno.
pairs.english: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umasangan claro y naan Jeova guiya Sion, yan y alabansaña guiya Jerusalem;
pairs.english: that men may declare the name of Yahweh in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y taotao sija manetnon ya mandaña, yan y raeno sija para ujasetbe si Jeova.
pairs.english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janadafe y minetgotto gui chalan; güiya munacadada y jaanijo.
pairs.english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ileco: O Yuusso chamo yo chumuchule gui lamita na jaanijo: y sacanmo sija para todoja y generasion.
pairs.english: I said, "My God, don't take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa desde y ampmam na tiempo jago pumolo y plinantan tano: yan y langet sija y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanmalingo, lao jago ungagaegueja: magajet na todo sija ufanguesbijo taegüije y magago: taegüije y bestido untolaeca sija, ya sija manmatalaeca.
pairs.english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago y mismojajao, yan y sacanmo sija ti ufanjocog.
pairs.english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguon y tentagomo ufangagaegue, yan y semiyanñija ufanmaplanta gui menamo.
pairs.english: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BENDISE si Jeova, O antijo: yan todo y sanjalomjo, bendise y santos na naanña.
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, O antijo, yan chamo malelefa todo ni y minaulegña:
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don't forget all his benefits;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y umasie todo tinaelayemo; ni y munamagong todo y chetnotmo;
pairs.english: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y munalibre y linâlâmo guinin y yinilang: ni y comorona jao ni güinaeyan mauleg yan y manadan minaase:
pairs.english: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y munanajong y pachotmo ni y manmauleg na güinaja: ya y pinatgonmo jananuebo taegüije y aguila.
pairs.english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova fumatinas y tinas na chocho sija, yan y juisio sija para todo ayo sija y manmachiguet.
pairs.english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munatungo si Moises ni y chalanña, ya y chechoña gui famaguon Israel.
pairs.english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova bula y minaase yan cariñoso, ñateng y binibuña yan gofmegae y minaaseña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti ufanlalatde para siempre: ni umantiene y binibuña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti guinin jafatinas guiya jita segun y isaota; ni uapasejit segun y tinaelayeta.
pairs.english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüije y langet goftaquilo gui jilo y tano, taegüijeja sendangculo y minaaseña para ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taemanoja chinagoña desde y sancatan, yan asta y sanlichan, taegüijeja chinagoña nae janajanao guiya jita y isaota.
pairs.english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoja yan y tata ni jaguaeya y famaguonña, taegüenaoja si Jeova jaguaeya ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya tumungo y jechurata; jajaso na jita y petbos.
pairs.english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao, y jaaniña taegüijeja y chaguan; taegüijeja y flores gui fangualuan lalachog.
pairs.english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y manglo manmalofan gui jiloña, yan güiya mapos: yan y sagayan ti siña jatungo mas.
pairs.english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minaase Jeova, guinin taejinecog asta taejinecog guijilo ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya, yan y tininasña gui famaguon y famaguon;
pairs.english: But Yahweh's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children's children;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya sija y umadadaje y tratuña, yan ayo sija y jumajaso y finanagüeña para ufatinas.
pairs.english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova japlanta y tronuña gui langet sija; yan y raenoña y naregla y jilo todoja.
pairs.english: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, jamyo ni angjetña sija, ni y manmatatnga gui minetgot, ni y cumumple y sinanganña, ni y umecungog y inagang y finoña.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova todo jamyo ni y inetnon sendaloña: jamyo ni y ministroña ni y fumatitinas y minalagoña.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, todo y finatinasña, gui todo y sagayan anae jagobiebietna: bendise si Jeova, O antijo.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BENDISE si Jeova, O antijo: O Jeova Yuusso, jago y sendangculo; jago minagagago ni y onra, yan y minagas.
pairs.english: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y untampen maesajao ni y manana taegüije y bestido: ni y jumuto juyong y langet sija taegüije y cottina.
pairs.english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y plumanta y jayo y aposentuña gui jalom janom: ni y fumatinas y mapagajes para caruajeña: ni y mamomocat gui jilo y papan y manglo.
pairs.english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y fumatinas y manglo sija para tentagoña: y ministroña y mañila y guafe.
pairs.english: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pumolo y plinantan tano, ya ti siña manacalamten para taejinecog.
pairs.english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumampe güe ni y tinadong taegüije y bestido: y janom sija manotojgue gui sanjilo y beca sija.
pairs.english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y linalatdemo, sija manjanao; ya pot y inagang y julumo mañadig manjanao.
pairs.english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manjanao julo gui beca sija, sija apan papa gui oriyan y bayesija, gui sagayan ni y jago fumamauleg para sija.
pairs.english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo y uttimonñija ya ti siña manmalofan guato; para ti siña jabira sija talo para utampe y tano.
pairs.english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don't turn again to cover the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago y tutujon y janom gui jalom y bayesija; ni y manmalalago gui entalo y egso sija.
pairs.english: He sends forth springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija numae guimenñija y todo gâgâ sija gui fangualuan: y manmachaleg na asno sija manmagong y majoñija.
pairs.english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya sija nae y pajaron y langet guaja sagañija ya mangacanta gui entalo y ramas sija.
pairs.english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya numaye janom y egso sija guinin y aposentuña sija: y tano jaspog ni y tinegcha y chechomo.
pairs.english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y chaguan munafanlâlâ para y guaca sija, yan y tinanom para usinetbe y taotao: para ufañule nengcano gui tano;
pairs.english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may bring forth food out of the earth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y bino ni y munamamagof y corason y taotao, yan y laña para ulamlam y mataña, yan y pan ni y munamemetgot y corason y taotao.
pairs.english: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man's heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y trongcon jayo Jeova manbula chugo; y sedro sija gui Libano ni y tinanomña;
pairs.english: Yahweh's trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y pajaro jafatitinas y chechoñija; ya y chuchuco, y trongcon pino guimaña.
pairs.english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taquilo na ogso sija para y manmachaleg na chiba: yan y acho sija guinegüe para y conejo.
pairs.english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatancho y pilan para y tiempo: y atdao tumungo y jinanaoña papa.
pairs.english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago fumatinas y jemjom yan puenge; anae todo y gâgâ gui jalomtano mangucunanaf mona.
pairs.english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manfamaguon na leon sija manaagang ni y manmaconeñija yan jaaliligao y nañija guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao cajulo, sija manmapos, yan manason sija papa gui jalom y liyangñija.
pairs.english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao jumajanao mona gui finatinasña yan gui chechoña, asta qui puenge.
pairs.english: Man goes forth to his work, to his labor until the evening.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, manminegae sija y chechomo! y minenajlom, jago fumatinas sija todo: y tano senbula ni y rinicumo.
pairs.english: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo guato gaegue y tase, dangculo yan ancho, anae y sanjalomña sija y güinaja na mangucunanaf ni ti siña matufong, todoja mandangculo yan mandiquique sija na gâgâ.
pairs.english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manjajanao y batco sija: ayo nae gaegue y lebiatan ni y finatinasmo para y jumugando gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija todo mumananggajao; sa jago siña unnae sija nañija gui tiempo ni matancho.
pairs.english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo y jago numae, sija naufandaña: unbaba y canaemo ya sija mannajong ni y minauleg.
pairs.english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnaatog y matamo, sija mañatsaga: unchule y jinagonñija, sija manmatae, yan manalo guato gui petbosñija.
pairs.english: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Untago mona y espiritumo, sija manfinatinas: yan jago munanuebo y inatan gui sanjilo y tano.
pairs.english: You send forth your Spirit: they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y minalag Jeova ugagaegue para taejinecog: Polo ya si Jeova umagof gui chechona:
pairs.english: Let the glory of Yahweh endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jaatan y jilo y tano yan jayengyong: ni y japacha y egso sija yan janaasgon.
pairs.english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jucantaye si Jeova taemenoja y inanaco y linâlâjo: bae jucantaye tinina y Yuusso mientras lalâlâyo.
pairs.english: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y jinasoco iya güiya usenmames: bae jugofmagof as Jeova.
pairs.english: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y manisao ya ufanlinachae gui tano, polo y manaelaye ya utaya. Bendise si Jeova, O antijo. Alaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias si Jeova; agang y naanña; namatungo y chechoña gui entalo taotao sija.
pairs.english: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye güe, cantaye güe ni y alabansa sija; fanadingan ni y todo y chechoña ni y mannamanman.
pairs.english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalag jamyo ni y santos na naanña: umanmagof ayo sija na corason y umaliligao si Jeova.
pairs.english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aligao si Jeova yan y minetgotña: Aligao y mataña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y ninamanman checho ni y monjayan jachogüe; ninamanmanña yan y juision y pachotña;
pairs.english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jamyo, ni y semiyan Abraham tentagoña, jamyo ni y famaguon Jacob inayegña sija.
pairs.english: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya si Jeova Yuusta: y juisioñasija mangaegue todo gui tano.
pairs.english: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jaso y tratuña para taejinecog, y finijo ni y tinagoña para mit na generasion.
pairs.english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na trato ni y jafatinas gui as Abraham, yan y jinilaña gui as Ysaac.
pairs.english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ayoja janafitme gui as Jacob para otden, yan as Israel para taejinecog na trato.
pairs.english: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylelegña: Yya jago guajo junaejao y tano Cananea, y facae y erensiamo.
pairs.english: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance";

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae sija mandidideja na numeron taotao: junggan, senmandidide yan taotao juyong güije;
pairs.english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manjanao guinin y un nasion asta y otro nasion, guinin y un raeno asta otro taotao;
pairs.english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti japolo ni un taotao na ujafatinas daño guiya sija: magajet na jalalatde y ray sija pot causañija:
pairs.english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Chamo pumapacha y pinalaejo, yan chamo munafanlalamen y profetajo sija.
pairs.english: "Don't touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y ñinalang gui jilo y tano: ya jayulang todo y minetgot y agon.
pairs.english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago un taotao gui menañija, si José ni y mabende para tentago.
pairs.english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija na adengña y ninafanlamen ni y cadena: güiya mapolo guientalo y lilog.
pairs.english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y tiempo anae macumple y finoña: ya y fino Jeova chumague güe,
pairs.english: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh's word proved him true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray matago ya pinila güe, ayo y magas taotao sija yan pinelo güe na ujanao libre.
pairs.english: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pinelo güe magas gui guimaña yan gobietnon todo y güinajaña:
pairs.english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para upreso y prinsipeña ni y minagofña; yan ufanagüe y manamco ni y manpápagat.
pairs.english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Israel locue jumalom guiya Egipto; yan si Jacob taotao juyong sumasaga gui tano Cam.
pairs.english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janafansenmegae y taotaoña; yan janafanmetgot mas que y enimigoñija.
pairs.english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jabira y corasonñija para ujachatlie y taotaoña sija, para ufanmatinas ni y finaye gui tentagoña sija.
pairs.english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago si Moises ni y tentagoña; yan si Aaron ni y guinin inayegña.
pairs.english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija japolo ni y señatña guiya sija, yan ninamanman gui tano Cam.
pairs.english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago y jemjom, ya ninajomjom; yan sija ti ninafanaguaguat contra y finoña.
pairs.english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn't rebel against his words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatolaeca y janomñija jafajâgâ, yan japuno y güijanñija.
pairs.english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tanoñija janae manadan ranas, ya megae gui jalom y aposenton y rayñija sija.
pairs.english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya sumasangan, yan manmato manadan dinaña lalo, yan juto sija gui todo y oriyan y tanoñija.
pairs.english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya numae sija uchan graniso, yan mañila guafe gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasaolag y trongcon ubasñija locue, yan y trongcon ygosñija; yan jajulog y trongcon jayo sija gui oriyan tanoñija.
pairs.english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y sumangan, yan y apacha sija manmato, yan uruga na ulo sija yan ayo taya numeroñija,
pairs.english: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jacano todo y tinanom gui jalom y tanoñija, yan jalachae sija y tinegcha gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno locue todo y finenana na finañagon laje gui tanoñija, y magas todo y ninasiñañija.
pairs.english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija juyong locue yan y salape yan y oro; yan taya ni un taotao malango gui triboñija.
pairs.english: He brought them forth with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya Egipto manmagof anae sija manjanao: pot minaañaoñija guinin podong guiya sija.
pairs.english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jajuto y mapagajes para ufantinampe; yan y guafe janae para ufaninina gui puenge.
pairs.english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmangagao y taotao, yan jaconie pajaro ni calang palumo sija; yan ninafanjaspog ni y pan langet.
pairs.english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jababa y acho yan y janom milalag juyong; manmalalago gui anglo na sagayan taegüije y sadog.
pairs.english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajaso y santos na sinanganña, yan Abraham ni y tentagoña.
pairs.english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone juyong y taotaoña yan y minagof, yan y inayegña gui cantasion sija.
pairs.english: He brought forth his people with joy, his chosen with singing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janae sija ni y tano y nasion sija: yan sija jachule para iyoñija ni y checho y taotao sija:
pairs.english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña adaje y otdenña, yan ufatinas y layña. Alaba jamyo si Jeova.
pairs.english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ALABA jamyo si Jeova. O nae grasias si Jeova; sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegueja para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye siña sumangan y gaesisiñan y checho Jeova? pot mamanue todo ni y alabansaña?
pairs.english: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso ayo sija y umadadaje y juisio, yan ayo y fumatitinas y tininas todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasoyo, O Jeova, nu y finaborese ni y unnae y taotaomo; O bisitayo nu y satbasionmo;
pairs.english: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jusiña lumie y minauleg gui inayegmo, para jusiña mumagof gui minagof y nasionmo, para jusiña mumalag gui erensiamo.
pairs.english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin manisaojam yan y tatanmame, infatinas y tinaelaye yan inchegüe y inechong.
pairs.english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tatanmame ti jatungo y ninamanmanmo guiya Egipto; ti jajaso y manadan y minaasemo; lao manmanembeste gui tase, junggan gui Tasen Agaga.
pairs.english: Our fathers didn't understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn't remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jasatbaja sija pot y naanña, para usiña janamatungo y dangculon y ninasiñaña.
pairs.english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jalalatde y Tasen Agaga locue yan janaanglo: lao jaesgaejon sija inanaco y todo gui tinadong, taegüije todo inanaco y desierto.
pairs.english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janafanlibre sija guinin y canae ayo y chumatlie sija, yan jarescata sija guinin y canae y enimigo.
pairs.english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y janom sija tumampe y contrarioñija: ya taya ni uno guiya sija sebla.
pairs.english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jajonggue y sinanganña sija; jacanta y tininaña.
pairs.english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guse manmalefa ni y chechoña: ti janangga y pinagatña:
pairs.english: They soon forgot his works. They didn't wait for his counsel,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manmalago megae gui jalomtano, yan matienta si Yuus gui desierto.
pairs.english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya numae sija ni y guinagaoñija; lao janamanae ni y minasogsog gui jalom y anteñija.
pairs.english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanugo as Moises gui fangualuan; yan si Aaron ni y santos Jeova.
pairs.english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh's saint.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano mababa ya pinañot si Datan, yan mantinampe y mangachong Abirom.
pairs.english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y guafe manafañila gui mangachongñija; ya y mañila sumonggue y manaelaye.
pairs.english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmamatinas tatnero guiya Horeb, yan maadora y diniriten y imagen.
pairs.english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije, jatulaeca y minalagñija para nu jechuran guaca ni y chumochocho chaguan.
pairs.english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalefa as Yuus ni y satbadotñija, ni y fumatinas y mandangculo na güinaja guiya Egipto;
pairs.english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mannamanman na checho gui tano Cam, yan mannamaañao na güinaja gui Tasen Agaga.
pairs.english: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina ilegña güiya, na uyunilang sija, yaguin ti si Moises ni y inayegña ti tumogue gui menaña gui finapetta, para ubira y binibuña para chaña yumuyulang sija.
pairs.english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn't destroy them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jachatlie y güaeyayon na tano, ya ti jajonggue y finoña.
pairs.english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn't believe his word,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mangonggong gui sa tiendañíja; ya ti jaecungog y inagang Jeova.
pairs.english: but murmured in their tents, and didn't listen to Yahweh's voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jajatsa y canaeña contra sija; para uyute sija gui jalom y desierto:
pairs.english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para uyute y semiyañija locue gui nasion sija, yan para uchalapon sija gui jalom y tano sija.
pairs.english: that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña sija gui Baal-peor; ya jacano y inefresen y manmatae.
pairs.english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine sija mannalalalo güe nu y chechoñija: ya derepente mato gui jiloñija sija chetnot.
pairs.english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janatojgue julo si Finees, ya jafatinas y juisio: ya y chetnot pumara.
pairs.english: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ayo nae jatufong iya güiya y tininas, gui todo y generasion sija para taejinecog.
pairs.english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija mannalalalo güe locue gui janom guiya Meriba: ya jumuyong daño para si Moises pot causañija.
pairs.english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija chumoma y espirituña; sa jasangan sin jinaso pot labiosña.
pairs.english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jayulang y nasion sija, taegüije si Jeova ni y mantinago sija.
pairs.english: They didn't destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mandaña sija yan y nasion sija, yan jaeyag y chechoñija:
pairs.english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jasetbe y idolosñija: jumuyong un laso para sija.
pairs.english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jaofrese y lajeñija yan y jagañija gui anite,
pairs.english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jachuda y jâgâ y manaeisao, magajet na y jâgâ y lajeñija yan y jagañija ni jaofrese gui idolos guiya Cananea: yan y tano ni y ninaáplacha ni y jâgâ.
pairs.english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije munafanáplacha pot y chechoñijaja, yan ninafanábale ni y finatinasñija.
pairs.english: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y binibon Jeova sinenggue contra y taotaoña, ya jaguefchatlie y erensiañija.
pairs.english: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janae nu sija gui canae y nasion sija; yan ayo y chumatlie sija janafanmagas gui jiloñija.
pairs.english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y enimigoñija locue chumiguet sija, yan sija chumule asta y jalom inesgue gui papa y canaeñija.
pairs.english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na biaje nae janafanlibre sija; lao sija maembeste güe ni y pinagatñija, yan manmachile papa gui tatpapa ni y tinaelayeñija.
pairs.english: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaatan y pinitiñija, anae jajungog y inagangñija.
pairs.english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajaso para sija y tratuña, yan ninafanmañotsot según y minegae y minaaseña.
pairs.english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafangaease locue ni ayo y cumone sija preso.
pairs.english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanlibrejam, O Jeova, Yuusmame, yan nafandañajam gui entalo y nasion sija, para unae grasias y santos na naanmo, yan ufangana gui alabansamo.
pairs.english: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova ni Yuus Israel guinin y taejinecog para y taejinecog. Polo ya todo taotao ilegñija. Amen. Alaba jamyo si Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, "Amen." Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias si Jeova, sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y ninafanlibre as Jeova ya ujasangan, anae janafanlibre guinin y canae y contrario;
pairs.english: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janafandaña sija juyong gui tano sija, guinin y sancatan, yan guinin y sanlichan, guinin y san lago, yan guinin y san jaya.
pairs.english: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaabag gui jalomtano gui chalan desierto; ya ti manmañoda siuda para ufañaga.
pairs.english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manñalang yan minajo sija, y anteñija manlalango gui sanjalomñija.
pairs.english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninesgaejon sija mona, gui tinas na chalan, para usiña manjanao para y siuda anae mañasaga.
pairs.english: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui famaguon taotao sija.
pairs.english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jananajong y malago na ante, yan janabula y ñalang na ante ni y minauleg.
pairs.english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
