pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmatatachong gui jemjom yan y jalom y anineng y finatae, ni y guinin jagode nu y pinite yan lulog;
pairs.english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manembeste contra y fino Yuus, yan jachatlie y pinagat y Gueftaquilo:
pairs.english: because they rebelled against the words of God , and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jachule papa y corasonñija gui checho; manbasnag papa ya taya para ufaninayuda.
pairs.english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was none to help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jachule sija juyong gui jemjom yan y anineng y finatae, yan jagutos y manmagodeñija.
pairs.english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bonds in sunder.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui famaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya yumamag y trangcan bronse, yan janapedaso y rejas lulog.
pairs.english: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaduco, sa pot y tinaelayeñija yan pot y inechongñija fanmanmamadese.
pairs.english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y anteñija jachatlie todo y clasen nengcano; yan manjijot gui trangcan y finatae.
pairs.english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manninae y finoña ya manninajomlo sija, yan manninalibre sija guinin y yinilangñija.
pairs.english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui fumaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya polo sija ya ujaofrese y inefresen grasias sija, yan jasangan claro y chechoña gui cantan minagof.
pairs.english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ni manjanao papa gui tase gui jalom y batco, ni y fumatinas chechoñija gui jilo manadan janom sija;
pairs.english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija lumie y checho Jeova, yan y ninamanmanña gui jalom y tinadong.
pairs.english: These see Yahweh's works, and his wonders in the deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatagoña, ya janacajulo y pagyon manglo, ni y jumatsa julo y napo sija.
pairs.english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo para y langet, manjanao talo papa para y tinadong: y anteñija manmaderite pot y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmatulaejon mona an tate, yan manmamangag taegüije y bulacho na taotao, yan manmalingo y jinasoñija.
pairs.english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janabasta y pagyo, yan y napo sija manmamatquilo.
pairs.english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmagof sa mangieto, ya taegüije jacone sija asta y minalagoñija na puetto.
pairs.english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na checoña gui famaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija umanacajulo güe locue gui y inetnon y taotao yan ufanmanalaba nu güiya gui tachong y manamco.
pairs.english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafasadog y desierto, yan jafaanglo na oda y tutujon janom;
pairs.english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafadesierton asiga y mauleg na tano, pot y tinaelayen ayo sija y mañasaga gui sanjalom.
pairs.english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafajagoen janom y desierto, yan janafamimichao y janom y anglo na oda.
pairs.english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ayo na janafañaga y manñalang, ya sija siña jafamauleg y siuda para ufañaga;
pairs.english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan matanme y fangualuan, yan manmananom gui fangualuan ubas, ya ufanmarecoge y tinegchan y aumento.
pairs.english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jabendise sija locue, para ufangosmegae; yan ti upolo y gañija gâgâ na udidide.
pairs.english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo sija mandidide yan mannecon papa, pot y chiniguet, chinatsaga, yan triniste.
pairs.english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jachuda sinala gui jilo y prinsepe sija, yan janafanabag sija gui jalomtano anae taya chalan.
pairs.english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao japolo y mannesesitao julo guinin y pinadese, yan mandaña gui familia sija taegüije y inetnon quinilo.
pairs.english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ujalie ayo yan ufanmagof; yan todo y tinaelaye ujinichom y pachotña.
pairs.english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea jaye na manmalate, ujaadaje este sija na güinaja; ya sija ujajaso y minaase gui as Jeova.
pairs.english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, y corasonjo esta meton; bae jucanta, magajetja na jucanta alabansa sija yan todo y minalagjo.
pairs.english: < < A Song. A Psalm by David. > > My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatmata guitala, yan atpa: guajoja na maesa magmatayo taftaf.
pairs.english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junae jao grasias, Jeova gui entalo y taotao sija: yan jucantaye alabansa, sija gui entalo y nasion sija.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y dangculon y minaasemo gui san jilo y langet: yan y minagajetmo tinacaja y mapagajes sija.
pairs.english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao, O Yuus, gui jilo y langet: yan y minalagomo gui san jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña ayo y güinaeyamo manlibre ni y agapa na canaemo, yan opejam.
pairs.english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ilegña gui sinantosña: Guajo jumagof, guajo jupatte Siquem, yan jumide juyong y bayen Sucot.
pairs.english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yyoco Gilaad; iyoco Manases: Efrain locue y minetgot y ilujo; Juda y bastonjo;
pairs.english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Moab y palanganajo anae jufagase adeng sija: y jilo Edom nae juyute y sapatoso: y jilo Filistia nae juagang.
pairs.english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye uconeyo asta y jalom y fitme na siuda? Jaye uinesgaejonyo asta y jalom Idumea?
pairs.english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jago, O Yuus, ni y yumute jam? yan jago, O Yuus, ti jumanao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: Haven't you rejected us, God? You don't go forth, God, with our armies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam linibre gui chinatsaga: sa taesetbe y inayudan y taotao.
pairs.english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: As Yuus nae utafanmatatnga: sa güiyaja uguinacha papa y enimiguta.
pairs.english: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO famatquiquilo, O Yuus, gui alabansajo;
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > God of my praise, don't remain silent,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y pachot y manaelaye yan y pachot y dinague manmababa contra guajo: sa manguecuentos contra guajo yan y mandacon na jula.
pairs.english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija umoriyayayeyo locue ni y finijo chinatlie; yan manmumo contra guajo sin jafa.
pairs.english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y apas y güinaeyaco, sija contrariujo: lao guajo siempre manayuyutyo.
pairs.english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan sija jaapaseyo taelaye pot mauleg, yan chinatlie pot y guinaeyaco.
pairs.english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo jao y taelaye na taotao guiya güiya: ya polo un contrario ya utojgue gui agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin majusga güe, polo ya umasentensia: yan y tinaetaeña ufamaisao.
pairs.english: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaaniña udidide: yan otro uchinile ofisioña.
pairs.english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguonña ufanaetata yan y asaguaña ubiuda.
pairs.english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y famaguonña ufanlaong yan ufanmangagao: ya polo sija ya umaliligao y nañija güije gui chago gui sagañija na mayulang.
pairs.english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya umaamot ya unnachule todo y güinajaña, yan y taotao juyong chumoleguan ni y finachochoña.
pairs.english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya taya ni jaye umaase ni güiya; yan ni uno ufinaborese y manaetata na famaguonña.
pairs.english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y famaguonña ufanmautut; yan gui generasion ni y jadalalalag, umafagasñaejon y naanñija.
pairs.english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Poly ya y tinaelayen y tataña sija umajaso gui as Jeova: ya y isao nanaña ti umafagasñaejon.
pairs.english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don't let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija siempre ufangaegue gui menan Jeova, sa güiya siña umutut y jinasoñija guinin y tano.
pairs.english: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jajaso mamanue minaase, lao japetsigue y peble yan y nesesitao na taotao, yan y mayulang na corason ujapuno sija.
pairs.english: because he didn't remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jaguaeya y matdision, ya ayo na mato guiya güiya; ya ti ninamagof ni y bendision, ya ayo na chago guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn't delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya mumagago güe ni y matdision taegüije y bestiduña, ya ayo na jumalom gui jalom y tiyanña taegüije y janom, yan taegüije y laña gui jalom tolangña.
pairs.english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ayo guiya güiya, taegüije y magago ni y jatatampegüe, yan para sinturon ni y jadudog güe siempre.
pairs.english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este apas y contrariujo sija guinin as Jeova, yan ayo sija ni y manguecuentos taelaye contra y antijo.
pairs.english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao fatinas para guajo, O Yuus Jeova, pot y naanmo: sa mauleg na minaasemo, enao mina nalibreyo.
pairs.english: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name's sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pobleyo, yan nesesitaoyo, yan y corasonjo mañetnot gui sanjalomjo.
pairs.english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mapos yo taegüije y anineng yaguin malofan: matafye yo julo yan papa taegüije y apacha.
pairs.english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y timoco mandafe pot y inayunat; yan y catneco manmasogsog, sa ti jataca y iinemog.
pairs.english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumuyong yo locue taegüije linalatde guiya sija: anae maaatanyo jayeyengyong y iloñija.
pairs.english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayudayo, O Jeova Yuusso; O satbayo segun y minaasemo:
pairs.english: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para sija ujatungo na este y canaemo: na jago, Jeova, fumatinas este.
pairs.english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija manmamatdise, lao jago manbendise: yaguin sija mangajulo, ufanmamajlao; lao y tentagomo umagof.
pairs.english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y contrariojo ufanminagago ni y desonra; yan ufantinampe sija ni y minamajlaoñija taegüije y capa.
pairs.english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova bae junae sendangculo na grasias nu y pachotto; junggan, jualabagüe gui linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya utojgüe gui agapa na canae y nesesitao, para usinatba güe guinin ayo sija y jumusga y antiña.
pairs.english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova ilegña ni y señotto, fatachong gui agapa na canaejo, asta qui jupolo y enimigo para fañajangan adengmo.
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh says to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uninamannae y baran minetgotmo guinin Sion: gobietna gui entalo y enimigumo sija.
pairs.english: Yahweh will send forth the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotaomo ufanmalago na ufanmanofrese nu sija gui jaanen y ninasiñamo: gui guinatbon sija y sinantos, guinin y tiyan y agaan, ungae serenon y pinatgonmo.
pairs.english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova manjula ya timañotsot, jago y pale para taejinecog segun y otden Melquisedec.
pairs.english: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova, gui agapa na canaemo, upanag todo y ray sija gui jaanin y binibuña.
pairs.english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufanjusga gui entalo y nasion sija, janabula y sagayan sija ni y tataotao y manmatae; unamagomgom y ilo gui jilo y megae na tano sija.
pairs.english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unaguimen y sadog gui chalan: enaomina güiya jumatsa julo y ilo.
pairs.english: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Guajo junae si Jeova grasias contodo y corasonjo, gui jalom y pinagat manunas, yan y jalom y inetnon taotao.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y checho Jeova mansendangculo, ya maaliligao ni ayo sija todo y ninafanmamagof nu estesija.
pairs.english: Yahweh's works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chechoña y onra yan minagas: yan y tininasña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas y mannamanman na chechoña para umajajaso: si Jeova cariñoso yan bula ni y minaase.
pairs.english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya guinin munae nengcano ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya: ya güiya siempre jajasoja tratuña.
pairs.english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jafanue y taotaoña ni y ninasiñan y chechoña, anae janae sija ni y erensian y nasion sija.
pairs.english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y checho sija y canaeña y minagajet yan juisio; ya todo y sinanganña sija manseguro.
pairs.english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manfitme sija para taejinecog yan taejinecog, yan mamafatinas gui minagajet yan y tininas.
pairs.english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janamannae y linibre para y taotaoña; ya jatago y tratuña para taejinecog: sinantos yan inenra y naanña.
pairs.english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: tinagoña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Dichoso y taotao ni maañao as Jeova, yan ninasendangculo y minagofña ni y tinagoña sija.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyaña manmatatnga gui jilo y tano: ya y generasion manunas ufandichoso.
pairs.english: His seed will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güinaja yan rinico mangaegue gui guimaña: ya y tininasña gagaegueja para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manunas nae cajulo y manana gui jalom jomjom: güiya cariñoso güe yan bula minaase, yan tunasgüe.
pairs.english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg para ayo na taotao ni y fumatitinas y cariño, yan numanaayao: güiya umantiene y causaña gui juisio.
pairs.english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya ti umanacalamten para taejinecog: y manunas para taejinecog: ufanmajajasoja.
pairs.english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti umaañao ni y manaelaye na notisia sija: y corasonña meton ya jaangoco si Jeova.
pairs.english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonña fitme ya güiya ti umaañao, asta qui jalie y diniseaña gui jilo y contrariuña sija.
pairs.english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya tumalapon, güiya numae ni y mamoble; ya y tininasña gagaegue para taejinecog, y canggelonña umajatsa ni y inenra.
pairs.english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye na taotao jalie ayo yan ninapinite: yan janachechegcheg y nifenña, yan maderite ya mapos: ya y diniseaña y taelaye umalingo.
pairs.english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba, O tentago Jeova sija. Fanmanalaba y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise the name of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito y naan Jeova, desde este na tiempo yan para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Blessed be the name of Yahweh, from this time forth and forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y quinajulo y atdao asta y minachomña papa, y naan Jeova para umaalaba.
pairs.english: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh's name is to be praised.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova gueftaquilo gui jilo todo y nasion yan y minalagña gui jilo y langet sija.
pairs.english: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye parejuña si Jeova ni y Yuusta, ni y japolo y tachongña gui sanjilo.
pairs.english: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y muna umitde güe para uatan y güinaja sija ni y mangaegue gui langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jumatsa julo y mamoble gui petbos, yan jajatsa y mananesitao gui monton estietcot.
pairs.english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unafanmatachong yan y prinsepe sija magajet, yan y prinsepen y taotaoña sija.
pairs.english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafamulan guma y ti fafañago na palaoan, ya jumuyong gofmagof na nanan famaguon. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE si Israel jumanao juyong Egipto, y guima Jacob guinin y taotao y finijo na ti matungo.
pairs.english: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juda jumuyong y santos na sagaña, yan Israel y gobietnoña.
pairs.english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tase jalie ayo, yan malago; Jordan masugon tate.
pairs.english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y beca sija manayog taegüije y quinilo laje yan y mandiquique ogso sija taegüije y manpatgon na quinilo sija.
pairs.english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa guaja guiya jago, O tase, na malagojao? Jago Jordan ni y masugon tate?
pairs.english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y beca sija ni y manayog taegüije y quinilo laje; yan jamyo di quique na ogso sija taegüije y manpatgon na quinilo sija?
pairs.english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mayeyengyong, jago tano, gui menan Jeova, gui menan y Yuus Jacob;
pairs.english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafaacho y jagoe janom, ya jafagagot y tutujon janom sija.
pairs.english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AJE ti iyajame, O Jeova, aje ti iyajame, lao iya naanmo, nae uminalag pot y minaasemo, yan pot y minagajetmo.
pairs.english: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa mojon y nasion ilegñija: Mangue pago y Yuusñija?
pairs.english: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God, now?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuusmame gaegue gui langet: guinin jafatinas jafaja y minalagoña.
pairs.english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y idolosñija sija salape yan oro, finatinas y canae y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja pachotñija lao ti manguecuentos: guaja atadogñija lao ti manmanlilie;
pairs.english: They have mouths, but they don't speak. They have eyes, but they don't see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja talangañija lao ti manmanjujungog: guaja güiengñija lao ti manmannginginge:
pairs.english: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja canaeñija lao ti manmangogote: guaja adengñija lao ti manmamomocat: ni ufanguentos ni y güetgüeroñija.
pairs.english: They have hands, but they don't feel. They have feet, but they don't walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y fumatinas sija manparejoja yan sija: magajet na jayeja y umangoco güe guiya sija,
pairs.english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Israel, angoco si Jeova: sa güiya y ayudañija yan y patangñija.
pairs.english: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O guma Aaron, angoco si Jeova: sa güiya y ayudañija yan y patangñija.
pairs.english: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y manmaañao as Jeova, angoco si Jeova: sa güiya y ayudañija yan y patangñija.
pairs.english: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova guinin jajaso jita: guiya bumendisijit; güiya bumendise y guima Israel; güiya bumendise y guima Aaron.
pairs.english: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya bumendise ayo sija y manmaañao as Jeova, todo y mandiquique yan y mandangculo.
pairs.english: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova unninamegae mas yan mas, jago yan y famaguonñija.
pairs.english: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo manbinendise as Jeova ni y fumatinas y langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet sija ni y langet Jeova sija: lao y tano mannae para y famaguon y taotao sija.
pairs.english: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmatae ti manmanalaba as Jeova, ni jaye güije gui manjajanao papa gui jalom y manmamatquiquiloja.
pairs.english: The dead don't praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita, tabendise si Jeova, desde pago na tiempo mona yan para taejinecog. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: But we will bless Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUGUAEYA si Jeova sa jajungog y inagangjo yan y tinayuyutto sija.
pairs.english: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa janaegueng y talangaña guiya guajo, enao mina na juaagangja güe mientras lâlâlâyo.
pairs.english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cuetdas y finatae umoriyayeyo, yan y piniten y naftan sumoda yo: ya jusoda chinatsaga yan triniste.
pairs.english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae juagang y naan Jeova; O Jeova, jugagagaojao, nalibre y antijo.
pairs.english: Then I called on the name of Yahweh: "Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaeyayon si Jeova yan tunas; junggan, y Yuusta senyoase.
pairs.english: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaadadaje y taeisao: guajo estaba macone tagpapa, yan güiya sumatbayo.
pairs.english: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Talo guato gui descansomo, O antijo; sa si Jeova uchalapon megae guiya jago.
pairs.english: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unalibre y antijo guinin y finatae, y atadogco guinen y lagosija, yan y adengjo guinin y pinedong.
pairs.english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jufamocat gui menan Jeova gui tano y manlalala.
pairs.english: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujojonggue, enao mina jusangan sa estaba gosdangculo y pinitijo.
pairs.english: I believed, therefore I said, "I was greatly afflicted."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yleco gui chinadigco, todo y taotao sija mandacon.
pairs.english: I said in my haste, "All men are liars."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa juapase si Jeova pot todo y minaulegña guiya guajo.
pairs.english: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juchule y copan satbasion, yan juagang y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the name of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juapase y promesajo as Jeova, pago gui menan todo y taotaoña sija.
pairs.english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaelaye gui linie Jeova, y finatae y mañantosña.
pairs.english: Precious in the sight of Yahweh is the death of his saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, magajet na guajo tentagomo; guajo y tentagomo, yan y lajin y tentagomo palaoan: jago pumula y magodeco.
pairs.english: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your handmaid. You have freed me from my chains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juofrese jao ni y inefresen grasias, yan juaagang y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juapase y promesajo as Jeova, pago gui menan todo y taotaoña sija.
pairs.english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui jalom y páteo y guima Jeova, gui talo guiya jago, O Jerusalem. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: in the courts of Yahweh's house, in the midst of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O fanmanalaba as Jeova, jamyo todo y nasion sija: fanmanalaba nu güiya jamyo todo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y minaaseña dangculo guiya jita; yan y minagajet Jeova gagaegue para taejinecog. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh's faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae gracias si Jeova; sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya si Israel ilegña pago, na y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y guima Aaron ilegña pago, na y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ayo sija y manmaañao pago as Jeova ilegñija, na minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juagang si Jeova gui chinatsagaco: ya si Jeova umopeyo, yan japoloyo güi dangculo na sagayan.
pairs.english: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova para guajo; ya ti jumaañao: jafa siña y taotao ufatinas guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova para guajo gui entalo güije sija y umayuyudayo: enao mina julie y dineseajo güije sija ni y chumatliiyo.
pairs.english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mas mauleg umaangoco si Jeova qui umapolo y inangoco gui taotao.
pairs.english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mas mauleg umaangoco si Jeova qui umapolo y inangoco y prinsipe sija.
pairs.english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y nasion umoriyayeyo: lao pot y naan Jeova juutut sija.
pairs.english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of Yahweh, I cut them off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija umoriyayeyo; junggan, sija umoriyayeyo: lao pot y naan Jeova juutut sija.
pairs.english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the name of Yahweh I indeed cut them off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija umoriyayeyo taegüije y obeja sija; sija manmapuno taegüije y guafen tituca: pot y naan Jeova na juutut sija.
pairs.english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the name of Yahweh I cut them off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumonegyo para jupodongyo, lao si Jeova umayudayo.
pairs.english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y minetgotto yan y cantaco, yan güiya jumuyong y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang y minagof yan y satbasion gaegue gui jalom y tiendan y manunas: y agapa na canae Jeova fumatitinas y minatatnga.
pairs.english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. "The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y agapa na canae Jeova majatsa julo; y agapa na canae Jeova fumatitinas y minatatnga.
pairs.english: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jumatae, lao bae julâlâ, yan jusangan claro y checho Jeova sija.
pairs.english: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah's works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jacastigayo megae: lao ti janaeyo guato gui finatae.
pairs.english: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Babayeyo ni y trangcan tininas sija: ya bae jujalom guiya sija, bae junae grasias si Jeova.
pairs.english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na trangcan Jeova; anae, manjajalom y manunas.
pairs.english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo junae jao grasias: sa jago jagasja umopeyo, yan jago jumuyong y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: guima, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este si Jeova chechoña; ya namanman gui atadogta.
pairs.english: This is Yahweh's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na jaane si Jeova fumatinas; tafanmagof yan tafansenmagof ni ayo.
pairs.english: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Satba pago, jugagagaojao, O Jeova: O Jeova, jugagagaojao, pago namannae minegae.
pairs.english: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso ayo y mamamaela gui naan Jeova; inbendisijao guinin y guima Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed is he who comes in the name of Yahweh! We have blessed you out of the house of Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
