pairs.english: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y Yuusso, yan bae junaejao grasias: jago y Yuusso, bae jujatsajao julo.
pairs.english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias si Jeova; sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegueja para taejinecog. Amen.
pairs.english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ALEPH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < ALEPH > > Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh's law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija y umadadaje y testimonioña, yan y umaliligao güe contodo y corasonñija.
pairs.english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na sija ti manmatitinas jafa ni ti tunas; sija manjajanao gui jinanaoña sija.
pairs.english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin untagojamja ni y finanagüemo para inguesadaje sija.
pairs.english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O mojon ya ufitme y jinanaojo sija, para juadaje y laymo.
pairs.english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae ti jumamajlao, yanguin esta jurespeta todo y tinagomo.
pairs.english: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junaejao grasias, yan y tininas y corason, yanguin jueyag y tinas na juisiomo.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juadaje y laymo; chamoyo sumesendingo.
pairs.english: I will observe your statutes. Don't utterly forsake me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BETH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jualiligaojao contodo y corasonjo; chamoyo munaabag gui tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don't let me wander from your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sinanganmo junaatog gui jalom y corasonjo, para chajo umiisao contra jago.
pairs.english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichosojao O Jeova; fanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Contodo y labiosso jagasja jusangan claro todo y juisio sija y pachotmo.
pairs.english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: magofyo sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jujaso y finanagüemo, ya jurespeta y jinanaomo sija.
pairs.english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jumagofyo ni y laymo sija: ti jumalefa ni y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GIMEL sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Baba y atadogco, ya julie y mannamanman sija gui tinagomo.
pairs.english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo taotao juyongyo gui tano: chamo naaatog y tinagomo sija guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don't hide your commandments from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo mayamag pot y minalagoña ni y guaja gui juisiomo sija todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unlalatde y sobetbio sija ni y manmatdito, ni y manabag gui tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafañuja guiya guajo y minamajlao, yan y dinespresia; sa jagasja juadaje y testimoniomo.
pairs.english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y prinsipe sija locue manmatachong yan manguecuentos contra guajo: lao y tentagomo jajajasoja y laymo sija.
pairs.english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y testimoniomo y minagofjo sija yan y taotaojo na pápagat sija.
pairs.english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DALETH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangan claro y jinanaojo sija, ya unopeyo: fanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natungoyo ni y chalan y finanagüemo sija; ayo nae jusangan y namanman y chechomo sija.
pairs.english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo maderite sa macat; nametgotyo jaftaemano y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nasuja guiya guajo y chalan mandacon; ya naeyo, pot y grasiasmo, y tinagomo.
pairs.english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja juayeg y chalan y minagajet: y juisiomo jagasja jupolo gui menajo.
pairs.english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusisigue y testimoniomo sija: O Jeova, chamo namamamajlaoyo.
pairs.english: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don't let me be disappointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jufalalagüe y chalan tinagomo sija, yanguin unnadangculo y corasonjo.
pairs.english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: HE sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naeyo tiningo, ya bae juadaje y laymo: junggan bae juadaje contodo y corasonjo.
pairs.english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafalofanyo gui chalan y tinagomo, sa ayoyo nae mamagof.
pairs.english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namangag guato y corasonjo gui testimoniomo, ya munga gui linatga.
pairs.english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bira y atadogco ni guinin manlilie banida; ya nalâtâyo gui jinanaomo sija.
pairs.english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafitme y sinanganmo gui tentagomo, ni y deboto nu jago.
pairs.english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bira y minamajlaojo ni y janamaaañaoyo; sa y juisiomo sija manmauleg.
pairs.english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Liija na minajalangyo ni y finanagüemo sija: nalâlâyo gui tininasmo.
pairs.english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: VAU sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae uguaja para juope y munamamamajlaoyo; sa juangocoyo ni y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamo todo chumuchule gui pachotto y sinangan y minagajetmo; sa jagasja junangga y juisiomo.
pairs.english: Don't snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae juadaje y laymo todo y tiempo, para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya julibre jumanao; sa jagasja jualigao y finanagüemo sija.
pairs.english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya bae jusangan locue y testimoniomo sija gui menan y ray sija, ya ti jumamajlao.
pairs.english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya bae jumagofyo gui tinagomo sija, ni y juguaeya.
pairs.english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jujatsa julo locue y canaejo sija gui tinagomo sija, ni y juguaeya; ya bae jujaso y laymo sija.
pairs.english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ZAIN sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este munamamagofyo gui trinisteco; sa y sinanganmo jagasja munalâlâyo.
pairs.english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gogosmachatgüeyo ni y mansobetbio: lao trabia ti juabag guinin y laymo.
pairs.english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don't swerve from your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jujajaso y juisiomo sija ni y guinin ampmam na tiempo, O Jeova, ya jagasja juconseulan maesayo.
pairs.english: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaguotyo y maepe na binibo, sa pot y manaelaye ni y madingo y laymo.
pairs.english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay sija cantaco sija gui guima anae taotao tumanoyo.
pairs.english: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jujajaso y naanmo, O Jeova qui puenge, ya juadadajeja y laymo.
pairs.english: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este guajayo, sa juadaje y finanagüemo.
pairs.english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHETH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jugagao y finaboresemo contodo y corasonjo: magaease nu guajo jaftaemano y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujaso gui jinanaojo sija, ya jubira y adengjo guato gui testimoniomo sija.
pairs.english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inalululayo, ya ti sumagayo, para juadaje y tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cuetdas manaelaye jafunutyo; lao ti malefayo ni y laymo.
pairs.english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won't forget your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jucajulo gui tatalopuenge, ya junaejao grasias, sa pot y tinas na juisiomo.
pairs.english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo gachong ayo sija y manmaañao nu jago, yan ayo sija y umadadaje y finanagüemo.
pairs.english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano, O Jeova, bula ni y minaasemo: fanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TETH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüeyo mauleg na juisio yan tiningo: sa jagasja jujonggue y tinagomo.
pairs.english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Antes di jutriste, umabagyo; lao pago juadaje y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago maulegjao, ya unfatinas mauleg; fanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sobetbio jafatinas un dinague contra guajo: bae juadadajeja y finanagüemo sija contodo y corasonjo.
pairs.english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonñija, manmantica calang sebo: lao jumagofyo ni y laymo.
pairs.english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mauleg para guajo, na guinin ninatristeyo; para jueyag y laymo sija.
pairs.english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay y pachotmo, maulegña para guajo, qui ni mit na oro yan salape.
pairs.english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JOD sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmaañao nu jago ujalieyo ya ufanmagof; sa jagasja junangga y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, jutungoja na y juisiomo tunas, yan pot y minagajetmo na unnatristeyo.
pairs.english: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo jutayuyutjao ya y minauleg y minaasemo unamagofyo, jaftaemano y sinanganmo gui tentagomo.
pairs.english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufato guiya guajo y cariñoso na minaasemo sija, para ulâlâyo; sa y tinagomo y minagofjo.
pairs.english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya manmamajlao y mansobetbio; sa manapodong yo nu y dinague: lao jujajasoja y finanagüe sija.
pairs.english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya umabira iyaguajo ayo sija y manmaañao nu jago, yan sija ujatungo y testimonio sija.
pairs.english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya fitme y corasonjo gui laymo, ya chajo mamamajlao.
pairs.english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CAPH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogco ninalachae pot y sinanganmo mientras ileleco: Ngaean nae unconsuelayo.
pairs.english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, "When will you comfort me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jumuyongyo calang y boteya gui jalom aso; lao trabia ti malelefayo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don't forget your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cuanto sija y jaanen y tentagomo? Asta ngaean nae unjusga ayo sija y pumetsisigueyo?
pairs.english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mansobetbio manmanguadog joyo para guajo, ni y ti taegüije laymo.
pairs.english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y tinagomo sija manunas: ayudayo sa sija mapetsisigueyo ni y dinague.
pairs.english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Canaja malalachaeyo gui jilo y tano; lao ti judingo y finanagüemo sija.
pairs.english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn't forsake your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalâlâyo pot y cariñoso na güinaeyamo, ayo nae juadaje y testimonion pachotmo.
pairs.english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LAMED sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minagajetmo gagaegue asta todo y generasion sija; jago plumanta y tano ya sumaga.
pairs.english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija jasisigueja asta pago na jaane jaftaemano y otdenmo; sa todos sija tentagomo.
pairs.english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ti jagas janamagofyo y laymo, jagas malingo ni y trinisteco.
pairs.english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jumalefa ni y finanagüemo sija para taejinecog: sa pot sija na unnalâlâyo.
pairs.english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo iyomoyo, satbayo; sa jualiligao y finanagüemo sija.
pairs.english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye manananggayo para umayulang; lao jugueguesjasoja y testimoniomo sija.
pairs.english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin julie y uttimon y todo quinabales; ya y tinagomo gosfeda.
pairs.english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MEM sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinagomo janafanungoñayo qui enemigujo sija; sa sija siempre infanjajameja.
pairs.english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megaeña tiningojo qui todo y maestronomo sija: sa y testimoniomo sija, y jinasojo.
pairs.english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manungoñayo qui y manbijo; sa juadadaje y finanagüemo sija.
pairs.english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junapara y adengjo guato gui todo chalan tinaelaye, para juadaje y sinangan.
pairs.english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jubirayo gui juisiomo: sa jagasja unfanagüeyo.
pairs.english: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na minames y sinanganmo ni y chinaguijo, junggan mamesña qui y miet para y pachotto.
pairs.english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin y finanagüemo sija nae mañuleyo tiningo: enaomina juchatlie todo y chalan mandacon.
pairs.english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NUN sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjulayo ya junafitme na juadaje y tinas na juisiomo sija.
pairs.english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gospiniteyo; nalâlâyo, O Jeova, jaftaemano y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, jutatayuyut jao: chajlao y libren y inefresen pachotto sija, ya fanagüeyo ni y juisiomo.
pairs.english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Antijo siempre gaegue güi canaejo; lao ti malelefayo ni y laymo.
pairs.english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won't forget your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye maplantayeyo laso; lao ti sumujayo gui finanagüemo.
pairs.english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven't gone astray from your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchule erensiaco para siempre y testimoniomo sija; sa sija y minagof y corasonjo.
pairs.english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumangag y corasonjo para jucumple y laymo sija; para taejinecog asta y uttimo.
pairs.english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SAMECH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y fanatogco na lugat yan y patangjo: junanangga, y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fañuja guiya guajo jamyo ni y chumogüe manaelaye: para juadadaje y tinago Yuusso.
pairs.english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mantieneyo jaftaemano y sinanganmo, para julâlâ: ya chamoyo na mamamajlao ni y ninanggaco.
pairs.english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mantieneyo ya juseguro: ya jurespeta y tinagomo sija siempre.
pairs.english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unpolo pot taya todo ayo sija y manaba gui laymo: sa y finababañija taebale.
pairs.english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafañuja todo ayo sija y manaelaye gui tano calang basula: enao mina juguaeya y testimoniomo sija.
pairs.english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y catneco lalaolao pot y maañaoña nu jago: ya maañaoyo ni y juisiomo sija.
pairs.english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AIN sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don't leave me to my oppressors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago unaseguro y tentagomo para mauleg; chamo pumópolo y sobetbio na unachatsagayo.
pairs.english: Ensure your servant's well-being. Don't let the proud oppress me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: y atadogco yafae pot y satbasionmo, yan pot y tinas na sinanganmo.
pairs.english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas gui tentagomo jaftaemano y minaasemo, yan fanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo tentagomoyo; naeyo tiningo, ya jutungo y tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta tiempo para si Jeova ufachocho: na sija manataebale y laymo.
pairs.english: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina juguaeya y tinagomo sija, mas qui y oro, junggan, mas qui y fino na oro.
pairs.english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina junaguaelaye todo y finanagüemo sa tunas pot todo güinaja: ya juchatlie y cada chalan dacon.
pairs.english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: PE sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y binaban y sinanganmo numae manana: jananae tinagoña y manaetiningo.
pairs.english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juguefbaba y pachotto, ya sumuspirosyo: sa majalangyo ni y tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajao guiya guajo, y unmaase nu guajo, taegüije y costumbremo ni unfatinas ni ayo sija ni gumaeya y naanmo.
pairs.english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naregla y pinecatto ni y sinanganmo: ya chamo na fangagae ninasiña y jafa na isao guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don't let any iniquity have dominion over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui chiniguet y taotao, ayo nae juadaje y finanagüemo.
pairs.english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanina y matamo gui jilo y tentagomo; ya unfanagüeyo ni y laymo.
pairs.english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janom sadog manmalalago papa gui atadogco sija sa sija ti maadaje y tinagomo.
pairs.english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don't observe your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TZADE sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja untago y testimoniomo sija gui tininas, yan minagajetja.
pairs.english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inigojo jalachaeyo, sa y contrariujo sija manmalefa ni y sinanganmo sija.
pairs.english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sinanganmo sengasgas: enao mina jaguaeya y tentagomo.
pairs.english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Diquiqueyo, ya madespresiayo, lao ti malelefayo ni y finanagüemo sija.
pairs.english: I am small and despised. I don't forget your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininasmo taejinecog na tininas ya y tinagomo minagajet.
pairs.english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chinatsaga yan pinite sumodayo: lao y tinagomo sija minagofjo.
pairs.english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y testimoniomo sija manunas para taejinecog: naeyo tiningo ya julâlâ.
pairs.english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: KOPH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja juagangjao; satbayo, ya juadaje y testimoniomo sija.
pairs.english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taftafñayo qui y egaan ya umagangyo: junangga guiya jago.
pairs.english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

pairs.english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y inagangjo jaftaemano y minauleg güinaeyamo: O Jeova, nalâlâyo, jaftaemano y juisiomo.
pairs.english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjijot ayo sija y tumatitiye y tinaelaye: sija mañago gui tinagomo.
pairs.english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jijot jao, O Jeova; yan todo y tinagomo sija minagajet.
pairs.english: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot guinin ampmam na tiempo jutungo y testimoniomo sija, ni y unplanta sija para siempre.
pairs.english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: RESH sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don't forget your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Plaitea y causaco, ya nalibreyo ni apasmo: nalâlâyo jaftaemano y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chago y satbasion gui manaelaye, sa ti maaliligao y laymo sija.
pairs.english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don't seek your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo y cariñoso na minaasemo, O Jeova, nalâlâyo jaftaemano y juisiomo sija.
pairs.english: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae pumetsisigueyo yan contrariujo; lao ti sumususujayo gui testimoniomo sija.
pairs.english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven't swerved from your testimonies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Julie y fumatinas dinague, ya tristeyo, sa ti maadaje y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don't observe your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso jafa muna juguaeya y finanagüemo sija: nalâlâyo, O Jeova, jaftaemano y munamauleg güinaeyamo.
pairs.english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y resumen sinanganmo minagajet; ya cada uno tunas na juisiomo sija gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SHIN sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumagofyo ni y sinanganmo, taegüije y manmañoda dangculo na inamot.
pairs.english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great spoil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jugoschatlie ya juingin y dinague; lao y laymo juguaeya.
pairs.english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siete maje gui un jaane jualabajao, sa pot y tinas na juisiomo.
pairs.english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo na pas guaja para ayo sija y gumaeya y laymo, ya taya lugatñija para ufanmatompo.
pairs.english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, jagasja junangga y satbasionmo, ya esta juchogüe y tinagomo sija.
pairs.english: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo esta jaadaje y tinagomo sija: ya sija mangosyajo.
pairs.english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta juadaje y finanagüemo sija yan y testimoniomo sija; sa todo y jinanaojo mangaegue gui menamo.
pairs.english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TAU sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tinayuyutto ya ufato gui menamo: nalibreyo jaftaemano y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y labiosso ya umasangan alabansa sija; sa unfanagüeyo ni y laymo sija.
pairs.english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y jilajo ucanta y sinanganmo: sa todo y tinagomo manunas.
pairs.english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ulisto y canaemo para uinayudayo; sa y tinagomo jagasja juayeg.
pairs.english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja majalangyo ni y satbasionmo, O Jeova: ya y laymo minagofjo.
pairs.english: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo ya ulâlâ y antijo, ya ualabajao: polo ya juisiomo sija uinayudayo.
pairs.english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juabagyo, parejo yan y malingo na quinilo: aligao y tentagomo; sa ti malelefayo ni y tiningomo sija.
pairs.english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don't forget your commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre y antijo, O Jeova, gui mandacon na labios, yan y mafáfababa na jula.
pairs.english: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa unmannae jao, pat jafa mas unmafatinas guiya jago y dacon: na jula?
pairs.english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cadidug y flechan y matatnga, yan y pinigan gago.
pairs.english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ae ae guajo, ni taotao tumanoyo guiya Meseg, ya sumagayo gui tiendan Kedar.
pairs.english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo sumaga apmam, yan ayo y chumatlie y pas.
pairs.english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo para pas, lao, anae cumuentosyo, sija para guera.
pairs.english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y umayuyudayo guinin as Jeova, ni y fumatinas y langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, y umadadaje Israel ti umatujog ni ti umaego.
pairs.english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y umadadajejao: si Jeova nujongmo gui agapa na canaemo.
pairs.english: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao ti unninasague gui jaane, ni y pilan gui puenge.
pairs.english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uninadaje gui todo tinaelaye: güiya uadaje y antimo.
pairs.english: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uninadaje yan jumujuyongjao yan jumajalomjao, desde pago na tiempo yan para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forth, and forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. By David. > > I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to Yahweh's house!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David's house.

pairs.chamorro: Fanmanayuyut para upas iyon Jerusalem: sa mumegae ayo sija y gumaeyajao.
pairs.english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pas ugaegue gui jalom y quelatmo, yan guinefsaga gui jalom palasyomo.
pairs.english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot causan y mañelujo yan y mangachongjo, jualog pago: Pas ugaegue gui sanjalommo.
pairs.english: For my brothers' and companions' sakes, I will now say, "Peace be within you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot causan guma Jeova Yuusso nae jualigao y minaulegmo.
pairs.english: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, parejo yan y atadog tentago sija ni y jaaatan y canae y amuñija, yan y atadog sija y palaoan jaaatan y canae y amafia; parejoja y atadogmame jaaatan locue si Jeova Yuusmame, asta qui ugaemaase nu jame.
pairs.english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu jame, O Jeova, gaease nu jame: sa guesmanbulajam ni y iningen.
pairs.english: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antita senbula ni y binitlean ayo sija y taepinite, yan y denespresian y mansobetbio.
pairs.english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. By David. > > If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Jeova ti guinin estaba gui bandata, anae y taotao sija mangajulo contra jita:
pairs.english: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae japañotjit lalâlâ, yanguin mangosbubu contra jita.
pairs.english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae janafanmachuchudajit y janom, yan y diquique na sadog malofan gui jilo y antita:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y mansobetbio na janom manmalofan gui jilo y antita.
pairs.english: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso si Jeova, sa ti mannae nu jita para güinaja y nifenñija.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo umescapa taegüije y pajaro yan umescapa güe gui lason y tiradot: magtos y laso, ya manescapajam.
pairs.english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y naan Jeova umayuyudajam, ni y fumatinas y langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: Our help is in the name of Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can't be moved, but remains forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taemanoja y egso sija gui oriyan Jerusalem, taegüijeja si Jeova gui oriyan y taotaoña sija, desde pago para taejinecog.
pairs.english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forth and forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y baran y manaelaye ti usaga gui jilo y fottuna y manunas; sa noseaja ujajuto mona canaeñija y manunas gui tinaelaye.
pairs.english: For the scepter of wickedness won't remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won't use their hands to do evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas mauleg güije sija gui manmauleg, O Jeova, yan ayo sija y manunas corasonñija.
pairs.english: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija y bumira sija ya malag y echong na chalanñija, si Yuus ufaninesgaejon yan ayo sija y manmamatitinas tinaelaye. Pas ugaegue guiya Israel.
pairs.english: But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y pachotto bula chinaleg, ya y jilata canta: ya ayonae ujaalog gui entalo y nasion sija: si Jeova jafatinas dangculo na güinaja para sija.
pairs.english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, "Yahweh has done great things for them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jafatinas dangculo na güinaja para jita; enaomina tafanmagof.
pairs.english: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bira talo y quinautibanmame, O Jeova, taegüije y sadog gui sumanjaya.
pairs.english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmananom yan lago: ufanmangoco yan minagof.
pairs.english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja jumajanao mona ya tuma tanges, mañuñule bonito na semiya; ufato talo yan y minagofña, jachuchuleja y manojon quinecoña.
pairs.english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo; iyon Salomon. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. > > Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taebale y uncajulo taftaf, ya undescansa atrasao, ya uncano y pan pinite: sa jananaeja ni y güinaeyaña y mamaego.
pairs.english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, y famaguon erensian Jeova: ya yi tinegcha y tiyan, apasiña.
pairs.english: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y flecha gui canae y matatnga na taotao; taegüijeja locue y famaguon y manpatgon.
pairs.english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magof y taotao yanguin bula y questat y flechaña nu sija: ti ufanmamajlao, lao ufanguentos yan y enemigo sija gui trangca.
pairs.english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won't be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa uncano y finachocho y canaemo: siempre unmagof yan umauleg para jago.
pairs.english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y asaguamo utaegüije y trongcon ubas ni y bula tinegcha gui jalom guimamo: y famaguonmo manparejo yan y tinanom olibo gui oriyan y lamasamo.
pairs.english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, taegüijeja y bendisionña ni y maañao as Jeova.
pairs.english: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ubinendisejao gui Sion; ya unlie y minauleg guiya Jerusalem todo y jaanin y linâlâmo.
pairs.english: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na unlie y famaguon y famaguonmo. Pas ugaegue guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Yes, may you see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na tiempo nae manapiniteyo desde y pinatgonjo: lao trabia ti mangana ni y ninasiñañija contra guajo.
pairs.english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanalado jaalado gui jilo y tatalojo: janafananaco y sutcoñija.
pairs.english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova tunaegüe: güiya umutut y cuetdas y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao todo ayo y bumira sija tate, todo sija y chumatlie Sion.
pairs.english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufantaegüije y chaguan gui jilo guma, ni y anglo antes di udoco:
pairs.english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chaña y manuutut chaguan munabubula y canaeña, ni y pechonña y manmanonojo.
pairs.english: with which the reaper doesn't fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ujaalog ayo sija y manmalolofan, Y bendision Jeova usaga gui jilomo; jame bumendise jao pot y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: Neither do those who go by say, "The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in the name of Yahweh."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, ecungog y inagangjo: polo ya talangamo sija uegueng gui inagang y guinagaojo.
pairs.english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin mojon unmatca y tinaelaye sija; Jeova, jaye utojgüe?
pairs.english: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja inasie guiya jago, para unmamaañagüe.
pairs.english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junanangga si Jeova, y antijo mannanangga, ya y sinanganña junanangga.
pairs.english: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo jananangga si Jeova, mas qui y guatdia sija ni manmannanangga y egaan: magajet na mas qui y guatdia sija manmannananangga y egaan.
pairs.english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.
