pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Israel nangga si Jeova; sa gui as Jeova guaja minaase, ya iya guiya nae megae na inalibre.
pairs.english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for with Yahweh there is loving kindness. With him is abundant redemption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya unalibre Israel todo gui tinaelayeña.
pairs.english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. By David. > > Yahweh, my heart isn't haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jufamatquilo yo yan junaquietoyo; taegüije y patgon yan ninasusu as nanaña: y antijo guiya guajo parejo yan y patgon ni y sumususu.
pairs.english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Israel nangga si Jeova, desde pago ya para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forth and forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano na manjula gui as Jeova yan japromete y Gaesisiña gui as Jacob;
pairs.english: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na ti jujalom gui tabetnaculon y guimajo, ni jufalag gui camajo:
pairs.english: "Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti junamatujog y atadogco; ni junamaego y lasas y atadogco,
pairs.english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta qui jusodayo y lugat para si Jeova, y tabetnaculo para y Gaesisiña gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na injingog masangangüe guiya Efrata ya inseda gui fangualuan qui jalomtano.
pairs.english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Infanjalom gui tabetnaculuña: inadora gui menan y fañajangan adengña.
pairs.english: "We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, gui lugat y descansomo: jago yan y atcan y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place; you, and the ark of your strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y mamalemo sija ya ufanminagago ni y tininas: ya y mañantosmo sija ufanagang ni y minagof.
pairs.english: Let your priest be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y naan y tentagomo as David, chamo bumibira y matan y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: For your servant David's sake, don't turn away the face of your anointed one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova manjula minagajet gui as, David; ti ubira güe; y tinegcha y tataotaomo, juplanta gui jilo tronumo.
pairs.english: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: "I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jaadaje y famaguonmo y tratujo, yan y testimoniojo ni y jufanagüe sija, asta y famaguonñija locue ufanmatachong gui tronumo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forevermore."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova guinin jaayeg Sion; este jadesea para sagaña.
pairs.english: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y lugat y descansoco para taejinecog: este nae jusaga; sa este judesea.
pairs.english: "This is my resting place forever. Here I will live, for I have desired it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jubendise dangculo y prebensionña: ya bae junafannajong y mamobleña ni y pan.
pairs.english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junafanminagago locue y mamaleña sija ni y satbasion: yan y mañantosña sija ufanagang managang ni y minagof.
pairs.english: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae junadoco y canggelon David: guinin jufamauleg y candit para y pinalaejo.
pairs.english: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junafanminagago y enemiguña sija ni y minamajlao; lao y jiloña nae unamagas y coronaña.
pairs.english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will be resplendent."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. By David. > > See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este parejo yan y mauleg na laña gui ilo, ni y mimilalag gui batbas, asta y batbas Aaron; ya jumajnanao papa asta y cueyon magaguña;
pairs.english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron's beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije serenon Hermon, ni y mamopodong gui jilo ogso guiya Sion; sa ayo nae mañago si Jeova y bendision, güiya taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion: for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forevermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Song of Ascents. > > Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh's house!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y canaemiyo gui sinantos na sagayan, ya fanmanbendise jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ni y fumatinas y langet yan y tano, bumendise jao guiya Sion.
pairs.english: May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo y naan Jeova: fanmanalaba güe, O jamyo, ni y tentago Jeova sija.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Praise the name of Yahweh! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y manotojgue gui jalom guma Jeova, y jalom pateo y guimayuus.
pairs.english: you who stand in the house of Yahweh, in the courts of our God's house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba as Jeova; sa si Jeova mauleg güe: fanganta y alabansa sija ni y naanña; sa magof este.
pairs.english: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jaayeg si Jacob para güiya, ya Israel para y güinajañaja namaesa.
pairs.english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel for his own possession.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungo na si Jeova dangculo güe: ya y Señotta taquiloña qui todo y Yuus.
pairs.english: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja y malagoña si Jeova, esteja jafatinas, gui langet yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y manadong na lugat.
pairs.english: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafangajujulo y asgon sija guinin y uttimon y tano; janalalamlam para uuchan; janachinile y manglo gui güinajaña.
pairs.english: who causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth; who makes lightnings with the rain; who brings forth the wind out of his treasuries;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y janalamen y finenana na finañago guiya Egipto, todo y taotao yan y gâgâ.
pairs.english: Who struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago señat sija yan mannamanman gui talo guiya jago, O Egipto: gui as Faraon yan todo y tentagoña.
pairs.english: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janalamen y mandangculo na nasion, yan japuno y manmatatñga na ray sija.
pairs.english: who struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Sehón ray y Amorreo yan si Og ray Basán, yan todo y raeno sija guiya Cananea:
pairs.english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mannae para erensia ni y tanoñija: para erensian y taotao na guiya Israel.
pairs.english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y naanmo O Jeova, gagaegue para taejinecog; y majasomo, O Jeova, para todo y generasion sija.
pairs.english: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova ujusga y taotaoña, ya ugaease ni y tentagoña sija.
pairs.english: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y idolos y nasion sija, salape yan oro, y checho y canae y taotao sija.
pairs.english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja pachotñija, lao ti manguecuentos: guaja atadogñija, lao ti manmanlilie;
pairs.english: They have mouths, but they can't speak. They have eyes, but they can't see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja talangañija; lao ti manmanjujungog; ni uguaja jinagong gui pachotñija.
pairs.english: They have ears, but they can't hear; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y fumatinas estesija ujafanparejoja yan sija: magajet na cada uno ni y umangoco sija ni ayosija.
pairs.english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O guma Israel, bendise si Jeova: O guma Aaron, bendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O guma Levi, bendise si Jeova: jamyo ni y manmaañao as Jeova, bendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova guinin Sion ni y sumaga guiya Jerusalem. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae si Jeova grasias; sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Yuus y yuus sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Señot y señot sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ayo y güiyaja namaesa fumatinas y dangculo namanman: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y pot y tiningo jafatinas y langet: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y jajuto y tano gui jilo janom sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para guiya ni y jafatinas y mandangculo na candet sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao para ufangobietna gui jaane: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pilan yan y pution sija para ufanmangobietna gui puenge: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y munalamen Egipto gui finenana na finañagoñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone juyong Israel gui entaloñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y metgot na jataf canae yan y canae na majala: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y japatten dos y Tasen Agaga: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafalofan Israel gui entaloña: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And made Israel to pass through its midst; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayute si Faraon yan todo y sendaluña sija gui Tasen Agaga: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea ; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y jaosgaejon y taotaoña y inanaco y desierto: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y janalamen y mandangculo na ray sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan japuno y mangaeninasiña sija na ray: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Sehón ray y Amorreo: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Og ray Basán: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mannae erensia ni y tanoñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na para erensian y tentagoña guiya Israel: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jajasojit gui managpapata: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janalibrejit gui coutrariuta: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y mannae nengcano para todo y catne: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Yuus y langet: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y oriyan y sadog Babilonia nae infanmatachong, magajet na manangesjit yanguin injaso Sion.
pairs.english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Incana y atpanmame gui trongcon sauses gui entaloña güije.
pairs.english: On the willows in its midst, we hung up our harps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güije ayo sija y cumonejit, jatagojit na tafanganta: ya ayo sija y lumachaejit, jatagojit na tafanmagof, ilegñija: Cantayejit uno ni y cantan Sion.
pairs.english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano incanta y cantan Jeova gui ti tanomame?
pairs.english: How can we sing Yahweh's song in a foreign land?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin malefayo nu jago, O Jerusalem! polo ya umalefa y agapa na canaejo ni y tiningoña.
pairs.english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti jujaso jao, polo ya unacheton y jilajo gui paladatto; yanguin ti juguaeyajao, Jerusalem, mas qui y prinsipat na minagofjo.
pairs.english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don't remember you; if I don't prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso O Jeova contra y famaguon Edom gui jaanin Jerusalem; ni ilegñija: Funas, funas asta y simientoña.
pairs.english: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, "Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jagan Babilonia ni y para unmayulang; umagof ayo y para uninapase taegüije ni y unsetbejam.
pairs.english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who rewards you, as you have served us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Umagof ayo, y uquenene na uyinite y famaguonmo contra y acho.
pairs.english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < By David. > > I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods , I will sing praises to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jufanadora para y santos na templomo, ya junae y naanmo grasias pot y cariñoso na güinaeyamo, yan pot y minagajetmo: sa unnadangculo y sinanganmo mas qui y naanmo.
pairs.english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane anae juagang, jago umopeyo, ya unanimayo, ni y minetgot y antijo.
pairs.english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y ray gui tano unmannae jao grasias, O Jeova, sa jagasja majungog y sinangan y pachotmo.
pairs.english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na ufanganta ni y chalan Jeova; sa dangculo y minalag Jeova.
pairs.english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh's glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea taquilo si Jeova, lao jarespetaja y managpapa: lao y sobetbio jatungoja desde y chago.
pairs.english: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but the proud, he knows from afar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea mamocatyo gui entalo y chinatsaga, unnalâlâyo: unestira mona y canaemo contra y binibun y enimigujo sija, ya y agapa na canaemo usatbayo.
pairs.english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova unacabales y gaegue guiya guajo: y minaasemo, O Jeova, gagaegue para taejinecog: chamo dumidingo y checo y canaemo.
pairs.english: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don't forsake the works of your own hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Untutungoja y finatachongjo yan y quinajulojo; untutungoja y jinasoco desde y chagogo.
pairs.english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unlilicue y finaposo yan y fanasonjo, ya untutungo todo y chalanjo.
pairs.english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya ni un sinangan gui jilajo: jao, estagüe, na untungoja todo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unoriyayeyo gui menajo, yan y tateco: yan unpolo y canaemo gui jilojo.
pairs.english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosnámanman este na tiningo para guajo; gostaquilo, ti siña jucomprende.
pairs.english: This knowledge is beyond me. It's lofty. I can't attain it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manoyo guato taegüe y espiritumo? pat manoyo jufalagüe taegüe yo gui menamo?
pairs.english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin cumajuloyo gui langet gaegueja jao güije; yanguin jujuto y camajo guiya sasalaguan, gaegueja jao locue güije.
pairs.english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol , behold, you are there!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin juchule y papan y egaan, ya jusaga gui uttimon y tase;
pairs.english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ayo gaegueja y canaemo na jaosgagaejonyo, ya y agapa na canaemo umantieneyo.
pairs.english: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jualog: Magajet na utampeyo y jemjom: asta y puenge uinayo.
pairs.english: If I say, "Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night";

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y jemjom ti uninatogüe: lao y puenge ufanina taegüije y jaane: y jemjom yan y mananana manparejoja para jago.
pairs.english: even the darkness doesn't hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago tumungo yo, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother's womb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junae jao grasias: sa gosnamaañao yan gosnamanman y mafatinasso: mannamanman y chechomo; ya y antijo jagostungo este.
pairs.english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tataotaojo ti umatog guiya jago, anae mafatinasyo gui secreto; ya matufog yo ni namanman, gui mas tagpapa na lugat gui tano.
pairs.english: My frame wasn't hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogmo lumie y tataotaojo ya ti cabales: ya y lebblomo nae manmatugue todo y pedason tataotaojo, ya taya ufatta.
pairs.english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna guaguan y jinasomo guiya guajo, O Yuus! Jafa muna megae sumaña!
pairs.english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jutufong sija, manmegaeña y numeroña qui y inae: yanguin magmatayo, gaeguejayo trabia guiya jago.
pairs.english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Seguro na unpuno y taelaye, O Yuus: enaomina mañuja guiya guajo y manmejga na taotao sija.
pairs.english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manguentos taelaye contra jago, ya y enimigumo sija machule y naanmo pot taya.
pairs.english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti juchatlie ayo sija, O Jeova, y chumatlie jao? yan ada ti unatristeyo pot ayo sija y mangajulo contra jago?
pairs.english: Yahweh, don't I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie sija ni y cabales na chinatlie: jutufong sija pot y enemigujo.
pairs.english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rejistrayo O Yuus, ya untungo y corasonjo: chagueyo ya untungo y jinasoco sija.
pairs.english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unlie cao guaja taelaye gui sumanjalomjo, ya unchachalaneyo gui chalan taejinecog.
pairs.english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. > > Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmanjaso taelaye gui corasonñija: cada jaane mandaña para y guera.
pairs.english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanmalagtos y jilañija taegüije y serpiente; binenon y culebbla guaja gui jalom y labiosñija. Sila.
pairs.english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper's poison is under their lips. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adajeyo O Jeova, gui canae y taelaye; adajeyo gui fette na taotao: ni y manmadetetmina para unasuja y pinecatto.
pairs.english: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sobetbio sija janaatog y laso yan y cuetdas para guajo: matiende y lagua gui oriyan chalan; manmanplanta ocodo para guajo. Sila.
pairs.english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegco as Jeova: Jago y Yuusso: ecungog y inagang y tinayuyutto, O Jeova.
pairs.english: I said to Yahweh, "You are my God." Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, Jeova, ni y minetgot y satbasionjo, jago tumampe y ilujo gui jaanin y guera.
pairs.english: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo numanae y taelaye ni y dineseaña, O Jeova; chamo umayuyuda y taelaye jinasoña; na noseaja unafannaquilo maesa sija. Sila.
pairs.english: Yahweh, don't grant the desires of the wicked. Don't let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ilun ayo sija y umoriyayeyo, polo ya utinampe sija ni y taelayen labiosñija.
pairs.english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufamodog y pinigan guafe gui jiloñija: polo ya ufanmayute sija guato gui jalom guafe; y jalom y tadong na joyo ya chañija fangajujulo talo.
pairs.english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti ufitme gui tano y cumuecuentos ni y taelaye: y tinaelaye jaaliligao y taelaye na taotao para uninaatlibes güe.
pairs.english: An evil speaker won't be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jutungo na si Jeova umantiene y causan y manpinite, yan y tininas y pebble.
pairs.english: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na umanae grasia y naanmo, ni y manunas: y manunas ufañaga gui menamo.
pairs.english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tinayuyutto ya umaplanta gui menamo taegüije y insensio; ya y jinatsaco julo ni y canaejo utaegüije y inefresen pupuenge.
pairs.english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y guatdia O Jeova gui menan pachotjo; adaje y pettan y labiosso.
pairs.english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo nafalag y tataelaye na güinaja y corasonjo, ya ufatinas y taelaye na chocho yan ayo sija na taotao y chumogüe tinaelaye: ya chamo na jucanoyo ni y mannge na nañija.
pairs.english: Don't incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don't let me eat of their delicacies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tininas ya unalamenyo, este y minauleg; ya ureprendeyo, ya utaegüije y laña gui jilo y ilujo: chamo na ilujo urechasa: sa asta anae manaelaye sija, y tinayuyutto ugagaegueja.
pairs.english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don't let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmayute papa y juesñija gui anae acho na lugat; ya ujajungog y sinanganjo sija, sa manmames.
pairs.english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y telangmame manmachalapon gui pachot y naftan; taegüije anae un taotao jaalado ya japuta y tano.
pairs.english: "As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol ."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y atadogco, mangaegue guiya jago, O Yuus Jeova: iya jago nae gagaegueja y inangococo: chamo dumidingo y antijo namaesa.
pairs.english: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don't leave my soul destitute.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adajeyo gui laso ni y maplanta para guajo, yan y ecodon y chumagüe y taelaye.
pairs.english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufamodong y manaelaye gui jalom y laguañija, mientras umescacapayo.
pairs.english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, while I pass by.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantan David anae Gagaegue gue gui Liyang; un Tinayuyut. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. > > I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jubasia y quejaco gui menaña, jufanue gui menaña ni y chinatsagaco.
pairs.english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y espiritujo lalango gui sumanjalomjo, untungoja y finaposso. Y chalan gui anae mamocatyo, manaatog y laso para guajo.
pairs.english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my path. In the way in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y agapa na canaejo ya lie; lao taya ni un taotao tumungoyo: y guine güeco esta malingo; taya ni un taotao umadaje y antijo.
pairs.english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juagang jao O Jeova; ilegco: Jago guinegüeco yan y patteco gui tano y manlalâlâ.
pairs.english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atituye y inagangjo; sa sen lumalagpapayo; nalibreyo gui pumetsisigueyo, sa manmetgotña qui guajo.
pairs.english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najuyong y antijo gui calaboso, ya junae grasias y naanmo: ujaoriyayeyo y manunas; sa unfatinas pot guajo gosmegae.
pairs.english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A Psalm by David. > > Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamo jumajalom gui juisio yan y tentagomo: sa taya taotao lalâlâ umajustifica gui menamo.
pairs.english: Don't enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigo guinin japetsigue y antijo; guinin jasaulag papa gui jilo oda y jaanijo: janasagayo gui anae jomjom na lugat sija, taegüije sija y guinin apmam na manmatae.
pairs.english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y espiritujo, lalango gui sumanjalomjo: y corasonjo gui sumanjalomjo triste.
pairs.english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujaso sija y apmam na jaane; jujaso todo y chechomo; jujajaso y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujuto mona y canaejo guiya jago: y antijo majo nu jago, taegüije y anglo na tano. Sila.
pairs.english: I spread forth my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungogyo enseguidas, O Jeova: sa malayo y antijo: chamo na naaatog y matamo guiya guajo; sa noseaja juparejo yan ayo sija y mannunog gui jalom joyo.
pairs.english: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don't hide your face from me, so that I don't become like those who go down into the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na jungogyo ni y cariñoso na güinaeyamo gui egaan; sa jagoja nae juangocoyo: natungoyo ni y chalan anae para jufamocat; sa jujatsa julo y antijo guiya jago.
pairs.english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo, O Jeova, gui enemigujo sija: jufalagüe jao, ya unnaatogyo.
pairs.english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüeyo ya jufatinas y minalagomo: sa jago y Yuusso: y espiritumo mauleg; osgaejonyo gui tano y manunas.
pairs.english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalâlâyo, O Jeova, pot y naanmo: pot y tininasmo, chule y antijo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name's sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan pot y cariñoso na güinaeyamo utut y enemigujo sija, ya unyulang todo sija y munapinite y antijo: sa guajo tentagomo.
pairs.english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < By David. > > Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaaseco yan y guimegüeco y iyoco tore na taquilo, yan y munalibreyo; y patangjo, yan y anae juangocoyo; ni y pumolo y taotaojo gui papajo.
pairs.english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge; who subdues my people under me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, jafa y taotao na unatituye y tiningoña? pat y lajin taotao na uncuecuenta güe?
pairs.english: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao parejoja yan y jinaja; y jaaniña parejoja yan y anineng ni y malofan.
pairs.english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natalagpapa, y langetmo, O Yuus, ya tunogjao papa: pacha y egso sija ya ufanaso.
pairs.english: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanyute ni y lamlam ya ufanchinalapon sija: nafanogcha y flechamo, ya ufaninestotba sija.
pairs.english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estira y canaemo guinin jilo; rescatayo yan nalibreyo gui manadan janom, gui canae y manaotao juyong.
pairs.english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pachotñija manguecuentos banida, ya y agapa na canaeñija, y dacon na canae agapa.
pairs.english: whose mouths speak deceit, Whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jucantaye jao ni y nuebo na canta, O Yuus: y guitala, ni y dies cuetdasña nae jucantaye jao ni y alabansa sija.
pairs.english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ayo y mannae satbasion gui ray sija: ni janalibre si David ni y tentagoña gui gosnalamen na espada.
pairs.english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescatayo ya nalibreyo gui canae y manaotao juyong, ni y pachotñija manguecuentos banida, ya y agapa na canaeñija y dacon na canae agapa.
pairs.english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y famaguonmame lalaje ufantaegüije y tinanom yanguin mandoco ya mangajulo gui pinatgonñija; ya y jaganmame ufantaegüije y mapopolo gui punta na acho, ni y malabla taegüije y palasyo.
pairs.english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lanchonmame bula, mannae todo clasen güinaja: ya gamame quinilo ufanmañago mit yan dies mit gui fangualuanmame.
pairs.english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gamame nobiyo sija ufanmangotga mauleg; ya chañija rumorompe jalom ni juyong, ya taya inagang pot pinite gui cayenmame.
pairs.english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija na taotao y manguaja ni este: Junggan, mandichoso ayo sija na taotao ni y Yuusñija si Jeova.
pairs.english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon Alabansa; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: < < A praise psalm by David.This is an acrostic psalm, with every verse (including the second half of verse 13) starting with a consecutive letter of the Hebrew alphabet. > > I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cada jaane jubendise jao; ya bae jualaba y naanmo para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo si Jeova, ya sumendangculo para umaalaba; ya y dinangculoña ti comprediyon.
pairs.english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un generasion ualaba y chechomo gui otro generasion, yan ujadeclara y matatnga na finatinasmo sija.
pairs.english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso ni y minalag na minagas y inenramo, yan y mannamanman y chechomo.
pairs.english: Of the glorious majesty of your honor, of your wondrous works, I will meditate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija ujasangan y ninasiñan y namaañao na finatinasmo sija; ya guajo bae judeclara y dinangculomo.
pairs.english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujasangan y majason dinangculon y minaulegmo, ya ufanganta ni y tininasmo.
pairs.english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova, cariñosogüe, yan bula minaase; ñateng para ulalalo, ya dangculo minaaseña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova mauleg para todo: ya y cariñoso na minaaseña gui jilo todo y chechoña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chechomo uninalaba jao, O Jeova; ya y mañantosmo unmabendise jao.
pairs.english: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujasangan y minalag y raenomo, yan ufanguentos ni y ninasiñamo.
pairs.english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujanamatungo y matatnga na finatinasña sija gui lalajen taotao, yan y minalag y minagasña gui raenoña.
pairs.english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raenomo, taejinecog na raeno, ya y gobietnomo gagaegueja para todo y generasion.
pairs.english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova mumantiene todo ayo sija y mamodong, yan jajatsa todo ayo y manetecon.
pairs.english: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y atadog sija numanangga jao; ya jago numae sija nañija gui mauleg na tiempo.
pairs.english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbaba y canaemo, ya unnafannajong todo y minalago y manlâlâlâ na güinaja.
pairs.english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova tunas güe gui todo y chalanña; ya cariñoso gui todo y chechoña.
pairs.english: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jijot gui todo ayo sija y umaagang gue; gui todo ayo y umaagang güe ni y minagajet.
pairs.english: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanbula y minalago ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya: ujungog locue y inagangñija, ya usatba sija.
pairs.english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaadadaje todo ayo sija y gumaeya güe: lao todo y manaelaye uyulang.
pairs.english: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usangan y tinina as Jeova: ya polo todo y catne, ya utinina y santos na naanña, para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. O antijo, alaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras lalâlâyo, bae jualaba si Jeova: jucantaye alabansa sija gui Yuusso mientras guajayo sustansiaco.
pairs.english: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo y inangocomo gui prinsipe sija, ni y lajin taotao, gui anae taya inayuda.
pairs.english: Don't put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinagongña jumanao, ya güiya tumalo guato gui edaña: ayoja na jaane malingo y jinasoña.
pairs.english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magof ayo y uguaja ni y Yuus Jacob para innayuda güe, ni y inangocoña gaegue gui as Jeova Yuusña:
pairs.english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafatinas y langet yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y mangaegue gui sumanjalomñija, ni y jaadaje y minagajet para taejinecog.
pairs.english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafatitinas juisio gui manmachiguet; ni y jananae nengcano y manñalang: si Jeova japupula y manmaprereso:
pairs.english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova bumababa y atadogñija y bachet: si Jeova jumajatsa ayo sija y manetecon; si Jeova jaguaeguaeya y manunas.
pairs.english: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaadadaje y taotao juyong sija; jamantietiene y taya tatañija yan y manbiuda; lao y chalan y tinaelaye, janaopop.
pairs.english: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ufangobietna para taejinecog; y Yuusmo, O Sion, para todo y generasion. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova: sa mauleg na utacantaye alabansa sija gui Yuusta; sa magof este; ya y alabansa respetao.
pairs.english: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jumajatsa Jerusalem: ja fandadaña y manmayute juyong guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanjomlo y manmayulang na corason, ya jabee y chetnotñija.
pairs.english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan y numeron y pution sija; jafanaan todo sija ni y naanñija.
pairs.english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo y Yuusta, yan matatnga gui ninasiña; tiningoña taeuttimo.
pairs.english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jumajatsa y manmanso: ya jachule papa y manaelaye gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova ni y finatinas grasias; cantaye alabansa sija gui atpa, para y Yuusta.
pairs.english: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jatatampe y langet ni y mapagages, ya jalilisto y ichan para y tano, ya janafandodoco y chaguan gui jilo ogso sija.
pairs.english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya numannae y gâgâ sija nañija, yan y fumaguon y aga sija ni y manaagang.
pairs.english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti ninamamagof ni y ninasiñan y cabayo: ni ti ninamamagof güe ni y adeng y taotao.
pairs.english: He doesn't delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ninamamagof güe ni y manmaañao nu güiya, ni y umangoco sija gui minaaseña.
pairs.english: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba si Jeova, O Jerusalem; alaba si Yuusmo, O Sion.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa janafanfitme y rejas y trangcamo: jabendise y famaguonmo gui sumanjalommo.
pairs.english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas pas gui jalom uttimomo, ya ninabula jao ni y guesmauleg na trigo.
pairs.english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y tinagoña gui jilo tano: y sinanganña malalago goschadig.
pairs.english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mannae niebe calang pulo: jachalapon y manengjeng na sereno calang apo.
pairs.english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute y aesña calang andesmorona sija: jaye siña tumojgue gui menan y manengjengña?
pairs.english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y sinanganña, ya jadirite: janafanguaefe y mangloña, ya y janom sija manmilalag.
pairs.english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
