pairs.chamorro: Jafanue si Jacob ni y sinanganña, ya y layña sija yan y juisioña sija y Israel.
pairs.english: He shows his word to Jacob; his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jafatinas taegüine gui un nasion: ya y juisioña, sija ti manmatungo sija. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don't know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova desde y langet: Fanmalaba nu güiya guiya jululo.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, todo y angjetña: fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya todo y inetnon sendaluña.
pairs.english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, atdao an pulan: fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya todo y pution ni y maniina.
pairs.english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, langet sija y langet sija, yan y janom sija ni y mangaegue gui jilo y langet.
pairs.english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, You waters that are above the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naan Jeova: sa manago, ya sija manfatinas.
pairs.english: Let them praise the name of Yahweh, For he commanded, and they were created.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya guinin plumanta sija locue para taejinecog yan taejinecog: jafatinas y tinago na tu ufalofan.
pairs.english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova desde y tano, jamyo ni y mandadao gui tinadong tase, yan todo y manadong.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guafe yan graniso; niebe yan asgon: manglo pagyo ni y cumumple y sinanganña:
pairs.english: Lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ogso sija yan todo y sabana; manmanogcha na trongcon jayo yan todo y sedrosija;
pairs.english: mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gâgâ yan todo y guaca; mangucunanas na gâgâ, yan y mangugupo na pajaro.
pairs.english: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ray sija y tano yan todo y taotao sija. Prinsipe sija, yan todo y jues y tano:
pairs.english: kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manfamaguon na lalaje, yan famalaoan: y manamco na taotao, yan famaguon:
pairs.english: both young men and maidens; old men and children:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naan Jeova: sa y naanñaja guefmanataquilo: y minalagña gui jilo tano yan y langet.
pairs.english: let them praise the name of Yahweh, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jajatsa julo locue y canggelon taotaoña; y tininan todo y mañantosña sija; magajet na sija y famaguon Israel, y taotao sija ni y manjijot guiya güiya. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Cantaye si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta, ya y tininaña gui inetnon y mañantos.
pairs.english: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo Israel ya umagof ni y fumatinas güe: polo y famaguon Sion ya ufanmagof ni y Rayñija.
pairs.english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naaña ni y dansa: ya umacantaye güe gui atpa yan pandireta.
pairs.english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova janamagof güe gui taotaoña: güiya janagatbo y manmanso ni y satbasion.
pairs.english: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y mañantos y ufanmagof gui minalag; polo ya ufanganta pot y minagof gui jilo y camañija.
pairs.english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taquilo na alabansa gui as Yuus ya ugaegue gui pachotñija, yan y espada ni y malagtos dos banda gui canaeñija;
pairs.english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujafatinas y inemog gui nasion sija, yan y castigo gui taotao sija;
pairs.english: To execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujagode y rayñija, ni y cadena sija; yan y manmagasñija ni y goden lulug.
pairs.english: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujafatinas gui jiloñija y matugue na juisio: este na inenra para todo y mañantosña. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Alaba si Yuus gui sinantos na sagaña: alaba gue gui feneda y ninasiñaña.
pairs.english: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y matatnga na finatinasña sija: alaba güe jaftaemanoja y minagas dinangculoña.
pairs.english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y sonidon y trompeta: alaba güe ni y guitala yan y atpa.
pairs.english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y pandireta, yan y dansa: alaba güe ni y gaecuetdas na dandan yan y flauta.
pairs.english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y agang na batingting: alaba güe ni gosagang na sonidon batingting.
pairs.english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo todo y güinaja ni y mangaejinagong ya ujaalaba si Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LEBLON y rasan Jesucristo lajin David, lajin Abraham.
pairs.english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ , the son of David, the son of Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Abraham jalilis si Ysaac; ya si Ysaac jalilis si Jacob; ya si Jacob jalilis si Judas yan y mañeluña.
pairs.english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas jalilis, gui as Tamar, si Fares yan si Sara; ya si Fares jalilis si Esrom; ya si Esrom jalilis si Aram;
pairs.english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Aram jalilis si Aminadab; ya si Aminadab jalilis si Naason; ya si Naason jalilis si Salmon;
pairs.english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Salmon jalilis, gui as Rahab, si Boos; ya si Boos jalilis, gui as Rut, si Obed; ya si Obed jalilis si Isai;
pairs.english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Isai jalilis si ray David; ya si ray David jalilis si Salomon ni guinin güiya nii ampmam palaoan Urias;
pairs.english: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Salomon jalilis si Roboam; ya si Roboam jalilis si Abias; ya si Abias jalilis si Asa;
pairs.english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Asa jalilis si Josafat; ya si Josafat jalilis si Joram; ya si Joram jalilis si Osias;
pairs.english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Osias jalilis si Joatam; ya si Joatam jalilis si Acas; ya si Acas jalilis si Esequias;
pairs.english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Esequias jalilis si Manases; si Manases jalilis si Amon; ya si Amon jalilis si Josias;
pairs.english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Josias jalilis si Joaquim; si Joaquim jalilis si Jeconias, yan y mañeluña anae manmacone guiya Babilonia.
pairs.english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos y manmacone guiya Babilonia, si Jeconias jalilis si Salatiel; si Salatiel jalilis si Sorobabel;
pairs.english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Sorobabel jalilis si Abiud; si Abiud jalilis si Eliaquim; si Eliaquim jalilis si Asor;
pairs.english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Asor jalilis si Sadog; si Sadog jalilis si Achim; si Achim si Eliud;
pairs.english: Azor became the father of Sadoc. Sadoc became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Eliud jalilis si Eleasar; si Eleasar jalilis si Matan; si Matan jalilis si Jacob;
pairs.english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jacob jalilis si José, asaguan Maria, na finañago si Jesus na mafanaan si Cristo.
pairs.english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus , who is called Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina todo y generasion desde as Abraham asta as David, catotse sija na generasion; ya desde as David asta manmacone guiya Babilonia, catotse na generasion; ya desde qui manmacone guiya Babilonia asta as Cristo, catotse na generasion.
pairs.english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 18 24790 ¶ Y mafañagon Jesucristo taegüine: Y nanaña as Maria, nobian José, antes de ujadaña, güiya esta masoda mapotgue pot y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si José asaguaña, sa mauleg na taotao, ti malago pinelo güe gui ninamamajlao, lao malagoña upinelo güe gui secreto.
pairs.english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajajaso este, mato para güiya y angjet Señot, anae jagüife gui minaegoña, na ilegña: José, lajin David, chamo maañao na unresibe si Maria asaguamo, sa y gaegue guiya güiya y linilis Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufañago un laje ya ufanaan si Jesus; sa güiya unafanlibre y taotaoña nu y isaoñija.
pairs.english: She shall bring forth a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo sija masusede para umacumple y esta jasangan y Señot pot y profeta, ni ilegña:
pairs.english: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, un vitgen na umapotgue, ya ufañago un laje ya ufanaan si Emanuel, na comoqueilegña na si Yuus gaegue guiya jita.
pairs.english: "Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son. They shall call his name Immanuel"; which is, being interpreted, "God with us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae magmata si José gui minaegoña, jafatinas taegüije y tinago y angjet, ya jaresibe y asaguaña.
pairs.english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti matungo asta qui mañago ni lajiña finenana; ya nae y naanña si Jesus.
pairs.english: and didn't know her sexually until she had brought forth her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mafañago si Jesus guiya Betlehem Judea gui jaanin ray Herodes, estagüe y manfaye na manmato guinin y sancatan para Jerusalem,
pairs.english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: mangue y ray Judios, ni mafañago? Sa y estreyasña inlie gui sancatan ya manmatojam para inadoragüe.
pairs.english: "Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este, si ray Herodes, inistotba yan todo y taotao Jerusalem locue.
pairs.english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maagange todo y prinsipen mamale yan y escriba sija güije na tano, manfinaesen mano nae mafañago si Cristo.
pairs.english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ilegñija: Iya Betlehem Judea; sa taegüine y munjayan matugue pot y profeta:
pairs.english: They said to him, "In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago Betlehem, tano Juda, ada ti sendiquique jao gui entalo y prinsipen Juda, sa iya jago nae ujuyong y magalaje, para upasto y taotaojo, Israel.
pairs.english: 'You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come forth a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Herodes, anae jaagang y manfaye gui secreto, jaquequetungo guiya sija, ngaean y estreyas nae malie.
pairs.english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya Jatago sija para Betlehem, ilegña: Janao fanmalag ayo guato ya inalula manmamaesen pot y patgon; yaguin esta inseda, insangane yo; ya jufato locue ya juadora güe.
pairs.english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, "Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jajungog y sinangan ray, manmapos; ya estagüe y estreyas ni y jalie gui sancatan, na mofona gui menañija asta qui mato ya sumaga gui anae estaba y patgon.
pairs.english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae malie y estreyas, gosdangculo minagofñija.
pairs.english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 11 24970 ¶ Anae manjalom gui guima, jasoda y patgon yan y nanaña, as Maria, ya mandimo ya maadora; ya mababa y güinajañija ya manae güe: oro, insenso, yan mira.
pairs.english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmasangane pot si Yuus gui güinife, na ti ufanmalag as Herodes, manjanao para y tanoñija gui otro chalan.
pairs.english: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn't return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 24990 ¶ Ya anae manmapos sija, y angjet y Señot mato gui as José gui güinife, ya ilegña: Cajulo ya uncone y patgon yan si nanaña, ya infanjanao para Egipto, ya infañaga güije, asta qui guajojao sumangane; sa si Herodes jaaligao y patgon para umapuno.
pairs.english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, "Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo güe, ya jacone y patgon yan si nanaña gui puenge ya manjanao para Egipto;
pairs.english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije asta que matae si Herodes, sa para umacumple y sinangan y Señot pot y profeta, na ilegña: Iya Egipto nae, juagang y Lajijo.
pairs.english: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, "Out of Egypt I called my son."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 16 25020 ¶ Si Herodes, anae jalie na mamofea güe ni manfaye, gueflalalo ya manago na ufanmapuno todo y famaguon ni guaja guiya Betlehem yan gui todo oriyaña ni dos años sacanñija para papa, jaftaemanoja y tiempo anae ninatungo ni y manfaye.
pairs.english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae macumple esta, ni y guinin masangan pot y profeta Jeremias, na ilegña:
pairs.english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inagang na majungog guiya Rama umagang, tumangis yan cumasao na dangculo; si Raquel cumasao pot y famaguonña, ya ti malago maconsuela sa manaegüe.
pairs.english: "A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn't be comforted, because they are no more."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 19 25050 ¶ Anae esta matae si Herodes, mato y angjet y Señot gui as José gui güinife, guiya Egipto,
pairs.english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Cajulo, cone y patgon yan si nanaña, ya infanjanao para y tano Israel; sa matae y cumequepuno y patgon.
pairs.english: "Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo ya jacone y patgon yan si nanaña ya manmalag y tano Israel.
pairs.english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajungog na si Arquelao, güiya y ray guiya Judea gui sagan tataña as Herodes, maañao malag guato; lao pot si Yuus ninatungo güe claro gui güinifeña, mapos malag y tanon Galilea.
pairs.english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, sumaga gui siuda na mafanaan Nasaret; para ucumple y masanganña pot y profeta sija, na umafanaan taotao Nasaret.
pairs.english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: "He will be called a Nazarene."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO sija na jaane, mato si Juan Bautista ya sumetmon gui desierton Judea,
pairs.english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Fanmañotsot sa y raenon langet jumijijot.
pairs.english: "Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta güiya uje y guinin jasangan y profeta Isaias, na ilegña: Inagang ni umagang gui desierto: Famauleg y chalan y Señot, natunas y chalanña.
pairs.english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, "The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y magaguña si Juan y pilon cameyo yan y godeña cuero na jachaflileg gui senturaña, ya y naña y apacha sija yan y miet jalom tano.
pairs.english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapos malag para güiya, Jerusalem yan Judea yan todo y tano gui oriyan Jordan,
pairs.english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya esta manmatagpange pot güiya, guiya Jordan, jasangan claro y isaoñija.
pairs.english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 7 25160 ¶ Ya jalie megae na Fariseo yan Saduseo sija na manmamaela para y tinagpangeña ya ilegña: Rasan culebla, jaye jamyo fumanagüe na insujaye y binibo ni mamaela?
pairs.english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmamatinas tinegcha digno ni y sinetsot.
pairs.english: Therefore bring forth fruit worthy of repentance!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo jumajaso sumangan gui sanjalommiyo, na si Abraham tatata; ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na siña si Yuus janacajulo este sija na acho famaguon gui as Abraham.
pairs.english: Don't think to yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father,' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago, esta locue y gachae gaegue na mapolo gui jale y trongcon jayo sija; ya todo y trongcon jayo ni ti manogcha mauleg, umautut ya umapolo gui guafe.
pairs.english: "Even now the axe lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo magajet jutagpange jamyo nu y janom para minañotsot, lao y mamamaela gui tateco, mas guaja ninasiñaña qui guajo: y sapatosña ti mauleg yo na jupula; güiya infantinagpange ni Espiritu Santo yan y guafe.
pairs.english: I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y abanicoña gaegue gui canaeña, ya unagasgas y tablaña, ya unaetnon y triguña jalom gui jalom camalin, ya usonggue y pajan trigo gui taejinecog na guafe.
pairs.english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 13 25220 ¶ Anae mato si Jesus guinin Galilea, malag Jordan gui as Juan para utinagpange.
pairs.english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Juan ti malago, ilegña: Nesesita yo matagpange pot jago, enaojao na mamaela guiya guajo?
pairs.english: But John would have hindered him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe as Jesus ilegña: Diejaloja, sa taegüenao mauleg para utacumple y todo na tininas. Ayo nae pinelo.
pairs.english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, "Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus, anae munjayan matagpange, cajulo gusisija guine y janom, y langet mababa pot güiya ya malie y Espiritun Yuus tumunog calang paluma y sumaga gui jiloña.
pairs.english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un vos guinin y langet na ilegña: Estagüiya y lajijo ni y guefyajo.
pairs.english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae quinene si Jesus ni Espiritu para y jalomtano para umatienta ni anite;
pairs.english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba umayunat cuarenta na jaane yan cuarenta na puenge ya despues ñalang.
pairs.english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya y manienienta, ya ilegña: Yaguin jago lajin Yuus, tago este y acho ya ufamapan.
pairs.english: The tempter came and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manope ilegña: Matugue esta: Ti y panja uninalâlâ y taotao, lao y todo y sinangan ni y jumuyong gui pachot Yuus.
pairs.english: But he answered, "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ninamalofan ni anite gui santa na siuda; pinelo gui jilo torren diquique, iyon y templo.
pairs.english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ilegña: Yaguin jago lajin Yuus, yutejao güine papa, sa matugue esta: Y angjet sija uninadje ya unquinajat ni canaeñija, para chaña y adengmo umatotpe contra y acho.
pairs.english: and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you.' and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don't dash your foot against a stone.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña: Locue esta matugue, chamo tietienta y Señot, Yuusmo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Again, it is written, 'You shall not test the Lord, your God.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo ninamalofan ni anite gui un sabana na sentáquilo ya jafanue todo y raeno sija gui jilo y tano yan y minagofñija,
pairs.english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Todo este sija junaejao yaguin dumimojao ya unadora yo.
pairs.english: He said to him, "I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Janao Satanas, sa matugue esta, y Señot Yuusmo na güiyaja unadora yan güiyaja unsetbe.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said to him, "Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae diningo ni anite, ya y angjet sija manmato ya masetbe güe.
pairs.english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 12 25380 ¶ Anae jajungog si Jesus na si Juan esta mapongle, tumalo guato Galilea.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadingo Nasaret, mato Capernaum ya sumaga gui oriyan tase gui oriyan tanon Sabulon yan Neftalim.
pairs.english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y guinin jasangan y profeta Isaias, na ilegña:
pairs.english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano Sabulon yan y tano Neftalim, chalan tase yan para otro banda guiya Jordan, Galilea y Gentiles.
pairs.english: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija nu y mañasaga gui jemjom, dangculo na manana liniiñija; y ayo sija nu y mañasaga tanon anineng y finatae, candet ufaninina.
pairs.english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 17 25430 ¶ Desde ayo jatutujon si Jesus sumetmon ya ilegña: Fanmañotsot, sa y raenon langet jijijot.
pairs.english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, "Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 18 25440 ¶ Ya anae jumajanao si Jesus gui tasen Galilea, jalie dos chumelo; si Simon mafanaan Pedro yan si Andres cheluña, na janatutunog y lagua gui tase sa manpescadot.
pairs.english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Dalalag yo ya junafanpescadot taotao jamyo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija japolo y lagua sija ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jumanao güije, jalie otro dos chumelo, si Santiago lajin Sebedeo, yan si Juan cheluña, gui sajyan yan si tatañija as Sebedeo na jalememenda y laguañija; ya jaagang.
pairs.english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija enseguidas japolo y sajyan yan si tatañija ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 23 25490 ¶ Ya jalilicue si Jesus iya Galilea mamanagüe gui sinagoga sija ya sumetmetmon ni raenon y evangelio, ya janafanjomlo todo y chetnot yan todo y pinite gui taotao;
pairs.english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y matunaña matungo todo guiya Siria; ya maquenenee güe guato todo manmalango, ni guaja todo clasen chetnot yan pinite; y maninanite yan y manbababa yan y manparalitico; ya janafanjomlo.
pairs.english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya madalalag güe linajyan taotao, guinin Galilea, yan guinin Decapolis, yan guinin Jerusalem, yan guinin Judea, yan y otro banda guiya Jordan.
pairs.english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE jalie si Jesus y linajyan taotao, cajulo gui un sabana, ya matachong; ya y disipuluña manmato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jababa y pachotña ya jafanagüe, ilegña:
pairs.english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mamoble gui Espiritu, sa uiyonñija y raenon langet.
pairs.english: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mantriste, sa sija umanafanmagof.
pairs.english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manmanso, sa sija ufanmaereda ni y tano.
pairs.english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manñalang yan manmajo ni tininas, sa sija umanafanjaspog.
pairs.english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manyóase, sa sija ufantinaca ni minaase.
pairs.english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mangasgas corasonñija, sa sija ujalie si Yuus.
pairs.english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y fumatitinas y pas, sa sija ufanmafanaan famaguon Yuus.
pairs.english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manmapetsigue pot causa y tininas; sa uiyonñija y raenon langet.
pairs.english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo, yaguin manmamatdise jamyo, yan manmapetsigue jamyo, yan manmasangane jamyo todo taelaye pot y naanjo, ya manmandague.
pairs.english: "Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof, ya infansenmagof, sa y premionmiyo gui langet sendangculo: sa taegüenaoja locue manmapetsigueñija y profeta sija ni y antes di jamyo.
pairs.english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 13 25640 ¶ Jamyo y asigan y tano; ya yaguin y asiga malingo y maaseña, jafa taemano manasne? taya baliña, na umayute juyong ya umagacha ni y taotao.
pairs.english: "You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo y candet y tano. Y siuda ni maplanta gui jilo y tano táquilo ti siña umatog.
pairs.english: You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can't be hidden.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya candet umasonggue ya umapolo gui papa un medida; lao umapolo gui candelero, ya umanainina todo y mangaegue gui jalom guma.
pairs.english: Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya umanina y candetmiyo gui menan y taotao sija, para ujalie y mauleg chechonmiyo, ya innamagof y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 17 25680 ¶ Chamiyo jumajaso na mato yo para juyulang y tinago pat y profeta sija; ti mato yo para juyulang, lao para jucumple.
pairs.english: "Don't think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn't come to destroy, but to fulfill.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo, nu y langet yan y tano ufalingo; lao ni un punto ni un pongpong gui tinago ufalingo, asta qui güiya todo macumple.
pairs.english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y yumulang uno güine gui sendiquique na tinago, ya mamanagüe ni taotao, diquique umafanaan gui raenon langet; lao jayeja y fumatinas ya mamanagüe umafanaan dangculo gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo sumangane jamyo: na y tininasmiyo yaguin ti mudongña qui y tininas y escriba yan y Fariseo sija, ti siña jamyo manjalom gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 21 25720 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangane sija gui manmalofan na tiempo: Chamo famumuno, ya jayeja y mamuno, peligroña gui juisio.
pairs.english: "You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, 'You shall not murder;' and 'Whoever shall murder shall be in danger of the judgment.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo na jayeja y lalalo ni cheluña, peligroña gui juisio, na jayeja y umalog ni cheluña, taetiningo jao, peligroña gui tribunal, lao jayeja y umalog bababa jao, peligroña gui guafen sasalaguan.
pairs.english: But I tell you, that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment; and whoever shall say to his brother, 'Raca !' shall be in danger of the council; and whoever shall say, 'You fool!' shall be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unchule y ninaimo guato gui attat, ya ayo nae unjaso na guaja linachimo gui chelumo;
pairs.english: "If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo güije y ninaimo gui menan y attat, ya unjanao finena ya inatungo yan y chelumo, ya ayo nae untalo guato ya unnaenñaejon y ninaimo.
pairs.english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atungo yan y contrariumo enseguidas, mientros gaegue jamyo gui chalanmiyo, noseaja, y cotrariumo unenentrega gui jues, ya y jues unenentrega gui ofisiat ya unmapolo gui preso.
pairs.english: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him in the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Seguro na ti unjuyong güije, asta qui anapase y uttimo na coble.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 27 25780 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Munga umábale,
pairs.english: "You have heard that it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery;'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na jayeja y umatan y palaoan nu ábale na minalagoña, jafatinas yan güiya y ábale gui jalom corasonña.
pairs.english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y agapa na atadogmo uninapodong jao, chule ya yute guiya jago; sa maulegña na ufalingo un pidaso guiya jago, qui todo y tataotaomo umayute guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y agapa na canaemo uninapodong jao, utut ya yute guiya jago; sa maulegña, na ufalingo un pidaso guiya jago, qui todo y tataotaomo umayute guiya sasalagüan.
pairs.english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 31 25820 ¶ Munjayan locue masangan: Jayeja y dumingo y asaguaña, umatugue y papet y inapattan umasagua.
pairs.english: "It was also said, 'Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na y dumingo y asaguaña ya ti pot inábale, jafatinas y ábale; ya jayeja y umasagua ayo y umadingo, jafatinas y ábale.
pairs.english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 33 25840 ¶ Injingogja locue y munjayan masangane sija gui manmalofan na tiempo: Munga manjula pot namaesa jao; lao unfatinas ni y Señot gui jinilamo.
pairs.english: "Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, 'You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Chamiyo fanmanjujula pot jafa; ti pot y langet, sa raenon Yuus;
pairs.english: but I tell you, don't swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y tano, sa sagan y adengña; ni pot Jerusalem, sa siuda y dangculo na Ray;
pairs.english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y ilumo unfanjula; sa ti siña y gaponulo uno naapaca, ni uno naatulong.
pairs.english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can't make one hair white or black.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manguentos jamyo, alog: Junggan, junggan; Aje, aje; sa yaguin mas qui este, taelaye jumuyong.
pairs.english: But let your 'Yes' be 'Yes' and your 'No' be 'No.' Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 38 25890 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Atadog yan atadog, nifen yan nifen,
pairs.english: "You have heard that it was said, 'An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Chamiyo fumatinas jafa contra y tinaelaye; yaguin jayejao pumatmada gui agapa na fasumo, birayeja ni y otro.
pairs.english: But I tell you, don't resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y munaquequemumojao ya jachule y magagomo, nae locue y capamo.
pairs.english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y umafuetsas jao na unjanao yan güiya un miya; unjanao yan güiya dos.
pairs.english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumagao jao, nae; ya y mumalago umayao jao, chamo jao rumiuusa.
pairs.english: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 43 25940 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Guaeya y tiguangmo ya chatlie y enemigomo.
pairs.english: "You have heard that it was said, 'You shall love your neighbor, and hate your enemy. '

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Guaeya y enemigonmiyo; bendise y mumatdidise jamyo; fantinas mauleg ni y chumatlie jamyo, tayuyute sija as Yuus ni y munamamajlao jamyo yan y pumetsigue jamyo,
pairs.english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para infanfamaguon y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet, nu y janafanina y atdao gui jilo y manaelaye yan y manmauleg; ya janauchan gui jilo y manunas yan y timanunas.
pairs.english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inguaeya ayo y gumaeya jamyo, jafa premionmiyo? Ada ti jafatinas locue taegüenao y publicano sija?
pairs.english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don't even the tax collectors do the same?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unsaluda y mañelunmiyo, jafa unfatinas mauleg? Ada ti jafatinas locue taegüenao y ti mangilisyano?
pairs.english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don't even the tax collectors do the same?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafangabales jamyo taegüije y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet, cabales.
pairs.english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ADAJE ya chamiyo fumatitinas y limosnanmiyo gui menan y taotao sija, para infanlinie; sa yaguin ti taegüenao, taya premionmiyo gui tatanmiyo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: "Be careful that you don't do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unfatitinas y limosnamo, chamo na catitiye trompeta gui menamo taegüije y jafatitinas y hipocrita sija gui sinagoga, yan y plasa para uguaja minalagñija nu y taotao sija. Magajet jusangane jamyo na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: Therefore when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin unfatitinas y limosnamo, chamo natutungo y canaemo acagüe jafa checho y canaemo agapa.
pairs.english: But when you do merciful deeds, don't let your left hand know what your right hand does,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ugaegue y limosnamo gui secreto, sa y tatamo ni jalilie gui secreto, güiya umapase jao gui publico.
pairs.english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 5 26040 ¶ Ya yaguin manaetaejao, munga taegüije y hipocrita, sa sija yanñija manmanaetae gui sinagoga yan y esquinan chalan manotojgue para ufanmalie nu y taotao sija. Magajet na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: "When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin manaetaejao, jalom gui aposentomo, ya juchum y pettamo, ya taetaye y tatamo ni y gaegue gui secreto; sa y tatamo ni y jalilie gui secreto, güiya umapase jao gui publico.
pairs.english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan manaetaejao chamo sumasangan un sinangan megae na biaje na taebale, taegüije y Gentiles; jinasoñija na ufanmajungog pot y megae sinanganñija.
pairs.english: In praying, don't use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fumatitinas taegüije iya sija; sa y tatanmiyo jatungoja jafa innesesita antes qui ingagao güe.
pairs.english: Therefore don't be like them, for your Father knows what things you need, before you ask him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao an manmanaetae jamyo taegüine: Tatanmame na gaegue jao gui langet: umatuna y naanmo.
pairs.english: Pray like this: 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Umamaela y raenomo, umafatinas y minalagomo jaftaemano gui langet taegüijija gui tano;
pairs.english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam pago nu y cada jaane na agonmame;
pairs.english: Give us today our daily bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya asiijam nu y dibenmame, taegüije yan inasisie y dumidibejam sija;
pairs.english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamojam pumópolo na infanbasnag gui tentasion, lao nafanlibrejam nu y taelaye; sa iyomo y raeno, yan y ninasiña, yan y minalag para taejinecog na jaane; Amen.
pairs.english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen. '

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inasie y umisagüe jamyo: maninasiija locue jamyo as tatanmiyo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: "For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ti unasie ayo sija y umisagüe jamyo, ti infaninasie locue ni tatanmiyo nu y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 16 26150 ¶ Yaguin umayuyunatjao, munga taegüije y hipocrita nu y triste na mata, jaago y matañija, para ufanmatungo ni taotao sija na manayunat. Magajet jusangane jamyo, na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: "Moreover when you fast, don't be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin umayunat jao, palalae y ilumo, ya unfagase y matamo;
pairs.english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head, and wash your face;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para munga malilie nu y taotao sija na umayuyunat jao, lao si tatamoja ni y gaegue gui secreto; ya si tatamo, ni jalilie gui secreto, güiya uninapase gui publico.
pairs.english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret, and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 19 26180 ¶ Chamiyo fannanaetnon güinaja para jamyo gui tano, mano nae y poliya yan y lamas uyinamag, yan y saque sija uyulang yan uchule;
pairs.english: "Don't lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao fannaetnon güinaja para jamyo gui langet, mano nae ni y poliya ni y lamas ti uyinamag, ya ni y saque sija ti uyulang yan ti uchule.
pairs.english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don't break through and steal;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae gaegue y güinajanmiyo, ayoja nae gaegue locue y corasonmiyo.
pairs.english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y candet y tataotao y atadog; yaguin y gasgas atadogmo, todo y tataotaomo ubula y manana.
pairs.english: "The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin y taelaye na atadogmo, todo y tataotaomo jomjom, Sa yaguin y manana ni y gaegue guiya jago jomjom, jafa na gosdangculo na jinemjom!
pairs.english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 24 26230 ¶ Taya ni uno siña sumetbe dos amo; sa jachatlie y uno, ya jaguflie y otro; pat jadalalag y uno ya jadespresia y otro. Ti siña jamyo insetbe si Yuus yan y güinaja.
pairs.english: "No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can't serve both God and Mammon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jusangane jamyo: Chamiyo fanmanjajaso pot y jaaninmiyo; jafa para incano, pat jafa para inguimen; ni pot para innaminagago y tataotaomiyo. Ada ti bale mas y linâlâmo qui y nengcano, yan y tataotaomo qui y magago?
pairs.english: Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanja y pajaro gui langet; ti manmanananon, ni ti manmangongoco, ni ti manmanrecocoje jalom gui camalin; sa si tatamoja gui langet munafañochocho. Ada ti mangaebalotña jamyo qui sija?
pairs.english: See the birds of the sky, that they don't sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you of much more value than they?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaye guiya jamyo, yaguin manjaso, siña jataluye y linecaña un codo?
pairs.english: "Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa jamyo na manmanjajaso pot magago? Jasoja y lirio sija gui fangualuan, jaftaemano manlâlâñiñija; ti manmachochocho ya ti manmajijila.
pairs.english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo, na si Salomon yan todo y minalagña, ti minagago parejo yan uno güine sija.
pairs.english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Yuus janaminagago y chaguan gui fangualuan; sa pago gaegue, ya agupa machule ya mapolo gui jetno, ada ti mas jamyo inninaminagago, taotao jamyo na didide jinengguenmiyo?
pairs.english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won't he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina, chamiyo jumajaso umalog: Jafajit tacano, pat jafajit taguimen, pat jafajit magaguta?
