pairs.english: "Therefore don't be anxious, saying, 'What will we eat?', 'What will we drink?' or, 'With what will we be clothed?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo este sija na güinaja, jaaliligao y Gentiles; ya y tatanmiyo gui langet jatungoja na innesesita todo este sija na güinaja.
pairs.english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao aligao fenena y raenon Yuus, yan y tininasña; ya despues todo este sija na güinaja infanmataluye.
pairs.english: But seek first God's Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumajaso y para agupa, sa y para agupa güiyaja güe ujaso. Basta para y cada y jaane y inalulaye.
pairs.english: Therefore don't be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day's own evil is sufficient.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMIYO fanmanjusga para ti infanmajusga.
pairs.english: "Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taemanoja yan manmajusga yan manmañogne jamyo, taegüijija locue infanmajusga; ya taemanoja y minedidamiyo, taegüijija locue infanmamediye.
pairs.english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa muna unlilie y migo gui atadog y chelumo, ya ti unjajaso y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa taemano unalog nu y chelumo: Maela ya junajanao enao y migo gui atadogmo; ya enagüija y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: Or how will you tell your brother, 'Let me remove the speck from your eye;' and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Hipocrita! Najanao finenana y jayo gui atadogmo? ya ayo nae siña ungueflie yan para unnajanao y migo gui atadog y chelumo.
pairs.english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother's eye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 6 26390 ¶ Chamiyo numanae y galago nu y santos, ni inpelo y perlasmiyo gui menan y babue; sa no seaja ujagacha nu y patasñija ya ujabira sija ya infanyenabalag jamyo.
pairs.english: "Don't give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 7 26400 ¶ Gagao ya infanmanae; aligao ya inseda; yajo ya infanmababaye.
pairs.english: "Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y mangagao, uresibe; ya y manaligao, usoda; ya y manyajo, umababaye.
pairs.english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja guiya jamyo, yaguin uguinagao nu y lajiña pan, ada unnae acho?
pairs.english: Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat yaguin uguinagao un güijan, ada unnae un serpiente?
pairs.english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ombre manaelaye jamyo, intingo numae mauleg na ninae y famaguonmiyo; ada ti mas y tatanmiyo, ni y gaegue gui langet, unnae mauleg na güinaja todo ayo y gumagaogüe?
pairs.english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina, jaftaemano y malagomiyo na y taotao ufatitinas nu jamyo, taegüijija infatitinas locue nu sija; sa este y lay yan y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 13 26460 ¶ Jalom gui maiot na potta, sa y feda na potta ya micanpo y chalan nu y jumananaogüe y finalingo, ya megae sija y fumapoposgüe.
pairs.english: "Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y maiot na potta ya dalalae na chalan y jumananaogüe y linâlâ, ya didide sija y sumosoda.
pairs.english: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 15 26480 ¶ Adaje jamyo nu y ti manmagajet na profeta, ni ufanmato guiya jamyo maninagagon quininilo, lao y sanjalomñija mangaegue lobo na mañaque.
pairs.english: "Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injatingo pot y tinegchañija. Ada y taotao ufañule ubas guine y títucan jayo, pat igos guine y títucan chaguan?
pairs.english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijija todo y mauleg na trongcon jayo, siempre mauleg tinegchaña; lao y taelaye na trongcon jayo, siempre taelaye tinegchaña.
pairs.english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti siña y mauleg na trongcon jayo manogcha taelaye; ni y taelaye na trongcon jayo manogcha mauleg.
pairs.english: A good tree can't produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y trongcon jayo ni ti manogcha mauleg, umautut ya umayute gui guafe,
pairs.english: Every tree that doesn't grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina pot y tinegchañija, injatingo.
pairs.english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 21 26540 ¶ Ti todo y umalog nu guajo: Señot! Señot! ujalom gui raenon langet; lao ayo y fumatinas y minalago y tatajo, ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Not everyone who says to me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae, güije na jaane, ualog nu guajo: Señot! Señot! ada ti inprofetisa pot y naanmo, yan innajanao y anite pot y naanmo, yan infatinas megae námanman na chocho pot y naanmo?
pairs.english: Many will tell me in that day, 'Lord, Lord, didn't we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo nae jusangane sija, ni y magajet ti jutungo jamyo, fanjanao guiya guajo, jamyo manmamatitinas inechong.
pairs.english: Then I will tell them, 'I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 24 26570 ¶ Enao mina jayeja y jumungog este sija y sinanganjo ya fumatinas, güiya parejo yan y méjnalom na taotao, na jafatinas y guimaña gui jilo acho;
pairs.english: "Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utunog y ichan, yan ufanmato y sadog, yan ufanmanguaefe y manglo, ya ubinate ayo na guma ya ti upodong, sa mafatinas gui jilo acho.
pairs.english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn't fall, for it was founded on the rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jayeja y jumungog este sija y sinanganjo, ya ti fumatinas, güiya parejo yan y bábaba na taotao na jafatinas y guimaña gui jilo unae;
pairs.english: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utunog y ichan yan ufanmato y sadog, yan ufanmanguaefe y manglo ya ubinate ayo na guma, ya upodong; ya gosdangculo y pinedongña.
pairs.english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell--and great was its fall."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, anae munjayan este sija jasangan si Jesus, ninafanmanman y linajyan taotao sija nu y doctrinaña.
pairs.english: It happened, when Jesus had finished saying these things, that the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafanagüe sija, calang uno ni gaeninasiña, lao ti calang y escriba sija.
pairs.english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae tumunog güe guinin y sabana, madalalag güe dangculo na linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe na mato un ategtog ya tinayuyut güe ilegña: Señot, yaguin malagojao, siña unnagasgas yo.
pairs.english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, "Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaestira y canaeña ya japacha ya ilegña: malagoyo, gasgasjao! Ya enseguidas y ategtog gasgas.
pairs.english: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, "I want to. Be made clean." Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus: Adaje ya chamo fañangangane ni jaye; lao falag y pale ya unfanue nu jago, ya unchule y ninae ni manago si Moises para testimonioñija.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "See that you tell nobody, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 5 26670 ¶ Ya anae jumalom si Jesus guiya Capernaum, mato guiya güiya un senturion guinagao güe,
pairs.english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Señot, y tentagojo gaegue guiyajame na umaason sa malango paralitico, ya gogosninachatsaga sa adit.
pairs.english: and saying, "Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nui guiya: Bae jufato ya junajomlo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "I will come and heal him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao senturion manope ya ilegña: Señot, ti siña na guajojao junafato gui papa atufjo, lao sanganja un palabra ya ujomlo y tentagojo.
pairs.english: The centurion answered, "Lord, I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo locue un taotao gui papa ninasiña, ya guaja sendalojo gui papa ninasiñajo; ya yaguin ilegco nu este na taotao: Janao, ya jumanao; yan ilegco ni otro: Maela, ya mamaela, yan ilegco ni tentagojo: Chogüe este, ya jachogüe.
pairs.english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and tell another, 'Come,' and he comes; and tell my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus, ninamanman, ya ilegña nu y dumadalalag güe: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na tayayo nae mañoda ni este na dangculon jinenggue guiya Israel!
pairs.english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to those who followed, "Most certainly I tell you, I haven't found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na ufanmato megae guine y sancatan, yan guine y sanlichan; ya ufanmatachong yan si Abraham yan si Ysaac yan si Jacob gui raenon langet;
pairs.english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y famaguon y raeno ufanmayute gui sumanjiyong gui jemjom; ya ayo nae uguaja cumasao yan checheg nifen.
pairs.english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Jesus ilegña nu y senturion: Janao, parejoja y unjonggue, umafatinas guiya jago; ya y tentagoña jumonlo güije na ora.
pairs.english: Jesus said to the centurion, "Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed." His servant was healed in that hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 14 26760 ¶ Ya anae mato si Jesus gui guiman Pedro, jalie y suegran Pedro na umaason gui cama, sa guaja calenturaña.
pairs.english: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick with a fever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japacha canaeña; ya pinelo ni calentura: ya cajulo ya jasetbe sija.
pairs.english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta pupuenge, maconie güe megae na maninanite, ya janajanao guiya sija todo y anite pot y sinanganña, yan janafanjomlo todo y manmalango.
pairs.english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y esta masangan pot y profeta Isaias, na ilegña: Güiya chumule y chetnotta yan cumacatga y pinitita.
pairs.english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: "He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 18 26800 ¶ Ya anae jalie si Jesus y linajyan taotao gui oriyaña, manago na ufanmalag y otro banda y sadog.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un escriba ya ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, judalalag jao mano y malagomo guato.
pairs.english: A scribe came, and said to him, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Y sora sija guaja liyangñija, ya y pajaro gui langet guaja chenchonñija: lao y Lajin taotao taya mano nae unaason y iluña.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya otro uno gui disipuluña ilegña nu güiya: Señot, nae yo lisensia ya jujanao finena ya jujafot y tatajo.
pairs.english: Another of his disciples said to him, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Dalalag yo; ya polo ya y manmatae ufanjinafot ni y mangaematae.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to him, "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 23 26850 ¶ Ya anae jumalom gui un sajyan, y disipuluña sija madalalag güe.
pairs.english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dangculo na pagyo mato gui tase ya y sajyan tinatampe nu y napo sija; ya güiya mamaegoja.
pairs.english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña ya mayajogüe ilegñija: Señot, nafanlibrejam sa manmalingojam!
pairs.english: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, "Save us, Lord! We are dying!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na manmaañao jamyo, taotao na didide jinengguenmiyo? Ayo nae cajulo ya jachoma y manglo yan y tase, ya dangculo na minalinao guaja.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?" Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija manmanman, ya ilegñija; jafa este na taotao na y manglo yan y tase maoosgueja güe?
pairs.english: The men marveled, saying, "What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 28 26900 ¶ Ya anae mato gui otro banda gui tano y taotao Gadara sija, umasoda yan dos na gaemanganite na manguine y naftan, yan mangosnamaañao y jechurañija; ya taya siña malofan güije na chalan.
pairs.english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, na manaagang ilegñija: Para jafajam nu jago Lajin Yuus? Matojao güine para usapetjam antes di y tiempo?
pairs.english: Behold, they cried out, saying, "What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chago guiya sija estaba un manada na gosmegae na babue mañochocho.
pairs.english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y anite sija matayuyutgüe ilegñija: Yaguin unyutejam juyong, najanaojam na fanmalag ayo y babue sija.
pairs.english: The demons begged him, saying, "If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Janao. Ya sija manjuyong ya, manmalag gui jalom y manadan babue; ya, estagüe, todo y babue manmalago papa gui un didog na lugat, asta y jalom tase, ya manmatae gui janom tase.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Go!" They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y munafañochocho y babue manmalago ya manmalag y siuda, ya jasangan todo y guaja, ya jafa susede yan y mangaemanganite.
pairs.english: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, todo y siuda manjanao para ufanasoda yan si Jesus, ya anae maliigüe, matayuyutgüe na ujanao gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jumalom gui un batco, mapos güe, ya malag y otro banda ya mato gui suidaña.
pairs.english: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, sija na manmangongone güe un malango, umaason gui cama sa paralitico; ya anae jalie si Jesus y jinenggueñija, ilegña nu y paralitico: Angoco lajijo; y isaomo unmaasie.
pairs.english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe sija palo escriba na ilegñija gui sanjalomñija: Este chumatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, "This man blasphemes."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo si Jesus y jinasoñija, ilegña: Jafa na manmanjajaso jamyo taelaye gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, "Why do you think evil in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa mas guse masangan: Y isaomo unmaasie: pat masangan: Cajulo ya unfamocat?
pairs.english: For which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Get up, and walk?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingoja na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña, gui jilo tano, para umaasie isao; (ayo nae ilegña nu y paralitico), Cajulo, chule y camamo ya unjanao para iyajamyo.
pairs.english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins..." (then he said to the paralytic), "Get up, and take up your mat, and go up to your house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo ya mapos para iyasija.
pairs.english: He arose and departed to his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie nu y linajyan taotao, ninafanmanman, ya manamalag si Yuus, sa mannae nu ayo na ninasiña gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 9 27050 ¶ Ya anae malofan si Jesus güije, jalie un taotao na matatachong gui bancon y tributo, na y naanña si Mateo, ya ilegña nu güiya, Dalalagyo. Ya cajulo ya dinalalag güe.
pairs.english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, "Follow me." He got up and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae estaba güe, matachong chumochocho gui jalom guma, estagüe, sija megae na publicano yan manisao, manmato ya mañija manmatachong gui lamasa yan si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: It happened as he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie este nu y Fariseo sija, ilegñija nu y disipuluña: Sa jafa y maestronmiyo na mañisija mañocho yan y publicano yan y manisao?
pairs.english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jajungog ayo, ilegña: Y manaechetnot ti janesesita medico: lao y manmalango.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janao ya inquetungo jafa este: Minaase malagojo, ya ti inefrese; sa ti mato yo para juaagang y manunas, lao y manisao para ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: But you go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. "

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 14 27100 ¶ Ayo nae y disipulon Juan manmato guiya güiya ya ilegñija: Jafa jame yan y Fariseo sija na manayuyunat megae; ya y disipulumo ti manayuyunat?
pairs.english: Then John's disciples came to him, saying, "Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don't fast?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Siña y mangachong y nobio, mantriste yaguin mañisijaja yan y nobio? Lao ufato y jaane, na y nobio umacone guiya sija, ya ayo nae ufanayunat.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya ni un taotao lumimendanñaejon y nuebo na magago gui mamagagonñañajeon ni y bijo; sa ayo na lemenda usuja gui magago, ya y minatitegña sentaelaye.
pairs.english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni umasajguane locue y nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero sa y boteyan cuero umafag ya umachuda y bino, ya manmalingo y boteyan cuero; lao umasajguane y nuebo na bino gui nuebo na boteyan cuero, ya uchamaog y dos.
pairs.english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 18 27140 ¶ Mientras jasangangane sija ni este, estagüe, un magas na mato ya inadoragüe ilegña: Y jagajo matae tiampmanja; lao nije ya maela ya unpolo y canaemo gui jiloña ya ulâlâ.
pairs.english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, "My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus ya dinalalag güe, yan y disipuluña locue.
pairs.english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 20 27160 ¶ Ya, estagüe, un palaoan na malango nu y minilalag y jâgâ, esta dose años, mato gui tateña ya japacha y madoblan y magaguña;
pairs.english: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña gui sumanjalomña: Yaguin jupachaja y magaguña, jujomlo.
pairs.english: for she said within herself, "If I just touch his garment, I will be made well."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jabiragüe ya anae malie güe ilegña: Jagajo, angoco, y jinengguemo unninajomlo. Ya y palaoan ninajomlo desde ayo na ora.
pairs.english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, "Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well." And the woman was made well from that hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato si Jesus gui guima ayo na magas, ya jalie y mandadandan nu y flauta yan y taotao sija manboruruca,
pairs.english: When Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Fañuja; sa y patgon palaoan ti mamatae, lao mamaego. Ya mabutleagüe.
pairs.english: he said to them, "Make room, because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping." They were ridiculing him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao sija anae mañuja, güiya mapos jalom, ya jamantiene canaeña; ya y patgon palaoan cajulo.
pairs.english: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malofan este na fama todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: The report of this went out into all that land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 27 27230 ¶ Anae mafapos si Jesus güije, madalalag güe dos taotao na bachet na umaagang ilegñija: Gaease nu jame, jago, Lajin David.
pairs.english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, "Have mercy on us, son of David!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato guato gui jalom guma, manmato guiya güiya y dos bachet, ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Injenggue na guajo siña jufatinas este? Ya sija ilegñija: Junggan Señot.
pairs.english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, "Do you believe that I am able to do this?" They told him, "Yes, Lord."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae japacha y atadogñija ya ilegña: Parejoja y jinengguenmiyo umafatinas.
pairs.english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, "According to your faith be it done to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y atadogñija manmababa. Ya si Jesus jagosencatga ilegña. Adaje ya chamiyo munatutungo ni uno.
pairs.english: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, "See that no one knows about this."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmapos sija, manafamta y famaña todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 32 27280 ¶ Ya anae manmapos sija; estagüe, machule guiya güiya un taotao na udo, na gaeanite.
pairs.english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ninajanao y anite y udo cumuentos. Ya y linajyan taotao ninafanmanman ya ilegñija: Taya este nae malie guiya Israel.
pairs.english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Pot y ninasiña y prinsipen anite, janajanao y anite sija.
pairs.english: But the Pharisees said, "By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalilicue si Jesus todo y siuda sija yan y sengsong, mamananagüe gui guima Yuusñija, ya jasesetmon y ebangelion y raeno, yan janafanmamagong todo y chetnot yan todo y pinite gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 36 27320 ¶ Anae jalie y linajyan taotao, ninamaase nu sija, sa manadingo ya manmachalapon calang y quinilo nu y taya pastotñija.
pairs.english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu y disipuluña: Magajet na y cosecha megae: lao y manfáfachocho didide.
pairs.english: Then he said to his disciples, "The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tayuyut y Señot y cosecha ya utago y manfáfachocho gui cosechaña.
pairs.english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae jaagang y dose na disipuluña, ya janae ninasiñañija contra y manaplacha na espiritu, para ujayute juyong; yan unafanmagong todo y chetnot, yan todo y manpinite.
pairs.english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y naan y dose apostoles sija este sija: Y finenana, si Simon na mafanaan si Pedro, yan si Andres cheluña: si Santiago, lajin Sebedeo, yan si Juan cheluña;
pairs.english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Felipe, yan si Bartolome; si Tomas, yan si Mateo y publicano; si Santiago, lajin Alfeo, yan si Lebeo, na y apiyiduña si Tadeo;
pairs.english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon Selote, yan si Judas Iscariote, ni y umintrega güe locue.
pairs.english: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y dose sija mantinago as Jesus na ufanjanao ya maninencatga ilegña: Chamiyo fanmalag y chalan y Gentiles; yan y siuda y Samaritano sija chamiyo fanjajalom:
pairs.english: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, "Don't go among the Gentiles, and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao gosmauleg para ufanmalag y malingo na quinilo gui guima Israel.
pairs.english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manjanao jamyo, setmon ya alog: Y raenon langet mato jijot.
pairs.english: As you go, preach, saying, 'The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjomlo y manmalango, nafan gasgas y manategtog, nafangajulo y manmatae, nafanjanao y anite sija: pot grasia na inresibe, fanmannae pot grasia.
pairs.english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers , and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fannanaetnon oro ni salape ni coble gui betsanmiyo;
pairs.english: Don't take any gold, nor silver, nor brass in your money belts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni tengguang para y chalan, ni dos na magago ni sapatos, ni baston; sa y fafáchocho jamerese y nengcanoña.
pairs.english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan todo na siuda, pat songsong na manjalom jamyo, guesaligao jaye mumerese, ya fañaga güije asta qui para infanjanao.
pairs.english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manjalom jamyo gui guima, saluda.
pairs.english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y guima jamerese, y pasmiyo usaga guiya güiya; lao yaguin ti jamerese, y pasmiyo utaloja guato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ti rumesibe jamyo, yan ti jaecungog y sinanganmiyo, fanjanao güije na guma pat suida, ya insacude contra sija todo y petbos gui adengmiyo.
pairs.english: Whoever doesn't receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake off the dust from your feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Y mas mauleg para y tano Sodoma yan Gomora gui jaanin sentensia, qui para ayo na siuda.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 16 27500 ¶ Estagüe, na guajo jamyo tumago, calang quinilo gui entalo lobo sija; fanmalate calang y serpiente sija, yan y fanmanso calang y paluma sija.
pairs.english: "Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo nu y taotao sija; sa infaninentrega gui inetnon ofisiat, ya infanmasaolag gui sinagogañija;
pairs.english: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmacone guato gui menan magalaje yan ray pot y naanjo, para testimonio contra sija yan y Gentiles.
pairs.english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manmaentrega jamyo, chamiyo jumajaso jafa para insangan; so ayoja na ora infanmanae jafa para insangan.
pairs.english: But when they deliver you up, don't be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jamyo infanguentos, lao y Espiritun y Tatanmiyo ni y cumuecuentos gui jalommiyo.
pairs.english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: "Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo infanchinatlie pot y naanjo; lao y sumigue asta y uttimo, güiya ucajulo gui langet.
pairs.english: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manmapetsigue jamyo gui un suida, fanmalag y otro: sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti infanmunjayan manjanao todo gui siudan Israel, asta qui mato y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo, ti dangculoña qui y maestro, yan y tentago qui y amuña.
pairs.english: "A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bastaja y disipulo yaguin parejoja y maestruña, ya y tentago yaguin parejoja y amuña. Sa yaguin y tata gui guima mafanaan Beetsebub, cuanto mas y familiana?
pairs.english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaañao; sa taya matatampe, para ti umalie: yan manaatog para ti umatungo.
pairs.english: Therefore don't be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo sija y jusangane jamyo gui jemjom, sanganñaejon gui manana: ya todo sija y injingog gui talanga, sanganñaejon desde y jilo guma.
pairs.english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo fanmaañao ni upinino y tataotao; sa ti siña japuno y ante: lao fanmaañaoñao ni ayo y siña yumute y tataotao yan y ante guato guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: Don't be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: "Aren't two sparrows sold for an assarion coin ? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father's will,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaponulonmiyo locue esta todo manmatufong.
pairs.english: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaañao; sa mas manbaliñaja jamyo qui y megae na pájaro.
pairs.english: Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayeja y sumanganyo gui menan taotao, güajo locue jusangangüe gui menam y tatajo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y pumuneyo gui menan taotao sija, guajo locue jupune güe gui menan y tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 34 27680 ¶ Chamiyo jumajaso na mato yo para jupolo pas gui tano: ti matoyo para jupolo pas, lao espada.
pairs.english: "Don't think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn't come to send peace, but a sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato yo para jupolo inaguaguat y laje contra y tataña, ya y jaga contra y nanaña, ya y yetna contra y suegraña.
pairs.english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y enemigoñija mangaegueja guiya sija.
pairs.english: A man's foes will be those of his own household.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya y tataña pat y nanaña mas qui guajo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo; ya y gumaeya y lajiña pat y jagaña mas qui guajo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo.
pairs.english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn't worthy of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, y ti chumule y quiluusña ya udalalagyo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo.
pairs.english: He who doesn't take his cross and follow after me, isn't worthy of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sumoda y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya y finalingaeguan ni y linâlâña pot y naanjo, güiya usoda.
pairs.english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 40 27740 ¶ Y rumisibe jamyo, jaresibeja yo; ya y rumisibeyo, jaresibeja y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y rumesibe un profeta pot y naan profeta, uresibe y premion profeta; ya y rumesibe y taotao tunas pot y naan y taotao tunas, uresibe y premion y taotao tunas.
pairs.english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masquesea jayeja y numae uno güine nu este sija y mandiquique, unoja bason janom ni y fresco, pot y naan y disipulo, magajet jusangane jamyo na ti ufalingo y premiuña.
pairs.english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you he will in no way lose his reward."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: and said to him, "Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?"

pairs.english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 7 27830 ¶ Anae manmapos sija, jatutujon si Jesus sumangan si Juan gui linajyan taotao. Jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie gui desierto? un trongcon piao na ninamayeyengyong ni y manglo?
pairs.english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat, jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie? un taotao na minagagon fino na magago? Estagüe, sija y manminagagon fino na magago, mangaegue gui guima y ray sija.
pairs.english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in king's houses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pot jafa injanagüe jamyo? Para inlie un profeta? Junggan, jusangane jamyo, mas qui y profeta.
pairs.english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este yuje y munjayan matugue: Estagüe na junajanao y taotao y tinagojo gui menan matamo, para ufamauleg y chalanmo gui menamo.
pairs.english: For this is he, of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti ucajulo gui entalo y manmafañañago gui famalaoan, uno mas dangculo qui si Juan Bautista; lao y mas diquique gui raenon langet mas dangculo qui güiya.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde y jaanin Juan Bautista asta pago, y raenon langet gaeninasiña; ya y manmatatnga sija uamot.
pairs.english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y profeta sija, yan y lay, japrofetisa asta si Juan.
pairs.english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: An manmalago jamyo inresibe; güiya si Ilias ni y umamaela.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaetalanga para unfanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 16 27920 ¶ Lao jaye nae juacompara este na rasa? Manparejo yan y famaguon ni manmatatachong gui plasa ya jaagang y mangachongñija,
pairs.english: "But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Indandane jamyo flauta, ya ti manbaela jamyo, manuugong jamyo lao ti manatanges jamyo.
pairs.english: and say, 'We played the flute for you, and you didn't dance. We mourned for you, and you didn't lament.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato si Juan ya ti chumocho ni gunimen, ya ilegñija: Gaeanite güe.
pairs.english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, 'He has a demon.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato y Lajin taotao ya chumocho yan gumimen, ya ilegñija: Estagüe un taotao na gachumocho, yan gagumimem, amigon y publicano sija yan y manisao; lao y tiningo manacabales ni y finatinasña.
pairs.english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, 'Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!' But wisdom is justified by her children. "

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn't repent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayjao, Corasin! Ayjao, Betsaida! sa yaguin iya Tiro yan Sidon nae mafatinas ayo y mannamanman ni y mafatinas guiya jamyo, esta jagas manmañotsot gui silisio yan apo.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na mas songunon Tiro yan Sidon qui para jamyo gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago, Capernaum, ni y jagas manataquito jao asta y langet; unmayute jao papa sasalaguan; sa yaguin iya Sodoma nae mojon mafatinas todo ayo y mannamanman ni jagas mafatinas guiya jago, mangagaegueja mojon asta pago na jaane.
pairs.english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo; na y mas songunon tano Sodoma, qui para jago gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom, on the day of judgment, than for you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 28 28040 ¶ Maela guiya guajo todo y manyayas, yan y menoson, ya guajo junafandescansa.
pairs.english: "Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light."

pairs.english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, "Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath."

pairs.english: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
