pairs.english: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?" that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegna: Jafa taotao guaja gui entalo miyo yaguin guaja un quinilo na podong gui joyo, gui jaanin sabalo, ada ti uestira y canaeña ya jochule?
pairs.english: He said to them, "What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won't he grab on to it, and lift it out?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti mas baliña un taotao qui un quinilo? Pot este, cabales na umafatinas mauleg gui jaanin sabado.
pairs.english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni y ayo na taotao: Juto y canaemo; ya jajuto ya finamauleg talo parejo yan y otro.
pairs.english: Then he told the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 14 28200 ¶ Ayo nae y Fariseo sija manjanao, ya manafaesen entre sija contra güiya para umapuno güe.
pairs.english: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jatungo ai Jesus, mapos güije; ya madalalag güe linajyan taotao, ya janafanjomlo todosija.
pairs.english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya guefmanencatga, na chañija munamatutungo güe.
pairs.english: and commanded them that they should not make him known:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y esta munjayan masangan pot y profeta Isaias, ilegña:
pairs.english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y tentagojo ni y juayig, y güinaeyaco ni y janamagof y antijo: na jupoluye ni y Espiritujo gui jiloña, ya jasangane Gentiles y juisio.
pairs.english: "Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti upotfia, ni uagang; ya taya ni uno ujiningog y inagangña gui chalan.
pairs.english: He will not strive, nor shout; neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti umayulang y piao ni mayamag ni umapuno y mechan dangis ni y aasa asta qui machule y juisio para y guinana.
pairs.english: He won't break a bruised reed. He won't quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y naanña, manmannanangga y Gentiles.
pairs.english: In his name, the nations will hope."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 22 28280 ¶ Ya machuliegüe guato un inanite, na bachet yan udo, ya janajomlo; ayo nae cumuentos y udo yan manlie.
pairs.english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Ada ti este yuje y lajin David?
pairs.english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, "Can this be the son of David?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo sija jajungog ya ilegñija: Este ti uyute juyong y anite, yaguin ti pot Beetsebub, magas y anite sija.
pairs.english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, "This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus, anae jatungo y jinasoñija, ilegña: Todo y raeno umadibide contra güiyaja uyulang; ya cada guma, pat siuda, umadibide contra güiyaja, ti usaga.
pairs.english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Satanas jayute juyong si Satanas, güiya umadibide contra güiyaja, ya jaftaemano y raenoña sumaga?
pairs.english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin guajo pot si Beetsebub juyuyute juyong y anite sija; pot jaye y famaguonmiyo, fanyinite sija juyong? Pot ayo, sija ufanjuesmiyo.
pairs.english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin pot y Espiritun Yuus, juyute juyong y anite sija, magajet na esta mato guiya jamyo y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come upon you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa? Jaftaemano siña un taotao jumalom gui guima y matatnga na taotao ya uyulang todo y güinajaña, yanguin ti jagode finenana y matatnga? Ayo nae siña jayulang y guimaña.
pairs.english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti jumajame, contrariujo güe; ya y ti rumecoje güe guiya guajo, güiya umachalapon.
pairs.english: "He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn't gather with me, scatters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 31 28370 ¶ Pot enao na jusangane jamyo: Todo isao yan y chatfino contra si Yuus, umasie y taotao sija; lao y chatfino contra y Espiritu, ti umaasie y taotao.
pairs.english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y cumuentos contra y Lajin taotao, umaasie; lao jayeja y cumuentos contra y Espiritu Santo, ti umaasie, ni este na tiempo, ni y ayo na mamamaela.
pairs.english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, neither in this age, nor in that which is to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas mauleg na trongcon jayo, yan y tinegchaña mauleg; pat fatinas taelaye na trongcon jayo, yan taelaye y tinegchaña; sa pot y tinegchaña, y jayo esta matungo.
pairs.english: "Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O rasan culebla! jafa taemano jamyo na manaelaye siña manguentos mauleg, lo sa gui minegae y guaja gui corason, sinasangan y pachot.
pairs.english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg na taotao, nu y mauleg na güinaja gui corasonña, mauleg chinileleña; lao y taelaye na taotao, nu y taelaye na güinaja gui corasonña, taelaye chinileleña.
pairs.english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na todo y finijo na taesetbe ya jasasangan y taotao sija, janesesita ufanmannae cuenta gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y finomo na unmanatunas jao, yan pot y finomo na unmasentensia jao.
pairs.english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 38 28440 ¶ Ayo nae manmanope y escriba yan y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Maestro manmalagojam na inlie un señatmo.
pairs.english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope ilegña nu sija: y generasion manaelaye yan manábale manmanaliligao y señat, lao taya señat ufanmanae, na y señat Jonas profeta.
pairs.english: But he answered them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenaoja si Jonas sumaga tres na jaane yan tres na puenge gui jalom y tiyan y bayena, ayo locue mina y Lajin taotao, usaga tres na jaane yan tres na puenge gui jalom corason y tano.
pairs.english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao Ninibe ufangajulo gui juisio yan este na generasion, ya ufanmasentensia, sa sija manmañotsot ni y setmon Jonas; ya estagüeja, uno güine na lugat na mas dangculo qui si Jonas.
pairs.english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raena gui sancatan ucajulo gui juisio yan este na generasion ya ufanmasentensia, sa mato guine y uttimon tano, para uecungog y tiningo Salomon, ya estagüeja uno güine na lugat na mas dangculo qui si Salomon.
pairs.english: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y áplacha na espiritu jumanao gui taotao, mamomocat gui anglo na lugat, ya jaaliligao nae udescansa, lao ti mañoda.
pairs.english: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn't find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña: Jutalo guato para y iyajame ni anae guine ayoyo. Ya anae mato guato, jasoda taesinajguan, binale yan maadotna.
pairs.english: Then he says, 'I will return into my house from which I came out,' and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapos, ya mangone talo gachongña siete na espiritu na mas taelaye qui güiya, ya manjalom ya mañaga güije; ya mas taelaye uttimoña yuje na taotao qui y finenaña. Taegüineja locue ujumuyong este na generasion y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 46 28520 ¶ Ya anae estaba güe cumuecuentos yan y taotao sija; estagüe, si nanaña, yan y mañeluña mangaegue gui sumanjiyong, na manmalago na umacuentuse güe.
pairs.english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña uno: Estagüe, si nanamo, yan y mañelumo gui sumanjiyong, na manmalago na umacuentuse jao.
pairs.english: One said to him, "Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaope ayo y sumangan este, ya ilegña: Jaye nanajo yan jaye mañelujo?
pairs.english: But he answered him who spoke to him, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajuto y canaeña gui disipuluña, ya ilegña: Estagüe, y nanajo yan y mañelujo.
pairs.english: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, "Behold, my mother and my brothers!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo ayo y fumatinas y minalago y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet, este güiya chelujo laje, yan chelujo palaoan, yan nanajo.
pairs.english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na jaane, jinanaoña si Jesus gui guima, matachong gui oriyan tase.
pairs.english: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya dangculo na linajyan taotao; ya jumalom güe gui un batco, ya matachong; ya todo y linajyan taotao manmatachong gui oriyan unae.
pairs.english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacuentuse sija megae na acomparasion, ilegña: Estagüe y tátanom na jumuyong para ufananom.
pairs.english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, "Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manananom, palo gui semiya manpodong gui oriyan chalan, ya manmato y pájaro sija ya macano.
pairs.english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo gui semiya manpodong gui jilo acho na lugat, na ti megae odaña; ya doco ti apmam, sa ti tadong papa gui eda.
pairs.english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn't have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manina y atdao, mansinenggue sa taejale, ya ninamalayo.
pairs.english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo mamodong gui entalo títuca sija ya mandoco y títuca ya chiniguet.
pairs.english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo manpodong gui mauleg na oda, ya manmanogcha; y uno siento, y otro sesenta, y otro treinta.
pairs.english: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato y disipuluña sija ya ilegñija: Jafajao na cumuecuentuse sija pot acomparasion sija?
pairs.english: The disciples came, and said to him, "Why do you speak to them in parables?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope ilegña. Sa esta manmanae jamyo, para intingo y misterion y raenon langet, lao sija ti ufanmanae.
pairs.english: He answered them, "To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y guaja, umanae para uguaja mas; lao ayo y taya iyoña, achog uguaja y iyoña, umachule.
pairs.english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jucuentuse sija pot acomparasion; sa y manmanaatan, ya ti manmanlie, ya manecungog, ya ti manmanjujungog, ni ujatungo.
pairs.english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don't see, and hearing, they don't hear, neither do they understand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ya sija nae umacumple y sinangan Isaias ni ilegña: Anae manmanjujungog, ujungog ya ti utungo; ya anae manmanaatan, ufanmanlie, ya ti ujasiente.
pairs.english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, 'By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonñija este na taotao sija manmacat, ya y talangañija mapot manmanjungog, ya y atadogñija jajujuchom; para chañija fanmanlilie ni atadogñija, yan ufanmanjungog ni talangañija, ya ujatungo ni corasonñija, ya ujatolaeca sija, ya guajo junajomlo sija.
pairs.english: for this people's heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and should turn again; and I would heal them.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mandichoso y atadogmiyo, sa manmanlie, yan y talanganmiyo sa manmanjungog.
pairs.english: "But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na megae na profeta, yan manunas na taotao jagasja manmalago na ujalie y liniinmiyo, ya ti jalie; yan ujajungog y jiningogmiyo, ya ti jajungog.
pairs.english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 28740 ¶ Ecungog jamyo y acomparision y tátanom.
pairs.english: "Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayeja y umecungog y sinangan y raeno, ya ti jatungo, mato y Taelaye ya janajanao y esta matanme gui corasonña. Este yuje semiya ni y pedong gui oriyan chalan.
pairs.english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y matanme gui jilo acho na lugat, este yuje y jumungog y sinangan, ya jaresibe ni y minagofña.
pairs.english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taya jale guiya güiya, ya gaegue un ratoja; sa anae mato y triniste yan minamajlao pot causan di y sinangan, ti apmam matompo gui isao.
pairs.english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y matanme gui entalo títuca sija; este yuje y jumungog y sinangan; lao y inadajiña ni y tano, yan dinague ni güinaja, jañucot y sinangan ya sumaga sin tinegchaña.
pairs.english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y matanme gui mauleg na oda; este yuje y jumungog y sinangan ya jatungo, ya manogcha locue; ya y tinegchaña y uno siento, ya y otro sesenta, ya y otro treinta.
pairs.english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and brings forth, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 24 28800 ¶ Otro acomparasion jasangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet parejoja yan un taotao ni manananom gui fangualuanña, mauleg na semiya.
pairs.english: He set another parable before them, saying, "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tiempo nae manmamaego y taotao sija, mato y enemigo ya jatanme y taelaye na chaguan gui entalo y trigo, ya mapos.
pairs.english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mandoco y trigo ya manmanogcha, y taelaye na chaguan mandoco locue.
pairs.english: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato y tentago y tatan familia ya ilegñija nu güiya: Señot, ada ti mauleg na semiya tinanommo gui fangualuanmo? Jafa mina guaja taelaye na chaguan?
pairs.english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, 'Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where did this darnel come from?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija: Un enemigo fumatinas este. Ya y tentagoña ilegñija nu güiya: Malagojao ya infanjanao ya inchile?
pairs.english: "He said to them, 'An enemy has done this.' "The servants asked him, 'Do you want us to go and gather them up?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Munga, sa no sea yaguin inchile y taelaye na chaguan, innabineog locue y trigo.
pairs.english: "But he said, 'No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufandaña mandoco sija na dos asta y quineco; an mato y tiempon quineco, bae jualog ni para ufanmangoco: Chile finena y taelaye na chaguan, ya inguede famanojo para umasonggue; ya y trigo polo gui jalom y camalinjo.
pairs.english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, "First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn."'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 28870 ¶ Otro acomparasion sinangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet parejoja yan y pepitas y mostasa, ni jachule un taotao ya jatanme gui fangualuanña.
pairs.english: He set another parable before them, saying, "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na güiya mas diquique gui todo y semiya sija; lao anae esta mandoco, güiya mas dangculo gui manmagogulae, ya mamatrongconjayo, ya manmato sija y pájaron y aire, ya manmamatinas y chenchon gui ramasña.
pairs.english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 33 28890 ¶ Otro acomparasion sinangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet, parejoja yan y libadura, ni y un palaoan jachule ya janana gui tres medidan arina, asta qui todo manbolacho.
pairs.english: He spoke another parable to them. "The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo estesija jasangan si Jesus pot acomparasion gui linajyan taotao; ya taya jasangane sija sin acomparasion.
pairs.english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn't speak to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y munjayan masangan pot y profeta na ilegña: Jubaba y pachotto pot acomparasion: ya jusangan güinaja sija ni manafanatog desde y plinantan y tano.
pairs.english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, "I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jadingo y linajyan taotao ya mapos, ya jumalon gui guima; ya manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña sija, ya ilegñija: Naclaruyejam ni y acomparasion y taelaye na chaguan gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope sija ilegña: Ayo y mananom mauleg na semiya y Lajin taotao yuje.
pairs.english: He answered them, "He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y fangualuan, y tano; y manmauleg na semiya, y famaguon y raeno, ya y taelaye na chaguan y famaguon y Maligno.
pairs.english: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y enemigo, ni y tumanme, y anitegüe; ya y quineco, y jinecog y siglo; ya y para ufanmangone, y angjet sija.
pairs.english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao machule y taelaye na chaguan ya masonggue gui guafe, taegüijija locue y jinecog y siglo.
pairs.english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utago y Lajin taotao y angjetña sija; ya urecoje todo ayo sija y fumatitinas y tinempo, yan y fumatitinas y tinaelaye;
pairs.english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uyute gui jetnon guafe; ya ayo nae uguaja tumanges, yan chegcheg nifen.
pairs.english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y manunas, ufanmanina calang y atdao, gui raenon y Tatanñija. Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 44 29000 ¶ Y raenon langet locue, parejoja yan un senguaguan na güinaja ni y mananana gui un fangualuan, ya un taotao, anae jasoda, janana, ya mapos yan pot y minagofña jabende todo y iyoña ya jafajan ayo na fangualuan.
pairs.english: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 45 29010 ¶ Y raenon langet parejoja locue yan un taotao ni manbebende, na manaliligao bonito na petlas:
pairs.english: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mañoda un petlas na senguaguan, mapos ya jabende todo y güinajaña ya jafajan ayo.
pairs.english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 47 29030 ¶ Y raenon langet parejoja locue, yan un lagua ni y mayute guato gui tase, ya mangone todo clase:
pairs.english: "Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta bula, majala guato gui oriyan unae; ya manmatachong, ya majoca y manmauleg ya masajguane gui sajguanñija, ya y manaelaye mayute juyong.
pairs.english: which, when it was filled, they drew up on the beach. They sat down, and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüinija locue y jinecog y siglo: ufato y angiet sija ya ujanafanjanao y manaelaye gui entalo y manunas;
pairs.english: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come forth, and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ujayute gui jetnon guafe; ya ayo nae uguaja güije tumanges, yan chegcheg nifen.
pairs.english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Intingo todo estesija? Sija ilegñija nu guiya: Junggan.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Have you understood all these things?" They answered him, "Yes, Lord."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Pot este todo escriba ni mafatinas disipulo gui raenon langet, parejoja yan y tatan un familia, ni y jachuchule gui güinajaña bijo sija, yan nuebo sija.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 53 29090 ¶ Ya anae janafonjayan si Jesus todo este sija na acomparasion, mapos güije.
pairs.english: It happened that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui tanoña, mamanagüe gui guimayuusñija, ya sija ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Guine mano nae jumuyong este na tiningoña, ya este sija mandangculo na ninasiña?
pairs.english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, "Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti güiya este y lajin y catpintero? Ada si nanaña ti mafanaan si Maria? yan y mañeluña, ti sija si Santiago, si José, si Simon, yan si Judas?
pairs.english: Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ada ti manjijita yan y mañeluña palaoan? Guine mano nae uguaja este na taotao todo estesija? Ya guaja guiya güiya disgusto.
pairs.english: Aren't all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y profeta taya onraña, gui tanoña yan y guimaña; lao gaeonraña gui otro lugat.
pairs.english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jafatinas güije megae na mannamanman, sa taya jinengguenñija.
pairs.english: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo si Herodes y tetrarca jajungog y faman Jesus;
pairs.english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu y tentagoña sija: Este si Juan Bautista: güiya cajulo gui entalo y manmatae, enao mina mandangculo na mannamanman jafatitinas guiya güiya.
pairs.english: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 3 29170 ¶ Sa si Herodes esta jacone si Juan, ya jagode, ya japolo gui calaboso, pot si Herodias, asaguan Felipe y cheluña.
pairs.english: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan ilegña nu güiya: Ti tunas na un guaja jao nu este na palaoan.
pairs.english: For John said to him, "It is not lawful for you to have her."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malago na upinino güe, maañao ni y linajyan taotao; sa pineloñija na si Juan profeta güe.
pairs.english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y jaanin y mafañagon Herodes, y jagan Herodias bumaela gui talo, ya ninamagof si Herodes,
pairs.english: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este japromete ya manjula na uninae todo y guinagaoña.
pairs.english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya guinin umatungo finena an nanaña, ya ilegña: Naeyo güine gui un plato ni y ilon Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y ray ninatriste; lao pot causa y juramentoña yan y mangachongña na mangaegue gui lamasa, manago na umanae.
pairs.english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, manago na umautot y ilon Juan gui calaboso.
pairs.english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machule guato y ilo gui un plato, ya manae y patgon palaoan, ya güiya chumule para si nanaña.
pairs.english: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija, manmato ya machule y tataotaoña, ya majafot, ya manmapos, ya masangane si Jesus.
pairs.english: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 13 29270 ¶ Ya anae jajungog este si Jesus, mapos güije gui un batco para y desierto na lugat na sumajnge: ya anae majungog ni y linajyan taotao sija, madalalague güe, manmamocatja desde siuda sija.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao si Jesus, ya jalie y dangculo na linajyan taotao: ya ninamaase ni ayo sija, ya janafanjomlo y manmalango sija.
pairs.english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 15 29290 ¶ Ya anae estaba pupnenge güije na jaane, manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña sija ya ilegñija; Este na lugat desierto ya y tiempo esta ufalofan; tago y linajyan taotao ya ufanjanao, ya ufanmalag y sengsong sija, ya ufanmamajan nañija.
pairs.english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, "This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Taya nesesida na sija ufanjanao: jamyo innae nañija.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to them, "They don't need to go away. You give them something to eat."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ilegñija nu güiya: Taya güine guaja na sincoja na pan, ya dos na güijan.
pairs.english: They told him, "We only have here five loaves and two fish."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña: Chulieyofan güine mague.
pairs.english: He said, "Bring them here to me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y linajyan taotao na ufanmatachong gui jilo chaguan, jachule y sinco na pan yan dos na güijan ya jaatan julo y langet, ya jabendise: ya jaipe y pan ya janae y disipulo sija, ya y disipulo janae y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho todos, ya manjaspog; ya anae majoca y sebblan pedaso sija na maipe, bula dose na canastra.
pairs.english: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañocho sija, sinco mit na lalaje, ti matufong y famalaoan yan y famaguon.
pairs.english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 22 29360 ¶ Enseguidas si Jesus janafanjalom y disipuluña sija gui un batco, ya manjanao manmofona, manmalag y otro bandan sadog, y tiempo nae güiya janafanjanao y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

pairs.english: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatungo na ti mansinangane sija na ujaadaje sija ni y lebaduran pan; lao y finanagüen y Fariseo yan y Saduseo sija.
pairs.english: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 13 30020 ¶ Ya anae mato si Jesus gui Sesarean Filipe, jafaesen y disipuluña sija ilegña: Jaye ilegñiñija y taotao sija nu y Lajin taotao?
pairs.english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, "Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Guaja umalog na jago si Juan Bautista; ya guaja umalog, si Elias; ya guaja umalog, si Jeremias, pat uno gui profeta sija.
pairs.english: They said, "Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Ya jamyo, jaye ilegmimiyo nu guajo?
pairs.english: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Simon Pedro ilegña: Jago si Cristojao, y Lajin Yuus ni y lalâlâ.
pairs.english: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae inepe as Jesus ilegña: Dichosojao, Simon, lajin Jonas; sa ti jufanuejao sensen ni jâgâ, na y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo locue sumanganejao, na jago si Pedro; ya y jilo este na acho, jufatinas y iglesiamo; ya y pettan sasalaguan taeninasiña contra guiya.
pairs.english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya junaejao ni y yaben y raenon langet; ya todoja y ungode gui tano, umagodeja locue gui langet; ya todoja y unpula gui tano, umapula locue gui langet.
pairs.english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatago y disipuluña sija, na chañija fanmañangangane ni jaye na güiya si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 21 30100 ¶ Desde ayo na tiempo jatutujon si Jesus dumeclaraye y disipuluña sija, na guaja nesesidaña na ujanao para Jerusalem, ya upadese megae sija gui manbijo, yan y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno, ya umanacajulo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro, quinene güe ya tinitujon güe rineprende, ilegña: Señot, maase nu jago: este ti usiña jago.
pairs.english: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, "Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jabiragüe, ya ilegña as Pedro: Suja gui menajo, Satanas: jago un tropero para guajo; sa ti untungo y güinaja Yuus, na y güinajan taotaoja sija.
pairs.english: But he turned, and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 24 30130 ¶ Ayo nae si Jesus, ilegña ni y disipuloña sija: Yanguin jaye malago dumalalag yo, polo ya upune namaesagüe, ya uchule y quiluusña ya udalalag yo.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y malago munalibre y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya jayeja y finalingaeguan ni y linâlâña pot guajo, güiya usoda.
pairs.english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa probechoña y taotao, yanguin jagana todo y tano, ya y linâlâña malingo? Pat jafa na apas ufannae y taotao pot y linâlâña.
pairs.english: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Lajin taotao, ufato gui minalog y Tataña yan y angjetna sija; ya ayo nae uapase cada uno taemano y chechoña.
pairs.english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: na guaja palo gui mangaegue güine, na ti ujachague finatae, asta qui jalie y Lajin taotao na mato gui raenoña.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di y saes na jaane, si Jesus jacone si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan cheluña, ya jacone julo gui un taquilo na finabeca, na sumajnge.
pairs.english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaaggo y jechuraña gui menanñija; ya y mataña manina calang y atdao; ya y magaguña apaca calang y manana.
pairs.english: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, na manmato güiya sija si Moises yan si Elias, na manguecuentos yan güiya.
pairs.english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pedro, ilegña as Jesus: Señot, mauleg na mangaeguejit güine: yaguin malagojao, bae jufatinas güine tres na tabetnaculo; para jago y uno, para si Moises y uno, yan para si Elias y uno.
pairs.english: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let's make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae cumuecuentos güe, estagüe, un malag na mapagajes jananujong gui jiloñija, ya, estagüe, un inagang gui mapagajes na ilegña; Estagüiya y Lajijo na maguflie, na guefyajo: ecungog güe.
pairs.english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este y disipulo sija, manpodong gui jilo matañija ya mangosmaañao.
pairs.english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus mato ya manpinacha, ilegña: Fangajulo ya chamiyo fanmaaañao.
pairs.english: Jesus came and touched them and said, "Get up, and don't be afraid."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajatsa y atadogñija, taya jalie na si Jesusja.
pairs.english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manunog papa guine y finabeca, si Jesus mantinago ya ilegña: Chamiyo fanmañangangane ni jaye ni liniimiyo, asta qui y Lajin taotao esta cajulo gui entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Don't tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe ya ilegñija: Jafa nae na ilegñija y escriba sija na si Elias ufato finena?
pairs.english: His disciples asked him, saying, "Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus, ilegña: Magajet na si Elias ufato finena, ya ujananalo todo y güinaja.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na si Elias esta mato, ya ti matungogüe: lao mafatinas guiya güiya todo y malagoñija. Taegüenaoja locue y Lajin taotao upadese nu sija.
pairs.english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y disipulo sija jatungo na mansinangane sija as Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 14 30310 ¶ Ya anae manmato sija gui linajyan taotao, mato guiya güiya un taotao na dinimumuye güe ya ilegña:
pairs.english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Señot, gaease ni lajijo; sa malango baba, ya gogosjapadese; sa megae nae podong gui guafe, yan megae nae podong gui janom.
pairs.english: "Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin juchulie guato y disipulumo, lao tisiña manajomio.
pairs.english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ilegña: O generasion na ti manjonggue yan manchatpayon! asta ngaean nae utafanjijitaja? asta ngaean nae jususungonja jamyo? Chulie yo fan mague.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalalatde si Jesus y anite, ya mapos gui malango, ya y patgon jomlo desde ayo na ora.
pairs.english: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato y disipulo sija gui as Jesus, ya ilegñija: Jafajam mina ti siña inyite juyong?
pairs.english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, "Why weren't we able to cast it out?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Pot diquique na jinengguenmiyo: sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na yanguin mangaejinenggue jamyo, calang y pepitas mostasa, injaalog ni este na jalom tano: Janao güine; ya ujanao, ya taya ti siña para jamyo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Lao este na classe ti jumanao juyong, yaguin ti y minauleg y tinayuyut.)
pairs.english: But this kind doesn't go out except by prayer and fasting."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 22 30390 ¶ Ya anae manmamocat guiya Galilea, ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Y Lajin taotao umaentrega gui canae y taotao sija;
pairs.english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapuno; lao y mina tres na jaane, ucajulo. Ya sija ninafangostriste.
pairs.english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up." They were exceedingly sorry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 24 30410 ¶ Ya anae manmato guiya Capernaum, manmato gui as Pedro ayosija y manmangongobbla y medio siclo, y tributo, ya ilegñija: Ada ti manapapase y maestronmiyo y medio siclo y tributo?
pairs.english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, "Doesn't your teacher pay the didrachma?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña: Junggan. Ya anae jumalom güe gui jalom guma, si Jesus, cuenentuse güe antes, ilegña: Jafa jinasosomo Simon? Y ray y tano sija, jaye jacocobbla tributo pat senso? y famaguonñija, pat y taotaojuyong?
pairs.english: He said, "Yes." When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ilegña, Y taotaojuyong; si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Ayo nae y famaguon manlibre.
pairs.english: Peter said to him, "From strangers." Jesus said to him, "Therefore the children are exempt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para mungajit fumatinas y tinempo para sija, Janao falag y tase, ya unyute y jagüet, ya y finenana na güijan na mato, cone; ya an unbaba y pachotña, unsoda y un siclo; chule este ya nae para guajo yan para jago.
pairs.english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo, manmato y disipulo sija gui as Jesus, ya ilegñija: Jaye mas dangculo gui raenon langet?
pairs.english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, "Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang si Jesus un patgon, ya japolo gui entaloñija,
pairs.english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in their midst,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Magajet jusangane jamyo, yaguin ti inbira jamyo, ya ti infanjuyong calang, y diquique na famaguon, sen ti infanjalom gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: and said, "Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y umumitde calang este na patgon, este uguefdangculo gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y rumesibe un patgon, parejo yan este, pot y naanjo, jaresibeja yo locue.
pairs.english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jayeja y munamatompo uno güine gui estesija mandiquique ni y jumonggue yo, mas mauleg umagode gui agagaña y dangculo na molinon acho, ya umayute gui anae tadodong y tase.
pairs.english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 7 30510 ¶ Ayay y tano pot y tinempo sija! sa nesesita na ufato y tinempo sija, lao, ayay ayo na taotao, y uminafato y tinempo.
pairs.english: "Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 8 30520 ¶ Enao mina yaguin y canaemo, pat y adengmo, unninaquepodongjao, utut ya unnajanao guiya jago: sa maulegña na unqueyaojao, pat mangcojao, ya unjalom gui linâlâmo, qui uguaja dos canaemo, yan dos adengmo, ya unmapolo gui taejinecog na guafe.
pairs.english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y atadogmo unninaquepodongjao, chule ya unnajanao guiya jago; sa maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâmo yan un atadog, qui uguaja dos atadogmo, ya unmapolo gui guafen sasalaguan.
pairs.english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out, and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 10 30540 ¶ Atan ya chamiyo dumesprenesia uno güine gui estesija y mandiquique; sa guajo sumangane jamyo, na y angjetñija gui langet, siesiempreja jaliliija y matan y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: See that you don't despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa y Lajin taotao mato para usatba y manmalingo.)
pairs.english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa jinasonmimiyo? Yaguin guaja un taotao na gaega siento na quinilo, ya finalingaeguan uno: Ada ti upolo y noventa y nueve gui jalomtano, ya ujanao ya ujaligao ayo y malingo?
pairs.english: "What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn't he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jasoda, magajet jusangane jamyo, na magofña ni ayo, qui y noventa y nueve ni y ti manmalingo.
