pairs.chamorro: Ya yañija y finenana na saga gui guipot, yan y finenana na tachong gui sinagoga;
pairs.english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y manmasaluda gui plasa, yan ufanmafanaan ni y taotao sija, Rabi.
pairs.english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called 'Rabbi, Rabbi' by men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo chamiyo fanmalalago manmafanaan. Rabi; sa unoja Maestronmiyo, ya todo jamyo mañelo.
pairs.english: But don't you be called 'Rabbi,' for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmamananaan ni uno tatanmiyo gui tano; sa unoja Tatanmiyo, na gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni infanmamanaan uno amunmiyo; sa unoja amunmiyo, si Cristo.
pairs.english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y mas dangculo guiya jamyo, güiya utentagonmiyo.
pairs.english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y munadangculon namae sagüe, umumitde; ya jayeja y munaumitden namaesagüe, güiya udangculo.
pairs.english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 13 32480 ¶ Lao ay ay para jamyo escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa injichom y raenon langet gui menan y taotao sija; ya ni jamyo ti manjalom, ni y para ufanjalom ti inpelo na ufanjalom.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows' houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa inticho y guima y biuda sija yan inagó y tinaetae; pot este inresibe dangculo na sentensia.)
pairs.english: "But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don't enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa inlilicue y tase yan y tano para infatinas un prosélito, ya anae esta infatinas, infatitinas güe lalajin sasalaguan dosbiaje mas qui jamyo.
pairs.english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much of a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 16 32510 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, bachet na guia sija ni y ilegmiyo: Jayeja y manjula pot templo, taya este; lao jayeja y manjula pot y oron y templo, gaeisao güe.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, 'Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manbababa yan manbachet! Jafa mas dangculo, y oro pat y templo, ni y munasantos y oro?
pairs.english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y manjula pot y attat, taya este; lao jayeja y manjula pot y ninae ni gaegue gui jiloña, gaeisao güe.
pairs.english: 'Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manbachet jamyo! Jafa mas dangculo, y ninae pat y attat ni munasantos y ninae?
pairs.english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y manjula pot y attat, manjula pot ayo yan todo y guaja gui jiloña.
pairs.english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it, and by everything on it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manjula pot y templo, manjula pot ayo yan pot güiya y sumaga gui jinalomña.
pairs.english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it, and by him who was living in it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manjula pot y langet, manjula pot y trono Yuus, yan pot güiya ni gaegue na matatachong gui jiloña.
pairs.english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him who sits on it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 23 32580 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa manmanapase jamyo diesmo y yetba buena, yan anis yan comino, ya inpelo y mas dangculo gui lay; y juisio, y minaase, yan y jinenggue. Este nesesita umafatinas, ya munga mapolo na ti infatinas y otro sija.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bachet jamyo na guia sija! sa inguicula y ñamo, ya inpapañot y cameyo.
pairs.english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 25 32600 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa infagagase y sumanjiyeng y posuelo yan y plato; lao y sumanjalom bula inamot yan minampos.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fariseo bachet jao! fagase finena y sumanjalom gui posuelo yan y plato, ya despues y sumanjiyong ugasgas locue.
pairs.english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 27 32620 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa manparejo jamyo yan y manmablanquea na naftan na y sanjiyongña magajet na mauleg malie: lao y sumanjalomña bula tolang manmatae, yan todo y ináplacha.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao locue jamyo y sumanjiyong magajet na manunas malie jamyo ni taotao sija; lao y sumanjalom bula hipocresia yan inechong.
pairs.english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 29 32640 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa infatinas naftan y profeta sija, ya inadotna y naftan y manunas,
pairs.english: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegmiyo: Yaguin mangaeguejam gui jaanin y tatanmame sija, ti infangachong yan sija gui jâgâ y profeta sija.
pairs.english: and say, 'If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn't have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo mina jamyo mismo innae testimonio contra jamyo, na jamyo famaguon ayo sija y pumuno y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue innabula y medidan y tatanmiyo.
pairs.english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Colebla sija, rasan colebla sija! Jaf taemano jamyo insujaye gui sentensian sasalaguan?
pairs.english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 34 32690 ¶ Enaomina estagüeyo na junae jamyo profeta sija, yan manmalate yan escribasija; ya palo guiya sija inpino ya inatane gui quiluus; ya y palo guiya sija, inpanag gui sinagoganmiyo, ya inpetsigue sija guinin siuda asta siuda;
pairs.english: Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ufato gui jilomiyo todo y tunas na jâgâ ni y machuda gui jilo y tano, desde y jâgân Abel y tinas, asta y jâgâ Sacharias, lajin Barachias, ni inpino gui entalo templo yan y attat.
pairs.english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusagane jamyo, na todo estesija ufanmato gui jilo este na generasion.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 37 32720 ¶ Jerusalem! Jerusalem! ni y pumuno y profeta sija, ni infagas ni acho todo y manmatago para jago, cuanto biaje malagoyo na jurecoje y famaguonmo, calang y ponedera yan jarecoje y poyitasña sija gui papa papaña, lao ti manmalago jamyo!
pairs.english: "Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na madingo guiya jamyo y guimanmiyo na ti mataotagüe.
pairs.english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo jamyo sumangane, na desde pago, ti inliiyo, asta qui ilegmiyo: Dichoso güe y mato. pot y naan y Señot.
pairs.english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA si Jesus jumuyong gui templo ya mapos; manmato y disipuluña sija, para umafanue ni y mafatinas y templo.
pairs.english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jaope sija, ilegña: Ti inlie todo estesija? Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti umapolo güine un acho gui jilo otro acho, na ti umayulang.
pairs.english: But he answered them, "You see all of these things, don't you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae matatachong güe gui sabana Olibo, manmato guiya güiya y disipulo sija, ya ilegñija: Sangane jam ngaean ufanjuyong estesija na güinaja, yan jafa taemano na señat y finatomo, yan y jinecog y tiempo?
pairs.english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus, ilegña: Adaje ya chamiyo fanmadadague ni jaye.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ujaalog: Guajo si Cristo; ya megae ujadague.
pairs.english: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmanjungog guera yan sinangan nu y guera; atan ya chamiyo ninafañachatsaga; sa nesesita na todo este ufanjuyong, lao trabia ti y jinecog.
pairs.english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren't troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo nasion contra nasion, yan raeno contra raeno; ya uguaja ñinalang yan linao gui lugat sija.
pairs.english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo este sija na güinaja y tutujon y pininite.
pairs.english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae infanmaentrega para infanmanapute, ya infanmapuno; ya infanmachatlie gui todo nasion pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae innafanmatompo; ya ufanaentrega unos y otros, ya ufanachatlie unos y otros.
pairs.english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ti manmagajet na profeta ufangajulo, ya ujadague megae.
pairs.english: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y janamegae y tinaelaye, y güinaeyan y megae janamanenggeng.
pairs.english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y sumungon asta y jinecog, este usatba.
pairs.english: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapredica este y ebangelion y raeno gui todo y tano, para testimonio gui todo y nasion, ya ayo nae ufato y jinecog.
pairs.english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 15 32890 ¶ Enaomina an inlie y chinatlie y inginon na yinilang, ni y jasangan si Daniel profeta ni tumotojgue gui santos na lugat; (y tumataetae güiya utungo).
pairs.english: "When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y mangaegue guiya Judea, manmalago para y taquilo na jalomtano;
pairs.english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui jilo atof, ti ufanunog ya ujachule jafa gui guimaña;
pairs.english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out things that are in his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui fangualuan, ti ufanalo tate ya ujachule y magagoña.
pairs.english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ay ay para y manmapotgue, yan y mannanasuso, güije na jaane!
pairs.english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanaetae, sa y jinanaonmiyo, munga gui tiempon manenggeng ni y sabado.
pairs.english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter, nor on a Sabbath,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo na tiempo uguaja dangculo na pininite, ya desde y tutujon y tano asta pago, taya nae guaja; ya taya mas na uguaja asta jinecog.
pairs.english: for then there will be great oppression, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ayo na jaane sija ti manafangadada, ni un catne usiña ninalibre; lao pot y manmaayig, ayo sija na jaane umanafangadada.
pairs.english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jaye na taotao umalog nu jago: Estagüe si Cristo, pat ayo; chamo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: "Then if any man tells you, 'Behold, here is the Christ,' or, 'There,' don't believe it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo y ti manmagajet na Cristo yan ti manmagajet na profeta sija; ya ufanmamanue dangculo na señat sija, yan mannamanman, ya, yaguin siña, ujadagueja asta y manmaayig.
pairs.english: For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na jusangane jamyo antes.
pairs.english: "Behold, I have told you beforehand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ilegñija nu jamyo: Estagüe na gaegue güi desierto, chamo jumajanao; pat, Estagüe, na gaegue gui sanjalom gui cuatto, chamo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: If therefore they tell you, 'Behold, he is in the wilderness,' don't go out; 'Behold, he is in the inner rooms,' don't believe it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa calang y lamlam ni y jumuyong gui sancatan, ya manina gui sanlichan, taegüijija locue y minamaela y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae mañaga y tataotao y matae, ayo locue nae ufandaña y aguila sija.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaangoco si Yuus; polo ya ulinibre pago, yaguin malago nu güiya, sa ilegña: Güajo Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mañaque locue, ni y manmaatane yan güiya gui quiluus, manajuyonge güe locue.
pairs.english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 45 34910 ¶ Ya desde y mina saes na ora guaja jinemjom todo y jilo y tano, asta y mina nuebe na ora.
pairs.english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina nuebe na ora, si Jesus umagang nu y dangculon inagang ilegña: Eli, Eli, lama sabactani! cumequeilegña: Yuusso, Yuusso, jafa na undingo yo?
pairs.english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?" That is, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo ni manestaba güije, majungog güe, ya ilegñija: Si Elias este jaaagang.
pairs.english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, "This man is calling Elijah."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas malago uno guiya sija, ya jachule y espongja y janafañopchop binagle, ya japolo gui un piao, ya janae güe para uguimen.
pairs.english: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palo ilegñija: Polo ya talie cao ufato si Elias ya uninalibre.
pairs.english: The rest said, "Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 50 34960 ¶ Ayo nae si Jesus, anae munjayan umagang talo otro biaje nu y dangculon inagang jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe y cottinan y templo na masise y dos pedaso, guinin sumanjilo asta y sumanpapa; ya y tano mayengyong, ya y acho sija mangoca.
pairs.english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y naftan sija manmababa ya megae na tataotao mañantos sija ni manmamaego, mangajulo;
pairs.english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao gui naftan, despues di quinajiloña, ya mato gui santos na siuda, ya manalie ya megae.
pairs.english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y senturion, yan y mangaegue yan güiya na maadadaje si Jesus, anae malie y linao yan todo ayo sija y manmafatinas, mangosmaañao ya ilegñija: Sumen magajet na Lajin Yuus este.
pairs.english: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, "Truly this was the Son of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue güije megae na famalaoan na manmanaatan gui chago, ni jadalalag si Jesus guine Galilea ya jasesetbe.
pairs.english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui entalo ayo sija si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago yan José, yan y nanan y famaguon Sebedeo.
pairs.english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 57 35030 ¶ Ya anae este pupuenge güije na jaane, mato un taotao Arimatea, na rico, na y naanña si José, na güiya locue disipulon Jesus.
pairs.english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus' disciple came.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya mato gui as Pilato, ya jagagao y tataotao Jesus. Ayo nae si Pilato manago na umanae.
pairs.english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule si José y tataotao, ya jabalutan ni un sabanas na gasgas,
pairs.english: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo gui nuebo na naftanña, ni y finatinasñaja gui acho ni sacapico; ya janagalileque guato un dangculon acho y pettan y naftan, ya mapos.
pairs.english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 61 35070 ¶ Ya manestaba güije si Maria Magdalena, yan y otro Maria, na manmatatachong gui menan y naftan.
pairs.english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 62 35080 ¶ Ya y inagpaña na jaane, despues di y jaanen finamauleg, mandaña y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y Fariseo sija gui as Pilato,
pairs.english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Señot, injaso na ayo y dacon ilegña, anae estaba lalâlâ: Despues di tres na jaane, jucajulo talo.
pairs.english: saying, "Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: 'After three days I will rise again.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina fanago, ya umaasegura y naftan, asta y mina tres na jaane; sa noseaja ufanmato y disipulo sija an puenge ya ujasaque; ya ujaalog ni taotao sija: Cajulo esta gui entalo manmatae: ya y uttimo na linache udangculoña qui y finenana.
pairs.english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, 'He is risen from the dead;' and the last deception will be worse than the first."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña si Pilato nu sija: Inguaja un guatdianmiyo; janao, ya inasegura todo manu y ninasiñanmiyo.
pairs.english: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmapos sija, ya maadaje y naftan para umaasegura, ya maseyo y acho.
pairs.english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YUTTIMO na ora y sabalo, gui egaan anae mumanánaná y finénana na jaane gui semana, mato si Maria Magdalena yan y otro Maria, para ujalie y naftan.
pairs.english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe un dangculon linao; sa y angjet y Señot tumunog guine y langet, ya janagalileg y acho gui petta, ya matachong gui sumanjilo.
pairs.english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jechuraña parejo yan y lamlam, ya y magaguña apaca calang niebe.
pairs.english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y minaañao nu güiya, y guatdia sija mayengyong ya sumaga calang manmatae.
pairs.english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope y angjet, ilegña ni famalaoan sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao jamyo; sa jutungoja na inaliligao si Jesus, ni guinin maatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: The angel answered the women, "Don't be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüe güine; sa esta cajulo, taegüine guinin jasangan. Maela ya inlie y lugat anae guinin umaason y Señot;
pairs.english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janao fanlagoguse, ya sangane y disipuluña sija, na esta cajulo gui entalo y manmatae, ya infanninanangga Galilea: ya ayo nae inlie güe; estagüe, na esta jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, 'He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Behold, I have told you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae sija manapos gui naftan, manmaañao yan mangosmagof, yan manmalalago para umannae notisia y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 9 35210 ¶ Ya estagüe si Jesus na manasoda ya ilegña nu sija: Fanmagof todos! Ya sija manmato, ya manmagote y adengña ya maadora güe.
pairs.english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmaañao; janao ya sangane mañelujo na ufanjanao para Galilea; ya ayo nae ujaliiyo güije.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said to them, "Don't be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 11 35230 ¶ Anae manmapos sija, estagüe palo gui guatdia sija na manmato gui siuda, ya janatungo y prinsipen y mamale sija, todo y munjayan manmafatinas.
pairs.english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mandaña yan y manamco na taotao ya manaconseja entre sija, mannae y sendalo sija megae na salape,
pairs.english: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Alog, y disipuluña sija manmato gui anae puenge, ya masaque güe, anae manmamaegojam.
pairs.english: saying, "Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jaecungog este y magalaje, jame innamalago güe ya infanseguro.
pairs.english: If this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae sija jachule y salape ya jafatinas jafa y manmafanagüe sija: ya esta na sinangan mapublilica ni Judio sija asta pago na jaane.
pairs.english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 16 35280 ¶ Ya y onse na disipulo sija manmapos para Galilea, gui un ogso anae guinin mantinago as Jesus.
pairs.english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie, maadoragüe; lao y palo buebuente.
pairs.english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 18 35300 ¶ Ya mato guiya sija si Jesus ya jasangane sija, ilegña: Todo y ninasiña manaeyo, gui langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanjanao, ya fannaquilisyano todo y nasion sija, tagpange sija pot y naan y Tata, yan y Lajiña, yan y Espiritu Santo:
pairs.english: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüe sija, na ujaadaje todosija ni jutago jamyo; sa estagüe jugagaegueja guiya jamyo todo y jaane, asta y jinecog y tano. Amen.
pairs.english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age." Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TUTUJON y ibangelion Jesucristo, Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano esta matugue gui profeta Isaias: Estagüe, guajo tumago y tentagojo gui menan matamo, para ufamauleg y chalanmo gui menamo.
pairs.english: As it is written in the prophets, "Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynagang ni umaagang gui desierto: Fanmauleg y chalan y Señot: natunas y cayejonña.
pairs.english: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan managpange gui desierto, ya jasetmon y tinagpangen minañotsot para inasiin isao sija.
pairs.english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao guiya güiya guato todo y tano Judea, yan todo sija guiya Jerusalem; ya todo sija mantinagpange gui sadog Jordan, ya jaconfesatñaejon y isaoñija.
pairs.english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Juan minagagon pulon cameyo, yan sinturon cuero gui senturaña; ya y naña, apacha yan miet monte.
pairs.english: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansesetmon, ilegña: Ufato gui tateco uno na masgaeninasiña qui guajo, y coreas y sapatosña, ti digno yo nu jutecon ya jupula.
pairs.english: He preached, saying, "After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo magajet na jutagpange jamyo yan janom; lao güiya infantinagpange ni Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 9 35410 ¶ Ya susede ayo sija na jaane, na si Jesus mato guine Nasaret Galilea, ya tinagpange as Juan gui Jordan.
pairs.english: It happened in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas nae cajulo gui janom, jalie na mababa y langet, ya y Espiritu, calang paluma tumunog gui jiloña,
pairs.english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un inagang guine y langet na ilegña: Jago y lajijo ni yajo, iya jago nae gosmagof yo.
pairs.english: A voice came out of the sky, "You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas ninafalag y desierto ni Espiritu.
pairs.english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije cuarenta na jaane, ya tinienta as Satanas; yan mañisija y manmachaleg na gâgâ sija; ya y angjet sija masetbe güe.
pairs.english: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 14 35460 ¶ Anae munjayan si Juan mapreso, mato si Jesus guiya Galilea, jasesetmon y ibangelion Yuus.
pairs.english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Y tiempo esta macumple; ya y raenon Yuus esta jijot: fanmañotsot, ya injenggue y ibangelio.
pairs.english: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 16 35480 ¶ Ya mamomocat gui oriyan tasen Galilea, jalie si Simon, yan si Andres chelun Simon, na jayuyute y lagua gui tase, sa sija manpescadot.
pairs.english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Maela dalalagyo, ya junafanpescadot taotao jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas japolo y laguañija ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae malofan talo didide mona, jalie si Santiago, lajin Sebedeo, yan si Juan cheluña, na manestaba locue gui batco na jalememenda y laguañija.
pairs.english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas jaagang; ya jadingo si tatanñija as Sebedeo gui batco yan y manmachocho sija, ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 21 35530 ¶ Ya manjalom Capernaum; ya enseguidas, gui sábado na jaane, jumalom gui sinagoga ya mamanagüe.
pairs.english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ninafanmanman ni finanagüeña; sa jafananagüe sija calang uno ni gaeninasiña, ya ti calang y escriba sija.
pairs.english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas guaja güije gui sinagogañija un taotao na guaja áplacha na espiritu, ya güiya umagang,
pairs.english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Parajafa jam nu jago, Jesus taotao Nasaret? Matojao para unnafanaelayejam? Jutungoja jayejao, jago y Santos guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: saying, "Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jalalatde ilegña: Pacaca, ya maela juyong guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y áplacha na espiritu tiniteg güe, ya ninaagang gosdangculo na inagang, jumuyong guiya güiya.
pairs.english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo sija ninafanmanman, pot este manafaesen entre sija, ilegñija: Jafa este? Jafa na nuebo finanagüe este! yan ninasiña jatago y manáplacha na espiritu, ya maosgueja güe?
pairs.english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas y famaña manamamta todo gui tano oriyan Galilea.
pairs.english: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 29 35610 ¶ Ya enseguidas anae jumuyong gui sinagoga, mato gui guima Simon yan si Andres, yan si Santiago yan si Juan.
pairs.english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y suegran Simon estaba na umaason sa malango yan calentura: ya masangane güe enseguidas nu y palaoan.
pairs.english: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mato güe, ya jamantiene canaeña, ya jajatsa julo; ya pinelo ni calentura, ya güiya sumetbe sija.
pairs.english: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 32 35640 ¶ Ya anae estaba esta pupuenge, anae machom y atdao, maconiigüe todo ni manmañetnot yan y maninanite.
pairs.english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y siuda mandaña gui petta.
pairs.english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanjomlo megae ni manestaba manmalango todo clasen chetnot sija; ya jayute juyong megae na anite sija; ya ti japolo nu y anite sija cumuentos sa matungo güe.
pairs.english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 35 35670 ¶ Ya y egaan güije, cajulo gostaftaf, jojomjomja trabia, ya jumuyong, ya malag y un lugat desierto, ya manaetae güije.
pairs.english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinatiye güe as Simon, yan y mangachochongña.
pairs.english: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae masoda güe, ilegñija nu güiya: Todo umaliligaojao.
pairs.english: and they found him, and told him, "Everyone is looking for you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Nije tafanmalag y otro lugat gui sengsong ni jijot, ya jufansetmon locue güije; sa pot este na matoyo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom gui sinagogañija todo Galilea, sesetmon ya jayuyute juyong y anite sija.
pairs.english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 40 35720 ¶ Ya un ategtog mato guiya güiya, tinayuyut güi ya dumimo, ya ilegña: Yaguin malagojao, siña unnagasgasyo.
pairs.english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, "If you want to, you can make me clean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, "I want to. Be made clean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y chetnot y ategtog mapos guiya güiya ya gasgas güe.
pairs.english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jagosencatga, ya jatago na ujanao,
pairs.english: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Atan ya chamo sumangangane ni jaye jafa; lao sigueja gui jinanaomo ya unfanue y pale nu jago, ya unofrese ni guinasgasmo ni si Moises manago, para testimonioñija.
pairs.english: and said to him, "See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya mapos, ya jatutujon munamatungo, yan janagosmamta y checho; pot este, si Jesus ti siña jumalom matungo nu güiya gui siuda; lao sumasagaja gui sumanjiyong gui lugat desierto sija, ya manmato guiya güiya guinin todo y patte sija.
pairs.english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA otro biaje güiya jumalom guiya Capernaum, despues di malofan ti megae na jaane sija; ya majungog na gaegue güe gui jalom guma.
pairs.english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña megae, ya ti manulag, ni gui oriyan y petta; ya jasetmon y sinangan guiya sija.
pairs.english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato guiya güiya manmangongone un paralitico, na macocone ni cuatro.
pairs.english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti siña manmato guiya güiya pot y linajyan taotao, manajanao y atof anae estaba güe, ya anae munjayan mababa, manatunog y cama anae mapopolo y paralitico.
pairs.english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus y jinenggueñija, ilegña ni paralitico: Lajijo, y isaomo unmaasie.
pairs.english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije manmatatachong palo escriba sija, ya manmanjajaso gui corasonñija, ilegñija:
pairs.english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na cumuecuentos este na taotao chatfino contra si Yuus? Jaye siña manasie isao, solo si Yuusja?
pairs.english: "Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatungo si Jesus enseguidas gui espirituña na manmanjajaso gui sumanjalomñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa muna injajaso este sija gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, "Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa mas guse taalog y paralitico: Y isaomo unmaasie; pat taalog: Cajulo, chule y camamo, ya unjanao?
pairs.english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingo na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña gui jilo tano manasie isao (ilegña ni paralitico),
pairs.english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"--he said to the paralytic--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualog nu jago: Cajulo, ya unchule y camamo ya janao falag iyajamyo.
pairs.english: "I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo güe enseguidas, ya jachule y camaña, ya mapos gui menan todo; enao muna todo ninafanmanman, ya manamalag si Yuus, ilegñija: Taya nae inlie ayo.
pairs.english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, "We never saw anything like this!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 35900 ¶ Ya jumanao talo gui oriyan tase, ya todo y linajyan taotao manmato guiya güiya, ya jafanagüe sija.
pairs.english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan jalie si Levi, lajin Alfeo, na matatachong gui bancon y tributo sija, ya ilegña nu güiya: Dalalagyo. Ya cajulo ya dinalalag güe.
pairs.english: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, "Follow me." And he arose and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede na estaba güe matachong para uchocho gui lamasa gui guima ayo, ya megae sija na publicano yan manisao sija manmatatachong mañisija locue yan si Jesus, yan y disipoluña sija; sa guaja megae dumadalalag güe.
pairs.english: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba sija gui entalo y Fariseo sija, anae jalie na mañochocho yan y manisao yan y publicano sija, ilegñija ni disipoluña sija: Jafa este na güiya chomocho yan gumiguimen, yan y publicano sija yan y manisao?
pairs.english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, "Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus, ilegña nu sija: Y manjomlo ti janesesita medico, na y manmalango. Ti matoyo para juagang y manunas, na y manisao sija.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 18 35950 ¶ Ya y disipulon Juan, yan y disipulon Fariseo sija manayunat: ya manmato, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa muna y disipulon Juan yan y disipulon Fariseo sija manayuyunat; ya y disipulumo ti manayuyunat?
pairs.english: John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, "Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don't fast?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Siña manayunat y mangaegue gui guipot umasagua, yaguin mañisija yan y nobio? Y tiempo nae mañisijaja yan y nobio, ti siña manayunat.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ufato y jaane sija, na y nobio umanajanao guiya sija; ya ayo sija na jaane nae ufanayunat.
pairs.english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya ni uno lumimendanñañaejon y nuebo na magago gui bijo na bestido; sa ayo y nuebo na limenda ujanao gui bijo, ya mas taelaye y matiteg.
pairs.english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya ni uno umasajguane y nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero: sa y nuebo na bino uyamag y boteyan cuero sija, ya umachuda y bino, ya y boteyan cuero manmalingo; lao y nuebo na bino, y nuebo na boteyan cuero nae umasajguane.
pairs.english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 23 36000 ¶ Ya manmapos este, malolofan güe gui jalom fangualuan trigo gui sabado na jaane; ya y disipoluña sijas igue di manmanjala ni espiga sija.
pairs.english: It happened that he was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija, ilegñija: Atanja, jafa na jafatitinas gui sabado na jaane y ti mauleg para umafatinas?
pairs.english: The Pharisees said to him, "Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Taya nae intaetae jafa checho David anae janesesita, ya ñalang yan y mangachongña?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry--he, and those who were with him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa taemano jalomña gui guimayuus anae si Abiatar magas na pale, ya jacano y pan ni inefrese, ni ti para macano, na para y pale sija; ya janae locue y mangachongña sija?
pairs.english: How he entered into God's house when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña talo nu sija: Y sabado pot y taotao na mafatinas: ti y taotao pot y sabado.
pairs.english: He said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y Lajin taotao Señot locue gui sabado.
pairs.english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jumalom talo gui sinagoga; ya guaja güije un taotao na anglo un canaeña.
pairs.english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija maaatanja güe cao unajomlo gui sabado na jaane; para umafaaela.
pairs.english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni ayo na taotao y anglo un canaeña: Tojgue julo gui entalo.
pairs.english: He said to the man who had his hand withered, "Stand up."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Siña tafatinas mauleg gui sabado na jaane pat taelaye? nalibre y linâlâ pat puno? Lao sija manmamatquiquiloja.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?" But they were silent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jaatan gui oriya sija yan y linalalo, ninapinite pot y majetog corasoññija, ya ilegña nu y taotao: Estira mona y canaemo. Ya jaestira, ya y canaeña tumalo mauleg parejo yan y otro.
pairs.english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
