pairs.english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, "Teacher, don't you care that we are dying?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo güe, ya jalalatde y manglo, ya ilegña ni tase: Pacaca famatquilo. Ya bumasta y manglo, ya guaja dangculo na catma.
pairs.english: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, "Peace! Be still!" The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa jamyo na gosmanmaañao? Taye jinengguenmiyo trabia?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangosmanmaañao, ya ilegñija entre sija: Jaye este, na asta y manglo yan y tase maosgue güe?
pairs.english: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA manmato gui otro bandan tase gui tano y taotao Gadara sija.
pairs.english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumuyong güe gui batco, enseguidas umasoda yan un taotao gui naftan sija ni guaja un áplacha na espiritu.
pairs.english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja sagaña gui jalom naftan sija, ya taya siña gumode güe nu y cadenaja:
pairs.english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae na biaje nae magode nu y tale sija yan cadena sija, lao y cadena sija esta manmayamag pot guiya; ya y tale sija manmagtos, ya taya siña munamanso güe.
pairs.english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya siempre yan puenge yan jaane, jumajanao ya umaagang gui entalo naftan sija, yan gui jalomtano sija, ya janalalamen güe ni acho sija.
pairs.english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus gui chago, malago, ya jaadora güe.
pairs.english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umagang gosdangculo na inagang, ilegña: Para jafayo ni jago, Jesus, Lajin y Gueftaquilo na Yuus? Jufanjula nu jago pot si Yuus na chamoyo munachachatsaga.
pairs.english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, "What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don't torment me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña nu güiya: Juyong güine na taotao, áplacha na espiritu.
pairs.english: For he said to him, "Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen: Jaye naanmo? Ya inepe, ilegña: Linajyan naanjo: sa manmegaejam.
pairs.english: He asked him, "What is your name?" He said to him, "My name is Legion, for we are many."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatayuyut megae, para chaña yiniyite juyong güije na tano.
pairs.english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije, jijot gui jalomtano sija, un dangculo na manadan babue na mañochocho.
pairs.english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matayuyut güe ni ayo todo sija na anite, ilegñija: Tagojam para y babue sija para infanjalom guiya sija.
pairs.english: All the demons begged him, saying, "Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manpinetmite as Jesus. Ya manjuyong ayo sija y manáplacha na espiritu, ya manjalom gui babue sija; ya y manada manmalago papa gui un didog na lugat asta y jalom tase, ya guaja sija dos mit; ya manmatmos gui tase.
pairs.english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y munafañochocho y babue sija manmalago ya manmañangane gui siuda yan y fangualuan sija. Ya manjanao sija para ujalie jafa ayo y guinin mafatinas.
pairs.english: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui as Jesus, ya malie y guinin ninachatsaga ni anite, matatachong, ya minagagago, ya jatungo ayo y guaja ni linajyan; ya manmaañao.
pairs.english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinagane ni ayo sija y lumie; jafa taemano matoña ayo y guinin guaja anite, yan y babue sija.
pairs.english: Those who saw it declared to them how it happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matutujon matayuyut güe na ujanao gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom güe gui batco, tinayuyut güe ni ayo y guinin guaja anite, para ujasija.
pairs.english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ti pinetmite, lao ilegña un güiya: Janao falag iyajamyo gui amigumo sija; ya unsangane sija na dangculon güinaja y Señot finatinasña nu jago, yan guaja minaaseña nu jago.
pairs.english: He didn't allow him, but said to him, "Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maposgüe ya jatutujon sumanganñaejon guiya Decapolis na dangculon güinaja y finatinas Jesus nu güiya: ya todo ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan otro biaje si Jesus gui un batco para y otro banda, mandaña guiya güiya un dangculo na linajyan taotao; ya gaegue güe gui oriyan tase.
pairs.english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato uno gui prinsipe sija gui sinagoga, y naanña si Jairo; ya anae linie güe, podong gui adengña;
pairs.english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinayuyut güe megae, ilegña: Y jagajo cumequematae. Nije ya unpolo y canaemo gui jiloña, para ujomlo, yan ulâlâ.
pairs.english: and begged him much, saying, "My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao yan Jesus, ya megae na taotao sija madalalag güe, ya machiguet güe.
pairs.english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un palaoan na numanajuyong jâgâ esta dose años.
pairs.english: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japadese megae medico, ya jagasta todo y güinajaña, ya taya jaaprobecha; lao lumala adid,
pairs.english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog ayosija na cumuentos si Jesus, jumalom gui entalo y taotao sija gui sumantate, ya japacha y magaguña.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña: Yaguin jupacha y magaguñaja, uguajayo jinemlo.
pairs.english: For she said, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y menegae y jâgâña umanglo, ya jasiente y tataotaoña na esta jomlo ni ayo na chetnot.
pairs.english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus enseguidas jatungo guiya güiyaja, na ninasiña jumuyong guiya güiya, jabira güe guato gui linajyan taotao, ya ilegña: Jaye pumacha y magagujo?
pairs.english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, "Who touched my clothes?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija ilegñija nu güiya: Unlie y linayan taotao na machichiguetjao, ya ilegmo: Jaye pumachayo?
pairs.english: His disciples said to him, "You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manatan gui oriya para ulie y fumatinas este.
pairs.english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo nae y palaoan maañao ya manlaloalao, jatungo na iyagüiya nae mafatinas, mato ya podong gui menaña, ya jasangane todo ni magajet.
pairs.english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Jagajo, y jinengguemo unninajomlo; janao yan minagof, ya unjomio ni chetnotmo.
pairs.english: He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 35 37160 ¶ Y tiempo nae cumuecuentos güe, manmato guine y guima y prinsipen sinagoga ya ilegñija: Y jagamo matae: para jafa di unnachachatsaga mas y Maestro?
pairs.english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler's house saying, "Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus, anae jajungog este na sinangan, ilegña ni prinsipen sinagoga: Chamo maaañao; jonggueja.
pairs.english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, "Don't be afraid, only believe."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti japetmite ni uno na událalag güe, solo si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan, chelun Santiago.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato gui guima y prinsipen y sinagoga, ya jalie y atboroto yan y manatanges yan y manugung.
pairs.english: He came to the synagogue ruler's house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom, ilegña nu sija: Jafa na manatborotao jamyo, yan manatanges jamyo? Y patgon na palaoan ti matae, na mamaego.
pairs.english: When he had entered in, he said to them, "Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamofea güe. Lao güiya janafanjuyong todo, ya jacone y tata yan y nanan y patgon na palaoan, yan y mangachochongña, ya manjalom anae gaegue y patgon na palaoan.
pairs.english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, "Talitha cumi!" which means, being interpreted, "Girl, I tell you, get up!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jagosencatga sija na taya ujanatungo: ya manago na umanachocho y patgon palaoan.
pairs.english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae jumanao güije mato gui tanoña; ya y disipuluña sija madalalag güe.
pairs.english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y sábado na jaane, jatutujon mamanagüe gui sinagoga; ya megae ni jumungog güe ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Mano nae guaja este taotao este sija na güinaja? Yan jafa este na tiningo y esta manae güe? ya jaftaemano este sija na ninámanman ni mafatinas ni canaeña?
pairs.english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, "Where did this man get these things?" and, "What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti este y catpintero, lajin Maria, chelun Santiago, yan si Joses, yan si Juda, yan si Simon? Ada ti manjijita yan y mañeluña famalaoan güine? Ya maninefefende nu güiya.
pairs.english: Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren't his sisters here with us?" They were offended at him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Taya profeta sin onraña lao y tanoñaja, yan entre y parientesña sija, ya y guimaña.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña jafatinas güije jafa na námanman, na japolo y canaeña gui jilo palo manmalango sija, ya janajomlo.
pairs.english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ninámanman ni ti manmanjongguenñija; ya malilicue gui y sengsong sija mananagüe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 7 37310 ¶ Ya jaagang y dose sija, y jatutujon tumago dos en dos, ya janae ninasiñañija gui jilo manáplacha na espiritu sija;
pairs.english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ufanchenancleta; ya munga manminagago dos na magago.
pairs.english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Manoja na guma nae manjalom jamyo; fañaga güije, asta gui manjanao jamyo güije na lugat.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo sija y ti rumesibe jamyo, ni ti maninecungog jamyo, fanjanao güije, sacude y petbos ni gaegue gui papa adengmiyo para testimonio contra sija. Magajet jusangane jamyo, na mas sungunon na castigon Sodoma, yan Gomora gui jaanin y sentensia, qui ayo na sidua.
pairs.english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos jasetmon na y taotao sija ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayute juyong megae na anite sija, ya japapalae laña megae na manmalango sija, ya janafanjomlo.
pairs.english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 14 37380 ¶ Ya jajungog y ray Herodes y faman Jesus (sa afamao y naanña), ya ilegña: Si Juan Bautista cajulo guine y manmatae sija; ya pot este mangaeninasiña na chocho, esta fumatinas nu güiya.
pairs.english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, "John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo ilegñija: Si Elias. Y palo ilegñija: Profeta güe, pat uno gui profeta sija.
pairs.english: But others said, "He is Elijah." Others said, "He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Herodes, ilegña: Este si Juan ni guine judegüeya: güiya cajulo guine y manmatae sija.
pairs.english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, "This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiyaja si Herodes manago na umamantiene si Juan, ya umapreso gui catset pot si Herodias, asaguan y cheluña as Felipe, sa jacone para asaguaña.
pairs.english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, for he had married her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan ilegña as Herodes: Ti cabales na uncone y asaguan y chelumo.
pairs.english: For John said to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este si Herodias uninaguaguat contra güiya, ya jadesesao na upuno, lao ti janasiña.
pairs.english: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn't,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Herodes maañao as Juan, jatungo na tunas yan Santos na taotao ya jaguefadaje. Ya anae jajungog, gosbumuebuente gui corasonña; ya jaecungogjao ni minagofña.
pairs.english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato un jaane na si Herodes gumupot ni mafañaguña, ya mamatinas sena para y prinsipeña sija yan y capitan sija, yan y manmagas sija guiya Galilea;
pairs.english: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom y jagan Herodias, ya bumaela, ya janamagof si Herodes, yan ayo sija y mangachochongña gui lamasa; ya y ray ilegña ni patgon na palaoan: Gagaoyo ni malagomo, ya junaejao.
pairs.english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, "Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjula: Todo y ungagaoyo, junae asta lamita gui raenoco.
pairs.english: He swore to her, "Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos güe, ya ilegña as nanaña: Jafa jugagao? Si nanaña ilegña: Y ilun Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: She went out, and said to her mother, "What shall I ask?" She said, "The head of John the Baptizer."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jumalom enseguidas gui ray ya jagagao, ilegña: Malagoyo pago na unnaeyo gui un plato ni ilun Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, "I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ray ninagostriste; lao pot y juramentoña, yan ayo sija y mangachongña gui lamasa, ti malago japune.
pairs.english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn't wish to refuse her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y ray manago uno gui guatdia, jatago na ujanao ya uchinilie ni iluña. Ya mapos, ya jadegüeya gui jalom catset.
pairs.english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John's head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machule guato y iluña gui un plato, ya manae y patgon palaoan, ya y patgon palaoan janae y nanaña.
pairs.english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog ni disipuluña sija, manmato, ya machule y tataotaoña, ya mapolo gui un naftan.
pairs.english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 30 37540 ¶ Ya y apostoles mandaña gui as Jesus, ya masangane güe todo ni chechoñija, yan y finanagüenñija.
pairs.english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña su sija: Maela jamyo apatte gui un lugat desierto, ya infandescansa didide; sa megae sija manjajanao, yan manmafato, ya manaelugat mañocho.
pairs.english: He said to them, "You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile." For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos gui un batco gui un lugat desierto apatte.
pairs.english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lumie sija na manjanao megae, ya matungo güe; ya manmalalago para ayo megae manmamomocat gui siuda sija, ya manmato antes qui sija, ya mandaña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumuyong si Jesus jalie y linajyan taotao ya ninamaase nu sija, sa manparejoja yan y quinilo sija ni taya pastotñija; ya jatutujon fumanagüe megae na güinaja.
pairs.english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae estaba pupuenge, y disipuluña sija manmato guiya güiya, ilegñija: Y lugat desierto este, ya esta pupuenge.
pairs.english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, "This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najanao sija para ufanmalag y campo yan y sengsong sija gui oriya, ya ujafanmamajan pan para sija.
pairs.english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manope, ilegña nu sija: Nae sija mañija. Ya sija ilegñija nu güiya: Infanjanao ya infanmamajan pan pot dosientos na denario, para innae sija nañija?
pairs.english: But he answered them, "You give them something to eat." They asked him, "Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Cuanto na pan guaja jamyo? Janao, ya inlie. Ya anae jatungo sija, ilegñija: Sinco, yan dos na güijan.
pairs.english: He said to them, "How many loaves do you have? Go see." When they knew, they said, "Five, and two fish."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago, sija na ujanafanmatachong todos pot mangachong gui jilo y manbetde na chaguan.
pairs.english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmatachong pot mangachong, siento yan siento, yan sincuenta yan sincuenta.
pairs.english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y sinco na pan yan y dos na güijan, ya manatan julo gui langet, ya jabendise, ya jaipe y pan sija; ya janae y disipuluña sija para ujaplanta gui sanmenañija; ya y dos na güiyan manmapatte todos.
pairs.english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho todos, ya manjaspog.
pairs.english: They all ate, and were filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajatsa y pedaso sija dose na canastra manbula; yan pedaso y güijan sija locue.
pairs.english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y mañocho ni pan, sinco mit na lalaje sija.
pairs.english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 45 37690 ¶ Ya enseguidas jaapura y disipuluña sija na ufangajulo gui batco, ya ufanjanao gui menaña gui otro banda guiya Betsaida, mientras janajanao y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues, anae munjayan janajanao sija, mapos malag y egso para ufanaetae.
pairs.english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta pupuenge, y batco estaba gui talo gui tase, ya güiyaja namaesa gui tano.
pairs.english: When evening had come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie sija na manmachochocho mapot manmamómogsae, sa y manglo contrario para sija; ya jijot gui mina cuatro na guatdia gui puenge, mato güe guiya sija, mamómocat gui jilo tase; ya malago na ufalofan gui oriyañija.
pairs.english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie nu sija, na mamómocat gui jilo tase, jinasoñija na pantasma, ya managang;
pairs.english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todos lumie güe, ya ninafañatsaga. Lao enseguidas jacuentuse sija, ya ilegña nu sija: Angoco jamyo, guajoyo; chamiyo fanmaaañao.
pairs.english: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, "Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo guiya sija gui batco, ya y manglo mapos: ya sija ninafangosmanman;
pairs.english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija ti jatungo y milagron y pan sija; sa y corasonñija estaba mangosmajetog.
pairs.english: for they hadn't understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 53 37770 ¶ Ya anae manmalofan para y otro banda, manmato gui tano Genesaret, ya manmalag y puetto.
pairs.english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong sija gui batco, enseguidas matungo güe.
pairs.english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago gui oriyan todo ayo na tano, ya matutujon mañule gui todo y patte, manmalango sija gui cama, mano nae majungog na estaba güije.
pairs.english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manuja nae jumalom, songsong, pat suida, pat fangualuan, mapolo papa y malango sija gui chalan, y matayuyut güe na upacha y canton y magaguña, ya todo ayo sija y japacha, manjomlo.
pairs.english: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might touch just the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mandaña guiya güiya y Fariseo sija, yan palo gui escriba sija ni manmato guine Jerusalem,
pairs.english: Then the Pharisees, and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malie palo gui disipuluña na mañochocho pan yan áplacha na canae, ni comequeilegña na pot ti jafagase.
pairs.english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is, unwashed, hands, they found fault.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Fariseo sija, yan toda y Judio sija, jaadadaje y tradision manamco sija, yaguin megae nae ti jafagase y canaeñija, ti ufañocho.
pairs.english: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato guine y metcado, yaguin ti jafagase sija, ti ufañocho; yan megae sija na güinaja rinesibeñija para ujaadaje, parejoja yan mafagase y copa sija, yan y jara sija, yan y bason coble sija.
pairs.english: They don't eat when they come from the marketplace, unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen ni Fariseo sija yan y escriba sija: Jafa y disipulumo sija na ti manmamómocat taemano y tradision manamco sija; mañochochoja pan yan aplacha y canaeñija?
pairs.english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, "Why don't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Hipocrita jamyo; mauleg sinanganña si Isaias, ni y esta matugue: Este sija na taotao y labiosñija nae maonrayo, lao y corasonñija chago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: He answered them, "Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, 'This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taebale jaadorayo, manmamananagüe ni finanagüe ni tinago taotao sija.
pairs.english: But in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa inpelo jamyo y tinago Yuus, ya mantietiene fitme y tradision taotao sija: (ni y mafagase y jara sija, yan y copa sija, yan infatinas megae sija na güinaja parejo yan este.)
pairs.english: "For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men--the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet jamyo yumute y tinago Yuus para inadaje y tradisionmiyo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Moises ilegña: Onra si tatamo yan si nanamo; ya y mumatdise y tata pat y nana, seguro na umatae.
pairs.english: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother;' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo ilegmiyo: Yaguin y taotao ilegña ni tataña pat nanaña: Y Cotban (cumequeilegña y ninae) na jago umaprobecha pot guajo, güiya sumaga libre.
pairs.english: But you say, 'If a man tells his father or his mother, "Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban , that is to say, given to God";'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inpelo güe na ufatinas taya para si tataña pat si nanaña;
pairs.english: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inrechasa y sinangan Yuus ni ninaenmiyo na tradision; yan megae sija na güinaja finatinasmiyo parejo yan este.
pairs.english: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 14 37940 ¶ Ya jaagang talo guiya güiya todo y linajyan taotao ya ilegña: Ecungog jamyo todos, ya intingo.
pairs.english: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, "Hear me, all of you, and understand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya gui sumanjiyong gui taotao ni y janajalom, siña numataelaye, lao y janajujuyong gui jinalomña, ayo sija munatataelaye y taotao
pairs.english: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Yaguin guaja gaetalanga para ufanjungog, uecungog)
pairs.english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom gui guima, jadingo y linajyan taotao, y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe ni acomparasion.

pairs.english: He said to them, "Are you thus without understanding also? Don't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can't defile him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: because it doesn't go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods ?"

pairs.english: He said, "That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y gui jinalomña gui corason y taotao sija nae, manjujuyong y manaelaye na jinaso sija, y manadulterio, y manábale yan y manpegno,
pairs.english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
