pairs.english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo este sija na tinaelaye, manguine jalom ya janatataelaye y taotao.
pairs.english: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 24 38040 ¶ Ya cajulo güije, mapos para y oriyan Tiro yan Sidon; ya jumalom gui guima, malagoña na taya utiningo; lao ti siña unatog.
pairs.english: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn't want anyone to know it, but he couldn't escape notice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajungog masasangan güe un palaoan na y diquique na jagaña, guaja un áplacha na espiritu, mato ya jatomba güe gui adengña:
pairs.english: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan Griega, gui tano Sirofenisa, y tinayuyut güe na uyute juyong gui jagaña y anite.
pairs.english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu guiya: Polo finena ya ufanjaspog y famaguon sija; sa ti mauleg machule y pan y famaguon, ya ufanmayotte y galago sija.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to her, "Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope y palaoan, ilegña: Junggan, Señot; lao y galago sija, gui papa lamasa, jacacanoja y andesmoronan y famaguon sija.
pairs.english: But she answered him, "Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni palaoan: Pot este na sinangan, janao y anite jumanao gui jagamo.
pairs.english: He said to her, "For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumanao para iyasija, jasoda na y jagaña umaason gui jilo cama, ya y anite esta jumanao.
pairs.english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 31 38110 ¶ Ya tumalo jumanao gui oriyan Tiro yan malofan guiya Sidon, ya mato gui tasen Galilea; ya malofan gui entalo y oriyan Decapolis.
pairs.english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the region of Decapolis.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maconie güe un tanga ya udo, ya matayuyut güe na upolo y canaeña gui jiloña.
pairs.english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janasajnge güe gui linajyan taotao, ya japolo y calolotña gui talangan y tanga, ya tumola ya japacha y jilaña;
pairs.english: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatan julo y langet sumospiros, ya ilegña: Efatha, cumequeilegña, mababa!
pairs.english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, "Ephphatha!" that is, "Be opened!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mababa y talangaña; ya mapula y gumogode y jilaña, ya cumuentos mauleg.
pairs.english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija, na chañija sumangangane ni jaye; lao mientras mas jaencatga, mas manamamto;
pairs.english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafangosmanman, ilegñija: Mauleg finatinasña todo: janafanmanjungog y mananga, ya y manudo janafanguentos.
pairs.english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, "He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maase yo ni linajyan taotao sa esta tres jaane na manjame; ya taya jafa nañija.
pairs.english: "I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin junafanjanao sin mañocho para iyasija, ufanlalango gui chalan; sa palo guiya sija manmato guine y chago.
pairs.english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija, maope güe: Guine mano nae siña manafanjaspog este taotao sija pan, güine gui desierto?
pairs.english: His disciples answered him, "From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya jafaesen sija: Cuanto na pan guaja jamyo? Ylegñija, siete.
pairs.english: He asked them, "How many loaves do you have?" They said, "Seven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatago y linajyan taotao na ufanason gui jilo oda; ya jachule y siete na pan, ya janae Yuus maase ya jaipe, ya janae y disipuluña sija para ujaplanta gui menanñija; ya sija japlanta gui menan y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan guaja locue palo mandiquique na güijan sija; ya anae jabendise, jatago na ujaplanta locue gui menanñija.
pairs.english: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues mañocho, ya manjaspog; ya majatsa y pidaso sija ni sebbla, siete canastra.
pairs.english: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañocho sija, buente cuatro mit; ya jadespide.
pairs.english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas jumalom gui batco yan y disipuluña sija, ya manmato gui oriyan Dalmanuta.
pairs.english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 11 38280 ¶ Ya manmato y Fariseo sija, ya matutujon manafaesen yan güiya, manmanaliligao guiya güiya un señat guine y langet, matietienta güe.
pairs.english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumospiros gostadong gui espirituña, ya ilegña: Jafa na mangagagao señat este na generasion? Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti umanae señat este na generasion.
pairs.english: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, "Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadingo sija, ya jumalom talo gui batco, ya mapos para y otro banda.
pairs.english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 14 38310 ¶ Ya manmalefa ti manmañule pan, ya taya na unoja na pan gui batco.
pairs.english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn't have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija, ilegña: Atan, adaje jamyo ni lebaduran y Fariseo sija, yan y lebaduran Herodes.
pairs.english: He warned them, saying, "Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafaesen gui entalo sija, ilegña: Pot y taya panta.
pairs.english: They reasoned with one another, saying, "It's because we have no bread."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Jafa manafaesen gui entalomiyo pot y taya panmiyo? Ti injaso ni ti intingo? Majejetogja trabia y corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, "Why do you reason that it's because you have no bread? Don't you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja atadogmiyo, lao ti manmanlilie jamyo? Guaja talanganmiyo, ya ti manmanjujungogja jamyo? Ya ti injajasoja?
pairs.english: Having eyes, don't you see? Having ears, don't you hear? Don't you remember?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae juipe y sinco na pan sija entalo y sinco mit, cuanto na canastra injatsa bula ni pidaso sija ni sebbla? Ylegñija: Dose.
pairs.english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?" They told him, "Twelve."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y siete na pan sija entalo y cuatro mit, cuanto na canastra injatsa bula ni pidaso sija ni sebbla? Ylegñija: Siete.
pairs.english: "When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?" They told him, "Seven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Ti intingo asta pago?
pairs.english: He asked them, "Don't you understand, yet?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 22 38390 ¶ Ya mato guiya Betsaida; ya maconie güe guato un bachet, ya matayuyut güe na upacha güe.
pairs.english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jamantiene y canae y bachet, ya jacone asta y jiyong y siuda; ya anae jatolae y atadogña, japolo y canaeña gui jiloña, ya jafaesen: Unlie jafa?
pairs.english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manatan ya, ilegña: Julie taotao sija; lao julie sija calang trongconjayo na manmamómocat.
pairs.english: He looked up, and said, "I see men; for I see them like trees walking."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses japolo ya canaeña talo gui atadogña ya jaguefatan; ya jomlo, ya manlie claro todo.
pairs.english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago para iyasija, ilegña: Chamo jumajalom gui sengsong (ni usangane jaye gui siuda).
pairs.english: He sent him away to his house, saying, "Don't enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 27 38440 ¶ Ya mapos si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija gui sensong sija y Cesarean Felipe: ya y chalan jafaesen y disipuluña sija, ilegña nu sija: Jaye ilegñija y taotao sija nu guajo?
pairs.english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, "Who do men say that I am?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija masangane güe, ilegñija: Si Juan Bautista; y palo ilegñija: Si Elias; y palo ilegñija: Uno gui profeta sija.
pairs.english: They told him, "John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jafaesen sija: Ya jamyo, jaye ilegmiyo nu guajo? Inepe as Pedro ilegña: Jago si Cristo jao.
pairs.english: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "You are the Christ."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija na chañija sumangangane ni jaye pot güiya.
pairs.english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon fumanagüe sija na y Lajin taotao janesesita upadese megae, ya umarechasa ni manamco sija, yan y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno; ya ucajulo talo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya claroja nae jasangan este na sinangan. Ayo nae si Pedro quinene güe, ya tinitujon güe rineprende.
pairs.english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jabira güe, ya jaatan y disipuluña sija, jalalatde si Pedro ilegña: Suja guiya guajo, Satanas; sa ti unadadaje y güinaja sija ni para si Yuus, na y güinajan taotao sija.
pairs.english: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, "Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang y linajyan taotao yan y disipuluña sija, ya ilegña nu sija; Jaye y malago tumatiye yo, upune maesa güe, ya uchule y quiluusña ya udalalagyo.
pairs.english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, "Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y malago sumatba y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; lao y finalingaeguan ni linâlâña pot guajo, yan y ibangelio, este usatba y linâlâña.
pairs.english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, jafa uaprobecha y taotao, yaguin jagana todo y tano, ya finalingaeguan ni linâlâña?
pairs.english: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jafa na apas ufannae y taotao pot y linâlâña?
pairs.english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamajlao nu guajo yan y sinaganjo, gui sanmenan este y generasion ábale yan gaeisao, unimamajlaogüe locue ni Lajin taotao y tiempo nae mato gui minalag y Tataña, yan y mañantos na angjetña sija.
pairs.english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ilegña nu sija: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na guaja palo sija ni mangaegue güine na ti ujaguaeya finatae, asta que jalie y raenon Yuus na mato yan ninasiña.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see the Kingdom of God come with power."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 2 38570 ¶ Anae esta malofan y sais na jaane, si Jesus jacone si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan, janafañajnge sijaja gui un taquilo na ogso; ya jaago güe gui menanñija.
pairs.english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magaguña manmañila, gosapaca calang niebe, taya ni un fafagas gui tano siña munaapaca taegüine.
pairs.english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manalie na mato guiya güiya si Elias yan Moises, na manguecuentos yan si Jesus.
pairs.english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope si Pedro, ilegña as Jesus: Maestro mauleg utafañagajit güine, ya tafanmamatinas tres tabetnáculo; para jago y uno, para si Moises y otro, yan para si Elias y otro.
pairs.english: Peter answered Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si ti jatungo jafa usangan, sa estaba mangosmaañao.
pairs.english: For he didn't know what to say, for they were very afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un mapagajes y manjineme sija, ya un inagang gui mapagajes, ilegña: Este y güinaeyaco na Lajijo, jingog güe.
pairs.english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya derepente jaatan gui oriyañija, ti manmanlie ni jaye, na si Jesusja yan sija.
pairs.english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manunog sija guine y egso, jaencatga sija na chañija sumangangane ni jaye ni liniiñija, asta que y Lajin taotao esta cajulo guine entalo y manmatae.
pairs.english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jaadaje ayo na sinangan guiya sijaja, manafaesen gui entaloñija: Jafa ayo y cajulo guine entalo y manmatae cumequeilegña.
pairs.english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the "rising from the dead" meant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija: Y escriba sija ilegñija, si Elias nesesita ufato finenana.
pairs.english: They asked him, saying, "Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manope ilegña nu sija: Si Elias magajet nesesita ufato finenana, ya jafatinas talo todo y güinaja: Jafa esta matugue gui Lajin taotao na upadese megae ya manataya guaelayeña?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo na si Elias esta mato ya esta mafatinas guiya güiya todo y malagoñija, taegüine esta matugue nu güiya.
pairs.english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 14 38690 ¶ Ya anae mato gui disipuluña sija, jalie un dangculon linajyan taotao gui oriyañija, yan y escriba sija ni manafaesen yan sija.
pairs.english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas todo y linajyan taotao, anae malie güe, ninafangosmanman, ya manmalago guato guiya güiya ya masaluda güe.
pairs.english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him greeted him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen sija, ilegña! Jafana manafaesen jamyo yan sija?
pairs.english: He asked the scribes, "What are you asking them?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope uno gui linajyan taotao, ilegña: Maestro juconie jao mague na lajijo, na guaja un espiritun udo;
pairs.english: One of the multitude answered, "Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manoja nae quinene güe, japedadasos; ya bóboan, ya janachechegcheg y nifenña, ya ninayafae; ya jusangane y disipulumo sija, na ujayute juyong, lao ti manasiña.
pairs.english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe, ilegña nu sija: O generasion ni ti manjonggue! asta ngaean nae utafanjijitaja? asta ngaean nae jususungonja jamyo? maelayofan mague.
pairs.english: He answered him, "Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maconie guato guiya güiya; ya anae jalie, enseguidas y espiritu manlálaolao güe; ya güiya podong gui jilo oda gumagalileg ya bóboan.
pairs.english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen y tataña; cuanto tiempo esta desde qui mato este guiya güiya? Güiya ilegña: Desde qui diquique:
pairs.english: He asked his father, "How long has it been since this has come to him?" He said, "From childhood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na biaje nae yinite gui jalom guafe, yan y jalom janom para upinino; lao yaguin siña jao ayudajam, gaemaase nu jame.
pairs.english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus, ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin siña jao, todo siña para y manjonggue.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas y tatan y patgon, jaagang yan y lagoña, ya elegña: Jujonggue; ayuda y taejinenggueco.
pairs.english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, "I believe. Help my unbelief!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Jesus jalie na manmalalago y linajyan taotao, jalalatde y áplacha na espiritu, ilegña: Espiritun udo yan tanga, guajo jao tumago, juyong guiya güiya, ya chamo jumajalom talo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, "You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y espiritu umagang, ya manlalaolao güe megae, ya jumuyong; ya güiya sumaga calang matae, enaomina megae ilegñija, na esta matae.
pairs.english: Having cried out, and convulsed greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, "He is dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jamantiene canaeña, ya jinatsa güe; ya cajulo.
pairs.english: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom güe gui jalom guma, y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe en secreto, ilegñija: Jafajam na ti innasiña yumute juyong?
pairs.english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, "Why couldn't we cast it out?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Este na rasan anite sija, taya siña munajanao, na y tinayuyut.
pairs.english: He said to them, "This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 30 38850 ¶ Ya manmapos güije, manmalofan inanaco Galilea; ya ti malago na guaja utiningo güe.
pairs.english: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn't want anyone to know it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafanagüe y disipuluña sija ya ilegña nu sija: Y Lajin taotao umaentrega gui canae taotao sija, ya umapuno; lao yaguin este matae, ucajulo talo despues di tres na jaane.
pairs.english: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, "The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo este na sinangan, ya manmaañao na ujafaesen güe.
pairs.english: But they didn't understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 33 38880 ¶ Ya mato guiya Capernaum; ya anae mato gui guima, jafaesen sija: Jafa jamyo na manafaesen entalomiyoja gui chalan?
pairs.english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, "What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija manmamatquiquiloja; sa guine manafaesen gui chalan uno y otro, jaye guiya sija udangculo.
pairs.english: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmatachong, ya jaagang y dose ya ilegña nu sija: Y malago fuminenana, uuttimon gui tododos, yan utentagon tododos.
pairs.english: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, "If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone un patgon, ya japolo gui entaloñija; ya jajogüe gui canaeña, ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: He took a little child, and set him in their midst. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y rumesibe pot y naanjo uno ni manaegüine na famaguon, jaresibe yo, ya y rumesibe yo, ti guajo jaresibe, na y tumago yo.
pairs.english: "Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn't receive me, but him who sent me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan, ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, inlie uno na manyute juyong anite sija pot y naanmo, ya inchema, sa ti jadadalalagjit.
pairs.english: John said to him, "Teacher, we saw someone who doesn't follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña: Chamiyo chumochoma; sa ni uno ni fumatinas milagro pot y naanjo, siña gusisija jasangan taelaye guiya guajo.
pairs.english: But Jesus said, "Don't forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo y ti contra jita, manjijitaja.
pairs.english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y numae jamyo un copan janom, sa iyon Cristo jamyo, magajet jusangane jamyo, na sen ti ufalingo y apasña.
pairs.english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ's, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ninaquepodong uno guine sija gui mandiquique ni jumonggue yo; mauleg para güiya, umagode gui agagaña un acho atutong, ya umayute gui jalom tase.
pairs.english: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin y canaemo ninaquepodong jao, utut; maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâ mangco, qui uguaja dos canaemo, ya unjanao para sasalaguan, y guafe ni ti siña mapuno.
pairs.english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae; ya y guafe taejinecog nae umapuno.)
pairs.english: 'where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y adengmo ninaquepodong jao, utut: maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâ cojo, qui uguaja dos adengmo ya unyenite para sasalaguan;
pairs.english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae, ya y guafe taejinecog nae umapuno.)
pairs.english: 'where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y atadogmo ninaquepodong jao, lagnos; maulegña na unjalom gui raenon Yuus, yan un atadogja, qui uguaja dos atadogmo ya unyenite para sasalaguan.
pairs.english: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into the Kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae, ya y guafe taejinecog na umapuno.)
pairs.english: 'where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todos ufanmaasne yan guafe; (ya todo y inefrese ufanmaasne yan asiga).
pairs.english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mauleg y asiga; lao yaguin y asiga malingo y maasenña, jaftaemano numamaasen? Guaja asiganmiyo guiya jamyoja; yan guaja pas gui entalomiyo.
pairs.english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA cajulo güije, mato qui oriyan Judea, gui otro bandan Jordan; ya manalo y linajyan taotao mandaña guiya güiya; ya jatalo fumanagüe, taegüije, y costumbreña.
pairs.english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato y Fariseo sija guiya güiya, ya mafaesen güe cao tunas y laje uyute y asaguaña? matietienta güe.
pairs.english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya manope, ilegña nu sija: Jafa mantinago jamyo as Moises?
pairs.english: He answered, "What did Moses command you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Si Moises japetmite na umatugue papet inapattan umasagua ya uyute.
pairs.english: They said, "Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope, ilegña nu sija: Pot y majetog corasonmiyo na mantiniguie jamyo ni este na tinago.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to them, "For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yuus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este na rason y laje udingo si tataña yan si nanaña, ya udaña yan y asaguaña.
pairs.english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y este y dos, umana unoja na catne; ya esta ti udos mas, na unoja na catne.
pairs.english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja si Yuus munadaña, y taotao ti unadesapatta.
pairs.english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jalom guma, y disipulo sija mafaesen güe talo ni ayoja.
pairs.english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jayeja y yumute y asaguaña, ya umasagua yan otro, jafatinas y adulterio contra y palaoan.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y palaoan yumute y asaguaña, ya umasagua yan otro, jafatinas adulterio.
pairs.english: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 13 39180 ¶ Ya machulie guato guiya güiya diquique na famaguon para upacha: ya y disipulo sija jalalatde ayo sija.
pairs.english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus, sen ti ninamagof ya ilegña nu sija: Polo y diquique na famaguon ya ufanmamaela guiya guajo; chamiyo chumochoma; sa iyon este sija y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, "Allow the little children to come to me! Don't forbid them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na y ti rumesibe y raenon Yuus calang un patgon, ti ujalom gui jalom ayo.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
