pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo: Jayeja y umalog ni este y egso, janao ya unyutejao gui tase; ya ti bumuebuente gui corasonña, lao jajonggue na umafatinas ayo y sinanganña; uguaja.
pairs.english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' and doesn't doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jusangane jamyo: Na todo sija ingagao, anae manmanaetae jamyo, jenggue na esta inresibe, ya infanmannae.
pairs.english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya an manojgue ya mananaetaejamyo, asie yanguin guajajao jafa contra jaye; sa y Tatanmiyo locue ni y gaegue gui langet, uninasie ni y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin ti manasiijamyo, y Tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet ti uninasie ni y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 39840 ¶ Ya manmato talo Jerusalem, ya anae mamomocat gui templo, manmato y magas mamale, yan y escriba, yan y manamco sija;
pairs.english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders came to him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Pot jafa na ninasiña na unfatitinas estesija? yan jayejao numae ni este na ninasiña, para unfatinas estesija?
pairs.english: and they began saying to him, "By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Bae jufaesen locue jamyo un finaesen ya inepeyo, ayonae jusangane jamyo pot jafa na ninasiña na jufatitinas este sija.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinagpangen Juan, guinen y langet, pat guinen y taotao sija? epeyo.
pairs.english: The baptism of John--was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajajaso gui sumanjalomñija, ilegñija: Yanguin ilegmame, Guinen y langet; ualog: Jafanae na ti injenggue güe?
pairs.english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, "If we should say, 'From heaven;' he will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ilegmame guinen y taotao sija--manmaañao ni y taotao, sa pineloñija todo na magajet na profeta si Juan.
pairs.english: If we should say, 'From men'"--they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanope, ilegñija as Jesus: Ti intingo. Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu sija; ni guajo locue ti jusangane jamyo pot jafa naninasiña, na jufatitinas estesija.
pairs.english: They answered Jesus, "We don't know." Jesus said to them, "Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA sigue di jacuentuse sija acomparasion sija. Un taotao mananom gui fangualuan ubas, ya jacolat nu trongcon tituca, ya manguadog un joyo para un lagat ya jafatinas un tore, ya jaatquila y manfafachocho, ya mapos güe malag otro tano.
pairs.english: He began to speak to them in parables. "A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the winepress, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta tiempo, jatago uno gui tentagoña para ayo y manmachochocho, para ujaresibe guinen manmachochocho y tinegcha y fangualuan ubas.
pairs.english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone y tentago, ya masaulag, ya manajanao taesinajguan.
pairs.english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago talo y otro tentagoña; ya mapoca y iluña, ya manataelaye güe gosdangculo.
pairs.english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatalo tumago y otro, ya mapuno; yan otro megae ya palo manmasaulag yan palo manmapuno.
pairs.english: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja unoja lajiña na sumenyaña; ya güiya uttimo jatago, ilegña: Ufangaerespeto ni y lajijo.
pairs.english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y manmachochocho, ilegñija gui sumanjalomñija. Estagüe y eredero; nije tapuno, ya y fangualuan uiyota.
pairs.english: But those farmers said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone güe, ya mapuno, ya mayute juyong gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa pago ufatinas y magas y fangualuan? Ufato, ya uyulang todo y manmachochocho, ya ufannae otro ni y fangualuan.
pairs.english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya nae intaetae este na tinigue: Y acho, ni y jarechasa y manmanmatitinas ni y guima, esteja mapolo cuentan ulo gui esquina.
pairs.english: Haven't you even read this Scripture: 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este finatinas y Señot, ya janafanmanman gui menan atadogta.
pairs.english: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes'?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maaliligao para umagote lao manmaañao ni y linajyan taotao; sa matungo na jasasangan y acomparasion contra sija: ya madingo, ya manmapos gui jinanaoñija.
pairs.english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 13 40030 ¶ Ya manmatago guato guiya güiya palo gui Fariseo sija yan taotao Herodes; para umaquegacha gui sinanganña.
pairs.english: They sent some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato, ilegñija nu güiya: Maestro, intingo na jago magajetjao; ya taya unadadaje ni un taotao; sa ti guaelaye nu jago y finaboresen taotao, lao mamananagüejao ni y magajet na chalan Yuus. Tunas na infanmanaejam tributo as Sesat, pat aje?
pairs.english: When they had come, they asked him, "Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Innae, pat mungajam numae? Lao si Jesus jatungoja y quinadoñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa muna na intietientayo? maela un denarion salape ya julie.
pairs.english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?" But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, "Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae machulie guato, ilegña nu sija: Iyon jaye este na imagen yan tinigue? Ylegñija nu güiya: Iyon Sesat.
pairs.english: They brought it. He said to them, "Whose is this image and inscription?" They said to him, "Caesar's."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Nae si Sesat ni y iyon Sesat, ya si Yuus ni y iyon Yuus. Ya ninafangosmanman nu güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's." They marveled greatly at him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 18 40080 ¶ Ya manmato guiya güiya y Saduseo sija ni y ilegñija, na taya quinajulo y mannatae; ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija:
pairs.english: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maestro, jatuguiejam si Moises: Yanguin y chelun un taotao matae, ya y palaoan ni y asaguaña sumaga ya taya patgonña, ayo y laje ni y chelun y matae, uasagua talo y palaoan, ya ufamasemiya gui cheluña.
pairs.english: "Teacher, Moses wrote to us, 'If a man's brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja seite lalaje na mañelu: y finenana umasagua, ya matae ti mapolo semiya:
pairs.english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inasagua talo y palaoan ni y mina dos, ya matae talo taya pineloña semiya: ya y mina tres taegüijeja talo.
pairs.english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y siete, ti mapolo semiyañijo; despues di todos, matae y palaoan locue.
pairs.english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y quinajulo y manmatae, jaye guiya sija ugae asagua y palaoan? sa todo y siete manmasagua.
pairs.english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Ada ti manlache jamyo, sa ti intingo y tinigue, ni y ninasiñan Yuus?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Isn't this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mangajulo guinen manmatae, ni ufanasagua, ni umanafanasagua; lao manparejoja yan y angjet sija gui langet.
pairs.english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmatae ni y ufannacajulo; ti untaetae gui leblon Moises, jaftaemano si Yuus gui jalomtano guiya trongcon jayo ni y ilegña as Moises: Guajo si Yuus Abraham, yan si Yuus Ysaac, yan si Yuus Jacob?
pairs.english: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven't you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob' ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti güiya si Yuus y manmatae, na si Yuus y manlâlâlâ; enaomina ninafangoslache jamyo.
pairs.english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 28 40180 ¶ Ya uno gui escriba mato, ya jajungog na manafaesen entresija, ya jatungo na mauleg inepeña nu sija, finaesen güe: Jafa y finenana qui todo na tinago?
pairs.english: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, "Which commandment is the greatest of all?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope: Este y finenana na tinago: Jingog O Israel: Y Señot Yuusta, unoja na Señot:
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "The greatest is, 'Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaeya jamyo y Señot, Yuusmiyo, contodo y corasonmiyo, yan contodo y antenmiyo, yan contodo y jinasonmiyo, yan contodo y minetgotmiyo.
pairs.english: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y segundo: Guaeya y tiguangmo parejo yan jago. Taya otro tinago mas, mandangculo qui estesija.
pairs.english: The second is like this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba ilegña nu güiya. Magajet Maestro, mauleg na unsangan na güiya unoja; ya taya otro na güiyaja.
pairs.english: The scribe said to him, "Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ugumaeya güe contodo y corason, yan contodo y tiningo, yan contodo y minetgot, yan ugumaeya y tiguangña parejo yan güiya, mas qui todo y inefrese, yan y ninae sija.
pairs.english: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus ni y minejnalom inepeña, ilegña nu güiya: Ti chagojao gui raenon Yuus. Ya taya ni un taotao fumaesen güe talo desde ayo.
pairs.english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the Kingdom of God." No one dared ask him any question after that.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 35 40250 ¶ Ya maninepe as Jesus gui anae mamananagüe gui templo, ilegña: Jafa na ilegñija y escriba sija, na si Cristo Lajin David?
pairs.english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, "How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David mismo ilegña gui Espiritu Santo: Y Señot ilegña ni y Señotto: Fatachong gui agapa na canaejo, asta qui jupolo y enemigumo sija gui papa y fañajangan adengmo.
pairs.english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet."'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 37 40270 ¶ David jafanaan güe Señot; ya jaftaemano na y lajiña? Ya manmagof y dangculon linajyan taotao sija anae majungog.
pairs.english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?" The common people heard him gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 38 40280 ¶ Ya ilegña gui finanagüeña: Adaje jamyo ni y escriba sija, sa yanñija manjanao yan y anaco magagoñija, yan yanñija manmasaluda gui metcado,
pairs.english: In his teaching he said to them, "Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y manmagas na tachong gui sinagoga, yan y ya jululo na tachong gui guipot;
pairs.english: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jatucho y guima y biuda sija, ya janafananaco tinaetaeñija ni y dinague: este sija ujaresibe dangculo na sentensia.
pairs.english: those who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 41 40310 ¶ Ya anae matachong si Jesus gui menan y cajon ni y para y ninae; megae na taotao manmato, ya manmanyute jalom salape gui cajon; ya y megae na manrico sija, megae yiniteñija jalom.
pairs.english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un pobble na buida; ya manyute jalom dos cobble na bale buente un centavos.
pairs.english: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jaagang y disipuluña, ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Este y pebble na biuda, mas megae yiniteña jalom qui ni todo ayo sija y guinen manmanyute jalom gui cajon.
pairs.english: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y manmanyute jalom, pot y minegaeñijaja; lao güiya pot y minalagoñaja na jayute jalom todo y güinajaña; asta y sustentoña todo.
pairs.english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae jumuyong gui templo; ilegña nu güiya uno gui disipuluña: Maestro, liija na jechuran acho, yan guma sija.
pairs.english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Unlie este sija na mandangculon guma? taya usobbla ni un acho gui jilo y otro, na ti umayute papa.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 3 40370 ¶ Ya anae matachong gui jilo y finabeca na y naanña Olibo, gui menan y templo, finaesen gui secreto as Pedro, yan Santiago, yan si Juan, yan si Andres,
pairs.english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Sanganejam, ngaean estesija ufanmato? yan jafa na señat yanguin para todo estesija nae ufanmacumple?
pairs.english: "Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jatutujon ilegña nu sija: Adaje jamyo, ya chamiyo fanmafabababa.
pairs.english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ualog: Guajo güiya Jesucristo, ya ufababa megae.
pairs.english: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he! ' and will lead many astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin injingog y guera, yan y masangan y guera: chamiyo ninafañachatsaga: sa nesesita estesija jumuyong: lao trabia ti y jinecog.
pairs.english: "When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y nasion sija ufangajulo contra y nasion, yan y raeno contra raeno: ya uguaja linao gui megae na lugat ya uguaja ñinalang: estesija tutujon y pinite.
pairs.english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 9 40430 ¶ Lao adaje jamyo: sa infanmaentrega gui tribunal sija; ya infanmasaulag gui sinagoga: yan infanojgue gui menan y manmagas sija yan y ray sija, pot causa de guajo para un testimonio contra sija.
pairs.english: But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ibangelio nesesita umapredica finenana gui entre todo y nasion.
pairs.english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae maconejamyo, ya maentregajamyo, chamiyo jumajaso jafa para insangan, ni injasuye jafa: sa jafaja y manaejamyo güije na ora, ayoja insangan: sa ti jamyo infangcuentos, na y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don't be anxious beforehand, or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago y laje uentrega y cheluña laje, para umapuno; ya y tata y lajiña: ya y famaguon ufangajulo contra y mañaenanñija: ya uuafanmapuno.
pairs.english: "Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo infanmachatlie ni todo y taotao sija, pot y naanjo: lao jaye y sumungon asta y uttimo, umasatba.
pairs.english: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae inlie y chinatlie y inginon na yinilang tumotojgue gui anae ti para utojgue, (y mananaetae utungo) ayo sija y mangaegue guiya Judea ufanmalago para y jalomtano:
pairs.english: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui jilo guma, chaña tumutunog ni ujalom ya ufañule jafa na güinaja gui jalom gumaña.
pairs.english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui fangualuan, chaña tumatalo tate para uchule y magaguña.
pairs.english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mannamaase ayo sija y manmapotgue yan y mannanasusu, güije sija na jaane!
pairs.english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jinanaomiyo sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Pray that your flight won't be in the winter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo sija na jaane, uguaja pininite, ni y taya nae guaja desde y matutujon y tano, anae jafatinas si Yuus, asta pago; ni uguaja asta jinecog.
pairs.english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ti janacadada y Señot ayo sija na jaane, taya catne usatba: lao pot y rason y manmaayigja, ni y inayigña, janacadada ayo sija na jaane.
pairs.english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin guaja umalog nu jago: Estagüe si Cristo: pat ayogüe guato; chamiyo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there!' don't believe it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo sija ti manmagajet na Cristo sija, yan ti manmagajet na profeta sija, ya ufanmamanue sija señat yan mannamanman, para ufanmamababa, yanguin janasiña, asta y manmaayig.
pairs.english: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao adaje jamyo: Sa estagüeja, na jusangane jamyo todos antes.
pairs.english: But you watch. "Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 24 40580 ¶ Lao ayo sija na jaane an munjayan y pininite sija; ujomjom y atdao, ya y pilan ti ufanina,
pairs.english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pution sija gui langet ufamodong, ya y ninasifia sija gui langet ufanmayengyong.
pairs.english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo nae ujalie y Lajin taotao na mamamaela gui sanjalom mapagajes, yan y dangculon ninasiñaña yan y minalagña.
pairs.english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae utago y angjetña sija na ujarecoje y inayigña sija, guinen y cuatro na manglo, guinen y uttimon y tano asta y uttimon y langet.
pairs.english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 28 40620 ¶ Tingo y acomparasion y trongcon igos; Anae mamaulegja trabia y ramasña, ya manjajagonja, intingoja na esta jijijot y tiempon maepe.
pairs.english: "Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and puts forth its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue anae inlie estesija, na manmato, tingoja na güiya esta jijijot, parejoja yan esta gaegue gui petta.
pairs.english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Este na generasion ti ufanmalofan, asta que todo estesija munjayan manmachogüe.
pairs.english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet yan y tano, ufanmalofan, lao y sinanganjo ti ufalofan.
pairs.english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na jaane pat ayo na ora, taya ni un taotao tumungo; ni y angjet sija ni mangaegue gui langet, ni y Laje; na y Tata güiyaja.
pairs.english: But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo: fanbela, ya infanmanaetae: sa ti intingo ngaean y tiempo.
pairs.english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don't know when the time is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Say y Lajin taotao, parejoja yan un taotao ni y jumajanao chago ya jadingo y gumaña; ya janae y tentagoña ninasiñañija yan cada uno y chechoña, ya jatago y pottero na ufanbela.
pairs.english: "It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanbela, sa ti intingo ngaean nae ufato y magas y guima; cao y pupuenge, pat y tatalopuenge, pat y oogayo, pat y egaan;
pairs.english: Watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na, noseaja derepente ufato, ya infansineda manmamaego.
pairs.english: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa y jusangane jamyo, jusanganeja todos: Fanbela.
pairs.english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJA dos na jaane antes di guipot y pascua yan y taelibadura na pan: ya y magas mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, maaliligao jaftaemano para umafababa, ya umacone, ya umapuno.
pairs.english: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegñija: Munga gui guipot na jaane, sa noseaja uguaja atboroto ni y taotao sija.
pairs.english: For they said, "Not during the feast, because there might be a riot of the people."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 3 40740 ¶ Ya anae estaba guiya Betania, gui guima Simon y ategtog, ya matachong gui lamasa para uchocho; mato un palaoan mañuñule un alabastro na boteyan inggüenten puro nardo, na gosguaguan; ya mafag y boteya, ya jachuda gui jilo y ilon Jesus.
pairs.english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard--very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja sija ninafanbubo sanjalomñija, ya ilegñija: Jafa este na inggüente na manalalastimaja?
pairs.english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, "Why has this ointment been wasted?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maulegña umabende pot tresientos peseta, ya ufanmanae y mamobble: ya malalatde y palaoan.
pairs.english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor." They grumbled against her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña: Pologüe namaesa. Jafaja na inatbororota güe? Mauleg finatinasña nu guajo.
pairs.english: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manjajamyoja yan y mamobble siempre; ya ngaeanja nae manmalago jamyo, infatinasja mauleg guiya sija: lao guajo ti tafanjijitaja siempre.
pairs.english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jafatinas taemanoja y ninasiñaña: güiya mato antes, para uinggüentiye y tataotaojo, para y naftan.
pairs.english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Manoja este na ebangelio nae mapredica, gui todo y tano, este locue y finatinasña umasangan, para memoriasña.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 10 40810 ¶ Ya si Judas Iscariote, uno gui dose, mapos malag y magas mamale, para umentrega güe guiya sija.
pairs.english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog, ninafansenmagof, ya mapromete manae güe salape. Ya jaaliligao jaftaemano para uinentrega.
pairs.english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 12 40830 ¶ Ya y finenana na jaane y taelibadura na pan, anae maofrese y pascua, y disipuluña ilegñija nu güiya; Manojam malagomo guato ya infamauleg nae para unchocho gui pascua?
pairs.english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y dos gui disipuluña, ya ilegña nu sija: Janao fanmalag y siuda, sa infanasoda güije yan un taotao na mangangatga un jarran janom: dalalag güe.
pairs.english: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, "Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya amanoja nae jumalom, alog ni y taotao guma: Y Maestro, ilegña: Mangue y aposento ni y anae para infañocho gui pascua yan y disipulujo?
pairs.english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says, "Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya infanfinanue un dangculo na cuatto; esta mafamauleg yan listo; ayo nae famauleg para jita.
pairs.english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija manmapos, ya manmato gui siuda, ya jasoda jaftaemano y mansinangane sija: ya mafamauleg para y pascua.
pairs.english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 17 40880 ¶ Ya y pupuenge mato yan y dose.
pairs.english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatatachong ya mañochocho, si Jesus ilegña: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Uno guiya jamyo umentregayo; güiyaja uchumocho yan guajo.
pairs.english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, "Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me--he who eats with me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ninafangostriste, ya ilegñija nu güiya uno yan otro: Guajo? y otro ilegña: Guajo?
pairs.english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, "Surely not I?" And another said, "Surely not I?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope ilegña nu sija: Uno gui dose ni y jumajame manotche gui tason.
pairs.english: He answered them, "It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Lajin taotao magajet na mapos, ni y esta matugue pot güiya: lao namaase ayo na taotao ni y jaentrega y Lajin taotao. Maulegña ayo na taotao na ti umafañago.
pairs.english: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 22 40930 ¶ Ya anae mañochocho, jachule si Jesus y pan, ya jabendise, ya jaipe, ya janae sija, ilegña: Chile ya incano, sa este y tataotaojo.
pairs.english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, "Take, eat. This is my body."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y posuelo, ya anae munjayan janae grasia, janae sija: ya todos manguimen.
pairs.english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Este y jâgâjo, gui nuebo na testamento, ni machuda pot y megae.
pairs.english: He said to them, "This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti juguimen talo ni y tinegcha ubas, asta ayo na jaane, na juguimen nuebo gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan macanta un himno, manmapos manmalag y finabeca Olibo.
pairs.english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 27 40980 ¶ Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Todos jamyo infaninefende pot guajo; sa esta matugue: Bae jupanag y pastot, ya y quinilo sija ufanmachalapon.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao despues di lâlâyo talo, ya cumajuloyo, jujanao esta y menanmiyo guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Jesus.
pairs.english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone guato gui un lugat na y naanña Golgota: cumequeilegña, Sagan calabera.
pairs.english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, "The place of a skull."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manae guimenña, bino manadaña yan mira, lao ti jaresibe.
pairs.english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maatane güe gui quiluus, manafacae ni magaguña; ya manrifa jaye uchinile cada uno.
pairs.english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina tres na ora, anae maatane güe gui quiluus.
pairs.english: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tinigue y fumaaelagüe, matugue gui sanjilo. Y RAY JUDIOS.
pairs.english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, "THE KING OF THE JEWS."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maatane dos na saque yan güiya: y uno gui agapaña, ya y otro gui acagüeña.
pairs.english: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya macumple y tinigue ni y ilegña: Güiya, usaouao matufong yan y manisao.)
pairs.english: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, "He was numbered with transgressors."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macacase todo ni y manmalolofan, ya jayeyengyong y ilonñija, ya ilegñija: Ay! jago ni y unyulang y templo, ya unjatsa talo gui mina tres na jaane;
pairs.english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, "Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Satba maesajao, ya maela tunog papa güenao gui quiluus.
pairs.english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue y magas mamale, manmanbotlelea gui entaloñija, ya ilegñija yan y escriba sija: Jasatba y palo, ya güiya na maesa ti siña güe jasatba.
pairs.english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, "He saved others. He can't save himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Cristo y Ray Israel, polo ya utunog pago gui quiluus, para utafanlie, ya utafanjonggue güe. Yan ayo y mangachochongña manmaatane gui quiluus madespresia güe.
pairs.english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him. " Those who were crucified with him insulted him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 33 41760 ¶ Ya anae mato y mina saes na ora, jomjom todo y tano asta y mina nuebe na ora.
pairs.english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina nuebe na ora, janagosagang si Jesus ilegña: Eli, Eli, lama sabactani? cumequeilegña: Yuusso, Yuusso, jafa muna undingoyo?
pairs.english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" which is, being interpreted, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manotojgue gui oriyaña, anae majungog güe, ilegñija: Estagüe na jaaagang si Elias.
pairs.english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, "Behold, he is calling Elijah."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago uno, ya jasupog y espongja gui binagle, ya japolo gui puntan y piao, ya janae para uguimen, ya ilegña: Poloja güe namaesa; ya utafanlie cao ufato si Elias, ya uninatunog.
pairs.english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, "Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus umagang goságang, ya jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y cottinan y templo, masisen dos pedaso, y sanjilo asta y sanpapa.
pairs.english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y senturion ni y tumotojgue gui menaña, linie, na taegüenao jaentrega y espiritu, ilegña: Magajet na este na taotao Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, "Truly this man was the Son of God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue locue sija famalaoan, na maaatan gui chago, ya entre sija estaba si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago y patgon, yan si José, yan si Salome;
pairs.english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae estaba güe guiya Galilea, madalalag güe, ya masetbe güe; yan megae sija na famalaoan mangachochongña julo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 42 41850 ¶ Ya anae estaba pupuenge, sa ayo na jaane y Preparasion, cumequeilegña y jaane antes di y sábado,
pairs.english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si José, taotao Arimatea, mauleg na taotao na pápagat, ni y jananangga locue y raenon Yuus; ya mapos yan atrebe malag as Pilato, ya jagagao y tataotao Jesus.
pairs.english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninamanman si Pilato, cao esta matae; ya jaagang y senturion, ya jafaesen cao esta matae algun tiempo.
pairs.english: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo gui senturion; janae si José ni y tataotao.
pairs.english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: tataotaoña sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan José, jalie amano nae mapolo.
pairs.english: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae esta malofan y sabado, si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago, yan si Salome, manmamajan paopao, para ufato ya umapalalae güe.
pairs.english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taftataf gui egaan, gui finenana na jaane gui semana, manmato gui naftan gui quinajulo y atdao.
pairs.english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija entre sija: Jaye uninagalileg y acho gui pettan y naftan?
pairs.english: They were saying among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maaatan, malie na esta managalileg y acho, sa gosdangculo.
pairs.english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjalom gui naftan, malie un patgon na taotao, na matatachong gui agapa na banda, minagagon apaca na anaco; ya ninafangosmaañao.
pairs.english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao: inaliligao si Jesus Nasareno, ni y maatane gui quiluus: esta cajulo; taegüe güine; liija y lugat anae mapopolo güe.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janao infanjanao, ya insangane y disipuluña, yan si Pedro: Güiya jumanao gui menanmiyo guiya Galilea; ayo nae inlie güe, ni y guinin mansinangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos juyong, ya manmalago gui naftan, sa jumuyong manlalaolao yan manmanman; ya ti ufanmanangane jafa ni y taotao; sa mangosmanmaañao.
pairs.english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 9 41990 ¶ Lao anae cajulo si Jesus, taftataf gui egaan gui finenana na jaane gui semana, umalie finena, yan Maria Magdalena, ni y guinin janajuyong siete na anite.
pairs.english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos güe, ya jasangane ayo y guinin mangachochongña, ni y mantriste, yan manatanges.
pairs.english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija, anae jajungog na esta lâlâ ya umalie yan Mana, ti majonggue.
pairs.english: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmalofan estesija, manmalie talo yan dos, lao otro jechuraña; gui anae manjajanao gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos, ya manmasangane y palo disipulo: lao ti majonggue.
pairs.english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 14 42040 ¶ Despues di ayo, manmalie yan y onse gui anae mañochocho, ya jalalatde ni y ti manjengguenñija, yan y majetog corasonñija, sa ti majonggue ayo sija y lumie güe despues di cumajulo.
pairs.english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn't believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija; Janao fanmalag todo y tano, ya predica y ibangelio todo y ninajuyong sija.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y manjonggue ya matagpange, usatba; lao ayo y ti manjonggue; umasentensia.
pairs.english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este sija na señat ufantinattitiye ayo sija y manmanjonggue: Pot y naanjo ujayute juyong y anite sija; ufanguentos ni y nuebo na finijo;
pairs.english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmangajat culebla sija, ya, yanguin manguimen jafa na beneno; ti uninafanlamen: ya ujapolo y canaeñija gui manmalango sija, ya ujanafanjomlo.
pairs.english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 19 42090 ¶ Enao y Señot, despues di mansinangane sija, rinisibe ni y langet, ya matachong gui agapa Yuus.
pairs.english: So then the Lord , after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos, ya mapredica y sinangan gui todo y lugat, mañisija manmachocho yan y Señot, ya manafitme y sinangan ni y umatitiye na señat. Amen.
pairs.english: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: POT y guaja megae y umapolo y canaeñija para ufannaregla y cuentos nu y ayo na güinaja na esta guefmaasegura gui entalo jame,
pairs.english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja ninaejam ni guine y tutujoña y testigojam ni y malie, nu y yan y ministrojam y sinangan;
pairs.english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinasoco mauleg locue nu guajo, sa juguefegaga sinengcabales todo y güinaja guine y tutujonña, na jutuguie jao pot y inaregla, jago guesmagas na Teofilo;
pairs.english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para untungo sija y magajet ayosija mano nae unresibe y finanagüe.
pairs.english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 5 42150 ¶ Guaja gui jaanin Herodes, ray guiya Judea, un pale, naanña si Sacharias, y clasen Abias; y asaguaña guinin sija jagan Aaron ya y naaña si Elisabet.
pairs.english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na dos mauleg gui sanmenan Yuus, jajananao gui todo y lay yan y tinago Señot, ti lalatdiyon.
pairs.english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya patgonñija; sa si Elisabet tifáfañago; yan y dos megae jaaniñija.
pairs.english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 8 42180 ¶ Ya jumuyong, anae mañeñetbe si Sacharias, gui ofisio y pale gui menan Yuus, gui chechon y clasiña,
pairs.english: Now it happened, while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his division,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y costumbren y ofisio y pale, y chechoña na jumalom gui guimayuus ya jasonggue y paopao.
pairs.english: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y linajyan taotao mangaegue gui sanjiyong manmananaetae gui oran paopao.
pairs.english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya y angjet y Señot, na gaegue gui agapa y attat y paopao.
pairs.english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inestotba si Sacharias anae jalie, ya mato minaañao gui jiloña.
pairs.english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Sacharias, chamo maaañao; sa y tinaetaemo este majungog; ya y asaguamo as Elisabet ufañago y patgon laje, ya umafanaan naanña si Juan.
pairs.english: But the angel said to him, "Don't be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uguaja jao minagof yan alegria; ya y megae umagof nu y mafañaguña.
pairs.english: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa udangculo güe gui menan Señot; ya ti uguimen bino ni metgot na guinem ya ubulagüe Espiritu Santo, guinin y tiyan nanaña.
pairs.english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae gui famaguon Israel, ujabira nu y Señot, Yuusñija.
pairs.english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: YA si Jesus, bula Espirita Santo, tumato guato gui Jordan, ya quinene ni Espiritu asta y desierto.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije cuarenta na jaane ya tinienta nu y anite. Ya ti chumocho ni jafa, güije sija na jaane; ya anae esta macumple, ñalang güe.
pairs.english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya y anite: Yaguin jago Lajin Yuus, tago este y acho ya ufamapan.
pairs.english: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope qüe: Esta mamatugue, na ti y panja munalâlâ y taotao.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone güe quinene julo, ya finanue güe todo y raeno gui jilo y tano gui un momento y tiempo,
pairs.english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y anite ilegña nu güiya: Bae junae jao ni este na ninasiña todo, yan y minalagñija; sa guajo maentrega, ya jaye y malagojo, junae.
pairs.english: The devil said to him, "I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jago, yaguin unadora gui menajo, todosija iyomo.
pairs.english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ya ilegña: Esta matugue na y Señot Yuusmo unadora, ya güiyaja unsetbe.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Get behind me Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta matugue, na y angjetña sija jaencatga nu jago para unmaadaje,
pairs.english: for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y canaeñija unquilile sa chamo matompo y adengmo gui acho.
pairs.english: and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña: Esta masangan: Chamo tietienta y Señot Yuusmo.
pairs.english: Jesus answering, said to him, "It has been said, 'You shall not tempt the Lord your God.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta munjayan todo y tentasionña y anite mapos guiya güiya un rato.

pairs.english: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

pairs.english: He said to them, "Doubtless you will tell me this parable, 'Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ninafanmanman nu y finanagüeña; sa y sinanganña gaeninasiña.
pairs.english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Jei! pelojam! para jafajam nu jago, Jesus Nasareno? Matojao para unyulangjam? jutungojao jayejao; jago ayo na Santos gui as Yuus!
pairs.english: saying, "Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jalalatde ya ilegña: Pacaca ya maela juyong guiya güiya. Ya anae y anite mayute güe gui entaloñija, jumuyong guiya güiya; ya taya ninalamen.
