pairs.english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silent, and come out of him!" When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya minamanman mato gui jilo todo sija, ya manadingan uno yan otro, ilegñija: Jafa na cuentos este? Sa nu y gobietnaña yan y ninasiñaña jatago y áplacha na anite sija ya unfanjuyong?
pairs.english: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, "What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y famaña masanganñaejon todo y lugat sija gui oriyaña ayona.
pairs.english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 38 44180 ¶ Ya jacajulo jumanao juyong gui guimayuus ya jumalom gui guiman Simon; ya y suegran Simon esta umaason, malingo nu y dangculo na calenturaña; ya matayuyutgüe pot güiya.
pairs.english: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatojgue gui jijutña, ya jalalatde y calentura ya y calentura pinelo; ya güiya cajulo ensiguidas ya jasetbe.
pairs.english: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 40 44200 ¶ Ya y tiempo y minachom y atdao nae, todo y mangaemalango ni y megae na chetnot, manmaconie guiya güiya; ya japolo y canaeña gui jilo cada uno guiya sija, ya janafanjomlo sija.
pairs.english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anite sija manjuyong locue guiya megae, na manaagang ya ilegñija: Jago, y Lajin Yuus! Lao güiya jalalatde ya ti japolo ya ufanguentos, sa matungo güe na güiya si Cristo.
pairs.english: Demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, "You are the Christ, the Son of God!" Rebuking them, he didn't allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 42 44220 ¶ Ya anae esta taftaf y jaane, jumanao para un jalomtano: ya y linajyan taotao sija maaliligao güe ya manmafato guiya güiya ya manmalago sija ufanmantiene güe para munga mapos guiya sija.
pairs.english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn't go away from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Nesesitayo locue gui palo siuda umapredica y raenon Yuus: sa para este na matagoyo.
pairs.english: But he said to them, "I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japredidica gui guimayuus sija guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede anae y linajyan taotao manoriya yan machichiguet güe ya jaecungog y sinangan Yuus, na güiya gaegue tumotojgue gui oriyan jagoe Genesaret.
pairs.english: Now it happened, while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie dos batco na estaba jijot gui oriyan y jagoe; ya y manpescadot manunog güije, ya jafagase y laguañija.
pairs.english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom güine gui un batco ya y iyon Simon; ya jagagao na unafalag y tano didide. Ya matachong ya mamanagüe desde y batco ni linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan cumuentos, ilegña as Simon: Juyong gui tadong na tase ya innatunog y laguanmiyo para un quinene.
pairs.english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Simon ya ilegña: Maestro estajam manmachocho todo puenge ya taya quinenemame; lao pot y sinanganmo bae innatunog y lagua.
pairs.english: Simon answered him, "Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatinas este, japongle un dangculo na quinenen güijan; ya esta tiniteg y laguanñija.
pairs.english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jaseñat y mangachongñija ni mangaegue gui otro batco, para ufanmato ya ufaninayuda. Ya manmato, ya janabulaja y dos batco, ya jatutujon manmañoñogñog.
pairs.english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie este si Simon Pedro, dumimo papa gui as Jesus ya ilegña: Suja guiya guajo, Señot; sa taotao isaoyo.
pairs.english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ninamaañao yan todos y mangaegue guiya güiya, pot causa de y quinenen güijan ni y inquene;
pairs.english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije ja locue as Santiago yan si Juan, famaguon Sebedeo, ya sija mangachong Simon. Ya ilegña si Jesus as Simon: Chamo maaaño: sa desde pago ufangone jao y taotao.
pairs.english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, "Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta mañule gui tano y batcoñija; todo jayute ya madalaggüe.
pairs.english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 12 44360 ¶ Ya susede anae gaegue güe gui uno gui siuda sija, estagüe un taotao na bula ategtog: güiya anae jalie si Jesus, podong gui mataña gui menaña ya jagagao, ilegña: Señot, yaguin malagojao, siñajao unnagasgasyo?
pairs.english: It happened, while he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, "Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaestira y canaeña ya japacha, ilegña: Malagoyo, gasgasjao; ya enseguidas y ategtog jumanao guiya güiya.
pairs.english: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, "I want to. Be made clean." Immediately the leprosy left him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinago güe, na chaña sangangane ni jaye: lao janao, unfanue y pale nu jago ya unofrese ni y guinasgasmo, taemanoja y tinagon Moises para testimonio nu sija.
pairs.english: He commanded him to tell no one, "But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y masanganña jumanao megae; ya mandaña y dangculon linajyan taotao para umajungog yan para ufanmagong y chetnotñija.
pairs.english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jaapatta güe asta y jalomtano ya manaetae.
pairs.english: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 17 44410 ¶ Ya susede gui un jaane na estabagüe mamanagüe; ya mangaegue y Fariseo sija yan y magas y lay, manmatatachong, sa sija manmato guinen y sengsong Galilea, yan Judea, yan y ya Jerusalem; ya y ninasiñan y Señot gaegue güije para unamagong.
pairs.english: It happened on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe sija taotao na macocone un taotao gui jilo un cama na paralitico; ya maaliligao mano nae mañule jalom para umapolo gui menaña.
pairs.english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti masoda mano nae umapolo pot causa y linajyan taotao, mangajulo gui jilo guma ya guinin y atof nae manatunog yan camaña gui entalo, asta y gui menan Jesus.
pairs.english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst before Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y jinengguenñija yuje sija, ilegña: Taotao, y isaomo umaasie.
pairs.english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba yan y Fariseo sija jatutujon manmanjaso, ya ilegñija: Jaye güe este na usangan chatfino contra si Yuus? Jaye siña manasie isao, na si Yuusja?
pairs.english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jatungo y jinasonñija; manope ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa injajaso gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, "Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa sen taeminapot masangan: Y isaomo unmaasie; pat masangan: Cajulo ya unfanmocat?
pairs.english: Which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you;' or to say, 'Arise and walk?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingoja na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña gui tano para umasie isao (ilegña nu y paralitico), jusanganejao: Cajulo, chule y camamo ya unjanao para iyajamyo.
pairs.english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins" (he said to the paralyzed man), "I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas güiya cajulo gui menanñija, ya jachule ayo anae umaasongüe ya jumanao para y guimaña, ya jatuna si Yuus,
pairs.english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmanman todosija, ya matuna si Yuus; ya manbula y minaañao, ilegñija: Inlie námanman sija pago.
pairs.english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen strange things today."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 27 44510 ¶ Ya despues di estesija, jumanao, ya jalie un publicano na y naanña si Levi, matatachong gui bancon y tributo ya ilegña: Dalalagyo.
pairs.english: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, "Follow me!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo todo y güinajaña ya cajulo ya jadalalaggüe.
pairs.english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas si Levi un dangculon gupot gui guimaña: ya guaja un dangculon linajyan publicano sija, yan otro sija manmatachong gui lamasa yan sija.
pairs.english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija yan y escribañija, mangogonggong contra y disipuluña sija, ilegñija: Sajafa na manjajamyo mañocho yan manguimen yan y publicanosija yan y manisao?
pairs.english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Y manaechetnot ti janesesita medico; lao y manmalango.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti matoyo para juagang y manunas, lao y manisao para ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 33 44570 ¶ Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Y disipulon Juan manayuyunat megae na biaje, ya jafatitinas tinayuyut; parejoja yan y disipulon Fariseo sija; ya iyoco mañochocho yan manguiguimen?
pairs.english: They said to him, "Why do John's disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Siña innaayunat y mangaegue gui guipot uma sagua anae mañisijaja yan y nobio?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ufato jaane na y nobio umana suja; ayo nae ufanayunat güije na jaane sija.
pairs.english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane sija locue un acomparasion: Taya taotao janajanao pidason magago gui nuebo na bestido ya japolo gui bijo na bestido; no sea ujatiteg y nuebo ya locue y magago guinin nuebo ti parejo yan y bijo.
pairs.english: He also told a parable to them. "No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya mananaye nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero: ya no sea, y bino ni nuebo uyinamag y boteyan cuero, ya y bino umachuda, ya y boteyan cuero ufalingo.
pairs.english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y nuebo bino na nasesita y nuebo na boteyan cuero nae umapolo.
pairs.english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ni un taotao ni gumimen y bijo na bino umalago ni nuebo; sa ualog: Y bijo maulegña.
pairs.english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, 'The old is better.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede y un sabado, jumajanao si Jesus gui fangualuan maies; ya y disipuluña sija, manmanjajala ni y masotcan maies, ya jacano, jagugugan ni y canaeñija.
pairs.english: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first, that he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Jafa na infatitinas y ti tunas na umafatinas gui sabado na jaane:
pairs.english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, "Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus iligña: Taya nae intaetae este y finatinas David anae ñalang yan y mangachongña?
pairs.english: Jesus, answering them, said, "Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jumalom gui guimayuus, ya jachule ya jacano y pan ni y mafamamauleg, yan janae locue y mangachongña: ni y ti tunas na ucano na para y mamaleja?
pairs.english: how he entered into God's house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Y Lajin Taotao locue Señot y sabado.
pairs.english: He said to them, "The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 6 44690 ¶ Ya susede y otro sabado, na jumalom gui guimayuus ya mamanagüe: ya estaba güije un taotao na anglo y agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba yan y Fariseo sija maaatan güe, cao unajomlo gui sabado na jaane; para uquefanmañoda jafa ya umafaaela.
pairs.english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jatungoja y jinasonñija; ya ilegña ni ayo na taotao y anglo canaeña: Cajulo ya untojgue gui tálolo! ya tumojgue julo.
pairs.english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, "Rise up, and stand in the middle." He arose and stood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Jufafaesen jamyo uno. Tunas gui sabado na umafatinas y mauleg pat y taelaye? numalibre linâlâ pat mamuno?
pairs.english: Then Jesus said to them, "I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatan todos y oriyañija ya ilegña nu güiya: Estira mona y canaemo. Ya guiya jafatinas taegüije, ya y canaeña numalo ya magong taegüije y otro.
pairs.english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija mansénbubo, ya manguecuentos uno yan otro, jafa mojon ujafatinas gui as Jesus.
pairs.english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 12 44750 ¶ Ya susede gui ayo sija na jaane, jumanao para ufanaetae gui un ogso ya todo y puenge jasigue di manaetaeja para as Yuus.
pairs.english: It happened in these days, that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, jaagang y disipuluña sija; ya jaayig dose guiya sija, ni manmafanaan locue apostoles.
pairs.english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon ni jafanaan locue Pedro, yan si Andres cheluña, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan, si Felipe, yan si Bartolome,
pairs.english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Mateo, yan si Tomas, yan si Santiago, lajin Alfeo, yan si Simon ni mafanaan Selote,
pairs.english: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Judas chelun Santiago, yan si Judas Iscariote ni y traidot;
pairs.english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manunog yan sija ya tumojgue gui un lugat ni yano; yan y dangculon linajyan disipuluña sija, yan y dangculon linajyan taotao, guinin todo yya Judea, yan yya Jerusalem, yan y tano Tiro yan yya Sidon, ni manmato para umaecungog, yan para uninafanmagong y chetnotñija;
pairs.english: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan manafanmagong ayo sija y munafanachatsaga ni y espiritun áplacha.
pairs.english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago pumapacha güe y linajyan taotao: sa manjujuyong guiya güiya ninasiña ya janafanmamagong todo sija.
pairs.english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out from him and healed them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 20 44830 ¶ Ya güiya manatan julo gui disipuluña, ya ilegña: Mandichoso jamyo ni mamobble; sa iyonmiyo y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo ni y manñalang pago: sa ufanjaspog. Mandichoso y manatanges: sa ufañaleg.
pairs.english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo yaguin y taotao sija infanchinatlie, yan ujaapatta sija guiya jamyo ya ujalalatde jamyo ya ujayute juyong y naanmiyo pot taelaye pot causa y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fansenmagof güije na jaane; yan infanayog ni minagofmiyo: sa, estagüe, y premionmiyo dangculo gui langet; sa taegüenaoja jafatitinas y tatañija ni y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ay jamyo ni manrico! sa esta guaja consuelonmiyo.
pairs.english: "But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay jamyo ni esta manjaspog pago! sa infanñalang. Ay jamyo ni mañachaleg pago! sa jamyo infanugong yan infananges.
pairs.english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay jamyo yaguin todo y taotao sija manguecuentos mauleg nu jamyo! sa taegüenaoja ujafatinas y tatañija ni y manfatso na profeta.
pairs.english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 27 44900 ¶ Lao jusangangane jamyo ni jumujungog: Güaeya y enemigonmiyo; fatinas mauleg ni y chumatlie jamyo,
pairs.english: "But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise y mumatdise jamyo, ya infanmanaetae pot y namamajlao jamyo.
pairs.english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pumatmada y un banda fasumo, naeja locue ni y otro, ya y chumule y capamo, chamo chumochoma na uchule y chininamo locue.
pairs.english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don't withhold your coat also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cada uno ni y gumagaojao, nae; ya y chumule y güinajamo, chamo tumalulugua gumagao.
pairs.english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don't ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa y malagomiyo ni y taotao jafatinas nu jamyo; taegüijija fatinas locue nu sija:
pairs.english: "As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inguaeya y gumaeya jamyo, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo? sa y manisao locue jaguaeya y gumaeya sija.
pairs.english: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin infatinas mauleg ni y fumamamauleg jamyo, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo? sa y manisao locue jafatitinasja taegüenao.
pairs.english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin innaayao na ayo sija ni y guaja ninanggamo para infanresibe, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo: sa y manisao janaayao y manisao para ufanmanresibe taegüije talo.
pairs.english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaeya jamyo y enimigunmiyo ya infatinas mauleg nu sija: ya innaaayao, ya chamiyo fantataeninangga, ya udangculo y premionmiyo yan infanfamaguon y Gueftaguilo: sa güiya cariñoso nu y ingrato sija, yan y taelaye.
pairs.english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue fanyóase, taegüije y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet yóase.
pairs.english: Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumusga, sa ti infanjinisga: chamiyo sumetetensia, sa ti infansinentensia: nafanlibre, ya y ninafanlibre:
pairs.english: Don't judge, and you won't be judged. Don't condemn, and you won't be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanae, ya infanmanae; mauleg na medida y majoño papa, ya umachaochao ya umachúchuda, ufanmannae y taotao sija gui jalom pechonmiyo; sa ayoja na medida y anae manmide jamyo: infanmamediye talo jamyo.
pairs.english: "Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 39 45020 ¶ Ya jasangane sija un acomparasion ilegña: Siña y bachet jaosgaejon y otro bachet? ti ujaachapodong y dos gui joyo?
pairs.english: He spoke a parable to them. "Can the blind guide the blind? Won't they both fall into a pit?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo ti taquiloña qui y maestro: lao cada uno ni y cabales, güiya utaegüijija y maestroña.
pairs.english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa muna unlilie y migo gui atadog y chelumo; ya ti unlilie y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa muna siña unalog ni y chelumo: Chelujo, maela ya junajanao y migo gui atadogmo, yanguin jago ti unlilie y jayo gui atadogmo? Hipocrita jao, yute juyong finena y jayo gui atadogmo, ya ayo nae unlie claro para unnajanao y migo gui atadog y chelumo.
pairs.english: Or how can you tell your brother, 'Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,' when you yourself don't see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya mauleg na trongco, ni y fanogcha taelaye, ni y taelaye na trongco ni y fanogcha mauleg.
pairs.english: For there is no good tree that brings forth rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that brings forth good fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa cada trongco matungoja pot y tinegchaña. Sa ti ufanmanrecoje y taotao sija igos gui manituca ni ufanmanrecoje ubas gui jalom gadon.
pairs.english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don't gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg na taotao, ni y mauleg na guinaja gui corasonña, mañuñule mauleg; ya y taelaye na taotao, ni y taelaye na güinaja gui corasonña, mañuñule taelaye: sa y minegae y corason jasasangan y pachotña.
pairs.english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 46 45090 ¶ Ya jafa na infananaanyo Señot, Señot, ya ti infatitinas y jusangangane jamyo?
pairs.english: "Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and don't do the things which I say?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y mato guiya guajo ya jaecungog y sinanganjo ya jafatinas; jufanue jaye parejuña:
pairs.english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words, and does them, I will show you who he is like.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan un taotao ni y manjatsa guma, ya jaguadog tadong ya japolo y simiento gui jilo y fitme na acho; ya yanguin cajulo y manadan janom, ya milag y sadog chineneg ayo na guma; lao ti umayengyong, sa maplanta gui jilo y acho.
pairs.english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep, and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y umeecungog ya ti jafatinas; parejo yan y taotao ni y manjatsa guma gui jilo oda ya ti janaye simiento; ya anae milag y sadog ya chineneg, enseguidas upodong; ya dangculo y yinilang ayo na guma.
pairs.english: But he who hears, and doesn't do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di munjayan todo y finanagüeña si Jesucristo gui talangan taotao sija, güiya jumalom guiya Capernaum.
pairs.english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tentago un senturion ni y guefyaña, estaba malango, ya esta para umatae.
pairs.english: A certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae y senturion jajungog na masasangan si Jesus, jatago y manamco na Judios, para umagagao na ufato ya unajomlo y tentagoña.
pairs.english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato as Jesus, guefmagagao ilegñija: Dignogüe na unfatinas este pot güiya:
pairs.english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, "He is worthy for you to do this for him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagüaeya y nasionmame ya japlantaye jam sinagoganmame.
pairs.english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao yan si Jesus. Ya anae esta manjijot gui guima y senturion jatago y amiguña sija para ualog as Jesus: Señot chamo ninachachatsaga; sa ti dignoyo na junajalom jao gui papa atofjo;
pairs.english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, "Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ti jujaso na dignoyo na jufato guiya jago; lao sanganja ya ujomlo y tentagojo.
pairs.english: Therefore I didn't even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo locue na taotao gaegeuyo gui papa y ninasiña, ya guaja gui papajo sendalo sija; yan ileco nu este: Janao, ya mapos; ya y otro: Maela, ya mato; ya y tentagojo: Fatinas este, ya jafatinas.
pairs.english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus este, ninamanman nu güiya, ya jabiragüe ilegña ni y linajyan taotao ni y dumalalag güe: Jusangane jamyo na ti jusoda taegüije na dinangculon jinenggue ni iya Israel.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manalo sija guato gui guima y manmanago, jasoda na jomlo y tentago ni estaba malango.
pairs.english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 11 45230 ¶ Ya susede un rato despues di este na, si Jesus jumanao asta un siuda ni mafanaan Nain; ya mañisija yan y disipuluña yan y dangculon manadan taotao.
pairs.english: It happened soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta jijot gui pettan y siuda, estagüe na macocone un matae, güiyaja lajin nanaña, ya biuda locue, ya linajyan taotao siuda mangachongchongña.
pairs.english: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae linie ni y Señot ninamaase nu güiya, ya ilegña nu güiya: Chamo cumacasao.
pairs.english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, "Don't cry."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lumatguato ya japacha y andas; ya y chumuchule mañaga. Ya ilegña: Patgon, guajo jao sumangane, cajulo.
pairs.english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, "Young man, I tell you, arise!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y estaba matae matachong ya jatutujon cumuentos, ya inentrega as Jesus gui as nanaña.
pairs.english: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmaaañao todosija, ya maalaba si Yuus ilegñija: Dangculo na profeta esta cajulo entre yya jita: ya, si Yuus jagas jabisita taotaoña.
pairs.english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has arisen among us!" and, "God has visited his people!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao este na famaña gui todo yya Judea yan todo oriya y tano.
pairs.english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 18 45300 ¶ Ya y disipulon Juan masangane güe todo estesija.
pairs.english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang si Juan dos gui disipuluña ya jatago para as Jesus, ilegña: Cao jago yuje y para ufato pat infanmannangga jam otro?
pairs.english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, "Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato y taotao sija guiya güiya, ilegñija: Si Juan Bautista tumagojam para yya jago, ilegña: Cao jago yuje y para ufato pat infanmannangga jam otro?
pairs.english: When the men had come to him, they said, "John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, 'Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo mismo na ora, janafanjomlo megae ni y manmalango yan y mangaechetnotsija yan espiritun manaelaye; yan megae na manbachet ninafanmanlie.
pairs.english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Janao yan sangane si Juan ni y liniimiyo yan y jiningogmiyo; sa y manbachet manmanlie, ya y mangojo manmamocat, ya y manategtog mangasgas, ya y mananga manmanjungog, y manmatae manafangajulo, ya umapredica y ibangelio gui mamobble.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dichoso ayo y ti sumosoda y lugat para umatompo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 24 45360 ¶ Ya anae manmapos y mantinago as Juan, jatutujon cumuentuse y taotao sija pot si Juan: Jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie gui desierto? un piao ni y yinengyong ni y manglo?
pairs.english: When John's messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie? un taotao na puru suabe magaguña? Estagüe, ayo sija y manminagagago ni y malagno magago yan manlalâlâ gui guinatbo, gui palasyon y ray nae mañasaga.
pairs.english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jafa injanagüe para inlie? un profeta? magajet, jusangane jamyo na mas que un profeta.
pairs.english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este yuje y esta matugue: Estagüe na jatago y tentagojo gui menan matamo, ni para ufamauleg y chalanmo gui menamo.
pairs.english: This is he of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na entre ayo sija y manmafañago gui famalaoan, taya dangculoña qui si Juan; lao y diquiqueja gui raenon Yuus dangculoña qui güiya.
pairs.english: "For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao anae majungog güe, yan y publicano sija, jajustifica si Yuus ya manmatagpange ni y tinagpangen Juan.
pairs.english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John's baptism.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo yan y manmagas y lay, jarechasa y consejon Yuus contra sijaja; sa ti manmatagpange pot güiya.
pairs.english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: "To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manparejo yan y famaguon ni manmatatachong gui plasa ya manaagang uno yan otro ya ilegñija: Indadane jamyo flauta, y ti manbaela jamyo, manuugonge jamyo, ya ti manatanges jamyo.
pairs.english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call one to another, saying, 'We piped to you, and you didn't dance. We mourned, and you didn't weep.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato si Juan Bautista ni uchocho pan ni uguimen bino, ya ilelegmiyo: Guaja anitiña.
pairs.english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato y Lajin taotao, ya chumocho yan gumimen, ya ilelegmiyo: Estagüe, un taotao na gachumocho yan gagumimen bino, yan amigon y publicano sija, yan y manisao.
pairs.english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tiningo manacabales ni y todo famaguonña.
pairs.english: Wisdom is justified by all her children."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 36 45480 ¶ Ya malago uno gui Fariseo sija na ufañija mañocho. Ya jumalom gui guima y Fariseo ya matachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee's house, and sat at the table.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un palaoan gui siuda, na miisao, ya anae jatungo na gaegue si Jesus matatachong gui lamasa gui guima y Fariseo, mañule un boteyan alabastro na ingüente.
pairs.english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumojgue gui taten Jesus, ya cumasao; ya jatutujon munafotgon ni lagoña y adeng Jesus, ya jasaosao ni y gapuniluña; ya jachichico y adengña ya japapalae ni y inggüente.
pairs.english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie este y Fariseo ni y umagange güe, cumuentos gui sumanjalomña, ilelegña: Este na taotao yaguin profeta güe, jatungo jafa este na palaoan y pumapacha güe sa güiya miisao.
pairs.english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, "This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Simon, guaja para jasangane jao. Ya güiya ilegña: Sangan Maestro.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." He said, "Teacher, say on."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un taotao guaja dos dumídibe: ya y uno mandidibe quinientos monedan denario, ya y otro sincuenta.
pairs.english: "A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae taya apasñija, inasie todo y dos. Enao mina, jaye guiya sija mas güinaeya?
pairs.english: When they couldn't pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Simon, ya ilegña: Y pineloco na ayo y mas maasie; ya güiya ilegña: Tunas jinisgamo.
pairs.english: Simon answered, "He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most." He said to him, "You have judged correctly."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabira güe guato gui palaoan, ya ilegña as Simon: Unlilie este na palaoan? Jumalomyo gui guimamo, ti unnaeyo janom para y adengjo; lao este janafotgon y adengjo ni lagoña, ya jasaosao ni y gapuniluña.
pairs.english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ti unnaeyo un chico: lao este na palaoan desde que jumalomyo ti pumapara jachico y adengjo.
pairs.english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti unpalae y ilujo ni laña, lao este japalae y adengjom inggüente.
pairs.english: You didn't anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jusangane jao, na y isaoña, ni y megae, umaasie; sa güiya megae maguaeyaña; lao y didide maasiiña, didide maguaeyaña.
pairs.english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Y isaomo maasie.
pairs.english: He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mangachochongña manmatachong gui lamasa, jatutujon sumangan gui sumanjalomñija: Jaye este na ufanasie locue isao?
pairs.english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni palaoan: Y jinengguemo unsinatba; janao yan pas.
pairs.english: He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede un rato despues na jajanaogüe y siuda sija yan y sengsong sija manpredidica, yan numanafanungo nu y ibangelion y raenon Yuus; ya mañisija yan y dose,
pairs.english: It happened soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of the Kingdom of God. With him were the twelve,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo sija famalaoan ni guinin nanafanmagong ni manaelayen espiritu yan y chetnot sija; si Maria ni mafanaan magdalena ni jumuyong guiya güiya siete na manganite,
pairs.english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Juana, asaguan Chusa, mayetdomon Herodes; yan si Susana yan megae ni pumalo ni jasesetbe ni güinajañija:
pairs.english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod's steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 4 45660 ¶ Ya anae mandaña y dangculon linajyan taotao, yan y manestaba cada siuda manmato guiya güiya, jacuentuse pot un acomparasion.
pairs.english: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tátanom jumanao para ufananom y semiyaña; ya anae manmananom, palo podong gui oriyan chalan; ya todo magacha, ya manmato sija y pajaro gui langet ya macano.
pairs.english: "The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui jilo acho; ya anae lachog, ninamalayo sa ti fofotgon.
pairs.english: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui jalom tituca; ya mandoco mañija y tituca, ya chiniguit.
pairs.english: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui mauleg y tano; ya mandoco, ya manogcha siento pot uno. Ya anae esta jasangan estesija umagang: Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, uecungog.
pairs.english: Other fell into the good ground, and grew, and brought forth fruit one hundred times." As he said these things, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 9 45710 ¶ Ya y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe: Jafa este na acomparasion?
pairs.english: Then his disciples asked him, "What does this parable mean?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guiya ilegña: Esta manmannae jamyo para intingo y misterion y raenon Yuus lao y pumalo pot acomparasion; para ujaaatanja ya ti ujalie, yan ujaecungogja ya ti ujatungo.
pairs.english: He said, "To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables; that 'seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues este ayo na acomparasion: Y semiya y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gui oriyan chalan ayo sija y jagas jumungog; ya despues mato y manganite ya janasuja y sinangan gui corasonñija sa ti mojon ufanmanjonggue ya ufanmasatba.
pairs.english: Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jilo acho, ayo sija y anae jajungog, jaresibe y sinangan nu y minagof; lao estesija manaejale; sa jajonggue un ratoja, lao anae mato tentasion mamodong.
pairs.english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pedong gui jalom tituca, este sija y jumungog; ya mientras jumanao gui chalanñija, manchiniguit ni inadajeñiñija, yan y güinaja, yan y minagof tano gui este linâlâ, ya ti jumuyong tinegchañija cabales.
pairs.english: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y mangaegue gui mauleg na tano, este sija na guinin jumungog y sinangan gui corason ni mauleg yan tunas, jamantietiene, ya manogcha yan manpasensia.
pairs.english: That in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and bring forth fruit with patience.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 16 45780 ¶ Ni uno ni mañoñonggue candet, utampe nu y batde pat upolo gui papa catre, lao upolo gui jilo lamasa para y jumajalom ulie y manana.
pairs.english: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya manaatog ya ti umafatanñaejon; ni gae gui secreto ya ti umatungo, ujuyong gui manana.
pairs.english: For nothing is hidden, that will not be revealed; nor anything secret, that will not be known and come to light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guesadaje jaftaemano y jiningogmiyo: sa masquesea jaye y guaja, umanae; lao masquesea jaye y taya, unajanao ayo y pineloña na uguaja.
pairs.english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 19 45810 ¶ Ayonae manmato guiya güiya si nanaña yan y mañeluña, lao tisiña manlatguato guiya güiya pot y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane, ilegñija nu güiya: Si nanamo yan y mañelumo manmatotojgue gui sanjiyong na manmalago na unmalie.
pairs.english: It was told him by some saying, "Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ya ilegña nu sija: Y nanajo yan y mañelujo, ayosija y jumungog y sinangan Yuus ya jafatinas.
pairs.english: But he answered them, "My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 22 45840 ¶ Ya susede y uno gui ayosija jaane nae, na jumalom gui un batco, güiya yan y disipoluña sija; ya ilegña nu sija: Nije tafanjanao y otro banda jagoe; ya manjanao.
pairs.english: Now it happened on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake." So they launched out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mumamayama sija, güiya maego; ya manguaefe un dangculon, pagyo y manglo gui jagoe; ya bula y batco janom ya mangaegue sija gui peligro.
pairs.english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato guiya güiya, ya mapangon, ilegñija: Maestro, maestro, tafanmalingo. Ya magmata, ya jalalatde y manglo yan y chaochao y janom; ya pumara, ya jumuyong malinao.
pairs.english: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, "Master, master, we are dying!" He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Mano nae gaegue jinengguenmiyo? Ya sija manmaañao ya ninafanmanman, ilegñija uno yan otro: Jaye este, na asta y manglo yan y janom jatago ya maoosgueja?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Where is your faith?" Being afraid they marveled, saying one to another, "Who is this, then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 26 45880 ¶ Ya manmato asta, y tano y taotao Gadara sija, ni gaegue gui sanmenan y Galilea.
pairs.english: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumanao para y tano, umasoda yan un taotao gui jiyong y siuda na gaemanganite; ya apmam na tiempo ti minagagago ni usaga gui guima, na y naftanja.
pairs.english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn't live in a house, but in the tombs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus, umagang, ya jatombagüe gui menaña ya ilegña ni dangculo na inagang: Para jafayo nu jago Jesus, Lajin Yuus Gueftaquilo? Jusuplica jao na chamoyo sumasapet.
pairs.english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, "What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torment me!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatago y espiritun áplacha na ufanjanao gui taotao; sa apmam na tiempo na maguot güe: mamantiene güe preso ya magode nu y cadena yan tale sija; ya jayamag y guinede ya quinene ni y manganite asta y desierto sija.
pairs.english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bands apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya finaesen as Jesus: Jaye naanmo? Ya güiya ilegña: Linajyan; sa megae na manganite manjalom guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" He said, "Legion," for many demons had entered into him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masuplica güe na chaña tumatago na ufanjanao para y tadong na joyo.
pairs.english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije un inetnon babue na lajyan na mañochocho gui jalom tano: ya masuplica güe na ufanpinelo ya ufanjalom güije sija. Ya manpinelo.
pairs.english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. He allowed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong y manganite gui taotao, manjalom gui babue ya y inetnon manmanunugo sajyao guato gui un didog gui jagoe ya manmatmos.
pairs.english: The demons came out from the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija munafañochocho y babue anae jalie y mafatinas, manmapos ya jasangane y taotao siuda yan gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao para ujalie y mafatinas; ya manmato gui as Jesus; ya masoda y taotao ni anae guinin jumuyong y manganite, na minagagago ya guaja jinasoña cabales, ya matatachong gui adeng Jesus; ya ninafanmaañao.
pairs.english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane ni lumie, jafa taemano manamagongña ayo y guinin jinatme manganite.
pairs.english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 37 45990 ¶ Ayonae todo y taotao gui tano y Gadarenos yan todo y oriyan, magagao na ujanao guiya sija; sa mansenmaañao; ya güiya cajulo gui batco ya tumalo tate.
pairs.english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. He entered into the boat, and returned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na taotao anae guinun manjuyong y manganite, siniplica güe para usaga guiya güiya; lao janajanao ya ilegña:
pairs.english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Talo guato guiya jamyo ya unfañangane jaftaemano na dangculon güinaja finatinasña si Yuus nu jago. Ya guiña jumanao, ya jasanganñaejon todo gui siuda jaftaemano finatinasña si Jesus nu güiya.
pairs.english: "Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you." He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 40 46020 ¶ Ya anae tumalo guato si Jesus maresibe ni y linajyan taotao sija ya mangosmagof; sa todoja numananggaja.
pairs.english: It happened, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
