pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un taotao na y naanña si Jairo, ya güiya locue magas y sinagoga; mato ya jatombagüe papa gui adeng Jesus, ya jagagao na ujalom gui guimaña.
pairs.english: Behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet, and begged him to come into his house,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guaja unoja jagaña na esta guaja dose años, ya estaba jijot na umatae. Ya anae jumanao maapupura güe ni linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 43 46050 ¶ Ya un palaoan na numanajuyong jâgâ esta dose años, esta jalachae gumasta todo y güinajaña ni jaapaseñaejon medico, lao taya siña munamagong,
pairs.english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians, and could not be healed by any,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato gui tateña ya japacha y madoblan magaguña, ya enseguidas esta bumasta y jâgâña.
pairs.english: came behind him, and touched the fringe of his cloak, and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña: Jayeyo pumacha? Lao anae todos japune ilegña si Pedro yan y mangachongña: Maestro, y linajyan taotao umanoriya jao yan machichiguit jao,
pairs.english: Jesus said, "Who touched me?" When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, "Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña: Guajayo pumacha; sa guajo jutungo na guaja ninasiña jumuyong guiya guajo.
pairs.english: But Jesus said, "Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y palaoan anae jalie na ti siña janaatog, mato ya manlalaolao, ya jatombagüe gui menaña, ya jasangan gui menan y taotao sija todos, pot jafa na japacha, yan jaftaemano na ninajomlo enseguidas.
pairs.english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Hija, y jinengguemo unninajomlo; janao ya upas.
pairs.english: He said to her, "Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 49 46110 ¶ Ya mientras cumuecuentos, mato uno ni taotao y magas y sinagoga ya ilegña: Y jagamo matae, chamo umestototba y Maestro.
pairs.english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue's house came, saying to him, "Your daughter is dead. Don't trouble the Teacher."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus manopegüe: Chamo maaañao; jonggueja sa güiya ujomlo.
pairs.english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, "Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guima, taya japolo na ujalom yan güiya na si Pedro, si Juan, yan si Santiago, yan y tatan y patgon, yan y nanaña.
pairs.english: When he came to the house, he didn't allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todos mangacasao, yan malamementagüe; lao ilegña: Chamiyo fangacasao; sa ti matae, lao mamaego.
pairs.english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, "Don't weep. She isn't dead, but sleeping."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macháchatgue güe, sa matungoja na esta matae.
pairs.english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jamantiene y canaeña ya jaagang ilegña: Patgon palaoan, cajulo.
pairs.english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, "Child, arise!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato y espirituña talo, ya enseguidas cajulo; ya manago na umanachocho.
pairs.english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmanman y mañaenaña: lao jaencatga na chañija sumangangane ni un taotao jafa y mafatinas.
pairs.english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jaagang ya mandaña y dose disipuluña ya janae ninasiña gui jilo y manganite todo, yan para ufanmanamte nu y chetnot sija.
pairs.english: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago na ujapredica y raenon Yuus, yan unafanjomlo y manmalango.
pairs.english: He sent them forth to preach the Kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmañuñule ni jafa para y chalan, ni baston, ni botsa, ni pan, ni salape; ni infangaemagago dos.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Take nothing for your journey--neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats apiece.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cuatquiera na guma nae manjalom jamyo, fañaga güije asta que manjanao jamyo.
pairs.english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo sija y ti rumesibe jamyo, anae manjanao jamyo güije na siuda, sacude y petbos gui adengmiyo para testimonio contra sija.
pairs.english: As many as don't receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao sija, ya manmalofan sija gui sengsong, mapredidica y ibangelio, yan mannanajomlo gui todo y lugat.
pairs.english: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Herodes tetrarca jajungog masangan este sija na finatinas, ya estaba guefinestotba ni y sinañgan palo na si Juan esta cumajulo guinin manmatae.
pairs.english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pumalo ilegñija: Si Elias jumuyong talo; ya otros umalog; na uno gui manamco na profeta lâlâ talo.
pairs.english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Herodes: Si Juan guajo dumegüeya; ya jaye este nae jujungog sija na güinaja? Ya japrocura lumie güe.
pairs.english: Herod said, "John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things?" He sought to see him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 10 46280 ¶ Ya anae manalo guato y apostoles sija, masangane güe todo ni y finatinasñija. Ya jacone sija ya mañuja asta un banda, gui un siuda ni mafanaan Betsaida.
pairs.english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them, and withdrew apart to a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta matungo ni y linajyan taotao sija, madálalag güe; ya güiya jaresibe, ya jasangane ni y raenon Yuus; ya janafanjomlo y numesesita manmaamte.
pairs.english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of the Kingdom of God, and he cured those who needed healing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaane jatutujon pumuenge; ya mafatoigüe nu y dose ya ilegñija nu güiya: Nafanjanao, y linajyan taotao, para ufanjanao asta y sengsong yan y fangualuan gui oriya, ya ufañaga ya ufanmanaligao nañija; sa mangaeguejit güine gui desierto na lugat.
pairs.english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, "Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo innafañocho. Ya ilegñija: Taya guajata na sincoja na pan yan dos güijan, patsino nije tafanjanao tafanmamajan nengcano para todo este sija na taotao.
pairs.english: But he said to them, "You give them something to eat." They said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja buente sinco mit na taotao. Ya ilegña ni disipuluña: Nafanmatachong pot compania, cada compania sincuenta.
pairs.english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, "Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije mafatinas, ya mannafamatachong todos.
pairs.english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y sinco na pan yan y dos güijan, ya jaatan julo y langet ya jabendise ya jaipe; ya janae y disipoluña para upolo gui menan y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho ya manjaspog todos; ya esta majatsa y sebla y pedaso sija, dose canastra.
pairs.english: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 18 46360 ¶ Ya susede, anae mananaetae güiyaja namaesa, estabaja mangaegue guiya güiya y disipuluña, ya jafaesensija, ilegña: Jaye ilegñiñija y taotao nu guajo?
pairs.english: It happened, as he was praying alone, that the disciples were with him, and he asked them, "Who do the multitudes say that I am?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: umalog: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They answered, "'John the Baptizer,' but others say, 'Elijah,' and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Lao jamyo, jaye ilegmimiyo nu guajo? Ya manope si Simon Pedro ya ilegña: Si Cristo, gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manguenesencatga sija ya jatago na chañija sumangangane ni jaye nu este;
pairs.english: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: Y Lajin taotao nesesita ufamadese megae, ya umarechasa ni y manamco sija, yan y manmagas y mamale yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno ya umanacajulo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija todos: Yaguin guaja y malago tumatiyego, upunenaesa güe, ya uchule y quiluusña cada jaane ya udalalagyo.
pairs.english: He said to all, "If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa masqueseaja jaye y malago na usatba y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya masquesea jaye y malingo y linâlâña pot y naanjo, güiya usatba.
pairs.english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: maesa gue?
pairs.english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa masqueseaja jaye pot y mamajlao guajo yan pot y sinanganjo, mamajlao locue nu este y Lajin taotao, yaguin mato gui minalagña yan y minalag tata yan y mañantos na angjet sija.
pairs.english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao magajet jusangane jamyo: Na guaja palo gui mangaegue güine, na ti uchague y finatae asta que ujalie y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 28 46460 ¶ Ya susede mina ocho na jaane, despues di estesija na sinangan, jacone mañija yan Pedro, yan si Juan, yan si Santiago, ya cajulo gui egso ni taquilo para ufanaetae.
pairs.english: It happened about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras mananaetae güe, y jechuran mataña tolaeca; ya y magaguña jumuyong apaca ya malag.
pairs.english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjuyong yan y minalagñija, ya manguecuentos pot y jinanaoña, na para ucumple guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro yan y mangachogña, mansenmatujog; ya anae manmagmata, malie y minalagña yan ayo na dos taotao ni mangachongña.
pairs.english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, mientras sumusuja sija guiya güiya, si Pedro ilegña as Jesus: Maestro, maulegñaja tafañaga güine; ya nije tafanmamatinas tres na tabetnaculo; uno para jago, uno para si Moises, yan uno para si Elias; ti jatungo jafa jasasangan.
pairs.english: It happened, as they were parting from him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah," not knowing what he said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras jasasangan este, mato un mapagajes ya mantinampe; ya ninafanguefmaañao anae manjalom gui mapagajes.
pairs.english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un inagang gui mapagajes na ilegña: Este y lajijo, inayigco; ecungog güe.
pairs.english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan ayo na inagang, esta masoda si Jesucristo güigüiyaja namaesa; ya sija manmamatquiloja, ya güije sija na jaane, taya jasangane ni jaye pot y liniiñija.
pairs.english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 37 46550 ¶ Ya susede inagpaña güije na jaane, anae manunog guinin y egso, ya y dangculon linajyan taotao masoda güe.
pairs.english: It happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, un taotao gui entalo y linajyan, na umagang ilegña: Maestro jutayuyut jao na unlie y lajijo; sa y unoja patgonjo:
pairs.english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, un espiritu na quinene, ya enseguidas umagang; ya ninalaolao güe ya numanajuyong buo, ya aapmam na pinadese na sumuja guiya güiya, na ninalalamenja,
pairs.english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin jutayuyut y disipulumo na ujayute juyong; ya ti manasiña.
pairs.english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn't."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña: O generasion na ti manjonggue, yan manchatpayon! asta ngaean nae utafanjijita, ya jujasusungon jamyo? conieyo fan mague ni y lajimo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mámamamaela, y anite yinite papa ya guefninalaolao. Lao si Jesus jalalatde y espiritun áplacha ya janajomlo y patgon ya janatalo guato as tataña.
pairs.english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todos ninafanman nu y minagas Yuus, lao mientras manmamanman todos pot todo estesija ni y jafatinas, ilegña ni disipuluña;
pairs.english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya utatcalon gui talanganmiyo este sija na sinangan: sa umaentrega y Lajin taotao gui canae taotao sija.
pairs.english: "Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo este na sinangan, ya manafaninatogüe para chañija tumutungo: ya manmaañao mafaesen güe ni ayo na sinangan.
pairs.english: But they didn't understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 46 46640 ¶ Ya jumuyong manafaesen entre sija, jaye guiya sija udangculoña.
pairs.english: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus anae jaliija y jinason y corasonñija, jacone un patgon ya japolo gui bandaña,
pairs.english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye y rumesibe este na patgon pot naanjo jaresibeyo; ya y rumesibeyo, jaresibe y tumagoyo; sa jaye y mas diquique guiya jamyo, ayo dangculo.
pairs.english: and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 49 46670 ¶ Ya manope si Juan ya ilegña: Maestro inlie uno na manyuyute juyong y manganite pot y naanmo; ya inchema sa ti jadadalalagjit.
pairs.english: John answered, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow with us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus ni sija; chamiyo chumochoma, sa ayo ni ti contra jamyo, guiya para jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Don't forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 51 46690 ¶ Ya susede, anae mato y jaane nae jijot para umaresibe gui sanjilo; janameton y mataña para ujanao para Jerusalem,
pairs.english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago tentago sija na ufanmofona gui menaña; ya majanao manjalom gui un songsong Samaritano, para umanalistuye güe güije.
pairs.english: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti maresibe güe, sa y mataña meton para ujananao para Jerusalem.
pairs.english: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie este ni disipuluña, si Santiago, yan si Juan, ilegñija: Señot, malago jao ya utafanmanago ya utunog guafe guinin y langet, ya ufanlinachae?
pairs.english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, "Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jabira güe ya manlinalatde.
pairs.english: But he turned and rebuked them, "You don't know of what kind of spirit you are.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao para y otro songsong.
pairs.english: For the Son of Man didn't come to destroy men's lives, but to save them." They went to another village.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 57 46750 ¶ Ya anae manjajanao sija, un taotao ilegña nu güiya gui chalan: Señot, bae judalalagjao manoja y unjanao guato.
pairs.english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, "I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu güiya: Y sora sija mangaeliyang, ya y pajaro sija gui langet mangaechenchon; lao y Lajin taotao taya sangaña ni anae para upolo y iluña.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni otro: Dalalagyo. Ya güiya ilegña; Señot, sottayo naya ya finenana jujanao ya jujafot si tatamo.
pairs.english: He said to another, "Follow me!" But he said, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: Polo y manmatae ya ufanajafot y manmataeñija; lao jago janao ya unpredica y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to him, "Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña locue otro; judalalagja jao Señot; lao sottayo naya ya judespideyo ni y mangaegue guiya jame.
pairs.english: Another also said, "I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus: Ni uno ni pumopolo y canae gui alado ya uatan tateña ni y digno para y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But Jesus said to him, "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE munjayan este sija na güinaja, jaayig y Señot otro setenta, ya jatago dos en dos gui menaña para todo y siuda yan ayo na lugat anae para ufato güe.
pairs.english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Y cosecha megae, lao y manmachochocho didide; enaomina gagao y Señot y cosecha, ya ufanago ni manmachochocho para y cosechaña.
pairs.english: Then he said to them, "The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanjanao gui chalanmiyo; estagüe na jutago jamyo taegüije quinilo gui entalo y lobo sija.
pairs.english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmañuñule botsa ni maleta, ni sapatos: ni jaye insaluda gui jinanaonmiyo.
pairs.english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja mano na guma nae manjalom jamyo, finenana in alog: Pas para este na guma.
pairs.english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja güije patgon y pas, y pasmiyo usaga guiya güiya; yaguin taya, utalo guato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fañaga güije na guma, fañocho yan infanguimen todo y manmanaenmiyo; sa y machochoeho ufanmerese nu y apasña. Chamiyo fanjajanao guma pot guma.
pairs.english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masquesea mano na siuda nae manjalom jamyo, ya manmaresibe jamyo, cano jafa y manmasajyane jamyo.
pairs.english: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya nafanjomlo y manmalango ni guaja güije, ya inalog nu sija: y raenon Yuus esta mato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, 'The Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao masqueseaja mano na suida nae manjalom jamyo, ya ti manmaresibe jamyo, fanjanao gui cayeñija, ya inalog:
pairs.english: But into whatever city you enter, and they don't receive you, go out into its streets and say,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y petbos ni jachetune y adengmame güine gui siudanmiyo, insacude contra jamyo; lao tingo este na y raenon Yuus mato jijot guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: 'Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: mas sungunon Sodoma güije na jaane qui ayo na siuda.
pairs.english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay! ay! jao Corasin: ay! ay! jao Betsaida! sa yaguin guiya Tiro yan Sidon nae manmafatinas este sija na mannamanman y manmafatinas guiya jamyo, jagas sen amco manmañotsot, infanmatachong gui silisio yan y apo.
pairs.english: "Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mas sungunon Tiro yan Sidon qui para jamyo gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago Capernaum, unacajulo jao asta y langet? umachule papa asta sasalaguan.
pairs.english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumungog jamyo, jajungogyo; ya y dumesecha jamyo, jadesechayo; ya y dumesechayo, jadesecha y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 17 46970 ¶ Ya manalo guato y setenta yan y minagofñija, ya ilegñija: Señot, asta y manganite insujejeta pot y naanmo.
pairs.english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Julie si Satanas taegüije y lamlam ni y pedong guinin y langet.
pairs.english: He said to them, "I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, na junae jamyo ninasiña para ingacha y culebla, yan y alacran, yan y jilo todo y ninasiñan y enemigo, ya taya siña munafanlamen jamyo.
pairs.english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao chamiyo ninafanmamagof pot este, pot y espiritu sija ni insujejeta; lao fanmagof jamyo pot y naanmiyo ni esta matugue gui langet.
pairs.english: Nevertheless, don't rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 21 47010 ¶ Ya ayoja na ora magof si Jesus gui Espiritu Santo ya ilegña: Junae jao grasia, O Tata, Señot y langet yan y tano, sa unana este sija na güinaja gui manmejnalom yan manmanungo, ya unfanue gui mandiquique; junggan Tata, sa taegüine nae senmagof gui menamo.
pairs.english: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, "I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y güinaja sija jagasja jaentregayo y Tatajo; ya taya tumungo jaye y Lajiña, na y Tataja; ya jaye y Tata, na y Lajiñaja, yan ayo y minalago y lajiña ufinanue.
pairs.english: Turning to the disciples, he said, "All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabiragüe guato gui disipulo sija, ya ilegña: Mandichoso y atadog ni manmanlie nu estesija ni y liniinmiyo:
pairs.english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, "Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jusangane jamyo, na megae na profeta yan ray sija, dumesesea na ulie nu estesija ni y liniinmiyo, ya ti malie; yan ujajungog nu estesija ni y jiningogmiyo ya ti jajungog.
pairs.english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 25 47050 ¶ Ya, estagüe, un magas y lay na tumojgue julo ya tinietientagüe, ya ilegña: Maestro, jafa jufatinas para juereda y taejinecog na linâlâ?
pairs.english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Jafa matugue gui tinago? jafa untataetae?
pairs.english: He said to him, "What is written in the law? How do you read it?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope, ilegña: Guaeya y Señot Yuosmo contodo gui corasonmo, yan contodo y antimo, yan contodo y minetgotmo, yan contodo y tiningomo; yan y tiguangmo taegüije iya jago namaesa.
pairs.english: He answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Mauleg inepemo: fatinas este, ya unlâlâ.
pairs.english: He said to him, "You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya, malago na unatunas maesa güe, ilegña as Jesus: Ya jaye tiguangjo?
pairs.english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, "Who is my neighbor?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus ya ilegña: Un taotao tumunog guinin Jerusalem asta Jerico, ya podong gui entalo y manaque; y machule y magaguña ya manachetnudan güe, ya manjanao ya mapolo cana matae.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede na un pale tumunog güijeja na chalan; ya anae jalie malofanja gui otro banda.
pairs.english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijeja locue un Lebita, anae mato jijot güije na lugat, ya jaatanja, ya malofanja gui otro banda.
pairs.english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un Samaritano, anae jumajanao güije na chalan, mato lugat nae gaegue güe, ya anae jalie, ninamaase,
pairs.english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guato guiya güiya jabee y chetnot sija ya janaye laña yan bino; ya janamaudae gui gaña gâgâ, ya jacone asta y guima publico ya jaadaje.
pairs.english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: anae para ujanao sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, 'Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaye y tiguang entre y tres, pot ayo y pedong gui entalo y manaque?
pairs.english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Ayo y maase nu güiya. Ayonae ilegña Janao ya unfatinas locue taegüije.
pairs.english: He said, "He who showed mercy on him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do likewise."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 38 47180 ¶ Ya anae jumajanao, jumalom gui un songsong; ya un palaoan na y naanña si Marta rinesibegüe gui guimaña.
pairs.english: It happened as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja uno cheluña palaoan na y naanña si Maria, na locue matatachongja gui adeng Jesus, ya jaecungogja y sinanganña.
pairs.english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Marta esta inestotba pot megae sinetbeña, ya mato guiya güiya, ya ilegña: Señot, ada ti unlie y chelujo na upaloyo ya jufañeñetbeja na maesa? Tago ya uayudayo.
pairs.english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, "Lord, don't you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Marta, Marta, esta jago inestotba ya guesmanadaje jao, pot megae na güinaja:
pairs.english: Jesus answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao unoja manesesita; ya si Maria jaayig ayo mauleg na patte ni ti umachule guiya güiya.
pairs.english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede anae mananaetae güe gui un lugat, ya magpo, uno gui disipuluña ilegña nu güiya: Señot, fanagüejam manmanaetae, taegüije locue as Juan ni jafanagüe y disipuluña!
pairs.english: It happened, that when he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña na sija: Yaguin manmanaetae jamyo alog: Tata, Umatuna y naanmo. Umamaela y raenomo,
pairs.english: He said to them, "When you pray, say, 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam pago cada jaane ni y nengcanomame.
pairs.english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unasiijam ni isaomame; sa jame locue inasisie todo ayo y dumidibe jam. Ya chamojam pumopolo gui tentasion.
pairs.english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 5 47270 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye guiya jamyo y gaeamigo uno, ya ufinatoigüe gui tatalopuenge, ya ualog nu güiya: Amigo naayaoyo tres pan;
pairs.english: He said to them, "Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un amigojo mato guiya guajo guinin bumiaje, ya taya ni jafa para juplantaye gui menaña;
pairs.english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y gaegue gui sumanjalom ufanope, ya ualog: Chamo umatbororotayo; sa esta majuchom y petta, ya estagüejam gui cama yan y famaguonjo; ti siñayo cajulo ya junae jao.
pairs.english: and he from within will answer and say, 'Don't bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give it to you'?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: Achogja ti ucajulo ya uninae pot y amiguña: lao pot y magagaoña, ucajulo ya unae jaftaemano y janesesita.
pairs.english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: Gagao, ya infanmanae; aligao ya inseda; yajo, ya infanmababaye.
pairs.english: "I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y mangagao uresibe; ya y manaligao usoda; ya y manayajo, umababaye.
pairs.english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jaye guiya jamyo na tata, yan uguinagao ni y lajiña un pan, ya unnae un acho? pat un güijan ya enbes di güijan unnae culebla?
pairs.english: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won't give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat yan guinagao un chada, ada unnae un alacran?
pairs.english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won't give him a scorpion, will he?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues ombre jamyo, ni y manaelaye, intingo numae mauleg na ninae y famaguonmiyo, cuanto mas y Tatanmiyo gui langet unae ni y Espiritu Santo todo ayo y gumagao güe?
pairs.english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 14 47360 ¶ Ya jayute juyong un anite na udo. Ya susede anae jumuyong este y anite, y ido cumuentos, ya y linajyan taotao sija ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. It happened, when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija ilegñija: Pot si Beetsebub, ni magas y manganite, na jayuyuteja juyong y manganite sija.
pairs.english: But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y pumalo matietientagüe, magagagao un señat gui langet.
pairs.english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jatungo y jinason ayo sija ya ilegña nu sija: Todo y raeno umadibide contra güiyaja, uyulang; ya y guima umadibide contra guma, upodong.
pairs.english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Satanas locue madibide contra güiya namaesa, jaftaemano y raenoña sumaga? Sa ilegmiyo na juyuyute juyong y manganite pot si Beetsebub.
pairs.english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin junajujuyong y manganite pot si Beetsebub, pot jaye y famaguonmiyo ufanyinite sija juyong? Enaomina sija ufanjues para jamyo.
pairs.english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin pot y calulot Yuus nae, juyuyute juyong y manganite, magajet na y raenon Yuus mato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un taotao ni matatnga, ya jafamauleg y atmasña, ya japulan y guimaña: todo güinajaña, manseguro.
pairs.english: "When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mato otro na matatngaña qui güiya ya inañao, inamot ni atmasña anae jaangoco güe ya jafacae y güinajaña.
pairs.english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y ti jumujame, contra guajo yuje; ya ayo y ti rumecocoge guiya guajo machalapon.
pairs.english: "He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn't gather with me scatters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y espiritun áplacha, anae jumuyong gui taotao, jumajanao gui anglo na lugat, manaliligao dinescansa; ya anae ti mañoda, ilegña: Bae talo guato gui guimajo anae jumanaoyo.
pairs.english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, 'I will turn back to my house from which I came out.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, jasoda mabale yan maadotna.
pairs.english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao ya mangone yan güiya otro siete espiritu mas manaelayeña qui güiya, ya jumalom ya sumaga güije: ya taelayeña y uttimoña ayo na taotao qui y finena.
pairs.english: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 47490 ¶ Ya susede anae jasangan estesija, un palaoan gui linajyan taotao, umagang ilegña nu güiya: Dichoso ayo na tuyan y chumuchulejao, yan ayo na pecho y anae sumususo jao.
pairs.english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña: junggan, lao dichosuña ayo y jumungog y sinangan Yuus, ya jaadaje.
pairs.english: But he said, "On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 29 47510 ¶ Ya anae manetnon y linajyan taotao guiya güiya, jatutujon sumangan: Este na generasion manaelaye: manmanaliligao señat; lao ti ufanmannae nu señat mas na ayoja y señat Jonas.
pairs.english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüije si Jonas y señat para y taotao Ninibe taegüijeja locue y Lajin taotao para güine na generasion.
pairs.english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raenan sanjaya cumajulo gui jaanin juisio yan y taotao este na generasion ya manquinendena; sa mato guinin y uttimon y tano para uecungog y minalate Salomon; ya estagüeja uno dangculoña qui si Salomon gaegue guine na lugat.
pairs.english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao sija guiya Ninibe, ufangajulo gui jaanin juisio yan este na generasion ya manquinendena; sa manmañotsot pot y prenedican Jonas; ya estagüe uno mas dangculoña qui si Jonas gaegue güine na lugat.
pairs.english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 33 47550 ¶ Taya ni un taotao munaaatog gui bedega y candet ni esta masonggue, ni upolo gui papa ganta, sino y candelero para todo y manjajalom ujalie y manana.
pairs.english: "No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y candet y taotao, y atadog; yaguin y atadogmo sensiyo todo y tataotaomo maninina; lao yaguin taelaye, y tataotaomo locue bula jomjom.
pairs.english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan pues sa y manana ni y gaegue guiya jago, munga jomjom.
pairs.english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn't darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina yaguin todo y tataotaomo bula manana, ni mano na lugat nae guaja jomjom, cabales na ubula manana, taegüije y yanguin malag ininaña y candet ya inina jao.
pairs.english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 37 47590 ¶ Ya mientras cumuecuentos, un Fariseo siniplicagüe na usija chumocho, ya jumalom ya matachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo ninamanman anae jalie este, pot y ti jafagase güe finena antes di uchocho.
pairs.english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña nu güiya: Pago jamyo ni Fariseo, y sumanjiyongja gui copa yan plato innagagasgas, lao y sumanjalommiyo bula inamot an tinaelaye.
pairs.english: The Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaejinaso jamyo, ada ayo y fumatinas gui sumanjiyong, ti güiya locue y fumatinas gui sumanjalom?
pairs.english: You foolish ones, didn't he who made the outside make the inside also?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y guajanmiyo naenñaejon limosña; ya estagüe na todo ufangasgas para jamyo.
pairs.english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 42 47640 ¶ Lao ay, ay jamyo Fariseo! ni infanmannae diesmos nu y yetba buena yan laruda yan todo golae; ya innafapos y tininas yan y güinaeyan Yuus. Estesija nesesita infatinas, sin pelo y pumalo.
pairs.english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay, ay jamyo Fariseo! sa ingüaeya etmas manaquilo na tachong gui sinagoga, yan y sinaluda sija gui metcado.
pairs.english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay jamyo! sa calang jamyo naftan ni ti malilie; ya y taotao sija manmalolofanja gui sumanjilo ya ti matungo.
pairs.english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don't know it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 45 47670 ¶ Ya manope un magas y lay, ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, yaguin unsangan estesija unlatdejam locue.
pairs.english: One of the lawyers answered him, "Teacher, in saying this you insult us also."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña: Ay ay jamyo locue y manmagas y lay! sa innafanmangangatga y taotao sija ni ayo na catga y macat para uchule, ya ni un calolotmiyo innainete para inayuda.
pairs.english: He said, "Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won't even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay, ay jamyo! sa infatinas y naftan, y profeta sija, ya y tatanmiyo pumuno.
pairs.english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine mantestigo jamyo, ya inconsienteja y checho y tatanmiyo; sa sija magajet pumuno, ya jamyo fumatinas y naftanñija.
pairs.english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña y minalate Yuus: Bae managoyo profeta yan apostoles para sija; ya megae guiya sija inpino yan inpetsigue:
pairs.english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, 'I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin este na generasion manesesita machule y jâgâ todo y profeta, ni manmachuda desde y tutujon y tano;
pairs.english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde jâgâ Abel, asta y jâgâ Sacharias, ni y matae gui entalo y attat yan y templo; magajet, jusangane jamyo na umanesesita machule guinin este na generasion.
pairs.english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.' Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay jamyo y manmagas y lay! sa innajanao y yaben tiningo; ya ti infanjalom jamyo yan y mangequejalom inchechema.
pairs.english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn't enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 53 47750 ¶ Ya anae jumuyong güije, y escribas yan y Fariseos sija, matutujon ma afuefuetsas ya macacase para usigue cumuentos megae;
pairs.english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maespipia, para umaquechule jafa guinin y pachotña.
pairs.english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayo na tiempo, anae mandaña megae na mit na linajyan taotao, asta managacha uno yan otro; ya jatutujon sumangane y disipuluña sija finenana: Adaje jamyo ni y libaduran y Fariseo sija ni y hipocresia.
pairs.english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya na matatampe na ti umababa; pat mananana, na ti umatungo.
pairs.english: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jafa guinin sinanganmiyo gui jemjom, umajungog gui manana; ya jafa y incuentuse gui talanga gui jalom aposento, umaagangnaejon gui jilo guma.
pairs.english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo ni y amigujo sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao ni ayo sija y pumuno y tataotao, sa an munjayan ayo, taya jafa siña ujafatinas.
pairs.english: "I tell you, my friends, don't be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo jaye inmaañagüe: Fanmaañao jamyo ni ayo y yanguin munjayan japuno, guaja ninasiñaña na uyute asta sasalaguan: Junggan, jusangañe jamyo: Fanmaañao jamyo nu güiya.
pairs.english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him, who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti mabende sinco na pajaro, pot dos na octabo? ya ni uno guiya sija mamalefañaejon gui menan Yuus?
pairs.english: "Aren't five sparrows sold for two assaria coins ? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao asta y gaponulonmiyo esta manmatufong. Chamiyo fanmaaañao: sa manbaliña jamyo qui y megae pajaro.
pairs.english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 8 47840 ¶ Ya jusangane jamyo: Jayeja y comonfesatñaejonyo gui menan y taotao sija; uquinenfesatñaejon locue ni y Lajin taotao gui menan y angjet Yuus.
pairs.english: "I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, him will the Son of Man also confess before the angels of God;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y pumuneyo gui menan taotao sija, siempre pune güe gui menan y angjet Yuus.
pairs.english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of the angels of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y cumuentos contra y Lajin taotao, umaasie; lao y chumatfino contra Espiritu Santo, ti umaasie.
pairs.english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmacone jamyo gui menan y sinagoga sija, yan y manmagas, yan y gaesisiña, chamiyo madadaje jaftaemano yan jafa para inepe, ni jafa para insangan;
pairs.english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don't be anxious how or what you will answer, or what you will say;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Espiritu Santo infanfinanagüe güije na ora jafa para insangan.
pairs.english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 13 47890 ¶ Ya uno gui linajyan taotao ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, tayo y chelujo ya ufacaeyo ni y erensia.
pairs.english: One of the multitude said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: Taotao, jaye pumoloyo gui jilomo para jues, pat para mamacae?
pairs.english: But he said to him, "Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Atan, ya inguesadaje jamyo ni y linagga: sa y linâlâ y taotao, ti guinin y manadan güinaja sija ni y jasagagaye.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man's life doesn't consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane un parabola, ilegña: y fangualuan un taotao na rico, jumujuyong megae na quineco.
pairs.english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, "The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjaso gui sumanjalomña, ilegña: Jafa jufatinas, sa taya mano nae jupolo y quinecojo.
pairs.english: He reasoned within himself, saying, 'What will I do, because I don't have room to store my crops?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Este bae jufatinas: bae jujala papa y lanchoco, ya jujatsa y mas dangculo; ya ayo nae jupolo todo y maiisso yan y güinajajo.
pairs.english: He said, 'This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jualog ni y antijo: Ante, megae güinajamo, para megae na sacan; descansa, ya unchocho, yan unguimen, yan unmagof.
pairs.english: I will tell my soul, "Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, be merry."'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
