pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus ilegña nu güiya: Taejinaso jao! pago na puenge nesesita umachule y antimo: ya para jaye ayo sija na güinaja ni unnaetnon?
pairs.english: "But God said to him, 'You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared--whose will they be?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja y manaetnon y güinaja para güiyaja, ya ti urico para si Yuus.
pairs.english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 22 47980 ¶ Ya ilegña ni y disipoluña sija: Enaomina jusangane jamyo, Chamiyo madadaje pot y linâlânmiyo, jafa para incano; ni y tataotaonmiyo, jafa para innaminagago.
pairs.english: He said to his disciples, "Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y linâlâ mas qui y nengcano, ya y tataotao mas qui y magago.
pairs.english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y aga sija, na ti manmanananom, ni ufanmangoco; ni uguaja sagannengcanoñija ni lancho; ya si Yuus janachocho sija; ya cuanto mas manmauleg jamyo qui y pajaro!
pairs.english: Consider the ravens: they don't sow, they don't reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jaye guiya jamyo pot inadaje siña uaumenta un codo y linecaña?
pairs.english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti siña inchegüe y mas diquique, para jafa inadadaje y pumalo?
pairs.english: If then you aren't able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y lirio sija, jaftaemano mandocoñiñija! ti manmachochocho, ni ufanmanjila; ya jusangane jamyo na si Salomon contodo y minalagña, ti minagago parejo yan uno guiya sija.
pairs.english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Yuus janafanminagago y chaguan qui fangualuan ni y gaegue pago, ya agupa esta mayute guato gui jetno; ti mas magajet na inninafanminagago jamyo, O jamyo didide na jinenggue?
pairs.english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo umaliligao jafa para incano, ni jafa para inguimen, ni infanbuébuente gui jinasonmiyo.
pairs.english: Don't seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo este sija na güinaja manmaaliligao ni y nasion sija gui tano: lao y tatanmiyo jatungoja na innesesita estesija na güinaja.
pairs.english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao aligao finena y raenoña; ya todo este sija na güinaja umanafandaña para jamyo.
pairs.english: But seek God's Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaaañao, jamyo diquique na manada; sa este minagof y tatanmiyo, na infanninae ni y raeno.
pairs.english: Don't be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bende y güinajamo, ya unfannae. limosna; fanmamamauleg botsa ni ti ubijo, un güinaja gui langet na ti ufatta, anae ti usineda ni y saque, ni ti upotliya.
pairs.english: Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don't grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn't fail, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae gaegue y güinajamo, ayoja nae gaegue locue y corasonmo.
pairs.english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 35 48110 ¶ Polo ya esta madudog y senturanmiyo, ya esta masonggue y candet miyo;
pairs.english: "Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanparejo yan ayo na taotao sija y jananangga y señotñija, yanguin tumalo guato guinin y guipot umasagua; sa para yanguin mato ya manyajo, umababaye enseguidas.
pairs.english: Be like men watching for their lord, when he returns from the marriage feast; that, when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija na tentago, yanguin mato y señot, mansineda manbebela; magajet jusangane jamyo, na ududog güe, ya unafanmatachong para ufañocho, ya ufalag y sumanmena ya usetbe sija.
pairs.english: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you, that he will dress himself, and make them recline, and will come and serve them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin ufato gui segundo na bela ya gui tetsero, ya mansineda sija taegüijeja, mandichoso ayo sija na tentago.
pairs.english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch, and finds them so.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este tingo na yanguin y tata gui guima mojon jatungo jafa na ora nae ufato y saque, upulan ya ti upolo na umayulang y guimaña.
pairs.english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not allowed his house to be broken into.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina nafanlisto jamyo locue, sa ufato y Lajin taotao, güije na ora gui anae ti injajaso.
pairs.english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don't expect him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 41 48170 ¶ Ayonae ilegña si Pedro: Señot, unsangan este na acomparasion para jame, pat para todos?
pairs.english: Peter said to him, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña: Jaye nae ayo y mauleg yan mejnalom na mayetdomo, ni y ninamagas ni y señotña gui güinajana, para uninanae naña gui tiempoña?
pairs.english: The Lord said, "Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso ayo na tentago y yanguin mato y señotña, sineda na jachochogüe taegüije.
pairs.english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo; na uninamagas gui jilo y güinajaña, todo.
pairs.english: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin ayo na tentago y ilegña gui jalom corasonña: Y señotjo caeja mato; ya jatutujon pumanag y famalaoan na tentago, yan y lalaje; ya chumocho, yan gumimen, ya bumolacho;
pairs.english: But if that servant says in his heart, 'My lord delays his coming,' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y señot ayo na tentago, ufato güije na jaane gui anae ti jananangga, yan gui ora anae ti jatungo, ya uninasuja, ya uninafandaña y patteña yan y ti manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn't expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn't know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na tentago y jatungo y minalago y señotña; ya ti jalisto güe, ni jafatinas jaftaemano y minalagoña, umasaulag megae.
pairs.english: That servant, who knew his lord's will, and didn't prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y ti jatungo, ya jafatinas digno na umasauleg, lao didide masaulagña. Sa jayeja y megae manaiña, siempre megae uchule, ya jaye y megae catgoña, mas megae magagaoña.
pairs.english: but he who didn't know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 49 48250 ¶ Matoyo para juyute y guafe gui jilo tano: ya jafa malagojo yanguin esta todo mañiñila?
pairs.english: "I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja tagpangeco para jumatagpange; ya jafa chachatsagajayo asta qui umacumple!
pairs.english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injajaso jamyo na matoyo para junae pas y tano? Jusangane jamyo, na aje; lao mas para inaguaguat.
pairs.english: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa desde pago sigue mona, uguaja gui un guma sinco na ti manparejo, y tres contra y dos, ya y dos contra y tres.
pairs.english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tata uaguaguat contra y lajiña, ya y laje contra y tata; ya y nana contra y jagaña, ya y jaga contra y nana; y suegra contra y yetna, ya y yetna contra y suegraña.
pairs.english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 54 48300 ¶ Ya ilegña locue ni y taotao sija: Yanguin inlilie y mapagajes na cajulo gui sumanlichan, siempre ilelegmiyo: Mamamaela y ichan; ya magajet.
pairs.english: He said to the multitudes also, "When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, 'A shower is coming,' and so it happens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin manguaefe y manglo sanjaya, ilelegmiyo: Uguaja maepe; ya ufato.
pairs.english: When a south wind blows, you say, 'There will be a scorching heat,' and it happens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manhipocrita jamyo; intingo umegsamina y langet, yan y tano; ya jafa na ti intingo umegsamina y tiempo pago?
pairs.english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don't interpret this time?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa na ni jamyo ti injisga jafa y tinas?
pairs.english: Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras jumanao jao yan y enemigumo para y magas, procura munaquelibre jao gui jinanaomo; na noseaja uninarastra guato gui jues, ya y jues uninentrega gui ofisiat, ya y ofisiat unpinelo gui calaboso.
pairs.english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jao: Ti unjanao juyong güije, asta qui unapase y uttimo na marabidi.
pairs.english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny. "

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mangaegue güije na tiempo taotao sija, ni masangane güe pot y Galileo sija, ni si Pilatos janadaña y jâgâñija yan y inefresenñija.
pairs.english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope ya ilegña nu sija: Jinasonmiyo na este sija na Galileo, mas manisao qui todo Galileo sija na japadese ayo sija?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo na aje; sa yanguin ti manmañotsot jamyo, manparejoja jamyo manáchamalingo.
pairs.english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat ayo sija y diesiocho ni y podong y tore gui jiloñija guiya Siloe ya manpinino, jinasonmiyo na mas manisao ayo sija qui todo y taotao ni y mañasaga Jerusalem?
pairs.english: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo na aje; sa yanguin ti manmañotsot jamyo, manparejoja jamyo manáchamalingo.
pairs.english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 6 48410 ¶ Ya jasangan este na acomparasion: Un taotao guaja y trongcon igos na matanme gui fangualuanña; ya anae mato para uegaga cao guaja tinegchaña, ti mañoda.
pairs.english: He spoke this parable. "A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni y lancheruña: Esta guaja tres años ni matoyo güine na trongcon igos, manegagayo tinegcha, ya taya nae mañodayo; utut papa; para jafa na jaocucupa y tano?
pairs.english: He said to the vine dresser, 'Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ilelegña nu güiya: Señot, polo pago na año ya juguadog y oriyaña, ya junaye estietcot:
pairs.english: He answered, 'Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin ufanogcha, mauleg; yanguin aje, siempre, unutut.
pairs.english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 10 48450 ¶ Ya estaba na mamananagüe gui un sinagoga, gui sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe un palaoan, na guaja un espiritun malango guiya güiya esta diesiocho años, ya esta ninaojlo, ya tisiña tumacho.
pairs.english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae linie as Jesus, inagang ya ilegña nu güiya: Palaoan, libre jao gui malangumo.
pairs.english: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, "Woman, you are freed from your infirmity."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo y canaeña gui jiloña; ya enseguidas ninatunas, ya jaalaba si Yuus.
pairs.english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y magas sinagoga lalalo sa si Jesus, numanajomlo gui sabado na jaane, ya manope ilegña nu y linajyan taotao sija: Guaja saes na jaane para ufanmachocho y taotao sija: ya este nae mauleg mato para numajomlo; lao ti y sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, "There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae inepe ni y Señot, ya ilegña: Hipocrita jamyo, ada ti siña cada uno guiya jamyo upula y gaña guaca, pat asno gui pesebre, ya ucone ya unaguimen gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: Therefore the Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña este na palaoan, ni y jagan Abraham, ni guinede as Satanas diesiocho años, manalibre gui magodeña, gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasangan estesija, todo y enemiguña ninafan mamajlao; ya todo y taotao sija ninafanmagof, pot todo y sennamagof na güinaja ni y machogüe pot güiya.
pairs.english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 48530 ¶ Pot enao ilegña: Jafa parejuña y raenon Yuus? yan jafa nae juacompara?
pairs.english: He said, "What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y granon y semiyan mustasa, ni y jachule y taotao, ya jatanme gui jalom jardinña; ya docó, ya jumuyong trongcon jayo; ya esta y pajaro sija gui langet mañaga gui ramasña.
pairs.english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña talo: Jafa nae juacompara y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Again he said, "To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y libadura, ni jachule un palaoan, ya janaatog gui tres medidan arina, asta qui todo manespongja.
pairs.english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 22 48570 ¶ Ya jumajanao gin chalaña, malag y siuda sija, yan y sengsong mamananagüe, ya jumajananao para Jerusalem.
pairs.english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña uno nu güiya: Señot, didide manmasatba? si Jesus ilegña nu sija,
pairs.english: One said to him, "Lord, are they few who are saved?" He said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefprocura mangejalom gui maiot na potta; sa jusangane jamyo na megae prumocucura mangejalom, lao ti mansiña.
pairs.english: "Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y magas y guima jayasja cajulo ya jajuchom y petta, ya intitujon jamyo manmanojgue gui sumanjiyong ya inyajo y petta, ya ilegmi miyo: Señot, babayejam: ya ufanope ya ualog nu jamyo: Ti jutungo manguinemano jamyo:
pairs.english: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, 'Lord, Lord, open to us!' then he will answer and tell you, 'I don't know you or where you come from.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya intitujon umalog: Guinin mañochojam yan manguimenjam gui menamo, yan mamanagüe jam gui cayenmame.
pairs.english: Then you will begin to say, 'We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ualog: Jusangane jamyo, na ti jutungo manguinemano jamyo: fañuja guiya guajo, todos jamyo ni y chumogüe y tinaelaye.
pairs.english: He will say, 'I tell you, I don't know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae uguaja cumasao, yan chegcheg nifen, yanguin inlie si Abraham, yan si Ysaac, yan si Jacob, yan todo y profeta sija, gui raenon Yuus; ya jamyo infanmachoneg juyong.
pairs.english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in the Kingdom of God, and yourselves being thrown outside.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufanmato manguinen y sancatan yan y sanlichan, yan y sanlago yan y sanjaya; ya ufanmatachong gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in the Kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe na guaja manuttimo ya ufanfinenana, y guaja manfinenana ya ufanuttimo.
pairs.english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 48660 ¶ Ya ayo na ora, manmato Fariseo sija ya ilegñija nu güiya: Janao ya unsuja güine; sa malago si Herodes na unpinino.
pairs.english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, "Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Janao, sangane ayo na sora, na estagüe, na juyute juyong y anite sija, yan manaamteyo pago na jaane yan agupa, ya y mina tres na jaane ufonjayanyo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Go and tell that fox, 'Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao nesesita jufamocat pago yan agupa yan y inagpaña, sa ti siña na ufalingo y profeta gui Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can't be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jerusalem! Jerusalem! ni y unpuno y profeta sija, yan unfagas ni acho ayo sija y manmatago para güiya! cuanto biaje malagoyo na junafandaña y famaguonmo, taegüije y ponidera janafandaña y poyitasña gui papa papaña, ya timalago jamyo!
pairs.english: "Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na manmapoluye jamyo ni y guimanmiyo taetaotao; ya jusangane jamyo: Ti inliiyo, asta qui mato ayo na tiempo anae inalog: Dichoso ayo y mamamaela ni y naan y Señot.
pairs.english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede na anae jumalom gui guima un magas Fariseo, para uchocho pan, gui sabado na jaane, ya sija maespipiaja.
pairs.english: It happened, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, un taotao gaegue gui menaña na malango binaya.
pairs.english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ya jacuentuse manmagas y lay, yan y Fariseo sija, ilegña: Tunas numajomlo gui sabado na jaane pat aje?
pairs.english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manmamatquiquiloja. Ayonae jacone güe, ya janajomlo, ya jasotta na ujanao.
pairs.english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaope sija ilegña: Jaye guiya jamyo, yanguin guaja gaña asno pat guaca, podong gui jalom tupo, ada ti enseguidas ujatsa gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: He answered them, "Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn't immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña talo manmanope ni estesija.
pairs.english: They couldn't answer him regarding these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 7 48770 ¶ Ya jasangan un acomparasion ni y manmaconbida, anae jaatituye ni y jaayig y mas managquilo na tachong gui lamasa; ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin quinenbida jao ni un taotao para y guipot, chamo fatatachong gui mas tagquilo na tachong; sa ufato otro na mas onrao qui jago, ni y quinenbidaña locue;
pairs.english: "When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don't sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufato y cumonbida jao ya ualog nu jago: Nae este lugat y este taotao; ya ayonae untutujon mumamajlao yanguin sumaga jao gui mas uttimo na lugat.
pairs.english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, 'Make room for this person.' Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin quinenbida jao, janao ya fatachong gui mas tagpapa na lugat; sa yanguin mato y cumonbida jao, ualog nu jago: Amigo, janao falag iya jululo; ya ayonae unguaja inenra gui menan ayo sija y mangachongmo ni y manmatachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, 'Friend, move up higher.' Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y manataquilo maesa güe, unaumitde güe ya y umunaumitde güe, umanataquilo.
pairs.english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 12 48820 ¶ Ya ilegña nu ayo y guinin cumonbida güe: Yanguin mamatinas jao nataloane pat sena, chamo umagagange y manamigumo sija, ni y mañelumo, ni y manparientesmo, ni y manrico na tiguangmo; sa noseaja unmaconbida locue talo, ya unmaapase.
pairs.english: He also said to the one who had invited him, "When you make a dinner or a supper, don't call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin gumupot jao, agange y mamoble, yan y manmanco yan y mancojo, yan y manbachet;
pairs.english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya undichoso; sa ti siña maapase jao; lao unmaapase gui quinajulo y manunas.
pairs.english: and you will be blessed, because they don't have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 15 48850 ¶ Ya anae jajungog este, uno gui mangachongña ni y manmatachong gui lamasa, ilegña nu güiya: Dichoso ayo y uchocho pan gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, "Blessed is he who will feast in the Kingdom of God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: un taotao jafatinas un dangculon sena, ya mangonbida megae:
pairs.english: But he said to him, "A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y tentagoña gui oran sena, na ualog ni ayo sija y manmaconbida: Nije; sa esta todo listo.
pairs.english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, 'Come, for everything is ready now.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon cada uno umescusa güe. Y fenenana ilegña: Mamajanyo un pidason tano, ya nesesitayo jujanao ya julie; jugagao jao na unescusayo.
pairs.english: They all as one began to make excuses. "The first said to him, 'I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y otro ilegña: Mamajanyo sinco pares na nobiyo para mancareta, ya bae jujanao ya juchague: jugagao jao na unescusayo.
pairs.english: "Another said, 'I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y otro ilegña: Umasaguayo, ya enaomina ti siñayo mato.
pairs.english: "Another said, 'I have married a wife, and therefore I can't come.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumalo guato y tentago, ya janatungo y senotña nu este sija. Ayo nae y magas y guima ninagoslalalo, ya ilegña ni y tentagoña: Janao, lasajyao falag y caye sija yan y chalan gui siudad, ya uncone mague y mamoble, yan y mancojo, yan y manbachet, yan y manmanco.
pairs.english: "That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña y tentago: Señot, esta mafatinas y tinagomo, ya trabia guaguajaja lugat.
pairs.english: "The servant said, 'Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y señot ilegña ni y tentagoña: Janao falag y dangculo na chalan yan y lugat ni y guaja ngangao, ya unafuetsas sija, ya ufanjalom para ubula y guimajo.
pairs.english: "The lord said to the servant, 'Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jusangane jamyo, na ni uno güije sija gui guinin manmaconbida, uchague y senajo.
pairs.english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 25 48950 ¶ Ya mañisija mangaegue yan un dangculon manadan taotao; ya jabira güe, ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja un taotao mato guiya guajo, ya ti jachatlie si tataña, yan si nanaña, yan y asaguaña, yan y famaguonña, yan mañeluña lalaje, yan y mañeluña famalaoan, yan y linâlâña locue, ti siñagüe disipulujo.
pairs.english: "If anyone comes to me, and doesn't disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can't be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ti cumatga y quiluusña, ya dumalalag yo; ti siñagüe disipulojo.
pairs.english: Whoever doesn't bear his own cross, and come after me, can't be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaye guiya jamyo, ujaso manjatsa un tore, ya ti ufatachong finena ya utufong y para gastoña cao siña uninafunjayan?
pairs.english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn't first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa noseaja yanguin esta japolo y simiento, ya ti siña janafunjayan; todo y lumie jatutujon manmanbotlea nu güiya,
pairs.english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: Este na taotao jatutujon manjatsa, ya ti siña janafunjayan.
pairs.english: saying, 'This man began to build, and wasn't able to finish.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jaye y ray, anae jajanao para uguera contra y otro ray, ti ufatachong finena, ya ufañangane cao siña güe yan y dies mit, utagam y mamamaela yan veinte mit contra güiya?
pairs.english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Patseno, mientras chachagoja y otro trabia, janajanao un compañia, ya ufangagao pas.
pairs.english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue; masquesea jaye guiya jamyo y ti rumechasa todo y güinajaña; ti siñagüe disipulujo.
pairs.english: So therefore whoever of you who doesn't renounce all that he has, he can't be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y asiga mauleg; lao yanguin malingo y asiga maasenña, jaftaemano manasne?
pairs.english: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti mauleg para y tano, ni para fanyútian basula; masenyuteja ni y taotao. Jaye y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya uecungog.
pairs.english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA manjijijot guato guiya güiya, todo y publicano, yan y manisao, para umaecungog güe.
pairs.english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangogonggong y Fariseo sija, yan y escriba ilelegñija: Este na taotao, jaresisibeja y manisao, ya mañisijaja mañocho.
pairs.english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, "This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangane sija ni este na acomparasion, ilegña:
pairs.english: He told them this parable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye na taotao guiya jamyo, y yanguin guaja gaña siento na quinilo, ya ufinalingaeguan ni y uno, ada ti ujanao ya udingo y nobentainuebe gui desierto asta qui jasoda ayo y malingo?
pairs.english: "Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn't leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda, jaapagaye ya jamagogofgüe.
pairs.english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guimaña, jaagange todo y manamiguña, yan y tignangña, ya ilelegña nu sija: Nije tafanmagof, sa jagasja jusoda y gajo quinilo ni y guinin malingo.
pairs.english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na taegüenaoja locue uguaja gui langet, minagof yanguin un taotao na isao mañotsot, mas qui y nobentainuebe manunas na taotao ni y ti janesesita manmañotsot.
pairs.english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 8 49130 ¶ Pat, jaye na palaoan, y yanguin uguaja iyoña dies na pidason salape, ya ufinalingaeguan ni y uno; ada ti usonggue y candet ya ubale y jalom guma, ya uguesaligao asta qui usoda?
pairs.english: Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn't light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin esta jasoda, jaagange y manamigaña, yan y tiguangña ya mandaña, ya ilelegña: Nije tafanmagof, sa jagasja jusoda y pidason salape ni y guinin malingo.
pairs.english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, 'Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue jusangane jamyo, na uguaja minagof gui menan y angjet Yuus, pot y un taotao na isao ni y mañotsot.
pairs.english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 11 49160 ¶ Ya ilegña: Un taotao guaja dos lajiña:
pairs.english: He said, "A certain man had two sons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mas patgon, ilegña as tataña: Tata, naeyo ni y patteco gui güinaja ni y para guajo. Ya jafacae para sija ni y güinajaña.
pairs.english: The younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of your property.' He divided his livelihood between them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti megae na jaane malofan, anae y mas patgon janafandaña todo, ya mapos asta y chago na tano; ya jagasta todo y güinajaña güije gui guipot yan bisio di gula.
pairs.english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jagasta todo esta: mato un dangculon ñinalang güije na tano, ya jatutujon taena.
pairs.english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao, ya jatituye gui un taotao güije na tano: ya tinago para y fangualuanña, para unachocho babue sija.
pairs.english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatatanga na unabula tiyanña ni y lasas frijoles ni y jacacano y babue sija; ya taya ni un taotao numanaegüe.
pairs.english: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae numalo y jinasoña, ilegña: Cuanto na jotnaleron tata, mangaena pan, ya manmañoñobblaja, ya guajo güine jumatae ñalang!
pairs.english: But when he came to himself he said, 'How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough to spare, and I'm dying with hunger!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jucajulo ya jujanao para as tata, ya jualog nu güiya: Tata, umisaoyo contra y langet, yan contra jago,
pairs.english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, "Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti dignoyo mas na jumafanaan lajimo: naparejoyo yan y jotnalerumo sija.
pairs.english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants."'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo, ya mapos para as tataña. Lao chagoja trabia, si tataña linie güe, ya ninamaase, ya finalagüe, ya tinegtog, ya chinicogüe.
pairs.english: "He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y patgon ilegña as tataña: Tata, umisaoyo contra y langet, yan contra jago; ti dignoyo mas na jumafanaan lajimo.
pairs.english: The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tata ilegña ni y tentagoña sija: Chule y mas mauleg na magago ya umanaminagago; ya umapolo y aniyu gui calolotña, yan y sapatos gui adengña:
pairs.english: "But the father said to his servants, 'Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umacone mague un tatnero ni y mas yomog, ya umapuno ya tafañocho ya tafanmagof;
pairs.english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este y lajijo guinin matae, ya lâlâ talo; guinin malingo, ya masoda. Ya jatutujon sija manmagof.
pairs.english: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.' They began to celebrate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lajiña ni y mas amco estaba gui fangualuan; ya anae guaguato ya esta jijot gui guima, jajungog y dandan yan y manbabaila:
pairs.english: "Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang uno gui tentago sija, ya jafaesen jafa ayo sija.
pairs.english: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Y chelumo mato; ya si tatamo japuno y tatnero ni y mas yomog, sa jaresibe gae seguro yan sano.
pairs.english: He said to him, 'Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninagoslalalo, ya ti malago jumalom: ayonae jumuyong si tataña, ya siniplica na ujalom.
pairs.english: But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ilegña as tataña: Estagüe, megae na año nae jusesetbe jao, ya taya nae ti jaosgue jafa na tinagomo: lao taya nae unnaeyo un patgon chiba para infanmagof yan y manamigujo sija:
pairs.english: But he answered his father, 'Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mato este na lajimo ni y jalachae todo y güinajamo gui manputa sija; unpunueja ni y mas yomog na tatnero.
pairs.english: But when this, your son, came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Lajijo, siempre jumijitaja; ya todo y güinajajo iyomo.
pairs.english: "He said to him, 'Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mauleg para utafanmagof ya utafanalegria: sa este y chelumo guinin matae, ya lâlâ talo; yan guinin malingo, ya esta masoda.
pairs.english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ilegña locue ni y disipuluña sija: Guaja un taotao na rico, ya guaja mayetdomuña; ya este mafaaela guiya güiya na jagasta y güinajaña.
pairs.english: He also said to his disciples, "There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janamaagange, ya ilegña nu güiya: Jafa este y jujujungog guiya jago? Fannae cuenta pot y mayetdomumo, sa ti siña jao mumayetdomo mas.
pairs.english: He called him, and said to him, 'What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y mayetdomo, ilegña gui sumanjalomña: Jafa jufatinas? sa y señotjo unajanaoyo gui mayetdomujo: Taya minetgotto para ufanguadog; mamajlaojo umogagao.
pairs.english: "The manager said within himself, 'What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don't have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jutungo esta jafa jufatinas, para yanguin manajanaoyo gui mayetdomujo, jumaresibeyo gui guimañija.
pairs.english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang cada uno gui manmadidibe ni y señotña, ya ilegña ni y finenana: Cuanto undidibe y señotjo?
pairs.english: Calling each one of his lord's debtors to him, he said to the first, 'How much do you owe to my lord?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Siento na medidan laña. Ayonae ilegña nu güiya: Chule y cuentamo ya unfatachong guse ya untugue sincuenta.
pairs.english: He said, 'A hundred batos of oil.' He said to him, 'Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña talo ni y otro: Ya jago, cuanto dibimo? Ilegña: Siento na medidan trigo. Ylegña talo: Chule y cuentamo ya untugue ochenta.
pairs.english: Then he said to another, 'How much do you owe?' He said, 'A hundred cors of wheat.' He said to him, 'Take your bill, and write eighty.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaalaba y señot y taelaye na mayetdomo; sa pot y jagostungo chumogüe: sa y famaguon este na tano, manmejnalomña y generasionñija, qui y famaguon y manana.
pairs.english: "His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: He wouldn't for a while, but afterward he said to himself, 'Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña: Ecungog jafa y ti tunas na jues ilelegña.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti unalibre si Yuus y inayigña, ni y maaagang güe jaane, yan puenge, ya apmam na jasungon pot sija?
pairs.english: Won't God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na enseguidas unafanlibre. Lao anae ufato y Lajin taotao, ufañoda jinenggue gui jilo tano?
pairs.english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"

pairs.chamorro: N 18 9 50140 ¶ Ya jasangan este na acomparasion ni ayo sija y umangocon maesa sija na manunas, ya jadespresia y pumalo:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dos na taotao jumanao julo gui templo para ujafanaetae: Y un Fariseo, ya y otro publicano.
pairs.english: "Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Fariseo tumojgue, ya taegüine tinaetaeña gui sumanjalomña: Junae jao grasias Yuus, sa ti parejoyo yan y pumalo na taotao, ni y manáplacha, yan manábale, ni y este publicano.
pairs.english: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: 'God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortioners, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Umayuyunatyo dos biaje gui semana; mannanaeyo diesmos ni y todo güinajajo.
pairs.english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y publicano gaegue na tumotojgue gui chago; ya ti jaguesjatsa y atadogña julo gui langet; lao jaseseco y pechoña, ya ilelegña: Yuus, gaease nu guajo, sa taotao isaoyo.
pairs.english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn't even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, 'God, be merciful to me, a sinner!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na, este na taotao jumanao papa y guimaña, ya maasie y isaoña, mas mauleg qui y otro; sa cada uno y minadangculo güe, uninaumitde; ya y munamitde güe, umanadangculo.
pairs.english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 15 50200 ¶ Ya maconie guato guiya güiya ni y diquique na famaguonñija, para upacha; ya anae manlinie ni y disipulo sija, manmalalatde.
pairs.english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jaagang sija, ya ilegña: Polo y diquique na famaguon ya ufanmamaela guiya guajo, ya chamiyo chumochoma; sa iyon este sija y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus summoned them, saying, "Allow the little children to come to me, and don't hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na y ti rumesibe y raenon Yuus taegüije y diquique na patgon, ti ujalom güije.
pairs.english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 18 50230 ¶ Ya un taotao na magas, finaesen güe ilelegña: Mauleg na Maestro, jafa jufatinas para juereda y taejinecog na linâlâ?
pairs.english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, "Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Jafa na ilegmo nu guajo mauleg? taya mauleg na unoja, si Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus asked him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one--God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utungo y tinago sija: Chamo umábale, Chamo famumuno, Chamo fañañaque, Chamo sumasangan y ti magajet na sinangan, Onra si tatamo, yan nanamo.
pairs.english: You know the commandments: 'Don't commit adultery,' 'Don't murder,' 'Don't steal,' 'Don't give false testimony,' 'Honor your father and your mother.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Todo este sija juadaje desde y pinatgonjo.
pairs.english: He said, "I have observed all these things from my youth up."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog este sija si Jesus, ilegña nu güiya: Guaja uno fattamo trabia: bende todo y güinajamo, ya unfacae y mamobble, ya uguaja güinajamo gui langet, ya maela dalalagyo.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jajungog estesija, ninágostriste; sa gosrico güe.
pairs.english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae linie as Jesus, ilegña: Namanminapot ayo sija y mangaegüinaja manjalom gui raenon Yuus!
pairs.english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guseña malofan un cameyo gui matan y jaguja, qui ujalom un rico gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y jumungog, ilegñija: Jaye nae siña satbo?
pairs.english: Those who heard it said, "Then who can be saved?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Y güinaja ni y ti mansiña para y taotao sija; mansiña para as Yuus.
pairs.english: But he said, "The things which are impossible with men are possible with God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña si Pedro: Estagüeja na indingo y iyonmame, ya indalalag jao.
pairs.english: Peter said, "Look, we have left everything, and followed you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na taya ni un taotao ni y dumingo guma, pat asagua, pat mañelu, pat mañaena, pat famaguon, pot y raenon Yuus,
pairs.english: He said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God's sake,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti uresibe mas megae pago na tiempo, lao y mamamaela na tiempo, taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 31 50360 ¶ Ya jacone y dose, ya ilegña nu sija: Estagüe, na manjajanaojit julo Jerusalem, ya todosija y tinigue y profeta sija pot y Lajin taotao, ufanmacumple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa nesesita na umaentrega gui taotao juyong, ya umabotlea, yan umafaesegnane, yan umatolae:
pairs.english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umasaulag, ya umapuno; ya y mina tres na jaane, ucajulo talo.
pairs.english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo ni uno gui este sija: ya este na sinangan manaatog guiya sija, ya ni ti jatungo jafa sija y masangan.
pairs.english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn't understand the things that were said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 35 50400 ¶ Ya susede anae esta jijijot Jerico, estaba un taotao bachet gui oriyan chalan na matatachong, ya umógagao:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog y linajyan taotao na manmalolofan, mamaesen jafa ayo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane güe, na si Jesus Nasareno malolofan.
pairs.english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: He cried out, "Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machoma ni y manmofona para ufamatquilo: lao mas umagang megae: Jago ni y Lajin David, gaease nu guajo.
pairs.english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "You son of David, have mercy on me!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumojgue si Jesus, ya manago na umaconie guato guiya güiya: ya anae esta jijijot, finaesen:
pairs.english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa malagomo jufatinas guiya jago? Ya güiya ilegña: Señot, para jufanlie.
pairs.english: "What do you want me to do?" He said, "Lord, that I may see again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu güiya: Fanlie: y jinengguemo unsinatba.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas jaresibe y liniiña, ya jadalalag güe, yan janamalag si Yuus; yan todo y taotao sija, anae malie, maalaba si Yuus.
pairs.english: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jumalom si Jesus, ya malofan inanaco Jerico.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago mona, ya umeculo gui trongcon sicomoro para ulie: sa nesesita na ufapos güije.
pairs.english: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato si Jesus güije na lugat, manatan julo, ya ilegña nu güiya: Saqueo, tunog lasajyao, sa pago na, jaane nesesita na jusaga gui guimamo.
pairs.english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumajyao papa, ya jaresibe güe yan y minagofña.
pairs.english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie este, todos mangonggong, ilegñija: Mapos, para usaga gui isao na taotao.
pairs.english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, "He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Saqueo tumojgue ya ilegña ni y Señot: Estagüe, Señot, y lamita gui güinajajo junae y mamobble sija; ya yanguin guaja chinelejo pot finababa bae junae cuatro talo.
pairs.english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, "Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu güiya: Pago na jaane mato y satbasion güine na guma; sa güiya locue Lajin Abraham.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Lajin taotao mato para ualigao, yan usatba y manmalingo.
pairs.english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 11 50590 ¶ Ya mientras majujungog este sija, jaaumenta ya jasangan un acomparasion, sa pot y esta jijijot Jerusalem, yan pot y jinasonñija na enseguidas ufato y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este na ilegña: Un taotao na magas, jumanao para y chago na tano para uresibe y raeno, yan para utaloja guato.
