pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang y dies na tentagoña, ya jaentrega dies na minan moneda, ya ilegña nu sija: Nafangagana asta qui ufato.
pairs.english: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, 'Conduct business until I come.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotaoña gui güije na tano machatlie güe, ya manmanago un compañia guato guiya güiya, ilegñija: Mungajam na ufangobietna este na taotao gui jilo mame.
pairs.english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, 'We don't want this man to reign over us.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae esta jaresibe y raeno, tumalo guato, ya manago na ufanmaagange y tentago sija ni y janae ni y salape, para utungo cuanto cada uno güinanaña.
pairs.english: "It happened when he had come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y finenana, ilegña: Señot, y minamo mangana dies na mina mas.
pairs.english: The first came before him, saying, 'Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Mauleg na finatinasmo, mauleg jao na tentago. Pot y tunas jao gui didide, guaja ninasiñamo gui jilo y dies na siuda.
pairs.english: "He said to him, 'Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y mina dos, ilegña: Señot, y minamo mangana sinco na mina.
pairs.english: "The second came, saying, 'Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya locue ilegña nu güiya: Jago gui jilo sinco na siuda.
pairs.english: "So he said to him, 'And you are to be over five cities.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato y otro ilegña: Señot, estagüe y minamo na juadaje ya jupolo gui jalom y setbiyetas:
pairs.english: Another came, saying, 'Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa maañaoyo nu jago, sa recto jao na taotao: unchuchule y ti unpolo, ya uncococo y ti untanom.
pairs.english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn't lay down, and reap that which you didn't sow.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: For they can't die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y manmatae ni umanafangajulo, asta si Moises mamanue gui finajalomtano, anae jafanaan y Señot, Yuus Abraham yan Yuus Ysaac yan Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord 'The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti güiya Yuus manmatae, na manlâlâ: sa todosija manlala guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanope palo gui escriba sija ilegñija: Maestro, mauleg sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Some of the scribes answered, "Teacher, you speak well."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo, ti matatnga mafaesen güe talo jafa.
pairs.english: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 41 51370 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na ilegñija na si Cristo lajin David?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Why do they say that the Christ is David's son?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiyaja si David umalog gui leblon y Salmos: Y Señot ilegña ni y Señotjo, Fatáchong gui agapa na canaejo,
pairs.english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta qui jupolo y enemigumo sija para fañajangan y adengmo.
pairs.english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet."'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna si David finanaan güe Señot, ya jaftaemano mina ulajiña?
pairs.english: "David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 45 51410 ¶ Ya majujungogja ni y taotao sija, anae ilegña ni y disipuluña:
pairs.english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo ni y escriba sija, sa yanñija manmamocat yan y anaco na magago, yan yanñija manmasaluda gui plasa, yan y finénana na tachong gui sinagoga sija; yan y finénana na saga gui guipot;
pairs.english: "Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jalachae y guima y biuda sija, yan manmamanunue ni y anaco tinaetaeñija pot taya; estesija ujaresibe mandangculo na sinentensia.
pairs.english: who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manatan julo, jalie y manrico na taotao sija, na jayuyute jalom y ninaenñija gui cajon salape.
pairs.english: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie locue un pobble na biuda, na manyute jalom güije dos coble.
pairs.english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jusangane jamyo ni y magajet. Este y pebble na biuda, manyute jalom mas qui todo sija:
pairs.english: He said, "Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo estesija, y sebblanñijaja manmayute jalom minaeñija: lao este yan y pinebbleña, jayute todo jalom y güinajaña.
pairs.english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 5 51480 ¶ Yan pot y manguecuentos palo pot y templo, ni y maadotna manbonito na acho sija yan ninae sija, ilegña:
pairs.english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija na güinaja y inlie, estagüe, ufanmato jaane sija, na taya usobbla güine un acho gui jilo y otro, na ti umayute papa.
pairs.english: "As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 7 51500 ¶ Ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija: Maestro, ngaean nae ujuyong estesija? yan jafa na señat uguaja, yanguin jijot para ufanmato este sija na güinaja?
pairs.english: They asked him, "Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña: Guesadaje jamyo ya chamiyo fanmafabábaba: sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ujaalog: Güiya yo ya y tiempo esta jijijot; chamiyo dumalálalaque sija.
pairs.english: He said, "Watch out that you don't get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he ,' and, 'The time is at hand.' Therefore don't follow them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin injingog y guera sija, yan y atboroto, chamiyo faninespápanta: sa nesesita ufanmato este sija finena; lao y uttimo ti enseguidas.
pairs.english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don't be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won't come immediately."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 10 51530 ¶ Ayo nae ilegña nu sija: Y nasion sija ufangajulo contra y nasion, ya y raeno contra raeno:
pairs.english: Then he said to them, "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uguaja dangculon linao, ya y cada lugat ñinalang yan peste; yan uguaja minaañao sija, yan mandangculo na señat guinin y langet.
pairs.english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao antes di todo este sija, ujapolo y canaeñija gui jilomiyo, ya infanmapetsigue, yan infanmaentrega gui sinagoga sija, yan y catset, yan infanmacone guato gui ray sija, yan y manmagas pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ujuyong este guiya jamyo para testimonio.
pairs.english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo gui corason miyo, na chamiyo jumajaso finena jafa para inepe:
pairs.english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo junae jamyo pachot yan tiningo, ni todo y enimigunmiyo ti siña macontra ni umachaba.
pairs.english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanenentrega ni y mañaenanmiyo, yan y mañelunmiyo, yan y parientesmiyo, yan y amigonmiyo; yan guaja guiya jamyo umanamapuno.
pairs.english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmachatlie ni todo y taotao pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ni uno gui gaponulonmiyo ufalingo.
pairs.english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manpasensianmiyo nae, inganaye y antenmiyo.
pairs.english: "By your endurance you will win your lives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae inlie Jerusalem, na esta ineriyaye ni y sendalo sija, intingoja na esta jijijot y mayulangña.
pairs.english: "But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae y mangaegue guiya Judea, ufanmalago para y egso sija; ya ayo sija y mangaegue gui entaloña ufanjuyong; ya y mangaegue gui fangualuan, chañija fanjajalom güije.
pairs.english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este sija y jaanin inemog, sa para umacumple todo y güinaja ni y esta manmatugue.
pairs.english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mannamaase ayo sija y manmapotgue, yan y mannanasusu güije sija na jaane! sa uguaja dangculon chinatsaga gui jilo tano, yan binibo gui jilo este taotao sija.
pairs.english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufamodong gui jilo y filon y espada, ya ufanmacone preso gui todo y nasion: ya Jerusalem umagacha papa ni y Gentiles, asta qui umacumple y tiempon y Gentiles.
pairs.english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 25 51680 ¶ Ya uguaja señat sija gui atdao yan y pilan, yan y pution sija; yan chinatsagan nasion sija gui jilo tano pot y guinadon pangpang y tase yan y napo.
pairs.english: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manlalalango y taotao sija, pot y manmaañaoñija, yan pot y ninanangga ni ayo sija y manmamamaela para y tano: sa manmayengyong y ninasiñan y langet sija.
pairs.english: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae ujalie y Lajin taotao na mamamaela gui y mapagajes yan y ninasiña yan y dangculon minalag.
pairs.english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta jatutujon sumesede este sija, ayonae infanalag jilo, ya injatsa julo y ilunmiyo; sa esta jijijot y para inmanafanlibre.
pairs.english: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 29 51720 ¶ Ya jasangane sija un acomparasion, ilegña: Atanja y trongcon igos, yan todo y trongcon jayo sija.
pairs.english: He told them a parable. "See the fig tree, and all the trees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin esta manmañúñuso, inlie ya intingoja maesa jamyo na esta jijijot y verano.
pairs.english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue jamyo yanguin inlie esta sija na masusede, tingo na esta jijijot y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Ti ufapos este na generasion, asta qui todo sija manmacumple.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet yan y tano ufanmalofan, lao y finojo ti ufalofan.
pairs.english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 34 51770 ¶ Ya inguesadaje jamyo na ufanbula y corasonmiyo ni y pinadog mañocho yan inelacho, yan y inadajen este na linâlâ, ya ufato guiya jamyo ayo na jaane derepente,
pairs.english: "So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijeja y laso: sa taegüijeja ufinatoña gui jilo todo sija y mañasaga gui jilo tano.
pairs.english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina fanbela todo tiempo, ya infanmanaetae, ya para infansiña manescapa ni todo estesija y ni ufanmato, yan para infanojgue gui menan y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 37 51800 ¶ Ya mamananagüe cada jaane gui templo; yan cada puenge jumajanao, ya sumasaga gui un ogso na mafanaan ogso Olibo.
pairs.english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija manmafato gui templo, taftaf gui egaan, para umaecungog güe.
pairs.english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae estaba jijijot y jaanin y guipot y pan ni taelibadura, ni mafanaan pascua.
pairs.english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magas mamale yan y escriba sija maaliligao jaftaemano para umapuno güe; lao manmaañao ni y taotaosija.
pairs.english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 3 51840 ¶ Ya jumalom si Satanas gui as Judas y apeyiduña Iscariote, uno gui numerou y dose.
pairs.english: Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maposgüe, ya manguentos yan y magas mamale, yan y manmagas, jafataemano para uinentrega guiya sija.
pairs.english: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmagof, ya matratos na umanae salape.
pairs.english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manpromete ya jaaliligao lugat para uqueentrega guiya sija, yanguin manaegüe y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 7 51880 ¶ Ya mato y jaanin y taelibadura na pan, anae nesesita umaofrese y pascua.
pairs.english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago si Pedro yan Juan, ilegña: Janao ya innalisto y pascua para jita, para utafañocho.
pairs.english: He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija nu güiya: Mano malagomo nae innalisto?
pairs.english: They said to him, "Where do you want us to prepare?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Estagüe, anae manjalom jamyo gui siuda, infanasoda güije yan un taotao, na mañuñule un jarran janom; dalalaque güe jalom mano na guma nae jumalom.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inalog ni y gaéguima: Y Maestro ilegña nu jago: Manggue y aposento anae para juchocho gui pascua yan y disipulujo sija?
pairs.english: Tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanfinanue ni y dangculo na aposento gui sanjilo todo cabales: ayonae innalisto.
pairs.english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao ya masoda jaftaemano y mansinangane sija; ya manalisto para y pascua.
pairs.english: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 14 51950 ¶ Ya anae mato y ora, matachong papa mañija yan y dose na apostoles.
pairs.english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jagasja juguefdesea na utafañocho guine na pascua antes di jufamadese:
pairs.english: He said to them, "I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jusangane jamyo: Ti juchocho mas, asta qui macumple gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Herodes yan y sendaluña, madespresia yan mabotlea, yan manaminagago ni lamlam na magago, ya manatalo guato as Pilatos.
pairs.english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pilatos janaetnon y magas y mamale, yan y magalaje yan y taotao sija,
pairs.english: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Inquene mague guiya guajo este na taotao na janaquequelache y taotao sija; ya, estagüe, na jufaesen gui menanmiyo, ya taya jusoda ni jafa na isao güine na taotao pot y finaaelamimiyo sija.
pairs.english: and said to them, "You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aje, ni si Herodes: sa junafalag iya güiya, ya, estagüe, ni jafa na ufanmerese na finatae pot y guinin finatinasña.
pairs.english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina bae jucastiga ya jusotta.
pairs.english: I will therefore chastise him and release him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manesesita na umasotta uno gui guipot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mapreso pot un jatsamiento yan mamuno ni y jafatinas gui siuda.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: but they shouted, saying, "Crucify! Crucify him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija gui mina tres biaje: Sa jafa? jafa na taelaye finatinasña este na taotao? Taya ni jafa na causa para umapuno jusoda guiya güiya. Pot este na rason bae jucastigaja ya jusotta.
pairs.english: He said to them the third time, "Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija enseguidas janadangculo inagangñija, ya magagao na umaatane gui quiluus. Ya y inagangñija mangana.
pairs.english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pilatos janae sentensia na ufatinas taemano y guinagaoñiñija.
pairs.english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masotta ayo y guinin mapreso pot jatsamiento yan mamuno, ayo y guinin magagagao: ya manmaentrega as Jesus gui minalagoñija.
pairs.english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 27 52790 ¶ Ya matatitiye ni y dangculon linajyan taotao yan famalaoan sija ni mangacasao yan manatangis pot güiya.
pairs.english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jabira güe tate guiya sija ilegña; Famalaoan Jerusalem, chamiyo fangacasao pot guajo, lao fangacasao pot jamyoja yan pot y famaguonmiyo.
pairs.english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don't weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, na ufato sija jaane nae umaalog: Mandichoso sa y manmachora, yan y tiyan sija ni ti manmamañago, yan y pecho sija ni ti manmamómogsae.
pairs.english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae matutujon maalog ni egso sija: Famodong gui jilonmame; ya y sabana sija: Tampe jam.
pairs.english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and tell the hills, 'Cover us.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin y betde na jayo jafatinas estesija, y anglo, jafa uchogüe?
pairs.english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 32 52840 ¶ Ya macone locue dos palo na taelaye finatinasñija para ufanmapuno yan güiya.
pairs.english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato güije na lugat ni mafanaan Calabera, maatane gui quiluus güije yan ayo y dos ni y taelaye finatinasñija, uno gui agapa ya y otro gui acagüe.
pairs.english: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña: Tata, asie estesija; sa ti jatungo jafa jachochogüe. Ya manafacae entre sija y magaguña, ya marifa.
pairs.english: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing." Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija manotojgue ya maaatanja. Ya mabotlelea ni y magas sija locue, ya ilelegñija: Ufañatba otrosija: palo ya usatban maesagüe, yaguin este si Cristo, ni guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, "He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamofefea ni y sendalo sija, manmato guiya güiya, ya mafanunue ni y binagle.
pairs.english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Yaguin jago Ray y Judio sija, satban maesa jao.
pairs.english: and saying, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja locue un tinigue gui jiloña: ESTE GUIYA Y RAY Y JUDIO SIJA.
pairs.english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uno gui ayo y taelaye finatinasñija ilegna: Yaguin jago si Cristojao? Satban maesajao yan jame.
pairs.english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, "If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao inepe ni otro, ya linalatde ilegña: Ti maañao jao as Yuus, sa gaegue jao gui mismo sinentensia?
pairs.english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, "Don't you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita magajet na tunas; sa utafanresibe pot y finatinasta: lao este na taotao, taya taelaye finatinasña.
pairs.english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jesus, jajaso yo yaguin matojao gui raenomo.
pairs.english: He said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña nu güiya: Magajet jusangane jao: Pago mismo na jaane utajita na dos guiya Paraiso.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae buente y oran a las sais, jumuyong jomjom todo y jilo y tano asta y oran a las nuebe,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y atdao jomjom, ya y cottinan templo maipe gui talo.
pairs.english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae umagang si Jesus, ni dangculo na inagang, ilegña: Tata, y canaemo nae jupolo y espiritujo; ya anae munjayan jasangan este, jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" Having said this, he breathed his last.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 47 52990 ¶ Ya anae jalie y senturion estesija y manmalofan, janamalag si Yuus, ilegña: Sen magajet este na taotao na tunas.
pairs.english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous man."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y atungoña yan y famalaoan ni tumatitiye güe desde Galilea, manestaba manlachago maatanja este sija.
pairs.english: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for the Kingdom of God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LAO y finenana na jaane gui semana, gui taftataf gui egaan, manmato gui naftan, mapmañuñule guato paopao ni y finamaulegñija.
pairs.english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masoda y acho na esta managalileg gui pettan y naftan.
pairs.english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüe güine, lao esta cajulo: jaso y mansinangane jamyo, anae estataba Galilea,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Na nesesita na y Lajin taotao umaentrega gui canae y taotao sija ni manisao, y umaatane gui quiluus, ya ucajulo talo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jajaso sija y sinanganña,
pairs.english: They remembered his words,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija japolo na taetiningo, y sinanganñija ya ti majonggue.
pairs.english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn't believe them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 12 53200 ¶ Ayonae cajulo si Pedro, ya malago asta y naftan: ya anae ñumejon ya jaatan jalom, jalilie y sabanasja gui un lugat, ya mapos güe iyasija ya ninamanman nu este y manmalofan.
pairs.english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 13 53210 ¶ Ya, estagüe, dos guiya sija na jumajanao, güijeja na jaane, para un songsong ni naanña Emmaus, sesenta estadios desde Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cumuecuentos y dos mona pot todo estesija y masusede.
pairs.english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae cumuecuentos y dos, ya manafaesen entre sija, mato si Jesus ya mañisija manjanao.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y atadogñija calang manmatampe, para chañija tumutungo güe.
pairs.english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na cuentosmimiyo uno yan otro, anae manajanao jamyo, ya mañaga ya ninafantriste?
pairs.english: He said to them, "What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe ni ayo y uno ni y naanña si Cleofas ya ilegña nu güiya: Ada sumagaja jao guiya Jerusalem, ya ti untungo jafa manmalofan güine sija na jaane?
pairs.english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, "Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things which have happened there in these days?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña nu sija: Jafa sija? Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Ayo sija iyon si Jesus Nasareno, ni profeta güe ni gaeninasiña gui checho yan y sinangan gui menan Yuus yan todo y taotao sija;
pairs.english: He said to them, "What things?" They said to him, "The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maentrega, gui magas mamale yan y magalajenmame para umasentensia ni y finatae, ya maatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jame innanangga sa güiya y para unafanlibre y Israel. Junggan, yan mas qui todo este, pago esta mina tres na jaane desde que masusede estesija.
pairs.english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan locue palo famalaoan ni mangachongmame janamanman jam sa manmato gui naftan gui taftataf gui egaan;
pairs.english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti masoda y tataotaoña, manmato guiya jame ilegñija na manmanlie sija y liniin angjet sija, ni y jasnangane na lâlâgüe.
pairs.english: and when they didn't find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamjanao guato gui naftan palo gui mangachongmame ya masoda taemanoja y sinangan y famalaoan; lao ti malie güe.
pairs.english: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: O taotao manaetiningo jamyo, yan y ñateng y corasonmiyo para injenggue todo y sinangan y profeta sija!
pairs.english: He said to them, "Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti nesesita na si Cristo ufamadese nu este sija ya taegüine nae ujalom gui minalagña?
pairs.english: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon desde as Moises, yan y profeta sija, y jasangangane claro todo ni tinigue ni y pot güiya.
pairs.english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui sengsong ni jajananagüe güije; ya jasigue para mas chago jinanaoña.
pairs.english: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija janasaga fuetsao, ilegñija: Maela tafañaga sa este puenge ya jocog y jaane; ya jumalom para usaga mañisija.
pairs.english: They urged him, saying, "Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over." He went in to stay with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, anae matachong gui lamasa yan sija, jachule y pan ya jabendise, ya jaipe ya manninae.
pairs.english: It happened, that when he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manmababa atadogñija ya matungo güe; lao güiya jamalingoja gui inatanñija.
pairs.english: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija entre y dos: Ada ti sinenggue y corasonta gui sumanjalomta mientras jacuentutusejit gui chalan, yan anae jababayejit ni y tinigue?
pairs.english: They said one to another, "Weren't our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cumajulo y dos güije na ora, ya tumalo guato Jerusalem: ya masoda y onse mandadaña, yan y manestaba mangachongñiñija,
pairs.english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilelegñija: Magajet, esta cajulo y Señot, na umalie yan si Simon.
pairs.english: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae sija jasangane nu este sija y masusede gui chalan; yan jafa taemano, tungoñija anae jaipe y pan.
pairs.english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 36 53440 ¶ Ya mientras manguecuentos nu este sija, güiya tumojgueja gui entaloñija, y ilegña nu sija: Pas guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, "Peace be to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manmaañao ya manmajngang ya jinasonñija na manmanlie sija un espiritu.
pairs.english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na ninafanestotba jamyo? Ya jafa na cumajulo y jinasonmiyo gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: He said to them, "Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanja y canaejo yan y adengjo, sa guajo mismoyo: pacha yan inlie sa y espiritu taecatne ni tolang, taegüije inliija na guajayo,
pairs.english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see that I have."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasangan este, manfinanue ni y canaeña yan y adengña.
pairs.english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti jajonggue sija pot minagofñija, ya ninafanmanman, güiya ilegña nu sija: Guaja güine jafa para utacano?
pairs.english: While they still didn't believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija janae un pedason güijan na mapeja.
pairs.english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule ya jacano gui menanñija.
pairs.english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 44 53520 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Este sija na sinangan ni y jusangangane jamyo anae manjijita: taemanoja na nesesita na umacumple todo y esta matugue gui lay Moises yan y profeta sija, yan y Salmos pot guajo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manbinaba y jinasoñija para ujatungo y tinigue;
pairs.english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Taegüine esta matugue, na si Cristo ufamadese ya ucajulo talo guinin y manmatae gui mina tres na jaane;
pairs.english: He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapredica gui naanña y sinetsot yan inasiin isao, gui todo y nasion sija, umatutujon desde Jerusalem.
pairs.english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo testigo nu estesija na güinaja.
pairs.english: You are witnesses of these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, na bae jutago y promesan y Tatajo gui jilo miyo: lao jamyo fañaga gui siuda guiya Jerusalem, asta que manminagago jamyo ni y ninasiña guinin iya jululo.
pairs.english: Behold, I send forth the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 50 53580 ¶ Ya manquinene juyong asta Betania; ya jajatsa y canaeña ya manbinendise sija.
pairs.english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae manbinendise, jaapatte güe guiya sija ya machule julo gui Langet.
pairs.english: It happened, while he blessed them, that he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jaadora ya manalo guato Jerusalem yan y dangculon minagofñija;
pairs.english: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue siempre gui templo, manmanbendidise as Yuus. Amen.
pairs.english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tutujonña gaegue y Finijo, ya y Finijo güiya yan si Yuus; ya y Finijo güiya si Yuus.
pairs.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya gaegue gui tutujonña yan si Yuus.
pairs.english: The same was in the beginning with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y güinaja sija manmafatinas pot güiya; yaguin ti pot güiya, taya ni esta mafatinas, nu y gaegue gui finatinas sija.
pairs.english: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linâlâ gaegue guiya güiya, ya y linâlâ, güiya y candet y taotao sija.
pairs.english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y candet gui jalom jomjom maniina, ya y jemjom ti matungo.
pairs.english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn't overcome it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y un taotao ni manafato guine as Yuus, y naanña si Juan.
pairs.english: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya mamaela para testimonio, para ufannae testimonio nu y candet, para ufanmanjonggue todo y taotao pot güiya.
pairs.english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti y candet, lao mamaela para ufannae testimonio nu y candet.
pairs.english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y magajet na candet ni maniina y todo taotao, na mamamaela güine gui tano.
pairs.english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya gaegue gui tano, ya y tano mafatinas pot güiya, ya y tano ti matungo güe.
pairs.english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn't recognize him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya mato gui iyoña ya iyoña ti marisibe güe.
pairs.english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn't receive him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y rumesibe güe, güiya janae ninasiñanñija para ufamaguon Yuus; junggan, para todo ni y jumonggue y naanña.
pairs.english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children, to those who believe in his name:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmalilis ti guinin y jâgâ, ya ti guinin y minagof y catne, ya ti guinin minagof y taotao, lao guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na Finijo mamacatne ya sumaga guiya jita (ya talie y minalagña, ayo na minalag taegüije y linilisja gui tata), bula y grasia yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manae testimonio nu güiya ya umagang ya ilegña: Güiya ayo y jusasangan: y mamaela gui tateco, güiya dangculoña qui guajo, sa güiya finenena qui guajo.
pairs.english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, "This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui binilaña manmañulijit todo, yan y grasia pot y grasia.
pairs.english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinago sija pot si Moises esta manae, lao y grasia yan y minagajet, pot si Jesucristo namanmato.
pairs.english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, taya taotao lumie, taya na tiempo, ayo na Lajiña, y linilisja, na gaegue san jalom y pechon tata, güiya jafanue jit nu güiya.
pairs.english: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y testimonien Juan, anae y Judio sija manafanmato nu y mamale yan Lebita sija, guine Jerusalem, ni manmafasen: Jago, jaye jao?
pairs.english: This is John's testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jaconfesatñaejon ya ti japune, lao jaconfesatñaejon, ilegña: Guajo ti Jesucristo yo.
pairs.english: He declared, and didn't deny, but he declared, "I am not the Christ."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen: Jafa nae? Jago si Elias? Ya ilegña: Ti guajo yo. Jago ayo na profeta? Ya manope: Aje.
pairs.english: They asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the prophet?" He answered, "No."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegñija nu güiya: Jaye jao? para siñajam infanmanope ni y tumago jam. Jafa ilelegmo nu jago namaesa?
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Guajo inagang yo nu y umaagang gui desierto; natunas y chalan señot, taegüije ilegña si Esaias profeta.
pairs.english: He said, "I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' as Isaiah the prophet said."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija ni namanmato ni y guinin Fariseo sija.
pairs.english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafafaesen güe ya ilegñija nu güiya: Sajafa na managpangejao, yaguin ti jago si Jesucristo, ni si Elias, ni y ayo na profeta?
pairs.english: They asked him, "Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manope ilelegña: Guajo managpagpange an janom; mas y entalo miyo, guaja uno na ti intingo.
pairs.english: John answered them, "I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don't know.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este uje y mamaela gui tateco, y mas dangculo qui guajo, ya guajo ti dignoyo na jupula ni y coreas y sapatosña.
pairs.english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to loosen."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija finatinas guiya Betania y otra banda gui Jordan, anae managpagpange si Juan.
pairs.english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 29 53900 ¶ Y siguiente na jaane jalie si Juan si Jesus na mamaela para iya güiya ya ilegña: Estagüe y corderon Yuus na janajanao y isao gui tano.
pairs.english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este yuje ileo, na y tateco mamamaela un laje y dangculoña qui guajo, sa güiya finenena qui guajo.
pairs.english: This is he of whom I said, 'After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti jutungo; lao para umafanue y Israel nu güiya, enao mina mato yo yan managpagpange yo an janom.
pairs.english: I didn't know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manae testiomonio ilegña: Julie y Espiritu ni tumutunog guinin y langet, taegüije y paluma ya sumaga gui jiloña.
pairs.english: John testified, saying, "I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti jutungo güe, lao y munamamaela yo para ufanagpange an janom, ayo sumangane yo: Sobre ayo na unlie na tumunog y Espiritu ya sumaga guiya güiya, este uje y managpagpange ni Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: I didn't recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, 'On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo julie ya manae yo testimonio nu y güiya y Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 35 53960 ¶ Y siguiente na jaane tumalo manmatojgue si Juan yan dos gui disipuluña.
pairs.english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 36 53970 ¶ Ya Jaatan si Jesus ni mamomocat güije, ya ilegña: Estagüe y Corderon Yuus.
pairs.english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya majungog ni dos na disipuluña comequentosña yan madalalag si Jesus.
pairs.english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabira güe si Jesus ya jalie na madadalalag güe nu sija ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa inaliligao? Ya sija ilegñija: Rabi (este finijo comequeilegña, gui chamorro, Maestro) manu sagamo?
pairs.english: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, "What are you looking for?" They said to him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), "where are you staying?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: mamaela ya unlie. Manmamaela ya jalie manu nae sumaga ya mañagaja yan güiya, güije na jaane, sa jijut y ora y mina dies.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Come, and see." They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Andres y chelun Simon Pedro, güiya uno gui dos y jumungog umadingan an Juan, yan madalalag güe.
pairs.english: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jasoda finena y cheluña as Simon, ya ilegña nu güiya: Tasoda y Mesias (ni y cumequeilegña: güiya si Cristo).
pairs.english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah!" (which is, being interpreted, Christ ).

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone guato as Jesus; anae inatan as Jesus ilegña: Jago Simon, patgon Jonas: jago mafanaan Sefas (cumequeilegña: acho).
pairs.english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is by interpretation, Peter).

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y siguiente na jaane, malago si Jesus malag Galilea, ya jasoda si Felipe, taotao Betsaida, gui siudan Andres yan Pedro.
pairs.english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, "Follow me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Felipe jasoda si Nataniel ya ilegña nu güiya: Esta tasoda ayo y jatugue si Moises gui tinago yan y profeta, Jesus, taotao Nasaret y patgon José.
pairs.english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, "We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Nataniel: Guinin Nasaret siña jumuyong minauleg? Ylegña si Felipe: maela ya unlie.
pairs.english: Nathanael said to him, "Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jalie mamaela para iya güiya, si Nataniel, ya ilegña nu güiya: Estagüe senmagajet iyon Israel, na taya finababa guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Nataniel: Guine manu na untungo yo? Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Antes di si Felipe uninagang, na gaegue jao gui papa y ygos, guajo julie jao.
pairs.english: Nathanael said to him, "How do you know me?" Jesus answered him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
