pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Nataniel ya ilegña: Rabi, jago uje y lajin Yuus, jago uje y ray guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Nathanael answered him, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Sa jusangane jao, na julie jao gui papa y ygos, ya unjonggue? Jago unlie mandangculoña na güinaja qui este.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Because I told you, 'I saw you underneath the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, y mamaela na tiempo nae unlie y langet mababa ya y angjet sija guine as Yuus mangajujulo yan manututunog gui jilo y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: He said to him, "Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mina tres na jaane, mafatinas y guipot umasagua, gui Cana, siudan Galilea, ya y nanaña si Jesus gaegue güije.
pairs.english: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus yan y disipuluña maagange locue para y guipot umasagua.
pairs.english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae taya y bino, y nanaña si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Taya binoñija.
pairs.english: When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no wine."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pot jafayo na juentalo nu jago, palaoan? trabia ti mafato y orajo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si nanaña ilegña ni manmañeñetbe: Fatinas todo y tinagoña.
pairs.english: His mother said to the servants, "Whatever he says to you, do it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y estaba güije saes lauyan acho, parejoja yan y guinasgasñija y Judios, na manulat, cada uno, dos pat tres cantaro.
pairs.english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Nafanbula este sija lauyan janom. Ya manafanbula asta y pachot.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Fill the water pots with water." They filled them up to the brim.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chile pago ya innae y maestrosala; ya machule.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast." So they took it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y maestrosala jachague y janom na mafatimas bino, ya ti jatungo guine mano: (lao y manmañeñetbe tumungo, na jachule y janom), y maestrosala jaagange y nobio;
pairs.english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Todo y taotao janafofona y mauleg na bino; ya yaguin esta manjaspog, ayo nae y mas manaelaye: lao jago unnanana y mauleg na bino asta pago.
pairs.english: and said to him, "Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na tutujon y señatña sija, jafatinas si Jesus, guiya Cana suidan Galilea, ya janamatungo y minalagña; ya y disipuluña sija majonggue güe.
pairs.english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Despues di este tumunog guiya Capernaum, güiya yan y mañeluña yan y disipuluña sija, ya mañaga güije ti megae na jaane.
pairs.english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 54240 ¶ Y estaba güije jijot y pascuan y Judios, ya si Jesus cajulo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasoda gui guimayuus manmanbebende y nubiyo yan y quinilo, yan y paluma, yan y manmanulalaeca manmatatachong:
pairs.english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaolag ni tale, ya janafanmalago todo gui guimayuus, yan y quinilo, yan y nubiyo; yan y machapon y salape y manmanulalaeca, yan manaalinquin y lamasa,
pairs.english: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money, and overthrew their tables.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni manmanbebende ni paluma: Nafanjanao güine este sija na güinaja, ya chamiyo fumatitinas y guima tata, guima namajan.
pairs.english: To those who sold the doves, he said, "Take these things out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manmanjaso y disipuluña ni estaba matugue: Ynigo y guimamo cumano yo.
pairs.english: His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for your house will eat me up."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 18 54290 ¶ Y Judio sija manmanope ya ilegñija; Jafa na señat unfanuejam taegüije ayo, sa jago unfatinas este sija na güinaja?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore answered him, "What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ya ilegña: Yulang este na gumayuus, ya y tres na jaane; junacajulo talo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y Judio sija ilegñija: Gui cuarentaisaes años manacajulo este na gumayuus, ya jago, gui tres na jaane, unacajulo?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said, "It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya umadingan ni guima tataotaoña.
pairs.english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae cajulo guine manmatae, y disipuluña jajaso na munjayan jasangane este, ya manmanjonggue ni tinigue sija yan y sinangan ni jasangan si Jesus.
pairs.english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 23 54340 ¶ Ya, güiya gaegue guiya Jerusalem gui pascua, y jaane ni guipot, ya megae manmanjonggue ni naanña, anae malie sija y señatña sija ni jafatinas.
pairs.english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus namaesa, ti jaangoco güe guiya sija, sa güiya jatungo todo taotao,
pairs.english: But Jesus didn't trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya nesesida na jaye unae testimonio ni taotao, sa güiya tumungo y guaja gui jalom taotao.
pairs.english: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA guaja un taotao Fariseo na naanña si Nicodemo, prinsipe y Judiosija.
pairs.english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este mato gui as Jesus gui puenge ya ilegna nu güiya: Rabi, jame intingo na jago maestro guine as Yuus, sa taya siña fumatinas este sija na señat, ni unfatitinas, yaguin ti sumisija yan Yuus.
pairs.english: The same came to him by night, and said to him, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jao, na y ti mafañago talo, ti siña jalie y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can't see the Kingdom of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Nicodemo: Jafa muna siña y taotao mafañago yaguin este biju; siña güe jumalom dos biaje, talo gui jalom y tiyan nanaña ya umafañago?
pairs.english: Nicodemus said to him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, na y ti mafañago ni janom yan ni iyon Espiritu, ti siña jumalom gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can't enter into the Kingdom of God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y mafañago ni guine catne, catneja güe; ya y mafañago guine Espiritu, espirituja güe.
pairs.english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo ninamamanman ni jusangane jao: Y nesesita jamyo na mafañago talo.
pairs.english: Don't marvel that I said to you, 'You must be born anew.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manglo manguaefe mano malagoña, ya unjungog y bengbengña, lao ti untungo guine manu mague, ni tampoco para manu guato. Taegüenao todo ayo y manmafañago guine Espiritu.
pairs.english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don't know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Nicodemo manope ya ilegña: Jafa muna siña este?
pairs.english: Nicodemus answered him, "How can these things be?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jago un maestro guiya Israel ya ti untungo este?
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, Y tatungo, tasangan; ya y talie tadeclara, ya ti inresibe y testimoniota.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don't receive our witness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jusangane jao güinajan tano, ya ti unjonggue, jafa taemano unjonggue yaguin jusangane jao güinajan langet?
pairs.english: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya cajulo gui langet, güiyaja y tumunog guine y langet, güiya matungo, y Lajin taotao ni y gaegue gui langet,
pairs.english: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaf taemanoja si Moises janacajulo y serpiente gui desierto, taegüijeja na nesesita na y Lajin taotao umanacajulo.
pairs.english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para todo ayo y jumonggue güe, ti siña malingo, ya guaja linâlâña na taejinecog.
pairs.english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 16 54520 ¶ Sa taegüenao na jaguaeya si Yuus y tano, janae ni linilisja Lajiña y para todo ayo y jumonggue güe, ti siña malingo, ya guaja linâlâña na taejinecog.
pairs.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jatago si Yuus y Lajiña guato gui tano, para usapit y tano, lao para y tano unalibre pot güiya.
pairs.english: For God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumonggue güe, ti umasapit; ayo y ti jumonggue güe ayo umasapit, sa ti manjonggue ni naan unoja na Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este na sinapit, na y inina malag y tano, ya y taotao sija gaonñija y jemjom qui y inina, sa y finatinasñija taelaye.
pairs.english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo ayo y fumatinas y taelaye, chatlie y inina, ya ti malag y inina, sa y chechoña no sea umareprende.
pairs.english: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn't come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y fumatinas y magajet, malag y inina, para y unamatungo finatinasña, sa y finatinasña guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 22 54580 ¶ Despues di estesija, mato si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija, gui un tano Judea ya gaegue güije yan sija managpange.
pairs.english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Managpapange locue si Juan, guiya Enon, jijot guiya Salim, sa gaegue güije megae na janom: ya sija manmamaela, ya manmatagpange.
pairs.english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan trabia ti mapopolo gui catset.
pairs.english: For John was not yet thrown into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja un inaguaguat entre sija yan y disipulon Juan yan y Judio sija pot y guinasgas.
pairs.english: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui as Juan, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Rabi, ayo y gaegue güije guinin iya jago, gui otro banda Jordan ni unnae testimonio, estagüe! na jatagpange, yan y todo y taotao manmato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: They came to John, and said to him, "Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Juan ilegña: Ti siña y taotao manresibe jafa, yaguin ti manae guine y langet.
pairs.english: John answered, "A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyoja innae testimonio na guinin jusangan: Ti guajo si Jesucristo, lao guajo matago gui menaña.
pairs.english: You yourselves testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but, 'I have been sent before him.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja asaguaña, güiya y nobio locue; lao amigon nobio, ni y tomotojgue ya jajujungogja, ya magof dangculo pot y sinangan y nobio. Taegüine pues este minagofjo esta macumple.
pairs.english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya siempre, lumálamodong; ya guajo manaladiquique.
pairs.english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 31 54670 ¶ Y guinin jila mague, güiya mas taquilo qui todo; ya y iyon y tano, tanoja güe, ya iyon y tanoja jasasangan; ya y mamaela guine langet, güiya iyajululo.
pairs.english: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tanae testimonio, nu y lumie ya jajungog, ya taya rumesibe y testimonioña.
pairs.english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y rumesibe y testimonioña, este sumeyo na si Yuus, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinago as Yuus, y fino Yuus jasangan; sa si Yuus ti mannanae güe ni y Espiritu pot medida.
pairs.english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tata yaña y Lajiña ya todo y güinaja japolo gui canaeña.
pairs.english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumonggue y Lajiña guaja taejinecog na linâlâ; ya ayo y ti manjonggue y Lajiña, ti ulie linâlâ, lao y binibon Yuus gaegue gui jiloña.
pairs.english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won't see life, but the wrath of God remains on him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE y Señot jatungo, na Fariseo sija manmanjungog, na si Jesus jafatinas disipuluña ya jatagpange megaeña qui si Juan.
pairs.english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Achogja ti si Jesus namaesa matagpange, lao y disipuluñaja),
pairs.english: (although Jesus himself didn't baptize, but his disciples),

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadingo guiya Judea, ya mapos talo malag Galilea.
pairs.english: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janesesita na umalofan inanaco Samaria.
pairs.english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato pues gui un siudan Samaria, na mafanaan Sicar, jijot gui fangualuan na si Jacob janae si José, lagiña.
pairs.english: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güine y tipo Jacob. Enaomina si Jesus, sa yayas güe guinin y chalan, matachong gui oriyan y tipo. Güenao na ora cana a las saes.
pairs.english: Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour .

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato un palaoan Samaria para ufanlupog janom; ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Naeyo ya juguinem.
pairs.english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give me a drink."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y disipuluña manmapos para y siuda, para ufanmamajan nengcano.
pairs.english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan Samaria: Jaftaemano na jago y Judio jao, ya untagojit najunaguinemjao, ya guajo palaoan Samaria? (Sa y Judio sija ti manatungo yan y taotao Samaria).
pairs.english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, "How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin untungo y ninaeña si Yuus yan jaye güe y sumangane jao, naeyo ya juguinem: jago ungagao güe ya güiya unninae janom lalâlâ.
pairs.english: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, 'Give me a drink,' you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan ilegña nu güiya: Señot, taya siña unlupog, sa y tipo tadong: amano pues nae guaja jao ni y janom lalâlâ.
pairs.english: The woman said to him, "Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada dangculoña jao qui y tatanmame as Jacob, ni y numaejam nu este na tupo, ya güiya gumiguinem yan famaguonña, yan y gaña gâgâ sija?
pairs.english: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Jaye y guminem nu este na janom, güiya umajo talo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered her, "Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y guminem uje na janom y junae güe, para todo y tiempo ti umajo; ya ayo na janom y guajo junae güe, güiya y janom tupo, ni jumuyong para linâlâ na taejinecog.
pairs.english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan: Señot, naeyo nu este na janom para ti siñayo majo, ni jutalo mague para jufanlupog.
pairs.english: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water, so that I don't get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Janao agange y asaguamo, ya unmamaela güine mague.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y palaoan ya ilegña nu güiya: Taya asaguajo. Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Mauleg sinanganmo na ilegmo. Taya asaguajo.
pairs.english: The woman answered, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You said well, 'I have no husband,'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sinco jagas asaguamo; ya pago y gaegue guiya jago, ti güiya y asaguamo: este unsangan pot minagajet.
pairs.english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya y palaoan: Señot, pineloco nu jago, profeta jao.
pairs.english: The woman said to him, "Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tatanmame manmanadodora güine gui jalomtano, ya jamyo ilegmiyo, na iya Jerusalem, ayo na lugat, siempre nae umafatinas y adorasion.
pairs.english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Palaoan, jonggue yo sa ufato y ora, na ti este na jalomtano, ni iya Jerusalem, inadora jamyo si Yuus Tata.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo inadora ti intingo. Jame inadora y tiningomame, sa y satbasion y Judio sija güiya.
pairs.english: You worship that which you don't know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jaane umamaela, ya güiya güe pago, nae y magajet na manmanadododora, uje adodora si Yuus Tata gui espiritu yan y minagajet; sa si Yuus Tata, locue jaaliligao ayo sija y umadodora güe.
pairs.english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshippers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, güiya Espiritu, ya y umadora güe, siempre jaadora güe y espiritu yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan: Guajo jutungo na y Mesias umamaela (ayo y naanña si Cristo); yaguin mato güe, güiya ufanagüejit todo.
pairs.english: The woman said to him, "I know that Messiah comes," (he who is called Christ). "When he has come, he will declare to us all things."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajoyo, ni umadingangane jao.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "I am he, the one who speaks to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 27 54990 ¶ Ya pot este manmato y disipuluña ya ninafanmanman pot y umadingan yan y palaoan: ya ni uno siña umalog: Jafa finaesesenmo? pat, pot jafa uncuentutuse güe?
pairs.english: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, "What are you looking for?" or, "Why do you speak with her?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao y palaoan japolo y batdeña, ya mapos malag y siuda, jasangane y taotao sija ya ilegña:
pairs.english: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmamaela ya inlie un taotao ni sumangane yo todo y finatinaso! Güiya buente si Cristo?
pairs.english: "Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmapos gui siuda, ya manmalag as Jesus.
pairs.english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na tiempo magagagao güe ni disipulo sija, ilegñija: Rabi, chocho!
pairs.english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña na sija: Guaja najo nengcano na jamyo ti intingo.
pairs.english: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you don't know about."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y disipulo sija ilegñija entre sija: Buente guaja chumulilie naña?
pairs.english: The disciples therefore said one to another, "Has anyone brought him something to eat?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y nengcanojo y jufatinas y minalago ayo y tumago yo, ya magpo chechoña.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti ilegmiyo: Guaja trabia cuatro na meses nae ufato y quineco? Estagüe na jusangane jamyo: Fanalagquilo y matanmiyo ya inatan y fangualuan sija, sa esta manapaca para quineco.
pairs.english: Don't you say, 'There are yet four months until the harvest?' Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mangoco uresibe y apasña, ya uchule y tinegcha para taejinecog na linâlâ; para ayo y mangoco, ya ayo y manananom mandaña gui minagof.
pairs.english: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este macumple y sinangan: uno manananom ya y otro mangongoco.
pairs.english: For in this the saying is true, 'One sows, and another reaps.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jamyo tumago para infanmangoco ya ti jamyo chumogüe; otro manmachocho ya jamyo manjalom gui chechoñija.
pairs.english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven't labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 39 55110 ¶ Ya megae na taotao Samaria, taotao güije na siuda, manmanjonggue nu güiya pot y sinangan y palaoan, sa manae testimonio na ilegña: Jasangane yo todo ni y finatinasjo.
pairs.english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, "He told me everything that I did."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae y taotao Samaria manmato guiya güiya, magagao na usaga ya ufandaña; ya güiya sumaga güije dos na jaane.
pairs.english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmanjonggue nu güiya gofmegae pot y sinanganña.
pairs.english: Many more believed because of his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu y palaoan: Pago ti pot y finomo na injenggue; sa jame mismo injingog güe, ya intingo na este, güiya y magajet na Salvadot y tano.
pairs.english: They said to the woman, "Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 43 55150 ¶ Ya depues di dos na jaane, jumanao güije ya malag Galilea.
pairs.english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Potjafa na si Jesus mismo manae testimonio, na y profeta gui tanoña taya onraña.
pairs.english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este anae malag Galilea, y taotao Galilea maresibe güe sa malie todo y finatinasña guiya Jerusalem, na jafatinas gui tiempo y guipot; sa sija locue manmalag y guipot.
pairs.english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 46 55180 ¶ Mato, otro biaje, si Jesus, guiya Cana siuda guiya Galilea, nae y jafatinas bino y janom: ya guaja güije un magalaje na y lajiña malango guiya Capernaum.
pairs.english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog na si Jesus, jumanao gui Juda ya tumunog para Galilea, mapos güe malag as Jesus, ya jagagao na utunog guiya Capernaum, ya uamte y lajiña, sa esta cumequematae.
pairs.english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin ti inlie señat sija, yan y ninamanman sija, ti injenggue.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to him, "Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña y magalage nu güiya: Señot, tunog lasajyao, antes qui umatae y lajijo!
pairs.english: The nobleman said to him, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu güiya: Janao, sa y lajimo lâlâ! Jajonggue y taotao y sinangan Jesus ni y sinangane güe, ya mapos.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Go your way. Your son lives." The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae güiya tumutunog, y familiaña matagam güe ya masangane na ilegñija, Na y lajimo lâlâ!
pairs.english: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying "Your child lives!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamaesen jafa na ora y lajiña na mumauleg, ya ilegñija: Nigap gui las siete na ora pinelo ni calenturaña.
pairs.english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatungo y tataña enao na ora nae sinangane güe as Jesus, Y lajimo lâlâ; ya güiya namaesa jajonggue yan todo y familiaña!
pairs.english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives." He believed, as did his whole house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y mina dos na señat, na jafatinas si Jesus, anae jinanaoña guiya Judea, para Galilea.
pairs.english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan este sija, guaja gupot y Judio sija ya si Jesus cajulo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya Jerusalem, jijot gui petta quinilo sija, guaja un tangque janom na mafananaan gui fino Hebreo, Betesda, na guaja sinco potta.
pairs.english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, "Bethesda," having five porches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manestaba güije megagae na manmalango: bachet, mangojo, yan mansogsog.
pairs.english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije un taotao na esta malofan treinta y ocho años na malango.
pairs.english: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linie as Jesus na umaason, ya anae jatungo na amam na tiempo, ilegña nu güiya: Malago jao na umagong?
pairs.english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to be made well?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe güe ni y malango: Señot, taya jaye yo unninajalom gui tangque y tiempo nae y janom sigue ni calalamten, ya anae jumajanaoyo, otro tumunog antes qui guajo.
pairs.english: The sick man answered him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, another steps down before me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sinanangane as Jesus: Cajulojao, jatsa y camamo ya unjanao!
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Arise, take up your mat, and walk."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas magong y chetnot ayo na taotao, ya jajatsa y camaña ya mapos. Lao ayo na jaane sabado.
pairs.english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 10 55350 ¶ Ylegñija y Judio sija nu y manamagong: Sabado, este na jaane, ti tunas unchule y camamo!
pairs.english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe: Ayo y munamagong yo, güiya namaesa sumangane yo: jatsa y camamo ya unjanao.
pairs.english: He answered them, "He who made me well, the same said to me, 'Take up your mat, and walk.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mafaesen güe: Jaye enao na taotao y sumangane jao, na unjatsa y camamo yan unjanao?
pairs.english: Then they asked him, "Who is the man who said to you, 'Take up your mat, and walk'?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y guinin minamagong güe, ti jatungo jaye; sa si Jesus esta mapos, sa gaegue güije na lugat, un linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: But he who was healed didn't know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sineda güe despues as Jesus, gui templo, ya ilegña: Estagüe esta magong jao; chamo umiisao talo no sea na taelayeña qui este ufato guiya jago.
pairs.english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na taotao mapos, ya jasangane Judio sija na si Jesus ninamagong y chetnotña.
pairs.english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na rason, y Judio sija madulalag si Jesus, sa y jafatinas este na güinaja gui sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Jesus maninepe: Si tatajo jafatitinas asta pago, yan guajo locue jufatitinas.
pairs.english: But Jesus answered them, "My Father is still working, so I am working, too."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na rason y Judio sija japrocura mas dangculo para ujapuno, say ti janainaleja y sabado na jaane, lao pot y jasangan locue na si Yuus güiya y tataña; jafatitinas güiyaja parejo yan si Yuus.
pairs.english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 19 55440 ¶ Entonses si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Ti siña y Lajiña jafatinas jafa pot güiya namaesa, lao jafa y jalie finatinas y tata; sa todo y finatinasña, taemanoja y Lajiña locue fumatinas.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore answered them, "Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata yaña y Lajiña ya jafanue nu güiya todo ni jafatitinas; ya jafanue nu güiya y checho ni mandangculo, ya jamyo unfanmanman.
pairs.english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao si Tata janafangajulo y manmatae ya jananae linâlâñija, taegüije locue y Lajiña janae y linâlâ, jaye malagoña.
pairs.english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata taya jaye jajujusga, lao todo y juisio, janae y Lajiña.
pairs.english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para todo ufanmanonra ni Lajiña jaf taemanoja jaonra y Tata. Ya y ti umonra y Lajiña, ti jaonra si Tata ni tumago güe.
pairs.english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn't honor the Son doesn't honor the Father who sent him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y jumungog y sinanganjo, ya jumonggue ayo y tumago yo, guaja linâlâfia taejinecog; ya ti ufato gui sinapet; lao esta malofan guine y finatae para y linâlâ.
pairs.english: "Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn't come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y ora mamamaela, ya pago esta; na y manmatae sija ujajungog y inagang Lajin Yuus; ya ayo sija y jumungog, ufanlâlâ.
pairs.english: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God's voice; and those who hear will live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüine y Tata guaja linâlâfia guiya güiyaja; taegüineja janae locue y Lajiña, para uguaja linâlâña guiya güiyaja:
pairs.english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janae locue ninasiñaña para ufatinas juisio, sa güiya y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo ninafanmamanman ni este: sa y ora mamamaela, na todo ayo sija y mangaegue gui naftan, umajungog y inagangña,
pairs.english: Don't marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao juyong; y fumatinas mauleg, ufanjuyong gui quinajulo para linâlâ; ya ayo sija y fumatinas taelaye, y quinajulo para sinapit.
pairs.english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 30 55550 ¶ Ti siña yo namaesa mamatinas jafa: taemanoja y jiningogco, ayoja jujusga, sa y juisioco tunas, sa ti jualiligao y minalagojo; lao y minalago y tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don't seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin mannae yo testimonio nu guajo namaesa, y testimoniojo ti magajet.
pairs.english: "If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja otro na mannanae testimonio. nu guajo; ya guajo jutungo na y testimonioña, ni y ninaiña pot guajo, magajet.
pairs.english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo manmatago para as Juan, ya güiya mannae testimonio ni magajet;
pairs.english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y testimonio ni juresibe, ti guinin y taotao: lao jusangane estesija, para jamyo infanlibre.
pairs.english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y lámpara ni masonggue ya maniina; ya jamyo infanmalago manmagof didide na tiempo gui candetña.
pairs.english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y testimonio ni gaegue guiya guajo mas dangculo qui y gaegue gui as Juan; sa y finatinas ni y Tata numaeyo para umacumple, ayo na finatinas na guajo jufatinas; este jatestifica nu guajo, nu y Tata tumago yo.
pairs.english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tata locue ni y tumago yo, güiya namaesa mannae y testimonio nu guajo. Jamyo tat nae injingog bosña, ni locue ti inlie jechuraña.
pairs.english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya sinanganña sumaga guiya jamyo; sa ti injenggue na güiya manago.
pairs.english: You don't have his word living in you; because you don't believe him whom he sent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aligao y tinigue sija sa y jinasonmiyo iya güiya nae inguaja y linâlâ na taejinecog; ya sija todo ufanmannae testimonio nu guajo,
pairs.english: "You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti manmalago jamyo manmamaela guiya guajo, para uguaja linâlâ.
pairs.english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynenra y taotao sija, guajo ti juresibe.
pairs.english: I don't receive glory from men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo jutungo jamyo na taya y güinaeyan Yuus ni y gaegueja guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: But I know you, that you don't have God's love in yourselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo mato yo pot y naan Tatajo, ya ti inresibe yo; yaguin otro mato pot y naanña namaesa, ayo inresibe.
pairs.english: I have come in my Father's name, and you don't receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna siña injenggue jamyo ni y rumesibe inenra uno sija yan otro, ya ti inaligao y inenraja na mato guine as Yuus na unoja?
pairs.english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don't seek the glory that comes from the only God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti injaso na jufaaela jamyo gui as Tata: ya y fumaaela jamyo si y Moises, ayo nae gaegue ininangganmiyo.
pairs.english: "Don't think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Moises.
pairs.english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin tinigueña sija ti injenggue, jafa muna injenggue y sinanganjo?
pairs.english: But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe my words?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan estesija, mapos si Jesus malag y otro banda y tasen Galilea, na ayo y tasen Tiberias.
pairs.english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya madalalag güe ni y dangculo na linajyan taotao sa jalie sija y megaegae na señat ni jafatinas gui manmalango.
pairs.english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus gui un ogso, ya matachong güije yan y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jijot y guipot pascua, guipot y Judio sija.
pairs.english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae tumalag jilo si Jesus, jalie na guaja mamamaela para iya güiya, un linajyan na taotao, ilegña as Felipe: Manu nae tafanmamajan pan para ufañocho este sija?
pairs.english: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, "Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan este para uchague güe; sa güiya tumungo jafa ufatinas.
pairs.english: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Felipe: Dosiento na denario na pan, ti ufannajong para cada uno guiya sija ufañule didide.
pairs.english: Philip answered him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya, uno gui disipuluña sija, Andres, chelun Simon Pedro:
pairs.english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un patgon gaegue güine na guaja sinco pan sebada yan dos güijan na diquique: Lao jafa na estesija, gui entalo y este na minegae?
pairs.english: "There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Nafanason y taotao. Ya megae na chaguan gaegue güije na lugat, ya manason y taotao, cana sinco mil na lalaje.
pairs.english: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjaspog ilegña ni disipuluña sija: Joca todo y dinidide ni y tetenjan, sa munga guaja malingo.
pairs.english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, "Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

pairs.english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, "This is truly the prophet who comes into the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjalom gui un sajyan, ya manchinichile ni tase para Capernaum. Ya pago jomjom, ya si Jesus ti manfinatotoe sija.
pairs.english: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo dangculo na napon pot rason un dangculo na manglo na manguaefe.
pairs.english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta manmamogsae gui tase calang bente sinco pot trenta estadio, malie si Jesus na mamomocat gui jilo y tase ya lumalajijot guato gui sajyan: ya manmaañao sija.
pairs.english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña nu sija: Guajoyo; chamiyo fanmaañao!
pairs.english: But he said to them, "It is I . Don't be afraid."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmagof anae maresibe gui sajyan; ya ensiguidas mato y sajyan gui tano ni y jajananao güe.
pairs.english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 22 55940 ¶ Y inagpaña na jaane, y linajyan taotao ni gaegue gui otro bandan tase, jalilie na taya güije mas na unoja na sajyan diquique, ya jatungo na si Jesus ti jumalom gui sajyan yan y disipuloña sija, lao y disipuloña sija esta manmapos sijaja;
pairs.english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn't entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya manmato sija y sajyan diquique guine Tiberias, jijot güije na lugat anae mañocho ni pan, despues di y Señot janae si Yuus grasias.)
pairs.english: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y linajyan taotao sija na si Jesus taegüe güije, ni y disipuluña sija; manjalom sija locue gui sajyan diquique, ya manmapos para Capernaum, maaliligao si Jesus.
pairs.english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn't there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae masoda gui otro bandan tase, ilegñija nu güiya: Rabi Ngaean nae mato jao güine?
pairs.english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you come here?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus ilegña: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo; na inaliligao yo, ti pot y liniimiyo ni señat sija; lao pot y quinanomiyo ni pan, y ninafanjaspog jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmachocho, munga para ayo y fafalingo na nengcano, lao ayo na nengcano y sumaga taejinecog na linâlâ, ni y Lajin taotao numae jamyo; sa güiya sineyo ni Tata, si Yuus.
pairs.english: Don't work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa tafatinas, para utafatinas y checho Yuus?
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "What must we do, that we may work the works of God?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Este y checho Yuus, na injenggue ayo y jatago.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa na señat unfatinas para inlie, ya injenggue jao? Jafa chechomo?
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si tatanmame jacano y mana gui desierto, taemanoja y munjayan matugue; pan guine y langet manmanae para u jacano.
pairs.english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, 'He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti si Moises numae jamyo ni pan guine y langet, si Tatajo janae jamyo ni magajet na pan guine y langet.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y pan Yuus ayo y tumunog guine y langet, ya jananae linâlâ y tano.
pairs.english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegñija nu güiya: Señot naejam siempre ni este na pan!
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "Lord, always give us this bread."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Guajo y pan lalâlâ; y mato guiya guajo, ti uñalang; ya y jumonggue yo, ti umajo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo; na este inlie yo ya ti injenggue.
pairs.english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don't believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y janae yo si Tata, ufato guiya guajo; ya ayo y ufanmato guiya guajo, gosmagajet na guajo ti siña juyute güe juyong.
pairs.english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa tumunog yo guine y langet ti para jufatinas y minalagojo, lao y minalagoña ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y minalagoña ayo y tumago yo, na todo y janae yo ti siña junafalingo taya, lao junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y minalagon Tata, na todo ayo y jalie y Lajiña ya jinenggue guiya güiya, uguaja linâlâña taejinecog; ya junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 41 56130 ¶ Enaomina y Judio sija mamofea güe anae jasangan: Guajo y pan ni tumunog guine y langet.
pairs.english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, "I am the bread which came down out of heaven."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
