pairs.english: They said, "Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, 'I have come down out of heaven?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmanmofefea entre jamyo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya siña mato guiya guajo yaguin si Tata, ni tumago yo, ti quinene güe; ya guajo junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

pairs.english: It is written in the prophets, 'They will all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Ayo y jumonggue yo guaja linâlâña na taejinecog,
pairs.english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y pan y linâlâ.
pairs.english: I am the bread of life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si tatanmiyo, jacano y mana gui jalomtano ya manmatae.
pairs.english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y pan ni tumunog guine y langet, para jaye y cumano güe, ti umatae.
pairs.english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cumano y catneco, ya jaguimen y jâgâjo, guaja linâlâña taejinecog, ya junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y catneco, güiya y magajet na nengcano; ya y jâgâjo, güiya y magajet na guimen.
pairs.english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y cumano y catneco, y jaguimen y jâgâjo, sumaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine y Tata, ni lalâlâ, janamamaela yo, ya guajo lalâlâ pot si Tata; taegüineja locue y cumano yo, güiya locue ulâlâ pot guajo.
pairs.english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y pan ni tumunog guine y langet; ti parejo yan y tatanmiyo ni cumano y mana ya manmatae: y cumano este na pan ulâlâ para taejinecog.
pairs.english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven--not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija jasangan guiya sunagoga, parejoja yan anae mamanagüe guiya Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 60 56320 ¶ Enaomina megae gui disipuluña sija anae majungog este, ilegñija: Majetog na sinangan este; jaye siña umecungog?
pairs.english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: pot sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, "Does this cause you to stumble?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa yaguin inlie y Lajin taotao cajulo anae gaegue antes?
pairs.english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y espiritu mannanae linâlâ; y catne taya probechoña: y sinangan sija ni jusangane jamyo, ayo espiritu, yan ayo linâlâ.
pairs.english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: But there are some of you who don't believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn't believe, and who it was who would betray him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Pot este na rason jusangane jamyo: na taya siña mato guiya guajo, yaguin ti ninae ni Tatajo.
pairs.english: He said, "For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 66 56380 ¶ Ayo nae, megae gui disipoluña sija manalo tate, ya ti mañija talo manjanao yan güiya.
pairs.english: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus ni dose: Manmalago jamyo manjanao locue?
pairs.english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, "You don't also want to go away, do you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Simon Pedro: Señot, jayejam injanao güe? Jago nae guaja sija y sinangan ni taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame injenggue, ya intingo na jago Ayo na Santos na guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jaope sija: Ti juayig jamyo dose, ya y uno guiya jamyo anite?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangan pot si Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon: sa este y para uinentrega gae, uno gui dose.
pairs.english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di manmalofan estesija, si Jesus jumanao para Galilea: ya ti malago mamocat guiya Judea, sa y Judio sija maaliligao güe para umapuno.
pairs.english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba jijot y guipot y Judio sija, na mafanaan gupot tabetnaculo.
pairs.english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mañeluña sija pot este na rason ilegñija nu güiya: Falofan güine, ya unjanao para Judea, para y disipulumo sija locue ujalie y chechomo sija ni unfatitinas.
pairs.english: His brothers therefore said to him, "Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya ni uno, mamatitinas jafa na güinaja gui secreto, ya güiyaja mismo ualigao na umatungo gui publico. Yaguin unfatitinas este sija na güinaja, fanuejao gui tano.
pairs.english: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mañeluña sija locue ti majonggue güe.
pairs.english: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y tiempoco ti mafato trabia, lao y tiemponmiyo siempre esta listo.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano ti siña manchinatlie jamyo; lao guajo jachatlie, sa mannae yo testimonio pot güiya, na y chechoña manaelaye.
pairs.english: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infangajulo güine na gupot; guajo ti jucajulo güine na gupot; sa y tiempoco trabia ti macumple.
pairs.english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangane estesija, sumaga trabia guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 10 56530 ¶ Lao anae y mañeluña sija mangajulo; ayo nae güiya locue cumajulo gui guipot; ti gui publico, lao calang gui secreto.
pairs.english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y Judio sija maaliligao güe gui guipot; ya ilegñija: Manggue güe?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, "Where is he?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja un dangculon gonggong entalo y linajyan taotao sija pot güiya; sa guaja ilegñija: Güiya mauleg na taotao; palo, ilegñija: Aje, lao jadadague y taotao sija.
pairs.english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others said, "Not so, but he leads the multitude astray."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ni uno umadingan gui publico pot güiya, sa manmaañao ni Judio sija.
pairs.english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 14 56570 ¶ Anae y entalo y guipot, cajulo si Jesus gui templo ya mamanagüe.
pairs.english: But when it was now the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna y Judio sija manamanman ya ilegñija: Jafa muna jatungo este letra na ti umeeyag?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, "How does this man know letters, having never been educated?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus ilegña: Y finanagüeco, ti iyoco lao iyon ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore answered them, "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja y mumalago fumatitinas y minalagoña, güiya utumungo y finanagüeco, cao güiya iyon Yuus, pat jusangan estesija na güinaja pot guajo namaesa.
pairs.english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y umadingan pot güiyaja, ualiligao y minalagña namaesa; lao y umaligao y minalag iyon ayo y tumago güe, güiya magajet ya taya tinaelaye gaegue guiya güiya.
pairs.english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti manninae jamyo as Moises y tinago sija, ya taya uno guiya jamyo cumumple ya tinago sija? Sajafa na inprocucura para inpino yo?
pairs.english: Didn't Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao manmanope: Anite guaja guiya jago! Jaye promucucuraja pumano jao?
pairs.english: The multitude answered, "You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña: Un chocho guajo fumatinas, ya todo jamyo ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este si Moises manninae jamyo ni y circunsision (na ti guine as Moises lao iyon y tata sija), ya asta pago gui sabado incircunsida y taotao.
pairs.english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y taotao resibe gui sabado y circunsision, para ti umapoca y tinagon Moises; manbubo jamyo nu guajo, sa junasenguefjomlo un taotao gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo injisga taemanoja y liniinmiyo, lao injisga taemanoja y cabales na juisio.
pairs.english: Don't judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 25 56680 ¶ Ylegñija locue palo gui taotao Jerusalem: Ti güiya este y manmaliligao para upuno.
pairs.english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, "Isn't this he whom they seek to kill?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lie na umadingan jafa malagoña, ya taya sumangan jafa nu güiya. Siña na y magalaje sija jatungo magajet, na este si Cristo?
pairs.english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita tumungo este na taotao, guine mano güe: ya anae mato si Jesucristo, taya uno tumungo taotao mano.
pairs.english: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus entonses umagang gui. templo anae mamananagüe ilegña: Jamyo intingo yo, jaye yo, yan intingo locue taotao mano yo; ya guajo mamaela ti pot guajoja: lao y tumago yo, güiya magajet, ya jamyo ti intingo güe.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, "You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don't know.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo tumungo güe, sa guine güiya yo, ya güiya tumago yo!
pairs.english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japrocura sija para macone güe, lao taya uno mato canaeña guiya güiya, sa y oraña trabia ti mafato.
pairs.english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae gui linajyan taotao jumonggue güe, ya ilegñija: Ada yaguin si Cristo mamaela, ujafatinas mas megae na señat qui y fumatiñas este na taotao?
pairs.english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, "When the Christ comes, he won't do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Fariseo sija jumungog na y linajyan taotao manafaesen pot estesija, ya y manmagas mamale yan y Fariseo sija manmanago ni ofisiatñija para umacone.
pairs.english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina si Jesus ilegña: Trabia didide na tiempo gaegue yo guiya jamyo, ya despues bae falag ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said, "I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynaligao yo, ya ti inseda yo; ya mano nae gaegue yo, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Judio sija ilegñija entre sijaja: Para mano este, para ti siñajit tasoda güe? Mapos buente para y manmachapon sija anae mangaegue sija gui entalo y Griego sija, ya mamnanagüe ni y Griego sija?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, "Where will this man go that we won't find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na sinangan na ayo y esta masangan: Inaligao yo ya ti inseda yo, ya mano nae gaegue yo, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: What is this word that he said, 'You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come'?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 37 56800 ¶ Y uttimo na jaane, dangculo na jaanin gupot, si Jesus tumojgue, ya umagang ilegña: Yaguin y taotao guaja minajo umamaela guiya guajo, ya uguinem.
pairs.english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumonggueyo, taegüije y sinangan y Tinigue: y sanjalomña manmimilalag y sadog janom na lalâlâ.
pairs.english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan este na sinangan pot y Espiritu, ni para uresibe ayo sija y manmanjonggue guiya güiya: sa trabia taya mananae ni Espiritu Santo, sa si Jesus ti rumesibe y minalagña,
pairs.english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn't yet glorified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses palo gui linajyan taotao, manmanjungog nu este na sinangan, ilegñija: Sumenmagajet na este güiya y ayo na profeta.
pairs.english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, "This is truly the prophet."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palo ilegñija: Este güiya si ayo na Cristo: Y palo despues ilegñija: Jafa? guinin Galilea umamaela si Cristo?
pairs.english: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti ilelegña y Tinigue, na si Cristo mamaela gui semiyan David, yan guinin y sengsong iya Betlehem anae sumaga si David?
pairs.english: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja inaguguat gui entalo linajyan taotao pot güiya.
pairs.english: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja guiya sija y manmalago na ujacone, lao taya uno siña minajalom canaeña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 45 56880 ¶ Ayonae y ofisiat sija manmalag y magas na mamale yan y Fariseo sija; ya ilegñija nu sija: Sajafa muna ti inchile güe mague?
pairs.english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, "Why didn't you bring him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ofisiat sija manmanope: Taya na taotao umadingan taegüine.
pairs.english: The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this man!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Fariseo sija maninepe: Jamyo locue manabag gui chalan?
pairs.english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, "You aren't also led astray, are you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada guaja palo y jumonggue güe gui magalaje sija pat y Fariseo sija?
pairs.english: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija na linajyan taotao ni ti jatungo y tinago sija, manmatdito.
pairs.english: But this multitude that doesn't know the law is accursed."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Nicodemo (ayo y mato gui as Jesus antes güiya uno guiya sija),
pairs.english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjujusga un taotao y iyota na tinago, yaguin y finenana ti majungog guiya güiya ya matungo jafa y finatinasña?
pairs.english: "Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jago locue taotao Galilea? Aligao, ya unlie, cao guine Galilea taya nae cajulo profeta.
pairs.english: They answered him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee. "

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manalo guato cada uno gui guimañija.
pairs.english: Everyone went to his own house,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jesus malag y egso Olibo.
pairs.english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taftaf gui egaan, tumalo guato gui templo ya todo y taotao sija manmato guiya güiya; ya güiya matachong güije ya mamanagüe nu sija.
pairs.english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y escriba yan y Fariseo sija, macocona un palaoan na masoda gui adulterio, ya mapolo güe gui entalo,
pairs.english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija nu güiya: Maestro, estagüe na palaoan, guine masoda gui adulterio, anae jafatinasja.
pairs.english: they told him, "Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinago Moises jatagojam na infagas ni y acho enao sija. Jago, jafa unsangan?
pairs.english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such. What then do you say about her?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ilegñija, intienta güe para siña mafaaelagüe. Lao si Jesus dumilog papa, manugue gui tano ni y calolotña.
pairs.english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya como sisigue mafaesen, manatunasgüe ya ilegña nu sija: Yaguin uno guiya jamyo taeisao, fumagas nu y güiya, y finenana na acho.
pairs.english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dumilog talo papa ya manugue gui tano ni y calolotña.
pairs.english: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjungog sija, manjajanao juyong uno yan uno, matutujon gui mansenbijo asta y manuttimo; ya si Jesus sumaga yan y palaoan ni y gaegue gui entalo.
pairs.english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Palaoan, mano nae mangaegue sija? taya ni uno nientensia jao?
pairs.english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, "Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Taya uno Señot. Ya ilegña si Jesus: Guajo locue ti jusentensia jao: janao ya chamo unisao talo.
pairs.english: She said, "No one, Lord." Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 12 57080 ¶ Mansinangane as Jesus talo ilegña nu sija: Guajo candet y tano: y dumalalag yo ti ufamocat gui jemjon; ya guajaja candet y linâlâ.
pairs.english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y Fariseo sija ilegñija nu güiya: Jago guiya jagoja mananae testimonio lao ti magajet na testimoniomo.
pairs.english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, "You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ilegña nu sija: Achoja guajoja manae testimonio nu guajo, magajet na testimoniojo; sa jutungo guine mano yo, yan para mano yo; lao jamyo ti intingo guine mano yo, yan para mano yo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don't know where I came from, or where I am going.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo pot y catne injisga; lao guajo ti jumusga ni jaye.
pairs.english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guajo jumusga, y juisioco, güiya magajet; sa ti guajoja; lao guajo yan Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junggan, ya esta matugue gui tinagomiyo na y testimonio y dos taotao, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: It's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo manae testimomio pot guajoja, yan manae yo testimonio si Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu guiya: Mano nae gaegue si Tatamo? Manope si Jesus: Ti intingo yo yan ti intingo y Tatajo; yaguin intingo yo, y Tatajo locue intingo.
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "Where is your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na finijo jasangan si Jesus gui tesoro mamanagüe gui templo; ya taya cumone güe; sa asta pago ti mafato y oraño.
pairs.english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 21 57170 ¶ Ya ilegña talo nu sija si Jesus: Guajo bae janao, ya inaligao yo, ya y isaomiyo nae infanmatae; mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: Jesus said therefore again to them, "I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can't come."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija entonses y Judio sija; Upuno maesa güe? sa ilegña mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said, "Will he kill himself, that he says, 'Where I am going, you can't come?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo iyon sampapa, guajo iyon sanjilo; jamyo iyon este na tano; guajo ti iyon este na tano.
pairs.english: He said to them, "You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao jusangane jamyo na infanmatae gui isaomiyo; sa yaguin ti injenggue na guajo yo; y isaomiyo nae infanmatae.
pairs.english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna ilegñija nu güiya? Jago, jayejao? Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Nae matutujon jusangane jamyo locue.
pairs.english: They said therefore to him, "Who are you?" Jesus said to them, "Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na güinaja yo, para jusangane jamyo ya injisga jamyo: ya y tumago yo, güiya magajet; ya jafa y jiningogco guiya güiya, ayo sija jusangan gui tano.
pairs.english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti matungo na güiya y jacuentuse sija ni pot Tata.
pairs.english: They didn't understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña si Jesus: Ngaean nae infangajulo jamyo y Lajin taotao, ayo nae intingo na guajo yo, ya taya jufatitinas pot guajoja; lao jaftaemano si Tata fumanagüe yo taegüine jusangan.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tumagoyo, güiya gaegue guiya guajo; ti jadingo yo maesaja sa jufatitinas siempre minagofña.
pairs.english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn't left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jasasangan este sija na güinaja megae jumongguegüe.
pairs.english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 31 57270 ¶ Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus ni Judio sija ni y jumonggue güe: Yaguin jamyo insisique y sumaga gui sinanganjo, jamyo manmagajet disipulujo;
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, "If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya intingo y minagajet ya y minagajet inninafanlibre jamyo.
pairs.english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope as Jesus: Jame semiyan Abraham, ya ti infanmañetbe ni jaye; jafa muna ilegmo: Jamyo unafanlibre?
pairs.english: They answered him, "We are Abraham's seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, 'You will be made free?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na todo ayo y fumatinas y isao, güiya tentago y isao.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tentago ti usago gui guima para todo tiempo; lao y lajiña sumaga para todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y Lajin Yuus munafanlibre jamyo, entonses magajet na manlibre jamyo.
pairs.english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jutungo na jamyo semiyan Abraham; lao manmalago jamyo para inpino yo; sa y sinanganjo ti omlat guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: I know that you are Abraham's seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y liniijo gui as Tata jusasangan, ya jamyo y jiningogmiyo gui as tatanmiyo infatitinas.
pairs.english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Si Abraham tatata. Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Yaguin famaguon Abraham jamyo; y chechon Abraham infatinas jamyo.
pairs.english: They answered him, "Our father is Abraham." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manmalago jamyo pago para inpino yo, taotao na jagas jusangane jamyo ni magajet, ayo y jujungog gui as Yuus; si Abraham ti fumatinas este.
pairs.english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn't do this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infatitinas y finatinas tatanmiyo. Ylegñija nu güiya: Jame ti finañagon ábale; un tataja guajajit, si Yuusja.
pairs.english: You do the works of your father." They said to him, "We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Yaguin si Yuus tatanmiyo, magajet na inguflie yo; sa guajo jumuyong yan mato yo guinin as Yuus; ti jumuyong yo guinin guajoja, lao güiya tumago yo.
pairs.english: Therefore Jesus said to them, "If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven't come of myself, but he sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna ti intingo y sinanganjo? Sa ti siña injingog y finojo.
pairs.english: Why don't you understand my speech? Because you can't hear my word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo iyon tatanmiyo anite: jamyo ya y guinâumabale y tatanmiyo intatanga na infatinas. Güiya y mamuno desde y tutujoña; ya ti sumaga gui minagajet, sa taya minagajet gaegue guiya güiya. Yaguin jasangan mandague, y iyoña jasangan; sa dacon güe, ya tatan dacon güe.
pairs.english: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn't stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti injenggue yo, sa jusangane jamyo ni magajet.
pairs.english: But because I tell the truth, you don't believe me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye guiya jamyo ucombense yo ni y isao? Yaguin jusangan y magajet, pot jafa muna jamyo ti injenggue yo?
pairs.english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y iyon Yuus, y sinangan Yuus jajungog; ya pot este na rason jamyo ti injijingog, sa ti iyon Yuus jamyo.
pairs.english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope entonses y Judio sija, ya ilegñija nu guiya: Ti mauleg y sinanganmame, na jago taotao Samaria, ya gaeanite jao?
pairs.english: Then the Jews answered him, "Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Guajo tae anite yo; lao juonra si Tata, ya jamyo indesonra yo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "I don't have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti umaliligao inenrajo; guaja ayo na umaliligao ya jajujusga.
pairs.english: But I don't seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet y magajet jusangane jamyo: Yaguin y taotao jaadaje y sinanganjo, ti ulie finatae para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Judio sija ilegñija nu güiya. Pago nae intingo na gaeanite jao. Si Abraham matae yan y profeta sija; ya jago sumangan: Yanguin y taotao jaadaje y sinanganjo, ti ulie finatae para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Then the Jews said to him, "Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, 'If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago dangculoña qui si tatanmame as Abraham ni esta matae? Yan y profeta manmatae. Jaye jao fumatinas namaesa?
pairs.english: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Yaguin junamalagyo maesa, y minalagjo taya guaja; güiya si Tata y numanamalag yo: ya ilegmiyo na güiya si Yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti intingo güe, lao guajo tumungo güe; yaguin ilegco na ti jutungo güe, dacon yo parejo yan jamyo mandacon: lao jutungo güe yan juadaje y sinanganña.
pairs.english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, 'I don't know him,' I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Abraham, tatanmiyo mumagof sa jalie y jaanijo; ya anae jalie ninamagof.
pairs.english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ilegñija nu güiya y Judio sija: Asta pago taya jao sincuenta años, ya unlie si Abraham?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said to him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusagane jamyo, antes qui si Abraham, esta guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM. "

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmañule entonses acho, para umadagas güe: lao si Jesus mapos gui templo, ti matungo.
pairs.english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through their midst, and so passed by.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE malofan gui sanmenan, jalie un taotao na bachet desde y mafañagoña.
pairs.english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen güe ni y disipuloña ilegñija: Rabi, jaye umisao, este na taotao pat y mañaenaña, para que umafañago bachet?
pairs.english: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Ti umisao este na taotao ni sija manaenaña lao para y finatinas Yuus ya ufafanue guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tanesesita na infatitinas y checho ayo y tumago yo mientras y jaane; sa an mato y puenge, taya siña machocho.
pairs.english: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae gagaegue yo gui jilo y tano, y candet y tano guajoja.
pairs.english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Munjayan jasangan este, tumola gui tano, ya jafatinas fache nu y tela, ya y fache japalae y atadog y bachet,
pairs.english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Janao fagase jao gui estanque Siloe (Ya cumequeilegña, tinago). Enao mina maposgüe ya fagase güe, ya anae tumalo guato este manlie.
pairs.english: and said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means "Sent"). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este y tiguangña sija yan ayo y guinin manmalie antes, ya matungo na ampmam na mangagagao limosña, ilegñija: Ada ti este güiya ayo y matatachong ya gagao?
pairs.english: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, "Isn't this he who sat and begged?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja sija sumangan: Güiya este; ya guaja palo sija sumangan: Ale, lao parejo yan güiya. Lao güiyaja ilegña: Guajo yo.
pairs.english: Others were saying, "It is he." Still others were saying, "He looks like him." He said, "I am he."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jaf taemano mababaña y atadogmo?
pairs.english: They therefore were asking him, "How were your eyes opened?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope ya ilegña: Ayo na taotao, naanña si Jesus, güiya fumatinas y fachae ya palae y atadogco, ya ilegña nu guajo: Janao falag y estanque Siloe ya unfagase jao! Mapos yo ya jufagase yo ya juresibe y liniijo.
pairs.english: He answered, "A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.' So I went away and washed, and I received sight."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Manggue yuje? Ylegña: Ti jutungo.
pairs.english: Then they asked him, "Where is he?" He said, "I don't know."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 13 57680 ¶ Macone guato gui Fariseo sija y guinin manbachet.
pairs.english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na jaane sabado anae si Jesus jafatinas y fachae, ya jababa y atadogña sija.
pairs.english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Fariseo sija locue mafaesen güe talo: Jafa muna manlie güe. Ya ilegña nu sija: Janaye ni fachae y sanjilo gui atadogco, ya jufagase yo, ya manlie yo.
pairs.english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, "He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo gui Fariseo sija ilegñija: Este na taotao ti güiya guinin as Yuus, sa ti jaadaje y sabado. Lao palo sija ilegñija: Jafa muna siña un taotao ni gaeisao, jafatitinas taemanoja y señat sija? Ya guaja dibision gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, because he doesn't keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" There was division among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija talo ni bachet: Jago, jafa ilegmo nu güiya, ya esta mababa pot güiya y atadogmo sija? Ya ilegña: Profetagüe.
pairs.english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, "What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y Judio sija, ti majonggue y esta masangan na güiya, y guinin bachet, ya esta jarisibe y liniiña, asta que nae maagange y mañaena y bachet ni esta jarisibe liniiña.
pairs.english: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmafaesen ilegñija: Este patgonmiyo ni ilegmiyo bachet guinin y mafañagoña? Ya jafa pago ninamanlie?
pairs.english: and asked them, "Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y tata ya, ilegñija: Yntingo na este patgonmame, ya bachet guinin y mafañagoña:
pairs.english: His parents answered them, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaftaemano pago na manliigüe, ti intingo; pat jaye bumaba y atadogña, ti intingo; faesen güe; guaja sacanña: Güiya usangan pot güiyaja namaesa.
pairs.english: but how he now sees, we don't know; or who opened his eyes, we don't know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija ilegñija si mañaenaña, sa manmaañao ni y Judio sija: sa unoja na jinaso gui entalo y Judio sija, na yaguin guaja sumangan na güiya si Cristo, umayute güe gui sanjiyong y sinagoga.
pairs.english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ilegñija sija mañaenaña: Gauja sacaña; faesen güe.
pairs.english: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age. Ask him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina sija maagange talo y taotao ni y guinin bachet, ya ilegñija nu guiya: Nae minalag si Yuus: Jita tumungo na este na taotao güiya taotao isao güe.
pairs.english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, "Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manope yuje: Cao taotao isao güe, ti jutungo; unoja jugoftungo; na guajo, guinin bachet yo, ya pago manlie yo.
pairs.english: He therefore answered, "I don't know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija talo: Jafa finatinasña nu jago? Jaftaemano jababa y atadogmo?
pairs.english: They said to him again, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe sija: Jusangane jamyo esta, ya ti injingog: Jafa muna manmalago jamyo injingog talo? Ada manmalago jamyo buente locue disipuluña?
pairs.english: He answered them, "I told you already, and you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don't also want to become his disciples, do you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses janafanmamajlao ya ilegñija: Jago disipuluña; ya jame disipulon Moises!
pairs.english: They insulted him and said, "You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jame intingo na si Yuus guinin jasangan pot si Moises; lao este na taotao ti intingo taotao mano güe.
pairs.english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don't know where he comes from."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y taotao ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na namanman este, ya ti intingo jamyo taotao mano; ya güiya bumaba y atadogco!
pairs.english: The man answered them, "How amazing! You don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jame intingo na si Yuus ti jajungog y manisao; yaguin guaja maañao as Yuus ya jaosgue y minalagoña, este jiningog.
pairs.english: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshipper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin y tutujon y tano, taya nae majungog, ni uno mababa atadogña ni mafañago bachet.
pairs.english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin este ti guine as Yuus, ti siña jafatinas jafa.
pairs.english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmanope ilegñija nu güiya: Jago mafañago jao gui isao sija! Ada jago fumanagüe jam? Ya mayute juyong.
pairs.english: They answered him, "You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?" They threw him out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 35 57900 ¶ Jajungog si Jesus na mayute juyong, ya anae jasoda, ilegña: Unjonggue y Lagin Yuus?
pairs.english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe ya ilegña: Jaye enao Señot, para guajo umajonggue güe?
pairs.english: He answered, "Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Esta unlie güe ya ayo y umadingangange jao, güiya güe.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jujonggue, Señot. Ya jaadora güe.
pairs.english: He said, "Lord, I believe!" and he worshiped him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Guajo pot juisio mamaela yo güine gui jilo y tano, para y ti manmanlilie, ufanmanlie; ya y manmanlie, ayo sija ufanbachet.
pairs.english: Jesus said, "I came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanjungog y ayo na Fariseo sija ni y mangaegue guiya güiya ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jame locue, manbachet jam?
pairs.english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, "Are we also blind?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: An mojon manbachet jamyo, taya isaomiyo; pago nae insasangan, talie; enao mina isaomiyo gagaegue.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, 'We see.' Therefore your sin remains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MAGAJET ya magajet y jusangane jamyo, na ti jumalon gui pettan y guelat y quinilo sija, lao ucajulo gui otro lugat, ayo y ladron yan saque.
pairs.english: "Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumalom gui petta, güiya y pastot y quinilo.
pairs.english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot guiya güiya y magas y petta; ya y quinilo sija jajungog y inagangña: ya y gaña quinilo sija jaagang pot y naana, ya jacone sija gui san jiyong.
pairs.english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jacone mapos y todo iyoña sija, güiya jumanao gui sanmenañija: ya quinilo sija madalalag güe, sa matungo y inagangña.
pairs.english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao juyong, sija ti madalalag güe, lao manmalago guato guinin menaña: sa ti jatungo y inagangña ni taotaoj uyong sija.
pairs.english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don't know the voice of strangers."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na acomparasion mansinangane as Jesus: lao sija ti jatungo jafa sija mansingane sija.
pairs.english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn't understand what he was telling them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 7 58030 ¶ Mantinalugua as Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo, na guajo pottan y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them again, "Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep's door.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y manmamaela antes que guajo, ladron yan saque sija: ya ti manmanjungog y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y petta: ya y jumalom guiya guajo, güiya umasatba, y ujalom yan ujuyong ya usoda y pasto.
pairs.english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: linâlâñija.
pairs.english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y mauleg na pastot: ya y mauleg na pastot y linâlâña japolo pot y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao nii maapapase, ya ti pastot; ya ti gaña y quinilo sija, an jalie y lobo ni y mamaela, japolo y quinilo sija ya malago guato; ya y lobo maquinene ya manchinalapon sija quinilo:
pairs.english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn't own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malago guato güe sa güiya taotao nii maapapase ya taya inadajiña ni y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn't care for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y mauleg na pastot: sa jutungo y iyoco, ya y iyoco matungo yo.
pairs.english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I'm known by my own;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y Tata jatungo yo, taegüijija locue guajo jutungo y tata; ya jupolo y linâlâjo pot y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajayo palo quinilo locue ni taegüe güine na colat, ayo sija locue nesesita yo juchule, ya sija ujajungog y inagangjo; ya uguaja un manadanquinilo yan un pastot.
pairs.english: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao na jaguaeya yo si Tata, sa jupolo y linâlâjo, para uchule talo.
pairs.english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya munajanao guiya guajo, lao jupolo pot guajo na maesa. Guaja yo ninasiñajo para jupolo yan guajayo ninasiñajo para jutalo chumule. Este na tinago juresibe guine y Tatajo.
pairs.english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 19 58150 ¶ Ya guaja inaguaguat gui entalo y Judio sija pot este na sinagan sija.
pairs.english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae sija ilegñija: Biju guaja güe, ya babagüe; sa jafa inicungog güe?
pairs.english: Many of them said, "He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija y palo: Este na sinagan ti sija iyon y biju: Ada siña y biju ubaba y atadog y manbachet?
pairs.english: Others said, "These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 22 58180 ¶ Ya anae mafatitnas y guipot y inefresengumayuus, guiya Jerusalem, ya ayo na tiempo manenggeng.
pairs.english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus mapos malag y templo, gui corredot Salomon.
pairs.english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manetnon guato guiya güiya y Judio sija ya ilegñija nu güiya: Asta ngaean nae unnabuebuente y antita? Yaguin jago yuje na Cristo, sangan ni claro.
pairs.english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, "How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Guajo jagas jusangane jamyo ya ti injenggue: y checho ni y jufatinas gui naan Tata, estesija manmannanae testimonio nu guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo ti injenggue, sa ti jamyo quinilojo; (taegüine guinin jusangane jamyo).
pairs.english: But you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gajo quinilo sija jajungog y inagangjo; ya jutungo sija; ya sija madalalag yo.
pairs.english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo junae sija linâlâñija taejinecog; ya para todo y tiempo taya nae ufanmalingo ya ni jaye ufaninamot sija gui canaejo.
pairs.english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tata ni unaeyo, dangculoña qui todo; ya taya gaesisiña para uamot sija gui canae y Tatajo.
