pairs.english: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father's hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo yan si Tata, jame unoja.
pairs.english: I and the Father are one."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 31 58270 ¶ Tumalo manmañule acho y Judio sija, para umafagas güe.
pairs.english: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Megae manmauleg na finatinas jufanue jamyo guine as Tatajo; pot jafa na chechoña inquequefagas yo ni y acho?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maope güe ni Judio sija ilegñija: Pot y mauleg na chechomo ti infagas jao; lao pot ayo y chatfino contra si Yuus; sa jago, taotaojao, mama Yuusjao.
pairs.english: The Jews answered him, "We don't stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Taegüe güi tinigue gui tinagonmiyo, Guajo umalog: Yuus jamyo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Isn't it written in your law, 'I said, you are gods?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmafanaan Yuus, sija na mamaela gui jiloñija y finijo Yuus (ya y tinigue ti siña maipe);
pairs.english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can't be broken),

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegmiyo ni ayo y jaconsagra y Tata ya matgo guato gui tano: Jago chumatfino as Yuus, sa jusangan: Guajo Lajin Yuus?
pairs.english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You blaspheme,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jufatitinas y ti iyon Tata, munga injenggue yo.
pairs.english: If I don't do the works of my Father, don't believe me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin jufatinas, achogja ti injenggue yo, jenggue y checho sija: para siña jamyo intingo ya injenggue na si Tata gaegue guiya guajo, ya guajo gaegue guiya Tata.
pairs.english: But if I do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japrocucura talo para umaconegüe: lao güiya mapos gui canaeñija.
pairs.english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo guato talo gui otro bandan Jordan, ayo na lugat nae finenana managpapange si Juan; ya sumaga güije.
pairs.english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae manmato guiya güiya ya ilegñija: Si Juan magajet na ni un señat jafatinas; ya magajet todo y sinangan Juan nu este na taotao jumuyong magajet.
pairs.english: Many came to him. They said, "John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae manmanjonggue güije nu güiya.
pairs.english: Many believed in him there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTABA entonses malango un taotao, naanña si Lasaro, taotao Betania, un songsong iyon Maria yan si Marta cheluña.
pairs.english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Maria uje y pumalae inggüente y Señot, ya jasaosao y adengña ni y gaponiluña, ya y cheluña, as Lasaro, estaba malango.
pairs.english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanago y mañeluña famalaoan guiya güiya ilegñija: Señot, estagüe, ayo y unguaeya esta malango.
pairs.english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, "Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajungog si Jesus, ilegña: Este na chetnot ti güiya y para matae, lao para minalag gui as Yuus, para y Lajin Yuus umaonra pot güiya.
pairs.english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, "This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaguaeya si Jesus si Marta yan y cheluña yan si Lasaro.
pairs.english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog, na estaba malango, ayo na tiempo sumagagüe dos dias güije na lugat anae gaegue.
pairs.english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di este ilegña ni y disipuluña: Nije tafanmalag Judea talo.
pairs.english: Then after this he said to the disciples, "Let's go into Judea again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija nu güiya y disipulo sija: Rabi, pago didide nae maquequechague jao ni Judio sija na unmafagas ni y acho: Ada untalo guato güije?
pairs.english: The disciples told him, "Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Taya y un jaane dose ora? y jumajanao gui jaane, ti siña matompo, sa manlilie y candet este na tano.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "Aren't there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumajanao an puenge, matompo, sa taya candet guiya güiya.
pairs.english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn't in him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan estesija, ya despues di este ilegña nu sija: Lasaro, amigonmame maego: ya bae janao para uyayajo gui maegoña.
pairs.english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, "Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu güiya y disipulosija: Señot, yaguin maego, mauleg jumuyong.
pairs.english: The disciples therefore said, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangan este si Jesus gui tinataeña: sija jajaso na umadingan na dumescansañaeñaejon gui maegoña.
pairs.english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña claro nu sija: Lasaro, güiya matae.
pairs.english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, "Lazarus is dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magof yo sa taegüe yo güije, pot causa y jamyo, para injenggue; nitafanmalag y ya güiya.
pairs.english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let's go to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tomas, ayo y naanña si Didimo, ilegña nu y otro disipulo sija: ufanmalagjit locue, nije tafanmatae yan güiya.
pairs.english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, "Let's go also, that we may die with him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Jesus ya jasoda na estaba cuatro na jaane gui naftan.
pairs.english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Betania jijot guiya Jerusalem, buente quince na estadio.
pairs.english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na Judio sija manmato gui as Marta ya si Maria para uconsuela pot y cheluñija.
pairs.english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Marta, anae jajungog na si Jesus mamamaela, jajanao güe para urisibe: ya estaba si Maria matatachong gui guima.
pairs.english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao si Marta ilegña as Jesus: Señot yaguin mojon gaeguejao güine y chelujo ti umatae.
pairs.english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jutungo pago, todo y ungagao si Yuus, ninaejao as Yuus.
pairs.english: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu güiya: Ucajulo talo y chelumo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Marta ilegña nu güiya: Guajo jutungo na ucajulo gui quinajulon manmatae gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: Martha said to him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajo y quinajulon manmatae yan y linâlâ; ayo y jumonggue yo, achogja esta matae, ulâlâ talo;
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo y lâlâ ya jumonggue yo, ti umatae para todo y tiempo. Unjonggue este?
pairs.english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya: Si Señot, guinin jujonggue na jago ayo na Cristo, Lajin Yuus, güiya na para umamaela gui tano.
pairs.english: She said to him, "Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God's Son, he who comes into the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan este, mapos ya jaagang gui secreto si Maria cheluña, ilegña: Si Maestro estagüe ya inagagangejao.
pairs.english: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, "The Teacher is here, and is calling you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog, cajulo gusisija ya jumanao asta guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya asta pago ti mafato si Jesus gui sengsong, lao gaegue güije na lugat anae si Marta jagas sineda güe.)
pairs.english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonces y Judiosija na manestaba gui guima yan güiya, y maconsuela güe, anae jalie si Maria cajulo gusisija ya mapos, madalalag güe, pineloñija na ufalag y naftan para utanges güije.
pairs.english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, "She is going to the tomb to weep there."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Maria anae mato gui lugat anae estaba si Jesus ya jalie, japodong gui adengña, ya ilegña: Señot yaguin gaeguejao güine ti umatae y chelujo.
pairs.english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, "Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Jesus jalie na tumatanges, yan y Judio sija ni manamamamaela yan güiya manatanges, umugong gui espiritu, ya inestotba,
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Mano nae unpolo güe? Ilegñija nu güiya: Señot, maela ya unlie.
pairs.english: and said, "Where have you laid him?" They told him, "Lord, come and see."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus tumanges.
pairs.english: Jesus wept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija entonses y Judio sija: Estagüe, taegüenao jaguflie güe!
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said, "See how much affection he had for him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao palo guiya sija ilegñija: Ti siña este na ubaba y atadog y bachet, fatinas ni este ti umatae?
pairs.english: Some of them said, "Couldn't this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jaumugong talo guiya güiya, ya mato gui naftan. Güiya un liyang ya mapoluye un acho gui sanjiloña.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Najanao y acho. Si Marta, chelun y matae, ilegña nu güiya: Señot, mutong esta, sa finatae cuatro na jaane.
pairs.english: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, "Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Ti guinin jusangane jao na guin manjonggue jao, unlie y minalag Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Didn't I tell you that if you believed, you would see God's glory?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae sija janajanao y acho, Ya si Jesus tumalag julo ya ilegña: Tata, grasias junaejao sa guinin unjungog yo.
pairs.english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, "Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo jutungo na siempre unjungungog yo; lao pot y linajyan taotao ni gaegue gui oriyajo, jusangan este, para ujajonggue na jagoyo tumago.
pairs.english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude that stands around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan este, umaagang ni dangculo na inagang: Lasaro maela juyong.
pairs.english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ayo y guine matae, jumuyong, magogode dos canaeña yan y adeng nu y bendas; ya y mataña mafalulutan nu y sudario. Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Pula ya inpilo ya ujanao.
pairs.english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Free him, and let him go."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 45 58830 ¶ Pot este megae na Judio sija na manmato gui as Maria ya jalie y finatinas Jesus, majonggue güe.
pairs.english: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo guiya sija na manmapos para Fariseo sija, ya jasangane sija y finatinas Jesus.
pairs.english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 47 58850 ¶ Ayo nae y manmagas y mamale yan y Fariseo sija, mandaña ya janaetnon y sinedrio ya ilegñija: Jafa tafatinas? Sa este na taotao mamatitinas megae na señat sija?
pairs.english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, "What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin tapolo taegüenao, todo y taotao manmanjonggue guiya güiya: ya ufanmamaela y Romano sija ya u janajanao y sagata yan y tanota.
pairs.english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Caefas uno guiya sija, güiya magas na pale güije na sacan, mansinangane: Jamyo ti intingo jafa!
pairs.english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni injaso na mauleg para jita sa un taotao matae pot y taotao sija, para munga na todo y nasion ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este ti jasangan guine güiyaja; lao güiya y magas na pale güije na sacan ya japrofetisa na si Jesus umatae pot y nasion.
pairs.english: Now he didn't say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti pot ayoja na nasion; lao locue para ufandaña gui unoja y famaguon Yuus ni y jagas manmachalapon.
pairs.english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo na jaane manafaesen entre para sija umapuno.
pairs.english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ti jumajanao gui publico gui entalo Judio sija; lao mapos güije para y tano na jijot gui jalomtano, guiya un siuda na mafananaan Efraim; ya sumaga güe güije yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 55 58930 ¶ Ya y pascuan Judio sija estaba jijot; ya megae gui tano mangajulo guiya Jerusalem antes di pascua para ujanagasgas sija.
pairs.english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanaligao as Jesus, ya manadingan entre sija gui templo, ya ilegñija: Jafa jinasonmiyo, nu güiya, ti umamaela gui guipot.
pairs.english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, "What do you think--that he isn't coming to the feast at all?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y prinsipin y mamale sija yan y Fariseo manmanae tinago na yaguin jaye tumungo mano nae gaegue, umasangan para inquene güe.
pairs.english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo, saes na jaane antes de pascua, si Jesus malag Betania anae estaba si Lasaro, ayo y guinin matee, ya si Jesus munacajulo guine y entelo manmatae.
pairs.english: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanmatinas güije un sena, ya si Marta mañeñetbe; ya si Lasaro, güiya uno gui entalo sija na manmatatachong gui lamasa yan güiya.
pairs.english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Maria jachule un libra na inggüente, gasgas na natda, guefguaguan, ya japalae y adeng Jesus, ya jasaosao y adengña nu gaponuluña; ya bula y guima ni pao inggüente.
pairs.english: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña uno gui disipuluña, si Judas Iscariote lajin Simon, ayo y umintrega güe,
pairs.english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa mina ti mabende este na inggüente pot tres siento denario na salape, ya unumae y mamobble?
pairs.english: "Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ilegña, ti pot inadajiña ni mamobble; lao pot guiya y saque, ya guaja y betsaña, ya jachuchule ayo y sinajguanña.
pairs.english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña si Jesus, Polo güe, para ayo na jaane nae majafot yo, na uadaje este.
pairs.english: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamobble siempre gagaegue guiya jamyo; lao guajo taegüeyo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 9 59040 ¶ Entonses, dangculo na linajyan taotao, gui Judio sija, jatungo na gaegue güe güije, ya manmato, ti pot causan si Jesusja, lao locue para umalie si Lasaro ni guinin janacajulo guine y entelo manmatae.
pairs.english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafaesen entre sija, manmagas y mamale sija, para umapuno locue si Lasaro.
pairs.english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot causa di güiya, megae na Judio sija manmalag ayo ya manmanjonggue gui as Jesus.
pairs.english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 12 59070 ¶ Ynagpaña na jaane, dangculo na linajyan taotao, y manmato gui guipot, anae majungog na si Jesus mato guiya Jerusalem,
pairs.english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmañule ni y ramas y trongcon palma ya manmapos para umaresibe güe ya manaagang: Osana! Dichoso güe ni mamamaela ni y naan y Señot, y Ray Israel!
pairs.english: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, "Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda si Jesus un patgon na bulico, matachong gui jiloña; taegüije y matugue:
pairs.english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo maañao, jago jagan Sion! estagüe y Raymo na mato, matatachong gui jilo un patgon bulico.
pairs.english: "Don't be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey's colt."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana, y disipuloña ti jatungo estesija; lao y tiempo anae si Jesus esta cumajulo gui langet, entonses manmajaso na estesija este matugue nu güiya, ya sija guinin manmafatinas este sija yan güiya.
pairs.english: His disciples didn't understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao na estaba mañisija, anae jaagang juyong si Lasaro gui naftan, ya janacajulo gui entalo manmatae, janae testimonio nu güiya.
pairs.english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao locue y linajyan taotao manmato ya maresibe güe, sa majungog na munjayan jafatinas este na señat.
pairs.english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao Fariseo sija ilegñija entre sija: Lie na taya probechonmiyo: Estagüe na todo gui jilo y tano manjanao ya dalalag güe.
pairs.english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, "See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 20 59150 ¶ Ya guaja sija na taotao Griego ni gui ayo sija na mangajulo para uadodora gui guipot:
pairs.english: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija manmato gui as Felipe taotao Betsaida guiya Galilea, ya magagao güe, ilegñija: Señot, manmalagojam inlie si Jesus!
pairs.english: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, "Sir, we want to see Jesus."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Felipe ya jasangane si Andres; ya mamaela si Andres yan si Felipe masangane si Jesus.
pairs.english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 23 59180 ¶ Ya si Jesus maninepe ilegña: Y ora mato na y Lajin taotao uresibe y minalagña.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na y granon trigo ni ti upodong gui tano, ya umatae, güiya namaesa sumaga; yaguin matae megae na tinegcha uchule.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya y linâlâña ufinalaguaejon; y chumatlie y linâlâña güine gui tano, pinipilanja y taejinecog na jaane.
pairs.english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja y somesetbe yo, udalalag yo; ya mano nae gaegue yo, ayo locue nae ugaegue y somesetbe yo. Yaguin guaja y somesetbe yo, si Tata uenenra güe.
pairs.english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago lebog y antijo: Ya jafa quentosjo? Tata nalibre yo pago na ora! Lao pot este mato yo güine na ora.
pairs.english: "Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? 'Father, save me from this time?' But for this cause I came to this time.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata, namalag y naanmo! Pot enao mato guine y langet un inagang, ilegña: Estaba junamalag, ya bae junamalag otro biaje.
pairs.english: Father, glorify your name!" Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, "I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao na mangaegue ya injingog ilegñija: guinin julo este. Palo ilegñija: Un angjet sumangane güe.
pairs.english: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, "An angel has spoken to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña: Ti mato este na inagang pot y causaco lao pot y causanmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "This voice hasn't come for my sake, but for your sakes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago gaegue y juisio nu este na tano. Pago y magas este na tano umayute juyong.
pairs.english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo, yaguin guajo umajatsayo guine y tano, jucone todo para guajoja.
pairs.english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este masangan para umatungo jafa na finatae nae umatae.
pairs.english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepeña y linajyan taotao: Jame injingog y lay na si Cristo ugaegue para todo y tiempo. Jafa mina unsangan: Na y Lajin taotao nesesita umajatsa? Jaye güe este Lajin taotao?
pairs.english: The multitude answered him, "We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up?' Who is this Son of Man?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Didide na tiempo y candet ugaegue gui entalonmiyo. Fanmamocat mientras guaguaja y candet para jamyo, sa no sea infanguinacha ni y jemjom; sa y jumajanao gui jemjom, ti jatungo para mano nae y jinanaoña.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn't overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras guaguaja y candet para jamyo, fanmanjonggue ni y candet, para unfamaguon y candet jamyo. Estesija jasangan si Jesus, ya mapos ya umatog pot sija.
pairs.english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light." Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 37 59320 ¶ Lao achogja jafatinas megae na señat gui menanñija ti majonggue güe.
pairs.english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn't believe in him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y sinangan ni ilegña si Isaias profeta: Señot, jaye jumonggue y sinanganta? Ya y canae y Señot, jaye guinin munamalie?
pairs.english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, "Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este mina ti siña sija majonggue, sa tomalo jasangan si Isaias:
pairs.english: For this cause they couldn't believe, for Isaiah said again,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanbachet y atadogñija, ya janamajetog y corasoñija: Sa ti manmalie ni y atadogñija, ni ujatungo ni y corasonñija, ya sigue mamañotsot, ya guajo juamte sija.
pairs.english: "He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jasangan si Isaias, anae jalie minalagña ya inadingane.
pairs.english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 42 59370 ¶ Pago na tiempo achogja megae na taotao senmagas, jumonggue gue; lao pot causa y Fariseo sija, ti masangan claro, na no sea mayute gui sinagoga.
pairs.english: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa muna manmalago sija y inenra y taotao, qui y inenra guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: for they loved men's praise more than God's praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 44 59390 ¶ Si Jesus umagang ilegña: Y jumonggue yo, guajoja, ti jajonggue lao ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Jesus cried out and said, "Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y umatan yo, güiya umatan y tumago yo.
pairs.english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato yo gui jilo y tano parejoja y candet, para todo ayo y jumonggue yo, ti sumaga gui jemjom.
pairs.english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumungog y sinanganjo ya ti jajonggue, guajo ti jujusga; sa ti mato yo para jufanjusga gui tano, lao para junafanlibre y tano.
pairs.english: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn't believe, I don't judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y rumechasa yo ya ti rumesibe y sinanganjo, guaja ujinisga güe: Y sinangan ni jusangan, güiya ufanjusga güije uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: He who rejects me, and doesn't receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti guinin juadingan namaesa; lao si Tata ni tumago yo, güiya numae yo tinago ni para jusangan yan y para jucuentos.
pairs.english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jutungo na y tinagoña, güiya linâlâ taejinecog: enaomina ayo sija jusangan; taegüije si Tata guinin jasangane yo, taegüijeja jusasangan.
pairs.english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA antes di y guipot pascua, jatungo si Jesus na y oraña esta mato para ujanao güine na tano para y Tata, esta jaguaeya y iyoña sija ni mangaegue güine gui tano, ya jaguaeya sija asta y jinecog.
pairs.english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sena munjayan ya y anite esta jumalom gui corason Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon, ni umentrega güe;
pairs.english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatungo si Jesus na y Tata jagasja janae todo ni güinaja gui canaeña, ya mato güe guinin as Yuus, ya as Yuus guaguato;
pairs.english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and was going to God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo gui sena ya janajanao y magagoña, ya jachule un toaya, ya jaafuyut güiya namaesa.
pairs.english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta munjayan este, janaye y janom gui palangana diquique, ya jatutujon fumagase y adeng y disipulo sija, ya jasaosao nu y toaya na jaafuyut güe.
pairs.english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae malag as Simon Pedro; ya este ilegña nu güiya: Señot jago fumagase y adengjo?
pairs.english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, "Lord, do you wash my feet?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Y jufatitinas ti untungo pago; lao ti ampmam untungo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "You don't know what I am doing now, but you will understand later."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pedro ilegña nu güiya: Ti unfagase y adengjo ni ngaean! Ynepe as Jesus: Yaguin ti jufagase jao taepattemo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Peter said to him, "You will never wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I don't wash you, you have no part with me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Simon Pedro: Señot, ti adengjoja, lao locue asta y canaejo yan y ilujo.
pairs.english: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Y esta mafagase, ti guaelaye yaguin adengña esta mafagase, lao esta gasgas todo. Ya jamyo mangasgas pago, achogja ti todos.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta matungo jaye uje y umentrega güe; pot enao ilegña: Ti mangasgas jamyo todos.
pairs.english: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, "You are not all clean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 12 59570 ¶ Anae munjayan manfinagase y adengñija, jachule y magagoña ya tumalo matachong otro biaje, ya mansinangane: Yntingo y finatinasjo?
pairs.english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infanaan yo Maestro yan Señot: ya y sinanganmiyo mauleg; sa guajo yo.
pairs.english: You call me, 'Teacher' and 'Lord.' You say so correctly, for so I am.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guajo Señotmiyo yan Maestronmiyo, guinin jufagase y adengmiyo, debe jamyo locue infanafagase y adengmiyo uno yan otro.
pairs.english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un ejemplo junae jamyo, sa taemanoja guajo jufatinase jamyo, jamyo locue infatitinas.
pairs.english: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y tintago ti güiya magasña na y senotña; ni y matago, ti güiya magasña na y tumago güe.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin intingo este sija na güinaja, mandichoso jamyo yaguin infatitinas,
pairs.english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 59630 ¶ Ti umadingan yo nu jamyo todo: guajo tumungo sija y inayigco; lao para umacumple y tinigue sija: Y chumocho pan yan guajo, güiya cumajulo contra guajo y dedegoña.
pairs.english: I don't speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, 'He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde pago jusangane jamyo antes di ujuyong, para yaguin jumujuyong, injenggue na guajo yo.
pairs.english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na y rumesibe y tinagojo, jaresibe yo; ya y rumesibe yo, jaresibe y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, "Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo sija manaatan entre sija uno yan otro ya ti matungo jaye umadingan.
pairs.english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y uno gui disipuluña na guiniflie as Jesus, estaba umaason gui pechon Jesus.
pairs.english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus' breast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Simon Pedro fumatinas señat nu este, para umafaesen jaye uje na umadingan.
pairs.english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, "Tell us who it is of whom he speaks."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae, y umaason gui jilo pechon Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Señot jaye uje?
pairs.english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast, asked him, "Lord, who is it?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina manope si Jesus: Ayo uje ni junafotgue ni pan ya junae güe. Ya janafotgon y pan, ya janae si Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore answered, "It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it." So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan y quinanoña ni y pan fotgon, si Satanas jumalom guiya güiya. Entonses si Jesus sinangane: Fatinas guse y finatinasmo.
pairs.english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, "What you do, do quickly."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni uno, guiya sija na mangaegue gui lamasa, tumungo pot jafa na umasangane.
pairs.english: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pineloñija y palo guiya sija, sa si Judas na gaebetsa, na si Jesus sumangane: Fajan y güinaja na mannesesitajit para y guipot; pat ufanmanae y mamobble.
pairs.english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, "Buy what things we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya, guinin mañule y pan fotgon, enseguidas mapos; ya esta puenge.
pairs.english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 59760 ¶ Pot enao, anae esta mapos güe, ilegña si Jesus: Pago y Lajin taotao rumesisibe y minalagña, ya si Yuus rumesibe y minalagña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus minamalag güe guiya güiya; ya enseguidas unamalag güe.
pairs.english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandiquique na fumaguon, ti juapmam guiya jamyo; ya inaligao yo; ya taegüenoja jusangane y Judio sija: Mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela; taemanoja pago jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you can't come,' so now I tell you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tinago nuebo junae jamyo, na infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo; taegüije yan guajo juguaeya jamyo, ya jamyo locue infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo.
pairs.english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just like I have loved you; that you also love one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este todo y taotao ufanmatungo na jamyo disipulujo, yaguin infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo.
pairs.english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon Pedro ilegña nu güiya: Señot, para mano jao? Ynepe as Jesus: Mano yo guato, ti siña jao pago undalalag yo, lao ti apmam undalalag yo.
pairs.english: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going, you can't follow now, but you will follow afterwards."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Pedro: Señot, sa jafa na ti siña judalalag jao pago? jupolo y linâlâjo guiya jago.
pairs.english: Peter said to him, "Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Unpolo y linâlâmo guiya guajo? Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, na ti uoo y gayo asta tiempo na undague yo tres biaje!
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMIYO ninafañachatsaga corasonmiyo: injenggue si Yuus, jenggue yo locue.
pairs.english: "Don't let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guima Tatajo nae guaja megae na sagayan: yaguin ti utaegüine mojon jagas jusagane jamyo. Bae jujanao ya jufamauleg y saga para jamyo.
pairs.english: In my Father's house are many homes. If it weren't so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jumanao yo ya jufamauleg y saga para jamyo, jumamaela talo mague ya jucone jamyo yan guajo; sa manoja yo nae sumaga, ayoja locue jamyo.
pairs.english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mano yo guato, intingo y chalan.
pairs.english: Where I go, you know, and you know the way."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Tomas: Señot, ti intingo para mano jao; ya jafa taemano tungomame nu y chalan?
pairs.english: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don't know where you are going. How can we know the way?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajo y chalan, yan y minagajet, yan y linâlâ; taya malag y Tata, yan ti pot guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guinin intingoyo, mojon intingo locue y Tatajo; ya desde pago intingo güe ya inlie güe.
pairs.english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu guiya si Felipe: Señot, fanue jam nu y Tata ya basta para jame.
pairs.english: Philip said to him, "Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Megae na tiempo na manjita, ya asta pago ti untungo yo Felipe? Y lumiiyo, jaliija y Tata. Ya jafa muna ilegmo: Fanue jam nu y Tata?
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, 'Show us the Father?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti unjonggue na guajo gaegue gui as Tata, ya y Tata gaegue guiya guajo? Sa y finijo nu y jusasangan, ti jusasangan pot guajoja; lao y Tata nu y sumasasaga guiya guajo, ayo fumatinas y chechoña sija.
pairs.english: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jenggue na gaegue yo gui as Tata, ya y Tata gaegue guiya guajo: yaguin ti pot este, jenggueyo pot y checho sija.
pairs.english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo: Y jumonggueyo, y checo nu y juchogüe, güiya chumogüe locue; ya mas dangculo na chocho qui este jachogüe; sa jujanao para as Tata.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y ingagao pot y naanjo, bae jufatinas, sa y Tata uresibe minalagña nu y Lajiña.
pairs.english: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja y ingagaoyo pot y naanjo, bae jufatinas ayo.
pairs.english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin inguaeya yo, inadaje y tinagojo.
pairs.english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jutayuyut si Tata ya infanninae otro Consoladot para ugaegue guiya jamyo na taejinecog.
pairs.english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y Espiritun minagajet nu y tano ti siña umaresibe; sa ti malie güe, ya ti matungo güe; lao jamyo intingo güe; sa sumaga yan jamyo, ya ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can't receive; for it doesn't see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti judingo jamyo güetfano: jumamaela guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dididija talo, y tano ti uliiyo; lao jamyo inliija yo; sa lâlâyo, ya infanlâlâja locue.
pairs.english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güije na jaane umasusede na intingo na gaegueyo gui as Tata, ya jamyo guiya guajo ya guajo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guaja y tinagojo ya jaadadaje, ayo yo gumaeya; ya y gumaeya yo, ugüinaeya as Tata, ya juguaeya güe; ya jufanuegüe nu guajo mamaesa.
pairs.english: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Judas, ti si Iscariote: Señot, jafa muna unfanue jam nu jago namaesa ya ti unfanue y tano?
pairs.english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, "Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jaye yo y gumaeya, uadaje y sinanganjo; ya ugüinaeya as Tata, ya jame infatoigüe güe ya insagaye güe.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti gumaeya yo, ti jaadaje y sinanganjo; ya y sinangan nu y injingog, ti sinanganjo, lao iyon y Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: He who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words. The word which you hear isn't mine, but the Father's who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusagane jamyo anae manjijita.
pairs.english: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y Consoladat y Espiritu Santo; nu si Tata utinago pot y naanjo, güiya infanfinanagüe todosija, ya inninafanjajasoja todo y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pas jupoluye jamyo; y pasjo junae jamyo; ti taegüine y ninaen y tano na ninaejo. Chamiyo ninafañachatsaga corasonmiyo ni infanmaañao.
pairs.english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo jagas injingogja jafa y jusagane jamyo, bae jujano, ya jutalo güine mague guiya jamyo. Yaguin inguaeya yo, magajet infanmagof, sa bae jujanao ya jufalag as Tata; sa si Tata dangculoña qui guajo.
pairs.english: You heard how I told you, 'I go away, and I come to you.' If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said 'I am going to my Father;' for the Father is greater than I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jagas jusangane jamyo antes qui umasusede, para yanguin jasusede, jamyo injenggue.
pairs.english: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde pago na tiempo ti jucuentuse jamyo megae, sa y magalagen este na tano ufato, ya taya iyoña guiya guajo;
pairs.english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tano ujatungo na juguaeya si Tata, ya jaftaemanoja si Tata jasangane yo, ayo muna jufatinas. Fangajulo ya nije tafanjanao.
pairs.english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJO y magajet na trongconubas ya si Tatajo güiya y magas y fangualuan.
pairs.english: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y ramas guiya guajo nu y taetinegcha, janajanao; ya todo ayo y ramas nu y gaetinegcha, janagasgas, para umegae tinegchaña.
pairs.english: Every branch in me that doesn't bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago nae jamyo mangasgas pot y finijo nu y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fañaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya jamyo. Taegüije y ramas ti siña mañogcha güiya namaesa, yaguin ti sumaga gui trongconubas, parejoja yan jamyo yaguin ti infañaga guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can't bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y trongconubas, jamyo y ramas. Y sumaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya güiya, güiya ufañogcha megae; sa apatte di guajo taya siña infatinas.
pairs.english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un taotao ti sumaga guiya guajo, umanajanao güe parejoja yan y ramas, ya umalayo, ya jajojoca, ya japopolo gui guafe, ya ufanmasonggue.
pairs.english: If a man doesn't remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin mañaga jamyo guiya guajo, ya y finojo sumaga guiya jamyo, infanmangagao todo y malagomiyo ya jufatinas para jamyo.
pairs.english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este uninamalag si Tatajo, ya infanmanogcha megae; ya taegüenao jamyo y udisipulojo.
pairs.english: "In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao si Tata jaguaeya yo, guajo parejoja juguaeya jamyo locue; ya fañaga jamyo gui güinaeyaco.
pairs.english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin inadadaje y tinagojo sija, jamyo infañañaga gui güinaeyaco; parejoja yan guajo juadadaje y tinago y Tatajo ya sumasasaga yo gui güinaeyaña.
pairs.english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and remain in his love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusangane jamyo, para minagofjo usaga guiya jamyo, ya y minagofmiyo ubula.
pairs.english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y tinagojo, na infanguaeya entre jamyo uno yan otro, calang y juguaeya jamyo.
pairs.english: "This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya uno guaja güinaeyaña mas dangculo qui este, na y taotao japolo y linâlâfia pot y amiguña sija.
pairs.english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo y amigujo sija, yaguin infatinas jafa y jutago jamyo.
pairs.english: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jagasja jufanaan jamyo tentago sija, sa y tentago ti jatungo jafa checho y magasña; lao jufanaan jamyo amigo sija; sa todosija ni jujungog gui as Tata, junatungoja jamyo.
