pairs.english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn't know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jamyo umayig yo, lao guajo jamyo umayig ya jutago jamyo, na infanjanao ya infanmanogcha, ya y tinegchanmiyo usaga; sa todosija y ingagao si Tata pot y naanjo, güiya infanninae.
pairs.english: You didn't choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jutago jamyo, na infanaguaeya entre jamyo uno yan otro.
pairs.english: "I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manchinatlie jamyo nu y tano, intingoja na guajo finena chinatlie antes qui jamyo.
pairs.english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin iyon y tano jamyo y tano uguaeya iyoña: lao ti iyon y tano jamyo, ya guajo jamyo umayig gui tano, ayo muna manchinatlie jamyo nu y tano.
pairs.english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso jamyo y sinangan ni munjayan jusangane jamyo: Y tentago ti dangculoña qui y magasña. Yaguin mapetsigue yo, infanmapetsigue jamyo locue; yaguin manadaje y sinanganjo, umanadaje y sinanganmiyo locue.
pairs.english: Remember the word that I said to you: 'A servant is not greater than his lord.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo estesija umafatinas guiya jamyo pot causan y naanjo; sa ti matungo ayo y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they don't know him who sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ti matoyo, ya ti jusangane sija, taya isaoñija; lao pago taya escusañija pot y isaoñija.
pairs.english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y chumatlie yo, güiya chumatlie si Tata locue.
pairs.english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ti jufatinas gui entaloñija chochosija na taya ni uno fumatinas, taya isaoñija; lao pago esta jalie ya jachatlie yo yan si Tata.
pairs.english: If I hadn't done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn't have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este ususede, sa para umacumple y sinangan nu y matugue gui tinagoñija: sija chumatlie yo, sin jafa.
pairs.english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, 'They hated me without a cause.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin mato y Consoladot, ni y junamamaela guinin as Tata, y Espiritu y minagajet nu y mamaela guinin as Tata, güiya infanninae testimonio pot guajo.
pairs.english: "When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo locue infanmannae testimonio, sa guinin manjijita desde y tutujonña.
pairs.english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTESIJA jusangane jamyo para chamiyo, fanmatotompo.
pairs.english: "These things have I spoken to you, so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Infanmayute juyong gui sinagoga sija; junggan, y tiempo ufato nae jayeja y pumuno jamyo, jinasoña na jafatinas y checho Yuus.
pairs.english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estesija infanfinatinas, sa ti jatungo y Tata, ni guajo.
pairs.english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estesija guinin jusangane jamyo, na yaguin ufato ayo na ora, injaso estesija, jaftaemanoja y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago bae jujanao para ayo y tumago yo; ya taya uno guiya jamyo ufaesen yo: Para mano jao?
pairs.english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pot y jusangane jamyo nu estesija y pinite esta bula y corasonmiyo.
pairs.english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo ni minagajet, na maulegñaja para jamyo na jujanao; sa yaguin ti jumanao yo, y Consoladot ti umamaela guiya jamyo; lao yaguin jumanao yo, junamamaela güe guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don't go away, the Counselor won't come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin ufato güe, ujusga y tano ni isao yan y tininas yan y juisio:
pairs.english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y isao sa sija ti majonggue yo;
pairs.english: about sin, because they don't believe in me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininas sa bae jujanao para y Tata, ya jocog nae inliiyo;
pairs.english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won't see me any more;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y juisio sa y magas este y tano esta jajusga.
pairs.english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja yo megae na güinaja trabia para jusangane jamyo; lao ti siña jamyo insingon pago.
pairs.english: "I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ufato ayo y Espiritun minagajet, güiya infanfinanue jamyo todo y minagajet; sa ti usangan pot güiyaja, lao todosija, jiningogña, ayosija usangan: yan ayosija y umasusede despues, inninafanmanatungo jamyo.
pairs.english: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufannae yo minalag sa mañuñule y güinaja na guiya guajo ya ujasangane jamyo.
pairs.english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todosija y güinajan Tata, iyoco; ayo mina, jusangan na mañuñule y güinaja na guiya guajo ya ujasangane jamyo.
pairs.english: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Trabia dididija na tiempo, ti inlie yo talo; ya y otro biaje dididija na tiempo inlie yo.
pairs.english: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo disipulo ilegñija entre sija uno yan otro: Jafa muna ilegña este nu jita? Dididija na tiempo ti inlie yo; ya y otro biaje, dididija na tiempo inlie yo: sa bae jujanao para as Tata?
pairs.english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, "What is this that he says to us, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;' and, 'Because I go to the Father?'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegñija: Jafa este muna ilegña? Dididija na tiempo? Ti tatungo jafa ilegña.
pairs.english: They said therefore, "What is this that he says, 'A little while?' We don't know what he is saying."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jatungoja si Jesus na manmalago na umafaesen güe, ya ilegña nu sija: Manafaesen entre jamyo jafa y ilelegco: Dididija na tiempo ya ti inlie yo; ya otro biaje, dididija na tiempo inlie yo?
pairs.english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, "Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo: infananges yan infanugungñaejon, lao y tano umagof; ya jamyo infantriste, lao y tristenmiyo umabira para minagof.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palaoan yaguin para ufañago guaja pinitiña, sa mato y oraña; lao yaguin munjayan jafañago y patgon, mafeta nu y pinitiña, pot y minagofña na esta mañago un taotao gui tano.
pairs.english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jamyo locue magajet na infantriste; lao yaguin manaliijit talo, ufanmagof corasonmiyo, ya taya siña munajanao y minagofmiyo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na jaane ti infaesen yo ni jafa. Magajet y magajet y jusangane jamyo, todosija y ingagao y Tata, infanninae pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: "In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta pago taya ingagagao pot y naanjo: gagao ya inresibi, ya ubula y minagofmiyo.
pairs.english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 25 60660 ¶ Estesija guinin jusangane jamyo gui acomparasion sija; lao ufato y ora na ti jusangane jamyo gui acomparasion sija, lao jusangane jamyo claro y güinajan Tata.
pairs.english: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na jaane infanmangagao pot y naanjo: lao ada ti jusangane jamyo na guajo jutayuyute jamyo gui Tata;
pairs.english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don't say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata mangüinaeya jamyo, sa esta inguaeya yo, ya injenggue na mamaela yo guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamaela yo guinin as Tata, ya matoyo gui tano: lao judingo talo y tano, sa bae janao para as Tata.
pairs.english: I came out from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipuluña ilegñija: Estagüe, pago na unsangan claro, ya taya acomparasion unsangan.
pairs.english: His disciples said to him, "Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago intingo na jago untungo todosija; ya ti unnesesita ni jaye unfinaesenjao: pot este injenggue na jago mamaela guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: Now we know that you know all things, and don't need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came forth from God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe sija as Jesus: Injenggue pago?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na ufato y ora, ya esta mato pago, na cada uno ujanao para y iyoña, ya indingo yo namaesaja; lao trabia ti guajoja namaesaja sa jumajame an Tata.
pairs.english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusangane jamyo, para infangaepas guiya guajo. Infangaemasâpet gui tano; lao mantiene y minatatnganmiyo, sa guajo esta jugana y tano.
pairs.english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTESIJA jasangan si Jesus ya tumalag jilo gui langet, ya ilegña: Tata, esta mato y ora; namalag y Lajimo, sa y Lajimo unninamalag locue.
pairs.english: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, "Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejaja unnae güe ninasiñaña para todo y catne; ya para todosija y unnae güe, güiya numae sija taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este yuje y taejinecog la linâlâ, na intingo jao, na unoja y magajet na Yuus; yan si Jesuscristo nu y jago tumago.
pairs.english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta junamalag jao gui tano, ya munjayan y chechojo nu y unnaeyo na juchogüe.
pairs.english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago, jagoja Tata, unnamalag yo yan jago na maesa ni ayo na minalag anae estaba jumijita antes di y tano.
pairs.english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta jufanue nu y naanmo y taotao nu y unnae yo gui tano; sa iyomo, ya unnae yo; ya sija maadaje y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago sija matungo na todosija y unnae yo, sija iyomo.
pairs.english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finijo sija ni y unnae yo, jusangane sija; ya jaresibe, yan jatungo magajet na mamaela yo guinin jago; ya jajonggue na jagoyo tumago.
pairs.english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came forth from you, and they have believed that you sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jutayuyute sija; ti y tano jutayuyute, lao sija y unnaeyo, sa sija iyomo.
pairs.english: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todosija y iyomo, iyoco; ya y iyoco, iyomo; ya guajayo minalag guiya sija.
pairs.english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago taegüe yo gui tano, ya este sija mangaegue gui tano; ya mato yo guiya jago. Tata Santo adaje pot y naanmo, ayo sija y unnaeyo, para ufanunoja, parejo an jita.
pairs.english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae estaba yo manjajame gui tano, juadadajeja sija pot y naanmo; ayo sija ni y unnaeyo ya juadadajeja ya taya ni uno malilingo, lao unoja esta malingo, güiya patgon yinilang; para ujacumple y tinigue sija.
pairs.english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago mato yo iya jago; ya estesija jusasangan gui tano para y minagofjo ubula guiya sija.
pairs.english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo guinin numae sija ni y sinanganmo; ya y tano manchinatlie sija; sa sija ti iyon y tano, parejoja yan guajo ti iyon y tano.
pairs.english: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jutayuyut jao na unnajanao gui tano, lao unadaje sija gui tinaelaye.
pairs.english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ti iyon y tano, parejo yan guajo ti iyon y tano.
pairs.english: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nagasgas sija pot y minagajetmo; y sinanganmo güiya minagajet.
pairs.english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao jago tumago yo gui tano, parejoja guajo locue munajutago sija gui tano.
pairs.english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot sija, juconsagra yo namaesa, para sija locue ufangasgas pot y minagajet.
pairs.english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ta ti sijaja jutayuyute, lao ayo sija locue y jumonggue yo pot y sinanganñija.
pairs.english: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa para todo sija ufanunoja; parejoja yan jago, Tata, gaegue jao guiya guajo, ya guajo gaegue guiya jago; sija locue ufanunoja guiya jita; para ujonggue y tano na jago tumago yo.
pairs.english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y minalag nu y unnae yo, junae sija: para ufanunoja parejo yan jita unoja.
pairs.english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo guiya sija, ya jago guiya guajo, para ufancabales gui unoja; ya para utungo y tano, na jago tumago yo, ya ungüaeya sija, parejoja yan güinaeyamo nu guajo.
pairs.english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata! ayosija y unnae yo, malago yo na manoyo nae gaegue, sija ufangaegue locue; para ujalie y minalagjo ni y unnae yo; sa unguaeya yo antes di jiniyong y tano.
pairs.english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata tunas jao, y tano ti jatungo jao; lao guajo tumungo jao, ya estesija jatungo na jago tumagoyo.
pairs.english: Righteous Father, the world hasn't known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo minamatungo sija y naanmo ya bae junatungo: na ayo na güinaeya ni y ungüaeya yo, ayo gaegue guiya sija, yan guajo guiya sija.
pairs.english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE si Jesus munjayan jasangan este sija na sinangan, mapos yan y disipuluña para otro banda y sadog Sidron, anae guaja un güetta, ya jumalom güe yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas locue, ni y umentrega güe, jatungo ayo na lugat; sa megae na biaje si Jesus jumanao güije yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Judas mañule y inetnon sendalo, yan y ofisiat sija ni manmagas na mamale yan y Fariseo, mamalag ayo na lugat, manmañuñule falot, yan candet, yan atmas.
pairs.english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus jatungo todosija na ufanmato guiya güiya, ya jumuyong güe gui menanñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye inaliligao?
pairs.english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went forth, and said to them, "Who are you looking for?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepeñija: Si Jesus Nasareno. Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Guajo yo. Gaegue güije locue mañisija yan Judas y umentrega güe.
pairs.english: They answered him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am he." Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan: Guajo yo; manalo guato ya mamodong gui tano.
pairs.english: When therefore he said to them, "I am he," they went backward, and fell to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tomalo jafaesen sija: Jaye inaliligao? Ya ilegñija: Si Jesus Nasareno.
pairs.english: Again therefore he asked them, "Who are you looking for?" They said, "Jesus of Nazareth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus; Munjayanyo jusangane jamyo na guajo yo: Yaguin guajo inaliligao, polo ya ufanjanao este sija:
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ucumple y sinangan na esta jasangan: Ayo sija ni unnae yo, ni uno junafalingo.
pairs.english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, "Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Simon Pedro guaja espadaña, jachule ya janachetnudan un tentago mamale, ya jautut un talagaña gui agapa. Ya y tentago naanña si Malco.
pairs.english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus elegña as Pedro: Na jalom y espadamo gui baena; y copa ni janaeyo si tata, ada taya para juguimen?
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, "Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na tiempo y inetnon sendalo, yan y magas sendalo, yan y ofisiat y Judio sija, macone si Jesus ya magode.
pairs.english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya finenana machule guato as Annas; sa güiya y suegron Caefas, na magasja na pale güije na año.
pairs.english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Caefas manae consejo ni y Judio sija, na janesisita un taotao para umatae pot y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 15 61150 ¶ Ya madalalag si Jesus si Simon Pedro, taegüenao yan otro disipulo. Ya ayo y otro disipulo atungo y magas na pale; ya jumalom yan si Jesus; gui quelat y palasyon y magas na pale.
pairs.english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro gaegue gui sanjiyong y petta. Entonses ayo y otro disipulo ni y atungo y magas na pale jumuyong, ya jasangane y pottera, ya janajalom si Pedro.
pairs.english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ayo na palaoan ni y jaadaje y petta ilegña as Pedro: Ti jago locue disipulon este na taotao? Güiya ilegña: Aje, ti guajo.
pairs.english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, "Are you also one of this man's disciples?" He said, "I am not."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaegue güije y tentago sija yan y ofisiat, sija, manotojgue, ya jafatinas y guafin pinigan; sa manenggeng; ya janafanmamaepe sija: ya esta tomotojgue mañisija yan Pedro janamamaepe güe.
pairs.english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 19 61190 ¶ Ya y magas na pale jafaesen si Jesus jaftaemano y disipuluña yan y doctrinaña.
pairs.english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepeña si Jesus: Guajo sumangan claro gui tano; guajo siempre mamanagüe guiya sinagogo yan y templo anae manetnon todo y Judio sija; ya taya jucuentuse gui secreto.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa mina unfafaesen yo? Faesen y manmanjungog ni y jusangane sija. Estagüe, sija y tumungo y sinanganjo.
pairs.english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae güiya esta sumangan este, uno gui ofisiat sija na mangaegue güije, japatmada si Jesus ya ilegña: Taegüenao unope y magas na pale?
pairs.english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, "Do you answer the high priest like that?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe güe as Jesus: Yaguin jusangan taelaye, nae testimonio nu y taelaye; yaguin mauleg, pot jafa mina innachinudan yo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Annas ninamacone güe mangode para as Caefas, magas na pale.
pairs.english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 25 61250 ¶ Ayo nae si Simon Pedro estaba tomotojgue janamamaepe güe. Entonses ilegñija nu güiya: Ada ti güiya jao uno gui disipuluña? Güiya mandague ya ilegña: Ti guajo yo.
pairs.english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, "You aren't also one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, and said, "I am not."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uno gui tentagon magas na pale, parientes ayo y jautut si Pedro y talagaña, ya sinangane: Ti julie jao gui güetta yan güiya?
pairs.english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, "Didn't I see you in the garden with him?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Luego mandague talo si Pedro. Y enseguidas y gayo umoo.
pairs.english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 28 61280 ¶ Ayo nae macone si Jesus güine as Caefas gui jalom palasyo: ya ogaan güije; ya sija ti manjalom gui palasyo, pot no sea infanninaale, lao para usiña mañocho gui pascua.
pairs.english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn't enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mapos juyong si Pilato guiya sija ya ilegña: Jafa na finaaela inchichile contra este na taotao?
pairs.english: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, "What accusation do you bring against this man?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Yaguin ti taelaye finatinasña, ti inentregao.
pairs.english: They answered him, "If this man weren't an evildoer, we wouldn't have delivered him up to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina si Pilato ilegña nu sija: Chile güe jamyo ya injisga jaftaemano y laymiyo. Ylegñija y Judio sija nu güiya: Ti tunas na jame, infanmannae finatae ni jaye.
pairs.english: Pilate therefore said to them, "Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law." Therefore the Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y sinangan Jesus ni jasangan, janamatungo jafa na finataeña nae umatae.
pairs.english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 33 61330 ¶ Entonses si Pilato tumalo jumalom gui palasyo ya jaagang si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jago jao y Ray Judio sija?
pairs.english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, "Are you the King of the Jews?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Unsasangan este pot jagoja namaesa, pat otro sija sumangangane jao pot guajo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, "Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato manope: Guajo Judio yo? Nasionmo, ya y manmagas na mamale, maentrega yo nu jago: Jafa finatinasmo?
pairs.english: Pilate answered, "I'm not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Y raenoco, ti ujuyong gui sanjilo este na tano: Yaguin y raenoco ujuyong gui sanjilo este na tano, y tentagojo sija ufanmumo, pot guajo, ya ti jumaentrega gui Judio sija: lao pago y raenoco ti ujuyong güine.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn't be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Pilato ilegña nu güiya: Jago pues un ray jao? Ynepe as Jesus: Jago umalog na guajo un ray. Guajo minamafañago yo, pot este, yan minamamaela yo gui tano pot este, para umanae testimonio ni minagajet. Todo ayo y iyon minagajet, jajungog y inagangjo.
pairs.english: Pilate therefore said to him, "Are you a king then?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato ilegña nu güiya: Jafa na güinaja y minagajet? Anae munjayan jasangan este, tumalo guato gui Judio sija ya ilegña nu sija: Guajo ti mañoda yo guiya güiya jafa na isao.
pairs.english: Pilate said to him, "What is truth?" When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, "I find no basis for a charge against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo guaja costumbrenmiyo na junalibre uno para jamyo gui pascua. Manmalago jamyo na junalibre y Ray Judio sija?
pairs.english: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses managang talo ya ilegñija: Ti este; lao si Barabas. Ya si Barabas güiya un saque.
pairs.english: Then they all shouted again, saying, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae si Pilato jachule si Jesus, ya jasaulag.
pairs.english: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sendalo sija jadufog tituca para un corona, ya japolo gui iluña ya manaminagago güe ni magagon agaga.
pairs.english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmato jijot ya ilegñija: Jafa tatatmano jao, Ray Judio sija? Ya manae patmada.
pairs.english: They kept saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" and they kept slapping him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Pilato jumuyong talo, ya ilegña nu sija: Estagüe na jachule guiya jamyo juyong, para intingo na ni un isao jusoda guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, "Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo anae si Jesus mapos juyong, jachuchule y coronan tituca yan y magagon agaga. Ya ilegña nu sija si Pilato: Estagüe y taotao!
pairs.english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, "Behold, the man!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae malie güe ni y magas mamale yan y ofisiat sija, manaagang ilegñija: Atane gui quiluus, atane gui quiluus. Si Pilato ilegña nu sija: Chile jamyo ya inatane gui quiluus; sa guajo ti mañoda yo jafa na isao guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, "Crucify! Crucify!" Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maope güe ni y Judio sija: Jame guaja laymame, ya segun y laymame, debe umatae, sa jafa na güiya jafatinas maesa güe Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato anae jajungog este na sinangan, guaja güe mas dangculo na minaañao;
pairs.english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom talo gui palasyo ya ilegña as Jesus: Jago, taotao mano jao? Ya si Jesus taya inepeña.
pairs.english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, "Where are you from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato pues ilegña nu güiya: Jago ti umadingane yo? Ti untungo na guaja yo ninasiñajo para junalibre jao, ya para juatane jao gui quiluus?
pairs.english: Pilate therefore said to him, "Aren't you speaking to me? Don't you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe si Jesus: Ti siña y ninasiñamo contra guajo, yaguin ti manaejao gui sanjilo; enao mina y umentrega yo guiya jago, guaja mas dangculo na isao.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, "You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin este, si Pilato jaaligao y lugat para unalibre gue: lao y Judio sija managang ilegñija: Yaguin unnalibre este na taotao, ti amigon Sesat jao; sa ayo y umanaray, jasangan contra si Sesat.
pairs.english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Pilato jajungog este na sinangan, jachule si Jesus juyong ya matachong gui tribuna, gui lugat na mafanaan Piso, ya y Hebreo na finojo Gábbatta.
pairs.english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called "The Pavement," but in Hebrew, "Gabbatha."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y tiempo para ufamauleg y pascua: jijot y ora gui las saes. Entonses ilegña ni y Judio sija: Estagüe y Raymiyo!
pairs.english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, "Behold, your King!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manaagang, ilegñija: Najanao! najanao! Atane gui quiluus! Ylegña nu sija si Pilato: Juatane y Raymiyo? Magas na mamale manmanope: Taya raymame na si Sesatja.
pairs.english: They cried out, "Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses maentrega güe guiya sija para umatane gui quiluus. Ya sija cumone si Jesus!
pairs.english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 17 61570 ¶ Ya güiya chumuchuchule y quiluusña, jumanao para ayo na lugat na mafanaan y sagan calabera, cumequeilegña gui Hebreo na finijo, Golgota;
pairs.english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called "The Place of a Skull," which is called in Hebrew, "Golgotha,"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae maatane gui quiluus; yan y gachongña otro dos, gui dos banda Jesus ya si Jesus gui talo.
pairs.english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manugue si Pilato un tinigue ya mapolo gui sanjilo y quiluus. Ya y tinigue: SI JESUS NASARENO, RAY Y JUDIO SIJA.
pairs.english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, "JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na Judio sija tumaetae este na tinigue, sa y lugat anae maatane si Jesus, jijot gui siuda, ya esta matugue gui Hebreo, yan Griega, yan Lating.
pairs.english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae elegñija as Pilato y manmagas na mamale yan y Judio sija: Chamo titigue: Ray y Judio sija: lao güiya umalog: Guajo y Ray y Judio sija.
pairs.english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, "Don't write, 'The King of the Jews,' but, 'he said, I am King of the Jews.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Pilato: Jafa y jutugue esta jutugue.
pairs.english: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 23 61630 ¶ Entonses y sendalo sija, anae munjayan maatane gui quiluus si Jesus, machule y magaguña, ya mafatinas cuatro patte, cada sendalo un patte; yan y tunico na magago locue; güiya taya malagseña, lao todo matufog desde y sanjilo asta y sanpapa.
pairs.english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao ilegñija entre sija: Mungajit umipe, lao tapolo suette gui jiloña, jaye gaeyo güe: para umacumple y tinigue na ilegña: Mapatte entre sija y magagujo, ya y tunico na magagojo mafatinas y suette. Estesija y sendalo fumatinas.
pairs.english: Then they said to one another, "Let's not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be," that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, "They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots." Therefore the soldiers did these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 25 61650 ¶ Ya manotojgue gui fiun quiluus Jesus, si nanaña, yan y chelun nanaña as Maria, yan si Maria palaoan Cleopas, yan si Maria Magdalena.
pairs.english: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus si nanaña, yan y disipuluña ni jaguaeya na tomotojgue jijot, ilegña as nanaña: Palaoan, enaogüe y lajimo!
pairs.english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, "Woman, behold your son!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Despues, ilegña ni disipulo: Enaogüe si nanamo. Desde ayo na ora y disipulo inadaje güe gui guimaña.
pairs.english: Then he said to the disciple, "Behold, your mother!" From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 28 61680 ¶ Despues di este, jatungo si Jesus na todosija esta manmacumple, para y tinigue umacumple, ilegña: Majoyo.
pairs.english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I am thirsty."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije un nayan na bula y binagle: Ya sija nabula y espongja y binagle ya mapolo gui jilo un jayo na naanña y hisopo, ya manafalag y pachotña.
pairs.english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Jesus jaguinem y binagle, elegña: Jocog esta: ya janaeguen y iluña ya jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, "It is finished." He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 31 61710 ¶ Entonses y Judio sija, sa ayo na jaane y jaanen Preparasion; para y tataotao sija taya usaga gui quiluus gui sabado na jaane (sa dangculo ayo na jaane y sabado), manmangagao as Pilato na ufanmajulog y adengñija ya umanafanjanao güije.
pairs.english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanmato sija y sendalo ya majulog y adengña y finenana, yan y otro, ayo dos y guinin y matane gui quiluus yan guiya;
pairs.english: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato gui as Jesus, ya malie na güiya esta matae, ti julog y adengña:
pairs.english: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn't break his legs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao uno gui sendalo sija, janaadotgan gui calaguagña y lansaña, ya jumuyong y jâgâ yan janom.
pairs.english: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya y lumie mannae testimonio, ya y testimonioña, güiya magajet: ya güiya tumungo na jafa, ilegña magajet, para jamyo locue injenggue.
pairs.english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este na güinaja jumuyong esta para umacumple y tinigue na ilegña: Ni un tolang guiya güiya umajulog.
pairs.english: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, "A bone of him will not be broken."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan locue otro tinigue ilegña: Umaatan ayo ni janaadotgan.
pairs.english: Again another Scripture says, "They will look on him whom they pierced."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 38 61780 ¶ Despues di malofan estesija, si José taotao Arimatea, ya disipulon Jesus, lao gui secreto sa maañao ni Judio sija, jagagao si Pilato na güiya unajanao y tataotao Jesus: entonses si Pilato japolo. Ya mato güe ya janajanao y tataotaoña.
pairs.english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato locue si Nicodemo, na jagas mato gui as Jesus gui puenge, mañuñule un dinañan mira yan chaguan na jajatot, na y minacatña sien libra.
pairs.english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jachule y tataotao Jesus, ya maafuyut magago yan paopao, taemanoja y costumbre y Judio sija an manmanjafot.
pairs.english: So they took Jesus' body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na lugat nae maatane gui quiluus, guaja un güetta, ya y güetta nae guaja un naftan nuebo, ya asta pago taya nae mapoluye.
pairs.english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapolo si Jesus, sa ayo na jaane y jaanin Preparasion y Judio sija (sa ayo na naftan estaba jijot).
pairs.english: Then because of the Jews' Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana na jaane gui semana, gui egaan anae ti claro, si Maria Magdalena mato gui naftan, ya jalie y acho na manajanao gui naftan.
pairs.english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses malago ya malag as Simon Pedro, yan y otro disipulo ni güinaeya as Jesus, ya ilegña nu sija: Jachule y Señot gui naftan ya jame ti intingo mano nae japolo.
pairs.english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have laid him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmapos si Pedro yan y otro disipulo, ya manmato gui naftan.
pairs.english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago sija y dos umetnon: ya y otro disipulo malago chadigña qui si Pedro, ya mato finenana gui naftan.
pairs.english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ñumejon ya jaatan, ya jalie y magago lenso na mapolo; lao ti jumalom.
pairs.english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn't enter in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mato si Simon Pedro ni dumadalalag güe, ya jumalom gui naftan, ya jalie y magago lenso na mapolo,
pairs.english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magago sudario na gaegue gui jilo y iluña, ti mapolo yan y palo magago, lao y otro lugat na mabalulutan.
pairs.english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses jumalom locue ayo y otro disipulo, ni guine mato finenana gui naftan; ya jalie yan jajonggue.
pairs.english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti matutungo trabia y tinigue, na janesesita na güiya ucajulo guine entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manalo y disipulo sija guato gui guimañija.
pairs.english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 11 61930 ¶ Ya si Maria gaegue güije gui san jiyong, jijot y naftan ya tumatanges; ya tumanges, ñumejon papa y jaatan y sanjalom y naftan;
pairs.english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie dos angjet na minagagon apaca, na manmatatachong, y uno gui para y ilo, y otro para y adeng, anae y tataotao Jesus guine mapolo.
pairs.english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Palaoan, jafa na tumatanges jao? Ylegña nu sija: Sa jafa muna jachule y Señotjo, ya ti jutungo mano nae japolo.
pairs.english: They told her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don't know where they have laid him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jasangan este, tumalo tate, ya jalie si Jesus, güije na tomotojgue, lao ti jatungo cao güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Palaoan, jafa na tumatanges jao? Jaye unaliligao? Pineloña na ayo na taotao y taotao y güetta, ilegña nu guiya: Señot, yaguin jago chumule, sangane yo mano nae unpolo, ya juchule güe.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?" She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Maria! Jabira guiya güiya ya, ilegña gui Hebreo na finijo: Raboni! cumequeilegña, Maestro;
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned and said to him, "Rabboni !" which is to say, "Teacher !"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Chamo yo pumapacha; sa asta pago ti cajulo yo gui as Tata; lao janao para y mañelujo ya unsangane sija, na jucajulo gui Tatajo ya yan Tatamiyo, y Yuusjo yan y Yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to her, "Don't hold me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Maria Magdalena ya jasangane y disipulo sija: Esta julie y Señot; ya jaftaemano sinangane güe nu este na güinaja.
pairs.english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 19 62010 ¶ Ya anae esta pupuenge, güije mismo na jaane, y finenana gui semana, ya y petta manmajujuchom, güije nae mangaegue y disipulo sija manetnon sa manmaañao ni Judio sija, mato si Jesus, ya tumojgue güe gui talo ya ilegña nu sija: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace be to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, manfinanue ni canaeña yan y calaguagña. Ayo nae manmagof y disipulo sija anae malie y Señot.
pairs.english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija talo: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo; taemanoja si Tata ni tumago yo, taegüije locue jutago jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them again, "Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, manguaefe gui jiloñija ya ilegña nu sija: Resibe jamyo y Espirito Santo.
pairs.english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inasie ni y isaoñija, sija ufanmaasie; ya iyonñija y indetiene sija ufanmadetiene.
pairs.english: If you forgive anyone's sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone's sins, they have been retained."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 24 62060 ¶ Ya si Tomas, uno gui dose, na mafananaan si Didimo, taegüe guiya sija anae mato si Jesus.
pairs.english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn't with them when Jesus came.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya y palo disipulo: Y Señot guinin talie. Lao ilegña nu sija: Yaguin ti julie gui canaeña y señat y lilog sija, ya junajalom y calalotjo gui señat y lilog, yan ti junajalom y canaejo gui calaguagña, ti jujonggue.
pairs.english: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 26 62080 ¶ Ya despues di manmalofan ocho na jaane, anae disipulo sija mangaegue talo gui sanjalom, mañisija yan si Tomas. Mato si Jesus, macandalo y petta, ya sumaga gui entalo ya ilegña: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace be to you."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña as Tomas: Namamaela güine mague y calolotmo, ya unlie y canaejo; ya namamaela güine mague y canaemo, ya unnajalom gui calaguagmo; ya chamo tataeinangoco, lao unjonggue.
pairs.english: Then he said to Thomas, "Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don't be unbelieving, but believing."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Tomas manope ya ilegña nu güiya: Señotjo yan Yuusjo.
pairs.english: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pot y unlie yo, Tomas, na unjonggue yo: mandichoso ayo sija y ti manmanlie, lao manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 30 62120 ¶ Magajet, megae sija na señat palo na jafatinas si Jesus gui menan y disipuluña na ti matugue güine na leblo:
pairs.english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este sija manmatugue para injenggue na si Jesus, güiya si Cristo, Lajin Yuus; ya anae injenggue, guaja jamyo taejinecog la linâlâ pot y naanña.
pairs.english: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan estesija, jafanue gue si Jesus otro biaje y disipulo sija gui oriyan tasen Tiberias; ya taegüine jafanue güe namaesa.
pairs.english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaegue mandadaña si Simon Pedro yan si Tomas, na mafananaan si Didimo, yan si Nataniel, taotao Cana guiya Galilea, yan y famaguon Sebedeo, yan otro dos disipuluña.
pairs.english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Simon Pedro: Jujanao para jucone y güijan. Ylegñija nu güiya: Jame indalalag jao. Manmapos ya manjalom gui un sajyan; ya ayo na puenge, taya quineneñija.
pairs.english: Simon Peter said to them, "I'm going fishing." They told him, "We are also coming with you." They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manana gui egaan si Jesus sumaga tomotojgue gui oriyan tase; ya y disipulo ti matungo cao güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu sija si Jesus: Famaguon, guaja jamyo jafa para incano? Manope güe: Taya.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore said to them, "Children, have you anything to eat?" They answered him, "No."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Yute y lagua gui agapan y sajyan, ya inseda. Mayute ya ti manasiña machule gui tase pot y minegae y güijan.
