pairs.english: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." They cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na disipulo y güinaeya as Jesus, umadingane si Pedro: Güiya y Señot. Entonses si Simon Pedro anae jajungog na güiya y Señot jadudog güe nu y magagon pescadot (sa taemagago güe), ya tumayog gui tase.
pairs.english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It's the Lord!" So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo disipulo sija manmato yan y sajyan (sa ti chago gui tano, lao guaja dosientos codo) machule y lagua, na bula ni güijan.
pairs.english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato gui tano manmanlie guafe y pinigan na mapolo esta y güijan gui jiloña, yan pan.
pairs.english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Chule mague y güijan ni inquene pago.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have just caught."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo anae cajulo si Simon Pedro ya jajala y lagua para y tano, bula dangculon güijan sija, siento y sincuenta y tres; ya achogja taegüenao y minegaeña, y lagua ti matitig.
pairs.english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn't torn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Fanmamaela ya infañocho. Ya ni uno gui disipulo sija fumaesen güe: Jago, jaye jao? matungo na güiya y Señot.
pairs.english: Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast." None of the disciples dared inquire of him, "Who are you?" knowing that it was the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mamaela si Jesus, ya jachule y pan ya manninae, ya y güijan taegüenao.
pairs.english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta güiya y mina tres na biaje na si Jesus jafanue güe y disipuluña desde tiempo nae cajulo güe guine entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 15 62280 ¶ Anae munjayan mañocho, si Jesus ilegña as Simon Pedro: Simon lajin Juan, unguaeya yo mas qui este sija? Sinangane güe: Si Señot, jago tumungo na juguaeya jao. Ylegña nu güiya: Pasto y gajo patgon quinilo.
pairs.english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you." He said to him, "Feed my lambs."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo ilegña nu güiya y mina dos biaje: Simon, lajin Juan, unguaeya yo? Ylegña nu güiya: Si Señot, untungoja na juguflie jao. Ylegña nu güiya: Adaje y gajo quinilo.
pairs.english: He said to him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you." He said to him, "Tend my sheep."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y mina tres na biaje: Simon, lajin Juan, unguflie yo? Ninatriste si Pedro na sinangane güe asta tres biaje: Unguflie yo? ya ilegña nu güiya: Señot, jago tumungo todosija: jago tumungo na juguflie jao. Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pasto y gajo quinilo.
pairs.english: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?" Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, "Do you have affection for me?" He said to him, "Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you." Jesus said to him, "Feed my sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, anae patgon jao, undudog jao nu y sentura ya malag y malagomoja: ya anae bijo jao unjuto y canaemo, ya guinede jao ni y otro, ya unquinene guato gui ti malagomo.
pairs.english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don't want to go."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este ilegña, janatungo jafa na finatae nae siña namalag si Yuus. Ya anae jasangan este, ilegña nu güiya: Dalalag yo.
pairs.english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, "Follow me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses jabira güe si Pedro ya jalie ayo na disipulo na güinaeya as Jesus dinalalag güe; ya locue umason gui pichon gui sena, ya sinangane, Señot jaye uje y umentregao?
pairs.english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' breast at the supper and asked, "Lord, who is going to betray You?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Pedro jalie este, ilegña as Jesus: Señot, jafa jumuyong para este?
pairs.english: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, "Lord, what about this man?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yegña nu güiya si Jesus: Yaguin malagojo na güiya ugagaegue asta qui mato yo, jafa y uguaja guiya jago? Dalalag yo.
pairs.english: Jesus said to him, "If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumuyong este na sinangan entre y mañelo na ayo na disipulo ti umatae: lao si Jesus sinangane, na ti umatae; lao yaguin malagoyo na güiya ugagaegue asta qui mato yo, jafa y uguaja guiya jago?
pairs.english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers , that this disciple wouldn't die. Yet Jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, but, "If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 24 62370 ¶ Este güiya y disipulo ni manae testimonio nu este sija na güinaja, ya jatugue este sija na güinaja: ya tatungo na y testimonioña, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 25 62380 ¶ Ya guaja locue palo megae na güinaja na jafatinas si Jesus, yaguin ufanmangue cada uno, jujaso na todo y tano ti omlat y leblo sija y ufanmatugue. Amen.
pairs.english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana na sinangan, jutugue, O Teofilo, pot todo ayo sija, na si Jesus jatutujon fumatinas, yan mamanagüe.
pairs.english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y jaane anae maresibe gui sanjilo, despues di munjayan jatago pot y Espiritu Santo y apostoles sija ni y inayegña:
pairs.english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ayo locue y jafanue nu güiya lalâlâ, anae munjayan mapinito pot y megae na señat, liniiñija cuarenta na jaane yan manguecuentos güinaja sija ni y mangaegue gui raenon Yuus:
pairs.english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God's Kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña yan sija, ya jatago sija na chañija fanjajanao Jerusalem, lao ujanangga y promesan y Tata ni y, ilegña, injingog guiya guajo:
pairs.english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, "Don't depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan magajet na managpapange ni y janom: lao jamyo infanmatagpange ni y Espiritu Santo ti megae na jaane desde pago.
pairs.english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 6 62440 ¶ Enao mina, ayo sija y mandaña, finaesen güe, ilegñija: Señot, malago jao unnatalo guato y raeno guiya Israel?
pairs.english: Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, "Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Ti para jamyo intingo y jaane yan y tiempo sija, ni y pinelon y Tata gui ninasiñañaja.
pairs.english: He said to them, "It isn't for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo infanmanresibe y ninasiña anae si Espiritu Santo ufato gui jilo miyo: yan jamyo utestigojo sija, iya Jerusalem yan todo iya Judea yan Samaria, yan asta y uttimon y tano.
pairs.english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este na güinaja, mientras maaatan güe, machule güe gui sanjilo; ya y mapagajes rinesibe güe, guinen liniiñija.
pairs.english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maaatan fitme y langet, anae mapos güe, estagüe dos taotao na minagagon ápaca, manotojgue jijot guiya sija.
pairs.english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y ilegñija locue: Jamyo taotao Galilea, jafa na manotojgue jamyo ya inaatan julo y langet? este mismo si Jesus ni y maresibe gui sanjilo guinen iya jamyo para y langet, umamaela talo taegüijeja anae inlie güe jumanao para y langet.
pairs.english: who also said, "You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 12 62500 ¶ Ayo nae sija manalo guato Jerusalem guinen y egso Olibo, ni y jijot Jerusalem, gui sabado na jaana na jinanao.
pairs.english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae sija manjalom, manjanao julo gui sanjilo na cuarto anae mañasaga todos, si Pedro yan si Juan yan si Santiago yan si Andres yan si Felipe yan si Tomas yan si Bartolome yan si Mateo yan si Santiago lajin Alfeo yan si Simon Selote yan si Judas chelun Santiago.
pairs.english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija todo mañasagaja gui un jinasoja na tinaetae, yan manmangagagao fitme, yan y palo famalaoan sija yan si Maria nanan Jesus, yan y mañeluña lalaje sija.
pairs.english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

pairs.english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour .

pairs.chamorro: Ya un taotao na coja desde y jalom y tiyan nanaña, ya machuchule, ya mapopolo cada jaane gui pettan y guimayuus, ni y mafanaan Bonita, para ufangagao limosna ni y manjajalom gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: A certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie si Pedro yan Juan na jumajalom gui guimayuus, ya jagagao limosna.
pairs.english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inataugüe as Pedro yan Juan, ya ilegñija: Atanjam.
pairs.english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, "Look at us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaecungog sija, yan jananangga na uresibe jafa na güinaja guiya sija.
pairs.english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Pedro ilegña: Salape yan oro, tayayo; lao jafa y güinajajo junae jao. Pot y naan Jesucristo Nasareno, cajulo ya unfamocat.
pairs.english: But Peter said, "Silver and gold have I none, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamantiene y agapa na canaeña, ya jajatsa julo; ya enseguidas y adengña yan y telang y bayoguña mumetgot.
pairs.english: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya tumayog julo, ya tumojgue, ya jatutujon mamocat; ya jumalom yan sija gui jalom y guimayuus, mamomocat yan tumatayog, yan jaalalaba si Yuus;
pairs.english: Leaping up, he stood, and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao lumie güi na mamomocat, yan jaalalaba si Yuus;
pairs.english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija matungoja na güiya ayo y matatachong, ni y umogagao limosna gui Bonita na Petta gui guimayuus: ya sija manbula ni y namanman, yan minaañao, ni ayo y jumuyong guiya güiya.
pairs.english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 11 63220 ¶ Ya y anae güiya quinequene as Pedro yan Juan, todo y taotao manmalago ya mandaña guiya sija gui coridot ni y mafanaan Salomon ya dangculo na ninamanmanñija.
pairs.english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Pedro jalie ayo, jaope y taotao sija ilegña: Taotao Israel, sa jafa na ninafanmanman jamyo ni este? pat jafa na ingueguesatanjam taegüije y pot ninasiñanmameja, pat pot y dinebotonmameja na innafamocat este na taotao?
pairs.english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, "You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus Abraham, yan Ysaac, yan Jacob, y Yuus y tatata ni y janamalago y Tentagoña as Jesus; ni y inentrega yan inpine gui menan Pilatos, anae jadetetmina ya japolo güe na ujanao.
pairs.english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up, and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo inpine Ayo y Santos yan Tunas, yan ingagagao na infanmanae un taotao ni y pegno;
pairs.english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan inpino y prinsipen linâlâ, ni y si Yuus janacajulo guinen y manmatae; ni y jame mantestigo.
pairs.english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y naanña, pot y jinenggue y naanña, janametgot este na taotao ni y liniimiyo, yan y tiningomiyo; junggan, y jinenggue, ni y pot güiya, mannae güe ni este na cabales na jinemlo gui menan miyo todos.
pairs.english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago, mañelujo, nae jutungo na pot y taya tiningomiyo na infatinas ayo, taegüije y finatinas y magalajenmiyo locue.
pairs.english: "Now, brothers , I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na güinaja y janamatungo si Yuus antes, pot y pachot todo sija y profeta, na si Cristoña ufamadese, ya taegüije ucumple.
pairs.english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina fanmañotsot, ya inbira talo jamyo, ya y isaomiyo ufanmafunas, para siña ufato y tiempon y refresco guinen menan Yuus;
pairs.english: "Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya para güiya umatago ayo Cristo, ni y esta matancho antes para jamyo; güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y langet nesesita uresibe asta y tiempo sija anae todo y güinaja mannanalo mauleg talo, ni y jasangan si Yuus gui pachot y santos na profetaña sija, ni jagas mangaegue desde qui matutujon y tano.
pairs.english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet na si Moises ilegña: Y Señot Yuus, unacajulo un profeta guiya jamyo, gui entalo mañelunmiyo, taegüine iya guajo; iya guiya nae injingog todo y güinaja ni y mansinangane jamyo.
pairs.english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, 'The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umasusede na todo y ante ni y ti malago umecungog ayo na profeta, umaguefyulang gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: It will be, that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na todo sija y profeta desde as Samuel yan ayo sija y manatate, todos ni y manmañangan, taegüine masangan güine sija na jaane.
pairs.english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo sija y famaguon y profeta sija, yan y trato ni y si Yuus jafatinas gui mañaenata, ilegña as Abraham: Ya y semiyamo nae todo y familia sija gui tano ufanbendise.
pairs.english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, 'In your seed will all the families of the earth be blessed.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Iya jamyo nae finena, si Yuus, janacajulo y Tentagoña, ya jatago na infanbinendise, ya ubira cada uno guiya jamyo guinin y tinaelayenmiyo.
pairs.english: God, having raised up his servant, Jesus, sent him to you first, to bless you, in turning away everyone of you from your wickedness."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manguecuentos yan y taotao sija, y magas na mamale yan y magas y templo, yan y Saduseosija, manmato guiya sija,
pairs.english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guesinestotba, sa sija jafananagüe y taotao sija, ya japredidica y quinajulo guinin y manmatae, pot si Jesus.
pairs.english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapolo canae gui jiloñija, ya manmapreso asta y inagpaña, sa estaba esta pupuenge.
pairs.english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao megae sija y jumungog y sinangan majonggue; ya y numeron y taotao sija, buente sinco mit.
pairs.english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 5 63420 ¶ Ya y inagpaña güije, y magasñija yan y manamco, yan y escriba sija mandaña guiya Jerusalem;
pairs.english: It happened in the morning, that their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan mangaegue si Annas, magas y mamale, yan si Caefas, yan si Juan, yan si Alejandro, yan ayosija parientes y magas mamale,
pairs.english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japlanta sija gui talo, jafaesen: Pot jafa na ninasiña, pat jaye na naan na infatinas este?
pairs.english: When they had stood them in the middle of them, they inquired, "By what power, or in what name, have you done this?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro, bula ni y Espiritu Santo, ilegña nu sija: Jamyo ni y magas y taotao, yan y manamco guiya Israel,
pairs.english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, "You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmachaguejam pago na jaane pot y mauleg finatinas para y malango na taotao, sa jafa muna manajomlo;
pairs.english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Intingo todo jamyo, yan todo y taotao guiya Israel, na pot y naan Jesucristo, y Nasareno, ni y inatane gui quiluus, ni y ninacajulo as Yuus guinin y manmatae; pot güiyaja este na taotao na tumojgue gui menan miyo ya jomlo.
pairs.english: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand here before you whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya yuje na acho y innataebale jamyo ni y manmanjatsa, na jumuyong cabesan esquina.
pairs.english: He is 'the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ni uguaja satbasion gui otro; sa taya otro naan gui papa y langet, manmanae y taotao sija, para usiña utafansatbo.
pairs.english: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 13 63500 ¶ Ya anae malie y minatatngan Pedro yan Juan, ya jinasonñija na manaetiningo ya manlanga na taotao, ninafanmanman, ya ayonae matungo na guinin mañisija yan si Jesus.
pairs.english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie y taotao ni y manajomlo na mañisija manojgue, taya jafa siña ujasangan contra ayo.
pairs.english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jatago sija na ufanjuyong gui dinaña, manasangane entre sija,
pairs.english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Jafa tafatinas ni este sija na taotao? sa magajet na afamao na milagro mafatinas pot sija, ya manmamatungo esta ni todo ayo sija y mañasaga Jerusalem; ya ti siña tapune.
pairs.english: saying, "What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can't deny it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao trabia mientras ti chachago matalaña gui entalo y taotao sija; nije taencatga sija, ya chañija fanmañangangane ni este na naan desde pago.
pairs.english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let's threaten them, that from now on they don't speak to anyone in this name."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang sija, ya jaencatga na senchañija sumasangan, ni ufanmamanagüe ni y naan Jesus.
pairs.english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro yan Juan manope ilegñija: Jusga, cao tunas gui menan Yuus na inosgueña jamyo qui si Yuus;
pairs.english: But Peter and John answered them, "Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa tisiña inpelo na ti insangan y liniimame yan y jiningogmame.
pairs.english: for we can't help telling the things which we saw and heard."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta jaencatga sija mas, jasotta, sa taya siña jafa ujasoda para ujacastiga, pot causa y taotaosija; sa todo mumalag si Yuus pot ayo y mafatinas.
pairs.english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao ni y anae mafatinas este y milagron y jinelo, mas di cuarenta años inamcoña.
pairs.english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 23 63600 ¶ Ya anae masotta na ujanao, manjanao para y mangachongñija, ya jasangane todo ni y mansinangane sija ni y magas mamale yan y manamco.
pairs.english: Being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija ayo, jajatsa y inagangñija para as Yuus, ilegñija: O Señot, jago Yuus, ni y fumatinas y langet, yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y mangae gui sanjalomñija;
pairs.english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, "O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pot Espiritu Santo ni y pachot y tentagomo as David ilegmo: Sa jafa y Gentiles na manlalalo, ya y taotao sija manmanjaso ni y taebale na güinaja?
pairs.english: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, 'Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray sija gui tano manotojgue julo, ya y magalaje sija mandaña contra y Señot, yan contra si Cristoña.
pairs.english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ .'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet na gui este siuda contra y santos na Tentagomo as Jesus, ni y unpalalae; todo si Herodes, yan Poncio Pilato, yan y Gentiles yan y taotao guiya Israel, mandaña,
pairs.english: "For truly, in this city against your holy servant, Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujafatinas jafa y tinancho antes y canaemo, yan y consejumo para ususede.
pairs.english: to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, O Señot, lie y amenasoñija: ya unnae y tentagomo sija, na contodo y minatatnga ujasangan y sinanganmo,
pairs.english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras unjujuto mona y canaemo para umajomlo; ya para y señat yan mannamanman umafatinas pot y naan y santos na Tentagomo as Jesus.
pairs.english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan manmanaetae, y lugat anae mandadaña mayengyong; ya todos manbula ni y Espiritu Santo, ya manmatatnga jasangan y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 32 63690 ¶ Ya y inetnon güije sija ni y manmanjonggue, manunoja na corason yan unoja na ante: ni uno guiya sija ualog iyoña ayo y jasagagaye; lao todo y güinaja manparejo iyonñija.
pairs.english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan dangculo na ninasiña na manmannae y apostoles testimonio ni y quinajulo y Señot Jesus: ya megae na grasia gaegue gui jiloñija todos.
pairs.english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ni uno guiya sija nesesitao; sa todo ayo sija y mangaeiyo tano pat guma, jabende ya jachule y balen ayo y binendenñija,
pairs.english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo gui adeng y apostoles sija: ya manmapapatte cada taotao jafataemano y janesesita.
pairs.english: and laid them at the apostles' feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 36 63730 ¶ Ayonae si José, ni y mafanaan ni y apostoles Barnabé (ni y comoqueilegña, lajin consuelo) ni y Lebita, taotao Chipre,
pairs.english: Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja tanoña, ya jabende, ya jachule y salape, ya japolo gui adeng apostoles sija.
pairs.english: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LAO un taotao naanña si Ananias, yan si Safira asaguaña, na jabende güinajanñija,
pairs.english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janana palo gui baliña, ya y asaguaña jatungo ja locue ayo, ya jachule un patteja ya japolo gui adeng y apostoles.
pairs.english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro ilegña: Ananias, sa jafa na janabula si Satanas y corasonmo para undague y Espiritu Santo, yan unnana palo gui balen y tano?
pairs.english: But Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras sumasaga, ada ti iyomo? ya anae munjayan mabende, ada taegüe gui ninasiñamo? sa jafa na unjaso este gui corasonmo? ti y taotao undague, na si Yuus.
pairs.english: While you kept it, didn't it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn't it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven't lied to men, but to God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Ananias este na finijo, podong papa ya matae: ya dangculon minaañao mato gui jilo ayo sija todo y jumujungog este na güinaja.
pairs.english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mabalutan ni y manfamaguon na lalaje, ya machule juyong y majafot.
pairs.english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 7 63810 ¶ Ya anae malofan buente tres oras, jumalom y asaguaña, ti jatungo jafa guinin mafatinas.
pairs.english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro ilegña nu güiya: Sanganeyo cao inbende y tanomiyo pot un tanto. Ya güiya ilegña: Junggan pot ayo na tanto.
pairs.english: Peter answered her, "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much." She said, "Yes, for so much."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pedro ilegña: Jafa na umatungo jamyo para intienta y Espiritu y Señot! estagüiyaja gui petta y adeng ayo sija y jumafot y asaguamo, ya umachule jaojuyong.
pairs.english: But Peter asked her, "How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae enseguidas podong papa gui adengña ya matae; ya y manfamaguon na lalaje manjalom ya masoda güe na matae, ya machule ya majafot gui oriyan y asaguaña.
pairs.english: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato dangculon minaañao gui jilo todo y iglesia, yan y jilo todo ayo sija y jumujungog estesija.
pairs.english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 12 63860 ¶ Ya pot y canae y apostoles sija, megae na señat yan mannamanman manmafatinas gui entalo taotao; ya sija todos mandaña gui un jinasoja gui coridot Salomon.
pairs.english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo sija, ni un taotao malago dumañae sija; lao y taotao manafandangculo sija.
pairs.english: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmanjonggue gui Señot, mas maaumenta y linajyan parejoja y lalaje yan y famalaoan;
pairs.english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enao na sija manmangongone malango gui chalan sija, ya manmapopolo gui cama yan y camiya, na para, yaguin malofan si Pedro, y aninengña ufanjinemeja palo guiya sija.
pairs.english: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae manmato locue linajyan taotao guinin y siuda, gui oriyan Jerusalem, manmangongone megae na manmalango, yan ayo sija y ninafañachatsaga ni y manáplacha na espiritu: yan manafanjomlo sija.
pairs.english: Multitudes also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 17 63910 ¶ Ya anae y magas na pale tomojgue julo, yan todo ayo sija y mangachochongña (ni y inetnon Saduseo) ya manbula inigo.
pairs.english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo canae gui jilo y apostoles, ya jacone gui calaboson y publico.
pairs.english: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y angjet y Señot anae esta puenge, jababa y pettan y calaboso ya manquinene sija, ya ilegña:
pairs.english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janao fanojgue gui jalom y guimayuus, ya insangane y taotao todo y sinangan este na Linâlâ.
pairs.english: "Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija ayo, manjalom gui guimayuus, taftataf gui egaan, ya manmamanagüe. Lao anae mato y magas mamale, yan ayo sija y mangachochongña, janafanmaagange y sinedrio yan todo y compañia ni mamapagot ni y famaguon Israel, ya jatago para y calaboso para ujacone sija.
pairs.english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmato y ofisiat sija gui calaboso, ti manmasoda sija; ya manalo tate ya manmañangane,
pairs.english: But the officers who came didn't find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Y calaboso, magajet na inseda majujuchomja todo, ya y manmamamumulan manestabaja na manotojgue gui jiyong potta: lao anae inbaba, taya taotao inseda gui sanjalom.
pairs.english: "We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y capitan y guimayuus, yan y manmagas mamale, jajungog este na sinangan ninafanestotba sa ti jatungo manonae ufanjuyong.
pairs.english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mato uno ya mansinangane sija, ilegña: Ayo sija na taotao y inpelo gui calaboso, mangaegue gui guimayuus na manmamananagüe ni y taotao sija.
pairs.english: One came and told them, "Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jumanao y capitan yan y manmagas sija, ya manmacone sija, ti manmaafuetsas, sa manmaañao ni y taotao sija, sa noseaja ufanmadago ni acho.
pairs.english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmacone sija, manmapolo gui menan y sinedrio ya manfinaesen ni y magas na pale,
pairs.english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: Inguesencatga jamyo na chamiyo fanmamananagüe ni este na naan. Ya estagüe inbula Jerusalem ni y finanagüenmiyo. Ya jinasonmiyo na inchile y jâgân este taotao gui jilomame.
pairs.english: saying, "Didn't we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man's blood on us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pedro, yan y palo na apostoles, ilegñija: Nesesita na taosgueña si Yuus finena qui y taotao sija.
pairs.english: But Peter and the apostles answered, "We must obey God rather than men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuus y mañaenata sija, janacajulo si Jesus ni ayo y inpino, yan incana gui trongcon jayo.
pairs.english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya jinatsa as Yuus gui agapa na canaeña, para u-Prinsipe yan u-Satbadot, para unae sinetsot iya Israel, yan inasiin y isao.
pairs.english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame testigo ni este sija na güinaja; yan y Espiritu Santo locue, ni y si Yuus numae ayo sija y umosgue gue.
pairs.english: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 33 64070 ¶ Ya anae jajungog sija ayo, manchinachat asta y corasonñija, ya manaseyo para ufanmapuno sija.
pairs.english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and determined to kill them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae tumojgue julo uno gui sinedrio, un Fariseo, ni y naanña si Gamaliel, na magas y lay, ya maonra ni y taotao todo; ya manago na umanafanlasuja didide ayo sija taotao.
pairs.english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo lalajen, Israel, adaje jamyo jafa jinasonmimiyo para infatinas ni este sija na taotao.
pairs.english: He said to them, "You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa antes di este sija na jaane cajulo si Teudas, janabanidoso güi taegüije y jaye na taotao; ya iya guiya nae manguaguato un manadan lalaje, guaja buente cuatro sientos mandaña sijaja; ni y mapuno; yan todo ayo sija y umosgue güe manmachalapon ya manjuyong sin jafa.
pairs.english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di este na taotao, cajulo si Judas na taotao Galileo, gui jaanen y manmaempadrona; ya jacone un manada gui tateña: ya güiya locue malingo; yan todo ayo sija y umosgue güe manmachalapon.
pairs.english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago jusangane jamyo: Insetta este sija na taotao, ya inpelo sijaja; sa este na pinagat, pat este na chocho, yaguin guinin y taotao, ufanmayute,
pairs.english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin as Yuus, ti siña inyilang, sa noseaja infanmumo contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafamaulegja, ya anae manmaagang y apostoles guiya sija, manmasaulag ya manmatago na chañija sumasangan y naan Jesus, ya manmapolo na ujafanjanao.
pairs.english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina manjanao gui menan y sinedrio, mansenmagof sa japolo na ujamerese pumadese y minamajlao pot y naan Jesus.
pairs.english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus' name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y jaane sija, ti mandescacansa manmamanagüe yan manmañangane as Jesus ni y Cristogüe, gui guimayuus, yan y iyasija.
pairs.english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayo sija na jaane anae lumamegae y disipulo sija, mangogonggong y Helenitas sija contra y Hebreo sija, sa y manbiuda guiya sija, ti manmaatiende gui sinetbeñija cada jaane.
pairs.english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y dose, jaagang y manadan disipulo guato guiya sija, ya ilegñija: Ti tunas na tapolo y sinangan Yuus, ya tasetbe y lamasa sija.
pairs.english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, "It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mañelo, aligao entre jamyo siete na taotao ni y manmauleg, ni y manbula Espiritu, yan minejnalom, ya tapolo para este na chocho.
pairs.english: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita, tasigueja fitme y manmanaetae, yan y sinetbe y sinangan.
pairs.english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na sinangan, ninafanmagof y manada todo; ya maayeg si Esteban, un taotao na bula jinenggue yan Espiritu Santo, yan si Felipe, yan si Prócoro, yan si Nicanor, yan si Timón, yan si Parmenas, yan si Nicolás proseliton Antioquia.
pairs.english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmaplanta gui menan y apostoles: ya anae munjayan manmanaetae, japolo y canaeñija gui jiloñija.
pairs.english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sinangan Yuus lumalamegae; ya y disipulo megae manmaumentaña guiya Jerusalem; ya dangculon manadan mamale locue, manmanosgue ni y jinenggue.
pairs.english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 8 64240 ¶ Ya si Esteban, bula y grasia yan ninasifia, jafatinas namanman na milagro yan señat gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja mangajulo güije gui sinagoga ni y manmafanaan sinagogan Libertinos, yan Sireneo sija, yan Alejandrino sija, yan ayo sija iya Silisia, yan Asia, managuaguat yan si Esteban.
pairs.english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called "The Libertines," and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao tisiña macontra y tiningo, yan y Espiritu ni y jasangan.
pairs.english: They weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmasusuug y taotao sija na ujaalog: Injingogja güe na jasangan y chinatfino contra si Moises, yan contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafangalamten y taotao sija, yan y manamco, yan y escribasija; ya manmato guiya güiya, ya macone güe guato gui sinedrio,
pairs.english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,

pairs.chamorro: Y sinangan ni y janamanajanao si Yuus para y famaguon Israel, mapredica y pas pot si Jesucristo: (güiya y Señot para todo)--
pairs.english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ--he is Lord of all--

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na sinangan, jamyo intingoja y masanganñaejon todo guiya Judea, ya matutujon guiya Galilea, despues di y tinagpange ni y japredica si Juan:
pairs.english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya si Jesus Nasareno; jaftaemano si Yuus japalae ni y Espiritu Santo yan y ninasiña: ya jumajanao ya jafatitinas y mauleg, yan janafanjomlo todo ayo sija y manchinichiguet ni y anite; sa sumisija yan Yuus.
pairs.english: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame mantestigo todo y güinaja ni y finatinasña gui tano Judios, yan iya Jerusalem; ayo y japuno sija, ya jacana gui trongcon jayo:
pairs.english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ninacajulo as Yuus gui mina tres na jaane, ya japolo ya ufinanue güe senclaroja,
pairs.english: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti para todo y taotao, lao para y testigo sija ni y manmaayeg antes as Yuus; junggan, para jita, ni y guinin manjita mañocho yan manguimen despues di cajulo guinin y manmatae.
pairs.english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatagojit na tapredica gui taotao sija, yan tanamatungo na güiya tinancho as Yuus para ujuyong Jues y manlalâlâ yan y manmatae.
pairs.english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot güiya na manmannae todo y profeta testimonio, na pot y naanña, jayeja y jumongue güe uresibe inasiin y isao.
pairs.english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 44 66180 ¶ Ya mientras jasanganja trabia si Pedro este sija na sinangan, y Espiritu Santo podong gui jilo ayo sija todo y jumujungog y sinangan.
pairs.english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y manmasirconsida ni y manmanjonggue, ninafanmanman, ya megae manmato as Pedro, sa asta y Gentiles locue manmachudae ni y ninaen y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajungog na manguecuentos ni y jilañija, ya manadangculo si Yuus. Ayonae manope si Pedro, ilegña:
pairs.english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye siña na taotao chumoma y janom para ti ufanmatagpange este sija y rumesibe y Espiritu Santo taegüine iya jita?
pairs.english: "Can any man forbid the water, that these who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we should not be baptized?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago sija na ujafanmatagpange ni y naan Jesucristo. Ya matayuyut güe na ufañaga unos cuantos na jaane.
pairs.english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA y apostoles yan y mañelo ni y manestaba Judea, jajungog na y Gentiles jaresibe locue y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato si Pedro Jerusalem, managuaguat yan ayo sija y manmansirconsisida,
pairs.english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Jago jumajalom jao gui ti manmasirconsida, yan manjajamyo mañocho.
pairs.english: saying, "You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro jasigue sumangane sija claro y sinesede, ilegña:
pairs.english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estabayo gui siuda guiya Joppe na mananaetae; ya anae lalangoyo, julie y vision, un nayan tumunog, taegüije y dangculo na sabanas, ni mapolo pot cuatro punta ni y tumunog guinin y langet; ya mato guiya guajo:
pairs.english: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae juatan ayo, ya jujaso, julie y cuatro patasña na gâgâ gui tano, yan manmachaleg sija na gâgâ, yan y mangucunanaf na gâgâ, yan y pajaro sija gui aire.
pairs.english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jujungog locue y inagang na ilegña nu guajo: Cajulo Pedro; puno ya uncano.
pairs.english: I also heard a voice saying to me, 'Rise, Peter, kill and eat!'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegco: Aje, Señot: sa taya comun, pat áplacha guinin jumalom gui jalom pachotjo.
pairs.english: But I said, 'Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaopeyo talo y inagang guinin y langet, ilegña: Jafa y janagasgas si Yuus, chamo fumatitinas comun.
pairs.english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, 'What God has cleansed, don't you call unclean.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este mafatinas tres biaje: ya todo manmachule talo guato gui langet.
pairs.english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe enseguidas manotojgue güije gui menan guma anae sumasagayo, tres na taotao, manmatago guinin Sesarea para iya guajo.
pairs.english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatagoyo na judalalag sija ya chajo fumatitinas dinesparejo. Ya manjame yan este sija y saes na mañelo, ya manjalomjam gui guima y taotao:
pairs.english: The Spirit told me to go with them, without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasanganejam ni y liniiña ni y angjet ni y tumotojgue gui jalom gumaña, ya jaftaemano ilegña nu güiya: Fanago taotao para Joppe, ya uncone si Simon ni y apiyiduña Pedro;
pairs.english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, 'Send to Joppa, and get Simon, whose surname is Peter,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unsinangane sinangan sija anae unsatbo; jago, yan todo y guimamo.
pairs.english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae sigue di cumuentosyo, podong y Espiritu Santo gui jiloñija, taegüijeja gui jilota gui tutujonña.
pairs.english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jujaso y sinangan y Señot, ni y ilegña: Si Juan, magajet na managpapange ni y janom; lao jamyo infanmatagpange ni y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, 'John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin manninae sija locue as Yuus y ninae, taegüije y janaejit anae jumongguejit y Señot Jesucristo, ya jayeyo na siña jucontra si Yuus?
pairs.english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija estesija, manmamatquilo, ya manamalag si Yuus, ilegñija: Magajet na janae locue si Yuus y Gentiles sinetsot para linâlâ.
pairs.english: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, "Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 19 66410 ¶ Ya ayo sija y manmachalapon pot y mapetsiguen ni y Esteban, manjanao asta Finesia, yan Chipre, yan Antioquia, ya taya nae japredica y sinangan na ayoja sija y Judios.
pairs.english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija taotao Chipre, yan Sirene, ya anae manmato Antioquia, manguentos yan y Griegosija, ya japredica y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañisijaja yan y canae y Señot; ya megae manmanjonggue ya jabira sija para y Señot.
pairs.english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato este sija na notisia gui iglesia ni y estaba Jerusalem: ya matago si Barnabé, na ujanao asta Antioquia;
pairs.english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
