pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, ya jalie y grasian Yuus, magof güe; ya jasangane sija todo, na nu sinasuyen y corasonñija, unafanmeton sija gui Señot:
pairs.english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya mauleg na taotao, ya bula ni y Espiritu Santo, yan jinenggue: ya megae na taotao manmafato gui Señot.
pairs.english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae mapos güe para Tarso, para ualigao si Saulo:
pairs.english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda, jacone guato Antioquia. Ya un año di mandadañaja güije yan iglesia, ya manmamananagüe megae na taotao; ya y disipulo sija manmafanaan finena mangilisyano guiya Antioquia.
pairs.english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. It happened, that for a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 66490 ¶ Ya este sija na jaane, manmato profeta sija guinin Jerusalem para Antioquia,
pairs.english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sesat.
pairs.english: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y disipulo sija, cada uno jaftaemano y güinajaña, jadetetmina para umanamamaela inayuda para y mañelo ni y mañasaga Judea:
pairs.english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija locue jafatinas, janamaela para y manamco pot y canae Barnabé yan Saulo.
pairs.english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayoja na tiempo, y ray Herodes jaestira y canaeña para unafanlamen palo gui taotao iglesia.
pairs.english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno si Santiago chelun Juan ni y espada.
pairs.english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie na ninafanmagof y Judios, jasigue para ucone si Pedro locue. Ya ayo y jaanen y pan sin lebadura?
pairs.english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macone güe, japolo gui calaboso, ya jaentrega y diesisaes na sendalo para upinilan; majasusuye na despues di y pascua umaconie y taotao sija.
pairs.english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Pedro mapongle gui calaboso: lao y iglesia ti pumapara manmanayuyut as Yuus pot güiya.
pairs.english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Herodes canaja quinene gue, güijeja na puenge anae estaba si Pedro na mamaego gui entalo y dos sendalo, ya magogode ni dos na cadena: ya y manmamumulan gui menan y petta, mapupulan y calaboso:
pairs.english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un angjet y Señot tumotojgue gui oriyaña, ya y candet manina gui jalom y cuatton calaboso: ya japanag si Pedro gui calaguagña ya yinajo, ilegña: Cajulo laguse, ya y cadenaña manbasnag guinin y canaeña.
pairs.english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, "Stand up quickly!" His chains fell off from his hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Dudog jao ya gode y dogamo: ya taegüenao finatinasña. Ya y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Polo y magagumo guiya jago, ya dalalagyo.
pairs.english: The angel said to him, "Get dressed and put on your sandals." He did so. He said to him, "Put on your cloak, and follow me."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao juyong ya jadalalag, ya ti jatungo ayo cao magajet y finatinas y angjet; lao jinasoña na manlie güe vision.
pairs.english: And he went out and followed him. He didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmalofan gui finenana yan y mina dos na guatdia, manmato gui trangcan lulug ni y dumalalalaque y siuda; ni y mababa para sija sin jafa; ya manjanao juyong ya manmalofan gui inanaco un chalan; ya enseguidas jumanao y angjet guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta manungo talo si Pedro, ilegña: Pago nae jutungo na magajet na y Señot jatago y angjetna, na unalibreyo gui canae Herodes, yan todo y ninanggan y taotao y Judios.
pairs.english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, "Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajaso este na güinaja, mato gui guima Maria nanan Juan, ni y apiyiduña Marcos; anae megae mandadaña ya manmananayuyut.
pairs.english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manyajo si Pedro gui pettan y trangca, un patgon na palaoan mato para umaope, na y naanña si Rode.
pairs.english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo na y inagang Pedro, ti jababa y trangca pot y minagofña, lao malago jalom ya mansinangane na tumotojgue si Pedro gui menan y trangca.
pairs.english: When she recognized Peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu guiya: Esta jao caduca. Lao güiya ilelegñaja: Junggan, magajet taegüenao. Ayonae sija ilegñija: Ayo y angjetña.
pairs.english: They said to her, "You are crazy!" But she insisted that it was so. They said, "It is his angel."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro, sisigueja di manyajo: ya anae jababa malie güe, ya ninafansenlujan.
pairs.english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mansineñas as Pedro ni y canaeña na ufamacaca, ya mansinangane jaftaemano y Señot anae quinene güe juyong gui calaboso. Ya ilegña: Janao ya unsangane si Santiago ni este sija na güinaja, yan y mañelo. Ya mapos ya malag y otro lugat.
pairs.english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, "Tell these things to James, and to the brothers." Then he departed, and went to another place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas qui manana, ti didide na atboroto gui sendalo sija, manggue si Pedro.
pairs.english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jaaligao si Herodes si Pedro ya ti jasoda, janafanmaegsamina y manmanmamumulan ya manago na ufanmapuno. Ya jumanao papa guinin Judea para Sesarea, ya sumaga güije.
pairs.english: When Herod had sought for him, and didn't find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Herodes sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king's personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king's country for food.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un tinancho na jaane, minagago si Herodes ni y magagon ray, ya matachong gui tronuña, ya jacuentuse sija un sinangan.
pairs.english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya managang y taotao sija, ilegñija: Inagang un yuus, ti inagang taotao.
pairs.english: The people shouted, "The voice of a god, and not of a man!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas pinada ni y angjet y Señot, sa ti janae si Yuus minalag: ya quinano ni ilo ya matae.
pairs.english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y sinangan Yuus lumadangculo yan mumemegae.
pairs.english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Barnabé yan Saulo, tumalo guato guinin Jerusalem, anae munjayan y ministroñija, yan jacocone mañisija si Juan y apiyiduña Marcos.
pairs.english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John whose surname was Mark.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA estaba güije gui ilesia guiya Antioquia, profeta sija yan maestro, sija: Barnabé, yan si Simeon ni y mafanaan Niger, yan si Lucio, taotao Sirene, yan si Manaen, ni y chamapogsae yan Herodes tetrarca, yan si Saulo.
pairs.english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras sija sumesetbe y Señot, yan manayuyunat, y Espiritu Santo ilegña: Abatta guiya guajo Barnabé yan Saulo para y checho anae guinin juagange sija.
pairs.english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, "Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae anae esta manayunat yan manmanayuyut yan japolo y canaeñija gui jilo ayo sija, jatago sija na ufanjanao.
pairs.english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 4 66810 ¶ Ya manmatago sija pot y Espiritu Santo, ya manunog para Seleusia; ya desde ayo mumamaya para Chipre.
pairs.english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mangaegue gui Salamina, japredica y sinangan Yuus gui sinagogan y Judiosija: ya mañisijaja locue yan si Juan ni y sumesetbe sija.
pairs.english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe todo inanaco y isla asta Pafo, jasoda un taotao na cacana, fatso na profeta, Judio, na y naanña si Bar-Jesus:
pairs.english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y estaba yan y magalajen y tano, si Sergio Paulo, gaetiningo na taotao; ya jaaagang si Barnabé yan Saulo, sa malago na ujungog y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manquinentra as Elymas, taotao na cacana (taegüine nae comequilegña y naanña), jaaliligao na unamabira guinin jinenggue y magalaje.
pairs.english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn aside the proconsul from the faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Saulo ni y naanña locue Pablo, bula ni y Espiritu Santo, inaatanja güe,
pairs.english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: O bula jao todo dinague, yan tinaelaye, jago lajin anite, jago enemigun todo y tininas, ada ti pumapara jao unnataelaye y tinas na chalan y Señot?
pairs.english: and said, "Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago estagüiya y canae y Señot gui jilomo, ya unbachet ya ti unlie y atdao pot un tiempo. Ya enseguidas podong gui jiloña y nublado ya jomjom, ya jumanao manaligao jaye uminantiene y canaeña para uinesgaejongüe.
pairs.english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!" Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y magalaje jafa y mafatinas, jajonggue ya ninasenmanman ni y finanagüen y Señot.
pairs.english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 13 66900 ¶ Ya anae si Pablo yan y mangachongña jadingo Pafo, ya mumamaya ya manmato Petga guiya Pamfilia, ya si Juan jumanao guiya sija ya tumalo guato Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija manmalofan inanaco guinin Petga, manmato Antioquia guiya Pisidia; ya manjalom gui sinagoga gui sabado na jaane ya manmatachong.
pairs.english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jataetae y lay yan y profeta sija, y magas y sinagoga ninafamnaagange sija ilegñija: Jamyo mañelo, yaguin guaja jafa na finijo para insangane y taotao sija, sangan.
pairs.english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo tumojgue julo ya mañeñas ni y canaeña, ilegña: Taotao Israel, yan jamyo ni y manmaañao as Yuus, ecungog.
pairs.english: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuus este na taotao iya Israel, jaayeg y mañaenata, yan jajatsa y taotao sija anae mañasaga taegüije y taotao juyong guiya Egipto, ya ni y taquilo na canaeña jacone sija juyong güije.
pairs.english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y cuarenta años ni tiempo, jasungon ni y costumbreñija gui jalomtano.
pairs.english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin mujayan jayulang siete na nasion gui tano Cananea, ya japatte y tanoñija guiya sija para y erensiañija nae mañasaga, como cuatro siento y sincuenta años;
pairs.english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di ayo sija, manninae sija jues sija asta qui mato y profeta Samuel.
pairs.english: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues manmalago ray: ya manninae as Yuus as Saulo lajin Sis, un taotao gui tribon Benjamin para cuarenta años.
pairs.english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaanae jarechasa si Saulo, janacajulo guiya sija si David para rayñija. Sa si Yuus numae güe locue testimonio, ilegña: Guajo jusoda si David lajin Isai, un taotao na parejoja yan y corasonjo, ya güiya ucumple todo y malagojo.
pairs.english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, 'I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyan este na taotao nae, unacajulo si Yuus guiya Israel y Satbadot Jesus jaftaemanoja y promesa:
pairs.english: From this man's seed, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Juan finena prumedica, antes di y finatoña, y tinagpangen sinetsot para todo y taotao guiya Israel.
pairs.english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jacumple si Juan y chechoña, ilegña: Jayeyo jinasonmimiyo? Ti guajo güe. Lao estagüe na mamamaela uno gui tateco, na ni y sapatos gui adengña ti dignoyo na jupula.
pairs.english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, 'What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mañelo lalaje, fumaguon y rasan Abraham, yan jayeja guiya jamyo y maañao as Yuus, sa para jamyo na matago y sinangan este na satbasion.
pairs.english: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot ayo sija y mañasaga Jerusalem, yan y magasñija sa ti matungo si Yuus, ni y sinangan y profeta ni y jatataetaeja cada sabado, anae masentensia güe jacumple sija.
pairs.english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn't know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya achogja ti jasoda sija jafa na causa guiya güiya na umapuno, lao magagao si Pilatos na umapuno.
pairs.english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macumple todo ayo y esta matugue pot güiya, machule papa guinin y jayo, ya mapolo gui jalom y naftan.
pairs.english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus munacajulo guinen y manmatae:
pairs.english: But God raised him from the dead,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malie megae na jaane ni ayo sija y mangachochongña mangajulo guinin Galilea para Jerusalem, ni y pago testiguña sija gui taotao.
pairs.english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame chumule guiya jamyo y mauleg na notisia, ni ayo na promesa y mafatinas gui mañaena,
pairs.english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano si Yuus cumunple guiya jita, ni y famaguonñija, sa ayonae janacajulo si Jesus talo; taegüije locue y esta matugue gui mina dos gui Salmos: Jago y Lajijo ya pago na jaane nae julilis jao.
pairs.english: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, 'You are my Son. Today I have become your father.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninacajulo guinin y manmatae, ya pago ti utalo guato gui minitong guinin jasangan taegüine: Guajo junae jao ni y santos yan magajet na bendisjon David.
pairs.english: "Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: 'I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña locue y otro Salmo: Na chamo pumopolo y Santosmo na ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, 'You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David anae munjayan jasetbe y generasionña pot y pinagat Yuus, maego ya mapolo manafandaña yan y mañaenaña, ya jalie y minitong.
pairs.english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, and was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y ninacajulo as Yuus talo ti jalie minitong.
pairs.english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umatungo guiya jamyo mañelo lalaje, na pot este na taotao na mapredidica guiya jamyo y inasiin y isao:
pairs.english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers , that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot güiya na todo ayo y jumonggue manunas ni todo y güinaja, sa ti siña jamyo manunas, pot y lay Moises.
pairs.english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje na nosea ufato guiya jamyo, y masangan gui profeta sija;
pairs.english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, jamyo ni y manmañatlilie, yan infanmanman, yan infanmalingo. Sa machochochoyo ni y checho y jaanemniyo, ayo na chocho y ti injengue, ni jaye na taotao unaclaro guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: 'Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong gui sinagoga, jagagao na umapredica este na sinangan guiya sija gui siguiente sabado.
pairs.english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manadingo y inetnon gui sinagoga, megae na Judios yan y deboto na proselito sija dumalalag si Pablo yan Barnabé; ni y sumangangane siga yan jaeepogna ufañaga gui grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 44 67210 ¶ Ya y siguiente sabado canaja todo y taotao y siuda mandaña para ujajungog y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: The next Sabbath almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jalie y Judios y linajyan taotao, manbula linatga, ya manguentos contra ayo y sinangan Pablo ya jachatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo yan Barnabé jausa y minatatngañija, ilegñija: Nesesita ayo y sinangan Yuus ni y esta manmasangane jamyo finena, lao pot innasuja guiya jamyo, injisganmaesa jamyo na ti dignojamyo y taejinecog na linâlâ, ya estagüe na tabirajit para y Gentiles.
pairs.english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, "It was necessary that God's word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao tinagoña si Yuus nu jita, ilegña: Jupolo jamyo para candet y Gentiles, na jamyo siña para satbasion asta y uttimon patte y tano.
pairs.english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, 'I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este y Gentiles, ninafansenmagof, ya maalaba y sinangan Yuus: ya megae manmanjonggue ni ayo sija y manmatancho para y taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machalapon y sinangan Yuus todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: The Lord's word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 50 67270 ¶ Lao y Judio sija, janafangalamten y mandebota yan y manonra na famalaoan, yan y manmagas na taotao sija gui siuda, ya janafangajulo pinetsigue contra si Pablo yan Barnabé, ya janafanmayute juyong gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija, jasacude y petbos gui adengñija contra sija, ya manjanao para Iconio.
pairs.english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipulo sija, manbula minagof yan y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: The disciples were filled with joy with the Holy Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede na manjalom gui sinagogan y Judios guiya Iconio, ya taegüenao manguentos na un dangculo na linajyan Judios yan Griegos manman jonggue.
pairs.english: It happened in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija na Judios y ti manmanosgue, jasuug y anten y Gentil sija, para ufanmanjaso taelaye contra y mañelo.
pairs.english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mañagaja apmam, manguecuentos matatnga ni y Señot, ni y mannae testimonio ni y sinangan y grasiaña, yan mannae señat sija, yan mannamanman sija para ujafatinas ni y canaeñija.
pairs.english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linajyan taotao gui siuda manmadibide; y un banda mañija yan y Judios, ya y otro banda mañija yan y apostoles.
pairs.english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmamatinas insulto y Judios yan y Gentiles, yan y magasñija, para ufanmacase sija, yan ufanmafagas ni y ocho,
pairs.english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta matungo nu sija; ya manmalago guato Listra yan Derbe, siuda iya Licaonia, yan y tano gui oriya.
pairs.english: they became aware of it, and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güije japredica sija y ibangelio.
pairs.english: There they preached the Good News.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 8 67370 ¶ Ya estaba güije guiya Listra un taotao na taeninasiña y adengña, sa cojo desde y jalom tuyan nanaña; ya taya nae mamocat:
pairs.english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na taotao jajungog si Pablo na cumuentos: ya enseguidas na inatan, tiningo na guaja jinenggueña para umanajomlo,
pairs.english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaagang dangculo na inagang ilegña: Tojgue julo tunas ni y adengmo. Ya guiya mangope julo, ya mamocat.
pairs.english: said with a loud voice, "Stand upright on your feet!" He leaped up and walked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie ni y linajyan taotao sija y finatinas Pablo, jajatsa y inagangñija ilegñija gui cuentos Licaonia: Y yuus sija ni manparejo yan taotao, manunog guiya jita.
pairs.english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, "The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafanaan si Barnabé Jupiter; ya si Pablo mafanaan Mercurio, sa güiya magas na cuecuentos.
pairs.english: They called Barnabas "Jupiter," and Paul "Mercury," because he was the chief speaker.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y pale y Jupiter ni y temploña estaba gui menan y siuda, mangone toro sija, yan mañule coronan flores guato gui pettan y trangca, ya malago na ufanmamatinas inefrese, yan y linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae majungog ni y apostoles, si Barnabé yan si Pablo, jatiteg y magagoñija, ya manmalago gui entalo y linajyan taotao ya manaagang,
pairs.english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Señot sija, jafa na infatinas este sija? Jame locue manaotaojam, manparejojajit, ya insangane jamyo na inbira jamyo güine gui este sija manaesetbe, ya infanmalag y lalâlâ na Yuus, ni y jafatinas y langet, yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y sinajguanña:
pairs.english: "Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky and the earth and the sea, and all that is in them;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmalofan na generasion sija, japolo todo y nasion na ufanjanao gui minalagoñija.
pairs.english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea güiya ti jadingo güe sin testigo, sa mauleg finatinasña, ya janaejit uchan guinin y langet, yan megae na tinegcha, janafanbula y corasonta nengcano yan minagof.
pairs.english: Yet he didn't leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este sija na sinangan, canamapot jaafuetsas y linajyan taotao na chañija fumatitinas inefrese guiya sija.
pairs.english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 19 67480 ¶ Ya manmato güije Judios guinin Antioquia, yan Iconio, ni y manafanmañaña y linajyan; ya anae munjayan mafagas ni y acho si Pablo, mabatsala juyong gui siuda, jinasoñija na matae.
pairs.english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras manotojgue y disipulo sija gui oriyaña, cumajulo ya jumalom gui siuda; ya y inagpaña güije, jumanao yan si Barnabé manmalag Derbe.
pairs.english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japredica y ibangelio güije na siuda, yan mamadisipulo megae; tumalo guato Listra, yan Iconio, yan Antioquia,
pairs.english: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanfitme y anten y disipulo sija, ya jaaconseja na ujasigueja gui jinenggue; sa nesesita megae na pinite sija, ya ayonae siñajit manjalom gui raenon Yuus,
pairs.english: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into the Kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jatancho y manamco gui cada guimayuus, yan manaetae, yan umayunat, yan jatayuyute sija gui as Yuus ni manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalofan y inanaco Pisidia, ya manmato Pamfilia.
pairs.english: They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan mapredica y sinangan guiya Petga, manunog guiya Atalia;
pairs.english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo mangagama asta Antioquia, anae manmanae ni y grasian Yuus, para y checho ni y mafatinas.
pairs.english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato ya mandaña iglesia gui guimayuus, masangan todo sija y finatinas Yuus pot sija; yan jaftaemano jababaye y Gentiles ni y pettan y jinenggue.
pairs.english: When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaga güije yan y disipulo sija, apmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA manmato palo taotao sija guinin Judea, ya jafanagüe y mañelo ilegñija: Yaguin ti manmasirconsida jamyo taemano y costumbren Moises, ti siña jamyo mansatbo.
pairs.english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, "Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can't be saved."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae megae na inaguaguat yan finaesen as Pablo yan Barnabé yan sija, y maneio jaayeg si Pablo yan si Barnabé, yan palo guiya sija, para ujafanjanao julo Jerusalem guiya apostoles yan manamco pot este na finaesen.
pairs.english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae manmaesgaejon ni y iglesia gui jinanaoñija, manmalofan y inanaco Finesia, yan Samaria, ya masasangan claro y manmañotsot y Gentiles; ya ninafangosmagof y mañelo todos.
pairs.english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato Jerusalem, manmaresibe gui iglesia yan y apostoles, yan y manamco; ya jadeclara todo y finatinas Yuus pot sija.
pairs.english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mangajulo güije palo sija y inetnon Fariseo ni y manmanjonggue, ya ilegnija: Nesesita ufanmasirconsida sija, yan ufanmatago ya ujaadaje y tinago Moises.
pairs.english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, "It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña y apostoles yan y manamco para ujajasuye este.
pairs.english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta megae na finaesen, cumajulo si Pedro ya ilegña nu sija: Mañelo lalaje, intingoja jafa na manayeg si Yuus guiya jamyo, apmam na tiempo, na y Gentiles ujajungog y sinangan y ibangelio pot y pachotjo, ya ujajonggue.
pairs.english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, "Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Yuus, ni y tumungo y corason, janafantestigo sija, yan janae ni y Espiritu Santo, jaftaemanoja y jafatinas guiya jita;
pairs.english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya japolo dinesparejo entre sija yan jita, janafangasgas y corasonñija ni y jinenggue.
pairs.english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa pago mina intietienta si Yuus, para inpelo y yugo gui agaga y disipulo sija, na ni y mañaenata ni jita tisiña jacatga?
pairs.english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao tajonggue na pot y grasian y Señot Jesus utafansatbo, taegüije iya sija.
pairs.english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 12 67690 ¶ Ayonae manmamatquilo todo y linajyan taotao, ya maatituye si Pablo yan Barnabé ni y jasasangan y señot sija yan y mannamanman jafatinas si Yuus gui entalo Gentiles pot sija.
pairs.english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmamatquilo, manope si Santiago ilegña: Mañelo lalaje, ecungogyo.
pairs.english: After they were silent, James answered, "Brothers, listen to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan si Simeon jaftaemano si Yuus ni y jabisita finena y Gentiles, para ufangone guiya sija taotao para y naanña.
pairs.english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan pot este na manparejo y sinangan y profeta sija, ni y esta manmatugue:
pairs.english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta munjayan estesija, jutalo mague, ya jujatsa y tabernaculon David, ni y podong; yan jujatsa talo y manmayulang güije, yan juplanta julo;
pairs.english: 'After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para y manetenjan na taotao, ujaaligao yi Señot, yan todo y Gentiles ni y umafanaan y naanjo.
pairs.english: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; All the Gentiles who are called by my name, Says the Lord, who does all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña y Señot ni y janamatungo estesija desde y tutujon y tano.
pairs.english: All his works are known to God from eternity.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y jinasoco taegüine, na mungajit umatborota ayo sija y manguinin y entalo y Gentiles, ya jabira sija para as Yuus.
pairs.english: "Therefore my judgment is that we don't trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao utatuguie sija, ya ujafañuja gui pinetlilon y idolos, yan y inábale, yan y neñicot na gâgâ, yan y jâgâ.
pairs.english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: layña sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae yañija y apostoles yan y manamco yan todo y iglesia, na umanafanjanao y manmaayeg na taotao gui inetnonñija para Antioquia para ufañija yan si Pablo yan Barnabé; y naanñija, si Judas y apiyiduña Barsabas, yan si Silas, manmagas na taotao sija gui entre y mañelo:
pairs.english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmangue carta pot sija, taegüine: Y apostoles yan manamco na mañelo, jasaluda y mañelo na Gentiles ni y mangaegue guiya Antioquia yan Siria yan Silisia:
pairs.english: They wrote these things by their hand: "The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa injingog na palo ni y manjanao guinin iya jame, maninatborota jamyo ni y sinangan, janataelaye y antenmiyo; lao ti manmannae jam ni enao na tinago:
pairs.english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, 'You must be circumcised and keep the law,' to whom we gave no commandment;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jinasonmame na mandañajam unoja, para innafanjanao y manmaayeg na taotao para jamyo, yan y güinaeyanmame as Pablo yan Barnabé,
pairs.english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taotao sija na janapeligro y jaanenñija pot y naan y Señot Jesucristo.
pairs.english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina innajanao si Judas yan Silas, ni y infansinangane locue ni y pachotñija taegüineja.
pairs.english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinason y Espiritu Santo, yan jame, na munga mapolo gui jilomiyo mas dangculo na catga qui y manesesita.
pairs.english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na infañuja gui nengcano ni y manmaofrese y idolos, yan y jâgâ, yan y neñicot na gâgâ, yan y inábale; ya yaguin inadaje jamyo estesija, infatinas mauleg. Adios jamyo todos.
pairs.english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 30 67870 ¶ Ya anae manajanao, manmato Antioquia: ya janafandaña y linajyan taotao, maentrega y catta;
pairs.english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae munjayan mataetae, ninafansenmagof, pot y consuelo.
pairs.english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas yan Silas manprofeta locue, ya japagat y mañelo ni y megae na sinangan, yan janafitme sija.
pairs.english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaga güije didide na tiempo, despues manafanjanao en pas ni y mañelo, para y manmatago sija.
pairs.english: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pablo yan si Barnabé mañasaga gui Antioquia, na mamananagüe, yan manpredidica ni y sinangan y Señot; yan megae palo locue.
pairs.english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 36 67930 ¶ Ya anae malofan palo jaane, ilegña si Pablo as Barnabé: Nije tajanao talo ya tabisita ya mañeluta gui cada siuda anae y guinin tapredica y sinangan y Señot, ya utalie jafa chechoñija.
pairs.english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let's return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Barnabé malago na ujacone gachongñija si Juan, ni y apiyiduña Marcos.
pairs.english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jinasoña si Pablo, na ti mauleg na ufañija, sa sumuja guiya sija desde Pamfilia, ya ti mandinalalag sija gui checho.
pairs.english: But Paul didn't think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn't go with them to do the work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumuyong dangculon minaguaguat, ya manadisapatta; ya si Barnabé jacone si Marcos, ya mangama gui batco para Chipre;
pairs.english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo jayeg si Silas ya mapos, manmaencatga ni y mañelo ni y grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao todo inanco Siria yan Silisia, janafanfitme y inetnon mangilisyano sija.
pairs.english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mato güe locue Derbe yan Lystra: Ya estagüe, estaba güije un disipulo na y naanña si Timoteo, lajin un palaoan Judio, ni y manjonggue; lao y tataña Griego.
pairs.english: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed; but his father was a Greek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gosmauleg y famaña gui mañelo ni y mangaegue Lystra yan Iconio.
pairs.english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya malago Pablo na ujasija jumanao: ya quinene ya ninamasirconsida, sa pot y Judio sija ni y mangaegue güije na lugat: sa todoja tumungo na y tataña Griego.
pairs.english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe todo y siuda sija, manmanae para ujaadaje, y tinago sija, ni y tinago y apostoles yan y manamco ni y mangaegue guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y iglesia sija nae mumemetgot y jinenggue, ya lumalamegae y numero cada jaane.
pairs.english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 6 68040 ¶ Ya anae jajanagüe todo inanacon tanon Frygia, yan Galasia, ya manchinema ni y Espiritu Santo na ujapredica y sinangan guiya Asia;
pairs.english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato jijot y Misia, manmalago na ufanjanao para Bitinia: lao ti manpinelo ni y Espiritun Jesus na ufanjanao;
pairs.english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn't allow them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalofan oriyan Misia, ya manunog Troas.
pairs.english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae puenge, jalie si Pablo un vision, na un taotao Masedonia, tumotojgue güije ya gumagagao güe ilegña: Mamaela mague guiya Masedonia ya unayudajam.
pairs.english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, "Come over into Macedonia and help us."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jalie y vision, enseguidas manmalagojam na manjanao para Masedonia, ya pinelonmame na y Señot umagangjam para inpredica y ibangelio guiya sija.
pairs.english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 11 68090 ¶ Ya anae mangagamajam guinin Troas, manmatojam gui tunas na chalan para Samotrasia, ya y inagpaña na jaane manmatojam Neapolis;
pairs.english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo asta Filipos, ni y mas dangculo na siuda güije na patte guiya Masedonia, yan un colonia romana: ya mañagajam güije na siuda unos cuantos na jaane.
pairs.english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sabado na jaane, manjanaojam juyong gui siuda gui oriyan sadog, anae pinelonmame un lugat tinayuyut: ya manmatachongjam ya incuentuse y famalaoan sija ni y mandaña güije.
pairs.english: On the Sabbath day we went forth outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un palaoan na y naanña si Lydia, na manbebende purpura gui siudad Tiatira, ni y jaadodora si Yuus, jajungogjam; sa binaba y corasonña ni y Señot para uatituye y jasasangan si Pablo.
pairs.english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us; whose heart the Lord opened to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: palaoan, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and stay." So she persuaded us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 16 68140 ¶ Ya susede anae manjanaojam para lugat tinayuyut, na manasodajam yan un patgon na palaoan na gae espiritu Pitonico, ni y janafangana megae y amuña pot y manadibibina:
pairs.english: It happened, as we were going to prayer, that a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadadalag si Pablo yan jame, ya umaagang ilegña: Este sija na taotao y tentago y Gueftaquilo na Yuus ni y fumanuejit ni y chalan y satbasion.
pairs.english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este finatinasña y palaoan megae na jaane. Lao si Pablo gosninaestotba ya jabira güe ya ilegña ni y espiritu: Jutago jao pot y naan Jesucristo na unjuyong guiya güiya. Ya jumuyong güijeja na ora.
pairs.english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!" It came out that very hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 19 68170 ¶ Ya anae jalie y amuña na mapos y ninanggaña para ufangana, maguut si Pablo yan Silas, ya macone guato gui plasa gui menan manmagas,
pairs.english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmacone guato gui manmagas y lay, ilegña: Este sija na taotao. Judios ya jaatbororota y siudata,
pairs.english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, "These men, being Jews, are agitating our city,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmamananagüe costumbre ni y ti combiene para jita na utaresibe, ni utaadaje, sa jita taotao Roma.
pairs.english: and set forth customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangajulo y linajyan taotao ya mandaña contra sija: ya y manmagas sija jatiteg guiya sija y magaguñija, ya manmanago na ufanmasaulag.
pairs.english: The multitude rose up together against them, and the magistrates tore their clothes off of them, and commanded them to be beaten with rods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta megae na sinaulag ni y manmasaulagñija, manmapolo gui jalom calaboso, ya maencatga y atcaede na uguesadje sija.
pairs.english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y rumesibe este na tinago, manpinelo sija guiya jalolom na calaboso, ya jaguesgode y adengñija gui sipo.
pairs.english: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tatalo puenge manaetae si Pablo yan Silas, yan jacantaye si Yuus alabansa sija: ya manjiningog ni ayo sija y manmaprereso.
pairs.english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya derepente guaja güije un dangculon linao, ya asta y simienton y calaboso yinengyong: ya enseguidas manmababa todo y petta, ya todo y preso manmapula y guedenñija.
pairs.english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone's bonds were loosened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae magmata y atcaede, ya jalie na mababa y pettan y calaboso, jalagnos y espadaña ya malago na upuno maesa güe, sa pineloña na manmalago y preso sija.
pairs.english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo umagang ni y dangculo na inagang, ilegña: Chamo munalalamen jao: sa estagüejamja todos.
pairs.english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, "Don't harm yourself, for we are all here!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae mangagao candet sija, ya tumayog jalom, ya mato manlalaolao ni y minaañao, ya podong gui menan Pablo yan Silas,
pairs.english: He called for lights and sprang in, and, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija juyong, ya ilegña: Señores, jafa jufatinas para jusatbo?
pairs.english: and brought them out and said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Jenggue y Señot Jesus ya unsatbo yan y iya guimamo.
pairs.english: They said, "Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane güe ni y sinangan y Señot, yan todo y mañasaga gui guimaña.
pairs.english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayoja na ora gui puenge nae jacone ya jafagase y sinaulagñija: ya matagpange güe enseguidas yan todo y iyoña.
pairs.english: He took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija guato gui guimaña ya japlantaye nañija gui menañija, ya ninasenmagof sa jajonggue si Yuus yan todo y iya guimaña.
pairs.english: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 35 68330 ¶ Ya anae egaan na jaane, manmanago y manmagas sargento sija ilegñija: Setta ayo sija na taotao ya ufanjanao.
pairs.english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, "Let those men go."
