pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y atcaede jasangane si Pablo ni este na sinangan, ilegña: Manmanago y manmagas na infanmasotta: ya pago fañuja ya infanjanao en pas.
pairs.english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, "The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out, and go in peace."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo ilegña nu sija: Janafanmasaulagjam sin infanmaecungog, yan manmapresojam, ya taotao Roma jamja: ya pago inmanafanjuyong sin infanatungo? Aje: lao nafanmato ya sija unafanjuyongjam.
pairs.english: But Paul said to them, "They have beaten us publicly, without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sargento sija jasangane y manmagas ni este na sinangan: ya ninafanmaañao anae jajungog na taotao Roma sija.
pairs.english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato ya manmagagao sija, ya anae manatanjuyong, manmagagao na ufanjuyong gui siuda.
pairs.english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong gui calaboso, manjalom gui guima Lydia; ya anae jalie y mañelo, jaconsuela ya manjanao.
pairs.english: They went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia's house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, and departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae guinen manmalofan inanaco Amfipolis yan Apolonia, manmato Tesalónica, anae guaja sinagogan Judios,
pairs.english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo segun costumbreña, jumalom güije sija, ya tres sabado jaadingane sija ni y Tinigue.
pairs.english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadeclararayeja sija, na si Cristo nesesita ufamadese, ya ucajulo talo guinin y manmatae: ya este na Jesus ni y jusangane jamyo, güiya y Cristo.
pairs.english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, "This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija manmanjonggue, ya mandaña yan si Pablo yan Silas: yan y mandeboto na Griego un dangculon manada; ya ti didide na manmagas na famalaoan.
pairs.english: Some of them were persuaded, and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Judio sija pot y inigoñija, palo manaelaye na taotao gui mancanaya; ya mandaña un linajyan taotao jaatborota y siuda; ya maataca y guima Jason, ya maprocura manmaquecone sija juyong gui menan taotao.
pairs.english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace, and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti manmasoda, macone si Jason yan palo gui mañelo guato gui manmagas y siuda, ya managang ilegñija: Este yuje sija y munafanaatlibes y tano, ya manmato güine locue;
pairs.english: When they didn't find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, "These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jaresibe si Jason; ya todo este sija cumocontra y tinago Sesat; ilegñija na guaja otro ray, si Jesus.
pairs.english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatborota todo y taotao yan y manmagas y siuda anae majungog este sija.
pairs.english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmañule segurida gui as Jason yan y pumalo, manmasotta.
pairs.english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 10 68480 ¶ Ya anae puenge enseguidas matago ni y mañelo si Pablo yan Silas para Berea; ya anae manmato, manjalom gui sinagogan y Judios.
pairs.english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija mas manmauleg qui ayo iya Tesalónica, sa rumesibe y sinangan contodo y minalagoñija, yan matataetae y Tinigue cada jaane, para umalie cao magajet ayo sija.
pairs.english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina megae guiya sija manmanjonggue; yan y manjulon locue na famalaoan Griego, yan y lalaje ti didide.
pairs.english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Judios Tesalónica anae jatungo na japredidica si Pablo y sinangan Yuus guiya Berea, manmato locue güije, ya manafangalamten yan manafaninestotba y linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas matago ni y mañelo si Pablo na ujanao asta y tase; lao si Silas yan Timoteo mañagaja güije.
pairs.english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y umadadaje si Pablo, macone asta Atenas; ya manresibe tinago para si Silas yan Timoteo, na ujalaguse guato guiya güiya, ya manmapos.
pairs.english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 16 68540 ¶ Ya mientras manninanangga as Pablo guiya Atenas, calamten y espirituña gui sanjalomña anae jalie y siuda na bula y idolos.
pairs.english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina gui sinagoga jaadingane y Judio sija, yan y mandeboto na taotao sija, yan todo y asodaña gui plasa todo y jaane.
pairs.english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manmalate gui finanagüe y Epicureo yan Estoicosija, managuaguat yan güiya, ya palo ilegñija: Jafa cumequeilegña este na caducon cuicuentos? Otro palo ilegñija: Buente mannae notisia y nuebo na yuus; sa jasangane sija as Jesus, yan y quinajulo talo.
pairs.english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, "What does this babbler want to say?" Others said, "He seems to be advocating foreign deities," because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone güe guato gui as Areopago, ilegñija. Siñajam intingo este y nuebo na finanagüe ni y unsasangan?
pairs.english: They took hold of him, and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, "May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa uunafanmanjujungogjam ni y güinaja ni tatnae injingog, enaomina manmalagojam intingo jafa estesija.
pairs.english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa todo iya Atenas, yan y manaotao juyong ni y mañasaga güije, taya chechoñiñija na para ufanguentosja, yan para ufanecungog ni y nuebo na güinaja.)
pairs.english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae tumojgue si Pablo gui talo gui Areopago, ya ilegña; Jamyo ni y lalajen Atenas, julie na guefdeboto jamyo.
pairs.english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus, and said, "You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa anae malofanyo, ya juatan jafa y inadoranmimiyo, jusoda gui un attat este na tinigue: PARA Y TI MATUNGO NA YUUS. Ayo y inadodoraja ni y ti intingo; güiya jusangangane jamyo.
pairs.english: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: 'TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.' What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I announce to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ni y fumatinas y tano yan todo y güinaja ni y mangaegue gui sumanjalomña; güiya Señot gui langet yan y tano, ti sumasaga gui templo ni y finatinas canae;
pairs.english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn't dwell in temples made with hands,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni umasetbe ni y canae taotao sija, taegüije y guaja janesesita; sa güiya mannae todo linâlâ, yan jinagong, yan todo y güinaja;
pairs.english: neither is he served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: na jâgâ sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujaaligao y Señot, yaguin siña buente masiente ya umasoda güe, sa ti chago güe cada uno guiya jita.
pairs.english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iya güiya nae utafanlâlâ yan utafangalamten, yan utafanguaja sustansiata; taegüije y palo gui poetan miyo, ilegñija: Sa jita locue y rasaña.
pairs.english: 'For in him we live, and move, and have our being.' As some of your own poets have said, 'For we are also his offspring.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jita y rasan Yuus, mungajit jumaso na y yiniusan Yuus parejo yan oro, pat salape, pat acho, pat y finatinas y jinason y taotao.
pairs.english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jaconsidera si Yuus y tiempo anae manaetiningo; lao pago, manago na todo y taotao ufanmañotsot;
pairs.english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatancho un jaane, ni y anae para ujusga ni y tininas, y tano, ni ayo na taotao y jatago; ni y mannae testimonio todo y taotao, sa janacajulo guinin y manmatae.
pairs.english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija y quinajulo talo guinin y manmatae, palo manmanbotlea; ya y palo ilegñija: Injingog jao talo otro biaje, pot este.
pairs.english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, "We want to hear you again concerning this."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae mapos si Pablo gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao palo mandaña guiya güiya, manmanjonggue: ya y palo güije sija, si Dionisio, taotao Areopago, yan un palaoan na y naanña Dámaris, yan palo mangachongñiñija.
pairs.english: But certain men joined with him, and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di estesija, jumanao si Pablo guiya Atenas ya mato Corinto:
pairs.english: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasoda un Judio na naanña si Aquila, mafañagon Ponto, ni ti apmamam na mato guinin Italia, yan y asaguaña as Prisila, sa manago si Claudio na todo y Judios ufanjanao Roma; ya mato guiya sija.
pairs.english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa parejoja chechoñiñija, ya sumaga yan sija, ya machochoeho: sa y chechoñiñija manmamatitinas y guima tienda.
pairs.english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañangangane gui sinagoga cada sabado, ya japrocucura para usuug y Judio yan y Griego sija.
pairs.english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 5 68770 ¶ Lao anae mato si Silas yan Timoteo guinin Masedonia, si Pablo chineneg ni sinangan na unamatungo gui Judios na si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macontra sija yan machatfino nu sija, jasacude y magaguña, ya ilegña nu sija: Y jâgâmiyo gui jilo y ilunmiyo: guajo gasgasyo; ya desde pago bae jujanao para y Gentiles.
pairs.english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos ya jumalom gui guima un taotao na y naanña si Tito Justo na manadodora as Yuus, na y guimaña jijot gui sinagoga.
pairs.english: He departed there, and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Crispo magas y sinagoga, jajonggue y Señot, yan todo y guimaña: ya megae na taotao Corinto jumungog ya manjonggue ya manmatagpange.
pairs.english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot jacuentuse si Pablo gui puenge gui vision, ilegña: Chamo maaañao, lao cuentos, ya chamo famatquiquilo:
pairs.english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, "Don't be afraid, but speak and don't be silent;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegueyo guiya jago, ya taya taotao siña guaguato guiya jago para unninalamen: sa megae taotaojo güine na siuda.
pairs.english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije un año yan saes meses, jafananagüe sija ni y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 12 68840 ¶ Ya anae si Galión magalajen Acaya, y Judio sija mangajulo, gui un jinasoja, contra si Pablo, ya macone gui menan y tribunal,
pairs.english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Este na taotao jasuug y taotao sija para ujaadora si Yuus contra y lay.
pairs.english: saying, "This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae para ubaba si Pablo y pachotña, si Galión ilegña ni y Judio sija: Yaguin mojon jafa na inechong pat tinaelaye, O jamyo Judios, con rason jusungon jamyo.
pairs.english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ya yaguin y finaesen finijoja, yan naan sija, yan y laymiyo, adaje maesa jamyo; sa guajo ti malagoyo ujues ni enao na güinaja.
pairs.english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don't want to be a judge of these matters."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafañuja gui tribunal.
pairs.english: He drove them from the judgment seat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae todosija maguut si Sostenes, magas y sinagoga, ya masaulag gui menan y tribunal. Ya si Galión, ti jaatituye ayo sija na güinaja.
pairs.english: Then all the Greeks laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn't care about any of these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 18 68900 ¶ Ya sumaga si Pablo güije megae na jaane, ya despues jadingo y mañelo, ya mangagama gui batco desde ayo asta Siria, ya sumisija yan si Prisila, yan Aquila; ya maguasguas y iluña guiya Cencrea: sa gae promesa.
pairs.english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato Efeso ya jadingo sija güije: ya güiyaja jumalom gui sinagoga, ya jaadingane y Judios.
pairs.english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae magagaogüe na usaga apmam yan sija, ti malago;
pairs.english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jadingo sija ilegña: Bae jutalo mague guiya jamyo, yaguin malago si Yuus. Ya mangama gui batco desde Efeso.
pairs.english: but taking his leave of them, and saying, "I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills," he set sail from Ephesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae tumayog gui tano Sesarea, cumajulo, ya jasaluda y iglesia, ya mapos papa Antioquia.
pairs.english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di sumaga güije ti apmam na tiempo, maposgüe ya jajanagüe todo y inanaco tano Galasia, yan Frygia, para unafanmetgot todo y disipulo.
pairs.english: Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 24 68960 ¶ Ya mato guiya Efeso un taotao na Judio, na y naanña si Apolos, mafañagon Alejandria, un taotao na faye, yan gaeninasiña gui Tinigue sija.
pairs.english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na taotao, mafanagüe ni y chalan y Señot; maepe gui Espiritu, jasasangan yan mamananagüe claro ni y chalan y Señot, lao ayoja tinagpangenja Juan tiningoña:
pairs.english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon sumangan ni y minatatnga gui sinagoga: ya anae jiningog as Prisila yan Aquila, macone ya mafanagüe mas claro ni y chalan Yuus.
pairs.english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malago malofan Acaya, y mañelo mananima güe ya manmanugue para y disipulo ya manmaencatga na umaresibe güe: ya anae mato jaayuda megae ayo sija y manmanjonggue pot y grasia:
pairs.english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gosjanasiña macontra y Judios, y publico nae jafanunue ni y Tinigue sija, na si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede mientras estataba si Apolos guiya Corinto, si Pablo malofan gui managquilo na costa ya mato Efeso: ya mañoda palo disipulo sija güije.
pairs.english: It happened that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Inresibe y Espiritu Santo desde qui manmanjonggue jamyo? Ya ilegñija: Taya nae injingog cao esta manae Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: He said to them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" They said to him, "No, we haven't even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa nae manmatagpangenmiyo? Ya sija ilegñija: Y tinagpangen Juan.
pairs.english: He said, "Into what then were you baptized?" They said, "Into John's baptism."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña si Pablo: Si Juan, magajet na managpapange ni y tinagpangen sinetsot, ya jasangane y taotao sija, na ujajonggue ayo y ufato despues di güiya, ayo y as Cristo Jesus.
pairs.english: Paul said, "John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Jesus."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija este, manmatagpange ni y naan y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japlanta si Pablo y canaeña gui jiloñija, y Espiritu Santo mato gui jiloñija: ya manguentos ni y tifinoñija, ya manmanprofetisa.
pairs.english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija todos dose na taotao lalaje.
pairs.english: They were about twelve men in all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 8 69080 ¶ Ya jumalom si Pablo gui sinagoga, ya cumuentos libre tres meses; jasangan yan y animo gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: He entered into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning the Kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae palo manmajetog, ya ti manmalago manmanjonggue, ya manguecuentos taelaye pot ayo na Chalan gui menan y linajyan taotao, sumuja si Pablo guiya sija, ya janafañuja y disipulo sija, ya manadingan cada jaane gui escuelan Tiranno.
pairs.english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dos años di mafatinas este: para todo ayo y mañasaga Asia ujajungog y sinangan y Señot Jesus, parejoja y Judio yan y Griego sija.
pairs.english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas si Yuus milagro pot y canae Pablo:
pairs.english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para guinin y tataotaoña nae umachule paño sija para y manmalango, ya y chetnot ufañuja guiya sija; yan y manaelaye na espiritu ufanjuyong guiya sija.
pairs.english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the evil spirits went out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo Judios na manaesagañija, taotao binanggelio, japrocura na jasangan nu ayo sija y manguaja taelaye na espiritu y naan y Señot Jesus, ilegñija: Innafanjula jao pot si Jesus, ni y japredidica si Pablo.
pairs.english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, "We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja siete na lalaje, famaguon un Judio ni naaña si Sceva, ya magas mamale, na jafatinas este sija.
pairs.english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope y taelaye na espiritu, ilegña: Si Jesus jutungo, yan si Pablo jutungo; lao jaye jamyo?
pairs.english: The evil spirit answered, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao ni y guaja taelaye na espiritu, tumayog gui jiloñija; ya jagana sija, sa mas gaeninasiñaña qui sija; ya esta manmalago sija güije na guma, manerido yan taya magaguñija.
pairs.english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matungo este todo ni y Judios, yan y Griego sija yan ayo sija y mañasaga Efeso; ya podong y minaañao gui jiloñija todos, ya manadangculo y naan y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ni y manmanjonggue manmato, ya mangonfesat manmañangane ni y chechoñija.
pairs.english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing, and declaring their deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ni ayo sija locue y umuusa y magica jachule y leblonñija, ya jasonggue gui menan todo y taotao: ya matufong y balenñija, ya masoda na sincuenta mil na pidason salape,
pairs.english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüenao mumegagaeña y ninasiñan y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 21 69210 ¶ Ya despues di este sija, jajaso si Pablo gui espirituña, anae malofan inanaco Masedonia yan Acaya na ujanao para Jerusalem, ilegña: Yaguin esta matoyo güije, nesesita yo na julie locue Roma.
pairs.english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, "After I have been there, I must also see Rome."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya depues di jatago dos para Masedonia ni y sumesetbe güe, si Timoteo yan Erasto, güiya sumagaja Asia un rato.
pairs.english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 23 69230 ¶ Ya ayo na tiempo guaja güije atboroto pot ayo na Chalan.
pairs.english: About that time there arose no small stir concerning the Way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un platero na taotao na y naanña si Demetrio, ya mamatitinas attat salape para si Diana, ya ti didide na ganansia chinileleña para y manmamatitinas.
pairs.english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janaetnon yan todo y manmachochocho ni y taegüije, ya ilegña: Señores, intingoja na este na chocho nae manmañoñodajit güinajata.
pairs.english: whom he gathered together, with the workmen of like occupation, and said, "Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inliija yan injingog, na ti ayoja iya Efeso, lao cana todo iya Asia nae megae na taotao jasuug si Pablo, yan jabira, sa ilegña na ti manyuus ayo sija y finatinas canae.
pairs.english: You see and hear, that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods, that are made with hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti esteja nae uguaja peligro y chechota na unafanaebale lao asta y templon y dangculo na yuus si Diana umarechasa, ya y tinaquiloña umayulang, ni y todo iya Asia yan todo y tano umadodora.
pairs.english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing, and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 28 69280 ¶ Ya anae jajungog sija este na sinangan, ninafangosbubu, ya managang ilegñija: Dangculo y Dianan Efesios.
pairs.english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y siuda bula atboroto; ya mandaña unoja ya manjalom gui teatro ya macone si Gayo yan Aristarco, taotao Masedonia mangachong Pablo gui jinanaoña.
pairs.english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago si Pablo na ufalag y anae mangaegue y taotao sija; lao ti mapolo ni y disipulo.
pairs.english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn't allow him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manmagas Asia ni y manamiguña, manmanago na umasangane na chaña jumalom güe gui teatro.
pairs.english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo, managang un inagang: ya y palo, otro inagang; sa manatborotao y dinana; ya megaeña ti tumungo jafa na mandaña sija.
pairs.english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn't know why they had come together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone si Alejandro gui entre y linajyan taotao, ya mapolo mona ni y Judios, ya mañeñas si Alejandro ni y canaeña na ufanmamatquilo, sa malago umadingane y taotao sija,
pairs.english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae matungo na Judio güe, todos managang gui un inagang buente dos oras, ilegñija: Dangculo y Dianan Efesios.
pairs.english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y secretario y inetnon magalalaje munjayan janaquieto y taotao, ilegña nu sija: Jamyo ni y taotao Efeso, jafa na taotao ayo y ti jatungo na y siuda Efesios manmanadodora ni y dangculo na yuus Diana, yan y imagen ni y podong guinin y Jupiter?
pairs.english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, "You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn't know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inlie na estesija ti siña macontra, nesesita na infanmamatquilo, ya chamiyo fumatitinas jafa.
pairs.english: Seeing then that these things can't be denied, you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rash.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jamyo cumone mague este sija na taotao, na ti mañaque gui guimayuus, ni ujachatfino contra y yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Demetrio yan y palo ni y mangachongña guaja quejanñija contra y otro taotao: guaja tribunal y lay: ya guaja y jues; polo ya ufanafaaela uno y otro.
pairs.english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin inseda jamyo jafa pot otro sija, umafatinas gui inetnon y magalalaje taemanoja y lay.
pairs.english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mangaeguejit gui peligro, na utafanmafaesen pot este sija na atboroto, ya taya jafa siña urasonta pot este.
pairs.english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning this day's riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn't be able to give an account of this commotion."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan cumuentos, janajanao y dinaña.
pairs.english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae bumasta y atboroto, jaagang si Pablo y disipulo sija, ya anae jaaconsejo ya jadingo, mapos para Masedonia.
pairs.english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe inanaco ayo sija na lugat, ya janae sija megae na consejo, mapos malag Gresia.
pairs.english: When he had gone through those parts, and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije tres meses, ya manananggaja para ucone ni y Judios, anae maudae gui batco ya janao para Siria, jajaso na utalo guato Masedonia.
pairs.english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maosgaejon asta Asia, si Sopater patgon Pirro guiya Berea, yan iya Tesalónica, si Aristarcho yan si Segundo, yan si Gayo guiya Derbe, yan si Timoteo: ya iya Asia, si Tiquico yan si Trófimo.
pairs.english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe; Timothy; and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija manjanao finena, ya janananggajam Troas,
pairs.english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di y pan sinlibadura, manmaudaejam gui batco desde Filipos, infatoigüe sija guiya Troas gui mina sinco na jaane; ya mañagajam güije siete na jaane.
pairs.english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 7 69480 ¶ Ya y finenana na jaane gui semana, anae mandaña y disipulo para umaipe y pan, si Pablo japredica guiya sija, sa esta güe listo para ujanao gui inagpaña: ya sisigueja di manpredica asta y tatalopuenge.
pairs.english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day, and continued his speech until midnight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na candet gui sanjilo na cuatto anae estabajam na mandadaña.
pairs.english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije un patgon na taotao na y naanña si Eutico, na matatachong sanjilo gui un bentana, ya guesmaego; ya y inanaco y prinedican Pablo, matomba gui maegoña, ya podong desde y mina tres na piso, ya anae majatsa matae.
pairs.english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third story, and was taken up dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumunog papa si Pablo ya dumimo gui jiloña, ya jatogtog ilegña: Chamiyo ninafañachatsaga, sa y linâlâña gaegueja gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: Paul went down, and fell upon him, and embracing him said, "Don't be troubled, for his life is in him."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae cajulo talo, jaipe y pan ya mañocho, ya cumuentos asta qui manana; ya ayonae jumanao.
pairs.english: When he had gone up, and had broken bread, and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lâlâ patgon na taotao, ya ti didide ninafanmagof.
pairs.english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 13 69540 ¶ Ya manmaposjam para y batco, ya manmaudaejam guato Asos, sa para ayo nae inquene si Pablo: sa taegüije matagoña, ya malagoñaja ufamocat.
pairs.english: But we who went ahead to the ship set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there, for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manasodajam Asos, inquene güe, ya manmatojam Mitilene.
pairs.english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard, and came to Mitylene.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya manmatojam gui inagpaña na jaane gui menan Chio, ya y inagpaña talo güije na jaane, manmatojam Samo, ya mañagajam Trogilio; ya y inagpaña na jaane, manjanaojam para Mileto.
pairs.english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Pablo malagoña umaudae gui batco para Efeso, sa ti malago jagasta y tiempo guiya Asia; sa inalulula, na mano y ninasiñaña, na ufato Jerusalem gui jaanen y Pentecostes.
pairs.english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 17 69580 ¶ Ya desde Mileto manago guato Efeso na ufanmaagange y manamco gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato guiya güiya, ilegña nu sija: Injatingo desde y finenenana na jaane anae matoyo Asia, jafa manaemanojit todo y tiempo,
pairs.english: When they had come to him, he said to them, "You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusetbe y Señot contodo y inimitde na jinaso, yan y minegae lago, yan y tentasion sija ni y manmato guiya guajo pot y ninanggan y Judios.
pairs.english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaftaemano ti maañao yo jusangane jamyo todo y mauleg para jamyo, lao jufanue jamyo yan jufanagüe jamyo, gui publico yan gui guima yan guma.
pairs.english: how I didn't shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junamatungo gui Judios yan y Griego sija locue, y sinetsot para as Yuus, yan y jinenggue para y Señotta as Jesucristo.
pairs.english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, estagüe y Espiritu na janajanaoyo para Jerusalem, ti jutungo jafa ufanmato guiya guajo güije.
pairs.english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esteja y Espiritu Santo janae yo testimonio na gui cada siudad, ilegña, na y guinede yan y pinite ufañaga guiya guajo.
pairs.english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taya güine na güinaja unacalamtenyo, ni ti junaguaguan y linâlâjo para guajo, lao guefmalago yo na junafunjayan y chechojo, yan y obligasionjo ni y juresibe gui Señot Jesus, para junamatungo y ebangelion y grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: But these things don't count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, estagüe na jutungo jamyo todos, ya ni uno guiya jamyo ni y anae guinin jupredica y raenon Yuus, ulinie y matajo mas.
pairs.english: "Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching the Kingdom of God, will see my face no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao na jucone jamyo para testigo pago na jaane, na guajo gasgasyo guinin todo y jâgâ y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am clean from the blood of all men,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa trabia ti munjajayan junatungo jamyo todo ni y pinagat Yuus.
pairs.english: for I didn't shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefadaje jamyo, yan todo y manada ni y ninafanmagas jamyo ni y Espiritu Santo, para inapasto inetnon mangilisyano iyon Yuus, ni y jafajan ni y jâgâñaja.
pairs.english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jujatungo este, na despues di jumanaoyo, y manaelaye sija na lobo ufanjalom gui entalomiyo, ya ti unasobbla y manada.
pairs.english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya jamyo locue nae ufangajulo sija taotao na jasasangan y manaelaye na güinaja sija, para ufanmangone disipulo sija para udalalag sija.
pairs.english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina adaje, ya injaso na pot tres años, ti pumaparayo jusangane cada uno parejoja jaane yan puenge cumacasaoyo.
pairs.english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn't cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago mañelujo, jutayuyute jamyo as Yuus, yan y sinangan y grasiaña, ni y siña manjinatsa jamyo julo, yan infanninae erensianmiyo yan todo ayo sija y manafangasgas.
pairs.english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up, and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya jucodisia ni jaye na taotao, salape pat oro, pat magago.
pairs.english: I coveted no one's silver, or gold, or clothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo, intingo este sija na canae y sumesetbeyo gui nesesidajo, yan ayo sija y mangachochongjo.
pairs.english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta junae jamyo mauleg na ejemplo gui todosija, jaftaemano ya guaja obligasionmiyo na inadaje y manaemetgot yan injaso y sinangan y Señot Jesus, ni y ilegña: Mas dichoso y mannae qui y manresibe.
pairs.english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 36 69770 ¶ Ya anae munjayan jasangan taegüine, dumimo papa ya manmanayuyut todos.
pairs.english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todosija mananges ya matogtog y agâgâ Pablo ya machico.
pairs.english: They all wept a lot, and fell on Paul's neck and kissed him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafansenpinite todos pot y sinanganña, na ti ujalie y mataña mas. Ya maosgaejon gui jinanaoña asta y batco.
pairs.english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae susede na manadingojam, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya manmatojam gui tinas na chalan para Coos, ya y inagpaña na jaane manmatojam Rodas, ya desde ayo asta Pátara.
pairs.english: When it happened that we had parted from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inseda un batco na jumajanao para Finesia, ya manmaudaejam, ya manjanaojam.
pairs.english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae intutujon lumie Chipre inpelo gui acagüe, ya manjanaojam asta Siria, ya manmatojam Tiro: sa para umadescatga güije y batco.
pairs.english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmañodajam güije disipulo, mañagajam siete na jaane; ya ilegñija as Pablo pot y Espiritu, na chaña jumajanao julo Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae inquimple todo esta ayo sija na jaane, manjanaojam ya insigue y jinanaomame, ya manmaosgaejonjam ni y asaguanñija yan y famaguonñija, asta qui manjuyongjam gui siuda: ya mandimojam gui oriyan tase ya manmanayuyutjam.
pairs.english: When it happened that we had accomplished the days, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, anae manadingojam, uno y otro, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya sija manalo guato guiya sija.
pairs.english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 7 69860 ¶ Ya anae inquimple y jinanaomame desde Tiro, manmatojam Tolemaida, ya insaluda y mañelo, ya mañagajam güije yan sija un jaane.
pairs.english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña, jame ni y mangachong Pablo, manjanaojam, ya manmatojam Sesarea; ya manjalomjam gui guima Felipe y ebangelista ni y uno gui siete, ya mañagajam güije yan güiya.
pairs.english: On the next day, we, who were Paul's companions, departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na taotao, guaja cuatro jagaña na vitgen na manmanprofetisa.
pairs.english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras mañagajam güije megae na jaane, mato papa guinin Judea un profeta na y naanña Agabo.
pairs.english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato guiya jame, jachule y senturon Pablo, ya jagode güe canaeña yan y adengña, ya ilegña: Taegüine ilegña y Espiritu Santo: Taegüineja magodeña y gaeiyo este na senturon, ni y Judios ni mangaegue Jerusalem, ya umaentrega gui canae Gentiles.
pairs.english: Coming to us, and taking Paul's belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, "Thus says the Holy Spirit: 'So will the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.'"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae injingog este sija, parejoja jame yan ayo y mañasaga güije na lugat, matayuyut güe na chaña jumajanao julo Jerusalem.
pairs.english: When we heard these things, both we and they of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manope si Pablo ilegña: Jafa na manatanges jamyo, ya inyamag y corasonjo? sa esta listoyo ti para jumagodeja, lao asta jumatae guiya Jerusalem, pot y naan Jesucristo.
pairs.english: Then Paul answered, "What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae timalago manamañaña, manbastajam ilegmame: Y minalago y Señot umafatinas.
pairs.english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, "The Lord's will be done."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 15 69940 ¶ Ya despues di ayo sija na jaane, inchile y güinajanmame ya manjanaojam papa Jerusalem.
pairs.english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjame locue yan palo disipulon Sesarea, ya manmangongone un Mnason iya Chipre, y bijo na disipulo ya infanjame mañaga.
pairs.english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatojam Jerusalem, mangosmagof y mañelo jaresibejam.
pairs.english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña, manjanaojam yan si Pablo para as Santiago: ya todo y manamco manestaba.
pairs.english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasaluda sija, jasanganen adumidide ni y finatinas Yuus gui entalo Gentiles pot y chechoña.
pairs.english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija, maalaba y Señot, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Unlie chelujo cuantos miles na Judios y manmanjonggue, yan maneggo ni y tinago:
pairs.english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, "You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matungo guinin jago, na unfanagüe todo y Judios ni y mangaegue gui Gentiles, na ujafañuja gui as Moises, ilegmo, na munga manmasirconsida y famaguonñija, ni ujadalalag y costumbre.
pairs.english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children neither to walk after the customs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa nae umafatinas? Magajet na ujajungog na mato jao.
pairs.english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina fatinas este y insangane jao: Guajajam cuatro na taotao na manmanpromesa;
pairs.english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cone sija, ya unnagasgas jao yan sija, ya unfangata pot sija ya ufanmadasae ilunñija; ya todo utiningo na ayo sija y matungo pot jago taya guaja; lao jago locue dalalag jaftaemano y tinago, ya unadaje y lay.
pairs.english: Take them, and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y Gentiles ni y manmanjonggue, esta intigue na innafagpo, na chañija umadadaje ni uno güine; solo ujaadajeja sija güije na güinaja y manmaofrese y idolos, yan y jâgâ, y mamuno, yan y inábale.
pairs.english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo jacone y taotao sija, ya y inagpaña na jaane janagasgas güe yan sija, jumalom gui templo para usangan y macumplen y jaanen y managasgas, asta qui ufanmaofrese y inefrese cada uno guiya sija.
pairs.english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 27 70060 ¶ Ya anae esta cana mamagpo y siete na jaane, ni Judios ni y mangaegue Asia, anae malie güe gui templo, janafangalamten todo y taotao contra güiya.
pairs.english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya managang ilegñija: Taotao Israel, fanmanayuda: Estagüe yuje na taotao y jafananagüe todo y taotao manoja guato contra y pueblo, yan y lay, yan este na lugat: yan janafanjalom y Gentiles gui templo, ya janataelaye este na lugat.
pairs.english: crying out, "Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple, and has defiled this holy place!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa guinin malie güe antes yan si Trófimo, un taotao Efeso, gui siuda, ya jinasoñija na si Pablo cumone jalom gui templo.)
pairs.english: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo manatborotao y siuda, yan todo y taotao manmalago, ya macone si Pablo, ya manajuyong gui templo; ya enseguidas manmajuchom y petta.
pairs.english: All the city was moved, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjajanao para umapuno si Pablo, mato notisia gui magas y inetnon, na todo iya Jerusalem man atborotao.
pairs.english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas mangone sendalo sija yan capitan, ya manmalago guato guiya sija; ya anae malie y magas y inetnon yan y sendalo sija, manbasta masaulag si Pablo.
pairs.english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y magas y inetnon jumijot, ya quinene güe, ya manago na umagode dos na cadena: ya mamaesen jaye güe, yan jafa finatinasña.
pairs.english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo manaagang un inagang, ya y palo, otro inagang, gui entre y linajyan taotao: ya anae ti siña tumungo y magajet pot y atboroto, manago na umacone guato gui castiyo.
pairs.english: Some shouted one thing, and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn't find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guaot, sa macocone ni y sendalo sija, pot y finijom y linajyan taotao;
pairs.english: When he came to the stairs, it happened that he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manatateja y linajyan taotao, ya manaagangja ilegñija: Fañuja yan guiya.
pairs.english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, "Away with him!"

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 37 70160 ¶ Ya anae para umacone si Pablo gui castiyo, ilegña nu y magas inetnon: Siñajit cumuentos? ya ilegña: Untungo Griego?
pairs.english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, "May I speak to you?" He said, "Do you know Greek?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jago ayo y taotao Egipto, ni y antes di este sija na jaane unfatinas jatsamiento, ya uncone guato gui desierto cuatro mil na taotao ni y manpegno?
pairs.english: Aren't you then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?"
