pairs.english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat, and let it fall off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, si Pablo jagagao sija todos na ujafañocho, ilegña: Este y mina catorse na jaane ni y tanananggaja, sisiguejajit di manayunat, ti mañochojit ni jafa.
pairs.english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, "This day is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jutatayuyut jamyo na infañocho, sa este para linâlâmiyo: sa ni uno gui gapon ulonmiyo ufalingo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, jachule y pan ya janae grasia si Yuus gui menañija todos: ya anae jaipe, jatutujon cumano.
pairs.english: When he had said this, and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all, and he broke it, and began to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo todo sija y manmauleg minagofñija, mañocho locue.
pairs.english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame todos ni y manestaba gui batco, dosientos setenta y saes na taotao sija.
pairs.english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjaspog, manañajlalang y batco, ya mayute y trigo gui jalom tase.
pairs.english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, ti matungo y tano: lao masoda un diquique na sadog na guaja oriyaña; ya jinasoñija na ujanajalom y batco.
pairs.english: When it was day, they didn't recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmajatsa y angcla ya masotta gui tase, ya manmapula y tale y timon, ya jajatsa y layag para y manglo, ya jatutujon manjanao para y oriyan tase.
pairs.english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya podong gui jalom un lugat anae umasoda y dos tase, ya malago y batco gui jilo tano; ya y sanmena na patte cheton, ya sumagaja ti siña calamten, lao y santate na patte mayamag ni y finijom y napo sija.
pairs.english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manatungo y sendalo sija, na ujapuno todo y preso sija, na nosea uguaja guiya sija tumungo numango ya uescapa.
pairs.english: The soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y senturion malago na unasatbo si Pablo, ya jaadaje sija gui jinasoñija; ya manago na y siña numango uyute sija finena gui tase, ya ujafanjanao para y tano.
pairs.english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manetejnan, palo gui jilo tabbla, yan palo gui pidason mayamag batco, ya taegüenao nae manmalofan, ya todo sija mansatbo ya manescapa seguro para y tano.
pairs.english: and the rest should follow, some on planks, and some on other things from the ship. So it happened that they all escaped safely to the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manescapa esta, ayonae matungo na y isla naanña Melita.
pairs.english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao ti mangilisyano, jafamaulegjam: sa manmanotne guafe ya jaresibejam cada uno, sa pot y ichan, yan y manenggeng.
pairs.english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire, and received us all, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae janafandaña si Pablo y palitun jayo, ya jamanojo ya japolo gui jilo y guate, jumuyong un vibora guinin y maipe, ya cheton gui canaeña.
pairs.english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie ni y taotao ti mangilisyano y beneno na gâgâ na umacalaye gui canaeña, manasangane ilegñija: Este na taotao pegno, masqueseaja umescapa gui tase; lao ti upinelo ni y inenog na ulâlâ.
pairs.english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said one to another, "No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasacude y gâgâ guato gui jalom guafe, ya ti ninalamen.
pairs.english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn't harmed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mataaatanja cao uninapogpog, pat upodong enseguidas ya umatae; lao anae esta laapmam na maatan, ya malie na ti ninalamen, jatulaeca y jinasoñija, ya ilegñija na yuus güe.
pairs.english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 7 72210 ¶ Ayo na lugat, guaja fangualuanña sija y magas y isla, na y naanña si Publio; ni y rumesibejam, ya janafañagajam tres na jaane.
pairs.english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us, and courteously entertained us for three days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tatan Publio estaba na umaason sa malango calentura, yan jinaga: ya jumalom si Pablo, ya anae munjayan manaetae, japolo y canaeña gui jilo y malango, ya janajomlo.
pairs.english: It happened that the father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan este, y palo locue gui isla ni y guaja chetnotñija, manmato ya uninafanjomlo.
pairs.english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came, and were cured.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gosmegae manmatunanmame; ya anae majanaojam, manmacatgayejam ni ayo sija y innesesita,
pairs.english: They also honored us with many honors, and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 11 72250 ¶ Ya anae malofan tres meses, manjanaojam gui un batco Alejandrina, ni y estaba gui isla na mannanangga na ufalofan y tiempon manenggeng, na y señatña Castor yan Polux.
pairs.english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was "The Twin Brothers."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatojam Siracusa, mañagajam güije tres na jaane.
pairs.english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo manoriyajam, ya manmatojam guiya Regio; ya anae malofan un jaane na manguaefe y manglo sanjaya, manmatojam guiya Puteoli gui inagpaña.
pairs.english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmañodajam mañelumame güije, ya manmalago na infañaga ya infanjame siete na jaane; ya ayonae infanmalag Roma.
pairs.english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo, anae manmajungogjam ni y mañelunmame, manmato para ujatagamjam, asta y Metcadon Appio, yan y Tres Taberna; ni y anae jalie si Pablo, janae grasia si Yuus, ya jaangoco.
pairs.english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God, and took courage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 16 72300 ¶ Ya anae manmatojam Roma, y senturuon jaentrega y preso sija gui magas y guatdia: lao si Pablo mapolo na usaga namaesa yan un sendalo ni y umadadaje güe.
pairs.english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae malofan tres na jaane, jaagang si Pablo y manmagas y Judio sija; ya anae manmato ya mandaña, ilegña nu sija: Guajo mañelujo lalaje, achogja taya finatinaso contra y taotao sija, ni contra y costumbren y mañaenata jumaentrega preso desde Jerusalem asta y canae y taotao Roma:
pairs.english: It happened that after three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, "I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people, or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y para yaguin munjayan maegsaminayo, manmalago na jumasotta, sa taya jafa finatinaso para jumapuno.
pairs.english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae macontra ni y Judio sija, nesesitayo na jugagao jinisga gui as Sesat; ti pot para jufaaela y nasionjo.
pairs.english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este rason juagang jamyo, para julie jamyo, yan para utafanguentos: sa pot y ninanggan Israel na magodeyo ni este na cadena.
pairs.english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jame taya rinesibenmame carta guiya Judea pot jago, ni uno gui mañelo ni y manmato, cumuentos pat manmañangane jafa pot jago.
pairs.english: They said to him, "We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manmalagojam na injingog jao, jafa jinasosomo; sa este na secta, intingoja na masqueseaja mano guato masangan contra.
pairs.english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 23 72370 ¶ Ya anae esta matanchue un jaane, manmato megae guiya güiya, gui sagaña; ya jasangane yan janamatungo y raenon Yuus: janafanmañaña sija pot si Jesus, yan pot y tinago Moises, yan pot y profeta sija; desde y egaan asta y pupuenge.
pairs.english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about the Kingdom of God, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo, manmanjonggue ni y sinangan, palo ti manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti unoja corasonñija, manjanao anae munjayan jasangan si Pablo un sinangan: Mauleg sinanganña y Espiritu Santo pot y profeta Isaias gui mañaenata,
pairs.english: When they didn't agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, "The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah, the prophet, to our fathers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: Janao fanmalag este sija na taotao, ya inalog, Inecungog, ya injingog, ya ti incomprende; ya y inquelie, inlie, ya ti intingo.
pairs.english: saying, 'Go to this people, and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corason este sija na taotao, manmajetog, ya y talanganñija mapot manmanjungog, ya jajuchom y atadogñija; sa noseaja ufanmanlie ni y atadogñija, yan ufanmanjungog ni y talanganñija, yan ujatungo ni y corasonñija, ya ufanmañotsot, ya janafanjomlo sija.
pairs.english: For this people's heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.'

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina tingo na y este satbasion gui as Yuus manajanao para y Gentiles sija; ya sija ujajungog.
pairs.english: "Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations. They will also listen."

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya anae munjayan jasangan este sija na sinangan, manjanao y Judio sija, ya gueguesmanafaesen entre sija;)
pairs.english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Pablo sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house, and received all who were coming to him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japredidica y raenon Yuus, yan mamananagüe ni ayo sija y pot y Señot Jesucristo, contodo y linibriña, ya taya ni un taotao chumoma.
pairs.english: preaching the Kingdom of God, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO y taotao, ni ti mamomocat gui pinagat y manaelaye, ni y ti sumasaga gui chalan manisao, ni y ti matatachong gui siyan ayo sija y manmanmofefea.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guiya lay Jeova, ayo y minagofña, ya y layña jajaso, jaane yan puenge.
pairs.english: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüijeja y trongcon jayo ni y matanme gui oriyan sadog, ya guaja tinegchaña gui tiempoña, ya y jagonña ti umalayo; ya todo y finatinasña mumemegae.
pairs.english: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ti taegüine y manaelaye; lao parejo yan y paja ni y güinaefe ni y manglo.
pairs.english: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa enao na ti mangajujulo y manaelaye gui sentensia; ni y manisao gui y inetnon manunas.
pairs.english: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jatungo y chalan manunas: lao y chalan manaelaye ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SA jafa na manlalalo y nasion sija, ya y taotao sija manmanjaso y banida?
pairs.english: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manotojgue y ray sija gui tano, ya y prinsipe sija manafaesen entalo sija contra si Jeova, yan contra y pinalaeña, ilegñija:
pairs.english: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nita yulang y guinideña, ya nasuja guiya jita y godeña.
pairs.english: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sumasaga gui langet uchumachaleg: ya y Señot jamofefea sija.
pairs.english: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cumuentos yan sija yan y linalaloña: ya y binibuña ninafañatsaga sija.
pairs.english: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo japolo y rayjo gui jilo Sion, gui santos na egsojo.
pairs.english: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jusangan y tinagojo: si Jeova ilegña nu guajo: Lajijo jao; ya guajo julilis jao pago na jaane.
pairs.english: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gagaoyo ya guajo junaejao ni y nasion sija pot y erensiamo ya y uttimon patte y tano, uiyomo.
pairs.english: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unyulang sija ni y baran lulog; taegüije y bason y yero unyogyog sija.
pairs.english: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, tingo, O ray sija: resibe finanagüe, jamyo man jues gui tano.
pairs.english: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Setbe si Jeova ni y minaañao, yan fanmagof ni minayengyong.
pairs.english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chico y laje, no sea ulalálalo, ya unfanmalingo jamyo gui chalan, sa gusisija y linalaloña sinenggue. Mandichoso todos y umangoco sija guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jafa muna manlajyan y enimigujo! Megae mangajulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae umaalog ni y antijo: Taya inayuda para güiya, gui as Yuus. Sila.
pairs.english: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, jago y patang gui oriyajo; y minalagjo yan ayo ni y janacajulo y ilujo.
pairs.english: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagangjo juagang si Jeova, ya güiyaja umopeyo gui santos na ogsoña. Sila.
pairs.english: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juason ya maegoyo; ya magmatayo; sa si Jeova gumuguutyo.
pairs.english: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti maañaoyo nu y dies mit na taotao, ni y mapolo sija gui oriyajo contra guajo.
pairs.english: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova; nalibre yo, O Yuusso: sa jago manalamen todo y enimigujo ni y guijadas; y nifen y manaelaye unyamag.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Jeova nae gaegue y satbasion: ya y taotaomo nae gaegue y bendisonmo. Sila.
pairs.english: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE juagangjao, opeyo, O Yuus y tininasso: anae chatsagayo jago munadangculoyo: maase nu guajo ya jungog y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo, famaguon taotao, asta ñgaean nae innanalo y onraco gui minamajlao? Asta ñgaean yanmiyo y banida ya inaliligao y dinague? Sila.
pairs.english: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tingoja, na si Jeova japolo apatte y deboto para güiya namaesa: si Jeova jajungog yo, anae juagang güe.
pairs.english: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fangalamten ya chatmiyo faniisao: fanmanjaso nu y corasonmiyo gui jilo camanmiyo, ya famacaca. Sila.
pairs.english: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae y tunas na inefresen ya angoco si Jeova.
pairs.english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae umaalog: Jaye ufanuejit jafa minauleg? Jatsa gui jilonmame, O Jeova, y minalag y matamo.
pairs.english: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago numae minagof y corasonjo, megaeña qui uguaja sija anae umemegae y maeisñija yan y binoñija.
pairs.english: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pas nae umason yo ya taegüijeja maegoyo: sa jagoja Jeova, unnasagayo seguro.
pairs.english: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG, O Jeova, y sinanganjo, ecungog y jinasoco.
pairs.english: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ecungog y vos y inagangjo, Ray jo, yan Yuusso: sa jago jutaetaetaye.
pairs.english: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, y egaan unjungog y vosso; y egaan juguaguato y tinaetaejo guiya jago, ya jubébela.
pairs.english: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jago na Yuus ni y gumaeya y tinaelaye: y taelaye ti usaga guiya jago.
pairs.english: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti manasaga y mangaduco gui menan matamo: ya ti yamo todo y fumatitinas y taelaye.
pairs.english: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumulang y manguecuentos mandague: ya y taotao cajâgâ yan y dinague, si Jeova jaguefchatlie.
pairs.english: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajoja, yan y megagae y minaasemo, bae jalom gui guimamo: ya juadora anae juatan y santo templomo ni y ninamaañaomo.
pairs.english: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, esgaejonyo gui tininasmo, pot causa ya enimigujo; natunas gui menajo y chalanmo.
pairs.english: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya finitme gui pachotñija; ya sanjalomñija senmanaelaye: naftan mababa y agagañija; yan y jilañija finande:
pairs.english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Condena sija, O Yuus, polo y ufamodong pot y pinagatñija: gui minegae y isaoñija nasuja sija sa managuaguat contra jago.
pairs.english: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmagof todos y umangngocojao, polo para taejinecog ya ufanagang pot y minagofñija sa undefiende sija, polo ya ufanmagof ni jago, y gumaeya y naanmo.
pairs.english: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago bumendise y manunas; O Jeova, parejoja yan un patang unpolo gui oriyaña y finaborese.
pairs.english: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA chamoyo lumalalatde ni y binibumo: chamoyo cumastitiga nu y dangculo na linalalomo.
pairs.english: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova, sa estagüe yo namasogsog: amte yo, O Jeova, sa y tolangjo esta mananatchatsaga.
pairs.english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y antijo esta senchatsaga: Ya jago, O Jeova, asta ngaean?
pairs.english: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nanalo, O Jeova, nalibre y antijo: satbayo pot causa y minaasemo.
pairs.english: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finatae nae taya jinaso guiya jago: ya y naftan nae jaye numannae jao grasias?
pairs.english: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yayasyo nu y todo y siningonjo: todo y puenge junamamaya y camajo ni lagojo: junafotgon y catreco nu y lagojo.
pairs.english: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo esta magasta nu y pinite: ninafanbijo pot todo ayo y munachachatsaga yo.
pairs.english: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjanao guiya guajo todo ayo y fumatitinas y taelaye: sa si Jeova jajungog y vos y casaojo.
pairs.english: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jajungog y guinagaojo: si Jeova uresibe y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmamajlao ya ninafañatsaga megae, todo y enimigujo: sija manalo, sija manmamajlao gusise.
pairs.english: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, yya jago nae gaegue y inangococo: Satbayo todo gui pumetsisigue yo, ya nalibre yo.
pairs.english: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para chaña pumedasitos y antijo taegüije y leon, ni jayulang, anae taya jaye uninalibre.
pairs.english: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, yaguin jufatinas este: yaguin guaja gui canaejo taelaye;
pairs.english: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan juapase taelaye y sumaga guiya guajo yan pas, (magajet na junalibre y pumetsisigue yo pot taya causa:)
pairs.english: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japetsisigue y enimigujo y antijo, ya jachule; magajet, na jagacha gui tano y jaanijo: ya y onraco japolo gui eda. Sila.
pairs.english: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, yan y linalalomo; jatsa namaesa contra y binibon y munachachatsagayo: ya magmata pot guajo untago y sentensia.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inetnon taotao unineriyaye jao: ya gui san jiloñija natalo jao guato gui san jilo.
pairs.english: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jajusga y taotao: jusgayo, O Jeova, taemanoja y tininasso: taemanoja y minaulegmo ni y gaegue guiya guajo.
pairs.english: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ujocog y taelayen manaelaye, lao nafitme y manunas: sa si Yuus, ni tinas, jachachague y corason yan y jinaso gui sanjalom.
pairs.english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y patangjo gaegue gui as Yuus, güiya munalibre y manunas gui corason.
pairs.english: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus y tinas na jues: magajet na si Yuus lalalalo todo na jaane.
pairs.english: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y taotao ti jabira güe, güiya janamalagtos y espadaña: janaregla y atcosña ya janalisto.
pairs.english: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas para güiya y atmas y finatae: janafañila y flechaña.
pairs.english: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na uguaja piniten mañago tinaelaye: magajet na mapotgue y inacacha ya mañago dinague.
pairs.english: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaguadog y tipo, ya janatadong: ya esta podong gui joyo na y finatinasñaja.
pairs.english: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inacachaña ubira güi jilo y iluña: ya y binibuña upodong gui jilo cácagongña.
pairs.english: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junae si Jeova gracias taemanoja y tininasña: ya jucantaye ni y tinina y naan Jeova Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Señotmame, jafa muna mauleg y naanmo gui todo y tano: ni y unpolo y minalagmo gui jilo y langet.
pairs.english: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin pachot y mandiquique yan y mañususo nae unpolo y minetgot? Pot y enimigumo sija: sa para unnasuja y enimigo yan y umeemog.
pairs.english: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae julie y langetmo, ni y checho y calolotmo, y pilan yan y pution, ni jago pumolo;
pairs.english: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y taotao, para uguaja guiya güiya jinaso? yan lajin taotao para ubinesita güe.
pairs.english: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unfatinas didide diquiqueña qui y angjeles, ya uncorona güe ni y minalag yan inenra.
pairs.english: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmagas todo ni checho y canaemo: todo unpolo gui papa y adengña.
pairs.english: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y quinilo yan y nobiyo todo ayo: taegüenaoja y gâgâ ni gaegue gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pajaro gui langet, yan y güijan gui tase: ya jafaja ni manmalolofan gui chalan y tase.
pairs.english: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Señotmame: jafa muna mauleg y naanmo gui todo y tano.
pairs.english: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE junae grasias si Jeova contodo y corasonjo: bae jufanue todo ni ninamanman na chechomo.
pairs.english: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jumagof, ya unnasenmagofyo guiya jago: jucantaye ni y tinina y naanmo O jago Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y enimiguja unnabira sija tate: manbasnag, ya manmalingo gui menamo.
pairs.english: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago fumatinas y jinasoco yan y causaco: unfatachong gui trono, ya unjusga y tinas.
pairs.english: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unlalatde y nasion sija, guinin unyulang y manaelaye, guinin unfunas y naanñija para siempre taejinecog.
pairs.english: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta malachae y enimigo; esta mayulang para siempre: yan y siuda ni y inyilang, y jinasoñija manachamalingo yan sija.
pairs.english: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova sumaga calang ray para siempre, ya janalisto y tronuña para usentensia.
pairs.english: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jumusga y tano ni tininas, ujajusga y taotao sija yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova locue y taquilo na tore para y manmachiguit, y taquilo na tore gui tiempon chinatsaga.
pairs.english: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaangoco sija guiya jago y tumungo y naanmo; sa jago, Jeova, ti unyute ayo y umaliligao jao.
pairs.english: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova ni y tinina ni sumasaga gui Sion: namatungo gui entalo taotao sija y checoña.
pairs.english: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa anae jacocobla y jâgâ jajaso sija: ya ti malefa ni inagang y mamoble.
pairs.english: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova; atan y pinitejo ni jususungonja y chumatlie yo, jago y munacajulo yo gui pettan finatae:
pairs.english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jufamanue todo ni y tininamo gui trangcan y jagan Sion: ya umagof yo gui satbasionmo.
pairs.english: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmafondo y nasion gui joyo ni y finatinasñija: ya y casiyas nae ni janaaatog, y patasñija esta mangodon.
pairs.english: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova janamatungo güe ni y sentensia ni jafatinas; ya jalaso y taelaye ni y checho y canaena: Jinaso. Sila.
pairs.english: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmanalo guato y manaelaye gui sasalaguan: yan todo y taotao ni manmalefa as Yuus.
pairs.english: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti para siempre umamalefanñaejon y nesesitao: ni y ninanggan y mamoble ufanmalingo para siempre.
pairs.english: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova: chamo munamametgot y taotao: ya ufanmajusga y nasion gui menamo.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo, O Jeova, y minaañao guiya sija: polo ya utungo y nasion na sija taotaoja.
pairs.english: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAFA na tumojgue jao na chago, O Jeova? jafa na umatogjao gui tiempon chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot sobetbia y taelaye na japetsisigue y pebble; ufanmachule gui finababa y manmajajaso.
pairs.english: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa enao mina jatunanmaesagüe y taelaye, ni y minalago y antiña: ya y manlagga jarechasa; junggan, jadespresia si Jeova.
pairs.english: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jasangan: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanña chatsaga todo y tiempo; y juisiomo goschago gui linieña: ya todo y enimiguña, güiya jaguaefe sija.
pairs.english: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña gui corasonña: Ti jucalamten: gui todo y generasion sija, ti jufalag y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y matdision bula y pachotña yan dinague yan chiniguit: y papa y jilaña inacacha yan tinaelaye.
pairs.english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaegue matatachong y lugat ti matungo gui sengsong: ya y umatog na lugat japupuno y taeisao: y atadogña manaatanja contra y pebble.
pairs.english: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jananangga gui lugat ti matungo, taegüije y leon gui liyangña: jananangga para ucone y pebble: jacone y pebble anae jayotte ni y lasoña.
pairs.english: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jacojajatgüe, janatunog, megae na manaeninasiña mamodong gui gaesisiña na iyoña.
pairs.english: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña gui corasonña: Si Yuus esta malefa: janaatog y mataña; taya nae jalie.
pairs.english: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova; O Yuus, jatsa y canaemo: chamo malelefa ni y mamoble.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa jadespresia y taelaye si Yuus; ya ilegña gui corasonño: Jago ti ugagao.
pairs.english: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago lumie: sa jago umatan y inacacha yan y minattrata, para uchule gui canaemo: yya jago nae mandaña y mamoble: y manaesaena, jago umayuyuda.
pairs.english: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yulang y canae y manaelaye: ya ayo y taelaye, aliligao jao y tinailayeña asta qui ti unsoda.
pairs.english: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova Ray na para taejinecog yan taejinecog: ya y nasion esta manmalachae gui tanoña.
pairs.english: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minalago y manumitde jago jumungog, O Jeova: jago dumespopone y corasonñija, ungueguesecungog ni y talangamo:
pairs.english: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unjusga y manaesaena yan y mamoble: para chamo tumatalo munamaañao y taotao gui tano.
pairs.english: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AS Jeova nae juangocoyo: jafa na ilegmo ni antijo: Gupo gui egsomo calang pajaro?
pairs.english: In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, y manaelaye na jaaregla y atcos: jafamauleg y flecha gui taliña para uflecha gui jinemjom y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y plinanta sija esta mayulang: jafa siña y manunas ujafatinas.
pairs.english: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova gaegue gui santos na temploña; si Jeova, y tronuña gaegue gui langet; y atadogña manlilie yan y babaliña jachachague y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jachachague y manunas: lao y manaelaye, ya y gumaeya mandague, y antiña chumatlie.
pairs.english: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uuchan y casiyas gui jilo y manaelaye: guafe yan asufre ya y manglo na mañila y patteña gui basuña.
pairs.english: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinas Jeova; yaña y tinas: ya jaatan y manunas y mataña.
pairs.english: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYUDA, O Jeova, sa jocog mandeboto: sa jocog y manmauleg gui entalo y famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masasangang taebale cada uno gui tiguangña: yan labios na jaande, yan doble na corason jasasangan.
pairs.english: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uutut todo y labios na jaande, yan y jila ni cumuecuentos mandangculo:
pairs.english: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na ujaalog: Pot y jilata na utagana; y labiosta iyota: jaye siña señot gui jilota?
pairs.english: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y chiniguit y mamoble y an y inigong y mannesesitao: pago bae cajulo, ilegña si Jeova: guajo jupolo güi na seguro, ni y jaguaefeye.
pairs.english: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finijo Jeova, gasgas na finijo: calang salape na managasgas gui jotno gui jilo y tano: managasgas siete biaje.
pairs.english: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Jeova, ni umadadaje sija, jago umantiene para taejinecog, guine este na generasion.
pairs.english: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jijot gui oriya manjajanao y manaelaye: anae esta nacajulo y tinaelaye gui entalo y famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ASTA ngaean, O Jeova, nae, umalefa jao guajo para taejinecog? asta ngaean nae unnaatog y matamo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean nae jujaso y pinagat gui antijo, anae guaja pinite gui corasonjo todo y jaane? Asta ngaean nae ufangajulo y enimigujo guiya guajo?
pairs.english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso ya jungogyo, O Jeova, Yuusso: ina y atadogjo sija para mungayo maego gui maego finatae.
pairs.english: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa chaña umaalog y enimigujo: Jugana güe: sa chaña y enimigujo fanmamagof yaguin calamtenyo.
pairs.english: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, y minaasemo nae juangocoyo: ya umagof y corasonjo gui satbasionmo.
pairs.english: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae cantaye si Jeova: sa jafatinas y mauleg guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YLEGÑA y taetiningo gui corasonña: Taya Yuus: sija manpotlilo, jafatinas y chatliion na chocho: taya ni uno ni y fumatitinas y mauleg.
pairs.english: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaaatan desde y langet y jilo y famaguon taotao, para ulie cao guaja uno malate, yan jaaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todos manlache; manjuyong potlilo todo; taya jaye fumatitinas y mauleg, taya ni uno.
pairs.english: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti jatungo todo y fumatitinas y taelaye? ni y jacacano y taotaojo, taegüije y chumochocho pan? ya si Jeova ti jaaagang.
pairs.english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manlaolao ni minaañao: sa si Yuus gaegue gui rasan y manunas.
pairs.english: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pinagat y pebble innamamajlao, sa si Jeova guinegüeña.
pairs.english: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malago, y satbasion Israel mato guinin Sion! Anae jatalo si Jeova quinautiba y taotaoña, ayo nae magof si Jacob yan magof Israel.
pairs.english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jaye usaga gue tabernaculumo? jaye usaga gui santos na ogsomo.
pairs.english: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumanao gui minauleg, ya y fumatitinas y tininas, yan y cumuecuentos magajet gui jalom corasonña.
pairs.english: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti fafajiyunge ni jilaña, ni ti jafatitinas taelaye gui amiguña, ni usigue sumangan y minamajlao contra y tiguangña.
pairs.english: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui atadogña ninadespresiao ni y taotao áplacha, lao y maañao as Jeova jaonra: y manjula para dañoña namaesa ya ti jatolaeca.
pairs.english: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y salapeña ti mannanae para ufangana, ni uchule y apas contra y taeisao: ya y fumatinas estesija ti siña cumalamten.
pairs.english: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ADAJE yo, O Yuus: sa iya jago nae gaegue y inangococo.
pairs.english: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegmo, O antijo, as Jeova: jago Señotto: taya minaulegco yaguin taegüe guiya jago.
pairs.english: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañantos ni mangaegue gui tano, sija manmagas ya todo y minalagojo gaegue guiya sija.
pairs.english: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mumegae y piniteñija ni tumolaeca si Jeova pot otro Yuus: ti juofrese ni y inefreseñija na jâgâ, ni juchule y naanñija gui labiosso.
pairs.english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y patten ni y ineredajo, yan y basujo: jago mumantietiene y fottunajo.
pairs.english: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, y fottunajo upodong gui lugat na magof: magajet na bonito na ineredajo.
pairs.english: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jubendise si Jeova, ni y japagat yo: ya an puenge nae jafananagüe yo y jinasoco gui san jalomjo.
pairs.english: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jupolo gui menajo para siempre: sa yaguin gaegue güe gui agapajo, ti siña yo manacalamten.
pairs.english: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina magof y corasonjo ya magof y inenrajo: locue y catneco sumaga seguro.
pairs.english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti undingo y antijo gui naftan: ni unnae y santosmo para ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnatungoyo ni y chalan y linâlâ: binilan minagof y gaegue gui menamo: ya y agapa na canaemo guaja minagof para siempre.
pairs.english: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG, O Jeova, y taotao tunas: atituye y casaojo; guefecungog y tinaetaejo, na ti jumajanao gui labios dinagüe.
pairs.english: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
