pairs.chamorro: Polo y menamo nae ya ujuyong y sentensiajo: lie ni y atadogmo y tininas.
pairs.english: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago guinin chumague y corasonjo; guinin unbisitayo gui puenge; guinin unchagueyo ya taya sinedamo: y jinasoco na ti manisagüe y pachotto.
pairs.english: Thou has proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou has tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para y finatinas y taotao, pot y finijo ni guinin y labiosmo, jumantiene yo gui san juyong y chalan ni y manyuyulang.
pairs.english: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinecatto guiniut gui chalanmo, ya y adengjo ti susulong.
pairs.english: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja juagang jao, sa jago unope yo, O Yuus: naegueng guiya guajo y talangamo, ya jungog y sinanganjo.
pairs.english: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanue ni y minaasemo ni namanman, jago na unnalibre y umangoco sija guiya jago, guinin y ayosija ni mangajulo contra y agapa na canaemo.
pairs.english: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje yo, taegüije y atilong y niñon mata, naatog yo gui papa y anineng papamo,
pairs.english: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y menan y manaelaye ni y jumojoño yo: y gostaelaye y enimigujo ni majijujute yo.
pairs.english: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmaafuyot ni y linedoñija: ya y pachotñija cumuecuentos sobetbio.
pairs.english: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinecatmame nae maoriyayejam pago: japolo y atadogñija para ujayutejam gui tano.
pairs.english: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y león ni y gosmalago ni y naña: ya y león diquique ni y gaegue gui saga na umaalog.
pairs.english: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, polo jao gui menaña, yute papa: libre y antijo gui manaelaye nu y espadamo.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui taotao sija nu y canaemo, O Jeova, gui taotao ni y iyon tano, ayo na güinajaña gaegue gui estisija na jaane: ayo y tiyanña unabula nu y tesorumo: sija manjaspog y famaguon, ya polo y sebla y güinaja gui mandiquique na patgonñija.
pairs.english: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo, yan y tininas julie y matamo: najong yo anae magmata yo gui pinarejumo.
pairs.english: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUGUAEYAJAO, O Jeova, y minetgotto.
pairs.english: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y achojo, y castiyujo, yan y nanalibrijo: Yuusso, metgot y achojo, juangoco yo guiya güiya; patangjo yan y cánggilon y satbasionjo, y leca na torijo.
pairs.english: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juagang si Jeova, ni combiene na mannae todo ni y alabansa: taegüije bae julibre gui enimigujo.
pairs.english: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato guiya guajo y piniten finatae, ya y minilalag y tinaelaye janamaañaoyo.
pairs.english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y piniten naftan gaegue gui oriyajo, y lason finatae mato guiya guajo.
pairs.english: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chinatsagaco nae juagang si Jeova, ya juagang y Yuusso: güiya jajungog gui temploña y vosso, ya y inagangjo gui menaña, jumalom y talangaña.
pairs.english: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y tano calamten ya mayengyong, ya y simiento sija y egso manmanyengyong yan mangalamten, sa güiya lalalo.
pairs.english: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo aso gui güiingña, ya guinin pachotña guafe manonggue y pinigan mañila pot este.
pairs.english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y janamangag y langet ya tumunog: ya teog na jinemjom gaegue gui sampapa y adengña.
pairs.english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maudae güe gui jilo un querubin, ya gumupo güe; magajet na gumupo güe gui jilo y papan y manglo.
pairs.english: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo jinemjom para fanatuganña; para y tabernaculuña gui oriyaña; jinemjom y janom, teog na mapagajes guinin y langet.
pairs.english: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y minalag gui menaña y teog na mapagajesña malofan: graniso yan pinigan guafe.
pairs.english: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jajulo locue si Jeova gui langet, ya y Gueftaquilo jasangan ni y inagangña: graniso yan pinigan guafe.
pairs.english: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y flechaña ya manchinalapon: ya magajet, megae na lamlam ya manyinilang.
pairs.english: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae esta malie y tinadong y janom, ya janamababa y simiento y tano sija pot y linalatdemo, O Jeova, pot y güinaefen y jinagong gui güiingmo.
pairs.english: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago desde sanjilo, jachuleyo; ya jaatoyo guinin y megae na janom.
pairs.english: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalibrego gui manmetgot na enimigujo, yan y chumatliéyo, sa sija mas manmetgot qui guajo.
pairs.english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmato guiya guajo gui un jaanen y chinatsagaco: lao si Jeova, güiya y fanapojo.
pairs.english: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachuleyo locue gui anae ancho na lugat: janalibreyo sa ninamagof ni guajo.
pairs.english: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaapaseyo taemanoja y y tininasso: taemanoja y guinasgas y canaejo unaeyo.
pairs.english: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa juadaje y chalan Jeova: ya ti taelaye yo na juapattayo gui as Yuusso.
pairs.english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y jinasoña mangaegue gui menajo: ya ti junajanao guiya guajo y tinagoña.
pairs.english: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo cabales guiya güiya: ya juadaje yo guinin y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jaapaseyo si Jeova taemanoja y tininasso: taemanoja y guinasgas y canaejo gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaemaase unfanue na gaemaasejao: ya y taotao ni y cabales, unfanue na cabales jao.
pairs.english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gasgas unfanue na gasgasjao: ya y camten unfanue na camtenjao.
pairs.english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago munalibre y mangaepinite na taotao; ya y sobetbio na atadog jago munatunog.
pairs.english: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago munamalag y candetto: si Jeova, Yuusso, namanana y jemjom guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot jago na jufalagüe y inetnon sendalo: ya pot y Yuusso jugope y quelat.
pairs.english: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus, cabales y chalanña: y fino Jeova esta machague: patang güe para todo y numanangga güe.
pairs.english: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye si Yuus yaguin ti si Jeova güe? ya jaye y acho, jaguin ti si Yuusta?
pairs.english: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus jagogode yo ni y minetgot: ya jafatitinas cabales y chalanjo?
pairs.english: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatitinas y adengjo taegüije y adeng y benado: ya janasagayo gui taquilo na sagajo sija.
pairs.english: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafanagüe y canaejo para y guera: ya enaomina y canaejo judobla y atcas bronse.
pairs.english: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unnaeyo locue ni y patang gui satbasionmo: ya y agapa na canaemo mumantietieneyo; ya y minansomo munamegaeyo.
pairs.english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnadangculo y pinecatto gui papajo; ya y adengjo ti usulong.
pairs.english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Judulalag y enimigujo sija, ya jugâchâ: ya ti jubirago talo asta que jocog.
pairs.english: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junafanmañetnot, ya ti siña mangajulo: mamodong sija gui papa adengjo.
pairs.english: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin ungode yo ni y minetgot para y guera: unnafanecon y enimigujo gui papajo.
pairs.english: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unfatinas ni y enimigujo na unaeyo ni y tataloñija, para juyulang y chumatliiyo.
pairs.english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: manaagange sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae juguleg sija taegüije y petbos gui menan y manglo; taegüije y fache gui chalan ni y manmachalapon.
pairs.english: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unnalibre yo gui y inaguaguat y taotao: guinin unadaje yo para jumagas gui nasion sija: y taotao sija ni ti jutungo ujasesetbeyo.
pairs.english: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog guiya guajo ujaosgueyo: ya y taotao juyong ujaosgueyo ni y dinague.
pairs.english: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taotao juyong manlinachae ya manmamamaela ya manlalaolao guinin manmapongle.
pairs.english: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lâlâ si Jeova; ya ubendito y achojo: ya umanataquilo na Yuus y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ni y numae yo y inemog, ya jasujeta y taotao gui papajo.
pairs.english: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalibre yo gui enimigujo: magajet na unnasanjiloyo gui ayo sija y mangajulo contra guajo: ya janalibre yo gui taotao ni y matatnga.
pairs.english: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este junae jao grasias gui entalo y nasion sija, O Jeova; ya jucanta y alabansa para y naanmo.
pairs.english: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo na linibre janae y rayña; ya jafanue minaase ni y pinalaeña; as David ya y semiyaña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet munaclaro y minalag Yuus; ya y fineda mamanue y checho canaeña.
pairs.english: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y un jaane yan y otro jaane masangang y finijo, ya y un puenge ya y otro puenge mamanue tiningo.
pairs.english: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya sinangan, ni finijo; ti siña umajungog y vosñija.
pairs.english: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gui todo y tano jumanao y rayaña, ya asta uttimon y tano y finoña: ya japolo tabernaculo para atdao guiya sija.
pairs.english: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya taegüije y nobio ni jumujuyong guinin y cuattoña, ya jamagof taegüije y matatnga na taotao, para ufalago gui finalago.
pairs.english: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinanaoña guinin un punta gui langet, ya y linilicoña asta y uttimoña: ya taya jaye uatog ni y minaepeña.
pairs.english: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay Jeova cabales, jafamauleg y ante; y testimonion Jeova seguro, janafanmalalate y manaeisao.
pairs.english: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finañagüe Jeova tunas, janafanmamagof y corason: y tinago Jeova claro, janafanmalag y atadogsija.
pairs.english: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaañao as Jeova gasgas, sumaga para taejinecog; y sentensian Jeova magajet, ya todo tunas.
pairs.english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na malago mas que y oro, magajet mas que y megae na oro ni y manfino: mames mas que y miet, que y titijo gui sagan miet.
pairs.english: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tentagomo locue mapagat yan sija: ya yaguin jaadaje sija y uguaja dangculo na apas.
pairs.english: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linachiña jaye utiningo? ya y linache na ti jutungo, nalibreyo.
pairs.english: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unmantiene locue y tentagomo guinin y sobetbio na isao: ya munga mangae ninasiñañija guiya guajo: ayo nae cabalesyo ya gasgas yo guinin y dangculo na quinebrantan y tinago.
pairs.english: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y sinangang y pachotto ya y jinason y corasonjo umauleg gui menamo, O Jeova, minetgotto yan y munalilibreyo.
pairs.english: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova uninepejao y jaanen chinatsaga: y naan y Yuus Jacob ninacajulojao.
pairs.english: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utago y para uinayudajao guinin y santuario, ya guinin y Sion unninametgotjao.
pairs.english: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujaso todo y ninaemo, ya uchajlao y inefresimo sinenggue.
pairs.english: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae jao taemanoja y minalago y corasonmo, ya cumple todo y pinagatmo.
pairs.english: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utafangana gui satbasionmo, ya y naan y Yuusmame injatsa julo y banderanmame: ucumple si Jeova todo y guinagaomo.
pairs.english: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jutungo na si Jeova jaadadaje y pinalaeña: güiya uinepe gue guinin santos y langetña yan y minetgot y satbasion gui agapaña.
pairs.english: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija gui caretasija, ya ayosija gui cabayosija nae jaangocosija: lao jita y naan Jeova, ni y Yuusta, utajajasoja.
pairs.english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija mandimo ya mamodong: lao jita tafangajulo ya tafanogue tunas.
pairs.english: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, nalibre: polo y Ray ya uopejam anae inagang.
pairs.english: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, gui minetgotmo ninamagof y ray; ya gui satbasionmo ninamagof megae!
pairs.english: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minalago y corasonña, jago numae: ya ti unpune ni y guinagao y labiosña.
pairs.english: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa untagam güe nu y bendision y minauleg: y coronan oro nu y fino, unpolo gui jilo y iluña.
pairs.english: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linâlâ na guinagaoña unnae: y anaco na jaane, para siempre taejinecog.
pairs.english: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo y minalagña gui satbasionmo: onra yan minagas unpolo gui jiloña.
pairs.english: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago bumendise para taejinecog: unnamagof güe yan minagof gui menamo.
pairs.english: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y ray jaangongoco si Jeova: ya pot y minaase y Gueftaquilo ti calamten.
pairs.english: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo usoda todo y enimigumo: y agapa na canaemo usoda todo y chumatlie jao.
pairs.english: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo sija taegüije y jetnon guafe gui tiempon binibumo: si Jeova yumulang sija anae lalalo, ya y guafe ufanlinachae.
pairs.english: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tinegchaña unyulang gui jilo y tano, ya y semiyaña gui entalo y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja majasuye y taelaye contra jago: jagasja majaso y dinague ni y ti siña mafatinas.
pairs.english: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago fumatinas na jabira y tataloñija ya unnalisto y jalon y atcosmo contra y matañija.
pairs.english: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taquilo jao, O Jeova, yan y minetgotmo: incantaye yan inalabaye y ninasiñamo.
pairs.english: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YUUSSO, Yuusso, sa jafa na undingo yo? sa jafa chago jao gui inayudajo yan y finijo gui inigongjo.
pairs.english: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, juagang gui jaane ya ti unope: ya gui puenge lao jusoda y descanso.
pairs.english: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y santos jao, O jago ni y sumasaga gui alabansan Israel.
pairs.english: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya jago nae manangoco y tatanmame: manangoco ya unnafanlibre sija.
pairs.english: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maaagang jao ya ninafanlibre: manmanangoco nu jago ya ti manmamajlao.
pairs.english: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo y gâgâ ilo ya ti taotao: namamajlao gui lalaje ya madespresia gui taotao.
pairs.english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y lumiiyo manatchatgue pot guajo mamuyuyueyo ya jayeyengyong y ilonñija.
pairs.english: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angoco jao as Jeova; polo ya ulibre gue: polo ya ulibre güe sa güinaeya güe.
pairs.english: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y chumule yo gui tiyan: ya unnafanangoco anae gaegue yo gui jaof nanajo.
pairs.english: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui jilomo mayute yo guinin y tiyan: desde y tiyan nanajo jago Yuusso.
pairs.english: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo chachago guiya guajo; sa y chinatsagaco esta jijot, sa taya jaye yo uayuda.
pairs.english: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na toro jaoriyayeyo: manmetgot na toron Básan jumijujuteyo.
pairs.english: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabababa y pachotñija guiya guajo taegüije y león ni tegcho yan cumate.
pairs.english: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janamachuda yo taegüije y janom, todo y telangjo manápula: y corasonjo taegüije y danges; esta madirite gui talo gui sanjalomjo.
pairs.english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anglo y minetgotto taegüije y pedason an mafag: ya y jilajo cheton gui paladatto: ya gui petbos finatae nae unpoloyo.
pairs.english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa maoriyayayeyo y galago sija: majijujuteyo y inetnon y manaelaye; ya manadochon gui canaejo yan y adengjo.
pairs.english: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mojon jusangan todo ni y telangjo: sija jaatanyo ya jaconsidedera.
pairs.english: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maipe gui entaloñija todo y bestidujo: ya y magagujo marifa.
pairs.english: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, chamo chachago: O jago, minetgotto, chadig yan unayudayo.
pairs.english: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre gui espada y antijo: y beyan corasonjo, guinin y ninasiñan y galago.
pairs.english: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui pachot y león; magajet, guinin y canggilon y nubiyo ni titogcha, unope yo.
pairs.english: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusaasgane y mañelujo y naanmo: ya gui entalo gui inetnon taotao bae jualalabajao.
pairs.english: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmaañao as Jeova, fanmanalaba nu güiya: todo y semiyan Jacob fanmanonra nu güiya: ya fanmaañao nu güiya todo y semiyan Israel.
pairs.english: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti guinin jadespresia ni jachatlie y pinadesen y pebble; ni unaatog y mataña guiya güiya: ya anae jaagang guiya güiya, jajungog.
pairs.english: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya jago nae mamaela y alabansajo gui dangculon inetnon: ya y promesajo juapase gui menan y manmaañao güe.
pairs.english: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufañocho y manmanso ya ufanjaspog: ufanmanalaba as Jeova y umaliligao güe: polo ya ufanmanlâlâ y corasonmiyo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujajaso ya ufanalo guato as Jeova todo y uttimon y tano: ya ufamnanadora gui menamo todo y familian y nasion sija.
pairs.english: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa as Jeova y raeno: ya güiya umagas gui todo nasion.
pairs.english: For the kingdom is the LORD's: and he is the governor among the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufañocho ya ufanmanadora todo y yinemog y tano: gui menanña ufandimo, todo y manunog gui eda: güiyaja ni y tisiña unalala y antiña.
pairs.english: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un semiya usinetbe güe: ya umasangan si Jeova asta y uttimo generasion.
pairs.english: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmato ya ufanmasangan y tininasña ni y taotao na umafañago, na güiya fumatinas este.
pairs.english: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova güiya y pastotjo: tayayo unafatta.
pairs.english: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manbetde na chaguan nae janaason yo: ya y quieto na janom nae jaosgaejon yo.
pairs.english: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jananalo y antijo: jaosgaejon yo gui chalan tininas pot y naanña.
pairs.english: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jufamocat gui chalan y anineng y finatae, ti maañao yo ni jafa na taelaye, sa jago gaegue guiya guajo: y baramo yan y bastonmo unnae yo minagof.
pairs.english: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unfamauleg y lamasa gui menajo yan y menan y enimigujo sija: naye laña y ilujo, ya y copajo esta machúchuda.
pairs.english: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sen magajet y minauleg yan y minaase madalalagyo todo nu sija gui jaanen linâlâjo: ya y guima Jeova jusaga para taejinecog na jaane.
pairs.english: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano iyon Jeova yan y binilaña: y tano yan y manasaga gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: The earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya fumatinas gui jilo y tase: ya gui jilo y janom nae japolo fitme.
pairs.english: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye ucajulo gui egso Jeova? ya jaye ugaegue gui sagan y sinantosña.
pairs.english: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y gasgas canaeña yan y gasgas corasonña: ni ti pumopolo gui taebale y antiña ni ufanjula ni y dinague.
pairs.english: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uresibe y bendision Jeova: yan y tininas guine as Yuus satbasionña.
pairs.english: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na generasion y umaliligao güe: y umaliligao y matamo, O Yuus Jacob. Sila.
pairs.english: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y ilonmiyo, O jamyo trangco sija ya umajatsa julo y taejinecog na potta sija, ya y Ray langet ujalom.
pairs.english: Lift up your head, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye este na Ray langet? Si Jeova, metgot yan matatnga: si Jeova matatnga gui guera.
pairs.english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y ilonmiyo, O jamyo trangca sija ya umajatsa julo y taejinecog na potta sija ya y Ray langet ujalom.
pairs.english: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye este na Bay langet? Si Jeova gui inetnon sendalo, güiya ayo y Ray langet. Sila.
pairs.english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae jujatsa y antijo.
pairs.english: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, iyajago nae juangocoyo: chamo yo munamamamajlao; chamo pumopolo y enimigujo na ugana gui jilojo.
pairs.english: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, na todo y mumananggajao ti ufanmamajlao: sija ufanmamajlao ni y chumogüe dinague sin jafa.
pairs.english: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo, O Jeova, fanueyo; fanagüe yo, ni y chalanmo.
pairs.english: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Osgaejonyo gui minagajetmo ya unfanagüeyo; sa jago y Yuus ni y satbasionjo: iyajago nae jufannangga todotdia.
pairs.english: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso, O Jeova, y mauleg na minaasemo; yan y mauleg na güinaeyamo, sa sija guinin apmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo jumajaso y isao y pinatgonjo, ni y quinebrantaco ni y tinago: segun y güinaeyamo jasoyo, pot y minauleg y naanmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mauleg yan tunas si Jeova: pot enao na jafanagüe y maniisao ni y chalan.
pairs.english: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanso ufanfinanagüe gui juisio: yan y manmanso ufanguinia gui chalan.
pairs.english: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chalan Jeova güinaeya yan minagajet ni y ayo y umadadaje y tratuña yan y testimoniuña.
pairs.english: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y naanmo, O Jeova, asie y isaojo sa gosdangculo.
pairs.english: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye ayo na taotao y maañao as Jeova? güiya ufinanagüe ni y chalan mano y inayegña.
pairs.english: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antiña usaga gui mauleg: ya y semiyaña uereda y tano.
pairs.english: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y secreton Jeova gaegue guiya sija y mumaañaogüe güe; ya güiya ufanagüe sija ni y tratuña.
pairs.english: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo siempre juatan si Jeova; sa güiya ujala y adengjo juyong gui laso.
pairs.english: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanyo, ya gaease ni guajo: sa guajo taeconsueloyo yan piniteyo.
pairs.english: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chinatsagan y corasonjo lumalamegae: najuyongyo gui pinitijo.
pairs.english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y trinesteco yan y pinitijo; ya unasie todo y isaojo.
pairs.english: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y enimigujo, sa sija manmegae, ya sija chumatliiyo ni y fejman na chinatlie.
pairs.english: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y antijo ya nalibreyo: ya chajo mamamajlao, sa iyajago nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minauleg yan y tininas juadádajeyo: sa jago junanangga.
pairs.english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre, O Yuus, y iya Israel gui todo y chinatsagaña.
pairs.english: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUSGAYO, O Jeova, sa guajo jumajanao yo gui tininasso: juangocoyo locue gui as Jeova: pot enao na ti jusulong.
pairs.english: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ecsamina yo, O Jeova, ya chagueyo: chague y jinasojo gui jinalomjo yan y corasonjo.
pairs.english: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y güinaeyamo gaegue gui menan atadogjo; ya gui minagajetmo nae jumajanaoyo.
pairs.english: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jagasja matachongyo yan y ti manmagajet na taotao; ni jujalom yan y lumilipa.
pairs.english: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie y inetnon y chumogüe taelaye: ya ti jufatachong yan y manaelaye.
pairs.english: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jufagase y canaejo ni y tinaeisao: taegüije juoriya gui attatmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para junajungog y inagang y grasias yan para jusangan todo y ninamanmanmo.
pairs.english: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, yajo y sagan y guimamo: yan y lugat nae sumasaga minalagmo.
pairs.english: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo na fandadaña yan y maniisao y antijo, ni y jaanijo yan y taotao cájaga.
pairs.english: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayosija na canaeñija mangaegue y nacacha: ya y agapa y canaeñija bula ni y catnada.
pairs.english: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo jumajanao yo yan y tininasso: nalibreyo, ya gaease ni guajo.
pairs.english: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y adengjo gaegue gui lugat ni yano: ya gui inetnon taotao nae jubendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova y candetto yan y satbasionjo? ya jaye jumaañagüeyo? si Jeova y minetgot y linâlâjo, ya jaye yo nae jumaañao?
pairs.english: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manmato guiya guajo y chumogüe taelaye para u jacano y catneco, y contrariojo yan y enimigujo, sija manmatompo ya manmatomba.
pairs.english: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja ujapolo un inetnon sendalo contra guajo ti maañao y corasonjo: achogja ucajulo y guera contra guajo, este nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unoja na güinaja jugagao gui as Jeova, este jualiligao; na jugaegue gui guima Jeova todo y jaanen linâlâjo, para julie y guinatbon Jeova ya para jualigao gui temploña.
pairs.english: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munaatogyo gui tabernacoluña gui jaanen pinite: ya janaatogyo gui fanatog y tabernacoluña: ya japoloyo julo gui jilo y acho.
pairs.english: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago janataquiloyo y ilujo gui jilo y enimigujo gui oriyajo: ya junae gui tabernacoluña inefresen minagof; bae jucantae, magajet, jucantaye alabansa sija si Jeova.
pairs.english: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Jeova, anae juagang ni inagangjo, gaease locue ni guajo ya unopeyo.
pairs.english: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ilegmo: Aligao jamyo y matajo; y corasonjo ilegña nu jago: O Jeova, y matamo jualiligao.
pairs.english: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo munaaatog y matamo guiya guajo; chamo munasusuja yan y binibumo y tentagomo: jago guinin ayudajo; chamoyo yumuyute ya chamoyo dumidingo, O Yuus gui satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si tatajo yan nanajo yumuteyo: si Jeova jumocayo.
pairs.english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüeyo, O Jeova, ni y chalanmo: ya osgaejonyo, gui chalan yano, pot rason y enimigujo.
pairs.english: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo pumopolo gui minalago y contrariojo: sa mangajujulo contra guajo mandacon na testigo, ya jaye usinangang y taease.
pairs.english: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin lalangoyo yaguin ti jujonggue na guaja nae julie y minauleg Jeova gui tano ni y manlâlâlâ.
pairs.english: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nangga si Jeova: nametgotjao ya polo ya unamatatnga y corasonmo: magajet, na nangga jao si Jeova.
pairs.english: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, juaagang; achojo, chamo fatilúluye yo: yaguin infatiluye yo, guajo uparejo yan y manútunog gui tadong y joyo.
pairs.english: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y inagang y guinagaojo anae juagang jao: anae jujatsa y canaejo gui sinantos templomo.
pairs.english: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo cumocone guato gui manaelaye yan y chumogüe y taelaye: ya jasasangan y pas gui tiguangña ya y inacacha gaegue gui corasonñija.
pairs.english: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae sija taemanoja y chechoñija: ya taemanoja y taelayen chechoña. Nae sija taemanoja y finatinas y canaeñija: apase ni y para ujamarese.
pairs.english: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa timanmalago jalie y checho Jeova, ni y finatinas y canaeña, ufanyinilang sija ya ti uninafangajulo.
pairs.english: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova, sa jajungong y inagang y guinagaojo.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y minetgotto yan y patangjo; y iyagüiya nae manangoco y corasonjo, ya guajo uayuda: Enao mina senmagof y corasonjo; ya y quinantaco nae jualabagüe.
pairs.english: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova y minetgotñija: ya güiya y minetgot y satbasion para y pinalaeña.
pairs.english: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre y taotaomo ya bendise y erensiamo: ya nafañocho sija ya unmantiene sija para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAE si Jeova, O famaguon manmetgot, nae si Jeova ni inenra yan y minetgot.
pairs.english: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova y inenra ni mauleg para y naanña: adora si Jeova ni guinatbon y sinantosña.
pairs.english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova gaegue gui jilo y janomsija: ya y Yuus langet janajujulo: junggan, si Jeova, gui jilo y megae na janom.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova y ninasiña: y inagang Jeova bula y minagas.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova yumuyulang y trongcon y sedrosija: magajet na jayulang si Jeova y trongcon sedrosija y Líbano.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanayog sija locue taegüije y tatnero: y Líbano yan y Sirion taegüije y patgon y dadao na nubiyo.
pairs.english: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova umuutut y mañila y guafe.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova munamayengyong y jalomtano: janameyeyengyong si Jeova y jalomtano guiya Cades.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inagang Jeova munafanmañañago y binado sija ya janafanquesnuda y jalomtano: ya y temploña nae todo y güinaja ilegña: Minalag.
pairs.english: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova anae guaja delubio matachong calang un ray; magajet na matatachong si Jeova calang ray na taejinecog.
pairs.english: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova unae minetgot y taotaoña: si Jeova jabendise y taotaoña ni y pas.
pairs.english: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNATAQUILO jao, O Jeova; sa jago unnajatsa yo julo: ya ti unnafanmagof y enimigujo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuusso, juagangjao ya unnajomloyo.
pairs.english: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, jago munacajulo y antijo gui naftan: unadajeyo na lâlâyo para mungayo tumunog gui naftan.
pairs.english: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova, O jamyo mañantosña: ya innae grasias y santos na naaña.
pairs.english: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot didideja guaja linalaloña; gui finaboreseña nae guaja linâlâ: yaguin y pupuenge majon sumaga y tinanges; y egaan mato y minagof.
pairs.english: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo jagas ileco anae lumálaguaja yo: ti jucalamten talo taejinecog.
pairs.english: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
