pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, pot y finaboresemo jagasja unnafitme y egsojo: lao unnana y matamo, ya guajo chumatsaga.
pairs.english: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya jago, O Jeova, juaagangjao: ya si Jeova jutayuyut.
pairs.english: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafayo probechoco gui jâgâjo, anae tumunog yo gui naftan? Ada uinalabajao ni y petbos? Ada usangan y minagajetmo?
pairs.english: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Jeova, ya gaease ni guajo: Jeova, jago para inayudajo.
pairs.english: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumira y inigongjo gui baela: ya unpula y lutojo ya unnaquinereasyo ni y minagof;
pairs.english: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jucantaye jao inenra ya ti jufamatquilo: O Jeova, Yuusso, junaejao grasias para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae juangoco: chamoyo munamamamajlao para taejinecog: nalibreyo gui tininasmo.
pairs.english: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Egueng papa guiya guajo y talangamo, nalibreyo guse: jago y para guajo acho ni y fitme, pot y guima lumijing nae para unnalibreyo.
pairs.english: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y achojo yan y castiyujo; enao mina pot y naanmo esgaejonyo ya chachalalaneyo.
pairs.english: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chuleyo gui lagua ni y munanaaatogyo gui ti umatungo: sa jago y seguro na sagajo.
pairs.english: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo nae, junae ni y espiritujo: unnalibreyo, O Jeova, jago Yuus minagajet.
pairs.english: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie ayo sija y numanangga y taebale na dinague: lao guajo si Jeova juangongoco.
pairs.english: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumagof ya jusenmagof gui minaasemo: sa jagas unlie y pinitijo: ya jagas untungo y antijo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago ti jumujuchomyo gui canae y enimigujo: jagas unpolo y adengjo gui dangculo na sagayan.
pairs.english: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease ni guajo, O Jeova, sa estagüe yo gui chinatsaga: sa y atadogjo linachae ni y pinite, junggan, y antijo yan y tataotaojo.
pairs.english: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanijo linachae ni y trinestico, ya y sacanjo ni y suspiros: linalachae y minetgotto pot y tinaelayeco: ya y telangjo mananglo.
pairs.english: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot todo y enimigujo, jumuyongyo mamajlao, magajet na sentaegüijeja a para y tiguangjo yan y minaañao ni y manatungoyo: ya y lumiliiyo gui sanjiyong mañuja guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta malefayo taegüije y matae ni ti manjaso: taegüijeyo y an mafag baso.
pairs.english: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jujungog y dinisonran y lajyayan: minaañao sija gui todo oriya: anae manafaesen entresija contra guajo, ya majasusuye para umacone y antijo.
pairs.english: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, iya jago nae juangocoyo, O Jeova: ileco: Jago y Yuusso.
pairs.english: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y canaemo nae gaegue y tiempoco: nalibre yo gui canae y enimigujo yan y pumetsisigueyo.
pairs.english: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanina y matamo gui jilo y tentagomo: nalibreyo ni y güinaeyamo.
pairs.english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, chamo yo munamámamajlao; sa jagasja juaagangjao: polo y manaelaye ya ufanmamajlao: polo sija ya ufanmamatquilo gui naftan.
pairs.english: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmamatquilo y labios ni y manmandadague; sa manguecuentos saguat contra y manunas, yan sobetbia yan despresio.
pairs.english: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna dangculo y minaulegmo ni unadadaje para y mumaañaogüe jao, na unfatinas para y umangocojao gui menan y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago nae ufanatog sija na ti umatungo gui menamo guinin y taelaye na contraton taotao; jago unadaje sija gui guima lumijing guinin y inaguaguat y jila sija.
pairs.english: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova: sa jafanueyo ninamanman gui minaaseña gui siudan manmetgot.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ileco y nalulajo: Juutut yo gui menan atadogmo; lao magajet na jago jumungog y vos y guinagaojo anae juagangjao.
pairs.english: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaeya si Jeova todo jamyo mañantos; ya y manmauleg adaje si Jeova, ya apase megagae y fumatitinas ni y sobetbia.
pairs.english: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmetgot jamyo, ya inafanmatatnga y corasonmiyo, todo y numanangga si Jeova.
pairs.english: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO y maasie ni y taelayen finatinasña, ya y isaoña matampe.
pairs.english: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y ti jacatgaye si Jeova ni tinaelaye, ni uguaja gui espirituña dinague.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae mamatquiloyo, y telangjo ninafanbijo, ni y inigongjo todotdia.
pairs.english: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaane yan y puenge y canaemo macat guiya guajo; ya y finetgonjo mabira para y inanglo gui tiempon maepe. Sila.
pairs.english: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y isaojo junatungo jao ya y tinaelayeco ti junaatog; ya ileco: Guajo bae juconfesatñaejon y tinaelayen finatinasso as Jeova; ya jago unasie y taelayen y isaojo. Sila.
pairs.english: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este nae umatayuyut jao y mandeboto todos gui tiempo anae mojon siña ujasoda: senmagajet anae machuchuda inetnon y janom, ti ufato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y fanatugco; ya gui chinatsaga jago unadajeyo: ya nu y cantan linibre, jago unoriyayeyo.
pairs.english: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junatungo jao ya jufanagüe jao ni y chalan anae jumajanao: jupagat jao nu y atadogco.
pairs.english: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumarérejo yan y cabayo, pat y mula ni taya tiningoñija: na nesesita y modasa yan y freno para umantiene; yaguin taya estesija ti malago guaguato guiya jago.
pairs.english: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na triniste para y manaelaye: lao y numaangongoco si Jeova, minaase umoriyayayegüe.
pairs.english: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof as Jeova, ya infansenmagof, O jamyo manunas; ya fanagang ni y minagof, todo y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMAGOF gui as Jeova jamyo manunas: sa y manunas bonito na alabansa.
pairs.english: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmannae grasias indandane si Jeova ni atpa: cantaye güe ni alabansa nu y guitala ni y gaecuetdas dies.
pairs.english: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye güe ni y nuebo na canta: dandan mauleg ni y agang.
pairs.english: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y fino Jeova tunas: ya todo y chechoña esta mafatinas ni y minagajet.
pairs.english: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya yaña y tininas yan y juisio; ya cariño na güinaeya gui as Jeova, bula y tano.
pairs.english: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y fino Jeova esta mafatinas y langetsija: ya pot y jajaja ni y pachotña, todo y inetnonñija.
pairs.english: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munadaña gui un monton y janom gui tase: güiya pumolo gui atmasén y tinadongsija.
pairs.english: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmaañao as Jeova todo y tano: manmaañao nu güiya todo mañasaga gui tano.
pairs.english: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya umalog ya jumuyong: güiya manago ya sumaga fitme.
pairs.english: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova munataesetbe y pinagat y nasion; ya güiya munataebale y jinaso y taotao.
pairs.english: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pinagat Jeova sumaga para taejinecog: y jinason y corasonña para todo y generasion.
pairs.english: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y nasion ni si Jeova Yuusña: yan y taotao ni y jaayeg pot erensia para güiya.
pairs.english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD: and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y langet jaatan si Jeova: jalilie todos y famaguon Adam.
pairs.english: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y sagaña na lugat jaatan; jaatitutuye todo y mañasaga gui jilo y tano.
pairs.english: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya fumatinas y corasonñija todos: yan jaatitutuye todo y chechoñija.
pairs.english: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray ti umalibre pot y dangculon inetnon sendaloña: y matatnga na taotao ti umasatba pot y dangculon minetgotña.
pairs.english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cabayo taebale para useguro: sa güiya ti unalibre ni uno nu y dangculon jinilatña.
pairs.english: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, y atadog Jeova gui jilo y manmaañagüe güe: gui jiloñija y numanangga y minaaseña.
pairs.english: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unalibre gui finatae y antiñija: ya para unae linâlâ gui ñinalang.
pairs.english: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antita jagas jananangga si Jeova: y ayudata yan y patangta güiya.
pairs.english: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot güiya manmagof y corasonta, sa y sinantos naanña nae jagas taangocojit.
pairs.english: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y minaasemo, O Jeova, ugaegue guiya jame, según ninangganmamame guiya jago.
pairs.english: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUBENDISE si Jeova gui todo y tiempo: y alabansaña siésiempreja sumaga gui pachotto.
pairs.english: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova umalaba y antijo: man manjungog y manmanso ya ninafanmagof.
pairs.english: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junadangculo si Jeova guiya guajo: ya nita tanataquilo y naanña gui un vos.
pairs.english: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualigao si Jeova ya güiya jajungogyo: ya todo y minaañaojo janalibreyo.
pairs.english: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija inatangüe ya infaninina: ya y matañija ti ufanmamajlao.
pairs.english: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y namase na taotao umagang, ya si Jeova jumungog, ya ninalibre todo gui chinatsagaña.
pairs.english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y angjet Jeova jaoriyaye sija y manmaañao nu güiya ya janalibre sija.
pairs.english: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chague ya unlie na mauleg si Jeova: dichoso y taotao ni umangocogüe guiya güiya.
pairs.english: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmaañao as Jeova, jamyo mañantosña: sa taya ufatta para y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mandiquique na león mannamase ya manñalang; ya y umaliligao si Jeova ti ufatta ni jafa na minauleg.
pairs.english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela jamyo famaguon, ecungog yo: ya jufanagüe jamyo ni y minaañao as Jeova.
pairs.english: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye enao na taotao y tumátana y linâlâ, ya yaña megae na jaane para ulie y minauleg?
pairs.english: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y jilamo gui taelaye, yan y labiosmo na ucuentos mandague.
pairs.english: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Suja gui taelaye ya fatinas y mauleg; aligao y pas ya dalalag.
pairs.english: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadog Jeova gaegue gui jilo y manunas: ya y talangaña esta mababa pot y inagangñija.
pairs.english: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y matan Jeova contra y fumatitinas y taelaye para uutut gui tano y jinasoñija.
pairs.english: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Managang y manunas ya si Jeova jumungog: ya todo y chinatsagañija ninafanlibre.
pairs.english: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jijot esta si Jeova gui manmaque branta na corason: yan y manmañetnot na espiritu janalibre.
pairs.english: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae y pinitiñiñija y manunas: lao todo ayo si Jeova munafanlibre.
pairs.english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaadaje todo y telangñija: ya ni uno guiya sija umayamag.
pairs.english: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: taotao sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalilibre si Jeova y linâlâ y tentagoña: ya taya ni uno ni umangoco güe usinentensia.
pairs.english: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AGUAGUATE, O Jeova, ayo y umaguaguaguateyo; mumo yan ayo y amumumujo.
pairs.english: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mantiene y patang yan guinegüe, ya tojgue para unayudayo.
pairs.english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chule y lansa ya patang y chalan contra ayo y pumetsisigueyo: alog ni antijo: Guajo y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao, ya ufanquinenfunde y umaliligao y antijo: polo ya ufanalo tate ya ufanmamajlao y jumajaso y taelayejo.
pairs.english: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya calang y paja gui menan y manglo: ya y angjet Jeova ufanchineneg sija.
pairs.english: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y chalanñija ya jomjom yan palagse: ya y angjet Jeova ufanpinetsigue sija.
pairs.english: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sin causa manatog para guajo y lagua gui joyo: ya sin causa manmanguadog joyo para y antijo.
pairs.english: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufato guiya güiya ya yinilang ni ti jatungo: polo ya y lagua ni janaaatog, ucone maesagüe: yan y jalom yinilang nae upodong güe.
pairs.english: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umagof y antijo gui as Jeova: ya umagof gui satbasionña.
pairs.english: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y telangjo y ilegñija: Jeova, jaye parejumo? ni unalibre y mamoble gui mas manmetgot qui güiya: magajet na y mamoble yan y mannesesitao, guinin y jachulelejguan?
pairs.english: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo testigon mandague: ya jafaesenyo ni y ti jutungo.
pairs.english: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaeyo ni taelaye pot y mauleg, ya manataelaye y antijo.
pairs.english: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo anae manmalango sija, magagojo y luto: junatriste y antijo yan umayunat: y tinaetaejo tumalo jalom gui pechoco.
pairs.english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamomocat yo ya ileleco: Güiya buente y gachongjo, pat y chelujo: ya tumecon yo triste calang uno ni y umuugung pot si nanaña.
pairs.english: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae desgrasiaoyo, sija manmagof ya mandaña: ya y gosnamaase mandaña contra guajo ya guajo ti jutungo: sija matitegyo ya ti manbasta.
pairs.english: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y áplacha na minefea gui fandango, janachéchegcheg y nifenñija guiya guajo.
pairs.english: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, asta ngaean nae unatan? nalibre y antijo gui yinilangña, yan y beya y corasonjo gui león.
pairs.english: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junae jao grasias gui dangculon y inetnon taotao: ya jualaba jao gui entalo linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo na ufanmamagof guiya guajo y enimigujo sin jafa? ni ayo y chumatlieyo sin causa jaachetgue yo nu y atadog.
pairs.english: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti manguecuentos pas: ya contra y manmanso gui tano jajajaso y finijo dinague.
pairs.english: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jabababa y pachotñija contra guajo; ilegñija: Ja, ja y atadogmameja lumie.
pairs.english: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unlie este, O Jeova; chamo famatquiquilo: O Jeova, chamo chachago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso ya fagmata para y juisioco; junggan, para y causaco Yuusso yan y Señotto.
pairs.english: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusgayo taemanoja y tininasmo, O Jeova, Yuusso, ya chamo pumopolo na ufanmamagof guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo na ujaalog gui corasonñija: Ja, taegüije manmalagojit; chamo pumopolo na ujaalog: Jita jagas tacalamot güe.
pairs.english: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao ya ufañatsaga ayo sija y manmagof pot y manadañujo: polo ya ufanminagago ni y minamajlao yan y disonra y munadangculo sija contra guajo.
pairs.english: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanagang ni minagof ya ufanmagof y gumaeya y tinas na causaco: junggan, polo ya ujaalog siempre: innadangculo si Jeova, ni y yaña na memegae y tentagoña.
pairs.english: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jilajo usangan ni y tininasmo, yan todotdia ni y alabansamo.
pairs.english: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YINEMBESTE y taelaye, ilegña gui corasonjo, taya minaañao as Yuus gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot enao jafaande maesa güe gui atadogña, ya ti usoda y taelayeña ya umachatlie gue.
pairs.english: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finijo gui pachotña manaelaye yan finababa: basta güe ni utungo yan ufatinas y mauleg.
pairs.english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinaelaye jajajaso gui jilo camaña: japolo maesa güe gui un chalan ni y ti mauleg: ti jachatlie y inacacha.
pairs.english: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, asta y langet y güinaeyamo; y minagajetmo inataca asta y mapagajes.
pairs.english: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininasmo taegüije y egso Yuus; y juisiomo sija dangculoña tinadong: y taotao yan y gâgâ, jago umadadaje, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosdangculo y balotña y güinaeyamo, O Yuus! ya y famaguon taotao ufanmagogue gui papa y anineng y papamo.
pairs.english: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufansennajong ni y minegae y guimamo: ya jago unnafanguimen ni y sadog y minagofmo.
pairs.english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyajago nae gaegue y bebô y linâlâ: ya y ininamo nae infanmalie inina.
pairs.english: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sisigueja y güinaeyamo para y tumungo jao; ya y tininasmo para manunas na corason.
pairs.english: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo ya ufato contra guajo y patas y sobetbio: ni y canae y manaelaye unasuja yo.
pairs.english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mamodong y manmamatitinas ni y taelaye: sija manmachoneg ya ti siña ufangajulo.
pairs.english: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO umestotban mamaesa jao ni y chumogüe daño, ni unguaja embidia, ni y fumatitinas y taelaye.
pairs.english: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufanmautut guse taegüijeja y chaguan, ya ufanmalayo taegüije y chaguan betde.
pairs.english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angocojao as Jeova, ya fatinas y mauleg: saga gui tano ya unchogüe minauleg.
pairs.english: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magofjao as Jeova: ya güiya unninae ni guinagao y corasonmo.
pairs.english: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bira y chalanmo para as Jeova: ya angocogüe locue, ya güiya unajuyong este.
pairs.english: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janajanao y tininasmo taegüije y manana: ya y juisiomo taegüije y taloane.
pairs.english: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Quieto jao as Jeova, ya nanggagüe nu y siningon: chamo umestotban mamaesa jao ni y mumegae, gui chalanña ni y taotao ni fumatitinas y dinague.
pairs.english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Basta y binibo, ya polo y linalalo; chamo umestotban mamaesa jao para unfatinas y dano.
pairs.english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y chumogüe dano ufanmautut: lao y numanangga si Jeova, sija ujaereda y tano.
pairs.english: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde este didide ti utaegüe y taelaye: magajet na jaguefjajaso y sagaña ya utaegüe güe.
pairs.english: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manmanso ujaereda y tano: ya ufanmagof maesa sija ni megae na pas.
pairs.english: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye man jajaso dinague contra y manunas ya janachechegcheg y nifenñija guiya güiya.
pairs.english: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova chumachaleg pot güiya: sa jalilie na ufato gui jaaniña.
pairs.english: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye jalagnos y espada, yan janadilog y atcosñija para uyute papa y mamoble yan y mannesesitao: para ujapuno sija y manunas gui chalan.
pairs.english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y espadañija jumalom gui corasonñijaja ya y atcosñija umayamag.
pairs.english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maulegñaja y didide gui manunas, qui y minegae gui megae na manaelaye.
pairs.english: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y canae y manaelaye ufanmayamag: lao si Jeova jamantietene y manunas.
pairs.english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatungo si Jeova y jaanen y manunas: ya y erensiañija usaga para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija, ti ufanmamajlao gui taelaye na tiempo: ya y jaanen ñinalang ufanjaspog.
pairs.english: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manaelaye ufanmalingo: yan y enimigon Jeova ufanparejo y sebon cotdero sija: sija ufanlinachae, calang aso ufanguelinachae.
pairs.english: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye mañuñule inayao ya ti jaapapasetalo: ya y manunas guaja minaaseñija ya mannae.
pairs.english: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayosija y manbendise pot güiya ujaereda y tano: ya ayosija y manmatdise pot güiya ufanmautut.
pairs.english: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinanao y mauleg na taotao si Jeova mumantietene; ya güiya yaña y chalanña.
pairs.english: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin matomba, ti uguefpodong: sa si Jeova mumantietene nu y canaeña.
pairs.english: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guine patgon yo ya estayo bijo; lao tatnae julie y mauleg madingo, ni y semiyaña manegagao nengcanoñija.
pairs.english: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todotdia guaja minaase yan ninaayao: ya y simiyaña para bendision.
pairs.english: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Suja gui taelaye, ya fatinas y mauleg; ya sumasasaga jao para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova yaña y juisio, ya ti jadingo y mañantosña: sija ufanmaadaje para siempre: ya y semiyan y manaelaye ufanmautut.
pairs.english: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ujaereda y tano ya usaga para taejinecog gui jiloña.
pairs.english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachot y manunas manguecuentos minalate, ya y jilaña cumuecuentos juisio.
pairs.english: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay y Yuusña gaegue gui corasonña, pot enao na y adengña ti usulong.
pairs.english: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye jaespipia y tinas ya jaegaga para upuno.
pairs.english: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ti upinelo gue gui canaeña: ni usinentensia güe yan manjusga.
pairs.english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nangga si Jeova ya adaje y chalanña, ya güiya unninataquilo para unereda y tano: anae y manaelaye ufanmautut, jago siempre unlie.
pairs.english: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jagas julie y taelaye na dangculo ninasiñaña, ya janamayao güe, calang y atbot ni betde gui edaña.
pairs.english: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalofan ya estagüe, na taegüe: magajet na jualigao ya tisiña masoda.
pairs.english: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y cabales, ya atan y tinas na taotao: sa y uttimoña ayo na taotao y pas.
pairs.english: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manaelaye todo manmayulang: ya y uttimon y manaelaye ufanmautut.
pairs.english: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y satbasion y manunas gui as Jeova: güiya y minetgotñija gui tiempon y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova ufaninayuda ya uninafanlibre gui manaelay: ya uninafansatba sa sija numananggagüe.
pairs.english: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, chamoyo lumalálatde nu y lalalomo, ni uncastigayo nu y binibumo.
pairs.english: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y flechamo cheton guiya guajo: ya y canaemo macat gui jilojo.
pairs.english: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya jinemlo gui catneco pot y binibumo: ya taya pas gui telangjo pot causa y isaojo.
pairs.english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinaelayeco malofan gui jilo ilujo: sija sen macat guiya guajo taegüije y catga macat.
pairs.english: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chetnotto manmutung yan manpotlilo, pot causa y binabajo.
pairs.english: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pinite yo yan gostumecon yo: todotdia jumajanaoyo yan umuugong yo.
pairs.english: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atayojo bula sinenggue: ya taya jinemlo gui catneco.
pairs.english: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manyafaeyo yan gosmamuteyo: cumate yo pot y atboroto gui corasonjo.
pairs.english: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, y menamo nae gaegue todo y tinangajo: ya y inigongjo tiunaatog guiya jago.
pairs.english: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo bobongbong, y minetgotto malingo: ya y minalag y atadogjo fatta esta.
pairs.english: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya yo yan y mangachongjo manotojgue chago gui chetnotto; ya parientesso manotojgue gui chago.
pairs.english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija ni y umaliligao y antijo manmaplanta laso para guajo; ya y umaliligao y dañujo manguecuentos tinaelaye: ya todotdia manmanajaso ni y finababa.
pairs.english: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, calang tanga, ti jujungog: ya guajo calang udo ni ti ubaba y pachotña.
pairs.english: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na guajo calang un taotao ni ti manjujungog: ya taya linalatde gui pachotña.
pairs.english: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iya jago, O Jeova, junanangga: jago unfanope, O Jeova, Yuusso.
pairs.english: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ileco: Chañija fanmamagof guiya guajo: anae sulong y adengjo manladangculon sija guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo cana na ugadon: ya y pinitijo gaegue siesiempre gui menajo.
pairs.english: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jusangan y tinaelayeco; bae jutriste pot y isaojo.
pairs.english: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigujo manlâlâ ya manmetgot: ya mumemegaeja y chumatlieyo sin jafa.
pairs.english: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija locue ni y jaapapase y mauleg pot y taelaye, sija contrarionjo, sa judadalalag y mauleg.
pairs.english: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo dumidingoyo, O Jeova: O Yuusso, chamo chachago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Laguse ya unayudayo, O Jeova y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJO ileco bae juadaje y chalanjo, para chajo umiisao pot y jilajo: bae juadaje y pachotto ni freno, anae y manaelaye mangaegue gui menajo.
pairs.english: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jugueffamatquilo ya juquieto gui minauleg: ya y pinitijo manatbororota.
pairs.english: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo maepe gui sanjalomjo: anae jujajaso, y guafe mañoñonggue: ayo nae cumuentos yo yan y jilajo.
pairs.english: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natungo yo, Jeova, ni uttimoco, yan y medidan y jaanijo cuanto guaja; natungoyo jafa na checayo.
pairs.english: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na un atafja unnae y jaanijo; ya y sacanjo calangja taya gui menamo: sen magajet na todo y taotao taebale anae guaja mas balotña.
pairs.english: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Senmagajet na calang anineng jumajanao todo y taotao: senmagajet na taesetbe y atborotoñija: Sa manrecocoje y güinaja ya ti jatungo jaye y chinile.
pairs.english: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, Jeova, jafa junangga? y ninanggaco gaegue guiya jago.
pairs.english: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibre yo gui todo y tinaelayeco, chamoyo pumopolo na jumanamamajlao gui taetiningo.
pairs.english: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo mamatquilo, ti jubaba y pachotto: sa jago fumatinas.
pairs.english: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najanao guiya guajo y sinaulagmo: sa pot y tinetpen y canaemo lumachaeyo.
pairs.english: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae unnatunas y taotao nu y linalatde, pot y tinaelaye, ninalachae y bonituña taegüije y puliya: senmagajet na todo y taotao taebale.
pairs.english: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y tinaetaejo, O Jeova, ecungog y inagangjo: chamo famatquilo gui menan y lagojo: sa taotao tumano yo guiya jago: pago finatoyo taegüeje y mañaenajo todos.
pairs.english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Poloyo ya jufañule minetgot, antes de jujanao ya ti jutalo.
pairs.english: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNANGGA nu y siningon as Jeova; ya janaegueng maesa güe guiya guajo, ya jajungog y inagangjo.
pairs.english: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya chumule yo guinin un joyo chatliion, guinin fache na tadong: ya japolo y adengjo gui jilo acho, ya janafitme y jinanaojo.
pairs.english: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo gui pachotto canta na mannuebo, junggan, y alabansa gui Yuusta. Megae lumie ya manmaañao, ya ufanangoco as Jeova.
pairs.english: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni jaangoco gui as Jeova: ya ti jaaatan y mansobetbio ni y manabag manmalag y mandague.
pairs.english: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae O Jeova, y ninamanmanmo ni unfatinas: yan y jinasomo para jame; ti siña maaregla sija gui menamo: yaguin guajo judeclara ya jusangang sija, tisiña matufong sa gosmegae.
pairs.english: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inefresen ninae ti yamo: y talangajo jagasja unbaba: inefresen sinenggue ya y ninae pot y isao, ti jagasja ungagao.
pairs.english: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ileco: Estagüe na matoyo: gui finalulon y leblo nae esta matugue pot guajo.
pairs.english: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yajo para jufatinas y minalagomo, O Yuusso: magajet na y laymo gaegue gui jalom corasonjo.
pairs.english: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jagas jusangan y tininas gui jalom y dangculo na inetnon taotao: estagüe, na ti junaquiequeto y labiosso, O Jeova, jago tumungo.
pairs.english: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti junaatog y tininasmo gui jalom corasonjo; y minagajetmo yan satbasionmo jagas jusangan: ti jupune y minaasemo yan y minaulegmo gui dangculon inetnon taotao.
pairs.english: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Jeova, chamo dumitietietene y minaasemo para guajo: sa y minaasemo yan y minagajetmo juadadaje yo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegue gui oriyajo y tinaelaye asta ti tufungon: jajiguef yo y tinaelayeco sija, ya ti siña juatan julo; megaeña mas que y gapotulo gui ilujo, ya y corasonjo yafae esta.
pairs.english: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malagojao, O Jeova, unnalibreyo: O Jeova, laguse para unayudayo.
pairs.english: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao ya ufaninestotba ayo y umaliligao y antijo para uyulang: polo ya ufanalo tate ya ufanmamajlao, ni y yañija y munataelaye yo.
pairs.english: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanlapoble sija, pot y minamajlaoñija, ni y umaalog ni guajo: Ja, ja.
pairs.english: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmagof ya ufansemagof ni jago, todo y umaliligao jao: ya polo ya siesiempreja ujaalog, y gumaeya y satbasionmo: Ladangculo Jeova.
pairs.english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo pobleyo ya nesesitaoyo; lao si Jeova jajajasoyo. Jago y umayuyudayo yan y munalibre yo: O Yuusso, chamo atrasasao.
pairs.english: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DICHOSO ayo y maase ni y mamoble; sa y jaanen y tinaelaye nae, si Jeova ulinibre.
pairs.english: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uinadajegüe, yan umantiene güe lâlâ; ya güiya udichoso gui tano; ya tiuenentrega güe gui minalago y enemiguña.
pairs.english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uinayuda güe jilo camaña ni y pinitiña; unfatinas todo y camaña anae malango.
