pairs.english: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ilegco: Jeova gaease nu guajo: najomlo y antijo; sa umisaoyo contra jago.
pairs.english: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: y enemigujo jasangan y taelaye contra guajo ilegñija: Ngaean umatae, ya ufalingo y naanña?
pairs.english: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae mato para uliiyo, jasangan y taebale; y corasonña nae mandaña y tinaelaye pot güiyaja; anae jumanao juyong jasangan ayo.
pairs.english: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chumatliiyo manañangon entre sija contra guajo; contra guajo nae majaso y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti mauleg na chetnot, ilegñija, sumaga guiya güiya; sa anae umason gui cama ti siña ninacajulo talo.
pairs.english: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y güinaeyaco nae juangocoyo, güiya y cumano y najo pan, jajatsa y dedegoña contra guajo.
pairs.english: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago Jeova, gaease nu guajo, ya unacajuloyo, para juapase sija.
pairs.english: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jutungo, na unmagof guiya guajo, sa y enemigujo ti ujagana yo.
pairs.english: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo, gui quinabalesso unmantieneyo; ya unpoloyo gui menamo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendesido si Jeova ni y Yuus Israel, ni y taejinecog, yan taejinecog. Amen, Amen.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: TAEGÜIJE y benabo ni y guija, ni y malago ni y minilalag y janom: taegüijeja locue y antijo sumospípiros pot jago, O Yuus.
pairs.english: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo majo pot si Yuus, pot y lalâlâ na Yuus; ngaean nae jufato, ya juanog gui menan Yuus?
pairs.english: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lagojo guinin nengcanojo, jaane yan puenge, ya todo y jaane ilegñiñijaja nu guajo: Manggue y Yuusmo?
pairs.english: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jujaso estesija, machuda juyong y antijo guiya guajo, anae manmalofan y linajyan taotao, maposyo, ya jucone sija asta y guimayuus; yan y minagof, yan y tinina; un linajyan na umadadaje y guipot na jaane.
pairs.english: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilogjao, O antijo? yan jafa na estotbajao gui jinalomjo? Nangga jao si Yuus, sa guajo bae jutuna güe pot y ayudo gui menaña.
pairs.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yuusso, y antijo esta dumilog gui jinalomjo; pot enao na jujajasojao desde y tano guiya Jordan, yan Hermonitas, desde y egso Misar.
pairs.english: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tinadong, jaagang y otro tinadong, pot palangpang y janommo sija: todo y napomo, yan y langatmo, manmalofan gui jilojo.
pairs.english: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago si Jeova y minaaseña gui jaane, ya y puenge y cantaña guiya guajo, ya y tinaetae para y Yuus a linâlâjo.
pairs.english: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualog as Yuus, y achojo: Jafa na malefajao nu guajo? Jafa mina na tristeyo pot y chiniguit y enemigo?
pairs.english: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoja yan y espada gui telangjo, y enemigujo mamofeayo, anae ilegñija cada jaane nu guajo: Mano nae gaegue y Yuusmo?
pairs.english: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilog jao, O antijo? yan jafa na, estotbajao gui jinalomjo? Nangga si Yuus, sa bae jutuna güe, ni y ayuda nu y matajo, yan y Yuusso.
pairs.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUSGAYO, O Yuus, ya unsangan y mumujo contra y nasion ni y ti manjonggue: O coneyo gui manmandadague, yan y manaelaye na taotao.
pairs.english: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago Yuus y ninasiñajo; jafa na unrechasa? ya fafa mina tristeyo pot y chiniguit y enemigo?
pairs.english: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O tago y mananamo, yan y minagajetmo; ya uesgaejonyo: ya uchuleyo asta y santos na egsomo, yan y tabetnaculumo.
pairs.english: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jujalom gui attat Yuus, y as Yuus nae gaegue y dangculon minagofjo; Ja jutuna jao yan y atpa, O Yuus, Yuusso.
pairs.english: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na dumilog jao, O antijo? yan jafa na estotba jao gui jinalomjo? Nangga si Yuus; sa bae jutuna güe, ni y inayuda nu y matajo, yan y Yuusso.
pairs.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAME injingog ni y talanganmame, O Yuus, na jasanganejam y tantanmane, ni y finatinasmo gui tiemponñija, gui antiguo na tiempo.
pairs.english: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nu y canaemoja unyute y nasion, ya unpolo sija; unnafantriste y taotao sija, ya unnafanjanao.
pairs.english: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti inchile y tano pot espadanñija para iyonñija, ni ti unnafanlibre pot y canaeñija; lao y agapa na canaemo yan y canaemo, yan y minalag y matamo, sa unguaeya sija.
pairs.english: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y Rayjo, O Yuus: fanago linibre para si Jacob.
pairs.english: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jago na inyite papa y enemigonmame: pot y naanmo, na ingacha y mangajulo contra jame.
pairs.english: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti juangocoyo ni y flechaco, ni y espadajo ti ulibreyo.
pairs.english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago umadadajejam gui enemigonmame; ya y chumatliijam unnafanmamajlao.
pairs.english: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gui as Yuus tatunanmaesa jit todot dia; ya para taejinecog, intina y naanmo.
pairs.english: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago unyute jam, ya unnafanmamajlaojam; ya ti jumanaojao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbirajam tate guinin y enemigonmame; ya ayo sija y chumatliijam, manmañaque para sija namaesa.
pairs.english: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unpolojam taegüije y quinilo ni y para umacano; ya janafanmachalaponjam gui entalo y nasion.
pairs.english: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbende y taotaomo pot taya; ya ti mumegae y güinajamo pot y balenñija.
pairs.english: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmamajlaojam ni y tiguangmame; pot y manmanmofefea, yan manmanbotlelea ni y mangaegue gui oriyanmame.
pairs.english: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmafa y sinanganjam gui entalo y nasion, pot y yinengyong y ilonñija gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y desenrajo gaegueja gui menajo todot dia; ya y minamajlao y matajo jatampe yo.
pairs.english: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y inagang ayo y numanamamajlao, yan y chumatfino contra si Yuus; pot y enemigo yan y taotao ni y maneemog.
pairs.english: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo este manmato guiya jame; lao ti manmalelefajam nu jago, ni ti manmatinasjam mandague ni y tratumo.
pairs.english: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonmame ti inbira tate; ni y pinecatmame ti sumuja gui chalanmo.
pairs.english: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja unyamagjam gui sagan y jacal sija, ya untampejam ni y aninen y finatae.
pairs.english: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin manmalefajam ni y naan Yuusmame, ya inestira y canaemame pot y otro Yuus;
pairs.english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti ualigaojam si Yuus? Sa jatungoja y secreton y corason.
pairs.english: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junggan, pot y jago manmapunojam todo y inanaco y jaane; manmatufongjam taegüije y quinilo ni y para umapuno.
pairs.english: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fagmata, jafajao na mamaego, Señot? Cajulo, chamojam yumuyute para siempre.
pairs.english: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa nae unnaatog y matamo, ya malefajao ni y pinitenmame yan y chiniguitmame.
pairs.english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antenmame esta dumilog gui petbos; ya y tiyanmame cheton papa gui tano.
pairs.english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo ya unayudajam, ya unnafanlibrejam gui minaasemo.
pairs.english: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo machúchuda nu y mauleg na güinaja; jusangan ayo sija y para y ray; y jilajo, calang y pluman y chadeg mangue.
pairs.english: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefpaguñajao qui y famaguon y taotao sija: y grasia machúchuda jalom gui labiosmo; enaomina binendisejao as Yuus, para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gode y espadamo gui cháchagamo, O gosbalente jao, yan y langetmo yan y minagasmo.
pairs.english: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y minagasmo sigue di mumegae, sa pot y minagajet, yan y minanso, yan tininas: ya y agapa na canaemo unfinanagüe ni y mannamaañao na güinaja.
pairs.english: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y flechamo manacadedog; mamodong y taotao gui papamo; sija gaegue gui corason y enemigon y ray.
pairs.english: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronumo taejinecog, yan taejinecog, O Yuus: y bariyan y raenomo, tunas na bariya.
pairs.english: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeya y tininas, ya unchatlie y tinaelaye; enaomina si Yuus ni y Yuusmo, pinalaejao ni y lañan minagof, mas qui y mangachongmo.
pairs.english: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: manjuyong sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaga sija y ray, mangaegue gui entalo y manonrada na famalaoanmo; ya y rayna matátachong gui agapamo yan y magaguña y oron Ofir.
pairs.english: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog O jaga, jaso ya tecon y talangamo; ya unmalefa ni y mañataotaomo, yan y guima tatamo.
pairs.english: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ugosmalago y ray ni y bonitamo; sa güiya y Señotmo yanguin unadora güe.
pairs.english: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jagan Tiro yan y ninae ugaegue güije; asta y manrico gui entalo y taotao unmagaogao ni y fabotmo.
pairs.english: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jagan y ray, gui palasyo gosbonita güe: y magaguña maadotna ni y oro.
pairs.english: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Macone guato gui as ray, yan y magaguña ni y mabotda: y bitgen sija mangachongña ni y tumattitiye, sija unquinenie guato.
pairs.english: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija machulilie guato yan minagof yan alegria: ufanjalom gui palasyon y ray.
pairs.english: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui lugat si tatamo, y ugaegae y famaguonmo; unnafanprinsipe gui todo y tano.
pairs.english: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo junamajaso y naanmo gui todo y generasion sija: enaomina y taotao sija mannaejao grasias para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus, güiya y guinegüeta yan y minetgotta, enseguidas manayuda gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mungajit manmaañao, achogaja ucalamten y tano, yan y egso umachule asta y talo gui tase sija;
pairs.english: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogaja manapangpang y janom ya chatsaga; achogaja umayeyengyong y egso sija, pot causa y minatatgaña. Sila.
pairs.english: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayogüeja y sadog yan y minilalagña sija janamamagof y siuda Yuus; y santos na sagan y tabetnaculo guiya Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus gaegue gui entaloña; ti ucalamten; si Yuus uinayuda y ininan y egaan.
pairs.english: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manlalalo y nasion sija, ya mangalamten y raeno sija; umagang, ya maderite y tano.
pairs.english: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjijita yan y Señot y inetnon sendalo. Y Yuus Jacob, güiya y guinegüeta. Sila.
pairs.english: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya inlie y checho Jeova; Jafa na yinilang jafatinas gui jilo tano?
pairs.english: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munabasta y guera, asta y uttimon y tano; jayulang y atcos, ya jautut y lansa; güiya sumonggue y caretan guera gui guafe.
pairs.english: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Quieto, ya untungo na guajo si Yuus: jutaquilo gui entalo y nasion sija, jutaquilo gui tano.
pairs.english: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjijita yan y Señot y inetnon sendalo. Y Yuus Jacob, güiya y guinegüeta. Sila.
pairs.english: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAFAMAGPAG y canaemiyo todo jamya na taotao; agang si Yuus ni y inagang guinana.
pairs.english: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova sentaquilo yan namaañao; Güiya mas dangculo na ray gui jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ugana todo y taotao ya upolo gui papata; yan y nasion sija gui papa adengta.
pairs.english: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya umayig y erensiata ni y para jita: y minagas gui as Jacob ni y güinaeyaña. Sila.
pairs.english: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus mapos julo yan y inagang, si Jeova yan y sonidon y trompeta.
pairs.english: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanganta tinina sija para si Yuus; fanganta tinina sija; fanganta tinina sija para y rayta, fanganta tinina sija.
pairs.english: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus güiya ray todo y tano: fanganta y tinina sija, yan y tiningo.
pairs.english: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus mangobiebietna gui jilo y nasion sija; si Yuus matatachong gui tronon y sinantosña.
pairs.english: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y prinsipen y taotao sija mandaña ufantaotao y Yuus Abraham; sa y patang y tano, iyon Yuus: Güiya y sentaquilo.
pairs.english: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DANGCULO si Yuus, ya para umagueftuna, gui siuda y Yuusta, gui egso y sinantosña.
pairs.english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bonito na sagayan, y minagof todo gui tano, y egso Sion gui sumanlago na banda, siuda y dangculo na ray.
pairs.english: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus esta matungo gui jalom y palasyoña, na para y guinegüe.
pairs.english: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa estagüe y ray sija na mandaña, manmalofan ya mandadañaja.
pairs.english: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalie, ya luego ninafanmanman; ninafañatsaga, ya maninalulula manjanao.
pairs.english: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mayengyong gumote sija güije; yan y pinite taegüije y palaoan yan para ufañago.
pairs.english: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumamag y batcon Tarsis, ni y manglo sancatan.
pairs.english: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y jiningogmame, taegüijeja liniimame gui siuda y Señot y inetnon sendalo; gui siuda y Yuusmame: si Yuus plumanta para taejinecog. Sila.
pairs.english: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injaso y güinaeyamo, O Yuus, gui talo gui templomo.
pairs.english: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y naanmo, O Yuus, taegüijeja y tininamo asta y uttimon y tano: y agapa na canaemo, bula ni y tininas.
pairs.english: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namagof y egso Sion, yan sija jagan Juda ufanmagof; pot y jinisgamo sija.
pairs.english: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Famocat gui Sion, ya unjanagüe y oriyaña; ya untufong y tore güije.
pairs.english: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matca y colatña ni y munaseguguro, ya injaso y palasyoña; para usiña jamyo insangane y generasion ni y mamamaela.
pairs.english: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este na Yuus, y Yuusta para taejinecog, yan taejinecog: güiya uesgaejonjit, asta y finataeta.
pairs.english: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JINGOG este todo jamyo ni y taotao; ecungog jamyo todos ni y mañasaga. gui tano:
pairs.english: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo todo mandaña, y managpapa, y managquilo, y manrico, yan y mamoble.
pairs.english: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usangan y minalate; ya y jinason y corasonjo y tiningo.
pairs.english: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juecungog y parabola; ya jubaba y jemjom sinanganjo gui atpa.
pairs.english: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa na maañaoyo gui jaanen y tinaelaye, anae y tinaelayen y dedegoco jaoriyayayeyo?
pairs.english: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y umangongoco sija ni y güinajañija, yan jatunanmaesaja ni y minegae y riniconñija;
pairs.english: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya guiya sija siña umapasiye y cheluña, ni unae si Yuus ni y rumescata güe;
pairs.english: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa y ninálibre y antinñija, dangculo presiuña, ya para upolu para siempre.)
pairs.english: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ulâlâ asta y taejinecog, ya ti ulie minitong.
pairs.english: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jalie na y manmalate na taotao sija manmamataeja, y manaejinaso yan y manbababa, manmalingo, ya japolo y güinajañija para y palo.
pairs.english: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinason y sumanjalomñija, na y guimañija usaga para taejinecog, ya y anae mañasaga na lugat para y todo generasion sija; ya jafanaan y tanoñija, ni y naanñijaja.
pairs.english: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao ti sumaga gui onraña, parejoja yan y gâgâ na matae.
pairs.english: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y jinanaoñiñija, y binabanñiñijaja; ya anae esta manmapos, manmagof y taotao nu y sinanganñija. Sila.
pairs.english: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanquinano gui naftan parejoja yan y manadan quinilo y finatae upinasto sija; ya y manunas mangaeninasiña gui jiloñija gui egaan; ya y boninituñija, para ulachae gui jalom naftan, sa taya sagaña.
pairs.english: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus unalibre y antijo gui ninasiñan y naftan; sa uresibeyo. Sila.
pairs.english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo maaañao, yanguin guaja taotao urico; yanguin y güinaja, y guimaña mumémegae;
pairs.english: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yanguin matae, taya uchule; y güinajaña, ti udinalalaggüe.
pairs.english: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogaja anae lalâlâ, dichoso y antiña; sa matutunajao ni y taotao sija, yanguin unfamauleg mamaesajao.
pairs.english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujanao para y generasion tataña; ti ufanmanlie manana.
pairs.english: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao ni y maoonra, ya ti matungo; parejoja yan y gâgâ ni y umatae.
pairs.english: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus, junggan, si Yuus, si Jeova sumangan, ya jaagang y tano desde y quinajulo y atdao asta y tumunogña papa güije.
pairs.english: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sumanjiyong Sion, gosbonito, sí Yuus umiina.
pairs.english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuusta ufato, ya ti ufamatquilo: y guafe ufanlinachae gui menaña, ya uguaja dangculon pinagyo gui oriyaña.
pairs.english: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: uagang gui taquilo na langet yan y tano, para ujusga y taotaoña.
pairs.english: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafandaña y mañantos guiya guajo; ayo sija y fumatinas y tratujo pot y inefrese.
pairs.english: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet udineclara y tininasña: sa si Yuus güiyaja y jues. Sila.
pairs.english: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jingog, O taotaojo, ya jusangan; O Israel, ya bae jusangan testimonio contra jago: guajo si Yuus, ni si Yuusmo.
pairs.english: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti julalatde jao pot y inefresimo, ya y inefresimo sinenggue, para todo y jaane gui menajo.
pairs.english: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jufangone nubiyo gui guimamo, ni laje na chiba gui quelatmo.
pairs.english: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y gâgâ gui jalom tano, gâjo, yan y gâgâ sija gui jilo y mit na sabana.
pairs.english: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungo todo y pajaro gui jalom tano; y manmachaleg na gâgâ sija gui jalomtano; todo gâjo.
pairs.english: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ñalangyo, ti jusanganejao; sa iyoco y tano, yan y sinajguanña.
pairs.english: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchoco catnen nubiyo, pat jugui. men jâgâ chiba?
pairs.english: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Yuus inefresen grasia; ya unapase y promesamo gui Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unagangyo gui jaanen y chinatsaga: junalibrejao, ya siempre unonrayo.
pairs.english: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña si Yuus ni y manaelaye; Jafa unfatinas para undeclara y tina. gojo, pat jagas unchule y tratujo gui pachotmo?
pairs.english: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago unchatlie y finanagüe, ya unyute y sinanganjo gui tatemo.
pairs.english: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae unlie y saque, undalalag güe; yan jagas gaepattejao yan y manábale.
pairs.english: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unnasetbe y pachotmo gui tae laye, ya y jilamo fumatitinas ocodon dinague.
pairs.english: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matátachongjao, ya cumuecuentosjao contra y chelumo; undesonra y lajin nanamo.
pairs.english: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija finatinasmo, lao mamatquiquilojayo: jinasomo na parejojitja: lao bae julalatdejao, ya jupolo tinaelayemo sija gui menan matamo.
pairs.english: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jaso este, jamyo ni y manmalefa as Yuus; na noseaja jusisi jamyo ya jufapidasos, ya taya unalibre.
pairs.english: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y numaeyo inefresen tinina, jaonrayo; ya ayo y munatutunas y sinanganña, jufanue ni y satbasion Yuus.
pairs.english: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus, jaftaemanoja y minauleg güinaeyamo, jaftaemanoja y minegae y minaasemo; fuñas y tinaelayeco.
pairs.english: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosfagaseyo todo ni y tinaelayeco, ya unnagasgasyo ni y isaojo.
pairs.english: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungoja y tinaelayeco: ya y isaojo gaegueja siempre gui menajo.
pairs.english: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa contra jago, jagoja, juisagüe, ya jufatinas y daño gui menan matamo: para utunas yanguin cumuentosjao, ya utaefatta yanguin manjusgajao.
pairs.english: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, na mafatinasyo gui tinaelaye, yan y isao nae si nanajo mumapotguenaejonyo.
pairs.english: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüeja, na unguaeya y magajet guiya jalolom; ya y umatog na lugat nae unnatungoyo ni y tiningo.
pairs.english: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nagasgasyo ni hisopo, ya jumuyong gasgas: fagaseyo ya jumuyong apacaña, qui y niebe.
pairs.english: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjungogyo minagof yan y alegria para ufanmagof y telangjo ni y unyamag.
pairs.english: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naatog y matamo gui isaojo; ya unfunas todo y inechongjo.
pairs.english: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas gui sumanjalomjo y gasgas na corason, O Yuus; ya unnanuebo y tinas na espiritu gui sumanjalomjo.
pairs.english: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo yumuyuteyo gui menamo; yan chamo chumuchule y santos na Espiritumo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natalo mague guiya guajo y minagof y satbasionmo: ya unmantieneyo ni y libre na Espiritumo.
pairs.english: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jufanagüe y manaelaye ni y chalanmo: ya y maniisao ufanmañotsot guiya jago.
pairs.english: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui isao gui jâgâ, O Yuus, jago Yuus y satbasinojo; ya y jilajo ucanta agang ni y tininasmo.
pairs.english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, baba y labiosso: ya y pachotto ufamanue ni y matunamo.
pairs.english: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti yamo inefrese para junaejao; ti magofjao ni y inefresen sinenggue.
pairs.english: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inefrese para si Yuus, manmayamag na espiritu: y mayamag yan y pinite na corason, O Yuus, jago siempre ti undespresia.
pairs.english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas mauleg, ni y minauleg minagofmo, guiya Sion; fatinas y quelat Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae unmagof ni y inefresen tininas, y inefresen sinenggue yan y cabales na inefresen sinenggue: Ayo nae unmaofrese nubiyo gui attatmo.
pairs.english: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JAFA na tunanmaesajao gui inacacha, O matatnga na taotao? y minaasen Yuus sumasagaja cada jaane siempre.
pairs.english: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jilamo fumatitinas ocodon y taelaye: parejo yan y malagtos na inabajan batbas, machochoeho dinague.
pairs.english: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeyaña y daño mas qui y mauleg; yan y mandague, mas qui cumuentos ni y tininas. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unguaeya todo y mannanataelaye na sinangan: O, dacon na jula.
pairs.english: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus unyinilang locue para taejinecog; unquinene, ya unjinala juyong gui guimamo magago; ya unjinale juyong gui tano y lalâlâ. Sila.
pairs.english: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ilegñija:
pairs.english: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, yuje na taotao y ti japolo si Yuus para minetgotña: lao jaangoco güe ni y manadan güinajaña, ya janametgot güe ni y tinaelayeña.
pairs.english: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, parejoyo yan y betde na troncon oliba gui jalom guimayuus; juangongocoyo ni y minaase Yuus para taejinecog, yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junaejao grasias, para taejinecog, sa unfatinas este; ya junangga y naanmo, sa este mauleg; gui menan y mañantosmo.
pairs.english: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ILEGÑA y taetiningo gui corasonña: Taya Yuus. Manpotlilo sija, mafatinas y chatliion na tinaelaye; taya ni uno ni fumatitinas mauleg.
pairs.english: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus gui langet tumalag pápapa y famaguon taotao sija; para ulie cao guaja gaetiningo, ni y umaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todos sija manalo tate; ya manjuyong potlilo sija; taya ni uno ni fumatitinas y mauleg, aje, taya ni uno.
pairs.english: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya tiningoñija ni chumogüe inechong? ni y macano y taotaojo sija, taegüije yan mañochocho pan: ya ti maagang si Yuus.
pairs.english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangosmanmaañao sija gui anae taya minaañao: sa si Yuus janafanmachapon adisapatta y telang ayo y tumotojgue contra jago; jago jagas unnafanmamajlao, sa si Yuus manrenechasa sija.
pairs.english: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, na y satbasion Israel mojon ujuyong guiya Sion! anae si Yuus janatalo y quinautiba y taotaoña; ayo nae umagof si Jacob, yan ufanmagof y Israel.
pairs.english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SATBAYO, O Yuus, pot y naanmo, ya unjusgayo pot y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog y tinaetaejo, O Yuus; ecungog y sinangan y pachotto.
pairs.english: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao juyong sija mangajulo contra guajo, yan y taotao ni y fijon y minatatgañija maaliligao y antijo; sija jagasja ti japopolo si Yuus gui menanñija. Sila.
pairs.english: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na si Yuus umayuyudayo; si Jeova mañisija yan ayo y mumantietene y antijo.
pairs.english: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uapase taelaye y enemigujo sija; yulang sija gui minagajetmo.
pairs.english: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa inefresijo ni y minalagojo bae junaejao; bae jualaba y naanmo, O Jeova, sa mauleg.
pairs.english: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munalibreyo todo gui chinatsaga: sa y atadogjo jagasja jalie y minalagojo contra y enemigujo.
pairs.english: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y tinaetaejo, O Yuus: ya chamo umaatog maesa jao gui guinagaojo.
pairs.english: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atituyeyo, ya opeyo: sa inestotbayo gui trinistieco, ya umugongyo;
pairs.english: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y inagang y enemigo: sa pot y chiniguit y manaelaye; sa mayute y tinaelaye gui jilojo, ya pot y biniboñija, na machatliiyo, japetsigueyo.
pairs.english: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo gospute gui sumanjalomjo: yan y minaañao y finatae podong gui jilojo.
pairs.english: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Minaañao yan linaolao, manmato guiya guajo; y linijan ñumoñoyo.
pairs.english: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegco: O mojon yanguin gaepapayo, taegüije y paluma! ayo nae jugupo chago, ya judescansa.
pairs.english: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, ayo nae jujanao chago, ya jusaga gui jalomtano. Sila.
pairs.english: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mojon bae jualula malag y guinegüe, guinin y duron manglo yan y pinagyo.
pairs.english: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yulang, O Jeova, ya ipe y jilañija; sa jagasja julie y fijom na manaelaye, ya y manmanpotfifia gui siuda.
pairs.english: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaane yan puenge manjajanao gui sumanjilo y quelatña: inechong yan inacacha mangaegue gui entaloña.
pairs.english: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaelaye mangaegue gui entaloña; chiniguit yan dinague ti usuja gui chalanña.
pairs.english: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti y enemigo lumalatdeyo; ayo nae siña jusungon; ni ti ayo y chumatliiyo ni y munadangculo güe contra guajo: ayo nae junaatog maesayo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jagoja, un taotao, ni y parejujo, yan y gachongjo, yan y senjuguflie na amigujo.
pairs.english: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamis na inangoco manasangane jam y jinasonmame; ya tafanmamocat yan linajyan taotao gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya derepente ufanchinile ni y finatae: polosija ya ufansinetta papa manlalâlâ guiya sasalaguan; sa guaja y manaelaye gui sagañija yan y sanjalomñija.
pairs.english: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, bae juagang si Yuus; ya si Jeova usatbayo.
pairs.english: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pupuenge, ogaan, yan taloane, jufanjaso ya juagang duro, ya güiya ujungog y inaganjo.
pairs.english: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jagasja munalibre y antijo qui pas, guinin y guera ni y comontrayo: sa megae pumotfifia yo.
pairs.english: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ufaninjingog, ya ufaninepe sija; asta ayo y mañasaga desde y apmam na tiempo. Sila. Ti taotao sija ni siempre jatulaeca, ya ti manmaañao as Yuus.
pairs.english: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaestira mona y canaeña contra ayo sija ni y manpas guiya güiya: jayulang y tratuña.
pairs.english: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sinangan y pachotña palagseña qui y mantica, lao guera gui jalom corasonña; y sinanganña mananana qui y laña; lao puro ayo sija espada in malagnos.
pairs.english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y catgamo gui as Jeova, ya güiya uminantiene; sa taya nae jasotta y manunas ya umanacalamten.
pairs.english: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Yuus, ufansinetta sija papa gui joyon finatae; sa y manmejgá, yan manfáfababa na taotao sija, ti ufanlâlâ ni lamita gui jaaniñija; lao guajo juangocoyo nu jago.
pairs.english: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus; sa y taotao malago na ujapañotyo; mumumo todot dia, ya jachichiguityo.
pairs.english: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todot dia y enemigujo manmalago na ujapañotyo; sa megae mamumujo ya mansobetbio.
pairs.english: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja na tiempo nae maañaoyo, juangocojayo guiya jago.
pairs.english: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus jualaba y finoña; gui as Yuus nae jagasja jupolo y inangococo, ti maañaoyo; jafa ufatinas y catne guiya guajo?
pairs.english: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todot dia mabira y sinanganjo; sa todo y jinasoñija contra guajo para tinaelaye.
pairs.english: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandaña ya manatog maesasija; ya magueguesatituye y pinecatjo, anae jagas mananangga sija y antijo.
pairs.english: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanescapa nu y tinaelaye? gui binibo nae unyute papa y taotao sija, O Yuus.
pairs.english: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago sumangan y jinanaojo; polo gui jalom boteyamo y lagojo: manaegüe sija gui leblomo?
pairs.english: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
