pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae, ujabira sija tate y enemigujo y jaane nae juagangjao; este jutungo, na si Yuus para guajo.
pairs.english: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus jualaba y finoña: gui as Jeova jualaba y finona.
pairs.english: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus nae jagasja jupolo y inangococo; ya siempre ti jumaañao; jafa y taotao ufatinas guiya guajo?
pairs.english: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y promesamo gaegue guiya guajo, O Yuus: ya juapasejao siempre ni y inefresen grasias.
pairs.english: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja unnalibre y antijo gui finatae; ti siempre unnalibre y adengjo an podong? para jufamocat gui menan Yuus gui candet y manlálâlâ.
pairs.english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GAEASE nu guajo, O Yuus, gaease nu guajo; sa y antijo guinegüe güe guiya jago: magajet, y anineng y papamo ugogüeyo asta qui manmalofan y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juagang si Yuus Gueftaquilo; si Yuus ni y jafatinas todo y güinaja para guajo.
pairs.english: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanago guinin y langet ya unalibreyo; anae jalalatde ayo y malago pumañotyo. Sila. Si Yuus utago y minaaseña yan y minagajetña.
pairs.english: He shall send from heaven, and save from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo gaegue gui entalo y león sija: ya umaasonyo gui entalo ayo sija y minañila guafe, junggan, yan y lalajin taotao sija ni y nifenñija y lansa sija, yan flecha sija, ya y jilañija malagtos na espada.
pairs.english: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao gui jilo y langet, O Yuus; polo y inenramo todo gui sanjilo tano.
pairs.english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagas mamatinas laso, para y pinecatto; y antijo tumecon papa; jagas manmaguadog joyo gui menajo; ya sija mamodong maesaja gui taloloja. Sila.
pairs.english: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo, esta meton, O Yuus, y corasonjo esta meton; bae jucanta, magajetja, jucanta alabansa sija.
pairs.english: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fagmata, inenrajo; fagmata, guitala yan atpa; guajoja na maesa magmatayo taftaf.
pairs.english: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junaetjao grasias, O Jeova, gui entalo y taotao sija; jucantayejao alabansa sija gui entalo y nasion sija.
pairs.english: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa asta y langet, dangculo y minaasemo, yan asta y mapagajes y minagajetmo.
pairs.english: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao gui jilo y langet, O Yuus; polo y minalagmo todo gui sanjilo y tano.
pairs.english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: anae debe de sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, na y jalom corason nae manmachochocho jamyo tinaelaye; intajlang gui canaenmiyo y tinaelaye gui tano.
pairs.english: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manaelaye, manaotao juyong desde y jalom tuyan: enseguidas qui manmafañago, manabag manguecuentos ni y mandague.
pairs.english: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y binenoñija, parejo yan y binenon y culebbla: sija parejo yan y tangan y serpiente, ni y jajuchum talangaña;
pairs.english: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jaecungog y inagang y encantador, ni y gosfaye manencanta.
pairs.english: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yamag y nifenñija gui jalom pachotñija, O Yuus: yamag juyong y dangculo na nifen y patgon leon, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmadirite taegüije y janom ni y malalagoja gui iyoña: anae jaachechetgüe y flechaña, polo ya calang manutut.
pairs.english: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya utaegüije y acaleja ni y madirite ya umalofan: taegüije y taetiempo na mañagon palaoan, ni y ti guinin lumilie y atdao.
pairs.english: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: guafen y sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ufanmagof yanguin jalilie y inemog; ufagase y adengña gui jâgâ y taelaye.
pairs.english: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ualog y taotao: Magajet na guaja apasñija y manunas: magajet guaja si Yuus ni y manjujusga gui tano.
pairs.english: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NALIBREYO gui enemigujo sija, O Yuusso; polo yo gui jilo guinin ayosija ni y mangajujulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui chumogüe y tinaelaye, ya satbayo gui manmejga na taotao sija.
pairs.english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, na mananangga y antijo: y manmetgot mandaña contra guajo; ti pot y tinaelayeco, ni ti pot y isaojo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalago ya japrepara sija, sin y linachijo; fagmata, ya unayudayo, ya unlie.
pairs.english: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, si Yuus Israel; fagmata ya unbisita todo y nasion sija; chamo gagaease ni y manaelaye. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manalo guato yan pupuenge: ya manboruruca taegüije y galago, ya malilicucue y siuda.
pairs.english: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Liija, sa mannutugap juyong guinin y pachotñija: espada sija guaja gui jalom labiosñija; jaye, ilegñiñija, cao jajungog?
pairs.english: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, siempre unchatgue sija; siempre unmofea todo y nasion.
pairs.english: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O minetgotto, junanangga jao; sa si Yuus y guimajo lumijing.
pairs.english: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuusso nu y minaaseña, ugaegue gui menajo: si Yuus unaliiyo y minalagojo, gui jilo y enemigujo sija.
pairs.english: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumupuno sija, sa trabia ti manmalelefa y taotaojo; chalapon sija pot y ninasiñamo; ya unchule sija papa, O Jeova, patangmame.
pairs.english: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y isao y pachotñija, yan pot y sinangan y labiosñija, polo ya ufanmacone, pot y sobetbioñija: yan pot y matdision, yan manmandadague ni y sinanganñija.
pairs.english: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lachae sija ni y binibumo, lachae sija, para sija ti ufangaegue talo: ya ujatungo na si Yuus mangobiebietna gui as Jacob, asta y uttimon y tano. Sila.
pairs.english: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya an pupuenge, polo ya ufanalo guato, ya unfanboruca taegüije y galago ya umalilicue y siuda.
pairs.english: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjajanao julo yan papa, ya ufanmanaliligao nañija; ya usaga todo puenge yanguin ti manjaspog.
pairs.english: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo, jucanta ni y ninasiñamo; magajet, na jucanta agang ni y minaasemo yan ogaan; sa guinin jago y guimajo lumijing, yan y guinegüeco gui jaanen chinatsagaco.
pairs.english: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O minetgotjo, jucantaye y alabansa sija; sa si Yuus y guimajo lumijing, yan y Yuus y minaasejo.
pairs.english: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago yumutejam, jago gumapotjam papa; guinin lalalojao; O, natalojam guato.
pairs.english: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jagasja munamayengyong y tano; jago yumulang; nafanjomlo y yinilangña sija, sa manmayeyengyong.
pairs.english: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unfanue y taotaomo sija ni y manmajetog na güinaja; unnafanguimenjam ni y binon na matulalaejon.
pairs.english: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnae ayo sija ni y manmaañao nu jago, un bandera para ujatsa pot y minagajet. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa para ufanlibre y güinaeyamo; satba ni y agapa na canaemo, yan opejam.
pairs.english: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus sumangan y sinantosña; siempre jumagof; ya siempre judibide iya Siquem, ya jumide y bayen Sucot.
pairs.english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Iyoco Galaad, ya iyoco Manases: Efraim y guinegüe y ilujo; Juda y baston minagasso.
pairs.english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Moab, y palanggana para jufagagaseyo; y jilo Edom nae juyute y sapatosso: Filistia, agangjao pot guajo.
pairs.english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye uchinileyo guato gui fitme na siuda? jaye uesgaejonyo guato Edom?
pairs.english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mungajao, O Yuus, ni y guinin yumutejam? yan jago, O Yuus, ti jumanao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam inayuda contra y contrario gui chinatsaga; sa taebale y inayudan taotao.
pairs.english: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin as Yuus nae infatinas y minatatnga; sa güiyaja ni ugacha papa y contrarionmame.
pairs.english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y inaganjo, O Yuus; atituye y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y uttimon y tano juagang jao, anae taeninasiña y corasonjo: chalaneyo asta y acho ni y mas taquilo qui guajo.
pairs.english: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago guinin y guinegüeco, yan y guiman lumijing guinin y enemigo.
pairs.english: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusaga gui jalom y tabetnaculumo para taejinecog: ya jugogüeyo gui tinampen y papamo. Sila.
pairs.english: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago O Yuus guinin jumungog y promesajo; jago guinin numaeyo ni y erensian ayo sija y manmaañao ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munaanaco y jaanin y ray; y sacanña taegüije y megae na generasion sija.
pairs.english: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Usaga gui menan Yuus para taejinecog: O, nalisto y güinaeya yan y minagajet, para ufanadaje güe.
pairs.english: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este jucantaye y naanmo para taejinecog, para jufatinas y prinimetijo cada jaane.
pairs.english: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo janananggaja si Yuus; sa guinin güiya nae mamaela y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiyaja y achojo yan y satbasionjo, güiya y torejo taquilo: ya ti megae jumanacalamten.
pairs.english: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaen nae intigong contra unoja taotao? todos jamyo infanmapuno; taegüije y padet ni y cumba, yan taegüije y matomba na colat.
pairs.english: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manafaesenja gui entaloñija na umayute papa gui ninasiñaña: manmagof ni y dinague sija: manmanbendidise ni y pachotñija, lao manmanmatdidise qui sumanjalomñija.
pairs.english: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus nanggajao, O antijo; sa guinin güiya y ninanggaco.
pairs.english: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiyaja y achojo yan y satbasionjo; güiya y torejo taquilo, ya ti jumanacalamten.
pairs.english: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui as Yuus nae gaegue y satbasionjo yan y minalagjo; y acho y minetgotjo yan y guinegüeco mangaegue gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Angoco gue todo y tiempo, jamyo ni y taotao sija; chuda y corasonmiyo gui menaña: si Yuus y guinegüe para jita. Sila.
pairs.english: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Seguro todo y taotao sija ni y umitde condisioñija manjinaja; ya y managquilo condisioñija, un dinague; yanguin manmapolo gui balansa, todos manñajlalangña qui y jinaja.
pairs.english: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo umangongoco jao gui inamot, yan chamo na gagaebale y sinaque: yanguin y güinaja manlalamegae; chamo pumópolo y corasonmo guiya sija.
pairs.english: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin jasangan si Yuus un biaje; ya dos biaje jagasja jujungog este; na y ninasiña iyon Yuus.
pairs.english: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyomoja locue Jeova y minaase: sa unapapaseja cada taotao jaftaemano y chechonâ.
pairs.english: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago y Yuusso; taftaf jualigao jao; y antijo majo pot jago, y catneco majalang nu jago, gui anglo an majo na tano, anae taya janom;
pairs.english: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije juatan jao gui templo para julie y ninasiñamo yan y minlagmo.
pairs.english: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mauleg güinaeyamo maulegña qui y linâlâ; y labiosso ualabajao.
pairs.english: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine jubendise jao gui linâlâjo; ya jujatsa julo y canaejo ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo ujaspog taegüije y ujaspog ni y titanos an montica; ya y pachotjo ualabajao yan y minagof y labiosso.
pairs.english: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jujaso jao gui jilo camajo; ya y jinasoco nu jago gui ora nae bumebelayo an puenge.
pairs.english: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago guinin umayudayo; enaomina y anineng y papamo nae jumagof.
pairs.english: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo dangculo na tinatitiye jao: y agapa na canaemo mumantieteneyo.
pairs.english: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija y umaliligao y antijo, para umayulang, sija ufanjanao para y mas tadong na joyo gui tano.
pairs.english: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmaentrega gui jinilat y espada; sija ugüinaja para y sora sija.
pairs.english: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y ray umagof gui as Yuus; ya todo y manmanjula pot güiya unfanmagof: sa y pachot ayo sija y manmandadague ufanmajuchom.
pairs.english: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y inagangjo, O Yuus, gui quejaco: adaje y linâlâjo ni y minaañaoña ni y enemigo.
pairs.english: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naatogyo gui secreto na pinagat y manaelaye; yan y inatborota ni y chumogüe y taelaye.
pairs.english: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y janafanmalagtos y jilañija taegüije y espada, yan janafanapunta y flechañija, ni manmalaet na sinangan.
pairs.english: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujaflecha gui secreto y cabales; ya derepente manflecha güe, ya ti maañao.
pairs.english: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanfitmeja sija gui na jinasuye taelaye: manmanafaesen para ujananaplinanta y laso; ya ilegñija: Jaye ufanlinie?
pairs.english: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanaliligao ni y tinaelaye; ilegñija na tacumple guse y inaligaota: cada uno guiya sija manacjalom jinasonñija yan corasonñija manadong.
pairs.english: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus flumecha sija, ya enseguidas ninafanlamen nu y flecha.
pairs.english: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije ninafanmatompo; y jilañija contra sija; ya todo y lumie sija ujayengyong y ilonñija.
pairs.english: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija ufanmaañao; ya ujasangan y checho Yuus: sa ujaguesjaso y finatinasña.
pairs.english: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ufanmagof sija gui as Jeova, ya ujaangoco nu güiya; yan todo y manunas na corason, ufanmalag.
pairs.english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinina unanangga jao guiya Sion, O Yuus; iya jago nae umapase y promesa.
pairs.english: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jago ni y jumungog y utinaetae, todo y catne ufanmato guiya jago.
pairs.english: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaganayo y tinaelaye sija; lao y isaomame, jago umasie.
pairs.english: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y unayeg, ya unnaguaguato guiya jago, para usaga gui sagamo: manjaspogjam ni y minauleg y guimamo, asta y santos na lugat gui templomo.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y namaañao na güinaja nae unopejam gui tininas; O Yuus y satbasionmame; jago y ninangga gui uttimon puntan tano todo, yan asta todo ayo sija y manlachago, ni y mangaegue gui jilo y tase.
pairs.english: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y pot ninasiñaña japlanta seguro y egso, madudog ni y ninasiñaña;
pairs.english: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: janafanbasta sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija ni y mañasaga gui uttimon tano, manmaañao ni señatmo: unnamagof y jumuyong y egaan yan y pupuenge.
pairs.english: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumisita y tano yan unriega; unnagosrico; y sadog Yuus bula janom: unnafanmauleg y maies para sija yanguin esta unnalisto y tano taegüije.
pairs.english: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafangosbula janom y sutcoñija: unnafitme a pujañija güije; ya unnamañaña ni y ichan; ya unbendise y sinisoñija.
pairs.english: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uncorona y sacan sija ni y minaulegmo; ya y finaposmo manutujo y mantica.
pairs.english: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manutujo gui jilo y pastaje sija gui desierto: ya y mandiquique na sabana madudog ni y minagof.
pairs.english: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pastaje sija manminagago ni y manadan gâgâ; y baye sija locue mantinampe ni y maies; manesalao ni y minagofñija, ya mangacanta locue.
pairs.english: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FATINAS y minagof na inagang gui as Yuus todo y tano.
pairs.english: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Canta y minagof gui naanña: namalag y tininaña.
pairs.english: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alog as Yuus: jafa na manámaañao y chechomo: pot y dinangculon y ninasiñamo uninaseja y contrarionmo papa.
pairs.english: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y tano umadodorajao yan macantatayejao: yan macantataye y naanmo. Sila.
pairs.english: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya inlie y checho Yuus: na ninámaañao y chechoña gui jilo y famaguon y taotao.
pairs.english: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatolaeca y tase y anglo na tano: ya japocacate y sadog: ya ayo nae manmagofjam nu güiya.
pairs.english: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jagobiebietna ni y minetgotña para taejinecog: y atadogña pumupulan y nasion sija: ya munga y managuaguat na ujajatsa sija. Sila.
pairs.english: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanbendise ni y Yuusta jamyo ni y taotao ya namajungog y inagang y tininaña:
pairs.english: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y mumantiene y antita gui linâlâ: ya ti japolo y adengta na usulong.
pairs.english: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago chumaguejam, O Yuus; jagasja unchague jam taegüije y salape an machague.
pairs.english: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumulejam gui jalom y laso: unpolo chinatsaga na catga gui sinturanmame.
pairs.english: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago namaudae y taotao guijilomame: jame infaposgüe y guafe an y janom: lao unchulejam asta y jalom y rico na sagayan.
pairs.english: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujalom gui jalom guimamo yan y sinenggue na inefrese sija: ya bae juapase jao ni y promesajo,
pairs.english: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y labiosso sumangan, yan y pachotto jagas cumuentos anae estabayo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junaejao sinenggue na inefrese ni y yemog yan paopao na tatneron quinilo: bae junaejao nobiyo yan chiba sija. Sila.
pairs.english: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maela ya injingong, todo ayo y manmañao as Yuus, ya bae jusangane jamyo jafa finatinasña ni y antijo.
pairs.english: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo juagang güe ni y pachotto: ya güiya umaalaba ni y jilajo.
pairs.english: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jumantiene y tinaelaye gui corasonjo, si Jeova ti ujungogyo.
pairs.english: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao magajet na si Yuus jajungog: güiya umadaje y inagang y tinaetaejo.
pairs.english: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Yuus, sa ti jabira y tinaetaejo ni y minaaseña guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, gaease ni jame ya unbendisejam: yan janafanmalag y mataña gui jilomame. Sila.
pairs.english: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña matungo y chalanmo gui jilo y tano yan y satbasionmo gui nasion todos:
pairs.english: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taotao ya umatuna jao, O Yuus: polo y taotao todo ya umatuna.
pairs.english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, polo y nasion sija ya ufanmagof yan ufanganta ni y minagof: sa jago siempre jumusga y taotao gui tininas yan ungobietna y nasion sija gui jilo y tano. Sila.
pairs.english: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taotao ya umatuna jao, O Yuus: polo y taotao todo ya umatuna.
pairs.english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tano jagasja unajuyong megae tinegchaña: ya si Yuus ni y Yuusta ubendisejit.
pairs.english: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ubendisejit: yan todo y uttimon y tano umaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: POLO si Yuus ya ucajulo, polo y enimiguña ya ufanmachalapon: polo ayo sija y chumatlie güe ya ufanmalago gui menaña.
pairs.english: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y manajanao y aso, taegüijeja yute sija: taegüije y maderite y danges gui menan guafe, taegüijeja manmalingoñija y manaelaye gui menan Yuus.
pairs.english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y manunas ufansénmagof: ufansenalegre gui menan Yuus: magajet ya usendangculo y minagofñija.
pairs.english: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Yuus, cantaye alabansa sija y naanña: nacajulo y chalan para ayo na maudae y inanaco y desierto sija; y naanña, si Yah ya fansenmagof gui menaña.
pairs.english: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tatan y manaetata ya y jues para y manbiuda, si Yuus gui sinantos na sagaña.
pairs.english: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus munafañaga y taeparientes gui familia sija: güiya chumule juyong preso para umegae: lao y managuaguat mañagaja gui anglo na tano.
pairs.english: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, mientras unjanao gui menan y taotao; mientras na unfamocat gui inanaco desierto. Sila.
pairs.english: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano mayeyengyong, y langet locue manutujo gui menan Yuus: ayo iya Sinae mayengyong gui menan Yuus, ni si Yuus guiya Israel.
pairs.english: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, O Yuus, tumago megae na uchan, yan jago munafitme y erensiamo na taotao anae yayas.
pairs.english: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inetnon taotaomo mañaga güije: jago, O Yuus, fumamauleg y minaulegmo para y mamoble.
pairs.english: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jananae ni finijo: yan mandangculo ayo na inetnon famalaoan ni y munamatungo:
pairs.english: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ray sija y inetnon sendalo falago chadig: ya güiya palaoan ni y sumasaga iya sija mafacae y inamot na güinaja.
pairs.english: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmalago jamyo dumescansa gui quelat quinilo; calang y papan y paluma nii platiao, yan y piluña nii amariyo calang oro.
pairs.english: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ayo todo janasiña manafanmachalapon y ray sija guiya güiya: taegüije anae mamodong nieve guiya Salmón.
pairs.english: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egso Yuus y egso Basán: y gostaquilo na ogso y egso Basán.
pairs.english: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa na manaatansegüet, jamyo nii manaquilo na osgo guato gui egso güinaeyan Yuus para sagaña: magajet na si Jeova sumaga güije para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y caretan Yuus y viente mil, junggan, miyares yan miyares ya si Jeova gui entaloñija taegüije iya Sinae, iya santos na sagaña.
pairs.english: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jao cajulo iya jululo, jagas uncone y mamacautiba na megae: jagas unresibe ninae sija entre taotao sija: magajet entre y managuaguat locue, para si Jeova Yuus usiña sumaga gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si, Jeova nii todo y jaane jaencatga y catgata, junggan, ayo y Yuus y satbasionta. Sila.
pairs.english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus güiya si Yuus satbasion para jita: ya y jinanao guinin y finatae iyon Jeova, Señot.
pairs.english: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus janafanlamen y ilon y enimiguña yan y cácagong y manmipe ayo y sisigueja gui isaoña.
pairs.english: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jeova ilegña: Bae chule talo guinin Basán, bae chule sija talo, guinin y tádodong na tase.
pairs.english: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y adengmo siña umanaatunog gui jâgâ ya y jila y gamo galago siña patten y enimigumo.
pairs.english: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija jalie y jinanaomo, O Yuus; magajet y jinanao y Yuusso, Rayjo gui sinantos na sagaña.
pairs.english: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mangacanta manjajanao gui menan, y mandadangdang yan y dandanñija jatatituye; y entaloñija y donseya sija ni y mandadangdang nii pandireta.
pairs.english: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanbendise si Yuus gui jalom y inetnon taotao; junggan, jamyo y tutujonña guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae estaba y diquique as Benjamin y magasñija, y prinsipen Juda yan y compañia apapagat, y prinsipen Sabulon yan y prinsipen Neftali.
pairs.english: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuusmo tumago y minetgotmo; O Yuus, nametgot y chechomo para jame.
pairs.english: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot causa y templomo guiya Jerusalem, y ray sija manmañuñule ninae sija para jago.
pairs.english: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lalatde y dadao na gâgâ gui piao, y manadan nobiyo yan y tatneron gataotao, nii guinocha papa adengñija y pedason salape sija: jochalapon ayosija taotao nii manmalago manguera.
pairs.english: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmato y prinsipe sija guinin Egipto: Etiopia guse ujaestira y canaeña gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Yuus jamyo nii raenon tano; O canta tinina para y Señot. Sila.
pairs.english: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ayo y maudae gui jilo y langet y langet sija, nii guinin ampman na tiempo; estagüe na güiya masangan nii inagang; nii gaeninasiña na inagang.
pairs.english: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan y minetgot Yuus: y minagasña gaegue gui jilo Israel, yan y minetgotña gaegue gui jalom y mapagages.
pairs.english: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, ninamaañaojao gui santos na sagamo sija: y Yuus Israel, güiya numae minetgot yan ninasiña y taotaoña: Bendito si Yuus.
pairs.english: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NALIBREYO, O Yuus; sa y janom manjalom asta y antijo.
pairs.english: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magñoyo gui tadong na luño; anae ti siñayo tumojgue: guajo mato y jalom tadong na janom anae y milag malofan gui jilojo.
pairs.english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yayasyo ni y inagangjo: y agagajo ninaanglo: y atadogco linálachae mientras junanangga si Yuusso.
pairs.english: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija y chumatliiyo pot taya, megaeña qui y gapotulo gui ilujo: ayosija y manmalago umututyo nii enemigujo sin jafa na linache, mangaeninasiña: ayo nae guajo junatalo guato ayo y taya nae juchuleguan.
pairs.english: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago tumungo y taetiningojo: yan y isaojo sija ti junaatog guiya jago.
pairs.english: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo ayo sija y numananggajao munafanmamamajlao pot guajo, O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo: chamo ayo sija y umaliligaojao umadesonra pot guajo, O Yuus Israel.
pairs.english: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot jago jupadese y linalatde: minamajlao tumampe y matajo.
pairs.english: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin manataotao juyong yo nii mañelujo; yan taotao juyongyo gui famaguon nanajo.
pairs.english: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y inigo y guimamo cumanoyo: ya y linalatdeñija y ayo sija nii lumalatde jao manbasnag guiya guajo.
pairs.english: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae tumangesyo ya junamajalang y antijo pot ti chumocho, este y para malalatdeco.
pairs.english: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jufatinas y luto para magagujo, jumuyongyo un cuentos nu sija.
pairs.english: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y manmatatachong gui petta, manadingan contra guajo: ya guajo y cantasionñija anae mangacanta y manbulacho.
pairs.english: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajoja, y tinaetaejo guiya jago, O Jeova, gui tiempon y finaboresemo: O Yuus, pot y minegae y minaasemo opeyo gui minagajet y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo gui liño ya chajo mamagño: polo ya ulibreyo güije sija nii chumatliiyo, yan gui y tinadong y janom sija.
pairs.english: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo y minilalag na janom na ufalofan gui jilojo, ni unpolo y tinadong na upañotyo; chamo pumopolo y joyo na ujuchom y pachotña gui jilojo.
pairs.english: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Opeyo, O Jeova; sa y minaasemo gosmauleg: taemanoja y minegae y minaasemo, birajao guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo na aatog y matamo gui tentagomo; sa gaegue yo gui chinatsaga: opeyo guse.
pairs.english: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najijot jao gui antijo ya unnalibre: rescatayo sa juguaja y enimigujo sija.
pairs.english: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago tumungo y malalatdeco, yan y minamajlaojo yan y madesonraco: y contrariojo mangaegue todo gui menamo.
pairs.english: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linalatde yumulang y corasonjo: yan bulayo y pinite: ya manaliligaoyo jaye upinite, lao taya ni uno: yan y numamagofyo lao ti jusoda ni uno.
pairs.english: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija numaeyo locue lalaet para nengcanojo: yan anae majoyo, sija numaeyo binagle para juguimen.
pairs.english: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya lamasañija mamalaso gui menanñija: polo ya yaguin gaegue sija gui pas, este para ocodo.
pairs.english: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ujomjom y atadogñija para chañija fanmalilie; yan janayeyengyong nii sinturanñija para todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Basija gui jiloñija y binibumo, ya polo y dangculon linalalomo ya ufanjeniguif sija.
pairs.english: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y sagañija ya umayulang: yan taya ni uno siña sumaga gui tiendañija.
pairs.english: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija pumetsigue ayo sija y sinaolagmo: ya sija sumangan y pinitinja ni y ninafanlamenmo.
pairs.english: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naye mas taelaye y tinaelayeñija, ya chamo munafanjajalom gui tininasmo.
pairs.english: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo ya umafunas sija gui leblon linâlâ: ya munga manmatugue sija yan y manunas.
pairs.english: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo pobleyo yan tristeyo: polo y satbasionmo, O Yuus, ya upoloyo guiya jululo.
pairs.english: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jualaba y naan Yuus nu y cantasion, ya junadangculo güe nu y inefresen grasias.
pairs.english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este munaguefmagof si Jeova mas qui y nobiyo, pat y toro nii mangaecángjilon yan papaquis.
pairs.english: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanso, jalie este ya ninafanmagof: ya y corasonmiyo ufanlâlâ y unaaliligao si Yuus.
pairs.english: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jajungog y mannesesitao ya ti jachatlie y prenesuña sija.
pairs.english: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y langet yan tano ya umaalaba güe, yan y tase sija yan todo y güinaja nii mangalalamten gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and everything that moveth therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus ujasatba y Sion yan ujafatinas y siuda sija guiya Juda: para usiña sija mañaga güije yan uguaja para y iyonñija.
pairs.english: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiya locue gui tentagoña uereda ni ayo: ya ayo sija y gumaeya y naanña unafañaga güije.
pairs.english: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NACHADIG, O Yuus, para unalibreyo: nachadig umayudayo, O Yuus.
pairs.english: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufaninistotba ni y umaliligao y antijo: polo sija ya ufanalo tate yan ufanmamajlao ni y manmagof nii desonraco.
pairs.english: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanalo tate para apas y minamajlaoñija ja ni y ilegñija: Aha, Aha.
pairs.english: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ayo todo y umaliligaojao ya unfanmagof yan ufansenmagof ni jago: ya polo ya ayo y gumaeya y satbasionmo ya ilelegñija siésiempreja: Umanasendangculo si Yuus.
pairs.english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo pobleyo yan nesesitaoyo: nachadig jao guiya guajo, O Yuus: sa jago umayuyudayo, yan y munalibreyo; O Jeova, chamo umatrasasao.
pairs.english: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Jeova, nae jupolo y inangococo: ya chajo mamámajlao para taejinecog.
pairs.english: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
