pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo, nii tininasmo ya rescatayo: naapo y talangamo guiya guajo ya unsatbayo.
pairs.english: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y acho y saga para guajo, anae mafatoyo todo y tiempo: jago mannae tinago na jumasatbayo: sa jago y finitmeco yan y castiyujo.
pairs.english: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescatayo, O Yuusso, juyong gui canae y manaelaye yan y canae y ti manunas yan y manrecto na taotao.
pairs.english: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y ninanggaco, O Jeova Yuus: jago y inangococo desde y pinatgonjo.
pairs.english: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago mumantieneyo desde y jalom tuyan, jago chumuleyo juyong guinin y tiyan nana: ya y tininajo todo y tiempo guiya jago.
pairs.english: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo taegüije y ninamanman gui linajyan; lao jago y megot na guinegüeco.
pairs.english: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto ubula nii tininamo, an y inenramo todot dia.
pairs.english: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamoyo yumuyute gui tiempo y inamcojo: yaguin minetgotto esta jocog chamoyo dumidingo.
pairs.english: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigujo manadingan contra guajo; yan ayo sija y numanangga y antijo, manafaesen entre sija.
pairs.english: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: Diningogüe as Yuus: petsigue ya enchilegüe; sa taya para ulinibregüe.
pairs.english: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, chamo chachago guiya guajo; Yuusso, nachadig yan para unayudayo.
pairs.english: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufanlinachae, ayo y contrarion y antijo; polo sija ya ufantinampe nii minamajlao yan y sinala, y umaliligao y dañujo.
pairs.english: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo juananangga todo y tiempo, yan junalala megae y tininajo guiya jago.
pairs.english: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usinangan y tininasmo, yan y satbasionmo todot dia: sa ti jutungo y minegaeña.
pairs.english: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jufalag y minetgot gui as Yuus, Jeova; ya jusangan y tininasmo, magajet, iyomoja namaesa.
pairs.english: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, jago jagasja fumanagüe yo desde y pinatgonjo; yan asta pago jusangan claro nii ninamanman y chechomo.
pairs.english: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago locue anae estayo bijo ya chungeyo, O Yuus chamoyo dumidingo: asta que jusangan claro nii minetgotmo y manmámamaela na generasion, yan y ninasiñamo cada uno ni ayo y ufanmato.
pairs.english: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y tinasmo locue, O Yuus, sumentaquilo; jagasja unfatinas y mandangculo na güinaja sija: O Yuus, jaye uparejumo?
pairs.english: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y fumanuejam mandangculo na pinite yan chinatsaga, siempre unnalâlâjam talo, yan unchulejam talo julo guinin y tinadong y tano.
pairs.english: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aumenta y dinangculoco; yan birajao ya unamamagofyo.
pairs.english: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo locue bae jualaba jao yan y guitala: magajet, y minagajetmo, O Yuusso: yyajago nae jucantaye yan y atpa, O jagoja na Santos guiya Israel.
pairs.english: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y labiosso sendangculo minagofña anae jucantayejao tinina; yan y antijo ni jago munalilibre.
pairs.english: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jilajo locue jasasangan y tininasmo todot dia: sa innafanmamajlao yan innafaninestotba ayo y umaliligao y dañujo.
pairs.english: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAE y ray ni juisiomo, O Yuus, yan y tininasmo gui lajin y ray.
pairs.english: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ufanjusga y taotaomo gui tininas, yan y mamoblemo gui juisio.
pairs.english: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y beca sija chumule y pas gui taotao yan y mandiquique na ogso sija pot y tininas.
pairs.english: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufanjusga y mamoble na taotao, güiya ufañatba y famaguon y mannesesitao, yan ufanyinamag y manmachaleg.
pairs.english: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanmaañao ni jago mientras gagaegue y atdao, yan y pilan gui todo y generasion yan y generasion.
pairs.english: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya tumunog papa taegüije y ichan gui jilo y manmautot na chaguan: taegüije minatmon janom ni y nafotgon y tano.
pairs.english: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaaniña sija, mumamta y tininas; ya y pas sumenmegae asta qui jocog y pilan.
pairs.english: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya uguaja minagasña locue guinin y tase asta y tase, yan guinin y sadog asta y uttimon y tano.
pairs.english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y mañasaga gui desierto, manecon gui menaña; ya y enimiguña sija mamanjojoflag gui eda.
pairs.english: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ray sija guiya Tarsis yan isla sija ufanmañuñule ninae: yan y ray sija guiya Sabá yan iya Seba ufanmannae ninae.
pairs.english: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet, y ray todos ujatomba sija gui menaña: yan y nasion todos usinetbe güe.
pairs.english: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya unalibre y nesesitao an jumagang; yan ayo locue y peble an ni y taya uinayuda.
pairs.english: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanmañotbla y mamoble yan y mannesesitao yan ujasatba y anten y mannesesitao.
pairs.english: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanlibre y antiñija guinin y chiniguit yan y finijom: yan ugagaebale y jâgâñija gui menan atadogña.
pairs.english: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya lumala, ya para güiya umanae ni y oron Sabá; ya y tinayuyut locue mafatitinas pot güiya todo y tiempo; sa sija ufanbendise güe todot dia.
pairs.english: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa uguaja megae na maies gui jalom y eda gui sanjilo y puntan y beca sija; ya y tinegchaña ufanmayengyong taegüije y Libano.; ya sija gui siuda ninafangatbo taegüije y chaguan gui eda.
pairs.english: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y naanña gagaegue para taejinecog: y naanña sisigueja taegüije y siniguen y atdao: yan todo y taotao ufandichoso guiya güiya; yan todo y nasion umafanaan güe dichoso.
pairs.english: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova Yuus, ni si Yuus Israel, sa güiyaja na maesa fumatinas y mannamanman na güinaja.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan bendito y minalag y naanmo para taejinecog: ya polo todo y tano ya ufanbula ni y minalagmo. Amen yan Amen.
pairs.english: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magpo y tinayuyut David ni y lajin Isai.
pairs.english: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SENMAGAJET si Yuus na mauleg para Israel, ni ayo sija y mangasgas na corason.
pairs.english: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo cánaja sumuja y adengjo; didideja tentenjan sulon y pinecatta.
pairs.english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jumalatgue y mangaduco, anae julie y minauleg y manaelaye.
pairs.english: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya pinite gui finataeñija: lao y minetgotñija fitme.
pairs.english: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya chinatsagañija taegüije y otro taotao sija; ni ufanmasapet taegüije y palo na taotao sija.
pairs.english: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina na sobetbia y cadena nii lisayon y cueyoñija; y finijom tumampe sija taegüije y magago.
pairs.english: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogñija mamachom ni y yinemog; guajañija mas qui y corason siña umalatgue.
pairs.english: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmanbotlelea, yan jasasangan chiniguit gui tinaelaye: jasasangan y mansentaquilo.
pairs.english: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo y pachotñija gui langet, yan y jilañija janafanmamocat gui inanaco y tano.
pairs.english: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y taotaoña manalo mague: yan y binilan y janom gui posuelo umafugo nu sija.
pairs.english: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Jaftaemano tungoña si Yuus? Ada guaja tiningo gui Gueftaquilo?
pairs.english: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa estagüe ya sija y manaelaye; ya sija manmegae gui tano, sa taya chinatsagañija todo y jaane.
pairs.english: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Senmagajet na taebale y junagasgas y corasonjo: yan jufagase y canaejo gui guinasgas.
pairs.english: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y inanaco y jaane chatsagayo, yan y castigojo cada ogaan.
pairs.english: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jagasja jualog, bae jusangan este; este na jagasja judague y generasion: y famaguonmo.
pairs.english: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jujaso jaftaemano na jutungo este, sumenmacat para guajo;
pairs.english: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta que jujalom gui sinantos na sagayan gui as Yuus; ya jujaso y uttimoñija.
pairs.english: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jago pumolo sija gui palagse na sagayan; jago yumute sija papa gui jalom y yinilang.
pairs.english: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaftaemano na ufanyinilang, gui un rato! sija chadig malimachae ni y minaañao sija.
pairs.english: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije güinife an magmata; taegüenaoja, O Señot, yaguin magmatajao, unchatlie y jechurañija.
pairs.english: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonjo estaba triste, ya matogchayo gui sumanjalom.
pairs.english: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na taegüije taejinasoyo, yan taetiningoyo: taegüijeyo y gâgâ gui menamo.
pairs.english: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja gagaegueyo siempre guiya jago; jago mumantiene y agapa na canaejo.
pairs.english: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umesgaejonyo ni y consejumo, ya despues unresibeyo gui langet.
pairs.english: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeyo guajayo gui langet sino jagoja? ya taya gui jilo y tano güinaeyaco, na jagoja.
pairs.english: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y catneco yan y corasonjo malachae: lao si Yuus y minetgot y corasonjo, yan y güinajajo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe ya ayo sija y mañago guiya jago, na ufanmalingo: jago yumulang todo ayo sija y manjanao guiya jago para inábale.
pairs.english: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mauleg para guajo y juguaguato jijot gui as Yuus: sa jupolo y inangococo gui Señot Jeova, para usiña jusangan todo y chechomo.
pairs.english: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, sajafa na unyutejam para taejinecog? sajafa na y linalomo umasgon contra y quinilo sija gui pastajimo?
pairs.english: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y inetnonmo ni y unfajan gui ampmam na tiempo; y tribon y erensiamo, ni y jago sumatba; yan y egso Sion, anae sumasagajao.
pairs.english: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa y adengmo para taejinecog na yinilang: sa y enimigo jafatinas y tinaelaye todo gui jalom y sinantos na sagamo.
pairs.english: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y contrariumo sija manaagang gui entalo y inetnonmo; ya japolo julo y banderañija para señat sija.
pairs.english: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y taotao y jajatsa julo y gachae sija gui jilo y chemchom na trongco jayo sija.
pairs.english: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago sija yumute papa y binetda na chocho un biajeja, ni y gachae yan y mattiyo sija.
pairs.english: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija sumanggüe y sinantos na sagamo, yan munainale y sagan y naanmo, sanpapa gui tano.
pairs.english: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija gui corasonñija: Nije tayulang sija ni mandaño: ya sija sumonggue todo y sinagogan Yuus gui tano.
pairs.english: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti talie y señatta sija: ya taya ni uno profeta mas: ni uguaja sija ni utiningo asta ngaean.
pairs.english: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean, O Yuus, nae y contrario ulalatde? ya y enimigo ufañatfino contra y naanmo para taejinecog?
pairs.english: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa na unjedo y canaemo, junggan y agapa na canaemo? jala juyong gui pechomo ya unyulang.
pairs.english: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus y Rayjo gui ampmam na tiempo, jafatitinas y satbasion gui entalo y tano.
pairs.english: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago dumibide y tase ni y ninasiñamo: jago yumamag y ilon y alo sija gui tase.
pairs.english: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ni y dadao na güijan, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumaba y matan janom yan y minilalag: jago munafananglo y manmetgot na sadog sija.
pairs.english: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane iyomo, y puenge locue iyomo: jago fumamauleg y inina yan y atdao.
pairs.english: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo todo y oriyan y tano: jago fumatinas y tiempon maepe yan y tiempom manengjeng.
pairs.english: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso este, na y enimigo manmalalatde, O Jeova, ya ayo y mangaduco na taotao jachatfino y naanmo.
pairs.english: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, chamo umintrerega y anten y gamo paluma gui dadao na gâgâ: chamo malelefa ni y dinaña y mamoblemo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Respeta y trato: sa y jemjom na sagayan sija gui tano manbula y sagan y manmalamaña.
pairs.english: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, Chamo munafanatalo manmamajlao y manmachichiguit: polo y mamoble yan y mannesesitao ya umalalaba y naanmo.
pairs.english: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Yuus, gogüe y causamo: jaso jaftaemano y manaejinaso na taotao ni y lumalatdejao cada jaane.
pairs.english: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo malelefa ni y inangang y contrariumo sija; y borucan ayo sija y mangajulo contra jago, lumala cajuloja siesiempre.
pairs.english: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YYAJAGO, O Yuus, innae grasia; iyajago innae grasia sa y naanmo esta jijot: sa y ninamanman na chechomo masasangan.
pairs.english: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ngaean nae jusoda y tiempo na mamatca, bae jujusga ni y tinas.
pairs.english: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano yan todo y mañasaga mamalachae: guajo chumuchule julo y jaliguiña. Sila.
pairs.english: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ileco ni y mansobetbio: Chamiyo fumatitinas y sinebetbio: yan ni y manaelaye, chamiyo jumajatsa julo y canggelon.
pairs.english: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumajatsa y canggelonmiyo gui taquilo; chamiyo fanguecuentos ni y tiso na tongjo.
pairs.english: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinatsa ni y ufato ni y guinin y sancatan, ni y guinin y sanlichan, ni y guinin y sajaya.
pairs.english: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus y jues: güiya pumolo papa uno, yan jajatsa julo otro.
pairs.english: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegue gui canae Jeova y copa, yan y bino ni lalálalo; bula dinaña, ya jachuda juyong taeguijeja; lao y asiento gui fondoña, todo y manaelaye gui tano jafufugo ya jaguiguimen sija.
pairs.english: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo bae jusangan claro para taejinecog; ya bae jucantaye si Yuus Jacob, y alabansa sija.
pairs.english: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y canggelon y manaelaye locue bae juutot: lao y canggelon y manunas umanafangajulo.
pairs.english: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MATUNGO si Yuus esta guiya Juda: y naanña manadangculo guiya Israel.
pairs.english: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya Salem nae gaegue y tabetnacoluña, ya y sagaña gaegue guiya Sion.
pairs.english: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jayamag sija y flechan y atcos; yan y patang yan y espada, yan y guera. Sila.
pairs.english: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malagjao yan magas jao mas qui y tadong na jalomtano.
pairs.english: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmajetog na corason manmayulang manafanaelaye; esta jamaego y minaegoñija; ya taya ni un taotao ni y gaeninasiña jasoda y canaeñija.
pairs.english: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y chinemamo, O Yuus Jacob, todo careta yan y cabayo manmayute gui minaego y finatae.
pairs.english: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago, junggan jago, para unamaañao: ya jaye siña tumogue gui menamo yan lalalojao?
pairs.english: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munamajungog y sentensia guinin y langet; ya y tano manmaañao, ya manmamatquilo.
pairs.english: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Yuus jacajulo gui juisio, para usatba todo y manmanso gui tano. Sila.
pairs.english: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na y binibon y taotao uinalabajao: yan y seblan y binibo, jago sumoma.
pairs.english: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Promete ya inapase si Jeova ni y Yuusmiyo: todo ayo y mangaegue gui oriyaña manmañuñule ninae para güiya ni y namaañao.
pairs.english: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munamautut y espiriton y prinsipe sija: sa güiya y namaañao para y ray sija gui tano.
pairs.english: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE juagang si Yuus ni y inagangjo; magajet na si Yuus ni y inagangjo; ya güiya jumungogyo.
pairs.english: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane y chinatsagaco jualigao y Señot: y canaejo maestira gui puenge ya pumapara: y antijo ti malago manamagof.
pairs.english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso, si Yuus ya janaestotbayo: umuugongyo, sa y espiritujo lalalango. Sila.
pairs.english: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago unadaje y atadogjo ni taemaego: sa taegüije chatsagayo na ti siñayo cumuentos.
pairs.english: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo jujajaso y jaane ni y ampmam manmalofan, yan y sacan ni y ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso y cantaco gui puenge: jujajaso ni y corasonjo; ya y espiritujo guine guefaligao?
pairs.english: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada uyute y Señot para taejinecog? ya ti utalo y finaboresiña?
pairs.english: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cao y minaaseña usenjanaoja para taejinecog? ya y promesaña ufanlingo para taejinecog?
pairs.english: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malefa si Yuus na uyóase? ya pot y linalaloña na jajuchom y güinaeyaña? Sila.
pairs.english: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ileco: Este y dinafejo: lao bae jujaso y sacan sija gui agapa na canae y Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusangan y checho Jeova: sa bae jujaso y ninamanmanmo gui ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jujaso locue todo y chechomo, yan jusangan sumanjalomjo y finatinasmo.
pairs.english: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo, O Yuus, gague gui sinantos na sagayan: jaye dangculo na yuus calang y Yuusta?
pairs.english: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago y Yuus ni y fumatinas y mannamanman: jago munamatungo y minetgotmo gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yan y canaemo munafanlibre y taotaomo; ni y famaguon Jacob yan José. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y janom malie jao, O Yuus, y janom malie jao, ya sija ninafanmaañao: ya y tinadong locue ninafanmayengyong.
pairs.english: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mapagajes sija manmañuñuda janom: ya y langet mannae y inagang: ya y flechamo locue manjanao juyong.
pairs.english: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palampan y jilumo estaba gui remolino; ya y lamlam maniiina gui tano: ya y tano manmayengyong yan manlalaolao.
pairs.english: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chalanmo gui tase, ya y finaposmo gui mandangculo na janom, ya y guinachamo ti matungo.
pairs.english: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umesgaejon y taotaomo taegüije y manadang quinilo pot y canae Moises yan Aaron.
pairs.english: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ECUNGOG, O taotaojo, y tinagojo: na inecungog ni y talanganmo y sinangan y pachotto.
pairs.english: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jubaba y pachotto gui acomparasion: bae jusangan sinangan na gui jemjom gui ampmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayosija ni y injingog yan y intingo, yan y tatanmame ni jasanganejam.
pairs.english: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti innafanatog sija guinin y famaguonñija, masangangane y generasion ni y manmamamaela ni y tinina sija gui Señot, yan y minetgotña yan y mannamanman na chechoña ni y jachogüe.
pairs.english: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya munacajulo y testimonio gui as Jacob, yan japolo tinago guiya Israel, ni y janatungo sija y famaguonñija.
pairs.english: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujatungo y generasion ni y manmamamaela, y famaguonja ni y finañagonñija; ni y ufangajulo ya ujasangane y famaguonñija.
pairs.english: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña japolo y ninanggañija gui as Yuus, ya ti ufanmalefa ni y checho Yuus, lao jaadaje y tinagoña sija.
pairs.english: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chañija fanaegüigüije y tatañija; un generasion ni managuaguat yan ti manmalago manmanosgue: y generasion ni y ti japolo y corasonñija gui tinas, yan ayo na espirituñija y ti manfitme gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguon Efraim, guaja atmas yan manmañule y atcos sija, manalo tate gui jaanen y guera.
pairs.english: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jaadaje y traton Yuus, ya ti manmalago na ufanmamocat gui tinagoña.
pairs.english: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalefa ni y chechoña, yan y ninamanmanña ni y manfinanue sija.
pairs.english: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namanman na güinaja finatinasña gui menan y tatañija, gui tano Egipto, gui fangualuan Soan.
pairs.english: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadebide y tase ya janafanmalofan gui inanaco sija todo; yan janafañaga y janom taegüije y monton.
pairs.english: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaane janafanenesgaegaejonja ni y mapagajes; yan todo puenge y finañila y guafe.
pairs.english: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japanag y acho gue desierto, ya janae sija na ufanguinem taegüije na jumuyong guinin y dangculon tinadong.
pairs.english: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañule minilalag locue guinin y acho, yan janafalalago y janom taegüije y sadog.
pairs.english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao trabia sisigueja mas isagüegüe, ya manmanembeste contra Gueftaquilo gui desierto.
pairs.english: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jatienta si Yuus gui corasonñija, yan mangagagao catne pot y güinaeyañija.
pairs.english: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na sija manguentos contra si Yuus; ilegñija: Ada siña si Yuus jafamaulequejit lamasa gui desierto?
pairs.english: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, na anae japanag y acho, manjuyong y janom, ya y minilalag manmachuchuda. Ada siña güe manae pan locue? umafamauleg catne para y taotaoña?
pairs.english: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae jajungog este, y Señot ninabubo: ya umasonggue y guafe contra as Jacob, yan y linalalo locue cajulo contra Israel;
pairs.english: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jajonggue si Yuus, yan ti jaangoco sija gui satbasionña.
pairs.english: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya tumago y mapagajes guinin y sanjilo; yan jababa y pettan langet.
pairs.english: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janauchan papa y mana gui jiloñija para ujacano, yan janae sija ni y maies y langet.
pairs.english: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao cumano y na y manmetgot: güiya numae sija catne para ufanjaspog.
pairs.english: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago y manglo sancatan na ufanguaefe gui jalom y langet: yan pot y ninasiñaña jachachalane y manglo sanjaya.
pairs.english: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janauchan catne locue gui jiloñija taegüije y petbos; yan y pajaro ni gaepapa taegüije inae gui tase;
pairs.english: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo ayo sija na ufanbasnag gui entalo y campoñija, ya gui oriyan y sagañija.
pairs.english: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jacano, ya mangosjaspog sija; sa güiya numae sija ni y tinangañiñija.
pairs.english: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ti janajanao guiya sija y tinangañija; lao estabaja trabia y catneñija gui jalom y pachotñija,
pairs.english: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y binibon Yuus mato gui jiloñija, ya japuno y mas manyomog guiya sija, yan jayute papa y patgon na taotao sija guiya Israel.
pairs.english: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao contodo este, sigueja di maaiisao trabia: yan ti majonggue y mamnamanman na chochoña.
pairs.english: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na y jaaneñija janafanlinachae ni y banidá; yan y sacanñija gui minaañao.
pairs.english: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae japuno sija, ayo nae manafaesen pot güiya yan jabira sija ya maaligao guse si Yuus.
pairs.english: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and inquired early after God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jajaso na si Yuus y achoñija, yan y Gueftaquilo na Yuus y Satbadotñija.
pairs.english: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja ujafaande güe ni y pachotñija yan ujadague ni y jilañija.
pairs.english: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonñija ti tunas guiya güiya: ni ufanfitme gui tratuña.
pairs.english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jajatsa sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajaso na sija catneja; y manglo na malofan ya mapos ya ti mamaela talo.
pairs.english: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cuanto biaje manmanembeste contra güiya gui jalomtano yan manatriste güe gui desierto!
pairs.english: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manalo tate ya matienta si Yuus; ya macase y Santosgüe guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jajaso y canaeña; ni jaane anae ninafanlibre gui contrario.
pairs.english: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pineloña na señatña guiya Egipto: yan y ninamanmanña gui fangualuan Soan:
pairs.english: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jatulaeca y Sadog janajâgâ; yan y minilalag para chañija fanguiguimen.
pairs.english: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae megae na lalo para ufanquinano; yan rana sija para ufanyinilang.
pairs.english: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae y ilo oruga ni y aumentan tano; ya y finachochoñija y apacha.
pairs.english: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayulang y fangualuanñija ubas ni y ichan grano; yan y trongco igos sija ni y hielo.
pairs.english: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japolo y gañija gâgâ locue gui papa y ichan grano, ya y manadan gañija gui minaepen lamlam.
pairs.english: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute gui jiloñija y fijom na binibuña; binibo, linalalo, yan chinatsaga; y manadan manaelaye na angjet sija.
pairs.english: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamatinas chalan para y linalaloña; ya ti jachoma y antiñija guinin y finatae, lao japolo y linâlâñija gui peste.
pairs.english: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno todo y finenena na finañagon guiya Egipto, y mas magas naminetgotñija gui jalom y tiendan Cam!
pairs.english: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao chalane juyong y taotaoña taegüije y quinilo sija, yan jaesgagaejon sija gui desierto taegüije y manadan, gâgâ.
pairs.english: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule sija gui seguro, ya sija ti manmaañao: lao y tase tumampe y enimigoñija.
pairs.english: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija asta y oriyan y sinantos na sagaña, güineja na ogso ni y guinanan y agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute juyong y nasion locue gui menañija, yan jafacae guiya sija y erensiañija ya jaraya, ya janafañaga y tribon Israel gui jalom y tiendañija.
pairs.english: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija trabia jatietentaja, yan manmanembebesteja contra y Gueftaquilo na Yuus, yan ti jaadaje y tinagoña.
pairs.english: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manalo tate, yan manmafatinas dinague taegüije y tatañija: ya manmabira sija gui un banda taegüije y dacon na atco.
pairs.english: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa macase güe ya mannalalalo pot y sagañija ni taquilo ya masuog güe ya manafanugo ni y imageñija ni tinaga.
pairs.english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog este si Yuus, ninabubo, yan jagoschatlie iya Israel.
pairs.english: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot ayo na jadingo y tabetnaculo guiya Silo, yan y tienda ni y japolo gui entalo taotao sija.
pairs.english: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janae ni y minetgotña y cautibo, ya y minalagña gui canae y contrario.
pairs.english: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janae y espada ni y taotaoña: yan ninabubo ni y erensiaña.
pairs.english: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linachae ni y guafe y manpatgon na lalaje; ya y manpatgon na famalaoan taya cantan umasagua.
pairs.english: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mamaleñija manmodong gui espada; ya y manbiuda sija ti ninafantriste.
pairs.english: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot magmata taegüije y uno ni y guinin mamaego, yan taegüije y matatñga na taotao ni y ninaaagang pot rason di y bino.
pairs.english: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno y enimiguña sija ni y mañasaga gui santate: yan japolo sija güi taejinecog na minamajlao.
pairs.english: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ademas jarechasa y tabetnaculo gui as José, ya ti jaayeg y tribon Efraim.
pairs.english: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaayeg tribon Juda, ayo ogso Sion ni y güinaeyaña.
pairs.english: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas y sinantos na sagaña taegüije y manaquilo na sagayan sija, taegüije y tano na japlanta para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaayeg si David locue na tentagoña, yan jacone güe guinin y quelat y quinilo,
pairs.english: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jacone sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije janafañocho sija segun y tininas y corasonña; yan jaesgaejon sija pot y tiningon y canaeña.
pairs.english: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: mayulang sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tataotao y manmatae na tentagomo manmanae nañija y pajaro gui langet: ya y catnen y mañantosmo y gâgâ gui tano.
pairs.english: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jâgâñija manmachuda taegüije y janom, gui oriyan Jerusalem; sa taya jaye ufanjinafog.
pairs.english: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manafanmamamajlaojam ni y tiguangmame: manmamofeajam yan manmabotleajam ni y mañasaga gui oriyanmame.
pairs.english: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean, O Señot, unlalalo para taejinecog? ya y inigomo sinenggue taegüije y guafe?
pairs.english: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chuda juyong y binibumo gui jilo y nasion ni y ti tumungojao, yan y jilo y raeno sija ni y ti umaagan y naanmo.
pairs.english: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija lumachae si Jacob, yan jayulang y sagañija.
pairs.english: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo jumajaso contra jame y tinaelayen y tatamname: Polo y minauleg minaasemo ya uchadig insedajam; sa manafangostagpapjamam.
pairs.english: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayudajam, O Yuus, gui satbasionmame pot y minalag y naanmo; yan nafanlibrejam, yan fagase y isaomame pot y naanmo.
pairs.english: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa ilegñija y nasion ni ti manmanjonggue: Mangue y Yuusñija? Polo y inemog y jâgâ y tentagomo sija ni y manmachuda ya umatungo ni y nasion ni ti manmanjonggue, gui menan y matanmame.
pairs.english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y inigon y manmapreso mato gui menamo; segun y dinangculo y ninasiñamo adaje ayo sija y esta manmatancho para ufanmatae.
pairs.english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya apase gui tiguangmame siete mas gui jalom y pechoñija, y linalatdeñija, sa sija lumalatdejao, O Señot.
pairs.english: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jame y taotaomo yan y quinilo gui pastajimo, bae inalaba jao para taejinecog; ya infanmamanue ni y alabansamo para todo y generasion.
