pairs.english: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ECUNGOG, O Pastot guiya Israel, jago ni y umesgagaejon si José taegüije y manadan quinilo; jago ni y sumasaga gui entalo y querubin sija manina mona.
pairs.english: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y menan Efraim, yan Benjamin, yan Manases, nacajulo y minatatngamo, ya maelajao para usatbajam.
pairs.english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Yuus; ya nafanina y matamo ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, asta ngaean unlálalaloja contra y tinayuyut y taotaomo?
pairs.english: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unafañochocho sija ni y pan lago; yan unnae sija ni y lago para ujaguinem gui dangculo na medida.
pairs.english: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnafanmumojam yan y tiguangmame: yan y enimigonmame manmachachatgue jam gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Yuus y inetnon sendalo, ya nafanina y matamo; ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumule juyong y trongcon ubas guiya Egipto: ya jagasja unyute juyong y nasion, ya untanme güe.
pairs.english: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago fumamauleg y saga gui menaña, ya güiya y natadodong y jaleña, yan nabula y tano.
pairs.english: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sabana sija mantinampe ni y aninengña, yan y ramasña taegüije y sedro Yuus na trongcon jayo.
pairs.english: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago juyong y ramasña gui tase; yan y manlodo na siniso gui sadog.
pairs.english: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa unjulog papa y quelatña: ya todo y manmalolofan gui chalan matitife güe?
pairs.english: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y balaco guinin y jalomtano machuchule ya mayúyulang, yan y manmachaleg na gâgâ gui fangualuan cumacano.
pairs.english: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajao talo, O Yuus inentnon sendalo, ingagagao jao: ya talag papa guinin y langet ya unlie yan unbisita este na trongcon ubas,
pairs.english: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fangualuan ni y tinanom y agapa na canaemo, yan y ramas ni jago munafitme para jagoja namaesa,
pairs.english: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masinenggue ni y guafe, ya mautut papa esta; ya manmalingo pot y chinema gui menamo.
pairs.english: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y canaemo gui jilo y taotao gui agapa na canaemo, gui jilo y lajin y taotao ni unnametgot para jago.
pairs.english: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ti infanalo tate guinin jago: nafanlâlâjam ya bae inagang y naanmo.
pairs.english: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam talo, O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, ya nafanina y matamo; ya infansatbo.
pairs.english: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANGANTA agang gui as Yuus ni y minetgotta: fatinas y magof na boruca gui as Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entona y salmo, yan chule mague y pandireta; yan y magof na atpa yan y guitala.
pairs.english: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaefe y trompeta gui tiempo y nuebo na pulan, gui tiempon gualafon na pulan, gui jaanen y guipot magas.
pairs.english: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este lay guiya Israel: yan y tinago Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas este as José para untestimonio anae jumanao juyong gui inanaco y tano Egipto: anae jujungog y finijo na ti siña jutungo.
pairs.english: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y apagaña guinin y catga: yan y canaeña manalibre guinin y lauya.
pairs.english: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umaagan gui chinatsaga, ya guajo munalibrejao: guajo umopejao gui umatog na sagayan julo: ya juchaguejao gui oriyan janom guiya Meriba. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O taotaojo, ya guajo junae jao testimonio, O Israel, yaguin malagojao unecungogyo!
pairs.english: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Munga otro yuus, guiya jago; ni unadora otro yuus.
pairs.english: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo y Jeova Yuusmo, ni y chumule jao juyong gui tano Egipto: baba y pachotmo, ya bae nabula.
pairs.english: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotaojo ti jajungog y inagangjo; ya iya Israel ti malago ni guajo.
pairs.english: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jupolo sija ya jumanao ni y minajetog y corasonñija: para ufanmamomocat ni y pinagatñija.
pairs.english: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O yaguin y taotaojo majungog yo, ya iya Israel manmamocat gui chalanjo!
pairs.english: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña guse juchoma y enimigoñija, ya jubira y canaejo contra y contrarioñija.
pairs.english: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y umanmachatlie ni y Jeova, mojon mansujeto sija guiya güiya: y tiempoñija usaga para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafañocho sija locue ni y mas mauleg na trigo: yan y miet ni jumujuyong gui acho anae junajaspog jao.
pairs.english: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Yuus tumotojgue gui inetnon Yuus; ya jajusga gui entalo yuus sija.
pairs.english: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean nae unjusga ti tunas, yan unresibe y taotao sija ni y manaelaye? Sila.
pairs.english: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusga y mamoble yan y manaesaena: ya nafanunas y manpinite yan y mannesesitao.
pairs.english: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescata mamoble yan y mannesesitao: nafanlibre sija gui canae y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jatungo ni ujaquetungo: manmamomocatja gui jalom jomjom: ya todo y plinantan tano manalamten.
pairs.english: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ileco: Jamyo yuus; yan todo jamyo y famaguon y Gueftaquilo.
pairs.english: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao infanmataeja taegüije y taotao sija, yan infanbasnag taegüije y uno gui prinsipe sija.
pairs.english: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Yuus, jusga y tano: sa jago umerensia todo y nasion.
pairs.english: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO famatquiquilo, O Yuus: ya chamo tiumaagan yan chamo quequeto, O Yuus.
pairs.english: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, enimigumo na manpalalangpang: yan ayo sija y chumatlie jao jajatsa y iloñija.
pairs.english: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manpinagat ni y dinague consejo contra y taotaomo, yan manafaesen entre sija contra y ninafanatogmo.
pairs.english: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin ilegñija: Maela, ya nije tautut sija ni y guinin y nasion; para y naan Israel munga majaso mas.
pairs.english: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija manafaesen entre sija ni y unoja corason; ya managogüe contra jago.
pairs.english: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tiendan Edom yan Ismaelita sija: Moab yan Agareno sija.
pairs.english: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gebal yan Ammon yan Amaleg; Filistia yan y mañasaga guiya Tiro.
pairs.english: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asur locue mandaña yan sija: sa maninayuda ni y famaguon Lot. Sila.
pairs.english: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas guiya sija taegüije unfatinas iya Madian yan taegüije iya Sisara taegüije iya Jabin jijot gui sadog Sison:
pairs.english: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmalingo guiya Endor: manjuyong manaegüije y estiecot para y tano.
pairs.english: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas y magasñija ya parejo yan Oreb yan Seeb; magajet na todo y prinsipeñija parejo yan Sebah yan Salmuna:
pairs.english: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y ilegñija: Nije jitaja tachule y sagayan para iyotaja.
pairs.english: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuusso, fatinas sija ya ufanparejo yan y petbos ni y remolílino; parejo yan y ngasan trigo gui menan y manglo;
pairs.english: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y guafe anae jasonggue y jalomtano, yan taegüije y mañila anae finaliñagüe y sabana.
pairs.english: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijija petsigue sija ni y pagyomo, yan nafanmaañao sija ni y dangculon pinagyomo.
pairs.english: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nabula y matañija ni y dinesonra: para sija ujaaligao y naanmo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ufanmamajlao yan ufanmaañao para taejinecog: magajet na sija ufandesonrao, ya ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujatungo na jagoja y naanmo si Jeova, na jagoja y Gueftaquilo gui jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAGÜINAEYAYON y sagamo, O Señot y inetnon sendalo!
pairs.english: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo tumatanga, magajet na asta ninamalango pot y sagan y Jeova: y corasonjo yan y catneco agagange y lâlâlâ na Yuus.
pairs.english: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet y gorrión mañoda gumaña, yan y golondrina chenchonña para güiya, anae siña mapolo y famaguonña, esta y jalom y attatmo, O Señot y inetnon sendalo, Rayjo yan Yuusso.
pairs.english: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija y mañasaga gui jalom y guimamo; sa sigueja di malabajao:
pairs.english: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y minetgotña gaegue guiya jago: yan y chalan para jago gaegue gui corasonña.
pairs.english: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae janafanmalofan gui inanaco bayen tinangis jafatinase tupo sija; ya y taftaf na ichan locue tinampe ni y bendision.
pairs.english: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: otro sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, jungog y tinayuyutto: ecungog, O Yuus Jacob. Sila.
pairs.english: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lie, O Yuus, patangmame: ya atan y matan y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y un jaane gui sagamo mas mauleg qui un mit. Gañacoja na jupottero gui guima y Yuusso, qui jusaga gui jalom y sagan y manaelaye.
pairs.english: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Jeova Yuus, güiya y atdao yan y patang: si Jeova unfannae grasia yan minalag: ti jachoma y manmauleg na güinaja ni y mammamomocat gui tininas.
pairs.english: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Señot y inetnon sendalo, dichoso y taotao ni y umangoco güe guiya jago.
pairs.english: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA, jago guinin ninamagof jao ni y tanomo: sa unnafanalo mague y manmacautiba sija gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago guinin umasie y tinaelayen y taotaomo: yan untampe todo y isaoñija. Sila.
pairs.english: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin unnajanao todo y binibumo: ya unbirajao talo guinin y finijom y binibumo.
pairs.english: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Birajam, O Yuus, gui satbasionmame, yan nabasta y binibumo guiya jame.
pairs.english: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada unlalalaloja nu jame para taejinecog? Ada unnajujuyong y linâlâlomo para todo y generasion?
pairs.english: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti unnalâlâjam talo: para y taotaomo ufanmagof ni jago?
pairs.english: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanuejam ni y minaasemo, O Jeova, ya unnaejam ni y satbasionmo.
pairs.english: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jujungog jafa usangan si Yuus Jeova: sa güiya usangan y pas gui taotaoña, yan y mañantos sija: lao chañija natalo guato gui binaba.
pairs.english: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na y satbasionña esta jijot güije sija ni manmaañao nu güiya: para y minalag usaga gui tanomame.
pairs.english: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Minaase yan minagajet manásoda ya mandaña: y tininas yan y pas manachico.
pairs.english: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minagajet lacho julo gui tano; yan y tininas jaatan papa guinin y langet.
pairs.english: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na si Jeova numae ni y minauleg: ya y tanota manae minegaeña.
pairs.english: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tininas jumajanao gui menaña; yan japolo y pinecatña y chalan para ufamocat.
pairs.english: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: NAEGUENG papa y talangamo, O Jeova, ya unopeyo: sa pobleyo yan nesesitaoyo.
pairs.english: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje y antijo; sa debotoyo: O jago ni y Yuusso, nalibre y tentagomo sa jaangoco gue guiya jago.
pairs.english: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaease nu guajo, O Jeova: sa juaagang jao todot dia.
pairs.english: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Namagof y anten y tentagomo; sa iya jago, O Jeova, nae jujatsa julo y antijo.
pairs.english: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, y mauleg yan y chadig manasie; yan dangculo y minaasemo güije todo gui umaagangjao.
pairs.english: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungog, O Señot y tinayuyutto: yan ecungog y inagang y guinagagaojo.
pairs.english: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanen y chinatsagaco juagangjao: ya jago y unopeyo.
pairs.english: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y entalo y yuus sija, taya taegüenao iya jago, O Jeova; ni jafa na chocho parejo yan y chechomo.
pairs.english: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y nasion sija ni y finatinasmo, manmato y manmanadora gui menamo, O Jeova; yan ufanalaba y naanmo.
pairs.english: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago dangculojao yan unfatitinas y manmaman na güinaja: jagoja na maesa Yuus.
pairs.english: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jinason sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jualaba jao, O Jeova, Yuusso, contodo y corasonjo: yan junamalag y naanmo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sendangculo y minaasemo para guajo; sa guinin unnalibre y antijo guinin iya papapa guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, y mansobetbio mangajulo contra guajo, yan y inetnon y managuaguat na taotao jagasja maaliligao y antijo: yan ti mapolo jao gui menañija.
pairs.english: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, si Yuus jao ni y bila minaase yan cariñoso, ñateng para binibo yan dangculo na minaase yan minagajet.
pairs.english: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O birajao, guiya guajo ya gaease nu guajo: nae ni y minetgotmo y tentagomo, yan nalibre y lajin y tentagomo palaoan.
pairs.english: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanueyo ni y señat para y mauleg: para ujalie ayo sija y chumatliiyo ya ufanmamajlao: sa jago, Jeova, y umayudayo yan cumonsuelayo.
pairs.english: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YPLINANTAÑA gaegue gui santos na ogso.
pairs.english: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaguaeyaña si Jeova y trangca Sion mas que todo y saga sija gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalag na güinaja y manmasasangan guiya jago, O siuda Yuus. Sila.
pairs.english: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo bae jusangan ni y Rahab yan Babilonia gui entalo ayo sija ni y tumunogyo: Sa, estagüe, Palestina yan Tiro yan Etiopia: este na taotao mafañagon güije.
pairs.english: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan iya Sion ualog: Este yan ayo na taotao mafañagon iya güiya: yan y Gueftaquilo namaesa unafitmegüe.
pairs.english: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeovaja tumufong anae jatugue sija y taotao, na esta na taotao mafañagon güije. Sila.
pairs.english: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ufangaegue güije: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus satbasionjo, güajo guinin umaagan jaane yan puenge gui menamo:
pairs.english: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tinayuyutto ya ufato gui menamo: naegueng y talangamo gui inagangjo.
pairs.english: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y antijo bula chinatsaga sija: ya y linâlâjo esta jijot gui para y naftan.
pairs.english: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estayo matufong yan ayo sija y manjajanao papa gui joyo: sa taegüije yo y taotao ni y taya ayudaña.
pairs.english: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mayute esta gui entalo y manmatae, taegüije y manmapuno ni y manaason jalom y naftan; ni y ti unjajaso mas: ni y manmautut guinin y canaemo.
pairs.english: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumoloyo guiya papapa na joyo, gui jalom jomjom na lugat gui jalom y tinadong.
pairs.english: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y binibumo sumasaga macat guiya güajo, ya unachatsagayo nu y todo napomo. Sila.
pairs.english: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago munafanjanao lachago y manatungojo guiya guajo; unpoloyo na jumachatlie nu sija: mapongleyo ya ti siñayo manajanao.
pairs.english: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo ninalachae pot y pinitijo: ya juagangjajao, O Jeova, cada jaane, jujuto juyong y canaejo guiya jago.
pairs.english: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada unnamalie y ninamanman gui manmatae? Siña y manmatae mangajulo ya unmaalaba? Sila.
pairs.english: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña y minauleg güinaeyamo masangan gui jalom y naftan? pat y minagajetmo gui yinilang?
pairs.english: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Siña y ninamanmanmo matungo gui jalom jomjom? yan y tininasmo gui jalom tano ni y manmalefa?
pairs.english: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo iya jago, O Jeova, umaagangyo: yan ogaan tinayuyutto ufato gui menamo.
pairs.english: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa, O Jeova, na unyute y antijo? Sajafa na unnaatog y matamo guinin iya guajo?
pairs.english: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gofchatsaga tristeyo yan cana yo matae, desde y pinatgonjo: mientras jususungon y minamaañaomo, ya janagosestotbayo.
pairs.english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fijom na binibumo malofan guiya guajo: ya y minamaañaomo umututyo.
pairs.english: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manmato gui oriyajo todot dia taegüije y janom: mandaña gui oriyajo.
pairs.english: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y güinaeyaco yan y amigujo unnafañago guiya guajo, yan y manatungojo gui jalom jomjom.
pairs.english: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE jucanta y minaase Jeova para taejinecog: ya y pachotto nae junamatungo y minagajetmo gui todo y generasion.
pairs.english: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ileco: Y minaase umanacajulo para taejinecog: ya y minagajetmo unnafitme todo gui langet.
pairs.english: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jufatinas y trato gui inayegco, yan manjulayo gui as David ni y tentagojo.
pairs.english: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyamo junafitme para taejinecog: ya jufatinas julo y tronumo gui todo y generasion. Sila.
pairs.english: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y langet sija ufanmanalaba ni y ninamanmanmo, O Jeova: y minagajetmo locue gui inetnon y mañantos.
pairs.english: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaye gui langet sija siña parejuña si Jeova? Jaye gui lajin y gaeninasiña uparejuña si Jeova?
pairs.english: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, gosnamaañao gui pinagat y mañantos, yan umamaanaogüe güe mas qui todo ni ayo sija y mangaegue gui oriyaña.
pairs.english: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo, jaye matatnga parejo yan jago, O YAH? ya y minagajetmo ni y gaegue gui oriyamo?
pairs.english: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umaregla y sobetbian tase: anae y napo mangajulo, jago pumoca sija.
pairs.english: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago yumamag iya Rahab ya unfapidaso taegüije y uno ni y mapuno; jago chumalapon y enimigumo ni y canae y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet sija iyomo, yan yo tano locue iyomo: y tano yan y binilan sinajguanña ni y plinantamo sija.
pairs.english: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sanlago yan y sanjaya, jago fumatinas sija: Tabor yan Hermon manmagof ni y naanmo.
pairs.english: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaegue guiya jago y canae ni y matatnga: sa y canaemo metgot, ya taquilo y agapa na canaemo.
pairs.english: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininas yan y juisio y plinantan tronumo: minaase yan minagajet manjajanao gui menan metamo.
pairs.english: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo na taotao y tumungo y magof na inagang: sa manmamocat gui mananan y matamo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y naanmo nae manmamagof todot dia: yan y tininasmo nae munafangajulo.
pairs.english: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago y minalag y minetgotñija: yan pot y finaboresimo na injatsajulo y canggelonmame.
pairs.english: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iyon Jeova y patangta: yan y rayta iyon Ayo na Santos guiya Israel.
pairs.english: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae unsangan gui guinigüife gui mañantosmo, ya ilegmo: guajo jupolo y inayuda gui jilo y uno ni y matatnga: yan junacajulo y uno na y maayeg gui taotao.
pairs.english: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusoda si David na tentagojo; ya jupalae güe nu y santos na lañajo.
pairs.english: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya y canaejo munafitme: yan y canaejoja locue munametgot güe:
pairs.english: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y enimigo taeinamot guiya güiya: ni y lajin y manaelaye ti umanalamen güe.
pairs.english: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae juyute papa y contrarioña gui menaña yan jucastiga ayo sija y chumatlie güe.
pairs.english: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minagajetto yan y minaasejo usaga guiya güiya: yan pot y naanjo na umanacajulo y canggelonña.
pairs.english: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya bae jupolo y canaeña locue gui jalom tase, yan y agapa na canaeña gui jalom sadog.
pairs.english: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya umalog ni guajo: Jago y tatajo, Yuusso, yan y acho gui satbasionjo.
pairs.english: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jupolo güe locue pot finenana na finañagujo, mas taquiloña qui y ray sija gui tano.
pairs.english: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaasejo bae juadaje pot güiya para taejinecog, yan y tratujo ufitme guiya güiya.
pairs.english: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y semiyaña locue junasaga para ugaegue taejinecog, yan y tronuña taegüije y jaanen y langet.
pairs.english: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin famaguonña dumingo y tinagojo, yan ti manmamomocat gui juisioco,
pairs.english: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin maquebranta y layjo yan ti maadaje y tinagojo;
pairs.english: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jufatoegüe gui inaguaguatñija yan y bara, ya jusaulag gui tinaelayeñija.
pairs.english: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minaasejo ti junajanao todo guiya güiya: ya ti jupolo na ufatta y minagajetto.
pairs.english: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tratujo ti juquebranta ni jutolaeca y sinanganjo ni jumuyong gui labiosso.
pairs.english: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un biajeja jufanjula pot y sinantosso ya ti judague si David.
pairs.english: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y semiyaña gagaegue para taejinecog, yan y tronuña taegüijeja y atdao gui menajo.
pairs.english: His seed shall endure forever, and his throne as the sun before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maplanta para taejinecog taegüije y pilan, ya taegüije y gosmagajet na testigo gui langet. Sila.
pairs.english: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago jagasja unyute yan unrechasa, jago jagasja lalalojao ni y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unchatlie y traton y tentagomo; ya unnaale y coronaña asta papa gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unyamag papa todo y quelatña; yan unyulang y minetgot na castiyaña.
pairs.english: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y manmalolofan gui ayo na chalan mayuteñaeñaejon: güiya manamamamajlao ni y tiguangña.
pairs.english: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jumatsa julo y agapa na canae y contrariuña sija; yan jago munafanmagof todo y enimiguña.
pairs.english: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jago locue bumira y filon y espadaña, ya ti unnafitme güe gui guera.
pairs.english: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago jagasja munabasta y minalagña, yan unyute y tronuña papa gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaanen y pinatgonña jago jagasja munacadada: jago jagasja tumampe güe ni y minamajlao. Sila.
pairs.english: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ngaean sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, jaso na quinadada y tiempoco esta: pot jafa na taesetbe jagas unfatinas todo y famaguan taotao?
pairs.english: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye na taotao enao y lalâlâ ya ti ulie finatae, ni y ujanalibre y antiña gui ninasiñan y naftan? Sila.
pairs.english: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, mangue y minaasemo sija ni y ampmam, ni y jinilamo as David gui minagajetmo?
pairs.english: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso, Jeova, y minamajlao y tentagomo sija: ni y jucatgaja gui jalom pechoco, y minamamajlao y taotao todo ni y matatnga:
pairs.english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y enimigumo mannanamamajlao, O Jeova: ni y enimigumo munamamajlao y pinecat y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova para taejinecog: Amen yan Amen.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JEOVA jago guinin saganmamame yan todo y generasion.
pairs.english: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Antes de najuyong y egso sija ya unfatinas y tano todo yan y mañasaga: sa desde y tutujonña yan asta y taejinecog, jagoja si Yuus.
pairs.english: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago bumira y taotao para y yinilang; ya ilelegmo: Fanalo guato, jamyo famaguon taotao.
pairs.english: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mit años gui menamo taegüijeja y nigapja anae malofan esta, yan taegüijeja y ora gui bumebela gui puenge.
pairs.english: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago chumule sija taegüije y minilag y janom; manaegüije y minaego: ya y egaan manaeguije y chaguan ni y manlacho julo.
pairs.english: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y egaan, mumegae ya manlacho julo; lao y pupuenge manmautut yan ufanmalayo.
pairs.english: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y linalalomo nae lumachaejam, yan y binibumo nae munafañatsagajam.
pairs.english: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa unpolo y tinaelayenmame gui menamo, yan y ti matungo na isaomame gui minananan y matamo.
pairs.english: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sat odo y jaaninmame manmalofan gui binibumo: inlachae y sacanmame ni y taegüijeja cuentos ni y masangan esta.
pairs.english: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaanen y sacanmame setenta años, ya y pot y minetgot siña gagaegue asta ochenta años; lao y sobetbiañija y checho yan y trineste; sa munaguse manmapos: yan jame mangupo.
pairs.english: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye tumungo y ninasiñan y linalalomo, ya y binibumo segun y ninamaañao guiya jago.
pairs.english: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya fanagüejam tumufong y jaaninmame, para mojon usiña guajajam un corason ni y malate.
pairs.english: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Talo mague, O Jeova: asta ngaean? ya polo ya unfañotsot pot y tentagomo.
pairs.english: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nafannajong jam taftaf ni y minaasemo: ya insiña manmagof yan infansenmagof todo gui jaaninmame.
pairs.english: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmagof jam, segun na jaane anae unnafanpinite jam, yan y sacan anae inlie y taelaye:
pairs.english: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y chechomo umalie gui tentagomo sija, yan y minalagmo gui famaguonña.
pairs.english: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y guinatbon Jeova ni y Yuusta ugaegue guiya jame; ya unnafitme guiya jame y checho y canaeta: magajet, y checho y canaemame unnafitme.
pairs.english: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA y sumasaga gui umatog na sagayan y Gueftaquilo, güiya usaga gui papa y anineng y Todojajanasiña.
pairs.english: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jusangan as Jeova, güiya y umamparayo yan y castiyujo: Yuusso, iya güiya nae juangocoyo.
pairs.english: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya unninalibre guinin y lason y tiradot, yan guinin y yinilang peste.
pairs.english: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya untinampe ni y piluña, yan y papa y papaña nae unangoco jao: y minagajetña uguinogüemo yan upatangmo.
pairs.english: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ti unmaañao ni y minamaañao y puenge; ni y flecha ni mangugupo gui jaane;
pairs.english: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y peste ni manmamomocat gui jalom jomjom; ni pot y yinilang ni y lumachae y taloane.
pairs.english: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mit ufanbasnag gui oriyamo, yan y dies mit gui agapa na canaemo: lao ti siña mato jijot guiya jago.
pairs.english: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atadogmoja umatan, yan lumie y apas y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagoja, O Jeova, y umamparayo! Sa jagasja unfatinas y Gueftaquilo na sagamo.
pairs.english: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya taelaye ufato guiya jago, ni jafa na chetnot ujijot gui sagamo.
pairs.english: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaencatga y angjetña sija nu jago, para uninadaje todo gui jinanaomo.
pairs.english: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unmajatsa julo ni y canaeñija, ya ti umanafannotpe acho y adengmo.
pairs.english: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unfamgacha gui jilo y leon yan y culebla: y patgon leon yan y serpiente ungagacha gui papa adeng sija.
pairs.english: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa japolo y güinaeyaña guiya guajo, enao mina junalibre güe: guajo pumolo güe gui taquilo, sa güiya guinin tumungo y naanjo.
pairs.english: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya umagangyo ya guajo umopegüe: sa jumajame gui chinatsaga; junalibre güe yan juonra güe.
pairs.english: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inanaco y linâlâña junanajong güe, yan jufanue güe ni y satbasionjo.
pairs.english: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MAULEG para umannae grasias si Jeova ya umacanta y alabansa sija gui naanmo, O Jago, Gueftaquilo:
pairs.english: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para infamamanue ni y minauleg güinaeyamo gui egaan yan y minagajetmo cada puenge.
pairs.english: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui dandan ni y dies cuetdasña; yan gui guitala; yan gui atpa yan y mames na inagang.
pairs.english: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago, Jeova, unnamagofyo nu y chechomo: ya bae junagana pot y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, namandinangculo sija y chechomo! yan jinasomo mansentadong:
pairs.english: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao ni y aguaguat ti jatungo: ni y caduco ti jatutungo este.
pairs.english: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y manaelaye lachog taegüije y chaguan, yan anae todo y chumogüe y tinaelaye manlajyan: ayo mina ufanmayulang para taejinecog:
pairs.english: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, para taejinecog gagaegue y tinaquilo.
pairs.english: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, y enimigumo, O Jeova, sa, estagüe, y enimigumo na ufanmalingo; yan todo y chumochogüe y tinaelaye ufanmachalapon.
pairs.english: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y canggelonjo, jago munacajulo taegüije y canggelon y titogcha na nubiyo: ya mapalaeyo ni y lañan nuebo.
pairs.english: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y atadogcoja lumie y güinaeyaco gui enimigujo sija yan y talangajoja jumungog y güinaeyaco ni chumogüe y taelaye ni y mangajulo contra guajo.
pairs.english: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinas lâlâ taegüije y trongcon palma: lumadangculo güe taegüije y trongcon sedro gui Libano.
pairs.english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
