pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmatanme gui guima Jeova, manlâlâ gui jalom y sagan y Yuusta.
pairs.english: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sigueja di manmanogcha asta que manbijo: manmesgo yan manbetde.
pairs.english: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ufanmamanue na si Jeova goftunas: güiya y achojo ya taya tinaelaye guiya güiya.
pairs.english: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna mabeste güe ni y ninasifia; si Jeova numabeste güe, ni y minetgot dinidog güe: y tano locue ninafitme ya ti siña manacalamten.
pairs.english: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronumo mafatinas desde di ampmam na tiempo: jago guinin y taejinecog.
pairs.english: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo y minalag sija, O Jeova, ya y minalag sija mangajulo y inangangñija; y minalag sija mangajulo y napoñija.
pairs.english: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mastaquilo y inagang sija y minegae y janom sija, yan y fijom na napo gui tase, si Jeova gui sanjilo gaesisiña.
pairs.english: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y testimoniomo sija mansenmagajet: sinantosja conbiene gui jalom guimamo, O Jeova, para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, Yuus Jao, ni y inemog iyomo; O Yuus Jao, ni y inemog iyomo, famanuen maesajao ni y minalag.
pairs.english: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa jao julo, jago y jues y tano: nae ni y apasñija y mansobetbio.
pairs.english: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, asta ngaean y manaelaye, asta ngaean y manaelaye nae ufanmagana?
pairs.english: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmefno, sija sumangan sinaguat yan todo y chumochogüe y tinaelaye manbanidoso.
pairs.english: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija yumamag ya japedasitos y taotaomo, O Jeova, yan janafanpinite y erensiamo.
pairs.english: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija pumuno y biuda yan taotao juyong, yan japuno y manaetata.
pairs.english: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegñija: Si Jeova ti ujalie, ni si Yuus Jacob ti ufanatituye.
pairs.english: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanatituye, jamyo managuaguat gui taotao: yan jamyo mangaduco, ngaean nae infanmalate?
pairs.english: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y plumanta y talanga, ada ti ujungog? ya ayo y fumatinas y atadog, ada ti ulie?
pairs.english: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y cumastiga y taotao sija ada ti ujanafanunas? ayoja y fumanagüe y taotao ni y tiningo?
pairs.english: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jatungo y jinason y taotao, na sija puro jinaja.
pairs.english: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso y taotao ni y unnaregla güe, O Jeova, yan ufanagüe güe ni y tinagomo;
pairs.english: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago siña numae gui descanso guinin y jaanin y chinatsaga, asta qui y joyo maguadog para y manaelaye.
pairs.english: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova ti janasuja y taotaoña, ni ti udingo y erensiaña.
pairs.english: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jinisga utalo guato gui tininas: yan todo y manunas na corason ujadalalag.
pairs.english: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye malago cajulo para guajo contra y chumochogüe y daño? Jaye malago tumojgue julo para guajo contra y chumochogüe y taelaye?
pairs.english: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Jeova guinin ti umayudayo, y antijo gusija guinin sumaga gui finatquilo.
pairs.english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ileco: Sulong y adengjo: y minaasemo, O Jeova, mumantieneyo.
pairs.english: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae juguaja y manadan jinasoco gui sanjalomjo, y quinensuelamo sija ninasenmagof y antijo.
pairs.english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tronon tinaelaye uguaja comunion yan jago, ni y fumatinas daño pot y tinago?
pairs.english: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija mandaña contra y anten y manunas, yan ja sentensia y jâgâ y taeisao.
pairs.english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jeova guinin y leca na torijo: yan Yuusso y achon y guinegüeco.
pairs.english: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya chumule gui jiloñija y isaoñija, yan ujautut sija gui dañoñijaja; ya si Jeova, ni y Yuusta, umutut sija.
pairs.english: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O maela, ya tacantaye si Jeova: nije tafatinas y minagof na inagang para y acho y satbasionta.
pairs.english: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nije taufanmato gui menaña yan y grasias, ya tafatinas y minagof na inagang nu y salmos.
pairs.english: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova y dangculo na Yuus, yan y dangculo na Ray gui jilo todo yuus.
pairs.english: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jalom y canaeña nae mangaegue y manadong na sagayan gui tano: y minetgot y beca sija iyoña locue.
pairs.english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tase iyoña yan güiya fumatinas: yan y canaeñaja fumatinas y anglo na tano.
pairs.english: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O maela nije taadora ya tafanecon papa, nije tafandimo gui menan Jeova ni y fumatinasjit.
pairs.english: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya y Yuusta; yan jita y taotao gui pastajiña, yan y quinilo gui canaeña. Pago na jaane yaguin injingog y inagangña,
pairs.english: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo munafanmajejetog y corasonmiyo, taegüije guiya Meriba, taegüije y jaanin y tentasion gui desierto.
pairs.english: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y tatanmiyo tumientayo, machagueyo, yan malie y chechojo.
pairs.english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cuarenta años inapmamña nae tristeyo pot este na generasion, ya ileco: Sija na taotao ni y manlache gui corasonñija, yan jagasja ti jatungo y chalanjo.
pairs.english: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot ayo na manjulayo gui binibujo, ya sija ti siña majalom gui descansoco.
pairs.english: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O cantaye si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta: cantaye si Jeova todo y tano.
pairs.english: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova, bendise y naanña; fanmamanue ni y satbasionña guinin y jaane yan y jaane.
pairs.english: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan claro y minalagña gui nasion sija ya y ninámanmanña gui entalo todo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova dangculo, yan sendangculo para umaalaba: güiya umamaañaogüe mas qui todo yuus.
pairs.english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y yuus y nasion sija manidolo: lao si Jeova fumatinas y langet sija.
pairs.english: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Onra yan minagas mangaegue gui menaña: minetgot yan guinatbo mangaegue gui jalom y santos na sagaña.
pairs.english: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova, O familian gui taotao sija, nae si Jeova minalag yan minetgot.
pairs.english: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nae si Jeova ni y minalag sa uiyon y naanña: chule y ninae ya maela sanjalom gui sagaña.
pairs.english: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O adora si Jeova gui guinatbon y sinantosña: fanlaolao gui menaña todo y tano.
pairs.english: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sangan gui nasion sija na si Jeova jagobiebietna: y tano maplanta locue ni y ti siña manacalamten: guiya jumusga y taotao gui tininas.
pairs.english: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmagof y langet sija, yan senmagof y tano; ya y tase palalangpang, yan y binilaña.
pairs.english: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y fangualuan senmagof yan todo y mangaegue gui sanjalomña: ayonae todo y trongco sija gui jalomtano mangantapot y minagof.
pairs.english: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui menan Jeova, sa güiya umamamaela; sa guiya umamamaela para ujusga y tano: ujusga y tano gui tininas, yan y taotao sija gui minagajetña.
pairs.english: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna, polo ya y tano umagof; polo ya y minegae y isla ufansenmagof.
pairs.english: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mapagajes yan y jemjom sija mangaegue gui oriyaña: tininas yan juisio y plinantan y tronuña.
pairs.english: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guafe manjanao gui menaña, yan mausinesenggue y enimiguña gui oriya.
pairs.english: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lamlamña maninina y tano: ya y tano malie ya ninalaolao.
pairs.english: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egso sija manmadirite taegüije y danges gui menan Jeova, gui menan y Señot y tano todo.
pairs.english: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet sumangan claro y tininasña, yan todo y taotao guinin malie y minalagña.
pairs.english: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanmamajlao todo ayo sija y sumesetbe y imagen sija ni tinaga, ni y tunanmaesaja sija y ídolo sija: Adora güe todo jamyo ni y yuus.
pairs.english: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya Sion jajungog ya ninamagof, yan y jagan Juda sija ninafansenmagof; sa pot y juisiomo sija, O Jeova.
pairs.english: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago Jeova, mas taquilo gui jilo todo y tano: ya jago umanacajulo chago gui jilo todo y yuus.
pairs.english: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jamyo y gumaeya si Jeova, jachatlie y daño: güiya umadaje y anten y mañantosña: güiya munafanlibre sija juyong gui canae y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manana matanme para y manunas, yan minagof para y manunas na corason.
pairs.english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof as Jeova jamyo ni y manunas; nae grasias y santos na naaña.
pairs.english: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CANTAYE si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta; sa güiya fumatinas y mannamanman na güinaja: sa y agapa na canaeña, yan y santos na canaeña fumatinas y satbasion para güiya.
pairs.english: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova janamatungo y satbasionña: y tininasña jafanue gui menan y nasion sija.
pairs.english: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jajaso y minaaseña yan y minagajetña para y guima Israel: ya todo sija y uttimon y tano, guinin malie y satbasion y Yuusta.
pairs.english: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas y minagof na inagang as Jeova, todo y tano: agang yan fanganta, nu y minagof, junggan, fanganta alabansa sija.
pairs.english: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantayo si Jeova y alabansa sija, nu y atpa; y atpa yan y inagang y guinatbon musica.
pairs.english: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y trompeta sija yan y sonidon y cotneta; fatinas y minagof na inagang gui menan y Ray Jeova.
pairs.english: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y tase upalalangpang yan y binilaña; y tano yan y mañasaga gui sanjalomña;
pairs.english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y manadan janom ujanafamapagpag canaeñija: polo ya y egso sija manganta pot y minagof.
pairs.english: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui menan Jeova: sa güiya umamamaela para ujusga y tano: ujusga y tano, gui tininas yan y taotao sija gui minagajet.
pairs.english: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova jagobiebietna; polo ya y taotao sija ufanlaolao; matatachong güe guijilo y querubin: polo ya y tano ufangalamten.
pairs.english: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova dangculo guiya Sion: yan güiya mas taquilo gui jilo todo y taotao.
pairs.english: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija ufanalaba y dinagculon yan y namaañao na naanmo; sa santos güe.
pairs.english: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ninasiñan y ray locue jaguaeya y juisio: jago pumolo y tininas; jago fumatinas y juisio yan y tininas gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nacajulo si Jeova ni y Yuusta, yan adora gui fañajangan y adengña; sa santos güe.
pairs.english: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Moises yan Aaron gui entalo mamale, yan si Samuel manisija yan ayo y umaagang y naanña; sija umaagang si Jeova, ya güiya umope sija.
pairs.english: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya cumuentutuse sija gui jalom y jaliguen y mapagajes: sija umadaje y tinagoña, yan y otden ni y mannae sija.
pairs.english: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago umope sija, O Jeova Yuusmame: jago si Yuus ni y umasie sija, achogja jago chumule y inemog gui chechoñija.
pairs.english: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nacajulo si Jeova ni y Yuusta, yan adora güe gui santos na ogsoña: sa si Jeova, ni y Yuusta, santos güe.
pairs.english: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FATINAS y minagof na inagang as Jeova: jamyo tano todos.
pairs.english: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Setbe si Jeova ni y minagof: maela gui menaña ya fanganta.
pairs.english: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tingo na si Jeova, güiya si Yuus: güiyaja y fumatinas jit, yan jita iyoña; jita y taotaoña yan y quinilo sija gui pastajiña.
pairs.english: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanjalom gui trangcaña yan y inefresen grasias, ya y jalom y sagaña yan y alabansa: nae güe grasias, yan bendise y naanña.
pairs.english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova mauleg; y minaaseña ugagaegue para taejinecog; yan y minagajet para todo y generasion sija.
pairs.english: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BAE jucanta y minaase yan y juisio: iyajago nae O Jeova, bae jucanta.
pairs.english: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae juadajeyo ni y malate gui cabales na jinanao. O ngaean nae unfato jao guiya guajo? bae jufamocat gui jalom guimajo yan y cabales na corason.
pairs.english: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mungayo pumolo y taelaye na güinaja gui menan atadogjo: juchatlie y chechoñija ayo y manabag sija: tiucheton guiya guajo.
pairs.english: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chatpayon na corason junafanjanao guiya guajo; ti yajo tumungo y manaelaye na güinaja.
pairs.english: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y secreto na finajiyunge y tiguangña, güiya bae juyulang: ya ayo y taquilo y inatanña yan y sobetbio na corason ti siña jusungon.
pairs.english: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogjo bae janameton y manmanjonggue gui tano, para ufañaga sija guiya guajo: ya ayo y mamomocat gui cabales na jinanao, güiya siempre sumesetbeyo.
pairs.english: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y chumochogüe y dinague ti siña sumaga gui jalom guimajo: ya ayo y sumasagan y mandague ti siña numafitme gui menan y atadogjo.
pairs.english: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y egaan yan y egaan bae juyulang todo y manaelaye gui tano; para uutot todo y chumochogüe ni y taelaye gui siuda Jeova.
pairs.english: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: JUNGOG y tinayuyutto, O Jeova, polo y inagangjo ya ufato guiya Jago.
pairs.english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo munaatog y matamo guiya guajo gui jaanen anae chatsagayo: naegueng y talangamo guiya guajo; y jaane anae juagangjao, opeyo guse.
pairs.english: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jaanijo linachae taegüije y aso, ya y telangjo janon taegüije y falot.
pairs.english: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonjo manetnot, yan anglo taegüije chaguan; sa malefayo jucano y najo pan.
pairs.english: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y inagang y inigongjo y telangjo mafachet yan y catneco.
pairs.english: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoyo yan y pelicano na pájaro gui desierto: yan taegüijeyo y memo gui lugat na mayulang.
pairs.english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jupulan, yan jumuyong yo taegüije y gorrion na pajaro güigüiyaja gui jilo y atof y guima.
pairs.english: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y enimigujo lumalatdeyo todot dia; yan ayo sija y manlalalo contra guajo manmanjula pot guajo.
pairs.english: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagasja jucano y apo taegüije y pan, yan manadaña y guimenjo yan y tanges.
pairs.english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y linalalomo yan y binibumo: sa jago jumatsayo yan yumuteyo.
pairs.english: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaanijo taegüije y anineng ni y umaso; yan angloyo taegüije y chaguan.
pairs.english: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, O Jeova, gagaegue jao para taejinecog: yan y memoriasmo asta todo y generasion.
pairs.english: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ucajulo, yan umaase ni iya Sion: sa y tiempo para unmaase nu güiya, magajet na mato y tiempo ni y matancho.
pairs.english: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tentagomo ninafanmagof ni y achoña: yan ninafanmaase ni y petbosña.
pairs.english: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y nasion sija ufanmaañao ni y naan Jeova, yan todo y ray sija gui tano ni y minalagmo.
pairs.english: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jafatinas y Sion, umanog güe gui jalom y minalagña.
pairs.english: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagoflamen y tinayuyut y mannesesitao; yan ti jachatlie y tinayuyutñija.
pairs.english: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Utugue este para y generasion ni y manmámamaela: yan y taotao ni y ufanmafatinas ujaalaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya jagasja jaatan papa gui y tinaquilo y santos na sagaña; guinin y langet nae si Jeova jaatan y tano.
pairs.english: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujungog y inigong y manmaprereso: yan para upula ayo sija y manmatancho para ufanmapuno.
pairs.english: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umasangan claro y naan Jeova guiya Sion, yan y alabansaña guiya Jerusalem;
pairs.english: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y taotao sija manetnon ya mandaña, yan y raeno sija para ujasetbe si Jeova.
pairs.english: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janadafe y minetgotto gui chalan; güiya munacadada y jaanijo.
pairs.english: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo ileco: O Yuusso chamo yo chumuchule gui lamita na jaanijo: y sacanmo sija para todoja y generasion.
pairs.english: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa desde y ampmam na tiempo jago pumolo y plinantan tano: yan y langet sija y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ufanmalingo, lao jago ungagaegueja: magajet na todo sija ufanguesbijo taegüije y magago: taegüije y bestido untolaeca sija, ya sija manmatalaeca.
pairs.english: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago y mismojajao, yan y sacanmo sija ti ufanjocog.
pairs.english: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguon y tentagomo ufangagaegue, yan y semiyanñija ufanmaplanta gui menamo.
pairs.english: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BENDISE si Jeova, O antijo: yan todo y sanjalomjo, bendise y santos na naanña.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, O antijo, yan chamo malelefa todo ni y minaulegña:
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y umasie todo tinaelayemo; ni y munamagong todo y chetnotmo;
pairs.english: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y munalibre y linâlâmo guinin y yinilang: ni y comorona jao ni güinaeyan mauleg yan y manadan minaase:
pairs.english: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y munanajong y pachotmo ni y manmauleg na güinaja: ya y pinatgonmo jananuebo taegüije y aguila.
pairs.english: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova fumatinas y tinas na chocho sija, yan y juisio sija para todo ayo sija y manmachiguet.
pairs.english: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya munatungo si Moises ni y chalanña, ya y chechoña gui famaguon Israel.
pairs.english: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova bula y minaase yan cariñoso, ñateng y binibuña yan gofmegae y minaaseña.
pairs.english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti ufanlalatde para siempre: ni umantiene y binibuña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti guinin jafatinas guiya jita segun y isaota; ni uapasejit segun y tinaelayeta.
pairs.english: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüije y langet goftaquilo gui jilo y tano, taegüijeja sendangculo y minaaseña para ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taemanoja chinagoña desde y sancatan, yan asta y sanlichan, taegüijeja chinagoña nae janajanao guiya jita y isaota.
pairs.english: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoja yan y tata ni jaguaeya y famaguonña, taegüenaoja si Jeova jaguaeya ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya.
pairs.english: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya tumungo y jechurata; jajaso na jita y petbos.
pairs.english: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y taotao, y jaaniña taegüijeja y chaguan; taegüijeja y flores gui fangualuan lalachog.
pairs.english: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y manglo manmalofan gui jiloña, yan güiya mapos: yan y sagayan ti siña jatungo mas.
pairs.english: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y minaase Jeova, guinin taejinecog asta taejinecog guijilo ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya, yan y tininasña gui famaguon y famaguon;
pairs.english: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yya sija y umadadaje y tratuña, yan ayo sija y jumajaso y finanagüeña para ufatinas.
pairs.english: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova japlanta y tronuña gui langet sija; yan y raenoña y naregla y jilo todoja.
pairs.english: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, jamyo ni angjetña sija, ni y manmatatnga gui minetgot, ni y cumumple y sinanganña, ni y umecungog y inagang y finoña.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova todo jamyo ni y inetnon sendaloña: jamyo ni y ministroña ni y fumatitinas y minalagoña.
pairs.english: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise si Jeova, todo y finatinasña, gui todo y sagayan anae jagobiebietna: bendise si Jeova, O antijo.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: BENDISE si Jeova, O antijo: O Jeova Yuusso, jago y sendangculo; jago minagagago ni y onra, yan y minagas.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y untampen maesajao ni y manana taegüije y bestido: ni y jumuto juyong y langet sija taegüije y cottina.
pairs.english: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y plumanta y jayo y aposentuña gui jalom janom: ni y fumatinas y mapagajes para caruajeña: ni y mamomocat gui jilo y papan y manglo.
pairs.english: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y fumatinas y manglo sija para tentagoña: y ministroña y mañila y guafe.
pairs.english: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pumolo y plinantan tano, ya ti siña manacalamten para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumampe güe ni y tinadong taegüije y bestido: y janom sija manotojgue gui sanjilo y beca sija.
pairs.english: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y linalatdemo, sija manjanao; ya pot y inagang y julumo mañadig manjanao.
pairs.english: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manjanao julo gui beca sija, sija apan papa gui oriyan y bayesija, gui sagayan ni y jago fumamauleg para sija.
pairs.english: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago pumolo y uttimonñija ya ti siña manmalofan guato; para ti siña jabira sija talo para utampe y tano.
pairs.english: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatago y tutujon y janom gui jalom y bayesija; ni y manmalalago gui entalo y egso sija.
pairs.english: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija numae guimenñija y todo gâgâ sija gui fangualuan: y manmachaleg na asno sija manmagong y majoñija.
pairs.english: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya sija nae y pajaron y langet guaja sagañija ya mangacanta gui entalo y ramas sija.
pairs.english: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya numaye janom y egso sija guinin y aposentuña sija: y tano jaspog ni y tinegcha y chechomo.
pairs.english: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y chaguan munafanlâlâ para y guaca sija, yan y tinanom para usinetbe y taotao: para ufañule nengcano gui tano;
pairs.english: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y bino ni y munamamagof y corason y taotao, yan y laña para ulamlam y mataña, yan y pan ni y munamemetgot y corason y taotao.
pairs.english: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y trongcon jayo Jeova manbula chugo; y sedro sija gui Libano ni y tinanomña;
pairs.english: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae y pajaro jafatitinas y chechoñija; ya y chuchuco, y trongcon pino guimaña.
pairs.english: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taquilo na ogso sija para y manmachaleg na chiba: yan y acho sija guinegüe para y conejo.
pairs.english: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatancho y pilan para y tiempo: y atdao tumungo y jinanaoña papa.
pairs.english: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago fumatinas y jemjom yan puenge; anae todo y gâgâ gui jalomtano mangucunanaf mona.
pairs.english: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manfamaguon na leon sija manaagang ni y manmaconeñija yan jaaliligao y nañija guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao cajulo, sija manmapos, yan manason sija papa gui jalom y liyangñija.
pairs.english: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao jumajanao mona gui finatinasña yan gui chechoña, asta qui puenge.
pairs.english: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jeova, manminegae sija y chechomo! y minenajlom, jago fumatinas sija todo: y tano senbula ni y rinicumo.
pairs.english: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo guato gaegue y tase, dangculo yan ancho, anae y sanjalomña sija y güinaja na mangucunanaf ni ti siña matufong, todoja mandangculo yan mandiquique sija na gâgâ.
pairs.english: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manjajanao y batco sija: ayo nae gaegue y lebiatan ni y finatinasmo para y jumugando gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija todo mumananggajao; sa jago siña unnae sija nañija gui tiempo ni matancho.
pairs.english: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo y jago numae, sija naufandaña: unbaba y canaemo ya sija mannajong ni y minauleg.
pairs.english: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unnaatog y matamo, sija mañatsaga: unchule y jinagonñija, sija manmatae, yan manalo guato gui petbosñija.
pairs.english: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Untago mona y espiritumo, sija manfinatinas: yan jago munanuebo y inatan gui sanjilo y tano.
pairs.english: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y minalag Jeova ugagaegue para taejinecog: Polo ya si Jeova umagof gui chechona:
pairs.english: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jaatan y jilo y tano yan jayengyong: ni y japacha y egso sija yan janaasgon.
pairs.english: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jucantaye si Jeova taemenoja y inanaco y linâlâjo: bae jucantaye tinina y Yuusso mientras lalâlâyo.
pairs.english: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y jinasoco iya güiya usenmames: bae jugofmagof as Jeova.
pairs.english: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y manisao ya ufanlinachae gui tano, polo y manaelaye ya utaya. Bendise si Jeova, O antijo. Alaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias si Jeova; agang y naanña; namatungo y chechoña gui entalo taotao sija.
pairs.english: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye güe, cantaye güe ni y alabansa sija; fanadingan ni y todo y chechoña ni y mannamanman.
pairs.english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmalag jamyo ni y santos na naanña: umanmagof ayo sija na corason y umaliligao si Jeova.
pairs.english: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aligao si Jeova yan y minetgotña: Aligao y mataña para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y ninamanman checho ni y monjayan jachogüe; ninamanmanña yan y juision y pachotña;
pairs.english: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jamyo, ni y semiyan Abraham tentagoña, jamyo ni y famaguon Jacob inayegña sija.
pairs.english: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya si Jeova Yuusta: y juisioñasija mangaegue todo gui tano.
pairs.english: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jaso y tratuña para taejinecog, y finijo ni y tinagoña para mit na generasion.
pairs.english: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na trato ni y jafatinas gui as Abraham, yan y jinilaña gui as Ysaac.
pairs.english: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ayoja janafitme gui as Jacob para otden, yan as Israel para taejinecog na trato.
pairs.english: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylelegña: Yya jago guajo junaejao y tano Cananea, y facae y erensiamo.
pairs.english: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae sija mandidideja na numeron taotao: junggan, senmandidide yan taotao juyong güije;
pairs.english: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manjanao guinin y un nasion asta y otro nasion, guinin y un raeno asta otro taotao;
pairs.english: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti japolo ni un taotao na ujafatinas daño guiya sija: magajet na jalalatde y ray sija pot causañija:
pairs.english: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Chamo pumapacha y pinalaejo, yan chamo munafanlalamen y profetajo sija.
pairs.english: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y ñinalang gui jilo y tano: ya jayulang todo y minetgot y agon.
pairs.english: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago un taotao gui menañija, si José ni y mabende para tentago.
pairs.english: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija na adengña y ninafanlamen ni y cadena: güiya mapolo guientalo y lilog.
pairs.english: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
