pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafangaease locue ni ayo y cumone sija preso.
pairs.english: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanlibrejam, O Jeova, Yuusmame, yan nafandañajam gui entalo y nasion sija, para unae grasias y santos na naanmo, yan ufangana gui alabansamo.
pairs.english: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova ni Yuus Israel guinin y taejinecog para y taejinecog. Polo ya todo taotao ilegñija. Amen. Alaba jamyo si Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias si Jeova, sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y ninafanlibre as Jeova ya ujasangan, anae janafanlibre guinin y canae y contrario;
pairs.english: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan janafandaña sija juyong gui tano sija, guinin y sancatan, yan guinin y sanlichan, guinin y san lago, yan guinin y san jaya.
pairs.english: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaabag gui jalomtano gui chalan desierto; ya ti manmañoda siuda para ufañaga.
pairs.english: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manñalang yan minajo sija, y anteñija manlalango gui sanjalomñija.
pairs.english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninesgaejon sija mona, gui tinas na chalan, para usiña manjanao para y siuda anae mañasaga.
pairs.english: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O, para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui famaguon taotao sija.
pairs.english: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jananajong y malago na ante, yan janabula y ñalang na ante ni y minauleg.
pairs.english: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y manmatatachong gui jemjom yan y jalom y anineng y finatae, ni y guinin jagode nu y pinite yan lulog;
pairs.english: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manembeste contra y fino Yuus, yan jachatlie y pinagat y Gueftaquilo:
pairs.english: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jachule papa y corasonñija gui checho; manbasnag papa ya taya para ufaninayuda.
pairs.english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jachule sija juyong gui jemjom yan y anineng y finatae, yan jagutos y manmagodeñija.
pairs.english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui famaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya yumamag y trangcan bronse, yan janapedaso y rejas lulog.
pairs.english: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaduco, sa pot y tinaelayeñija yan pot y inechongñija fanmanmamadese.
pairs.english: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y anteñija jachatlie todo y clasen nengcano; yan manjijot gui trangcan y finatae.
pairs.english: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manninae y finoña ya manninajomlo sija, yan manninalibre sija guinin y yinilangñija.
pairs.english: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na chechoña gui fumaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya polo sija ya ujaofrese y inefresen grasias sija, yan jasangan claro y chechoña gui cantan minagof.
pairs.english: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ni manjanao papa gui tase gui jalom y batco, ni y fumatinas chechoñija gui jilo manadan janom sija;
pairs.english: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija lumie y checho Jeova, yan y ninamanmanña gui jalom y tinadong.
pairs.english: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatagoña, ya janacajulo y pagyon manglo, ni y jumatsa julo y napo sija.
pairs.english: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangajulo para y langet, manjanao talo papa para y tinadong: y anteñija manmaderite pot y chinatsaga.
pairs.english: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmatulaejon mona an tate, yan manmamangag taegüije y bulacho na taotao, yan manmalingo y jinasoñija.
pairs.english: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maagang si Jeova gui chinatsagañija, ya güiya munalibre sija gui pinadeseñija.
pairs.english: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janabasta y pagyo, yan y napo sija manmamatquilo.
pairs.english: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmagof sa mangieto, ya taegüije jacone sija asta y minalagoñija na puetto.
pairs.english: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O para y taotao sija mojon ufanmanalaba si Jeova pot y minaulegña, yan pot y ninamanman na checoña gui famaguon y taotao sija!
pairs.english: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija umanacajulo güe locue gui y inetnon y taotao yan ufanmanalaba nu güiya gui tachong y manamco.
pairs.english: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafasadog y desierto, yan jafaanglo na oda y tutujon janom;
pairs.english: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafadesierton asiga y mauleg na tano, pot y tinaelayen ayo sija y mañasaga gui sanjalom.
pairs.english: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafajagoen janom y desierto, yan janafamimichao y janom y anglo na oda.
pairs.english: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ayo na janafañaga y manñalang, ya sija siña jafamauleg y siuda para ufañaga;
pairs.english: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan matanme y fangualuan, yan manmananom gui fangualuan ubas, ya ufanmarecoge y tinegchan y aumento.
pairs.english: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jabendise sija locue, para ufangosmegae; yan ti upolo y gañija gâgâ na udidide.
pairs.english: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo sija mandidide yan mannecon papa, pot y chiniguet, chinatsaga, yan triniste.
pairs.english: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jachuda sinala gui jilo y prinsepe sija, yan janafanabag sija gui jalomtano anae taya chalan.
pairs.english: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao japolo y mannesesitao julo guinin y pinadese, yan mandaña gui familia sija taegüije y inetnon quinilo.
pairs.english: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manunas ujalie ayo yan ufanmagof; yan todo y tinaelaye ujinichom y pachotña.
pairs.english: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea jaye na manmalate, ujaadaje este sija na güinaja; ya sija ujajaso y minaase gui as Jeova.
pairs.english: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, y corasonjo esta meton; bae jucanta, magajetja na jucanta alabansa sija yan todo y minalagjo.
pairs.english: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatmata guitala, yan atpa: guajoja na maesa magmatayo taftaf.
pairs.english: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junae jao grasias, Jeova gui entalo y taotao sija: yan jucantaye alabansa, sija gui entalo y nasion sija.
pairs.english: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y dangculon y minaasemo gui san jilo y langet: yan y minagajetmo tinacaja y mapagajes sija.
pairs.english: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nadangculojao, O Yuus, gui jilo y langet: yan y minalagomo gui san jilo todo y tano.
pairs.english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usiña ayo y güinaeyamo manlibre ni y agapa na canaemo, yan opejam.
pairs.english: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ilegña gui sinantosña: Guajo jumagof, guajo jupatte Siquem, yan jumide juyong y bayen Sucot.
pairs.english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yyoco Gilaad; iyoco Manases: Efrain locue y minetgot y ilujo; Juda y bastonjo;
pairs.english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Moab y palanganajo anae jufagase adeng sija: y jilo Edom nae juyute y sapatoso: y jilo Filistia nae juagang.
pairs.english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye uconeyo asta y jalom y fitme na siuda? Jaye uinesgaejonyo asta y jalom Idumea?
pairs.english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jago, O Yuus, ni y yumute jam? yan jago, O Yuus, ti jumanao yan y inetnon sendalonmame.
pairs.english: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam linibre gui chinatsaga: sa taesetbe y inayudan y taotao.
pairs.english: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: As Yuus nae utafanmatatnga: sa güiyaja uguinacha papa y enimiguta.
pairs.english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMO famatquiquilo, O Yuus, gui alabansajo;
pairs.english: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y pachot y manaelaye yan y pachot y dinague manmababa contra guajo: sa manguecuentos contra guajo yan y mandacon na jula.
pairs.english: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija umoriyayayeyo locue ni y finijo chinatlie; yan manmumo contra guajo sin jafa.
pairs.english: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y apas y güinaeyaco, sija contrariujo: lao guajo siempre manayuyutyo.
pairs.english: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan sija jaapaseyo taelaye pot mauleg, yan chinatlie pot y guinaeyaco.
pairs.english: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo jao y taelaye na taotao guiya güiya: ya polo un contrario ya utojgue gui agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin majusga güe, polo ya umasentensia: yan y tinaetaeña ufamaisao.
pairs.english: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaaniña udidide: yan otro uchinile ofisioña.
pairs.english: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y famaguonña ufanaetata yan y asaguaña ubiuda.
pairs.english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y famaguonña ufanlaong yan ufanmangagao: ya polo sija ya umaliligao y nañija güije gui chago gui sagañija na mayulang.
pairs.english: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya umaamot ya unnachule todo y güinajaña, yan y taotao juyong chumoleguan ni y finachochoña.
pairs.english: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya taya ni jaye umaase ni güiya; yan ni uno ufinaborese y manaetata na famaguonña.
pairs.english: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya y famaguonña ufanmautut; yan gui generasion ni y jadalalalag, umafagasñaejon y naanñija.
pairs.english: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Poly ya y tinaelayen y tataña sija umajaso gui as Jeova: ya y isao nanaña ti umafagasñaejon.
pairs.english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija siempre ufangaegue gui menan Jeova, sa güiya siña umutut y jinasoñija guinin y tano.
pairs.english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jajaso mamanue minaase, lao japetsigue y peble yan y nesesitao na taotao, yan y mayulang na corason ujapuno sija.
pairs.english: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jaguaeya y matdision, ya ayo na mato guiya güiya; ya ti ninamagof ni y bendision, ya ayo na chago guiya güiya.
pairs.english: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya mumagago güe ni y matdision taegüije y bestiduña, ya ayo na jumalom gui jalom y tiyanña taegüije y janom, yan taegüije y laña gui jalom tolangña.
pairs.english: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ayo guiya güiya, taegüije y magago ni y jatatampegüe, yan para sinturon ni y jadudog güe siempre.
pairs.english: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este apas y contrariujo sija guinin as Jeova, yan ayo sija ni y manguecuentos taelaye contra y antijo.
pairs.english: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao fatinas para guajo, O Yuus Jeova, pot y naanmo: sa mauleg na minaasemo, enao mina nalibreyo.
pairs.english: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pobleyo, yan nesesitaoyo, yan y corasonjo mañetnot gui sanjalomjo.
pairs.english: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mapos yo taegüije y anineng yaguin malofan: matafye yo julo yan papa taegüije y apacha.
pairs.english: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y timoco mandafe pot y inayunat; yan y catneco manmasogsog, sa ti jataca y iinemog.
pairs.english: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumuyong yo locue taegüije linalatde guiya sija: anae maaatanyo jayeyengyong y iloñija.
pairs.english: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayudayo, O Jeova Yuusso; O satbayo segun y minaasemo:
pairs.english: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para sija ujatungo na este y canaemo: na jago, Jeova, fumatinas este.
pairs.english: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya sija manmamatdise, lao jago manbendise: yaguin sija mangajulo, ufanmamajlao; lao y tentagomo umagof.
pairs.english: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y contrariojo ufanminagago ni y desonra; yan ufantinampe sija ni y minamajlaoñija taegüije y capa.
pairs.english: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova bae junae sendangculo na grasias nu y pachotto; junggan, jualabagüe gui linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya utojgüe gui agapa na canae y nesesitao, para usinatba güe guinin ayo sija y jumusga y antiña.
pairs.english: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jeova ilegña ni y señotto, fatachong gui agapa na canaejo, asta qui jupolo y enimigo para fañajangan adengmo.
pairs.english: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova uninamannae y baran minetgotmo guinin Sion: gobietna gui entalo y enimigumo sija.
pairs.english: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotaomo ufanmalago na ufanmanofrese nu sija gui jaanen y ninasiñamo: gui guinatbon sija y sinantos, guinin y tiyan y agaan, ungae serenon y pinatgonmo.
pairs.english: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova manjula ya timañotsot, jago y pale para taejinecog segun y otden Melquisedec.
pairs.english: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova, gui agapa na canaemo, upanag todo y ray sija gui jaanin y binibuña.
pairs.english: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufanjusga gui entalo y nasion sija, janabula y sagayan sija ni y tataotao y manmatae; unamagomgom y ilo gui jilo y megae na tano sija.
pairs.english: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unaguimen y sadog gui chalan: enaomina güiya jumatsa julo y ilo.
pairs.english: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Guajo junae si Jeova grasias contodo y corasonjo, gui jalom y pinagat manunas, yan y jalom y inetnon taotao.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y checho Jeova mansendangculo, ya maaliligao ni ayo sija todo y ninafanmamagof nu estesija.
pairs.english: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y chechoña y onra yan minagas: yan y tininasña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas y mannamanman na chechoña para umajajaso: si Jeova cariñoso yan bula ni y minaase.
pairs.english: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya guinin munae nengcano ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya: ya güiya siempre jajasoja tratuña.
pairs.english: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jafanue y taotaoña ni y ninasiñan y chechoña, anae janae sija ni y erensian y nasion sija.
pairs.english: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y checho sija y canaeña y minagajet yan juisio; ya todo y sinanganña sija manseguro.
pairs.english: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manfitme sija para taejinecog yan taejinecog, yan mamafatinas gui minagajet yan y tininas.
pairs.english: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janamannae y linibre para y taotaoña; ya jatago y tratuña para taejinecog: sinantos yan inenra y naanña.
pairs.english: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: tinagoña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Dichoso y taotao ni maañao as Jeova, yan ninasendangculo y minagofña ni y tinagoña sija.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyaña manmatatnga gui jilo y tano: ya y generasion manunas ufandichoso.
pairs.english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güinaja yan rinico mangaegue gui guimaña: ya y tininasña gagaegueja para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manunas nae cajulo y manana gui jalom jomjom: güiya cariñoso güe yan bula minaase, yan tunasgüe.
pairs.english: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg para ayo na taotao ni y fumatitinas y cariño, yan numanaayao: güiya umantiene y causaña gui juisio.
pairs.english: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya ti umanacalamten para taejinecog: y manunas para taejinecog: ufanmajajasoja.
pairs.english: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti umaañao ni y manaelaye na notisia sija: y corasonña meton ya jaangoco si Jeova.
pairs.english: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y corasonña fitme ya güiya ti umaañao, asta qui jalie y diniseaña gui jilo y contrariuña sija.
pairs.english: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya tumalapon, güiya numae ni y mamoble; ya y tininasña gagaegue para taejinecog, y canggelonña umajatsa ni y inenra.
pairs.english: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taelaye na taotao jalie ayo yan ninapinite: yan janachechegcheg y nifenña, yan maderite ya mapos: ya y diniseaña y taelaye umalingo.
pairs.english: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba, O tentago Jeova sija. Fanmanalaba y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito y naan Jeova, desde este na tiempo yan para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde y quinajulo y atdao asta y minachomña papa, y naan Jeova para umaalaba.
pairs.english: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova gueftaquilo gui jilo todo y nasion yan y minalagña gui jilo y langet sija.
pairs.english: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye parejuña si Jeova ni y Yuusta, ni y japolo y tachongña gui sanjilo.
pairs.english: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y muna umitde güe para uatan y güinaja sija ni y mangaegue gui langet yan y tano.
pairs.english: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jumatsa julo y mamoble gui petbos, yan jajatsa y mananesitao gui monton estietcot.
pairs.english: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unafanmatachong yan y prinsepe sija magajet, yan y prinsepen y taotaoña sija.
pairs.english: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafamulan guma y ti fafañago na palaoan, ya jumuyong gofmagof na nanan famaguon. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE si Israel jumanao juyong Egipto, y guima Jacob guinin y taotao y finijo na ti matungo.
pairs.english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juda jumuyong y santos na sagaña, yan Israel y gobietnoña.
pairs.english: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tase jalie ayo, yan malago; Jordan masugon tate.
pairs.english: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y beca sija manayog taegüije y quinilo laje yan y mandiquique ogso sija taegüije y manpatgon na quinilo sija.
pairs.english: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa guaja guiya jago, O tase, na malagojao? Jago Jordan ni y masugon tate?
pairs.english: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y beca sija ni y manayog taegüije y quinilo laje; yan jamyo di quique na ogso sija taegüije y manpatgon na quinilo sija?
pairs.english: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mayeyengyong, jago tano, gui menan Jeova, gui menan y Yuus Jacob;
pairs.english: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafaacho y jagoe janom, ya jafagagot y tutujon janom sija.
pairs.english: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AJE ti iyajame, O Jeova, aje ti iyajame, lao iya naanmo, nae uminalag pot y minaasemo, yan pot y minagajetmo.
pairs.english: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa mojon y nasion ilegñija: Mangue pago y Yuusñija?
pairs.english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuusmame gaegue gui langet: guinin jafatinas jafaja y minalagoña.
pairs.english: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y idolosñija sija salape yan oro, finatinas y canae y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja pachotñija lao ti manguecuentos: guaja atadogñija lao ti manmanlilie;
pairs.english: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ubinendisejao gui Sion; ya unlie y minauleg guiya Jerusalem todo y jaanin y linâlâmo.
pairs.english: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na unlie y famaguon y famaguonmo. Pas ugaegue guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na tiempo nae manapiniteyo desde y pinatgonjo: lao trabia ti mangana ni y ninasiñañija contra guajo.
pairs.english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manmanalado jaalado gui jilo y tatalojo: janafananaco y sutcoñija.
pairs.english: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova tunaegüe: güiya umutut y cuetdas y manaelaye.
pairs.english: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufanmamajlao todo ayo y bumira sija tate, todo sija y chumatlie Sion.
pairs.english: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufantaegüije y chaguan gui jilo guma, ni y anglo antes di udoco:
pairs.english: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chaña y manuutut chaguan munabubula y canaeña, ni y pechonña y manmanonojo.
pairs.english: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ujaalog ayo sija y manmalolofan, Y bendision Jeova usaga gui jilomo; jame bumendise jao pot y naan Jeova.
pairs.english: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, ecungog y inagangjo: polo ya talangamo sija uegueng gui inagang y guinagaojo.
pairs.english: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin mojon unmatca y tinaelaye sija; Jeova, jaye utojgüe?
pairs.english: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja inasie guiya jago, para unmamaañagüe.
pairs.english: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junanangga si Jeova, y antijo mannanangga, ya y sinanganña junanangga.
pairs.english: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y antijo jananangga si Jeova, mas qui y guatdia sija ni manmannanangga y egaan: magajet na mas qui y guatdia sija manmannananangga y egaan.
pairs.english: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Israel nangga si Jeova; sa gui as Jeova guaja minaase, ya iya guiya nae megae na inalibre.
pairs.english: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya unalibre Israel todo gui tinaelayeña.
pairs.english: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na jufamatquilo yo yan junaquietoyo; taegüije y patgon yan ninasusu as nanaña: y antijo guiya guajo parejo yan y patgon ni y sumususu.
pairs.english: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Israel nangga si Jeova, desde pago ya para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano na manjula gui as Jeova yan japromete y Gaesisiña gui as Jacob;
pairs.english: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na ti jujalom gui tabetnaculon y guimajo, ni jufalag gui camajo:
pairs.english: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti junamatujog y atadogco; ni junamaego y lasas y atadogco,
pairs.english: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta qui jusodayo y lugat para si Jeova, y tabetnaculo para y Gaesisiña gui as Jacob.
pairs.english: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na injingog masangangüe guiya Efrata ya inseda gui fangualuan qui jalomtano.
pairs.english: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Infanjalom gui tabetnaculuña: inadora gui menan y fañajangan adengña.
pairs.english: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo, O Jeova, gui lugat y descansomo: jago yan y atcan y minetgotmo.
pairs.english: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y mamalemo sija ya ufanminagago ni y tininas: ya y mañantosmo sija ufanagang ni y minagof.
pairs.english: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot y naan y tentagomo as David, chamo bumibira y matan y pinalaemo.
pairs.english: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova manjula minagajet gui as, David; ti ubira güe; y tinegcha y tataotaomo, juplanta gui jilo tronumo.
pairs.english: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jaadaje y famaguonmo y tratujo, yan y testimoniojo ni y jufanagüe sija, asta y famaguonñija locue ufanmatachong gui tronumo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova guinin jaayeg Sion; este jadesea para sagaña.
pairs.english: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y lugat y descansoco para taejinecog: este nae jusaga; sa este judesea.
pairs.english: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jubendise dangculo y prebensionña: ya bae junafannajong y mamobleña ni y pan.
pairs.english: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junafanminagago locue y mamaleña sija ni y satbasion: yan y mañantosña sija ufanagang managang ni y minagof.
pairs.english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae junadoco y canggelon David: guinin jufamauleg y candit para y pinalaejo.
pairs.english: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae junafanminagago y enemiguña sija ni y minamajlao; lao y jiloña nae unamagas y coronaña.
pairs.english: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este parejo yan y mauleg na laña gui ilo, ni y mimilalag gui batbas, asta y batbas Aaron; ya jumajnanao papa asta y cueyon magaguña;
pairs.english: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije serenon Hermon, ni y mamopodong gui jilo ogso guiya Sion; sa ayo nae mañago si Jeova y bendision, güiya taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Cantan Quinajulo. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatsa julo y canaemiyo gui sinantos na sagayan, ya fanmanbendise jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ni y fumatinas y langet yan y tano, bumendise jao guiya Sion.
pairs.english: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo y naan Jeova: fanmanalaba güe, O jamyo, ni y tentago Jeova sija.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y manotojgue gui jalom guma Jeova, y jalom pateo y guimayuus.
pairs.english: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba as Jeova; sa si Jeova mauleg güe: fanganta y alabansa sija ni y naanña; sa magof este.
pairs.english: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova jaayeg si Jacob para güiya, ya Israel para y güinajañaja namaesa.
pairs.english: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jutungo na si Jeova dangculo güe: ya y Señotta taquiloña qui todo y Yuus.
pairs.english: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja y malagoña si Jeova, esteja jafatinas, gui langet yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y manadong na lugat.
pairs.english: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafangajujulo y asgon sija guinin y uttimon y tano; janalalamlam para uuchan; janachinile y manglo gui güinajaña.
pairs.english: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y janalamen y finenana na finañago guiya Egipto, todo y taotao yan y gâgâ.
pairs.english: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago señat sija yan mannamanman gui talo guiya jago, O Egipto: gui as Faraon yan todo y tentagoña.
pairs.english: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janalamen y mandangculo na nasion, yan japuno y manmatatñga na ray sija.
pairs.english: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Sehón ray y Amorreo yan si Og ray Basán, yan todo y raeno sija guiya Cananea:
pairs.english: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mannae para erensia ni y tanoñija: para erensian y taotao na guiya Israel.
pairs.english: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y naanmo O Jeova, gagaegue para taejinecog; y majasomo, O Jeova, para todo y generasion sija.
pairs.english: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova ujusga y taotaoña, ya ugaease ni y tentagoña sija.
pairs.english: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y idolos y nasion sija, salape yan oro, y checho y canae y taotao sija.
pairs.english: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja pachotñija, lao ti manguecuentos: guaja atadogñija, lao ti manmanlilie;
pairs.english: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja talangañija; lao ti manmanjujungog; ni uguaja jinagong gui pachotñija.
pairs.english: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija y fumatinas estesija ujafanparejoja yan sija: magajet na cada uno ni y umangoco sija ni ayosija.
pairs.english: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O guma Israel, bendise si Jeova: O guma Aaron, bendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O guma Levi, bendise si Jeova: jamyo ni y manmaañao as Jeova, bendise si Jeova.
pairs.english: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito si Jeova guinin Sion ni y sumaga guiya Jerusalem. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae si Jeova grasias; sa güiya mauleg: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Yuus y yuus sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Señot y señot sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ayo y güiyaja namaesa fumatinas y dangculo namanman: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y pot y tiningo jafatinas y langet: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y jajuto y tano gui jilo janom sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para guiya ni y jafatinas y mandangculo na candet sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao para ufangobietna gui jaane: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pilan yan y pution sija para ufanmangobietna gui puenge: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y munalamen Egipto gui finenana na finañagoñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone juyong Israel gui entaloñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y metgot na jataf canae yan y canae na majala: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y japatten dos y Tasen Agaga: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafalofan Israel gui entaloña: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayute si Faraon yan todo y sendaluña sija gui Tasen Agaga: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y jaosgaejon y taotaoña y inanaco y desierto: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para güiya ni y janalamen y mandangculo na ray sija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan japuno y mangaeninasiña sija na ray: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Sehón ray y Amorreo: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Og ray Basán: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mannae erensia ni y tanoñija: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na para erensian y tentagoña guiya Israel: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jajasojit gui managpapata: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janalibrejit gui coutrariuta: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
