pairs.chamorro: Ni y mannae nengcano para todo y catne: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O nae grasias y Yuus y langet: sa y minaaseña gagaegue para taejinecog.
pairs.english: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y oriyan y sadog Babilonia nae infanmatachong, magajet na manangesjit yanguin injaso Sion.
pairs.english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Incana y atpanmame gui trongcon sauses gui entaloña güije.
pairs.english: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güije ayo sija y cumonejit, jatagojit na tafanganta: ya ayo sija y lumachaejit, jatagojit na tafanmagof, ilegñija: Cantayejit uno ni y cantan Sion.
pairs.english: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano incanta y cantan Jeova gui ti tanomame?
pairs.english: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin malefayo nu jago, O Jerusalem! polo ya umalefa y agapa na canaejo ni y tiningoña.
pairs.english: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti jujaso jao, polo ya unacheton y jilajo gui paladatto; yanguin ti juguaeyajao, Jerusalem, mas qui y prinsipat na minagofjo.
pairs.english: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso O Jeova contra y famaguon Edom gui jaanin Jerusalem; ni ilegñija: Funas, funas asta y simientoña.
pairs.english: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O jagan Babilonia ni y para unmayulang; umagof ayo y para uninapase taegüije ni y unsetbejam.
pairs.english: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Umagof ayo, y uquenene na uyinite y famaguonmo contra y acho.
pairs.english: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jufanadora para y santos na templomo, ya junae y naanmo grasias pot y cariñoso na güinaeyamo, yan pot y minagajetmo: sa unnadangculo y sinanganmo mas qui y naanmo.
pairs.english: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaane anae juagang, jago umopeyo, ya unanimayo, ni y minetgot y antijo.
pairs.english: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y ray gui tano unmannae jao grasias, O Jeova, sa jagasja majungog y sinangan y pachotmo.
pairs.english: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na ufanganta ni y chalan Jeova; sa dangculo y minalag Jeova.
pairs.english: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea taquilo si Jeova, lao jarespetaja y managpapa: lao y sobetbio jatungoja desde y chago.
pairs.english: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea mamocatyo gui entalo y chinatsaga, unnalâlâyo: unestira mona y canaemo contra y binibun y enimigujo sija, ya y agapa na canaemo usatbayo.
pairs.english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova unacabales y gaegue guiya guajo: y minaasemo, O Jeova, gagaegue para taejinecog: chamo dumidingo y checo y canaemo.
pairs.english: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Untutungoja y finatachongjo yan y quinajulojo; untutungoja y jinasoco desde y chagogo.
pairs.english: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unlilicue y finaposo yan y fanasonjo, ya untutungo todo y chalanjo.
pairs.english: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya ni un sinangan gui jilajo: jao, estagüe, na untungoja todo, O Jeova.
pairs.english: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unoriyayeyo gui menajo, yan y tateco: yan unpolo y canaemo gui jilojo.
pairs.english: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gosnámanman este na tiningo para guajo; gostaquilo, ti siña jucomprende.
pairs.english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manoyo guato taegüe y espiritumo? pat manoyo jufalagüe taegüe yo gui menamo?
pairs.english: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin cumajuloyo gui langet gaegueja jao güije; yanguin jujuto y camajo guiya sasalaguan, gaegueja jao locue güije.
pairs.english: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin juchule y papan y egaan, ya jusaga gui uttimon y tase;
pairs.english: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta ayo gaegueja y canaemo na jaosgagaejonyo, ya y agapa na canaemo umantieneyo.
pairs.english: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jualog: Magajet na utampeyo y jemjom: asta y puenge uinayo.
pairs.english: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y jemjom ti uninatogüe: lao y puenge ufanina taegüije y jaane: y jemjom yan y mananana manparejoja para jago.
pairs.english: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago tumungo yo, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junae jao grasias: sa gosnamaañao yan gosnamanman y mafatinasso: mannamanman y chechomo; ya y antijo jagostungo este.
pairs.english: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tataotaojo ti umatog guiya jago, anae mafatinasyo gui secreto; ya matufog yo ni namanman, gui mas tagpapa na lugat gui tano.
pairs.english: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atadogmo lumie y tataotaojo ya ti cabales: ya y lebblomo nae manmatugue todo y pedason tataotaojo, ya taya ufatta.
pairs.english: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna guaguan y jinasomo guiya guajo, O Yuus! Jafa muna megae sumaña!
pairs.english: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jutufong sija, manmegaeña y numeroña qui y inae: yanguin magmatayo, gaeguejayo trabia guiya jago.
pairs.english: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Seguro na unpuno y taelaye, O Yuus: enaomina mañuja guiya guajo y manmejga na taotao sija.
pairs.english: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manguentos taelaye contra jago, ya y enimigumo sija machule y naanmo pot taya.
pairs.english: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti juchatlie ayo sija, O Jeova, y chumatlie jao? yan ada ti unatristeyo pot ayo sija y mangajulo contra jago?
pairs.english: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juchatlie sija ni y cabales na chinatlie: jutufong sija pot y enemigujo.
pairs.english: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rejistrayo O Yuus, ya untungo y corasonjo: chagueyo ya untungo y jinasoco sija.
pairs.english: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unlie cao guaja taelaye gui sumanjalomjo, ya unchachalaneyo gui chalan taejinecog.
pairs.english: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmanjaso taelaye gui corasonñija: cada jaane mandaña para y guera.
pairs.english: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanmalagtos y jilañija taegüije y serpiente; binenon y culebbla guaja gui jalom y labiosñija. Sila.
pairs.english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adajeyo O Jeova, gui canae y taelaye; adajeyo gui fette na taotao: ni y manmadetetmina para unasuja y pinecatto.
pairs.english: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sobetbio sija janaatog y laso yan y cuetdas para guajo: matiende y lagua gui oriyan chalan; manmanplanta ocodo para guajo. Sila.
pairs.english: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegco as Jeova: Jago y Yuusso: ecungog y inagang y tinayuyutto, O Jeova.
pairs.english: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Yuus, Jeova, ni y minetgot y satbasionjo, jago tumampe y ilujo gui jaanin y guera.
pairs.english: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo numanae y taelaye ni y dineseaña, O Jeova; chamo umayuyuda y taelaye jinasoña; na noseaja unafannaquilo maesa sija. Sila.
pairs.english: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ilun ayo sija y umoriyayeyo, polo ya utinampe sija ni y taelayen labiosñija.
pairs.english: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufamodog y pinigan guafe gui jiloñija: polo ya ufanmayute sija guato gui jalom guafe; y jalom y tadong na joyo ya chañija fangajujulo talo.
pairs.english: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti ufitme gui tano y cumuecuentos ni y taelaye: y tinaelaye jaaliligao y taelaye na taotao para uninaatlibes güe.
pairs.english: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jutungo na si Jeova umantiene y causan y manpinite, yan y tininas y pebble.
pairs.english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na umanae grasia y naanmo, ni y manunas: y manunas ufañaga gui menamo.
pairs.english: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tinayuyutto ya umaplanta gui menamo taegüije y insensio; ya y jinatsaco julo ni y canaejo utaegüije y inefresen pupuenge.
pairs.english: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y guatdia O Jeova gui menan pachotjo; adaje y pettan y labiosso.
pairs.english: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo nafalag y tataelaye na güinaja y corasonjo, ya ufatinas y taelaye na chocho yan ayo sija na taotao y chumogüe tinaelaye: ya chamo na jucanoyo ni y mannge na nañija.
pairs.english: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y tininas ya unalamenyo, este y minauleg; ya ureprendeyo, ya utaegüije y laña gui jilo y ilujo: chamo na ilujo urechasa: sa asta anae manaelaye sija, y tinayuyutto ugagaegueja.
pairs.english: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmayute papa y juesñija gui anae acho na lugat; ya ujajungog y sinanganjo sija, sa manmames.
pairs.english: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y telangmame manmachalapon gui pachot y naftan; taegüije anae un taotao jaalado ya japuta y tano.
pairs.english: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y atadogco, mangaegue guiya jago, O Yuus Jeova: iya jago nae gagaegueja y inangococo: chamo dumidingo y antijo namaesa.
pairs.english: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adajeyo gui laso ni y maplanta para guajo, yan y ecodon y chumagüe y taelaye.
pairs.english: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufamodong y manaelaye gui jalom y laguañija, mientras umescacapayo.
pairs.english: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantan David anae Gagaegue gue gui Liyang; un Tinayuyut. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jubasia y quejaco gui menaña, jufanue gui menaña ni y chinatsagaco.
pairs.english: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y espiritujo lalango gui sumanjalomjo, untungoja y finaposso. Y chalan gui anae mamocatyo, manaatog y laso para guajo.
pairs.english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan y agapa na canaejo ya lie; lao taya ni un taotao tumungoyo: y guine güeco esta malingo; taya ni un taotao umadaje y antijo.
pairs.english: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Juagang jao O Jeova; ilegco: Jago guinegüeco yan y patteco gui tano y manlalâlâ.
pairs.english: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atituye y inagangjo; sa sen lumalagpapayo; nalibreyo gui pumetsisigueyo, sa manmetgotña qui guajo.
pairs.english: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najuyong y antijo gui calaboso, ya junae grasias y naanmo: ujaoriyayeyo y manunas; sa unfatinas pot guajo gosmegae.
pairs.english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamo jumajalom gui juisio yan y tentagomo: sa taya taotao lalâlâ umajustifica gui menamo.
pairs.english: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y enimigo guinin japetsigue y antijo; guinin jasaulag papa gui jilo oda y jaanijo: janasagayo gui anae jomjom na lugat sija, taegüije sija y guinin apmam na manmatae.
pairs.english: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y espiritujo, lalango gui sumanjalomjo: y corasonjo gui sumanjalomjo triste.
pairs.english: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujaso sija y apmam na jaane; jujaso todo y chechomo; jujajaso y checho y canaemo.
pairs.english: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujuto mona y canaejo guiya jago: y antijo majo nu jago, taegüije y anglo na tano. Sila.
pairs.english: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jungogyo enseguidas, O Jeova: sa malayo y antijo: chamo na naaatog y matamo guiya guajo; sa noseaja juparejo yan ayo sija y mannunog gui jalom joyo.
pairs.english: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na jungogyo ni y cariñoso na güinaeyamo gui egaan; sa jagoja nae juangocoyo: natungoyo ni y chalan anae para jufamocat; sa jujatsa julo y antijo guiya jago.
pairs.english: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalibreyo, O Jeova, gui enemigujo sija: jufalagüe jao, ya unnaatogyo.
pairs.english: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanagüeyo ya jufatinas y minalagomo: sa jago y Yuusso: y espiritumo mauleg; osgaejonyo gui tano y manunas.
pairs.english: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nalâlâyo, O Jeova, pot y naanmo: pot y tininasmo, chule y antijo gui chinatsaga.
pairs.english: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan pot y cariñoso na güinaeyamo utut y enemigujo sija, ya unyulang todo sija y munapinite y antijo: sa guajo tentagomo.
pairs.english: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y minaaseco yan y guimegüeco y iyoco tore na taquilo, yan y munalibreyo; y patangjo, yan y anae juangocoyo; ni y pumolo y taotaojo gui papajo.
pairs.english: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jeova, jafa y taotao na unatituye y tiningoña? pat y lajin taotao na uncuecuenta güe?
pairs.english: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao parejoja yan y jinaja; y jaaniña parejoja yan y anineng ni y malofan.
pairs.english: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Natalagpapa, y langetmo, O Yuus, ya tunogjao papa: pacha y egso sija ya ufanaso.
pairs.english: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanyute ni y lamlam ya ufanchinalapon sija: nafanogcha y flechamo, ya ufaninestotba sija.
pairs.english: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estira y canaemo guinin jilo; rescatayo yan nalibreyo gui manadan janom, gui canae y manaotao juyong.
pairs.english: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y pachotñija manguecuentos banida, ya y agapa na canaeñija, y dacon na canae agapa.
pairs.english: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jucantaye jao ni y nuebo na canta, O Yuus: y guitala, ni y dies cuetdasña nae jucantaye jao ni y alabansa sija.
pairs.english: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ayo y mannae satbasion gui ray sija: ni janalibre si David ni y tentagoña gui gosnalamen na espada.
pairs.english: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Rescatayo ya nalibreyo gui canae y manaotao juyong, ni y pachotñija manguecuentos banida, ya y agapa na canaeñija y dacon na canae agapa.
pairs.english: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y famaguonmame lalaje ufantaegüije y tinanom yanguin mandoco ya mangajulo gui pinatgonñija; ya y jaganmame ufantaegüije y mapopolo gui punta na acho, ni y malabla taegüije y palasyo.
pairs.english: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lanchonmame bula, mannae todo clasen güinaja: ya gamame quinilo ufanmañago mit yan dies mit gui fangualuanmame.
pairs.english: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gamame nobiyo sija ufanmangotga mauleg; ya chañija rumorompe jalom ni juyong, ya taya inagang pot pinite gui cayenmame.
pairs.english: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija na taotao y manguaja ni este: Junggan, mandichoso ayo sija na taotao ni y Yuusñija si Jeova.
pairs.english: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Salmon Alabansa; iyon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cada jaane jubendise jao; ya bae jualaba y naanmo para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo si Jeova, ya sumendangculo para umaalaba; ya y dinangculoña ti comprediyon.
pairs.english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un generasion ualaba y chechomo gui otro generasion, yan ujadeclara y matatnga na finatinasmo sija.
pairs.english: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jujajaso ni y minalag na minagas y inenramo, yan y mannamanman y chechomo.
pairs.english: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija ujasangan y ninasiñan y namaañao na finatinasmo sija; ya guajo bae judeclara y dinangculomo.
pairs.english: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujasangan y majason dinangculon y minaulegmo, ya ufanganta ni y tininasmo.
pairs.english: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova, cariñosogüe, yan bula minaase; ñateng para ulalalo, ya dangculo minaaseña.
pairs.english: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova mauleg para todo: ya y cariñoso na minaaseña gui jilo todo y chechoña.
pairs.english: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y chechomo uninalaba jao, O Jeova; ya y mañantosmo unmabendise jao.
pairs.english: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ujasangan y minalag y raenomo, yan ufanguentos ni y ninasiñamo.
pairs.english: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujanamatungo y matatnga na finatinasña sija gui lalajen taotao, yan y minalag y minagasña gui raenoña.
pairs.english: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raenomo, taejinecog na raeno, ya y gobietnomo gagaegueja para todo y generasion.
pairs.english: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova mumantiene todo ayo sija y mamodong, yan jajatsa todo ayo y manetecon.
pairs.english: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y atadog sija numanangga jao; ya jago numae sija nañija gui mauleg na tiempo.
pairs.english: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Unbaba y canaemo, ya unnafannajong todo y minalago y manlâlâlâ na güinaja.
pairs.english: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova tunas güe gui todo y chalanña; ya cariñoso gui todo y chechoña.
pairs.english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jijot gui todo ayo sija y umaagang gue; gui todo ayo y umaagang güe ni y minagajet.
pairs.english: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya unafanbula y minalago ayo sija y manmaañao nu güiya: ujungog locue y inagangñija, ya usatba sija.
pairs.english: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaadadaje todo ayo sija y gumaeya güe: lao todo y manaelaye uyulang.
pairs.english: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y pachotto usangan y tinina as Jeova: ya polo todo y catne, ya utinina y santos na naanña, para taejinecog yan taejinecog.
pairs.english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. O antijo, alaba si Jeova.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras lalâlâyo, bae jualaba si Jeova: jucantaye alabansa sija gui Yuusso mientras guajayo sustansiaco.
pairs.english: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo pumopolo y inangocomo gui prinsipe sija, ni y lajin taotao, gui anae taya inayuda.
pairs.english: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinagongña jumanao, ya güiya tumalo guato gui edaña: ayoja na jaane malingo y jinasoña.
pairs.english: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magof ayo y uguaja ni y Yuus Jacob para innayuda güe, ni y inangocoña gaegue gui as Jeova Yuusña:
pairs.english: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafatinas y langet yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y mangaegue gui sumanjalomñija, ni y jaadaje y minagajet para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jafatitinas juisio gui manmachiguet; ni y jananae nengcano y manñalang: si Jeova japupula y manmaprereso:
pairs.english: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova bumababa y atadogñija y bachet: si Jeova jumajatsa ayo sija y manetecon; si Jeova jaguaeguaeya y manunas.
pairs.english: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jaadadaje y taotao juyong sija; jamantietiene y taya tatañija yan y manbiuda; lao y chalan y tinaelaye, janaopop.
pairs.english: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ufangobietna para taejinecog; y Yuusmo, O Sion, para todo y generasion. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova: sa mauleg na utacantaye alabansa sija gui Yuusta; sa magof este; ya y alabansa respetao.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jumajatsa Jerusalem: ja fandadaña y manmayute juyong guiya Israel.
pairs.english: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanjomlo y manmayulang na corason, ya jabee y chetnotñija.
pairs.english: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan y numeron y pution sija; jafanaan todo sija ni y naanñija.
pairs.english: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dangculo y Yuusta, yan matatnga gui ninasiña; tiningoña taeuttimo.
pairs.english: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova jumajatsa y manmanso: ya jachule papa y manaelaye gui jilo oda.
pairs.english: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cantaye si Jeova ni y finatinas grasias; cantaye alabansa sija gui atpa, para y Yuusta.
pairs.english: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jatatampe y langet ni y mapagages, ya jalilisto y ichan para y tano, ya janafandodoco y chaguan gui jilo ogso sija.
pairs.english: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya numannae y gâgâ sija nañija, yan y fumaguon y aga sija ni y manaagang.
pairs.english: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti ninamamagof ni y ninasiñan y cabayo: ni ti ninamamagof güe ni y adeng y taotao.
pairs.english: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jeova ninamamagof güe ni y manmaañao nu güiya, ni y umangoco sija gui minaaseña.
pairs.english: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba si Jeova, O Jerusalem; alaba si Yuusmo, O Sion.
pairs.english: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa janafanfitme y rejas y trangcamo: jabendise y famaguonmo gui sumanjalommo.
pairs.english: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafatinas pas gui jalom uttimomo, ya ninabula jao ni y guesmauleg na trigo.
pairs.english: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y tinagoña gui jilo tano: y sinanganña malalago goschadig.
pairs.english: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mannae niebe calang pulo: jachalapon y manengjeng na sereno calang apo.
pairs.english: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayute y aesña calang andesmorona sija: jaye siña tumojgue gui menan y manengjengña?
pairs.english: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janajanao y sinanganña, ya jadirite: janafanguaefe y mangloña, ya y janom sija manmilalag.
pairs.english: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafanue si Jacob ni y sinanganña, ya y layña sija yan y juisioña sija y Israel.
pairs.english: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jafatinas taegüine gui un nasion: ya y juisioña, sija ti manmatungo sija. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova desde y langet: Fanmalaba nu güiya guiya jululo.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, todo y angjetña: fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya todo y inetnon sendaluña.
pairs.english: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, atdao an pulan: fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya todo y pution ni y maniina.
pairs.english: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo nu güiya, langet sija y langet sija, yan y janom sija ni y mangaegue gui jilo y langet.
pairs.english: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naan Jeova: sa manago, ya sija manfatinas.
pairs.english: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya guinin plumanta sija locue para taejinecog yan taejinecog: jafatinas y tinago na tu ufalofan.
pairs.english: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova desde y tano, jamyo ni y mandadao gui tinadong tase, yan todo y manadong.
pairs.english: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guafe yan graniso; niebe yan asgon: manglo pagyo ni y cumumple y sinanganña:
pairs.english: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ogso sija yan todo y sabana; manmanogcha na trongcon jayo yan todo y sedrosija;
pairs.english: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gâgâ yan todo y guaca; mangucunanas na gâgâ, yan y mangugupo na pajaro.
pairs.english: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ray sija y tano yan todo y taotao sija. Prinsipe sija, yan todo y jues y tano:
pairs.english: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manfamaguon na lalaje, yan famalaoan: y manamco na taotao, yan famaguon:
pairs.english: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naan Jeova: sa y naanñaja guefmanataquilo: y minalagña gui jilo tano yan y langet.
pairs.english: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jagasja jajatsa julo locue y canggelon taotaoña; y tininan todo y mañantosña sija; magajet na sija y famaguon Israel, y taotao sija ni y manjijot guiya güiya. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Cantaye si Jeova ni y nuebo na canta, ya y tininaña gui inetnon y mañantos.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo Israel ya umagof ni y fumatinas güe: polo y famaguon Sion ya ufanmagof ni y Rayñija.
pairs.english: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija ya ujaalaba y naaña ni y dansa: ya umacantaye güe gui atpa yan pandireta.
pairs.english: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Jeova janamagof güe gui taotaoña: güiya janagatbo y manmanso ni y satbasion.
pairs.english: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y mañantos y ufanmagof gui minalag; polo ya ufanganta pot y minagof gui jilo y camañija.
pairs.english: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y taquilo na alabansa gui as Yuus ya ugaegue gui pachotñija, yan y espada ni y malagtos dos banda gui canaeñija;
pairs.english: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujafatinas y inemog gui nasion sija, yan y castigo gui taotao sija;
pairs.english: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujagode y rayñija, ni y cadena sija; yan y manmagasñija ni y goden lulug.
pairs.english: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujafatinas gui jiloñija y matugue na juisio: este na inenra para todo y mañantosña. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: FANMANALABA jamyo as Jeova. Alaba si Yuus gui sinantos na sagaña: alaba gue gui feneda y ninasiñaña.
pairs.english: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y matatnga na finatinasña sija: alaba güe jaftaemanoja y minagas dinangculoña.
pairs.english: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y sonidon y trompeta: alaba güe ni y guitala yan y atpa.
pairs.english: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y pandireta, yan y dansa: alaba güe ni y gaecuetdas na dandan yan y flauta.
pairs.english: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Alaba güe ni y agang na batingting: alaba güe ni gosagang na sonidon batingting.
pairs.english: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo todo y güinaja ni y mangaejinagong ya ujaalaba si Jeova. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
pairs.english: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LEBLON y rasan Jesucristo lajin David, lajin Abraham.
pairs.english: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Abraham jalilis si Ysaac; ya si Ysaac jalilis si Jacob; ya si Jacob jalilis si Judas yan y mañeluña.
pairs.english: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas jalilis, gui as Tamar, si Fares yan si Sara; ya si Fares jalilis si Esrom; ya si Esrom jalilis si Aram;
pairs.english: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Aram jalilis si Aminadab; ya si Aminadab jalilis si Naason; ya si Naason jalilis si Salmon;
pairs.english: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Salmon jalilis, gui as Rahab, si Boos; ya si Boos jalilis, gui as Rut, si Obed; ya si Obed jalilis si Isai;
pairs.english: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Isai jalilis si ray David; ya si ray David jalilis si Salomon ni guinin güiya nii ampmam palaoan Urias;
pairs.english: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Salomon jalilis si Roboam; ya si Roboam jalilis si Abias; ya si Abias jalilis si Asa;
pairs.english: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Asa jalilis si Josafat; ya si Josafat jalilis si Joram; ya si Joram jalilis si Osias;
pairs.english: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Osias jalilis si Joatam; ya si Joatam jalilis si Acas; ya si Acas jalilis si Esequias;
pairs.english: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Esequias jalilis si Manases; si Manases jalilis si Amon; ya si Amon jalilis si Josias;
pairs.english: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Josias jalilis si Joaquim; si Joaquim jalilis si Jeconias, yan y mañeluña anae manmacone guiya Babilonia.
pairs.english: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos y manmacone guiya Babilonia, si Jeconias jalilis si Salatiel; si Salatiel jalilis si Sorobabel;
pairs.english: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Sorobabel jalilis si Abiud; si Abiud jalilis si Eliaquim; si Eliaquim jalilis si Asor;
pairs.english: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Asor jalilis si Sadog; si Sadog jalilis si Achim; si Achim si Eliud;
pairs.english: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Eliud jalilis si Eleasar; si Eleasar jalilis si Matan; si Matan jalilis si Jacob;
pairs.english: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jacob jalilis si José, asaguan Maria, na finañago si Jesus na mafanaan si Cristo.
pairs.english: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina todo y generasion desde as Abraham asta as David, catotse sija na generasion; ya desde as David asta manmacone guiya Babilonia, catotse na generasion; ya desde qui manmacone guiya Babilonia asta as Cristo, catotse na generasion.
pairs.english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 18 24790 ¶ Y mafañagon Jesucristo taegüine: Y nanaña as Maria, nobian José, antes de ujadaña, güiya esta masoda mapotgue pot y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si José asaguaña, sa mauleg na taotao, ti malago pinelo güe gui ninamamajlao, lao malagoña upinelo güe gui secreto.
pairs.english: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajajaso este, mato para güiya y angjet Señot, anae jagüife gui minaegoña, na ilegña: José, lajin David, chamo maañao na unresibe si Maria asaguamo, sa y gaegue guiya güiya y linilis Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufañago un laje ya ufanaan si Jesus; sa güiya unafanlibre y taotaoña nu y isaoñija.
pairs.english: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo sija masusede para umacumple y esta jasangan y Señot pot y profeta, ni ilegña:
pairs.english: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, un vitgen na umapotgue, ya ufañago un laje ya ufanaan si Emanuel, na comoqueilegña na si Yuus gaegue guiya jita.
pairs.english: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae magmata si José gui minaegoña, jafatinas taegüije y tinago y angjet, ya jaresibe y asaguaña.
pairs.english: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti matungo asta qui mañago ni lajiña finenana; ya nae y naanña si Jesus.
pairs.english: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mafañago si Jesus guiya Betlehem Judea gui jaanin ray Herodes, estagüe y manfaye na manmato guinin y sancatan para Jerusalem,
pairs.english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: mangue y ray Judios, ni mafañago? Sa y estreyasña inlie gui sancatan ya manmatojam para inadoragüe.
pairs.english: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este, si ray Herodes, inistotba yan todo y taotao Jerusalem locue.
pairs.english: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maagange todo y prinsipen mamale yan y escriba sija güije na tano, manfinaesen mano nae mafañago si Cristo.
pairs.english: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ilegñija: Iya Betlehem Judea; sa taegüine y munjayan matugue pot y profeta:
pairs.english: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago Betlehem, tano Juda, ada ti sendiquique jao gui entalo y prinsipen Juda, sa iya jago nae ujuyong y magalaje, para upasto y taotaojo, Israel.
pairs.english: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Herodes, anae jaagang y manfaye gui secreto, jaquequetungo guiya sija, ngaean y estreyas nae malie.
pairs.english: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, inquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya Jatago sija para Betlehem, ilegña: Janao fanmalag ayo guato ya inalula manmamaesen pot y patgon; yaguin esta inseda, insangane yo; ya jufato locue ya juadora güe.
pairs.english: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jajungog y sinangan ray, manmapos; ya estagüe y estreyas ni y jalie gui sancatan, na mofona gui menañija asta qui mato ya sumaga gui anae estaba y patgon.
pairs.english: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae malie y estreyas, gosdangculo minagofñija.
pairs.english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 11 24970 ¶ Anae manjalom gui guima, jasoda y patgon yan y nanaña, as Maria, ya mandimo ya maadora; ya mababa y güinajañija ya manae güe: oro, insenso, yan mira.
pairs.english: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmasangane pot si Yuus gui güinife, na ti ufanmalag as Herodes, manjanao para y tanoñija gui otro chalan.
