pairs.english: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 24990 ¶ Ya anae manmapos sija, y angjet y Señot mato gui as José gui güinife, ya ilegña: Cajulo ya uncone y patgon yan si nanaña, ya infanjanao para Egipto, ya infañaga güije, asta qui guajojao sumangane; sa si Herodes jaaligao y patgon para umapuno.
pairs.english: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo güe, ya jacone y patgon yan si nanaña gui puenge ya manjanao para Egipto;
pairs.english: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije asta que matae si Herodes, sa para umacumple y sinangan y Señot pot y profeta, na ilegña: Iya Egipto nae, juagang y Lajijo.
pairs.english: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 16 25020 ¶ Si Herodes, anae jalie na mamofea güe ni manfaye, gueflalalo ya manago na ufanmapuno todo y famaguon ni guaja guiya Betlehem yan gui todo oriyaña ni dos años sacanñija para papa, jaftaemanoja y tiempo anae ninatungo ni y manfaye.
pairs.english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae macumple esta, ni y guinin masangan pot y profeta Jeremias, na ilegña:
pairs.english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inagang na majungog guiya Rama umagang, tumangis yan cumasao na dangculo; si Raquel cumasao pot y famaguonña, ya ti malago maconsuela sa manaegüe.
pairs.english: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 19 25050 ¶ Anae esta matae si Herodes, mato y angjet y Señot gui as José gui güinife, guiya Egipto,
pairs.english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Cajulo, cone y patgon yan si nanaña, ya infanjanao para y tano Israel; sa matae y cumequepuno y patgon.
pairs.english: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo ya jacone y patgon yan si nanaña ya manmalag y tano Israel.
pairs.english: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajungog na si Arquelao, güiya y ray guiya Judea gui sagan tataña as Herodes, maañao malag guato; lao pot si Yuus ninatungo güe claro gui güinifeña, mapos malag y tanon Galilea.
pairs.english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, sumaga gui siuda na mafanaan Nasaret; para ucumple y masanganña pot y profeta sija, na umafanaan taotao Nasaret.
pairs.english: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO sija na jaane, mato si Juan Bautista ya sumetmon gui desierton Judea,
pairs.english: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Fanmañotsot sa y raenon langet jumijijot.
pairs.english: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta güiya uje y guinin jasangan y profeta Isaias, na ilegña: Inagang ni umagang gui desierto: Famauleg y chalan y Señot, natunas y chalanña.
pairs.english: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y magaguña si Juan y pilon cameyo yan y godeña cuero na jachaflileg gui senturaña, ya y naña y apacha sija yan y miet jalom tano.
pairs.english: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapos malag para güiya, Jerusalem yan Judea yan todo y tano gui oriyan Jordan,
pairs.english: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya esta manmatagpange pot güiya, guiya Jordan, jasangan claro y isaoñija.
pairs.english: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 7 25160 ¶ Ya jalie megae na Fariseo yan Saduseo sija na manmamaela para y tinagpangeña ya ilegña: Rasan culebla, jaye jamyo fumanagüe na insujaye y binibo ni mamaela?
pairs.english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmamatinas tinegcha digno ni y sinetsot.
pairs.english: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo jumajaso sumangan gui sanjalommiyo, na si Abraham tatata; ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na siña si Yuus janacajulo este sija na acho famaguon gui as Abraham.
pairs.english: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago, esta locue y gachae gaegue na mapolo gui jale y trongcon jayo sija; ya todo y trongcon jayo ni ti manogcha mauleg, umautut ya umapolo gui guafe.
pairs.english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo magajet jutagpange jamyo nu y janom para minañotsot, lao y mamamaela gui tateco, mas guaja ninasiñaña qui guajo: y sapatosña ti mauleg yo na jupula; güiya infantinagpange ni Espiritu Santo yan y guafe.
pairs.english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y abanicoña gaegue gui canaeña, ya unagasgas y tablaña, ya unaetnon y triguña jalom gui jalom camalin, ya usonggue y pajan trigo gui taejinecog na guafe.
pairs.english: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 13 25220 ¶ Anae mato si Jesus guinin Galilea, malag Jordan gui as Juan para utinagpange.
pairs.english: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Juan ti malago, ilegña: Nesesita yo matagpange pot jago, enaojao na mamaela guiya guajo?
pairs.english: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe as Jesus ilegña: Diejaloja, sa taegüenao mauleg para utacumple y todo na tininas. Ayo nae pinelo.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus, anae munjayan matagpange, cajulo gusisija guine y janom, y langet mababa pot güiya ya malie y Espiritun Yuus tumunog calang paluma y sumaga gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un vos guinin y langet na ilegña: Estagüiya y lajijo ni y guefyajo.
pairs.english: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae quinene si Jesus ni Espiritu para y jalomtano para umatienta ni anite;
pairs.english: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba umayunat cuarenta na jaane yan cuarenta na puenge ya despues ñalang.
pairs.english: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya y manienienta, ya ilegña: Yaguin jago lajin Yuus, tago este y acho ya ufamapan.
pairs.english: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manope ilegña: Matugue esta: Ti y panja uninalâlâ y taotao, lao y todo y sinangan ni y jumuyong gui pachot Yuus.
pairs.english: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ninamalofan ni anite gui santa na siuda; pinelo gui jilo torren diquique, iyon y templo.
pairs.english: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ilegña: Yaguin jago lajin Yuus, yutejao güine papa, sa matugue esta: Y angjet sija uninadje ya unquinajat ni canaeñija, para chaña y adengmo umatotpe contra y acho.
pairs.english: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña: Locue esta matugue, chamo tietienta y Señot, Yuusmo.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo ninamalofan ni anite gui un sabana na sentáquilo ya jafanue todo y raeno sija gui jilo y tano yan y minagofñija,
pairs.english: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Todo este sija junaejao yaguin dumimojao ya unadora yo.
pairs.english: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Janao Satanas, sa matugue esta, y Señot Yuusmo na güiyaja unadora yan güiyaja unsetbe.
pairs.english: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae diningo ni anite, ya y angjet sija manmato ya masetbe güe.
pairs.english: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 12 25380 ¶ Anae jajungog si Jesus na si Juan esta mapongle, tumalo guato Galilea.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadingo Nasaret, mato Capernaum ya sumaga gui oriyan tase gui oriyan tanon Sabulon yan Neftalim.
pairs.english: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y guinin jasangan y profeta Isaias, na ilegña:
pairs.english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano Sabulon yan y tano Neftalim, chalan tase yan para otro banda guiya Jordan, Galilea y Gentiles.
pairs.english: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija nu y mañasaga gui jemjom, dangculo na manana liniiñija; y ayo sija nu y mañasaga tanon anineng y finatae, candet ufaninina.
pairs.english: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 17 25430 ¶ Desde ayo jatutujon si Jesus sumetmon ya ilegña: Fanmañotsot, sa y raenon langet jijijot.
pairs.english: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 18 25440 ¶ Ya anae jumajanao si Jesus gui tasen Galilea, jalie dos chumelo; si Simon mafanaan Pedro yan si Andres cheluña, na janatutunog y lagua gui tase sa manpescadot.
pairs.english: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Dalalag yo ya junafanpescadot taotao jamyo.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija japolo y lagua sija ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jumanao güije, jalie otro dos chumelo, si Santiago lajin Sebedeo, yan si Juan cheluña, gui sajyan yan si tatañija as Sebedeo na jalememenda y laguañija; ya jaagang.
pairs.english: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija enseguidas japolo y sajyan yan si tatañija ya madalalag güe.
pairs.english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 23 25490 ¶ Ya jalilicue si Jesus iya Galilea mamanagüe gui sinagoga sija ya sumetmetmon ni raenon y evangelio, ya janafanjomlo todo y chetnot yan todo y pinite gui taotao;
pairs.english: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y matunaña matungo todo guiya Siria; ya maquenenee güe guato todo manmalango, ni guaja todo clasen chetnot yan pinite; y maninanite yan y manbababa yan y manparalitico; ya janafanjomlo.
pairs.english: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya madalalag güe linajyan taotao, guinin Galilea, yan guinin Decapolis, yan guinin Jerusalem, yan guinin Judea, yan y otro banda guiya Jordan.
pairs.english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE jalie si Jesus y linajyan taotao, cajulo gui un sabana, ya matachong; ya y disipuluña manmato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jababa y pachotña ya jafanagüe, ilegña:
pairs.english: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mamoble gui Espiritu, sa uiyonñija y raenon langet.
pairs.english: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mantriste, sa sija umanafanmagof.
pairs.english: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manmanso, sa sija ufanmaereda ni y tano.
pairs.english: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manñalang yan manmajo ni tininas, sa sija umanafanjaspog.
pairs.english: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manyóase, sa sija ufantinaca ni minaase.
pairs.english: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y mangasgas corasonñija, sa sija ujalie si Yuus.
pairs.english: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y fumatitinas y pas, sa sija ufanmafanaan famaguon Yuus.
pairs.english: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso y manmapetsigue pot causa y tininas; sa uiyonñija y raenon langet.
pairs.english: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo, yaguin manmamatdise jamyo, yan manmapetsigue jamyo, yan manmasangane jamyo todo taelaye pot y naanjo, ya manmandague.
pairs.english: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmagof, ya infansenmagof, sa y premionmiyo gui langet sendangculo: sa taegüenaoja locue manmapetsigueñija y profeta sija ni y antes di jamyo.
pairs.english: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 13 25640 ¶ Jamyo y asigan y tano; ya yaguin y asiga malingo y maaseña, jafa taemano manasne? taya baliña, na umayute juyong ya umagacha ni y taotao.
pairs.english: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo y candet y tano. Y siuda ni maplanta gui jilo y tano táquilo ti siña umatog.
pairs.english: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya candet umasonggue ya umapolo gui papa un medida; lao umapolo gui candelero, ya umanainina todo y mangaegue gui jalom guma.
pairs.english: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya umanina y candetmiyo gui menan y taotao sija, para ujalie y mauleg chechonmiyo, ya innamagof y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 17 25680 ¶ Chamiyo jumajaso na mato yo para juyulang y tinago pat y profeta sija; ti mato yo para juyulang, lao para jucumple.
pairs.english: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo, nu y langet yan y tano ufalingo; lao ni un punto ni un pongpong gui tinago ufalingo, asta qui güiya todo macumple.
pairs.english: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y yumulang uno güine gui sendiquique na tinago, ya mamanagüe ni taotao, diquique umafanaan gui raenon langet; lao jayeja y fumatinas ya mamanagüe umafanaan dangculo gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo sumangane jamyo: na y tininasmiyo yaguin ti mudongña qui y tininas y escriba yan y Fariseo sija, ti siña jamyo manjalom gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 21 25720 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangane sija gui manmalofan na tiempo: Chamo famumuno, ya jayeja y mamuno, peligroña gui juisio.
pairs.english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo na jayeja y lalalo ni cheluña, peligroña gui juisio, na jayeja y umalog ni cheluña, taetiningo jao, peligroña gui tribunal, lao jayeja y umalog bababa jao, peligroña gui guafen sasalaguan.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unchule y ninaimo guato gui attat, ya ayo nae unjaso na guaja linachimo gui chelumo;
pairs.english: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo güije y ninaimo gui menan y attat, ya unjanao finena ya inatungo yan y chelumo, ya ayo nae untalo guato ya unnaenñaejon y ninaimo.
pairs.english: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atungo yan y contrariumo enseguidas, mientros gaegue jamyo gui chalanmiyo, noseaja, y cotrariumo unenentrega gui jues, ya y jues unenentrega gui ofisiat ya unmapolo gui preso.
pairs.english: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Seguro na ti unjuyong güije, asta qui anapase y uttimo na coble.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 27 25780 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Munga umábale,
pairs.english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na jayeja y umatan y palaoan nu ábale na minalagoña, jafatinas yan güiya y ábale gui jalom corasonña.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y agapa na atadogmo uninapodong jao, chule ya yute guiya jago; sa maulegña na ufalingo un pidaso guiya jago, qui todo y tataotaomo umayute guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y agapa na canaemo uninapodong jao, utut ya yute guiya jago; sa maulegña, na ufalingo un pidaso guiya jago, qui todo y tataotaomo umayute guiya sasalagüan.
pairs.english: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut if off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 31 25820 ¶ Munjayan locue masangan: Jayeja y dumingo y asaguaña, umatugue y papet y inapattan umasagua.
pairs.english: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na y dumingo y asaguaña ya ti pot inábale, jafatinas y ábale; ya jayeja y umasagua ayo y umadingo, jafatinas y ábale.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 33 25840 ¶ Injingogja locue y munjayan masangane sija gui manmalofan na tiempo: Munga manjula pot namaesa jao; lao unfatinas ni y Señot gui jinilamo.
pairs.english: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Chamiyo fanmanjujula pot jafa; ti pot y langet, sa raenon Yuus;
pairs.english: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y tano, sa sagan y adengña; ni pot Jerusalem, sa siuda y dangculo na Ray;
pairs.english: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni pot y ilumo unfanjula; sa ti siña y gaponulo uno naapaca, ni uno naatulong.
pairs.english: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manguentos jamyo, alog: Junggan, junggan; Aje, aje; sa yaguin mas qui este, taelaye jumuyong.
pairs.english: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 38 25890 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Atadog yan atadog, nifen yan nifen,
pairs.english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Chamiyo fumatinas jafa contra y tinaelaye; yaguin jayejao pumatmada gui agapa na fasumo, birayeja ni y otro.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y munaquequemumojao ya jachule y magagomo, nae locue y capamo.
pairs.english: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y umafuetsas jao na unjanao yan güiya un miya; unjanao yan güiya dos.
pairs.english: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumagao jao, nae; ya y mumalago umayao jao, chamo jao rumiuusa.
pairs.english: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 43 25940 ¶ Injingogja y munjayan masangan: Guaeya y tiguangmo ya chatlie y enemigomo.
pairs.english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo: Guaeya y enemigonmiyo; bendise y mumatdidise jamyo; fantinas mauleg ni y chumatlie jamyo, tayuyute sija as Yuus ni y munamamajlao jamyo yan y pumetsigue jamyo,
pairs.english: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para infanfamaguon y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet, nu y janafanina y atdao gui jilo y manaelaye yan y manmauleg; ya janauchan gui jilo y manunas yan y timanunas.
pairs.english: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inguaeya ayo y gumaeya jamyo, jafa premionmiyo? Ada ti jafatinas locue taegüenao y publicano sija?
pairs.english: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unsaluda y mañelunmiyo, jafa unfatinas mauleg? Ada ti jafatinas locue taegüenao y ti mangilisyano?
pairs.english: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafangabales jamyo taegüije y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet, cabales.
pairs.english: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ADAJE ya chamiyo fumatitinas y limosnanmiyo gui menan y taotao sija, para infanlinie; sa yaguin ti taegüenao, taya premionmiyo gui tatanmiyo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin unfatitinas y limosnamo, chamo na catitiye trompeta gui menamo taegüije y jafatitinas y hipocrita sija gui sinagoga, yan y plasa para uguaja minalagñija nu y taotao sija. Magajet jusangane jamyo na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin unfatitinas y limosnamo, chamo natutungo y canaemo acagüe jafa checho y canaemo agapa.
pairs.english: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ugaegue y limosnamo gui secreto, sa y tatamo ni jalilie gui secreto, güiya umapase jao gui publico.
pairs.english: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 5 26040 ¶ Ya yaguin manaetaejao, munga taegüije y hipocrita, sa sija yanñija manmanaetae gui sinagoga yan y esquinan chalan manotojgue para ufanmalie nu y taotao sija. Magajet na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin manaetaejao, jalom gui aposentomo, ya juchum y pettamo, ya taetaye y tatamo ni y gaegue gui secreto; sa y tatamo ni y jalilie gui secreto, güiya umapase jao gui publico.
pairs.english: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan manaetaejao chamo sumasangan un sinangan megae na biaje na taebale, taegüije y Gentiles; jinasoñija na ufanmajungog pot y megae sinanganñija.
pairs.english: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fumatitinas taegüije iya sija; sa y tatanmiyo jatungoja jafa innesesita antes qui ingagao güe.
pairs.english: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao an manmanaetae jamyo taegüine: Tatanmame na gaegue jao gui langet: umatuna y naanmo.
pairs.english: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Umamaela y raenomo, umafatinas y minalagomo jaftaemano gui langet taegüijija gui tano;
pairs.english: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam pago nu y cada jaane na agonmame;
pairs.english: Give us this day our daily bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya asiijam nu y dibenmame, taegüije yan inasisie y dumidibejam sija;
pairs.english: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamojam pumópolo na infanbasnag gui tentasion, lao nafanlibrejam nu y taelaye; sa iyomo y raeno, yan y ninasiña, yan y minalag para taejinecog na jaane; Amen.
pairs.english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inasie y umisagüe jamyo: maninasiija locue jamyo as tatanmiyo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ti unasie ayo sija y umisagüe jamyo, ti infaninasie locue ni tatanmiyo nu y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 16 26150 ¶ Yaguin umayuyunatjao, munga taegüije y hipocrita nu y triste na mata, jaago y matañija, para ufanmatungo ni taotao sija na manayunat. Magajet jusangane jamyo, na esta guaja premioñija.
pairs.english: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jago, yaguin umayunat jao, palalae y ilumo, ya unfagase y matamo;
pairs.english: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para munga malilie nu y taotao sija na umayuyunat jao, lao si tatamoja ni y gaegue gui secreto; ya si tatamo, ni jalilie gui secreto, güiya uninapase gui publico.
pairs.english: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 19 26180 ¶ Chamiyo fannanaetnon güinaja para jamyo gui tano, mano nae y poliya yan y lamas uyinamag, yan y saque sija uyulang yan uchule;
pairs.english: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao fannaetnon güinaja para jamyo gui langet, mano nae ni y poliya ni y lamas ti uyinamag, ya ni y saque sija ti uyulang yan ti uchule.
pairs.english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae gaegue y güinajanmiyo, ayoja nae gaegue locue y corasonmiyo.
pairs.english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y candet y tataotao y atadog; yaguin y gasgas atadogmo, todo y tataotaomo ubula y manana.
pairs.english: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin y taelaye na atadogmo, todo y tataotaomo jomjom, Sa yaguin y manana ni y gaegue guiya jago jomjom, jafa na gosdangculo na jinemjom!
pairs.english: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 24 26230 ¶ Taya ni uno siña sumetbe dos amo; sa jachatlie y uno, ya jaguflie y otro; pat jadalalag y uno ya jadespresia y otro. Ti siña jamyo insetbe si Yuus yan y güinaja.
pairs.english: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jusangane jamyo: Chamiyo fanmanjajaso pot y jaaninmiyo; jafa para incano, pat jafa para inguimen; ni pot para innaminagago y tataotaomiyo. Ada ti bale mas y linâlâmo qui y nengcano, yan y tataotaomo qui y magago?
pairs.english: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanja y pajaro gui langet; ti manmanananon, ni ti manmangongoco, ni ti manmanrecocoje jalom gui camalin; sa si tatamoja gui langet munafañochocho. Ada ti mangaebalotña jamyo qui sija?
pairs.english: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaye guiya jamyo, yaguin manjaso, siña jataluye y linecaña un codo?
pairs.english: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa jamyo na manmanjajaso pot magago? Jasoja y lirio sija gui fangualuan, jaftaemano manlâlâñiñija; ti manmachochocho ya ti manmajijila.
pairs.english: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo, na si Salomon yan todo y minalagña, ti minagago parejo yan uno güine sija.
pairs.english: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Yuus janaminagago y chaguan gui fangualuan; sa pago gaegue, ya agupa machule ya mapolo gui jetno, ada ti mas jamyo inninaminagago, taotao jamyo na didide jinengguenmiyo?
pairs.english: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina, chamiyo jumajaso umalog: Jafajit tacano, pat jafajit taguimen, pat jafajit magaguta?
pairs.english: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo este sija na güinaja, jaaliligao y Gentiles; ya y tatanmiyo gui langet jatungoja na innesesita todo este sija na güinaja.
pairs.english: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao aligao fenena y raenon Yuus, yan y tininasña; ya despues todo este sija na güinaja infanmataluye.
pairs.english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumajaso y para agupa, sa y para agupa güiyaja güe ujaso. Basta para y cada y jaane y inalulaye.
pairs.english: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMIYO fanmanjusga para ti infanmajusga.
pairs.english: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taemanoja yan manmajusga yan manmañogne jamyo, taegüijija locue infanmajusga; ya taemanoja y minedidamiyo, taegüijija locue infanmamediye.
pairs.english: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa muna unlilie y migo gui atadog y chelumo, ya ti unjajaso y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa taemano unalog nu y chelumo: Maela ya junajanao enao y migo gui atadogmo; ya enagüija y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Hipocrita! Najanao finenana y jayo gui atadogmo? ya ayo nae siña ungueflie yan para unnajanao y migo gui atadog y chelumo.
pairs.english: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 6 26390 ¶ Chamiyo numanae y galago nu y santos, ni inpelo y perlasmiyo gui menan y babue; sa no seaja ujagacha nu y patasñija ya ujabira sija ya infanyenabalag jamyo.
pairs.english: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 7 26400 ¶ Gagao ya infanmanae; aligao ya inseda; yajo ya infanmababaye.
pairs.english: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y mangagao, uresibe; ya y manaligao, usoda; ya y manyajo, umababaye.
pairs.english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja guiya jamyo, yaguin uguinagao nu y lajiña pan, ada unnae acho?
pairs.english: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat yaguin uguinagao un güijan, ada unnae un serpiente?
pairs.english: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ombre manaelaye jamyo, intingo numae mauleg na ninae y famaguonmiyo; ada ti mas y tatanmiyo, ni y gaegue gui langet, unnae mauleg na güinaja todo ayo y gumagaogüe?
pairs.english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina, jaftaemano y malagomiyo na y taotao ufatitinas nu jamyo, taegüijija infatitinas locue nu sija; sa este y lay yan y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 13 26460 ¶ Jalom gui maiot na potta, sa y feda na potta ya micanpo y chalan nu y jumananaogüe y finalingo, ya megae sija y fumapoposgüe.
pairs.english: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y maiot na potta ya dalalae na chalan y jumananaogüe y linâlâ, ya didide sija y sumosoda.
pairs.english: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 15 26480 ¶ Adaje jamyo nu y ti manmagajet na profeta, ni ufanmato guiya jamyo maninagagon quininilo, lao y sanjalomñija mangaegue lobo na mañaque.
pairs.english: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injatingo pot y tinegchañija. Ada y taotao ufañule ubas guine y títucan jayo, pat igos guine y títucan chaguan?
pairs.english: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijija todo y mauleg na trongcon jayo, siempre mauleg tinegchaña; lao y taelaye na trongcon jayo, siempre taelaye tinegchaña.
pairs.english: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti siña y mauleg na trongcon jayo manogcha taelaye; ni y taelaye na trongcon jayo manogcha mauleg.
pairs.english: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y trongcon jayo ni ti manogcha mauleg, umautut ya umayute gui guafe,
pairs.english: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina pot y tinegchañija, injatingo.
pairs.english: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 21 26540 ¶ Ti todo y umalog nu guajo: Señot! Señot! ujalom gui raenon langet; lao ayo y fumatinas y minalago y tatajo, ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae, güije na jaane, ualog nu guajo: Señot! Señot! ada ti inprofetisa pot y naanmo, yan innajanao y anite pot y naanmo, yan infatinas megae námanman na chocho pot y naanmo?
pairs.english: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo nae jusangane sija, ni y magajet ti jutungo jamyo, fanjanao guiya guajo, jamyo manmamatitinas inechong.
pairs.english: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 24 26570 ¶ Enao mina jayeja y jumungog este sija y sinanganjo ya fumatinas, güiya parejo yan y méjnalom na taotao, na jafatinas y guimaña gui jilo acho;
pairs.english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utunog y ichan, yan ufanmato y sadog, yan ufanmanguaefe y manglo, ya ubinate ayo na guma ya ti upodong, sa mafatinas gui jilo acho.
pairs.english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jayeja y jumungog este sija y sinanganjo, ya ti fumatinas, güiya parejo yan y bábaba na taotao na jafatinas y guimaña gui jilo unae;
pairs.english: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utunog y ichan yan ufanmato y sadog, yan ufanmanguaefe y manglo ya ubinate ayo na guma, ya upodong; ya gosdangculo y pinedongña.
pairs.english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, anae munjayan este sija jasangan si Jesus, ninafanmanman y linajyan taotao sija nu y doctrinaña.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafanagüe sija, calang uno ni gaeninasiña, lao ti calang y escriba sija.
pairs.english: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae tumunog güe guinin y sabana, madalalag güe dangculo na linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe na mato un ategtog ya tinayuyut güe ilegña: Señot, yaguin malagojao, siña unnagasgas yo.
pairs.english: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaestira y canaeña ya japacha ya ilegña: malagoyo, gasgasjao! Ya enseguidas y ategtog gasgas.
pairs.english: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus: Adaje ya chamo fañangangane ni jaye; lao falag y pale ya unfanue nu jago, ya unchule y ninae ni manago si Moises para testimonioñija.
pairs.english: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 5 26670 ¶ Ya anae jumalom si Jesus guiya Capernaum, mato guiya güiya un senturion guinagao güe,
pairs.english: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Señot, y tentagojo gaegue guiyajame na umaason sa malango paralitico, ya gogosninachatsaga sa adit.
pairs.english: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nui guiya: Bae jufato ya junajomlo.
pairs.english: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao senturion manope ya ilegña: Señot, ti siña na guajojao junafato gui papa atufjo, lao sanganja un palabra ya ujomlo y tentagojo.
pairs.english: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo locue un taotao gui papa ninasiña, ya guaja sendalojo gui papa ninasiñajo; ya yaguin ilegco nu este na taotao: Janao, ya jumanao; yan ilegco ni otro: Maela, ya mamaela, yan ilegco ni tentagojo: Chogüe este, ya jachogüe.
pairs.english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus, ninamanman, ya ilegña nu y dumadalalag güe: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na tayayo nae mañoda ni este na dangculon jinenggue guiya Israel!
pairs.english: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo sumangane jamyo, na ufanmato megae guine y sancatan, yan guine y sanlichan; ya ufanmatachong yan si Abraham yan si Ysaac yan si Jacob gui raenon langet;
pairs.english: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y famaguon y raeno ufanmayute gui sumanjiyong gui jemjom; ya ayo nae uguaja cumasao yan checheg nifen.
pairs.english: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Jesus ilegña nu y senturion: Janao, parejoja y unjonggue, umafatinas guiya jago; ya y tentagoña jumonlo güije na ora.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 14 26760 ¶ Ya anae mato si Jesus gui guiman Pedro, jalie y suegran Pedro na umaason gui cama, sa guaja calenturaña.
pairs.english: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japacha canaeña; ya pinelo ni calentura: ya cajulo ya jasetbe sija.
pairs.english: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta pupuenge, maconie güe megae na maninanite, ya janajanao guiya sija todo y anite pot y sinanganña, yan janafanjomlo todo y manmalango.
pairs.english: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y esta masangan pot y profeta Isaias, na ilegña: Güiya chumule y chetnotta yan cumacatga y pinitita.
pairs.english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 18 26800 ¶ Ya anae jalie si Jesus y linajyan taotao gui oriyaña, manago na ufanmalag y otro banda y sadog.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un escriba ya ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, judalalag jao mano y malagomo guato.
pairs.english: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Y sora sija guaja liyangñija, ya y pajaro gui langet guaja chenchonñija: lao y Lajin taotao taya mano nae unaason y iluña.
pairs.english: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya otro uno gui disipuluña ilegña nu güiya: Señot, nae yo lisensia ya jujanao finena ya jujafot y tatajo.
pairs.english: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Dalalag yo; ya polo ya y manmatae ufanjinafot ni y mangaematae.
pairs.english: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 23 26850 ¶ Ya anae jumalom gui un sajyan, y disipuluña sija madalalag güe.
pairs.english: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dangculo na pagyo mato gui tase ya y sajyan tinatampe nu y napo sija; ya güiya mamaegoja.
pairs.english: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña ya mayajogüe ilegñija: Señot, nafanlibrejam sa manmalingojam!
pairs.english: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na manmaañao jamyo, taotao na didide jinengguenmiyo? Ayo nae cajulo ya jachoma y manglo yan y tase, ya dangculo na minalinao guaja.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao sija manmanman, ya ilegñija; jafa este na taotao na y manglo yan y tase maoosgueja güe?
pairs.english: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 28 26900 ¶ Ya anae mato gui otro banda gui tano y taotao Gadara sija, umasoda yan dos na gaemanganite na manguine y naftan, yan mangosnamaañao y jechurañija; ya taya siña malofan güije na chalan.
pairs.english: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, na manaagang ilegñija: Para jafajam nu jago Lajin Yuus? Matojao güine para usapetjam antes di y tiempo?
pairs.english: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chago guiya sija estaba un manada na gosmegae na babue mañochocho.
pairs.english: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
