pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y anite sija matayuyutgüe ilegñija: Yaguin unyutejam juyong, najanaojam na fanmalag ayo y babue sija.
pairs.english: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Janao. Ya sija manjuyong ya, manmalag gui jalom y manadan babue; ya, estagüe, todo y babue manmalago papa gui un didog na lugat, asta y jalom tase, ya manmatae gui janom tase.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y munafañochocho y babue manmalago ya manmalag y siuda, ya jasangan todo y guaja, ya jafa susede yan y mangaemanganite.
pairs.english: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, todo y siuda manjanao para ufanasoda yan si Jesus, ya anae maliigüe, matayuyutgüe na ujanao gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jumalom gui un batco, mapos güe, ya malag y otro banda ya mato gui suidaña.
pairs.english: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, sija na manmangongone güe un malango, umaason gui cama sa paralitico; ya anae jalie si Jesus y jinenggueñija, ilegña nu y paralitico: Angoco lajijo; y isaomo unmaasie.
pairs.english: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe sija palo escriba na ilegñija gui sanjalomñija: Este chumatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo si Jesus y jinasoñija, ilegña: Jafa na manmanjajaso jamyo taelaye gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa mas guse masangan: Y isaomo unmaasie: pat masangan: Cajulo ya unfamocat?
pairs.english: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingoja na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña, gui jilo tano, para umaasie isao; (ayo nae ilegña nu y paralitico), Cajulo, chule y camamo ya unjanao para iyajamyo.
pairs.english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo ya mapos para iyasija.
pairs.english: And he arose, and departed to his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie nu y linajyan taotao, ninafanmanman, ya manamalag si Yuus, sa mannae nu ayo na ninasiña gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 9 27050 ¶ Ya anae malofan si Jesus güije, jalie un taotao na matatachong gui bancon y tributo, na y naanña si Mateo, ya ilegña nu güiya, Dalalagyo. Ya cajulo ya dinalalag güe.
pairs.english: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae estaba güe, matachong chumochocho gui jalom guma, estagüe, sija megae na publicano yan manisao, manmato ya mañija manmatachong gui lamasa yan si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie este nu y Fariseo sija, ilegñija nu y disipuluña: Sa jafa y maestronmiyo na mañisija mañocho yan y publicano yan y manisao?
pairs.english: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jajungog ayo, ilegña: Y manaechetnot ti janesesita medico: lao y manmalango.
pairs.english: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janao ya inquetungo jafa este: Minaase malagojo, ya ti inefrese; sa ti mato yo para juaagang y manunas, lao y manisao para ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 14 27100 ¶ Ayo nae y disipulon Juan manmato guiya güiya ya ilegñija: Jafa jame yan y Fariseo sija na manayuyunat megae; ya y disipulumo ti manayuyunat?
pairs.english: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Siña y mangachong y nobio, mantriste yaguin mañisijaja yan y nobio? Lao ufato y jaane, na y nobio umacone guiya sija, ya ayo nae ufanayunat.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya ni un taotao lumimendanñaejon y nuebo na magago gui mamagagonñañajeon ni y bijo; sa ayo na lemenda usuja gui magago, ya y minatitegña sentaelaye.
pairs.english: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni umasajguane locue y nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero sa y boteyan cuero umafag ya umachuda y bino, ya manmalingo y boteyan cuero; lao umasajguane y nuebo na bino gui nuebo na boteyan cuero, ya uchamaog y dos.
pairs.english: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 18 27140 ¶ Mientras jasangangane sija ni este, estagüe, un magas na mato ya inadoragüe ilegña: Y jagajo matae tiampmanja; lao nije ya maela ya unpolo y canaemo gui jiloña ya ulâlâ.
pairs.english: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus ya dinalalag güe, yan y disipuluña locue.
pairs.english: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 20 27160 ¶ Ya, estagüe, un palaoan na malango nu y minilalag y jâgâ, esta dose años, mato gui tateña ya japacha y madoblan y magaguña;
pairs.english: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña gui sumanjalomña: Yaguin jupachaja y magaguña, jujomlo.
pairs.english: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jabiragüe ya anae malie güe ilegña: Jagajo, angoco, y jinengguemo unninajomlo. Ya y palaoan ninajomlo desde ayo na ora.
pairs.english: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato si Jesus gui guima ayo na magas, ya jalie y mandadandan nu y flauta yan y taotao sija manboruruca,
pairs.english: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Fañuja; sa y patgon palaoan ti mamatae, lao mamaego. Ya mabutleagüe.
pairs.english: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao sija anae mañuja, güiya mapos jalom, ya jamantiene canaeña; ya y patgon palaoan cajulo.
pairs.english: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malofan este na fama todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 27 27230 ¶ Anae mafapos si Jesus güije, madalalag güe dos taotao na bachet na umaagang ilegñija: Gaease nu jame, jago, Lajin David.
pairs.english: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato guato gui jalom guma, manmato guiya güiya y dos bachet, ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Injenggue na guajo siña jufatinas este? Ya sija ilegñija: Junggan Señot.
pairs.english: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae japacha y atadogñija ya ilegña: Parejoja y jinengguenmiyo umafatinas.
pairs.english: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y atadogñija manmababa. Ya si Jesus jagosencatga ilegña. Adaje ya chamiyo munatutungo ni uno.
pairs.english: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmapos sija, manafamta y famaña todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 32 27280 ¶ Ya anae manmapos sija; estagüe, machule guiya güiya un taotao na udo, na gaeanite.
pairs.english: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae ninajanao y anite y udo cumuentos. Ya y linajyan taotao ninafanmanman ya ilegñija: Taya este nae malie guiya Israel.
pairs.english: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Pot y ninasiña y prinsipen anite, janajanao y anite sija.
pairs.english: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalilicue si Jesus todo y siuda sija yan y sengsong, mamananagüe gui guima Yuusñija, ya jasesetmon y ebangelion y raeno, yan janafanmamagong todo y chetnot yan todo y pinite gui taotao sija.
pairs.english: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 36 27320 ¶ Anae jalie y linajyan taotao, ninamaase nu sija, sa manadingo ya manmachalapon calang y quinilo nu y taya pastotñija.
pairs.english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu y disipuluña: Magajet na y cosecha megae: lao y manfáfachocho didide.
pairs.english: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tayuyut y Señot y cosecha ya utago y manfáfachocho gui cosechaña.
pairs.english: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae jaagang y dose na disipuluña, ya janae ninasiñañija contra y manaplacha na espiritu, para ujayute juyong; yan unafanmagong todo y chetnot, yan todo y manpinite.
pairs.english: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y naan y dose apostoles sija este sija: Y finenana, si Simon na mafanaan si Pedro, yan si Andres cheluña: si Santiago, lajin Sebedeo, yan si Juan cheluña;
pairs.english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Felipe, yan si Bartolome; si Tomas, yan si Mateo y publicano; si Santiago, lajin Alfeo, yan si Lebeo, na y apiyiduña si Tadeo;
pairs.english: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon Selote, yan si Judas Iscariote, ni y umintrega güe locue.
pairs.english: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y dose sija mantinago as Jesus na ufanjanao ya maninencatga ilegña: Chamiyo fanmalag y chalan y Gentiles; yan y siuda y Samaritano sija chamiyo fanjajalom:
pairs.english: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao gosmauleg para ufanmalag y malingo na quinilo gui guima Israel.
pairs.english: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manjanao jamyo, setmon ya alog: Y raenon langet mato jijot.
pairs.english: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nafanjomlo y manmalango, nafan gasgas y manategtog, nafangajulo y manmatae, nafanjanao y anite sija: pot grasia na inresibe, fanmannae pot grasia.
pairs.english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fannanaetnon oro ni salape ni coble gui betsanmiyo;
pairs.english: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni tengguang para y chalan, ni dos na magago ni sapatos, ni baston; sa y fafáchocho jamerese y nengcanoña.
pairs.english: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan todo na siuda, pat songsong na manjalom jamyo, guesaligao jaye mumerese, ya fañaga güije asta qui para infanjanao.
pairs.english: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manjalom jamyo gui guima, saluda.
pairs.english: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y guima jamerese, y pasmiyo usaga guiya güiya; lao yaguin ti jamerese, y pasmiyo utaloja guato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ti rumesibe jamyo, yan ti jaecungog y sinanganmiyo, fanjanao güije na guma pat suida, ya insacude contra sija todo y petbos gui adengmiyo.
pairs.english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Y mas mauleg para y tano Sodoma yan Gomora gui jaanin sentensia, qui para ayo na siuda.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 16 27500 ¶ Estagüe, na guajo jamyo tumago, calang quinilo gui entalo lobo sija; fanmalate calang y serpiente sija, yan y fanmanso calang y paluma sija.
pairs.english: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo nu y taotao sija; sa infaninentrega gui inetnon ofisiat, ya infanmasaolag gui sinagogañija;
pairs.english: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmacone guato gui menan magalaje yan ray pot y naanjo, para testimonio contra sija yan y Gentiles.
pairs.english: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manmaentrega jamyo, chamiyo jumajaso jafa para insangan; so ayoja na ora infanmanae jafa para insangan.
pairs.english: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jamyo infanguentos, lao y Espiritun y Tatanmiyo ni y cumuecuentos gui jalommiyo.
pairs.english: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cheloja uinentrega y cheluña para umapuno, ya y tata y lajiña: ya y famaguon ufangajulo contra tatañija, ujanamapuno.
pairs.english: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo infanchinatlie pot y naanjo; lao y sumigue asta y uttimo, güiya ucajulo gui langet.
pairs.english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin manmapetsigue jamyo gui un suida, fanmalag y otro: sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti infanmunjayan manjanao todo gui siudan Israel, asta qui mato y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo, ti dangculoña qui y maestro, yan y tentago qui y amuña.
pairs.english: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bastaja y disipulo yaguin parejoja y maestruña, ya y tentago yaguin parejoja y amuña. Sa yaguin y tata gui guima mafanaan Beetsebub, cuanto mas y familiana?
pairs.english: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaañao; sa taya matatampe, para ti umalie: yan manaatog para ti umatungo.
pairs.english: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo sija y jusangane jamyo gui jemjom, sanganñaejon gui manana: ya todo sija y injingog gui talanga, sanganñaejon desde y jilo guma.
pairs.english: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo fanmaañao ni upinino y tataotao; sa ti siña japuno y ante: lao fanmaañaoñao ni ayo y siña yumute y tataotao yan y ante guato guiya sasalaguan.
pairs.english: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti mabende dos gorrión na pájaro pot un coble? yan ni uno guiya sija upodong gui tano sin utungo si tatanmiyo.
pairs.english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaponulonmiyo locue esta todo manmatufong.
pairs.english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaañao; sa mas manbaliñaja jamyo qui y megae na pájaro.
pairs.english: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayeja y sumanganyo gui menan taotao, güajo locue jusangangüe gui menam y tatajo ni gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y pumuneyo gui menan taotao sija, guajo locue jupune güe gui menan y tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 34 27680 ¶ Chamiyo jumajaso na mato yo para jupolo pas gui tano: ti matoyo para jupolo pas, lao espada.
pairs.english: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato yo para jupolo inaguaguat y laje contra y tataña, ya y jaga contra y nanaña, ya y yetna contra y suegraña.
pairs.english: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y enemigoñija mangaegueja guiya sija.
pairs.english: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya y tataña pat y nanaña mas qui guajo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo; ya y gumaeya y lajiña pat y jagaña mas qui guajo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo.
pairs.english: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, y ti chumule y quiluusña ya udalalagyo, ti ufanmerese nu guajo.
pairs.english: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sumoda y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya y finalingaeguan ni y linâlâña pot y naanjo, güiya usoda.
pairs.english: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 40 27740 ¶ Y rumisibe jamyo, jaresibeja yo; ya y rumisibeyo, jaresibeja y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y rumesibe un profeta pot y naan profeta, uresibe y premion profeta; ya y rumesibe y taotao tunas pot y naan y taotao tunas, uresibe y premion y taotao tunas.
pairs.english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masquesea jayeja y numae uno güine nu este sija y mandiquique, unoja bason janom ni y fresco, pot y naan y disipulo, magajet jusangane jamyo na ti ufalingo y premiuña.
pairs.english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae munjayan jatago si Jesus y dose disipuluña, jumanao para ufamanagüe, yan usetmom gui siudañija.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog si Juan, gui guima presuña, y finatinas Jesucristo; jatago. dos gui disipuluña,
pairs.english: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jago ayo y para ufato pat infanmannanggajam otro?
pairs.english: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ilegña: Janao ya innatungo si Juan todo ni y liniimiyo yan y jiningogmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y bachet manmanlie, y mancojo manmamocat, y manategtog mangasgas, y mananga manmanjungog: y manmatae manafangajulo ya y mamoble manmasangane ni y evangelio.
pairs.english: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dichoso y ti sumasoda lugat para umatompo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 7 27830 ¶ Anae manmapos sija, jatutujon si Jesus sumangan si Juan gui linajyan taotao. Jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie gui desierto? un trongcon piao na ninamayeyengyong ni y manglo?
pairs.english: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat, jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie? un taotao na minagagon fino na magago? Estagüe, sija y manminagagon fino na magago, mangaegue gui guima y ray sija.
pairs.english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pot jafa injanagüe jamyo? Para inlie un profeta? Junggan, jusangane jamyo, mas qui y profeta.
pairs.english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este yuje y munjayan matugue: Estagüe na junajanao y taotao y tinagojo gui menan matamo, para ufamauleg y chalanmo gui menamo.
pairs.english: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti ucajulo gui entalo y manmafañañago gui famalaoan, uno mas dangculo qui si Juan Bautista; lao y mas diquique gui raenon langet mas dangculo qui güiya.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde y jaanin Juan Bautista asta pago, y raenon langet gaeninasiña; ya y manmatatnga sija uamot.
pairs.english: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y profeta sija, yan y lay, japrofetisa asta si Juan.
pairs.english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: An manmalago jamyo inresibe; güiya si Ilias ni y umamaela.
pairs.english: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaetalanga para unfanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 16 27920 ¶ Lao jaye nae juacompara este na rasa? Manparejo yan y famaguon ni manmatatachong gui plasa ya jaagang y mangachongñija,
pairs.english: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Indandane jamyo flauta, ya ti manbaela jamyo, manuugong jamyo lao ti manatanges jamyo.
pairs.english: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato si Juan ya ti chumocho ni gunimen, ya ilegñija: Gaeanite güe.
pairs.english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato y Lajin taotao ya chumocho yan gumimen, ya ilegñija: Estagüe un taotao na gachumocho, yan gagumimem, amigon y publicano sija yan y manisao; lao y tiningo manacabales ni y finatinasña.
pairs.english: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 20 27960 ¶ Ayo nae jatutujon lumalalatde y siuda sija nae guinin jafatinas sumenmegae na namanman Sa ti manmanjonggue, ilegña:
pairs.english: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayjao, Corasin! Ayjao, Betsaida! sa yaguin iya Tiro yan Sidon nae mafatinas ayo y mannamanman ni y mafatinas guiya jamyo, esta jagas manmañotsot gui silisio yan apo.
pairs.english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na mas songunon Tiro yan Sidon qui para jamyo gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago, Capernaum, ni y jagas manataquito jao asta y langet; unmayute jao papa sasalaguan; sa yaguin iya Sodoma nae mojon mafatinas todo ayo y mannamanman ni jagas mafatinas guiya jago, mangagaegueja mojon asta pago na jaane.
pairs.english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo; na y mas songunon tano Sodoma, qui para jago gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 25 28010 ¶ Ayo na tiempo nae, manope si Jesus ilegña: Grasias junaejao, Tata, Señot y langet yan y tano, sa unnafanatog estesija gui manmalate yan manmejnalom, ya unfanue y famaguon.
pairs.english: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja Tata: sa taegüenao y mauleg gui liniimo.
pairs.english: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y güinaja jaentrega yo si Tata; ya taya tumungo y Lajiña na si Tataja: ni taya tumungo, si Tata na y lajiñaja, ya ayoja y lajiña malagoña unafanungo.
pairs.english: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 28 28040 ¶ Maela guiya guajo todo y manyayas, yan y menoson, ya guajo junafandescansa.
pairs.english: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo y yugojo gui jilomiyo, ya infaneyag guiya guajo, sa guajo manso yan umitde gui corasonjo; ya infanmañoda descanso para y antinmiyo.
pairs.english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y yugojo mañana, ya y catgaco ñajlalang.
pairs.english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo nae jumajanao si Jesus un sabalo na jaane gui entalo mais ya y disipuluña manñalang, ya jatutujon manmañule ni espiga ya jacano.
pairs.english: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y Fariseo sija, ilegñija: Estagüe y disipulumo na jafatitinas y ti mauleg para umafatinas gui sabalo na jaane.
pairs.english: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Ada ti untaetae, jafa finatinasña si David, anae ñalang yan y mangachogña?
pairs.english: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano jumalom gui guimayuus, ya jacano y pan proposision sija, na ti cabales güiya ucano, ni y mangachongña; lao para y mamaleja?
pairs.english: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat, ada ti untaetae gui lay, na y jaanin y sabado, gui templo y mamale sija japrofana y sabado, ya taya isaoñija?
pairs.english: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo sumangane jamyo, uno mas dangculo qui y templo gaegue güine.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin intingo jafa este ilelegña, Minaase malagojo, ti inefrese, ti insangan mojon contra y manaeisao.
pairs.english: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Señot y sabado y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 9 28150 ¶ Ya anae jumanao güije malag y gumayusñija;
pairs.english: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe un taotao na majlog y canaeña; ya mafaesen ilegñija: Ada mauleg para jita na infanamte gui sabado? para umafaaela güe.
pairs.english: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegna: Jafa taotao guaja gui entalo miyo yaguin guaja un quinilo na podong gui joyo, gui jaanin sabalo, ada ti uestira y canaeña ya jochule?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti mas baliña un taotao qui un quinilo? Pot este, cabales na umafatinas mauleg gui jaanin sabado.
pairs.english: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni y ayo na taotao: Juto y canaemo; ya jajuto ya finamauleg talo parejo yan y otro.
pairs.english: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 14 28200 ¶ Ayo nae y Fariseo sija manjanao, ya manafaesen entre sija contra güiya para umapuno güe.
pairs.english: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jatungo ai Jesus, mapos güije; ya madalalag güe linajyan taotao, ya janafanjomlo todosija.
pairs.english: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya guefmanencatga, na chañija munamatutungo güe.
pairs.english: And charged them that they should not make him known:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y esta munjayan masangan pot y profeta Isaias, ilegña:
pairs.english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y tentagojo ni y juayig, y güinaeyaco ni y janamagof y antijo: na jupoluye ni y Espiritujo gui jiloña, ya jasangane Gentiles y juisio.
pairs.english: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti upotfia, ni uagang; ya taya ni uno ujiningog y inagangña gui chalan.
pairs.english: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti umayulang y piao ni mayamag ni umapuno y mechan dangis ni y aasa asta qui machule y juisio para y guinana.
pairs.english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y naanña, manmannanangga y Gentiles.
pairs.english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 22 28280 ¶ Ya machuliegüe guato un inanite, na bachet yan udo, ya janajomlo; ayo nae cumuentos y udo yan manlie.
pairs.english: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Ada ti este yuje y lajin David?
pairs.english: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo sija jajungog ya ilegñija: Este ti uyute juyong y anite, yaguin ti pot Beetsebub, magas y anite sija.
pairs.english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus, anae jatungo y jinasoñija, ilegña: Todo y raeno umadibide contra güiyaja uyulang; ya cada guma, pat siuda, umadibide contra güiyaja, ti usaga.
pairs.english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Satanas jayute juyong si Satanas, güiya umadibide contra güiyaja, ya jaftaemano y raenoña sumaga?
pairs.english: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin guajo pot si Beetsebub juyuyute juyong y anite sija; pot jaye y famaguonmiyo, fanyinite sija juyong? Pot ayo, sija ufanjuesmiyo.
pairs.english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin pot y Espiritun Yuus, juyute juyong y anite sija, magajet na esta mato guiya jamyo y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa? Jaftaemano siña un taotao jumalom gui guima y matatnga na taotao ya uyulang todo y güinajaña, yanguin ti jagode finenana y matatnga? Ayo nae siña jayulang y guimaña.
pairs.english: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti jumajame, contrariujo güe; ya y ti rumecoje güe guiya guajo, güiya umachalapon.
pairs.english: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 31 28370 ¶ Pot enao na jusangane jamyo: Todo isao yan y chatfino contra si Yuus, umasie y taotao sija; lao y chatfino contra y Espiritu, ti umaasie y taotao.
pairs.english: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y cumuentos contra y Lajin taotao, umaasie; lao jayeja y cumuentos contra y Espiritu Santo, ti umaasie, ni este na tiempo, ni y ayo na mamamaela.
pairs.english: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fatinas mauleg na trongcon jayo, yan y tinegchaña mauleg; pat fatinas taelaye na trongcon jayo, yan taelaye y tinegchaña; sa pot y tinegchaña, y jayo esta matungo.
pairs.english: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O rasan culebla! jafa taemano jamyo na manaelaye siña manguentos mauleg, lo sa gui minegae y guaja gui corason, sinasangan y pachot.
pairs.english: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg na taotao, nu y mauleg na güinaja gui corasonña, mauleg chinileleña; lao y taelaye na taotao, nu y taelaye na güinaja gui corasonña, taelaye chinileleña.
pairs.english: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na todo y finijo na taesetbe ya jasasangan y taotao sija, janesesita ufanmannae cuenta gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot y finomo na unmanatunas jao, yan pot y finomo na unmasentensia jao.
pairs.english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 38 28440 ¶ Ayo nae manmanope y escriba yan y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Maestro manmalagojam na inlie un señatmo.
pairs.english: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope ilegña nu sija: y generasion manaelaye yan manábale manmanaliligao y señat, lao taya señat ufanmanae, na y señat Jonas profeta.
pairs.english: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenaoja si Jonas sumaga tres na jaane yan tres na puenge gui jalom y tiyan y bayena, ayo locue mina y Lajin taotao, usaga tres na jaane yan tres na puenge gui jalom corason y tano.
pairs.english: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao Ninibe ufangajulo gui juisio yan este na generasion, ya ufanmasentensia, sa sija manmañotsot ni y setmon Jonas; ya estagüeja, uno güine na lugat na mas dangculo qui si Jonas.
pairs.english: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raena gui sancatan ucajulo gui juisio yan este na generasion ya ufanmasentensia, sa mato guine y uttimon tano, para uecungog y tiningo Salomon, ya estagüeja uno güine na lugat na mas dangculo qui si Salomon.
pairs.english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y áplacha na espiritu jumanao gui taotao, mamomocat gui anglo na lugat, ya jaaliligao nae udescansa, lao ti mañoda.
pairs.english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña: Jutalo guato para y iyajame ni anae guine ayoyo. Ya anae mato guato, jasoda taesinajguan, binale yan maadotna.
pairs.english: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapos, ya mangone talo gachongña siete na espiritu na mas taelaye qui güiya, ya manjalom ya mañaga güije; ya mas taelaye uttimoña yuje na taotao qui y finenaña. Taegüineja locue ujumuyong este na generasion y manaelaye.
pairs.english: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 46 28520 ¶ Ya anae estaba güe cumuecuentos yan y taotao sija; estagüe, si nanaña, yan y mañeluña mangaegue gui sumanjiyong, na manmalago na umacuentuse güe.
pairs.english: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña uno: Estagüe, si nanamo, yan y mañelumo gui sumanjiyong, na manmalago na umacuentuse jao.
pairs.english: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaope ayo y sumangan este, ya ilegña: Jaye nanajo yan jaye mañelujo?
pairs.english: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajuto y canaeña gui disipuluña, ya ilegña: Estagüe, y nanajo yan y mañelujo.
pairs.english: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo ayo y fumatinas y minalago y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet, este güiya chelujo laje, yan chelujo palaoan, yan nanajo.
pairs.english: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na jaane, jinanaoña si Jesus gui guima, matachong gui oriyan tase.
pairs.english: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya dangculo na linajyan taotao; ya jumalom güe gui un batco, ya matachong; ya todo y linajyan taotao manmatachong gui oriyan unae.
pairs.english: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacuentuse sija megae na acomparasion, ilegña: Estagüe y tátanom na jumuyong para ufananom.
pairs.english: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manananom, palo gui semiya manpodong gui oriyan chalan, ya manmato y pájaro sija ya macano.
pairs.english: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Palo gui semiya manpodong gui jilo acho na lugat, na ti megae odaña; ya doco ti apmam, sa ti tadong papa gui eda.
pairs.english: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manina y atdao, mansinenggue sa taejale, ya ninamalayo.
pairs.english: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo mamodong gui entalo títuca sija ya mandoco y títuca ya chiniguet.
pairs.english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo manpodong gui mauleg na oda, ya manmanogcha; y uno siento, y otro sesenta, y otro treinta.
pairs.english: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato y disipuluña sija ya ilegñija: Jafajao na cumuecuentuse sija pot acomparasion sija?
pairs.english: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope ilegña. Sa esta manmanae jamyo, para intingo y misterion y raenon langet, lao sija ti ufanmanae.
pairs.english: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y guaja, umanae para uguaja mas; lao ayo y taya iyoña, achog uguaja y iyoña, umachule.
pairs.english: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jucuentuse sija pot acomparasion; sa y manmanaatan, ya ti manmanlie, ya manecungog, ya ti manmanjujungog, ni ujatungo.
pairs.english: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ya sija nae umacumple y sinangan Isaias ni ilegña: Anae manmanjujungog, ujungog ya ti utungo; ya anae manmanaatan, ufanmanlie, ya ti ujasiente.
pairs.english: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y corasonñija este na taotao sija manmacat, ya y talangañija mapot manmanjungog, ya y atadogñija jajujuchom; para chañija fanmanlilie ni atadogñija, yan ufanmanjungog ni talangañija, ya ujatungo ni corasonñija, ya ujatolaeca sija, ya guajo junajomlo sija.
pairs.english: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mandichoso y atadogmiyo, sa manmanlie, yan y talanganmiyo sa manmanjungog.
pairs.english: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na megae na profeta, yan manunas na taotao jagasja manmalago na ujalie y liniinmiyo, ya ti jalie; yan ujajungog y jiningogmiyo, ya ti jajungog.
pairs.english: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 28740 ¶ Ecungog jamyo y acomparision y tátanom.
pairs.english: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jayeja y umecungog y sinangan y raeno, ya ti jatungo, mato y Taelaye ya janajanao y esta matanme gui corasonña. Este yuje semiya ni y pedong gui oriyan chalan.
pairs.english: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y matanme gui jilo acho na lugat, este yuje y jumungog y sinangan, ya jaresibe ni y minagofña.
pairs.english: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taya jale guiya güiya, ya gaegue un ratoja; sa anae mato y triniste yan minamajlao pot causan di y sinangan, ti apmam matompo gui isao.
pairs.english: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y matanme gui entalo títuca sija; este yuje y jumungog y sinangan; lao y inadajiña ni y tano, yan dinague ni güinaja, jañucot y sinangan ya sumaga sin tinegchaña.
pairs.english: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y matanme gui mauleg na oda; este yuje y jumungog y sinangan ya jatungo, ya manogcha locue; ya y tinegchaña y uno siento, ya y otro sesenta, ya y otro treinta.
pairs.english: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 24 28800 ¶ Otro acomparasion jasangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet parejoja yan un taotao ni manananom gui fangualuanña, mauleg na semiya.
pairs.english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tiempo nae manmamaego y taotao sija, mato y enemigo ya jatanme y taelaye na chaguan gui entalo y trigo, ya mapos.
pairs.english: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mandoco y trigo ya manmanogcha, y taelaye na chaguan mandoco locue.
pairs.english: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato y tentago y tatan familia ya ilegñija nu güiya: Señot, ada ti mauleg na semiya tinanommo gui fangualuanmo? Jafa mina guaja taelaye na chaguan?
pairs.english: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija: Un enemigo fumatinas este. Ya y tentagoña ilegñija nu güiya: Malagojao ya infanjanao ya inchile?
pairs.english: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Munga, sa no sea yaguin inchile y taelaye na chaguan, innabineog locue y trigo.
pairs.english: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya ufandaña mandoco sija na dos asta y quineco; an mato y tiempon quineco, bae jualog ni para ufanmangoco: Chile finena y taelaye na chaguan, ya inguede famanojo para umasonggue; ya y trigo polo gui jalom y camalinjo.
pairs.english: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
