pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 28870 ¶ Otro acomparasion sinangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet parejoja yan y pepitas y mostasa, ni jachule un taotao ya jatanme gui fangualuanña.
pairs.english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na güiya mas diquique gui todo y semiya sija; lao anae esta mandoco, güiya mas dangculo gui manmagogulae, ya mamatrongconjayo, ya manmato sija y pájaron y aire, ya manmamatinas y chenchon gui ramasña.
pairs.english: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 33 28890 ¶ Otro acomparasion sinangane sija ilegña: Y raenon langet, parejoja yan y libadura, ni y un palaoan jachule ya janana gui tres medidan arina, asta qui todo manbolacho.
pairs.english: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo estesija jasangan si Jesus pot acomparasion gui linajyan taotao; ya taya jasangane sija sin acomparasion.
pairs.english: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y munjayan masangan pot y profeta na ilegña: Jubaba y pachotto pot acomparasion: ya jusangan güinaja sija ni manafanatog desde y plinantan y tano.
pairs.english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jadingo y linajyan taotao ya mapos, ya jumalon gui guima; ya manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña sija, ya ilegñija: Naclaruyejam ni y acomparasion y taelaye na chaguan gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope sija ilegña: Ayo y mananom mauleg na semiya y Lajin taotao yuje.
pairs.english: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y fangualuan, y tano; y manmauleg na semiya, y famaguon y raeno, ya y taelaye na chaguan y famaguon y Maligno.
pairs.english: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y enemigo, ni y tumanme, y anitegüe; ya y quineco, y jinecog y siglo; ya y para ufanmangone, y angjet sija.
pairs.english: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao machule y taelaye na chaguan ya masonggue gui guafe, taegüijija locue y jinecog y siglo.
pairs.english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utago y Lajin taotao y angjetña sija; ya urecoje todo ayo sija y fumatitinas y tinempo, yan y fumatitinas y tinaelaye;
pairs.english: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uyute gui jetnon guafe; ya ayo nae uguaja tumanges, yan chegcheg nifen.
pairs.english: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y manunas, ufanmanina calang y atdao, gui raenon y Tatanñija. Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya ujungog.
pairs.english: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 44 29000 ¶ Y raenon langet locue, parejoja yan un senguaguan na güinaja ni y mananana gui un fangualuan, ya un taotao, anae jasoda, janana, ya mapos yan pot y minagofña jabende todo y iyoña ya jafajan ayo na fangualuan.
pairs.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 45 29010 ¶ Y raenon langet parejoja locue yan un taotao ni manbebende, na manaliligao bonito na petlas:
pairs.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mañoda un petlas na senguaguan, mapos ya jabende todo y güinajaña ya jafajan ayo.
pairs.english: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 47 29030 ¶ Y raenon langet parejoja locue, yan un lagua ni y mayute guato gui tase, ya mangone todo clase:
pairs.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta bula, majala guato gui oriyan unae; ya manmatachong, ya majoca y manmauleg ya masajguane gui sajguanñija, ya y manaelaye mayute juyong.
pairs.english: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüinija locue y jinecog y siglo: ufato y angiet sija ya ujanafanjanao y manaelaye gui entalo y manunas;
pairs.english: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ujayute gui jetnon guafe; ya ayo nae uguaja güije tumanges, yan chegcheg nifen.
pairs.english: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Intingo todo estesija? Sija ilegñija nu guiya: Junggan.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Pot este todo escriba ni mafatinas disipulo gui raenon langet, parejoja yan y tatan un familia, ni y jachuchule gui güinajaña bijo sija, yan nuebo sija.
pairs.english: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 53 29090 ¶ Ya anae janafonjayan si Jesus todo este sija na acomparasion, mapos güije.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui tanoña, mamanagüe gui guimayuusñija, ya sija ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Guine mano nae jumuyong este na tiningoña, ya este sija mandangculo na ninasiña?
pairs.english: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti güiya este y lajin y catpintero? Ada si nanaña ti mafanaan si Maria? yan y mañeluña, ti sija si Santiago, si José, si Simon, yan si Judas?
pairs.english: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ada ti manjijita yan y mañeluña palaoan? Guine mano nae uguaja este na taotao todo estesija? Ya guaja guiya güiya disgusto.
pairs.english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y profeta taya onraña, gui tanoña yan y guimaña; lao gaeonraña gui otro lugat.
pairs.english: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jafatinas güije megae na mannamanman, sa taya jinengguenñija.
pairs.english: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo si Herodes y tetrarca jajungog y faman Jesus;
pairs.english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu y tentagoña sija: Este si Juan Bautista: güiya cajulo gui entalo y manmatae, enao mina mandangculo na mannamanman jafatitinas guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 3 29170 ¶ Sa si Herodes esta jacone si Juan, ya jagode, ya japolo gui calaboso, pot si Herodias, asaguan Felipe y cheluña.
pairs.english: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan ilegña nu güiya: Ti tunas na un guaja jao nu este na palaoan.
pairs.english: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malago na upinino güe, maañao ni y linajyan taotao; sa pineloñija na si Juan profeta güe.
pairs.english: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y jaanin y mafañagon Herodes, y jagan Herodias bumaela gui talo, ya ninamagof si Herodes,
pairs.english: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este japromete ya manjula na uninae todo y guinagaoña.
pairs.english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya guinin umatungo finena an nanaña, ya ilegña: Naeyo güine gui un plato ni y ilon Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y ray ninatriste; lao pot causa y juramentoña yan y mangachongña na mangaegue gui lamasa, manago na umanae.
pairs.english: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, manago na umautot y ilon Juan gui calaboso.
pairs.english: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machule guato y ilo gui un plato, ya manae y patgon palaoan, ya güiya chumule para si nanaña.
pairs.english: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija, manmato ya machule y tataotaoña, ya majafot, ya manmapos, ya masangane si Jesus.
pairs.english: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 13 29270 ¶ Ya anae jajungog este si Jesus, mapos güije gui un batco para y desierto na lugat na sumajnge: ya anae majungog ni y linajyan taotao sija, madalalague güe, manmamocatja desde siuda sija.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao si Jesus, ya jalie y dangculo na linajyan taotao: ya ninamaase ni ayo sija, ya janafanjomlo y manmalango sija.
pairs.english: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 15 29290 ¶ Ya anae estaba pupnenge güije na jaane, manmato guiya güiya y disipuluña sija ya ilegñija; Este na lugat desierto ya y tiempo esta ufalofan; tago y linajyan taotao ya ufanjanao, ya ufanmalag y sengsong sija, ya ufanmamajan nañija.
pairs.english: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Taya nesesida na sija ufanjanao: jamyo innae nañija.
pairs.english: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ilegñija nu güiya: Taya güine guaja na sincoja na pan, ya dos na güijan.
pairs.english: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña: Chulieyofan güine mague.
pairs.english: He said, Bring them hither to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y linajyan taotao na ufanmatachong gui jilo chaguan, jachule y sinco na pan yan dos na güijan ya jaatan julo y langet, ya jabendise: ya jaipe y pan ya janae y disipulo sija, ya y disipulo janae y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho todos, ya manjaspog; ya anae majoca y sebblan pedaso sija na maipe, bula dose na canastra.
pairs.english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañocho sija, sinco mit na lalaje, ti matufong y famalaoan yan y famaguon.
pairs.english: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 22 29360 ¶ Enseguidas si Jesus janafanjalom y disipuluña sija gui un batco, ya manjanao manmofona, manmalag y otro bandan sadog, y tiempo nae güiya janafanjanao y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jadespide y linajyan taotao, cajulo gui un ogso na sumajnge, ya manaetae. Ya estaba gui puenge, ya sumasaga güigüiyaja namaesa.
pairs.english: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y batco pago estaba gui talo gui tase, pinapada ni napo, sa y manglo contra.
pairs.english: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina cuatro na guatdia gui puenge, si Jesus jumanao para iyasija mamomocat gui jilo tase.
pairs.english: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie ni disipuluña sija na mamomocat gui jilo tase, ninafañatsaga, ya ilegñija: Fafañagüe este; ya managang ni y minaañaoñija.
pairs.english: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas si Jesus cumuentos, ilegña nu sija: Angoco jamyo; guajoyo; chamiyo fanmaaañao.
pairs.english: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope si Pedro ilegña: Señot, yaguin jago, tago yo ya jufalag iyajago gui jilo janom.
pairs.english: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña: Maela. Ya tumunog si Pedro gui batco, ya mamocat gui jilo janom para uguaguato gui as Jesus.
pairs.english: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jalie na dangculo na manglo, ninamaañao; ya anae jatutujon dimafondo, jaagang, ilegña: Señot, nalibreyo.
pairs.english: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas si Jesus jajuto mona y canaeña, ya guiniut güe, ya ilegña nu güiya: Taotao na didide jinengguemo! Sa jafa ti unjonggue?
pairs.english: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjalom julo gui batco, y manglo quieto.
pairs.english: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae manmato gui as Jesus escriba yan Fariseo sija, guiya Jerusalem, ya ilegñija:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa disipulomo na ti jaosgue y tradision y manbijo? sa ti jafagagase y canaeñija anae mañocho pan?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaope sija ilegña: Jafa locue jamyo na ti inesgue y tinago Yuus pot tradisionmiyo?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Yuus manago, ilegña: Onra si tatamo, yan si nanamo; ya y mumatdise si tataña, pat si nanaña, magajet na umatae.
pairs.english: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo ilegmiyo: Jayeja y umalog ni tataña, pat si nanaña: Y ninae para si Yuus, ayo na probechonmiyo guiya guajo;
pairs.english: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti guaelaye na ujaonra si tataña. Enaomina innataelaye y Sinangan Yuus pot y tradisionmiyo.
pairs.english: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Hipocritas! Cabales y sinangan nu jamyo as Isaias anae ilegña:
pairs.english: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na taotao sija, nu y labiosñija jaonrayo; lao y corasonñija chago guiya guajo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taesetbe y inadodorayo, manmamananagüe y finanagüenñija ni y sinangan taotao.
pairs.english: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 10 29600 ¶ Ya jaagang y linajyan taotao, ya ilegña nu sija: Ecungog ya intingo.
pairs.english: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti y jumajalom gui pachot, muna natataelaye y taotao; na ayo y jumujuyong gui pachot, ayo muna natataelaye y taotao.
pairs.english: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato y disipuluña sija, ya ilegnija nu güiya: Untungo na y Fariseo sija ninafandisgustao anae jajungog este na sinangan?
pairs.english: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jaope sija ilegña: Todo tinanom ni y ti jatanom y Tatajo na gaegue gui langet, umajajleg.
pairs.english: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo sija: y bachet ya uguia y bachet; yaguin y bachet uguia y bachet, sija na dos uchapodongja gui joyo.
pairs.english: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pedro, ilegña: Sanganejam nu este na acomparasion.
pairs.english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña: Ada locue trabia jamyo ti intitingoja?
pairs.english: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti intingo na todo y jumalom gui pachot, jumajanao para y tiyan, ya mayuyute gui lugat umatog.
pairs.english: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y jumuyong gui pachot, estesija guine y corason, ya estesija muna natataelaye y taotao.
pairs.english: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gui corason nae manjujuyong y taelaye na jinaso, manpegno taotao, adulterio, inabale, saque, ti manmagajet na testimonio, chatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija muna fanataelaye y taotao; lao y chumocho yan y ti mafagase canaeña, ti ninatataelaye y taotao.
pairs.english: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao si Jesus güije, malag y oriyan Tiro yan Sidon.
pairs.english: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe un palaoan, taotao Cananea, na jumanao gui ayo sija na oriya, ya umaagang, ilegña: Señot, Lajin David, gaemaase nu guajo; y jagajo ninachatsaga fefman ni anite.
pairs.english: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ti jaope sinangan: Ayo nae manmato y disipuluña sija, ya magagao güe ilegñija: Tago güe ya ujanao, sa esta jame jaagang.
pairs.english: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaope ilegña: Ti guajo matago na y manmalingo na quinilo gui guima Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y palaoan mato, ya jaadoro güe, ilegña: Señot, ayudayo.
pairs.english: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope güi ilegña: Ti mauleg na tachule y pan y famaguon ya tayute y galago sija.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan manope: Magajet Señot; lao y galago sija, mañochochoja ni andesmorona ni mamopodong gui lamasan y amuñijo.
pairs.english: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope si Jesus, ilegña: Palaoan! dangculo jinengguemo: umafatinas guiya jago jafa y malagomo. Ya jomlo y jagaña desde ayo na ora.
pairs.english: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus mapos güije, ya mato jijot gui tasen Galilea: ya cajulo gui jilo un finabeca, ya matachong güije.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato guiya güiya linajyan taotao, na guaja guiya sija cojo, bachet, udo, mangco, yan palo sija megae na manmalango, ya manmapolo gui adeng Jesus; ya janafanjomlo.

pairs.english: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

pairs.english: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

pairs.english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

pairs.english: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Atan, ya inadaje jamyo ni y lebaduran y Fariseo yan y Saduseo sija.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manmanjaso gui sanjalomñija, ilegñija: Buente pot y ti manmañulejam pan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatungo si Jesus, ilegña nu sija: Jafa jinasonmimiyo gui sanjalommiyo, taotao na didide jinengguenmiyo, pot y ti manmañule jamyo pan?
pairs.english: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti intitingo, ni ti injajaso y sinco na pan, gui sinco mit, ya cuanto na canastra injeca.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y siete na pan gui cuatro mit, ya cuanto na canastra injeca?
pairs.english: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa este na ti intingo, na ti pot y pan na jusangane jamyo? Lao inadaje jamyo ni y lebaduran y Fariseo yan y Saduseo sija.
pairs.english: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatungo na ti mansinangane sija na ujaadaje sija ni y lebaduran pan; lao y finanagüen y Fariseo yan y Saduseo sija.
pairs.english: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Guaja umalog na jago si Juan Bautista; ya guaja umalog, si Elias; ya guaja umalog, si Jeremias, pat uno gui profeta sija.
pairs.english: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Ya jamyo, jaye ilegmimiyo nu guajo?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Simon Pedro ilegña: Jago si Cristojao, y Lajin Yuus ni y lalâlâ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae inepe as Jesus ilegña: Dichosojao, Simon, lajin Jonas; sa ti jufanuejao sensen ni jâgâ, na y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo locue sumanganejao, na jago si Pedro; ya y jilo este na acho, jufatinas y iglesiamo; ya y pettan sasalaguan taeninasiña contra guiya.
pairs.english: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya junaejao ni y yaben y raenon langet; ya todoja y ungode gui tano, umagodeja locue gui langet; ya todoja y unpula gui tano, umapula locue gui langet.
pairs.english: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatago y disipuluña sija, na chañija fanmañangangane ni jaye na güiya si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 21 30100 ¶ Desde ayo na tiempo jatutujon si Jesus dumeclaraye y disipuluña sija, na guaja nesesidaña na ujanao para Jerusalem, ya upadese megae sija gui manbijo, yan y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno, ya umanacajulo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro, quinene güe ya tinitujon güe rineprende, ilegña: Señot, maase nu jago: este ti usiña jago.
pairs.english: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jabiragüe, ya ilegña as Pedro: Suja gui menajo, Satanas: jago un tropero para guajo; sa ti untungo y güinaja Yuus, na y güinajan taotaoja sija.
pairs.english: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 24 30130 ¶ Ayo nae si Jesus, ilegña ni y disipuloña sija: Yanguin jaye malago dumalalag yo, polo ya upune namaesagüe, ya uchule y quiluusña ya udalalag yo.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y malago munalibre y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya jayeja y finalingaeguan ni y linâlâña pot guajo, güiya usoda.
pairs.english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafa probechoña y taotao, yanguin jagana todo y tano, ya y linâlâña malingo? Pat jafa na apas ufannae y taotao pot y linâlâña.
pairs.english: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Lajin taotao, ufato gui minalog y Tataña yan y angjetna sija; ya ayo nae uapase cada uno taemano y chechoña.
pairs.english: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: na guaja palo gui mangaegue güine, na ti ujachague finatae, asta qui jalie y Lajin taotao na mato gui raenoña.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di y saes na jaane, si Jesus jacone si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan cheluña, ya jacone julo gui un taquilo na finabeca, na sumajnge.
pairs.english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaaggo y jechuraña gui menanñija; ya y mataña manina calang y atdao; ya y magaguña apaca calang y manana.
pairs.english: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, na manmato güiya sija si Moises yan si Elias, na manguecuentos yan güiya.
pairs.english: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pedro, ilegña as Jesus: Señot, mauleg na mangaeguejit güine: yaguin malagojao, bae jufatinas güine tres na tabetnaculo; para jago y uno, para si Moises y uno, yan para si Elias y uno.
pairs.english: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae cumuecuentos güe, estagüe, un malag na mapagajes jananujong gui jiloñija, ya, estagüe, un inagang gui mapagajes na ilegña; Estagüiya y Lajijo na maguflie, na guefyajo: ecungog güe.
pairs.english: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este y disipulo sija, manpodong gui jilo matañija ya mangosmaañao.
pairs.english: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus mato ya manpinacha, ilegña: Fangajulo ya chamiyo fanmaaañao.
pairs.english: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajatsa y atadogñija, taya jalie na si Jesusja.
pairs.english: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manunog papa guine y finabeca, si Jesus mantinago ya ilegña: Chamiyo fanmañangangane ni jaye ni liniimiyo, asta qui y Lajin taotao esta cajulo gui entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe ya ilegñija: Jafa nae na ilegñija y escriba sija na si Elias ufato finena?
pairs.english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus, ilegña: Magajet na si Elias ufato finena, ya ujananalo todo y güinaja.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo sumangane jamyo, na si Elias esta mato, ya ti matungogüe: lao mafatinas guiya güiya todo y malagoñija. Taegüenaoja locue y Lajin taotao upadese nu sija.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y disipulo sija jatungo na mansinangane sija as Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 14 30310 ¶ Ya anae manmato sija gui linajyan taotao, mato guiya güiya un taotao na dinimumuye güe ya ilegña:
pairs.english: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Señot, gaease ni lajijo; sa malango baba, ya gogosjapadese; sa megae nae podong gui guafe, yan megae nae podong gui janom.
pairs.english: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin juchulie guato y disipulumo, lao tisiña manajomio.
pairs.english: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ilegña: O generasion na ti manjonggue yan manchatpayon! asta ngaean nae utafanjijitaja? asta ngaean nae jususungonja jamyo? Chulie yo fan mague.
pairs.english: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalalatde si Jesus y anite, ya mapos gui malango, ya y patgon jomlo desde ayo na ora.
pairs.english: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato y disipulo sija gui as Jesus, ya ilegñija: Jafajam mina ti siña inyite juyong?
pairs.english: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Pot diquique na jinengguenmiyo: sa magajet jusangane jamyo, na yanguin mangaejinenggue jamyo, calang y pepitas mostasa, injaalog ni este na jalom tano: Janao güine; ya ujanao, ya taya ti siña para jamyo.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Lao este na classe ti jumanao juyong, yaguin ti y minauleg y tinayuyut.)
pairs.english: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 22 30390 ¶ Ya anae manmamocat guiya Galilea, ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Y Lajin taotao umaentrega gui canae y taotao sija;
pairs.english: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapuno; lao y mina tres na jaane, ucajulo. Ya sija ninafangostriste.
pairs.english: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 24 30410 ¶ Ya anae manmato guiya Capernaum, manmato gui as Pedro ayosija y manmangongobbla y medio siclo, y tributo, ya ilegñija: Ada ti manapapase y maestronmiyo y medio siclo y tributo?
pairs.english: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña: Junggan. Ya anae jumalom güe gui jalom guma, si Jesus, cuenentuse güe antes, ilegña: Jafa jinasosomo Simon? Y ray y tano sija, jaye jacocobbla tributo pat senso? y famaguonñija, pat y taotaojuyong?
pairs.english: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ilegña, Y taotaojuyong; si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Ayo nae y famaguon manlibre.
pairs.english: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para mungajit fumatinas y tinempo para sija, Janao falag y tase, ya unyute y jagüet, ya y finenana na güijan na mato, cone; ya an unbaba y pachotña, unsoda y un siclo; chule este ya nae para guajo yan para jago.
pairs.english: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo, manmato y disipulo sija gui as Jesus, ya ilegñija: Jaye mas dangculo gui raenon langet?
pairs.english: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang si Jesus un patgon, ya japolo gui entaloñija,
pairs.english: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Magajet jusangane jamyo, yaguin ti inbira jamyo, ya ti infanjuyong calang, y diquique na famaguon, sen ti infanjalom gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y umumitde calang este na patgon, este uguefdangculo gui raenon langet.
pairs.english: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y rumesibe un patgon, parejo yan este, pot y naanjo, jaresibeja yo locue.
pairs.english: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jayeja y munamatompo uno güine gui estesija mandiquique ni y jumonggue yo, mas mauleg umagode gui agagaña y dangculo na molinon acho, ya umayute gui anae tadodong y tase.
pairs.english: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 7 30510 ¶ Ayay y tano pot y tinempo sija! sa nesesita na ufato y tinempo sija, lao, ayay ayo na taotao, y uminafato y tinempo.
pairs.english: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 8 30520 ¶ Enao mina yaguin y canaemo, pat y adengmo, unninaquepodongjao, utut ya unnajanao guiya jago: sa maulegña na unqueyaojao, pat mangcojao, ya unjalom gui linâlâmo, qui uguaja dos canaemo, yan dos adengmo, ya unmapolo gui taejinecog na guafe.
pairs.english: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y atadogmo unninaquepodongjao, chule ya unnajanao guiya jago; sa maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâmo yan un atadog, qui uguaja dos atadogmo, ya unmapolo gui guafen sasalaguan.
pairs.english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 10 30540 ¶ Atan ya chamiyo dumesprenesia uno güine gui estesija y mandiquique; sa guajo sumangane jamyo, na y angjetñija gui langet, siesiempreja jaliliija y matan y Tatajo ni y gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa y Lajin taotao mato para usatba y manmalingo.)
pairs.english: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa jinasonmimiyo? Yaguin guaja un taotao na gaega siento na quinilo, ya finalingaeguan uno: Ada ti upolo y noventa y nueve gui jalomtano, ya ujanao ya ujaligao ayo y malingo?
pairs.english: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin jasoda, magajet jusangane jamyo, na magofña ni ayo, qui y noventa y nueve ni y ti manmalingo.
pairs.english: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüineja, ti minalago Tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet, na uguaja malingo uno güine gui estesija y mandiquique.
pairs.english: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 15 30590 ¶ Yaguin y chelumo inisagüejao, janao, ya unsangane ni y linachiña, jamyoja na dos; yanguin inecungogjao, ungana y chelumo.
pairs.english: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao, yaguin ti jaecungogjao, fangone gachongmo uno, pat dos, sa para y pachot dos pat tres na testigo, ucabales todo y sinangan.
pairs.english: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti jaecungog sija, sangane y inetnon mangilisyano; lao yaguin ti malago jaecungog y inetnon mangilisyano, güiya para jago parejo yan un taotaojuyong pat publicano.
pairs.english: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na todo y inguede gui tano, ufanmagode locue gui langet: ya todo y inpila gui tano, ufanmapula locue gui langet.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo talo, na yaguin dos guiya jamyo inguaja un corason gui jilo tano, pot jafa na güinaja ni ingagao; umafatinas para sija, pot y Tatajo na gaegue gui langet.
pairs.english: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae guaja dos pat tres, na mandadaña pot y naanjo, gaegue yo güije gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 21 30650 ¶ Ayo nae si Pedro mato guiya güiya ya ilegña: Señot, cuanto biaje juasie y chelujo yaguin jaisagüeyo? asta siete biaje?
pairs.english: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
