pairs.chamorro: (Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa inticho y guima y biuda sija yan inagó y tinaetae; pot este inresibe dangculo na sentensia.)
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa inlilicue y tase yan y tano para infatinas un prosélito, ya anae esta infatinas, infatitinas güe lalajin sasalaguan dosbiaje mas qui jamyo.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 16 32510 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, bachet na guia sija ni y ilegmiyo: Jayeja y manjula pot templo, taya este; lao jayeja y manjula pot y oron y templo, gaeisao güe.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manbababa yan manbachet! Jafa mas dangculo, y oro pat y templo, ni y munasantos y oro?
pairs.english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y manjula pot y attat, taya este; lao jayeja y manjula pot y ninae ni gaegue gui jiloña, gaeisao güe.
pairs.english: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manbachet jamyo! Jafa mas dangculo, y ninae pat y attat ni munasantos y ninae?
pairs.english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y manjula pot y attat, manjula pot ayo yan todo y guaja gui jiloña.
pairs.english: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manjula pot y templo, manjula pot ayo yan pot güiya y sumaga gui jinalomña.
pairs.english: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manjula pot y langet, manjula pot y trono Yuus, yan pot güiya ni gaegue na matatachong gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 23 32580 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa manmanapase jamyo diesmo y yetba buena, yan anis yan comino, ya inpelo y mas dangculo gui lay; y juisio, y minaase, yan y jinenggue. Este nesesita umafatinas, ya munga mapolo na ti infatinas y otro sija.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bachet jamyo na guia sija! sa inguicula y ñamo, ya inpapañot y cameyo.
pairs.english: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 25 32600 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa infagagase y sumanjiyeng y posuelo yan y plato; lao y sumanjalom bula inamot yan minampos.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fariseo bachet jao! fagase finena y sumanjalom gui posuelo yan y plato, ya despues y sumanjiyong ugasgas locue.
pairs.english: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 27 32620 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo, escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa manparejo jamyo yan y manmablanquea na naftan na y sanjiyongña magajet na mauleg malie: lao y sumanjalomña bula tolang manmatae, yan todo y ináplacha.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao locue jamyo y sumanjiyong magajet na manunas malie jamyo ni taotao sija; lao y sumanjalom bula hipocresia yan inechong.
pairs.english: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 29 32640 ¶ Ay ay para jamyo escriba yan Fariseo sija, hipocrita! sa infatinas naftan y profeta sija, ya inadotna y naftan y manunas,
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegmiyo: Yaguin mangaeguejam gui jaanin y tatanmame sija, ti infangachong yan sija gui jâgâ y profeta sija.
pairs.english: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo mina jamyo mismo innae testimonio contra jamyo, na jamyo famaguon ayo sija y pumuno y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue innabula y medidan y tatanmiyo.
pairs.english: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Colebla sija, rasan colebla sija! Jaf taemano jamyo insujaye gui sentensian sasalaguan?
pairs.english: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 34 32690 ¶ Enaomina estagüeyo na junae jamyo profeta sija, yan manmalate yan escribasija; ya palo guiya sija inpino ya inatane gui quiluus; ya y palo guiya sija, inpanag gui sinagoganmiyo, ya inpetsigue sija guinin siuda asta siuda;
pairs.english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ufato gui jilomiyo todo y tunas na jâgâ ni y machuda gui jilo y tano, desde y jâgân Abel y tinas, asta y jâgâ Sacharias, lajin Barachias, ni inpino gui entalo templo yan y attat.
pairs.english: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusagane jamyo, na todo estesija ufanmato gui jilo este na generasion.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 37 32720 ¶ Jerusalem! Jerusalem! ni y pumuno y profeta sija, ni infagas ni acho todo y manmatago para jago, cuanto biaje malagoyo na jurecoje y famaguonmo, calang y ponedera yan jarecoje y poyitasña sija gui papa papaña, lao ti manmalago jamyo!
pairs.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na madingo guiya jamyo y guimanmiyo na ti mataotagüe.
pairs.english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo jamyo sumangane, na desde pago, ti inliiyo, asta qui ilegmiyo: Dichoso güe y mato. pot y naan y Señot.
pairs.english: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA si Jesus jumuyong gui templo ya mapos; manmato y disipuluña sija, para umafanue ni y mafatinas y templo.
pairs.english: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jaope sija, ilegña: Ti inlie todo estesija? Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti umapolo güine un acho gui jilo otro acho, na ti umayulang.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae matatachong güe gui sabana Olibo, manmato guiya güiya y disipulo sija, ya ilegñija: Sangane jam ngaean ufanjuyong estesija na güinaja, yan jafa taemano na señat y finatomo, yan y jinecog y tiempo?
pairs.english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus, ilegña: Adaje ya chamiyo fanmadadague ni jaye.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ujaalog: Guajo si Cristo; ya megae ujadague.
pairs.english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmanjungog guera yan sinangan nu y guera; atan ya chamiyo ninafañachatsaga; sa nesesita na todo este ufanjuyong, lao trabia ti y jinecog.
pairs.english: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo nasion contra nasion, yan raeno contra raeno; ya uguaja ñinalang yan linao gui lugat sija.
pairs.english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo este sija na güinaja y tutujon y pininite.
pairs.english: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae infanmaentrega para infanmanapute, ya infanmapuno; ya infanmachatlie gui todo nasion pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae innafanmatompo; ya ufanaentrega unos y otros, ya ufanachatlie unos y otros.
pairs.english: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ti manmagajet na profeta ufangajulo, ya ujadague megae.
pairs.english: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y janamegae y tinaelaye, y güinaeyan y megae janamanenggeng.
pairs.english: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y sumungon asta y jinecog, este usatba.
pairs.english: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapredica este y ebangelion y raeno gui todo y tano, para testimonio gui todo y nasion, ya ayo nae ufato y jinecog.
pairs.english: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 15 32890 ¶ Enaomina an inlie y chinatlie y inginon na yinilang, ni y jasangan si Daniel profeta ni tumotojgue gui santos na lugat; (y tumataetae güiya utungo).
pairs.english: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y mangaegue guiya Judea, manmalago para y taquilo na jalomtano;
pairs.english: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui jilo atof, ti ufanunog ya ujachule jafa gui guimaña;
pairs.english: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui fangualuan, ti ufanalo tate ya ujachule y magagoña.
pairs.english: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ay ay para y manmapotgue, yan y mannanasuso, güije na jaane!
pairs.english: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanaetae, sa y jinanaonmiyo, munga gui tiempon manenggeng ni y sabado.
pairs.english: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo na tiempo uguaja dangculo na pininite, ya desde y tutujon y tano asta pago, taya nae guaja; ya taya mas na uguaja asta jinecog.
pairs.english: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ayo na jaane sija ti manafangadada, ni un catne usiña ninalibre; lao pot y manmaayig, ayo sija na jaane umanafangadada.
pairs.english: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jaye na taotao umalog nu jago: Estagüe si Cristo, pat ayo; chamo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo y ti manmagajet na Cristo yan ti manmagajet na profeta sija; ya ufanmamanue dangculo na señat sija, yan mannamanman, ya, yaguin siña, ujadagueja asta y manmaayig.
pairs.english: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na jusangane jamyo antes.
pairs.english: Behold, I have told you before.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ilegñija nu jamyo: Estagüe na gaegue güi desierto, chamo jumajanao; pat, Estagüe, na gaegue gui sanjalom gui cuatto, chamo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa calang y lamlam ni y jumuyong gui sancatan, ya manina gui sanlichan, taegüijija locue y minamaela y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae mañaga y tataotao y matae, ayo locue nae ufandaña y aguila sija.
pairs.english: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 29 33030 ¶ Ti apmam despues di y pininiten ayo sija na jaane, y atdao ujomjom, ya y pilan ti ufanina; ya y pution sija ufamodong guine y langet; ya y nina siñan y langet ufanmayengyong.
pairs.english: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae uanog señat y Lajin taotao gui langet; yan ayo nae ufanugung todo y tribu sija gui tano; ya ujalie y Lajin taotao na mamamaela gui jilo y mapagajes sija gui langet, yan y ninasiñaña yan y dangculon minalagña.
pairs.english: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya utago y angetña sija yan y dangculo na catin y trompeta ya ujanadaña y inayigñija guine y cuatro manglo, desde y un punta gui langet asta y otro.
pairs.english: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 32 33060 ¶ Tingo y acomparasion y trongcon igos. Yanguin y ramasña mañaña ya manjagon, intingo na jijot y fañomnagan.
pairs.english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue jamyo, yaguin inlie todo este sija na güinaja, intingoja na esta jijot gui petta sija.
pairs.english: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti ufanmalofan este na generasion, asta qui todo este sija na güinaja manmacumple.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet yan y tano ufanmalofan; lao y sinanganjo sija ti ufanmalofan.

pairs.english: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus mamatquiloja. Ya y magas y mamale ilegña nu güiya: Jutayuyutjao pot y lalâlâ na Yuus, na unsanganejam cao jago si Cristo, Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Jago guinin sumangan. Ya jusangane jamyo na desde pago inlie y Lajin taotao na matatachong gui agapa y ugaeninasiña na canae, ya umamaela gui jalom y mapagajes sija gui langet.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y magas y mamale, jatiteg y magaguña, ya ilegña: Cumuentos chatfino contra si Yuus: jafa mas na utanesesita testigo sija? Estagüe esta pago na injingog y chinatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa pinelonmimiyo? Sija manmanope ilegñija: Jamerese y finatae.
pairs.english: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae matolae y mataña yan patmada güe; ya y palo manafañetnot nu y dinemo;
pairs.english: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Profetisayejam, O Cristo! jayejao munafañetnot?
pairs.english: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 26 69 34400 ¶ Ya ayo na tiempo si Pedro estaba matatachong gui sumanjiyong gui guelat; ya mato guija güiya un palaoan tentago, ya ilegña: Manjajamjo locue yan si Jesus y Galileo.
pairs.english: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jadague gui menan todos, ilegña: Ti jutungo jafa ilelegmo.
pairs.english: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumuyong gui petta; linie ni otro palaoan, ya ilegña ni ayo y manestaba güije: Este locue mañisija yan si Jesus Nasareno.
pairs.english: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadague talo ya manjula ilegña: Ti jutungo ayo na taotao.
pairs.english: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti apmam despues manmato sija y mangaegue güije, ya ilegñija as Pedro: Magajet na jago locue uno guiya sija; sa y sinanganmo dumiclalara jao.
pairs.english: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatutujon mumatdise, yan manjula, ilegña: Ti jutungo ayo na taotao. Ya enseguidas cumanta y gayo.
pairs.english: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajaso si Pedro y sinangan Jesus ni ilegña: Antes di ucanta y gayo, undagueyo tres biaje. Ya mapos juyong ya gueftumanges.
pairs.english: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mato y egaan, todo y prinsipen y mamale, yan y manamco na taotao sija, mandaña y manaconseja entre sija contra si Jesus, para umapuno güe.
pairs.english: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan magode güe, macone ya maentrega gui as Ponsio Pilato y magalaje.
pairs.english: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 3 34490 ¶ Ayo nae si Judas, y umentrega güe, jalie na esta umayogua, ya mañotsot ya jachule talo guato y treinta pidason salape gui prinsipen y mamale yan y manamco na taotao sija,
pairs.english: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Guajo isaoyo, juentrega y taeisao na jâgâ. Lao sija ilegñija: Jafa ayo guiyajame? Jagoja adaje.
pairs.english: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayute y pidason salape jalom gui jalom y templo, ya mapos ya jañaca güe.
pairs.english: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y prinsipen y mamale sija, jachule y salape ya ilegñija: Ti tunas na tapolo gui tesoro sa baliña y jâgâ.
pairs.english: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manaconseja entre sija, ya mafajan y fangualuan oyero, para y naftan y taotaojuyong.
pairs.english: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo mina mafanaan ayo na fangualuan: Fangualuan jâgâ, asta pago na jaane.
pairs.english: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae macumple y sinangan na pot y profeta Jeremias, ni ilegña: Ya sija jachule y treinta pidason salape, presio ayo y gaebale, y presio na mapolo gui jiloña y famaguon Israel;
pairs.english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanae sija, para ujafajan y fangualuan y oyero taegüenao, na jatagoyo y Señot.
pairs.english: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 11 34570 ¶ Ya si Jesus estaba tomotojgue gui menan y magalaje, ya y magalaje finaesen güe, ilegña: Jago y Ray Judio sija? Si Jesus ilegña: Jago umalog.
pairs.english: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mafaaela ni y prinsipen y mamale, yan y manamco sija, ti manope ni jafa.
pairs.english: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Pilato ilegña nu güiya: Ti unjujungog cuanto na güinaja nae manmadeclara contra jago?
pairs.english: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti manope ni un sinangan; ya ninagosmanman y magalaje.
pairs.english: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaanin y guipot, costumbreña y magalaje na usotta pot y taotao sija un preso, jaye y malagoñija.
pairs.english: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja presoñija uno na afamao, na y naanña si Barabas.
pairs.english: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mandaña ilegña si Pilato nu sija: Jaye malagonmiyo jusottaye jamyo? Si Barabas pat si Jesus, ni mafanaan Cristo?
pairs.english: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatungoja na pot embidiañija muna maentrega güe.
pairs.english: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 19 34650 ¶ Ya anae estaba güe na matatachong gui tribuna, y asaguaña manago nu güiya, ilegña: Chamo umeentalo nu enao tunas na taotao; sa pago jupadedese megae sija gui güinife pot güiya.
pairs.english: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y prisipen y mamale sija, yan y manamco sija jasoyo y taotao sija, na ujagagao si Barabas, ya si Jesus, umapuno.
pairs.english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magalaje manope, ilegña nu sija: Jaye gui dos malagonmiyo jusottaye jamyo? Sija ilegñija: Si Barabas.
pairs.english: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato ilegña nu sija: Ya jafa jufatinas as Jesus ni mafanaan Cristo? Todos sija ilegñija: Umatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jafa na taelaye finatinasña? Lao sija managang mas duro, ilegñija: Umatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 24 34700 ¶ Anae jalie si Pilato na taya jafa na probecho, lao mas y ninafanyaoyao, mañule janom ya jafagase y canaeña gui menan y taotao sija, ya ilegña: Taeisaoyo gui jâgâ este y tunas na taotao: lie jamyo.
pairs.english: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanope todo y taotao sija ilegñija: Y jâgâña usaga guiya jame, yan y famaguonmame.
pairs.english: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae masotta si Barabas, ya an munjayan mapanag si Jesus, maentrega para umaatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y sendalon y magalaje macone si Jesus gui pretorio, ya mandaña guiya güiya todo y manadan sendalo sija.
pairs.english: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapula y magaguña, ya manaminagago agaga na magagon anaco.
pairs.english: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapolo gui iluña un corona na mafatinas ni títuca sija, yan un piao gui agapa na canaeña; ya mandimo gui menaña, ya mamofefea, ilegñija: Jafa talatmanu jao Ray Judio sija!
pairs.english: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matolae güe, ya machule y piao ya mapanag y iluña.
pairs.english: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan mamofefea, mapula y magagon anaco, ya manaminagago ni magaguña, ya macone para umaatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 32 34780 ¶ Ya anae jumajanao manasoda yan un taotao Sirene na y naanña si Simon: este maobliga para uchinilie ni quiluusña.
pairs.english: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 33 34790 ¶ Ya anae manmato gui un lugat na mafanaan Golgota, cumequeilegña, y sagan calabera,
pairs.english: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mannae para uguimen binagle, manadaña yan lalaet; ya anae jachague, ti malago jaguimen.
pairs.english: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan maatane gui quiluus, mandesapatta y magaguña, mayute suette sija gui jiloña; (para umacumple y mumayan masangan pot y profeta: Ujanaadesapatta y magagujo, ya y jilo y magagujo ufanmayute suette sija.)
pairs.english: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmatachong, ya maadadaje güe güije.
pairs.english: And sitting down they watched him there;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapolo gui iluña y mafaelaña, matugue: ESTE SI JESUS RAY Y JUDIO SIJA.
pairs.english: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae maatane yan güiya gui quiluus yan y dos na saque; y uno gui agapaña ya y otro gui acagüeña.
pairs.english: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 39 34850 ¶ Ya y taotao na manmalolofan, masangane güe innataelaye, ya jayeyengyong y iluñija,
pairs.english: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Jago y yumute papa y templo, ya y mina tres na jaane unnacajulo; libre maesajao; yaguin jago Lajin Yuus, tunog papa güenao gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüinija locue mamofefea güe y prisipen mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, yan y Fariseo sija, yan y manamco na taotao sija, ilegñija:
pairs.english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janalibre y palo, ya ti siñagüe janalibre na maesa. Güiya y Ray y Israel; polo ya utunog papa pago gui quiluus, ya ayo nae utajonggue güe.
pairs.english: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaangoco si Yuus; polo ya ulinibre pago, yaguin malago nu güiya, sa ilegña: Güajo Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mañaque locue, ni y manmaatane yan güiya gui quiluus, manajuyonge güe locue.
pairs.english: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 45 34910 ¶ Ya desde y mina saes na ora guaja jinemjom todo y jilo y tano, asta y mina nuebe na ora.
pairs.english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina nuebe na ora, si Jesus umagang nu y dangculon inagang ilegña: Eli, Eli, lama sabactani! cumequeilegña: Yuusso, Yuusso, jafa na undingo yo?
pairs.english: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo ni manestaba güije, majungog güe, ya ilegñija: Si Elias este jaaagang.
pairs.english: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas malago uno guiya sija, ya jachule y espongja y janafañopchop binagle, ya japolo gui un piao, ya janae güe para uguimen.
pairs.english: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palo ilegñija: Polo ya talie cao ufato si Elias ya uninalibre.
pairs.english: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue güije megae na famalaoan na manmanaatan gui chago, ni jadalalag si Jesus guine Galilea ya jasesetbe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui entalo ayo sija si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago yan José, yan y nanan y famaguon Sebedeo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule si José y tataotao, ya jabalutan ni un sabanas na gasgas,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo gui nuebo na naftanña, ni y finatinasñaja gui acho ni sacapico; ya janagalileque guato un dangculon acho y pettan y naftan, ya mapos.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 61 35070 ¶ Ya manestaba güije si Maria Magdalena, yan y otro Maria, na manmatatachong gui menan y naftan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 62 35080 ¶ Ya y inagpaña na jaane, despues di y jaanen finamauleg, mandaña y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y Fariseo sija gui as Pilato,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina fanago, ya umaasegura y naftan, asta y mina tres na jaane; sa noseaja ufanmato y disipulo sija an puenge ya ujasaque; ya ujaalog ni taotao sija: Cajulo esta gui entalo manmatae: ya y uttimo na linache udangculoña qui y finenana.
pairs.english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña si Pilato nu sija: Inguaja un guatdianmiyo; janao, ya inasegura todo manu y ninasiñanmiyo.
pairs.english: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmapos sija, ya maadaje y naftan para umaasegura, ya maseyo y acho.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YUTTIMO na ora y sabalo, gui egaan anae mumanánaná y finénana na jaane gui semana, mato si Maria Magdalena yan y otro Maria, para ujalie y naftan.
pairs.english: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe un dangculon linao; sa y angjet y Señot tumunog guine y langet, ya janagalileg y acho gui petta, ya matachong gui sumanjilo.
pairs.english: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jechuraña parejo yan y lamlam, ya y magaguña apaca calang niebe.
pairs.english: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y minaañao nu güiya, y guatdia sija mayengyong ya sumaga calang manmatae.
pairs.english: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope y angjet, ilegña ni famalaoan sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao jamyo; sa jutungoja na inaliligao si Jesus, ni guinin maatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janao fanlagoguse, ya sangane y disipuluña sija, na esta cajulo gui entalo y manmatae, ya infanninanangga Galilea: ya ayo nae inlie güe; estagüe, na esta jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae sija manapos gui naftan, manmaañao yan mangosmagof, yan manmalalago para umannae notisia y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 28 9 35210 ¶ Ya estagüe si Jesus na manasoda ya ilegña nu sija: Fanmagof todos! Ya sija manmato, ya manmagote y adengña ya maadora güe.
pairs.english: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un inagang guine y langet na ilegña: Jago y lajijo ni yajo, iya jago nae gosmagof yo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas ninafalag y desierto ni Espiritu.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Maela dalalagyo, ya junafanpescadot taotao jamyo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jalalatde ilegña: Pacaca, ya maela juyong guiya güiya.
