pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y áplacha na espiritu tiniteg güe, ya ninaagang gosdangculo na inagang, jumuyong guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo sija ninafanmanman, pot este manafaesen entre sija, ilegñija: Jafa este? Jafa na nuebo finanagüe este! yan ninasiña jatago y manáplacha na espiritu, ya maosgueja güe?
pairs.english: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas y famaña manamamta todo gui tano oriyan Galilea.
pairs.english: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 29 35610 ¶ Ya enseguidas anae jumuyong gui sinagoga, mato gui guima Simon yan si Andres, yan si Santiago yan si Juan.
pairs.english: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y suegran Simon estaba na umaason sa malango yan calentura: ya masangane güe enseguidas nu y palaoan.
pairs.english: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mato güe, ya jamantiene canaeña, ya jajatsa julo; ya pinelo ni calentura, ya güiya sumetbe sija.
pairs.english: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 32 35640 ¶ Ya anae estaba esta pupuenge, anae machom y atdao, maconiigüe todo ni manmañetnot yan y maninanite.
pairs.english: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y siuda mandaña gui petta.
pairs.english: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanjomlo megae ni manestaba manmalango todo clasen chetnot sija; ya jayute juyong megae na anite sija; ya ti japolo nu y anite sija cumuentos sa matungo güe.
pairs.english: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 35 35670 ¶ Ya y egaan güije, cajulo gostaftaf, jojomjomja trabia, ya jumuyong, ya malag y un lugat desierto, ya manaetae güije.
pairs.english: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinatiye güe as Simon, yan y mangachochongña.
pairs.english: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae masoda güe, ilegñija nu güiya: Todo umaliligaojao.
pairs.english: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Nije tafanmalag y otro lugat gui sengsong ni jijot, ya jufansetmon locue güije; sa pot este na matoyo.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom gui sinagogañija todo Galilea, sesetmon ya jayuyute juyong y anite sija.
pairs.english: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 40 35720 ¶ Ya un ategtog mato guiya güiya, tinayuyut güi ya dumimo, ya ilegña: Yaguin malagojao, siña unnagasgasyo.
pairs.english: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y chetnot y ategtog mapos guiya güiya ya gasgas güe.
pairs.english: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jagosencatga, ya jatago na ujanao,
pairs.english: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Atan ya chamo sumangangane ni jaye jafa; lao sigueja gui jinanaomo ya unfanue y pale nu jago, ya unofrese ni guinasgasmo ni si Moises manago, para testimonioñija.
pairs.english: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya mapos, ya jatutujon munamatungo, yan janagosmamta y checho; pot este, si Jesus ti siña jumalom matungo nu güiya gui siuda; lao sumasagaja gui sumanjiyong gui lugat desierto sija, ya manmato guiya güiya guinin todo y patte sija.
pairs.english: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA otro biaje güiya jumalom guiya Capernaum, despues di malofan ti megae na jaane sija; ya majungog na gaegue güe gui jalom guma.
pairs.english: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña megae, ya ti manulag, ni gui oriyan y petta; ya jasetmon y sinangan guiya sija.
pairs.english: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmato guiya güiya manmangongone un paralitico, na macocone ni cuatro.
pairs.english: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti siña manmato guiya güiya pot y linajyan taotao, manajanao y atof anae estaba güe, ya anae munjayan mababa, manatunog y cama anae mapopolo y paralitico.
pairs.english: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus y jinenggueñija, ilegña ni paralitico: Lajijo, y isaomo unmaasie.
pairs.english: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije manmatatachong palo escriba sija, ya manmanjajaso gui corasonñija, ilegñija:
pairs.english: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na cumuecuentos este na taotao chatfino contra si Yuus? Jaye siña manasie isao, solo si Yuusja?
pairs.english: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatungo si Jesus enseguidas gui espirituña na manmanjajaso gui sumanjalomñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa muna injajaso este sija gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa mas guse taalog y paralitico: Y isaomo unmaasie; pat taalog: Cajulo, chule y camamo, ya unjanao?
pairs.english: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingo na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña gui jilo tano manasie isao (ilegña ni paralitico),
pairs.english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jualog nu jago: Cajulo, ya unchule y camamo ya janao falag iyajamyo.
pairs.english: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae cajulo güe enseguidas, ya jachule y camaña, ya mapos gui menan todo; enao muna todo ninafanmanman, ya manamalag si Yuus, ilegñija: Taya nae inlie ayo.
pairs.english: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 35900 ¶ Ya jumanao talo gui oriyan tase, ya todo y linajyan taotao manmato guiya güiya, ya jafanagüe sija.
pairs.english: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan jalie si Levi, lajin Alfeo, na matatachong gui bancon y tributo sija, ya ilegña nu güiya: Dalalagyo. Ya cajulo ya dinalalag güe.
pairs.english: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede na estaba güe matachong para uchocho gui lamasa gui guima ayo, ya megae sija na publicano yan manisao sija manmatatachong mañisija locue yan si Jesus, yan y disipoluña sija; sa guaja megae dumadalalag güe.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba sija gui entalo y Fariseo sija, anae jalie na mañochocho yan y manisao yan y publicano sija, ilegñija ni disipoluña sija: Jafa este na güiya chomocho yan gumiguimen, yan y publicano sija yan y manisao?
pairs.english: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus, ilegña nu sija: Y manjomlo ti janesesita medico, na y manmalango. Ti matoyo para juagang y manunas, na y manisao sija.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 18 35950 ¶ Ya y disipulon Juan, yan y disipulon Fariseo sija manayunat: ya manmato, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa muna y disipulon Juan yan y disipulon Fariseo sija manayuyunat; ya y disipulumo ti manayuyunat?
pairs.english: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Siña manayunat y mangaegue gui guipot umasagua, yaguin mañisija yan y nobio? Y tiempo nae mañisijaja yan y nobio, ti siña manayunat.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ufato y jaane sija, na y nobio umanajanao guiya sija; ya ayo sija na jaane nae ufanayunat.
pairs.english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya ni uno lumimendanñañaejon y nuebo na magago gui bijo na bestido; sa ayo y nuebo na limenda ujanao gui bijo, ya mas taelaye y matiteg.
pairs.english: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya ni uno umasajguane y nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero: sa y nuebo na bino uyamag y boteyan cuero sija, ya umachuda y bino, ya y boteyan cuero manmalingo; lao y nuebo na bino, y nuebo na boteyan cuero nae umasajguane.
pairs.english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 23 36000 ¶ Ya manmapos este, malolofan güe gui jalom fangualuan trigo gui sabado na jaane; ya y disipoluña sijas igue di manmanjala ni espiga sija.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija, ilegñija: Atanja, jafa na jafatitinas gui sabado na jaane y ti mauleg para umafatinas?
pairs.english: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Taya nae intaetae jafa checho David anae janesesita, ya ñalang yan y mangachongña?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa taemano jalomña gui guimayuus anae si Abiatar magas na pale, ya jacano y pan ni inefrese, ni ti para macano, na para y pale sija; ya janae locue y mangachongña sija?
pairs.english: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña talo nu sija: Y sabado pot y taotao na mafatinas: ti y taotao pot y sabado.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y Lajin taotao Señot locue gui sabado.
pairs.english: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jumalom talo gui sinagoga; ya guaja güije un taotao na anglo un canaeña.
pairs.english: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija maaatanja güe cao unajomlo gui sabado na jaane; para umafaaela.
pairs.english: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni ayo na taotao y anglo un canaeña: Tojgue julo gui entalo.
pairs.english: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Siña tafatinas mauleg gui sabado na jaane pat taelaye? nalibre y linâlâ pat puno? Lao sija manmamatquiquiloja.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jaatan gui oriya sija yan y linalalo, ninapinite pot y majetog corasoññija, ya ilegña nu y taotao: Estira mona y canaemo. Ya jaestira, ya y canaeña tumalo mauleg parejo yan y otro.
pairs.english: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmapos y Fariseo sija, ya manaconseja yan y taotao Herodes sija, contra güiya, para umapuno.
pairs.english: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus sumuja para y tase yan y disipuluña sija; ya madalalag un dangculon linajyan taotao guine Galilea, yan guine Judea,
pairs.english: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan guine Jerusalem, yan guine Idumea, yan y otro bandan Jordan, yan guine oriyan Tiro yan Sidon, dangculo na linajyan taotao anae majungog y dangculon finatinasña sija, manmato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangane y disipoluña sija, na un diquique na batco uninananggaja güe, pot y linajyan taotao para munga güe manachatsaga,
pairs.english: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guaja megae janafanjomlo; ya pot ayo na manpodong gui jiloña, todo y mangaechetnot para umapacha,
pairs.english: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manáplacha sija na espiritu locue, anae malie güe, manpodong papa gui menaña, ya managang, ilegñija: Jago y Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: N 3 13 36180 ¶ Ya cajulo gui egso, ya jaagang guiya güiya ayo sija y malagoña, ya sija manmato guiya güiya.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ufangaeninasiña para ujayute juyong y anite sija.
pairs.english: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija si Simon, ni japolo sobrenaaña si Pedro;

pairs.chamorro: Yan si Andres, yan si Felipe, yan si Bartolome, yan si Mateo, yan si Tomas yan si Santiago, lajin Alfeo, yan si Tadeo, yan si Simon y Cananeo;
pairs.english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Judas Iscariote ni y locue umentrega güe: ya manjalom talo gui guima.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 20 36250 ¶ Ya y linajyan taotao mandaña talo, ya pot este sija ti siña ni ufañochocho pan.
pairs.english: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog na familiaña sija, manmato para umaguot; sa ilegñija: Esta ti guiya güe.
pairs.english: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba sija ni manmato guine Jerusalem, ilegñija, na guaja güe as Beetsebub, ya pot y prinsipen anite na manyuyute juyong anite sija.
pairs.english: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya umagang sija, ya ilegña nu sija pot acomparasion: Jafataemano siña si Satanas jayute juyong si Satanas?
pairs.english: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un raeno madibide contra güiyaja, ayo na raeno ti siña sumaga.
pairs.english: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un guma madibide contra güiyaja, ayo na guma ti siña sumaga.
pairs.english: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Satanas cajulo contra güiyaja, ya madibide ti siña sumaga: lao gae jinecog.
pairs.english: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya ni un taotao siña jumalom gui guima y matatnga na taotao, ya unataelaye y güinajaña sija, yaguin ti jagode finena y matatnga na taotao; ya ayo nae unataelaye y güinajaña.
pairs.english: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na todo y isao sija ufanmaasie gui lalajin taotao sija, yan y chinatfino contra cuatquieraja sija na chinatfinue.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jayeja y chumatfino contra y Espiritu Santo, taemaasie ni ngaean; ya peligroña y taejinecog na isao:
pairs.english: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegñija, güiya guaja áplacha na espiritu.
pairs.english: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato si nanaña, yan y mañeluña, ya manestaba gui sumanjiyong, manmanago na umaagang güe.
pairs.english: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linajyan taotao estaba manmatatachong gui oriyaña; ya ilegñija nu güiya: Estagüe si nanamo yan y mañelumo gui sumanjiyong na maaliligaojao.
pairs.english: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaope sija, ilegña: Jaye nanajo yan jaye mañelujo?
pairs.english: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manaatan gui oriya anae manestaba manmatatachong gui oriyaña, ya ilegña: Estagüe y nanajo, yan y mañelujo!
pairs.english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y fumatinas y minalago Yuus, güiya chelujo laje, yan chelujo palaoan, yan nanajo.
pairs.english: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jatutujon otro biaje mananagüe gui oriyan tase; ya mandaña guiya güiya dangculo na linajyan taotao, enao mina jumalom gui un batco, ya matachong gui tase; ya todo y linajyan taotao manestaba gui jilo tano gui oriyan tase.
pairs.english: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafanagüe sija megae pot acomparasion, ya ilegña nu sija gui finanagüeña.
pairs.english: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ecungog: Estagüe y tatanom na jumuyong para ufananom.
pairs.english: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manananom, palo mamodong gui oriyan chalan; ya mato y pajaron y aire ya macano.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo mamodong gui jilo acho, anae ti megae na oda; ya enseguidas mandoco, sa ti tadong gui eda.
pairs.english: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae cajulo y atdao, sinenggue, sa taejaleñija manmalayo.
pairs.english: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo mamodong gui entalo tituca sija; ya mandoco y tituca sija, ya chiniguet, ya ti manogcha.
pairs.english: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo mamodong gui mauleg na tano, ya manmanogcha, ya mangajulo ya manmegae; ya uno manogcha treinta, y otro sesenta, y otro ciento.
pairs.english: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu sija: Y gae talanga para ufanjungog, güiya uecungog.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 10 36500 ¶ Ya anae estaba güe güiyaja, y manestaba gue oriyaña yan y dose, mafaesen güi ni y acomparasion sija.
pairs.english: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo manmanae y misterion raenon Yuus; lao y mangaegue gui sumanjiyong, pot acomparasion nae umafatinas todo estesija;
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para y manlilie, jalie ya ti jasiente; ya y manecungog, manmanjungog, lao ti jatungo; sa no sea ufanmabra talo, ya ufanmmaasie ni isaoñija.
pairs.english: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Ti intingo este na acomparasion? Jafa taemano nae, tungonmiyo todo ni acomparasion sija?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tatanom jatanme y finijo.
pairs.english: The sower soweth the word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejoja locue yan este sija y manmatanme gui jilo acho; anae majungog y finijo, enseguidas maresibe todo ni y minagofñija;
pairs.english: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taya jaleñija, ya ti jadura apmam; sa anae cajulo y triniste, pat y pinetsigue pot y finijo, enseguidas maninefende.
pairs.english: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este yuje sija y manmatanme gui entalo tituca sija; y jumungog y finijo;
pairs.english: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y inadajen este y tano, yan y dinaguen y güinaja sija, yan y minalago ni guaja gui palo güinaja sija, manjalom ya machiguet y finijo ya jumuyong ti manogcha.
pairs.english: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este yuje sija y manmatanme gui mauleg na tano; y jumungog y finijo ya maresibe, ya manmanogcha, ya uno treinta y otro sesenta, y otro siento.
pairs.english: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 21 36610 ¶ Ylegña nu sija locue: Esta machule y candet para umapolo gui papa medida, pat gui papa cama? Ya ti para umapolo gui jilo lamasa?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya na manaatog, ti umafatanñaejon; ni gae gui secreto ya ti umababa.
pairs.english: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya uecungog.
pairs.english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija locue: Adaje jafa y jiningogmiyo. Y medida anae inmediye sija, ayoja nae infanmamidiye jamyo; ya infanmanae jamyo mas.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y guaja, umanae: ya y taya, esta y güinajaña, unajanao.
pairs.english: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 26 36660 ¶ Ya ilegña: Taegüine y raenon Yuus, yaguin un taotao manyute semiya gui jalom oda;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maego, ya cajulo gui puenge yan jaane, ya semiya mapta ya doco, ti jatungo jafataemano.
pairs.english: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tano güiyaja manogcha, finena jagon, enseguidas y espiga, despues y grano bula gui espiga.
pairs.english: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y tinegcha dumangculo, enseguidas mapolo y sese para mangoco, sa mato y cosecha.
pairs.english: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 30 36700 ¶ Ya ilegña: Jafajit nae tanaparejo y raenon Yuus? pat jafa na acomparasion nae taacompara?
pairs.english: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan un granon mostasa, ni y anae matanme gui tano, achogja güiya mas diquique gui entalo todo y semiya sija ni y guaja gui jilo y tano.
pairs.english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae matanme, doco, ya güiya mas dangculo qui todo na golae, ya manramas ni mandangculo na ramasña; ya pot este y pajaron y aire siña mañaga gui papa y nijongña.
pairs.english: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 33 36730 ¶ Yan megae sija na acomparasion parejo yan este sija, jasangane sija finijo, jaftaemano y siña jajungog.
pairs.english: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sin acomparasion ti jasangane sija; lao y disipoluña sija anae mañisijaja janaclaruye todo.
pairs.english: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija güijija na jaane, anae esta pupuenge: Nije tafanmalofan gui otro banda.
pairs.english: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadingo y linajyan taotao, ya macone güe mañija, anae gaegue güe sui jalom batco. Ya guaja locue palo diquique na batco mañisija.
pairs.english: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo un dangculon pagyon manglo, ya jinatme ni napo sija y jalom batco, ya ninabula.
pairs.english: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya gaegue gui popa na mamaego gui jilo alunan; ya mayajo, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Maestro, taya unadadaje na infanmatae?
pairs.english: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo güe, ya jalalatde y manglo, ya ilegña ni tase: Pacaca famatquilo. Ya bumasta y manglo, ya guaja dangculo na catma.
pairs.english: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa jamyo na gosmanmaañao? Taye jinengguenmiyo trabia?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

pairs.chamorro: Ya mangosmanmaañao, ya ilegñija entre sija: Jaye este, na asta y manglo yan y tase maosgue güe?
pairs.english: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja sagaña gui jalom naftan sija, ya taya siña gumode güe nu y cadenaja:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae na biaje nae magode nu y tale sija yan cadena sija, lao y cadena sija esta manmayamag pot guiya; ya y tale sija manmagtos, ya taya siña munamanso güe.
pairs.english: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya siempre yan puenge yan jaane, jumajanao ya umaagang gui entalo naftan sija, yan gui jalomtano sija, ya janalalamen güe ni acho sija.
pairs.english: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus gui chago, malago, ya jaadora güe.
pairs.english: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umagang gosdangculo na inagang, ilegña: Para jafayo ni jago, Jesus, Lajin y Gueftaquilo na Yuus? Jufanjula nu jago pot si Yuus na chamoyo munachachatsaga.
pairs.english: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña nu güiya: Juyong güine na taotao, áplacha na espiritu.
pairs.english: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen: Jaye naanmo? Ya inepe, ilegña: Linajyan naanjo: sa manmegaejam.
pairs.english: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatayuyut megae, para chaña yiniyite juyong güije na tano.
pairs.english: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije, jijot gui jalomtano sija, un dangculo na manadan babue na mañochocho.
pairs.english: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matayuyut güe ni ayo todo sija na anite, ilegñija: Tagojam para y babue sija para infanjalom guiya sija.
pairs.english: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manpinetmite as Jesus. Ya manjuyong ayo sija y manáplacha na espiritu, ya manjalom gui babue sija; ya y manada manmalago papa gui un didog na lugat asta y jalom tase, ya guaja sija dos mit; ya manmatmos gui tase.
pairs.english: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y munafañochocho y babue sija manmalago ya manmañangane gui siuda yan y fangualuan sija. Ya manjanao sija para ujalie jafa ayo y guinin mafatinas.
pairs.english: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui as Jesus, ya malie y guinin ninachatsaga ni anite, matatachong, ya minagagago, ya jatungo ayo y guaja ni linajyan; ya manmaañao.
pairs.english: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinagane ni ayo sija y lumie; jafa taemano matoña ayo y guinin guaja anite, yan y babue sija.
pairs.english: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matutujon matayuyut güe na ujanao gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom güe gui batco, tinayuyut güe ni ayo y guinin guaja anite, para ujasija.
pairs.english: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ti pinetmite, lao ilegña un güiya: Janao falag iyajamyo gui amigumo sija; ya unsangane sija na dangculon güinaja y Señot finatinasña nu jago, yan guaja minaaseña nu jago.
pairs.english: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maposgüe ya jatutujon sumanganñaejon guiya Decapolis na dangculon güinaja y finatinas Jesus nu güiya: ya todo ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan otro biaje si Jesus gui un batco para y otro banda, mandaña guiya güiya un dangculo na linajyan taotao; ya gaegue güe gui oriyan tase.
pairs.english: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato uno gui prinsipe sija gui sinagoga, y naanña si Jairo; ya anae linie güe, podong gui adengña;
pairs.english: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinayuyut güe megae, ilegña: Y jagajo cumequematae. Nije ya unpolo y canaemo gui jiloña, para ujomlo, yan ulâlâ.
pairs.english: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao yan Jesus, ya megae na taotao sija madalalag güe, ya machiguet güe.
pairs.english: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un palaoan na numanajuyong jâgâ esta dose años.
pairs.english: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japadese megae medico, ya jagasta todo y güinajaña, ya taya jaaprobecha; lao lumala adid,
pairs.english: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog ayosija na cumuentos si Jesus, jumalom gui entalo y taotao sija gui sumantate, ya japacha y magaguña.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ilegña: Yaguin jupacha y magaguñaja, uguajayo jinemlo.
pairs.english: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y menegae y jâgâña umanglo, ya jasiente y tataotaoña na esta jomlo ni ayo na chetnot.
pairs.english: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus enseguidas jatungo guiya güiyaja, na ninasiña jumuyong guiya güiya, jabira güe guato gui linajyan taotao, ya ilegña: Jaye pumacha y magagujo?
pairs.english: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija ilegñija nu güiya: Unlie y linayan taotao na machichiguetjao, ya ilegmo: Jaye pumachayo?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manatan gui oriya para ulie y fumatinas este.

pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo nae y palaoan maañao ya manlaloalao, jatungo na iyagüiya nae mafatinas, mato ya podong gui menaña, ya jasangane todo ni magajet.
pairs.english: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Jagajo, y jinengguemo unninajomlo; janao yan minagof, ya unjomio ni chetnotmo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 35 37160 ¶ Y tiempo nae cumuecuentos güe, manmato guine y guima y prinsipen sinagoga ya ilegñija: Y jagamo matae: para jafa di unnachachatsaga mas y Maestro?
pairs.english: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus, anae jajungog este na sinangan, ilegña ni prinsipen sinagoga: Chamo maaañao; jonggueja.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

pairs.english: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

pairs.english: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jagosencatga sija na taya ujanatungo: ya manago na umanachocho y patgon palaoan.
pairs.english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae jumanao güije mato gui tanoña; ya y disipuluña sija madalalag güe.
pairs.english: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato y sábado na jaane, jatutujon mamanagüe gui sinagoga; ya megae ni jumungog güe ninafanmanman, ya ilegñija: Mano nae guaja este taotao este sija na güinaja? Yan jafa este na tiningo y esta manae güe? ya jaftaemano este sija na ninámanman ni mafatinas ni canaeña?
pairs.english: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti este y catpintero, lajin Maria, chelun Santiago, yan si Joses, yan si Juda, yan si Simon? Ada ti manjijita yan y mañeluña famalaoan güine? Ya maninefefende nu güiya.
pairs.english: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Taya profeta sin onraña lao y tanoñaja, yan entre y parientesña sija, ya y guimaña.
pairs.english: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña jafatinas güije jafa na námanman, na japolo y canaeña gui jilo palo manmalango sija, ya janajomlo.
pairs.english: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ninámanman ni ti manmanjongguenñija; ya malilicue gui y sengsong sija mananagüe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 7 37310 ¶ Ya jaagang y dose sija, y jatutujon tumago dos en dos, ya janae ninasiñañija gui jilo manáplacha na espiritu sija;

pairs.chamorro: Lao ufanchenancleta; ya munga manminagago dos na magago.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Manoja na guma nae manjalom jamyo; fañaga güije, asta gui manjanao jamyo güije na lugat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos jasetmon na y taotao sija ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayute juyong megae na anite sija, ya japapalae laña megae na manmalango sija, ya janafanjomlo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

pairs.chamorro: Palo ilegñija: Si Elias. Y palo ilegñija: Profeta güe, pat uno gui profeta sija.
