pairs.english: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiyaja si Herodes manago na umamantiene si Juan, ya umapreso gui catset pot si Herodias, asaguan y cheluña as Felipe, sa jacone para asaguaña.
pairs.english: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan ilegña as Herodes: Ti cabales na uncone y asaguan y chelumo.
pairs.english: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este si Herodias uninaguaguat contra güiya, ya jadesesao na upuno, lao ti janasiña.
pairs.english: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Herodes maañao as Juan, jatungo na tunas yan Santos na taotao ya jaguefadaje. Ya anae jajungog, gosbumuebuente gui corasonña; ya jaecungogjao ni minagofña.
pairs.english: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato un jaane na si Herodes gumupot ni mafañaguña, ya mamatinas sena para y prinsipeña sija yan y capitan sija, yan y manmagas sija guiya Galilea;
pairs.english: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom y jagan Herodias, ya bumaela, ya janamagof si Herodes, yan ayo sija y mangachochongña gui lamasa; ya y ray ilegña ni patgon na palaoan: Gagaoyo ni malagomo, ya junaejao.
pairs.english: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjula: Todo y ungagaoyo, junae asta lamita gui raenoco.
pairs.english: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos güe, ya ilegña as nanaña: Jafa jugagao? Si nanaña ilegña: Y ilun Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jumalom enseguidas gui ray ya jagagao, ilegña: Malagoyo pago na unnaeyo gui un plato ni ilun Juan Bautista.
pairs.english: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ray ninagostriste; lao pot y juramentoña, yan ayo sija y mangachongña gui lamasa, ti malago japune.
pairs.english: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas y ray manago uno gui guatdia, jatago na ujanao ya uchinilie ni iluña. Ya mapos, ya jadegüeya gui jalom catset.
pairs.english: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machule guato y iluña gui un plato, ya manae y patgon palaoan, ya y patgon palaoan janae y nanaña.
pairs.english: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog ni disipuluña sija, manmato, ya machule y tataotaoña, ya mapolo gui un naftan.
pairs.english: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 30 37540 ¶ Ya y apostoles mandaña gui as Jesus, ya masangane güe todo ni chechoñija, yan y finanagüenñija.
pairs.english: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña su sija: Maela jamyo apatte gui un lugat desierto, ya infandescansa didide; sa megae sija manjajanao, yan manmafato, ya manaelugat mañocho.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos gui un batco gui un lugat desierto apatte.
pairs.english: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lumie sija na manjanao megae, ya matungo güe; ya manmalalago para ayo megae manmamomocat gui siuda sija, ya manmato antes qui sija, ya mandaña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumuyong si Jesus jalie y linajyan taotao ya ninamaase nu sija, sa manparejoja yan y quinilo sija ni taya pastotñija; ya jatutujon fumanagüe megae na güinaja.
pairs.english: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae estaba pupuenge, y disipuluña sija manmato guiya güiya, ilegñija: Y lugat desierto este, ya esta pupuenge.
pairs.english: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Najanao sija para ufanmalag y campo yan y sengsong sija gui oriya, ya ujafanmamajan pan para sija.
pairs.english: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manope, ilegña nu sija: Nae sija mañija. Ya sija ilegñija nu güiya: Infanjanao ya infanmamajan pan pot dosientos na denario, para innae sija nañija?
pairs.english: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Cuanto na pan guaja jamyo? Janao, ya inlie. Ya anae jatungo sija, ilegñija: Sinco, yan dos na güijan.
pairs.english: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago, sija na ujanafanmatachong todos pot mangachong gui jilo y manbetde na chaguan.
pairs.english: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmatachong pot mangachong, siento yan siento, yan sincuenta yan sincuenta.
pairs.english: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y sinco na pan yan y dos na güijan, ya manatan julo gui langet, ya jabendise, ya jaipe y pan sija; ya janae y disipuluña sija para ujaplanta gui sanmenañija; ya y dos na güiyan manmapatte todos.
pairs.english: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho todos, ya manjaspog.
pairs.english: And they did all eat, and were filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajatsa y pedaso sija dose na canastra manbula; yan pedaso y güijan sija locue.
pairs.english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y mañocho ni pan, sinco mit na lalaje sija.
pairs.english: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 45 37690 ¶ Ya enseguidas jaapura y disipuluña sija na ufangajulo gui batco, ya ufanjanao gui menaña gui otro banda guiya Betsaida, mientras janajanao y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues, anae munjayan janajanao sija, mapos malag y egso para ufanaetae.
pairs.english: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta pupuenge, y batco estaba gui talo gui tase, ya güiyaja namaesa gui tano.
pairs.english: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie sija na manmachochocho mapot manmamómogsae, sa y manglo contrario para sija; ya jijot gui mina cuatro na guatdia gui puenge, mato güe guiya sija, mamómocat gui jilo tase; ya malago na ufalofan gui oriyañija.
pairs.english: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie nu sija, na mamómocat gui jilo tase, jinasoñija na pantasma, ya managang;
pairs.english: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todos lumie güe, ya ninafañatsaga. Lao enseguidas jacuentuse sija, ya ilegña nu sija: Angoco jamyo, guajoyo; chamiyo fanmaaañao.
pairs.english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo guiya sija gui batco, ya y manglo mapos: ya sija ninafangosmanman;
pairs.english: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sija ti jatungo y milagron y pan sija; sa y corasonñija estaba mangosmajetog.
pairs.english: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 53 37770 ¶ Ya anae manmalofan para y otro banda, manmato gui tano Genesaret, ya manmalag y puetto.
pairs.english: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong sija gui batco, enseguidas matungo güe.
pairs.english: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago gui oriyan todo ayo na tano, ya matutujon mañule gui todo y patte, manmalango sija gui cama, mano nae majungog na estaba güije.
pairs.english: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manuja nae jumalom, songsong, pat suida, pat fangualuan, mapolo papa y malango sija gui chalan, y matayuyut güe na upacha y canton y magaguña, ya todo ayo sija y japacha, manjomlo.
pairs.english: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mandaña guiya güiya y Fariseo sija, yan palo gui escriba sija ni manmato guine Jerusalem,
pairs.english: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malie palo gui disipuluña na mañochocho pan yan áplacha na canae, ni comequeilegña na pot ti jafagase.
pairs.english: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Fariseo sija, yan toda y Judio sija, jaadadaje y tradision manamco sija, yaguin megae nae ti jafagase y canaeñija, ti ufañocho.
pairs.english: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato guine y metcado, yaguin ti jafagase sija, ti ufañocho; yan megae sija na güinaja rinesibeñija para ujaadaje, parejoja yan mafagase y copa sija, yan y jara sija, yan y bason coble sija.
pairs.english: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen ni Fariseo sija yan y escriba sija: Jafa y disipulumo sija na ti manmamómocat taemano y tradision manamco sija; mañochochoja pan yan aplacha y canaeñija?
pairs.english: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Hipocrita jamyo; mauleg sinanganña si Isaias, ni y esta matugue: Este sija na taotao y labiosñija nae maonrayo, lao y corasonñija chago guiya guajo.
pairs.english: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taebale jaadorayo, manmamananagüe ni finanagüe ni tinago taotao sija.
pairs.english: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctines the commandments of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa inpelo jamyo y tinago Yuus, ya mantietiene fitme y tradision taotao sija: (ni y mafagase y jara sija, yan y copa sija, yan infatinas megae sija na güinaja parejo yan este.)
pairs.english: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet jamyo yumute y tinago Yuus para inadaje y tradisionmiyo.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Moises ilegña: Onra si tatamo yan si nanamo; ya y mumatdise y tata pat y nana, seguro na umatae.
pairs.english: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo ilegmiyo: Yaguin y taotao ilegña ni tataña pat nanaña: Y Cotban (cumequeilegña y ninae) na jago umaprobecha pot guajo, güiya sumaga libre.
pairs.english: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inpelo güe na ufatinas taya para si tataña pat si nanaña;
pairs.english: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inrechasa y sinangan Yuus ni ninaenmiyo na tradision; yan megae sija na güinaja finatinasmiyo parejo yan este.
pairs.english: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 14 37940 ¶ Ya jaagang talo guiya güiya todo y linajyan taotao ya ilegña: Ecungog jamyo todos, ya intingo.
pairs.english: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya gui sumanjiyong gui taotao ni y janajalom, siña numataelaye, lao y janajujuyong gui jinalomña, ayo sija munatataelaye y taotao
pairs.english: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Yaguin guaja gaetalanga para ufanjungog, uecungog)
pairs.english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom gui guima, jadingo y linajyan taotao, y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe ni acomparasion.
pairs.english: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Taegüenaja jamyo locue manaetiningo? Ti intingo na todo y guine jiyong ni jumajalom y taotao ti siña ninataelaye?
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jumajalom gui corasonña na y tiyanña ya malolofan gui secreto; taegüenao janagasgas todo y nengcano.
pairs.english: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan ilegña: Y jumujuyong gui taotao, ayo munatataelaye y taotao.
pairs.english: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y gui jinalomña gui corason y taotao sija nae, manjujuyong y manaelaye na jinaso sija, y manadulterio, y manábale yan y manpegno,

pairs.english: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan Griega, gui tano Sirofenisa, y tinayuyut güe na uyute juyong gui jagaña y anite.

pairs.english: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña ni palaoan: Pot este na sinangan, janao y anite jumanao gui jagamo.
pairs.english: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumanao para iyasija, jasoda na y jagaña umaason gui jilo cama, ya y anite esta jumanao.
pairs.english: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 31 38110 ¶ Ya tumalo jumanao gui oriyan Tiro yan malofan guiya Sidon, ya mato gui tasen Galilea; ya malofan gui entalo y oriyan Decapolis.
pairs.english: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maconie güe un tanga ya udo, ya matayuyut güe na upolo y canaeña gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janasajnge güe gui linajyan taotao, ya japolo y calolotña gui talangan y tanga, ya tumola ya japacha y jilaña;
pairs.english: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatan julo y langet sumospiros, ya ilegña: Efatha, cumequeilegña, mababa!
pairs.english: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mababa y talangaña; ya mapula y gumogode y jilaña, ya cumuentos mauleg.
pairs.english: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija, na chañija sumangangane ni jaye; lao mientras mas jaencatga, mas manamamto;
pairs.english: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafangosmanman, ilegñija: Mauleg finatinasña todo: janafanmanjungog y mananga, ya y manudo janafanguentos.
pairs.english: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maase yo ni linajyan taotao sa esta tres jaane na manjame; ya taya jafa nañija.
pairs.english: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin junafanjanao sin mañocho para iyasija, ufanlalango gui chalan; sa palo guiya sija manmato guine y chago.
pairs.english: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija, maope güe: Guine mano nae siña manafanjaspog este taotao sija pan, güine gui desierto?
pairs.english: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guiya jafaesen sija: Cuanto na pan guaja jamyo? Ylegñija, siete.
pairs.english: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jatago y linajyan taotao na ufanason gui jilo oda; ya jachule y siete na pan, ya janae Yuus maase ya jaipe, ya janae y disipuluña sija para ujaplanta gui menanñija; ya sija japlanta gui menan y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan guaja locue palo mandiquique na güijan sija; ya anae jabendise, jatago na ujaplanta locue gui menanñija.
pairs.english: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues mañocho, ya manjaspog; ya majatsa y pidaso sija ni sebbla, siete canastra.
pairs.english: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mañocho sija, buente cuatro mit; ya jadespide.
pairs.english: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas jumalom gui batco yan y disipuluña sija, ya manmato gui oriyan Dalmanuta.
pairs.english: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 11 38280 ¶ Ya manmato y Fariseo sija, ya matutujon manafaesen yan güiya, manmanaliligao guiya güiya un señat guine y langet, matietienta güe.
pairs.english: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumospiros gostadong gui espirituña, ya ilegña: Jafa na mangagagao señat este na generasion? Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti umanae señat este na generasion.
pairs.english: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadingo sija, ya jumalom talo gui batco, ya mapos para y otro banda.
pairs.english: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 14 38310 ¶ Ya manmalefa ti manmañule pan, ya taya na unoja na pan gui batco.
pairs.english: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija, ilegña: Atan, adaje jamyo ni lebaduran y Fariseo sija, yan y lebaduran Herodes.
pairs.english: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafaesen gui entalo sija, ilegña: Pot y taya panta.
pairs.english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Jafa manafaesen gui entalomiyo pot y taya panmiyo? Ti injaso ni ti intingo? Majejetogja trabia y corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja atadogmiyo, lao ti manmanlilie jamyo? Guaja talanganmiyo, ya ti manmanjujungogja jamyo? Ya ti injajasoja?
pairs.english: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae juipe y sinco na pan sija entalo y sinco mit, cuanto na canastra injatsa bula ni pidaso sija ni sebbla? Ylegñija: Dose.
pairs.english: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y siete na pan sija entalo y cuatro mit, cuanto na canastra injatsa bula ni pidaso sija ni sebbla? Ylegñija: Siete.
pairs.english: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ilegña nu sija: Ti intingo asta pago?

pairs.chamorro: N 8 22 38390 ¶ Ya mato guiya Betsaida; ya maconie güe guato un bachet, ya matayuyut güe na upacha güe.

pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jamantiene y canae y bachet, ya jacone asta y jiyong y siuda; ya anae jatolae y atadogña, japolo y canaeña gui jiloña, ya jafaesen: Unlie jafa?
pairs.english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago para iyasija, ilegña: Chamo jumajalom gui sengsong (ni usangane jaye gui siuda).

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 27 38440 ¶ Ya mapos si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija gui sensong sija y Cesarean Felipe: ya y chalan jafaesen y disipuluña sija, ilegña nu sija: Jaye ilegñija y taotao sija nu guajo?
pairs.english: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

pairs.english: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaencatga sija na chañija sumangangane ni jaye pot güiya.
pairs.english: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon fumanagüe sija na y Lajin taotao janesesita upadese megae, ya umarechasa ni manamco sija, yan y prinsipen y mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno; ya ucajulo talo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya claroja nae jasangan este na sinangan. Ayo nae si Pedro quinene güe, ya tinitujon güe rineprende.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jabira güe, ya jaatan y disipuluña sija, jalalatde si Pedro ilegña: Suja guiya guajo, Satanas; sa ti unadadaje y güinaja sija ni para si Yuus, na y güinajan taotao sija.
pairs.english: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang y linajyan taotao yan y disipuluña sija, ya ilegña nu sija; Jaye y malago tumatiye yo, upune maesa güe, ya uchule y quiluusña ya udalalagyo.
pairs.english: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y malago sumatba y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; lao y finalingaeguan ni linâlâña pot guajo, yan y ibangelio, este usatba y linâlâña.
pairs.english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, jafa uaprobecha y taotao, yaguin jagana todo y tano, ya finalingaeguan ni linâlâña?
pairs.english: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jafa na apas ufannae y taotao pot y linâlâña?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamajlao nu guajo yan y sinaganjo, gui sanmenan este y generasion ábale yan gaeisao, unimamajlaogüe locue ni Lajin taotao y tiempo nae mato gui minalag y Tataña, yan y mañantos na angjetña sija.
pairs.english: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ilegña nu sija: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na guaja palo sija ni mangaegue güine na ti ujaguaeya finatae, asta que jalie y raenon Yuus na mato yan ninasiña.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 2 38570 ¶ Anae esta malofan y sais na jaane, si Jesus jacone si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan, janafañajnge sijaja gui un taquilo na ogso; ya jaago güe gui menanñija.
pairs.english: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magaguña manmañila, gosapaca calang niebe, taya ni un fafagas gui tano siña munaapaca taegüine.
pairs.english: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manalie na mato guiya güiya si Elias yan Moises, na manguecuentos yan si Jesus.
pairs.english: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope si Pedro, ilegña as Jesus: Maestro mauleg utafañagajit güine, ya tafanmamatinas tres tabetnáculo; para jago y uno, para si Moises y otro, yan para si Elias y otro.
pairs.english: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si ti jatungo jafa usangan, sa estaba mangosmaañao.
pairs.english: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un mapagajes y manjineme sija, ya un inagang gui mapagajes, ilegña: Este y güinaeyaco na Lajijo, jingog güe.
pairs.english: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya derepente jaatan gui oriyañija, ti manmanlie ni jaye, na si Jesusja yan sija.
pairs.english: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manunog sija guine y egso, jaencatga sija na chañija sumangangane ni jaye ni liniiñija, asta que y Lajin taotao esta cajulo guine entalo y manmatae.
pairs.english: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jaadaje ayo na sinangan guiya sijaja, manafaesen gui entaloñija: Jafa ayo y cajulo guine entalo y manmatae cumequeilegña.
pairs.english: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija: Y escriba sija ilegñija, si Elias nesesita ufato finenana.
pairs.english: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manope ilegña nu sija: Si Elias magajet nesesita ufato finenana, ya jafatinas talo todo y güinaja: Jafa esta matugue gui Lajin taotao na upadese megae ya manataya guaelayeña?
pairs.english: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo na si Elias esta mato ya esta mafatinas guiya güiya todo y malagoñija, taegüine esta matugue nu güiya.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 14 38690 ¶ Ya anae mato gui disipuluña sija, jalie un dangculon linajyan taotao gui oriyañija, yan y escriba sija ni manafaesen yan sija.
pairs.english: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas todo y linajyan taotao, anae malie güe, ninafangosmanman, ya manmalago guato guiya güiya ya masaluda güe.
pairs.english: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen sija, ilegña! Jafana manafaesen jamyo yan sija?
pairs.english: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope uno gui linajyan taotao, ilegña: Maestro juconie jao mague na lajijo, na guaja un espiritun udo;
pairs.english: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manoja nae quinene güe, japedadasos; ya bóboan, ya janachechegcheg y nifenña, ya ninayafae; ya jusangane y disipulumo sija, na ujayute juyong, lao ti manasiña.
pairs.english: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe, ilegña nu sija: O generasion ni ti manjonggue! asta ngaean nae utafanjijitaja? asta ngaean nae jususungonja jamyo? maelayofan mague.
pairs.english: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maconie guato guiya güiya; ya anae jalie, enseguidas y espiritu manlálaolao güe; ya güiya podong gui jilo oda gumagalileg ya bóboan.
pairs.english: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafaesen y tataña; cuanto tiempo esta desde qui mato este guiya güiya? Güiya ilegña: Desde qui diquique:
pairs.english: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na biaje nae yinite gui jalom guafe, yan y jalom janom para upinino; lao yaguin siña jao ayudajam, gaemaase nu jame.
pairs.english: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus, ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin siña jao, todo siña para y manjonggue.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enseguidas y tatan y patgon, jaagang yan y lagoña, ya elegña: Jujonggue; ayuda y taejinenggueco.
pairs.english: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Jesus jalie na manmalalago y linajyan taotao, jalalatde y áplacha na espiritu, ilegña: Espiritun udo yan tanga, guajo jao tumago, juyong guiya güiya, ya chamo jumajalom talo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y espiritu umagang, ya manlalaolao güe megae, ya jumuyong; ya güiya sumaga calang matae, enaomina megae ilegñija, na esta matae.
pairs.english: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jamantiene canaeña, ya jinatsa güe; ya cajulo.
pairs.english: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom güe gui jalom guma, y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe en secreto, ilegñija: Jafajam na ti innasiña yumute juyong?
pairs.english: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Este na rasan anite sija, taya siña munajanao, na y tinayuyut.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 30 38850 ¶ Ya manmapos güije, manmalofan inanaco Galilea; ya ti malago na guaja utiningo güe.
pairs.english: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jafanagüe y disipuluña sija ya ilegña nu sija: Y Lajin taotao umaentrega gui canae taotao sija, ya umapuno; lao yaguin este matae, ucajulo talo despues di tres na jaane.
pairs.english: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo este na sinangan, ya manmaañao na ujafaesen güe.
pairs.english: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 33 38880 ¶ Ya mato guiya Capernaum; ya anae mato gui guima, jafaesen sija: Jafa jamyo na manafaesen entalomiyoja gui chalan?
pairs.english: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija manmamatquiquiloja; sa guine manafaesen gui chalan uno y otro, jaye guiya sija udangculo.
pairs.english: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manmatachong, ya jaagang y dose ya ilegña nu sija: Y malago fuminenana, uuttimon gui tododos, yan utentagon tododos.
pairs.english: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone un patgon, ya japolo gui entaloñija; ya jajogüe gui canaeña, ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y rumesibe pot y naanjo uno ni manaegüine na famaguon, jaresibe yo, ya y rumesibe yo, ti guajo jaresibe, na y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan, ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, inlie uno na manyute juyong anite sija pot y naanmo, ya inchema, sa ti jadadalalagjit.
pairs.english: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña: Chamiyo chumochoma; sa ni uno ni fumatinas milagro pot y naanjo, siña gusisija jasangan taelaye guiya guajo.
pairs.english: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo y ti contra jita, manjijitaja.
pairs.english: For he that is not against us is on our part.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y numae jamyo un copan janom, sa iyon Cristo jamyo, magajet jusangane jamyo, na sen ti ufalingo y apasña.
pairs.english: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ninaquepodong uno guine sija gui mandiquique ni jumonggue yo; mauleg para güiya, umagode gui agagaña un acho atutong, ya umayute gui jalom tase.
pairs.english: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin y canaemo ninaquepodong jao, utut; maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâ mangco, qui uguaja dos canaemo, ya unjanao para sasalaguan, y guafe ni ti siña mapuno.
pairs.english: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae; ya y guafe taejinecog nae umapuno.)
pairs.english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y adengmo ninaquepodong jao, utut: maulegña na unjalom gui linâlâ cojo, qui uguaja dos adengmo ya unyenite para sasalaguan;
pairs.english: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae, ya y guafe taejinecog nae umapuno.)
pairs.english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y atadogmo ninaquepodong jao, lagnos; maulegña na unjalom gui raenon Yuus, yan un atadogja, qui uguaja dos atadogmo ya unyenite para sasalaguan.
pairs.english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Anae y iloñija ti ufanmatae, ya y guafe taejinecog na umapuno.)
pairs.english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todos ufanmaasne yan guafe; (ya todo y inefrese ufanmaasne yan asiga).
pairs.english: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mauleg y asiga; lao yaguin y asiga malingo y maasenña, jaftaemano numamaasen? Guaja asiganmiyo guiya jamyoja; yan guaja pas gui entalomiyo.
pairs.english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA cajulo güije, mato qui oriyan Judea, gui otro bandan Jordan; ya manalo y linajyan taotao mandaña guiya güiya; ya jatalo fumanagüe, taegüije, y costumbreña.
pairs.english: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato y Fariseo sija guiya güiya, ya mafaesen güe cao tunas y laje uyute y asaguaña? matietienta güe.
pairs.english: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya manope, ilegña nu sija: Jafa mantinago jamyo as Moises?
pairs.english: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Si Moises japetmite na umatugue papet inapattan umasagua ya uyute.
pairs.english: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope, ilegña nu sija: Pot y majetog corasonmiyo na mantiniguie jamyo ni este na tinago.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yuus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este na rason y laje udingo si tataña yan si nanaña, ya udaña yan y asaguaña.
pairs.english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y este y dos, umana unoja na catne; ya esta ti udos mas, na unoja na catne.
pairs.english: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja si Yuus munadaña, y taotao ti unadesapatta.
pairs.english: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jalom guma, y disipulo sija mafaesen güe talo ni ayoja.
pairs.english: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jayeja y yumute y asaguaña, ya umasagua yan otro, jafatinas y adulterio contra y palaoan.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yaguin y palaoan yumute y asaguaña, ya umasagua yan otro, jafatinas adulterio.
pairs.english: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 13 39180 ¶ Ya machulie guato guiya güiya diquique na famaguon para upacha: ya y disipulo sija jalalatde ayo sija.
pairs.english: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus, sen ti ninamagof ya ilegña nu sija: Polo y diquique na famaguon ya ufanmamaela guiya guajo; chamiyo chumochoma; sa iyon este sija y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na y ti rumesibe y raenon Yuus calang un patgon, ti ujalom gui jalom ayo.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajogüe sija ya japolo y canaeña gui jiloñija, ya jabendise sija.
pairs.english: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 17 39220 ¶ Ya anae jumanao gui chalan, mato uno malalago ya dinimuye güe gui menaña ya finaesen güe: Mauleg na Maestro, jafa jufatinas para juereda y taejinecog na linâlâ?
pairs.english: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Jafa na ilegmo nu guajo mauleg? Taya mauleg, na unoja, si Yuus.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Untungo y tinago sija: Chamofamumuno; chamo fumatinas adulterio; chamo fañañaque; chamo sumanganñaejon y ti magajet na testimonio; chamo chumu y ti iyomo; onra si tatamo yan si nanamo.
pairs.english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manope ilegña: Maestro, todo este juadadaje desde nae patgonyo.
pairs.english: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae matan güe as Jesus, güinaeya güe, ya ilegña nu güiya: Fatta jao uno: Janao ya ufajan todo y güinajamo, ya unnae y mamobble sija, ya uguaja güinajamo gui langet: ya maela, ya undalalag yo.
pairs.english: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ninamatolaeca y mataña ni este na sinangan ya mapos ninatriste; sa guaja megae güinajaña.
pairs.english: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus manatan gui oriya, ya ilegña ni disipuluña sija: Na minapot manjalom gui raenon Yuus ayo sija y mangaegüinaja!
pairs.english: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipulo sija ninafanmanman ni sinanganña: Lao si Jesus manope ilegña talo: Famaguon, na minapot manjalom, gui raenon Yuus y umangongoco sija gui güinaja!
pairs.english: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mas guse malofan un cameyo gui matan un jaguja, qui y gaegüinaja ujalom gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ninagos fanmanmanman, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Ayo nae, jaye siña satbo?
pairs.english: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus jaatan sija, ya ilegña: Para y taotao sija, este ti siña, lao para si Yuus ti taegüine; sa para si Yuus todo ninasiña.
pairs.english: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pedro jatutujon ilegña nu güiya: Estagüejamja na indingo todo, ya indadalalagjao.
pairs.english: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe as Jesus ilegña. Magajet jusanganejao: Taya ni un taotao ni y dumingo gumaña, pat mañeluña lalaje, pat mañeluña famalaoan, pat nanaña, pat tataña, pat famaguonña, pat fangualuaña, pot guajo, yan y ibangelio;
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na ti uresibe pagoja sienbiaje: guma sija, yan mañeluña lalaje, yan mañeluña famalaoan, yan nanaña, yan famaguonña, yan fangualuan sija, yan umapetsigue; ya y mámamaela na siglo, taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao megae na manfinenana, ufanuttimo, ya y manuttimo, ufanfinenana.
pairs.english: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 32 39370 ¶ Ya anae mangaegue gui chalan, mangajulo guiya Jerusalem; ya si Jesus malag y menañija; ya ninafanmanman: ya y dumadalalag mangosmaañao. Ya jacone talo y dose, ya jatutujon sumangane sija jafa ususede güe.
pairs.english: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umamofea, yan umatolae, yan umasaulag, yan umapuno; ya y despues di tres na jaane ucajulo talo.
pairs.english: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 35 39400 ¶ Ya si Santiago yan si Juan, lalajin Sebedeo, manmato jijot guiya güiya ya ilegñija nu güiya: Maestro, manmalagojam na unfatinas guiyajame jafa y malagomame.
pairs.english: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa malagonmiyo na jufatinas guiya jamyo?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija nu güiya: Nafanmatachongjam, y uno gui agapamo, ya y otro gui acagüemo, gui minalagmo.
pairs.english: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Ti intingo jafa ingagagao. Siña jamyo manguimen gui copa anae gumiguimenyo? yan infanmatagpange ni y matagpangeco?
pairs.english: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Mansiñajam. Ayonae ilegña si Jesus nu sija: infanguimen gui copa anae gumiguimenyo, yan infanmatagpange ni y ma tagpangeco;
pairs.english: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y infanmatachong gui agapajo, yan y acagüeco; ti guajo jufannae; lao para ayo sija ufanmanae y manmapreparaye.
pairs.english: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
