pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog este ni y dies, ninafanlalalo as Santiago yan Juan.
pairs.english: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao maninagang as Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Intingo na ayo y manmanafanmagas gui Gentiles, jafatinas minagas gui jiloñija; ya y manmagas, jafatinas ninasiña gui jiloñija.
pairs.english: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ti utaegüenao guiya jamyo; sa jaye y malago dumangculo guiya jamyo; güiya ufañeñetbe.
pairs.english: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaye guiya jamyo y malago mumagas; utentago para todo.
pairs.english: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet ni y Lajin taotao ti mato para umasetbe, lao para ufañetbe, ya para ufannae y jaaniña ni un rescate para unafanlibre megae.
pairs.english: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 46 39510 ¶ Ya manmato Jerico. Ya anae manjanao gui Jerico, yan y disipuluña yan un dangculon linajyan taotao, si Bartimeo lajin Timeo, na bachet, matatachong gui oriyan chalan, ya umegagao.
pairs.english: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog na si Jesus Nasareno, jatutujon umagang ilegña: Jesus, Lajin David, gaease nu guajo.
pairs.english: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae mumomye para ufamatquilo: lao mas umagang gosagang: Jago ni y Lajin David, gaease nu guajo.
pairs.english: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus tumojgüe ya ilegña: Agang güe. Ya maagang y bachet ilegñija nu güiya: Magofjao; cajulo sa inaagangjao.
pairs.english: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janasuja y capaña, y cajulo, ya malag as Jesus.
pairs.english: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manopegüe ya ilegña: Jafa malagomo jufatinas guiya jago? Y bachet ilegña nu güiya: Raboni, nafanliiyo.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae esta manjijijot Jerusalem, yan Betfage, yan Betania, gui egso Olibo, jatago dos gui disipuluña,
pairs.english: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Janao fanmalag y sengsong gui menanmiyo: ya enseguidas qui manjalom jamyo, inseda un patgon bulico, na magogode, na taya nae matachonge; pila ya inquene mague.
pairs.english: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin jaye na taotao umalog nu jamyo; Jafa na infatinas este? Sangane: Señot janesesita: ya enseguidas umanajanao mague.
pairs.english: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos, ya masoda nu patgon bulico gui caye na magogode gui jiyong potta ya mapula güe.
pairs.english: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y mangaegue güije ilegñija nu sija: Jafa na inpila enao y patgon bulico?
pairs.english: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane jaftaemano y mansinangane as Jesus: ya japolo na ufanjanao.
pairs.english: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus.
pairs.english: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae jajuto magagoñija gui chalan: yan palo y ramas jayo na manmanuutot gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ilegñija: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendito y raeno na mamamaela, y raenon y tatata as David, Hosana guiyajululu.
pairs.english: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jumalom Jerusalem, ya jumalom gui templo; ya anae munjayan jalie todo y güinaja, ya y pupuenge, mapos yan y dose, manmalag Betania.
pairs.english: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 12 39690 ¶ Ya y inagpaña anae manmato guinen Betania, ñalang.
pairs.english: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie mona un trongcon igos na gagaejagonja, malag ayo jinasoña na ufañoda jafa; lao anae mato guato, taya sinedaña na jagonja; sa ti tiempopoña y igos trabia.
pairs.english: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manope ya ilegña nu güiya: Taya ni un taotao uquinano y tinegchamo para siempre. Ya majungog ni y disipuluña.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 15 39720 ¶ Ya manmato Jerusalem; ya jumalom y templo, ya sigue di jayute juyong todo ayo sija y manmanbebende, yan y manmamamajan gui templo, yan janafanalinquin y lamasan salape y manmanulalaeca, yan y tachong y man manbebende paluma:
pairs.english: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya ni uno jaconsiente na ufañule baso gui templo.
pairs.english: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamanagüe, ilegña nu sija: Ada ti matugue na y guimajo umafanaan guma manaetae ni y todo nasion sija? lao jamyo fumatinas y liyang mañañaque.
pairs.english: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya majungog ni y magas mamale yan y escriba sija, ya maaliligao jaftaemano para umapuno; sa mamaañao nu güiya, sa janafanmamanman y linajyan taotao ni y finanagüeña.
pairs.english: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cada pupuenge, jumanao juyong gui siuda.
pairs.english: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y egaan anae manmalolofan, malie y trongcon igos na anglo desde y jale.
pairs.english: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jajaso si Pedro ya ilegña nu güiya: Rabi, estagüe y trongcon igos ni y unmatdise na anglo todo.
pairs.english: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Jenggue si Yuus.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet jusangane jamyo: Jayeja y umalog ni este y egso, janao ya unyutejao gui tase; ya ti bumuebuente gui corasonña, lao jajonggue na umafatinas ayo y sinanganña; uguaja.
pairs.english: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jusangane jamyo: Na todo sija ingagao, anae manmanaetae jamyo, jenggue na esta inresibe, ya infanmannae.
pairs.english: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya an manojgue ya mananaetaejamyo, asie yanguin guajajao jafa contra jaye; sa y Tatanmiyo locue ni y gaegue gui langet, uninasie ni y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin ti manasiijamyo, y Tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet ti uninasie ni y isaomiyo.
pairs.english: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 39840 ¶ Ya manmato talo Jerusalem, ya anae mamomocat gui templo, manmato y magas mamale, yan y escriba, yan y manamco sija;
pairs.english: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Pot jafa na ninasiña na unfatitinas estesija? yan jayejao numae ni este na ninasiña, para unfatinas estesija?
pairs.english: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Bae jufaesen locue jamyo un finaesen ya inepeyo, ayonae jusangane jamyo pot jafa na ninasiña na jufatitinas este sija.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinagpangen Juan, guinen y langet, pat guinen y taotao sija? epeyo.
pairs.english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajajaso gui sumanjalomñija, ilegñija: Yanguin ilegmame, Guinen y langet; ualog: Jafanae na ti injenggue güe?
pairs.english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ilegmame guinen y taotao sija--manmaañao ni y taotao, sa pineloñija todo na magajet na profeta si Juan.
pairs.english: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanope, ilegñija as Jesus: Ti intingo. Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu sija; ni guajo locue ti jusangane jamyo pot jafa naninasiña, na jufatitinas estesija.
pairs.english: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA sigue di jacuentuse sija acomparasion sija. Un taotao mananom gui fangualuan ubas, ya jacolat nu trongcon tituca, ya manguadog un joyo para un lagat ya jafatinas un tore, ya jaatquila y manfafachocho, ya mapos güe malag otro tano.
pairs.english: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta tiempo, jatago uno gui tentagoña para ayo y manmachochocho, para ujaresibe guinen manmachochocho y tinegcha y fangualuan ubas.
pairs.english: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone y tentago, ya masaulag, ya manajanao taesinajguan.
pairs.english: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago talo y otro tentagoña; ya mapoca y iluña, ya manataelaye güe gosdangculo.
pairs.english: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatalo tumago y otro, ya mapuno; yan otro megae ya palo manmasaulag yan palo manmapuno.
pairs.english: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja unoja lajiña na sumenyaña; ya güiya uttimo jatago, ilegña: Ufangaerespeto ni y lajijo.
pairs.english: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y manmachochocho, ilegñija gui sumanjalomñija. Estagüe y eredero; nije tapuno, ya y fangualuan uiyota.
pairs.english: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone güe, ya mapuno, ya mayute juyong gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa pago ufatinas y magas y fangualuan? Ufato, ya uyulang todo y manmachochocho, ya ufannae otro ni y fangualuan.
pairs.english: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya nae intaetae este na tinigue: Y acho, ni y jarechasa y manmanmatitinas ni y guima, esteja mapolo cuentan ulo gui esquina.
pairs.english: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este finatinas y Señot, ya janafanmanman gui menan atadogta.
pairs.english: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maaliligao para umagote lao manmaañao ni y linajyan taotao; sa matungo na jasasangan y acomparasion contra sija: ya madingo, ya manmapos gui jinanaoñija.
pairs.english: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 13 40030 ¶ Ya manmatago guato guiya güiya palo gui Fariseo sija yan taotao Herodes; para umaquegacha gui sinanganña.
pairs.english: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato, ilegñija nu güiya: Maestro, intingo na jago magajetjao; ya taya unadadaje ni un taotao; sa ti guaelaye nu jago y finaboresen taotao, lao mamananagüejao ni y magajet na chalan Yuus. Tunas na infanmanaejam tributo as Sesat, pat aje?
pairs.english: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Innae, pat mungajam numae? Lao si Jesus jatungoja y quinadoñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa muna na intietientayo? maela un denarion salape ya julie.
pairs.english: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae machulie guato, ilegña nu sija: Iyon jaye este na imagen yan tinigue? Ylegñija nu güiya: Iyon Sesat.
pairs.english: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Nae si Sesat ni y iyon Sesat, ya si Yuus ni y iyon Yuus. Ya ninafangosmanman nu güiya.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 18 40080 ¶ Ya manmato guiya güiya y Saduseo sija ni y ilegñija, na taya quinajulo y mannatae; ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija:
pairs.english: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maestro, jatuguiejam si Moises: Yanguin y chelun un taotao matae, ya y palaoan ni y asaguaña sumaga ya taya patgonña, ayo y laje ni y chelun y matae, uasagua talo y palaoan, ya ufamasemiya gui cheluña.
pairs.english: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja seite lalaje na mañelu: y finenana umasagua, ya matae ti mapolo semiya:
pairs.english: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inasagua talo y palaoan ni y mina dos, ya matae talo taya pineloña semiya: ya y mina tres taegüijeja talo.
pairs.english: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y siete, ti mapolo semiyañijo; despues di todos, matae y palaoan locue.
pairs.english: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y quinajulo y manmatae, jaye guiya sija ugae asagua y palaoan? sa todo y siete manmasagua.
pairs.english: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Ada ti manlache jamyo, sa ti intingo y tinigue, ni y ninasiñan Yuus?
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mangajulo guinen manmatae, ni ufanasagua, ni umanafanasagua; lao manparejoja yan y angjet sija gui langet.
pairs.english: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmatae ni y ufannacajulo; ti untaetae gui leblon Moises, jaftaemano si Yuus gui jalomtano guiya trongcon jayo ni y ilegña as Moises: Guajo si Yuus Abraham, yan si Yuus Ysaac, yan si Yuus Jacob?
pairs.english: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti güiya si Yuus y manmatae, na si Yuus y manlâlâlâ; enaomina ninafangoslache jamyo.
pairs.english: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 28 40180 ¶ Ya uno gui escriba mato, ya jajungog na manafaesen entresija, ya jatungo na mauleg inepeña nu sija, finaesen güe: Jafa y finenana qui todo na tinago?
pairs.english: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope: Este y finenana na tinago: Jingog O Israel: Y Señot Yuusta, unoja na Señot:
pairs.english: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaeya jamyo y Señot, Yuusmiyo, contodo y corasonmiyo, yan contodo y antenmiyo, yan contodo y jinasonmiyo, yan contodo y minetgotmiyo.
pairs.english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y segundo: Guaeya y tiguangmo parejo yan jago. Taya otro tinago mas, mandangculo qui estesija.
pairs.english: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba ilegña nu güiya. Magajet Maestro, mauleg na unsangan na güiya unoja; ya taya otro na güiyaja.
pairs.english: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ugumaeya güe contodo y corason, yan contodo y tiningo, yan contodo y minetgot, yan ugumaeya y tiguangña parejo yan güiya, mas qui todo y inefrese, yan y ninae sija.
pairs.english: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus ni y minejnalom inepeña, ilegña nu güiya: Ti chagojao gui raenon Yuus. Ya taya ni un taotao fumaesen güe talo desde ayo.
pairs.english: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 35 40250 ¶ Ya maninepe as Jesus gui anae mamananagüe gui templo, ilegña: Jafa na ilegñija y escriba sija, na si Cristo Lajin David?
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David mismo ilegña gui Espiritu Santo: Y Señot ilegña ni y Señotto: Fatachong gui agapa na canaejo, asta qui jupolo y enemigumo sija gui papa y fañajangan adengmo.
pairs.english: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 37 40270 ¶ David jafanaan güe Señot; ya jaftaemano na y lajiña? Ya manmagof y dangculon linajyan taotao sija anae majungog.
pairs.english: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 38 40280 ¶ Ya ilegña gui finanagüeña: Adaje jamyo ni y escriba sija, sa yanñija manjanao yan y anaco magagoñija, yan yanñija manmasaluda gui metcado,
pairs.english: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y manmagas na tachong gui sinagoga, yan y ya jululo na tachong gui guipot;
pairs.english: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jatucho y guima y biuda sija, ya janafananaco tinaetaeñija ni y dinague: este sija ujaresibe dangculo na sentensia.
pairs.english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 41 40310 ¶ Ya anae matachong si Jesus gui menan y cajon ni y para y ninae; megae na taotao manmato, ya manmanyute jalom salape gui cajon; ya y megae na manrico sija, megae yiniteñija jalom.
pairs.english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un pobble na buida; ya manyute jalom dos cobble na bale buente un centavos.
pairs.english: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jaagang y disipuluña, ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Este y pebble na biuda, mas megae yiniteña jalom qui ni todo ayo sija y guinen manmanyute jalom gui cajon.
pairs.english: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo y manmanyute jalom, pot y minegaeñijaja; lao güiya pot y minalagoñaja na jayute jalom todo y güinajaña; asta y sustentoña todo.
pairs.english: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae jumuyong gui templo; ilegña nu güiya uno gui disipuluña: Maestro, liija na jechuran acho, yan guma sija.
pairs.english: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Unlie este sija na mandangculon guma? taya usobbla ni un acho gui jilo y otro, na ti umayute papa.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 3 40370 ¶ Ya anae matachong gui jilo y finabeca na y naanña Olibo, gui menan y templo, finaesen gui secreto as Pedro, yan Santiago, yan si Juan, yan si Andres,
pairs.english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Sanganejam, ngaean estesija ufanmato? yan jafa na señat yanguin para todo estesija nae ufanmacumple?
pairs.english: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jatutujon ilegña nu sija: Adaje jamyo, ya chamiyo fanmafabababa.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ualog: Guajo güiya Jesucristo, ya ufababa megae.
pairs.english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin injingog y guera, yan y masangan y guera: chamiyo ninafañachatsaga: sa nesesita estesija jumuyong: lao trabia ti y jinecog.
pairs.english: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y nasion sija ufangajulo contra y nasion, yan y raeno contra raeno: ya uguaja linao gui megae na lugat ya uguaja ñinalang: estesija tutujon y pinite.
pairs.english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 9 40430 ¶ Lao adaje jamyo: sa infanmaentrega gui tribunal sija; ya infanmasaulag gui sinagoga: yan infanojgue gui menan y manmagas sija yan y ray sija, pot causa de guajo para un testimonio contra sija.
pairs.english: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ibangelio nesesita umapredica finenana gui entre todo y nasion.
pairs.english: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae maconejamyo, ya maentregajamyo, chamiyo jumajaso jafa para insangan, ni injasuye jafa: sa jafaja y manaejamyo güije na ora, ayoja insangan: sa ti jamyo infangcuentos, na y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago y laje uentrega y cheluña laje, para umapuno; ya y tata y lajiña: ya y famaguon ufangajulo contra y mañaenanñija: ya uuafanmapuno.
pairs.english: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo infanmachatlie ni todo y taotao sija, pot y naanjo: lao jaye y sumungon asta y uttimo, umasatba.
pairs.english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae inlie y chinatlie y inginon na yinilang tumotojgue gui anae ti para utojgue, (y mananaetae utungo) ayo sija y mangaegue guiya Judea ufanmalago para y jalomtano:
pairs.english: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui jilo guma, chaña tumutunog ni ujalom ya ufañule jafa na güinaja gui jalom gumaña.
pairs.english: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y gaegue gui fangualuan, chaña tumatalo tate para uchule y magaguña.
pairs.english: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mannamaase ayo sija y manmapotgue yan y mannanasusu, güije sija na jaane!
pairs.english: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jinanaomiyo sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ayo sija na jaane, uguaja pininite, ni y taya nae guaja desde y matutujon y tano, anae jafatinas si Yuus, asta pago; ni uguaja asta jinecog.
pairs.english: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ti janacadada y Señot ayo sija na jaane, taya catne usatba: lao pot y rason y manmaayigja, ni y inayigña, janacadada ayo sija na jaane.
pairs.english: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin guaja umalog nu jago: Estagüe si Cristo: pat ayogüe guato; chamiyo jumojonggue.
pairs.english: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ufangajulo sija ti manmagajet na Cristo sija, yan ti manmagajet na profeta sija, ya ufanmamanue sija señat yan mannamanman, para ufanmamababa, yanguin janasiña, asta y manmaayig.
pairs.english: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao adaje jamyo: Sa estagüeja, na jusangane jamyo todos antes.
pairs.english: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 24 40580 ¶ Lao ayo sija na jaane an munjayan y pininite sija; ujomjom y atdao, ya y pilan ti ufanina,
pairs.english: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pution sija gui langet ufamodong, ya y ninasifia sija gui langet ufanmayengyong.
pairs.english: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo nae ujalie y Lajin taotao na mamamaela gui sanjalom mapagajes, yan y dangculon ninasiñaña yan y minalagña.
pairs.english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae utago y angjetña sija na ujarecoje y inayigña sija, guinen y cuatro na manglo, guinen y uttimon y tano asta y uttimon y langet.
pairs.english: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 28 40620 ¶ Tingo y acomparasion y trongcon igos; Anae mamaulegja trabia y ramasña, ya manjajagonja, intingoja na esta jijijot y tiempon maepe.
pairs.english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue anae inlie estesija, na manmato, tingoja na güiya esta jijijot, parejoja yan esta gaegue gui petta.
pairs.english: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Este na generasion ti ufanmalofan, asta que todo estesija munjayan manmachogüe.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet yan y tano, ufanmalofan, lao y sinanganjo ti ufalofan.
pairs.english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na jaane pat ayo na ora, taya ni un taotao tumungo; ni y angjet sija ni mangaegue gui langet, ni y Laje; na y Tata güiyaja.
pairs.english: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo: fanbela, ya infanmanaetae: sa ti intingo ngaean y tiempo.
pairs.english: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Say y Lajin taotao, parejoja yan un taotao ni y jumajanao chago ya jadingo y gumaña; ya janae y tentagoña ninasiñañija yan cada uno y chechoña, ya jatago y pottero na ufanbela.
pairs.english: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanbela, sa ti intingo ngaean nae ufato y magas y guima; cao y pupuenge, pat y tatalopuenge, pat y oogayo, pat y egaan;
pairs.english: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na, noseaja derepente ufato, ya infansineda manmamaego.
pairs.english: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa y jusangane jamyo, jusanganeja todos: Fanbela.
pairs.english: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJA dos na jaane antes di guipot y pascua yan y taelibadura na pan: ya y magas mamale sija, yan y escriba sija, maaliligao jaftaemano para umafababa, ya umacone, ya umapuno.
pairs.english: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegñija: Munga gui guipot na jaane, sa noseaja uguaja atboroto ni y taotao sija.
pairs.english: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 3 40740 ¶ Ya anae estaba guiya Betania, gui guima Simon y ategtog, ya matachong gui lamasa para uchocho; mato un palaoan mañuñule un alabastro na boteyan inggüenten puro nardo, na gosguaguan; ya mafag y boteya, ya jachuda gui jilo y ilon Jesus.
pairs.english: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja sija ninafanbubo sanjalomñija, ya ilegñija: Jafa este na inggüente na manalalastimaja?
pairs.english: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maulegña umabende pot tresientos peseta, ya ufanmanae y mamobble: ya malalatde y palaoan.
pairs.english: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña: Pologüe namaesa. Jafaja na inatbororota güe? Mauleg finatinasña nu guajo.
pairs.english: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manjajamyoja yan y mamobble siempre; ya ngaeanja nae manmalago jamyo, infatinasja mauleg guiya sija: lao guajo ti tafanjijitaja siempre.
pairs.english: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jafatinas taemanoja y ninasiñaña: güiya mato antes, para uinggüentiye y tataotaojo, para y naftan.
pairs.english: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Manoja este na ebangelio nae mapredica, gui todo y tano, este locue y finatinasña umasangan, para memoriasña.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 10 40810 ¶ Ya si Judas Iscariote, uno gui dose, mapos malag y magas mamale, para umentrega güe guiya sija.
pairs.english: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog, ninafansenmagof, ya mapromete manae güe salape. Ya jaaliligao jaftaemano para uinentrega.
pairs.english: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 12 40830 ¶ Ya y finenana na jaane y taelibadura na pan, anae maofrese y pascua, y disipuluña ilegñija nu güiya; Manojam malagomo guato ya infamauleg nae para unchocho gui pascua?
pairs.english: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y dos gui disipuluña, ya ilegña nu sija: Janao fanmalag y siuda, sa infanasoda güije yan un taotao na mangangatga un jarran janom: dalalag güe.
pairs.english: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya amanoja nae jumalom, alog ni y taotao guma: Y Maestro, ilegña: Mangue y aposento ni y anae para infañocho gui pascua yan y disipulujo?
pairs.english: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya infanfinanue un dangculo na cuatto; esta mafamauleg yan listo; ayo nae famauleg para jita.
pairs.english: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipuluña sija manmapos, ya manmato gui siuda, ya jasoda jaftaemano y mansinangane sija: ya mafamauleg para y pascua.
pairs.english: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 17 40880 ¶ Ya y pupuenge mato yan y dose.
pairs.english: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatatachong ya mañochocho, si Jesus ilegña: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Uno guiya jamyo umentregayo; güiyaja uchumocho yan guajo.
pairs.english: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ninafangostriste, ya ilegñija nu güiya uno yan otro: Guajo? y otro ilegña: Guajo?
pairs.english: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manope ilegña nu sija: Uno gui dose ni y jumajame manotche gui tason.
pairs.english: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Lajin taotao magajet na mapos, ni y esta matugue pot güiya: lao namaase ayo na taotao ni y jaentrega y Lajin taotao. Maulegña ayo na taotao na ti umafañago.
pairs.english: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 22 40930 ¶ Ya anae mañochocho, jachule si Jesus y pan, ya jabendise, ya jaipe, ya janae sija, ilegña: Chile ya incano, sa este y tataotaojo.
pairs.english: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y posuelo, ya anae munjayan janae grasia, janae sija: ya todos manguimen.
pairs.english: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Este y jâgâjo, gui nuebo na testamento, ni machuda pot y megae.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti juguimen talo ni y tinegcha ubas, asta ayo na jaane, na juguimen nuebo gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan macanta un himno, manmapos manmalag y finabeca Olibo.
pairs.english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 27 40980 ¶ Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Todos jamyo infaninefende pot guajo; sa esta matugue: Bae jupanag y pastot, ya y quinilo sija ufanmachalapon.
pairs.english: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao despues di lâlâyo talo, ya cumajuloyo, jujanao esta y menanmiyo guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Pedro ilegña: Achogja todos maninefende; lao guajo aje.
pairs.english: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sinangane as Jesus ilegña: Magajet jusanganejao na jago pagoja na puenge, antes qui uoo dos biaje y gayo, unpuneyo tres biaje.

pairs.english: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
