pairs.chamorro: Ya macone guato gui un lugat na y naanña Golgota: cumequeilegña, Sagan calabera.
pairs.english: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manae guimenña, bino manadaña yan mira, lao ti jaresibe.
pairs.english: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maatane güe gui quiluus, manafacae ni magaguña; ya manrifa jaye uchinile cada uno.
pairs.english: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina tres na ora, anae maatane güe gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tinigue y fumaaelagüe, matugue gui sanjilo. Y RAY JUDIOS.
pairs.english: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maatane dos na saque yan güiya: y uno gui agapaña, ya y otro gui acagüeña.
pairs.english: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya macumple y tinigue ni y ilegña: Güiya, usaouao matufong yan y manisao.)
pairs.english: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macacase todo ni y manmalolofan, ya jayeyengyong y ilonñija, ya ilegñija: Ay! jago ni y unyulang y templo, ya unjatsa talo gui mina tres na jaane;
pairs.english: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Satba maesajao, ya maela tunog papa güenao gui quiluus.
pairs.english: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue y magas mamale, manmanbotlelea gui entaloñija, ya ilegñija yan y escriba sija: Jasatba y palo, ya güiya na maesa ti siña güe jasatba.
pairs.english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Cristo y Ray Israel, polo ya utunog pago gui quiluus, para utafanlie, ya utafanjonggue güe. Yan ayo y mangachochongña manmaatane gui quiluus madespresia güe.
pairs.english: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 33 41760 ¶ Ya anae mato y mina saes na ora, jomjom todo y tano asta y mina nuebe na ora.
pairs.english: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina nuebe na ora, janagosagang si Jesus ilegña: Eli, Eli, lama sabactani? cumequeilegña: Yuusso, Yuusso, jafa muna undingoyo?
pairs.english: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manotojgue gui oriyaña, anae majungog güe, ilegñija: Estagüe na jaaagang si Elias.
pairs.english: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago uno, ya jasupog y espongja gui binagle, ya japolo gui puntan y piao, ya janae para uguimen, ya ilegña: Poloja güe namaesa; ya utafanlie cao ufato si Elias, ya uninatunog.
pairs.english: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus umagang goságang, ya jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y cottinan y templo, masisen dos pedaso, y sanjilo asta y sanpapa.
pairs.english: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y senturion ni y tumotojgue gui menaña, linie, na taegüenao jaentrega y espiritu, ilegña: Magajet na este na taotao Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue locue sija famalaoan, na maaatan gui chago, ya entre sija estaba si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago y patgon, yan si José, yan si Salome;
pairs.english: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae estaba güe guiya Galilea, madalalag güe, ya masetbe güe; yan megae sija na famalaoan mangachochongña julo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 42 41850 ¶ Ya anae estaba pupuenge, sa ayo na jaane y Preparasion, cumequeilegña y jaane antes di y sábado,
pairs.english: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si José, taotao Arimatea, mauleg na taotao na pápagat, ni y jananangga locue y raenon Yuus; ya mapos yan atrebe malag as Pilato, ya jagagao y tataotao Jesus.
pairs.english: Joseph of Arimathaea, and honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninamanman si Pilato, cao esta matae; ya jaagang y senturion, ya jafaesen cao esta matae algun tiempo.
pairs.english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo gui senturion; janae si José ni y tataotao.
pairs.english: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: tataotaoña sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan José, jalie amano nae mapolo.
pairs.english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae esta malofan y sabado, si Maria Magdalena, yan si Maria nanan Santiago, yan si Salome, manmamajan paopao, para ufato ya umapalalae güe.
pairs.english: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taftataf gui egaan, gui finenana na jaane gui semana, manmato gui naftan gui quinajulo y atdao.
pairs.english: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija entre sija: Jaye uninagalileg y acho gui pettan y naftan?
pairs.english: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maaatan, malie na esta managalileg y acho, sa gosdangculo.
pairs.english: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjalom gui naftan, malie un patgon na taotao, na matatachong gui agapa na banda, minagagon apaca na anaco; ya ninafangosmaañao.
pairs.english: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao: inaliligao si Jesus Nasareno, ni y maatane gui quiluus: esta cajulo; taegüe güine; liija y lugat anae mapopolo güe.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janao infanjanao, ya insangane y disipuluña, yan si Pedro: Güiya jumanao gui menanmiyo guiya Galilea; ayo nae inlie güe, ni y guinin mansinangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos juyong, ya manmalago gui naftan, sa jumuyong manlalaolao yan manmanman; ya ti ufanmanangane jafa ni y taotao; sa mangosmanmaañao.
pairs.english: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 9 41990 ¶ Lao anae cajulo si Jesus, taftataf gui egaan gui finenana na jaane gui semana, umalie finena, yan Maria Magdalena, ni y guinin janajuyong siete na anite.
pairs.english: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos güe, ya jasangane ayo y guinin mangachochongña, ni y mantriste, yan manatanges.
pairs.english: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija, anae jajungog na esta lâlâ ya umalie yan Mana, ti majonggue.
pairs.english: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmalofan estesija, manmalie talo yan dos, lao otro jechuraña; gui anae manjajanao gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos, ya manmasangane y palo disipulo: lao ti majonggue.
pairs.english: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 14 42040 ¶ Despues di ayo, manmalie yan y onse gui anae mañochocho, ya jalalatde ni y ti manjengguenñija, yan y majetog corasonñija, sa ti majonggue ayo sija y lumie güe despues di cumajulo.
pairs.english: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija; Janao fanmalag todo y tano, ya predica y ibangelio todo y ninajuyong sija.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y manjonggue ya matagpange, usatba; lao ayo y ti manjonggue; umasentensia.
pairs.english: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este sija na señat ufantinattitiye ayo sija y manmanjonggue: Pot y naanjo ujayute juyong y anite sija; ufanguentos ni y nuebo na finijo;
pairs.english: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ufanmangajat culebla sija, ya, yanguin manguimen jafa na beneno; ti uninafanlamen: ya ujapolo y canaeñija gui manmalango sija, ya ujanafanjomlo.
pairs.english: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 19 42090 ¶ Enao y Señot, despues di mansinangane sija, rinisibe ni y langet, ya matachong gui agapa Yuus.
pairs.english: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapos, ya mapredica y sinangan gui todo y lugat, mañisija manmachocho yan y Señot, ya manafitme y sinangan ni y umatitiye na señat. Amen.
pairs.english: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: POT y guaja megae y umapolo y canaeñija para ufannaregla y cuentos nu y ayo na güinaja na esta guefmaasegura gui entalo jame,
pairs.english: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja ninaejam ni guine y tutujoña y testigojam ni y malie, nu y yan y ministrojam y sinangan;
pairs.english: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jinasoco mauleg locue nu guajo, sa juguefegaga sinengcabales todo y güinaja guine y tutujonña, na jutuguie jao pot y inaregla, jago guesmagas na Teofilo;
pairs.english: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para untungo sija y magajet ayosija mano nae unresibe y finanagüe.
pairs.english: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 5 42150 ¶ Guaja gui jaanin Herodes, ray guiya Judea, un pale, naanña si Sacharias, y clasen Abias; y asaguaña guinin sija jagan Aaron ya y naaña si Elisabet.
pairs.english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na dos mauleg gui sanmenan Yuus, jajananao gui todo y lay yan y tinago Señot, ti lalatdiyon.
pairs.english: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya patgonñija; sa si Elisabet tifáfañago; yan y dos megae jaaniñija.
pairs.english: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 8 42180 ¶ Ya jumuyong, anae mañeñetbe si Sacharias, gui ofisio y pale gui menan Yuus, gui chechon y clasiña,
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemanoja y costumbren y ofisio y pale, y chechoña na jumalom gui guimayuus ya jasonggue y paopao.
pairs.english: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y linajyan taotao mangaegue gui sanjiyong manmananaetae gui oran paopao.
pairs.english: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guiya güiya y angjet y Señot, na gaegue gui agapa y attat y paopao.
pairs.english: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inestotba si Sacharias anae jalie, ya mato minaañao gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Sacharias, chamo maaañao; sa y tinaetaemo este majungog; ya y asaguamo as Elisabet ufañago y patgon laje, ya umafanaan naanña si Juan.
pairs.english: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uguaja jao minagof yan alegria; ya y megae umagof nu y mafañaguña.
pairs.english: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa udangculo güe gui menan Señot; ya ti uguimen bino ni metgot na guinem ya ubulagüe Espiritu Santo, guinin y tiyan nanaña.
pairs.english: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae gui famaguon Israel, ujabira nu y Señot, Yuusñija.
pairs.english: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao si José guinin Galilea, guinin un siuda na naanña Nasaret, para ufalag Judea, gui siudan David, na mafanaan Betlehem, sa güiya y guima y familian David;
pairs.english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ufanmatugue gui padron yan si Maria, asaguaña umacamo yan güiya, anae estaba dangculo sa mapotgue,
pairs.english: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, anae gaegue sija güije, y jaaniña ni para ufañago esta macumple;
pairs.english: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañago un laje finenana na patgon; ya mabalutan ni y pañales, ya manaason qui cajon sacate; sa taya sagañija gui guima.
pairs.english: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 8 42980 ¶ Ya guaja pastot sija güije na tano, na mañaga gui fangualuan, ya jaadadaje y manadan quinilo gui puenge.
pairs.english: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe y angjet y señot tumotojgue guiya sija; y minalag Yuus jaina gui oriyañija; ya guaja dangculo na minaañao.
pairs.english: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y angjet ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmaañao; sa, estagüe, na juchule para jamyo mauleg na sinangan dangculo na minagof, para todo y taotao:
pairs.english: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta mafañago para jamyo gui siudan David, pago na jaane, un Satbadot, na güiya si Cristo, y Señot.
pairs.english: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y señatmiyo: Inseda y patgon mabalutan ni y pañales, ya umaason gui cajon sacate.
pairs.english: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas anog yan y angjet y linajyan y sendalo gui langet, na manmantutuna as Yuus, ya ilegñija:
pairs.english: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Minalag gui y Gueftaquilo as Yuus, ya y tano pas gui entalo taotao ni y minagofña dangculo.
pairs.english: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumuyong anae y angjet sija manmamapos guiya sija para y langet, y pastot sija manasangane. uno yan otro: Nije tafanmalag pues, asta Betlehem, ya talie este na güinaja ni esta jumuyong, na si Yuus jafanuejit.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato chadeg, ya jasoda si Maria yan José, yan y diquique na patgon umaason gui cajon sacate.
pairs.english: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta malie, janatungo y sinangan na mansinangane sija nu y diquique na patgon.
pairs.english: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y manmanjungog, ninafanmanman pot y pastot sija, ni y sinanganñija.
pairs.english: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Maria jananana todo este sija na sinangan, jajasosoye gui corasonña.
pairs.english: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manato guato y pastot sija yan manmagof ya matuna si Yuus pot todo y güinaja ni munjayan jajungog yan jalie, jaftaemano y esta jasangane sija.
pairs.english: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 21 43110 ¶ Ya anae esta macumple y ocho na jaane, para umasirconsida güe mafanaan naanña si Jesus, taegüije y finanaan nu y angjet antes qui umamapotgueñaejon gui tiyan nanaña.
pairs.english: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta macumple y jaanin y guinasgas, jaftaemanoja y lay Moises, sija macone güe guiya Jerusalem para umanae gui Señot.
pairs.english: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Jaftaemanoja y matuque gui lay y Señot: todo laje na jababa y tiyan, umafanaan santos para y Señot);
pairs.english: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya para umanae inefrese jaftaemanoja y masangan y lay y Señot, un pares na tortola pat dos patgon na paluma.
pairs.english: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, guaja un taotao guiya Jerusalem, na naanña si Simeon, ya este na taotao, cabales ya guefmanjonggue na jananangga y quinensuela y Israel: ya y Espiritu Santo gaegue gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya esta mafanue güe nu y Espiritu Santo, na ti ulie finatae, antes na ulie Cristo, y Señot.
pairs.english: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato güe pot y Espiritu gui templo, ya anae machule, nu si tataña, y patgon Jesus gui templo para umafatinas pot guiya, taemanoja y costumbren y lay,
pairs.english: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae güiya jajogue gui canaeña ya jabendise si Yuus ya ilegña:
pairs.english: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago polo, Señot, y tentagomo ya jumanao yan pas, taemanoja y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jalie y matajo y satbasionmo,
pairs.english: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni esta unfamauleg gui menan todo y taotao;
pairs.english: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y candit para ufanmatungo y nasion sija, yan y minalag para y taotaomo, Israel.
pairs.english: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 33 43230 ¶ Ya si José yan y nanaña ninafanmanman nu ayo sija y jasasangan nu güiya;
pairs.english: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabendise si Simeon ya ilegña ni nanaña as Maria: Estagüe na patgon esta mapolo para pinedong yan para ufanjinatsa y megae guiya Israel; yan para y señat ni y ninachatsaga,
pairs.english: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan y jago locue, sa y antimo na umadotgan nu y espada, ya para jinasoñija y megae na corason nae umatungo.
pairs.english: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gaegue locue güije, si Ana y profeta palaoan, jagan Fanuel gui tribun Aser (na güiya guaja megae na jaaniña, yan sumaga yan y asaguaña siete años desde y binitgenña;
pairs.english: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Yuus, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este mato güijija na ora ya janae si Yuus maase, ya jacumuentuse pot güiya todo sija y manmannangga ni linibre guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae esta jacumple todo sija, taemanoja y gaegue gui lay y Señot, manalo guato Galilea gui siudañija guiya Nasaret.
pairs.english: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y patgon dumangculo yan ninamatatnga ya bulagüe tiningo: ya y grasian Yuus gaegue gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 41 43310 ¶ Ya manjajanao sija tataña todo y sacan asta Jerusalem gui guipot y pascua.
pairs.english: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae guaja esta dose na años, sija mangajulo guiya Jerusalem taemanoja y costumbren y guipot.
pairs.english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jocog y jaane sija, manalo sija, ya sumaga y patgon, Jesus, guiya Jerusalem taetiningo nu y tataña sija.
pairs.english: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jinasoñija na gaegue gui mangachongñija, ya un jaane na manjajanaoja; ya maaliligao güe gui entalo y parientesñija yan y manatungoñija.
pairs.english: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae ti masoda güe, manalo guato Jerusalem maaliligao güe.
pairs.english: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae esta malofan tres na jaane, inseda güe gui templo matatachong gui entalo y manfaye maecungog yan mafafaesen.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo sija y jumujungog ninafanmanman ni tiningoña yan y inepeña.
pairs.english: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie manmajngan ya ilegña nu güiya si nanaña: Patgon, jafa na unfatinasjam taeguenao? Estagüe si tatamo yan guajo na inaliligao jao yan y pinitinmame!
pairs.english: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu sija: Pot jafa yo na inaliligao? Ti intingo na y checho y tatajo nesesita yo na fatinas?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo ayo na sinangan y mansinangane.
pairs.english: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumunog yan sija ya manjanao. guato Nasaret ya mansinejeta sija. Ya si nanaña jaadaje este todo sija gui corasoña.
pairs.english: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus lumálamodong gui tiningoña yan y linecaña yan y grasia gui as Yuus yan y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mina quinse na año gui tiempo anae si Tiberio Sesat jagobietna, ya si Ponsio Pilato, güiya magalaje guiya Judea; ya si Herodes, güiya magalaje tetrarca guiya Galilea; ya y cheluña as Felipe, güiya magalaje tetrarca guiya Iturea yan y ya tanon Traconite; ya si Lisanias, güiya magalaje tetrarca guiya Abilinia;
pairs.english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: este na tiempo sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya mato gui todo y tano gui oriyan Jordan, jasesetmon y managpang en sinetsot para y maasiin isao.
pairs.english: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije esta matugue gui leblo ni y sinangan y profeta Isaias, na ilegña: Inagangña ni y umaagang gui jalomtano: Famauleg y chalan y Señot, y cayejonña natutunas.
pairs.english: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y finacañada umanafanbula, yan todo y tano boca yan y manloca na ogso umanafanagpapa; yan y manechong umanafanunas, yan y chalan farangca unamafanyano.
pairs.english: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y catne ulie y satbasion Yuus.
pairs.english: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña ni y linajyan taotao na manmato para ufanmatagpange pot güiya: Rasan culebla, jaye jamyo fumanagüe na insuaye y binibo ni y mamamaela?
pairs.english: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chile tinegchanmiyo ni y magajet na sinetsot, ya chamiyo insigue di sumasangan nu jamyoja: Guaja tatanmame si Abraham; sa jusanganejamyo na siña, si Yuus güine gui acho janafangajulo y famaguon Abraham.
pairs.english: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pagoja y gachae gaegueja gui jale y trongcon jayo sija: todo y trongcon jayo na ti mauleg tinegchañija, umautut ya umayute gui guafe.
pairs.english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linajyan taotao mafaesen güe ya ilegñija: Pues jafajam infatinas?
pairs.english: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope, ilegña nu sija: Y guaja dos magaguña, unae y taya iyoña: ya y guaja naña ufatinas taegüijija.
pairs.english: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato locue y publicano sija para ufanmatatagpange, ya ilegñija: Maestro jafa infatinasjam?
pairs.english: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo gumagagao mas ni y esta jamyo manmatago.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije cuarenta na jaane ya tinienta nu y anite. Ya ti chumocho ni jafa, güije sija na jaane; ya anae esta macumple, ñalang güe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya y anite: Yaguin jago Lajin Yuus, tago este y acho ya ufamapan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope qüe: Esta mamatugue, na ti y panja munalâlâ y taotao.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone güe quinene julo, ya finanue güe todo y raeno gui jilo y tano gui un momento y tiempo,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y anite ilegña nu güiya: Bae junae jao ni este na ninasiña todo, yan y minalagñija; sa guajo maentrega, ya jaye y malagojo, junae.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ya y canaeñija unquilile sa chamo matompo y adengmo gui acho.

pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña: Esta masangan: Chamo tietienta y Señot Yuusmo.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para jusaganñaejon y guaeyayon na año y Señot.

pairs.english: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya minamanman mato gui jilo todo sija, ya manadingan uno yan otro, ilegñija: Jafa na cuentos este? Sa nu y gobietnaña yan y ninasiñaña jatago y áplacha na anite sija ya unfanjuyong?
pairs.english: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y famaña masanganñaejon todo y lugat sija gui oriyaña ayona.
pairs.english: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 38 44180 ¶ Ya jacajulo jumanao juyong gui guimayuus ya jumalom gui guiman Simon; ya y suegran Simon esta umaason, malingo nu y dangculo na calenturaña; ya matayuyutgüe pot güiya.
pairs.english: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatojgue gui jijutña, ya jalalatde y calentura ya y calentura pinelo; ya güiya cajulo ensiguidas ya jasetbe.
pairs.english: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 40 44200 ¶ Ya y tiempo y minachom y atdao nae, todo y mangaemalango ni y megae na chetnot, manmaconie guiya güiya; ya japolo y canaeña gui jilo cada uno guiya sija, ya janafanjomlo sija.
pairs.english: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anite sija manjuyong locue guiya megae, na manaagang ya ilegñija: Jago, y Lajin Yuus! Lao güiya jalalatde ya ti japolo ya ufanguentos, sa matungo güe na güiya si Cristo.
pairs.english: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 42 44220 ¶ Ya anae esta taftaf y jaane, jumanao para un jalomtano: ya y linajyan taotao sija maaliligao güe ya manmafato guiya güiya ya manmalago sija ufanmantiene güe para munga mapos guiya sija.
pairs.english: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Nesesitayo locue gui palo siuda umapredica y raenon Yuus: sa para este na matagoyo.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japredidica gui guimayuus sija guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede anae y linajyan taotao manoriya yan machichiguet güe ya jaecungog y sinangan Yuus, na güiya gaegue tumotojgue gui oriyan jagoe Genesaret.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie dos batco na estaba jijot gui oriyan y jagoe; ya y manpescadot manunog güije, ya jafagase y laguañija.
pairs.english: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom güine gui un batco ya y iyon Simon; ya jagagao na unafalag y tano didide. Ya matachong ya mamanagüe desde y batco ni linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan cumuentos, ilegña as Simon: Juyong gui tadong na tase ya innatunog y laguanmiyo para un quinene.
pairs.english: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Simon ya ilegña: Maestro estajam manmachocho todo puenge ya taya quinenemame; lao pot y sinanganmo bae innatunog y lagua.
pairs.english: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatinas este, japongle un dangculo na quinenen güijan; ya esta tiniteg y laguanñija.
pairs.english: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jaseñat y mangachongñija ni mangaegue gui otro batco, para ufanmato ya ufaninayuda. Ya manmato, ya janabulaja y dos batco, ya jatutujon manmañoñogñog.
pairs.english: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie este si Simon Pedro, dumimo papa gui as Jesus ya ilegña: Suja guiya guajo, Señot; sa taotao isaoyo.
pairs.english: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ninamaañao yan todos y mangaegue guiya güiya, pot causa de y quinenen güijan ni y inquene;
pairs.english: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije ja locue as Santiago yan si Juan, famaguon Sebedeo, ya sija mangachong Simon. Ya ilegña si Jesus as Simon: Chamo maaaño: sa desde pago ufangone jao y taotao.
pairs.english: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta mañule gui tano y batcoñija; todo jayute ya madalaggüe.
pairs.english: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 12 44360 ¶ Ya susede anae gaegue güe gui uno gui siuda sija, estagüe un taotao na bula ategtog: güiya anae jalie si Jesus, podong gui mataña gui menaña ya jagagao, ilegña: Señot, yaguin malagojao, siñajao unnagasgasyo?
pairs.english: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaestira y canaeña ya japacha, ilegña: Malagoyo, gasgasjao; ya enseguidas y ategtog jumanao guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinago güe, na chaña sangangane ni jaye: lao janao, unfanue y pale nu jago ya unofrese ni y guinasgasmo, taemanoja y tinagon Moises para testimonio nu sija.
pairs.english: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y masanganña jumanao megae; ya mandaña y dangculon linajyan taotao para umajungog yan para ufanmagong y chetnotñija.
pairs.english: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jaapatta güe asta y jalomtano ya manaetae.
pairs.english: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 17 44410 ¶ Ya susede gui un jaane na estabagüe mamanagüe; ya mangaegue y Fariseo sija yan y magas y lay, manmatatachong, sa sija manmato guinen y sengsong Galilea, yan Judea, yan y ya Jerusalem; ya y ninasiñan y Señot gaegue güije para unamagong.
pairs.english: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe sija taotao na macocone un taotao gui jilo un cama na paralitico; ya maaliligao mano nae mañule jalom para umapolo gui menaña.
pairs.english: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti masoda mano nae umapolo pot causa y linajyan taotao, mangajulo gui jilo guma ya guinin y atof nae manatunog yan camaña gui entalo, asta y gui menan Jesus.
pairs.english: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y jinengguenñija yuje sija, ilegña: Taotao, y isaomo umaasie.
pairs.english: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba yan y Fariseo sija jatutujon manmanjaso, ya ilegñija: Jaye güe este na usangan chatfino contra si Yuus? Jaye siña manasie isao, na si Yuusja?
pairs.english: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus jatungo y jinasonñija; manope ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa injajaso gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa sen taeminapot masangan: Y isaomo unmaasie; pat masangan: Cajulo ya unfanmocat?
pairs.english: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao para intingoja na y Lajin taotao guaja ninasiñaña gui tano para umasie isao (ilegña nu y paralitico), jusanganejao: Cajulo, chule y camamo ya unjanao para iyajamyo.
pairs.english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas güiya cajulo gui menanñija, ya jachule ayo anae umaasongüe ya jumanao para y guimaña, ya jatuna si Yuus,
pairs.english: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmanman todosija, ya matuna si Yuus; ya manbula y minaañao, ilegñija: Inlie námanman sija pago.
pairs.english: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 27 44510 ¶ Ya despues di estesija, jumanao, ya jalie un publicano na y naanña si Levi, matatachong gui bancon y tributo ya ilegña: Dalalagyo.
pairs.english: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo todo y güinajaña ya cajulo ya jadalalaggüe.
pairs.english: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas si Levi un dangculon gupot gui guimaña: ya guaja un dangculon linajyan publicano sija, yan otro sija manmatachong gui lamasa yan sija.
pairs.english: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija yan y escribañija, mangogonggong contra y disipuluña sija, ilegñija: Sajafa na manjajamyo mañocho yan manguimen yan y publicanosija yan y manisao?
pairs.english: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Y manaechetnot ti janesesita medico; lao y manmalango.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti matoyo para juagang y manunas, lao y manisao para ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 33 44570 ¶ Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Y disipulon Juan manayuyunat megae na biaje, ya jafatitinas tinayuyut; parejoja yan y disipulon Fariseo sija; ya iyoco mañochocho yan manguiguimen?
pairs.english: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Siña innaayunat y mangaegue gui guipot uma sagua anae mañisijaja yan y nobio?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ufato jaane na y nobio umana suja; ayo nae ufanayunat güije na jaane sija.
pairs.english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane sija locue un acomparasion: Taya taotao janajanao pidason magago gui nuebo na bestido ya japolo gui bijo na bestido; no sea ujatiteg y nuebo ya locue y magago guinin nuebo ti parejo yan y bijo.
pairs.english: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya mananaye nuebo na bino gui bijo na boteyan cuero: ya no sea, y bino ni nuebo uyinamag y boteyan cuero, ya y bino umachuda, ya y boteyan cuero ufalingo.
pairs.english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y nuebo bino na nasesita y nuebo na boteyan cuero nae umapolo.
pairs.english: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ni un taotao ni gumimen y bijo na bino umalago ni nuebo; sa ualog: Y bijo maulegña.
pairs.english: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede y un sabado, jumajanao si Jesus gui fangualuan maies; ya y disipuluña sija, manmanjajala ni y masotcan maies, ya jacano, jagugugan ni y canaeñija.
pairs.english: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Fariseo sija ilegñija: Jafa na infatitinas y ti tunas na umafatinas gui sabado na jaane:
pairs.english: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus iligña: Taya nae intaetae este y finatinas David anae ñalang yan y mangachongña?
pairs.english: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jumalom gui guimayuus, ya jachule ya jacano y pan ni y mafamamauleg, yan janae locue y mangachongña: ni y ti tunas na ucano na para y mamaleja?
pairs.english: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Y Lajin Taotao locue Señot y sabado.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 6 44690 ¶ Ya susede y otro sabado, na jumalom gui guimayuus ya mamanagüe: ya estaba güije un taotao na anglo y agapa na canaeña.
pairs.english: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y escriba yan y Fariseo sija maaatan güe, cao unajomlo gui sabado na jaane; para uquefanmañoda jafa ya umafaaela.
pairs.english: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jatungoja y jinasonñija; ya ilegña ni ayo na taotao y anglo canaeña: Cajulo ya untojgue gui tálolo! ya tumojgue julo.
pairs.english: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Jufafaesen jamyo uno. Tunas gui sabado na umafatinas y mauleg pat y taelaye? numalibre linâlâ pat mamuno?
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatan todos y oriyañija ya ilegña nu güiya: Estira mona y canaemo. Ya guiya jafatinas taegüije, ya y canaeña numalo ya magong taegüije y otro.
pairs.english: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija mansénbubo, ya manguecuentos uno yan otro, jafa mojon ujafatinas gui as Jesus.
pairs.english: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 12 44750 ¶ Ya susede gui ayo sija na jaane, jumanao para ufanaetae gui un ogso ya todo y puenge jasigue di manaetaeja para as Yuus.
pairs.english: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, jaagang y disipuluña sija; ya jaayig dose guiya sija, ni manmafanaan locue apostoles.
pairs.english: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon ni jafanaan locue Pedro, yan si Andres cheluña, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan, si Felipe, yan si Bartolome,
pairs.english: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Mateo, yan si Tomas, yan si Santiago, lajin Alfeo, yan si Simon ni mafanaan Selote,
pairs.english: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
