pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Judas chelun Santiago, yan si Judas Iscariote ni y traidot;
pairs.english: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manunog yan sija ya tumojgue gui un lugat ni yano; yan y dangculon linajyan disipuluña sija, yan y dangculon linajyan taotao, guinin todo yya Judea, yan yya Jerusalem, yan y tano Tiro yan yya Sidon, ni manmato para umaecungog, yan para uninafanmagong y chetnotñija;
pairs.english: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan manafanmagong ayo sija y munafanachatsaga ni y espiritun áplacha.
pairs.english: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago pumapacha güe y linajyan taotao: sa manjujuyong guiya güiya ninasiña ya janafanmamagong todo sija.
pairs.english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 20 44830 ¶ Ya güiya manatan julo gui disipuluña, ya ilegña: Mandichoso jamyo ni mamobble; sa iyonmiyo y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo ni y manñalang pago: sa ufanjaspog. Mandichoso y manatanges: sa ufañaleg.
pairs.english: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso jamyo yaguin y taotao sija infanchinatlie, yan ujaapatta sija guiya jamyo ya ujalalatde jamyo ya ujayute juyong y naanmiyo pot taelaye pot causa y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fansenmagof güije na jaane; yan infanayog ni minagofmiyo: sa, estagüe, y premionmiyo dangculo gui langet; sa taegüenaoja jafatitinas y tatañija ni y profeta sija.
pairs.english: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ay jamyo ni manrico! sa esta guaja consuelonmiyo.
pairs.english: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay jamyo ni esta manjaspog pago! sa infanñalang. Ay jamyo ni mañachaleg pago! sa jamyo infanugong yan infananges.
pairs.english: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay jamyo yaguin todo y taotao sija manguecuentos mauleg nu jamyo! sa taegüenaoja ujafatinas y tatañija ni y manfatso na profeta.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 27 44900 ¶ Lao jusangangane jamyo ni jumujungog: Güaeya y enemigonmiyo; fatinas mauleg ni y chumatlie jamyo,
pairs.english: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bendise y mumatdise jamyo, ya infanmanaetae pot y namamajlao jamyo.
pairs.english: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pumatmada y un banda fasumo, naeja locue ni y otro, ya y chumule y capamo, chamo chumochoma na uchule y chininamo locue.
pairs.english: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cada uno ni y gumagaojao, nae; ya y chumule y güinajamo, chamo tumalulugua gumagao.
pairs.english: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa y malagomiyo ni y taotao jafatinas nu jamyo; taegüijija fatinas locue nu sija:
pairs.english: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin inguaeya y gumaeya jamyo, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo? sa y manisao locue jaguaeya y gumaeya sija.
pairs.english: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin infatinas mauleg ni y fumamamauleg jamyo, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo? sa y manisao locue jafatitinasja taegüenao.
pairs.english: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin innaayao na ayo sija ni y guaja ninanggamo para infanresibe, jafa na grasia guajanmiyo: sa y manisao janaayao y manisao para ufanmanresibe taegüije talo.
pairs.english: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaeya jamyo y enimigunmiyo ya infatinas mauleg nu sija: ya innaaayao, ya chamiyo fantataeninangga, ya udangculo y premionmiyo yan infanfamaguon y Gueftaguilo: sa güiya cariñoso nu y ingrato sija, yan y taelaye.
pairs.english: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo locue fanyóase, taegüije y tatanmiyo ni y gaegue gui langet yóase.
pairs.english: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo jumusga, sa ti infanjinisga: chamiyo sumetetensia, sa ti infansinentensia: nafanlibre, ya y ninafanlibre:
pairs.english: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmanae, ya infanmanae; mauleg na medida y majoño papa, ya umachaochao ya umachúchuda, ufanmannae y taotao sija gui jalom pechonmiyo; sa ayoja na medida y anae manmide jamyo: infanmamediye talo jamyo.
pairs.english: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 39 45020 ¶ Ya jasangane sija un acomparasion ilegña: Siña y bachet jaosgaejon y otro bachet? ti ujaachapodong y dos gui joyo?
pairs.english: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo ti taquiloña qui y maestro: lao cada uno ni y cabales, güiya utaegüijija y maestroña.
pairs.english: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa muna unlilie y migo gui atadog y chelumo; ya ti unlilie y jayo gui atadogmo?
pairs.english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa muna siña unalog ni y chelumo: Chelujo, maela ya junajanao y migo gui atadogmo, yanguin jago ti unlilie y jayo gui atadogmo? Hipocrita jao, yute juyong finena y jayo gui atadogmo, ya ayo nae unlie claro para unnajanao y migo gui atadog y chelumo.
pairs.english: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya mauleg na trongco, ni y fanogcha taelaye, ni y taelaye na trongco ni y fanogcha mauleg.
pairs.english: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa cada trongco matungoja pot y tinegchaña. Sa ti ufanmanrecoje y taotao sija igos gui manituca ni ufanmanrecoje ubas gui jalom gadon.
pairs.english: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mauleg na taotao, ni y mauleg na guinaja gui corasonña, mañuñule mauleg; ya y taelaye na taotao, ni y taelaye na güinaja gui corasonña, mañuñule taelaye: sa y minegae y corason jasasangan y pachotña.
pairs.english: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 46 45090 ¶ Ya jafa na infananaanyo Señot, Señot, ya ti infatitinas y jusangangane jamyo?
pairs.english: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye y mato guiya guajo ya jaecungog y sinanganjo ya jafatinas; jufanue jaye parejuña:
pairs.english: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan un taotao ni y manjatsa guma, ya jaguadog tadong ya japolo y simiento gui jilo y fitme na acho; ya yanguin cajulo y manadan janom, ya milag y sadog chineneg ayo na guma; lao ti umayengyong, sa maplanta gui jilo y acho.
pairs.english: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y umeecungog ya ti jafatinas; parejo yan y taotao ni y manjatsa guma gui jilo oda ya ti janaye simiento; ya anae milag y sadog ya chineneg, enseguidas upodong; ya dangculo y yinilang ayo na guma.
pairs.english: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di munjayan todo y finanagüeña si Jesucristo gui talangan taotao sija, güiya jumalom guiya Capernaum.
pairs.english: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tentago un senturion ni y guefyaña, estaba malango, ya esta para umatae.
pairs.english: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae y senturion jajungog na masasangan si Jesus, jatago y manamco na Judios, para umagagao na ufato ya unajomlo y tentagoña.
pairs.english: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato as Jesus, guefmagagao ilegñija: Dignogüe na unfatinas este pot güiya:
pairs.english: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jagüaeya y nasionmame ya japlantaye jam sinagoganmame.
pairs.english: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao yan si Jesus. Ya anae esta manjijot gui guima y senturion jatago y amiguña sija para ualog as Jesus: Señot chamo ninachachatsaga; sa ti dignoyo na junajalom jao gui papa atofjo;
pairs.english: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ti jujaso na dignoyo na jufato guiya jago; lao sanganja ya ujomlo y tentagojo.
pairs.english: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo locue na taotao gaegeuyo gui papa y ninasiña, ya guaja gui papajo sendalo sija; yan ileco nu este: Janao, ya mapos; ya y otro: Maela, ya mato; ya y tentagojo: Fatinas este, ya jafatinas.
pairs.english: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus este, ninamanman nu güiya, ya jabiragüe ilegña ni y linajyan taotao ni y dumalalag güe: Jusangane jamyo na ti jusoda taegüije na dinangculon jinenggue ni iya Israel.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manalo sija guato gui guima y manmanago, jasoda na jomlo y tentago ni estaba malango.
pairs.english: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 11 45230 ¶ Ya susede un rato despues di este na, si Jesus jumanao asta un siuda ni mafanaan Nain; ya mañisija yan y disipuluña yan y dangculon manadan taotao.
pairs.english: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta jijot gui pettan y siuda, estagüe na macocone un matae, güiyaja lajin nanaña, ya biuda locue, ya linajyan taotao siuda mangachongchongña.
pairs.english: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae linie ni y Señot ninamaase nu güiya, ya ilegña nu güiya: Chamo cumacasao.
pairs.english: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lumatguato ya japacha y andas; ya y chumuchule mañaga. Ya ilegña: Patgon, guajo jao sumangane, cajulo.
pairs.english: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y estaba matae matachong ya jatutujon cumuentos, ya inentrega as Jesus gui as nanaña.
pairs.english: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmaaañao todosija, ya maalaba si Yuus ilegñija: Dangculo na profeta esta cajulo entre yya jita: ya, si Yuus jagas jabisita taotaoña.
pairs.english: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao este na famaña gui todo yya Judea yan todo oriya y tano.
pairs.english: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 18 45300 ¶ Ya y disipulon Juan masangane güe todo estesija.
pairs.english: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang si Juan dos gui disipuluña ya jatago para as Jesus, ilegña: Cao jago yuje y para ufato pat infanmannangga jam otro?
pairs.english: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato y taotao sija guiya güiya, ilegñija: Si Juan Bautista tumagojam para yya jago, ilegña: Cao jago yuje y para ufato pat infanmannangga jam otro?
pairs.english: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo mismo na ora, janafanjomlo megae ni y manmalango yan y mangaechetnotsija yan espiritun manaelaye; yan megae na manbachet ninafanmanlie.
pairs.english: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maninepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Janao yan sangane si Juan ni y liniimiyo yan y jiningogmiyo; sa y manbachet manmanlie, ya y mangojo manmamocat, ya y manategtog mangasgas, ya y mananga manmanjungog, y manmatae manafangajulo, ya umapredica y ibangelio gui mamobble.
pairs.english: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dichoso ayo y ti sumosoda y lugat para umatompo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 24 45360 ¶ Ya anae manmapos y mantinago as Juan, jatutujon cumuentuse y taotao sija pot si Juan: Jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie gui desierto? un piao ni y yinengyong ni y manglo?
pairs.english: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jafa injanagüe jamyo para inlie? un taotao na puru suabe magaguña? Estagüe, ayo sija y manminagagago ni y malagno magago yan manlalâlâ gui guinatbo, gui palasyon y ray nae mañasaga.
pairs.english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jafa injanagüe para inlie? un profeta? magajet, jusangane jamyo na mas que un profeta.
pairs.english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este yuje y esta matugue: Estagüe na jatago y tentagojo gui menan matamo, ni para ufamauleg y chalanmo gui menamo.
pairs.english: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na entre ayo sija y manmafañago gui famalaoan, taya dangculoña qui si Juan; lao y diquiqueja gui raenon Yuus dangculoña qui güiya.
pairs.english: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao anae majungog güe, yan y publicano sija, jajustifica si Yuus ya manmatagpange ni y tinagpangen Juan.
pairs.english: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo yan y manmagas y lay, jarechasa y consejon Yuus contra sijaja; sa ti manmatagpange pot güiya.
pairs.english: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manparejo yan y famaguon ni manmatatachong gui plasa ya manaagang uno yan otro ya ilegñija: Indadane jamyo flauta, y ti manbaela jamyo, manuugonge jamyo, ya ti manatanges jamyo.
pairs.english: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mato si Juan Bautista ni uchocho pan ni uguimen bino, ya ilelegmiyo: Guaja anitiña.
pairs.english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato y Lajin taotao, ya chumocho yan gumimen, ya ilelegmiyo: Estagüe, un taotao na gachumocho yan gagumimen bino, yan amigon y publicano sija, yan y manisao.
pairs.english: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tiningo manacabales ni y todo famaguonña.
pairs.english: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 36 45480 ¶ Ya malago uno gui Fariseo sija na ufañija mañocho. Ya jumalom gui guima y Fariseo ya matachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un palaoan gui siuda, na miisao, ya anae jatungo na gaegue si Jesus matatachong gui lamasa gui guima y Fariseo, mañule un boteyan alabastro na ingüente.
pairs.english: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumojgue gui taten Jesus, ya cumasao; ya jatutujon munafotgon ni lagoña y adeng Jesus, ya jasaosao ni y gapuniluña; ya jachichico y adengña ya japapalae ni y inggüente.
pairs.english: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie este y Fariseo ni y umagange güe, cumuentos gui sumanjalomña, ilelegña: Este na taotao yaguin profeta güe, jatungo jafa este na palaoan y pumapacha güe sa güiya miisao.
pairs.english: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Simon, guaja para jasangane jao. Ya güiya ilegña: Sangan Maestro.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un taotao guaja dos dumídibe: ya y uno mandidibe quinientos monedan denario, ya y otro sincuenta.
pairs.english: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae taya apasñija, inasie todo y dos. Enao mina, jaye guiya sija mas güinaeya?
pairs.english: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Simon, ya ilegña: Y pineloco na ayo y mas maasie; ya güiya ilegña: Tunas jinisgamo.
pairs.english: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabira güe guato gui palaoan, ya ilegña as Simon: Unlilie este na palaoan? Jumalomyo gui guimamo, ti unnaeyo janom para y adengjo; lao este janafotgon y adengjo ni lagoña, ya jasaosao ni y gapuniluña.
pairs.english: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago ti unnaeyo un chico: lao este na palaoan desde que jumalomyo ti pumapara jachico y adengjo.
pairs.english: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti unpalae y ilujo ni laña, lao este japalae y adengjom inggüente.
pairs.english: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina jusangane jao, na y isaoña, ni y megae, umaasie; sa güiya megae maguaeyaña; lao y didide maasiiña, didide maguaeyaña.
pairs.english: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Y isaomo maasie.
pairs.english: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mangachochongña manmatachong gui lamasa, jatutujon sumangan gui sumanjalomñija: Jaye este na ufanasie locue isao?
pairs.english: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni palaoan: Y jinengguemo unsinatba; janao yan pas.
pairs.english: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede un rato despues na jajanaogüe y siuda sija yan y sengsong sija manpredidica, yan numanafanungo nu y ibangelion y raenon Yuus; ya mañisija yan y dose,
pairs.english: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo sija famalaoan ni guinin nanafanmagong ni manaelayen espiritu yan y chetnot sija; si Maria ni mafanaan magdalena ni jumuyong guiya güiya siete na manganite,
pairs.english: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Juana, asaguan Chusa, mayetdomon Herodes; yan si Susana yan megae ni pumalo ni jasesetbe ni güinajañija:
pairs.english: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 4 45660 ¶ Ya anae mandaña y dangculon linajyan taotao, yan y manestaba cada siuda manmato guiya güiya, jacuentuse pot un acomparasion.
pairs.english: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tátanom jumanao para ufananom y semiyaña; ya anae manmananom, palo podong gui oriyan chalan; ya todo magacha, ya manmato sija y pajaro gui langet ya macano.
pairs.english: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui jilo acho; ya anae lachog, ninamalayo sa ti fofotgon.
pairs.english: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui jalom tituca; ya mandoco mañija y tituca, ya chiniguit.
pairs.english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan palo mamodong gui mauleg y tano; ya mandoco, ya manogcha siento pot uno. Ya anae esta jasangan estesija umagang: Y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, uecungog.
pairs.english: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 9 45710 ¶ Ya y disipuluña sija mafaesen güe: Jafa este na acomparasion?
pairs.english: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guiya ilegña: Esta manmannae jamyo para intingo y misterion y raenon Yuus lao y pumalo pot acomparasion; para ujaaatanja ya ti ujalie, yan ujaecungogja ya ti ujatungo.
pairs.english: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues este ayo na acomparasion: Y semiya y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gui oriyan chalan ayo sija y jagas jumungog; ya despues mato y manganite ya janasuja y sinangan gui corasonñija sa ti mojon ufanmanjonggue ya ufanmasatba.
pairs.english: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jilo acho, ayo sija y anae jajungog, jaresibe y sinangan nu y minagof; lao estesija manaejale; sa jajonggue un ratoja, lao anae mato tentasion mamodong.
pairs.english: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pedong gui jalom tituca, este sija y jumungog; ya mientras jumanao gui chalanñija, manchiniguit ni inadajeñiñija, yan y güinaja, yan y minagof tano gui este linâlâ, ya ti jumuyong tinegchañija cabales.
pairs.english: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y mangaegue gui mauleg na tano, este sija na guinin jumungog y sinangan gui corason ni mauleg yan tunas, jamantietiene, ya manogcha yan manpasensia.
pairs.english: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 16 45780 ¶ Ni uno ni mañoñonggue candet, utampe nu y batde pat upolo gui papa catre, lao upolo gui jilo lamasa para y jumajalom ulie y manana.
pairs.english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya manaatog ya ti umafatanñaejon; ni gae gui secreto ya ti umatungo, ujuyong gui manana.
pairs.english: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guesadaje jaftaemano y jiningogmiyo: sa masquesea jaye y guaja, umanae; lao masquesea jaye y taya, unajanao ayo y pineloña na uguaja.
pairs.english: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 19 45810 ¶ Ayonae manmato guiya güiya si nanaña yan y mañeluña, lao tisiña manlatguato guiya güiya pot y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane, ilegñija nu güiya: Si nanamo yan y mañelumo manmatotojgue gui sanjiyong na manmalago na unmalie.
pairs.english: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ya ilegña nu sija: Y nanajo yan y mañelujo, ayosija y jumungog y sinangan Yuus ya jafatinas.
pairs.english: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 22 45840 ¶ Ya susede y uno gui ayosija jaane nae, na jumalom gui un batco, güiya yan y disipoluña sija; ya ilegña nu sija: Nije tafanjanao y otro banda jagoe; ya manjanao.
pairs.english: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mumamayama sija, güiya maego; ya manguaefe un dangculon, pagyo y manglo gui jagoe; ya bula y batco janom ya mangaegue sija gui peligro.
pairs.english: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato guiya güiya, ya mapangon, ilegñija: Maestro, maestro, tafanmalingo. Ya magmata, ya jalalatde y manglo yan y chaochao y janom; ya pumara, ya jumuyong malinao.
pairs.english: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Mano nae gaegue jinengguenmiyo? Ya sija manmaañao ya ninafanmanman, ilegñija uno yan otro: Jaye este, na asta y manglo yan y janom jatago ya maoosgueja?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 26 45880 ¶ Ya manmato asta, y tano y taotao Gadara sija, ni gaegue gui sanmenan y Galilea.
pairs.english: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumanao para y tano, umasoda yan un taotao gui jiyong y siuda na gaemanganite; ya apmam na tiempo ti minagagago ni usaga gui guima, na y naftanja.
pairs.english: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus, umagang, ya jatombagüe gui menaña ya ilegña ni dangculo na inagang: Para jafayo nu jago Jesus, Lajin Yuus Gueftaquilo? Jusuplica jao na chamoyo sumasapet.
pairs.english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatago y espiritun áplacha na ufanjanao gui taotao; sa apmam na tiempo na maguot güe: mamantiene güe preso ya magode nu y cadena yan tale sija; ya jayamag y guinede ya quinene ni y manganite asta y desierto sija.
pairs.english: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya finaesen as Jesus: Jaye naanmo? Ya güiya ilegña: Linajyan; sa megae na manganite manjalom guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masuplica güe na chaña tumatago na ufanjanao para y tadong na joyo.
pairs.english: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije un inetnon babue na lajyan na mañochocho gui jalom tano: ya masuplica güe na ufanpinelo ya ufanjalom güije sija. Ya manpinelo.
pairs.english: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong y manganite gui taotao, manjalom gui babue ya y inetnon manmanunugo sajyao guato gui un didog gui jagoe ya manmatmos.
pairs.english: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija munafañochocho y babue anae jalie y mafatinas, manmapos ya jasangane y taotao siuda yan gui fangualuan.
pairs.english: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao para ujalie y mafatinas; ya manmato gui as Jesus; ya masoda y taotao ni anae guinin jumuyong y manganite, na minagagago ya guaja jinasoña cabales, ya matatachong gui adeng Jesus; ya ninafanmaañao.
pairs.english: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane ni lumie, jafa taemano manamagongña ayo y guinin jinatme manganite.
pairs.english: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 37 45990 ¶ Ayonae todo y taotao gui tano y Gadarenos yan todo y oriyan, magagao na ujanao guiya sija; sa mansenmaañao; ya güiya cajulo gui batco ya tumalo tate.
pairs.english: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na taotao anae guinun manjuyong y manganite, siniplica güe para usaga guiya güiya; lao janajanao ya ilegña:
pairs.english: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Talo guato guiya jamyo ya unfañangane jaftaemano na dangculon güinaja finatinasña si Yuus nu jago. Ya guiña jumanao, ya jasanganñaejon todo gui siuda jaftaemano finatinasña si Jesus nu güiya.
pairs.english: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 40 46020 ¶ Ya anae tumalo guato si Jesus maresibe ni y linajyan taotao sija ya mangosmagof; sa todoja numananggaja.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un taotao na y naanña si Jairo, ya güiya locue magas y sinagoga; mato ya jatombagüe papa gui adeng Jesus, ya jagagao na ujalom gui guimaña.
pairs.english: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guaja unoja jagaña na esta guaja dose años, ya estaba jijot na umatae. Ya anae jumanao maapupura güe ni linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 43 46050 ¶ Ya un palaoan na numanajuyong jâgâ esta dose años, esta jalachae gumasta todo y güinajaña ni jaapaseñaejon medico, lao taya siña munamagong,
pairs.english: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato gui tateña ya japacha y madoblan magaguña, ya enseguidas esta bumasta y jâgâña.
pairs.english: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Jesus ilegña: Jayeyo pumacha? Lao anae todos japune ilegña si Pedro yan y mangachongña: Maestro, y linajyan taotao umanoriya jao yan machichiguit jao,
pairs.english: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus ilegña: Guajayo pumacha; sa guajo jutungo na guaja ninasiña jumuyong guiya guajo.
pairs.english: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y palaoan anae jalie na ti siña janaatog, mato ya manlalaolao, ya jatombagüe gui menaña, ya jasangan gui menan y taotao sija todos, pot jafa na japacha, yan jaftaemano na ninajomlo enseguidas.
pairs.english: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him and how she was healed immediately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Hija, y jinengguemo unninajomlo; janao ya upas.
pairs.english: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 49 46110 ¶ Ya mientras cumuecuentos, mato uno ni taotao y magas y sinagoga ya ilegña: Y jagamo matae, chamo umestototba y Maestro.
pairs.english: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Jesus manopegüe: Chamo maaañao; jonggueja sa güiya ujomlo.
pairs.english: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guima, taya japolo na ujalom yan güiya na si Pedro, si Juan, yan si Santiago, yan y tatan y patgon, yan y nanaña.
pairs.english: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todos mangacasao, yan malamementagüe; lao ilegña: Chamiyo fangacasao; sa ti matae, lao mamaego.
pairs.english: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macháchatgue güe, sa matungoja na esta matae.
pairs.english: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jamantiene y canaeña ya jaagang ilegña: Patgon palaoan, cajulo.
pairs.english: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato y espirituña talo, ya enseguidas cajulo; ya manago na umanachocho.
pairs.english: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmanman y mañaenaña: lao jaencatga na chañija sumangangane ni un taotao jafa y mafatinas.
pairs.english: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA jaagang ya mandaña y dose disipuluña ya janae ninasiña gui jilo y manganite todo, yan para ufanmanamte nu y chetnot sija.
pairs.english: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago na ujapredica y raenon Yuus, yan unafanjomlo y manmalango.
pairs.english: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmañuñule ni jafa para y chalan, ni baston, ni botsa, ni pan, ni salape; ni infangaemagago dos.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cuatquiera na guma nae manjalom jamyo, fañaga güije asta que manjanao jamyo.
pairs.english: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo sija y ti rumesibe jamyo, anae manjanao jamyo güije na siuda, sacude y petbos gui adengmiyo para testimonio contra sija.
pairs.english: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao sija, ya manmalofan sija gui sengsong, mapredidica y ibangelio, yan mannanajomlo gui todo y lugat.
pairs.english: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Herodes tetrarca jajungog masangan este sija na finatinas, ya estaba guefinestotba ni y sinañgan palo na si Juan esta cumajulo guinin manmatae.
pairs.english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y pumalo ilegñija: Si Elias jumuyong talo; ya otros umalog; na uno gui manamco na profeta lâlâ talo.
pairs.english: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Herodes: Si Juan guajo dumegüeya; ya jaye este nae jujungog sija na güinaja? Ya japrocura lumie güe.
pairs.english: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 10 46280 ¶ Ya anae manalo guato y apostoles sija, masangane güe todo ni y finatinasñija. Ya jacone sija ya mañuja asta un banda, gui un siuda ni mafanaan Betsaida.
pairs.english: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta matungo ni y linajyan taotao sija, madálalag güe; ya güiya jaresibe, ya jasangane ni y raenon Yuus; ya janafanjomlo y numesesita manmaamte.
pairs.english: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jaane jatutujon pumuenge; ya mafatoigüe nu y dose ya ilegñija nu güiya: Nafanjanao, y linajyan taotao, para ufanjanao asta y sengsong yan y fangualuan gui oriya, ya ufañaga ya ufanmanaligao nañija; sa mangaeguejit güine gui desierto na lugat.
pairs.english: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo innafañocho. Ya ilegñija: Taya guajata na sincoja na pan yan dos güijan, patsino nije tafanjanao tafanmamajan nengcano para todo este sija na taotao.
pairs.english: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja buente sinco mit na taotao. Ya ilegña ni disipuluña: Nafanmatachong pot compania, cada compania sincuenta.
pairs.english: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüije mafatinas, ya mannafamatachong todos.
pairs.english: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule y sinco na pan yan y dos güijan, ya jaatan julo y langet ya jabendise ya jaipe; ya janae y disipoluña para upolo gui menan y linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañocho ya manjaspog todos; ya esta majatsa y sebla y pedaso sija, dose canastra.
pairs.english: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 18 46360 ¶ Ya susede, anae mananaetae güiyaja namaesa, estabaja mangaegue guiya güiya y disipuluña, ya jafaesensija, ilegña: Jaye ilegñiñija y taotao nu guajo?
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: umalog: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Lao jamyo, jaye ilegmimiyo nu guajo? Ya manope si Simon Pedro ya ilegña: Si Cristo, gui as Yuus.
pairs.english: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manguenesencatga sija ya jatago na chañija sumangangane ni jaye nu este;
pairs.english: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: Y Lajin taotao nesesita ufamadese megae, ya umarechasa ni y manamco sija, yan y manmagas y mamale yan y escriba sija, ya umapuno ya umanacajulo gui mina tres na jaane.
pairs.english: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija todos: Yaguin guaja y malago tumatiyego, upunenaesa güe, ya uchule y quiluusña cada jaane ya udalalagyo.
pairs.english: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa masqueseaja jaye y malago na usatba y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya masquesea jaye y malingo y linâlâña pot y naanjo, güiya usatba.
pairs.english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: maesa gue?
pairs.english: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa masqueseaja jaye pot y mamajlao guajo yan pot y sinanganjo, mamajlao locue nu este y Lajin taotao, yaguin mato gui minalagña yan y minalag tata yan y mañantos na angjet sija.
pairs.english: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao magajet jusangane jamyo: Na guaja palo gui mangaegue güine, na ti uchague y finatae asta que ujalie y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 28 46460 ¶ Ya susede mina ocho na jaane, despues di estesija na sinangan, jacone mañija yan Pedro, yan si Juan, yan si Santiago, ya cajulo gui egso ni taquilo para ufanaetae.
pairs.english: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras mananaetae güe, y jechuran mataña tolaeca; ya y magaguña jumuyong apaca ya malag.
pairs.english: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, dos taotao na cumuecuentos yan güiya; ya si Moises, yan Elias,
pairs.english: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjuyong yan y minalagñija, ya manguecuentos pot y jinanaoña, na para ucumple guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro yan y mangachogña, mansenmatujog; ya anae manmagmata, malie y minalagña yan ayo na dos taotao ni mangachongña.
pairs.english: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, mientras sumusuja sija guiya güiya, si Pedro ilegña as Jesus: Maestro, maulegñaja tafañaga güine; ya nije tafanmamatinas tres na tabetnaculo; uno para jago, uno para si Moises, yan uno para si Elias; ti jatungo jafa jasasangan.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras jasasangan este, mato un mapagajes ya mantinampe; ya ninafanguefmaañao anae manjalom gui mapagajes.
pairs.english: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato un inagang gui mapagajes na ilegña: Este y lajijo, inayigco; ecungog güe.
pairs.english: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malofan ayo na inagang, esta masoda si Jesucristo güigüiyaja namaesa; ya sija manmamatquiloja, ya güije sija na jaane, taya jasangane ni jaye pot y liniiñija.
pairs.english: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 37 46550 ¶ Ya susede inagpaña güije na jaane, anae manunog guinin y egso, ya y dangculon linajyan taotao masoda güe.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, un taotao gui entalo y linajyan, na umagang ilegña: Maestro jutayuyut jao na unlie y lajijo; sa y unoja patgonjo:
pairs.english: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa, estagüe, un espiritu na quinene, ya enseguidas umagang; ya ninalaolao güe ya numanajuyong buo, ya aapmam na pinadese na sumuja guiya güiya, na ninalalamenja,
pairs.english: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin jutayuyut y disipulumo na ujayute juyong; ya ti manasiña.
pairs.english: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus ya ilegña: O generasion na ti manjonggue, yan manchatpayon! asta ngaean nae utafanjijita, ya jujasusungon jamyo? conieyo fan mague ni y lajimo.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mámamamaela, y anite yinite papa ya guefninalaolao. Lao si Jesus jalalatde y espiritun áplacha ya janajomlo y patgon ya janatalo guato as tataña.
pairs.english: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todos ninafanman nu y minagas Yuus, lao mientras manmamanman todos pot todo estesija ni y jafatinas, ilegña ni disipuluña;
pairs.english: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya utatcalon gui talanganmiyo este sija na sinangan: sa umaentrega y Lajin taotao gui canae taotao sija.
pairs.english: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti jatungo este na sinangan, ya manafaninatogüe para chañija tumutungo: ya manmaañao mafaesen güe ni ayo na sinangan.
pairs.english: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 46 46640 ¶ Ya jumuyong manafaesen entre sija, jaye guiya sija udangculoña.
pairs.english: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus anae jaliija y jinason y corasonñija, jacone un patgon ya japolo gui bandaña,
