pairs.english: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye y rumesibe este na patgon pot naanjo jaresibeyo; ya y rumesibeyo, jaresibe y tumagoyo; sa jaye y mas diquique guiya jamyo, ayo dangculo.
pairs.english: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 49 46670 ¶ Ya manope si Juan ya ilegña: Maestro inlie uno na manyuyute juyong y manganite pot y naanmo; ya inchema sa ti jadadalalagjit.
pairs.english: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus ni sija; chamiyo chumochoma, sa ayo ni ti contra jamyo, guiya para jamyo.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 51 46690 ¶ Ya susede, anae mato y jaane nae jijot para umaresibe gui sanjilo; janameton y mataña para ujanao para Jerusalem,
pairs.english: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago tentago sija na ufanmofona gui menaña; ya majanao manjalom gui un songsong Samaritano, para umanalistuye güe güije.
pairs.english: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti maresibe güe, sa y mataña meton para ujananao para Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie este ni disipuluña, si Santiago, yan si Juan, ilegñija: Señot, malago jao ya utafanmanago ya utunog guafe guinin y langet, ya ufanlinachae?
pairs.english: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jabira güe ya manlinalatde.
pairs.english: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjanao para y otro songsong.
pairs.english: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 57 46750 ¶ Ya anae manjajanao sija, un taotao ilegña nu güiya gui chalan: Señot, bae judalalagjao manoja y unjanao guato.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu güiya: Y sora sija mangaeliyang, ya y pajaro sija gui langet mangaechenchon; lao y Lajin taotao taya sangaña ni anae para upolo y iluña.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni otro: Dalalagyo. Ya güiya ilegña; Señot, sottayo naya ya finenana jujanao ya jujafot si tatamo.
pairs.english: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: Polo y manmatae ya ufanajafot y manmataeñija; lao jago janao ya unpredica y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña locue otro; judalalagja jao Señot; lao sottayo naya ya judespideyo ni y mangaegue guiya jame.
pairs.english: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus: Ni uno ni pumopolo y canae gui alado ya uatan tateña ni y digno para y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE munjayan este sija na güinaja, jaayig y Señot otro setenta, ya jatago dos en dos gui menaña para todo y siuda yan ayo na lugat anae para ufato güe.
pairs.english: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Y cosecha megae, lao y manmachochocho didide; enaomina gagao y Señot y cosecha, ya ufanago ni manmachochocho para y cosechaña.
pairs.english: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanjanao gui chalanmiyo; estagüe na jutago jamyo taegüije quinilo gui entalo y lobo sija.
pairs.english: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmañuñule botsa ni maleta, ni sapatos: ni jaye insaluda gui jinanaonmiyo.
pairs.english: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masqueseaja mano na guma nae manjalom jamyo, finenana in alog: Pas para este na guma.
pairs.english: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja güije patgon y pas, y pasmiyo usaga guiya güiya; yaguin taya, utalo guato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fañaga güije na guma, fañocho yan infanguimen todo y manmanaenmiyo; sa y machochoeho ufanmerese nu y apasña. Chamiyo fanjajanao guma pot guma.
pairs.english: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masquesea mano na siuda nae manjalom jamyo, ya manmaresibe jamyo, cano jafa y manmasajyane jamyo.
pairs.english: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya nafanjomlo y manmalango ni guaja güije, ya inalog nu sija: y raenon Yuus esta mato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao masqueseaja mano na suida nae manjalom jamyo, ya ti manmaresibe jamyo, fanjanao gui cayeñija, ya inalog:
pairs.english: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y petbos ni jachetune y adengmame güine gui siudanmiyo, insacude contra jamyo; lao tingo este na y raenon Yuus mato jijot guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: mas sungunon Sodoma güije na jaane qui ayo na siuda.
pairs.english: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay! ay! jao Corasin: ay! ay! jao Betsaida! sa yaguin guiya Tiro yan Sidon nae manmafatinas este sija na mannamanman y manmafatinas guiya jamyo, jagas sen amco manmañotsot, infanmatachong gui silisio yan y apo.
pairs.english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mas sungunon Tiro yan Sidon qui para jamyo gui jaanin y sentensia.
pairs.english: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jago Capernaum, unacajulo jao asta y langet? umachule papa asta sasalaguan.
pairs.english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumungog jamyo, jajungogyo; ya y dumesecha jamyo, jadesechayo; ya y dumesechayo, jadesecha y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 17 46970 ¶ Ya manalo guato y setenta yan y minagofñija, ya ilegñija: Señot, asta y manganite insujejeta pot y naanmo.
pairs.english: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Julie si Satanas taegüije y lamlam ni y pedong guinin y langet.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, na junae jamyo ninasiña para ingacha y culebla, yan y alacran, yan y jilo todo y ninasiñan y enemigo, ya taya siña munafanlamen jamyo.
pairs.english: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao chamiyo ninafanmamagof pot este, pot y espiritu sija ni insujejeta; lao fanmagof jamyo pot y naanmiyo ni esta matugue gui langet.
pairs.english: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 21 47010 ¶ Ya ayoja na ora magof si Jesus gui Espiritu Santo ya ilegña: Junae jao grasia, O Tata, Señot y langet yan y tano, sa unana este sija na güinaja gui manmejnalom yan manmanungo, ya unfanue gui mandiquique; junggan Tata, sa taegüine nae senmagof gui menamo.
pairs.english: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y güinaja sija jagasja jaentregayo y Tatajo; ya taya tumungo jaye y Lajiña, na y Tataja; ya jaye y Tata, na y Lajiñaja, yan ayo y minalago y lajiña ufinanue.
pairs.english: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabiragüe guato gui disipulo sija, ya ilegña: Mandichoso y atadog ni manmanlie nu estesija ni y liniinmiyo:
pairs.english: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jusangane jamyo, na megae na profeta yan ray sija, dumesesea na ulie nu estesija ni y liniinmiyo, ya ti malie; yan ujajungog nu estesija ni y jiningogmiyo ya ti jajungog.
pairs.english: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 25 47050 ¶ Ya, estagüe, un magas y lay na tumojgue julo ya tinietientagüe, ya ilegña: Maestro, jafa jufatinas para juereda y taejinecog na linâlâ?
pairs.english: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Jafa matugue gui tinago? jafa untataetae?
pairs.english: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya manope, ilegña: Guaeya y Señot Yuosmo contodo gui corasonmo, yan contodo y antimo, yan contodo y minetgotmo, yan contodo y tiningomo; yan y tiguangmo taegüije iya jago namaesa.
pairs.english: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Mauleg inepemo: fatinas este, ya unlâlâ.
pairs.english: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya, malago na unatunas maesa güe, ilegña as Jesus: Ya jaye tiguangjo?
pairs.english: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus ya ilegña: Un taotao tumunog guinin Jerusalem asta Jerico, ya podong gui entalo y manaque; y machule y magaguña ya manachetnudan güe, ya manjanao ya mapolo cana matae.
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede na un pale tumunog güijeja na chalan; ya anae jalie malofanja gui otro banda.
pairs.english: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijeja locue un Lebita, anae mato jijot güije na lugat, ya jaatanja, ya malofanja gui otro banda.
pairs.english: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un Samaritano, anae jumajanao güije na chalan, mato lugat nae gaegue güe, ya anae jalie, ninamaase,
pairs.english: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato guato guiya güiya jabee y chetnot sija ya janaye laña yan bino; ya janamaudae gui gaña gâgâ, ya jacone asta y guima publico ya jaadaje.
pairs.english: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: anae para ujanao sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaye y tiguang entre y tres, pot ayo y pedong gui entalo y manaque?
pairs.english: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Ayo y maase nu güiya. Ayonae ilegña Janao ya unfatinas locue taegüije.
pairs.english: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 38 47180 ¶ Ya anae jumajanao, jumalom gui un songsong; ya un palaoan na y naanña si Marta rinesibegüe gui guimaña.
pairs.english: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja uno cheluña palaoan na y naanña si Maria, na locue matatachongja gui adeng Jesus, ya jaecungogja y sinanganña.
pairs.english: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Marta esta inestotba pot megae sinetbeña, ya mato guiya güiya, ya ilegña: Señot, ada ti unlie y chelujo na upaloyo ya jufañeñetbeja na maesa? Tago ya uayudayo.
pairs.english: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inepe as Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Marta, Marta, esta jago inestotba ya guesmanadaje jao, pot megae na güinaja:
pairs.english: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao unoja manesesita; ya si Maria jaayig ayo mauleg na patte ni ti umachule guiya güiya.
pairs.english: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede anae mananaetae güe gui un lugat, ya magpo, uno gui disipuluña ilegña nu güiya: Señot, fanagüejam manmanaetae, taegüije locue as Juan ni jafanagüe y disipuluña!
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña na sija: Yaguin manmanaetae jamyo alog: Tata, Umatuna y naanmo. Umamaela y raenomo,
pairs.english: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Naejam pago cada jaane ni y nengcanomame.
pairs.english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unasiijam ni isaomame; sa jame locue inasisie todo ayo y dumidibe jam. Ya chamojam pumopolo gui tentasion.
pairs.english: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 5 47270 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye guiya jamyo y gaeamigo uno, ya ufinatoigüe gui tatalopuenge, ya ualog nu güiya: Amigo naayaoyo tres pan;
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un amigojo mato guiya guajo guinin bumiaje, ya taya ni jafa para juplantaye gui menaña;
pairs.english: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y gaegue gui sumanjalom ufanope, ya ualog: Chamo umatbororotayo; sa esta majuchom y petta, ya estagüejam gui cama yan y famaguonjo; ti siñayo cajulo ya junae jao.
pairs.english: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: Achogja ti ucajulo ya uninae pot y amiguña: lao pot y magagaoña, ucajulo ya unae jaftaemano y janesesita.
pairs.english: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: Gagao, ya infanmanae; aligao ya inseda; yajo, ya infanmababaye.
pairs.english: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y mangagao uresibe; ya y manaligao usoda; ya y manayajo, umababaye.
pairs.english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jaye guiya jamyo na tata, yan uguinagao ni y lajiña un pan, ya unnae un acho? pat un güijan ya enbes di güijan unnae culebla?
pairs.english: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat yan guinagao un chada, ada unnae un alacran?
pairs.english: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pues ombre jamyo, ni y manaelaye, intingo numae mauleg na ninae y famaguonmiyo, cuanto mas y Tatanmiyo gui langet unae ni y Espiritu Santo todo ayo y gumagao güe?
pairs.english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 14 47360 ¶ Ya jayute juyong un anite na udo. Ya susede anae jumuyong este y anite, y ido cumuentos, ya y linajyan taotao sija ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija ilegñija: Pot si Beetsebub, ni magas y manganite, na jayuyuteja juyong y manganite sija.
pairs.english: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y pumalo matietientagüe, magagagao un señat gui langet.
pairs.english: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya jatungo y jinason ayo sija ya ilegña nu sija: Todo y raeno umadibide contra güiyaja, uyulang; ya y guima umadibide contra guma, upodong.
pairs.english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Satanas locue madibide contra güiya namaesa, jaftaemano y raenoña sumaga? Sa ilegmiyo na juyuyute juyong y manganite pot si Beetsebub.
pairs.english: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin junajujuyong y manganite pot si Beetsebub, pot jaye y famaguonmiyo ufanyinite sija juyong? Enaomina sija ufanjues para jamyo.
pairs.english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin pot y calulot Yuus nae, juyuyute juyong y manganite, magajet na y raenon Yuus mato guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un taotao ni matatnga, ya jafamauleg y atmasña, ya japulan y guimaña: todo güinajaña, manseguro.
pairs.english: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mato otro na matatngaña qui güiya ya inañao, inamot ni atmasña anae jaangoco güe ya jafacae y güinajaña.
pairs.english: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y ti jumujame, contra guajo yuje; ya ayo y ti rumecocoge guiya guajo machalapon.
pairs.english: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y espiritun áplacha, anae jumuyong gui taotao, jumajanao gui anglo na lugat, manaliligao dinescansa; ya anae ti mañoda, ilegña: Bae talo guato gui guimajo anae jumanaoyo.
pairs.english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, jasoda mabale yan maadotna.
pairs.english: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao ya mangone yan güiya otro siete espiritu mas manaelayeña qui güiya, ya jumalom ya sumaga güije: ya taelayeña y uttimoña ayo na taotao qui y finena.
pairs.english: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 47490 ¶ Ya susede anae jasangan estesija, un palaoan gui linajyan taotao, umagang ilegña nu güiya: Dichoso ayo na tuyan y chumuchulejao, yan ayo na pecho y anae sumususo jao.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña: junggan, lao dichosuña ayo y jumungog y sinangan Yuus, ya jaadaje.
pairs.english: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 29 47510 ¶ Ya anae manetnon y linajyan taotao guiya güiya, jatutujon sumangan: Este na generasion manaelaye: manmanaliligao señat; lao ti ufanmannae nu señat mas na ayoja y señat Jonas.
pairs.english: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüije si Jonas y señat para y taotao Ninibe taegüijeja locue y Lajin taotao para güine na generasion.
pairs.english: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y raenan sanjaya cumajulo gui jaanin juisio yan y taotao este na generasion ya manquinendena; sa mato guinin y uttimon y tano para uecungog y minalate Salomon; ya estagüeja uno dangculoña qui si Salomon gaegue guine na lugat.
pairs.english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taotao sija guiya Ninibe, ufangajulo gui jaanin juisio yan este na generasion ya manquinendena; sa manmañotsot pot y prenedican Jonas; ya estagüe uno mas dangculoña qui si Jonas gaegue güine na lugat.
pairs.english: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 33 47550 ¶ Taya ni un taotao munaaatog gui bedega y candet ni esta masonggue, ni upolo gui papa ganta, sino y candelero para todo y manjajalom ujalie y manana.
pairs.english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y candet y taotao, y atadog; yaguin y atadogmo sensiyo todo y tataotaomo maninina; lao yaguin taelaye, y tataotaomo locue bula jomjom.
pairs.english: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atan pues sa y manana ni y gaegue guiya jago, munga jomjom.
pairs.english: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina yaguin todo y tataotaomo bula manana, ni mano na lugat nae guaja jomjom, cabales na ubula manana, taegüije y yanguin malag ininaña y candet ya inina jao.
pairs.english: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 37 47590 ¶ Ya mientras cumuecuentos, un Fariseo siniplicagüe na usija chumocho, ya jumalom ya matachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Fariseo ninamanman anae jalie este, pot y ti jafagase güe finena antes di uchocho.
pairs.english: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña nu güiya: Pago jamyo ni Fariseo, y sumanjiyongja gui copa yan plato innagagasgas, lao y sumanjalommiyo bula inamot an tinaelaye.
pairs.english: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manaejinaso jamyo, ada ayo y fumatinas gui sumanjiyong, ti güiya locue y fumatinas gui sumanjalom?
pairs.english: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y guajanmiyo naenñaejon limosña; ya estagüe na todo ufangasgas para jamyo.
pairs.english: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 42 47640 ¶ Lao ay, ay jamyo Fariseo! ni infanmannae diesmos nu y yetba buena yan laruda yan todo golae; ya innafapos y tininas yan y güinaeyan Yuus. Estesija nesesita infatinas, sin pelo y pumalo.
pairs.english: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay, ay jamyo Fariseo! sa ingüaeya etmas manaquilo na tachong gui sinagoga, yan y sinaluda sija gui metcado.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay jamyo! sa calang jamyo naftan ni ti malilie; ya y taotao sija manmalolofanja gui sumanjilo ya ti matungo.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 45 47670 ¶ Ya manope un magas y lay, ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, yaguin unsangan estesija unlatdejam locue.
pairs.english: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña: Ay ay jamyo locue y manmagas y lay! sa innafanmangangatga y taotao sija ni ayo na catga y macat para uchule, ya ni un calolotmiyo innainete para inayuda.
pairs.english: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay, ay jamyo! sa infatinas y naftan, y profeta sija, ya y tatanmiyo pumuno.
pairs.english: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine mantestigo jamyo, ya inconsienteja y checho y tatanmiyo; sa sija magajet pumuno, ya jamyo fumatinas y naftanñija.
pairs.english: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña y minalate Yuus: Bae managoyo profeta yan apostoles para sija; ya megae guiya sija inpino yan inpetsigue:
pairs.english: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinin este na generasion manesesita machule y jâgâ todo y profeta, ni manmachuda desde y tutujon y tano;
pairs.english: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde jâgâ Abel, asta y jâgâ Sacharias, ni y matae gui entalo y attat yan y templo; magajet, jusangane jamyo na umanesesita machule guinin este na generasion.
pairs.english: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ay ay jamyo y manmagas y lay! sa innajanao y yaben tiningo; ya ti infanjalom jamyo yan y mangequejalom inchechema.
pairs.english: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 53 47750 ¶ Ya anae jumuyong güije, y escribas yan y Fariseos sija, matutujon ma afuefuetsas ya macacase para usigue cumuentos megae;
pairs.english: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maespipia, para umaquechule jafa guinin y pachotña.
pairs.english: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayo na tiempo, anae mandaña megae na mit na linajyan taotao, asta managacha uno yan otro; ya jatutujon sumangane y disipuluña sija finenana: Adaje jamyo ni y libaduran y Fariseo sija ni y hipocresia.
pairs.english: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya na matatampe na ti umababa; pat mananana, na ti umatungo.
pairs.english: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jafa guinin sinanganmiyo gui jemjom, umajungog gui manana; ya jafa y incuentuse gui talanga gui jalom aposento, umaagangnaejon gui jilo guma.
pairs.english: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo ni y amigujo sija: Chamiyo fanmaaañao ni ayo sija y pumuno y tataotao, sa an munjayan ayo, taya jafa siña ujafatinas.
pairs.english: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo jaye inmaañagüe: Fanmaañao jamyo ni ayo y yanguin munjayan japuno, guaja ninasiñaña na uyute asta sasalaguan: Junggan, jusangañe jamyo: Fanmaañao jamyo nu güiya.
pairs.english: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti mabende sinco na pajaro, pot dos na octabo? ya ni uno guiya sija mamalefañaejon gui menan Yuus?
pairs.english: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao asta y gaponulonmiyo esta manmatufong. Chamiyo fanmaaañao: sa manbaliña jamyo qui y megae pajaro.
pairs.english: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 8 47840 ¶ Ya jusangane jamyo: Jayeja y comonfesatñaejonyo gui menan y taotao sija; uquinenfesatñaejon locue ni y Lajin taotao gui menan y angjet Yuus.
pairs.english: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y pumuneyo gui menan taotao sija, siempre pune güe gui menan y angjet Yuus.
pairs.english: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y cumuentos contra y Lajin taotao, umaasie; lao y chumatfino contra Espiritu Santo, ti umaasie.
pairs.english: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmacone jamyo gui menan y sinagoga sija, yan y manmagas, yan y gaesisiña, chamiyo madadaje jaftaemano yan jafa para inepe, ni jafa para insangan;
pairs.english: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Espiritu Santo infanfinanagüe güije na ora jafa para insangan.
pairs.english: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 13 47890 ¶ Ya uno gui linajyan taotao ilegña nu güiya: Maestro, tayo y chelujo ya ufacaeyo ni y erensia.
pairs.english: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: Taotao, jaye pumoloyo gui jilomo para jues, pat para mamacae?
pairs.english: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Atan, ya inguesadaje jamyo ni y linagga: sa y linâlâ y taotao, ti guinin y manadan güinaja sija ni y jasagagaye.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mansinangane un parabola, ilegña: y fangualuan un taotao na rico, jumujuyong megae na quineco.
pairs.english: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjaso gui sumanjalomña, ilegña: Jafa jufatinas, sa taya mano nae jupolo y quinecojo.
pairs.english: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Este bae jufatinas: bae jujala papa y lanchoco, ya jujatsa y mas dangculo; ya ayo nae jupolo todo y maiisso yan y güinajajo.
pairs.english: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jualog ni y antijo: Ante, megae güinajamo, para megae na sacan; descansa, ya unchocho, yan unguimen, yan unmagof.
pairs.english: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus ilegña nu güiya: Taejinaso jao! pago na puenge nesesita umachule y antimo: ya para jaye ayo sija na güinaja ni unnaetnon?
pairs.english: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja y manaetnon y güinaja para güiyaja, ya ti urico para si Yuus.
pairs.english: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 22 47980 ¶ Ya ilegña ni y disipoluña sija: Enaomina jusangane jamyo, Chamiyo madadaje pot y linâlânmiyo, jafa para incano; ni y tataotaonmiyo, jafa para innaminagago.
pairs.english: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y linâlâ mas qui y nengcano, ya y tataotao mas qui y magago.
pairs.english: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y aga sija, na ti manmanananom, ni ufanmangoco; ni uguaja sagannengcanoñija ni lancho; ya si Yuus janachocho sija; ya cuanto mas manmauleg jamyo qui y pajaro!
pairs.english: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jaye guiya jamyo pot inadaje siña uaumenta un codo y linecaña?
pairs.english: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti siña inchegüe y mas diquique, para jafa inadadaje y pumalo?
pairs.english: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso y lirio sija, jaftaemano mandocoñiñija! ti manmachochocho, ni ufanmanjila; ya jusangane jamyo na si Salomon contodo y minalagña, ti minagago parejo yan uno guiya sija.
pairs.english: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin si Yuus janafanminagago y chaguan qui fangualuan ni y gaegue pago, ya agupa esta mayute guato gui jetno; ti mas magajet na inninafanminagago jamyo, O jamyo didide na jinenggue?
pairs.english: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya chamiyo umaliligao jafa para incano, ni jafa para inguimen, ni infanbuébuente gui jinasonmiyo.
pairs.english: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo este sija na güinaja manmaaliligao ni y nasion sija gui tano: lao y tatanmiyo jatungoja na innesesita estesija na güinaja.
pairs.english: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao aligao finena y raenoña; ya todo este sija na güinaja umanafandaña para jamyo.
pairs.english: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo fanmaaañao, jamyo diquique na manada; sa este minagof y tatanmiyo, na infanninae ni y raeno.
pairs.english: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bende y güinajamo, ya unfannae. limosna; fanmamamauleg botsa ni ti ubijo, un güinaja gui langet na ti ufatta, anae ti usineda ni y saque, ni ti upotliya.
pairs.english: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manoja nae gaegue y güinajamo, ayoja nae gaegue locue y corasonmo.
pairs.english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 35 48110 ¶ Polo ya esta madudog y senturanmiyo, ya esta masonggue y candet miyo;
pairs.english: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanparejo yan ayo na taotao sija y jananangga y señotñija, yanguin tumalo guato guinin y guipot umasagua; sa para yanguin mato ya manyajo, umababaye enseguidas.
pairs.english: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandichoso ayo sija na tentago, yanguin mato y señot, mansineda manbebela; magajet jusangane jamyo, na ududog güe, ya unafanmatachong para ufañocho, ya ufalag y sumanmena ya usetbe sija.
pairs.english: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin ufato gui segundo na bela ya gui tetsero, ya mansineda sija taegüijeja, mandichoso ayo sija na tentago.
pairs.english: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este tingo na yanguin y tata gui guima mojon jatungo jafa na ora nae ufato y saque, upulan ya ti upolo na umayulang y guimaña.
pairs.english: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina nafanlisto jamyo locue, sa ufato y Lajin taotao, güije na ora gui anae ti injajaso.
pairs.english: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 41 48170 ¶ Ayonae ilegña si Pedro: Señot, unsangan este na acomparasion para jame, pat para todos?
pairs.english: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña: Jaye nae ayo y mauleg yan mejnalom na mayetdomo, ni y ninamagas ni y señotña gui güinajana, para uninanae naña gui tiempoña?
pairs.english: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dichoso ayo na tentago y yanguin mato y señotña, sineda na jachochogüe taegüije.
pairs.english: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo; na uninamagas gui jilo y güinajaña, todo.
pairs.english: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin ayo na tentago y ilegña gui jalom corasonña: Y señotjo caeja mato; ya jatutujon pumanag y famalaoan na tentago, yan y lalaje; ya chumocho, yan gumimen, ya bumolacho;
pairs.english: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y señot ayo na tentago, ufato güije na jaane gui anae ti jananangga, yan gui ora anae ti jatungo, ya uninasuja, ya uninafandaña y patteña yan y ti manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na tentago y jatungo y minalago y señotña; ya ti jalisto güe, ni jafatinas jaftaemano y minalagoña, umasaulag megae.
pairs.english: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y ti jatungo, ya jafatinas digno na umasauleg, lao didide masaulagña. Sa jayeja y megae manaiña, siempre megae uchule, ya jaye y megae catgoña, mas megae magagaoña.
pairs.english: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 49 48250 ¶ Matoyo para juyute y guafe gui jilo tano: ya jafa malagojo yanguin esta todo mañiñila?
pairs.english: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I if it be already kindled?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja tagpangeco para jumatagpange; ya jafa chachatsagajayo asta qui umacumple!
pairs.english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Injajaso jamyo na matoyo para junae pas y tano? Jusangane jamyo, na aje; lao mas para inaguaguat.
pairs.english: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa desde pago sigue mona, uguaja gui un guma sinco na ti manparejo, y tres contra y dos, ya y dos contra y tres.
pairs.english: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tata uaguaguat contra y lajiña, ya y laje contra y tata; ya y nana contra y jagaña, ya y jaga contra y nana; y suegra contra y yetna, ya y yetna contra y suegraña.
pairs.english: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 54 48300 ¶ Ya ilegña locue ni y taotao sija: Yanguin inlilie y mapagajes na cajulo gui sumanlichan, siempre ilelegmiyo: Mamamaela y ichan; ya magajet.
pairs.english: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin manguaefe y manglo sanjaya, ilelegmiyo: Uguaja maepe; ya ufato.
pairs.english: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manhipocrita jamyo; intingo umegsamina y langet, yan y tano; ya jafa na ti intingo umegsamina y tiempo pago?
pairs.english: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa na ni jamyo ti injisga jafa y tinas?
pairs.english: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras jumanao jao yan y enemigumo para y magas, procura munaquelibre jao gui jinanaomo; na noseaja uninarastra guato gui jues, ya y jues uninentrega gui ofisiat, ya y ofisiat unpinelo gui calaboso.
pairs.english: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jao: Ti unjanao juyong güije, asta qui unapase y uttimo na marabidi.
pairs.english: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mangaegue güije na tiempo taotao sija, ni masangane güe pot y Galileo sija, ni si Pilatos janadaña y jâgâñija yan y inefresenñija.
pairs.english: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus manope ya ilegña nu sija: Jinasonmiyo na este sija na Galileo, mas manisao qui todo Galileo sija na japadese ayo sija?
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo na aje; sa yanguin ti manmañotsot jamyo, manparejoja jamyo manáchamalingo.
pairs.english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat ayo sija y diesiocho ni y podong y tore gui jiloñija guiya Siloe ya manpinino, jinasonmiyo na mas manisao ayo sija qui todo y taotao ni y mañasaga Jerusalem?
pairs.english: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo na aje; sa yanguin ti manmañotsot jamyo, manparejoja jamyo manáchamalingo.
pairs.english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 6 48410 ¶ Ya jasangan este na acomparasion: Un taotao guaja y trongcon igos na matanme gui fangualuanña; ya anae mato para uegaga cao guaja tinegchaña, ti mañoda.
pairs.english: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni y lancheruña: Esta guaja tres años ni matoyo güine na trongcon igos, manegagayo tinegcha, ya taya nae mañodayo; utut papa; para jafa na jaocucupa y tano?
pairs.english: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ilelegña nu güiya: Señot, polo pago na año ya juguadog y oriyaña, ya junaye estietcot:
pairs.english: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin ufanogcha, mauleg; yanguin aje, siempre, unutut.
pairs.english: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 10 48450 ¶ Ya estaba na mamananagüe gui un sinagoga, gui sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe un palaoan, na guaja un espiritun malango guiya güiya esta diesiocho años, ya esta ninaojlo, ya tisiña tumacho.
pairs.english: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae linie as Jesus, inagang ya ilegña nu güiya: Palaoan, libre jao gui malangumo.
pairs.english: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japolo y canaeña gui jiloña; ya enseguidas ninatunas, ya jaalaba si Yuus.
pairs.english: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y magas sinagoga lalalo sa si Jesus, numanajomlo gui sabado na jaane, ya manope ilegña nu y linajyan taotao sija: Guaja saes na jaane para ufanmachocho y taotao sija: ya este nae mauleg mato para numajomlo; lao ti y sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae inepe ni y Señot, ya ilegña: Hipocrita jamyo, ada ti siña cada uno guiya jamyo upula y gaña guaca, pat asno gui pesebre, ya ucone ya unaguimen gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña este na palaoan, ni y jagan Abraham, ni guinede as Satanas diesiocho años, manalibre gui magodeña, gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasangan estesija, todo y enemiguña ninafan mamajlao; ya todo y taotao sija ninafanmagof, pot todo y sennamagof na güinaja ni y machogüe pot güiya.
pairs.english: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 48530 ¶ Pot enao ilegña: Jafa parejuña y raenon Yuus? yan jafa nae juacompara?
pairs.english: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y granon y semiyan mustasa, ni y jachule y taotao, ya jatanme gui jalom jardinña; ya docó, ya jumuyong trongcon jayo; ya esta y pajaro sija gui langet mañaga gui ramasña.
pairs.english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña talo: Jafa nae juacompara y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejo yan y libadura, ni jachule un palaoan, ya janaatog gui tres medidan arina, asta qui todo manespongja.
pairs.english: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
