pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 22 48570 ¶ Ya jumajanao gin chalaña, malag y siuda sija, yan y sengsong mamananagüe, ya jumajananao para Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña uno nu güiya: Señot, didide manmasatba? si Jesus ilegña nu sija,
pairs.english: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefprocura mangejalom gui maiot na potta; sa jusangane jamyo na megae prumocucura mangejalom, lao ti mansiña.
pairs.english: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin y magas y guima jayasja cajulo ya jajuchom y petta, ya intitujon jamyo manmanojgue gui sumanjiyong ya inyajo y petta, ya ilegmi miyo: Señot, babayejam: ya ufanope ya ualog nu jamyo: Ti jutungo manguinemano jamyo:
pairs.english: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya intitujon umalog: Guinin mañochojam yan manguimenjam gui menamo, yan mamanagüe jam gui cayenmame.
pairs.english: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ualog: Jusangane jamyo, na ti jutungo manguinemano jamyo: fañuja guiya guajo, todos jamyo ni y chumogüe y tinaelaye.
pairs.english: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae uguaja cumasao, yan chegcheg nifen, yanguin inlie si Abraham, yan si Ysaac, yan si Jacob, yan todo y profeta sija, gui raenon Yuus; ya jamyo infanmachoneg juyong.
pairs.english: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufanmato manguinen y sancatan yan y sanlichan, yan y sanlago yan y sanjaya; ya ufanmatachong gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe na guaja manuttimo ya ufanfinenana, y guaja manfinenana ya ufanuttimo.
pairs.english: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 48660 ¶ Ya ayo na ora, manmato Fariseo sija ya ilegñija nu güiya: Janao ya unsuja güine; sa malago si Herodes na unpinino.
pairs.english: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Janao, sangane ayo na sora, na estagüe, na juyute juyong y anite sija, yan manaamteyo pago na jaane yan agupa, ya y mina tres na jaane ufonjayanyo.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao nesesita jufamocat pago yan agupa yan y inagpaña, sa ti siña na ufalingo y profeta gui Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: O Jerusalem! Jerusalem! ni y unpuno y profeta sija, yan unfagas ni acho ayo sija y manmatago para güiya! cuanto biaje malagoyo na junafandaña y famaguonmo, taegüije y ponidera janafandaña y poyitasña gui papa papaña, ya timalago jamyo!
pairs.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na manmapoluye jamyo ni y guimanmiyo taetaotao; ya jusangane jamyo: Ti inliiyo, asta qui mato ayo na tiempo anae inalog: Dichoso ayo y mamamaela ni y naan y Señot.
pairs.english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede na anae jumalom gui guima un magas Fariseo, para uchocho pan, gui sabado na jaane, ya sija maespipiaja.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, un taotao gaegue gui menaña na malango binaya.
pairs.english: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ya jacuentuse manmagas y lay, yan y Fariseo sija, ilegña: Tunas numajomlo gui sabado na jaane pat aje?
pairs.english: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manmamatquiquiloja. Ayonae jacone güe, ya janajomlo, ya jasotta na ujanao.
pairs.english: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaope sija ilegña: Jaye guiya jamyo, yanguin guaja gaña asno pat guaca, podong gui jalom tupo, ada ti enseguidas ujatsa gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña talo manmanope ni estesija.
pairs.english: And they could not answer him again to these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 7 48770 ¶ Ya jasangan un acomparasion ni y manmaconbida, anae jaatituye ni y jaayig y mas managquilo na tachong gui lamasa; ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin quinenbida jao ni un taotao para y guipot, chamo fatatachong gui mas tagquilo na tachong; sa ufato otro na mas onrao qui jago, ni y quinenbidaña locue;
pairs.english: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufato y cumonbida jao ya ualog nu jago: Nae este lugat y este taotao; ya ayonae untutujon mumamajlao yanguin sumaga jao gui mas uttimo na lugat.
pairs.english: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin quinenbida jao, janao ya fatachong gui mas tagpapa na lugat; sa yanguin mato y cumonbida jao, ualog nu jago: Amigo, janao falag iya jululo; ya ayonae unguaja inenra gui menan ayo sija y mangachongmo ni y manmatachong gui lamasa.
pairs.english: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jayeja y manataquilo maesa güe, unaumitde güe ya y umunaumitde güe, umanataquilo.
pairs.english: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 12 48820 ¶ Ya ilegña nu ayo y guinin cumonbida güe: Yanguin mamatinas jao nataloane pat sena, chamo umagagange y manamigumo sija, ni y mañelumo, ni y manparientesmo, ni y manrico na tiguangmo; sa noseaja unmaconbida locue talo, ya unmaapase.
pairs.english: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin gumupot jao, agange y mamoble, yan y manmanco yan y mancojo, yan y manbachet;
pairs.english: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya undichoso; sa ti siña maapase jao; lao unmaapase gui quinajulo y manunas.
pairs.english: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 15 48850 ¶ Ya anae jajungog este, uno gui mangachongña ni y manmatachong gui lamasa, ilegña nu güiya: Dichoso ayo y uchocho pan gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegña nu güiya: un taotao jafatinas un dangculon sena, ya mangonbida megae:
pairs.english: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y tentagoña gui oran sena, na ualog ni ayo sija y manmaconbida: Nije; sa esta todo listo.
pairs.english: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon cada uno umescusa güe. Y fenenana ilegña: Mamajanyo un pidason tano, ya nesesitayo jujanao ya julie; jugagao jao na unescusayo.
pairs.english: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y otro ilegña: Mamajanyo sinco pares na nobiyo para mancareta, ya bae jujanao ya juchague: jugagao jao na unescusayo.
pairs.english: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y otro ilegña: Umasaguayo, ya enaomina ti siñayo mato.
pairs.english: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumalo guato y tentago, ya janatungo y senotña nu este sija. Ayo nae y magas y guima ninagoslalalo, ya ilegña ni y tentagoña: Janao, lasajyao falag y caye sija yan y chalan gui siudad, ya uncone mague y mamoble, yan y mancojo, yan y manbachet, yan y manmanco.
pairs.english: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña y tentago: Señot, esta mafatinas y tinagomo, ya trabia guaguajaja lugat.
pairs.english: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y señot ilegña ni y tentagoña: Janao falag y dangculo na chalan yan y lugat ni y guaja ngangao, ya unafuetsas sija, ya ufanjalom para ubula y guimajo.
pairs.english: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jusangane jamyo, na ni uno güije sija gui guinin manmaconbida, uchague y senajo.
pairs.english: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 25 48950 ¶ Ya mañisija mangaegue yan un dangculon manadan taotao; ya jabira güe, ya ilegña nu sija:
pairs.english: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Achogja un taotao mato guiya guajo, ya ti jachatlie si tataña, yan si nanaña, yan y asaguaña, yan y famaguonña, yan mañeluña lalaje, yan y mañeluña famalaoan, yan y linâlâña locue, ti siñagüe disipulujo.
pairs.english: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jayeja y ti cumatga y quiluusña, ya dumalalag yo; ti siñagüe disipulojo.
pairs.english: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaye guiya jamyo, ujaso manjatsa un tore, ya ti ufatachong finena ya utufong y para gastoña cao siña uninafunjayan?
pairs.english: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa noseaja yanguin esta japolo y simiento, ya ti siña janafunjayan; todo y lumie jatutujon manmanbotlea nu güiya,
pairs.english: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: Este na taotao jatutujon manjatsa, ya ti siña janafunjayan.
pairs.english: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pat jaye y ray, anae jajanao para uguera contra y otro ray, ti ufatachong finena, ya ufañangane cao siña güe yan y dies mit, utagam y mamamaela yan veinte mit contra güiya?
pairs.english: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Patseno, mientras chachagoja y otro trabia, janajanao un compañia, ya ufangagao pas.
pairs.english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue; masquesea jaye guiya jamyo y ti rumechasa todo y güinajaña; ti siñagüe disipulujo.
pairs.english: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y asiga mauleg; lao yanguin malingo y asiga maasenña, jaftaemano manasne?
pairs.english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti mauleg para y tano, ni para fanyútian basula; masenyuteja ni y taotao. Jaye y gaetalanga para ufanjungog, güiya uecungog.
pairs.english: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA manjijijot guato guiya güiya, todo y publicano, yan y manisao, para umaecungog güe.
pairs.english: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangogonggong y Fariseo sija, yan y escriba ilelegñija: Este na taotao, jaresisibeja y manisao, ya mañisijaja mañocho.
pairs.english: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangane sija ni este na acomparasion, ilegña:
pairs.english: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye na taotao guiya jamyo, y yanguin guaja gaña siento na quinilo, ya ufinalingaeguan ni y uno, ada ti ujanao ya udingo y nobentainuebe gui desierto asta qui jasoda ayo y malingo?
pairs.english: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda, jaapagaye ya jamagogofgüe.
pairs.english: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guimaña, jaagange todo y manamiguña, yan y tignangña, ya ilelegña nu sija: Nije tafanmagof, sa jagasja jusoda y gajo quinilo ni y guinin malingo.
pairs.english: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na taegüenaoja locue uguaja gui langet, minagof yanguin un taotao na isao mañotsot, mas qui y nobentainuebe manunas na taotao ni y ti janesesita manmañotsot.
pairs.english: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 8 49130 ¶ Pat, jaye na palaoan, y yanguin uguaja iyoña dies na pidason salape, ya ufinalingaeguan ni y uno; ada ti usonggue y candet ya ubale y jalom guma, ya uguesaligao asta qui usoda?
pairs.english: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin esta jasoda, jaagange y manamigaña, yan y tiguangña ya mandaña, ya ilelegña: Nije tafanmagof, sa jagasja jusoda y pidason salape ni y guinin malingo.
pairs.english: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue jusangane jamyo, na uguaja minagof gui menan y angjet Yuus, pot y un taotao na isao ni y mañotsot.
pairs.english: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 11 49160 ¶ Ya ilegña: Un taotao guaja dos lajiña:
pairs.english: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mas patgon, ilegña as tataña: Tata, naeyo ni y patteco gui güinaja ni y para guajo. Ya jafacae para sija ni y güinajaña.
pairs.english: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti megae na jaane malofan, anae y mas patgon janafandaña todo, ya mapos asta y chago na tano; ya jagasta todo y güinajaña güije gui guipot yan bisio di gula.
pairs.english: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jagasta todo esta: mato un dangculon ñinalang güije na tano, ya jatutujon taena.
pairs.english: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao, ya jatituye gui un taotao güije na tano: ya tinago para y fangualuanña, para unachocho babue sija.
pairs.english: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatatanga na unabula tiyanña ni y lasas frijoles ni y jacacano y babue sija; ya taya ni un taotao numanaegüe.
pairs.english: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae numalo y jinasoña, ilegña: Cuanto na jotnaleron tata, mangaena pan, ya manmañoñobblaja, ya guajo güine jumatae ñalang!
pairs.english: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Bae jucajulo ya jujanao para as tata, ya jualog nu güiya: Tata, umisaoyo contra y langet, yan contra jago,
pairs.english: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti dignoyo mas na jumafanaan lajimo: naparejoyo yan y jotnalerumo sija.
pairs.english: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo, ya mapos para as tataña. Lao chagoja trabia, si tataña linie güe, ya ninamaase, ya finalagüe, ya tinegtog, ya chinicogüe.
pairs.english: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y patgon ilegña as tataña: Tata, umisaoyo contra y langet, yan contra jago; ti dignoyo mas na jumafanaan lajimo.
pairs.english: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tata ilegña ni y tentagoña sija: Chule y mas mauleg na magago ya umanaminagago; ya umapolo y aniyu gui calolotña, yan y sapatos gui adengña:
pairs.english: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umacone mague un tatnero ni y mas yomog, ya umapuno ya tafañocho ya tafanmagof;
pairs.english: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este y lajijo guinin matae, ya lâlâ talo; guinin malingo, ya masoda. Ya jatutujon sija manmagof.
pairs.english: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lajiña ni y mas amco estaba gui fangualuan; ya anae guaguato ya esta jijot gui guima, jajungog y dandan yan y manbabaila:
pairs.english: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang uno gui tentago sija, ya jafaesen jafa ayo sija.
pairs.english: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Y chelumo mato; ya si tatamo japuno y tatnero ni y mas yomog, sa jaresibe gae seguro yan sano.
pairs.english: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninagoslalalo, ya ti malago jumalom: ayonae jumuyong si tataña, ya siniplica na ujalom.
pairs.english: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope ilegña as tataña: Estagüe, megae na año nae jusesetbe jao, ya taya nae ti jaosgue jafa na tinagomo: lao taya nae unnaeyo un patgon chiba para infanmagof yan y manamigujo sija:
pairs.english: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae mato este na lajimo ni y jalachae todo y güinajamo gui manputa sija; unpunueja ni y mas yomog na tatnero.
pairs.english: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Lajijo, siempre jumijitaja; ya todo y güinajajo iyomo.
pairs.english: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mauleg para utafanmagof ya utafanalegria: sa este y chelumo guinin matae, ya lâlâ talo; yan guinin malingo, ya esta masoda.
pairs.english: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ilegña locue ni y disipuluña sija: Guaja un taotao na rico, ya guaja mayetdomuña; ya este mafaaela guiya güiya na jagasta y güinajaña.
pairs.english: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janamaagange, ya ilegña nu güiya: Jafa este y jujujungog guiya jago? Fannae cuenta pot y mayetdomumo, sa ti siña jao mumayetdomo mas.
pairs.english: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y mayetdomo, ilegña gui sumanjalomña: Jafa jufatinas? sa y señotjo unajanaoyo gui mayetdomujo: Taya minetgotto para ufanguadog; mamajlaojo umogagao.
pairs.english: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jutungo esta jafa jufatinas, para yanguin manajanaoyo gui mayetdomujo, jumaresibeyo gui guimañija.
pairs.english: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang cada uno gui manmadidibe ni y señotña, ya ilegña ni y finenana: Cuanto undidibe y señotjo?
pairs.english: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Siento na medidan laña. Ayonae ilegña nu güiya: Chule y cuentamo ya unfatachong guse ya untugue sincuenta.
pairs.english: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña talo ni y otro: Ya jago, cuanto dibimo? Ilegña: Siento na medidan trigo. Ylegña talo: Chule y cuentamo ya untugue ochenta.
pairs.english: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaalaba y señot y taelaye na mayetdomo; sa pot y jagostungo chumogüe: sa y famaguon este na tano, manmejnalomña y generasionñija, qui y famaguon y manana.
pairs.english: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusangane jamyo: Fanmamamauleg amigonmiyo pot y güinajan y timanunas; sa yanguin manfatta jamyo, infanrinesibe gui taejinecog na saganñija.
pairs.english: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tunas gui didide, tunasja locue gui megae; ya y ti tunas gui didide, ti tunasja locue gui megae.
pairs.english: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin ti guinin manunas jamyo gui ti magajet na güinaja, jaye infaninangoco gui magajet na güinaja?
pairs.english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya yanguin ti guinin manunas fiet jamyo gui iyon y otro taotao, jaye infanninae ni y iyonmiyo?
pairs.english: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni un tentago siña jasetbe dos na señot: sa uchatlie y uno, ya uguaeya y otro; pat atituye gui uno, ya udespresia y otro. Ti siña jamyo insetbe si Yuus, yan y güinaja.
pairs.english: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 14 49510 ¶ Ya y Fariseo sija locue, ni y mangasalape, majungog este sija; ya mabotlea güe.
pairs.english: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Jamyo yuje sija y innafanunas maesa jamyo gui menan y taotao sija; lao si Yuus jatungoja y corasonmiyo: sa ayo y guesmaguaeya gui entalo y taotao sija y chinatlie para y menan Yuus.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y lay, yan y profeta sija, mangaegue asta as Juan: ya desde ayo na tiempo y raenon Yuus mapredicañaejon, ya todoja jumalom nu y finijon.
pairs.english: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guseña malofan y langet yan y tano, qui na un pidasito gui lay ufatta.
pairs.english: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo ayo y dumingo y asaguaña, ya umasagua yan otro, jafatinas y abale; ya y umasagua ayo na palaoan ni y diningo ni y asaguañalaje, jafatinas y abale.
pairs.english: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 19 49560 ¶ Guaja un taotao na rico, na minagagagoja putpura, yan y guesmauleg na magago apaca, ya cada jaane gumupupot.
pairs.english: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja locue un pobble na umógagao limosna, y naanña si Lasaro, na bula chetnot, ni y estaba mapolo gui pettan y rico.
pairs.english: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malagogüe na umanachocho ni ayo y andesmoronan ni y mamopodong gui lamasan y rico; ya asta y galago manmato ya manmanjójoflag y chetnotña.
pairs.english: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues, matae y pebble ni y umógagao limosna, ya macone ni y angjet sija asta y pechon Abraham; matae locue y rico na taotao, ya majafot;
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y ya sasalaguan, jajatsa y atadogña, anae estaba gui sinapet, ya jalie si Abraham na chago, yan si Lasaro gui pechoña.
pairs.english: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umagang ilegña: Tata Abraham, gaease nu guajo, ya tago si Lasaro, para usupog y puntan calolotña gui janom ya unafresco y jilajo; sa estagüe na masasapetyo güine na mañila.
pairs.english: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Abraham ilegña: Laje, jaso na anae lalâlâ jao unresibe todo y manmauleg na güinajamo; taegüenaoja locue si Lasaro jaresibe y manaelaye na güinaja: lao pago, güiya mamagof güine, ya jago masasapet.
pairs.english: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gui todo estesija; esta mapolo fitme gui entalota un dangculon joyo na chojfe, para todo y manmalago manmalofan güine asta iya jamyo ti ufansiña; ni ufanmalofan y manmalago güenao manmalag iya jamyo.
pairs.english: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña: Pues jutayuyut jao tata, tago güe para y guima tata;
pairs.english: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajayo sinco mañelujo lalaje; para usangane sija testimonio; ni noseaja ufanmamaela locue güine gui sinapet na lugat.
pairs.english: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Abraham ilegña: Gaegueja si Moises yan y profeta sija, polo ya ujaecungogja.
pairs.english: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Aje, tata Abraham; sa yanguin uno ni y guinin manmatae jumanao para iya sija, ufanmañotsot.
pairs.english: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Yanguin ti maecungog si Moises, yan y profeta sija; ti ufanmaosgon achogja uguaja cajulo guinin y manmatae.
pairs.english: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ilegña ni y disipuluña sija: Ti siña ti ufato y escandalo; lao ay, ay ayo y munafato!
pairs.english: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maulegña na umagode gui agagaña un alutong, ya umayute gui tase, antes qui uninaquepodong uno güine gui mandiquique sija.
pairs.english: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo: Yanguin umisao y chelumo contra jago, reprende: y yanguin mañotsot, asie.
pairs.english: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin siete biaje gui un jaane umisao contra jago, ya siete biaje mafato guiya jago, ya ilelegña: Mañotsotyo, un asie.
pairs.english: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 5 49730 ¶ Ya y apostoles, ilegñija nu y Señot: Aumenta, y jinengguenmame.
pairs.english: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña: Yanguin mangaejinenggue jamyo taegüije y granon mostasa, ya mojon ilegmiyo nu este na sicómoro trongcon jayo: Chapag jao güenao, ya unplanta jao gui tase; ya mojon infaninesgueja.
pairs.english: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaye guiya jamyo y guaja tentagoña, na manalalado, pat mamamasto quinilo, y yanguin mato guinin y fangualuan, ualog nu güiya; maela enseguidas y fatachong, ya unchocho?
pairs.english: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti ualog nu güiya finena: Nalisto y senajo para juchocho, ya undudog jao, ya unsetbeyo asta qui munjayanyo chumocho, yan gumimen: ya despues nae unchocho, ya unguimen?
pairs.english: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Numae grasias ayo na tentago, sa jafatinas y matagoña? Jinasoco na aje.
pairs.english: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüineja locue jamyo, yanguin esta inchegüe todo ayo sija y jutago jamyo, ualog: Maninutil jam na tentago; sa ayoja y para y chechomame inchegüe.
pairs.english: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 11 49790 ¶ Ya susede anae jumanao para Jerusalem, ya malofan gui inanaco Samaria, yan Galilea.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumalom gui un songsong, manasoda güije yan dies na taotao na manategtog; ya manojgue desde y chago.
pairs.english: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajatsa y inagangñija, ya ilegñija: Jesus, Maestro, gaease nu jame.
pairs.english: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie, ilegña nu sija: Janao ya infanue y mamale nu jamyo. Ya susede anae manjajanao, manjuyong mangasgas.
pairs.english: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y uno guiya sija, anae jalie na jomlo güe, jabira güe tate, ya janaagagang mannae si Yuus minalag.
pairs.english: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatomba güe papa gui fion adeng si Jesus, ya janae grasias: este na taotao, Samaritano.
pairs.english: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Jesus, ilegña: Ada ti dies y mangasgas? ya manmangue y nuebe?
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya masoda tumalo mague para unae si Yuus grasias, na esteja y taotao juyong.
pairs.english: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña bu güiya: Cajulo ya unjanao; y jinengguemo munajomlo jao.
pairs.english: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 20 49880 ¶ Ya anae mafaesen ni y Fariseo sija, ngaean nae ufato y raenon Yuus, jaope ilegña: Y raenon Yuus, ti matungo finatoña.
pairs.english: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ujaalog: Estagüe! pat ayogüe! sa y raenon Yuus, gaegueja gui sumanjalommiyo.
pairs.english: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 22 49900 ¶ Ya ilegña ni y disipuluña sija: Ufato y jaane sija, na infanmalago na inlie uno gui jaanin y Lajin taotao, ya ti inlie.
pairs.english: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ujaalog nu jamyo: Estagüe, pat ayogüe; chamiyo tumatitiye, ni indalalaque sija.
pairs.english: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüijeja y lamlam, yan mañila gui un lugat gui papa y langet, ya inina y otro banda gui papa y langet; taegüineja locue y Lajin taotao, gui jaaniña.
pairs.english: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao nesesita na ufamadese finena megae, ya umarechasa ni este na generasion.
pairs.english: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jaftaemanoja y jaanin Noe, taegüijeja locue y jaanin y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mañocho, yan manguimen, yan manasagua, yan manafanasagua, asta ayo na jaane anae jumalom si Noe gui atca, ya mato y dilubio ya manyinilang sija todo.
pairs.english: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüineja locue jasusede gui jaanin Lot: mañocho, manguimen, manmamajan, manmanbende, manmananom, yan manmanjatsa guma;
pairs.english: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayoja na jaane anae jumanao si Lot guiya Sodoma, janauchan guafe, yan asufre guinin y langet, ya manyinilang todo sija.
pairs.english: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

pairs.english: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y publicano gaegue na tumotojgue gui chago; ya ti jaguesjatsa y atadogña julo gui langet; lao jaseseco y pechoña, ya ilelegña: Yuus, gaease nu guajo, sa taotao isaoyo.
pairs.english: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusangane jamyo, na, este na taotao jumanao papa y guimaña, ya maasie y isaoña, mas mauleg qui y otro; sa cada uno y minadangculo güe, uninaumitde; ya y munamitde güe, umanadangculo.
pairs.english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 15 50200 ¶ Ya maconie guato guiya güiya ni y diquique na famaguonñija, para upacha; ya anae manlinie ni y disipulo sija, manmalalatde.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na y ti rumesibe y raenon Yuus taegüije y diquique na patgon, ti ujalom güije.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 18 50230 ¶ Ya un taotao na magas, finaesen güe ilelegña: Mauleg na Maestro, jafa jufatinas para juereda y taejinecog na linâlâ?
pairs.english: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Jafa na ilegmo nu guajo mauleg? taya mauleg na unoja, si Yuus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu güiya: Pago na jaane mato y satbasion güine na guma; sa güiya locue Lajin Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

pairs.chamorro: Pot este na ilegña: Un taotao na magas, jumanao para y chago na tano para uresibe y raeno, yan para utaloja guato.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
