pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 27 51230 ¶ Ya manmato guiya güiya Saduseo sija, ni y sumangan na taya quinajulon manmatae; ya mafaesen güe,
pairs.english: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija: Maestro, si Moises jatuguiejam, na yanguin dos chumelo na laje, ya y uno guaja asaguaña, ya matae taya patgonña; ayo y cheluña uniasagua y palaoan, ya unacajulo semiya gui cheluña.
pairs.english: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja siete na lalaje na mañelu: ya y finenana umasagua, ya matae taya patgonña.
pairs.english: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: inasagua y palaoan sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inasagua talo ni y miná tres; yan taegüenaoja locue todo y siete manmatae ya taya famaguonñija.
pairs.english: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan uttimo matae locue.
pairs.english: Last of all the woman died also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y quinajulon manmatae, jaye gaeasagua y palaoan? sa inasagua todo ni y siete.
pairs.english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y famaguon este na tiempo manásagua yan manafanásagua:
pairs.english: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija y ufanmanmerese güije na tiempo, yan y quinajulon manmatae, ni ufanasagua, ni umanafanasagua:
pairs.english: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ti siña manmatae talo: sa manparejoja yan y angjet sija; yan manfamaguon Yuus, sa manfamaguon y quinajulon. manmatae.
pairs.english: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y manmatae ni umanafangajulo, asta si Moises mamanue gui finajalomtano, anae jafanaan y Señot, Yuus Abraham yan Yuus Ysaac yan Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti güiya Yuus manmatae, na manlâlâ: sa todosija manlala guiya güiya.
pairs.english: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanope palo gui escriba sija ilegñija: Maestro, mauleg sinanganmo.
pairs.english: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo, ti matatnga mafaesen güe talo jafa.
pairs.english: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 41 51370 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na ilegñija na si Cristo lajin David?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiyaja si David umalog gui leblon y Salmos: Y Señot ilegña ni y Señotjo, Fatáchong gui agapa na canaejo,
pairs.english: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta qui jupolo y enemigumo sija para fañajangan y adengmo.
pairs.english: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna si David finanaan güe Señot, ya jaftaemano mina ulajiña?
pairs.english: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 45 51410 ¶ Ya majujungogja ni y taotao sija, anae ilegña ni y disipuluña:
pairs.english: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje jamyo ni y escriba sija, sa yanñija manmamocat yan y anaco na magago, yan yanñija manmasaluda gui plasa, yan y finénana na tachong gui sinagoga sija; yan y finénana na saga gui guipot;
pairs.english: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan jalachae y guima y biuda sija, yan manmamanunue ni y anaco tinaetaeñija pot taya; estesija ujaresibe mandangculo na sinentensia.
pairs.english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manatan julo, jalie y manrico na taotao sija, na jayuyute jalom y ninaenñija gui cajon salape.
pairs.english: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie locue un pobble na biuda, na manyute jalom güije dos coble.
pairs.english: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jusangane jamyo ni y magajet. Este y pebble na biuda, manyute jalom mas qui todo sija:
pairs.english: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo estesija, y sebblanñijaja manmayute jalom minaeñija: lao este yan y pinebbleña, jayute todo jalom y güinajaña.
pairs.english: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 5 51480 ¶ Yan pot y manguecuentos palo pot y templo, ni y maadotna manbonito na acho sija yan ninae sija, ilegña:
pairs.english: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija na güinaja y inlie, estagüe, ufanmato jaane sija, na taya usobbla güine un acho gui jilo y otro, na ti umayute papa.
pairs.english: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 7 51500 ¶ Ya mafaesen güe, ilegñija: Maestro, ngaean nae ujuyong estesija? yan jafa na señat uguaja, yanguin jijot para ufanmato este sija na güinaja?
pairs.english: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña: Guesadaje jamyo ya chamiyo fanmafabábaba: sa megae ufanmato pot y naanjo, ya ujaalog: Güiya yo ya y tiempo esta jijijot; chamiyo dumalálalaque sija.
pairs.english: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yanguin injingog y guera sija, yan y atboroto, chamiyo faninespápanta: sa nesesita ufanmato este sija finena; lao y uttimo ti enseguidas.
pairs.english: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 10 51530 ¶ Ayo nae ilegña nu sija: Y nasion sija ufangajulo contra y nasion, ya y raeno contra raeno:
pairs.english: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya uguaja dangculon linao, ya y cada lugat ñinalang yan peste; yan uguaja minaañao sija, yan mandangculo na señat guinin y langet.
pairs.english: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao antes di todo este sija, ujapolo y canaeñija gui jilomiyo, ya infanmapetsigue, yan infanmaentrega gui sinagoga sija, yan y catset, yan infanmacone guato gui ray sija, yan y manmagas pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ujuyong este guiya jamyo para testimonio.
pairs.english: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo gui corason miyo, na chamiyo jumajaso finena jafa para inepe:
pairs.english: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guajo junae jamyo pachot yan tiningo, ni todo y enimigunmiyo ti siña macontra ni umachaba.
pairs.english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanenentrega ni y mañaenanmiyo, yan y mañelunmiyo, yan y parientesmiyo, yan y amigonmiyo; yan guaja guiya jamyo umanamapuno.
pairs.english: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya infanmachatlie ni todo y taotao pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ni uno gui gaponulonmiyo ufalingo.
pairs.english: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manpasensianmiyo nae, inganaye y antenmiyo.
pairs.english: In your patience possess ye your souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae inlie Jerusalem, na esta ineriyaye ni y sendalo sija, intingoja na esta jijijot y mayulangña.
pairs.english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae y mangaegue guiya Judea, ufanmalago para y egso sija; ya ayo sija y mangaegue gui entaloña ufanjuyong; ya y mangaegue gui fangualuan, chañija fanjajalom güije.
pairs.english: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este sija y jaanin inemog, sa para umacumple todo y güinaja ni y esta manmatugue.
pairs.english: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mannamaase ayo sija y manmapotgue, yan y mannanasusu güije sija na jaane! sa uguaja dangculon chinatsaga gui jilo tano, yan binibo gui jilo este taotao sija.
pairs.english: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ufamodong gui jilo y filon y espada, ya ufanmacone preso gui todo y nasion: ya Jerusalem umagacha papa ni y Gentiles, asta qui umacumple y tiempon y Gentiles.
pairs.english: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 25 51680 ¶ Ya uguaja señat sija gui atdao yan y pilan, yan y pution sija; yan chinatsagan nasion sija gui jilo tano pot y guinadon pangpang y tase yan y napo.
pairs.english: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manlalalango y taotao sija, pot y manmaañaoñija, yan pot y ninanangga ni ayo sija y manmamamaela para y tano: sa manmayengyong y ninasiñan y langet sija.
pairs.english: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae ujalie y Lajin taotao na mamamaela gui y mapagajes yan y ninasiña yan y dangculon minalag.
pairs.english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta jatutujon sumesede este sija, ayonae infanalag jilo, ya injatsa julo y ilunmiyo; sa esta jijijot y para inmanafanlibre.
pairs.english: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 29 51720 ¶ Ya jasangane sija un acomparasion, ilegña: Atanja y trongcon igos, yan todo y trongcon jayo sija.
pairs.english: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yanguin esta manmañúñuso, inlie ya intingoja maesa jamyo na esta jijijot y verano.
pairs.english: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenaoja locue jamyo yanguin inlie esta sija na masusede, tingo na esta jijijot y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet jusangane jamyo: Ti ufapos este na generasion, asta qui todo sija manmacumple.
pairs.english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet yan y tano ufanmalofan, lao y finojo ti ufalofan.
pairs.english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 34 51770 ¶ Ya inguesadaje jamyo na ufanbula y corasonmiyo ni y pinadog mañocho yan inelacho, yan y inadajen este na linâlâ, ya ufato guiya jamyo ayo na jaane derepente,
pairs.english: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüijeja y laso: sa taegüijeja ufinatoña gui jilo todo sija y mañasaga gui jilo tano.
pairs.english: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina fanbela todo tiempo, ya infanmanaetae, ya para infansiña manescapa ni todo estesija y ni ufanmato, yan para infanojgue gui menan y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 37 51800 ¶ Ya mamananagüe cada jaane gui templo; yan cada puenge jumajanao, ya sumasaga gui un ogso na mafanaan ogso Olibo.
pairs.english: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao sija manmafato gui templo, taftaf gui egaan, para umaecungog güe.
pairs.english: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae estaba jijijot y jaanin y guipot y pan ni taelibadura, ni mafanaan pascua.
pairs.english: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magas mamale yan y escriba sija maaliligao jaftaemano para umapuno güe; lao manmaañao ni y taotaosija.
pairs.english: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 3 51840 ¶ Ya jumalom si Satanas gui as Judas y apeyiduña Iscariote, uno gui numerou y dose.
pairs.english: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maposgüe, ya manguentos yan y magas mamale, yan y manmagas, jafataemano para uinentrega guiya sija.
pairs.english: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafanmagof, ya matratos na umanae salape.
pairs.english: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manpromete ya jaaliligao lugat para uqueentrega guiya sija, yanguin manaegüe y linajyan taotao.

pairs.english: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

pairs.chamorro: Para infañocho yan infanguimen, gui lamasajo gui raenoco; ya infanmatachong gui trono sija ya injisga y dose na tribo guiya Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jajaso sija y sinanganña,
pairs.english: And they remembered his words,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manalo guato gui naftan ya jasangane y onse nu este sija, yan todo y pumalo.
pairs.english: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija si Maria Magdalena yan si Juana, yan si Maria nanan Santiago; yan y pumalo palaoan ni mangachongñija, sumangane y apostoles nu estesija.
pairs.english: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija japolo na taetiningo, y sinanganñija ya ti majonggue.
pairs.english: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 12 53200 ¶ Ayonae cajulo si Pedro, ya malago asta y naftan: ya anae ñumejon ya jaatan jalom, jalilie y sabanasja gui un lugat, ya mapos güe iyasija ya ninamanman nu este y manmalofan.
pairs.english: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 13 53210 ¶ Ya, estagüe, dos guiya sija na jumajanao, güijeja na jaane, para un songsong ni naanña Emmaus, sesenta estadios desde Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cumuecuentos y dos mona pot todo estesija y masusede.
pairs.english: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae cumuecuentos y dos, ya manafaesen entre sija, mato si Jesus ya mañisija manjanao.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y atadogñija calang manmatampe, para chañija tumutungo güe.
pairs.english: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na cuentosmimiyo uno yan otro, anae manajanao jamyo, ya mañaga ya ninafantriste?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe ni ayo y uno ni y naanña si Cleofas ya ilegña nu güiya: Ada sumagaja jao guiya Jerusalem, ya ti untungo jafa manmalofan güine sija na jaane?
pairs.english: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass therein these days?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña nu sija: Jafa sija? Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Ayo sija iyon si Jesus Nasareno, ni profeta güe ni gaeninasiña gui checho yan y sinangan gui menan Yuus yan todo y taotao sija;
pairs.english: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maentrega, gui magas mamale yan y magalajenmame para umasentensia ni y finatae, ya maatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jame innanangga sa güiya y para unafanlibre y Israel. Junggan, yan mas qui todo este, pago esta mina tres na jaane desde que masusede estesija.
pairs.english: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan locue palo famalaoan ni mangachongmame janamanman jam sa manmato gui naftan gui taftataf gui egaan;
pairs.english: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti masoda y tataotaoña, manmato guiya jame ilegñija na manmanlie sija y liniin angjet sija, ni y jasnangane na lâlâgüe.
pairs.english: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamjanao guato gui naftan palo gui mangachongmame ya masoda taemanoja y sinangan y famalaoan; lao ti malie güe.
pairs.english: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: O taotao manaetiningo jamyo, yan y ñateng y corasonmiyo para injenggue todo y sinangan y profeta sija!
pairs.english: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti nesesita na si Cristo ufamadese nu este sija ya taegüine nae ujalom gui minalagña?
pairs.english: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon desde as Moises, yan y profeta sija, y jasangangane claro todo ni tinigue ni y pot güiya.
pairs.english: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui sengsong ni jajananagüe güije; ya jasigue para mas chago jinanaoña.
pairs.english: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija janasaga fuetsao, ilegñija: Maela tafañaga sa este puenge ya jocog y jaane; ya jumalom para usaga mañisija.
pairs.english: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede, anae matachong gui lamasa yan sija, jachule y pan ya jabendise, ya jaipe ya manninae.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manmababa atadogñija ya matungo güe; lao güiya jamalingoja gui inatanñija.
pairs.english: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija entre y dos: Ada ti sinenggue y corasonta gui sumanjalomta mientras jacuentutusejit gui chalan, yan anae jababayejit ni y tinigue?
pairs.english: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cumajulo y dos güije na ora, ya tumalo guato Jerusalem: ya masoda y onse mandadaña, yan y manestaba mangachongñiñija,
pairs.english: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilelegñija: Magajet, esta cajulo y Señot, na umalie yan si Simon.
pairs.english: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae sija jasangane nu este sija y masusede gui chalan; yan jafa taemano, tungoñija anae jaipe y pan.
pairs.english: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 36 53440 ¶ Ya mientras manguecuentos nu este sija, güiya tumojgueja gui entaloñija, y ilegña nu sija: Pas guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manmaañao ya manmajngang ya jinasonñija na manmanlie sija un espiritu.
pairs.english: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na ninafanestotba jamyo? Ya jafa na cumajulo y jinasonmiyo gui corasonmiyo?
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Atanja y canaejo yan y adengjo, sa guajo mismoyo: pacha yan inlie sa y espiritu taecatne ni tolang, taegüije inliija na guajayo,
pairs.english: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasangan este, manfinanue ni y canaeña yan y adengña.
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti jajonggue sija pot minagofñija, ya ninafanmanman, güiya ilegña nu sija: Guaja güine jafa para utacano?
pairs.english: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija janae un pedason güijan na mapeja.
pairs.english: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule ya jacano gui menanñija.
pairs.english: And he took it, and did eat before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 44 53520 ¶ Ya ilegña nu sija: Este sija na sinangan ni y jusangangane jamyo anae manjijita: taemanoja na nesesita na umacumple todo y esta matugue gui lay Moises yan y profeta sija, yan y Salmos pot guajo.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manbinaba y jinasoñija para ujatungo y tinigue;
pairs.english: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Taegüine esta matugue, na si Cristo ufamadese ya ucajulo talo guinin y manmatae gui mina tres na jaane;
pairs.english: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umapredica gui naanña y sinetsot yan inasiin isao, gui todo y nasion sija, umatutujon desde Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo testigo nu estesija na güinaja.
pairs.english: And ye are witnesses of these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, estagüe, na bae jutago y promesan y Tatajo gui jilo miyo: lao jamyo fañaga gui siuda guiya Jerusalem, asta que manminagago jamyo ni y ninasiña guinin iya jululo.
pairs.english: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 50 53580 ¶ Ya manquinene juyong asta Betania; ya jajatsa y canaeña ya manbinendise sija.
pairs.english: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae manbinendise, jaapatte güe guiya sija ya machule julo gui Langet.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija jaadora ya manalo guato Jerusalem yan y dangculon minagofñija;
pairs.english: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangaegue siempre gui templo, manmanbendidise as Yuus. Amen.
pairs.english: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tutujonña gaegue y Finijo, ya y Finijo güiya yan si Yuus; ya y Finijo güiya si Yuus.
pairs.english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya gaegue gui tutujonña yan si Yuus.
pairs.english: The same was in the beginning with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y güinaja sija manmafatinas pot güiya; yaguin ti pot güiya, taya ni esta mafatinas, nu y gaegue gui finatinas sija.
pairs.english: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linâlâ gaegue guiya güiya, ya y linâlâ, güiya y candet y taotao sija.
pairs.english: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y candet gui jalom jomjom maniina, ya y jemjom ti matungo.
pairs.english: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y un taotao ni manafato guine as Yuus, y naanña si Juan.
pairs.english: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya mamaela para testimonio, para ufannae testimonio nu y candet, para ufanmanjonggue todo y taotao pot güiya.
pairs.english: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ti y candet, lao mamaela para ufannae testimonio nu y candet.
pairs.english: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y magajet na candet ni maniina y todo taotao, na mamamaela güine gui tano.
pairs.english: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya gaegue gui tano, ya y tano mafatinas pot güiya, ya y tano ti matungo güe.
pairs.english: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya mato gui iyoña ya iyoña ti marisibe güe.
pairs.english: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo y rumesibe güe, güiya janae ninasiñanñija para ufamaguon Yuus; junggan, para todo ni y jumonggue y naanña.
pairs.english: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmalilis ti guinin y jâgâ, ya ti guinin y minagof y catne, ya ti guinin minagof y taotao, lao guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na Finijo mamacatne ya sumaga guiya jita (ya talie y minalagña, ayo na minalag taegüije y linilisja gui tata), bula y grasia yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manae testimonio nu güiya ya umagang ya ilegña: Güiya ayo y jusasangan: y mamaela gui tateco, güiya dangculoña qui guajo, sa güiya finenena qui guajo.
pairs.english: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui binilaña manmañulijit todo, yan y grasia pot y grasia.
pairs.english: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinago sija pot si Moises esta manae, lao y grasia yan y minagajet, pot si Jesucristo namanmato.
pairs.english: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, taya taotao lumie, taya na tiempo, ayo na Lajiña, y linilisja, na gaegue san jalom y pechon tata, güiya jafanue jit nu güiya.
pairs.english: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y testimonien Juan, anae y Judio sija manafanmato nu y mamale yan Lebita sija, guine Jerusalem, ni manmafasen: Jago, jaye jao?
pairs.english: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jaconfesatñaejon ya ti japune, lao jaconfesatñaejon, ilegña: Guajo ti Jesucristo yo.
pairs.english: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen: Jafa nae? Jago si Elias? Ya ilegña: Ti guajo yo. Jago ayo na profeta? Ya manope: Aje.
pairs.english: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegñija nu güiya: Jaye jao? para siñajam infanmanope ni y tumago jam. Jafa ilelegmo nu jago namaesa?
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: Guajo inagang yo nu y umaagang gui desierto; natunas y chalan señot, taegüije ilegña si Esaias profeta.
pairs.english: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija ni namanmato ni y guinin Fariseo sija.
pairs.english: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafafaesen güe ya ilegñija nu güiya: Sajafa na managpangejao, yaguin ti jago si Jesucristo, ni si Elias, ni y ayo na profeta?
pairs.english: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manope ilelegña: Guajo managpagpange an janom; mas y entalo miyo, guaja uno na ti intingo.
pairs.english: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este uje y mamaela gui tateco, y mas dangculo qui guajo, ya guajo ti dignoyo na jupula ni y coreas y sapatosña.
pairs.english: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija finatinas guiya Betania y otra banda gui Jordan, anae managpagpange si Juan.
pairs.english: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 29 53900 ¶ Y siguiente na jaane jalie si Juan si Jesus na mamaela para iya güiya ya ilegña: Estagüe y corderon Yuus na janajanao y isao gui tano.
pairs.english: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este yuje ileo, na y tateco mamamaela un laje y dangculoña qui guajo, sa güiya finenena qui guajo.
pairs.english: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti jutungo; lao para umafanue y Israel nu güiya, enao mina mato yo yan managpagpange yo an janom.
pairs.english: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Juan manae testiomonio ilegña: Julie y Espiritu ni tumutunog guinin y langet, taegüije y paluma ya sumaga gui jiloña.
pairs.english: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti jutungo güe, lao y munamamaela yo para ufanagpange an janom, ayo sumangane yo: Sobre ayo na unlie na tumunog y Espiritu ya sumaga guiya güiya, este uje y managpagpange ni Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo julie ya manae yo testimonio nu y güiya y Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 35 53960 ¶ Y siguiente na jaane tumalo manmatojgue si Juan yan dos gui disipuluña.
pairs.english: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 36 53970 ¶ Ya Jaatan si Jesus ni mamomocat güije, ya ilegña: Estagüe y Corderon Yuus.
pairs.english: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya majungog ni dos na disipuluña comequentosña yan madalalag si Jesus.
pairs.english: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabira güe si Jesus ya jalie na madadalalag güe nu sija ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa inaliligao? Ya sija ilegñija: Rabi (este finijo comequeilegña, gui chamorro, Maestro) manu sagamo?
pairs.english: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña: mamaela ya unlie. Manmamaela ya jalie manu nae sumaga ya mañagaja yan güiya, güije na jaane, sa jijut y ora y mina dies.
pairs.english: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Andres y chelun Simon Pedro, güiya uno gui dos y jumungog umadingan an Juan, yan madalalag güe.
pairs.english: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya jasoda finena y cheluña as Simon, ya ilegña nu güiya: Tasoda y Mesias (ni y cumequeilegña: güiya si Cristo).
pairs.english: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone guato as Jesus; anae inatan as Jesus ilegña: Jago Simon, patgon Jonas: jago mafanaan Sefas (cumequeilegña: acho).
pairs.english: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y siguiente na jaane, malago si Jesus malag Galilea, ya jasoda si Felipe, taotao Betsaida, gui siudan Andres yan Pedro.
pairs.english: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Felipe jasoda si Nataniel ya ilegña nu güiya: Esta tasoda ayo y jatugue si Moises gui tinago yan y profeta, Jesus, taotao Nasaret y patgon José.
pairs.english: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Nataniel: Guinin Nasaret siña jumuyong minauleg? Ylegña si Felipe: maela ya unlie.
pairs.english: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jalie mamaela para iya güiya, si Nataniel, ya ilegña nu güiya: Estagüe senmagajet iyon Israel, na taya finababa guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Nataniel: Guine manu na untungo yo? Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Antes di si Felipe uninagang, na gaegue jao gui papa y ygos, guajo julie jao.
pairs.english: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Nataniel ya ilegña: Rabi, jago uje y lajin Yuus, jago uje y ray guiya Israel.
pairs.english: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Sa jusangane jao, na julie jao gui papa y ygos, ya unjonggue? Jago unlie mandangculoña na güinaja qui este.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, y mamaela na tiempo nae unlie y langet mababa ya y angjet sija guine as Yuus mangajujulo yan manututunog gui jilo y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mina tres na jaane, mafatinas y guipot umasagua, gui Cana, siudan Galilea, ya y nanaña si Jesus gaegue güije.
pairs.english: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus yan y disipuluña maagange locue para y guipot umasagua.
pairs.english: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae taya y bino, y nanaña si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Taya binoñija.
pairs.english: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pot jafayo na juentalo nu jago, palaoan? trabia ti mafato y orajo.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si nanaña ilegña ni manmañeñetbe: Fatinas todo y tinagoña.
pairs.english: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y estaba güije saes lauyan acho, parejoja yan y guinasgasñija y Judios, na manulat, cada uno, dos pat tres cantaro.
pairs.english: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Nafanbula este sija lauyan janom. Ya manafanbula asta y pachot.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Chile pago ya innae y maestrosala; ya machule.
pairs.english: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y maestrosala jachague y janom na mafatimas bino, ya ti jatungo guine mano: (lao y manmañeñetbe tumungo, na jachule y janom), y maestrosala jaagange y nobio;
pairs.english: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Todo y taotao janafofona y mauleg na bino; ya yaguin esta manjaspog, ayo nae y mas manaelaye: lao jago unnanana y mauleg na bino asta pago.
pairs.english: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na tutujon y señatña sija, jafatinas si Jesus, guiya Cana suidan Galilea, ya janamatungo y minalagña; ya y disipuluña sija majonggue güe.
pairs.english: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Despues di este tumunog guiya Capernaum, güiya yan y mañeluña yan y disipuluña sija, ya mañaga güije ti megae na jaane.
pairs.english: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 13 54240 ¶ Y estaba güije jijot y pascuan y Judios, ya si Jesus cajulo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasoda gui guimayuus manmanbebende y nubiyo yan y quinilo, yan y paluma, yan y manmanulalaeca manmatatachong:
pairs.english: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaolag ni tale, ya janafanmalago todo gui guimayuus, yan y quinilo, yan y nubiyo; yan y machapon y salape y manmanulalaeca, yan manaalinquin y lamasa,
pairs.english: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña ni manmanbebende ni paluma: Nafanjanao güine este sija na güinaja, ya chamiyo fumatitinas y guima tata, guima namajan.
pairs.english: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manmanjaso y disipuluña ni estaba matugue: Ynigo y guimamo cumano yo.
pairs.english: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 18 54290 ¶ Y Judio sija manmanope ya ilegñija; Jafa na señat unfanuejam taegüije ayo, sa jago unfatinas este sija na güinaja?
pairs.english: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ya ilegña: Yulang este na gumayuus, ya y tres na jaane; junacajulo talo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y Judio sija ilegñija: Gui cuarentaisaes años manacajulo este na gumayuus, ya jago, gui tres na jaane, unacajulo?
pairs.english: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya umadingan ni guima tataotaoña.
pairs.english: But he spake of the temple of his body.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae cajulo guine manmatae, y disipuluña jajaso na munjayan jasangane este, ya manmanjonggue ni tinigue sija yan y sinangan ni jasangan si Jesus.
pairs.english: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 23 54340 ¶ Ya, güiya gaegue guiya Jerusalem gui pascua, y jaane ni guipot, ya megae manmanjonggue ni naanña, anae malie sija y señatña sija ni jafatinas.
pairs.english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Jesus namaesa, ti jaangoco güe guiya sija, sa güiya jatungo todo taotao,
pairs.english: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya nesesida na jaye unae testimonio ni taotao, sa güiya tumungo y guaja gui jalom taotao.
pairs.english: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA guaja un taotao Fariseo na naanña si Nicodemo, prinsipe y Judiosija.
pairs.english: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este mato gui as Jesus gui puenge ya ilegna nu güiya: Rabi, jame intingo na jago maestro guine as Yuus, sa taya siña fumatinas este sija na señat, ni unfatitinas, yaguin ti sumisija yan Yuus.
pairs.english: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jao, na y ti mafañago talo, ti siña jalie y raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Nicodemo: Jafa muna siña y taotao mafañago yaguin este biju; siña güe jumalom dos biaje, talo gui jalom y tiyan nanaña ya umafañago?
pairs.english: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, na y ti mafañago ni janom yan ni iyon Espiritu, ti siña jumalom gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y mafañago ni guine catne, catneja güe; ya y mafañago guine Espiritu, espirituja güe.
pairs.english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo ninamamanman ni jusangane jao: Y nesesita jamyo na mafañago talo.
pairs.english: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y manglo manguaefe mano malagoña, ya unjungog y bengbengña, lao ti untungo guine manu mague, ni tampoco para manu guato. Taegüenao todo ayo y manmafañago guine Espiritu.
pairs.english: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Nicodemo manope ya ilegña: Jafa muna siña este?
pairs.english: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jago un maestro guiya Israel ya ti untungo este?
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, Y tatungo, tasangan; ya y talie tadeclara, ya ti inresibe y testimoniota.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jusangane jao güinajan tano, ya ti unjonggue, jafa taemano unjonggue yaguin jusangane jao güinajan langet?
pairs.english: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya cajulo gui langet, güiyaja y tumunog guine y langet, güiya matungo, y Lajin taotao ni y gaegue gui langet,
pairs.english: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaf taemanoja si Moises janacajulo y serpiente gui desierto, taegüijeja na nesesita na y Lajin taotao umanacajulo.
pairs.english: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para todo ayo y jumonggue güe, ti siña malingo, ya guaja linâlâña na taejinecog.
pairs.english: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 16 54520 ¶ Sa taegüenao na jaguaeya si Yuus y tano, janae ni linilisja Lajiña y para todo ayo y jumonggue güe, ti siña malingo, ya guaja linâlâña na taejinecog.
pairs.english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti jatago si Yuus y Lajiña guato gui tano, para usapit y tano, lao para y tano unalibre pot güiya.
pairs.english: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumonggue güe, ti umasapit; ayo y ti jumonggue güe ayo umasapit, sa ti manjonggue ni naan unoja na Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este na sinapit, na y inina malag y tano, ya y taotao sija gaonñija y jemjom qui y inina, sa y finatinasñija taelaye.
pairs.english: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa todo ayo y fumatinas y taelaye, chatlie y inina, ya ti malag y inina, sa y chechoña no sea umareprende.
pairs.english: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
