pairs.chamorro: Ayo y fumatinas y magajet, malag y inina, para y unamatungo finatinasña, sa y finatinasña guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 22 54580 ¶ Despues di estesija, mato si Jesus yan y disipuluña sija, gui un tano Judea ya gaegue güije yan sija managpange.
pairs.english: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Managpapange locue si Juan, guiya Enon, jijot guiya Salim, sa gaegue güije megae na janom: ya sija manmamaela, ya manmatagpange.
pairs.english: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan trabia ti mapopolo gui catset.
pairs.english: For John was not yet cast into prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja un inaguaguat entre sija yan y disipulon Juan yan y Judio sija pot y guinasgas.
pairs.english: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato gui as Juan, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Rabi, ayo y gaegue güije guinin iya jago, gui otro banda Jordan ni unnae testimonio, estagüe! na jatagpange, yan y todo y taotao manmato guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Juan ilegña: Ti siña y taotao manresibe jafa, yaguin ti manae guine y langet.
pairs.english: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyoja innae testimonio na guinin jusangan: Ti guajo si Jesucristo, lao guajo matago gui menaña.
pairs.english: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja asaguaña, güiya y nobio locue; lao amigon nobio, ni y tomotojgue ya jajujungogja, ya magof dangculo pot y sinangan y nobio. Taegüine pues este minagofjo esta macumple.
pairs.english: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya siempre, lumálamodong; ya guajo manaladiquique.
pairs.english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 31 54670 ¶ Y guinin jila mague, güiya mas taquilo qui todo; ya y iyon y tano, tanoja güe, ya iyon y tanoja jasasangan; ya y mamaela guine langet, güiya iyajululo.
pairs.english: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tanae testimonio, nu y lumie ya jajungog, ya taya rumesibe y testimonioña.
pairs.english: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y rumesibe y testimonioña, este sumeyo na si Yuus, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tinago as Yuus, y fino Yuus jasangan; sa si Yuus ti mannanae güe ni y Espiritu pot medida.
pairs.english: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y tata yaña y Lajiña ya todo y güinaja japolo gui canaeña.
pairs.english: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumonggue y Lajiña guaja taejinecog na linâlâ; ya ayo y ti manjonggue y Lajiña, ti ulie linâlâ, lao y binibon Yuus gaegue gui jiloña.
pairs.english: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE y Señot jatungo, na Fariseo sija manmanjungog, na si Jesus jafatinas disipuluña ya jatagpange megaeña qui si Juan.
pairs.english: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Achogja ti si Jesus namaesa matagpange, lao y disipuluñaja),
pairs.english: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadingo guiya Judea, ya mapos talo malag Galilea.
pairs.english: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janesesita na umalofan inanaco Samaria.
pairs.english: And he must needs go through Samaria.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato pues gui un siudan Samaria, na mafanaan Sicar, jijot gui fangualuan na si Jacob janae si José, lagiña.
pairs.english: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güine y tipo Jacob. Enaomina si Jesus, sa yayas güe guinin y chalan, matachong gui oriyan y tipo. Güenao na ora cana a las saes.
pairs.english: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato un palaoan Samaria para ufanlupog janom; ya si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Naeyo ya juguinem.
pairs.english: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y disipuluña manmapos para y siuda, para ufanmamajan nengcano.
pairs.english: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan Samaria: Jaftaemano na jago y Judio jao, ya untagojit najunaguinemjao, ya guajo palaoan Samaria? (Sa y Judio sija ti manatungo yan y taotao Samaria).
pairs.english: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin untungo y ninaeña si Yuus yan jaye güe y sumangane jao, naeyo ya juguinem: jago ungagao güe ya güiya unninae janom lalâlâ.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palaoan ilegña nu güiya: Señot, taya siña unlupog, sa y tipo tadong: amano pues nae guaja jao ni y janom lalâlâ.
pairs.english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada dangculoña jao qui y tatanmame as Jacob, ni y numaejam nu este na tupo, ya güiya gumiguinem yan famaguonña, yan y gaña gâgâ sija?
pairs.english: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Jaye y guminem nu este na janom, güiya umajo talo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y guminem uje na janom y junae güe, para todo y tiempo ti umajo; ya ayo na janom y guajo junae güe, güiya y janom tupo, ni jumuyong para linâlâ na taejinecog.
pairs.english: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan: Señot, naeyo nu este na janom para ti siñayo majo, ni jutalo mague para jufanlupog.
pairs.english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Janao agange y asaguamo, ya unmamaela güine mague.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y palaoan ya ilegña nu güiya: Taya asaguajo. Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Mauleg sinanganmo na ilegmo. Taya asaguajo.
pairs.english: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa sinco jagas asaguamo; ya pago y gaegue guiya jago, ti güiya y asaguamo: este unsangan pot minagajet.
pairs.english: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya y palaoan: Señot, pineloco nu jago, profeta jao.
pairs.english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tatanmame manmanadodora güine gui jalomtano, ya jamyo ilegmiyo, na iya Jerusalem, ayo na lugat, siempre nae umafatinas y adorasion.
pairs.english: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Palaoan, jonggue yo sa ufato y ora, na ti este na jalomtano, ni iya Jerusalem, inadora jamyo si Yuus Tata.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo inadora ti intingo. Jame inadora y tiningomame, sa y satbasion y Judio sija güiya.
pairs.english: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jaane umamaela, ya güiya güe pago, nae y magajet na manmanadododora, uje adodora si Yuus Tata gui espiritu yan y minagajet; sa si Yuus Tata, locue jaaliligao ayo sija y umadodora güe.
pairs.english: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus, güiya Espiritu, ya y umadora güe, siempre jaadora güe y espiritu yan y minagajet.
pairs.english: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y palaoan: Guajo jutungo na y Mesias umamaela (ayo y naanña si Cristo); yaguin mato güe, güiya ufanagüejit todo.
pairs.english: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajoyo, ni umadingangane jao.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 27 54990 ¶ Ya pot este manmato y disipuluña ya ninafanmanman pot y umadingan yan y palaoan: ya ni uno siña umalog: Jafa finaesesenmo? pat, pot jafa uncuentutuse güe?
pairs.english: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao y palaoan japolo y batdeña, ya mapos malag y siuda, jasangane y taotao sija ya ilegña:
pairs.english: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmamaela ya inlie un taotao ni sumangane yo todo y finatinaso! Güiya buente si Cristo?
pairs.english: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmapos gui siuda, ya manmalag as Jesus.
pairs.english: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na tiempo magagagao güe ni disipulo sija, ilegñija: Rabi, chocho!
pairs.english: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña na sija: Guaja najo nengcano na jamyo ti intingo.
pairs.english: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y disipulo sija ilegñija entre sija: Buente guaja chumulilie naña?
pairs.english: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y nengcanojo y jufatinas y minalago ayo y tumago yo, ya magpo chechoña.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti ilegmiyo: Guaja trabia cuatro na meses nae ufato y quineco? Estagüe na jusangane jamyo: Fanalagquilo y matanmiyo ya inatan y fangualuan sija, sa esta manapaca para quineco.
pairs.english: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mangoco uresibe y apasña, ya uchule y tinegcha para taejinecog na linâlâ; para ayo y mangoco, ya ayo y manananom mandaña gui minagof.
pairs.english: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este macumple y sinangan: uno manananom ya y otro mangongoco.
pairs.english: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jamyo tumago para infanmangoco ya ti jamyo chumogüe; otro manmachocho ya jamyo manjalom gui chechoñija.
pairs.english: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 39 55110 ¶ Ya megae na taotao Samaria, taotao güije na siuda, manmanjonggue nu güiya pot y sinangan y palaoan, sa manae testimonio na ilegña: Jasangane yo todo ni y finatinasjo.
pairs.english: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae y taotao Samaria manmato guiya güiya, magagao na usaga ya ufandaña; ya güiya sumaga güije dos na jaane.
pairs.english: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manmanjonggue nu güiya gofmegae pot y sinanganña.
pairs.english: And many more believed because of his own word;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu y palaoan: Pago ti pot y finomo na injenggue; sa jame mismo injingog güe, ya intingo na este, güiya y magajet na Salvadot y tano.
pairs.english: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 43 55150 ¶ Ya depues di dos na jaane, jumanao güije ya malag Galilea.
pairs.english: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Potjafa na si Jesus mismo manae testimonio, na y profeta gui tanoña taya onraña.
pairs.english: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este anae malag Galilea, y taotao Galilea maresibe güe sa malie todo y finatinasña guiya Jerusalem, na jafatinas gui tiempo y guipot; sa sija locue manmalag y guipot.
pairs.english: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 46 55180 ¶ Mato, otro biaje, si Jesus, guiya Cana siuda guiya Galilea, nae y jafatinas bino y janom: ya guaja güije un magalaje na y lajiña malango guiya Capernaum.
pairs.english: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog na si Jesus, jumanao gui Juda ya tumunog para Galilea, mapos güe malag as Jesus, ya jagagao na utunog guiya Capernaum, ya uamte y lajiña, sa esta cumequematae.
pairs.english: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Yaguin ti inlie señat sija, yan y ninamanman sija, ti injenggue.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña y magalage nu güiya: Señot, tunog lasajyao, antes qui umatae y lajijo!
pairs.english: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu güiya: Janao, sa y lajimo lâlâ! Jajonggue y taotao y sinangan Jesus ni y sinangane güe, ya mapos.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae güiya tumutunog, y familiaña matagam güe ya masangane na ilegñija, Na y lajimo lâlâ!
pairs.english: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mamaesen jafa na ora y lajiña na mumauleg, ya ilegñija: Nigap gui las siete na ora pinelo ni calenturaña.
pairs.english: Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jatungo y tataña enao na ora nae sinangane güe as Jesus, Y lajimo lâlâ; ya güiya namaesa jajonggue yan todo y familiaña!
pairs.english: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y mina dos na señat, na jafatinas si Jesus, anae jinanaoña guiya Judea, para Galilea.
pairs.english: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan este sija, guaja gupot y Judio sija ya si Jesus cajulo guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya Jerusalem, jijot gui petta quinilo sija, guaja un tangque janom na mafananaan gui fino Hebreo, Betesda, na guaja sinco potta.
pairs.english: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manestaba güije megagae na manmalango: bachet, mangojo, yan mansogsog.
pairs.english: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije un taotao na esta malofan treinta y ocho años na malango.
pairs.english: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Linie as Jesus na umaason, ya anae jatungo na amam na tiempo, ilegña nu güiya: Malago jao na umagong?
pairs.english: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe güe ni y malango: Señot, taya jaye yo unninajalom gui tangque y tiempo nae y janom sigue ni calalamten, ya anae jumajanaoyo, otro tumunog antes qui guajo.
pairs.english: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sinanangane as Jesus: Cajulojao, jatsa y camamo ya unjanao!
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas magong y chetnot ayo na taotao, ya jajatsa y camaña ya mapos. Lao ayo na jaane sabado.
pairs.english: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 10 55350 ¶ Ylegñija y Judio sija nu y manamagong: Sabado, este na jaane, ti tunas unchule y camamo!
pairs.english: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe: Ayo y munamagong yo, güiya namaesa sumangane yo: jatsa y camamo ya unjanao.
pairs.english: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mafaesen güe: Jaye enao na taotao y sumangane jao, na unjatsa y camamo yan unjanao?
pairs.english: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y guinin minamagong güe, ti jatungo jaye; sa si Jesus esta mapos, sa gaegue güije na lugat, un linajyan taotao.
pairs.english: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sineda güe despues as Jesus, gui templo, ya ilegña: Estagüe esta magong jao; chamo umiisao talo no sea na taelayeña qui este ufato guiya jago.
pairs.english: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na taotao mapos, ya jasangane Judio sija na si Jesus ninamagong y chetnotña.
pairs.english: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na rason, y Judio sija madulalag si Jesus, sa y jafatinas este na güinaja gui sabado na jaane.
pairs.english: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Jesus maninepe: Si tatajo jafatitinas asta pago, yan guajo locue jufatitinas.
pairs.english: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na rason y Judio sija japrocura mas dangculo para ujapuno, say ti janainaleja y sabado na jaane, lao pot y jasangan locue na si Yuus güiya y tataña; jafatitinas güiyaja parejo yan si Yuus.
pairs.english: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 19 55440 ¶ Entonses si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Ti siña y Lajiña jafatinas jafa pot güiya namaesa, lao jafa y jalie finatinas y tata; sa todo y finatinasña, taemanoja y Lajiña locue fumatinas.
pairs.english: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata yaña y Lajiña ya jafanue nu güiya todo ni jafatitinas; ya jafanue nu güiya y checho ni mandangculo, ya jamyo unfanmanman.
pairs.english: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao si Tata janafangajulo y manmatae ya jananae linâlâñija, taegüije locue y Lajiña janae y linâlâ, jaye malagoña.
pairs.english: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata taya jaye jajujusga, lao todo y juisio, janae y Lajiña.
pairs.english: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para todo ufanmanonra ni Lajiña jaf taemanoja jaonra y Tata. Ya y ti umonra y Lajiña, ti jaonra si Tata ni tumago güe.
pairs.english: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y jumungog y sinanganjo, ya jumonggue ayo y tumago yo, guaja linâlâfia taejinecog; ya ti ufato gui sinapet; lao esta malofan guine y finatae para y linâlâ.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y ora mamamaela, ya pago esta; na y manmatae sija ujajungog y inagang Lajin Yuus; ya ayo sija y jumungog, ufanlâlâ.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüine y Tata guaja linâlâfia guiya güiyaja; taegüineja janae locue y Lajiña, para uguaja linâlâña guiya güiyaja:
pairs.english: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janae locue ninasiñaña para ufatinas juisio, sa güiya y Lajin taotao.
pairs.english: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo ninafanmamanman ni este: sa y ora mamamaela, na todo ayo sija y mangaegue gui naftan, umajungog y inagangña,
pairs.english: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao juyong; y fumatinas mauleg, ufanjuyong gui quinajulo para linâlâ; ya ayo sija y fumatinas taelaye, y quinajulo para sinapit.
pairs.english: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 5 30 55550 ¶ Ti siña yo namaesa mamatinas jafa: taemanoja y jiningogco, ayoja jujusga, sa y juisioco tunas, sa ti jualiligao y minalagojo; lao y minalago y tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin mannae yo testimonio nu guajo namaesa, y testimoniojo ti magajet.
pairs.english: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja otro na mannanae testimonio. nu guajo; ya guajo jutungo na y testimonioña, ni y ninaiña pot guajo, magajet.
pairs.english: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo manmatago para as Juan, ya güiya mannae testimonio ni magajet;
pairs.english: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y testimonio ni juresibe, ti guinin y taotao: lao jusangane estesija, para jamyo infanlibre.
pairs.english: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y lámpara ni masonggue ya maniina; ya jamyo infanmalago manmagof didide na tiempo gui candetña.
pairs.english: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y testimonio ni gaegue guiya guajo mas dangculo qui y gaegue gui as Juan; sa y finatinas ni y Tata numaeyo para umacumple, ayo na finatinas na guajo jufatinas; este jatestifica nu guajo, nu y Tata tumago yo.
pairs.english: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tata locue ni y tumago yo, güiya namaesa mannae y testimonio nu guajo. Jamyo tat nae injingog bosña, ni locue ti inlie jechuraña.
pairs.english: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya sinanganña sumaga guiya jamyo; sa ti injenggue na güiya manago.
pairs.english: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Aligao y tinigue sija sa y jinasonmiyo iya güiya nae inguaja y linâlâ na taejinecog; ya sija todo ufanmannae testimonio nu guajo,
pairs.english: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti manmalago jamyo manmamaela guiya guajo, para uguaja linâlâ.
pairs.english: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynenra y taotao sija, guajo ti juresibe.
pairs.english: I receive not honour from men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo jutungo jamyo na taya y güinaeyan Yuus ni y gaegueja guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo mato yo pot y naan Tatajo, ya ti inresibe yo; yaguin otro mato pot y naanña namaesa, ayo inresibe.
pairs.english: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna siña injenggue jamyo ni y rumesibe inenra uno sija yan otro, ya ti inaligao y inenraja na mato guine as Yuus na unoja?
pairs.english: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti injaso na jufaaela jamyo gui as Tata: ya y fumaaela jamyo si y Moises, ayo nae gaegue ininangganmiyo.
pairs.english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Moises.
pairs.english: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin tinigueña sija ti injenggue, jafa muna injenggue y sinanganjo?
pairs.english: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan estesija, mapos si Jesus malag y otro banda y tasen Galilea, na ayo y tasen Tiberias.
pairs.english: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya madalalag güe ni y dangculo na linajyan taotao sa jalie sija y megaegae na señat ni jafatinas gui manmalango.
pairs.english: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus gui un ogso, ya matachong güije yan y disipuluña sija.
pairs.english: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jijot y guipot pascua, guipot y Judio sija.
pairs.english: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae tumalag jilo si Jesus, jalie na guaja mamamaela para iya güiya, un linajyan na taotao, ilegña as Felipe: Manu nae tafanmamajan pan para ufañocho este sija?
pairs.english: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan este para uchague güe; sa güiya tumungo jafa ufatinas.
pairs.english: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Felipe: Dosiento na denario na pan, ti ufannajong para cada uno guiya sija ufañule didide.
pairs.english: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya, uno gui disipuluña sija, Andres, chelun Simon Pedro:
pairs.english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un patgon gaegue güine na guaja sinco pan sebada yan dos güijan na diquique: Lao jafa na estesija, gui entalo y este na minegae?
pairs.english: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Nafanason y taotao. Ya megae na chaguan gaegue güije na lugat, ya manason y taotao, cana sinco mil na lalaje.
pairs.english: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jachule si Jesus ayo sija na pan ya anae janae si Yuus grasias, jaipie todo ayo y manaason; taegüijija locue ni y güijan sija, jaf taemanoja y minalagoñija.
pairs.english: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjaspog ilegña ni disipuluña sija: Joca todo y dinidide ni y tetenjan, sa munga guaja malingo.
pairs.english: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajoca todo, ya janabula dose na canastran dangculo ni y dinidide, dinididin y sincoja na pan sebada, y tejnan ayo sija y mañocho.
pairs.english: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija na taotao, anae jalie y señat ni jafatinas si Jesus, ilegñija: Este senmagajet na güiya y profeta ni para umamaela gui tano.
pairs.english: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 15 55870 ¶ Ayo na tiempo jatungo si Jesus, na ufanmamaela para umacone pot minetgot, ya jafatinas y ray, tumalo guato gui un jalomtano güigüiyaja namaesa.
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta pupuenge manunog y disipuluña sija gui tase.
pairs.english: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjalom gui un sajyan, ya manchinichile ni tase para Capernaum. Ya pago jomjom, ya si Jesus ti manfinatotoe sija.
pairs.english: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo dangculo na napon pot rason un dangculo na manglo na manguaefe.
pairs.english: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta manmamogsae gui tase calang bente sinco pot trenta estadio, malie si Jesus na mamomocat gui jilo y tase ya lumalajijot guato gui sajyan: ya manmaañao sija.
pairs.english: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya ilegña nu sija: Guajoyo; chamiyo fanmaañao!
pairs.english: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmagof anae maresibe gui sajyan; ya ensiguidas mato y sajyan gui tano ni y jajananao güe.
pairs.english: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 22 55940 ¶ Y inagpaña na jaane, y linajyan taotao ni gaegue gui otro bandan tase, jalilie na taya güije mas na unoja na sajyan diquique, ya jatungo na si Jesus ti jumalom gui sajyan yan y disipuloña sija, lao y disipuloña sija esta manmapos sijaja;
pairs.english: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya manmato sija y sajyan diquique guine Tiberias, jijot güije na lugat anae mañocho ni pan, despues di y Señot janae si Yuus grasias.)
pairs.english: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y linajyan taotao sija na si Jesus taegüe güije, ni y disipuluña sija; manjalom sija locue gui sajyan diquique, ya manmapos para Capernaum, maaliligao si Jesus.
pairs.english: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae masoda gui otro bandan tase, ilegñija nu güiya: Rabi Ngaean nae mato jao güine?
pairs.english: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus ilegña: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo; na inaliligao yo, ti pot y liniimiyo ni señat sija; lao pot y quinanomiyo ni pan, y ninafanjaspog jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanmachocho, munga para ayo y fafalingo na nengcano, lao ayo na nengcano y sumaga taejinecog na linâlâ, ni y Lajin taotao numae jamyo; sa güiya sineyo ni Tata, si Yuus.
pairs.english: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa tafatinas, para utafatinas y checho Yuus?
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ilegña nu sija: Este y checho Yuus, na injenggue ayo y jatago.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu güiya: Jafa na señat unfatinas para inlie, ya injenggue jao? Jafa chechomo?
pairs.english: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si tatanmame jacano y mana gui desierto, taemanoja y munjayan matugue; pan guine y langet manmanae para u jacano.
pairs.english: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Jesus nu sija: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti si Moises numae jamyo ni pan guine y langet, si Tatajo janae jamyo ni magajet na pan guine y langet.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y pan Yuus ayo y tumunog guine y langet, ya jananae linâlâ y tano.
pairs.english: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegñija nu güiya: Señot naejam siempre ni este na pan!
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Guajo y pan lalâlâ; y mato guiya guajo, ti uñalang; ya y jumonggue yo, ti umajo para taejinecog.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo; na este inlie yo ya ti injenggue.
pairs.english: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y janae yo si Tata, ufato guiya guajo; ya ayo y ufanmato guiya guajo, gosmagajet na guajo ti siña juyute güe juyong.
pairs.english: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa tumunog yo guine y langet ti para jufatinas y minalagojo, lao y minalagoña ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y minalagoña ayo y tumago yo, na todo y janae yo ti siña junafalingo taya, lao junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este y minalagon Tata, na todo ayo y jalie y Lajiña ya jinenggue guiya güiya, uguaja linâlâña taejinecog; ya junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 41 56130 ¶ Enaomina y Judio sija mamofea güe anae jasangan: Guajo y pan ni tumunog guine y langet.
pairs.english: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija: Ada ti güiya este as Jesus lajin José? si tataña, yan nanaña tatungoja? Jafa pues muna ilegña: Guajo tumunog guine y langet?
pairs.english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus manope ya ilegña nu sija: Chamiyo fanmanmofefea entre jamyo.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya siña mato guiya guajo yaguin si Tata, ni tumago yo, ti quinene güe; ya guajo junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matugue esta gui profeta sija: Ya todo ayo sija ufanmafanagüe finanagüen Yuus. Enaomina cada uno ni jumungog y Tata ya jatungo y mafanagüeña, ufato guiya guajo.
pairs.english: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Munga yo na jusangan sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Ayo y jumonggue yo guaja linâlâña na taejinecog,
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y pan y linâlâ.
pairs.english: I am that bread of life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si tatanmiyo, jacano y mana gui jalomtano ya manmatae.
pairs.english: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y pan ni tumunog guine y langet, para jaye y cumano güe, ti umatae.
pairs.english: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y lalâlâ na pan ni tumunog guine y langet: yaguin guaja cumano este na pan, ulâlâ para todo y tiempo; junggan ya y pan ni guajo mannae, guiya mismo catneco, na junae para linâlâ y tano.
pairs.english: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 52 56240 ¶ Managuaguat entre sija y Judio sija, ilegñija: Jafa muna usiña este na taotao unaejit ni catneña para utacano?
pairs.english: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus pot anão ilegña nu sija: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Yaguin ti incano y catnen y Lajin taotao, ya ti inguimen y jâgâña, taya linâlâ guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y cumano y catneco, ya jaguimen y jâgâjo, guaja linâlâña taejinecog, ya junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y catneco, güiya y magajet na nengcano; ya y jâgâjo, güiya y magajet na guimen.
pairs.english: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y cumano y catneco, y jaguimen y jâgâjo, sumaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya güiya.
pairs.english: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine y Tata, ni lalâlâ, janamamaela yo, ya guajo lalâlâ pot si Tata; taegüineja locue y cumano yo, güiya locue ulâlâ pot guajo.
pairs.english: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüiya y pan ni tumunog guine y langet; ti parejo yan y tatanmiyo ni cumano y mana ya manmatae: y cumano este na pan ulâlâ para taejinecog.
pairs.english: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija jasangan guiya sunagoga, parejoja yan anae mamanagüe guiya Capernaum.
pairs.english: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 60 56320 ¶ Enaomina megae gui disipuluña sija anae majungog este, ilegñija: Majetog na sinangan este; jaye siña umecungog?
pairs.english: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: pot sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa yaguin inlie y Lajin taotao cajulo anae gaegue antes?
pairs.english: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y espiritu mannanae linâlâ; y catne taya probechoña: y sinangan sija ni jusangane jamyo, ayo espiritu, yan ayo linâlâ.
pairs.english: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo palo guiya jamyo na ti manmanjonggue. Sa si Jesus desde y finenana jatungoja jaye sija y ti ufanmanjonggue, yan jaye y uinentrega güe.
pairs.english: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Pot este na rason jusangane jamyo: na taya siña mato guiya guajo, yaguin ti ninae ni Tatajo.
pairs.english: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 66 56380 ¶ Ayo nae, megae gui disipoluña sija manalo tate, ya ti mañija talo manjanao yan güiya.
pairs.english: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus ni dose: Manmalago jamyo manjanao locue?
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Simon Pedro: Señot, jayejam injanao güe? Jago nae guaja sija y sinangan ni taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame injenggue, ya intingo na jago Ayo na Santos na guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus jaope sija: Ti juayig jamyo dose, ya y uno guiya jamyo anite?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangan pot si Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon: sa este y para uinentrega gae, uno gui dose.
pairs.english: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di manmalofan estesija, si Jesus jumanao para Galilea: ya ti malago mamocat guiya Judea, sa y Judio sija maaliligao güe para umapuno.
pairs.english: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba jijot y guipot y Judio sija, na mafanaan gupot tabetnaculo.
pairs.english: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mañeluña sija pot este na rason ilegñija nu güiya: Falofan güine, ya unjanao para Judea, para y disipulumo sija locue ujalie y chechomo sija ni unfatitinas.
pairs.english: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya ni uno, mamatitinas jafa na güinaja gui secreto, ya güiyaja mismo ualigao na umatungo gui publico. Yaguin unfatitinas este sija na güinaja, fanuejao gui tano.
pairs.english: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mañeluña sija locue ti majonggue güe.
pairs.english: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Y tiempoco ti mafato trabia, lao y tiemponmiyo siempre esta listo.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tano ti siña manchinatlie jamyo; lao guajo jachatlie, sa mannae yo testimonio pot güiya, na y chechoña manaelaye.
pairs.english: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infangajulo güine na gupot; guajo ti jucajulo güine na gupot; sa y tiempoco trabia ti macumple.
pairs.english: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangane estesija, sumaga trabia guiya Galilea.
pairs.english: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 10 56530 ¶ Lao anae y mañeluña sija mangajulo; ayo nae güiya locue cumajulo gui guipot; ti gui publico, lao calang gui secreto.
pairs.english: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y Judio sija maaliligao güe gui guipot; ya ilegñija: Manggue güe?
pairs.english: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja un dangculon gonggong entalo y linajyan taotao sija pot güiya; sa guaja ilegñija: Güiya mauleg na taotao; palo, ilegñija: Aje, lao jadadague y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ni uno umadingan gui publico pot güiya, sa manmaañao ni Judio sija.
pairs.english: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 14 56570 ¶ Anae y entalo y guipot, cajulo si Jesus gui templo ya mamanagüe.
pairs.english: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna y Judio sija manamanman ya ilegñija: Jafa muna jatungo este letra na ti umeeyag?
pairs.english: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus ilegña: Y finanagüeco, ti iyoco lao iyon ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja y mumalago fumatitinas y minalagoña, güiya utumungo y finanagüeco, cao güiya iyon Yuus, pat jusangan estesija na güinaja pot guajo namaesa.
pairs.english: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y umadingan pot güiyaja, ualiligao y minalagña namaesa; lao y umaligao y minalag iyon ayo y tumago güe, güiya magajet ya taya tinaelaye gaegue guiya güiya.
pairs.english: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
