pairs.chamorro: Ti manninae jamyo as Moises y tinago sija, ya taya uno guiya jamyo cumumple ya tinago sija? Sajafa na inprocucura para inpino yo?
pairs.english: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao manmanope: Anite guaja guiya jago! Jaye promucucuraja pumano jao?
pairs.english: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña: Un chocho guajo fumatinas, ya todo jamyo ninafanmanman.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este si Moises manninae jamyo ni y circunsision (na ti guine as Moises lao iyon y tata sija), ya asta pago gui sabado incircunsida y taotao.
pairs.english: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y taotao resibe gui sabado y circunsision, para ti umapoca y tinagon Moises; manbubo jamyo nu guajo, sa junasenguefjomlo un taotao gui sabado na jaane?
pairs.english: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamiyo injisga taemanoja y liniinmiyo, lao injisga taemanoja y cabales na juisio.
pairs.english: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 25 56680 ¶ Ylegñija locue palo gui taotao Jerusalem: Ti güiya este y manmaliligao para upuno.
pairs.english: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lie na umadingan jafa malagoña, ya taya sumangan jafa nu güiya. Siña na y magalaje sija jatungo magajet, na este si Cristo?
pairs.english: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita tumungo este na taotao, guine mano güe: ya anae mato si Jesucristo, taya uno tumungo taotao mano.
pairs.english: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus entonses umagang gui. templo anae mamananagüe ilegña: Jamyo intingo yo, jaye yo, yan intingo locue taotao mano yo; ya guajo mamaela ti pot guajoja: lao y tumago yo, güiya magajet, ya jamyo ti intingo güe.
pairs.english: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo tumungo güe, sa guine güiya yo, ya güiya tumago yo!
pairs.english: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Japrocura sija para macone güe, lao taya uno mato canaeña guiya güiya, sa y oraña trabia ti mafato.
pairs.english: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae gui linajyan taotao jumonggue güe, ya ilegñija: Ada yaguin si Cristo mamaela, ujafatinas mas megae na señat qui y fumatiñas este na taotao?
pairs.english: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Fariseo sija jumungog na y linajyan taotao manafaesen pot estesija, ya y manmagas mamale yan y Fariseo sija manmanago ni ofisiatñija para umacone.
pairs.english: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina si Jesus ilegña: Trabia didide na tiempo gaegue yo guiya jamyo, ya despues bae falag ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynaligao yo, ya ti inseda yo; ya mano nae gaegue yo, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Judio sija ilegñija entre sijaja: Para mano este, para ti siñajit tasoda güe? Mapos buente para y manmachapon sija anae mangaegue sija gui entalo y Griego sija, ya mamnanagüe ni y Griego sija?
pairs.english: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa na sinangan na ayo y esta masangan: Inaligao yo ya ti inseda yo, ya mano nae gaegue yo, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 37 56800 ¶ Y uttimo na jaane, dangculo na jaanin gupot, si Jesus tumojgue, ya umagang ilegña: Yaguin y taotao guaja minajo umamaela guiya guajo, ya uguinem.
pairs.english: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumonggueyo, taegüije y sinangan y Tinigue: y sanjalomña manmimilalag y sadog janom na lalâlâ.
pairs.english: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan este na sinangan pot y Espiritu, ni para uresibe ayo sija y manmanjonggue guiya güiya: sa trabia taya mananae ni Espiritu Santo, sa si Jesus ti rumesibe y minalagña,
pairs.english: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses palo gui linajyan taotao, manmanjungog nu este na sinangan, ilegñija: Sumenmagajet na este güiya y ayo na profeta.
pairs.english: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palo ilegñija: Este güiya si ayo na Cristo: Y palo despues ilegñija: Jafa? guinin Galilea umamaela si Cristo?
pairs.english: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti ilelegña y Tinigue, na si Cristo mamaela gui semiyan David, yan guinin y sengsong iya Betlehem anae sumaga si David?
pairs.english: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja inaguguat gui entalo linajyan taotao pot güiya.
pairs.english: So there was a division among the people because of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja guiya sija y manmalago na ujacone, lao taya uno siña minajalom canaeña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 45 56880 ¶ Ayonae y ofisiat sija manmalag y magas na mamale yan y Fariseo sija; ya ilegñija nu sija: Sajafa muna ti inchile güe mague?
pairs.english: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ofisiat sija manmanope: Taya na taotao umadingan taegüine.
pairs.english: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Fariseo sija maninepe: Jamyo locue manabag gui chalan?
pairs.english: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada guaja palo y jumonggue güe gui magalaje sija pat y Fariseo sija?
pairs.english: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija na linajyan taotao ni ti jatungo y tinago sija, manmatdito.
pairs.english: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Nicodemo (ayo y mato gui as Jesus antes güiya uno guiya sija),
pairs.english: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manjujusga un taotao y iyota na tinago, yaguin y finenana ti majungog guiya güiya ya matungo jafa y finatinasña?
pairs.english: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jago locue taotao Galilea? Aligao, ya unlie, cao guine Galilea taya nae cajulo profeta.
pairs.english: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manalo guato cada uno gui guimañija.
pairs.english: And every man went unto his own house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Jesus malag y egso Olibo.
pairs.english: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taftaf gui egaan, tumalo guato gui templo ya todo y taotao sija manmato guiya güiya; ya güiya matachong güije ya mamanagüe nu sija.
pairs.english: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y escriba yan y Fariseo sija, macocona un palaoan na masoda gui adulterio, ya mapolo güe gui entalo,
pairs.english: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija nu güiya: Maestro, estagüe na palaoan, guine masoda gui adulterio, anae jafatinasja.
pairs.english: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tinago Moises jatagojam na infagas ni y acho enao sija. Jago, jafa unsangan?
pairs.english: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ilegñija, intienta güe para siña mafaaelagüe. Lao si Jesus dumilog papa, manugue gui tano ni y calolotña.
pairs.english: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya como sisigue mafaesen, manatunasgüe ya ilegña nu sija: Yaguin uno guiya jamyo taeisao, fumagas nu y güiya, y finenana na acho.
pairs.english: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dumilog talo papa ya manugue gui tano ni y calolotña.
pairs.english: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjungog sija, manjajanao juyong uno yan uno, matutujon gui mansenbijo asta y manuttimo; ya si Jesus sumaga yan y palaoan ni y gaegue gui entalo.
pairs.english: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo si Jesus, ya ilegña nu güiya: Palaoan, mano nae mangaegue sija? taya ni uno nientensia jao?
pairs.english: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Taya uno Señot. Ya ilegña si Jesus: Guajo locue ti jusentensia jao: janao ya chamo unisao talo.
pairs.english: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 12 57080 ¶ Mansinangane as Jesus talo ilegña nu sija: Guajo candet y tano: y dumalalag yo ti ufamocat gui jemjon; ya guajaja candet y linâlâ.
pairs.english: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y Fariseo sija ilegñija nu güiya: Jago guiya jagoja mananae testimonio lao ti magajet na testimoniomo.
pairs.english: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus, ilegña nu sija: Achoja guajoja manae testimonio nu guajo, magajet na testimoniojo; sa jutungo guine mano yo, yan para mano yo; lao jamyo ti intingo guine mano yo, yan para mano yo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo pot y catne injisga; lao guajo ti jumusga ni jaye.
pairs.english: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guajo jumusga, y juisioco, güiya magajet; sa ti guajoja; lao guajo yan Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junggan, ya esta matugue gui tinagomiyo na y testimonio y dos taotao, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo manae testimomio pot guajoja, yan manae yo testimonio si Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu guiya: Mano nae gaegue si Tatamo? Manope si Jesus: Ti intingo yo yan ti intingo y Tatajo; yaguin intingo yo, y Tatajo locue intingo.
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na finijo jasangan si Jesus gui tesoro mamanagüe gui templo; ya taya cumone güe; sa asta pago ti mafato y oraño.
pairs.english: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 21 57170 ¶ Ya ilegña talo nu sija si Jesus: Guajo bae janao, ya inaligao yo, ya y isaomiyo nae infanmatae; mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija entonses y Judio sija; Upuno maesa güe? sa ilegña mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela.
pairs.english: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo iyon sampapa, guajo iyon sanjilo; jamyo iyon este na tano; guajo ti iyon este na tano.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao jusangane jamyo na infanmatae gui isaomiyo; sa yaguin ti injenggue na guajo yo; y isaomiyo nae infanmatae.
pairs.english: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao muna ilegñija nu güiya? Jago, jayejao? Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Nae matutujon jusangane jamyo locue.
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Megae na güinaja yo, para jusangane jamyo ya injisga jamyo: ya y tumago yo, güiya magajet; ya jafa y jiningogco guiya güiya, ayo sija jusangan gui tano.
pairs.english: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija ti matungo na güiya y jacuentuse sija ni pot Tata.
pairs.english: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña si Jesus: Ngaean nae infangajulo jamyo y Lajin taotao, ayo nae intingo na guajo yo, ya taya jufatitinas pot guajoja; lao jaftaemano si Tata fumanagüe yo taegüine jusangan.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tumagoyo, güiya gaegue guiya guajo; ti jadingo yo maesaja sa jufatitinas siempre minagofña.
pairs.english: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jasasangan este sija na güinaja megae jumongguegüe.
pairs.english: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 31 57270 ¶ Ayo nae ilegña si Jesus ni Judio sija ni y jumonggue güe: Yaguin jamyo insisique y sumaga gui sinanganjo, jamyo manmagajet disipulujo;
pairs.english: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya intingo y minagajet ya y minagajet inninafanlibre jamyo.
pairs.english: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope as Jesus: Jame semiyan Abraham, ya ti infanmañetbe ni jaye; jafa muna ilegmo: Jamyo unafanlibre?
pairs.english: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na todo ayo y fumatinas y isao, güiya tentago y isao.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tentago ti usago gui guima para todo tiempo; lao y lajiña sumaga para todo y tiempo.
pairs.english: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin y Lajin Yuus munafanlibre jamyo, entonses magajet na manlibre jamyo.
pairs.english: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jutungo na jamyo semiyan Abraham; lao manmalago jamyo para inpino yo; sa y sinanganjo ti omlat guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y liniijo gui as Tata jusasangan, ya jamyo y jiningogmiyo gui as tatanmiyo infatitinas.
pairs.english: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Si Abraham tatata. Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Yaguin famaguon Abraham jamyo; y chechon Abraham infatinas jamyo.
pairs.english: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manmalago jamyo pago para inpino yo, taotao na jagas jusangane jamyo ni magajet, ayo y jujungog gui as Yuus; si Abraham ti fumatinas este.
pairs.english: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infatitinas y finatinas tatanmiyo. Ylegñija nu güiya: Jame ti finañagon ábale; un tataja guajajit, si Yuusja.
pairs.english: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Yaguin si Yuus tatanmiyo, magajet na inguflie yo; sa guajo jumuyong yan mato yo guinin as Yuus; ti jumuyong yo guinin guajoja, lao güiya tumago yo.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa muna ti intingo y sinanganjo? Sa ti siña injingog y finojo.
pairs.english: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo iyon tatanmiyo anite: jamyo ya y guinâumabale y tatanmiyo intatanga na infatinas. Güiya y mamuno desde y tutujoña; ya ti sumaga gui minagajet, sa taya minagajet gaegue guiya güiya. Yaguin jasangan mandague, y iyoña jasangan; sa dacon güe, ya tatan dacon güe.
pairs.english: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti injenggue yo, sa jusangane jamyo ni magajet.
pairs.english: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye guiya jamyo ucombense yo ni y isao? Yaguin jusangan y magajet, pot jafa muna jamyo ti injenggue yo?
pairs.english: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y iyon Yuus, y sinangan Yuus jajungog; ya pot este na rason jamyo ti injijingog, sa ti iyon Yuus jamyo.
pairs.english: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope entonses y Judio sija, ya ilegñija nu guiya: Ti mauleg y sinanganmame, na jago taotao Samaria, ya gaeanite jao?
pairs.english: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Guajo tae anite yo; lao juonra si Tata, ya jamyo indesonra yo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo ti umaliligao inenrajo; guaja ayo na umaliligao ya jajujusga.
pairs.english: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet y magajet jusangane jamyo: Yaguin y taotao jaadaje y sinanganjo, ti ulie finatae para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses y Judio sija ilegñija nu güiya. Pago nae intingo na gaeanite jao. Si Abraham matae yan y profeta sija; ya jago sumangan: Yanguin y taotao jaadaje y sinanganjo, ti ulie finatae para taejinecog.
pairs.english: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago dangculoña qui si tatanmame as Abraham ni esta matae? Yan y profeta manmatae. Jaye jao fumatinas namaesa?
pairs.english: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Yaguin junamalagyo maesa, y minalagjo taya guaja; güiya si Tata y numanamalag yo: ya ilegmiyo na güiya si Yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti intingo güe, lao guajo tumungo güe; yaguin ilegco na ti jutungo güe, dacon yo parejo yan jamyo mandacon: lao jutungo güe yan juadaje y sinanganña.
pairs.english: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Abraham, tatanmiyo mumagof sa jalie y jaanijo; ya anae jalie ninamagof.
pairs.english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ilegñija nu güiya y Judio sija: Asta pago taya jao sincuenta años, ya unlie si Abraham?
pairs.english: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Magajet ya magajet jusagane jamyo, antes qui si Abraham, esta guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto them, Verily,verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmañule entonses acho, para umadagas güe: lao si Jesus mapos gui templo, ti matungo.
pairs.english: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE malofan gui sanmenan, jalie un taotao na bachet desde y mafañagoña.
pairs.english: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafaesen güe ni y disipuloña ilegñija: Rabi, jaye umisao, este na taotao pat y mañaenaña, para que umafañago bachet?
pairs.english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Ti umisao este na taotao ni sija manaenaña lao para y finatinas Yuus ya ufafanue guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tanesesita na infatitinas y checho ayo y tumago yo mientras y jaane; sa an mato y puenge, taya siña machocho.
pairs.english: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae gagaegue yo gui jilo y tano, y candet y tano guajoja.
pairs.english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Munjayan jasangan este, tumola gui tano, ya jafatinas fache nu y tela, ya y fache japalae y atadog y bachet,
pairs.english: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Janao fagase jao gui estanque Siloe (Ya cumequeilegña, tinago). Enao mina maposgüe ya fagase güe, ya anae tumalo guato este manlie.
pairs.english: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este y tiguangña sija yan ayo y guinin manmalie antes, ya matungo na ampmam na mangagagao limosña, ilegñija: Ada ti este güiya ayo y matatachong ya gagao?
pairs.english: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja sija sumangan: Güiya este; ya guaja palo sija sumangan: Ale, lao parejo yan güiya. Lao güiyaja ilegña: Guajo yo.
pairs.english: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jaf taemano mababaña y atadogmo?
pairs.english: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope ya ilegña: Ayo na taotao, naanña si Jesus, güiya fumatinas y fachae ya palae y atadogco, ya ilegña nu guajo: Janao falag y estanque Siloe ya unfagase jao! Mapos yo ya jufagase yo ya juresibe y liniijo.
pairs.english: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Manggue yuje? Ylegña: Ti jutungo.
pairs.english: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 13 57680 ¶ Macone guato gui Fariseo sija y guinin manbachet.
pairs.english: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na jaane sabado anae si Jesus jafatinas y fachae, ya jababa y atadogña sija.
pairs.english: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Fariseo sija locue mafaesen güe talo: Jafa muna manlie güe. Ya ilegña nu sija: Janaye ni fachae y sanjilo gui atadogco, ya jufagase yo, ya manlie yo.
pairs.english: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo gui Fariseo sija ilegñija: Este na taotao ti güiya guinin as Yuus, sa ti jaadaje y sabado. Lao palo sija ilegñija: Jafa muna siña un taotao ni gaeisao, jafatitinas taemanoja y señat sija? Ya guaja dibision gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija talo ni bachet: Jago, jafa ilegmo nu güiya, ya esta mababa pot güiya y atadogmo sija? Ya ilegña: Profetagüe.
pairs.english: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y Judio sija, ti majonggue y esta masangan na güiya, y guinin bachet, ya esta jarisibe y liniiña, asta que nae maagange y mañaena y bachet ni esta jarisibe liniiña.
pairs.english: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmafaesen ilegñija: Este patgonmiyo ni ilegmiyo bachet guinin y mafañagoña? Ya jafa pago ninamanlie?
pairs.english: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y tata ya, ilegñija: Yntingo na este patgonmame, ya bachet guinin y mafañagoña:
pairs.english: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaftaemano pago na manliigüe, ti intingo; pat jaye bumaba y atadogña, ti intingo; faesen güe; guaja sacanña: Güiya usangan pot güiyaja namaesa.
pairs.english: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija ilegñija si mañaenaña, sa manmaañao ni y Judio sija: sa unoja na jinaso gui entalo y Judio sija, na yaguin guaja sumangan na güiya si Cristo, umayute güe gui sanjiyong y sinagoga.
pairs.english: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este ilegñija sija mañaenaña: Gauja sacaña; faesen güe.
pairs.english: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina sija maagange talo y taotao ni y guinin bachet, ya ilegñija nu guiya: Nae minalag si Yuus: Jita tumungo na este na taotao güiya taotao isao güe.
pairs.english: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manope yuje: Cao taotao isao güe, ti jutungo; unoja jugoftungo; na guajo, guinin bachet yo, ya pago manlie yo.
pairs.english: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija talo: Jafa finatinasña nu jago? Jaftaemano jababa y atadogmo?
pairs.english: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe sija: Jusangane jamyo esta, ya ti injingog: Jafa muna manmalago jamyo injingog talo? Ada manmalago jamyo buente locue disipuluña?
pairs.english: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses janafanmamajlao ya ilegñija: Jago disipuluña; ya jame disipulon Moises!
pairs.english: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jame intingo na si Yuus guinin jasangan pot si Moises; lao este na taotao ti intingo taotao mano güe.
pairs.english: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope y taotao ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa na namanman este, ya ti intingo jamyo taotao mano; ya güiya bumaba y atadogco!
pairs.english: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jame intingo na si Yuus ti jajungog y manisao; yaguin guaja maañao as Yuus ya jaosgue y minalagoña, este jiningog.
pairs.english: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin y tutujon y tano, taya nae majungog, ni uno mababa atadogña ni mafañago bachet.
pairs.english: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin este ti guine as Yuus, ti siña jafatinas jafa.
pairs.english: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija manmanope ilegñija nu güiya: Jago mafañago jao gui isao sija! Ada jago fumanagüe jam? Ya mayute juyong.
pairs.english: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 9 35 57900 ¶ Jajungog si Jesus na mayute juyong, ya anae jasoda, ilegña: Unjonggue y Lagin Yuus?
pairs.english: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe ya ilegña: Jaye enao Señot, para guajo umajonggue güe?
pairs.english: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Esta unlie güe ya ayo y umadingangange jao, güiya güe.
pairs.english: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jujonggue, Señot. Ya jaadora güe.
pairs.english: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Guajo pot juisio mamaela yo güine gui jilo y tano, para y ti manmanlilie, ufanmanlie; ya y manmanlie, ayo sija ufanbachet.
pairs.english: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanjungog y ayo na Fariseo sija ni y mangaegue guiya güiya ya ilegñija nu güiya: Jame locue, manbachet jam?
pairs.english: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: An mojon manbachet jamyo, taya isaomiyo; pago nae insasangan, talie; enao mina isaomiyo gagaegue.
pairs.english: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: MAGAJET ya magajet y jusangane jamyo, na ti jumalon gui pettan y guelat y quinilo sija, lao ucajulo gui otro lugat, ayo y ladron yan saque.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumalom gui petta, güiya y pastot y quinilo.
pairs.english: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot guiya güiya y magas y petta; ya y quinilo sija jajungog y inagangña: ya y gaña quinilo sija jaagang pot y naana, ya jacone sija gui san jiyong.
pairs.english: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jacone mapos y todo iyoña sija, güiya jumanao gui sanmenañija: ya quinilo sija madalalag güe, sa matungo y inagangña.
pairs.english: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y taotao juyong, sija ti madalalag güe, lao manmalago guato guinin menaña: sa ti jatungo y inagangña ni taotaoj uyong sija.
pairs.english: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na acomparasion mansinangane as Jesus: lao sija ti jatungo jafa sija mansingane sija.
pairs.english: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 7 58030 ¶ Mantinalugua as Jesus ya ilegña nu sija: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo, na guajo pottan y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y manmamaela antes que guajo, ladron yan saque sija: ya ti manmanjungog y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y petta: ya y jumalom guiya guajo, güiya umasatba, y ujalom yan ujuyong ya usoda y pasto.
pairs.english: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: linâlâñija.
pairs.english: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y mauleg na pastot: ya y mauleg na pastot y linâlâña japolo pot y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao nii maapapase, ya ti pastot; ya ti gaña y quinilo sija, an jalie y lobo ni y mamaela, japolo y quinilo sija ya malago guato; ya y lobo maquinene ya manchinalapon sija quinilo:
pairs.english: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malago guato güe sa güiya taotao nii maapapase ya taya inadajiña ni y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y mauleg na pastot: sa jutungo y iyoco, ya y iyoco matungo yo.
pairs.english: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüije y Tata jatungo yo, taegüijija locue guajo jutungo y tata; ya jupolo y linâlâjo pot y quinilo sija.
pairs.english: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajayo palo quinilo locue ni taegüe güine na colat, ayo sija locue nesesita yo juchule, ya sija ujajungog y inagangjo; ya uguaja un manadanquinilo yan un pastot.
pairs.english: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao na jaguaeya yo si Tata, sa jupolo y linâlâjo, para uchule talo.
pairs.english: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya munajanao guiya guajo, lao jupolo pot guajo na maesa. Guaja yo ninasiñajo para jupolo yan guajayo ninasiñajo para jutalo chumule. Este na tinago juresibe guine y Tatajo.
pairs.english: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 19 58150 ¶ Ya guaja inaguaguat gui entalo y Judio sija pot este na sinagan sija.
pairs.english: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae sija ilegñija: Biju guaja güe, ya babagüe; sa jafa inicungog güe?
pairs.english: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija y palo: Este na sinagan ti sija iyon y biju: Ada siña y biju ubaba y atadog y manbachet?
pairs.english: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 22 58180 ¶ Ya anae mafatitnas y guipot y inefresengumayuus, guiya Jerusalem, ya ayo na tiempo manenggeng.
pairs.english: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus mapos malag y templo, gui corredot Salomon.
pairs.english: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manetnon guato guiya güiya y Judio sija ya ilegñija nu güiya: Asta ngaean nae unnabuebuente y antita? Yaguin jago yuje na Cristo, sangan ni claro.
pairs.english: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Guajo jagas jusangane jamyo ya ti injenggue: y checho ni y jufatinas gui naan Tata, estesija manmannanae testimonio nu guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo ti injenggue, sa ti jamyo quinilojo; (taegüine guinin jusangane jamyo).
pairs.english: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gajo quinilo sija jajungog y inagangjo; ya jutungo sija; ya sija madalalag yo.
pairs.english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo junae sija linâlâñija taejinecog; ya para todo y tiempo taya nae ufanmalingo ya ni jaye ufaninamot sija gui canaejo.
pairs.english: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tata ni unaeyo, dangculoña qui todo; ya taya gaesisiña para uamot sija gui canae y Tatajo.
pairs.english: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo yan si Tata, jame unoja.
pairs.english: I and my Father are one.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 31 58270 ¶ Tumalo manmañule acho y Judio sija, para umafagas güe.
pairs.english: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Megae manmauleg na finatinas jufanue jamyo guine as Tatajo; pot jafa na chechoña inquequefagas yo ni y acho?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maope güe ni Judio sija ilegñija: Pot y mauleg na chechomo ti infagas jao; lao pot ayo y chatfino contra si Yuus; sa jago, taotaojao, mama Yuusjao.
pairs.english: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe as Jesus: Taegüe güi tinigue gui tinagonmiyo, Guajo umalog: Yuus jamyo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmafanaan Yuus, sija na mamaela gui jiloñija y finijo Yuus (ya y tinigue ti siña maipe);
pairs.english: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegmiyo ni ayo y jaconsagra y Tata ya matgo guato gui tano: Jago chumatfino as Yuus, sa jusangan: Guajo Lajin Yuus?
pairs.english: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jufatitinas y ti iyon Tata, munga injenggue yo.
pairs.english: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin jufatinas, achogja ti injenggue yo, jenggue y checho sija: para siña jamyo intingo ya injenggue na si Tata gaegue guiya guajo, ya guajo gaegue guiya Tata.
pairs.english: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japrocucura talo para umaconegüe: lao güiya mapos gui canaeñija.
pairs.english: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo guato talo gui otro bandan Jordan, ayo na lugat nae finenana managpapange si Juan; ya sumaga güije.
pairs.english: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae manmato guiya güiya ya ilegñija: Si Juan magajet na ni un señat jafatinas; ya magajet todo y sinangan Juan nu este na taotao jumuyong magajet.
pairs.english: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae manmanjonggue güije nu güiya.
pairs.english: And many believed on him there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTABA entonses malango un taotao, naanña si Lasaro, taotao Betania, un songsong iyon Maria yan si Marta cheluña.
pairs.english: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Maria uje y pumalae inggüente y Señot, ya jasaosao y adengña ni y gaponiluña, ya y cheluña, as Lasaro, estaba malango.
pairs.english: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanago y mañeluña famalaoan guiya güiya ilegñija: Señot, estagüe, ayo y unguaeya esta malango.
pairs.english: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jajungog si Jesus, ilegña: Este na chetnot ti güiya y para matae, lao para minalag gui as Yuus, para y Lajin Yuus umaonra pot güiya.
pairs.english: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaguaeya si Jesus si Marta yan y cheluña yan si Lasaro.
pairs.english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog, na estaba malango, ayo na tiempo sumagagüe dos dias güije na lugat anae gaegue.
pairs.english: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di este ilegña ni y disipuluña: Nije tafanmalag Judea talo.
pairs.english: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija nu güiya y disipulo sija: Rabi, pago didide nae maquequechague jao ni Judio sija na unmafagas ni y acho: Ada untalo guato güije?
pairs.english: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus: Taya y un jaane dose ora? y jumajanao gui jaane, ti siña matompo, sa manlilie y candet este na tano.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y jumajanao an puenge, matompo, sa taya candet guiya güiya.
pairs.english: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan estesija, ya despues di este ilegña nu sija: Lasaro, amigonmame maego: ya bae janao para uyayajo gui maegoña.
pairs.english: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ilegñija nu güiya y disipulosija: Señot, yaguin maego, mauleg jumuyong.
pairs.english: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasangan este si Jesus gui tinataeña: sija jajaso na umadingan na dumescansañaeñaejon gui maegoña.
pairs.english: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña claro nu sija: Lasaro, güiya matae.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magof yo sa taegüe yo güije, pot causa y jamyo, para injenggue; nitafanmalag y ya güiya.
pairs.english: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Tomas, ayo y naanña si Didimo, ilegña nu y otro disipulo sija: ufanmalagjit locue, nije tafanmatae yan güiya.
pairs.english: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Jesus ya jasoda na estaba cuatro na jaane gui naftan.
pairs.english: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Betania jijot guiya Jerusalem, buente quince na estadio.
pairs.english: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na Judio sija manmato gui as Marta ya si Maria para uconsuela pot y cheluñija.
pairs.english: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Marta, anae jajungog na si Jesus mamamaela, jajanao güe para urisibe: ya estaba si Maria matatachong gui guima.
pairs.english: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao si Marta ilegña as Jesus: Señot yaguin mojon gaeguejao güine y chelujo ti umatae.
pairs.english: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jutungo pago, todo y ungagao si Yuus, ninaejao as Yuus.
pairs.english: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu güiya: Ucajulo talo y chelumo.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Marta ilegña nu güiya: Guajo jutungo na ucajulo gui quinajulon manmatae gui uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajo y quinajulon manmatae yan y linâlâ; ayo y jumonggue yo, achogja esta matae, ulâlâ talo;
pairs.english: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo y lâlâ ya jumonggue yo, ti umatae para todo y tiempo. Unjonggue este?
pairs.english: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya: Si Señot, guinin jujonggue na jago ayo na Cristo, Lajin Yuus, güiya na para umamaela gui tano.
pairs.english: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan este, mapos ya jaagang gui secreto si Maria cheluña, ilegña: Si Maestro estagüe ya inagagangejao.
pairs.english: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jajungog, cajulo gusisija ya jumanao asta guiya güiya.
pairs.english: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya asta pago ti mafato si Jesus gui sengsong, lao gaegue güije na lugat anae si Marta jagas sineda güe.)
pairs.english: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonces y Judiosija na manestaba gui guima yan güiya, y maconsuela güe, anae jalie si Maria cajulo gusisija ya mapos, madalalag güe, pineloñija na ufalag y naftan para utanges güije.
pairs.english: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
