pairs.chamorro: Ya si Maria anae mato gui lugat anae estaba si Jesus ya jalie, japodong gui adengña, ya ilegña: Señot yaguin gaeguejao güine ti umatae y chelujo.
pairs.english: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Jesus jalie na tumatanges, yan y Judio sija ni manamamamaela yan güiya manatanges, umugong gui espiritu, ya inestotba,
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Mano nae unpolo güe? Ilegñija nu güiya: Señot, maela ya unlie.
pairs.english: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus tumanges.
pairs.english: Jesus wept.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegñija entonses y Judio sija: Estagüe, taegüenao jaguflie güe!
pairs.english: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao palo guiya sija ilegñija: Ti siña este na ubaba y atadog y bachet, fatinas ni este ti umatae?
pairs.english: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus jaumugong talo guiya güiya, ya mato gui naftan. Güiya un liyang ya mapoluye un acho gui sanjiloña.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus: Najanao y acho. Si Marta, chelun y matae, ilegña nu güiya: Señot, mutong esta, sa finatae cuatro na jaane.
pairs.english: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Ti guinin jusangane jao na guin manjonggue jao, unlie y minalag Yuus.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae sija janajanao y acho, Ya si Jesus tumalag julo ya ilegña: Tata, grasias junaejao sa guinin unjungog yo.
pairs.english: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo jutungo na siempre unjungungog yo; lao pot y linajyan taotao ni gaegue gui oriyajo, jusangan este, para ujajonggue na jagoyo tumago.
pairs.english: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan este, umaagang ni dangculo na inagang: Lasaro maela juyong.
pairs.english: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ayo y guine matae, jumuyong, magogode dos canaeña yan y adeng nu y bendas; ya y mataña mafalulutan nu y sudario. Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Pula ya inpilo ya ujanao.
pairs.english: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 45 58830 ¶ Pot este megae na Judio sija na manmato gui as Maria ya jalie y finatinas Jesus, majonggue güe.
pairs.english: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guajo guiya sija na manmapos para Fariseo sija, ya jasangane sija y finatinas Jesus.
pairs.english: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 47 58850 ¶ Ayo nae y manmagas y mamale yan y Fariseo sija, mandaña ya janaetnon y sinedrio ya ilegñija: Jafa tafatinas? Sa este na taotao mamatitinas megae na señat sija?
pairs.english: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin tapolo taegüenao, todo y taotao manmanjonggue guiya güiya: ya ufanmamaela y Romano sija ya u janajanao y sagata yan y tanota.
pairs.english: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Caefas uno guiya sija, güiya magas na pale güije na sacan, mansinangane: Jamyo ti intingo jafa!
pairs.english: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni injaso na mauleg para jita sa un taotao matae pot y taotao sija, para munga na todo y nasion ufanmalingo.
pairs.english: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este ti jasangan guine güiyaja; lao güiya y magas na pale güije na sacan ya japrofetisa na si Jesus umatae pot y nasion.
pairs.english: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti pot ayoja na nasion; lao locue para ufandaña gui unoja y famaguon Yuus ni y jagas manmachalapon.
pairs.english: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo na jaane manafaesen entre para sija umapuno.
pairs.english: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ti jumajanao gui publico gui entalo Judio sija; lao mapos güije para y tano na jijot gui jalomtano, guiya un siuda na mafananaan Efraim; ya sumaga güe güije yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 55 58930 ¶ Ya y pascuan Judio sija estaba jijot; ya megae gui tano mangajulo guiya Jerusalem antes di pascua para ujanagasgas sija.
pairs.english: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanaligao as Jesus, ya manadingan entre sija gui templo, ya ilegñija: Jafa jinasonmiyo, nu güiya, ti umamaela gui guipot.
pairs.english: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y prinsipin y mamale sija yan y Fariseo manmanae tinago na yaguin jaye tumungo mano nae gaegue, umasangan para inquene güe.
pairs.english: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO na tiempo, saes na jaane antes de pascua, si Jesus malag Betania anae estaba si Lasaro, ayo y guinin matee, ya si Jesus munacajulo guine y entelo manmatae.
pairs.english: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanmatinas güije un sena, ya si Marta mañeñetbe; ya si Lasaro, güiya uno gui entalo sija na manmatatachong gui lamasa yan güiya.
pairs.english: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Maria jachule un libra na inggüente, gasgas na natda, guefguaguan, ya japalae y adeng Jesus, ya jasaosao y adengña nu gaponuluña; ya bula y guima ni pao inggüente.
pairs.english: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña uno gui disipuluña, si Judas Iscariote lajin Simon, ayo y umintrega güe,
pairs.english: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafa mina ti mabende este na inggüente pot tres siento denario na salape, ya unumae y mamobble?
pairs.english: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ilegña, ti pot inadajiña ni mamobble; lao pot guiya y saque, ya guaja y betsaña, ya jachuchule ayo y sinajguanña.
pairs.english: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña si Jesus, Polo güe, para ayo na jaane nae majafot yo, na uadaje este.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y mamobble siempre gagaegue guiya jamyo; lao guajo taegüeyo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 9 59040 ¶ Entonses, dangculo na linajyan taotao, gui Judio sija, jatungo na gaegue güe güije, ya manmato, ti pot causan si Jesusja, lao locue para umalie si Lasaro ni guinin janacajulo guine y entelo manmatae.
pairs.english: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafaesen entre sija, manmagas y mamale sija, para umapuno locue si Lasaro.
pairs.english: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot causa di güiya, megae na Judio sija manmalag ayo ya manmanjonggue gui as Jesus.
pairs.english: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 12 59070 ¶ Ynagpaña na jaane, dangculo na linajyan taotao, y manmato gui guipot, anae majungog na si Jesus mato guiya Jerusalem,
pairs.english: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmañule ni y ramas y trongcon palma ya manmapos para umaresibe güe ya manaagang: Osana! Dichoso güe ni mamamaela ni y naan y Señot, y Ray Israel!
pairs.english: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda si Jesus un patgon na bulico, matachong gui jiloña; taegüije y matugue:
pairs.english: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Chamo maañao, jago jagan Sion! estagüe y Raymo na mato, matatachong gui jilo un patgon bulico.
pairs.english: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana, y disipuloña ti jatungo estesija; lao y tiempo anae si Jesus esta cumajulo gui langet, entonses manmajaso na estesija este matugue nu güiya, ya sija guinin manmafatinas este sija yan güiya.
pairs.english: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao na estaba mañisija, anae jaagang juyong si Lasaro gui naftan, ya janacajulo gui entalo manmatae, janae testimonio nu güiya.
pairs.english: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao locue y linajyan taotao manmato ya maresibe güe, sa majungog na munjayan jafatinas este na señat.
pairs.english: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao Fariseo sija ilegñija entre sija: Lie na taya probechonmiyo: Estagüe na todo gui jilo y tano manjanao ya dalalag güe.
pairs.english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 20 59150 ¶ Ya guaja sija na taotao Griego ni gui ayo sija na mangajulo para uadodora gui guipot:
pairs.english: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija manmato gui as Felipe taotao Betsaida guiya Galilea, ya magagao güe, ilegñija: Señot, manmalagojam inlie si Jesus!
pairs.english: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Felipe ya jasangane si Andres; ya mamaela si Andres yan si Felipe masangane si Jesus.
pairs.english: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 23 59180 ¶ Ya si Jesus maninepe ilegña: Y ora mato na y Lajin taotao uresibe y minalagña.
pairs.english: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na y granon trigo ni ti upodong gui tano, ya umatae, güiya namaesa sumaga; yaguin matae megae na tinegcha uchule.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y gumaeya y linâlâña ufinalaguaejon; y chumatlie y linâlâña güine gui tano, pinipilanja y taejinecog na jaane.
pairs.english: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guaja y somesetbe yo, udalalag yo; ya mano nae gaegue yo, ayo locue nae ugaegue y somesetbe yo. Yaguin guaja y somesetbe yo, si Tata uenenra güe.
pairs.english: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago lebog y antijo: Ya jafa quentosjo? Tata nalibre yo pago na ora! Lao pot este mato yo güine na ora.
pairs.english: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata, namalag y naanmo! Pot enao mato guine y langet un inagang, ilegña: Estaba junamalag, ya bae junamalag otro biaje.
pairs.english: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y linajyan taotao na mangaegue ya injingog ilegñija: guinin julo este. Palo ilegñija: Un angjet sumangane güe.
pairs.english: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus ya ilegña: Ti mato este na inagang pot y causaco lao pot y causanmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago gaegue y juisio nu este na tano. Pago y magas este na tano umayute juyong.
pairs.english: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo, yaguin guajo umajatsayo guine y tano, jucone todo para guajoja.
pairs.english: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este masangan para umatungo jafa na finatae nae umatae.
pairs.english: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepeña y linajyan taotao: Jame injingog y lay na si Cristo ugaegue para todo y tiempo. Jafa mina unsangan: Na y Lajin taotao nesesita umajatsa? Jaye güe este Lajin taotao?
pairs.english: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Didide na tiempo y candet ugaegue gui entalonmiyo. Fanmamocat mientras guaguaja y candet para jamyo, sa no sea infanguinacha ni y jemjom; sa y jumajanao gui jemjom, ti jatungo para mano nae y jinanaoña.
pairs.english: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras guaguaja y candet para jamyo, fanmanjonggue ni y candet, para unfamaguon y candet jamyo. Estesija jasangan si Jesus, ya mapos ya umatog pot sija.
pairs.english: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 37 59320 ¶ Lao achogja jafatinas megae na señat gui menanñija ti majonggue güe.
pairs.english: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y sinangan ni ilegña si Isaias profeta: Señot, jaye jumonggue y sinanganta? Ya y canae y Señot, jaye guinin munamalie?
pairs.english: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot este mina ti siña sija majonggue, sa tomalo jasangan si Isaias:
pairs.english: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Janafanbachet y atadogñija, ya janamajetog y corasoñija: Sa ti manmalie ni y atadogñija, ni ujatungo ni y corasonñija, ya sigue mamañotsot, ya guajo juamte sija.
pairs.english: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jasangan si Isaias, anae jalie minalagña ya inadingane.
pairs.english: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 42 59370 ¶ Pago na tiempo achogja megae na taotao senmagas, jumonggue gue; lao pot causa y Fariseo sija, ti masangan claro, na no sea mayute gui sinagoga.
pairs.english: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot jafa muna manmalago sija y inenra y taotao, qui y inenra guine as Yuus.
pairs.english: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 12 44 59390 ¶ Si Jesus umagang ilegña: Y jumonggue yo, guajoja, ti jajonggue lao ayo y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y umatan yo, güiya umatan y tumago yo.
pairs.english: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato yo gui jilo y tano parejoja y candet, para todo ayo y jumonggue yo, ti sumaga gui jemjom.
pairs.english: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jumungog y sinanganjo ya ti jajonggue, guajo ti jujusga; sa ti mato yo para jufanjusga gui tano, lao para junafanlibre y tano.
pairs.english: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y rumechasa yo ya ti rumesibe y sinanganjo, guaja ujinisga güe: Y sinangan ni jusangan, güiya ufanjusga güije uttimo na jaane.
pairs.english: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti guinin juadingan namaesa; lao si Tata ni tumago yo, güiya numae yo tinago ni para jusangan yan y para jucuentos.
pairs.english: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jutungo na y tinagoña, güiya linâlâ taejinecog: enaomina ayo sija jusangan; taegüije si Tata guinin jasangane yo, taegüijeja jusasangan.
pairs.english: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA antes di y guipot pascua, jatungo si Jesus na y oraña esta mato para ujanao güine na tano para y Tata, esta jaguaeya y iyoña sija ni mangaegue güine gui tano, ya jaguaeya sija asta y jinecog.
pairs.english: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sena munjayan ya y anite esta jumalom gui corason Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon, ni umentrega güe;
pairs.english: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatungo si Jesus na y Tata jagasja janae todo ni güinaja gui canaeña, ya mato güe guinin as Yuus, ya as Yuus guaguato;
pairs.english: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo gui sena ya janajanao y magagoña, ya jachule un toaya, ya jaafuyut güiya namaesa.
pairs.english: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta munjayan este, janaye y janom gui palangana diquique, ya jatutujon fumagase y adeng y disipulo sija, ya jasaosao nu y toaya na jaafuyut güe.
pairs.english: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae malag as Simon Pedro; ya este ilegña nu güiya: Señot jago fumagase y adengjo?
pairs.english: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Y jufatitinas ti untungo pago; lao ti ampmam untungo.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pedro ilegña nu güiya: Ti unfagase y adengjo ni ngaean! Ynepe as Jesus: Yaguin ti jufagase jao taepattemo guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Simon Pedro: Señot, ti adengjoja, lao locue asta y canaejo yan y ilujo.
pairs.english: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Y esta mafagase, ti guaelaye yaguin adengña esta mafagase, lao esta gasgas todo. Ya jamyo mangasgas pago, achogja ti todos.
pairs.english: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta matungo jaye uje y umentrega güe; pot enao ilegña: Ti mangasgas jamyo todos.
pairs.english: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 12 59570 ¶ Anae munjayan manfinagase y adengñija, jachule y magagoña ya tumalo matachong otro biaje, ya mansinangane: Yntingo y finatinasjo?
pairs.english: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo infanaan yo Maestro yan Señot: ya y sinanganmiyo mauleg; sa guajo yo.
pairs.english: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guajo Señotmiyo yan Maestronmiyo, guinin jufagase y adengmiyo, debe jamyo locue infanafagase y adengmiyo uno yan otro.
pairs.english: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un ejemplo junae jamyo, sa taemanoja guajo jufatinase jamyo, jamyo locue infatitinas.
pairs.english: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y tintago ti güiya magasña na y senotña; ni y matago, ti güiya magasña na y tumago güe.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin intingo este sija na güinaja, mandichoso jamyo yaguin infatitinas,
pairs.english: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 18 59630 ¶ Ti umadingan yo nu jamyo todo: guajo tumungo sija y inayigco; lao para umacumple y tinigue sija: Y chumocho pan yan guajo, güiya cumajulo contra guajo y dedegoña.
pairs.english: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde pago jusangane jamyo antes di ujuyong, para yaguin jumujuyong, injenggue na guajo yo.
pairs.english: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo, na y rumesibe y tinagojo, jaresibe yo; ya y rumesibe yo, jaresibe y tumago yo.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Jesus sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipulo sija manaatan entre sija uno yan otro ya ti matungo jaye umadingan.
pairs.english: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y uno gui disipuluña na guiniflie as Jesus, estaba umaason gui pechon Jesus.
pairs.english: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Simon Pedro fumatinas señat nu este, para umafaesen jaye uje na umadingan.
pairs.english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae, y umaason gui jilo pechon Jesus ilegña nu güiya: Señot jaye uje?
pairs.english: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina manope si Jesus: Ayo uje ni junafotgue ni pan ya junae güe. Ya janafotgon y pan, ya janae si Judas Iscariote, lajin Simon.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan y quinanoña ni y pan fotgon, si Satanas jumalom guiya güiya. Entonses si Jesus sinangane: Fatinas guse y finatinasmo.
pairs.english: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni uno, guiya sija na mangaegue gui lamasa, tumungo pot jafa na umasangane.
pairs.english: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pineloñija y palo guiya sija, sa si Judas na gaebetsa, na si Jesus sumangane: Fajan y güinaja na mannesesitajit para y guipot; pat ufanmanae y mamobble.
pairs.english: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya, guinin mañule y pan fotgon, enseguidas mapos; ya esta puenge.
pairs.english: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 31 59760 ¶ Pot enao, anae esta mapos güe, ilegña si Jesus: Pago y Lajin taotao rumesisibe y minalagña, ya si Yuus rumesibe y minalagña guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus minamalag güe guiya güiya; ya enseguidas unamalag güe.
pairs.english: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mandiquique na fumaguon, ti juapmam guiya jamyo; ya inaligao yo; ya taegüenoja jusangane y Judio sija: Mano yo guato, jamyo ti siña manmamaela; taemanoja pago jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Un tinago nuebo junae jamyo, na infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo; taegüije yan guajo juguaeya jamyo, ya jamyo locue infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo.
pairs.english: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este todo y taotao ufanmatungo na jamyo disipulujo, yaguin infanguaeya uno yan otro entre jamyo.
pairs.english: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Simon Pedro ilegña nu güiya: Señot, para mano jao? Ynepe as Jesus: Mano yo guato, ti siña jao pago undalalag yo, lao ti apmam undalalag yo.
pairs.english: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Pedro: Señot, sa jafa na ti siña judalalag jao pago? jupolo y linâlâjo guiya jago.
pairs.english: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Unpolo y linâlâmo guiya guajo? Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, na ti uoo y gayo asta tiempo na undague yo tres biaje!
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: CHAMIYO ninafañachatsaga corasonmiyo: injenggue si Yuus, jenggue yo locue.
pairs.english: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guima Tatajo nae guaja megae na sagayan: yaguin ti utaegüine mojon jagas jusagane jamyo. Bae jujanao ya jufamauleg y saga para jamyo.
pairs.english: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jumanao yo ya jufamauleg y saga para jamyo, jumamaela talo mague ya jucone jamyo yan guajo; sa manoja yo nae sumaga, ayoja locue jamyo.
pairs.english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mano yo guato, intingo y chalan.
pairs.english: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Tomas: Señot, ti intingo para mano jao; ya jafa taemano tungomame nu y chalan?
pairs.english: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Guajo y chalan, yan y minagajet, yan y linâlâ; taya malag y Tata, yan ti pot guajo.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin guinin intingoyo, mojon intingo locue y Tatajo; ya desde pago intingo güe ya inlie güe.
pairs.english: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu guiya si Felipe: Señot, fanue jam nu y Tata ya basta para jame.
pairs.english: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Megae na tiempo na manjita, ya asta pago ti untungo yo Felipe? Y lumiiyo, jaliija y Tata. Ya jafa muna ilegmo: Fanue jam nu y Tata?
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti unjonggue na guajo gaegue gui as Tata, ya y Tata gaegue guiya guajo? Sa y finijo nu y jusasangan, ti jusasangan pot guajoja; lao y Tata nu y sumasasaga guiya guajo, ayo fumatinas y chechoña sija.
pairs.english: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jenggue na gaegue yo gui as Tata, ya y Tata gaegue guiya guajo: yaguin ti pot este, jenggueyo pot y checho sija.
pairs.english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo: Y jumonggueyo, y checo nu y juchogüe, güiya chumogüe locue; ya mas dangculo na chocho qui este jachogüe; sa jujanao para as Tata.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y ingagao pot y naanjo, bae jufatinas, sa y Tata uresibe minalagña nu y Lajiña.
pairs.english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jafaja y ingagaoyo pot y naanjo, bae jufatinas ayo.
pairs.english: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin inguaeya yo, inadaje y tinagojo.
pairs.english: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa bae jutayuyut si Tata ya infanninae otro Consoladot para ugaegue guiya jamyo na taejinecog.
pairs.english: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya y Espiritun minagajet nu y tano ti siña umaresibe; sa ti malie güe, ya ti matungo güe; lao jamyo intingo güe; sa sumaga yan jamyo, ya ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti judingo jamyo güetfano: jumamaela guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Dididija talo, y tano ti uliiyo; lao jamyo inliija yo; sa lâlâyo, ya infanlâlâja locue.
pairs.english: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güije na jaane umasusede na intingo na gaegueyo gui as Tata, ya jamyo guiya guajo ya guajo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y guaja y tinagojo ya jaadadaje, ayo yo gumaeya; ya y gumaeya yo, ugüinaeya as Tata, ya juguaeya güe; ya jufanuegüe nu guajo mamaesa.
pairs.english: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Judas, ti si Iscariote: Señot, jafa muna unfanue jam nu jago namaesa ya ti unfanue y tano?
pairs.english: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepe as Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jaye yo y gumaeya, uadaje y sinanganjo; ya ugüinaeya as Tata, ya jame infatoigüe güe ya insagaye güe.
pairs.english: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y ti gumaeya yo, ti jaadaje y sinanganjo; ya y sinangan nu y injingog, ti sinanganjo, lao iyon y Tata ni tumago yo.
pairs.english: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusagane jamyo anae manjijita.
pairs.english: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y Consoladat y Espiritu Santo; nu si Tata utinago pot y naanjo, güiya infanfinanagüe todosija, ya inninafanjajasoja todo y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pas jupoluye jamyo; y pasjo junae jamyo; ti taegüine y ninaen y tano na ninaejo. Chamiyo ninafañachatsaga corasonmiyo ni infanmaañao.
pairs.english: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo jagas injingogja jafa y jusagane jamyo, bae jujano, ya jutalo güine mague guiya jamyo. Yaguin inguaeya yo, magajet infanmagof, sa bae jujanao ya jufalag as Tata; sa si Tata dangculoña qui guajo.
pairs.english: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jagas jusangane jamyo antes qui umasusede, para yanguin jasusede, jamyo injenggue.
pairs.english: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Desde pago na tiempo ti jucuentuse jamyo megae, sa y magalagen este na tano ufato, ya taya iyoña guiya guajo;
pairs.english: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y tano ujatungo na juguaeya si Tata, ya jaftaemanoja si Tata jasangane yo, ayo muna jufatinas. Fangajulo ya nije tafanjanao.
pairs.english: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: GUAJO y magajet na trongconubas ya si Tatajo güiya y magas y fangualuan.
pairs.english: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todo y ramas guiya guajo nu y taetinegcha, janajanao; ya todo ayo y ramas nu y gaetinegcha, janagasgas, para umegae tinegchaña.
pairs.english: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago nae jamyo mangasgas pot y finijo nu y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fañaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya jamyo. Taegüije y ramas ti siña mañogcha güiya namaesa, yaguin ti sumaga gui trongconubas, parejoja yan jamyo yaguin ti infañaga guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo y trongconubas, jamyo y ramas. Y sumaga guiya guajo, ya guajo guiya güiya, güiya ufañogcha megae; sa apatte di guajo taya siña infatinas.
pairs.english: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin un taotao ti sumaga guiya guajo, umanajanao güe parejoja yan y ramas, ya umalayo, ya jajojoca, ya japopolo gui guafe, ya ufanmasonggue.
pairs.english: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin mañaga jamyo guiya guajo, ya y finojo sumaga guiya jamyo, infanmangagao todo y malagomiyo ya jufatinas para jamyo.
pairs.english: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este uninamalag si Tatajo, ya infanmanogcha megae; ya taegüenao jamyo y udisipulojo.
pairs.english: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao si Tata jaguaeya yo, guajo parejoja juguaeya jamyo locue; ya fañaga jamyo gui güinaeyaco.
pairs.english: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin inadadaje y tinagojo sija, jamyo infañañaga gui güinaeyaco; parejoja yan guajo juadadaje y tinago y Tatajo ya sumasasaga yo gui güinaeyaña.
pairs.english: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusangane jamyo, para minagofjo usaga guiya jamyo, ya y minagofmiyo ubula.
pairs.english: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y tinagojo, na infanguaeya entre jamyo uno yan otro, calang y juguaeya jamyo.
pairs.english: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya uno guaja güinaeyaña mas dangculo qui este, na y taotao japolo y linâlâfia pot y amiguña sija.
pairs.english: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo y amigujo sija, yaguin infatinas jafa y jutago jamyo.
pairs.english: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jagasja jufanaan jamyo tentago sija, sa y tentago ti jatungo jafa checho y magasña; lao jufanaan jamyo amigo sija; sa todosija ni jujungog gui as Tata, junatungoja jamyo.
pairs.english: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jamyo umayig yo, lao guajo jamyo umayig ya jutago jamyo, na infanjanao ya infanmanogcha, ya y tinegchanmiyo usaga; sa todosija y ingagao si Tata pot y naanjo, güiya infanninae.
pairs.english: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jutago jamyo, na infanaguaeya entre jamyo uno yan otro.
pairs.english: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manchinatlie jamyo nu y tano, intingoja na guajo finena chinatlie antes qui jamyo.
pairs.english: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin iyon y tano jamyo y tano uguaeya iyoña: lao ti iyon y tano jamyo, ya guajo jamyo umayig gui tano, ayo muna manchinatlie jamyo nu y tano.
pairs.english: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaso jamyo y sinangan ni munjayan jusangane jamyo: Y tentago ti dangculoña qui y magasña. Yaguin mapetsigue yo, infanmapetsigue jamyo locue; yaguin manadaje y sinanganjo, umanadaje y sinanganmiyo locue.
pairs.english: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao todo estesija umafatinas guiya jamyo pot causan y naanjo; sa ti matungo ayo y tumagoyo.
pairs.english: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ti matoyo, ya ti jusangane sija, taya isaoñija; lao pago taya escusañija pot y isaoñija.
pairs.english: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo y chumatlie yo, güiya chumatlie si Tata locue.
pairs.english: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin ti jufatinas gui entaloñija chochosija na taya ni uno fumatinas, taya isaoñija; lao pago esta jalie ya jachatlie yo yan si Tata.
pairs.english: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este ususede, sa para umacumple y sinangan nu y matugue gui tinagoñija: sija chumatlie yo, sin jafa.
pairs.english: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin mato y Consoladot, ni y junamamaela guinin as Tata, y Espiritu y minagajet nu y mamaela guinin as Tata, güiya infanninae testimonio pot guajo.
pairs.english: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo locue infanmannae testimonio, sa guinin manjijita desde y tutujonña.
pairs.english: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTESIJA jusangane jamyo para chamiyo, fanmatotompo.
pairs.english: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Infanmayute juyong gui sinagoga sija; junggan, y tiempo ufato nae jayeja y pumuno jamyo, jinasoña na jafatinas y checho Yuus.
pairs.english: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estesija infanfinatinas, sa ti jatungo y Tata, ni guajo.
pairs.english: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estesija guinin jusangane jamyo, na yaguin ufato ayo na ora, injaso estesija, jaftaemanoja y jusangane jamyo.
pairs.english: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago bae jujanao para ayo y tumago yo; ya taya uno guiya jamyo ufaesen yo: Para mano jao?
pairs.english: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pot y jusangane jamyo nu estesija y pinite esta bula y corasonmiyo.
pairs.english: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane jamyo ni minagajet, na maulegñaja para jamyo na jujanao; sa yaguin ti jumanao yo, y Consoladot ti umamaela guiya jamyo; lao yaguin jumanao yo, junamamaela güe guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin ufato güe, ujusga y tano ni isao yan y tininas yan y juisio:
pairs.english: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y isao sa sija ti majonggue yo;
pairs.english: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y tininas sa bae jujanao para y Tata, ya jocog nae inliiyo;
pairs.english: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y juisio sa y magas este y tano esta jajusga.
pairs.english: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guaja yo megae na güinaja trabia para jusangane jamyo; lao ti siña jamyo insingon pago.
pairs.english: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin ufato ayo y Espiritun minagajet, güiya infanfinanue jamyo todo y minagajet; sa ti usangan pot güiyaja, lao todosija, jiningogña, ayosija usangan: yan ayosija y umasusede despues, inninafanmanatungo jamyo.
pairs.english: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ufannae yo minalag sa mañuñule y güinaja na guiya guajo ya ujasangane jamyo.
pairs.english: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Todosija y güinajan Tata, iyoco; ayo mina, jusangan na mañuñule y güinaja na guiya guajo ya ujasangane jamyo.
pairs.english: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Trabia dididija na tiempo, ti inlie yo talo; ya y otro biaje dididija na tiempo inlie yo.
pairs.english: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo disipulo ilegñija entre sija uno yan otro: Jafa muna ilegña este nu jita? Dididija na tiempo ti inlie yo; ya y otro biaje, dididija na tiempo inlie yo: sa bae jujanao para as Tata?
pairs.english: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegñija: Jafa este muna ilegña? Dididija na tiempo? Ti tatungo jafa ilegña.
pairs.english: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jatungoja si Jesus na manmalago na umafaesen güe, ya ilegña nu sija: Manafaesen entre jamyo jafa y ilelegco: Dididija na tiempo ya ti inlie yo; ya otro biaje, dididija na tiempo inlie yo?
pairs.english: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet y jusangane jamyo: infananges yan infanugungñaejon, lao y tano umagof; ya jamyo infantriste, lao y tristenmiyo umabira para minagof.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y palaoan yaguin para ufañago guaja pinitiña, sa mato y oraña; lao yaguin munjayan jafañago y patgon, mafeta nu y pinitiña, pot y minagofña na esta mañago un taotao gui tano.
pairs.english: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago jamyo locue magajet na infantriste; lao yaguin manaliijit talo, ufanmagof corasonmiyo, ya taya siña munajanao y minagofmiyo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na jaane ti infaesen yo ni jafa. Magajet y magajet y jusangane jamyo, todosija y ingagao y Tata, infanninae pot y naanjo.
pairs.english: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta pago taya ingagagao pot y naanjo: gagao ya inresibi, ya ubula y minagofmiyo.
pairs.english: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 25 60660 ¶ Estesija guinin jusangane jamyo gui acomparasion sija; lao ufato y ora na ti jusangane jamyo gui acomparasion sija, lao jusangane jamyo claro y güinajan Tata.
pairs.english: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na jaane infanmangagao pot y naanjo: lao ada ti jusangane jamyo na guajo jutayuyute jamyo gui Tata;
pairs.english: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Tata mangüinaeya jamyo, sa esta inguaeya yo, ya injenggue na mamaela yo guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
