pairs.chamorro: Mamaela yo guinin as Tata, ya matoyo gui tano: lao judingo talo y tano, sa bae janao para as Tata.
pairs.english: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y disipuluña ilegñija: Estagüe, pago na unsangan claro, ya taya acomparasion unsangan.
pairs.english: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago intingo na jago untungo todosija; ya ti unnesesita ni jaye unfinaesenjao: pot este injenggue na jago mamaela guinin as Yuus.
pairs.english: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maninepe sija as Jesus: Injenggue pago?
pairs.english: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe na ufato y ora, ya esta mato pago, na cada uno ujanao para y iyoña, ya indingo yo namaesaja; lao trabia ti guajoja namaesaja sa jumajame an Tata.
pairs.english: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija jusangane jamyo, para infangaepas guiya guajo. Infangaemasâpet gui tano; lao mantiene y minatatnganmiyo, sa guajo esta jugana y tano.
pairs.english: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ESTESIJA jasangan si Jesus ya tumalag jilo gui langet, ya ilegña: Tata, esta mato y ora; namalag y Lajimo, sa y Lajimo unninamalag locue.
pairs.english: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Parejaja unnae güe ninasiñaña para todo y catne; ya para todosija y unnae güe, güiya numae sija taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este yuje y taejinecog la linâlâ, na intingo jao, na unoja y magajet na Yuus; yan si Jesuscristo nu y jago tumago.
pairs.english: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta junamalag jao gui tano, ya munjayan y chechojo nu y unnaeyo na juchogüe.
pairs.english: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago, jagoja Tata, unnamalag yo yan jago na maesa ni ayo na minalag anae estaba jumijita antes di y tano.
pairs.english: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta jufanue nu y naanmo y taotao nu y unnae yo gui tano; sa iyomo, ya unnae yo; ya sija maadaje y sinanganmo.
pairs.english: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago sija matungo na todosija y unnae yo, sija iyomo.
pairs.english: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y finijo sija ni y unnae yo, jusangane sija; ya jaresibe, yan jatungo magajet na mamaela yo guinin jago; ya jajonggue na jagoyo tumago.
pairs.english: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo jutayuyute sija; ti y tano jutayuyute, lao sija y unnaeyo, sa sija iyomo.
pairs.english: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todosija y iyomo, iyoco; ya y iyoco, iyomo; ya guajayo minalag guiya sija.
pairs.english: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pago taegüe yo gui tano, ya este sija mangaegue gui tano; ya mato yo guiya jago. Tata Santo adaje pot y naanmo, ayo sija y unnaeyo, para ufanunoja, parejo an jita.
pairs.english: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae estaba yo manjajame gui tano, juadadajeja sija pot y naanmo; ayo sija ni y unnaeyo ya juadadajeja ya taya ni uno malilingo, lao unoja esta malingo, güiya patgon yinilang; para ujacumple y tinigue sija.
pairs.english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago mato yo iya jago; ya estesija jusasangan gui tano para y minagofjo ubula guiya sija.
pairs.english: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo guinin numae sija ni y sinanganmo; ya y tano manchinatlie sija; sa sija ti iyon y tano, parejoja yan guajo ti iyon y tano.
pairs.english: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jutayuyut jao na unnajanao gui tano, lao unadaje sija gui tinaelaye.
pairs.english: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sija ti iyon y tano, parejo yan guajo ti iyon y tano.
pairs.english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Nagasgas sija pot y minagajetmo; y sinanganmo güiya minagajet.
pairs.english: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüenao jago tumago yo gui tano, parejoja guajo locue munajutago sija gui tano.
pairs.english: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot sija, juconsagra yo namaesa, para sija locue ufangasgas pot y minagajet.
pairs.english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ta ti sijaja jutayuyute, lao ayo sija locue y jumonggue yo pot y sinanganñija.
pairs.english: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa para todo sija ufanunoja; parejoja yan jago, Tata, gaegue jao guiya guajo, ya guajo gaegue guiya jago; sija locue ufanunoja guiya jita; para ujonggue y tano na jago tumago yo.
pairs.english: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y minalag nu y unnae yo, junae sija: para ufanunoja parejo yan jita unoja.
pairs.english: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo guiya sija, ya jago guiya guajo, para ufancabales gui unoja; ya para utungo y tano, na jago tumago yo, ya ungüaeya sija, parejoja yan güinaeyamo nu guajo.
pairs.english: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata! ayosija y unnae yo, malago yo na manoyo nae gaegue, sija ufangaegue locue; para ujalie y minalagjo ni y unnae yo; sa unguaeya yo antes di jiniyong y tano.
pairs.english: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tata tunas jao, y tano ti jatungo jao; lao guajo tumungo jao, ya estesija jatungo na jago tumagoyo.
pairs.english: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guajo minamatungo sija y naanmo ya bae junatungo: na ayo na güinaeya ni y ungüaeya yo, ayo gaegue guiya sija, yan guajo guiya sija.
pairs.english: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: ANAE si Jesus munjayan jasangan este sija na sinangan, mapos yan y disipuluña para otro banda y sadog Sidron, anae guaja un güetta, ya jumalom güe yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas locue, ni y umentrega güe, jatungo ayo na lugat; sa megae na biaje si Jesus jumanao güije yan y disipuluña.
pairs.english: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Judas mañule y inetnon sendalo, yan y ofisiat sija ni manmagas na mamale yan y Fariseo, mamalag ayo na lugat, manmañuñule falot, yan candet, yan atmas.
pairs.english: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus jatungo todosija na ufanmato guiya güiya, ya jumuyong güe gui menanñija, ya ilegña nu sija: Jaye inaliligao?
pairs.english: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepeñija: Si Jesus Nasareno. Si Jesus ilegña nu sija: Guajo yo. Gaegue güije locue mañisija yan Judas y umentrega güe.
pairs.english: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae munjayan jasangan: Guajo yo; manalo guato ya mamodong gui tano.
pairs.english: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tomalo jafaesen sija: Jaye inaliligao? Ya ilegñija: Si Jesus Nasareno.
pairs.english: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Jesus; Munjayanyo jusangane jamyo na guajo yo: Yaguin guajo inaliligao, polo ya ufanjanao este sija:
pairs.english: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ucumple y sinangan na esta jasangan: Ayo sija ni unnae yo, ni uno junafalingo.
pairs.english: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Simon Pedro guaja espadaña, jachule ya janachetnudan un tentago mamale, ya jautut un talagaña gui agapa. Ya y tentago naanña si Malco.
pairs.english: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Jesus elegña as Pedro: Na jalom y espadamo gui baena; y copa ni janaeyo si tata, ada taya para juguimen?
pairs.english: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na tiempo y inetnon sendalo, yan y magas sendalo, yan y ofisiat y Judio sija, macone si Jesus ya magode.
pairs.english: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya finenana machule guato as Annas; sa güiya y suegron Caefas, na magasja na pale güije na año.
pairs.english: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Caefas manae consejo ni y Judio sija, na janesisita un taotao para umatae pot y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 15 61150 ¶ Ya madalalag si Jesus si Simon Pedro, taegüenao yan otro disipulo. Ya ayo y otro disipulo atungo y magas na pale; ya jumalom yan si Jesus; gui quelat y palasyon y magas na pale.
pairs.english: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro gaegue gui sanjiyong y petta. Entonses ayo y otro disipulo ni y atungo y magas na pale jumuyong, ya jasangane y pottera, ya janajalom si Pedro.
pairs.english: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses ayo na palaoan ni y jaadaje y petta ilegña as Pedro: Ti jago locue disipulon este na taotao? Güiya ilegña: Aje, ti guajo.
pairs.english: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaegue güije y tentago sija yan y ofisiat, sija, manotojgue, ya jafatinas y guafin pinigan; sa manenggeng; ya janafanmamaepe sija: ya esta tomotojgue mañisija yan Pedro janamamaepe güe.
pairs.english: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 19 61190 ¶ Ya y magas na pale jafaesen si Jesus jaftaemano y disipuluña yan y doctrinaña.
pairs.english: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inepeña si Jesus: Guajo sumangan claro gui tano; guajo siempre mamanagüe guiya sinagogo yan y templo anae manetnon todo y Judio sija; ya taya jucuentuse gui secreto.
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sajafa mina unfafaesen yo? Faesen y manmanjungog ni y jusangane sija. Estagüe, sija y tumungo y sinanganjo.
pairs.english: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae güiya esta sumangan este, uno gui ofisiat sija na mangaegue güije, japatmada si Jesus ya ilegña: Taegüenao unope y magas na pale?
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe güe as Jesus: Yaguin jusangan taelaye, nae testimonio nu y taelaye; yaguin mauleg, pot jafa mina innachinudan yo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Annas ninamacone güe mangode para as Caefas, magas na pale.
pairs.english: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 25 61250 ¶ Ayo nae si Simon Pedro estaba tomotojgue janamamaepe güe. Entonses ilegñija nu güiya: Ada ti güiya jao uno gui disipuluña? Güiya mandague ya ilegña: Ti guajo yo.
pairs.english: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Uno gui tentagon magas na pale, parientes ayo y jautut si Pedro y talagaña, ya sinangane: Ti julie jao gui güetta yan güiya?
pairs.english: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Luego mandague talo si Pedro. Y enseguidas y gayo umoo.
pairs.english: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 28 61280 ¶ Ayo nae macone si Jesus güine as Caefas gui jalom palasyo: ya ogaan güije; ya sija ti manjalom gui palasyo, pot no sea infanninaale, lao para usiña mañocho gui pascua.
pairs.english: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mapos juyong si Pilato guiya sija ya ilegña: Jafa na finaaela inchichile contra este na taotao?
pairs.english: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanope ya ilegñija nu güiya: Yaguin ti taelaye finatinasña, ti inentregao.
pairs.english: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina si Pilato ilegña nu sija: Chile güe jamyo ya injisga jaftaemano y laymiyo. Ylegñija y Judio sija nu güiya: Ti tunas na jame, infanmannae finatae ni jaye.
pairs.english: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para umacumple y sinangan Jesus ni jasangan, janamatungo jafa na finataeña nae umatae.
pairs.english: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 33 61330 ¶ Entonses si Pilato tumalo jumalom gui palasyo ya jaagang si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jago jao y Ray Judio sija?
pairs.english: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Unsasangan este pot jagoja namaesa, pat otro sija sumangangane jao pot guajo?
pairs.english: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato manope: Guajo Judio yo? Nasionmo, ya y manmagas na mamale, maentrega yo nu jago: Jafa finatinasmo?
pairs.english: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ynepe as Jesus: Y raenoco, ti ujuyong gui sanjilo este na tano: Yaguin y raenoco ujuyong gui sanjilo este na tano, y tentagojo sija ufanmumo, pot guajo, ya ti jumaentrega gui Judio sija: lao pago y raenoco ti ujuyong güine.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Pilato ilegña nu güiya: Jago pues un ray jao? Ynepe as Jesus: Jago umalog na guajo un ray. Guajo minamafañago yo, pot este, yan minamamaela yo gui tano pot este, para umanae testimonio ni minagajet. Todo ayo y iyon minagajet, jajungog y inagangjo.
pairs.english: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato ilegña nu güiya: Jafa na güinaja y minagajet? Anae munjayan jasangan este, tumalo guato gui Judio sija ya ilegña nu sija: Guajo ti mañoda yo guiya güiya jafa na isao.
pairs.english: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo guaja costumbrenmiyo na junalibre uno para jamyo gui pascua. Manmalago jamyo na junalibre y Ray Judio sija?
pairs.english: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses managang talo ya ilegñija: Ti este; lao si Barabas. Ya si Barabas güiya un saque.
pairs.english: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYO nae si Pilato jachule si Jesus, ya jasaulag.
pairs.english: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sendalo sija jadufog tituca para un corona, ya japolo gui iluña ya manaminagago güe ni magagon agaga.
pairs.english: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmato jijot ya ilegñija: Jafa tatatmano jao, Ray Judio sija? Ya manae patmada.
pairs.english: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Pilato jumuyong talo, ya ilegña nu sija: Estagüe na jachule guiya jamyo juyong, para intingo na ni un isao jusoda guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo anae si Jesus mapos juyong, jachuchule y coronan tituca yan y magagon agaga. Ya ilegña nu sija si Pilato: Estagüe y taotao!
pairs.english: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae malie güe ni y magas mamale yan y ofisiat sija, manaagang ilegñija: Atane gui quiluus, atane gui quiluus. Si Pilato ilegña nu sija: Chile jamyo ya inatane gui quiluus; sa guajo ti mañoda yo jafa na isao guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Maope güe ni y Judio sija: Jame guaja laymame, ya segun y laymame, debe umatae, sa jafa na güiya jafatinas maesa güe Lajin Yuus.
pairs.english: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato anae jajungog este na sinangan, guaja güe mas dangculo na minaañao;
pairs.english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumalom talo gui palasyo ya ilegña as Jesus: Jago, taotao mano jao? Ya si Jesus taya inepeña.
pairs.english: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pilato pues ilegña nu güiya: Jago ti umadingane yo? Ti untungo na guaja yo ninasiñajo para junalibre jao, ya para juatane jao gui quiluus?
pairs.english: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope güe si Jesus: Ti siña y ninasiñamo contra guajo, yaguin ti manaejao gui sanjilo; enao mina y umentrega yo guiya jago, guaja mas dangculo na isao.
pairs.english: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guinin este, si Pilato jaaligao y lugat para unalibre gue: lao y Judio sija managang ilegñija: Yaguin unnalibre este na taotao, ti amigon Sesat jao; sa ayo y umanaray, jasangan contra si Sesat.
pairs.english: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Pilato jajungog este na sinangan, jachule si Jesus juyong ya matachong gui tribuna, gui lugat na mafanaan Piso, ya y Hebreo na finojo Gábbatta.
pairs.english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae y tiempo para ufamauleg y pascua: jijot y ora gui las saes. Entonses ilegña ni y Judio sija: Estagüe y Raymiyo!
pairs.english: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses manaagang, ilegñija: Najanao! najanao! Atane gui quiluus! Ylegña nu sija si Pilato: Juatane y Raymiyo? Magas na mamale manmanope: Taya raymame na si Sesatja.
pairs.english: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priest answered, We have no king but Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses maentrega güe guiya sija para umatane gui quiluus. Ya sija cumone si Jesus!
pairs.english: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 17 61570 ¶ Ya güiya chumuchuchule y quiluusña, jumanao para ayo na lugat na mafanaan y sagan calabera, cumequeilegña gui Hebreo na finijo, Golgota;
pairs.english: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae maatane gui quiluus; yan y gachongña otro dos, gui dos banda Jesus ya si Jesus gui talo.
pairs.english: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manugue si Pilato un tinigue ya mapolo gui sanjilo y quiluus. Ya y tinigue: SI JESUS NASARENO, RAY Y JUDIO SIJA.
pairs.english: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na Judio sija tumaetae este na tinigue, sa y lugat anae maatane si Jesus, jijot gui siuda, ya esta matugue gui Hebreo, yan Griega, yan Lating.
pairs.english: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae elegñija as Pilato y manmagas na mamale yan y Judio sija: Chamo titigue: Ray y Judio sija: lao güiya umalog: Guajo y Ray y Judio sija.
pairs.english: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manope si Pilato: Jafa y jutugue esta jutugue.
pairs.english: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 23 61630 ¶ Entonses y sendalo sija, anae munjayan maatane gui quiluus si Jesus, machule y magaguña, ya mafatinas cuatro patte, cada sendalo un patte; yan y tunico na magago locue; güiya taya malagseña, lao todo matufog desde y sanjilo asta y sanpapa.
pairs.english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot enao ilegñija entre sija: Mungajit umipe, lao tapolo suette gui jiloña, jaye gaeyo güe: para umacumple y tinigue na ilegña: Mapatte entre sija y magagujo, ya y tunico na magagojo mafatinas y suette. Estesija y sendalo fumatinas.
pairs.english: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 25 61650 ¶ Ya manotojgue gui fiun quiluus Jesus, si nanaña, yan y chelun nanaña as Maria, yan si Maria palaoan Cleopas, yan si Maria Magdalena.
pairs.english: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Jesus si nanaña, yan y disipuluña ni jaguaeya na tomotojgue jijot, ilegña as nanaña: Palaoan, enaogüe y lajimo!
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Despues, ilegña ni disipulo: Enaogüe si nanamo. Desde ayo na ora y disipulo inadaje güe gui guimaña.
pairs.english: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 28 61680 ¶ Despues di este, jatungo si Jesus na todosija esta manmacumple, para y tinigue umacumple, ilegña: Majoyo.
pairs.english: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gaegue güije un nayan na bula y binagle: Ya sija nabula y espongja y binagle ya mapolo gui jilo un jayo na naanña y hisopo, ya manafalag y pachotña.
pairs.english: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Jesus jaguinem y binagle, elegña: Jocog esta: ya janaeguen y iluña ya jaentrega y espiritu.
pairs.english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 31 61710 ¶ Entonses y Judio sija, sa ayo na jaane y jaanen Preparasion; para y tataotao sija taya usaga gui quiluus gui sabado na jaane (sa dangculo ayo na jaane y sabado), manmangagao as Pilato na ufanmajulog y adengñija ya umanafanjanao güije.
pairs.english: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanmato sija y sendalo ya majulog y adengña y finenana, yan y otro, ayo dos y guinin y matane gui quiluus yan guiya;
pairs.english: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato gui as Jesus, ya malie na güiya esta matae, ti julog y adengña:
pairs.english: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao uno gui sendalo sija, janaadotgan gui calaguagña y lansaña, ya jumuyong y jâgâ yan janom.
pairs.english: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya y lumie mannae testimonio, ya y testimonioña, güiya magajet: ya güiya tumungo na jafa, ilegña magajet, para jamyo locue injenggue.
pairs.english: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa este na güinaja jumuyong esta para umacumple y tinigue na ilegña: Ni un tolang guiya güiya umajulog.
pairs.english: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan locue otro tinigue ilegña: Umaatan ayo ni janaadotgan.
pairs.english: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 38 61780 ¶ Despues di malofan estesija, si José taotao Arimatea, ya disipulon Jesus, lao gui secreto sa maañao ni Judio sija, jagagao si Pilato na güiya unajanao y tataotao Jesus: entonses si Pilato japolo. Ya mato güe ya janajanao y tataotaoña.
pairs.english: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato locue si Nicodemo, na jagas mato gui as Jesus gui puenge, mañuñule un dinañan mira yan chaguan na jajatot, na y minacatña sien libra.
pairs.english: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae jachule y tataotao Jesus, ya maafuyut magago yan paopao, taemanoja y costumbre y Judio sija an manmanjafot.
pairs.english: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na lugat nae maatane gui quiluus, guaja un güetta, ya y güetta nae guaja un naftan nuebo, ya asta pago taya nae mapoluye.
pairs.english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae mapolo si Jesus, sa ayo na jaane y jaanin Preparasion y Judio sija (sa ayo na naftan estaba jijot).
pairs.english: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana na jaane gui semana, gui egaan anae ti claro, si Maria Magdalena mato gui naftan, ya jalie y acho na manajanao gui naftan.
pairs.english: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses malago ya malag as Simon Pedro, yan y otro disipulo ni güinaeya as Jesus, ya ilegña nu sija: Jachule y Señot gui naftan ya jame ti intingo mano nae japolo.
pairs.english: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmapos si Pedro yan y otro disipulo, ya manmato gui naftan.
pairs.english: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalago sija y dos umetnon: ya y otro disipulo malago chadigña qui si Pedro, ya mato finenana gui naftan.
pairs.english: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ñumejon ya jaatan, ya jalie y magago lenso na mapolo; lao ti jumalom.
pairs.english: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mato si Simon Pedro ni dumadalalag güe, ya jumalom gui naftan, ya jalie y magago lenso na mapolo,
pairs.english: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magago sudario na gaegue gui jilo y iluña, ti mapolo yan y palo magago, lao y otro lugat na mabalulutan.
pairs.english: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses jumalom locue ayo y otro disipulo, ni guine mato finenana gui naftan; ya jalie yan jajonggue.
pairs.english: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti matutungo trabia y tinigue, na janesesita na güiya ucajulo guine entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae manalo y disipulo sija guato gui guimañija.
pairs.english: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 11 61930 ¶ Ya si Maria gaegue güije gui san jiyong, jijot y naftan ya tumatanges; ya tumanges, ñumejon papa y jaatan y sanjalom y naftan;
pairs.english: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie dos angjet na minagagon apaca, na manmatatachong, y uno gui para y ilo, y otro para y adeng, anae y tataotao Jesus guine mapolo.
pairs.english: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya: Palaoan, jafa na tumatanges jao? Ylegña nu sija: Sa jafa muna jachule y Señotjo, ya ti jutungo mano nae japolo.
pairs.english: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae jasangan este, tumalo tate, ya jalie si Jesus, güije na tomotojgue, lao ti jatungo cao güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Palaoan, jafa na tumatanges jao? Jaye unaliligao? Pineloña na ayo na taotao y taotao y güetta, ilegña nu guiya: Señot, yaguin jago chumule, sangane yo mano nae unpolo, ya juchule güe.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Maria! Jabira guiya güiya ya, ilegña gui Hebreo na finijo: Raboni! cumequeilegña, Maestro;
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Chamo yo pumapacha; sa asta pago ti cajulo yo gui as Tata; lao janao para y mañelujo ya unsangane sija, na jucajulo gui Tatajo ya yan Tatamiyo, y Yuusjo yan y Yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato si Maria Magdalena ya jasangane y disipulo sija: Esta julie y Señot; ya jaftaemano sinangane güe nu este na güinaja.
pairs.english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 19 62010 ¶ Ya anae esta pupuenge, güije mismo na jaane, y finenana gui semana, ya y petta manmajujuchom, güije nae mangaegue y disipulo sija manetnon sa manmaañao ni Judio sija, mato si Jesus, ya tumojgue güe gui talo ya ilegña nu sija: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, manfinanue ni canaeña yan y calaguagña. Ayo nae manmagof y disipulo sija anae malie y Señot.
pairs.english: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jesus ilegña nu sija talo: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo; taemanoja si Tata ni tumago yo, taegüije locue jutago jamyo.
pairs.english: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, manguaefe gui jiloñija ya ilegña nu sija: Resibe jamyo y Espirito Santo.
pairs.english: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y inasie ni y isaoñija, sija ufanmaasie; ya iyonñija y indetiene sija ufanmadetiene.
pairs.english: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 24 62060 ¶ Ya si Tomas, uno gui dose, na mafananaan si Didimo, taegüe guiya sija anae mato si Jesus.
pairs.english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu güiya y palo disipulo: Y Señot guinin talie. Lao ilegña nu sija: Yaguin ti julie gui canaeña y señat y lilog sija, ya junajalom y calalotjo gui señat y lilog, yan ti junajalom y canaejo gui calaguagña, ti jujonggue.
pairs.english: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 26 62080 ¶ Ya despues di manmalofan ocho na jaane, anae disipulo sija mangaegue talo gui sanjalom, mañisija yan si Tomas. Mato si Jesus, macandalo y petta, ya sumaga gui entalo ya ilegña: Pas ugaegue guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña as Tomas: Namamaela güine mague y calolotmo, ya unlie y canaejo; ya namamaela güine mague y canaemo, ya unnajalom gui calaguagmo; ya chamo tataeinangoco, lao unjonggue.
pairs.english: Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses si Tomas manope ya ilegña nu güiya: Señotjo yan Yuusjo.
pairs.english: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pot y unlie yo, Tomas, na unjonggue yo: mandichoso ayo sija y ti manmanlie, lao manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 30 62120 ¶ Magajet, megae sija na señat palo na jafatinas si Jesus gui menan y disipuluña na ti matugue güine na leblo:
pairs.english: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este sija manmatugue para injenggue na si Jesus, güiya si Cristo, Lajin Yuus; ya anae injenggue, guaja jamyo taejinecog la linâlâ pot y naanña.
pairs.english: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: DESPUES di manmalofan estesija, jafanue gue si Jesus otro biaje y disipulo sija gui oriyan tasen Tiberias; ya taegüine jafanue güe namaesa.
pairs.english: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mangaegue mandadaña si Simon Pedro yan si Tomas, na mafananaan si Didimo, yan si Nataniel, taotao Cana guiya Galilea, yan y famaguon Sebedeo, yan otro dos disipuluña.
pairs.english: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Simon Pedro: Jujanao para jucone y güijan. Ylegñija nu güiya: Jame indalalag jao. Manmapos ya manjalom gui un sajyan; ya ayo na puenge, taya quineneñija.
pairs.english: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae manana gui egaan si Jesus sumaga tomotojgue gui oriyan tase; ya y disipulo ti matungo cao güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña nu sija si Jesus: Famaguon, guaja jamyo jafa para incano? Manope güe: Taya.
pairs.english: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Yute y lagua gui agapan y sajyan, ya inseda. Mayute ya ti manasiña machule gui tase pot y minegae y güijan.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na disipulo y güinaeya as Jesus, umadingane si Pedro: Güiya y Señot. Entonses si Simon Pedro anae jajungog na güiya y Señot jadudog güe nu y magagon pescadot (sa taemagago güe), ya tumayog gui tase.
pairs.english: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo disipulo sija manmato yan y sajyan (sa ti chago gui tano, lao guaja dosientos codo) machule y lagua, na bula ni güijan.
pairs.english: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato gui tano manmanlie guafe y pinigan na mapolo esta y güijan gui jiloña, yan pan.
pairs.english: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña si Jesus nu sija: Chule mague y güijan ni inquene pago.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo anae cajulo si Simon Pedro ya jajala y lagua para y tano, bula dangculon güijan sija, siento y sincuenta y tres; ya achogja taegüenao y minegaeña, y lagua ti matitig.
pairs.english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu sija si Jesus: Fanmamaela ya infañocho. Ya ni uno gui disipulo sija fumaesen güe: Jago, jaye jao? matungo na güiya y Señot.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses mamaela si Jesus, ya jachule y pan ya manninae, ya y güijan taegüenao.
pairs.english: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta güiya y mina tres na biaje na si Jesus jafanue güe y disipuluña desde tiempo nae cajulo güe guine entalo manmatae.
pairs.english: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 15 62280 ¶ Anae munjayan mañocho, si Jesus ilegña as Simon Pedro: Simon lajin Juan, unguaeya yo mas qui este sija? Sinangane güe: Si Señot, jago tumungo na juguaeya jao. Ylegña nu güiya: Pasto y gajo patgon quinilo.
pairs.english: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Tumalo ilegña nu güiya y mina dos biaje: Simon, lajin Juan, unguaeya yo? Ylegña nu güiya: Si Señot, untungoja na juguflie jao. Ylegña nu güiya: Adaje y gajo quinilo.
pairs.english: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ylegña nu güiya y mina tres na biaje: Simon, lajin Juan, unguflie yo? Ninatriste si Pedro na sinangane güe asta tres biaje: Unguflie yo? ya ilegña nu güiya: Señot, jago tumungo todosija: jago tumungo na juguflie jao. Ylegña nu güiya si Jesus: Pasto y gajo quinilo.
pairs.english: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jao, anae patgon jao, undudog jao nu y sentura ya malag y malagomoja: ya anae bijo jao unjuto y canaemo, ya guinede jao ni y otro, ya unquinene guato gui ti malagomo.
pairs.english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este ilegña, janatungo jafa na finatae nae siña namalag si Yuus. Ya anae jasangan este, ilegña nu güiya: Dalalag yo.
pairs.english: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Entonses jabira güe si Pedro ya jalie ayo na disipulo na güinaeya as Jesus dinalalag güe; ya locue umason gui pichon gui sena, ya sinangane, Señot jaye uje y umentregao?
pairs.english: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae si Pedro jalie este, ilegña as Jesus: Señot, jafa jumuyong para este?
pairs.english: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yegña nu güiya si Jesus: Yaguin malagojo na güiya ugagaegue asta qui mato yo, jafa y uguaja guiya jago? Dalalag yo.
pairs.english: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jumuyong este na sinangan entre y mañelo na ayo na disipulo ti umatae: lao si Jesus sinangane, na ti umatae; lao yaguin malagoyo na güiya ugagaegue asta qui mato yo, jafa y uguaja guiya jago?
pairs.english: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 24 62370 ¶ Este güiya y disipulo ni manae testimonio nu este sija na güinaja, ya jatugue este sija na güinaja: ya tatungo na y testimonioña, güiya magajet.
pairs.english: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 25 62380 ¶ Ya guaja locue palo megae na güinaja na jafatinas si Jesus, yaguin ufanmangue cada uno, jujaso na todo y tano ti omlat y leblo sija y ufanmatugue. Amen.
pairs.english: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y finenana na sinangan, jutugue, O Teofilo, pot todo ayo sija, na si Jesus jatutujon fumatinas, yan mamanagüe.
pairs.english: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta y jaane anae maresibe gui sanjilo, despues di munjayan jatago pot y Espiritu Santo y apostoles sija ni y inayegña:
pairs.english: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni ayo locue y jafanue nu güiya lalâlâ, anae munjayan mapinito pot y megae na señat, liniiñija cuarenta na jaane yan manguecuentos güinaja sija ni y mangaegue gui raenon Yuus:
pairs.english: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña yan sija, ya jatago sija na chañija fanjajanao Jerusalem, lao ujanangga y promesan y Tata ni y, ilegña, injingog guiya guajo:
pairs.english: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Juan magajet na managpapange ni y janom: lao jamyo infanmatagpange ni y Espiritu Santo ti megae na jaane desde pago.
pairs.english: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 6 62440 ¶ Enao mina, ayo sija y mandaña, finaesen güe, ilegñija: Señot, malago jao unnatalo guato y raeno guiya Israel?
pairs.english: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña nu sija: Ti para jamyo intingo y jaane yan y tiempo sija, ni y pinelon y Tata gui ninasiñañaja.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo infanmanresibe y ninasiña anae si Espiritu Santo ufato gui jilo miyo: yan jamyo utestigojo sija, iya Jerusalem yan todo iya Judea yan Samaria, yan asta y uttimon y tano.
pairs.english: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este na güinaja, mientras maaatan güe, machule güe gui sanjilo; ya y mapagajes rinesibe güe, guinen liniiñija.
pairs.english: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae maaatan fitme y langet, anae mapos güe, estagüe dos taotao na minagagon ápaca, manotojgue jijot guiya sija.
pairs.english: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y ilegñija locue: Jamyo taotao Galilea, jafa na manotojgue jamyo ya inaatan julo y langet? este mismo si Jesus ni y maresibe gui sanjilo guinen iya jamyo para y langet, umamaela talo taegüijeja anae inlie güe jumanao para y langet.
pairs.english: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 1 12 62500 ¶ Ayo nae sija manalo guato Jerusalem guinen y egso Olibo, ni y jijot Jerusalem, gui sabado na jaana na jinanao.
pairs.english: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae sija manjalom, manjanao julo gui sanjilo na cuarto anae mañasaga todos, si Pedro yan si Juan yan si Santiago yan si Andres yan si Felipe yan si Tomas yan si Bartolome yan si Mateo yan si Santiago lajin Alfeo yan si Simon Selote yan si Judas chelun Santiago.
pairs.english: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estesija todo mañasagaja gui un jinasoja na tinaetae, yan manmangagagao fitme, yan y palo famalaoan sija yan si Maria nanan Jesus, yan y mañeluña lalaje sija.
pairs.english: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
