pairs.chamorro: N 1 15 62530 ¶ Ya ayo sija na jaane, si Pedro tumojgue julo gui entalo y mañelo, ya y numeron y mandaña guaja siento y bente. Ya ilegña:
pairs.english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lalaje an mañelo, nesesita umacumple este na tinigue ni y jasangan antes y Espiritu Santo gui pachot David pot si Judas ni umesgaejon ayo sija y cumone si Jesus.
pairs.english: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya estaba matufong guiya jita, yan guaja patteña güine na sinetbe.
pairs.english: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na taotao, mamajan un fangualuan ni y apas y tinaelayeña; ya japodong papa y mapta tiyanña, ya malagnos todo tilipasña.
pairs.english: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este matungo todo ni y mañasaga guiya Jerusalem; ya pot enao na mafanaan ayo na fangualuan ni y finoñija: Aqueldama, comequeilegña, Fangualuan jâgâ.
pairs.english: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa esta matugue gui leblon y Salmos: Polo ya y sagaña umayulang ya taya taotao sumagaye: ya y ofisioña otro chumule.
pairs.english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Gui entalo estesija na taotao y mangachochongta todo y tiempo anae y Señot Jesus jumalom yan jumuyong guiya jita,
pairs.english: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matutujon guinen y tinagpangen Juan asta ayo na jaane anae maresibe gui sanjilo guinen iya jita, nesesita uno gui entalo sija umatancho testigo yan jita ni y quinajuluña.
pairs.english: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matancho dos, si José ni y mafanaan Barsabas ni y apiyiduña Justo, yan si Matias.
pairs.english: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanaetae ilegñija: Jago Señot ni y tumungo y corason y taotao todo, famanue jaye güine gui dos unayeg.
pairs.english: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para usaouao güine na sinetbe, yan y chechon apostoles anae si Judas ni y podong pot y tinaelayeña, ya güiya ujanao para y sagaña.
pairs.english: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmanae ni y suertenñija; ya y suerte podong gui as Matias; ya güiya matufong gui onse na apostoles.
pairs.english: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae mato y jaanen y Pentecostes, estaba todos na mandadaña gui un sagayan.
pairs.english: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas mato y boruca guinen y langet, taegüije y güinaefen y dangculo na manglo, ya ninabula todo y guima anae manmatatachong sija.
pairs.english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo nae manmato gui jiloñija dinga na jula sija, taegüije y guafe, ya sumaga gui jilo cada uno guiya sija.
pairs.english: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija todo manbula ni y Espiritu Santo, yan jatutujon sumangan y otro na finijo, taegüijija y Espiritu numae sija na ujasangan.
pairs.english: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañasaga güije guiya Jerusalem, Judio sija, na mandeboto na taotao, guinen todo y nasion ni y mangaegue gui papa y langet.
pairs.english: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae majungog esta na boruca, mandaña y linajyan taotao, ya sija manyinalaca, sa cada taotao jajungog sija na manguecuentos ni y finoñijaja.
pairs.english: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija todos ninafanlujan, yan ninafanmanman, ilegñija y uno ni y otro: Ada ti todo Galileo estesija y manguecuentos?
pairs.english: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa muna tajujungog cada taotao ni y finotaja gui anae manmafañagojit?
pairs.english: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Partos, yan Medos, yan Elamitas, yan sija y mañasaga guiya Mesopotamia, yan Judea, yan Capadosia, yan Ponto, yan Asia,
pairs.english: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan Phrygia, yan Pamfilia, yan Egipto, yan iya Libia ni y gaegue gui otro bandan Sirene, yan y manaotao juyong guiya Roma, Judio sija yan proselitos,
pairs.english: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cretensija, yan Arabsija: tajujungog sija manguecuentos ni y finota, y namanman na checho Yuus sija.
pairs.english: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija todos ninafanmanman, ya manbuebuenteja ilegñija uno yan y otro: Jafa este na taegüine?
pairs.english: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y palo sija manmanbotlelea ilegñija: Estesija na taotao manbula nuebo na bino.
pairs.english: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 14 62780 ¶ Lao si Pedro tumojgue julo gui entalo onse, ya jajatsa julo y inagangña, ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo taotao Judea, yan todo y mañasaga guiya Jerusalem, polo ya este umatungo guiya jamyo, yan ecungog y sinanganjo.
pairs.english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa estesija ti manbulacho, taegüenao y pinelonmiyo, sa pago y mina tresja na ora gui jaane.
pairs.english: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este ayo y guinen masangan pot y profeta Joel:
pairs.english: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na umasusede gui uttimo jaane sija, ilegña si Yuus, juchuda y Espiritujo gui jilo todo y catne; ya y famaguonmiyo lalaje yan famaguonmiyo famalaoan ufanmanprofetisa, ya patgonmiyo lalaje ujalie y liniiñija, ya y manbijo sija guiya jamyo, ufanmangüife ni y güinife sija;
pairs.english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na y jilo y tentagojo lalaje, yan y tentagojo famalaoan nae bae juchuda güije na jaane y Espiritujo; ya sija ujaprofetisa.
pairs.english: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya bae jufanue ni y na manman gui sanjilo gui langet, yan señat gui sanpapa gui tano; jâgâ yan guafe yan y asgon y aso:
pairs.english: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y atdao umatolaeca mafajomjom, ya y pilan mafajâgâ; antes di ufato y jaanin y Señot, ayo na jaane dangculo yan magas.
pairs.english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umasusede na masquesea jaye ni y umagang y naan y Señot, ufansatbo.
pairs.english: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 22 62860 ¶ Jamyo taotao Israel sija, jingog estesija finojo; si Jesus, taotao Nasaret, un taotao maasegura na güinaeyan Yuus güe guiya jamyo pot y ninasiña sija yan y namanman, yan y señat ni y finatinas Yuus pot güiya gui entalo miyo, taegüijeja jamyo locue intingoja;
pairs.english: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya manaenñaejon pot tinancho pinagat yan antes na tiningo Yuus, jamyo inquene, ni y manaelaye sija na canae ya inatane gui quiluus ya inpino.
pairs.english: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus janacajulo, ya japula y piniten finatae; sa ayo ti siña maguut güe.
pairs.english: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David sumangan pot güiya: Guajo julie siempre y Señot gui menan matajo; sa güiya gaegue agapa na canaejo, para ti siña junacalamten:
pairs.english: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina y corasonjo mumagof, yan y jilajo senmagof; yan y catneco locue usaga gui ninangga.
pairs.english: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa ti undingo y antijo gui naftan, ni ti unnae y Santosmo para ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jago guinen munatungoyo ni y chalan linâlâ: yan unnabulayo minagof gui menamo.
pairs.english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mañelujo lalaje, siñayo libre na jusangane jamyo ni y patriarca David, na matae ya majafot, ya y naftanña gaegue guiya jita asta pago na jaane.
pairs.english: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine, na güiya profeta, ya jatungo na si Yuus manjula ni y juramento pot güiya, na y tinegcha y lomoña ya unafatachong Uno gui tronuña.
pairs.english: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa guinen jalie este antes, na jasangan y quinajulo Cristo, na y antiña ti mapolo gui naftan; ni y catneña ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y as Jesus ni y ninacajulo as Yuus, ya enaomina jita todos mantestigo.
pairs.english: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taegüine na majatsa gui agapa na canae Yuus, ya guinen jaresibe guine y Tata y promesan Espiritu Santo, güiya chumuda este y inlie pago yan y injingog.
pairs.english: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David ti cajulo gui langet; lao ilegña nu güiyaja: Y Señot ilegña ni y Señotjo, fatachong gui agapa na canaejo,
pairs.english: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta que jupolo y enemigumo para fañajangan y adengmo.
pairs.english: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Polo ya todo y guima Israel ujatungo magajet, na si Yuus fumatinas güe y Señot yan Cristo; este uje y inatane gui quiluus.
pairs.english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae sija jajungog este, manmañiente gui corasonñija, ya ilegñija as Pedro yan y palo na apostoles sija: Mañelujo lalaje, jafajam infatinas?
pairs.english: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Pedro ilegña nu sija: Fanmañotsot, ya infanmatagpange cada uno guiya jamyo, ni y naan Jesucristo, para inasiin y isaomiyo, yan inresibe y ninaen y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y promesa para jamyo, yan para y famaguonmiyo, yan para todos, asta ayo sija y mangaegue gui chago, jayeja y inagang ni y Señot Yuusta.
pairs.english: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan megae otro na finijo janae testimonio, yan jasangane ilegña: Satba jamyo güine gui managuaguat na generasion.
pairs.english: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 2 41 63050 ¶ Ya ayo sija y manmagof rumesibe y finoña, manmatagpange: ya ayo na jaane, maaumenta guiya sija buente tres mit na taotao.
pairs.english: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija sisigueja fitme gui finanagüen y apostoles sija, yan mandadañaja yan maipe y pan, yan an manmaetae.
pairs.english: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya minaañao mato gui jilo todo y ante: yan megae na namanman yan señat manmafatinas pot y apostoles sija.
pairs.english: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo sija y manmanjonggue, mandadañaja, yan manguaja todo güinaja para uiyon todo;
pairs.english: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jabende iyonñija y güinajañija, yan ya manmapapatte y taotao sija cada uno taemanoja y nesesitaoña.
pairs.english: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija sisigueja fitme, yan unoja corasonñija todo y jaane, gui guimayuus, yan an maipe y pan sija gui iyasija, ya jacano nañija ni y mainagof, yan sensiyo y corasonñija.
pairs.english: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Manmanalaba as Yuus, yan mangaefabot ni y todo y taotao sija. Ya y Señot jaaumenta sija cada jaane, ni ayo sija y mansasatbo.
pairs.english: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: SI Pedro yan Juan, dumaña jumanao julo gui guimayuus para ujafanaetae, gui oran a las nuebe.
pairs.english: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un taotao na coja desde y jalom y tiyan nanaña, ya machuchule, ya mapopolo cada jaane gui pettan y guimayuus, ni y mafanaan Bonita, para ufangagao limosna ni y manjajalom gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie si Pedro yan Juan na jumajalom gui guimayuus, ya jagagao limosna.
pairs.english: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inataugüe as Pedro yan Juan, ya ilegñija: Atanjam.
pairs.english: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jaecungog sija, yan jananangga na uresibe jafa na güinaja guiya sija.
pairs.english: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae si Pedro ilegña: Salape yan oro, tayayo; lao jafa y güinajajo junae jao. Pot y naan Jesucristo Nasareno, cajulo ya unfamocat.
pairs.english: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamantiene y agapa na canaeña, ya jajatsa julo; ya enseguidas y adengña yan y telang y bayoguña mumetgot.
pairs.english: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya tumayog julo, ya tumojgue, ya jatutujon mamocat; ya jumalom yan sija gui jalom y guimayuus, mamomocat yan tumatayog, yan jaalalaba si Yuus;
pairs.english: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y taotao lumie güi na mamomocat, yan jaalalaba si Yuus;
pairs.english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija matungoja na güiya ayo y matatachong, ni y umogagao limosna gui Bonita na Petta gui guimayuus: ya sija manbula ni y namanman, yan minaañao, ni ayo y jumuyong guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 3 11 63220 ¶ Ya y anae güiya quinequene as Pedro yan Juan, todo y taotao manmalago ya mandaña guiya sija gui coridot ni y mafanaan Salomon ya dangculo na ninamanmanñija.
pairs.english: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Pedro jalie ayo, jaope y taotao sija ilegña: Taotao Israel, sa jafa na ninafanmanman jamyo ni este? pat jafa na ingueguesatanjam taegüije y pot ninasiñanmameja, pat pot y dinebotonmameja na innafamocat este na taotao?
pairs.english: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus Abraham, yan Ysaac, yan Jacob, y Yuus y tatata ni y janamalago y Tentagoña as Jesus; ni y inentrega yan inpine gui menan Pilatos, anae jadetetmina ya japolo güe na ujanao.
pairs.english: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jamyo inpine Ayo y Santos yan Tunas, yan ingagagao na infanmanae un taotao ni y pegno;
pairs.english: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan inpino y prinsipen linâlâ, ni y si Yuus janacajulo guinen y manmatae; ni y jame mantestigo.
pairs.english: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y naanña, pot y jinenggue y naanña, janametgot este na taotao ni y liniimiyo, yan y tiningomiyo; junggan, y jinenggue, ni y pot güiya, mannae güe ni este na cabales na jinemlo gui menan miyo todos.
pairs.english: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago, mañelujo, nae jutungo na pot y taya tiningomiyo na infatinas ayo, taegüije y finatinas y magalajenmiyo locue.
pairs.english: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo na güinaja y janamatungo si Yuus antes, pot y pachot todo sija y profeta, na si Cristoña ufamadese, ya taegüije ucumple.
pairs.english: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina fanmañotsot, ya inbira talo jamyo, ya y isaomiyo ufanmafunas, para siña ufato y tiempon y refresco guinen menan Yuus;
pairs.english: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya para güiya umatago ayo Cristo, ni y esta matancho antes para jamyo; güiya si Jesus.
pairs.english: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y langet nesesita uresibe asta y tiempo sija anae todo y güinaja mannanalo mauleg talo, ni y jasangan si Yuus gui pachot y santos na profetaña sija, ni jagas mangaegue desde qui matutujon y tano.
pairs.english: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa magajet na si Moises ilegña: Y Señot Yuus, unacajulo un profeta guiya jamyo, gui entalo mañelunmiyo, taegüine iya guajo; iya guiya nae injingog todo y güinaja ni y mansinangane jamyo.
pairs.english: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umasusede na todo y ante ni y ti malago umecungog ayo na profeta, umaguefyulang gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magajet na todo sija y profeta desde as Samuel yan ayo sija y manatate, todos ni y manmañangan, taegüine masangan güine sija na jaane.
pairs.english: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo sija y famaguon y profeta sija, yan y trato ni y si Yuus jafatinas gui mañaenata, ilegña as Abraham: Ya y semiyamo nae todo y familia sija gui tano ufanbendise.
pairs.english: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Iya jamyo nae finena, si Yuus, janacajulo y Tentagoña, ya jatago na infanbinendise, ya ubira cada uno guiya jamyo guinin y tinaelayenmiyo.
pairs.english: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manguecuentos yan y taotao sija, y magas na mamale yan y magas y templo, yan y Saduseosija, manmato guiya sija,
pairs.english: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guesinestotba, sa sija jafananagüe y taotao sija, ya japredidica y quinajulo guinin y manmatae, pot si Jesus.
pairs.english: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmapolo canae gui jiloñija, ya manmapreso asta y inagpaña, sa estaba esta pupuenge.
pairs.english: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao megae sija y jumungog y sinangan majonggue; ya y numeron y taotao sija, buente sinco mit.
pairs.english: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 5 63420 ¶ Ya y inagpaña güije, y magasñija yan y manamco, yan y escriba sija mandaña guiya Jerusalem;
pairs.english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan mangaegue si Annas, magas y mamale, yan si Caefas, yan si Juan, yan si Alejandro, yan ayosija parientes y magas mamale,
pairs.english: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japlanta sija gui talo, jafaesen: Pot jafa na ninasiña, pat jaye na naan na infatinas este?
pairs.english: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro, bula ni y Espiritu Santo, ilegña nu sija: Jamyo ni y magas y taotao, yan y manamco guiya Israel,
pairs.english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin manmachaguejam pago na jaane pot y mauleg finatinas para y malango na taotao, sa jafa muna manajomlo;
pairs.english: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Intingo todo jamyo, yan todo y taotao guiya Israel, na pot y naan Jesucristo, y Nasareno, ni y inatane gui quiluus, ni y ninacajulo as Yuus guinin y manmatae; pot güiyaja este na taotao na tumojgue gui menan miyo ya jomlo.
pairs.english: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya yuje na acho y innataebale jamyo ni y manmanjatsa, na jumuyong cabesan esquina.
pairs.english: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ni uguaja satbasion gui otro; sa taya otro naan gui papa y langet, manmanae y taotao sija, para usiña utafansatbo.
pairs.english: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 13 63500 ¶ Ya anae malie y minatatngan Pedro yan Juan, ya jinasonñija na manaetiningo ya manlanga na taotao, ninafanmanman, ya ayonae matungo na guinin mañisija yan si Jesus.
pairs.english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie y taotao ni y manajomlo na mañisija manojgue, taya jafa siña ujasangan contra ayo.
pairs.english: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jatago sija na ufanjuyong gui dinaña, manasangane entre sija,
pairs.english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Jafa tafatinas ni este sija na taotao? sa magajet na afamao na milagro mafatinas pot sija, ya manmamatungo esta ni todo ayo sija y mañasaga Jerusalem; ya ti siña tapune.
pairs.english: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao trabia mientras ti chachago matalaña gui entalo y taotao sija; nije taencatga sija, ya chañija fanmañangangane ni este na naan desde pago.
pairs.english: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang sija, ya jaencatga na senchañija sumasangan, ni ufanmamanagüe ni y naan Jesus.
pairs.english: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro yan Juan manope ilegñija: Jusga, cao tunas gui menan Yuus na inosgueña jamyo qui si Yuus;
pairs.english: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa tisiña inpelo na ti insangan y liniimame yan y jiningogmame.
pairs.english: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 4 32 63690 ¶ Ya y inetnon güije sija ni y manmanjonggue, manunoja na corason yan unoja na ante: ni uno guiya sija ualog iyoña ayo y jasagagaye; lao todo y güinaja manparejo iyonñija.
pairs.english: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan dangculo na ninasiña na manmannae y apostoles testimonio ni y quinajulo y Señot Jesus: ya megae na grasia gaegue gui jiloñija todos.

pairs.chamorro: Ya janana palo gui baliña, ya y asaguaña jatungo ja locue ayo, ya jachule un patteja ya japolo gui adeng y apostoles.

pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro ilegña: Ananias, sa jafa na janabula si Satanas y corasonmo para undague y Espiritu Santo, yan unnana palo gui balen y tano?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mientras sumasaga, ada ti iyomo? ya anae munjayan mabende, ada taegüe gui ninasiñamo? sa jafa na unjaso este gui corasonmo? ti y taotao undague, na si Yuus.
pairs.english: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog si Ananias este na finijo, podong papa ya matae: ya dangculon minaañao mato gui jilo ayo sija todo y jumujungog este na güinaja.
pairs.english: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato dangculon minaañao gui jilo todo y iglesia, yan y jilo todo ayo sija y jumujungog estesija.

pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pedro, yan y palo na apostoles, ilegñija: Nesesita na taosgueña si Yuus finena qui y taotao sija.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jamyo lalajen, Israel, adaje jamyo jafa jinasonmimiyo para infatinas ni este sija na taotao.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di este na taotao, cajulo si Judas na taotao Galileo, gui jaanen y manmaempadrona; ya jacone un manada gui tateña: ya güiya locue malingo; yan todo ayo sija y umosgue güe manmachalapon.
pairs.english: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago jusangane jamyo: Insetta este sija na taotao, ya inpelo sijaja; sa este na pinagat, pat este na chocho, yaguin guinin y taotao, ufanmayute,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
