pairs.chamorro: Enao mina manjanao gui menan y sinedrio, mansenmagof sa japolo na ujamerese pumadese y minamajlao pot y naan Jesus.
pairs.english: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo y jaane sija, ti mandescacansa manmamanagüe yan manmañangane as Jesus ni y Cristogüe, gui guimayuus, yan y iyasija.
pairs.english: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayo sija na jaane anae lumamegae y disipulo sija, mangogonggong y Helenitas sija contra y Hebreo sija, sa y manbiuda guiya sija, ti manmaatiende gui sinetbeñija cada jaane.
pairs.english: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y dose, jaagang y manadan disipulo guato guiya sija, ya ilegñija: Ti tunas na tapolo y sinangan Yuus, ya tasetbe y lamasa sija.
pairs.english: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina mañelo, aligao entre jamyo siete na taotao ni y manmauleg, ni y manbula Espiritu, yan minejnalom, ya tapolo para este na chocho.
pairs.english: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jita, tasigueja fitme y manmanaetae, yan y sinetbe y sinangan.
pairs.english: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na sinangan, ninafanmagof y manada todo; ya maayeg si Esteban, un taotao na bula jinenggue yan Espiritu Santo, yan si Felipe, yan si Prócoro, yan si Nicanor, yan si Timón, yan si Parmenas, yan si Nicolás proseliton Antioquia.
pairs.english: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmaplanta gui menan y apostoles: ya anae munjayan manmanaetae, japolo y canaeñija gui jiloñija.
pairs.english: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sinangan Yuus lumalamegae; ya y disipulo megae manmaumentaña guiya Jerusalem; ya dangculon manadan mamale locue, manmanosgue ni y jinenggue.
pairs.english: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 6 8 64240 ¶ Ya si Esteban, bula y grasia yan ninasifia, jafatinas namanman na milagro yan señat gui entalo y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja mangajulo güije gui sinagoga ni y manmafanaan sinagogan Libertinos, yan Sireneo sija, yan Alejandrino sija, yan ayo sija iya Silisia, yan Asia, managuaguat yan si Esteban.
pairs.english: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao tisiña macontra y tiningo, yan y Espiritu ni y jasangan.
pairs.english: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmasusuug y taotao sija na ujaalog: Injingogja güe na jasangan y chinatfino contra si Moises, yan contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manafangalamten y taotao sija, yan y manamco, yan y escribasija; ya manmato guiya güiya, ya macone güe guato gui sinedrio,
pairs.english: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmamalo testigo na ti magajet, ni ilegñija: Este na taotao ti malago bumasta cumuentos chinatfino contra este y santos na lugat, yan contra y tinago:
pairs.english: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa injingogja gue ilegña, na este y as Jesus taotao Nasaret uyulang este na lugat, yan utulaeca, y costumbre ni y jaentregajit si Moises.
pairs.english: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo ayo sija y manmatatachong gui sinedrio, maaatan güe, ya malie y mataña na calang matan angjet.
pairs.english: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYONAE ilegña y magas mamale: Taegüine este sija?
pairs.english: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Mañelujo lalaje yan mañaena, ecungog. Si Yuus y minalag fumatoigüe y tatata as Abraham anae estatabaja guiya Mesopotamia, antes di usaga Charran.
pairs.english: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Suja gui tanomo yan y manparientesmo, ya maela jalom gui tano ni y finanuejo nu jago.
pairs.english: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya jumanao juyong gui tano y Chaldeosija, ya sumaga Charran: ya desde ayo, anae matae si tataña, ninamalofangüe as Yuus güine mague na tano anae mañasaga jamyo pago.
pairs.english: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti ninae güe jafa na erensiaña güije, aje, taya ni para upolo y adengña gui jiloña: lao prinemete güe na uninae para güinajaña, yan y semiyaña despues di güiya, sa güiyaja trabia tataepatgon.
pairs.english: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Yuus jasangan taegüine, Na y semiyaña utaotao juyong gui ti tanoña; yan manmacone ya manmancautiba, ya manmatrata taelaye cuatro sientes años.
pairs.english: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y nasion ni y manmancautiba, bae jujusga, ilegña si Yuus; na despues di ayo, ufanmamaela juyong ya guajo jumasetbe güine na lugat.
pairs.english: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan manae güe ni y traton sirconsision: ya si Abraham jalilis si Ysaac, ya masirconsida güe gui mina ocho na jaane; ya si Ysaac jalilis si Jacob; ya si Jacob jalilis y dose na patriarcasija.
pairs.english: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y patriarca sija pot y inigoñija, mabende si José guiya Egipto: lao si Yuus estaba guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninalibre güe todo gui chinatsaga, yan ninae güe finaborese yan tiningo, gui menan Faraon, ray guiya Egipto; yan ninamagalaje güe guiya Egipto, yan todo y guimaña.
pairs.english: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae mato niñalang todo gui tano Egipto yan Charran, yan dangculon chinatsaga: ya y mañaenata ti manmañoda nengcanoñija.
pairs.english: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae si Jacob jajungog na guaja trigo guiya Egipto, jatago y mañaenata finenana na biaje.
pairs.english: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina dos biaje, matungo si José ni y mañeluña: ya y parientes José janatungo si Faraon.
pairs.english: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago si José na umaagange si tataña as Jacob para iya güiya, yan todo y manparientesña, setentaisinco na taotao.
pairs.english: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Jacob jumanao papa Egipto, ya matae güije yan y mañaenata sija.
pairs.english: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmachule guato Siquem, ya manmapolo gui naftan, ni y finajan Abraham pot salape, gui famaguon Emmor guiya Siquem.
pairs.english: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae esta jijot y tiempon y promesa, ni y si Yuus manjula as Abraham, ya y taotao lumamegae, yan manlajyan guiya Egipto,
pairs.english: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Asta qui y otro ray cajulo, ya ti jatungo si José.
pairs.english: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este jausa y malamañaña gui manparientesta, yan jatrata taelaye y mañaenata, sa janafanmayute y famaguonñija ni y pago finañago para chañija fanlalâlâ.
pairs.english: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na tiempo nae mafañago si Moises, ya sumenbonito; ya mapogsae gui guima tataña tres meses.
pairs.english: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mayute, y jagan Faraon jumoca, ya pinegsae para lajiña.
pairs.english: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Moises, maeyag ni y todo y tiningo y taotao Egipto, ya mangaeninasiñaña y finoña yan y chechoña sija.
pairs.english: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae cana jacumple cuarenta años y sacaña, mato gui corasonña na ubisita y mañeluña ni y famaguon Israel.
pairs.english: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jalie uno guiya sija ni y japadese y maltrato, ya jadefiende y mumatrata, ya japuno y taotao Egipto.
pairs.english: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pineluña na jatungo y mañeluña na uninafanlibre as Yuus ni y canaeña; lao ti jatungo sija.
pairs.english: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña na jaane, jafanue sija nu güiya anae managuaguat, ya malago na unaunoja talo sija, ilegña: Señores, jamyo mañelo; jafa na mananataelaye y uno yan y otro?
pairs.english: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y minalalamen y tiguangña, jachonegñaejon, ilegña: Jaye munamagas jao gui jilo mame?
pairs.english: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Malago jao unpunoyo taegüije anae unpuno nigap y taotao Egipto?
pairs.english: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafalago si Moises ni este na sinangan, ya tumaotao juyong gui tano Madian, gui anae jalilis y dos na lajiña.
pairs.english: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jacumple cuarenta años, mato guiya güiya un angjet gui jalomtano gui egso Sinae, gui mañila y guafe gui jalom y trongcon chaguan.
pairs.english: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie ayo si Moises, ninagosmanman ni y liniiña; ya anae lumajijot para ugueslie, y inagang y Señot mato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abrham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot ilegña nu güiya: Pula y sapatosmo gui adengmo; sa y lugat anae tumotojgue jao, santos na oda.
pairs.english: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa seguro julie, y manmasapet y taotaojo guiya Egipto, yan jujungog y inigongñiñija, ya tumunogyo para junafanlibre sija. Ya pago maela jao, sa jutago jao guato Egipto.
pairs.english: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este y as Moises ni y jarechasa ilegñija: Jaye munamagas jao yan unjues? Güiya tinago as Yuus na umagas yan uninafanlibre pot y canae y angjet ni y mafato guiya güiya gui jalomtano.
pairs.english: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya chumule sija juyong, ya despues manfinanue ni y namanman, yan señat sija gui tano Egipto, yan y Tasen Agaga, yan y jalomtano cuarenta anos.
pairs.english: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ayo y as Moises, ni y ilegña ni y famaguon Israel: Y Yuusmiyo janacajulo un profeta guiya jamyo gui mañelunmiyo taegüine iya guajo.
pairs.english: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este ayo y estaba gui inetnon, gui jalomtano, yan y angjet ni y cumuentuse güe gui egso Sinae, yan y mañaenata; ni y rumesibe y nalâlâ na tinago para ufanmanaejit.
pairs.english: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y mañaenata ti manmalago jaosgue lao mayute juyong guiya sija, ya y corasonñija manalo tate Egipto,
pairs.english: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija as Aaron: Fatinasejam Yuus para ujanao gui menanmame, as este y as Moises ni y cumonejam juyong gui tano Egipto, ti intingo jafa ujuyong.
pairs.english: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija manmamatinas un tatnero, ya machule y inefrese para idolo sija, güije sija na jaane, ya ninafansenmagof ni y checho y canaeñija.
pairs.english: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jabira si Yuus, ya japolo na ujaadora y inetnon y langet; taegüije esta matugue gui leblon y profeta: O jamyo ni y guima Israel, inofreseyo pinino gâgâ sija yan inefrese sija gui cuarenta años gui jalomtano?
pairs.english: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan injatsa y tabemaculon Moloc, yan y estreyas y Yuus Refán, jechura sija ni y infatinas para inadora sija; ya guajo juchule jamyo mas chago qui Babilonia.
pairs.english: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y mañaenata, guaja ni y tabernaculon y testimonio gui jalomtano, taegüije tinanchoña ni ilegña as Moises na ufatinas taemanoja na jechura y liniiña.
pairs.english: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y mañaenata locue gui tiempoñija a machule jalom yan si Josué anae jumalom gui erensian y Gentiles, ni y si Yuus yumute juyong gui menan y mañaenata, asta y jaanen David;
pairs.english: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y sumoda finaborese gui menan Yuus, yan jagagao na ualiligao tabernaculo para si Yuus Jacob.
pairs.english: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Salomon fumatinase güe un guma.
pairs.english: But Solomon built him an house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Gueftaquilo, ti sumasaga gui guima sija ni y finatinas canae; taegüije y sinangan y profeta.
pairs.english: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y langet tronujo, ya y tano fañajangan y papa adengjo; jafa na guma injatsayeyo? ilegña y Señot; pat jafa na sagayan nae jusaga?
pairs.english: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ada ti y canaejo fumatinas todo este sija na güinaja?
pairs.english: Hath not my hand made all these things?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jamyo ni y gaetongjo tiso, yan ti manmasirconsida y corason yan y talanga, sa siempre incontra y Espiritu Santo; taegüije y checho y mañaenanmiyo inchechegüe.
pairs.english: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye gui profeta ti japetsigue y mañaenanmiyo? ya japuno ayo sija y manmañangangane antes ni y mamamaela Uno na Tunas; ya jamyo pago inentrega, yan inpino;
pairs.english: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y inresibe y tinago pot y inareglan y angjet, ya ti inadaje.
pairs.english: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 7 54 64850 ¶ Ya anae jajungog estesija, manchinachat asta y corasonñija, ya janafañegcheg y nifenñija guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao güiya, bula ni y Espiritu Santo, ya jaatan meton y langet, ya jalie y minalag Yuus, yan si Jesus na tumotojgue gui agapa na canae Yuus.
pairs.english: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña, Estagüe na julie y langet na mababa, ya y Lajin taotao tumotojgue gui agapa na canae Yuus.
pairs.english: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae sija managang ni y dangculo na inagangñija, yan jatampe y talanganñija, ya manmalago guato guiya güiya;
pairs.english: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mayute juyong gui siuda, ya mafagas ni y acho: ya y testigo sija, japolo papa y magagoñija gui adeng un patgon na taotao na y naanña si Saulo.
pairs.english: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafagas ni y acho si Esteban, ya jaaagang ni Yuus, ilegña: Señot, Jesus, resibe y Espiritujo.
pairs.english: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dumimo papa, ya umagang ni y dangculo na inagangña, ilegña: Señot, chamo pumopolo este na isao gui cuentanñija; ya anae munjayan jasangan este, maego.
pairs.english: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA si Saulo jaconsiente gui finataeña. Ya ayo ni tiempo, guaja dangculon pinetsigue contra y iglesia guiya Jerusalem; ya todo sija, ni ti apostoles, manmachalapon gui tano Judea, yan Samaria;
pairs.english: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mandeboto na taotao, macatga si Esteban para umajafot, ya dangculo inigungñija pot güiya.
pairs.english: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Saulo jayulang y inetnon mangilisyano, ya jumalom gui cada guma, ya jabatatangga y lalaje yan y famalaoan para ufanmapreso.
pairs.english: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ayo sija y manmachalapon, manjanao para todo y lugat, ya japredidica y sinangan.
pairs.english: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Felipe mapos papa gui siuda Samaria, ya japredica guiya sija si Cristo.
pairs.english: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linajyan taotao sija, manunoja, ya maatituye ayo sija y sinangan Felipe, anae malie yan majungog y señat ni y finatinasña.
pairs.english: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa megae y manáplacha na espiritu, manaagang ni y dangculo na inagang, yan manjujuyong güije todo gui anae mañasaga; yan megae na manparalitico, yan mancojo, manafanjomlo.
pairs.english: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja un dangculon minagof güije na siuda.
pairs.english: And there was great joy in that city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: jaencanta sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo umatituye, desde y diquique asta y dangculo, ilegñija: Este na taotao, y dangculo na ninasiñan Yuus.
pairs.english: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mantituye, sa apmam na tiempo na numamanman ni y magicaña.
pairs.english: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmanjonggue as Felipe ni y japredica y ebangelio y raenon Yuus, yan y naan Jesucristo, manmatagpange todo, lalaje yan famalaoan.
pairs.english: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Simon manjonggue locue; ya anae matagpange, sumisijaja yan Felipe, ya ninamanman anae jalie y milagro yan y señat sija ni y manmafatinas.
pairs.english: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 14 65050 ¶ Ya y apostoles, ni y manestataba Jerusalem anae majungog na iya Samaria jaresibe y sinangan Yuus, matago guato si Pedro yan si Juan;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato guato, jatayuyute sija, para ujaresibe y Espiritu Santo:
pairs.english: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa trabia ti tumutunog gui jilo una guiya sija; sa manmatagpangeja pot y naan y Señot Jesus).
pairs.english: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae japolo y canaeñija gui jiloñija, ya maresibe y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie si Simon na pot y japolo y canaeñija y apostoles, manmannae ni y Espiritu Santo, jaofrese sija salape,
pairs.english: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

pairs.chamorro: Ilegña: Naeyo locue ni este na ninasiña, ya masqueseaja jaye nae jupolo y canaejo, uresibe y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro, ilegña nu güiya: Y salapemo ufalingo yan jago, sa jinasomo na y ninaen Yuus mafafajan salape.
pairs.english: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taya pattemo ni suertemo güine, sa y corasonmo ti tunas gui menan Yuus.
pairs.english: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina fañotsot ni este y tinaelayemo, ya untayuyute si Yuus, yaguin siña maasie jao ni y jinason y corasonmo.
pairs.english: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa julie na gaegue jao gui lalaet y minalaet, yan y guineden y tinaelaye.
pairs.english: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manope si Simon, ya ilegña: Tayuyuteyo gui Señot, ya chañija fanmafato guiya guajo ni uno gui este sija sinanganmiyo.
pairs.english: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 25 65160 ¶ Enao mina sija, anae guinin janae testimonio yan jasangan y sinangan y Señot, manalo guato Jerusalem, y japredica y ebangelio gui megae na sengsong y taotao Samaria sija.
pairs.english: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

pairs.english: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya cajulo, ya mapos; ya estagüe un taotao Etiopia na eunuco na gaeninasiña na dangculo gui papa Candase raynan taotao Etiopia sija, ya güiya encatgao todo ni y güinajan y ray na, ya mato Jerusalem para ufanadora.
pairs.english: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumalo guato, ya matachong gui jilo y iyoña carruaje ya jataetae y profeta Isaias.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Espiritu ilegña as Felipe: Janao jijot ya undañae y carruaje.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago guato guiya güiya si Felipe, ya anae jajungog na jatataetae y profeta Isaias, ilegña: Untungo jafa tinaetataemo?
pairs.english: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Jafa taemano siñayo yaguin taya fumanagüeyo? ya jagaogao na ucajulo ya ujasija matachong.
pairs.english: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y lugat gui Tinigue ni y jatataetae, taegüine: Macone taegüije y quinilo yaguin macone para umapuno; yan parejo yan y cotdero ni y ti cumecuentos gui menan y dumadasae, taegüejeja ti jabababa y pachotña.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inimitdeña nae y juisioña munajanao; ya jaye usinangan claro y generasionña? sa y linâlâfia machule gui tano.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 8 34 65250 ¶ Ya y eunuco jaope si Felipe ilegña: Jutayuyut jao, jaye jasangangane y profeta ni este? güiyaja, pat otro taotao?
pairs.english: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jababa si Felipe y pachotña, ya jatutujon gui este na tinigue sigue di mapredica güe si Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manago na umanasaga y carruaje; ya tumunog y dos gui jalom janom, si Felipe yan y eunuco; ya tinagpange güe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.

pairs.english: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

pairs.chamorro: Ya managang, ya manmamaesen cao sumasaga güije si Simon ni y apiyiduña Pedro.
pairs.english: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras jajajaso si Pedro y vision, y Espiritu ilegña nu güiya: Estagüe tres taotao na maaliligao jao.
pairs.english: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cajulo ya tunog papa, chamo bumuebuente na unjanao yan sija, sa guajo tumago sija.
pairs.english: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pedro tumunog papa para ayo taotao sija ya ilegña: Estagüiyayo ni y inaliligao; jafa guaja na inaliligaoyo?
pairs.english: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Si Cornelio ni y senturion, un taotao na tunas yan maañao as Yuus, yan guaja mauleg na testimonio gui entalo todo y nasion y Judio sija, sa ninatungo as Yuus pot y Santos na angjet ni y tinago jao na unjalom gui guimaña, ya ufanjungog finijo guiya jago.
pairs.english: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 23 65970 ¶ Ya jaagang sija na ufanjalom, ya ufañaga. Ya y inagpaña jumanao si Pedro yan sija, yan palo gui mañelo ni y manguinin Joppe maosgaejon güe,
pairs.english: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña talo na jaane, manjalom Sesarea. Ya manninanangga as Cornelio, ya jaagange y manparientesña yan y amiguña sija ni y guesmanatungo.
pairs.english: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae jumalom si Pedro, na tinagam as Cornelio, ya dumimo papa ya inadora güe.
pairs.english: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jinatsa as Pedro, ya ilegña: Tojgue julo, sa guajo taotaojayo locue.
pairs.english: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae cumuecuentos y dos, jumalom, ya jasoda megae ni y manmato ya mandaña;
pairs.english: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Pedro sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina matoyo guiya jamyo, sin jafa na sinangan, enseguidas qui matagoyo. Ya jufaesen jamyo jafa malagonmiyo na innamaagangeyo?
pairs.english: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Cornelio ilegña: Cuatro na jaane asta este na ora, estabayo juadadaje y mina nuebe na oran tinayuyut gui jalom gumajo, ya estaba un taotao na tumotojgue gui menajo na malag magaguña.
pairs.english: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilelegña: Cornelio, y tinayuyutmo majungog, yan y limosnamo manmajaso gui menan Yuus.
pairs.english: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Fanago para Joppe, ya umaagange si Simon, ni y apiyiduña Pedro: na sumasaga gui guima un Simon titumo, gui oriyan tase;
pairs.english: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina enseguidas junamaagange jao; ya mauleg finatinasmo sa mato jao. Pago estagüejit todos gui menan Yuus, para injingog todo y tinago jao as Señot.
pairs.english: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 34 66080 ¶ Ayonae si Pedro, jababa y pachotña, ya ilegña: Jutungo magajet na si Yuus taya janasasajnge taotao.
pairs.english: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao gui todo na nasion masqueseaja jaye ni y maaañao nu güiya, yan jafatitinas y tininas, ayo jaguaeya.
pairs.english: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y sinangan ni y janamanajanao si Yuus para y famaguon Israel, mapredica y pas pot si Jesucristo: (güiya y Señot para todo)--
pairs.english: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na sinangan, jamyo intingoja y masanganñaejon todo guiya Judea, ya matutujon guiya Galilea, despues di y tinagpange ni y japredica si Juan:
pairs.english: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya si Jesus Nasareno; jaftaemano si Yuus japalae ni y Espiritu Santo yan y ninasiña: ya jumajanao ya jafatitinas y mauleg, yan janafanjomlo todo ayo sija y manchinichiguet ni y anite; sa sumisija yan Yuus.
pairs.english: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame mantestigo todo y güinaja ni y finatinasña gui tano Judios, yan iya Jerusalem; ayo y japuno sija, ya jacana gui trongcon jayo:
pairs.english: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya ninacajulo as Yuus gui mina tres na jaane, ya japolo ya ufinanue güe senclaroja,
pairs.english: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti para todo y taotao, lao para y testigo sija ni y manmaayeg antes as Yuus; junggan, para jita, ni y guinin manjita mañocho yan manguimen despues di cajulo guinin y manmatae.
pairs.english: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatagojit na tapredica gui taotao sija, yan tanamatungo na güiya tinancho as Yuus para ujuyong Jues y manlalâlâ yan y manmatae.
pairs.english: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot güiya na manmannae todo y profeta testimonio, na pot y naanña, jayeja y jumongue güe uresibe inasiin y isao.
pairs.english: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 10 44 66180 ¶ Ya mientras jasanganja trabia si Pedro este sija na sinangan, y Espiritu Santo podong gui jilo ayo sija todo y jumujungog y sinangan.
pairs.english: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y manmasirconsida ni y manmanjonggue, ninafanmanman, ya megae manmato as Pedro, sa asta y Gentiles locue manmachudae ni y ninaen y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jajungog na manguecuentos ni y jilañija, ya manadangculo si Yuus. Ayonae manope si Pedro, ilegña:
pairs.english: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaye siña na taotao chumoma y janom para ti ufanmatagpange este sija y rumesibe y Espiritu Santo taegüine iya jita?
pairs.english: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago sija na ujafanmatagpange ni y naan Jesucristo. Ya matayuyut güe na ufañaga unos cuantos na jaane.
pairs.english: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA y apostoles yan y mañelo ni y manestaba Judea, jajungog na y Gentiles jaresibe locue y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato si Pedro Jerusalem, managuaguat yan ayo sija y manmansirconsisida,
pairs.english: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Jago jumajalom jao gui ti manmasirconsida, yan manjajamyo mañocho.
pairs.english: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro jasigue sumangane sija claro y sinesede, ilegña:
pairs.english: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estabayo gui siuda guiya Joppe na mananaetae; ya anae lalangoyo, julie y vision, un nayan tumunog, taegüije y dangculo na sabanas, ni mapolo pot cuatro punta ni y tumunog guinin y langet; ya mato guiya guajo:
pairs.english: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae juatan ayo, ya jujaso, julie y cuatro patasña na gâgâ gui tano, yan manmachaleg sija na gâgâ, yan y mangucunanaf na gâgâ, yan y pajaro sija gui aire.
pairs.english: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jujungog locue y inagang na ilegña nu guajo: Cajulo Pedro; puno ya uncano.
pairs.english: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ilegco: Aje, Señot: sa taya comun, pat áplacha guinin jumalom gui jalom pachotjo.
pairs.english: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jaopeyo talo y inagang guinin y langet, ilegña: Jafa y janagasgas si Yuus, chamo fumatitinas comun.
pairs.english: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este mafatinas tres biaje: ya todo manmachule talo guato gui langet.
pairs.english: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe enseguidas manotojgue güije gui menan guma anae sumasagayo, tres na taotao, manmatago guinin Sesarea para iya guajo.
pairs.english: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatagoyo na judalalag sija ya chajo fumatitinas dinesparejo. Ya manjame yan este sija y saes na mañelo, ya manjalomjam gui guima y taotao:
pairs.english: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasanganejam ni y liniiña ni y angjet ni y tumotojgue gui jalom gumaña, ya jaftaemano ilegña nu güiya: Fanago taotao para Joppe, ya uncone si Simon ni y apiyiduña Pedro;
pairs.english: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unsinangane sinangan sija anae unsatbo; jago, yan todo y guimamo.
pairs.english: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae sigue di cumuentosyo, podong y Espiritu Santo gui jiloñija, taegüijeja gui jilota gui tutujonña.
pairs.english: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae jujaso y sinangan y Señot, ni y ilegña: Si Juan, magajet na managpapange ni y janom; lao jamyo infanmatagpange ni y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin manninae sija locue as Yuus y ninae, taegüije y janaejit anae jumongguejit y Señot Jesucristo, ya jayeyo na siña jucontra si Yuus?
pairs.english: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija estesija, manmamatquilo, ya manamalag si Yuus, ilegñija: Magajet na janae locue si Yuus y Gentiles sinetsot para linâlâ.
pairs.english: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 19 66410 ¶ Ya ayo sija y manmachalapon pot y mapetsiguen ni y Esteban, manjanao asta Finesia, yan Chipre, yan Antioquia, ya taya nae japredica y sinangan na ayoja sija y Judios.
pairs.english: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija taotao Chipre, yan Sirene, ya anae manmato Antioquia, manguentos yan y Griegosija, ya japredica y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañisijaja yan y canae y Señot; ya megae manmanjonggue ya jabira sija para y Señot.
pairs.english: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mato este sija na notisia gui iglesia ni y estaba Jerusalem: ya matago si Barnabé, na ujanao asta Antioquia;
pairs.english: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, ya jalie y grasian Yuus, magof güe; ya jasangane sija todo, na nu sinasuyen y corasonñija, unafanmeton sija gui Señot:
pairs.english: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa güiya mauleg na taotao, ya bula ni y Espiritu Santo, yan jinenggue: ya megae na taotao manmafato gui Señot.
pairs.english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae mapos güe para Tarso, para ualigao si Saulo:
pairs.english: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jasoda, jacone guato Antioquia. Ya un año di mandadañaja güije yan iglesia, ya manmamananagüe megae na taotao; ya y disipulo sija manmafanaan finena mangilisyano guiya Antioquia.
pairs.english: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 11 27 66490 ¶ Ya este sija na jaane, manmato profeta sija guinin Jerusalem para Antioquia,
pairs.english: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sesat.
pairs.english: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y disipulo sija, cada uno jaftaemano y güinajaña, jadetetmina para umanamamaela inayuda para y mañelo ni y mañasaga Judea:
pairs.english: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija locue jafatinas, janamaela para y manamco pot y canae Barnabé yan Saulo.
pairs.english: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA ayoja na tiempo, y ray Herodes jaestira y canaeña para unafanlamen palo gui taotao iglesia.
pairs.english: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya japuno si Santiago chelun Juan ni y espada.
pairs.english: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie na ninafanmagof y Judios, jasigue para ucone si Pedro locue. Ya ayo y jaanen y pan sin lebadura?
pairs.english: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macone güe, japolo gui calaboso, ya jaentrega y diesisaes na sendalo para upinilan; majasusuye na despues di y pascua umaconie y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina si Pedro mapongle gui calaboso: lao y iglesia ti pumapara manmanayuyut as Yuus pot güiya.
pairs.english: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae si Herodes canaja quinene gue, güijeja na puenge anae estaba si Pedro na mamaego gui entalo y dos sendalo, ya magogode ni dos na cadena: ya y manmamumulan gui menan y petta, mapupulan y calaboso:
pairs.english: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estagüe, un angjet y Señot tumotojgue gui oriyaña, ya y candet manina gui jalom y cuatton calaboso: ya japanag si Pedro gui calaguagña ya yinajo, ilegña: Cajulo laguse, ya y cadenaña manbasnag guinin y canaeña.
pairs.english: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Dudog jao ya gode y dogamo: ya taegüenao finatinasña. Ya y angjet ilegña nu güiya: Polo y magagumo guiya jago, ya dalalagyo.
pairs.english: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao juyong ya jadalalag, ya ti jatungo ayo cao magajet y finatinas y angjet; lao jinasoña na manlie güe vision.
pairs.english: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmalofan gui finenana yan y mina dos na guatdia, manmato gui trangcan lulug ni y dumalalalaque y siuda; ni y mababa para sija sin jafa; ya manjanao juyong ya manmalofan gui inanaco un chalan; ya enseguidas jumanao y angjet guiya güiya.
pairs.english: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta manungo talo si Pedro, ilegña: Pago nae jutungo na magajet na y Señot jatago y angjetna, na unalibreyo gui canae Herodes, yan todo y ninanggan y taotao y Judios.
pairs.english: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajaso este na güinaja, mato gui guima Maria nanan Juan, ni y apiyiduña Marcos; anae megae mandadaña ya manmananayuyut.
pairs.english: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manyajo si Pedro gui pettan y trangca, un patgon na palaoan mato para umaope, na y naanña si Rode.
pairs.english: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jatungo na y inagang Pedro, ti jababa y trangca pot y minagofña, lao malago jalom ya mansinangane na tumotojgue si Pedro gui menan y trangca.
pairs.english: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegñija nu guiya: Esta jao caduca. Lao güiya ilelegñaja: Junggan, magajet taegüenao. Ayonae sija ilegñija: Ayo y angjetña.
pairs.english: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pedro, sisigueja di manyajo: ya anae jababa malie güe, ya ninafansenlujan.
pairs.english: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mansineñas as Pedro ni y canaeña na ufamacaca, ya mansinangane jaftaemano y Señot anae quinene güe juyong gui calaboso. Ya ilegña: Janao ya unsangane si Santiago ni este sija na güinaja, yan y mañelo. Ya mapos ya malag y otro lugat.
