pairs.english: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas qui manana, ti didide na atboroto gui sendalo sija, manggue si Pedro.
pairs.english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jaaligao si Herodes si Pedro ya ti jasoda, janafanmaegsamina y manmanmamumulan ya manago na ufanmapuno. Ya jumanao papa guinin Judea para Sesarea, ya sumaga güije.
pairs.english: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: si Herodes sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un tinancho na jaane, minagago si Herodes ni y magagon ray, ya matachong gui tronuña, ya jacuentuse sija un sinangan.
pairs.english: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya managang y taotao sija, ilegñija: Inagang un yuus, ti inagang taotao.
pairs.english: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas pinada ni y angjet y Señot, sa ti janae si Yuus minalag: ya quinano ni ilo ya matae.
pairs.english: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y sinangan Yuus lumadangculo yan mumemegae.
pairs.english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Barnabé yan Saulo, tumalo guato guinin Jerusalem, anae munjayan y ministroñija, yan jacocone mañisija si Juan y apiyiduña Marcos.
pairs.english: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA estaba güije gui ilesia guiya Antioquia, profeta sija yan maestro, sija: Barnabé, yan si Simeon ni y mafanaan Niger, yan si Lucio, taotao Sirene, yan si Manaen, ni y chamapogsae yan Herodes tetrarca, yan si Saulo.
pairs.english: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras sija sumesetbe y Señot, yan manayuyunat, y Espiritu Santo ilegña: Abatta guiya guajo Barnabé yan Saulo para y checho anae guinin juagange sija.
pairs.english: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae anae esta manayunat yan manmanayuyut yan japolo y canaeñija gui jilo ayo sija, jatago sija na ufanjanao.
pairs.english: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 4 66810 ¶ Ya manmatago sija pot y Espiritu Santo, ya manunog para Seleusia; ya desde ayo mumamaya para Chipre.
pairs.english: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mangaegue gui Salamina, japredica y sinangan Yuus gui sinagogan y Judiosija: ya mañisijaja locue yan si Juan ni y sumesetbe sija.
pairs.english: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe todo inanaco y isla asta Pafo, jasoda un taotao na cacana, fatso na profeta, Judio, na y naanña si Bar-Jesus:
pairs.english: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y estaba yan y magalajen y tano, si Sergio Paulo, gaetiningo na taotao; ya jaaagang si Barnabé yan Saulo, sa malago na ujungog y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manquinentra as Elymas, taotao na cacana (taegüine nae comequilegña y naanña), jaaliligao na unamabira guinin jinenggue y magalaje.
pairs.english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Saulo ni y naanña locue Pablo, bula ni y Espiritu Santo, inaatanja güe,
pairs.english: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: O bula jao todo dinague, yan tinaelaye, jago lajin anite, jago enemigun todo y tininas, ada ti pumapara jao unnataelaye y tinas na chalan y Señot?
pairs.english: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago estagüiya y canae y Señot gui jilomo, ya unbachet ya ti unlie y atdao pot un tiempo. Ya enseguidas podong gui jiloña y nublado ya jomjom, ya jumanao manaligao jaye uminantiene y canaeña para uinesgaejongüe.
pairs.english: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jalie y magalaje jafa y mafatinas, jajonggue ya ninasenmanman ni y finanagüen y Señot.
pairs.english: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 13 66900 ¶ Ya anae si Pablo yan y mangachongña jadingo Pafo, ya mumamaya ya manmato Petga guiya Pamfilia, ya si Juan jumanao guiya sija ya tumalo guato Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija manmalofan inanaco guinin Petga, manmato Antioquia guiya Pisidia; ya manjalom gui sinagoga gui sabado na jaane ya manmatachong.
pairs.english: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jataetae y lay yan y profeta sija, y magas y sinagoga ninafamnaagange sija ilegñija: Jamyo mañelo, yaguin guaja jafa na finijo para insangane y taotao sija, sangan.
pairs.english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo tumojgue julo ya mañeñas ni y canaeña, ilegña: Taotao Israel, yan jamyo ni y manmaañao as Yuus, ecungog.
pairs.english: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y Yuus este na taotao iya Israel, jaayeg y mañaenata, yan jajatsa y taotao sija anae mañasaga taegüije y taotao juyong guiya Egipto, ya ni y taquilo na canaeña jacone sija juyong güije.
pairs.english: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y cuarenta años ni tiempo, jasungon ni y costumbreñija gui jalomtano.
pairs.english: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guinin mujayan jayulang siete na nasion gui tano Cananea, ya japatte y tanoñija guiya sija para y erensiañija nae mañasaga, como cuatro siento y sincuenta años;
pairs.english: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di ayo sija, manninae sija jues sija asta qui mato y profeta Samuel.
pairs.english: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues manmalago ray: ya manninae as Yuus as Saulo lajin Sis, un taotao gui tribon Benjamin para cuarenta años.
pairs.english: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaanae jarechasa si Saulo, janacajulo guiya sija si David para rayñija. Sa si Yuus numae güe locue testimonio, ilegña: Guajo jusoda si David lajin Isai, un taotao na parejoja yan y corasonjo, ya güiya ucumple todo y malagojo.
pairs.english: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y semiyan este na taotao nae, unacajulo si Yuus guiya Israel y Satbadot Jesus jaftaemanoja y promesa:
pairs.english: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Juan finena prumedica, antes di y finatoña, y tinagpangen sinetsot para todo y taotao guiya Israel.
pairs.english: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jacumple si Juan y chechoña, ilegña: Jayeyo jinasonmimiyo? Ti guajo güe. Lao estagüe na mamamaela uno gui tateco, na ni y sapatos gui adengña ti dignoyo na jupula.
pairs.english: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mañelo lalaje, fumaguon y rasan Abraham, yan jayeja guiya jamyo y maañao as Yuus, sa para jamyo na matago y sinangan este na satbasion.
pairs.english: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Pot ayo sija y mañasaga Jerusalem, yan y magasñija sa ti matungo si Yuus, ni y sinangan y profeta ni y jatataetaeja cada sabado, anae masentensia güe jacumple sija.
pairs.english: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya achogja ti jasoda sija jafa na causa guiya güiya na umapuno, lao magagao si Pilatos na umapuno.
pairs.english: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macumple todo ayo y esta matugue pot güiya, machule papa guinin y jayo, ya mapolo gui jalom y naftan.
pairs.english: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Yuus munacajulo guinen y manmatae:
pairs.english: But God raised him from the dead:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malie megae na jaane ni ayo sija y mangachochongña mangajulo guinin Galilea para Jerusalem, ni y pago testiguña sija gui taotao.
pairs.english: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame chumule guiya jamyo y mauleg na notisia, ni ayo na promesa y mafatinas gui mañaena,
pairs.english: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano si Yuus cumunple guiya jita, ni y famaguonñija, sa ayonae janacajulo si Jesus talo; taegüije locue y esta matugue gui mina dos gui Salmos: Jago y Lajijo ya pago na jaane nae julilis jao.
pairs.english: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninacajulo guinin y manmatae, ya pago ti utalo guato gui minitong guinin jasangan taegüine: Guajo junae jao ni y santos yan magajet na bendisjon David.
pairs.english: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina ilegña locue y otro Salmo: Na chamo pumopolo y Santosmo na ulie y minitong.
pairs.english: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si David anae munjayan jasetbe y generasionña pot y pinagat Yuus, maego ya mapolo manafandaña yan y mañaenaña, ya jalie y minitong.
pairs.english: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo y ninacajulo as Yuus talo ti jalie minitong.
pairs.english: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya umatungo guiya jamyo mañelo lalaje, na pot este na taotao na mapredidica guiya jamyo y inasiin y isao:
pairs.english: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot güiya na todo ayo y jumonggue manunas ni todo y güinaja, sa ti siña jamyo manunas, pot y lay Moises.
pairs.english: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Adaje na nosea ufato guiya jamyo, y masangan gui profeta sija;
pairs.english: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Estagüe, jamyo ni y manmañatlilie, yan infanmanman, yan infanmalingo. Sa machochochoyo ni y checho y jaanemniyo, ayo na chocho y ti injengue, ni jaye na taotao unaclaro guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong gui sinagoga, jagagao na umapredica este na sinangan guiya sija gui siguiente sabado.
pairs.english: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manadingo y inetnon gui sinagoga, megae na Judios yan y deboto na proselito sija dumalalag si Pablo yan Barnabé; ni y sumangangane siga yan jaeepogna ufañaga gui grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 44 67210 ¶ Ya y siguiente sabado canaja todo y taotao y siuda mandaña para ujajungog y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jalie y Judios y linajyan taotao, manbula linatga, ya manguentos contra ayo y sinangan Pablo ya jachatfino contra si Yuus.
pairs.english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo yan Barnabé jausa y minatatngañija, ilegñija: Nesesita ayo y sinangan Yuus ni y esta manmasangane jamyo finena, lao pot innasuja guiya jamyo, injisganmaesa jamyo na ti dignojamyo y taejinecog na linâlâ, ya estagüe na tabirajit para y Gentiles.
pairs.english: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taegüenao tinagoña si Yuus nu jita, ilegña: Jupolo jamyo para candet y Gentiles, na jamyo siña para satbasion asta y uttimon patte y tano.
pairs.english: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog este y Gentiles, ninafansenmagof, ya maalaba y sinangan Yuus: ya megae manmanjonggue ni ayo sija y manmatancho para y taejinecog na linâlâ.
pairs.english: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya machalapon y sinangan Yuus todo güije na tano.
pairs.english: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 13 50 67270 ¶ Lao y Judio sija, janafangalamten y mandebota yan y manonra na famalaoan, yan y manmagas na taotao sija gui siuda, ya janafangajulo pinetsigue contra si Pablo yan Barnabé, ya janafanmayute juyong gui tanoñija.
pairs.english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao sija, jasacude y petbos gui adengñija contra sija, ya manjanao para Iconio.
pairs.english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y disipulo sija, manbula minagof yan y Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede na manjalom gui sinagogan y Judios guiya Iconio, ya taegüenao manguentos na un dangculo na linajyan Judios yan Griegos manman jonggue.
pairs.english: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ayo sija na Judios y ti manmanosgue, jasuug y anten y Gentil sija, para ufanmanjaso taelaye contra y mañelo.
pairs.english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mañagaja apmam, manguecuentos matatnga ni y Señot, ni y mannae testimonio ni y sinangan y grasiaña, yan mannae señat sija, yan mannamanman sija para ujafatinas ni y canaeñija.
pairs.english: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y linajyan taotao gui siuda manmadibide; y un banda mañija yan y Judios, ya y otro banda mañija yan y apostoles.
pairs.english: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae manmamatinas insulto y Judios yan y Gentiles, yan y magasñija, para ufanmacase sija, yan ufanmafagas ni y ocho,
pairs.english: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta matungo nu sija; ya manmalago guato Listra yan Derbe, siuda iya Licaonia, yan y tano gui oriya.
pairs.english: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güije japredica sija y ibangelio.
pairs.english: And there they preached the gospel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 8 67370 ¶ Ya estaba güije guiya Listra un taotao na taeninasiña y adengña, sa cojo desde y jalom tuyan nanaña; ya taya nae mamocat:
pairs.english: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo na taotao jajungog si Pablo na cumuentos: ya enseguidas na inatan, tiningo na guaja jinenggueña para umanajomlo,
pairs.english: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaagang dangculo na inagang ilegña: Tojgue julo tunas ni y adengmo. Ya guiya mangope julo, ya mamocat.
pairs.english: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie ni y linajyan taotao sija y finatinas Pablo, jajatsa y inagangñija ilegñija gui cuentos Licaonia: Y yuus sija ni manparejo yan taotao, manunog guiya jita.
pairs.english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mafanaan si Barnabé Jupiter; ya si Pablo mafanaan Mercurio, sa güiya magas na cuecuentos.
pairs.english: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y pale y Jupiter ni y temploña estaba gui menan y siuda, mangone toro sija, yan mañule coronan flores guato gui pettan y trangca, ya malago na ufanmamatinas inefrese, yan y linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae majungog ni y apostoles, si Barnabé yan si Pablo, jatiteg y magagoñija, ya manmalago gui entalo y linajyan taotao ya manaagang,
pairs.english: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Señot sija, jafa na infatinas este sija? Jame locue manaotaojam, manparejojajit, ya insangane jamyo na inbira jamyo güine gui este sija manaesetbe, ya infanmalag y lalâlâ na Yuus, ni y jafatinas y langet, yan y tano, yan y tase, yan todo y sinajguanña:
pairs.english: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmalofan na generasion sija, japolo todo y nasion na ufanjanao gui minalagoñija.
pairs.english: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masquesea güiya ti jadingo güe sin testigo, sa mauleg finatinasña, ya janaejit uchan guinin y langet, yan megae na tinegcha, janafanbula y corasonta nengcano yan minagof.
pairs.english: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este sija na sinangan, canamapot jaafuetsas y linajyan taotao na chañija fumatitinas inefrese guiya sija.
pairs.english: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 14 19 67480 ¶ Ya manmato güije Judios guinin Antioquia, yan Iconio, ni y manafanmañaña y linajyan; ya anae munjayan mafagas ni y acho si Pablo, mabatsala juyong gui siuda, jinasoñija na matae.
pairs.english: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras manotojgue y disipulo sija gui oriyaña, cumajulo ya jumalom gui siuda; ya y inagpaña güije, jumanao yan si Barnabé manmalag Derbe.
pairs.english: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japredica y ibangelio güije na siuda, yan mamadisipulo megae; tumalo guato Listra, yan Iconio, yan Antioquia,
pairs.english: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafanfitme y anten y disipulo sija, ya jaaconseja na ujasigueja gui jinenggue; sa nesesita megae na pinite sija, ya ayonae siñajit manjalom gui raenon Yuus,
pairs.english: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jatancho y manamco gui cada guimayuus, yan manaetae, yan umayunat, yan jatayuyute sija gui as Yuus ni manmanjonggue.
pairs.english: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalofan y inanaco Pisidia, ya manmato Pamfilia.
pairs.english: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan mapredica y sinangan guiya Petga, manunog guiya Atalia;
pairs.english: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo mangagama asta Antioquia, anae manmanae ni y grasian Yuus, para y checho ni y mafatinas.
pairs.english: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato ya mandaña iglesia gui guimayuus, masangan todo sija y finatinas Yuus pot sija; yan jaftaemano jababaye y Gentiles ni y pettan y jinenggue.
pairs.english: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaga güije yan y disipulo sija, apmam na tiempo.
pairs.english: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA manmato palo taotao sija guinin Judea, ya jafanagüe y mañelo ilegñija: Yaguin ti manmasirconsida jamyo taemano y costumbren Moises, ti siña jamyo mansatbo.
pairs.english: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae megae na inaguaguat yan finaesen as Pablo yan Barnabé yan sija, y maneio jaayeg si Pablo yan si Barnabé, yan palo guiya sija, para ujafanjanao julo Jerusalem guiya apostoles yan manamco pot este na finaesen.
pairs.english: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina anae manmaesgaejon ni y iglesia gui jinanaoñija, manmalofan y inanaco Finesia, yan Samaria, ya masasangan claro y manmañotsot y Gentiles; ya ninafangosmagof y mañelo todos.
pairs.english: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato Jerusalem, manmaresibe gui iglesia yan y apostoles, yan y manamco; ya jadeclara todo y finatinas Yuus pot sija.
pairs.english: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao mangajulo güije palo sija y inetnon Fariseo ni y manmanjonggue, ya ilegnija: Nesesita ufanmasirconsida sija, yan ufanmatago ya ujaadaje y tinago Moises.
pairs.english: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mandaña y apostoles yan y manamco para ujajasuye este.
pairs.english: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta megae na finaesen, cumajulo si Pedro ya ilegña nu sija: Mañelo lalaje, intingoja jafa na manayeg si Yuus guiya jamyo, apmam na tiempo, na y Gentiles ujajungog y sinangan y ibangelio pot y pachotjo, ya ujajonggue.
pairs.english: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan si Yuus, ni y tumungo y corason, janafantestigo sija, yan janae ni y Espiritu Santo, jaftaemanoja y jafatinas guiya jita;
pairs.english: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya japolo dinesparejo entre sija yan jita, janafangasgas y corasonñija ni y jinenggue.
pairs.english: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa pago mina intietienta si Yuus, para inpelo y yugo gui agaga y disipulo sija, na ni y mañaenata ni jita tisiña jacatga?
pairs.english: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao tajonggue na pot y grasian y Señot Jesus utafansatbo, taegüije iya sija.
pairs.english: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 12 67690 ¶ Ayonae manmamatquilo todo y linajyan taotao, ya maatituye si Pablo yan Barnabé ni y jasasangan y señot sija yan y mannamanman jafatinas si Yuus gui entalo Gentiles pot sija.
pairs.english: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmamatquilo, manope si Santiago ilegña: Mañelo lalaje, ecungogyo.
pairs.english: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jasangan si Simeon jaftaemano si Yuus ni y jabisita finena y Gentiles, para ufangone guiya sija taotao para y naanña.
pairs.english: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan pot este na manparejo y sinangan y profeta sija, ni y esta manmatugue:
pairs.english: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Anae esta munjayan estesija, jutalo mague, ya jujatsa y tabernaculon David, ni y podong; yan jujatsa talo y manmayulang güije, yan juplanta julo;
pairs.english: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para y manetenjan na taotao, ujaaligao yi Señot, yan todo y Gentiles ni y umafanaan y naanjo.
pairs.english: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegña y Señot ni y janamatungo estesija desde y tutujon y tano.
pairs.english: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina y jinasoco taegüine, na mungajit umatborota ayo sija y manguinin y entalo y Gentiles, ya jabira sija para as Yuus.
pairs.english: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao utatuguie sija, ya ujafañuja gui pinetlilon y idolos, yan y inábale, yan y neñicot na gâgâ, yan y jâgâ.
pairs.english: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: layña sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae yañija y apostoles yan y manamco yan todo y iglesia, na umanafanjanao y manmaayeg na taotao gui inetnonñija para Antioquia para ufañija yan si Pablo yan Barnabé; y naanñija, si Judas y apiyiduña Barsabas, yan si Silas, manmagas na taotao sija gui entre y mañelo:
pairs.english: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmangue carta pot sija, taegüine: Y apostoles yan manamco na mañelo, jasaluda y mañelo na Gentiles ni y mangaegue guiya Antioquia yan Siria yan Silisia:
pairs.english: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa injingog na palo ni y manjanao guinin iya jame, maninatborota jamyo ni y sinangan, janataelaye y antenmiyo; lao ti manmannae jam ni enao na tinago:
pairs.english: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jinasonmame na mandañajam unoja, para innafanjanao y manmaayeg na taotao para jamyo, yan y güinaeyanmame as Pablo yan Barnabé,
pairs.english: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Taotao sija na janapeligro y jaanenñija pot y naan y Señot Jesucristo.
pairs.english: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina innajanao si Judas yan Silas, ni y infansinangane locue ni y pachotñija taegüineja.
pairs.english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinason y Espiritu Santo, yan jame, na munga mapolo gui jilomiyo mas dangculo na catga qui y manesesita.
pairs.english: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na infañuja gui nengcano ni y manmaofrese y idolos, yan y jâgâ, yan y neñicot na gâgâ, yan y inábale; ya yaguin inadaje jamyo estesija, infatinas mauleg. Adios jamyo todos.
pairs.english: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 30 67870 ¶ Ya anae manajanao, manmato Antioquia: ya janafandaña y linajyan taotao, maentrega y catta;
pairs.english: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae munjayan mataetae, ninafansenmagof, pot y consuelo.
pairs.english: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Judas yan Silas manprofeta locue, ya japagat y mañelo ni y megae na sinangan, yan janafitme sija.
pairs.english: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañaga güije didide na tiempo, despues manafanjanao en pas ni y mañelo, para y manmatago sija.
pairs.english: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Silas ninamagof na ufañasagaja güije.
pairs.english: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Pablo yan si Barnabé mañasaga gui Antioquia, na mamananagüe, yan manpredidica ni y sinangan y Señot; yan megae palo locue.
pairs.english: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 15 36 67930 ¶ Ya anae malofan palo jaane, ilegña si Pablo as Barnabé: Nije tajanao talo ya tabisita ya mañeluta gui cada siuda anae y guinin tapredica y sinangan y Señot, ya utalie jafa chechoñija.
pairs.english: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Barnabé malago na ujacone gachongñija si Juan, ni y apiyiduña Marcos.
pairs.english: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y jinasoña si Pablo, na ti mauleg na ufañija, sa sumuja guiya sija desde Pamfilia, ya ti mandinalalag sija gui checho.
pairs.english: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumuyong dangculon minaguaguat, ya manadisapatta; ya si Barnabé jacone si Marcos, ya mangama gui batco para Chipre;
pairs.english: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo jayeg si Silas ya mapos, manmaencatga ni y mañelo ni y grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jumanao todo inanco Siria yan Silisia, janafanfitme y inetnon mangilisyano sija.
pairs.english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA mato güe locue Derbe yan Lystra: Ya estagüe, estaba güije un disipulo na y naanña si Timoteo, lajin un palaoan Judio, ni y manjonggue; lao y tataña Griego.
pairs.english: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gosmauleg y famaña gui mañelo ni y mangaegue Lystra yan Iconio.
pairs.english: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya malago Pablo na ujasija jumanao: ya quinene ya ninamasirconsida, sa pot y Judio sija ni y mangaegue güije na lugat: sa todoja tumungo na y tataña Griego.
pairs.english: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe todo y siuda sija, manmanae para ujaadaje, y tinago sija, ni y tinago y apostoles yan y manamco ni y mangaegue guiya Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y iglesia sija nae mumemetgot y jinenggue, ya lumalamegae y numero cada jaane.
pairs.english: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 6 68040 ¶ Ya anae jajanagüe todo inanacon tanon Frygia, yan Galasia, ya manchinema ni y Espiritu Santo na ujapredica y sinangan guiya Asia;
pairs.english: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato jijot y Misia, manmalago na ufanjanao para Bitinia: lao ti manpinelo ni y Espiritun Jesus na ufanjanao;
pairs.english: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalofan oriyan Misia, ya manunog Troas.
pairs.english: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae puenge, jalie si Pablo un vision, na un taotao Masedonia, tumotojgue güije ya gumagagao güe ilegña: Mamaela mague guiya Masedonia ya unayudajam.
pairs.english: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jalie y vision, enseguidas manmalagojam na manjanao para Masedonia, ya pinelonmame na y Señot umagangjam para inpredica y ibangelio guiya sija.
pairs.english: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavored to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 11 68090 ¶ Ya anae mangagamajam guinin Troas, manmatojam gui tunas na chalan para Samotrasia, ya y inagpaña na jaane manmatojam Neapolis;
pairs.english: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo asta Filipos, ni y mas dangculo na siuda güije na patte guiya Masedonia, yan un colonia romana: ya mañagajam güije na siuda unos cuantos na jaane.
pairs.english: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sabado na jaane, manjanaojam juyong gui siuda gui oriyan sadog, anae pinelonmame un lugat tinayuyut: ya manmatachongjam ya incuentuse y famalaoan sija ni y mandaña güije.
pairs.english: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya un palaoan na y naanña si Lydia, na manbebende purpura gui siudad Tiatira, ni y jaadodora si Yuus, jajungogjam; sa binaba y corasonña ni y Señot para uatituye y jasasangan si Pablo.
pairs.english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: palaoan, sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya, Ya jaafuetsasjam.
pairs.english: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 16 68140 ¶ Ya susede anae manjanaojam para lugat tinayuyut, na manasodajam yan un patgon na palaoan na gae espiritu Pitonico, ni y janafangana megae y amuña pot y manadibibina:
pairs.english: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jadadalag si Pablo yan jame, ya umaagang ilegña: Este sija na taotao y tentago y Gueftaquilo na Yuus ni y fumanuejit ni y chalan y satbasion.
pairs.english: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya este finatinasña y palaoan megae na jaane. Lao si Pablo gosninaestotba ya jabira güe ya ilegña ni y espiritu: Jutago jao pot y naan Jesucristo na unjuyong guiya güiya. Ya jumuyong güijeja na ora.
pairs.english: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 19 68170 ¶ Ya anae jalie y amuña na mapos y ninanggaña para ufangana, maguut si Pablo yan Silas, ya macone guato gui plasa gui menan manmagas,
pairs.english: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmacone guato gui manmagas y lay, ilegña: Este sija na taotao. Judios ya jaatbororota y siudata,
pairs.english: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmamananagüe costumbre ni y ti combiene para jita na utaresibe, ni utaadaje, sa jita taotao Roma.
pairs.english: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mangajulo y linajyan taotao ya mandaña contra sija: ya y manmagas sija jatiteg guiya sija y magaguñija, ya manmanago na ufanmasaulag.
pairs.english: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae esta megae na sinaulag ni y manmasaulagñija, manmapolo gui jalom calaboso, ya maencatga y atcaede na uguesadje sija.
pairs.english: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y rumesibe este na tinago, manpinelo sija guiya jalolom na calaboso, ya jaguesgode y adengñija gui sipo.
pairs.english: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y tatalo puenge manaetae si Pablo yan Silas, yan jacantaye si Yuus alabansa sija: ya manjiningog ni ayo sija y manmaprereso.
pairs.english: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya derepente guaja güije un dangculon linao, ya asta y simienton y calaboso yinengyong: ya enseguidas manmababa todo y petta, ya todo y preso manmapula y guedenñija.
pairs.english: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae magmata y atcaede, ya jalie na mababa y pettan y calaboso, jalagnos y espadaña ya malago na upuno maesa güe, sa pineloña na manmalago y preso sija.
pairs.english: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo umagang ni y dangculo na inagang, ilegña: Chamo munalalamen jao: sa estagüejamja todos.
pairs.english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae mangagao candet sija, ya tumayog jalom, ya mato manlalaolao ni y minaañao, ya podong gui menan Pablo yan Silas,
pairs.english: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija juyong, ya ilegña: Señores, jafa jufatinas para jusatbo?
pairs.english: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija ilegñija: Jenggue y Señot Jesus ya unsatbo yan y iya guimamo.
pairs.english: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masangane güe ni y sinangan y Señot, yan todo y mañasaga gui guimaña.
pairs.english: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayoja na ora gui puenge nae jacone ya jafagase y sinaulagñija: ya matagpange güe enseguidas yan todo y iyoña.
pairs.english: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jacone sija guato gui guimaña ya japlantaye nañija gui menañija, ya ninasenmagof sa jajonggue si Yuus yan todo y iya guimaña.
pairs.english: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 16 35 68330 ¶ Ya anae egaan na jaane, manmanago y manmagas sargento sija ilegñija: Setta ayo sija na taotao ya ufanjanao.
pairs.english: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y atcaede jasangane si Pablo ni este na sinangan, ilegña: Manmanago y manmagas na infanmasotta: ya pago fañuja ya infanjanao en pas.
pairs.english: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo ilegña nu sija: Janafanmasaulagjam sin infanmaecungog, yan manmapresojam, ya taotao Roma jamja: ya pago inmanafanjuyong sin infanatungo? Aje: lao nafanmato ya sija unafanjuyongjam.
pairs.english: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y sargento sija jasangane y manmagas ni este na sinangan: ya ninafanmaañao anae jajungog na taotao Roma sija.
pairs.english: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato ya manmagagao sija, ya anae manatanjuyong, manmagagao na ufanjuyong gui siuda.
pairs.english: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjuyong gui calaboso, manjalom gui guima Lydia; ya anae jalie y mañelo, jaconsuela ya manjanao.
pairs.english: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae guinen manmalofan inanaco Amfipolis yan Apolonia, manmato Tesalónica, anae guaja sinagogan Judios,
pairs.english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo segun costumbreña, jumalom güije sija, ya tres sabado jaadingane sija ni y Tinigue.
pairs.english: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jadeclararayeja sija, na si Cristo nesesita ufamadese, ya ucajulo talo guinin y manmatae: ya este na Jesus ni y jusangane jamyo, güiya y Cristo.
pairs.english: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo guiya sija manmanjonggue, ya mandaña yan si Pablo yan Silas: yan y mandeboto na Griego un dangculon manada; ya ti didide na manmagas na famalaoan.
pairs.english: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Judio sija pot y inigoñija, palo manaelaye na taotao gui mancanaya; ya mandaña un linajyan taotao jaatborota y siuda; ya maataca y guima Jason, ya maprocura manmaquecone sija juyong gui menan taotao.
pairs.english: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti manmasoda, macone si Jason yan palo gui mañelo guato gui manmagas y siuda, ya managang ilegñija: Este yuje sija y munafanaatlibes y tano, ya manmato güine locue;
pairs.english: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y jaresibe si Jason; ya todo este sija cumocontra y tinago Sesat; ilegñija na guaja otro ray, si Jesus.
pairs.english: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaatborota todo y taotao yan y manmagas y siuda anae majungog este sija.
pairs.english: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmañule segurida gui as Jason yan y pumalo, manmasotta.
pairs.english: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 10 68480 ¶ Ya anae puenge enseguidas matago ni y mañelo si Pablo yan Silas para Berea; ya anae manmato, manjalom gui sinagogan y Judios.
pairs.english: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija mas manmauleg qui ayo iya Tesalónica, sa rumesibe y sinangan contodo y minalagoñija, yan matataetae y Tinigue cada jaane, para umalie cao magajet ayo sija.
pairs.english: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina megae guiya sija manmanjonggue; yan y manjulon locue na famalaoan Griego, yan y lalaje ti didide.
pairs.english: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y Judios Tesalónica anae jatungo na japredidica si Pablo y sinangan Yuus guiya Berea, manmato locue güije, ya manafangalamten yan manafaninestotba y linajyan taotao sija.
pairs.english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas matago ni y mañelo si Pablo na ujanao asta y tase; lao si Silas yan Timoteo mañagaja güije.
pairs.english: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y umadadaje si Pablo, macone asta Atenas; ya manresibe tinago para si Silas yan Timoteo, na ujalaguse guato guiya güiya, ya manmapos.
pairs.english: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 17 16 68540 ¶ Ya mientras manninanangga as Pablo guiya Atenas, calamten y espirituña gui sanjalomña anae jalie y siuda na bula y idolos.
pairs.english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
