pairs.chamorro: Enaomina gui sinagoga jaadingane y Judio sija, yan y mandeboto na taotao sija, yan todo y asodaña gui plasa todo y jaane.
pairs.english: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manmalate gui finanagüe y Epicureo yan Estoicosija, managuaguat yan güiya, ya palo ilegñija: Jafa cumequeilegña este na caducon cuicuentos? Otro palo ilegñija: Buente mannae notisia y nuebo na yuus; sa jasangane sija as Jesus, yan y quinajulo talo.
pairs.english: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone güe guato gui as Areopago, ilegñija. Siñajam intingo este y nuebo na finanagüe ni y unsasangan?
pairs.english: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa uunafanmanjujungogjam ni y güinaja ni tatnae injingog, enaomina manmalagojam intingo jafa estesija.
pairs.english: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa todo iya Atenas, yan y manaotao juyong ni y mañasaga güije, taya chechoñiñija na para ufanguentosja, yan para ufanecungog ni y nuebo na güinaja.)
pairs.english: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae tumojgue si Pablo gui talo gui Areopago, ya ilegña; Jamyo ni y lalajen Atenas, julie na guefdeboto jamyo.
pairs.english: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa anae malofanyo, ya juatan jafa y inadoranmimiyo, jusoda gui un attat este na tinigue: PARA Y TI MATUNGO NA YUUS. Ayo y inadodoraja ni y ti intingo; güiya jusangangane jamyo.
pairs.english: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Si Yuus ni y fumatinas y tano yan todo y güinaja ni y mangaegue gui sumanjalomña; güiya Señot gui langet yan y tano, ti sumasaga gui templo ni y finatinas canae;
pairs.english: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni umasetbe ni y canae taotao sija, taegüije y guaja janesesita; sa güiya mannae todo linâlâ, yan jinagong, yan todo y güinaja;
pairs.english: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: na jâgâ sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
pairs.english: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para ujaaligao y Señot, yaguin siña buente masiente ya umasoda güe, sa ti chago güe cada uno guiya jita.
pairs.english: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa iya güiya nae utafanlâlâ yan utafangalamten, yan utafanguaja sustansiata; taegüije y palo gui poetan miyo, ilegñija: Sa jita locue y rasaña.
pairs.english: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin jita y rasan Yuus, mungajit jumaso na y yiniusan Yuus parejo yan oro, pat salape, pat acho, pat y finatinas y jinason y taotao.
pairs.english: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti jaconsidera si Yuus y tiempo anae manaetiningo; lao pago, manago na todo y taotao ufanmañotsot;
pairs.english: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jatancho un jaane, ni y anae para ujusga ni y tininas, y tano, ni ayo na taotao y jatago; ni y mannae testimonio todo y taotao, sa janacajulo guinin y manmatae.
pairs.english: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija y quinajulo talo guinin y manmatae, palo manmanbotlea; ya y palo ilegñija: Injingog jao talo otro biaje, pot este.
pairs.english: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae mapos si Pablo gui entaloñija.
pairs.english: So Paul departed from among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao palo mandaña guiya güiya, manmanjonggue: ya y palo güije sija, si Dionisio, taotao Areopago, yan un palaoan na y naanña Dámaris, yan palo mangachongñiñija.
pairs.english: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA despues di estesija, jumanao si Pablo guiya Atenas ya mato Corinto:
pairs.english: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasoda un Judio na naanña si Aquila, mafañagon Ponto, ni ti apmamam na mato guinin Italia, yan y asaguaña as Prisila, sa manago si Claudio na todo y Judios ufanjanao Roma; ya mato guiya sija.
pairs.english: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa parejoja chechoñiñija, ya sumaga yan sija, ya machochoeho: sa y chechoñiñija manmamatitinas y guima tienda.
pairs.english: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mañangangane gui sinagoga cada sabado, ya japrocucura para usuug y Judio yan y Griego sija.
pairs.english: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 5 68770 ¶ Lao anae mato si Silas yan Timoteo guinin Masedonia, si Pablo chineneg ni sinangan na unamatungo gui Judios na si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae macontra sija yan machatfino nu sija, jasacude y magaguña, ya ilegña nu sija: Y jâgâmiyo gui jilo y ilunmiyo: guajo gasgasyo; ya desde pago bae jujanao para y Gentiles.
pairs.english: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mapos ya jumalom gui guima un taotao na y naanña si Tito Justo na manadodora as Yuus, na y guimaña jijot gui sinagoga.
pairs.english: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Crispo magas y sinagoga, jajonggue y Señot, yan todo y guimaña: ya megae na taotao Corinto jumungog ya manjonggue ya manmatagpange.
pairs.english: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Señot jacuentuse si Pablo gui puenge gui vision, ilegña: Chamo maaañao, lao cuentos, ya chamo famatquiquilo:
pairs.english: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gaegueyo guiya jago, ya taya taotao siña guaguato guiya jago para unninalamen: sa megae taotaojo güine na siuda.
pairs.english: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije un año yan saes meses, jafananagüe sija ni y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 12 68840 ¶ Ya anae si Galión magalajen Acaya, y Judio sija mangajulo, gui un jinasoja, contra si Pablo, ya macone gui menan y tribunal,
pairs.english: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ilegñija: Este na taotao jasuug y taotao sija para ujaadora si Yuus contra y lay.
pairs.english: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae para ubaba si Pablo y pachotña, si Galión ilegña ni y Judio sija: Yaguin mojon jafa na inechong pat tinaelaye, O jamyo Judios, con rason jusungon jamyo.
pairs.english: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao ya yaguin y finaesen finijoja, yan naan sija, yan y laymiyo, adaje maesa jamyo; sa guajo ti malagoyo ujues ni enao na güinaja.
pairs.english: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafañuja gui tribunal.
pairs.english: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae todosija maguut si Sostenes, magas y sinagoga, ya masaulag gui menan y tribunal. Ya si Galión, ti jaatituye ayo sija na güinaja.
pairs.english: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 18 68900 ¶ Ya sumaga si Pablo güije megae na jaane, ya despues jadingo y mañelo, ya mangagama gui batco desde ayo asta Siria, ya sumisija yan si Prisila, yan Aquila; ya maguasguas y iluña guiya Cencrea: sa gae promesa.
pairs.english: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmato Efeso ya jadingo sija güije: ya güiyaja jumalom gui sinagoga, ya jaadingane y Judios.
pairs.english: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae magagaogüe na usaga apmam yan sija, ti malago;
pairs.english: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jadingo sija ilegña: Bae jutalo mague guiya jamyo, yaguin malago si Yuus. Ya mangama gui batco desde Efeso.
pairs.english: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae tumayog gui tano Sesarea, cumajulo, ya jasaluda y iglesia, ya mapos papa Antioquia.
pairs.english: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di sumaga güije ti apmam na tiempo, maposgüe ya jajanagüe todo y inanaco tano Galasia, yan Frygia, para unafanmetgot todo y disipulo.
pairs.english: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 18 24 68960 ¶ Ya mato guiya Efeso un taotao na Judio, na y naanña si Apolos, mafañagon Alejandria, un taotao na faye, yan gaeninasiña gui Tinigue sija.
pairs.english: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na taotao, mafanagüe ni y chalan y Señot; maepe gui Espiritu, jasasangan yan mamananagüe claro ni y chalan y Señot, lao ayoja tinagpangenja Juan tiningoña:
pairs.english: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatutujon sumangan ni y minatatnga gui sinagoga: ya anae jiningog as Prisila yan Aquila, macone ya mafanagüe mas claro ni y chalan Yuus.
pairs.english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malago malofan Acaya, y mañelo mananima güe ya manmanugue para y disipulo ya manmaencatga na umaresibe güe: ya anae mato jaayuda megae ayo sija y manmanjonggue pot y grasia:
pairs.english: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa gosjanasiña macontra y Judios, y publico nae jafanunue ni y Tinigue sija, na si Jesus y Cristo.
pairs.english: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA susede mientras estataba si Apolos guiya Corinto, si Pablo malofan gui managquilo na costa ya mato Efeso: ya mañoda palo disipulo sija güije.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Inresibe y Espiritu Santo desde qui manmanjonggue jamyo? Ya ilegñija: Taya nae injingog cao esta manae Espiritu Santo.
pairs.english: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Jafa nae manmatagpangenmiyo? Ya sija ilegñija: Y tinagpangen Juan.
pairs.english: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña si Pablo: Si Juan, magajet na managpapange ni y tinagpangen sinetsot, ya jasangane y taotao sija, na ujajonggue ayo y ufato despues di güiya, ayo y as Cristo Jesus.
pairs.english: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija este, manmatagpange ni y naan y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan japlanta si Pablo y canaeña gui jiloñija, y Espiritu Santo mato gui jiloñija: ya manguentos ni y tifinoñija, ya manmanprofetisa.
pairs.english: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo sija todos dose na taotao lalaje.
pairs.english: And all the men were about twelve.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 8 69080 ¶ Ya jumalom si Pablo gui sinagoga, ya cumuentos libre tres meses; jasangan yan y animo gui raenon Yuus.
pairs.english: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae palo manmajetog, ya ti manmalago manmanjonggue, ya manguecuentos taelaye pot ayo na Chalan gui menan y linajyan taotao, sumuja si Pablo guiya sija, ya janafañuja y disipulo sija, ya manadingan cada jaane gui escuelan Tiranno.
pairs.english: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya dos años di mafatinas este: para todo ayo y mañasaga Asia ujajungog y sinangan y Señot Jesus, parejoja y Judio yan y Griego sija.
pairs.english: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafatinas si Yuus milagro pot y canae Pablo:
pairs.english: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para guinin y tataotaoña nae umachule paño sija para y manmalango, ya y chetnot ufañuja guiya sija; yan y manaelaye na espiritu ufanjuyong guiya sija.
pairs.english: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo Judios na manaesagañija, taotao binanggelio, japrocura na jasangan nu ayo sija y manguaja taelaye na espiritu y naan y Señot Jesus, ilegñija: Innafanjula jao pot si Jesus, ni y japredidica si Pablo.
pairs.english: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja siete na lalaje, famaguon un Judio ni naaña si Sceva, ya magas mamale, na jafatinas este sija.
pairs.english: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope y taelaye na espiritu, ilegña: Si Jesus jutungo, yan si Pablo jutungo; lao jaye jamyo?
pairs.english: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao ni y guaja taelaye na espiritu, tumayog gui jiloñija; ya jagana sija, sa mas gaeninasiñaña qui sija; ya esta manmalago sija güije na guma, manerido yan taya magaguñija.
pairs.english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matungo este todo ni y Judios, yan y Griego sija yan ayo sija y mañasaga Efeso; ya podong y minaañao gui jiloñija todos, ya manadangculo y naan y Señot Jesus.
pairs.english: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ni y manmanjonggue manmato, ya mangonfesat manmañangane ni y chechoñija.
pairs.english: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae ni ayo sija locue y umuusa y magica jachule y leblonñija, ya jasonggue gui menan todo y taotao: ya matufong y balenñija, ya masoda na sincuenta mil na pidason salape,
pairs.english: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taegüenao mumegagaeña y ninasiñan y sinangan Yuus.
pairs.english: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 21 69210 ¶ Ya despues di este sija, jajaso si Pablo gui espirituña, anae malofan inanaco Masedonia yan Acaya na ujanao para Jerusalem, ilegña: Yaguin esta matoyo güije, nesesita yo na julie locue Roma.
pairs.english: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya depues di jatago dos para Masedonia ni y sumesetbe güe, si Timoteo yan Erasto, güiya sumagaja Asia un rato.
pairs.english: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 23 69230 ¶ Ya ayo na tiempo guaja güije atboroto pot ayo na Chalan.
pairs.english: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa un platero na taotao na y naanña si Demetrio, ya mamatitinas attat salape para si Diana, ya ti didide na ganansia chinileleña para y manmamatitinas.
pairs.english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janaetnon yan todo y manmachochocho ni y taegüije, ya ilegña: Señores, intingoja na este na chocho nae manmañoñodajit güinajata.
pairs.english: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inliija yan injingog, na ti ayoja iya Efeso, lao cana todo iya Asia nae megae na taotao jasuug si Pablo, yan jabira, sa ilegña na ti manyuus ayo sija y finatinas canae.
pairs.english: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti esteja nae uguaja peligro y chechota na unafanaebale lao asta y templon y dangculo na yuus si Diana umarechasa, ya y tinaquiloña umayulang, ni y todo iya Asia yan todo y tano umadodora.
pairs.english: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 19 28 69280 ¶ Ya anae jajungog sija este na sinangan, ninafangosbubu, ya managang ilegñija: Dangculo y Dianan Efesios.
pairs.english: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y siuda bula atboroto; ya mandaña unoja ya manjalom gui teatro ya macone si Gayo yan Aristarco, taotao Masedonia mangachong Pablo gui jinanaoña.
pairs.english: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago si Pablo na ufalag y anae mangaegue y taotao sija; lao ti mapolo ni y disipulo.
pairs.english: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo ni y manmagas Asia ni y manamiguña, manmanago na umasangane na chaña jumalom güe gui teatro.
pairs.english: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y palo, managang un inagang: ya y palo, otro inagang; sa manatborotao y dinana; ya megaeña ti tumungo jafa na mandaña sija.
pairs.english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya macone si Alejandro gui entre y linajyan taotao, ya mapolo mona ni y Judios, ya mañeñas si Alejandro ni y canaeña na ufanmamatquilo, sa malago umadingane y taotao sija,
pairs.english: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae matungo na Judio güe, todos managang gui un inagang buente dos oras, ilegñija: Dangculo y Dianan Efesios.
pairs.english: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae y secretario y inetnon magalalaje munjayan janaquieto y taotao, ilegña nu sija: Jamyo ni y taotao Efeso, jafa na taotao ayo y ti jatungo na y siuda Efesios manmanadodora ni y dangculo na yuus Diana, yan y imagen ni y podong guinin y Jupiter?
pairs.english: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Inlie na estesija ti siña macontra, nesesita na infanmamatquilo, ya chamiyo fumatitinas jafa.
pairs.english: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jamyo cumone mague este sija na taotao, na ti mañaque gui guimayuus, ni ujachatfino contra y yuusmiyo.
pairs.english: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yaguin si Demetrio yan y palo ni y mangachongña guaja quejanñija contra y otro taotao: guaja tribunal y lay: ya guaja y jues; polo ya ufanafaaela uno y otro.
pairs.english: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao yaguin inseda jamyo jafa pot otro sija, umafatinas gui inetnon y magalalaje taemanoja y lay.
pairs.english: But if ye inquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa mangaeguejit gui peligro, na utafanmafaesen pot este sija na atboroto, ya taya jafa siña urasonta pot este.
pairs.english: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan cumuentos, janajanao y dinaña.
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae bumasta y atboroto, jaagang si Pablo y disipulo sija, ya anae jaaconsejo ya jadingo, mapos para Masedonia.
pairs.english: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajanagüe inanaco ayo sija na lugat, ya janae sija megae na consejo, mapos malag Gresia.
pairs.english: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sumaga güije tres meses, ya manananggaja para ucone ni y Judios, anae maudae gui batco ya janao para Siria, jajaso na utalo guato Masedonia.
pairs.english: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya maosgaejon asta Asia, si Sopater patgon Pirro guiya Berea, yan iya Tesalónica, si Aristarcho yan si Segundo, yan si Gayo guiya Derbe, yan si Timoteo: ya iya Asia, si Tiquico yan si Trófimo.
pairs.english: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este sija manjanao finena, ya janananggajam Troas,
pairs.english: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya despues di y pan sinlibadura, manmaudaejam gui batco desde Filipos, infatoigüe sija guiya Troas gui mina sinco na jaane; ya mañagajam güije siete na jaane.
pairs.english: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 7 69480 ¶ Ya y finenana na jaane gui semana, anae mandaña y disipulo para umaipe y pan, si Pablo japredica guiya sija, sa esta güe listo para ujanao gui inagpaña: ya sisigueja di manpredica asta y tatalopuenge.
pairs.english: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na candet gui sanjilo na cuatto anae estabajam na mandadaña.
pairs.english: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya estaba güije un patgon na taotao na y naanña si Eutico, na matatachong sanjilo gui un bentana, ya guesmaego; ya y inanaco y prinedican Pablo, matomba gui maegoña, ya podong desde y mina tres na piso, ya anae majatsa matae.
pairs.english: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tumunog papa si Pablo ya dumimo gui jiloña, ya jatogtog ilegña: Chamiyo ninafañachatsaga, sa y linâlâña gaegueja gui sanjalomña.
pairs.english: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae cajulo talo, jaipe y pan ya mañocho, ya cumuentos asta qui manana; ya ayonae jumanao.
pairs.english: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya lâlâ patgon na taotao, ya ti didide ninafanmagof.
pairs.english: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 13 69540 ¶ Ya manmaposjam para y batco, ya manmaudaejam guato Asos, sa para ayo nae inquene si Pablo: sa taegüije matagoña, ya malagoñaja ufamocat.
pairs.english: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manasodajam Asos, inquene güe, ya manmatojam Mitilene.
pairs.english: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya desde ayo, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya manmatojam gui inagpaña na jaane gui menan Chio, ya y inagpaña talo güije na jaane, manmatojam Samo, ya mañagajam Trogilio; ya y inagpaña na jaane, manjanaojam para Mileto.
pairs.english: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa si Pablo malagoña umaudae gui batco para Efeso, sa ti malago jagasta y tiempo guiya Asia; sa inalulula, na mano y ninasiñaña, na ufato Jerusalem gui jaanen y Pentecostes.
pairs.english: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 17 69580 ¶ Ya desde Mileto manago guato Efeso na ufanmaagange y manamco gui guimayuus.
pairs.english: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato guiya güiya, ilegña nu sija: Injatingo desde y finenenana na jaane anae matoyo Asia, jafa manaemanojit todo y tiempo,
pairs.english: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jusetbe y Señot contodo y inimitde na jinaso, yan y minegae lago, yan y tentasion sija ni y manmato guiya guajo pot y ninanggan y Judios.
pairs.english: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaftaemano ti maañao yo jusangane jamyo todo y mauleg para jamyo, lao jufanue jamyo yan jufanagüe jamyo, gui publico yan gui guima yan guma.
pairs.english: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junamatungo gui Judios yan y Griego sija locue, y sinetsot para as Yuus, yan y jinenggue para y Señotta as Jesucristo.
pairs.english: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, estagüe y Espiritu na janajanaoyo para Jerusalem, ti jutungo jafa ufanmato guiya guajo güije.
pairs.english: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esteja y Espiritu Santo janae yo testimonio na gui cada siudad, ilegña, na y guinede yan y pinite ufañaga guiya guajo.
pairs.english: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao taya güine na güinaja unacalamtenyo, ni ti junaguaguan y linâlâjo para guajo, lao guefmalago yo na junafunjayan y chechojo, yan y obligasionjo ni y juresibe gui Señot Jesus, para junamatungo y ebangelion y grasian Yuus.
pairs.english: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, estagüe na jutungo jamyo todos, ya ni uno guiya jamyo ni y anae guinin jupredica y raenon Yuus, ulinie y matajo mas.
pairs.english: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao na jucone jamyo para testigo pago na jaane, na guajo gasgasyo guinin todo y jâgâ y taotao sija.
pairs.english: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa trabia ti munjajayan junatungo jamyo todo ni y pinagat Yuus.
pairs.english: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guefadaje jamyo, yan todo y manada ni y ninafanmagas jamyo ni y Espiritu Santo, para inapasto inetnon mangilisyano iyon Yuus, ni y jafajan ni y jâgâñaja.
pairs.english: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jujatungo este, na despues di jumanaoyo, y manaelaye sija na lobo ufanjalom gui entalomiyo, ya ti unasobbla y manada.
pairs.english: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya iya jamyo locue nae ufangajulo sija taotao na jasasangan y manaelaye na güinaja sija, para ufanmangone disipulo sija para udalalag sija.
pairs.english: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina adaje, ya injaso na pot tres años, ti pumaparayo jusangane cada uno parejoja jaane yan puenge cumacasaoyo.
pairs.english: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago mañelujo, jutayuyute jamyo as Yuus, yan y sinangan y grasiaña, ni y siña manjinatsa jamyo julo, yan infanninae erensianmiyo yan todo ayo sija y manafangasgas.
pairs.english: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya jucodisia ni jaye na taotao, salape pat oro, pat magago.
pairs.english: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamyo, intingo este sija na canae y sumesetbeyo gui nesesidajo, yan ayo sija y mangachochongjo.
pairs.english: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Esta junae jamyo mauleg na ejemplo gui todosija, jaftaemano ya guaja obligasionmiyo na inadaje y manaemetgot yan injaso y sinangan y Señot Jesus, ni y ilegña: Mas dichoso y mannae qui y manresibe.
pairs.english: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 20 36 69770 ¶ Ya anae munjayan jasangan taegüine, dumimo papa ya manmanayuyut todos.
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todosija mananges ya matogtog y agâgâ Pablo ya machico.
pairs.english: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ninafansenpinite todos pot y sinanganña, na ti ujalie y mataña mas. Ya maosgaejon gui jinanaoña asta y batco.
pairs.english: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae susede na manadingojam, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya manmatojam gui tinas na chalan para Coos, ya y inagpaña na jaane manmatojam Rodas, ya desde ayo asta Pátara.
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inseda un batco na jumajanao para Finesia, ya manmaudaejam, ya manjanaojam.
pairs.english: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae intutujon lumie Chipre inpelo gui acagüe, ya manjanaojam asta Siria, ya manmatojam Tiro: sa para umadescatga güije y batco.
pairs.english: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmañodajam güije disipulo, mañagajam siete na jaane; ya ilegñija as Pablo pot y Espiritu, na chaña jumajanao julo Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae inquimple todo esta ayo sija na jaane, manjanaojam ya insigue y jinanaomame, ya manmaosgaejonjam ni y asaguanñija yan y famaguonñija, asta qui manjuyongjam gui siuda: ya mandimojam gui oriyan tase ya manmanayuyutjam.
pairs.english: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya, anae manadingojam, uno y otro, manmaudaejam gui batco, ya sija manalo guato guiya sija.
pairs.english: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 7 69860 ¶ Ya anae inquimple y jinanaomame desde Tiro, manmatojam Tolemaida, ya insaluda y mañelo, ya mañagajam güije yan sija un jaane.
pairs.english: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña, jame ni y mangachong Pablo, manjanaojam, ya manmatojam Sesarea; ya manjalomjam gui guima Felipe y ebangelista ni y uno gui siete, ya mañagajam güije yan güiya.
pairs.english: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo na taotao, guaja cuatro jagaña na vitgen na manmanprofetisa.
pairs.english: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mientras mañagajam güije megae na jaane, mato papa guinin Judea un profeta na y naanña Agabo.
pairs.english: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato guiya jame, jachule y senturon Pablo, ya jagode güe canaeña yan y adengña, ya ilegña: Taegüine ilegña y Espiritu Santo: Taegüineja magodeña y gaeiyo este na senturon, ni y Judios ni mangaegue Jerusalem, ya umaentrega gui canae Gentiles.
pairs.english: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae injingog este sija, parejoja jame yan ayo y mañasaga güije na lugat, matayuyut güe na chaña jumajanao julo Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manope si Pablo ilegña: Jafa na manatanges jamyo, ya inyamag y corasonjo? sa esta listoyo ti para jumagodeja, lao asta jumatae guiya Jerusalem, pot y naan Jesucristo.
pairs.english: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae timalago manamañaña, manbastajam ilegmame: Y minalago y Señot umafatinas.
pairs.english: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 15 69940 ¶ Ya despues di ayo sija na jaane, inchile y güinajanmame ya manjanaojam papa Jerusalem.
pairs.english: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manjame locue yan palo disipulon Sesarea, ya manmangongone un Mnason iya Chipre, y bijo na disipulo ya infanjame mañaga.
pairs.english: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmatojam Jerusalem, mangosmagof y mañelo jaresibejam.
pairs.english: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña, manjanaojam yan si Pablo para as Santiago: ya todo y manamco manestaba.
pairs.english: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasaluda sija, jasanganen adumidide ni y finatinas Yuus gui entalo Gentiles pot y chechoña.
pairs.english: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog sija, maalaba y Señot, ya ilegñija nu güiya: Unlie chelujo cuantos miles na Judios y manmanjonggue, yan maneggo ni y tinago:
pairs.english: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya matungo guinin jago, na unfanagüe todo y Judios ni y mangaegue gui Gentiles, na ujafañuja gui as Moises, ilegmo, na munga manmasirconsida y famaguonñija, ni ujadalalag y costumbre.
pairs.english: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jafa nae umafatinas? Magajet na ujajungog na mato jao.
pairs.english: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enao mina fatinas este y insangane jao: Guajajam cuatro na taotao na manmanpromesa;
pairs.english: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Cone sija, ya unnagasgas jao yan sija, ya unfangata pot sija ya ufanmadasae ilunñija; ya todo utiningo na ayo sija y matungo pot jago taya guaja; lao jago locue dalalag jaftaemano y tinago, ya unadaje y lay.
pairs.english: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot y Gentiles ni y manmanjonggue, esta intigue na innafagpo, na chañija umadadaje ni uno güine; solo ujaadajeja sija güije na güinaja y manmaofrese y idolos, yan y jâgâ, y mamuno, yan y inábale.
pairs.english: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo jacone y taotao sija, ya y inagpaña na jaane janagasgas güe yan sija, jumalom gui templo para usangan y macumplen y jaanen y managasgas, asta qui ufanmaofrese y inefrese cada uno guiya sija.
pairs.english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purifcation, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 27 70060 ¶ Ya anae esta cana mamagpo y siete na jaane, ni Judios ni y mangaegue Asia, anae malie güe gui templo, janafangalamten todo y taotao contra güiya.
pairs.english: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya managang ilegñija: Taotao Israel, fanmanayuda: Estagüe yuje na taotao y jafananagüe todo y taotao manoja guato contra y pueblo, yan y lay, yan este na lugat: yan janafanjalom y Gentiles gui templo, ya janataelaye este na lugat.
pairs.english: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Sa guinin malie güe antes yan si Trófimo, un taotao Efeso, gui siuda, ya jinasoñija na si Pablo cumone jalom gui templo.)
pairs.english: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya todo manatborotao y siuda, yan todo y taotao manmalago, ya macone si Pablo, ya manajuyong gui templo; ya enseguidas manmajuchom y petta.
pairs.english: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjajanao para umapuno si Pablo, mato notisia gui magas y inetnon, na todo iya Jerusalem man atborotao.
pairs.english: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya enseguidas mangone sendalo sija yan capitan, ya manmalago guato guiya sija; ya anae malie y magas y inetnon yan y sendalo sija, manbasta masaulag si Pablo.
pairs.english: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y magas y inetnon jumijot, ya quinene güe, ya manago na umagode dos na cadena: ya mamaesen jaye güe, yan jafa finatinasña.
pairs.english: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya palo manaagang un inagang, ya y palo, otro inagang, gui entre y linajyan taotao: ya anae ti siña tumungo y magajet pot y atboroto, manago na umacone guato gui castiyo.
pairs.english: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato gui guaot, sa macocone ni y sendalo sija, pot y finijom y linajyan taotao;
pairs.english: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa manatateja y linajyan taotao, ya manaagangja ilegñija: Fañuja yan guiya.
pairs.english: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 21 37 70160 ¶ Ya anae para umacone si Pablo gui castiyo, ilegña nu y magas inetnon: Siñajit cumuentos? ya ilegña: Untungo Griego?
pairs.english: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ti jago ayo y taotao Egipto, ni y antes di este sija na jaane unfatinas jatsamiento, ya uncone guato gui desierto cuatro mil na taotao ni y manpegno?
pairs.english: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo ilegña: Guajo Judioyo, taotao Tarso, siuda Silisia--taotao un siuda ti diquique: ya jutayuyut jao na unpoloyo ya jucuentuse y taotao sija.
pairs.english: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ninae lisensia, tumojgue si Pablo gui guaot, ya jaseñas y taotao sija ni y canaeña. Ya anae manmamatquilo jacuentuse sija ni cuentos Hebrea, ilegña:
pairs.english: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: LALAJE mañelo yan mañaena, jingog y dumefiendeyo pago guiya jamyo!
pairs.english: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: (Ya anae majungog na mancuinentuse sija ni y fino Hebreo, ninafanmamatquilo mas;) ya ilegña:
pairs.english: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo magajet taotao na Judio, mafañagon Tarso, un siuda guiya Silisia; lao mapogsaeyo güine na siuda gui adeng Gamaliel, mafanagüeyo taemanoja y minagajet y lay y mañaenata, ya eggoyo para as Yuus, taegüenao iya jamyo pago na jaane.
pairs.english: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jupetsigue sija gui este jinanao asta junafanmapuno, jugogode ya juentrerega gui catset y lalaje yan y famalaoan.
pairs.english: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya parejoja y magas mamale locue numaeyo testimonio, yan todo y manada y manamco: guinin iya sija locue nae manresibeyo catta para y mañelo, ya jumanaoyo para Damasco, para jucone ayo sija ni y sinedajo güije ya jugode guato Jerusalem para ufanmasapet.
pairs.english: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae jumajanaoyo, ya esta jijotyo para Damasco gui taloane, enseguidas manina güije guinin y langet un dangculon candet gui oriyajo,
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya podongyo gui jilo tano, ya jujungog un inagang na ilegña nu guajo: Saulo, Saulo, sa jafa na unpetsisigueyo?
pairs.english: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya juope ilegco: Jayejao Señot? Ya ilegña nu güajo: Guajo si Jesus Nasareno ni y unpetsisigue.
pairs.english: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo y mangachochongjo jalie magajet y candet, ya ninafanmaañao; lao ti jajungog y inagang ayo y cumuentuseyo.
pairs.english: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegco: Jafa jufatinas Señot? Ya y Señot ilegña nu guajo: Cajulo ya janao falag Damasco; ya ayonae umasangane todo güinaja ni y matancho para chechomo.
pairs.english: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae ti siñayo manlie pot y minalag y candet, mapipetyo ni ayo sija y guinin mangachochongjo, ya maconeyo guato Damasco.
pairs.english: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Ananias, un taotao na deboto jaftaemanoja y lay, ya guaja mauleg na testimonio para todo y Judios sija ni y mañasaga güije,
pairs.english: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Mato guiya guajo, ya tumojgue, ya ilegña nu guajo: Chelujo Saulo, resibe y liniemo. Ya ayoja na ora nae juatan güe.
pairs.english: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Y Yuus mañaenata umayegjao, na para untungo y minalagoña, ya unlie Ayo Tunas, yan unjungog y inagang y pachotña.
pairs.english: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa jago utestiguña todo gui taotao, jafa y liniemo yan y jiningogmo.
pairs.english: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago jafa na sumasagajaoja? Cajulo ya unmatagpange, ya ufinagase y isaomo, agang y naanña.
pairs.english: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya susede anae tumaloyo guato Jerusalem, ya mientras mananaetaeyo gui templo, malingo y jinasoco,
pairs.english: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya julie güe, ya ilegña nu guajo: Laguse, ya unjanao juyong Jerusalem; sa ti manmalago maresibe y testemoniumo pot guajo.
pairs.english: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegco: Señot, jatungoja sija na manpresoyo yan mañaulag gui cada sinagoga ni ayo sija y jumonggue jao;
