pairs.english: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae machuda y jâgâ Esteban ni y testigomo, estabajayo na tumotojgue gui oriya, ya jucousienteja y mapunoña, ya juadaje y magagon ayo sija y pumuno güe.
pairs.english: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu guajo: Janao; sa guajo tumagojao chago desde este para y Gentiles.
pairs.english: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 22 70410 ¶ Ya majungog güe asta este na sinangan, ya entonses jajatsa y inagangñija, ya ilegñija: Najanao ayo na taotao gui jilo tano, sa ti combiene na ulâlâ.
pairs.english: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae managang, yan jayute y magagonñija, ya manmanyute oda gui aire,
pairs.english: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y magas inetnon jatago na umacone güe guato gui jalom castiyo, ya manago na umasaulag para umaegsamina, para utungo pot jafa causa na manaagang contra güiya.
pairs.english: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae magode güe ni y coreas, ilegña si Pablo ni y senturion ni y tumotojgue gui oriya: Tunas para jago na unsaulag un taotao na Romano sin umacondena?
pairs.english: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog ayo y senturion, mapos ya jasangane y magas inetnon ilegña: Adaje jafa y unquequechogüe, sa este na taotao Romano.
pairs.english: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y magas inetnon mato ya ilegña: Sanganeyo, jago Romano? Ya güiya ilegña: Junggan.
pairs.english: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magas inetnon manope ilegña: Pot y minegae salape na juchule este na linebre. Ya si Pablo ilegña: Lao guajo Romanoyo na finañago.
pairs.english: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manjanao guiya güiya ayo sija y para umegsamina güe: ya y magas inetnon ninamaañao locue, despues di jatungo na Romano, sa güiya munamagode.
pairs.english: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 22 30 70490 ¶ Ya y inagpaña, malago na utungo magajet cao jafa na mafaaela güe ni y Judios, ya masotta gui mapresuña, ya manago na ufanmato y magas mamale, yan y mangachongña, ya macone papa si Pablo ya mapolo gui menañija.
pairs.english: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA si Pablo jagueguesatan y inetnon, ya ilegña: Mañelo, lalâlâjayo contodo y minauleg y jinasoco asta este na jaane.
pairs.english: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magas na pale as Ananias, jatago ayo sija y manotojgue gui fionña na umapatmada pachotña.
pairs.english: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña si Pablo nu güiya: Si Yuus unpinatmada, apaca na padet: sa matachong jao para unjusgayo pot y lay; ya manago jao na jumapatmada contra y lay?
pairs.english: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo sija y manotojgue gui fionña, ilegñija: Yyon Yuus y magas na pale unlalalatde?
pairs.english: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayo nae ilegña si Pablo: Ti jutungo, mañelo cao güiya y magas na pale: sa esta matugue, Chamo sumasangan taelaye gui magalajen y tanomo.
pairs.english: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 6 70550 ¶ Lao anae jatungo si Pablo na y un patte Saduseo, ya y otro Fariseo, umagang juyong gui inetnon: Mañelo, Guajo Fariseo, lajin un Fariseo: gui ninangga yan y quinajulo guinen manmatae na mafafaesenyo.
pairs.english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, guaja inaguaguat gui entalo y Fariseo yan y Saduseo: ya manmadibide y inetnon taotao.
pairs.english: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y Saduseo ilegñija na taya quinajulo guinin manmatae, ni angjet, ni espiritu; lao y Fariseo jasasanganja todo.
pairs.english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayonae cajulo dangculon inagang: ya y palo escriba ni y manestaba gui Fariseo na patte, mangajulo ya managuaguat, ilegñija: Ti inseda tinaelaye güine na taotao: lao jafa, yaguin espiritu pat angjet sumangane güe?
pairs.english: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae guaja dangculon inaguaguat, ya y magas y inetnon maañao na nosea umapidaso si Pablo nu sija, manago ni y sendalo na ujafanjanao papa, ya ujacone si Pablo guiya sija fuetsao, ya umacone jalom gui castiyo.
pairs.english: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 11 70600 ¶ Ya anae puenge, y Señot tumojgue gui oriyaña, ya ilegña: Namauleg inangocomo Pablo: sa taemanoja y ninamatungomo nu guajo guiya Jerusalem, taegüijeja locue nae unnamatungo guiya Roma.
pairs.english: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 12 70610 ¶ Ya anae manana, palo gui Judios mandaña, ya manmanjula gui papa y matdision, ilegñija na ti ufañocho yan ti ufanguimen astaqui umapuno si Pablo.
pairs.english: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mas di cuarenta y fumatinas este na juramento.
pairs.english: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmalag y magas mamale, yan y manamco, ya ilegñija: Esta manmanjulajam gui papa y matdision, na ti infañocho ni jafa astaqui inpino si Pablo.
pairs.english: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago jamyo yan y dinaña, fanatungo yan y magas y inetnon ya infanmaconie agupa, ya inquetungo palo mas magajet pot güiya; ya jame infamaulegjam para, yaguin esta jijot, inpino.
pairs.english: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would inquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jajungog y lajin y chelun Pablo y ninangganñiñija, mapos ya jumalom gui castiyo, ya jasangane si Pablo.
pairs.english: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Pablo jaagang uno gui senturion ya ilegña: Cone este y patgon na taotao asta y magas y inetnon: sa guaja para usinangane.
pairs.english: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jamantiene, ya jacone guato gui magas y inetnon, ya ilegña: Si Pablo ni y maprereso jaagangyo, ya jatayuyutyo para jucone este y taotao guato guiya jago, sa guaja para unsinangane.
pairs.english: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y magas y inetnon, minantiene canaeña ya sumuja y dos gui un banda, ya finaesen, ilegña: Jafa ayo y para unsanganeyo?
pairs.english: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya güiya ilegña: Y Judios esta manatungo na unmagagao ya uncone agupa papa si Pablo gui inetnon, taegüije y malagoñija, na umaquetungo y magajet guiya güiya.
pairs.english: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would inquire somewhat of him more perfectly.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao chamo umangongoco jao nu sija: sa esta y manmannanangga pot güiya, mas di cuarenta na taotao ni y manmanjula na ti ufañocho, yan ti ufanguimen astaqui mapuno güe; ya pago umananggañiñija y promesamo.
pairs.english: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y magas y inetnon, janajanao y patgon na taotao, ya jaencatga, na chaña sumangangane ni jaye na taotao na ninatungo güe ni este na güinaja.
pairs.english: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jaagang dos na senturion, ya ilegña: Nalisto dosientos na sendalo para ufanjanao para Sesarea, yan setenta ni y manquinababayo, yan dosientos ni y manmanlalansa, para y mina tres na ora gui puenge;
pairs.english: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya unfamauleque sija gâgâ sija para ujanamaudae si Pablo, ya ujacone guato satbo gui as magalaje as Felix.
pairs.english: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manugue un catta, na taegüine mapoloña:
pairs.english: And he wrote a letter after this manner:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 26 70750 ¶ Claudio Lysias para y mas magas na magalaje as Felix, jusaluda jao.
pairs.english: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Este na taotao, macone ni y Judios ya para ujapuno: ya matoyo yan y sendalujo ya junalibre güe, sa jutungo na Romano güe.
pairs.english: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malagoyo na jutungo pot jafa na mafaaela güe, ya jucone guato gui inetnonñija:
pairs.english: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jusoda na mafaaela pot finaesen gui layñija; lao taya isaoña na jamerese na umapuno, pat umapreso.
pairs.english: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae masanganeyo jafa y Judios ninangganñiñija pot y taotao, enseguidas jutago para iya jago, ya fanago para ayo sija y fumaaela y ujasangan gui menamo jafa guaja guiya sija contra güiya. Adios.
pairs.english: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 23 31 70800 ¶ Ayonae y sendalo sija ni y tinagoña, macone si Pablo gui puenge ya macone guato Antipatris.
pairs.english: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña, mapolo y manquinababayo na ujafanjanao yan güiya, ya manalo guato gui castiyo.
pairs.english: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmato Sesarea, manae y magalaje ni y catta, ya mapoloja locue si Pablo gui menaña.
pairs.english: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan y magalaje jataetae y catta, jafaesen jafa na provinsia güe; ya jatungo na taotao Silisia.
pairs.english: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu güiya: Jujungog jao yaguin manmato locue ayo sija y fumaaela jao. Ya manago na umaadaje gui tribunal gui palasyo Herodes.
pairs.english: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae malofan sinco na jaane, si Ananias y mas magas na pale tumunog yan y manamco, yan un gacumuentos na naanña si Tertulo; mamacuentos gui magalaje contra si Pablo.
pairs.english: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae janamaagange si Tertulo, jatutujon famaaela, ilegña: Liija na pot jago na mansenmagofjam ni y dinangculon pas, yan mansenmauleg na chocho y manmachogüe güine na nasion pot y minaulegmo,
pairs.english: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya inresisibeja siempre gui todo y lugat sija contodo y minegae y grasia, O gosmauleg Felix.
pairs.english: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot ti junasaga jao laapmam, jutayuyut jao na unecungogjam pot y minauleg y didide na finomo.
pairs.english: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa inseda este na taotao na case, yan numanafanenbeste gui entalo y Judios todo y tano; yan y magas y secta y Nasareno sija;
pairs.english: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Güiya locue jumajanao, ya janafanataelaye y guimayuus: ya inquene güe sa manmalagojam na injisga jaftaemanoja y layta.
pairs.english: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y mas magas y inetnon as Lysias mato guiya jame, yan y dangculon linalaloña ya jacone gui canaemame;
pairs.english: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago y fumaaela na ufanmato guiya jago ya jagoja siña unegsamina ya untungo todo este sija na güinaja ni y infaaela güe.
pairs.english: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y Judios locue, jaconsienteja este na güinaja na utaegüine.
pairs.english: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 10 70940 ¶ Ayonae si Pablo, anae sineñas ni y magalaje na ucuentos; manope ilegña: Pot y jutungo na jago guinin jues megae na anos güine na nasion, juguesfanope pot guajoja;
pairs.english: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para untungo na taya trabia mas di dose años, desde qui cajuloyo Jerusalem para jufanadora.
pairs.english: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya nae masodayo gui templo juaguaguaguate ni jaye na taotao, ni junafangalamten y taotao sija; ni y sinagoga, ni mano na siuda;
pairs.english: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti siña ujaaprueba y güinaja ni y mafaaelajo pago.
pairs.english: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao este juconfesatñaejon guiya jago, na y jinanao ni y mafananaan un Secta, taegüenao nae jusesetbe si Yuus mañaenata; jujonggue todo y güinaja ni y manmatugue gui Lay yan y profeta sija.
pairs.english: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya guaja ninanggaco as Yuus, taegüije iya sija locue, na uguaja quinajulo guinin manmatae; parejoja y manmauleg yan y manaelaye.
pairs.english: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot este na juprocucura, na uguaja siempre gui jinasoco na chajo umofefende si Yuus, ni y taotao sija.
pairs.english: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago megae esta na años manmalofan matoyo para juchulie limosna y nasionjo, yan inefrese sija:
pairs.english: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Masodayo yan estesija, gasgas gui jalom y guimayuus, ya taya linajyan taotao, ni atboroto; lao guaja palo Judios ni y manguinin Asia:
pairs.english: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya sija, mannesesita ufangaegue güine gui menamo, ya ujasangan cao guaja jafa contra guajo.
pairs.english: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Patseno, sotta este y mangaegue güine ya ujasangan, yaguin manmañoda taelaye na finatinas guiya guajo, mientras tumotojgueyo gui menan y inetnon,
pairs.english: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot esteja y un inagang, anae estabayo gui entaloñija, ya umagangyo: Pot y quinajulo guinin y manmatae na jumafaesen pago na jaane pot jamyo.
pairs.english: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 22 71060 ¶ Lao si Felix, pot guaja mas magajet tiningoña ni ayo na jinanao, janafanmadetiene sija ya ilegña: Yaguin tumunog y mas magas y inetnon as Lysias, jutungo tododoja este y chechomiyo.
pairs.english: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jatago un senturion na uadaje si Pablo, yan unae linibre ya chaña chumochoma y manatungoña na ufanmato guiya güiya, pat umasetbe.
pairs.english: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 24 24 71080 ¶ Ya malofan unos cuantos na jaane, mato si Felix yan y asaguaña as Drusila na Judia, ya janamaagange si Pablo, ya majungog guiya güiya pot y jinenggue as Jesucristo.
pairs.english: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jaadingane pot y tininas, yan y minauleg, yan y jinisga ni ufato, ninamaañao si Felix, ya manope ilegña: Janao unjanao pago, ya yaguin guaja mauleg na lugat junamaagagange jao.
pairs.english: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jananangga locue na uninae as Pablo salape para usinetta; enaomina jatago na ufafato cada rato, ya ujaatungo.
pairs.english: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae malofan dos años, si Porcio Festo mato gui cuatton Felix: ya si Felix malago na ufanue y Judios minagof, japolo si Pablo na umapreso.
pairs.english: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYONAE jumalom si Festo gui provinsia, ya anae malofan tres na jaane cumajulo desde Sesarea asta Jerusalem.
pairs.english: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y magas mamale yan y magas y Judios manatungo güe contra si Pablo, ya matayuyut,
pairs.english: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magagagao finaborese contra si Pablo, na unajanao para Jerusalem; ya mananangga gui chalan para umapuno.
pairs.english: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao manope si Festo, na si Pablo umanasagaja Sesarea, ya güiyaja ujanao enseguidas.
pairs.english: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Ayo y mansiña guiya jamyo, ujadalalagyo papa, ya ujafaaela este na taotao, yaguin guaja taelaye guiya güiya.
pairs.english: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 25 6 71170 ¶ Ya anae sumaga güije mas di dies na jaane, mapos papa Sesarea; ya y inagpaña matachong gui tribunal, ya manago na umaconie as Pablo.
pairs.english: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mato, y Judios ni y manmato guinin Jerusalem, manojgue gui oriyaña, ya megae finaaelañija contra si Pablo, ya ti siña manamagajet nu sija.
pairs.english: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manope si Pablo pot güiyaja, ilegña: Ni contra y lay y Judios, ni contra y templo, ni contra si Sesat, ti juisagüe.
pairs.english: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao malago si Festo na unafanmagof y Judios; jaope si Pablo ilegña: Malago jao jumanao julo Jersalem, ya unmajusga pot este sija gui menajo?
pairs.english: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Pablo: Gaegueyo gui tribunal Sesat anae debe di jumajusga: para y Judios, taya taelaye na finatinaso; ungostungoja.
pairs.english: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa yaguin taelaye na finatinaso, pat guinin jufatinas jafa na jumerese y finatae, ti jureusayo na jumatae: lao yaguin taya jafa pot este y finaaelañija; taya ni un taotao uentregayo guiya sija. Jugagao jinisgajo gui as Sesat.
pairs.english: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan manguentos si Festo yan y taotao inetnon, jaope si Pablo ilegña: Gui as Sesat nae malagojao jinisgamo? Unfalag as Sesat.
pairs.english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 25 13 71240 ¶ Ya malofan palo jaane, mato si ray Agripa yan Bernise guiya Sesarea para umasaluda si Festo.
pairs.english: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mañaga güije megae na jaane, si Festo jadeclaraye si ray ni y causan Pablo, ilegña: Un taotao maprereso pot si Felix,
pairs.english: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae estabayo Jerusalem, y magas mamale yan y manamco gui Judios mafaesenyo, sa manmalago na umacondena.
pairs.english: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya juope sija, na ti costumbren y Romano na umaentrega un taotao na umapuno, antes di umanaafana yan y fumaaela, ya uguaja lisensiaña manope pot y mafaaelaña.
pairs.english: To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina anae mandaña guine, sinjufannangga, y inagpaña matachongyo gui tribunal, ya managoyo na jumaconie.
pairs.english: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manestabaja y fumaaela, lao taya finaaelañija jafa ni ayo y jinasosoco:
pairs.english: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao guaja finaesenñija contra güiya, pot y superstisionñija, pot y religionñija yan pot y un Jesus ni y matae, ya jaasegura si Pablo na lâlâ.
pairs.english: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ti juguestungo ayo sija na finaesen; jufaesen güe cao malago malag Jerusalem, ya ayo nae umajusga ni este sija.
pairs.english: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo, anae jagagao na umanasaga, para y jinisgan Augusto, managoyo na umanasaga asta qui junajanao para as Sesat.
pairs.english: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Agripa ilegña as Festo; Malagoyo locue na jujungog y taotao. Ya ilegña: Agupa na unjungog güe.
pairs.english: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 25 23 71340 ¶ Ya y inagpaña mato si Agripa yan Bernise, yan y minagasñija, ya jumalom gui tribunal, yan y mas magas y inetnon yan y mas manmagas gui siuda, ya manago si Festo na umacone si Pablo.
pairs.english: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña si Festo: Ray Agripa, yan todo y taotao ni y mangaegue güine na manjijita; inlie este na taotao ni y todo y linajyan Judios maqueja yan guajo guiya Jerusalem yan güine, elegñija na ti umanalâlâ mas.
pairs.english: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao anae jusoda na taya finatinasñajafa na umerese y finatae, ya anae güiyaja locue malago jinisgaña gui as Augusto, jujaso na junajanao.
pairs.english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya taya jafa magajet na güinajaña para jutugue para y Señotjo. Enaomina jucone güe mona gui menanmiyo, yan y menamo, O Ray Agripa, para yaguin munjayan maegsamina, uguaja jafa para jutugue.
pairs.english: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord. Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y jinasoco na taya rason na umanajanao y presonero, ya ti umanaclaro y isao ni y mapolo contra güiya.
pairs.english: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: AYONAE si Agripa ilegña as Pablo: Jupetmite jao na uncuentos pot jago namaesa. Ayonae si Pablo jaestira mona y canaeña ya manope pot güiya namaesa.
pairs.english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself. Then Paul stretched forth the hand, and answered for himself:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Magofyo ray, Agripa, sa jufanope pot guajo gui menamo pago na jaane, pot todo y mafaaelajo ni y Judio sija.
pairs.english: I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Yan pot y jutungo na jago untungo todo y costumbre yan y finaesen gui entre y Judios; pot enaomina jutayuyut jao na con pasensiamo umaecungogyo.
pairs.english: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y jaanejo desde y pinatgonjo, ni y finenana gui entre y nasionjo yan guiya Jerusalem, todo y Judios tumungo.
pairs.english: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Matungojayo desde y tutujonña, yaguin manmalago masangan, na taemanoja y mas tunas na secta y religionta, jumajanaoyo taegüije y Fariseo.
pairs.english: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pago, tumotojgueyo ya majus gayo pot y ninanggan y promesa ni y jafatinas si Yuus gui mañaenata.
pairs.english: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y manmaprometa y dose tribus, masestbeja si Yuus jaane yan puenge, mananangga na ufato. Ya pot ayo na ninangga ray Agripa, na mafaaelayo ni y Judio sija.
pairs.english: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Jaftaemano majusga y tijongguiyon entre jamyo, na si Yuus janacajulo y manmatae?
pairs.english: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Guajo magajet na jujaso gui jinalomjo, na nesesitayo jufatinas megae contra y naan Jesus Nasareno.
pairs.english: I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jufatinas este locue guiya Jerusalem; ya megae na mañantos jupreso, anae manresibeyo ninasiña guinin y magas mamale; ya anae para ufanmapuno, junae vosso contra sija.
pairs.english: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jucastiga sija gui sinagoga, ya juprocura na junafanman chatfino contra si Yuus; ya pot gogoslalaloyo contra sija, jupetsigue sija achogja asta otro siuda sija.
pairs.english: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae jumajanaoyo para Damasco yan y ninasiña guinin y magas mamale sija,
pairs.english: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Y taloane, O ray, julie gui chalan y candet guinin y langet, na malagña qui y ininan y atdao, ya manina gui oriyajo yan ayo y mangachochongjo manjanao.
pairs.english: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mamodongjam todo gui jilo oda, jujungog y inagang na jacuentuseyo gui fino Hebreo, ilegña: Saulo, Saulo, jafa na unpetsisigueyo? mapot para jago y unfamateg contra y títuca.
pairs.english: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegco: Jaye jao Señot? ya ilegña: Guajo si Jesus ni y unpetsisigue.
pairs.english: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao, cajulo ya untojgue; sa jufatoigüe jao pot este na jinaso, para junaministro jao yan untestigo ni este sija na güinaja y liniimo, yan ayo sija y pot y jufatoigüe jao;
pairs.english: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Junalibre jao gui pueblo yan y Gentiles, ya pago junajanao jao para iya sija,
pairs.english: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Para unbaba y atadogñija, yan unbira sija gui jemjom para y manana, yan y ninasiñan Satanas para as Yuus, ya ujaresibe y inasiin y isaoñija, yan erensia gui entalo ayo sija y manafangasgas pot y jinenggue ni y gaegue guiya guajo.
pairs.english: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya pot ayo, ti chatmatagoyo, O ray Agripa, para y vision y langet:
pairs.english: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jusangane finenana ayo sija y mangaegue Damasco, yan iya Jerusalem, yan todo y tano Judea, yan y Gentiles, na ufanmañotsot ya ujabira sija para as Yuus, yan ufanmachocho y chechoñija ni y para mañotsot.
pairs.english: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa pot este sija na maconeyo ni y Judios gui guimayuus para jumapuno.
pairs.english: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao jatacayo y inayudan Yuus, ya jusisigueja asta pago na jaane, mannanaeyo testimonio parejoja y diquique yan y dangculo; taya jusasangan na ayo y ufato ni y sinangan Moises yan y proteta sija;
pairs.english: Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Na si Cristo, nesesitagüe ufamadese, ya güiya ufinenana, pot ucajulo guinin y manmatae, ufannae candet gui pueblo yan y Gentiles.
pairs.english: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 26 24 71620 ¶ Ya anae cumuecuentos, umagang si Festo ni y dangculo na inagangña, ilegña: Caduco jao Pablo: megae na tiningo ninacaduco jao.
pairs.english: And as he thus spake for himself, Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao si Pablo ilegña: Ti caducoyo Festo; lao jusasangan y sinangan ni y magajet yan y tinas.
pairs.english: But he said, I am not mad, most noble Festus; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa y ray jatungoja estesija, cumuentosyoja gui menaña locue libre; sa seguroyo na taya güine sija na güinaja umanaatog guiya güiya; sa estesija, ti manmafatinas gui rincon.
pairs.english: For the king knoweth of these things, before whom also I speak freely: for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him; for this thing was not done in a corner.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ray Agripa, unjonggue y profeta sija? jutungo na unjonggue.
pairs.english: King Agrippa, believest thou the prophets? I know that thou believest.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae si Agripa ilegña as Pablo, Canaja unnamamañañayo para juquilisyano.
pairs.english: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo ilegña. Malagoyo as Yuus, na ti jagoja, lao todo ayo sija y jumungogyo pago na jaane, ufantaegüine iya guajo, fuera di y mapresujo.
pairs.english: And Paul said, I would to God, that not only thou, but also all that hear me this day, were both almost, and altogether such as I am, except these bonds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 26 30 71680 ¶ Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, cumajulo y ray yan y magalaje, yan Bernise, yan ayo sija y mangachongñiñija manmatachong.
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, the king rose up, and the governor, and Bernice, and they that sat with them:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae mañuja, manguentos uno yan y otro, ilegñija: Taya finatinasña este na taotao, na jamerese y finatae, pat umapreso.
pairs.english: And when they were gone aside, they talked between themselves, saying, This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae ilegña si Agripa as Festo: Este na taotao, umanalibre, yaguin ti jagagao jinisgaña gui as Sesat.
pairs.english: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae esta majasuye na para infanmaudae gui batco para Italia, maentrega si Pablo, yan otro manpreso gui uno na y naanña si Julio, senturion gui sendalon Augusto.
pairs.english: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjalomjam gui batcon Adrumeto, comoque janao para y costan Asia, manjanaojam; ya manjajame yan un Aristarcho, taotao Masedonio na sagaña Tesalónica.
pairs.english: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y inagpaña na jaane, manmatojam Sidon: ya si Julio jagosgüaeya si Pablo, ya janae linibre na ujanao para y manamiguña para unamagof güe.
pairs.english: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mamaudaejam gui batco manlayagjam papa jijot Chipre, desde ayo, sa y manglo contra.
pairs.english: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjanaojam gui tasen jijot Silisia yan Pamfilia, manmatojam Mira, gui siudad Lisia.
pairs.english: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasoda güije y senturion un batcon Alejandria, na jumajanao para Italia; ya janafanjalomjam.
pairs.english: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manmaudaejam gui batco megae na jaane, sa mumayayama senñateng, yan canaja ti manmatojam guato Gnido, ti japolojam y manglo, ya manmayama jijot papa Creta, guiya Salmon;
pairs.english: And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya gosmapot manmalofanjam umoriya inanaco güije na tase, manmatojam gui un lugat na mafanaan Bonito-Puerto, na jijot gui siuda Lasea.
pairs.english: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 9 71790 ¶ Ya anae megae na tiempo malofan, ya senpiligro y jinanaomame, sa y Ayunat esta malofan, ya si Pablo mansinangane sija,
pairs.english: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña nu sija: Señores, julie na este na jinanao, guaja uninalamen yan megae uninafanaelaye, ya ti y catgaja yan y batco, lao asta y jaanita locue.
pairs.english: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y senturion, jajonggueñaja y magas batco yan y gaeiyo y batco, qui ayo sija y sinangan Pablo.
pairs.english: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship, more than those things which were spoken by Paul.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa taya puerto nae siña para ufañaga y tiempon manenggeng, ya mas megae majaso na ufanmalofan güije gui tase locue, para ujaquelie jaftaemano nae siña manmato Fenix, ya ayo nae ufañaga güije y tiempon manenggeng, gui puerton Creta, ni y jadalalalaque y sanjaya gui sanlichan yan y sanlago gui sanlichan.
pairs.english: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manguaefe didide y manglo sanjaya, pinelonñija na ujataca y malagoñija, jadingo ayo ya manjanao guato oriyan Creta.
pairs.english: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao despues ti apmam na tiempo cajulo un dangculon manglo contra y batco, na mafanaan Euroclydon;
pairs.english: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya tinemba y batco ya tisiña injanao contra y manglo, inpelo na umachule ni y manglo.
pairs.english: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya malago asta y papa un isla na mafanaan Clauda, ya megae y chechomame pot y bote.
pairs.english: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda, we had much work to come by the boat:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ni y anae manmajatsa julo, ya manmaayuda, magode y batco gui sampapa; ya manmaañao na umayute gui Sirte, manatunog y layag ya ayonae manmachule ni y manglo.
pairs.english: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya janafangoschatsagajam y pinagyo, ya y inagpaña na jaane, jayute gui tase y catga, manachadeg y batco,
pairs.english: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y mina tres na jaane, inyite juyong ni y canaemameja y güinajan y batco.
pairs.english: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya megae na jaane na ti anog y atdao, ni y pution sija, ya ti didide na pagyo mato guiya jame, ya todo y ninangganmamame na infansatbo, malingo.
pairs.english: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao despues di apmam na timañocho, tumojgue si Pablo gui entaloñija ya ilegña: Señores, yaguin inecungogyo, ti tadingo Creta para tagana este na ninalamen yan minalingo.
pairs.english: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao pago juencatga jamyo na namauleg y inangoconmiyo; sa taya ni un taotao gui entre jamyo ufalingo y linâlâña, na y batcoja.
pairs.english: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life among you, but of the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Sa tumotojgue gui oriyajo pago na puenge y angjet Yuus, ni y jayeyo, yan jaye y jusetbe.
pairs.english: For there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ilegña: Chamo maaañao Pablo; sa nesesita unmacone guato gui menan Sesat; ya estagüeja na ninae jao as Yuus ni ayo sija y mangachochongmo gui batco.
pairs.english: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina señores, namauleg y inangoconmiyo; sa jujonggue na si Yuus, utaegüijeja y esta jasanganeyo.
pairs.english: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao nesesita tayutejit gui jilo un isla.
pairs.english: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: N 27 27 71970 ¶ Ya anae mato y mina catorse na puenge, taegüigüijeja jachuchulejajam papa yan julo tasen Adratico, ya y buente tatalopuenge, jinasonñija y marinero sija na esta manjijot gui un tano.
pairs.english: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya masondalea, ya masoda biente brasa; ya anae manjanao didide mona, masondalea talo, ya masoda quinse brasa.
pairs.english: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae manmaañaojam, na nosea infanbasnag gui jilo y acho, ya mayute cuatro na angcla juyong gui popa, ya madesesea na umanana.
pairs.english: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four anchors out of the stern, and wished for the day.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y marinero cumequefanmalago gui batco anae esta manatunog y bote gui tase, ya jinasonñija na siña ujayute y angcla gui proa.
pairs.english: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya si Pablo ilegña ni y senturion yan y sendalo sija: Yaguin ti mañaga estesija gui batco, ti siña jamyo mansatbo.
pairs.english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, Except these abide in the ship, ye cannot be saved.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ayonae y sendalo sija, jautot y tale todo gui bote, ya jasotta na upodong.
pairs.english: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, si Pablo jagagao sija todos na ujafañocho, ilegña: Este y mina catorse na jaane ni y tanananggaja, sisiguejajit di manayunat, ti mañochojit ni jafa.
pairs.english: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Enaomina jutatayuyut jamyo na infañocho, sa este para linâlâmiyo: sa ni uno gui gapon ulonmiyo ufalingo guiya jamyo.
pairs.english: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae munjayan jasangan este, jachule y pan ya janae grasia si Yuus gui menañija todos: ya anae jaipe, jatutujon cumano.
pairs.english: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya ayo todo sija y manmauleg minagofñija, mañocho locue.
pairs.english: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jame todos ni y manestaba gui batco, dosientos setenta y saes na taotao sija.
pairs.english: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manjaspog, manañajlalang y batco, ya mayute y trigo gui jalom tase.
pairs.english: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manana, ti matungo y tano: lao masoda un diquique na sadog na guaja oriyaña; ya jinasoñija na ujanajalom y batco.
pairs.english: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae manmajatsa y angcla ya masotta gui tase, ya manmapula y tale y timon, ya jajatsa y layag para y manglo, ya jatutujon manjanao para y oriyan tase.
pairs.english: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya podong gui jalom un lugat anae umasoda y dos tase, ya malago y batco gui jilo tano; ya y sanmena na patte cheton, ya sumagaja ti siña calamten, lao y santate na patte mayamag ni y finijom y napo sija.
pairs.english: And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya manatungo y sendalo sija, na ujapuno todo y preso sija, na nosea uguaja guiya sija tumungo numango ya uescapa.
pairs.english: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Lao y senturion malago na unasatbo si Pablo, ya jaadaje sija gui jinasoñija; ya manago na y siña numango uyute sija finena gui tase, ya ujafanjanao para y tano.
pairs.english: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y manetejnan, palo gui jilo tabbla, yan palo gui pidason mayamag batco, ya taegüenao nae manmalofan, ya todo sija mansatbo ya manescapa seguro para y tano.
pairs.english: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: YA anae manescapa esta, ayonae matungo na y isla naanña Melita.
pairs.english: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya y taotao ti mangilisyano, jafamaulegjam: sa manmanotne guafe ya jaresibejam cada uno, sa pot y ichan, yan y manenggeng.
pairs.english: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae janafandaña si Pablo y palitun jayo, ya jamanojo ya japolo gui jilo y guate, jumuyong un vibora guinin y maipe, ya cheton gui canaeña.
pairs.english: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya anae malie ni y taotao ti mangilisyano y beneno na gâgâ na umacalaye gui canaeña, manasangane ilegñija: Este na taotao pegno, masqueseaja umescapa gui tase; lao ti upinelo ni y inenog na ulâlâ.
pairs.english: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya jasacude y gâgâ guato gui jalom guafe, ya ti ninalamen.
pairs.english: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

pairs.attribution: bible-uedin contributors and OPUS; J. Tiedemann (2012), Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS. See packaged notices.
pairs.chamorro: Ya mataaatanja cao uninapogpog, pat upodong enseguidas ya umatae; lao anae esta laapmam na maatan, ya malie na ti ninalamen, jatulaeca y jinasoñija, ya ilegñija na yuus güe.
pairs.english: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.
